name: Aamir Bashir
title: Aamir Bashir
extract: Aamir Bashir is an Indian actor, film producer, and director who works in Hindi films. He is best known for his role in the thriller film, A Wednesday, which earned him a Screen Award nomination for Best Actor in a Supporting Role. For his directorial debut film Harud, he won the National Film Award for Best Urdu Feature Film at the 60th National Film Awards. He is also known for his work in several other film productions.
extract_id: Aamir Bashir adalah aktor India, produser film, dan sutradara yang bekerja di film-film Hindi. Dia dikenal terbaik untuk perannya dalam film thriller, A Wednesday, yang memberinya nominasi Screen Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik. Untuk debut sutradaranya dalam film Harud, ia memenangkan National Film Award untuk Film Fitur Urdu Terbaik di National Film Awards ke-60. Dia juga dikenal atas karyanya dalam beberapa produksi film lainnya.

name: Aamir Khan
title: Aamir Khan
extract: Aamir Hussain Khan is an Indian actor, filmmaker, and television personality who works in Hindi films. Referred to as "Mr. Perfectionist" in the media, through his career spanning over 30 years, Khan has established himself as one of the most notable actors of Indian cinema. Khan is the recipient of numerous awards, including nine Filmfare Awards, four National Film Awards, and an AACTA Award. He was honoured by the Government of India with the Padma Shri in 2003 and the Padma Bhushan in 2010, and received an honorary title from the Government of China in 2017.
extract_id: Aamir Hussain Khan adalah aktor India, pembuat film, dan tokoh televisi yang bekerja di film-film Hindi. Disebut sebagai "Mr. Perfectionist" di media, dalam karirnya yang berlangsung lebih dari 30 tahun, Khan telah menetapkan dirinya sebagai salah satu aktor paling terkenal dalam sinema India. Khan menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk sembilan Filmfare Awards, empat National Film Awards, dan satu AACTA Award. Ia dihormati oleh Pemerintah India dengan Padma Shri pada tahun 2003 dan Padma Bhushan pada tahun 2010, serta menerima gelar kehormatan dari Pemerintah Tiongkok pada tahun 2017.

name: Aaron Eckhart
title: Aaron Eckhart
extract: Aaron Edward Eckhart is an American actor.
extract_id: Aaron Edward Eckhart adalah aktor Amerika.

name: Aaron Sorkin
title: Aaron Sorkin
extract: Aaron Benjamin Sorkin is an American screenwriter, playwright, and filmmaker. As a writer for stage, television, and film, he is recognized for his fast-paced dialogue and extended monologues, complemented by frequent use of the storytelling technique called the "walk and talk". Sorkin has earned numerous accolades including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, five Primetime Emmy Awards, three Golden Globes, and two WGA Awards, in addition to a Laurence Olivier Award nomination.
extract_id: Aaron Benjamin Sorkin adalah penulis skenario Amerika, penulis drama, dan pembuat film. Sebagai penulis untuk panggung, televisi, dan film, ia dikenal karena dialognya yang cepat dan monolog panjang, dipadukan dengan penggunaan teknik bercerita yang sering disebut "walk and talk". Sorkin telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, lima Primetime Emmy Awards, tiga Golden Globes, dan dua WGA Awards, selain nominasi Laurence Olivier Award.

name: Aaron Taylor-Johnson
title: Aaron Taylor-Johnson
extract: Aaron Perry Taylor-Johnson is an English actor. His accolades include a Golden Globe Award and an Empire Award in addition to nominations for two British Academy Film Awards and a British Independent Film Award.
extract_id: Aaron Perry Taylor-Johnson adalah aktor Inggris. Penghargaan yang ia peroleh meliputi Golden Globe Award dan Empire Award selain nominasi untuk dua British Academy Film Awards dan British Independent Film Award.

name: Abdellatif Kechiche
title: Abdellatif Kechiche
extract: Abdellatif Kechiche, also known as Abdel Kechiche, is a Tunisian-French filmmaker and former actor. Known for his naturalistic style, his films usually explore the Arabic immigrant communities in contemporary France.
extract_id: Abdellatif Kechiche, juga dikenal sebagai Abdel Kechiche, adalah pembuat film Tunisia-Prancis dan mantan aktor. Dikenal dengan gaya naturalistiknya, film-filmnya biasanya mengeksplorasi komunitas imigran Arab di Prancis kontemporer.

name: Abhay Deol
title: Abhay Deol
extract: Abhay Deol is an Indian actor who predominantly works in Hindi films. Born in the Deol family, he made his screen debut with Imtiaz Ali's romantic comedy Socha Na Tha (2005). Deol was praised for his performances in the independent films Manorama Six Feet Under (2007) and Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye! (2008). His breakthrough came in 2009 with a starring role in Anurag Kashyap's black comedy Dev.D, a modern-day adaptation of Devdas.
extract_id: Abhay Deol adalah aktor India yang sebagian besar bekerja di film-film Hindi. Lahir dalam keluarga Deol, ia memulai debut layar dengan komedi romantis karya Imtiaz Ali Socha Na Tha (2005). Deol dipuji atas penampilannya dalam film independen Manorama Six Feet Under (2007) dan Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye! (2008). Terobosan kariernya terjadi pada 2009 dengan peran utama dalam komedi hitam Dev.D karya Anurag Kashyap, sebuah adaptasi modern dari Devdas.

name: Abhishek Chaubey
title: Abhishek Chaubey
description: Indian film director, writer and screenwriter
extract: Abhishek Chaubey is an Indian director, screenwriter and film producer known for his works in Hindi cinema.
extract_id: Abhishek Chaubey adalah sutradara, penulis skenario, dan produser film India yang dikenal atas karyanya di sinema Hindi.

name: Abhishek Kapoor
title: Abhishek Kapoor
extract: Abhishek Kapoor is an Indian film director, former actor, writer and producer who works in Hindi cinema. He is known for his work in the musical drama Rock On!! (2008), the buddy sports drama Kai Po Che! (2013), the musical romantic drama Fitoor (2016), the romantic disaster film Kedarnath (2018) and the social romantic drama Chandigarh Kare Aashiqui (2021), earning nominations for the Filmfare Award for Best Director for Rock On!! and Kai Po Che!.
extract_id: Abhishek Kapoor adalah sutradara film India, mantan aktor, penulis, dan produser yang bekerja di sinema Hindi. Ia dikenal atas karyanya dalam drama musikal Rock On!! (2008), drama olahraga persahabatan Kai Po Che! (2013), drama romantis musikal Fitoor (2016), film bencana romantis Kedarnath (2018), dan drama romantis sosial Chandigarh Kare Aashiqui (2021), meraih nominasi Filmfare Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik untuk Rock On!! dan Kai Po Che!.

name: Abigail Breslin
title: Abigail Breslin
extract: Abigail Breslin is an American actress. Following a string of film parts as a young child, she rose to prominence at age 10 after playing Olive Hoover in Little Miss Sunshine (2006), for which Breslin received a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress. She went on to establish herself as a mainstream actress with roles in films such as No Reservations (2007), Nim's Island (2008), Definitely, Maybe (2008), My Sister's Keeper, Zombieland, Rango (2011), The Call, August: Osage County, Ender's Game, Maggie (2015), Zombieland: Double Tap (2019) and Stillwater (2021). Breslin's other projects include the Fox series Scream Queens (2015–2016), where she portrayed Libby Putney, her first regular role on television.
extract_id: Abigail Breslin adalah aktris Amerika. Setelah beberapa peran film sebagai anak-anak, ia naik daun pada usia 10 tahun setelah memerankan Olive Hoover dalam Little Miss Sunshine (2006), yang memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik. Dia kemudian meneguhkan dirinya sebagai aktris arus utama dengan peran dalam film seperti No Reservations (2007), Nim's Island (2008), Definitely, Maybe (2008), My Sister's Keeper, Zombieland, Rango (2011), The Call, August: Osage County, Ender's Game, Maggie (2015), Zombieland: Double Tap (2019), dan Stillwater (2021). Proyek lainnya termasuk serial Fox Scream Queens (2015–2016), dimana dia memerankan Libby Putney, peran reguler pertamanya di televisi.

name: Abraham Attah
title: Abraham Attah
extract: Abraham Nii Attah is a Ghanaian actor, living in the United States.
extract_id: Abraham Nii Attah adalah aktor Ghana yang tinggal di Amerika Serikat.

name: Adam Baldwin
title: Adam Baldwin
extract: Adam Baldwin is an American actor. He made his film debut in My Bodyguard (1980) and later appeared in films including Full Metal Jacket (1987), Predator 2 (1990), Independence Day (1996), The Patriot (2000), and Serenity (2005). On television, he is known for playing Jayne Cobb in Firefly, John Casey in Chuck, and Mike Slattery in The Last Ship. He has also worked as a voice actor, including as Superman in Superman: Doomsday (2007) and Dutch in Halo 3: ODST (2009).
extract_id: Adam Baldwin adalah aktor Amerika. Ia memulai debut filmnya dalam My Bodyguard (1980) dan kemudian muncul dalam film termasuk Full Metal Jacket (1987), Predator 2 (1990), Independence Day (1996), The Patriot (2000), dan Serenity (2005). Di televisi, ia dikenal karena memerankan Jayne Cobb dalam Firefly, John Casey dalam Chuck, dan Mike Slattery dalam The Last Ship. Ia juga pernah bekerja sebagai aktor pengisi suara, termasuk sebagai Superman dalam Superman: Doomsday (2007) dan Dutch dalam Halo 3: ODST (2009).

name: Adam Driver
title: Adam Driver
extract: Adam Douglas Driver is an American actor. His breakout performance as Adam Sackler in the HBO television series Girls (2012–2017) earned him three consecutive Primetime Emmy nominations. Driver played supporting roles in Lincoln (2012), Frances Ha (2012), Inside Llewyn Davis (2013), and While We're Young (2014), before gaining more extensive recognition for his portrayal of Kylo Ren in the Star Wars sequel trilogy (2015–2019).
extract_id: Adam Douglas Driver adalah aktor Amerika. Penampilannya yang mengejutkan sebagai Adam Sackler dalam serial televisi HBO Girls (2012–2017) memberinya tiga nominasi Primetime Emmy berturut-turut. Driver memainkan peran pendukung dalam Lincoln (2012), Frances Ha (2012), Inside Llewyn Davis (2013), dan While We're Young (2014), sebelum mendapatkan pengakuan lebih luas atas perannya sebagai Kylo Ren dalam trilogi sekuel Star Wars (2015–2019).

name: Adam Elliot
title: Adam Elliot
description: Australian stop-motion animation writer, director, and producer
extract: Adam Benjamin Elliot is an Australian animator and filmmaker based in Melbourne. Established as an independent auteur of minimalistic narrative-driven films in animation, all of his films have generally use of tragicomedy genre with themes of bittersweet nature and psychological development to the characters; based loosely on his family and friends, each of his films is considered a Clayography – a portmanteau genre of clay animation and biography, coined by himself.
extract_id: Adam Benjamin Elliot adalah animator dan pembuat film Australia yang berbasis di Melbourne. Dikenal sebagai auteur independen dengan film-film naratif minimalis dalam animasi, semua filmnya biasanya menggunakan genre tragikomedi dengan tema yang bittersweet dan perkembangan psikologis karakter; berdasarkan secara longgar pada keluarga dan teman-temannya, setiap filmnya dianggap sebagai Clayography – gabungan genre animasi tanah liat dan biografi, istilah yang diciptakan oleh dirinya sendiri.

name: Adam McKay
title: Adam McKay
extract: Adam McKay is an American filmmaker. McKay began his career in the 1990s as a head writer for the NBC sketch comedy show Saturday Night Live (SNL). After leaving SNL, McKay collaborated with comedian Will Ferrell on his comedy films in the 2000s such as Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy (2004), Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby (2006), Step Brothers (2008), and The Other Guys (2010). Ferrell and McKay co-wrote and co-produced six television series and films, with McKay himself co-producing their website Funny or Die through their company, Gary Sanchez Productions.
extract_id: Adam McKay adalah pembuat film Amerika. McKay memulai kariernya pada 1990-an sebagai kepala penulis untuk acara komedi sketsa NBC Saturday Night Live (SNL). Setelah meninggalkan SNL, McKay berkolaborasi dengan komedian Will Ferrell dalam film komedi pada 2000-an seperti Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy (2004), Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby (2006), Step Brothers (2008), dan The Other Guys (2010). Ferrell dan McKay menulis dan memproduseri bersama enam serial televisi dan film, dengan McKay juga menjadi produser bersama situs web mereka Funny or Die melalui perusahaan mereka, Gary Sanchez Productions.

name: Adel Bencherif
title: Adel Bencherif
extract: Adel Bencherif is a French actor. He is best known for his role in the 2009 film A Prophet.
extract_id: Adel Bencherif adalah aktor Prancis. Ia dikenal terbaik untuk perannya dalam film A Prophet tahun 2009.

name: Adil Hussain
title: Adil Hussain
extract: Khandkar Mohammad Adil Hussain is an Indian actor who is known for his work in several Indian independent and mainstream film productions, as well as international cinema, in films such as The Reluctant Fundamentalist and Life of Pi . He received National Film Awards at the 64th National Film Awards for Hotel Salvation and Maj Rati Keteki.
extract_id: Khandkar Mohammad Adil Hussain adalah aktor India yang dikenal atas karyanya dalam beberapa produksi film independen dan utama India, serta sinema internasional, dalam film-film seperti The Reluctant Fundamentalist dan Life of Pi. Ia menerima National Film Awards pada National Film Awards ke-64 untuk Hotel Salvation dan Maj Rati Keteki.

name: Aditya Chopra
title: Aditya Chopra
extract: Aditya Chopra is an Indian film director, producer, and studio executive who works in Hindi Cinema. He is the Chairman of India's multi-national film, media, and entertainment conglomerate Yash Raj Films (YRF). The films he has produced make him the highest grossing Indian film producer of all time.
extract_id: Aditya Chopra adalah sutradara film India, produser, dan eksekutif studio yang bekerja di Sinema Hindi. Ia adalah Ketua dari konglomerat film, media, dan hiburan multinasional India, Yash Raj Films (YRF). Film-film yang diproduksinya menjadikannya produser film India dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa.

name: Aditya Dhar
title: Aditya Dhar
extract: Aditya Dhar is an Indian filmmaker who works in Hindi cinema. Having previously worked as a lyricist, Dhar made his directorial debut with the 2019 war film Uri: The Surgical Strike, a commercially successful venture which earned him the National Film Award for Best Direction. Dhar rose to prominence with the Dhurandhar duology, comprising Dhurandhar (2025) and Dhurandhar: The Revenge (2026). Both films rank among Indian cinema's top five highest earners ever at the box office.
extract_id: Aditya Dhar adalah pembuat film India yang bekerja di sinema Hindi. Sebelumnya bekerja sebagai penulis lagu, Dhar membuat debut penyutradaraannya dengan film perang Uri: The Surgical Strike (2019), sebuah usaha yang sukses secara komersial yang memberinya National Film Award untuk Penyutradaraan Terbaik. Dhar naik daun dengan duologi Dhurandhar, yang meliputi Dhurandhar (2025) dan Dhurandhar: The Revenge (2026). Kedua film tersebut termasuk dalam lima film dengan pendapatan tertinggi dalam sejarah sinema India di box office.

name: Adolphe Menjou
title: Adolphe Menjou
extract: Adolphe Jean Menjou [/'ædɒlf 'mɒnʒuː/] was an American actor whose career spanned both silent films and talkies. He became a leading man during the 1920s, known for his debonair and sophisticated screen presence. He was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Actor for his performance in The Front Page (1931).
extract_id: Adolphe Jean Menjou [/'ædɒlf 'mɒnʒuː/] adalah aktor Amerika yang kariernya mencakup film bisu dan film bersuara. Ia menjadi pemeran utama selama tahun 1920-an, dikenal karena kehadirannya di layar yang berkelas dan berpola. Ia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award Aktor Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam The Front Page (1931).

name: Adrian Molina
title: Adrian Molina
extract: Adrian Molina is an American animator, storyboard artist, screenwriter and director. He is best known for his works at Pixar, including co-writing and co-directing Coco (2017) and Elio (2025). For the latter, he received a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature and a win for the Satellite Award for Motion Picture, Animated or Mixed Media.
extract_id: Adrian Molina adalah animator, seniman storyboard, penulis skenario, dan sutradara Amerika. Ia dikenal terbaik atas karyanya di Pixar, termasuk menulis bersama dan menyutradarai bersama film Coco (2017) dan Elio (2025). Untuk yang terakhir, ia menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Film Animasi Terbaik dan memenangkan Satellite Award untuk Motion Picture, Animated or Mixed Media.

name: Adrien Brody
title: Adrien Brody
extract: Adrien Nicholas Brody is an American actor known for portraying intense, emotionally charged characters in both leading and supporting roles. In 2025, Time magazine listed him as one of the world's 100 most influential people.
extract_id: Adrien Nicholas Brody adalah aktor Amerika yang dikenal dengan peran karakter yang intens dan emosional baik dalam peran utama maupun pendukung. Pada 2025, majalah Time mencantumkannya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia.

name: Adèle Exarchopoulos
title: Adèle Exarchopoulos
extract: Adèle Exarchopoulos is a French actress. She had her career breakthrough starring as Adèle in the romance Blue Is the Warmest Colour ; at the 2013 Cannes Film Festival, she became the youngest person in the history of the festival to be awarded the Palme d'Or. She won it with her co-star Léa Seydoux.
extract_id: Adèle Exarchopoulos adalah aktris Prancis. Ia mencapai terobosan karier dengan memerankan Adèle dalam film romantis Blue Is the Warmest Colour; pada Festival Film Cannes 2013, ia menjadi orang termuda dalam sejarah festival yang dianugerahi Palme d'Or. Ia memenangkan penghargaan itu bersama rekan mainnya Léa Seydoux.

name: Adèle Haenel
title: Adèle Haenel
extract: Adèle Haenel is a French actress and political activist. She is the recipient of several accolades, including two César Awards from seven nominations and one Lumière Award from two nominations.
extract_id: Adèle Haenel adalah aktris dan aktivis politik Prancis. Ia menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk dua César Awards dari tujuh nominasi dan satu Lumière Award dari dua nominasi.

name: Agnes Moorehead
title: Agnes Moorehead
extract: Agnes Robertson Moorehead was an American actress. In a career spanning five decades, her credits included work in radio, stage, film, and television. Moorehead was the recipient of such accolades as a Primetime Emmy Award and two Golden Globe Awards, in addition to nominations for four Academy Awards.
extract_id: Agnes Robertson Moorehead adalah aktris Amerika. Dalam kariernya yang berlangsung lima dekade, kreditnya mencakup pekerjaan di radio, panggung, film, dan televisi. Moorehead menerima penghargaan seperti Primetime Emmy Award dan dua Golden Globe Awards, selain nominasi untuk empat Academy Awards.

name: Ahmet Mümtaz Taylan
title: Ahmet Mümtaz Taylan
extract: Ahmet Mümtaz Taylan is a Turkish film, television and theatre actor and director.
extract_id: Ahmet Mümtaz Taylan adalah aktor dan sutradara film, televisi, dan teater asal Turki.

name: Ahna Capri
title: Ahna Capri
extract: Anna Marie Nanasi, better known by her professional name Ahna Capri, was a Hungarian-American film and television actress best known for her role as Tania in the martial-arts film Enter the Dragon.
extract_id: Anna Marie Nanasi, lebih dikenal dengan nama profesionalnya Ahna Capri, adalah seorang aktris film dan televisi Hungaria-Amerika yang paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Tania dalam film seni bela diri Enter the Dragon.

name: Ahney Her
title: Ahney Her
extract: Whitney Cua Her, better known by her stage name Ahney Her, is an American actress. She is of Hmong descent.
extract_id: Whitney Cua Her, lebih dikenal dengan nama panggungnya Ahney Her, adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia berdarah Hmong.

name: Aidan Gillen
title: Aidan Gillen
extract: Aidan Murphy, known professionally as Aidan Gillen, is an Irish actor. He is the recipient of three Irish Film & Television Awards and has been nominated for a British Academy Television Award, a British Independent Film Award, a Tony Award, and a Drama Desk Award.
extract_id: Aidan Murphy, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Aidan Gillen, adalah seorang aktor Irlandia. Ia menerima tiga Irish Film & Television Awards dan telah dinominasikan untuk British Academy Television Award, British Independent Film Award, Tony Award, dan Drama Desk Award.

name: Aitana Sánchez-Gijón
title: Aitana Sánchez-Gijón
extract: Aitana Sánchez-Gijón de Angelis is a Spanish and Italian film screen and stage actress. After garnering attention for Going South Shopping (1989), she established her career in the 1990s, featuring in films such as The Bird of Happiness (1993), Mouth to Mouth (1995), The Chambermaid on the Titanic (1997), Jealousy (1999), and Volavérunt (1999).
extract_id: Aitana Sánchez-Gijón de Angelis adalah seorang aktris film dan panggung asal Spanyol dan Italia. Setelah mendapatkan perhatian lewat Going South Shopping (1989), dia mengukuhkan kariernya pada tahun 1990-an dengan tampil dalam film-film seperti The Bird of Happiness (1993), Mouth to Mouth (1995), The Chambermaid on the Titanic (1997), Jealousy (1999), dan Volavérunt (1999).

name: Ajay Devgn
title: Ajay Devgn
extract: Vishal Virender "Ajay" Devgan is an Indian actor, film director and producer who mainly works in Hindi films. He has appeared in over 100 films and has won numerous accolades, including four National Film Awards and four Filmfare Awards. In 2016, he was honoured by the Government of India with the Padma Shri, the country's fourth-highest civilian honour.
extract_id: Vishal Virender "Ajay" Devgan adalah aktor India, sutradara film, dan produser yang sebagian besar bekerja dalam film Hindi. Dia telah tampil dalam lebih dari 100 film dan telah memenangkan berbagai penghargaan, termasuk empat Penghargaan Film Nasional dan empat Penghargaan Filmfare. Pada tahun 2016, dia dihormati oleh Pemerintah India dengan Padma Shri, penghargaan sipil keempat tertinggi di negara tersebut.

name: Ajay Naidu
title: Ajay Naidu
extract: Ajay Kalahastri Naidu is an American actor and director best known for playing Samir in Office Space. He also made guest appearances in The West Wing and The Sopranos. Naidu was nominated for the Independent Spirit Award for Best Supporting Male for his performance in the film SubUrbia.
extract_id: Ajay Kalahastri Naidu adalah aktor dan sutradara Amerika yang paling dikenal karena memerankan Samir dalam Office Space. Ia juga tampil sebagai bintang tamu dalam The West Wing dan The Sopranos. Naidu dinominasikan untuk Independent Spirit Award sebagai Aktor Pendukung Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam film SubUrbia.

name: Aki Maeda
title: Aki Maeda
extract: Aki Maeda is a Japanese actress and singer. She has an older sister named Ai Maeda.
extract_id: Aki Maeda adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Jepang. Dia memiliki saudara perempuan yang lebih tua bernama Ai Maeda.

name: Akihiro Miwa
title: Akihiro Miwa
description: Japanese singer, actor, and drag queen (1935–2026)
extract: Akihiro Maruyama , better known by his stage name Akihiro Miwa , was a Japanese singer, actor, director, composer, author and drag queen. He appeared in the productions of Shūji Terayama, Tenjō Sajiki, Kinji Fukasaku, Yukio Mishima, and was a voice actor in two Hayao Miyazaki films.
extract_id: Akihiro Maruyama, lebih dikenal dengan nama panggungnya Akihiro Miwa, adalah seorang penyanyi, aktor, sutradara, komposer, penulis, dan drag queen Jepang. Ia tampil dalam produksi Shūji Terayama, Tenjō Sajiki, Kinji Fukasaku, Yukio Mishima, dan menjadi pengisi suara dalam dua film Hayao Miyazaki.

name: Akio Ôtsuka
title: Akio Otsuka
extract: Akio Otsuka is a Japanese actor, voice actor, and narrator from the Tokyo Metropolitan area. He is currently a freelancer and was previously affiliated with Mausu Promotion.
extract_id: Akio Otsuka adalah aktor, pengisi suara, dan narator asal Jepang dari wilayah Metropolitan Tokyo. Saat ini ia bekerja lepas dan sebelumnya berafiliasi dengan Mausu Promotion.

name: Akira Ishihama
title: Akira Ishihama
extract: Akira Ishihama was a Japanese actor.
extract_id: Akira Ishihama adalah seorang aktor Jepang.

name: Akira Kurosawa
title: Akira Kurosawa
extract: Akira Kurosawa was a Japanese filmmaker who directed 30 feature films in a career spanning six decades. With a bold and dynamic style strongly influenced by Western cinema yet distinct from it, he is widely regarded as one of the greatest and most influential filmmakers in the history of cinema. Known as a hands-on filmmaker, he was heavily involved with all aspects of production as a director, writer, producer, and editor.
extract_id: Akira Kurosawa adalah seorang pembuat film Jepang yang menyutradarai 30 film fitur dalam karir yang berlangsung selama enam dekade. Dengan gaya yang berani dan dinamis yang sangat dipengaruhi oleh sinema Barat namun berbeda darinya, dia secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film terbesar dan paling berpengaruh dalam sejarah sinema. Dikenal sebagai pembuat film yang langsung terlibat, ia sangat terlibat dalam semua aspek produksi sebagai sutradara, penulis, produser, dan editor.

name: Akshay Kumar
title: Akshay Kumar
extract: Akshay Hari Om Bhatia, known professionally as Akshay Kumar, is an Indian actor and film producer working in Hindi cinema. Referred to in the media as "Khiladi Kumar", he is the recipient of several accolades, including two National Film Awards and two Filmfare Awards. In 2009, the Government of India awarded him the Padma Shri, India's fourth-highest civilian honour. One of the most prolific actors in Indian cinema, Kumar has appeared in over 150 films in a career spanning over three decades. Forbes included Kumar in their lists of both highest-paid celebrities and highest-paid actors in the world from 2015 to 2020. Between 2019 and 2020, he was the only Indian on both lists.
extract_id: Akshay Hari Om Bhatia, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Akshay Kumar, adalah aktor dan produser film India yang berkarya di sinema Hindi. Dijuluki media sebagai "Khiladi Kumar", ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua National Film Awards dan dua Filmfare Awards. Pada 2009, Pemerintah India menganugerahi Padma Shri, penghargaan sipil tertinggi keempat di India. Sebagai salah satu aktor paling produktif di sinema India, Kumar telah tampil dalam lebih dari 150 film dalam karir yang berlangsung lebih dari tiga dekade. Forbes memasukkan Kumar dalam daftar selebritas dan aktor dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia dari 2015 hingga 2020. Antara 2019 dan 2020, ia menjadi satu-satunya orang India dalam kedua daftar tersebut.

name: Akshaye Khanna
title: Akshaye Khanna
extract: Akshaye Vinod Khanna is an Indian actor who predominantly works in Hindi films. Known for his versatility and strong portrayals. He is a recipient of numerous accolades including two Filmfare Awards.
extract_id: Akshaye Vinod Khanna adalah aktor India yang sebagian besar bekerja di film Hindi. Dikenal karena kemampuan beragam dan penampilan yang kuat. Ia menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk dua Filmfare Awards.

name: Al Ernest Garcia
title: Al Ernest Garcia
extract: Allan Ernest Garcia was an American actor and casting director, best known for his long association with Charlie Chaplin.
extract_id: Allan Ernest Garcia adalah aktor dan sutradara casting Amerika, paling dikenal karena asosiasi panjangnya dengan Charlie Chaplin.

name: Al Pacino
title: Al Pacino
extract: Alfredo James Pacino is an American actor. Known for his intense performances on stage and screen, Pacino is widely regarded as one of the greatest actors of all time. His career spans more than six decades, during which he has earned many accolades, achieving the Triple Crown of Acting by winning an Academy Award, two Tony Awards, and two Emmy Awards. He was honored with the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement in 1994, the Golden Globe Cecil B. DeMille Award in 2001, the AFI Life Achievement Award in 2007, the National Medal of Arts in 2011, the Kennedy Center Honor in 2016, the Sam Wanamaker Award in 2026 and the SAG-AFTRA Life Achievement Award in 2027. A method actor, Pacino studied at HB Studio and the Actors Studio where he was taught by Charlie Laughton and Lee Strasberg. Films in which he has appeared have grossed over $3 billion worldwide.
extract_id: Alfredo James Pacino adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal karena penampilan intensnya di panggung dan layar, Pacino secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar sepanjang masa. Karirnya berlangsung lebih dari enam dekade, selama itu ia meraih banyak penghargaan, termasuk Triple Crown of Acting dengan memenangkan Academy Award, dua Tony Awards, dan dua Emmy Awards. Ia dianugerahi Golden Lion untuk Lifetime Achievement pada 1994, Golden Globe Cecil B. DeMille Award pada 2001, AFI Life Achievement Award pada 2007, National Medal of Arts pada 2011, Kennedy Center Honor pada 2016, Sam Wanamaker Award pada 2026, dan SAG-AFTRA Life Achievement Award pada 2027. Sebagai aktor metode, Pacino belajar di HB Studio dan Actors Studio di mana ia diajar oleh Charlie Laughton dan Lee Strasberg. Film-film yang dibintanginya telah meraup pendapatan lebih dari $3 miliar di seluruh dunia.

name: Alain Delon
title: Alain Delon
extract: Alain Fabien Maurice Marcel Delon was a French actor, film producer, screenwriter, singer, and businessman. Acknowledged as a cultural and cinematic leading man of the 20th century, Delon emerged as one of the foremost European actors of the late 1950s to the late 1980s, and became an international sex symbol. He is regarded as one of the most well-known figures in French cinema. His style, looks, and roles, which made him an international icon, earned him enduring popularity.
extract_id: Alain Fabien Maurice Marcel Delon adalah aktor, produser film, penulis skenario, penyanyi, dan pengusaha Prancis. Diakui sebagai pria budaya dan sinema utama abad ke-20, Delon muncul sebagai salah satu aktor Eropa terkemuka dari akhir 1950-an hingga akhir 1980-an, dan menjadi simbol seks internasional. Ia dianggap sebagai salah satu tokoh paling terkenal dalam sinema Prancis. Gaya, penampilan, dan perannya, yang menjadikannya ikon internasional, memberinya popularitas yang bertahan lama.

name: Alain Resnais
title: Alain Resnais
extract: Alain Resnais was a French film director and screenwriter whose career extended over more than six decades. His films frequently explore the relationship between consciousness, memory, and the imagination, and he was noted for devising innovative formal structures for his narratives.
extract_id: Alain Resnais adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario Prancis yang karirnya berlangsung lebih dari enam dekade. Film-filmnya sering mengeksplorasi hubungan antara kesadaran, memori, dan imajinasi, dan ia dikenal karena menciptakan struktur formal inovatif untuk narasinya.

name: Alan Alda
title: Alan Alda
extract: Alphonso Joseph D'Abruzzo, known professionally as Alan Alda, is an American actor and filmmaker. In a career spanning seven decades on both stage and screen, he is best known for portraying Captain Benjamin Franklin "Hawkeye" Pierce in the CBS wartime sitcom M*A*S*H (1972–1983), where he also wrote and directed numerous episodes of the series. Alda has received numerous accolades, including six Primetime Emmy Awards and six Golden Globe Awards, as well as nominations for an Academy Award, a Grammy Award, three Tony Awards, and two BAFTAs.
extract_id: Alphonso Joseph D'Abruzzo, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Alan Alda, adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Dalam karir yang berlangsung tujuh dekade di panggung dan layar, ia paling dikenal karena memerankan Kapten Benjamin Franklin "Hawkeye" Pierce dalam sitkom perang M*A*S*H (1972–1983) di CBS, di mana ia juga menulis dan menyutradarai berbagai episode seri tersebut. Alda telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk enam Primetime Emmy Awards dan enam Golden Globe Awards, serta nominasi untuk Academy Award, Grammy Award, tiga Tony Awards, dan dua BAFTA.

name: Alan Arkin
title: Alan Arkin
extract: Alan Wolf Arkin was an American actor, filmmaker and musician. In a career spanning seven decades, he received numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a Tony Award as well as nominations for six Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Alan Wolf Arkin adalah aktor, pembuat film, dan musisi Amerika. Dalam karir yang berlangsung tujuh dekade, ia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Tony Award serta nominasi untuk enam Emmy Awards.

name: Alan Badel
title: Alan Badel
extract: Alan Fernand Badel was an English actor who appeared frequently on stage, in film, on radio and on television.
extract_id: Alan Fernand Badel adalah aktor Inggris yang sering tampil di panggung, film, radio, dan televisi.

name: Alan J. Pakula
title: Alan J. Pakula
description: American film director, writer and producer (1928–1998)
extract: Alan Jay Pakula was an American film director, screenwriter, and producer. Associated with the New Hollywood movement, his best-known works include his critically acclaimed "paranoia trilogy": the neo-noir mystery Klute (1971), the conspiracy thriller The Parallax View (1974), and the Watergate scandal drama All the President's Men (1976). His other notable films included Comes a Horseman (1978), Starting Over (1979), Sophie's Choice (1982), Presumed Innocent (1990), and The Pelican Brief (1993).
extract_id: Alan Jay Pakula adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser Amerika. Terkait dengan gerakan New Hollywood, karya terkenalnya meliputi "trilogi paranoia" yang dipuji secara kritis: misteri neo-noir Klute (1971), thriller konspirasi The Parallax View (1974), dan drama skandal Watergate All the President's Men (1976). Film terkenalnya yang lain termasuk Comes a Horseman (1978), Starting Over (1979), Sophie's Choice (1982), Presumed Innocent (1990), dan The Pelican Brief (1993).

name: Alan Mak
title: Alan Mak (director)
description: Hong Kong actor, writer and director (born 1965)
extract: Alan Mak Siu-fai, is a Hong Kong writer, director, actor and producer. He is best known for collaborating with director Andrew Lau and screenwriter Felix Chong on the Infernal Affairs film series (2002–2003).
extract_id: Alan Mak Siu-fai adalah penulis, sutradara, aktor, dan produser Hong Kong. Ia paling dikenal karena berkolaborasi dengan sutradara Andrew Lau dan penulis skenario Felix Chong dalam seri film Infernal Affairs (2002–2003).

name: Alan Parker
title: Alan Parker
extract: Sir Alan William Parker was an English filmmaker. His early career, beginning in his late teens, was spent as a copywriter and director of television advertisements. After about ten years of filming adverts, many of which won awards for creativity, he began screenwriting and directing films.
extract_id: Sir Alan William Parker adalah pembuat film Inggris. Karir awalnya, yang dimulai pada akhir masa remajanya, adalah sebagai penulis iklan dan sutradara iklan televisi. Setelah sekitar sepuluh tahun membuat iklan, banyak di antaranya memenangkan penghargaan atas kreativitasnya, ia mulai menulis skenario dan menyutradarai film.

name: Alan Rickman
title: Alan Rickman
extract: Alan Sidney Patrick Rickman was an English actor. He was renowned for his stage and screen roles and for his distinctive deep and languid voice. He received various accolades, including a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, and an Actor Award, in addition to nominations for two Tony Awards and a Laurence Olivier Award. In 2009, The Guardian named him one of the best actors never to have received an Academy Award nomination. Rickman died of pancreatic cancer on 14 January 2016, at the age of 69.
extract_id: Alan Sidney Patrick Rickman adalah aktor Inggris. Ia terkenal karena peran-perannya di panggung dan layar serta suara dalam dan lambatnya yang khas. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk BAFTA Award, Golden Globe Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dan Actor Award, selain nominasi untuk dua Tony Awards dan Laurence Olivier Award. Pada 2009, The Guardian menamakannya sebagai salah satu aktor terbaik yang tak pernah menerima nominasi Academy Award. Rickman meninggal karena kanker pankreas pada 14 Januari 2016, pada usia 69 tahun.

name: Alan Ruck
title: Alan Ruck
extract: Alan Douglas Ruck is an American actor. He is known for portraying Cameron Frye in John Hughes' film Ferris Bueller's Day Off (1986), as well as television roles as Stuart Bondek on the ABC sitcom Spin City (1996–2002) and Connor Roy on the HBO series Succession (2018–2023), the latter earning him Primetime Emmy and Golden Globe Award nominations. His other film credits include Class (1983), Bad Boys (1983), Three Fugitives (1989), Young Guns II (1990), Speed (1994), Star Trek Generations (1994), and Twister (1996).
extract_id: Alan Douglas Ruck adalah aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena memerankan Cameron Frye dalam film John Hughes, Ferris Bueller's Day Off (1986), serta peran televisi sebagai Stuart Bondek dalam sitkom ABC Spin City (1996–2002) dan Connor Roy dalam seri HBO Succession (2018–2023), yang terakhir memberinya nominasi Primetime Emmy dan Golden Globe Award. Kredit film lainnya termasuk Class (1983), Bad Boys (1983), Three Fugitives (1989), Young Guns II (1990), Speed (1994), Star Trek Generations (1994), dan Twister (1996).

name: Alan Tudyk
title: Alan Tudyk
extract: Alan Wray Tudyk is an American actor. His film work includes roles in 28 Days (2000), A Knight's Tale (2001), Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story (2004), 3:10 to Yuma (2007), and Trumbo (2015). He starred in the black comedy horror film Tucker & Dale vs. Evil (2010).
extract_id: Alan Wray Tudyk adalah aktor Amerika. Karya filmnya termasuk peran dalam 28 Days (2000), A Knight's Tale (2001), Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story (2004), 3:10 to Yuma (2007), dan Trumbo (2015). Dia membintangi film horor komedi hitam Tucker & Dale vs. Evil (2010).

name: Albert Brooks
title: Albert Brooks
description: American actor, comedian, director, and screenwriter (born 1947)
extract: Albert Lawrence Einstein, known professionally as Albert Brooks, is an American actor, comedian, director, and screenwriter. He received an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actor for his performance in the comedy-drama Broadcast News (1987) and was widely praised for his performance in the action drama Drive (2011). Brooks has acted in films such as Taxi Driver (1976), Private Benjamin (1980), Unfaithfully Yours (1984), Out of Sight (1998), My First Mister (2001), and Concussion (2015). He has written, directed, and starred in a number of comedies, including Modern Romance (1981), Lost in America (1985), and Defending Your Life (1991). He is the author of 2030: The Real Story of What Happens to America (2011).
extract_id: Albert Lawrence Einstein, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Albert Brooks, adalah aktor, komedian, sutradara, dan penulis skenario Amerika. Dia menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam drama komedi Broadcast News (1987) dan dipuji secara luas atas penampilannya dalam drama aksi Drive (2011). Brooks telah berakting dalam film seperti Taxi Driver (1976), Private Benjamin (1980), Unfaithfully Yours (1984), Out of Sight (1998), My First Mister (2001), dan Concussion (2015). Dia telah menulis, menyutradarai, dan membintangi sejumlah komedi, termasuk Modern Romance (1981), Lost in America (1985), dan Defending Your Life (1991). Dia adalah penulis 2030: The Real Story of What Happens to America (2011).

name: Albert Finney
title: Albert Finney
extract: Albert Finney was an English actor. He attended the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art and worked in the theatre before attaining fame for film acting during the early 1960s, debuting with The Entertainer (1960), directed by Tony Richardson, who had previously directed him in theatre. He maintained a successful career on stage and screen.
extract_id: Albert Finney adalah aktor Inggris. Dia menghadiri Royal Academy of Dramatic Art dan bekerja di teater sebelum meraih ketenaran sebagai aktor film pada awal 1960-an, debut dengan The Entertainer (1960), yang disutradarai oleh Tony Richardson, yang sebelumnya menyutradarainya di teater. Dia mempertahankan karier yang sukses di panggung dan layar kaca.

name: Albert Rémy
title: Albert Rémy
extract: Albert Rémy was a French actor best known for his supporting roles in François Truffaut's first two feature films. He played Antoine Doinel's father in The 400 Blows and Charlie Kohler's brother in Shoot the Piano Player. He also appeared in Marcel Carné's Les Enfants du Paradis, John Frankenheimer's The Train and René Clément's Is Paris Burning?
extract_id: Albert Rémy adalah aktor Prancis yang terkenal karena peran pendukungnya dalam dua film fitur pertama François Truffaut. Dia memerankan ayah Antoine Doinel dalam The 400 Blows dan saudara Charlie Kohler dalam Shoot the Piano Player. Dia juga muncul dalam Les Enfants du Paradis karya Marcel Carné, The Train karya John Frankenheimer, dan Is Paris Burning? karya René Clément.

name: Alberto Ammann
title: Alberto Ammann
extract: José Alberto Ammann Rey is an Argentine and Spanish actor. He has played various roles in films, television and theater. His feature film debut in Cell 211 (2009) earned him a Goya Award for Best New Actor. Other film works include performances in Lope: The Outlaw (2010), Eva (2011), Invader (2012), Thesis on a Homicide (2013), Betibú (2014), The Year of Fury (2020), Presencias (2022), and Upon Entry (2022). He is also known for playing Colombian drug trafficker Pacho Herrera in crime television series Narcos and Narcos: Mexico.
extract_id: José Alberto Ammann Rey adalah aktor Argentina dan Spanyol. Dia telah memainkan berbagai peran dalam film, televisi, dan teater. Debut film fitur pertamanya dalam Cell 211 (2009) memberinya Penghargaan Goya untuk Aktor Baru Terbaik. Karya film lainnya termasuk penampilan dalam Lope: The Outlaw (2010), Eva (2011), Invader (2012), Thesis on a Homicide (2013), Betibú (2014), The Year of Fury (2020), Presencias (2022), dan Upon Entry (2022). Dia juga dikenal karena memerankan pengedar narkoba Kolombia Pacho Herrera dalam serial televisi kriminal Narcos dan Narcos: Mexico.

name: Aldo Giuffrè
title: Aldo Giuffrè
extract: Aldo Giuffrè was an Italian film actor and comedian who appeared in over 90 films between 1948 and 2001. He was the brother of actor Carlo Giuffrè.
extract_id: Aldo Giuffrè adalah aktor film dan komedian Italia yang tampil dalam lebih dari 90 film antara tahun 1948 dan 2001. Dia adalah saudara aktor Carlo Giuffrè.

name: Aldo Silvani
title: Aldo Silvani
extract: Aldo Silvani was an Italian stage, film and voice actor. He appeared in more than 110 films between 1934 and 1964.
extract_id: Aldo Silvani adalah aktor panggung, film, dan pengisi suara Italia. Dia muncul dalam lebih dari 110 film antara 1934 dan 1964.

name: Alec Baldwin
title: Alec Baldwin
extract: Alexander Rae Baldwin III is an American actor and film producer. He is known for his leading and supporting roles in a variety of genres, from comedy to drama. He has received numerous accolades, including three Primetime Emmy Awards, three Golden Globe Awards and eight Actor Awards as well as nominations for an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, and Tony Award.
extract_id: Alexander Rae Baldwin III adalah aktor dan produser film Amerika. Dia dikenal karena peran utama dan pendukungnya dalam berbagai genre, dari komedi hingga drama. Dia telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk tiga Primetime Emmy Awards, tiga Golden Globe Awards, dan delapan Actor Awards serta nominasi untuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan Tony Award.

name: Alec Guinness
title: Alec Guinness
extract: Sir Alec Guinness was an English actor. In the BFI listing of the 100 most important British films of the 20th century, he was the single most noted actor, represented across nine films—six in starring roles and three in supporting roles—including five directed by David Lean and four from Ealing Studios. His accolades include an Academy Award, a BAFTA, a Golden Globe, a Tony Award and a Volpi Cup. In 1959, he was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II for services to the arts. He received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 1960, the Academy Honorary Award for lifetime achievement in 1980 and the BAFTA Academy Fellowship Award in 1989.
extract_id: Sir Alec Guinness adalah aktor Inggris. Dalam daftar BFI dari 100 film Inggris paling penting abad ke-20, dia adalah aktor paling terkenal, diwakili dalam sembilan film—enam sebagai pemeran utama dan tiga sebagai pemeran pendukung—termasuk lima yang disutradarai oleh David Lean dan empat dari Ealing Studios. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA, Golden Globe, Tony Award, dan Volpi Cup. Pada tahun 1959, dia mendapat gelar kesatria dari Ratu Elizabeth II atas jasa-jasanya di bidang seni. Dia menerima bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada tahun 1960, Academy Honorary Award untuk pencapaian seumur hidup pada 1980, dan BAFTA Academy Fellowship Award pada 1989.

name: Alec Secareanu
title: Alec Secăreanu
extract: Alexandru "Alec" Secăreanu is a Romanian actor. He gained international recognition for playing Gheorghe in the 2017 film God's Own Country.
extract_id: Alexandru "Alec" Secăreanu adalah aktor Rumania. Dia mendapat pengakuan internasional karena memerankan Gheorghe dalam film God’s Own Country tahun 2017.

name: Alejandro Amenábar
title: Alejandro Amenábar
description: Spanish-Chilean film director, screenwriter and composer
extract: Alejandro Fernando Amenábar Cantos is a Chilean-Spanish film director, screenwriter and composer. He has won nine Goya Awards—including Best Director for his 2001 film The Others—and two European Film Awards among other honors; he also accepted an Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film on behalf of Spain for The Sea Inside. He has written the screenplays to all seven of his films and composed almost all of their soundtracks.
extract_id: Alejandro Fernando Amenábar Cantos adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan komposer Chili-Spanyol. Dia telah memenangkan sembilan Penghargaan Goya—termasuk Sutradara Terbaik untuk filmnya tahun 2001 The Others—dan dua Penghargaan Film Eropa selain penghargaan lain; dia juga menerima Academy Award untuk Film Berbahasa Asing Terbaik atas nama Spanyol untuk The Sea Inside. Dia menulis skenario untuk semua tujuh filmnya dan mengkomposisikan hampir semua soundtrack-nya.

name: Alejandro G. Iñárritu
title: Alejandro González Iñárritu
extract: Alejandro González Iñárritu is a Mexican filmmaker. He is primarily known for making modern psychological drama films about the human condition. His films are Amores perros (2000), 21 Grams (2003), Babel (2006), Biutiful (2010), Birdman (2014), The Revenant (2015), Bardo (2022), and Digger (2026). Iñárritu's projects have garnered critical acclaim and numerous accolades, including four Academy Awards, three BAFTA Awards, and four Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Alejandro González Iñárritu adalah pembuat film Meksiko. Dia terutama dikenal karena membuat film drama psikologis modern tentang kondisi manusia. Filmnya adalah Amores perros (2000), 21 Grams (2003), Babel (2006), Biutiful (2010), Birdman (2014), The Revenant (2015), Bardo (2022), dan Digger (2026). Proyek Iñárritu telah meraih pujian kritis dan berbagai penghargaan, termasuk empat Academy Awards, tiga BAFTA Awards, dan empat Golden Globe Awards.

name: Alejandro Jodorowsky
title: Alejandro Jodorowsky
extract: Alejandro Jodorowsky Prullansky is a Chilean and French avant-garde filmmaker and writer. Known for his films El Topo (1970), The Holy Mountain (1973) and Santa Sangre (1989), Jodorowsky has been "venerated by cult cinema enthusiasts" for his work which "is filled with violently surreal images and a hybrid blend of mysticism and religious provocation".
extract_id: Alejandro Jodorowsky Prullansky adalah pembuat film dan penulis avant-garde Chili dan Prancis. Dikenal lewat film-filmnya El Topo (1970), The Holy Mountain (1973), dan Santa Sangre (1989), Jodorowsky telah "dihormati oleh para penggemar sinema kultus" atas karyanya yang "dipenuhi dengan gambar-gambar surealis yang kekerasan dan perpaduan hibrida antara mistisisme dan provokasi agama".

name: Aleksandr Antonov
title: Aleksandr Antonov (actor)
extract: Aleksandr Pavlovich Antonov was a Soviet film actor who had a lengthy career, stretching from the silent era to the 1950s. Antonov was named Merited Artist of the Russian Federation in 1950.
extract_id: Aleksandr Pavlovich Antonov adalah aktor film Soviet yang memiliki karier panjang, dari era bisu hingga tahun 1950-an. Antonov dinobatkan sebagai Merited Artist of the Russian Federation pada tahun 1950.

name: Aleksandr Kaydanovskiy
title: Alexander Kaidanovsky
extract: Alexander Leonidovich Kaidanovsky was a Soviet and Russian actor and film director.
extract_id: Alexander Leonidovich Kaidanovsky adalah aktor dan sutradara film Soviet dan Rusia.

name: Aleksey Kravchenko
title: Aleksei Kravchenko (actor)
extract: Aleksei Yevgenyevich Kravchenko is a Russian actor known for his role in the 1985 film Come and See as a young boy in the resistance army.
extract_id: Aleksei Yevgenyevich Kravchenko adalah aktor Rusia yang dikenal karena perannya dalam film Come and See tahun 1985 sebagai seorang bocah laki-laki di tentara perlawanan.

name: Aleksey Rozin
title: Aleksey Rozin
extract: Aleksey Anatolievich Rozin is a Russian film and stage actor.
extract_id: Aleksey Anatolievich Rozin adalah aktor film dan panggung Rusia.

name: Aleksey Serebryakov
title: Aleksei Serebryakov (actor)
extract: Aleksei Valeryevich Serebryakov, is a Russian stage and film actor. He started acting at 15, and is one of the most popular and highly paid Russian actors. He has appeared in Leviathan and McMafia.
extract_id: Aleksei Valeryevich Serebryakov adalah aktor panggung dan film Rusia. Dia mulai berakting pada usia 15 tahun, dan merupakan salah satu aktor Rusia yang paling populer dan bergaji tinggi. Dia tampil dalam Leviathan dan McMafia.

name: Alex Garland
title: Alex Garland
extract: Alexander Medawar Garland is an English author and filmmaker. He rose to prominence with his novel The Beach (1996). He received praise for writing the Danny Boyle films 28 Days Later (2002) and its sequel, 28 Years Later (2025), and Sunshine (2007), as well as Never Let Me Go (2010) and Dredd (2012). In video games, he co-wrote Enslaved: Odyssey to the West (2010) and was a story supervisor on DmC: Devil May Cry (2013).
extract_id: Alexander Medawar Garland adalah penulis dan pembuat film Inggris. Dia naik daun dengan novelnya The Beach (1996). Dia menerima pujian atas penulisan film-film Danny Boyle yaitu 28 Days Later (2002) dan sekuelnya, 28 Years Later (2025), serta Sunshine (2007), Never Let Me Go (2010), dan Dredd (2012). Dalam video game, dia ikut menulis Enslaved: Odyssey to the West (2010) dan menjadi supervisor cerita dalam DmC: Devil May Cry (2013).

name: Alex Proyas
title: Alex Proyas
extract: Alexander Proyas is an Australian filmmaker. He is known for directing the films The Crow (1994), Dark City (1998), I, Robot (2004) and Knowing (2009).
extract_id: Alexander Proyas adalah pembuat film Australia. Dia dikenal karena menyutradarai film-film The Crow (1994), Dark City (1998), I, Robot (2004), dan Knowing (2009).

name: Alex Sharp
title: Alex Sharp
extract: Alexander Ian Sharp is an English actor. He is known for originating the role of Christopher Boone in the Broadway production of The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time. He is also known to a wider audience as Will Downing in 3 Body Problem.
extract_id: Alexander Ian Sharp adalah aktor Inggris. Dia dikenal karena memerankan karakter Christopher Boone dalam produksi Broadway The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time. Dia juga dikenal oleh audiens yang lebih luas sebagai Will Downing dalam 3 Body Problem.

name: Alexander Gould
title: Alexander Gould
extract: Alexander Jerome Gould is an American actor. He is known for voicing the title character of the Pixar animated film Finding Nemo and for his portrayal of Shane Botwin on the Showtime drama series Weeds, the latter of which earned him two Screen Actors Guild Award nominations.
extract_id: Alexander Jerome Gould adalah aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena mengisi suara karakter utama dalam film animasi Pixar Finding Nemo dan karena perannya sebagai Shane Botwin dalam seri drama Showtime Weeds, yang memberinya dua nominasi Screen Actors Guild Award.

name: Alexander Granach
title: Alexander Granach
extract: Alexander Granach was a German-Austrian actor in the 1920s and 1930s who emigrated to the United States in 1938.
extract_id: Alexander Granach adalah aktor Jerman-Austria pada tahun 1920-an dan 1930-an yang berimigrasi ke Amerika Serikat pada tahun 1938.

name: Alexander Mackendrick
title: Alexander Mackendrick
extract: Alexander Mackendrick was an American-born Scottish film director and screenwriter. He directed nine feature films between 1949 and 1967, before retiring from filmmaking to become an influential professor at the California Institute of the Arts.
extract_id: Alexander Mackendrick adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film berkebangsaan Amerika kelahiran Skotlandia. Dia menyutradarai sembilan film fitur antara tahun 1949 dan 1967, sebelum pensiun dari pembuatan film untuk menjadi profesor berpengaruh di California Institute of the Arts.

name: Alexander Payne
title: Alexander Payne
extract: Constantine Alexander Payne is an American filmmaker. He is noted for his satirical depictions of contemporary American society. Payne has received numerous accolades, including two Academy Awards, a BAFTA Award, and two Golden Globe Awards, as well as a nomination for a Grammy Award.
extract_id: Constantine Alexander Payne adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika. Dia dikenal karena penggambaran satirinya tentang masyarakat Amerika kontemporer. Payne telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards, sebuah BAFTA Award, dan dua Golden Globe Awards, serta nominasi untuk Grammy Award.

name: Alexandra Maria Lara
title: Alexandra Maria Lara
extract: Alexandra Maria Lara is a Romanian-German actress, best known internationally for her roles in the films Downfall (2004), Control (2007), Youth Without Youth (2007), The Reader (2008), Rush (2013), and Geostorm (2017). From 2022 to 2025, she served as co-president of the Deutsche Filmakademie.
extract_id: Alexandra Maria Lara adalah seorang aktris Rumania-Jerman, yang dikenal secara internasional untuk perannya dalam film Downfall (2004), Control (2007), Youth Without Youth (2007), The Reader (2008), Rush (2013), dan Geostorm (2017). Dari 2022 hingga 2025, dia menjabat sebagai ko-presiden Deutsche Filmakademie.

name: Alexandre Rignault
title: Alexandre Rignault
extract: Alexandre Rignault was a French actor. He appeared in more than a hundred films between 1931 and 1985.
extract_id: Alexandre Rignault adalah seorang aktor Prancis. Ia tampil dalam lebih dari seratus film antara tahun 1931 dan 1985.

name: Alexandre Rodrigues
title: Alexandre Rodrigues (actor)
extract: Alexandre Rodrigues is a Brazilian actor. He is best known for playing the part of Buscapé (Rocket), the narrator and protagonist in the 2002 Brazilian film City of God.
extract_id: Alexandre Rodrigues adalah seorang aktor Brasil. Ia dikenal luas karena memerankan Buscapé (Rocket), narator dan protagonis dalam film Brasil tahun 2002 City of God.

name: Alexandru Potocean
title: Alexandru Potocean
extract: Alexandru Potocean is a Romanian film actor. He has appeared in more than fifteen films since 2005.
extract_id: Alexandru Potocean adalah aktor film Rumania. Dia telah tampil dalam lebih dari lima belas film sejak 2005.

name: Alfonso Cuarón
title: Alfonso Cuarón
extract: Alfonso Cuarón Orozco is a Mexican filmmaker. His accolades include four Academy Awards, three Golden Globe Awards, seven BAFTA Awards and one Golden Lion as well as a nomination for a Grammy Award.
extract_id: Alfonso Cuarón Orozco adalah seorang pembuat film Meksiko. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk empat Academy Awards, tiga Golden Globe Awards, tujuh BAFTA Awards, dan satu Golden Lion serta nominasi untuk Grammy Award.

name: Alfonso Gomez-Rejon
title: Alfonso Gomez-Rejon
extract: Alfonso Gomez-Rejon is an American film and television director. He made his directorial film debut with the slasher film The Town That Dreaded Sundown (2014). He has since directed the coming of age film Me and Earl and the Dying Girl (2015), and the historical drama The Current War (2017).
extract_id: Alfonso Gomez-Rejon adalah sutradara film dan televisi Amerika. Debut sutradaranya dalam film adalah film slasher The Town That Dreaded Sundown (2014). Sejak itu, dia menyutradarai film coming of age Me and Earl and the Dying Girl (2015), dan drama sejarah The Current War (2017).

name: Alfred Abel
title: Alfred Abel
extract: Alfred Peter Abel was a German film actor, director, and producer. He appeared in more than 140 silent and sound films between 1913 and 1938. His best-known performance was as Joh Fredersen in Fritz Lang's 1927 film, Metropolis.
extract_id: Alfred Peter Abel adalah aktor, sutradara, dan produser film Jerman. Ia tampil dalam lebih dari 140 film bisu dan suara antara tahun 1913 dan 1938. Penampilan yang paling dikenal adalah sebagai Joh Fredersen dalam film Metropolis karya Fritz Lang tahun 1927.

name: Alfred Hitchcock
title: Alfred Hitchcock
extract: Sir Alfred Joseph Hitchcock was an English filmmaker. He is widely regarded as one of the greatest and most influential figures in the history of cinema. In a career spanning six decades, he directed over 50 feature films, many of which are still widely watched and studied today. Known as the "Master of Suspense", Hitchcock became as well known as any of his actors thanks to his many interviews, his cameo appearances often near the beginning of his films, and his hosting and producing the television anthology Alfred Hitchcock Presents (1955–65). Among other accolades, his films garnered 46 Academy Award nominations, including six wins, although he never won the award for Best Director, despite five nominations.
extract_id: Sir Alfred Joseph Hitchcock adalah seorang pembuat film Inggris. Dia secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu tokoh terhebat dan paling berpengaruh dalam sejarah sinema. Dalam karier selama enam dekade, ia menyutradarai lebih dari 50 film panjang, banyak di antaranya masih banyak ditonton dan dipelajari hingga hari ini. Dikenal sebagai "Master of Suspense", Hitchcock menjadi terkenal setara dengan para aktornya berkat banyak wawancaranya, kemunculan cameo-nya yang sering dekat awal filmnya, serta menjadi pembawa acara dan produser antologi televisi Alfred Hitchcock Presents (1955–65). Di antara penghargaan lainnya, film-filmnya meraih 46 nominasi Academy Award, termasuk enam kemenangan, meskipun ia tidak pernah memenangkan penghargaan Sutradara Terbaik walaupun lima kali dinominasikan.

name: Ali Mosaffa
title: Ali Mosaffa
extract: Ali Mosaffa is an Iranian actor and filmmaker.
extract_id: Ali Mosaffa adalah aktor dan pembuat film Iran.

name: Alia Bhatt
title: Alia Bhatt
extract: Alia Bhatt is a British actress of Indian descent who predominantly works in Hindi films. Known for her portrayals of women in challenging circumstances, she has received several accolades, including a National Film Award and seven Filmfare Awards. She is one of India's highest-paid actresses. Time awarded her with the Time100 Impact Award in 2022 and named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2024.
extract_id: Alia Bhatt adalah seorang aktris Inggris keturunan India yang sebagian besar berkarya dalam film-film Hindi. Dikenal karena perannya memerankan wanita dalam situasi yang menantang, ia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk National Film Award dan tujuh Filmfare Awards. Dia adalah salah satu aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di India. Time memberikannya Time100 Impact Award pada 2022 dan menobatkannya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia pada 2024.

name: Alicia Vikander
title: Alicia Vikander
extract: Alicia Amanda Vikander is a Swedish actress. Her accolades include an Academy Award and an Actor Award, in addition to nominations for three BAFTAs and two Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Alicia Amanda Vikander adalah seorang aktris Swedia. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk sebuah Academy Award dan Actor Award, selain nominasi untuk tiga BAFTA dan dua Golden Globe Awards.

name: Alida Valli
title: Alida Valli
extract: Baroness Alida Maria Laura Altenburger von Marckenstein-Frauenberg, better known by her stage name Alida Valli, or simply Valli, was an Italian actress who appeared in more than 100 films in a 70-year career, spanning from the 1930s to the early 2000s. She was one of the biggest stars of Italian film during the Fascist era, once being called "the most beautiful woman in the world" by Benito Mussolini, and was internationally successful post-World War II.
extract_id: Baroness Alida Maria Laura Altenburger von Marckenstein-Frauenberg, yang lebih dikenal dengan nama panggung Alida Valli, atau sekadar Valli, adalah seorang aktris Italia yang tampil dalam lebih dari 100 film dalam karier tujuh dekade, dari tahun 1930-an hingga awal 2000-an. Dia adalah salah satu bintang terbesar film Italia selama era Fasis, pernah dijuluki "wanita tercantik di dunia" oleh Benito Mussolini, dan sukses secara internasional pasca Perang Dunia II.

name: Alisa Freyndlikh
title: Alisa Freindlich
extract: Alisa Brunovna Freindlich is a Russian actress. Since 1983, Freindlich has been a leading actress of the Bolshoi Drama Theater in Saint Petersburg, Russia. She was awarded the title of the People's Artist of the USSR in 1981.
extract_id: Alisa Brunovna Freindlich adalah seorang aktris Rusia. Sejak 1983, Freindlich menjadi aktris utama Teater Drama Bolshoi di Saint Petersburg, Rusia. Dia dianugerahi gelar Artis Rakyat Uni Soviet pada 1981.

name: Alison Doody
title: Alison Doody
extract: Alison Doody is an Irish actress and model. After making her feature film debut as Bond girl Jenny Flex in A View to a Kill (1985), she went on to play Elsa Schneider in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989). Other roles include Siobhan Donavan in A Prayer for the Dying (1987), Caroline Nolan in Echoes (1988), Charlotte in Taffin (1988), Rebecca Flannery in Major League II (1994) and Catherine Buxton in RRR (2022). She also played Pam in Beaver Falls (2011–2012).
extract_id: Alison Doody adalah seorang aktris dan model Irlandia. Setelah memulai debut film panjangnya sebagai Bond girl Jenny Flex dalam A View to a Kill (1985), dia melanjutkan memainkan Elsa Schneider dalam Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989). Peran lainnya termasuk Siobhan Donavan dalam A Prayer for the Dying (1987), Caroline Nolan dalam Echoes (1988), Charlotte dalam Taffin (1988), Rebecca Flannery dalam Major League II (1994) dan Catherine Buxton dalam RRR (2022). Dia juga memerankan Pam dalam Beaver Falls (2011–2012).

name: Allen Garfield
title: Allen Garfield
extract: Allen Garfield was an American film and television actor.
extract_id: Allen Garfield adalah seorang aktor film dan televisi Amerika.

name: Allen Leech
title: Allen Leech
extract: Allen Leech is an Irish actor. He is widely known for his roles as Tom Branson in the ITV period drama Downton Abbey (2010–2015) and Paul Prenter in the biopic Bohemian Rhapsody (2018).
extract_id: Allen Leech adalah seorang aktor Irlandia. Dia dikenal luas karena perannya sebagai Tom Branson dalam drama periode ITV Downton Abbey (2010–2015) dan Paul Prenter dalam film biografi Bohemian Rhapsody (2018).

name: Allison Williams
title: Allison Williams
extract: Allison Howell Williams is an American actress and film producer. She began her career in comedy and rose to prominence as a horror queen beginning in the late 2010s. Her accolades include a National Board of Review Award and nominations at the Critics' Choice, GMSA and SAG Awards.
extract_id: Allison Howell Williams adalah seorang aktris dan produser film Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya di bidang komedi dan mulai dikenal sebagai ratu horor sejak akhir 2010-an. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk National Board of Review Award dan nominasi pada Critics' Choice, GMSA, dan SAG Awards.

name: Ally Sheedy
title: Ally Sheedy
extract: Alexandra Elizabeth Sheedy is an American actress, author and teacher. Born in New York City, Sheedy began her career as a teenager acting in commercials and guest roles on television. She made her theatrical film debut in Bad Boys (1983). Due to her appearances in a string of teen-oriented films such as Oxford Blues (1984), The Breakfast Club (1985) and St. Elmo's Fire (1985), Sheedy and many of her co-stars were nicknamed the "Brat Pack".
extract_id: Alexandra Elizabeth Sheedy adalah seorang aktris, penulis, dan guru Amerika. Lahir di New York City, Sheedy memulai kariernya sebagai remaja yang berakting dalam iklan dan peran tamu di televisi. Dia membuat debut film teatrikalnya dalam Bad Boys (1983). Karena penampilannya dalam serangkaian film yang berorientasi pada remaja seperti Oxford Blues (1984), The Breakfast Club (1985), dan St. Elmo's Fire (1985), Sheedy dan banyak rekan mainnya dijuluki "Brat Pack".

name: Altan Erkekli
title: Altan Erkekli
extract: Reşit Altan Erkekli is a Turkish theatre, film and television actor.
extract_id: Reşit Altan Erkekli adalah aktor teater, film, dan televisi Turki.

name: America Ferrera
title: America Ferrera
extract: America Georgina Ferrera is an American actress. She has received numerous accolades, including a Primetime Emmy Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a Screen Actors Guild Award, in addition to a nomination for an Academy Award. In 2007 and 2024, Time named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world and in 2023, she was named in BBC's 100 Women list.
extract_id: America Georgina Ferrera adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Primetime Emmy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Screen Actors Guild Award, selain nominasi untuk Academy Award. Pada tahun 2007 dan 2024, Time menobatkannya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia dan pada 2023, dia masuk dalam daftar 100 Women BBC.

name: Amira Casar
title: Amira Casar
extract: Amira Casar is a British-French film actress. She was nominated for a César Award for Most Promising Actress for the 1997 film La Vérité si je mens! and also for the Palme d'Or at the 2005 Cannes Film Festival for the film To Paint or Make Love. In 2010, she won the Best Actress award at La Rochelle Television Film Festival in 2010 for her turn in La femme qui pleure au chapeau rouge.
extract_id: Amira Casar adalah seorang aktris film Inggris-Perancis. Dia dinominasikan untuk César Award untuk Most Promising Actress atas film La Vérité si je mens! (1997) dan juga untuk Palme d'Or di Festival Film Cannes 2005 untuk film To Paint or Make Love. Pada 2010, dia memenangkan penghargaan Aktris Terbaik di La Rochelle Television Film Festival untuk perannya dalam La femme qui pleure au chapeau rouge.

name: Amit Ravindernath Sharma
title: Amit Sharma (director)
extract: Amit Ravindernath Sharma is an Indian film and advertisement director and producer. In feature films, he is best known for producing and directing the 2018 National-award winning film Badhaai Ho, which was one of the highest grossing Bollywood films of 2018, having earned ₹220.34 crore as of December 2018.
extract_id: Amit Ravindernath Sharma adalah sutradara dan produser film serta iklan India. Dalam film fitur, dia paling dikenal sebagai produser dan sutradara film pemenang National Award 2018, Badhaai Ho, yang menjadi salah satu film Bollywood terlaris tahun 2018 dengan pendapatan mencapai ₹220,34 crore per Desember 2018.

name: Amit Sadh
title: Amit Sadh
extract: Amit Sadh is an Indian actor who is known for his work in several films and television productions. He is best known for his performances in films like Kai Po Che! (2013), Sultan (2016) and Gold (2018). In recent years, he has become well-known for his roles in web series. He played Inspector Kabir Sawant in three seasons of Breathe streaming on Amazon Prime Video. He won the Filmfare OTT Award for Best Supporting Actor in a Drama Series.
extract_id: Amit Sadh adalah aktor India yang dikenal dari sejumlah film dan produksi televisi. Dia paling dikenal karena penampilannya dalam film seperti Kai Po Che! (2013), Sultan (2016) dan Gold (2018). Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, ia menjadi terkenal karena perannya dalam seri web. Ia berperan sebagai Inspektur Kabir Sawant dalam tiga musim Breathe yang tayang di Amazon Prime Video. Ia memenangkan Filmfare OTT Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam Serial Drama.

name: Amitabh Bachchan
title: Amitabh Bachchan
extract: Amitabh Bachchan is an Indian actor, playback singer, and producer who primarily works in Hindi cinema. Widely considered one of the greatest, most accomplished and commercially successful actors in the history of Indian cinema, he has starred in over 200 films. Bachchan has been called "the Angry Young Man", the Shahenshah of Bollywood, Sadi ke Mahanayak, Bollywood's Star of the Millennium, or simply Big B. His dominance in the Indian film industry during the 1970s–80s led the French director François Truffaut to describe him as a "one-man industry". He is a recipient of several accolades including seven National Film Awards and seventeen Filmfare Awards & one South Filmfare award.
extract_id: Amitabh Bachchan adalah aktor, penyanyi latar, dan produser India yang sebagian besar berkarya di sinema Hindi. Secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terhebat, paling berprestasi, dan paling sukses secara komersial dalam sejarah sinema India, ia telah membintangi lebih dari 200 film. Bachchan dijuluki "the Angry Young Man", Shahenshah Bollywood, Sadi ke Mahanayak, Bintang Bollywood Milenium, atau cukup Big B. Dominasi dia di industri film India selama 1970-an–80-an membuat sutradara Perancis François Truffaut menyebutnya sebagai "industri satu orang". Ia penerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk tujuh National Film Awards dan tujuh belas Filmfare Awards serta satu Filmfare Selatan.

name: Amjad Khan
title: Amjad Khan (actor)
extract: Amjad Khan was an Indian actor and film director. He worked in over 132 films in a career spanning nearly twenty years. He was the son of the actor Jayant. He gained popularity for villainous roles in mostly Hindi films, the most famous among his enacted roles being Gabbar Singh in the 1975 film Sholay and of Dilawar in Muqaddar Ka Sikandar (1978).
extract_id: Amjad Khan adalah seorang aktor dan sutradara film India. Dia telah bekerja dalam lebih dari 132 film dalam kariernya yang berlangsung hampir dua puluh tahun. Dia adalah putra dari aktor Jayant. Dia mendapatkan popularitas untuk peran antagonis dalam sebagian besar film Hindi, yang paling terkenal di antara perannya adalah Gabbar Singh dalam film Sholay (1975) dan Dilawar dalam Muqaddar Ka Sikandar (1978).

name: Amole Gupte
title: Amole Gupte
extract: Amole Gupte is an Indian screenwriter, actor, singer and director, known for his work on the 2007 film Taare Zameen Par as a creative director and screenwriter. He conceived the film along with his wife, Deepa Bhatia. He was the chairperson of the Children's Film Society, India from 2012 to 2015. And presently serves as a member of the advisory board of the Kautik International Student Film Festival.
extract_id: Amole Gupte adalah seorang penulis skenario, aktor, penyanyi, dan sutradara India, dikenal karena karyanya dalam film Taare Zameen Par (2007) sebagai sutradara kreatif dan penulis skenario. Dia mencetuskan film tersebut bersama istrinya, Deepa Bhatia. Dia pernah menjabat sebagai ketua Children's Film Society, India dari tahun 2012 hingga 2015. Saat ini, ia menjabat sebagai anggota dewan penasihat Festival Film Mahasiswa Internasional Kautik.

name: Amrish Puri
title: Amrish Puri
extract: Amrish Puri was an Indian actor, who predominantly worked in Hindi cinema. He was one of the most notable and important figures in Indian cinema and theatre. Puri was known for his acting versatility. His dominating screen presence and distinctive deep voice made him stand out amongst other actors of his generation. Puri acted in more than 450 films, and established himself as one of the greatest actors in Indian cinema. He holds most Filmfare Award for Best Villain nominations. While he primarily worked in Hindi-language films, he had also appeared in Telugu, Kannada, Tamil, Malayalam and Marathi language films.
extract_id: Amrish Puri adalah seorang aktor India, yang sebagian besar bekerja di sinema Hindi. Dia adalah salah satu tokoh paling terkenal dan penting dalam sinema dan teater India. Puri dikenal karena kemampuan aktingnya yang serba bisa. Kehadirannya yang dominan di layar dan suara dalamnya yang khas membuatnya menonjol di antara aktor seangkatannya. Puri telah berakting dalam lebih dari 450 film, dan menempatkan dirinya sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar dalam sinema India. Dia memegang sebagian besar nominasi Filmfare Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terburuk. Meski ia terutama bekerja dalam film berbahasa Hindi, ia juga tampil dalam film berbahasa Telugu, Kannada, Tamil, Malayalam, dan Marathi.

name: Amrita Puri
title: Amrita Puri
extract: Amrita Puri is an Indian actress who mainly works in Hindi films and web shows. She made her acting debut with the romantic comedy-drama Aisha (2010), which earned her the Stardust Award for Breakthrough Performance – Female and also received Filmfare Award nomination for Best Supporting Actress. She had her first commercial success with the 2013 buddy sports drama Kai Po Che!.
extract_id: Amrita Puri adalah seorang aktris India yang sebagian besar bekerja dalam film dan acara web berbahasa Hindi. Dia memulai debut aktingnya dengan drama komedi romantis Aisha (2010), yang memberinya Stardust Award untuk Penampilan Terobosan – Wanita dan juga menerima nominasi Filmfare Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik. Kesuksesan komersial pertamanya adalah dengan drama olahraga persahabatan Kai Po Che! (2013).

name: Amy Adams
title: Amy Adams
extract: Amy Lou Adams is an American actress. Known for both her comedic and dramatic roles, she has been featured three times in annual rankings of the world's highest-paid actresses. She has received various accolades including two Golden Globes, and has been nominated for six Academy Awards, seven British Academy Film Awards, and two Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Amy Lou Adams adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dikenal untuk peran komedi dan dramatisnya, ia telah tampil tiga kali dalam peringkat tahunan aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia. Ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk dua Golden Globes, dan telah dinominasikan untuk enam Academy Awards, tujuh British Academy Film Awards, dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Amy Poehler
title: Amy Poehler
extract: Amy Meredith Poehler is an American actress, comedian, and podcaster. Known for her acclaimed roles in sketch comedy, sitcoms and comedy films, she has earned accolades including a Primetime Emmy Award from 26 nominations, two Golden Globe Awards, and a Peabody Award, as well as a nomination for a Grammy Award. Poehler was included on Time's list of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2011 and received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame for her contributions to comedy in 2015.
extract_id: Amy Meredith Poehler adalah seorang aktris, komedian, dan podcaster Amerika. Dikenal karena perannya yang diakui dalam komedi sketsa, sitkom, dan film komedi, ia telah meraih penghargaan termasuk Primetime Emmy Award dari 26 nominasi, dua Golden Globe Awards, dan Peabody Award, serta nominasi Grammy Award. Poehler masuk dalam daftar Time sebagai 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia pada tahun 2011 dan menerima bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame atas kontribusinya dalam dunia komedi pada tahun 2015.

name: Amy Ryan
title: Amy Ryan
extract: Amy Beth Dziewiontkowski, known professionally as Amy Ryan, is an American actress. She began her professional stage career in 1987 and made her Broadway debut in 1993 as a replacement in the original production of Wendy Wasserstein's The Sisters Rosensweig. She was nominated for the Tony Award for Best Featured Actress in a Play for her performances in Uncle Vanya (2000) and A Streetcar Named Desire (2005), and the Tony Award for Best Actress in a Play for Doubt: A Parable (2024).
extract_id: Amy Beth Dziewiontkowski, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Amy Ryan, adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia memulai karier panggung profesionalnya pada tahun 1987 dan membuat debut Broadway pada tahun 1993 sebagai pengganti dalam produksi asli The Sisters Rosensweig karya Wendy Wasserstein. Dia dinominasikan untuk Tony Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik dalam Drama untuk penampilannya dalam Uncle Vanya (2000) dan A Streetcar Named Desire (2005), serta Tony Award untuk Aktris Terbaik dalam Drama untuk Doubt: A Parable (2024).

name: Amy Smart
title: Amy Smart
extract: Amy Lysle Smart is an American actress and former model. Her first role in film was in Martin Kunert's anthology horror film Campfire Tales, followed by a minor part in Starship Troopers, directed by Paul Verhoeven. In 1998, Smart played a role in Dee Snider's Strangeland. She garnered widespread recognition after appearing in the mainstream teen drama Varsity Blues (1999), as well as for a recurring role as Ruby on the television series Felicity (1999–2001). Next was a lead role in the college sex comedy Road Trip (2000); she was a co-star in Jerry Zucker's ensemble comedy Rat Race (2001). She had a lead role opposite Ashton Kutcher in the sci-fi drama The Butterfly Effect (2004).
extract_id: Amy Lysle Smart adalah seorang aktris dan mantan model Amerika. Peran pertamanya dalam film adalah dalam film horor antologi Campfire Tales karya Martin Kunert, diikuti dengan peran kecil dalam Starship Troopers, yang disutradarai oleh Paul Verhoeven. Pada tahun 1998, Smart memerankan sebuah peran dalam Strangeland karya Dee Snider. Dia mendapatkan pengakuan luas setelah tampil dalam drama remaja arus utama Varsity Blues (1999), serta untuk peran berulang sebagai Ruby dalam serial televisi Felicity (1999–2001). Selanjutnya dia memerankan peran utama dalam komedi seks kampus Road Trip (2000); dia juga tampil sebagai pemeran pendukung dalam komedi ensemble Rat Race (2001) karya Jerry Zucker. Dia memerankan peran utama berlawanan Ashton Kutcher dalam drama fiksi ilmiah The Butterfly Effect (2004).

name: Ana Wagener
title: Ana Wagener
extract: Ana Álvarez Wagener is a Spanish actress. She has appeared in such films as The Sleeping Voice, My Prison Yard, Biutiful, and The Invisible Guest. Her television credits include the role of Vicenta Ramírez in La Señora and its successor 14 de abril. La República.
