extract_id: Ana Álvarez Wagener adalah seorang aktris Spanyol. Dia telah tampil dalam film-film seperti The Sleeping Voice, My Prison Yard, Biutiful, dan The Invisible Guest. Kredit televisinya meliputi peran Vicenta Ramírez dalam La Señora dan penerusnya 14 de abril. La República.

name: Ana de Armas
title: Ana de Armas
extract: Ana Celia de Armas Caso is a Cuban and Spanish actress. She has been nominated for several accolades, including an Academy Award, an Actor Award, a BAFTA, and two Golden Globes.
extract_id: Ana Celia de Armas Caso adalah seorang aktris Kuba dan Spanyol. Ia telah dinominasikan untuk beberapa penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Actor Award, BAFTA, dan dua Golden Globes.

name: Anamaria Marinca
title: Anamaria Marinca
extract: Anamaria Marinca is a Romanian actress. She made her screen debut with the Channel 4 film Sex Traffic, for which she won the British Academy Television Award for Best Actress. Marinca is also known for her performance in 4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days, earning several awards for her performance, and was nominated for the European Film Award for Best Actress, London Film Critics Circle Award for Actress of the Year, Los Angeles Film Critics Association Award for Best Actress and National Society of Film Critics Award for Best Actress. In 2008, at the 58th Berlin International Film Festival, she was presented the Shooting Stars Award by the European Film Promotion.
extract_id: Anamaria Marinca adalah seorang aktris Rumania. Dia memulai debut akting layar dengan film Channel 4 berjudul Sex Traffic, yang membuatnya memenangkan British Academy Television Award untuk Aktris Terbaik. Marinca juga dikenal karena penampilannya dalam 4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days, yang memberinya beberapa penghargaan, dan dinominasikan untuk European Film Award untuk Aktris Terbaik, London Film Critics Circle Award untuk Aktris Terbaik Tahun Ini, Los Angeles Film Critics Association Award untuk Aktris Terbaik, dan National Society of Film Critics Award untuk Aktris Terbaik. Pada tahun 2008, di Festival Film Internasional Berlin ke-58, dia diberikan Shooting Stars Award oleh European Film Promotion.

name: Anand Gandhi
title: Anand Gandhi
extract: Anand Gandhi is an Indian filmmaker, entrepreneur, media producer, innovator and systems researcher. His debut feature film, Ship of Theseus (2013), premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival, won the National Film Award for Best Picture. His second film, Tumbbad (2018), for which he served as director, creative director, executive producer, and screenwriter, opened the Critics' Week at the 75th Venice International Film Festival. Gandhi is also the founder of Memesys Culture Lab, a new media studio and systems think tank.
extract_id: Anand Gandhi adalah seorang pembuat film, pengusaha, produser media, inovator dan peneliti sistem asal India. Film fitur pertamanya, Ship of Theseus (2013), tayang perdana di Toronto International Film Festival, dan memenangkan Penghargaan Film Nasional untuk Film Terbaik. Film keduanya, Tumbbad (2018), di mana dia berperan sebagai sutradara, sutradara kreatif, produser eksekutif, dan penulis skenario, membuka Critics' Week di Festival Film Internasional Venesia ke-75. Gandhi juga merupakan pendiri Memesys Culture Lab, sebuah studio media baru dan think tank sistem.

name: Anatoliy Solonitsyn
title: Anatoly Solonitsyn
extract: Anatoly (Otto) Alekseyevich Solonitsyn was a Soviet actor known for his spiritually profound and deeply philosophical performances on stage and screen. Widely regarded as one of the greatest actors of the 20th century and one of the finest actors from the Soviet Union, he is revered for his work with Andrei Tarkovsky. He won the Silver Bear for Best Actor at the 31st Berlin International Film Festival.
extract_id: Anatoly (Otto) Alekseyevich Solonitsyn adalah seorang aktor Soviet yang dikenal karena penampilan yang mendalam secara spiritual dan filosofis di panggung dan layar. Dia dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar abad ke-20 dan salah satu aktor terbaik dari Uni Soviet, dan dihormati karena karyanya bersama Andrei Tarkovsky. Dia memenangkan Silver Bear untuk Aktor Terbaik di Festival Film Internasional Berlin ke-31.

name: Anders Thomas Jensen
title: Anders Thomas Jensen
extract: Anders Thomas Jensen is a Danish screenwriter and film director. His film Election Night won the 1998 Academy Award for Best Live Action Short Film.
extract_id: Anders Thomas Jensen adalah seorang penulis skenario dan sutradara film Denmark. Filmnya Election Night memenangkan Academy Award 1998 untuk Film Pendek Aksi Langsung Terbaik.

name: Andie MacDowell
title: Andie MacDowell
extract: Rosalie Anderson MacDowell is an American actress and former fashion model. MacDowell is known for her starring film roles in romantic comedies and dramas. She has modeled for Calvin Klein and has been a spokeswoman for L'Oréal since 1986.
extract_id: Rosalie Anderson MacDowell adalah seorang aktris Amerika dan mantan model mode. MacDowell dikenal karena perannya sebagai pemeran utama dalam film komedi romantis dan drama. Dia pernah menjadi model untuk Calvin Klein dan telah menjadi juru bicara L'Oréal sejak tahun 1986.

name: Andrea Eckert
title: Andrea Eckert
extract: Andrea Eckert is an Austrian stage and film actress, singer and documentary filmmaker.
extract_id: Andrea Eckert adalah seorang aktris panggung dan film Austria, penyanyi dan pembuat film dokumenter.

name: Andrea Riseborough
title: Andrea Riseborough
extract: Andrea Louise Riseborough is an English actress. She made her film debut with a small part in Venus (2006), and has since appeared in more prominent roles in Brighton Rock (2010), W.E. (2011), Shadow Dancer (2012), Oblivion (2013), Birdman (2014), Nocturnal Animals (2016), Battle of the Sexes, The Death of Stalin, Mandy, Nancy, The Grudge, Possessor and Good Boy (2025). For playing an alcoholic in To Leslie (2022), she was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actress.
extract_id: Andrea Louise Riseborough adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Dia memulai debut filmnya dengan peran kecil dalam Venus (2006), dan sejak itu telah tampil dalam peran yang lebih menonjol dalam Brighton Rock (2010), W.E. (2011), Shadow Dancer (2012), Oblivion (2013), Birdman (2014), Nocturnal Animals (2016), Battle of the Sexes, The Death of Stalin, Mandy, Nancy, The Grudge, Possessor dan Good Boy (2025). Untuk perannya sebagai seorang pecandu alkohol dalam To Leslie (2022), dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik.

name: Andreas Wilson
title: Andreas Wilson
extract: Andreas Axel Janota Wilson is a Swedish actor who played the leading role in the Oscar-nominated Evil. He has also starred in Kill Your Darlings, Babas bilar and Den utvalde. He was named as one of European films' "Shooting Stars" by the European Film Promotion in 2004. He has been modeling for the clothing store Abercrombie & Fitch.
extract_id: Andreas Axel Janota Wilson adalah seorang aktor Swedia yang memerankan peran utama dalam film Evil yang dinominasikan Oscar. Dia juga membintangi Kill Your Darlings, Babas bilar, dan Den utvalde. Dia dinobatkan sebagai salah satu "Shooting Stars" film Eropa oleh European Film Promotion pada tahun 2004. Dia juga pernah menjadi model untuk toko pakaian Abercrombie & Fitch.

name: Andrei Tarkovsky
title: Andrei Tarkovsky
extract: Andrei Arsenyevich Tarkovsky was a Soviet film director and screenwriter of Russian origin. He is widely considered one of the greatest directors in cinema history. His films explore spiritual and metaphysical themes and are known for their slow pacing and long takes, dreamlike visual imagery, and preoccupation with nature and memory.
extract_id: Andrei Arsenyevich Tarkovsky adalah seorang sutradara film dan penulis skenario Soviet keturunan Rusia. Dia secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu sutradara terbesar dalam sejarah sinema. Film-filmnya mengeksplorasi tema spiritual dan metafisik serta dikenal dengan tempo lambat dan pengambilan gambar panjang, citra visual seperti mimpi, dan perhatian terhadap alam dan memori.

name: Andrew Adamson
title: Andrew Adamson
extract: Andrew Ralph Adamson is a New Zealand film director, producer, screenwriter, and animator. He is best known for directing the DreamWorks animated film Shrek (2001), which is based on the children's picture book of the same name by American author William Steig and won the first Academy Award for Best Animated Feature at the 74th Academy Awards ceremony, and directing and co-writing Shrek 2 (2004), which was nominated for Academy Award for Best Animated Feature. He also directed and co-wrote the first two live-action film adaptations of C. S. Lewis' The Chronicles of Narnia novels: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (2005) and Prince Caspian (2008).
extract_id: Andrew Ralph Adamson adalah seorang sutradara, produser, penulis skenario, dan animator film asal Selandia Baru. Dia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai film animasi DreamWorks Shrek (2001), yang didasarkan pada buku bergambar anak-anak dengan judul yang sama oleh penulis Amerika William Steig dan memenangkan Academy Award pertama untuk Film Animasi Terbaik pada acara Academy Awards ke-74, serta menyutradarai dan menulis bersama Shrek 2 (2004), yang dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Film Animasi Terbaik. Dia juga menyutradarai dan menulis bersama dua adaptasi film laga pertama dari novel The Chronicles of Narnia karya C. S. Lewis: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (2005) dan Prince Caspian (2008).

name: Andrew Davis
title: Andrew Davis (director)
extract: Andrew Davis is an American film director, producer, screenwriter, and cinematographer. He is best known for having directed several successful action and thriller films during the 1980s and 1990s.
extract_id: Andrew Davis adalah seorang sutradara, produser, penulis skenario, dan sinematografer film Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena telah menyutradarai beberapa film aksi dan thriller sukses selama tahun 1980-an dan 1990-an.

name: Andrew Garfield
title: Andrew Garfield
extract: Andrew Russell Garfield is an English and American actor. He is known for his work across a variety of genres, from biographical dramas to action films, spanning both independent and blockbuster productions. His accolades include a Tony Award, two Critics' Choice Awards, a Golden Globe Award and a British Academy Television Award, in addition to nominations for two Academy Awards, three British Academy Film Awards and a Primetime Emmy Award. In 2022, Time magazine named him one of the 100 most influential people in the world.
extract_id: Andrew Russell Garfield adalah seorang aktor Inggris dan Amerika. Dia dikenal karena bekerja dalam berbagai genre, dari drama biografi hingga film aksi, mencakup produksi independen dan blockbuster. Penghargaan yang ia raih meliputi Tony Award, dua Critics' Choice Awards, Golden Globe Award, dan British Academy Television Award, selain nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards, tiga British Academy Film Awards, dan Primetime Emmy Award. Pada tahun 2022, majalah Time menamainya salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia.

name: Andrew Kevin Walker
title: Andrew Kevin Walker
extract: Andrew Kevin Walker is an American screenwriter. He is known for having written Seven (1995), for which he earned a nomination for the BAFTA Award for Best Original Screenplay, as well as several other films, including 8mm (1999), Sleepy Hollow (1999) and many uncredited script rewrites.
extract_id: Andrew Kevin Walker adalah seorang penulis skenario Amerika. Dia dikenal karena menulis film Seven (1995), yang membuatnya mendapatkan nominasi BAFTA Award untuk Skenario Asli Terbaik, serta beberapa film lain termasuk 8mm (1999), Sleepy Hollow (1999) dan banyak penulisan naskah ulang yang tidak dikreditkan.

name: Andrew Lau
title: Andrew Lau
extract: Andrew Lau Wai-keung is a Hong Kong filmmaker. Lau began his career in the 1980s and 1990s, serving as a cinematographer to filmmakers such as Ringo Lam, Wong Jing and Wong Kar-wai. In the 1990s, Lau decided to have more creative freedom as a cinematographer by becoming a film director and producer. Apart from making films in his native Hong Kong, Lau has also made films in mainland China, South Korea and the United States.
extract_id: Andrew Lau Wai-keung adalah seorang pembuat film Hong Kong. Lau memulai kariernya pada tahun 1980-an dan 1990-an sebagai sinematografer untuk pembuat film seperti Ringo Lam, Wong Jing, dan Wong Kar-wai. Pada tahun 1990-an, Lau memutuskan untuk memiliki kebebasan kreatif lebih sebagai sinematografer dengan menjadi sutradara dan produser film. Selain membuat film di Hong Kong tempat asalnya, Lau juga membuat film di Tiongkok daratan, Korea Selatan, dan Amerika Serikat.

name: Andrew Marton
title: Andrew Marton
extract: Andrew Marton was a Hungarian-American film director. In his career, he directed 39 films and television programmes, and worked on 16 as a second unit director, including the chariot race in Ben Hur (1959).
extract_id: Andrew Marton adalah seorang sutradara film Hungaria-Amerika. Dalam kariernya, ia menyutradarai 39 film dan program televisi, dan bekerja pada 16 lainnya sebagai sutradara unit kedua, termasuk adegan balap kereta di Ben Hur (1959).

name: Andrew Niccol
title: Andrew Niccol
extract: Andrew Niccol is a New Zealand filmmaker. He wrote and directed Gattaca (1997), Simone (2002), Lord of War (2005), In Time (2011), The Host (2013), and Good Kill (2014). He wrote and co-produced The Truman Show, which earned him a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay and won him the BAFTA Award in the same category. His high-concept science fiction films tend to explore social, cultural and political issues; artificial realities and simulations are frequent themes in his work.
extract_id: Andrew Niccol adalah seorang pembuat film dari Selandia Baru. Ia menulis dan menyutradarai Gattaca (1997), Simone (2002), Lord of War (2005), In Time (2011), The Host (2013), dan Good Kill (2014). Ia menulis dan memproduseri bersama The Truman Show, yang memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Best Original Screenplay dan memenangkan BAFTA Award di kategori yang sama. Film fiksi ilmiah konsep tinggi miliknya cenderung mengeksplorasi isu sosial, budaya, dan politik; realitas buatan dan simulasi sering menjadi tema dalam karyanya.

name: Andrew Robinson
title: Andrew Robinson (actor)
extract: Andrew Jordt Robinson is an American actor and the former director of the Master of Fine Arts acting program at the University of Southern California. Originally a stage actor, he works predominantly in supporting roles on television and in low-budget films. He is known for his portrayals of the psychopathic serial killer Scorpio in Dirty Harry (1971), Larry Cotton in the horror film Hellraiser (1987), and Elim Garak in the television series Star Trek: Deep Space Nine (1993–1999).
extract_id: Andrew Jordt Robinson adalah aktor Amerika dan mantan direktur program Master of Fine Arts di bidang akting di University of Southern California. Awalnya seorang aktor panggung, ia sebagian besar berperan sebagai pendukung di televisi dan film beranggaran rendah. Ia dikenal karena perannya sebagai pembunuh berantai psikopat Scorpio dalam Dirty Harry (1971), Larry Cotton dalam film horor Hellraiser (1987), dan Elim Garak dalam serial televisi Star Trek: Deep Space Nine (1993–1999).

name: Andrew Shim
title: Andrew Shim
extract: Andrew Shim is an American-born British actor best known for his appearances in the films and TV shows of Shane Meadows, especially This Is England (2006–2015). Although a United States citizen, he has lived most of his life in Britain since 1989.
extract_id: Andrew Shim adalah aktor berkewarganegaraan Inggris yang lahir di Amerika, dikenal terutama lewat penampilannya dalam film dan acara TV karya Shane Meadows, terutama This Is England (2006–2015). Meskipun warga negara Amerika Serikat, ia telah tinggal sebagian besar hidupnya di Inggris sejak 1989.

name: Andrew Stanton
title: Andrew Stanton
extract: Andrew Ayers Stanton is an American filmmaker and animator. He is best known as the director and co-writer of the Pixar animated films Finding Nemo (2003), WALL-E (2008), Finding Dory (2016), and Toy Story 5 (2026). He also directed the live-action films John Carter (2012) and In the Blink of an Eye (2026). For Pixar, Stanton was additionally co-writer on the first four Toy Story films (1995–2019), A Bug's Life (1998), Monsters, Inc. (2001), and has had a degree of involvement in each of the company's feature films. His films have grossed more than $4 billion making him the tenth highest-grossing film director of all-time, not adjusted for inflation.
extract_id: Andrew Ayers Stanton adalah pembuat film dan animator Amerika. Ia dikenal sebagai sutradara dan penulis naskah bersama film animasi Pixar Finding Nemo (2003), WALL-E (2008), Finding Dory (2016), dan Toy Story 5 (2026). Ia juga menyutradarai film live-action John Carter (2012) dan In the Blink of an Eye (2026). Untuk Pixar, Stanton juga menjadi penulis naskah bersama dalam empat film Toy Story pertama (1995–2019), A Bug's Life (1998), Monsters, Inc. (2001), dan terlibat dalam setiap film fitur perusahaan tersebut. Film-filmmya menghasilkan lebih dari $4 miliar sehingga menjadikannya sutradara film dengan pendapatan tertinggi kesepuluh sepanjang masa tanpa penyesuaian inflasi.

name: Andrey Zvyagintsev
title: Andrey Zvyagintsev
extract: Andrey Petrovich Zvyagintsev is a Russian filmmaker. His films usually explore Russian society and politics in the 21st century, featuring bleak atmosphere and neo-noir style.
extract_id: Andrey Petrovich Zvyagintsev adalah pembuat film Rusia. Film-filmnya biasanya mengeksplorasi masyarakat dan politik Rusia di abad ke-21, dengan suasana suram dan gaya neo-noir.

name: André Berley
title: André Berley
extract: André Berley was a French actor.
extract_id: André Berley adalah seorang aktor Prancis.

name: André S. Labarthe
title: André S. Labarthe
extract: André S. Labarthe was a French actor, film producer and director. He starred alongside Anna Karina in the 1962 film Vivre sa vie. He was the director of many television documentaries that profile specific individuals, beginning with Cinéastes de notre temps.
extract_id: André S. Labarthe adalah aktor, produser film, dan sutradara Prancis. Ia membintangi bersama Anna Karina dalam film Vivre sa vie tahun 1962. Ia adalah sutradara banyak film dokumenter televisi yang memprofilkan individu tertentu, dimulai dengan Cinéastes de notre temps.

name: Andy Devine
title: Andy Devine
extract: Andrew Vabre Devine was an American character actor known for his distinctive raspy, crackly voice and roles in Western films, including his role as Cookie, the sidekick of Roy Rogers in 10 feature films. He also appeared alongside John Wayne in films such as Stagecoach (1939), The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance, and How the West Was Won. He is also remembered as Jingles on the TV series The Adventures of Wild Bill Hickok from 1951 to 1958, as Danny McGuire in A Star Is Born (1937), and as the voice of Friar Tuck in the Disney Animation Studio film Robin Hood (1973).
extract_id: Andrew Vabre Devine adalah aktor karakter Amerika yang dikenal dengan suara serak dan berderak khas serta peran dalam film barat, termasuk perannya sebagai Cookie, pendamping Roy Rogers dalam 10 film fitur. Ia juga tampil bersama John Wayne dalam film seperti Stagecoach (1939), The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance, dan How the West Was Won. Ia juga dikenal sebagai Jingles dalam serial TV The Adventures of Wild Bill Hickok dari 1951 hingga 1958, sebagai Danny McGuire dalam A Star Is Born (1937), dan sebagai suara Friar Tuck dalam film animasi Disney Robin Hood (1973).

name: Andy Garcia
title: Andy Garcia
extract: Andrés Arturo García Menéndez is a Cuban American actor, director, producer, and musician. Known for his roles in film and television, he has received a Grammy Award, as well as nominations for an Academy Award, two Golden Globe Awards and two Primetime Emmy Awards. He first rose to prominence acting in Brian De Palma's The Untouchables (1987) followed by roles in Stand and Deliver (1988), Black Rain (1989) and Internal Affairs (1990). He then portrayed Vincent Mancini in Francis Ford Coppola's The Godfather Part III (1990), earning a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor and becoming the first Cuban to be nominated for an acting Oscar.
extract_id: Andrés Arturo García Menéndez adalah aktor, sutradara, produser, dan musisi Kuba-Amerika. Dikenal karena perannya di film dan televisi, ia telah menerima Grammy Award, serta nominasi Academy Award, dua Golden Globe Awards, dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards. Ia pertama kali dikenal luas karena berakting dalam The Untouchables (1987) karya Brian De Palma diikuti oleh peran dalam Stand and Deliver (1988), Black Rain (1989), dan Internal Affairs (1990). Ia kemudian memerankan Vincent Mancini dalam The Godfather Part III (1990) karya Francis Ford Coppola, mendapat nominasi Academy Award untuk Best Supporting Actor dan menjadi orang Kuba pertama yang dinominasikan untuk Oscar akting.

name: Andy Lau
title: Andy Lau
extract: Andy Lau Tak-wah, is a Hong Kong actor, singer-songwriter and film producer. He was named one of the Five Tiger Generals of TVB in the 1980s as well as one of the Four Heavenly Kings in the 1990s. Lau won the Hong Kong Film Award for Best Actor three times, the Golden Horse Award for Best Leading Actor twice, and was entered into the Guinness World Records for the "Most Awards Won by a Cantopop Male Artist" in 2000, with a total of 444 music awards by 2006. In 2018, Lau became a member of the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences. In 2024, Lau was elected vice chairman of the 11th China Film Association. Over a career of four decades, Lau has been one of the most commercially and critically successful artists in the Chinese-speaking world.
extract_id: Andy Lau Tak-wah adalah aktor, penyanyi-penulis lagu, dan produser film dari Hong Kong. Ia disebut salah satu dari Lima Jenderal Harimau TVB pada 1980-an serta salah satu Empat Raja Langit pada 1990-an. Lau memenangkan Hong Kong Film Award untuk Best Actor sebanyak tiga kali, Golden Horse Award untuk Best Leading Actor dua kali, dan masuk Guinness World Records sebagai "Most Awards Won by a Cantopop Male Artist" pada tahun 2000, dengan total 444 penghargaan musik hingga 2006. Pada 2018, Lau menjadi anggota Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences. Pada 2024, Lau terpilih sebagai wakil ketua China Film Association ke-11. Selama karirnya yang berlangsung selama empat dekade, Lau menjadi salah satu artis yang paling sukses secara komersial dan kritis di dunia berbahasa Tionghoa.

name: Andy Serkis
title: Andy Serkis
extract: Andrew Clement Serkis is an English actor and director. He is best known for his critically acclaimed roles comprising motion capture acting, animation, and voice acting for computer-generated characters such as Gollum in The Lord of the Rings film trilogy (2001–2003) and The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey (2012), King Kong in the eponymous 2005 film, Caesar in the Planet of the Apes reboot series (2011–2017), Captain Haddock / Sir Francis Haddock in Steven Spielberg's The Adventures of Tintin (2011), Baloo in his self-directed film Mowgli: Legend of the Jungle (2018) and Supreme Leader Snoke in the Star Wars sequel trilogy films The Force Awakens (2015) and The Last Jedi (2017).
extract_id: Andrew Clement Serkis adalah aktor dan sutradara Inggris. Ia dikenal karena perannya yang mendapat pujian kritis yang melibatkan akting motion capture, animasi, dan pengisi suara untuk karakter komputer seperti Gollum dalam trilogi film The Lord of the Rings (2001–2003) dan The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey (2012), King Kong dalam film eponymous tahun 2005, Caesar dalam seri reboot Planet of the Apes (2011–2017), Captain Haddock / Sir Francis Haddock dalam The Adventures of Tintin karya Steven Spielberg (2011), Baloo dalam film arahan sendiri Mowgli: Legend of the Jungle (2018), dan Supreme Leader Snoke dalam trilogi sekuel Star Wars The Force Awakens (2015) dan The Last Jedi (2017).

name: Aneesh Chaganty
title: Aneesh Chaganty
extract: Aneesh Chaganty is an American film director and screenwriter. He made his feature film directorial debut with the 2018 thriller Searching, for which he won the Alfred P. Sloan Feature Film Prize at the 2018 Sundance Film Festival.
extract_id: Aneesh Chaganty adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film Amerika. Ia memulai debut penyutradaraan film fitur dengan thriller Searching tahun 2018, yang memberinya penghargaan Alfred P. Sloan Feature Film Prize di Sundance Film Festival 2018.

name: Ang Lee
title: Ang Lee
extract: Ang Lee is a Taiwanese filmmaker. His films are known for their emotional charge and exploration of repressed and hidden emotions. During his career, Lee has received international critical and popular acclaim and numerous accolades, including two Academy Awards, four BAFTA Awards, and three Golden Globe Awards. He is also the only filmmaker to win the Golden Bear twice and one of only four filmmakers to win the Golden Lion twice, and received the BAFTA Fellowship in 2020.
extract_id: Ang Lee adalah pembuat film Taiwan. Film-filmnya dikenal karena muatan emosional dan eksplorasi emosi yang tertahan dan tersembunyi. Selama karirnya, Lee menerima pengakuan kritis dan populer secara internasional serta berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards, empat BAFTA Awards, dan tiga Golden Globe Awards. Ia juga satu-satunya pembuat film yang memenangkan Golden Bear dua kali dan salah satu dari empat pembuat film yang memenangkan Golden Lion dua kali, serta menerima BAFTA Fellowship pada 2020.

name: Angela Bassett
title: Angela Bassett
extract: Angela Evelyn Bassett is an American actress. Known for her work in film and television since the 1980s, she has received various accolades, including an Emmy Award and two Golden Globe Awards, as well as nominations for two Academy Awards. In 2023, Time magazine named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world, and she received an Academy Honorary Award.
extract_id: Angela Evelyn Bassett adalah aktris Amerika. Dikenal atas karya-karyanya di film dan televisi sejak 1980-an, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Emmy Award dan dua Golden Globe Awards, serta nominasi dua Academy Awards. Pada 2023, majalah Time menamainya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia, dan ia menerima Academy Honorary Award.

name: Angela Lansbury
title: Angela Lansbury
extract: Dame Angela Brigid Lansbury was an Irish-British and American actress and singer. In a career spanning 80 years, she played various roles across film, stage, and television. Although based for much of her life in the United States, her work attracted international attention.
extract_id: Dame Angela Brigid Lansbury adalah aktris dan penyanyi Irlandia-Inggris dan Amerika. Dalam karirnya yang berlangsung selama 80 tahun, ia memainkan berbagai peran di film, panggung, dan televisi. Meskipun sebagian besar hidupnya berbasis di Amerika Serikat, karyanya menarik perhatian internasional.

name: Angelina Jolie
title: Angelina Jolie
extract: Angelina Jolie is an American actress, filmmaker, and humanitarian. She is the recipient of numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, a Tony Award and three Golden Globe Awards. Films in which she has appeared have grossed over $6.9 billion worldwide. She has been named Hollywood's highest-paid actress multiple times.
extract_id: Angelina Jolie adalah aktris, pembuat film, dan pekerja kemanusiaan Amerika. Ia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Tony Award, dan tiga Golden Globe Awards. Film-film yang diperankannya menghasilkan lebih dari $6,9 miliar secara global. Ia telah beberapa kali dinobatkan sebagai aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di Hollywood.

name: Angie Dickinson
title: Angie Dickinson
extract: Angeline Dickinson is a retired American actress. She began her career on television, appearing in many anthology series during the 1950s, before gaining her breakthrough role in Gun the Man Down (1956) with James Arness and the Western film Rio Bravo (1959) with John Wayne and Dean Martin, for which she received the Golden Globe Award for New Star of the Year.
extract_id: Angeline Dickinson adalah aktris Amerika yang sudah pensiun. Ia memulai karirnya di televisi, tampil dalam banyak serial antologi selama 1950-an, sebelum mendapatkan peran terobosannya dalam Gun the Man Down (1956) bersama James Arness dan film Western Rio Bravo (1959) bersama John Wayne dan Dean Martin, yang memberinya Golden Globe Award untuk New Star of the Year.

name: Angus Macfadyen
title: Angus Macfadyen
extract: Angus Macfadyen is a Scottish actor. His roles include Robert the Bruce, both in Braveheart and Robert the Bruce, Komodo in Warriors of Virtue, Vice-Counsel Dupont in Equilibrium, Jeff Denlon in the Saw franchise, Robert Rogers in the AMC historical drama Turn: Washington's Spies, McCreedy in Cameron Crowe's We Bought a Zoo, and biologist James Murray in The Lost City of Z. He has made appearances on several television series such as Californication, Criminal Minds, Chuck, and Superman & Lois.
extract_id: Angus Macfadyen adalah aktor Skotlandia. Perannya termasuk Robert the Bruce dalam Braveheart dan Robert the Bruce, Komodo dalam Warriors of Virtue, Wakil Konsul Dupont dalam Equilibrium, Jeff Denlon dalam franchise Saw, Robert Rogers dalam drama sejarah AMC Turn: Washington's Spies, McCreedy dalam We Bought a Zoo karya Cameron Crowe, dan ahli biologi James Murray dalam The Lost City of Z. Ia juga tampil dalam beberapa serial televisi seperti Californication, Criminal Minds, Chuck, dan Superman & Lois.

name: Anil Dhawan
title: Anil Dhawan
extract: Anil Dhawan is an Indian actor who appears in Hindi films and television. He made his acting debut with Chetna (1970) and followed it up with a big hit in Piya Ka Ghar (1971). He is also known for his 2018 film Andhadhun.
extract_id: Anil Dhawan adalah aktor India yang tampil dalam film dan televisi Hindi. Ia memulai debut aktingnya dengan Chetna (1970) dan kemudian mendapat hits besar dengan Piya Ka Ghar (1971). Ia juga dikenal lewat film Andhadhun (2018).

name: Aniruddha Roy Chowdhury
title: Aniruddha Roy Chowdhury
extract: Aniruddha Roy Chowdhury is an Indian film director. He is the director and producer of multiple Bengali and Hindi films. He directed the highly successful Hindi movie Pink which received accolades from film critics and movie lovers alike.
extract_id: Aniruddha Roy Chowdhury adalah sutradara film India. Ia adalah sutradara dan produser dari beberapa film Bengali dan Hindi. Ia menyutradarai film Hindi yang sangat sukses Pink yang mendapat pujian dari kritikus film dan penikmat film.

name: Anita Ekberg
title: Anita Ekberg
extract: Kerstin Anita Marianne Ekberg was a Swedish actress active in American and European films, known for her beauty and curvaceous figure. She became prominent in her iconic role as Sylvia in the Federico Fellini film La Dolce Vita (1960). Ekberg worked primarily in Italy, where she became a permanent resident in 1964.
extract_id: Kerstin Anita Marianne Ekberg adalah aktris Swedia yang aktif di film Amerika dan Eropa, dikenal karena kecantikan dan bentuk tubuhnya yang berlekuk. Ia menjadi terkenal lewat perannya yang ikonik sebagai Sylvia dalam film Federico Fellini La Dolce Vita (1960). Ekberg bekerja terutama di Italia, di mana ia menjadi penduduk tetap pada 1964.

name: Anjelica Huston
title: Anjelica Huston
extract: Anjelica Huston is an American actress. Known for often portraying eccentric and distinctive characters, she has received multiple accolades, including an Academy Award and a Golden Globe Award, as well as nominations for three British Academy Film Awards and six Primetime Emmy Awards. In 2010, she was awarded a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
extract_id: Anjelica Huston adalah aktris Amerika. Dikenal sering memerankan karakter eksentrik dan khas, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award dan Golden Globe Award, serta nominasi untuk tiga British Academy Film Awards dan enam Primetime Emmy Awards. Pada 2010, ia dianugerahi bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame.

name: Ann Dvorak
title: Ann Dvorak
extract: Ann Dvorak was an American stage and film actress.
extract_id: Ann Dvorak adalah aktris panggung dan film Amerika.

name: Ann Reinking
title: Ann Reinking
extract: Ann Reinking was an American dancer, actress, choreographer, and singer. As a star of Broadway musicals, her credits include Over Here! (1974), Goodtime Charley (1975), Chicago (1977), Dancin' (1978), and Sweet Charity (1986). On screen, her films include All That Jazz (1979), Annie (1982), and Micki & Maude (1984).
extract_id: Ann Reinking adalah penari, aktris, koreografer, dan penyanyi Amerika. Sebagai bintang musikal Broadway, kredensialnya meliputi Over Here! (1974), Goodtime Charley (1975), Chicago (1977), Dancin' (1978), dan Sweet Charity (1986). Di layar lebar, film-filmnya termasuk All That Jazz (1979), Annie (1982), dan Micki & Maude (1984).

name: Anna Faris
title: Anna Faris
extract: Anna Kay Faris is an American actress, comedian, producer, writer, podcaster, and author. She rose to prominence for her comedic roles, particularly the lead part of Cindy Campbell in the Scary Movie films (2000–present). Her films as a leading actress have grossed over $1.5 billion worldwide.
extract_id: Anna Kay Faris adalah aktris, komedian, produser, penulis, podcaster, dan penulis Amerika. Ia dikenal berkat peran-peran komedinya, khususnya sebagai pemeran utama Cindy Campbell dalam film-film Scary Movie (2000–sekarang). Film-filmnya sebagai aktris utama telah meraup lebih dari $1,5 miliar secara global.

name: Anna Foglietta
title: Anna Foglietta
extract: Anna Foglietta is an Italian actress. She has appeared in the films Escort in Love and Ex – Amici come prima!. She has also appeared in several television series such as Distretto di Polizia and The Mafia Kills Only in Summer.
extract_id: Anna Foglietta adalah seorang aktris Italia. Dia telah tampil dalam film Escort in Love dan Ex – Amici come prima!. Dia juga pernah tampil dalam beberapa serial televisi seperti Distretto di Polizia dan The Mafia Kills Only in Summer.

name: Anna Karina
title: Anna Karina
extract: Anna Karina was a Danish and French film actress, director, writer, model, and singer. She was an early collaborator of French New Wave director Jean-Luc Godard, her first husband, performing in several of his films, including The Little Soldier (1960), A Woman Is a Woman (1961), My Life to Live (1962), Bande à part, Pierrot le Fou (1965), and Alphaville (1965). For her performance in A Woman Is a Woman, Karina won the Silver Bear Award for Best Actress at the Berlin Film Festival.
extract_id: Anna Karina adalah seorang aktris film Denmark dan Prancis, sutradara, penulis, model, dan penyanyi. Dia adalah kolaborator awal dari sutradara French New Wave Jean-Luc Godard, suami pertamanya, yang tampil dalam beberapa filmnya, termasuk The Little Soldier (1960), A Woman Is a Woman (1961), My Life to Live (1962), Bande à part, Pierrot le Fou (1965), dan Alphaville (1965). Untuk penampilannya dalam A Woman Is a Woman, Karina memenangkan Silver Bear Award untuk Aktris Terbaik di Festival Film Berlin.

name: Anna Kendrick
title: Anna Kendrick
extract: Anna Cooke Kendrick is an American actress, singer, and film director. Known for playing upbeat and endearing characters in comedies and musicals, her accolades include nominations for an Academy Award, a Primetime Emmy Award and a Tony Award.
extract_id: Anna Cooke Kendrick adalah seorang aktris, penyanyi, dan sutradara film Amerika. Dikenal karena memerankan karakter yang ceria dan menggemaskan dalam komedi dan musikal, pencapaiannya termasuk nominasi untuk Academy Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dan Tony Award.

name: Anna Massey
title: Anna Massey
extract: Anna Raymond Massey was an English actress. She won a BAFTA Best Actress Award for the role of Edith Hope in the 1986 TV adaptation of Anita Brookner's novel Hotel du Lac, a role that one of her co-stars, Julia McKenzie, has said "could have been written for her". Massey is also well known for her roles in Michael Powell's Peeping Tom (1960) and Alfred Hitchcock's Frenzy (1972), each as a woman who becomes involved with a suspected killer. She performed over one hundred character roles in British film and television. On the stage, in 1982, Massey won the Laurence Olivier Award for Actress of the Year in a Supporting Role for The Importance of Being Earnest and was nominated for the Award for Actress of the Year in a New Play for Summer.
extract_id: Anna Raymond Massey adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Dia memenangkan BAFTA Best Actress Award untuk peran Edith Hope dalam adaptasi TV tahun 1986 dari novel Anita Brookner Hotel du Lac, sebuah peran yang menurut salah satu rekan mainnya, Julia McKenzie, "bisa saja ditulis untuknya". Massey juga dikenal luas karena perannya dalam Michael Powell's Peeping Tom (1960) dan Alfred Hitchcock's Frenzy (1972), masing-masing sebagai seorang wanita yang terlibat dengan pembunuh yang dicurigai. Dia telah memerankan lebih dari seratus karakter dalam film dan televisi Inggris. Di panggung, pada tahun 1982, Massey memenangkan Laurence Olivier Award untuk Aktris Tahun Ini dalam Peran Pendukung untuk The Importance of Being Earnest dan dinominasikan untuk Award for Actress of the Year in a New Play untuk Summer.

name: Annalise Basso
title: Annalise Basso
extract: Annalise Basso is an American actress and model. She is best known for her role as LJ Folger in the post-apocalyptic dystopian thriller series Snowpiercer (2020–2022). She started her career as a child actress, appearing in the films Bedtime Stories (2008), Love Takes Wing (2009), Standing Up (2013) and Oculus (2013). From 2014 until 2015, she starred in the television series The Red Road.
extract_id: Annalise Basso adalah seorang aktris dan model Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai LJ Folger dalam serial thriller distopia pasca-apokaliptik Snowpiercer (2020–2022). Dia memulai kariernya sebagai aktris cilik, tampil dalam film Bedtime Stories (2008), Love Takes Wing (2009), Standing Up (2013) dan Oculus (2013). Dari 2014 hingga 2015, dia membintangi serial televisi The Red Road.

name: Anne Bancroft
title: Anne Bancroft
extract: Anne Bancroft was an American actress. Respected for her acting prowess and versatility, Bancroft received an Academy Award, three BAFTA Awards, two Golden Globe Awards, two Tony Awards, two Primetime Emmy Awards, and a Cannes Film Festival Award. She is one of 24 thespians to achieve the Triple Crown of Acting.
extract_id: Anne Bancroft adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dihormati karena kepiawaian dan keberagaman aktingnya, Bancroft menerima Academy Award, tiga BAFTA Awards, dua Golden Globe Awards, dua Tony Awards, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan penghargaan Festival Film Cannes. Dia adalah salah satu dari 24 pemain yang telah mencapai Triple Crown of Acting.

name: Anne Baxter
title: Anne Baxter
extract: Anne Baxter was an American actress, star of Hollywood films, Broadway productions, and television series. She won an Academy Award, a Golden Globe, and seven Photoplay Awards, and was nominated for an Emmy and two Laurel Awards.
extract_id: Anne Baxter adalah seorang aktris Amerika, bintang film Hollywood, produksi Broadway, dan serial televisi. Dia memenangkan Academy Award, Golden Globe, dan tujuh Photoplay Awards, serta dinominasikan untuk Emmy dan dua Laurel Awards.

name: Anne Dorval
title: Anne Dorval
extract: Anne Dorval is a French Canadian television, stage, and film actress. She is known for her work with Xavier Dolan that includes appearing in five of his films, I Killed My Mother (2009), Heartbeats (2010), Laurence Anyways (2012), Mommy (2014) and Matthias & Maxime (2019).
extract_id: Anne Dorval adalah seorang aktris televisi, panggung, dan film Kanada Prancis. Dia dikenal karena karyanya dengan Xavier Dolan yang mencakup tampil dalam lima filmnya, I Killed My Mother (2009), Heartbeats (2010), Laurence Anyways (2012), Mommy (2014) dan Matthias & Maxime (2019).

name: Anne Hathaway
title: Anne Hathaway
extract: Anne Jacqueline Hathaway is an American actress. Her work encompasses both screen and stage, and her accolades include an Academy Award, a British Academy Film Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award. Her films have grossed more than $6.7 billion worldwide.
extract_id: Anne Jacqueline Hathaway adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Karyanya mencakup layar dan panggung, dan pencapaiannya meliputi Academy Award, British Academy Film Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Primetime Emmy Award. Film-filmnya telah menghasilkan lebih dari $6,7 miliar di seluruh dunia.

name: Anne Le Ny
title: Anne Le Ny
description: French actress, screenwriter and film director (born 1962)
extract: Anne Le Ny is a French actress, screenwriter and film director.
extract_id: Anne Le Ny adalah seorang aktris, penulis skenario dan sutradara film Prancis.

name: Anne-Marie Duff
title: Anne-Marie Duff
extract: Anne-Marie Duff is a British actress and narrator. She is best known for her BAFTA-nominated television roles in Shameless and The Virgin Queen, and her performance as Grace Williams in Bad Sisters, for which she won the Best Supporting Actress BAFTA in 2024.
extract_id: Anne-Marie Duff adalah seorang aktris dan narator Inggris. Dia paling dikenal karena peran televisi nominasi BAFTA-nya dalam Shameless dan The Virgin Queen, serta penampilannya sebagai Grace Williams dalam Bad Sisters, yang membuatnya memenangkan Best Supporting Actress BAFTA pada 2024.

name: Annette Bening
title: Annette Bening
extract: Annette Carol Bening is an American actress. With a career spanning over four decades, she is known for her versatile work across screen and stage. Bening has received numerous accolades, including a BAFTA Award, two Actor Awards, and two Golden Globe Awards, in addition to nominations for five Academy Awards, two Tony Awards, and a Primetime Emmy Award, making her one of few artists nominated for the Triple Crown of Acting without winning.
extract_id: Annette Carol Bening adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dengan karier yang berlangsung lebih dari empat dekade, dia dikenal karena karya serbagunanya di layar dan panggung. Bening telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk BAFTA Award, dua Actor Awards, dan dua Golden Globe Awards, selain nominasi untuk lima Academy Awards, dua Tony Awards, dan satu Primetime Emmy Award, menjadikannya salah satu dari sedikit artis yang dinominasikan untuk Triple Crown of Acting tanpa memenangkan satu pun.

name: Annie Corley
title: Annie Corley
extract: Ann Parr "Annie" Corley is an American actress who has appeared in a wide variety of films and television shows since 1990. She may be best known for playing the daughter of Meryl Streep's character in the 1995 film The Bridges of Madison County.
extract_id: Ann Parr "Annie" Corley adalah seorang aktris Amerika yang telah tampil dalam berbagai film dan acara televisi sejak 1990. Dia mungkin paling dikenal karena memerankan putri dari karakter Meryl Streep dalam film The Bridges of Madison County (1995).

name: Annie Potts
title: Annie Potts
extract: Anne Hampton Potts is an American actress. She was nominated for a Golden Globe Award for Corvette Summer (1978) and won a Genie Award for Heartaches (1981), before appearing in Ghostbusters (1984), Ghostbusters II (1989), and in various projects within the Ghostbusters franchise. She also appeared in the films Pretty in Pink (1986), Jumpin' Jack Flash (1986), and Who's Harry Crumb? (1989). She voiced Bo Peep in the Toy Story franchise and in various Disney video games.
extract_id: Anne Hampton Potts adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award untuk Corvette Summer (1978) dan memenangkan Genie Award untuk Heartaches (1981), sebelum tampil dalam Ghostbusters (1984), Ghostbusters II (1989), dan berbagai proyek dalam franchise Ghostbusters. Dia juga tampil dalam film Pretty in Pink (1986), Jumpin' Jack Flash (1986), dan Who's Harry Crumb? (1989). Dia mengisi suara Bo Peep dalam franchise Toy Story dan berbagai video game Disney.

name: Annika Wedderkopp
title: Annika Wedderkopp
extract: Annika Hedegaard Wedderkopp, known mononymously as Annika, is a Danish actress and singer. As a child, she starred in The Hunt (2012) opposite Mads Mikkelsen. As a singer signed to Universal Music Denmark, she has charted three number-one songs in Denmark, starting in 2024 with "Sammen", a collaboration with Marstein. The song also reached number-one in Norway, marking her second after "Så længe jeg er sexy". Her debut album, AW, topped the Danish albums chart in 2025 and has been certified quadruple-platinum by IFPI Danmark.
extract_id: Annika Hedegaard Wedderkopp, yang dikenal secara mononim sebagai Annika, adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Denmark. Saat kecil, dia membintangi The Hunt (2012) berlawanan dengan Mads Mikkelsen. Sebagai penyanyi yang ditandatangani dengan Universal Music Denmark, dia telah mencetak tiga lagu nomor satu di Denmark, dimulai pada 2024 dengan "Sammen", kolaborasi dengan Marstein. Lagu tersebut juga mencapai nomor satu di Norwegia, menandai kedua kalinya setelah "Så længe jeg er sexy". Album debutnya, AW, memuncaki tangga lagu album Denmark pada 2025 dan telah disertifikasi quadruple-platinum oleh IFPI Danmark.

name: Annu Kapoor
title: Annu Kapoor
extract: Annu Kapoor is an Indian actor, singer, director, radio disc jockey, and television presenter who has appeared in over a hundred films, as well as television series. His career has spanned over 45 years as an actor, producer, director and singer. Besides acting, he also does a Radio show, named Suhaana Safar With Annu Kapoor which is broadcast on 92.7 Big FM. He has won numerous awards in his career, including two National Film Awards, one Filmfare Award and two Indian Television Academy Awards.
extract_id: Annu Kapoor adalah seorang aktor, penyanyi, sutradara, disc jockey radio, dan presenter televisi India yang telah tampil dalam lebih dari seratus film, serta serial televisi. Kariernya telah berlangsung lebih dari 45 tahun sebagai aktor, produser, sutradara, dan penyanyi. Selain berakting, ia juga menyajikan acara radio, bernama Suhaana Safar With Annu Kapoor yang disiarkan di 92.7 Big FM. Ia telah memenangkan banyak penghargaan dalam kariernya, termasuk dua National Film Awards, satu Filmfare Award, dan dua Indian Television Academy Awards.

name: Anouk Aimée
title: Anouk Aimée
extract: Nicole Françoise Florence Dreyfus, known professionally as Anouk Aimée or Anouk, was a French film actress who appeared in 70 films from 1947 until 2019. Having begun her film career at age 14, she studied acting and dance in her early years, besides her regular education. Although the majority of her films were French, she also made films in Spain, the United Kingdom, Italy and Germany, along with some American productions.
extract_id: Nicole Françoise Florence Dreyfus, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Anouk Aimée atau Anouk, adalah seorang aktris film Prancis yang muncul dalam 70 film dari 1947 hingga 2019. Setelah memulai karier filmnya pada usia 14 tahun, dia belajar akting dan tari di tahun-tahun awalnya, selain pendidikan regulernya. Meskipun sebagian besar filmnya adalah film Prancis, dia juga membuat film di Spanyol, Inggris, Italia, dan Jerman, bersama beberapa produksi Amerika.

name: Ansel Elgort
title: Ansel Elgort
extract: Ansel Elgort is an American actor and singer. He began his acting career with a supporting role in the horror film Carrie (2013). He gained wider recognition for starring as a teenage cancer patient in the romantic drama film The Fault in Our Stars (2014) and for his supporting role in The Divergent Series (2014–2016).
extract_id: Ansel Elgort adalah seorang aktor dan penyanyi Amerika. Dia memulai karier aktingnya dengan peran pendukung dalam film horor Carrie (2013). Dia mendapatkan pengakuan lebih luas dengan berperan sebagai pasien kanker remaja dalam film drama romantis The Fault in Our Stars (2014) dan peran pendukungnya dalam The Divergent Series (2014–2016).

name: Anthony Chau-Sang Wong
title: Anthony Wong
extract: Anthony Wong Chau-sang is a Hong Kong film actor, film director and singer, known for his intense portrayals of often-amoral characters. He has won the Hong Kong Film Award for Best Actor three times for The Untold Story (1993), Beast Cops (1998) and Still Human (2018), and won Taiwan's Golden Horse Award for Best Actor for The Sunny Side of the Street (2022). He is the first Hong Kong actor to have won Best Actor awards in films, stage theatre and TV. His other works include Hard Boiled (1992), Infernal Affairs trilogy (2002–2003) and the Hollywood film The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor (2008).
extract_id: Anthony Wong Chau-sang adalah seorang aktor film, sutradara film, dan penyanyi asal Hong Kong, dikenal karena penggambaran intens karakternya yang sering amoral. Dia telah memenangkan Hong Kong Film Award untuk Aktor Terbaik tiga kali untuk The Untold Story (1993), Beast Cops (1998) dan Still Human (2018), serta memenangkan Taiwan's Golden Horse Award untuk Aktor Terbaik untuk The Sunny Side of the Street (2022). Dia adalah aktor Hong Kong pertama yang memenangkan penghargaan Aktor Terbaik di film, teater panggung, dan TV. Karya lainnya termasuk Hard Boiled (1992), trilogi Infernal Affairs (2002–2003) dan film Hollywood The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor (2008).

name: Anthony Edwards
title: Anthony Edwards (actor)
extract: Anthony Charles Edwards is an American actor, director, and producer. He played Dr. Mark Greene on the first eight seasons of ER, for which he received a Golden Globe Award and six Screen Actors Guild Awards, and was nominated for four consecutive Primetime Emmy Awards. He has appeared in various films and television series, including Fast Times at Ridgemont High, Top Gun, Zodiac, Gotcha!, Miracle Mile, Revenge of the Nerds, Thunderbirds, Planes, Northern Exposure, and Designated Survivor.
extract_id: Anthony Charles Edwards adalah seorang aktor, sutradara, dan produser Amerika. Dia memerankan Dr. Mark Greene dalam delapan musim pertama ER, yang membuatnya menerima Golden Globe Award dan enam Screen Actors Guild Awards, serta dinominasikan untuk empat Primetime Emmy Awards berturut-turut. Dia telah tampil dalam berbagai film dan serial televisi, termasuk Fast Times at Ridgemont High, Top Gun, Zodiac, Gotcha!, Miracle Mile, Revenge of the Nerds, Thunderbirds, Planes, Northern Exposure, dan Designated Survivor.

name: Anthony Gonzalez
title: Anthony Gonzalez (actor)
extract: Anthony Gonzalez is an American actor. He has appeared in the TV series The Bridge (2014) and Criminal Minds: Beyond Borders (2017), and as the voice of Miguel in the Pixar film Coco (2017). He also provided the motion capture and voice for the character of Diego Castillo in the video game Far Cry 6 (2021).
extract_id: Anthony Gonzalez adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia pernah tampil dalam serial TV The Bridge (2014) dan Criminal Minds: Beyond Borders (2017), serta sebagai suara Miguel dalam film Pixar Coco (2017). Dia juga memberikan motion capture dan suara untuk karakter Diego Castillo dalam video game Far Cry 6 (2021).

name: Anthony Harvey
title: Anthony Harvey
extract: Anthony Harvey was an English filmmaker who began his career as a teenage actor, was a film editor in the 1950s, and moved into directing in the mid-1960s. Harvey had fifteen film credits as an editor, and he directed thirteen films, the second of which, The Lion in Winter (1968), earned him a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Director. Harvey's career is also notable for his recurring work with a number of leading actors and directors including Terry-Thomas, Peter Sellers, Katharine Hepburn, Peter O'Toole, Richard Attenborough, Liv Ullmann, Sam Waterston, Nick Nolte, the Boulting Brothers, Anthony Asquith, Bryan Forbes and Stanley Kubrick. He died in November 2017 at the age of 87.
extract_id: Anthony Harvey adalah seorang pembuat film Inggris yang memulai kariernya sebagai aktor remaja, menjadi editor film pada 1950-an, dan beralih menjadi sutradara pada pertengahan 1960-an. Harvey memiliki lima belas kredit film sebagai editor, dan dia menyutradarai tiga belas film, di antaranya yang kedua, The Lion in Winter (1968), memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik. Karier Harvey juga terkenal karena kerjanya berulang dengan sejumlah aktor dan sutradara terkemuka termasuk Terry-Thomas, Peter Sellers, Katharine Hepburn, Peter O'Toole, Richard Attenborough, Liv Ullmann, Sam Waterston, Nick Nolte, Boulting Brothers, Anthony Asquith, Bryan Forbes, dan Stanley Kubrick. Dia meninggal pada November 2017 pada usia 87 tahun.

name: Anthony Hopkins
title: Anthony Hopkins
extract: Sir Philip Anthony Hopkins is a Welsh actor. Considered one of Britain's most recognisable and prolific actors, he is known for his performances on the screen and stage. Hopkins has received numerous accolades, including two Academy Awards, four BAFTA Awards, two Primetime Emmy Awards, and a Laurence Olivier Award. He has also received the Cecil B. DeMille Award in 2005 and the BAFTA Fellowship for lifetime achievement in 2008. He was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II for his services to drama in 1993.
extract_id: Sir Philip Anthony Hopkins adalah seorang aktor Wales. Dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor Inggris yang paling dikenali dan produktif, ia dikenal karena penampilannya di layar dan panggung. Hopkins telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards, empat BAFTA Awards, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan Laurence Olivier Award. Ia juga menerima Cecil B. DeMille Award pada 2005 dan BAFTA Fellowship untuk pencapaian seumur hidup pada 2008. Ia dianugerahi gelar kebangsawanan oleh Ratu Elizabeth II atas jasanya dalam bidang drama pada 1993.

name: Anthony Michael Hall
title: Anthony Michael Hall
extract: Anthony Michael Hall is an American actor. Following his film debut in Six Pack (1982) and a supporting role as Russell "Rusty" Griswold in National Lampoon's Vacation (1983), Hall had his breakout with starring roles in three John Hughes-directed films: Sixteen Candles, The Breakfast Club, and Weird Science. Mainstream media associated Hall with a group of young actors known as the "Brat Pack" due to his roles in those films.
extract_id: Anthony Michael Hall adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Setelah debut filmnya di Six Pack (1982) dan peran pendukung sebagai Russell "Rusty" Griswold dalam National Lampoon's Vacation (1983), Hall mendapatkan terobosan dengan peran utama dalam tiga film yang disutradarai John Hughes: Sixteen Candles, The Breakfast Club, dan Weird Science. Media arus utama mengaitkan Hall dengan kelompok aktor muda yang dikenal sebagai "Brat Pack" karena perannya dalam film-film tersebut.

name: Anthony Perkins
title: Anthony Perkins
extract: Anthony Perkins was an American actor. He is best known for portraying Norman Bates in Alfred Hitchcock's 1960 film Psycho.
extract_id: Anthony Perkins adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan Norman Bates dalam film Alfred Hitchcock tahun 1960 Psycho.

name: Anthony Quinn
title: Anthony Quinn
extract: Manuel Antonio Rodolfo Quinn Oaxaca, known as Anthony Quinn, was a Mexican and American actor. He was known for his portrayal of earthy, passionate characters "marked by a brutal and elemental virility" in over 100 film, television and stage roles between 1936 and 2001. He was a two-time Academy Award winner, and was also nominated for five Golden Globe Awards, two BAFTA Awards and a Tony Award.
extract_id: Manuel Antonio Rodolfo Quinn Oaxaca, dikenal sebagai Anthony Quinn, adalah aktor Meksiko dan Amerika. Dia dikenal karena peranannya yang menggambarkan karakter yang alami dan penuh gairah "ditandai oleh virilitas yang brutal dan fundamental" dalam lebih dari 100 peran film, televisi, dan panggung antara 1936 dan 2001. Dia adalah pemenang Academy Award dua kali, dan juga dinominasikan untuk lima Golden Globe Awards, dua BAFTA Awards, dan satu Tony Award.

name: Anthony Russo
title: Russo brothers
extract: Anthony J. Russo and Joseph Vincent Russo, collectively known as the Russo brothers, are American filmmakers. They are best known for directing four films in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU): Captain America: The Winter Soldier (2014), Captain America: Civil War (2016), Avengers: Infinity War (2018), and Avengers: Endgame (2019). The pair are the fourth-highest-grossing directors of all time, with Endgame grossing over $2.937 billion worldwide and becoming the highest-grossing film of all time.
extract_id: Anthony J. Russo dan Joseph Vincent Russo, secara kolektif dikenal sebagai saudara Russo, adalah pembuat film Amerika. Mereka paling dikenal sebagai sutradara empat film di Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU): Captain America: The Winter Soldier (2014), Captain America: Civil War (2016), Avengers: Infinity War (2018), dan Avengers: Endgame (2019). Pasangan ini adalah sutradara dengan pendapatan tertinggi keempat sepanjang masa, dengan Endgame meraup lebih dari $2,937 miliar di seluruh dunia dan menjadi film dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa.

name: Antoine Fuqua
title: Antoine Fuqua
extract: Antoine Fuqua is an American director and producer. Known for his work on film, television, and music videos, and for his work in the action and thriller genres, he was originally known as a director of music videos, and made his film debut in 1998 with The Replacement Killers. His critical breakthrough was the 2001 crime thriller Training Day, winning the Black Reel Award for Outstanding Director.
extract_id: Antoine Fuqua adalah sutradara dan produser Amerika. Dikenal untuk karyanya dalam film, televisi, dan video musik, serta untuk karyanya di genre aksi dan thriller, dia awalnya dikenal sebagai sutradara video musik, dan debut filmnya pada tahun 1998 dengan The Replacement Killers. Terobosan kritiknya adalah thriller kejahatan tahun 2001 Training Day, memenangkan Black Reel Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik.

name: Antoine Olivier Pilon
title: Antoine Olivier Pilon
extract: Antoine Olivier Pilon is a Canadian actor.
extract_id: Antoine Olivier Pilon adalah aktor Kanada.

name: Anton Corbijn
title: Anton Corbijn
description: Dutch film director, video director, and photographer (born 1955)
extract: Anton Johannes Gerrit Corbijn van Willenswaard is a Dutch photographer, film director, and music video director. He is the creative director behind the visual output of Depeche Mode and U2, having handled the principal promotion and sleeve photography for both bands over three decades. His music videos include Depeche Mode's "Enjoy the Silence" (1990), U2's "One" (1991), Bryan Adams' "Do I Have to Say the Words?", Nirvana's "Heart-Shaped Box" (1993), Travis's "Re-Offender" (2003) and Coldplay's "Talk" (2005) and "Viva la Vida" (2008).
extract_id: Anton Johannes Gerrit Corbijn van Willenswaard adalah fotografer, sutradara film, dan sutradara video musik Belanda. Dia adalah direktur kreatif di balik keluaran visual Depeche Mode dan U2, yang menangani promosi utama dan fotografi sampul untuk kedua band selama tiga dekade. Video musiknya termasuk "Enjoy the Silence" (1990) oleh Depeche Mode, "One" (1991) oleh U2, "Do I Have to Say the Words?" oleh Bryan Adams, "Heart-Shaped Box" (1993) oleh Nirvana, "Re-Offender" (2003) oleh Travis dan "Talk" (2005) serta "Viva la Vida" (2008) oleh Coldplay.

name: Anton Walbrook
title: Anton Walbrook
extract: Adolf Anton Wilhelm Wohlbrück was an Austrian actor who settled in the United Kingdom under the name Anton Walbrook. A popular performer in Austria and pre-war Germany, he left Germany in 1936 out of concerns for his own safety and established a career in British cinema. Walbrook is perhaps best known for his roles in the original British film of Gaslight, The Life and Death of Colonel Blimp, The Red Shoes and Victoria the Great.
extract_id: Adolf Anton Wilhelm Wohlbrück adalah aktor Austria yang menetap di Inggris dengan nama Anton Walbrook. Sebagai seorang pemeran populer di Austria dan Jerman sebelum perang, dia meninggalkan Jerman pada tahun 1936 karena kekhawatiran akan keselamatannya sendiri dan membangun karier di perfilman Inggris. Walbrook mungkin paling dikenal karena perannya dalam film Britania asli Gaslight, The Life and Death of Colonel Blimp, The Red Shoes, dan Victoria the Great.

name: Antonella Attili
title: Antonella Attili
extract: Antonella Attili is an Italian film, theater and television actress.
extract_id: Antonella Attili adalah aktris Italia film, teater, dan televisi.

title: Antonia San Juan

name: Antonio Banderas
title: Antonio Banderas
extract: José Antonio Domínguez Bandera, known professionally as Antonio Banderas, is a Spanish actor. Known for his work in films of several genres, he has received numerous accolades, including a Cannes Film Festival Award and a Goya Award, as well as nominations for an Academy Award, two Primetime Emmy Awards, five Golden Globe Awards, and a Tony Award.
extract_id: José Antonio Domínguez Bandera, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Antonio Banderas, adalah aktor Spanyol. Dikenal atas karyanya dalam film dengan berbagai genre, dia telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Penghargaan Festival Film Cannes dan Penghargaan Goya, serta nominasi untuk Academy Award, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, lima Golden Globe Awards, dan satu Tony Award.

name: Antonio Resines
title: Antonio Resines
extract: Antonio Fernández Resines is a Spanish film and television actor.
extract_id: Antonio Fernández Resines adalah aktor film dan televisi asal Spanyol.

name: Anupam Kher
title: Anupam Kher
extract: Anupam Kher is an Indian actor, director and producer who works primarily in Hindi cinema. In a career spanning over four decades, he has acted in more than 540 films. A veteran of Indian cinema, Kher is recipient of two National Film Awards and eight Filmfare Awards for his acting performances. Government of India awarded him the Padma Shri in 2004 and the Padma Bhushan in 2016 for his contribution to Indian cinema and arts.
extract_id: Anupam Kher adalah aktor, sutradara, dan produser India yang bekerja terutama di perfilman Hindi. Dalam karier yang berlangsung lebih dari empat dekade, dia telah berakting dalam lebih dari 540 film. Sebagai veteran perfilman India, Kher menerima dua National Film Awards dan delapan Filmfare Awards untuk penampilan aktingnya. Pemerintah India menganugerahinya Padma Shri pada tahun 2004 dan Padma Bhushan pada tahun 2016 atas kontribusinya pada perfilman dan seni India.

name: Anurag Basu
title: Anurag Basu
extract: Anurag Basu (born 8 May 1970) is an Indian director, screenwriter, cinematographer, producer, and actor in Hindi cinema. After initial setbacks, his breakthrough came with the erotic thriller Murder (2004), and gained prominence with the musical romantic thriller Gangster: A Love Story (2006) and the ensemble urban drama Life in a... Metro (2007), the latter of which earned him the Filmfare Award for Best Screenplay and nomination for the Filmfare Award for Best Director.
extract_id: Anurag Basu (lahir 8 Mei 1970) adalah sutradara, penulis skenario, sinematografer, produser, dan aktor India dalam perfilman Hindi. Setelah mengalami beberapa kemunduran awal, terobosan kariernya datang dengan thriller erotis Murder (2004), dan memperoleh ketenaran dengan thriller musikal romantis Gangster: A Love Story (2006) serta drama perkotaan ensembe Life in a... Metro (2007), yang terakhir memberinya Penghargaan Filmfare untuk Skenario Terbaik dan nominasi untuk Sutradara Terbaik Filmfare.

name: Anurag Kashyap
title: Anurag Kashyap
extract: Anurag Kashyap is an Indian filmmaker and actor known for his works in Hindi and Tamil flim .He is the recipient of four Filmfare Awards. The Government of France made him a Knight of the Order of Arts and Letters in 2013.
extract_id: Anurag Kashyap adalah pembuat film dan aktor India yang dikenal atas karyanya dalam film Hindi dan Tamil. Dia menerima empat Filmfare Awards. Pemerintah Perancis mengangkatnya sebagai Knight of the Order of Arts and Letters pada tahun 2013.

name: Anushka Sharma
title: Anushka Sharma
extract: Anushka Sharma is an Indian film actress and producer who works in Hindi films. One of the leading actresses of the 2010s, she is the recipient of several accolades, including one Filmfare Award and three IIFA Awards. Sharma has appeared in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 in the 2010s and was featured by Forbes Asia in their 30 Under 30 list of 2018.
extract_id: Anushka Sharma adalah aktris dan produser film India yang bekerja di film Hindi. Salah satu aktris terkemuka pada tahun 2010-an, dia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk satu Filmfare Award dan tiga IIFA Awards. Sharma pernah masuk dalam daftar Celebrity 100 Forbes India pada 2010-an dan juga tampil dalam daftar 30 Under 30 Forbes Asia tahun 2018.

name: Anushka Shetty
title: Anushka Shetty
extract: Sweety Shetty, known professionally as Anushka Shetty, is an Indian actress known for her works in Tamil and Telugu films. With a career spanning over two decades as a lead actress in a variety of roles, Shetty is popularly referred to as "Queen of South Indian cinema" in the media. One of the highest-paid actresses in India, she is the recipient of three Filmfare Awards South, two Nandi Awards, two SIIMA Awards and one Tamil Nadu State Film Award. Shetty was honoured with Kalaimamani in 2010 by the Government of Tamil Nadu.
extract_id: Sweety Shetty, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Anushka Shetty, adalah aktris India yang dikenal atas karya-karyanya dalam film Tamil dan Telugu. Dengan karier yang berlangsung lebih dari dua dekade sebagai aktris utama dalam berbagai peran, Shetty secara populer disebut sebagai "Queen of South Indian cinema" di media. Sebagai salah satu aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di India, dia menerima tiga Filmfare Awards South, dua Nandi Awards, dua SIIMA Awards, dan satu Penghargaan Film Negara Bagian Tamil Nadu. Shetty dianugerahi Kalaimamani pada tahun 2010 oleh Pemerintah Tamil Nadu.

name: Aoi Miyazaki
title: Aoi Miyazaki
extract: Aoi Miyazaki is a Japanese actress. She is known for her roles in Nana and Virgin Snow.
extract_id: Aoi Miyazaki adalah aktris Jepang. Dia dikenal karena perannya dalam Nana dan Virgin Snow.

name: Aoi Yûki
title: Aoi Yūki
extract: Aoi Yabusaki , better known by her stage name Aoi Yūki , is a Japanese actress and singer. She voiced Nodoka Hanadera/Cure Grace in Healin' Good Pretty Cure, Madoka Kaname in Puella Magi Madoka Magica, Tsuyu Asui in My Hero Academia, Komachi Hikigaya in My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU, Rita Rossweisse in Honkai Impact 3rd, Tanya von Degurechaff in The Saga of Tanya the Evil, Lumine in Genshin Impact, Hibiki Tachibana in Senki Zesshou Symphogear, Diane in The Seven Deadly Sins, Tamaki Kotatsu in Fire Force, the young Murasaki Kuhōin in Kure-nai, Mami Nanami in Rent-A-Girlfriend, Kumoko/Shiraori in So I'm a Spider, So What?, Lucy in Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, Futaba Sakura in Persona 5, Sticks the Badger in Sonic Boom, Maomao in The Apothecary Diaries, and Lucy in Ninjala.
extract_id: Aoi Yabusaki, lebih dikenal dengan nama panggungnya Aoi Yūki, adalah aktris dan penyanyi Jepang. Dia mengisi suara Nodoka Hanadera/Cure Grace dalam Healin' Good Pretty Cure, Madoka Kaname dalam Puella Magi Madoka Magica, Tsuyu Asui dalam My Hero Academia, Komachi Hikigaya dalam My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU, Rita Rossweisse dalam Honkai Impact 3rd, Tanya von Degurechaff dalam The Saga of Tanya the Evil, Lumine dalam Genshin Impact, Hibiki Tachibana dalam Senki Zesshou Symphogear, Diane dalam The Seven Deadly Sins, Tamaki Kotatsu dalam Fire Force, Murasaki Kuhōin muda dalam Kure-nai, Mami Nanami dalam Rent-A-Girlfriend, Kumoko/Shiraori dalam So I'm a Spider, So What?, Lucy dalam Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, Futaba Sakura dalam Persona 5, Sticks the Badger dalam Sonic Boom, Maomao dalam The Apothecary Diaries, dan Lucy dalam Ninjala.

name: Aparna Balamurali
title: Aparna Balamurali
extract: Aparna Balamurali is an Indian actress and playback singer, who primarily works in Malayalam and Tamil films. She is the recipient of a National Film Award and a Filmfare Award South. Aparna is known for her roles in the films Maheshinte Prathikaaram (2016), Sunday Holiday (2017), Soorarai Pottru (2020), and Kishkindha Kaandam (2024), winning the National Film Award for Best Actress for Soorarai Pottru. In 2025, Aparna was placed by Forbes Asia in their 30 Under 30 list.
extract_id: Aparna Balamurali adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi playback India, yang terutama bekerja di film Malayalam dan Tamil. Dia adalah penerima National Film Award dan Filmfare Award South. Aparna dikenal atas perannya dalam film Maheshinte Prathikaaram (2016), Sunday Holiday (2017), Soorarai Pottru (2020), dan Kishkindha Kaandam (2024), memenangkan National Film Award untuk Aktris Terbaik untuk Soorarai Pottru. Pada tahun 2025, Aparna masuk dalam daftar 30 Under 30 Forbes Asia.

name: Aras Bulut Iynemli
title: Aras Bulut İynemli
extract: Aras Bulut İynemli is a Turkish actor. He is best known for his performances in As Time Goes by (2010–2013), Insider (2016–2017), The Pit (2017–2021), Miracle in Cell No.7 (2019), and Atatürk 1881 - 1919, the latter earned him a Turkish Film Critics Association Award nomination for Best Actor. In 2018, İynemli won the Golden Butterfly Award for Best Actor for his role in The Pit.
extract_id: Aras Bulut İynemli adalah aktor Turki. Dia paling dikenal untuk penampilannya dalam As Time Goes by (2010–2013), Insider (2016–2017), The Pit (2017–2021), Miracle in Cell No.7 (2019), dan Atatürk 1881 - 1919, yang terakhir memberinya nominasi Turkish Film Critics Association Award untuk Aktor Terbaik. Pada 2018, İynemli memenangkan Golden Butterfly Award untuk Aktor Terbaik untuk perannya dalam The Pit.

name: Archana Jois
title: Archana Jois
extract: Archana Jois is an Indian actress who appears in Kannada films. Jois is known for her role as Shanthamma, Rocky's mother in K.G.F film series. She also received Karnataka State Film Award for Best Actress for her performance in the film #Mute (2022).
extract_id: Archana Jois adalah aktris India yang tampil dalam film Kannada. Jois dikenal atas perannya sebagai Shanthamma, ibu Rocky dalam seri film K.G.F. Dia juga menerima Penghargaan Film Negara Karnakata untuk Aktris Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam film #Mute (2022).

name: Ariadna Gil
title: Ariadna Gil
extract: Ariadna Gil i Giner is a Spanish actress. She is known for her performances in films such as Belle Époque, Black Tears, and Pan's Labyrinth.
extract_id: Ariadna Gil i Giner adalah aktris Spanyol. Dia dikenal atas penampilannya dalam film-film seperti Belle Époque, Black Tears, dan Pan's Labyrinth.

name: Ariane Labed
title: Ariane Labed
extract: Ariane Labed is a French actress and film director. She is known for her feature film debut in Attenberg, for which she won the Volpi Cup for Best Actress, and appearing in Helen Edmundson's film Mary Magdalene in 2018.
extract_id: Ariane Labed adalah aktris dan sutradara film asal Prancis. Dia dikenal atas debut film fitur Attenberg, yang membuatnya memenangkan Volpi Cup untuk Aktris Terbaik, dan tampil dalam film Mary Magdalene karya Helen Edmundson pada 2018.

name: Arifin Putra
title: Arifin Putra
extract: Putra Arifin Scheunemann, known professionally as Arifin Putra, is an Indonesian actor. His international recognition is largely attributed to his role in the Indonesian action film The Raid 2: Berandal, which was released in the United States and other major markets around the world. He also starred in the 2009 Indonesian horror film, Rumah Dara.
extract_id: Putra Arifin Scheunemann, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Arifin Putra, adalah aktor Indonesia. Pengakuan internasionalnya sebagian besar disebabkan oleh perannya dalam film aksi Indonesia The Raid 2: Berandal, yang dirilis di Amerika Serikat dan pasar besar lainnya di seluruh dunia. Ia juga membintangi film horor Indonesia tahun 2009, Rumah Dara.

name: Armando Brancia
title: Armando Brancia
extract: Armando Brancia was an Italian film and television actor.
extract_id: Armando Brancia adalah aktor film dan televisi Italia.

name: Armie Hammer
title: Armie Hammer
extract: Armand Douglas Hammer is an American actor. He began his acting career with guest appearances in several television series. His first leading role was as Billy Graham in the 2008 film Billy: The Early Years and Hammer gained wider recognition for portraying the twins Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in David Fincher's biopic The Social Network (2010).
extract_id: Armand Douglas Hammer adalah aktor Amerika. Dia memulai karier aktingnya dengan penampilan tamu dalam beberapa serial televisi. Peran utama pertamanya adalah sebagai Billy Graham dalam film tahun 2008 Billy: The Early Years dan Hammer mendapatkan pengakuan lebih luas karena memerankan kembar Cameron dan Tyler Winklevoss dalam biopik David Fincher, The Social Network (2010).

name: Armin Mueller-Stahl
title: Armin Mueller-Stahl
extract: Armin Mueller-Stahl is a German retired actor who appeared in numerous English-language films starting in the 1980s. He was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for his role in Shine. In 2011, he was awarded the Honorary Golden Bear.
extract_id: Armin Mueller-Stahl adalah aktor pensiunan Jerman yang tampil dalam banyak film berbahasa Inggris mulai tahun 1980-an. Dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik atas perannya dalam Shine. Pada tahun 2011, dia dianugerahi Honorary Golden Bear.

name: Arno Frisch
title: Arno Frisch
extract: Arno Frisch is an Austrian actor. He has had central roles in two films by Michael Haneke, namely, Benny's Video and Funny Games.
extract_id: Arno Frisch adalah aktor Austria. Dia memiliki peran sentral dalam dua film karya Michael Haneke, yaitu Benny's Video dan Funny Games.

name: Arnold Lucy
title: Arnold Lucy
extract: Arnold Lucy was a British theatre and film actor, best known as Professor Kantorek in All Quiet on the Western Front (1930).
extract_id: Arnold Lucy adalah aktor teater dan film asal Inggris, yang paling dikenal sebagai Profesor Kantorek dalam All Quiet on the Western Front (1930).

name: Arnold Schwarzenegger
title: Arnold Schwarzenegger
description: Austrian and American bodybuilder, actor and politician (born 1947)
extract: Arnold Alois Schwarzenegger is an Austrian and American actor, businessman, film producer, politician, and former professional bodybuilder who served as the 38th governor of California from 2003 to 2011.
extract_id: Arnold Alois Schwarzenegger adalah aktor Austria dan Amerika, pengusaha, produser film, politikus, dan mantan binaragawan profesional yang menjabat sebagai gubernur California ke-38 dari tahun 2003 hingga 2011.

name: Arshad Warsi
title: Arshad Warsi
extract: Arshad Warsi is an Indian actor who appears in Hindi films. He is the recipient of several awards including a Filmfare Award from five nominations and is noted for acting in varied film genres.
extract_id: Arshad Warsi adalah aktor India yang tampil dalam film Hindi. Dia menerima beberapa penghargaan termasuk Filmfare Award dari lima nominasi dan dikenal karena berakting dalam berbagai genre film.

name: Art LaFleur
title: Art LaFleur
extract: Art LaFleur was an American character actor and acting coach.
extract_id: Art LaFleur adalah aktor karakter Amerika dan pelatih akting.

name: Art Malik
title: Art Malik
extract: Athar ul-Haque Malik, known as Art Malik, is a British actor. He achieved international fame in the 1980s through his starring and supporting roles in assorted British television serials and films. His breakout role was as Hari Kumar in the television serial The Jewel in the Crown (1984), which earned him a British Academy Television Award nomination for Best Actor.
extract_id: Athar ul-Haque Malik, yang dikenal sebagai Art Malik, adalah aktor Inggris. Dia mencapai ketenaran internasional pada tahun 1980-an melalui peran utama dan pendukungnya dalam berbagai serial televisi dan film Inggris. Peran terobosannya adalah sebagai Hari Kumar dalam serial televisi The Jewel in the Crown (1984), yang memberinya nominasi British Academy Television Award untuk Aktor Terbaik.

name: Art Parkinson
title: Art Parkinson
extract: Art Parkinson is an Irish actor from Moville in Inishowen, County Donegal, Ireland. He began his professional acting career at the age of seven. He is best known for his role as Rickon Stark on the HBO series Game of Thrones (2011–2016), and Kubo in the film Kubo and the Two Strings (2016).
extract_id: Art Parkinson adalah aktor Irlandia dari Moville di Inishowen, County Donegal, Irlandia. Dia memulai karier akting profesional pada usia tujuh tahun. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Rickon Stark dalam serial HBO Game of Thrones (2011–2016), dan Kubo dalam film Kubo and the Two Strings (2016).

name: Arthur O'Connell
title: Arthur O'Connell
extract: Arthur Joseph O'Connell was an American stage, film and television actor, who achieved prominence in character roles in the 1950s. He was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for both Picnic (1955) and Anatomy of a Murder (1959).
extract_id: Arthur Joseph O'Connell adalah aktor panggung, film, dan televisi Amerika, yang mencapai ketenaran dalam peran karakter pada 1950-an. Dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk film Picnic (1955) dan Anatomy of a Murder (1959).

name: Arthur Penn
title: Arthur Penn
extract: Arthur Hiller Penn was an American filmmaker, theatre director, and producer. He was a three-time Academy Award nominee for Best Director, and a Tony Award winner. Among other accolades, he was also nominated for a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe and two Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Arthur Hiller Penn adalah pembuat film, sutradara teater, dan produser Amerika. Dia tiga kali dinominasikan untuk Academy Award Sutradara Terbaik, dan pemenang Tony Award. Selain penghargaan lainnya, dia juga dinominasikan untuk BAFTA Award, Golden Globe, dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Arthur Rosson
title: Arthur Rosson
extract: Arthur Henry Rosson was an English film director. From 1917 to 1948, Rosson directed 61 feature films. He also worked on many major films as a second unit director until 1960, particularly for Cecil B. DeMille.
extract_id: Arthur Henry Rosson adalah sutradara film Inggris. Dari 1917 hingga 1948, Rosson menyutradarai 61 film fitur. Dia juga bekerja pada banyak film besar sebagai sutradara unit kedua hingga 1960, terutama untuk Cecil B. DeMille.

name: Artyom Bogucharskiy
title: Artyom Bogucharsky
description: Russian stage, film and television actor
extract: Artyom Gennadyevich Bogucharsky is a Russian stage, film and television actor who is perhaps best recalled internationally for his role in the 2002 drama, Lilya 4-ever.
extract_id: Artyom Gennadyevich Bogucharsky adalah aktor panggung, film, dan televisi Rusia yang mungkin paling diingat secara internasional untuk perannya dalam drama 2002, Lilya 4-ever.

name: Asa Butterfield
title: Asa Butterfield
extract: Asa Bopp Farr Butterfield is an English actor. Beginning his career as a child actor, he first achieved recognition as the lead of the historical drama film The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas (2008).
