He continued to headline films during the 2010s, starring in the adventure drama Hugo (2011), the science-fiction film Ender's Game (2013), the drama X+Y (2014), the fantasy Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children (2016) and the romantic science-fiction The Space Between Us (2017). From 2019 to 2023, Butterfield was the lead of the Netflix comedy-drama series Sex Education.
extract_id: Asa Bopp Farr Butterfield adalah aktor Inggris. Memulai kariernya sebagai aktor cilik, dia pertama kali meraih pengakuan sebagai pemeran utama dalam film drama sejarah The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas (2008). Dia terus menjadi pemeran utama dalam film-film selama tahun 2010-an, membintangi drama petualangan Hugo (2011), film fiksi ilmiah Ender's Game (2013), drama X+Y (2014), fantasi Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children (2016) dan fiksi ilmiah romantis The Space Between Us (2017). Dari 2019 hingga 2023, Butterfield menjadi pemeran utama dalam serial komedi-drama Netflix Sex Education.

name: Asaka Seto
title: Asaka Seto
extract: Asaka Seto also known as Megumi Ieda, is a Japanese actress who works at Foster Management. She won the award for Best Actress at the 24th Yokohama Film Festival for Travail. She is married to Yoshihiko Inohara of the band V6.
extract_id: Asaka Seto yang juga dikenal sebagai Megumi Ieda, adalah aktris Jepang yang bekerja di Foster Management. Dia memenangkan penghargaan Aktris Terbaik di Festival Film Yokohama ke-24 untuk Travail. Dia menikah dengan Yoshihiko Inohara dari band V6.

name: Asghar Farhadi
title: Asghar Farhadi
extract: Asghar Farhadi is an Iranian film director and screenwriter. He is considered one of the most prominent filmmakers of Iranian cinema as well as world cinema in the 21st century. His films have gained recognition for their focus on the human condition, and portrayals of intimate and challenging stories of internal family conflicts for which he has received many international accolades including two Academy Awards, a Golden Bear, and a Prix du scénario among others. In 2012, he was included on the annual Time 100 list of the most influential people in the world. That same year, he also received the Legion of Honour from France.
extract_id: Asghar Farhadi adalah sutradara dan penulis naskah film Iran. Dia dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film terkemuka dalam sinema Iran serta sinema dunia pada abad ke-21. Film-filmnya mendapat pengakuan atas fokus mereka pada kondisi manusia, dan penggambaran cerita intim dan menantang tentang konflik keluarga internal yang membuatnya menerima banyak penghargaan internasional termasuk dua Academy Awards, Golden Bear, dan Prix du scénario antara lain. Pada tahun 2012, dia masuk dalam daftar tahunan Time 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia. Pada tahun yang sama, dia juga menerima Legion of Honour dari Prancis.

name: Ash Brannon
title: Ash Brannon
extract: Ash Brannon is an American writer, director, visual artist, animator, and producer. He was a story artist and directing animator on Toy Story and co-director of Toy Story 2. He also directed and co-wrote the Sony Pictures Animation film Surf's Up. He also served as co-executive producer, story co-creator and writer on the Netflix animated series Arcane.
extract_id: Ash Brannon adalah penulis, sutradara, seniman visual, animator, dan produser Amerika. Dia adalah story artist dan sutradara animator pada Toy Story dan co-director Toy Story 2. Dia juga menyutradarai dan menulis bersama film Sony Pictures Animation Surf's Up. Dia juga menjabat sebagai co-executive producer, story co-creator, dan penulis pada serial animasi Netflix Arcane.

name: Asha Sharath
title: Asha Sharath
extract: Asha Sharath is an Indian actress and classical dancer, who predominantly works in Malayalam films and television, in addition to a few Tamil, Kannada and Telugu films. She is best known for her role as a police officer in the Drishyam film series.
extract_id: Asha Sharath adalah aktris dan penari klasik India, yang sebagian besar bekerja dalam film dan televisi Malayalam, selain beberapa film Tamil, Kannada, dan Telugu. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai perwira polisi dalam seri film Drishyam.

name: Ashton Kutcher
title: Ashton Kutcher
extract: Christopher Ashton Kutcher is an American actor, film producer and investor. His accolades include a People's Choice Award and fifteen Teen Choice Awards, in addition to a nomination for a Screen Actors Guild Award.
extract_id: Christopher Ashton Kutcher adalah aktor, produser film, dan investor Amerika. Penghargaannya meliputi People's Choice Award dan lima belas Teen Choice Awards, selain nominasi untuk Screen Actors Guild Award.

name: Ashutosh Gowariker
title: Ashutosh Gowariker
extract: Ashutosh Gowariker is an Indian film director, actor, screenwriter and producer who works in Indian Hindi cinema. He is best known for directing period sports drama Lagaan (2001), the social drama Swades (2004) and historical romantic drama Jodhaa Akbar (2008), winning the Filmfare Award for Best Film and Best Director for Lagaan and Jodhaa Akbar. Lagaan was nominated for the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film at the 74th Academy Awards, which makes him a voting member of the Academy Awards. He returned to acting by playing the lead role in the critically acclaimed comedy drama Ventilator (2016).
extract_id: Ashutosh Gowariker adalah sutradara film, aktor, penulis naskah, dan produser India yang bekerja di sinema Hindi India. Dia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai drama olahraga periodik Lagaan (2001), drama sosial Swades (2004), dan drama romantis sejarah Jodhaa Akbar (2008), memenangkan Filmfare Award untuk Film Terbaik dan Sutradara Terbaik untuk Lagaan dan Jodhaa Akbar. Lagaan dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Film Fitur Internasional Terbaik di Academy Awards ke-74, yang menjadikannya anggota pemilih Academy Awards. Dia kembali berakting dengan memerankan peran utama dalam drama komedi yang mendapat pujian Ventilator (2016).

name: Atsuko Tanaka
title: Atsuko Tanaka
extract: Atsuko Tanaka was a Japanese voice actress and narrator. Born in Maebashi, she became interested in acting during her youth, and while educated at Ferris University, worked as a background extra at Shochiku. After spending years working as an office lady for a Tokyo executive, she enrolled in the Tokyo Announcement Academy and joined the talent agency Mausu Promotion, with whom she was still affiliated at the time of her death.
extract_id: Atsuko Tanaka adalah aktris suara dan narator Jepang. Lahir di Maebashi, dia tertarik pada akting saat muda, dan saat belajar di Universitas Ferris, bekerja sebagai ekstra latar di Shochiku. Setelah bertahun-tahun bekerja sebagai office lady untuk seorang eksekutif Tokyo, dia mendaftar di Tokyo Announcement Academy dan bergabung dengan agensi bakat Mausu Promotion, yang masih dia afiliasi pada saat kematiannya.

name: Audrey Hepburn
title: Audrey Hepburn
extract: Audrey Kathleen Hepburn was a British actress and humanitarian. Recognised as a film and fashion icon, she was ranked by the American Film Institute as the third-greatest female screen legend from the Golden Age of Hollywood. She was inducted into the International Best Dressed Hall of Fame and is one of only a few entertainers who have won competitive Academy, Emmy, Grammy and Tony Awards.
extract_id: Audrey Kathleen Hepburn adalah aktris dan dermawan Inggris. Diakui sebagai ikon film dan mode, dia ditempatkan oleh American Film Institute sebagai legenda layar wanita ketiga terbesar dari Era Keemasan Hollywood. Dia dimasukkan ke dalam International Best Dressed Hall of Fame dan merupakan salah satu dari sedikit penghibur yang memenangkan Academy, Emmy, Grammy, dan Tony Awards secara kompetitif.

name: Audrey Tautou
title: Audrey Tautou
extract: Audrey Justine Tautou is a French actress. She made her acting debut at age 18 on television, and her feature film debut in Venus Beauty Institute (1999), for which she received critical acclaim and won the César Award for Most Promising Actress.
extract_id: Audrey Justine Tautou adalah aktris Prancis. Dia memulai debut aktingnya pada usia 18 tahun di televisi, dan debut film fitur dalam Venus Beauty Institute (1999), yang memberinya pujian kritis dan memenangkan César Award untuk Aktris Paling Menjanjikan.

name: Auli'i Cravalho
title: Auliʻi Cravalho
extract: Chloe Auliʻi Cravalho is an American actress and singer. She made her acting debut as the voice of the title character in the Disney animated musical film Moana (2016) and reprised her role in the 2024 sequel.
extract_id: Chloe Auliʻi Cravalho adalah aktris dan penyanyi Amerika. Dia memulai debut aktingnya sebagai pengisi suara karakter utama dalam film musikal animasi Disney Moana (2016) dan mengulangi perannya dalam sekuel tahun 2024.

name: Aura Garrido
title: Aura Garrido
extract: Aura Garrido Sánchez is a Spanish film and television actress. She has appeared in such films as Stockholm and the television series El ministerio del tiempo.
extract_id: Aura Garrido Sánchez adalah aktris film dan televisi Spanyol. Dia telah tampil dalam film seperti Stockholm dan serial televisi El ministerio del tiempo.

name: Aurore Clément
title: Aurore Clément
extract: Aurore Clément is a French actress who has appeared in French and English language movies and television productions.
extract_id: Aurore Clément adalah aktris Prancis yang telah tampil dalam film dan produksi televisi berbahasa Prancis dan Inggris.

name: Aurélien Recoing
title: Aurélien Recoing
extract: Aurélien Recoing is a French actor and stage director.
extract_id: Aurélien Recoing adalah aktor dan sutradara panggung asal Prancis.

name: Aya Okamoto
title: Aya Okamoto
extract: Aya Okamoto is a Japanese actress.
extract_id: Aya Okamoto adalah seorang aktris asal Jepang.

name: Ayberk Pekcan
title: Ayberk Pekcan
extract: Ayberk Pekcan was a Turkish actor and former civil servant, politician and labourer.
extract_id: Ayberk Pekcan adalah aktor Turki sekaligus mantan pegawai negeri, politikus, dan pekerja kasar.

name: Ayesha Kapoor
title: Ayesha Kapur
extract: Ayesha Giulia Kapur is an Indian-German actress, who is best known from the Bollywood movie Black. Kapur became the recipient of many awards in the "Best Supporting Actress" category. In doing so, she became the second youngest to be both nominated and win a Filmfare Award and is currently the youngest person ever to win a Zee Cine Award and an IIFA Award.
extract_id: Ayesha Giulia Kapur adalah aktris India-Jerman, yang paling dikenal dari film Bollywood Black. Kapur menerima banyak penghargaan di kategori "Aktris Pendukung Terbaik". Dengan pencapaiannya tersebut, dia menjadi yang termuda kedua yang dinominasikan sekaligus memenangkan Filmfare Award dan saat ini merupakan orang termuda yang memenangkan Zee Cine Award dan IIFA Award.

name: Ayushmann Khurrana
title: Ayushmann Khurrana
extract: Ayushmann Khurrana is an Indian actor and singer who works in Hindi films. Known for his portrayals of ordinary men often battling social norms, he is the recipient of several awards, including a National Film Award and four Filmfare Awards. He has appeared in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list of 2013 and 2019, and Time named him one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2020.
extract_id: Ayushmann Khurrana adalah aktor dan penyanyi India yang bekerja di film-film Hindi. Dikenal karena perannya sebagai pria biasa yang sering berjuang melawan norma sosial, ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk National Film Award dan empat Filmfare Awards. Ia pernah masuk dalam daftar Forbes India Celebrity 100 tahun 2013 dan 2019, dan Time menempatkannya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia pada tahun 2020.

name: BD Wong
title: BD Wong
extract: Bradley Darryl Wong is an American actor. Wong won a Tony Award for his performance as Song Liling in M. Butterfly, becoming the only actor in Broadway history to receive the Tony Award, Drama Desk Award, Outer Critics Circle Award, Clarence Derwent Award, and Theatre World Award for the same role. For his role as Whiterose in the television series Mr. Robot, he was nominated for both a Critic's Choice Television Award and an Emmy for Outstanding Guest Actor in a Drama Series.
extract_id: Bradley Darryl Wong adalah aktor Amerika. Wong memenangkan Tony Award untuk penampilannya sebagai Song Liling dalam M. Butterfly, menjadi satu-satunya aktor dalam sejarah Broadway yang menerima Tony Award, Drama Desk Award, Outer Critics Circle Award, Clarence Derwent Award, dan Theatre World Award untuk peran yang sama. Untuk perannya sebagai Whiterose dalam serial televisi Mr. Robot, ia dinominasikan untuk Critic's Choice Television Award dan Emmy untuk Outstanding Guest Actor in a Drama Series.

name: Babak Karimi
title: Babak Karimi
extract: Babak Karimi is a Czech-Iranian actor and film editor. For his role in A Separation, he won the Silver Bear for Best Actor at the 61st Berlin International Film Festival in 2011.
extract_id: Babak Karimi adalah aktor dan editor film Ceko-Iran. Untuk perannya dalam A Separation, ia memenangkan Silver Bear untuk Aktor Terbaik pada Festival Film Internasional Berlin ke-61 tahun 2011.

name: Bae Doona
title: Bae Doona
extract: Bae Doona, anglicized as Doona Bae, is a South Korean actress and photographer. She debuted as a model and first gained recognition for her roles in Barking Dogs Never Bite (2000), Take Care of My Cat (2001), and Sympathy for Mr. Vengeance (2002). She became known for her performances as a Korean exchange student in Linda Linda Linda (2005), archer Park Nam-joo in The Host (2006), and as a sex doll that comes to life in Air Doll (2009). She has also starred in A Girl at My Door (2014), Tunnel (2016), Broker and Next Sohee.
extract_id: Bae Doona, dalam bahasa Inggris dikenal sebagai Doona Bae, adalah aktris dan fotografer asal Korea Selatan. Ia memulai karier sebagai model dan pertama kali dikenal lewat perannya dalam Barking Dogs Never Bite (2000), Take Care of My Cat (2001), dan Sympathy for Mr. Vengeance (2002). Dia dikenal karena penampilannya sebagai mahasiswa pertukaran Korea dalam Linda Linda Linda (2005), pemanah Park Nam-joo dalam The Host (2006), dan sebagai boneka seks yang hidup dalam Air Doll (2009). Dia juga membintangi A Girl at My Door (2014), Tunnel (2016), Broker, dan Next Sohee.

name: Bahar Pars
title: Bahar Pars
extract: Bahar Pars is an Iranian-Swedish actress and filmmaker. She has performed on stage and screen, and is best known for her supporting role in the 2015 film A Man Called Ove.
extract_id: Bahar Pars adalah aktris dan pembuat film Iran-Swedia. Ia telah tampil di panggung dan layar, dan paling dikenal untuk peran pendukungnya dalam film tahun 2015 A Man Called Ove.

name: Baki Davrak
title: Baki Davrak
extract: Baki Davrak is a Turkish-German actor who is known for his leading role in the film The Edge of Heaven which won the Prix du scénario at the 2007 Cannes Film Festival.
extract_id: Baki Davrak adalah aktor Turki-Jerman yang dikenal karena peran utamanya dalam film The Edge of Heaven yang memenangkan Prix du scénario pada Festival Film Cannes 2007.

name: Barbara Bel Geddes
title: Barbara Bel Geddes
extract: Barbara Bel Geddes was an American stage and screen actress, artist, and children's author whose career spanned almost five decades. She received various accolades, including a Primetime Emmy Award and a Golden Globe Award, as well as nominations for an Academy Award and two Tony Awards. Bel Geddes was best known for her starring role as Miss Ellie Ewing in the television series Dallas, while her notable films included I Remember Mama (1948) and Vertigo (1958). In theatre, she is best remembered as Maggie in the original Broadway production of Cat on a Hot Tin Roof in 1955.
extract_id: Barbara Bel Geddes adalah aktris panggung dan layar Amerika, seniman, dan penulis anak-anak yang kariernya berlangsung hampir lima dekade. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Primetime Emmy Award dan Golden Globe Award, serta nominasi Academy Award dan dua Tony Awards. Bel Geddes paling dikenal untuk peran utamanya sebagai Miss Ellie Ewing dalam serial televisi Dallas, sementara film terkenalnya termasuk I Remember Mama (1948) dan Vertigo (1958). Di dunia teater, ia diingat sebagai Maggie dalam produksi Broadway asli Cat on a Hot Tin Roof pada 1955.

name: Barbara Hershey
title: Barbara Hershey
extract: Barbara Lynn Herzstein, better known as Barbara Hershey, is an American actress. In a career spanning more than 50 years, she has played a variety of roles on television and in cinema in several genres, including Westerns, horrors, and comedies. She began acting at age 17 in 1965, but did not achieve widespread critical acclaim until the 1980s. By that time, the Chicago Tribune referred to her as "one of America's finest actresses".
extract_id: Barbara Lynn Herzstein, lebih dikenal sebagai Barbara Hershey, adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dalam karier yang berlangsung lebih dari 50 tahun, ia memainkan berbagai peran di televisi dan perfilman dalam berbagai genre, termasuk Western, horor, dan komedi. Ia mulai berakting pada usia 17 tahun pada 1965, tetapi baru meraih pengakuan luas secara kritis pada tahun 1980-an. Saat itu, Chicago Tribune menyebutnya sebagai "salah satu aktris terbaik Amerika".

name: Barbara Stanwyck
title: Barbara Stanwyck
extract: Barbara Stanwyck was an American actress and dancer. A stage, film, and television star, during her 60-year professional career she was known for her strong, realistic screen presence and versatility. She was a favorite of directors, including Cecil B. DeMille, Fritz Lang, and Frank Capra, and made 86 films in 38 years before turning to television. She received numerous accolades, including three Primetime Emmy Awards and a Golden Globe Award, and was nominated for four Academy Awards.
extract_id: Barbara Stanwyck adalah aktris dan penari Amerika. Bintang panggung, film, dan televisi, selama karier profesionalnya selama 60 tahun, ia dikenal karena kehadiran layar yang kuat, realistis, dan serba bisa. Ia menjadi favorit sutradara, termasuk Cecil B. DeMille, Fritz Lang, dan Frank Capra, dan membuat 86 film dalam 38 tahun sebelum beralih ke televisi. Ia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk tiga Primetime Emmy Awards dan Golden Globe Award, serta dinominasikan empat kali untuk Academy Awards.

name: Baris Bagci
title: Barış Bağcı
extract: Barış Bağcı is a Turkish theater, cinema, and television actor. He is known for his role as Baiju Noyan in the TV series Diriliş: Ertuğrul. Also, he portrayed as Rashid ad-Din Sinan in TV series Kudüs Fatihi Selahaddin Eyyubi
extract_id: Barış Bağcı adalah aktor teater, sinema, dan televisi Turki. Ia dikenal karena peranannya sebagai Baiju Noyan dalam serial TV Diriliş: Ertuğrul. Selain itu, ia berperan sebagai Rashid ad-Din Sinan dalam serial TV Kudüs Fatihi Selahaddin Eyyubi.

name: Barkhad Abdi
title: Barkhad Abdi
extract: Barkhad Abdi is a Somali actor. He made his acting debut as the pirate Abduwali Muse in the biographical drama film Captain Phillips (2013), which earned him a British Academy Film Award for Best Actor in a Supporting Role, along with Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, and Actor Award nominations.
extract_id: Barkhad Abdi adalah aktor Somalia. Ia melakukan debut aktingnya sebagai bajak laut Abduwali Muse dalam film drama biografi Captain Phillips (2013), yang memberinya British Academy Film Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik, bersama nominasi Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Actor Award.

name: Barry Bostwick
title: Barry Bostwick
extract: Barry Knapp Bostwick is an American actor. He is best known for portraying Brad Majors in The Rocky Horror Picture Show (1975) and Mayor Randall Winston in the sitcom Spin City (1996–2002). Bostwick has also had considerable success in musical theatre, winning a Tony Award for his role in The Robber Bridegroom and performing the role of Danny Zuko in the original Broadway production of Grease.
extract_id: Barry Knapp Bostwick adalah aktor Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena memerankan Brad Majors dalam The Rocky Horror Picture Show (1975) dan Wali Kota Randall Winston dalam sitkom Spin City (1996–2002). Bostwick juga sukses dalam teater musikal, meraih Tony Award untuk perannya dalam The Robber Bridegroom dan memerankan Danny Zuko dalam produksi Broadway asli Grease.

name: Barry Cook
title: Barry Cook
extract: Barry Cook is an American film director who has worked in the animated film industry since the late 1970s. Cook and Tony Bancroft directed Mulan (1998), for which they won the 1998 Annie Award for Best Animated Feature. Cook was also the co-director for Arthur Christmas (2011), directed by Sarah Smith. Cook also directed Walking with Dinosaurs (2013) with Neil Nightingale.
extract_id: Barry Cook adalah sutradara film Amerika yang telah bekerja di industri film animasi sejak akhir 1970-an. Cook dan Tony Bancroft menyutradarai Mulan (1998), yang memenangkan Annie Award 1998 untuk Fitur Animasi Terbaik. Cook juga menjadi sutradara bersama untuk Arthur Christmas (2011), yang disutradarai oleh Sarah Smith. Cook juga menyutradarai Walking with Dinosaurs (2013) bersama Neil Nightingale.

name: Barry Fitzgerald
title: Barry Fitzgerald
extract: William Joseph Shields, known professionally as Barry Fitzgerald, was an Irish stage, film, and television actor. In a career spanning almost forty years, he appeared in such notable films as Bringing Up Baby (1938), The Long Voyage Home (1940), How Green Was My Valley (1941), The Sea Wolf (1941), Going My Way (1944), None but the Lonely Heart (1944), and The Quiet Man (1952). For Going My Way, he won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor and was simultaneously nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actor for the same performance. In 2020, he was listed at number 11 on The Irish Times list of Ireland's greatest film actors.
extract_id: William Joseph Shields, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Barry Fitzgerald, adalah aktor panggung, film, dan televisi Irlandia. Dalam kariernya yang berlangsung hampir empat puluh tahun, ia tampil dalam sejumlah film terkenal seperti Bringing Up Baby (1938), The Long Voyage Home (1940), How Green Was My Valley (1941), The Sea Wolf (1941), Going My Way (1944), None but the Lonely Heart (1944), dan The Quiet Man (1952). Untuk Going My Way, ia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dan secara bersamaan dinominasikan untuk Academy Award Aktor Terbaik untuk penampilan yang sama. Pada 2020, ia masuk peringkat 11 dalam daftar aktor film terbesar Irlandia menurut The Irish Times.

name: Barry Humphries
title: Barry Humphries
extract: John Barry Humphries was an Australian comedian, actor, author and satirist. He was best known for writing and playing his stage and television characters Dame Edna Everage and Sir Les Patterson. He appeared in numerous stage productions, films and television shows.
extract_id: John Barry Humphries adalah seorang pelawak, aktor, penulis, dan satiris asal Australia. Ia paling dikenal sebagai penulis dan pemeran karakter panggung dan televisinya Dame Edna Everage dan Sir Les Patterson. Ia tampil dalam berbagai produksi panggung, film, dan acara televisi.

name: Barry Keoghan
title: Barry Keoghan
extract: Barry Keoghan is an Irish actor. His accolades include a BAFTA Award, along with nominations for an Academy Award and two Golden Globe Awards. In 2020, he was listed at number 27 on The Irish Times list of Ireland's greatest film actors.
extract_id: Barry Keoghan adalah aktor Irlandia. Penghargaan yang ia terima antara lain BAFTA Award, bersama nominasi Academy Award dan dua Golden Globe Awards. Pada 2020, ia masuk peringkat 27 dalam daftar aktor film terbesar Irlandia menurut The Irish Times.

name: Barry Levinson
title: Barry Levinson
extract: Barry Levinson is an American filmmaker. He has received numerous accolades including the Academy Award for Best Director for Rain Man (1988), as well as four Primetime Emmy Awards and nominations for three Golden Globe Awards. Levinson's other best-known works are Diner (1982), The Natural (1984), Good Morning, Vietnam (1987), Bugsy (1991), and Wag the Dog (1997). In 2021, he co-executive produced the Hulu miniseries Dopesick and directed the first two episodes.
extract_id: Barry Levinson adalah pembuat film Amerika. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik untuk Rain Man (1988), serta empat Primetime Emmy Awards dan nominasi tiga Golden Globe Awards. Karya terbaik lain Levinson antara lain Diner (1982), The Natural (1984), Good Morning, Vietnam (1987), Bugsy (1991), dan Wag the Dog (1997). Pada 2021, ia menjadi produser eksekutif bersama untuk miniseri Hulu Dopesick dan menyutradarai dua episode pertama.

name: Barry Pepper
title: Barry Pepper
extract: Barry Robert Pepper is a Canadian-American actor. His best-known film roles include Private Daniel Jackson in Saving Private Ryan (1998), Corrections Officer Dean Stanton in The Green Mile (1999), Roger Maris in 61* (2001), he appeared in Jagged Edge music video Goodbye as a soldier (2001) Joseph L. Galloway in We Were Soldiers (2002), Charlie Halliday in The Snow Walker (2003), Mike Norton in The Three Burials of Melquiades Estrada (2005), Sergeant Michael Strank in Flags of Our Fathers (2006), Lucky Ned Pepper in True Grit (2010), DEA Agent Cooper in Snitch (2013), Vince in Maze Runner: The Scorch Trials (2015) and Maze Runner: The Death Cure (2018), and David Keller in Crawl (2019).
extract_id: Barry Robert Pepper adalah aktor Kanada-Amerika. Peran filmnya yang paling terkenal termasuk Private Daniel Jackson dalam Saving Private Ryan (1998), Pegawai Koreksi Dean Stanton dalam The Green Mile (1999), Roger Maris dalam 61* (2001), tampil dalam video musik Jagged Edge Goodbye sebagai tentara (2001), Joseph L. Galloway dalam We Were Soldiers (2002), Charlie Halliday dalam The Snow Walker (2003), Mike Norton dalam The Three Burials of Melquiades Estrada (2005), Sersan Michael Strank dalam Flags of Our Fathers (2006), Lucky Ned Pepper dalam True Grit (2010), Agen DEA Cooper dalam Snitch (2013), Vince dalam Maze Runner: The Scorch Trials (2015) dan Maze Runner: The Death Cure (2018), serta David Keller dalam Crawl (2019).

name: Basil Rathbone
title: Basil Rathbone
extract: Philip St. John Basil Rathbone was an English actor. Born in South Africa and raised in Derbyshire, he rose to prominence in the United Kingdom as a Shakespearean stage actor and went on to appear in more than 70 films, primarily costume dramas, swashbucklers, and, occasionally, horror films.
extract_id: Philip St. John Basil Rathbone adalah aktor Inggris. Lahir di Afrika Selatan dan dibesarkan di Derbyshire, ia menjadi terkenal di Inggris sebagai aktor panggung Shakespeare dan selanjutnya tampil dalam lebih dari 70 film, terutama drama kostum, film petualangan, dan sesekali film horor.

name: Beau Billingslea
title: Beau Billingslea
extract: John "Beau" Billingslea is an American actor, known as the voice of Jet Black in the critically acclaimed anime Cowboy Bebop, Ogremon in Digimon and Homura and Ay, the Fourth Raikage in Naruto Shippuden. In addition to voice acting, he appeared in many television shows and some films including North and South Book II: Love and War, Just Jordan, The Hannah Montana Movie, and Star Trek Into Darkness.
extract_id: John "Beau" Billingslea adalah aktor Amerika, dikenal sebagai suara Jet Black dalam anime yang mendapat pengakuan kritis Cowboy Bebop, Ogremon dalam Digimon, serta Homura dan Ay, Raikage Keempat dalam Naruto Shippuden. Selain dubbing, ia tampil di banyak acara televisi dan beberapa film termasuk North and South Book II: Love and War, Just Jordan, The Hannah Montana Movie, dan Star Trek Into Darkness.

name: Bee Vang
title: Bee Vang
extract: Bee Vang is an American actor of Hmong descent. He is best known for starring in Clint Eastwood's 2008 film Gran Torino as Thao Vang Lor.
extract_id: Bee Vang adalah aktor Amerika keturunan Hmong. Ia paling dikenal karena perannya dalam film Gran Torino karya Clint Eastwood tahun 2008 sebagai Thao Vang Lor.

name: Belén Rueda
title: Belén Rueda
extract: María Belén Rueda García-Porrero is a Spanish actress. She garnered recognition in Spain for her performances in the Globomedia-produced television series Periodistas (1998–2002) and, most notably, Los Serrano (2003–2007). Likewise, she has carved an international reputation among horror fans for her performances in horror and suspense works.
extract_id: María Belén Rueda García-Porrero adalah seorang aktris Spanyol. Dia mendapatkan pengakuan di Spanyol atas penampilannya dalam serial televisi yang diproduksi oleh Globomedia, Periodistas (1998–2002) dan, yang paling terkenal, Los Serrano (2003–2007). Demikian juga, dia telah membangun reputasi internasional di kalangan penggemar horor atas penampilannya dalam karya horor dan suspense.

name: Ben Affleck
title: Ben Affleck
extract: Benjamin Géza Affleck is an American actor and filmmaker. His accolades include two Academy Awards, two BAFTA Awards, and three Golden Globes. Affleck began his career as a child when he starred in the PBS educational series The Voyage of the Mimi (1984–1988). He later appeared in the independent comedy Dazed and Confused (1993) and several Kevin Smith comedies, including Mallrats (1995), Chasing Amy (1997), and Dogma (1999).
extract_id: Benjamin Géza Affleck adalah seorang aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Penghargaan yang diperolehnya termasuk dua Academy Awards, dua BAFTA Awards, dan tiga Golden Globes. Affleck memulai karirnya sebagai anak-anak ketika ia membintangi serial edukasi PBS The Voyage of the Mimi (1984–1988). Dia kemudian muncul dalam komedi independen Dazed and Confused (1993) dan beberapa komedi Kevin Smith, termasuk Mallrats (1995), Chasing Amy (1997), dan Dogma (1999).

name: Ben Foster
title: Ben Foster (actor)
extract: Benjamin A. Foster is an American actor. His films include The Punisher (2004), X-Men: The Last Stand and Alpha Dog, 30 Days of Night and 3:10 to Yuma, The Messenger and Pandorum, The Mechanic (2011), Contraband (2012), Kill Your Darlings and Lone Survivor, The Program (2015), Warcraft (2016), and Leave No Trace (2018). He has won an Independent Spirit Award for portraying Tanner Howard in Hell or High Water (2016). He also had a recurring role as Russell Corwin in Six Feet Under (2003–05).
extract_id: Benjamin A. Foster adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Film-filmnya meliputi The Punisher (2004), X-Men: The Last Stand dan Alpha Dog, 30 Days of Night dan 3:10 to Yuma, The Messenger dan Pandorum, The Mechanic (2011), Contraband (2012), Kill Your Darlings dan Lone Survivor, The Program (2015), Warcraft (2016), dan Leave No Trace (2018). Dia memenangkan Independent Spirit Award untuk memerankan Tanner Howard dalam Hell or High Water (2016). Dia juga memiliki peran berulang sebagai Russell Corwin dalam Six Feet Under (2003–05).

name: Ben Gazzara
title: Ben Gazzara
extract: Biagio Anthony "Ben" Gazzara was an American actor and director of film, stage, and television. He received numerous accolades including a Primetime Emmy Award and a Drama Desk Award, in addition to nominations for three Golden Globe Awards and three Tony Awards.
extract_id: Biagio Anthony "Ben" Gazzara adalah seorang aktor dan sutradara film, panggung, dan televisi asal Amerika. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Primetime Emmy Award dan Drama Desk Award, selain nominasi untuk tiga Golden Globe Awards dan tiga Tony Awards.

name: Ben Hardy
title: Ben Hardy (actor)
extract: Ben Hardy is an English actor. A graduate of the Royal Central School of Speech and Drama, he began his professional career on stage before moving into television and film.
extract_id: Ben Hardy adalah seorang aktor Inggris. Lulusan Royal Central School of Speech and Drama, dia memulai karir profesionalnya di panggung sebelum beralih ke televisi dan film.

name: Ben Johnson
title: Ben Johnson (actor)
extract: Francis Benjamin Johnson Jr. was an American actor, stuntman, and professional rodeo cowboy.
extract_id: Francis Benjamin Johnson Jr. adalah seorang aktor Amerika, stuntman, dan koboi rodeo profesional.

name: Ben Kingsley
title: Ben Kingsley
extract: Sir Ben Kingsley is an English actor. He has received various accolades throughout his career spanning seven decades, including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Grammy Award, and two Golden Globe Awards as well as nominations for four Primetime Emmy Awards and two Laurence Olivier Awards. Kingsley was appointed Knight Bachelor in 2002 for services to the British film industry. He was awarded a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 2010 and received the Britannia Award in 2014.
extract_id: Sir Ben Kingsley adalah seorang aktor Inggris. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan sepanjang karirnya yang berlangsung selama tujuh dekade, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Grammy Award, dan dua Golden Globe Awards serta nominasi untuk empat Primetime Emmy Awards dan dua Laurence Olivier Awards. Kingsley diangkat menjadi Knight Bachelor pada tahun 2002 atas jasanya kepada industri film Inggris. Dia dianugerahi bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada tahun 2010 dan menerima Britannia Award pada tahun 2014.

name: Ben Stiller
title: Ben Stiller
extract: Benjamin Edward Meara Stiller is an American actor, comedian, and filmmaker. Known for his blend of slapstick humor and sharp wit, Stiller rose to fame in the late 1990s with a group of comedic actors colloquially known as the Frat Pack. His films have grossed more than $2.6 billion in Canada and the United States. His accolades include an Emmy Award, a Directors Guild of America Award, a Britannia Award and a Teen Choice Award.
extract_id: Benjamin Edward Meara Stiller adalah seorang aktor, komedian, dan pembuat film Amerika. Dikenal karena perpaduan humor slapstick dan kecerdasan tajamnya, Stiller meraih ketenaran pada akhir 1990-an bersama sekelompok aktor komedi yang dikenal sebagai Frat Pack. Film-filmnya telah menghasilkan lebih dari $2,6 miliar di Kanada dan Amerika Serikat. Penghargaannya termasuk Emmy Award, Directors Guild of America Award, Britannia Award, dan Teen Choice Award.

name: Ben Whishaw
title: Ben Whishaw
extract: Benjamin John Whishaw is an English actor. He has received various accolades, including three British Academy Television Awards, two Emmy Awards and a Golden Globe Award, in addition to nominations for a British Academy Film Award and two Laurence Olivier Awards.
extract_id: Benjamin John Whishaw adalah seorang aktor Inggris. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk tiga British Academy Television Awards, dua Emmy Awards dan Golden Globe Award, selain nominasi untuk British Academy Film Award dan dua Laurence Olivier Awards.

name: Benedict Cumberbatch
title: Benedict Cumberbatch
extract: Benedict Timothy Carlton Cumberbatch is an English actor. He has received various accolades, including a British Academy Television Award, a Primetime Emmy Award and a Laurence Olivier Award, in addition to nominations for two Academy Awards, two British Academy Film Awards, and four Golden Globes. In 2014, Time magazine named him one of the 100 most influential people in the world, and in 2015, he was appointed a CBE for services to performing arts and charity.
extract_id: Benedict Timothy Carlton Cumberbatch adalah seorang aktor Inggris. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk British Academy Television Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dan Laurence Olivier Award, selain nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards, dua British Academy Film Awards, dan empat Golden Globes. Pada tahun 2014, majalah Time menamainya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia, dan pada tahun 2015, dia diangkat menjadi CBE atas jasanya di bidang seni pertunjukan dan amal.

name: Bengt Ekerot
title: Bengt Ekerot
extract: Nils Bengt Folke Ekerot was a Swedish actor and stage director best known for portraying Death in The Seventh Seal (1957) directed by Ingmar Bergman. In 1956, he directed the world premiere of Long Day's Journey into Night, considered the magnum opus of American playwright Eugene O'Neill.
extract_id: Nils Bengt Folke Ekerot adalah seorang aktor dan sutradara panggung Swedia yang paling dikenal karena memerankan Kematian dalam The Seventh Seal (1957) yang disutradarai oleh Ingmar Bergman. Pada tahun 1956, ia menyutradarai premiere dunia Long Day's Journey into Night, yang dianggap sebagai magnum opus dari penulis drama Amerika Eugene O'Neill.

name: Benicio Del Toro
title: Benicio del Toro
extract: Benicio Monserrate Rafael del Toro Sánchez is a Puerto Rican actor. His accolades include an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, a Goya Award, and the Best Actor awards at the Berlin International Film Festival and the Cannes Film Festival. Films in which he has appeared have grossed over $5.9 billion worldwide.
extract_id: Benicio Monserrate Rafael del Toro Sánchez adalah seorang aktor Puerto Rico. Penghargaan yang diperolehnya meliputi Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Golden Globe Award, Goya Award, dan penghargaan Aktor Terbaik di Festival Film Internasional Berlin dan Festival Film Cannes. Film-film yang dibintanginya telah meraup lebih dari $5,9 miliar di seluruh dunia.

name: Benjamin Bratt
title: Benjamin Bratt
extract: Benjamin Bratt is an American actor. He is known for playing Paco Aguilar in Blood in Blood Out. He had supporting film roles in the 1990s in Demolition Man (1993), Clear and Present Danger (1994) and The River Wild (1994). From 1995 to 1999, he starred as NYPD Detective Rey Curtis on the NBC drama series Law & Order, for which he received a nomination for the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama Series.
extract_id: Benjamin Bratt adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena memerankan Paco Aguilar dalam Blood in Blood Out. Dia memegang peran pendukung dalam film-film pada 1990-an seperti Demolition Man (1993), Clear and Present Danger (1994), dan The River Wild (1994). Dari 1995 hingga 1999, dia membintangi sebagai Detektif NYPD Rey Curtis dalam serial drama NBC Law & Order, yang membuatnya mendapatkan nominasi Primetime Emmy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam Serial Drama.

name: Bennett Miller
title: Bennett Miller
extract: Bennett Altman Miller is an American film director who is known for having directed the films Capote (2005), Moneyball (2011), and Foxcatcher (2014). He has been nominated twice for the Academy Award for Best Director.
extract_id: Bennett Altman Miller adalah seorang sutradara film Amerika yang dikenal karena menyutradarai film Capote (2005), Moneyball (2011), dan Foxcatcher (2014). Dia telah dua kali dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik.

name: Benno Fürmann
title: Benno Fürmann
extract: Benjamin "Benno" Fürmann is a German film and television actor. He played lead roles in the 2008 film The North Face, and Jerichow. He appeared in In Darkness, and was the voice of Puss in Boots in the Shrek franchise's German dubbing.
extract_id: Benjamin "Benno" Fürmann adalah seorang aktor film dan televisi Jerman. Dia memainkan peran utama dalam film The North Face (2008), dan Jerichow. Dia tampil dalam In Darkness, dan menjadi pengisi suara Puss in Boots dalam dubbing bahasa Jerman untuk waralaba Shrek.

name: Benoît Régent
title: Benoît Régent
extract: Benoît Régent was a French actor.
extract_id: Benoît Régent adalah seorang aktor Prancis.

name: Bernard-Pierre Donnadieu
title: Bernard-Pierre Donnadieu
extract: Bernard-Pierre Donnadieu was a French actor. He made more than 100 appearances in movies and television over his career, as well as in theatrical roles. He was often cast as a villain, criminal or psychopath. Donnadieu was the French voice of many lead roles in English-language movies dubbed into French.
extract_id: Bernard-Pierre Donnadieu adalah seorang aktor Prancis. Dia tampil lebih dari 100 kali di film dan televisi selama karirnya, serta dalam peran teater. Dia sering kali diperankan sebagai penjahat, kriminal, atau psikopat. Donnadieu merupakan suara bahasa Prancis dari banyak peran utama dalam film berbahasa Inggris yang didubbing ke dalam bahasa Prancis.

name: Bernardo Bertolucci
title: Bernardo Bertolucci
extract: Bernardo Bertolucci was an Italian film director and screenwriter with a career that spanned 50 years. Considered one of the greatest directors in the history of cinema, Bertolucci's work achieved international acclaim. With The Last Emperor (1987) he became the first Italian filmmaker to win the Academy Award for Best Director, and he received many other accolades including a BAFTA Award, a César Award, two Golden Globes, a Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement, and an Honorary Palme d'Or.
extract_id: Bernardo Bertolucci adalah seorang sutradara dan penulis skenario film Italia dengan karir yang berlangsung selama 50 tahun. Dianggap sebagai salah satu sutradara terbesar dalam sejarah sinema, karya Bertolucci memperoleh pengakuan internasional. Dengan The Last Emperor (1987), dia menjadi pembuat film Italia pertama yang memenangkan Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik, dan dia menerima banyak penghargaan lain termasuk BAFTA Award, César Award, dua Golden Globes, Golden Lion untuk Penghargaan Seumur Hidup, dan Palme d'Or Kehormatan.

name: Bernhard Wicki
title: Bernhard Wicki
extract: Bernhard Wolfgang Wicki was an Austrian-Swiss actor, film director and screenwriter. He was a key figure in the revitalization of post-war German-language cinema, particularly in West Germany, and also directed several Hollywood films.
extract_id: Bernhard Wolfgang Wicki adalah seorang aktor, sutradara film, dan penulis skenario Austria-Swiss. Dia merupakan tokoh kunci dalam revitalisasi perfilman berbahasa Jerman pascaperang, terutama di Jerman Barat, dan juga menyutradarai beberapa film Hollywood.

name: Bette Davis
title: Bette Davis
extract: Ruth Elizabeth "Bette" Davis was an American actress of film, television, and theater. Regarded as one of the greatest actresses in Hollywood history, she was noted for her willingness to play unsympathetic, sardonic characters and was known for her performances in a range of film genres, from contemporary crime melodramas to historical and period films and occasional comedies, although her greatest successes were her roles in romantic dramas. She won the Academy Award for Best Actress twice, was the first person to accrue ten Academy Award nominations for acting, and was the first woman to receive a Lifetime Achievement Award from the American Film Institute.
extract_id: Ruth Elizabeth "Bette" Davis adalah seorang aktris Amerika di bidang film, televisi, dan teater. Dianggap sebagai salah satu aktris terbesar dalam sejarah Hollywood, dia dikenal karena kesediaannya memainkan karakter yang tidak simpatik dan sardonik serta dikenal atas penampilannya dalam berbagai genre film, dari melodrama kejahatan kontemporer hingga film sejarah dan periode serta sesekali komedi, meskipun kesuksesannya yang terbesar adalah peran dalam drama romantis. Dia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik dua kali, menjadi orang pertama yang meraih sepuluh nominasi Academy Award untuk akting, dan menjadi wanita pertama yang menerima Lifetime Achievement Award dari American Film Institute.

name: Beverly D'Angelo
title: Beverly D'Angelo
extract: Beverly Heather D'Angelo is an American actress who starred as Ellen Griswold in the National Lampoon's Vacation films (1983–2015). She has appeared in over 60 films and was nominated for a Golden Globe Award for her role as Patsy Cline in Coal Miner's Daughter (1980), and for an Emmy Award for her role as Stella Kowalski in the TV film A Streetcar Named Desire (1984). D'Angelo's other film roles include Sheila Franklin in Hair (1979) and Doris Vinyard in American History X (1998).
extract_id: Beverly Heather D'Angelo adalah seorang aktris Amerika yang membintangi sebagai Ellen Griswold dalam film National Lampoon's Vacation (1983–2015). Dia telah tampil dalam lebih dari 60 film dan dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award untuk perannya sebagai Patsy Cline dalam Coal Miner's Daughter (1980), dan untuk Emmy Award untuk perannya sebagai Stella Kowalski dalam film TV A Streetcar Named Desire (1984). Peran film D'Angelo lainnya termasuk Sheila Franklin dalam Hair (1979) dan Doris Vinyard dalam American History X (1998).

name: Bibi Andersson
title: Bibi Andersson
extract: Berit Elisabet "Bibi" Andersson was a Swedish actress, best known for her frequent collaborations with filmmaker Ingmar Bergman. She received numerous accolades for her work, including four Guldbagge Awards, and Best Actress Awards from both the Cannes and Berlin film festivals. One of the greatest European Cinema actresses of all time, her performance in Avant-garde psychological thriller Persona is considered one of the best female acting performances in movie history as well as the finest role of her career.
extract_id: Berit Elisabet "Bibi" Andersson adalah seorang aktris Swedia, terkenal karena kolaborasinya yang sering dengan pembuat film Ingmar Bergman. Dia menerima banyak penghargaan untuk karyanya, termasuk empat Guldbagge Awards, dan Penghargaan Aktris Terbaik dari Festival Film Cannes dan Berlin. Sebagai salah satu aktris terbesar dalam Sinema Eropa sepanjang masa, penampilannya dalam film thriller psikologis Avant-garde Persona dianggap sebagai salah satu penampilan akting wanita terbaik dalam sejarah film serta peran terbaik dalam karirnya.

name: Biff McGuire
title: Biff McGuire
extract: William Joseph McGuire Jr.;, known as Biff McGuire, was an American actor, best known as Inspector Kramer in Nero Wolfe (1979).
extract_id: William Joseph McGuire Jr., dikenal sebagai Biff McGuire, adalah seorang aktor Amerika, paling dikenal sebagai Inspektur Kramer dalam Nero Wolfe (1979).

name: Bill Hader
title: Bill Hader
extract: William Thomas Hader Jr. is an American actor, comedian, and filmmaker. He was a cast member on the NBC sketch comedy series Saturday Night Live from 2005 to 2013, for which he received four Primetime Emmy Award nominations and a Peabody Award. He became known for his impressions and especially for his work on the Weekend Update segments, where he played Stefon, a flamboyant New York City nightclub tour guide.
extract_id: William Thomas Hader Jr. adalah seorang aktor, komedian, dan pembuat film Amerika. Dia menjadi anggota pemeran dalam serial komedi sketsa NBC Saturday Night Live dari 2005 hingga 2013, yang membuatnya menerima empat nominasi Primetime Emmy Award dan satu Peabody Award. Dia dikenal karena impresi dan terutama untuk karyanya dalam segmen Weekend Update, di mana dia memerankan Stefon, seorang pemandu tur klub malam New York City yang flamboyan.

name: Bill McKinney
title: Bill McKinney
extract: William Denison McKinney was an American character actor. He played the sadistic mountain man in John Boorman's 1972 film Deliverance and appeared in seven Clint Eastwood films, most notably as Captain Terrill, the commander pursuing the last rebels to "hold out" against surrendering to the Union forces in The Outlaw Josey Wales.
extract_id: William Denison McKinney adalah seorang aktor karakter Amerika. Dia memerankan pria gunung sadis dalam film Deliverance karya John Boorman pada tahun 1972 dan tampil dalam tujuh film Clint Eastwood, terutama sebagai Kapten Terrill, komandan yang mengejar pemberontak terakhir yang "bertahan" melawan penyerahan diri kepada pasukan Union dalam The Outlaw Josey Wales.

name: Bill Murray
title: Bill Murray
extract: William James Murray is an American actor and comedian, known for his deadpan delivery in roles ranging from studio comedies to independent dramas. He has received several accolades including a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, and two Primetime Emmy Awards as well as a nomination for an Academy Award. Murray was awarded the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor in 2016.
extract_id: William James Murray adalah aktor dan komedian Amerika, dikenal karena penyampaian materi yang datar dalam peran-peran mulai dari komedi studio hingga drama independen. Dia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan termasuk BAFTA Award, Golden Globe Award, dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards serta nominasi Academy Award. Murray dianugerahi Mark Twain Prize untuk American Humor pada tahun 2016.

name: Bill Nighy
title: Bill Nighy
extract: William Francis Nighy is a British actor. Known for his work on stage and screen, he has received various accolades including two BAFTA Awards and a Golden Globe Award, in addition to nominations for an Academy Award, a Tony Award, a Laurence Olivier Award and two Screen Actors Guild Awards.
extract_id: William Francis Nighy adalah aktor Inggris. Dikenal karena karyanya di panggung dan layar, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk dua BAFTA Awards dan Golden Globe Award, selain nominasi Academy Award, Tony Award, Laurence Olivier Award, dan dua Screen Actors Guild Awards.

name: Bill Nunn
title: Bill Nunn
extract: William Goldwyn Nunn III was an American actor. He was known for his collaborations with director Spike Lee, notably as Radio Raheem in Do the Right Thing (1989). He also portrayed Daily Bugle editor Robbie Robertson in the Sam Raimi Spider-Man film trilogy (2002–07), and co-starred in the sitcoms The Job (2001–02) and Sirens (2014–15).
extract_id: William Goldwyn Nunn III adalah aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena kolaborasinya dengan sutradara Spike Lee, terutama sebagai Radio Raheem dalam Do the Right Thing (1989). Dia juga memerankan editor Daily Bugle Robbie Robertson dalam trilogi film Spider-Man karya Sam Raimi (2002–07), serta bermain bersama dalam sitkom The Job (2001–02) dan Sirens (2014–15).

name: Bill Paxton
title: Bill Paxton
extract: William Paxton was an American actor, filmmaker and musician. A versatile character actor known for his distinctive Texan drawl and everyman screen persona, he was a four-time Golden Globe Award and a Primetime Emmy Award nominee, among other accolades.
extract_id: William Paxton adalah aktor, pembuat film, dan musisi Amerika. Seorang aktor karakter serba bisa yang dikenal dengan logat Texas khasnya dan persona layar sebagai orang biasa, dia dinominasikan empat kali untuk Golden Globe Award dan satu kali untuk Primetime Emmy Award, di antara penghargaan lainnya.

name: Bill Pullman
title: Bill Pullman
extract: William Pullman is an American actor. After graduating with a Master of Fine Arts degree in theater, he was an adjunct professor at Montana State University, before deciding to pursue acting.
extract_id: William Pullman adalah aktor Amerika. Setelah lulus dengan gelar Master of Fine Arts dalam bidang teater, dia menjadi dosen tambahan di Montana State University, sebelum memutuskan untuk mengejar karier akting.

name: Bill Sage
title: Bill Sage
extract: William Sage III is an American actor. He is known for his collaborations with director Hal Hartley. Sage has appeared in more than 90 movies, most notably American Psycho (2000), We Are What We Are (2013), Every Secret Thing (2014), and Wrong Turn (2021).
extract_id: William Sage III adalah aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena kolaborasinya dengan sutradara Hal Hartley. Sage telah tampil dalam lebih dari 90 film, terutama American Psycho (2000), We Are What We Are (2013), Every Secret Thing (2014), dan Wrong Turn (2021).

name: Billy Bob Thornton
title: Billy Bob Thornton
extract: Billy Bob Thornton is an American actor, filmmaker, screenwriter, and singer-songwriter. He received international attention after writing, directing and starring in the independent drama film Sling Blade (1996), for which he won an Academy Award for Best Adapted Screenplay and was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Actor. For his role in A Simple Plan (1998), he was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor.
extract_id: Billy Bob Thornton adalah aktor, pembuat film, penulis skenario, dan penyanyi-penulis lagu Amerika. Ia mendapatkan perhatian internasional setelah menulis, menyutradarai, dan membintangi film drama independen Sling Blade (1996), yang memberinya Academy Award untuk Best Adapted Screenplay dan nominasi Academy Award untuk Best Actor. Untuk perannya dalam A Simple Plan (1998), ia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Best Supporting Actor.

name: Billy Connolly
title: Billy Connolly
extract: Sir William Connolly is a Scottish actor, musician, television presenter, artist and retired stand-up comedian. He is sometimes known by the Scots nickname the Big Yin. Known for his idiosyncratic and often improvised observational comedy, frequently including strong language, Connolly has topped many UK polls as the greatest stand-up comedian of all time. In 2017, he was knighted at Buckingham Palace for services to entertainment and charity. In 2022, he received the BAFTA Fellowship for lifetime achievement from the British Academy of Film and Television Arts.
extract_id: Sir William Connolly adalah aktor, musisi, presenter televisi, seniman, dan komedian stand-up pensiunan asal Skotlandia. Ia kadang-kadang dikenal dengan julukan Skotlandia the Big Yin. Dikenal karena komedi observasionalnya yang idiosinkratik dan sering improvisasi, yang sering mengandung bahasa kuat, Connolly telah menduduki peringkat teratas di banyak jajak pendapat Inggris sebagai komedian stand-up terbesar sepanjang masa. Pada tahun 2017, ia dinobatkan sebagai ksatria di Istana Buckingham atas jasanya dalam hiburan dan amal. Pada 2022, ia menerima BAFTA Fellowship untuk pencapaian seumur hidup dari British Academy of Film and Television Arts.

name: Billy Crudup
title: Billy Crudup
extract: William Gaither Crudup is an American actor. Known for his roles on stage and screen, Crudup has received two Critics Choice Awards, two Emmy Awards, and a Tony Award as well as nominations for two Golden Globe Awards and an Olivier Award.
extract_id: William Gaither Crudup adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal karena peran-perannya di panggung dan layar, Crudup telah menerima dua Critics Choice Awards, dua Emmy Awards, dan satu Tony Award serta nominasi untuk dua Golden Globe Awards dan Olivier Award.

name: Billy Crystal
title: Billy Crystal
extract: William Edward Crystal is an American comedian, actor, and filmmaker. He is known as a stand-up comedian and for his film and stage roles. Crystal has received numerous accolades, including six Primetime Emmy Awards and a Tony Award as well as nominations for three Grammy Awards and three Golden Globe Awards. He was honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 1991, the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor in 2007, the Critics' Choice Lifetime Achievement Award in 2022, and the Kennedy Center Honors in 2023.
extract_id: William Edward Crystal adalah komedian, aktor, dan pembuat film Amerika. Dia dikenal sebagai komedian stand-up dan karena peran-perannya di film dan panggung. Crystal telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk enam Primetime Emmy Awards dan Tony Award serta nominasi untuk tiga Grammy Awards dan tiga Golden Globe Awards. Dia dianugerahi bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada 1991, Mark Twain Prize untuk American Humor pada 2007, Critics' Choice Lifetime Achievement Award pada 2022, dan Kennedy Center Honors pada 2023.

name: Billy Dee Williams
title: Billy Dee Williams
extract: William December Williams Jr. is an American actor, novelist and painter. He has appeared in over 100 films and television roles over six decades. He is best known for portraying Lando Calrissian in the Star Wars franchise and has also appeared in critically acclaimed and popular titles such as Mahogany (1975), Scott Joplin (1977), and Nighthawks (1981), as Harvey Dent in Batman (1989) and The Lego Batman Movie (2017), The Last Angry Man (1959), Carter's Army (1969), The Out-of-Towners (1970), The Final Comedown and Lady Sings the Blues, Hit! (1973), Fear City and Terror in the Aisles, Alien Intruder (1993) and The Visit (2000).
extract_id: William December Williams Jr. adalah aktor, novelis, dan pelukis Amerika. Dia telah tampil dalam lebih dari 100 film dan peran televisi selama enam dekade. Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan Lando Calrissian dalam waralaba Star Wars dan juga tampil dalam judul-judul yang mendapat pujian kritis maupun populer seperti Mahogany (1975), Scott Joplin (1977), dan Nighthawks (1981), sebagai Harvey Dent dalam Batman (1989) dan The Lego Batman Movie (2017), The Last Angry Man (1959), Carter's Army (1969), The Out-of-Towners (1970), The Final Comedown dan Lady Sings the Blues, Hit! (1973), Fear City dan Terror in the Aisles, Alien Intruder (1993) dan The Visit (2000).

name: Billy Wilder
title: Billy Wilder
extract: Billy Wilder was an Austrian and American film director and screenwriter. His career in Hollywood spanned five decades, and he is regarded as one of America's most versatile filmmakers. He received seven Academy Awards, a BAFTA Award and the Palme d'Or.
extract_id: Billy Wilder adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film Austria dan Amerika. Kariernya di Hollywood berlangsung selama lima dekade, dan ia dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film paling serbaguna di Amerika. Ia menerima tujuh Academy Awards, satu BAFTA Award, dan Palme d'Or.

name: Billy Zane
title: Billy Zane
extract: William George Zane Jr. is an American actor. His breakthrough role was in the Australian film Dead Calm (1989), a performance that earned him a nomination for the Chicago Film Critics Association Award for Most Promising Actor. He has since appeared in numerous films and television series, and starred as the main antagonist Caledon Hockley in the epic film Titanic (1997), for which he and the rest of the ensemble cast were nominated for a Screen Actors Guild Award.
extract_id: William George Zane Jr. adalah aktor Amerika. Peran terobosannya adalah dalam film Australia Dead Calm (1989), sebuah penampilan yang memberinya nominasi untuk Chicago Film Critics Association Award untuk Aktor Paling Menjanjikan. Sejak itu ia tampil dalam banyak film dan serial televisi, serta berperan sebagai antagonis utama Caledon Hockley dalam film epik Titanic (1997), di mana dia dan seluruh pemeran ensemble dinominasikan untuk Screen Actors Guild Award.

name: Birgitta Pettersson
title: Birgitta Pettersson
extract: Birgitta Pettersson is a Swedish film actress. She is best known for her appearances in several films by director Ingmar Bergman. She was born in Uppsala, Sweden.
extract_id: Birgitta Pettersson adalah aktris film Swedia. Dia paling dikenal karena tampil dalam beberapa film karya sutradara Ingmar Bergman. Dia lahir di Uppsala, Swedia.

name: Birgitta Valberg
title: Birgitta Valberg
extract: Birgitta Valberg was a Swedish actress. She was best known for her work in several Ingmar Bergman films made over 30 years, including the Bergman-produced Summer Paradise (1977). For her role in this film, which was directed by Gunnel Lindblom, another member of Bergman's repertory company, she won the award for Best Actress at the 13th Guldbagge Awards.
extract_id: Birgitta Valberg adalah aktris Swedia. Dia paling dikenal karena karyanya dalam beberapa film Ingmar Bergman yang dibuat selama lebih dari 30 tahun, termasuk Summer Paradise (1977) yang diproduksi Bergman. Untuk perannya dalam film ini, yang disutradarai oleh Gunnel Lindblom, anggota lain dari perusahaan repertori Bergman, ia memenangkan penghargaan Aktris Terbaik di Guldbagge Awards ke-13.

name: Birol Ünel
title: Birol Ünel
extract: Birol Ünel was a Turkish-German actor who played in German and Turkish films, television, and theatrical productions. He was perhaps best known for his role as the alcoholic Cahit Tomruk in Fatih Akin's 2004 drama film Head-On, for which he received the German film prize for Best Actor.
extract_id: Birol Ünel adalah aktor Turki-Jerman yang bermain dalam film, televisi, dan produksi teater Jerman dan Turki. Dia mungkin paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai alkoholik Cahit Tomruk dalam film drama Head-On karya Fatih Akin tahun 2004, yang memberinya penghargaan film Jerman untuk Aktor Terbaik.

name: Björk
title: Björk
extract: Björk Guðmundsdóttir is an Icelandic singer, songwriter, composer, record producer and actress. Noted for her distinct voice, three-octave vocal range, and eccentric public persona, she has developed an eclectic musical style over a career spanning five decades, drawing on electronica, pop, dance, trip hop, jazz, and avant-garde music. She is regarded as one of the most influential musicians of her era.
extract_id: Björk Guðmundsdóttir adalah penyanyi, penulis lagu, komposer, produser rekaman, dan aktris Islandia. Dikenal karena suaranya yang khas, jangkauan vokal tiga oktaf, dan persona publik yang eksentrik, dia telah mengembangkan gaya musik eklektik sepanjang karier yang berlangsung lima dekade, mengambil unsur dari electronica, pop, dance, trip hop, jazz, dan musik avant-garde. Dia dianggap sebagai salah satu musisi paling berpengaruh pada zamannya.

name: Blake Edwards
title: Blake Edwards
extract: Blake Edwards was an American film director, producer, and screenwriter. Often thought of as primarily a director of comedies, he also directed several drama, musical, and detective films. Late in his career, he took up writing, producing and directing for theater. He received an Honorary Academy Award in recognition of his writing, directing and producing an extraordinary body of work for the screen.
extract_id: Blake Edwards adalah sutradara, produser, dan penulis skenario film Amerika. Sering dianggap terutama sebagai sutradara komedi, dia juga menyutradarai beberapa film drama, musikal, dan detektif. Pada akhir kariernya, ia mulai menulis, memproduksi, dan menyutradarai teater. Dia menerima Honorary Academy Award sebagai penghargaan atas karya tulis, penyutradaraan, dan produksi untuk layar yang luar biasa.

name: Bo Hopkins
title: Bo Hopkins
extract: William Mauldin "Bo" Hopkins was an American actor. He was known for playing supporting roles in several major studio films from 1969 to 1979, especially for his breakout role in the ensemble cast of George Lucas' American Graffiti. His credits span numerous films and TV appearances.
extract_id: William Mauldin "Bo" Hopkins adalah aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena memerankan peran pendukung dalam beberapa film studio utama dari 1969 hingga 1979, terutama untuk peran terobosannya dalam pemeran ensemble film George Lucas American Graffiti. Kreditnya mencakup banyak film dan penampilan TV.

name: Boaz Yakin
title: Boaz Yakin
extract: Boaz Yakin is an American filmmaker based in New York City. He has written screenplays to films like The Rookie, Fresh, A Price Above Rubies, Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time, and Now You See Me, and has directed the 2000 sports drama Remember the Titans and the 2012 Jason Statham action film Safe. As a producer he has collaborated frequently with filmmaker Eli Roth and served as executive producer for the first two entries in the Hostel franchise.
extract_id: Boaz Yakin adalah pembuat film Amerika yang berbasis di New York City. Dia telah menulis skenario untuk film seperti The Rookie, Fresh, A Price Above Rubies, Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time, dan Now You See Me, serta menyutradarai drama olahraga Remember the Titans (2000) dan film aksi Jason Statham Safe (2012). Sebagai produser, dia sering berkolaborasi dengan pembuat film Eli Roth dan menjadi produser eksekutif untuk dua film pertama dalam waralaba Hostel.

name: Bob Balaban
title: Bob Balaban
extract: Robert Elmer Balaban is an American actor and filmmaker. Aside from his acting career, Balaban has directed three feature films, in addition to numerous television episodes and films, and was one of the producers nominated for the Academy Award for Best Picture for Gosford Park (2001), in which he also appeared. He is also an author of children's novels.
extract_id: Robert Elmer Balaban adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Selain karier aktingnya, Balaban telah menyutradarai tiga film fitur, selain banyak episode dan film televisi, dan menjadi salah satu produser yang dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Best Picture untuk Gosford Park (2001), di mana dia juga tampil. Dia juga adalah penulis novel anak-anak.

name: Bob Clark
title: Bob Clark
extract: Benjamin Robert Clark was an American film director and screenwriter. In the 1970s and 1980s, he was responsible for some of the most successful films in Canadian film history such as Black Christmas (1974), Murder by Decree (1979), Tribute (1980), Porky's (1981) and A Christmas Story (1983). He won a trio of Genie Awards with two additional nominations.
extract_id: Benjamin Robert Clark adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film Amerika. Pada tahun 1970-an dan 1980-an, dia bertanggung jawab atas beberapa film paling sukses dalam sejarah perfilman Kanada seperti Black Christmas (1974), Murder by Decree (1979), Tribute (1980), Porky's (1981) dan A Christmas Story (1983). Dia memenangkan tiga Genie Awards dengan dua nominasi tambahan.

name: Bob Fosse
title: Bob Fosse
extract: Robert Louis Fosse was an American choreographer, dancer, actor, filmmaker, and stage director. He is known for his work on stage and screen, and was arguably the most influential figure in the field of jazz dance in the twentieth century. He received numerous accolades including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, three Primetime Emmy Awards, nine Tony Awards, and the Palme d'Or.
extract_id: Robert Louis Fosse adalah koreografer, penari, aktor, pembuat film, dan sutradara panggung Amerika. Dia dikenal karena karyanya di panggung dan layar, dan bisa dibilang adalah figur paling berpengaruh di bidang tari jazz di abad kedua puluh. Dia menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, tiga Primetime Emmy Awards, sembilan Tony Awards, dan Palme d'Or.

name: Bob Gale
title: Bob Gale
extract: Michael Robert Gale is an American screenwriter, comic book writer, film producer and director. He is best known for co-writing the science fiction comedy film Back to the Future with his writing partner Robert Zemeckis. Gale co-produced all three films of the franchise and later served as associate producer of the animated TV series. Actor Michael J. Fox has referred to Gale as the "gatekeeper of the [Back to the Future] franchise".
extract_id: Michael Robert Gale adalah penulis skenario, penulis buku komik, produser film, dan sutradara Amerika. Dia paling dikenal sebagai co-penulis film komedi fiksi ilmiah Back to the Future bersama mitra penulisnya Robert Zemeckis. Gale juga memproduseri ketiga film dalam waralaba tersebut dan kemudian menjadi produser asosiasi untuk serial TV animasi. Aktor Michael J. Fox menyebut Gale sebagai "gatekeeper dari waralaba [Back to the Future]".

name: Bob Geldof
title: Bob Geldof
extract: Robert Frederick Zenon Geldof is an Irish singer-songwriter, political activist, television producer and entrepreneur. He rose to prominence in the late 1970s as the lead singer of the Irish rock band the Boomtown Rats, who achieved popularity as part of the punk rock movement. The band had UK number one hits with his co-compositions "Rat Trap" and "I Don't Like Mondays". Geldof starred as Pink in Pink Floyd's film Pink Floyd – The Wall (1982).
extract_id: Robert Frederick Zenon Geldof adalah penyanyi-penulis lagu, aktivis politik, produser televisi, dan pengusaha Irlandia. Dia menjadi terkenal pada akhir 1970-an sebagai vokalis utama band rock Irlandia the Boomtown Rats, yang meraih popularitas sebagai bagian dari gerakan punk rock. Band ini memiliki hit nomor satu di Inggris dengan lagu ciptaannya bersama "Rat Trap" dan "I Don't Like Mondays". Geldof berperan sebagai Pink dalam film Pink Floyd – The Wall (1982).

name: Bob Gunton
title: Bob Gunton
description: American film, television, and theatre actor (born 1945)
extract: Robert Patrick Gunton Jr. is an American character actor of stage and screen. He is known for playing characters including Warden Samuel Norton in the 1994 prison drama The Shawshank Redemption, Chief George Earle in 1993's Demolition Man, Dr. Walcott, the domineering dean of Virginia Medical School in Patch Adams, and Secretary of State Cyrus Vance in Argo. He also played Leland Owlsley in the Daredevil television series, Secretary of Defense Ethan Kanin in 24, and Noah Taylor in Desperate Housewives.
extract_id: Robert Patrick Gunton Jr. adalah aktor karakter Amerika yang berakting di panggung dan layar. Ia dikenal karena memerankan karakter termasuk Kepala Penjara Samuel Norton dalam drama penjara The Shawshank Redemption tahun 1994, Kepala George Earle dalam film Demolition Man tahun 1993, Dr. Walcott, dekan yang dominan dari Virginia Medical School dalam Patch Adams, dan Menteri Luar Negeri Cyrus Vance dalam Argo. Ia juga memerankan Leland Owlsley dalam serial televisi Daredevil, Menteri Pertahanan Ethan Kanin dalam 24, dan Noah Taylor dalam Desperate Housewives.

name: Bob Hoskins
title: Bob Hoskins
extract: Robert William Hoskins was an English actor and film director. Known for his intense but sensitive portrayals of "tough guy" characters, he began his career on stage before making his screen breakthrough playing Arthur Parker in the 1978 BBC Television serial Pennies from Heaven. He subsequently played acclaimed lead roles in the films The Long Good Friday (1980), Mona Lisa (1986), Who Framed Roger Rabbit (1988), Mermaids (1990), TwentyFourSeven (1997), Felicia's Journey (1999), Noriega: God's Favorite (2000), Last Orders (2001), The Good Pope: Pope John XXIII (2003) and Ruby Blue (2008).
extract_id: Robert William Hoskins adalah aktor dan sutradara film Inggris. Dikenal karena penggambaran intens namun sensitif terhadap karakter "tough guy", ia memulai kariernya di panggung sebelum menorehkan terobosan layar dengan memerankan Arthur Parker dalam serial televisi BBC Pennies from Heaven tahun 1978. Selanjutnya ia memainkan peran utama yang diakui dalam film The Long Good Friday (1980), Mona Lisa (1986), Who Framed Roger Rabbit (1988), Mermaids (1990), TwentyFourSeven (1997), Felicia's Journey (1999), Noriega: God's Favorite (2000), Last Orders (2001), The Good Pope: Pope John XXIII (2003), dan Ruby Blue (2008).

name: Bob Odenkirk
title: Bob Odenkirk
extract: Robert John Odenkirk is an American actor, screenwriter, comedian, and producer. His accolades include two Primetime Emmy Awards and three Critics' Choice Television Awards, in addition to nominations for five Golden Globe Awards and a Tony Award.
extract_id: Robert John Odenkirk adalah aktor, penulis skenario, komedian, dan produser Amerika. Penghargaan yang ia terima mencakup dua Primetime Emmy Awards dan tiga Critics' Choice Television Awards, selain nominasi untuk lima Golden Globe Awards dan satu Tony Award.

name: Bob Persichetti
title: Bob Persichetti
extract: Robert Persichetti Jr. is an American filmmaker, animator, and storyboard artist. He is best known for co-directing the film Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, for which he won the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature.
extract_id: Robert Persichetti Jr. adalah pembuat film, animator, dan seniman storyboard Amerika. Ia paling dikenal sebagai sutradara bersama film Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, yang memberinya Academy Award untuk Best Animated Feature.

name: Bob Peterson
title: Bob Peterson (filmmaker)
extract: Robert Peterson is an American cartoonist, animator, director, screenwriter, storyboard supervisor, and voice actor at Pixar. He was hired at Pixar by Roger Gould in 1994 as an animator for commercials, before subsequently becoming an animator on Toy Story (1995). He was the co-director, co-star, co-head, and co-writer for Up (2009). He conceived the idea of The Good Dinosaur (2015), and was the film's original director before being dismissed from it. His work as a writer for the films Up and Finding Nemo (2003) earned him nominations for the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay. He was also a co-writer on Cars 3 (2017) and won the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Short Form Animated Program for his work on Forky Asks A Question (2020).
extract_id: Robert Peterson adalah kartunis, animator, sutradara, penulis skenario, supervisor storyboard, dan pengisi suara di Pixar asal Amerika. Ia direkrut oleh Roger Gould di Pixar pada tahun 1994 sebagai animator untuk iklan komersial, sebelum kemudian menjadi animator pada Toy Story (1995). Ia adalah sutradara bersama, pemeran utama bersama, kepala bersama, dan penulis skenario bersama untuk Up (2009). Ia merancang ide untuk The Good Dinosaur (2015), dan merupakan sutradara asli film tersebut sebelum dikeluarkan. Karyanya sebagai penulis untuk film Up dan Finding Nemo (2003) memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Best Original Screenplay. Ia juga menjadi penulis bersama pada Cars 3 (2017) dan memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award untuk Outstanding Short Form Animated Program atas karyanya di Forky Asks A Question (2020).

name: Bobby Cannavale
title: Bobby Cannavale
extract: Robert Michael Cannavale better known as Bobby Cannavale is an American actor. His breakthrough came with the leading role as FDNY Paramedic Roberto "Bobby" Caffey in the NBC series Third Watch, a role he played from 1999 to 2001.
extract_id: Robert Michael Cannavale yang lebih dikenal sebagai Bobby Cannavale adalah aktor Amerika. Terobosan kariernya datang dengan peran utama sebagai Paramedis FDNY Roberto "Bobby" Caffey dalam serial NBC Third Watch, peran yang dimainkan dari 1999 hingga 2001.

name: Bodil Rosing
title: Bodil Rosing
extract: Bodil Rosing was a Danish-American stage and film actress in the silent and sound eras.
extract_id: Bodil Rosing adalah aktris panggung dan film Denmark-Amerika pada era film bisu dan bersuara.

name: Boman Irani
title: Boman Irani
description: Indian actor, producer, filmmaker, voice artist and photographer (born 1959)
extract: Boman Irani is an Indian actor and comedian who works primarily in Hindi-language films. He has featured in over 100 films, and is the recipient of a Filmfare Award and two IIFA Awards.
extract_id: Boman Irani adalah aktor dan komedian India yang terutama bekerja dalam film berbahasa Hindi. Ia telah tampil dalam lebih dari 100 film, dan merupakan penerima Filmfare Award serta dua IIFA Awards.

name: Bong Joon Ho
title: Bong Joon Ho
extract: Bong Joon Ho is a South Korean filmmaker. His work is characterized by emphasis on social and class themes, genre-mixing, dark comedy, and sudden tone shifts. He is the recipient of numerous accolades including three Academy Awards, two British Academy Film Awards, and five Asian Film Awards, as well as nominations for two Golden Globe Awards. In 2017, he was included on Metacritic's list of the 25 best film directors of the 21st century, and in 2020, he was listed as one of the 100 most influential people in the world by Time and among the Bloomberg 50.
extract_id: Bong Joon Ho adalah pembuat film Korea Selatan. Karyanya ditandai dengan penekanan pada tema sosial dan kelas, pencampuran genre, komedi gelap, dan perubahan nada yang tiba-tiba. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk tiga Academy Awards, dua British Academy Film Awards, dan lima Asian Film Awards, serta nominasi untuk dua Golden Globe Awards. Pada 2017, ia masuk dalam daftar Metacritic sebagai 25 sutradara film terbaik abad ke-21, dan pada 2020, ia tercantum sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia oleh Time serta termasuk dalam Bloomberg 50.

name: Bonnie Bedelia
title: Bonnie Bedelia
extract: Bonnie Bedelia Culkin is an American actress. After beginning her career in theatre in the 1960s, Bedelia starred in the CBS daytime soap opera Love of Life and made her film debut in The Gypsy Moths. Bedelia subsequently appeared in the films They Shoot Horses, Don't They?, Lovers and Other Strangers, Heart Like a Wheel, The Prince of Pennsylvania, Die Hard, Presumed Innocent, Sordid Lives, and Needful Things.
extract_id: Bonnie Bedelia Culkin adalah aktris Amerika. Setelah memulai kariernya di teater pada 1960-an, Bedelia membintangi opera sabun siang CBS Love of Life dan memulai debut filmnya dalam The Gypsy Moths. Bedelia kemudian tampil dalam film They Shoot Horses, Don't They?, Lovers and Other Strangers, Heart Like a Wheel, The Prince of Pennsylvania, Die Hard, Presumed Innocent, Sordid Lives, dan Needful Things.

name: Bonnie Hunt
title: Bonnie Hunt
description: American actress, comedian, writer and director (born 1961)
extract: Bonnie Hunt is an American actress and comedian. Beginning in the 1980s, she gained recognition for supporting roles in films including Rain Man (1988), Beethoven (1992), Beethoven's 2nd (1993), Jumanji (1995), Jerry Maguire (1996), and The Green Mile (1999). Hunt made her directorial debut with the romantic drama Return to Me (2000), in which she also starred.
extract_id: Bonnie Hunt adalah aktris dan komedian Amerika. Dimulai pada 1980-an, ia mendapat pengakuan lewat peran pendukung dalam film seperti Rain Man (1988), Beethoven (1992), Beethoven's 2nd (1993), Jumanji (1995), Jerry Maguire (1996), dan The Green Mile (1999). Hunt membuat debut sebagai sutradara dengan drama romantis Return to Me (2000), di mana ia juga membintangi.

name: Bora Todorovic
title: Bora Todorović
extract: Borivoje "Bora" Todorović was a Serbian actor. He was the younger brother of the actress, Mira Stupica, and father of Srđan Todorović.
extract_id: Borivoje "Bora" Todorović adalah aktor Serbia. Ia adalah adik dari aktris Mira Stupica, dan ayah dari Srđan Todorović.

name: Boris Karloff
title: Boris Karloff
extract: William Henry Pratt, known professionally as Boris Karloff, was an English actor. His portrayal of Frankenstein's monster in the horror film Frankenstein (1931), his 82nd film, established him as a horror icon, and he reprised the role for the sequels Bride of Frankenstein (1935) and Son of Frankenstein (1939). He also appeared as Imhotep in The Mummy (1932), and voiced the Grinch in, as well as narrating, the animated television special of Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas! (1966), which won him a Grammy Award.
extract_id: William Henry Pratt, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Boris Karloff, adalah aktor Inggris. Perannya sebagai monster Frankenstein dalam film horor Frankenstein (1931), film ke-82-nya, menjadikannya ikon horor, dan ia mengulang peran tersebut dalam sekuel Bride of Frankenstein (1935) dan Son of Frankenstein (1939). Ia juga tampil sebagai Imhotep dalam The Mummy (1932), dan mengisi suara Grinch serta menjadi narator dalam spesial televisi animasi Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas! (1966), yang memberinya Grammy Award.

name: Boyd Holbrook
title: Boyd Holbrook
extract: Robert Boyd Holbrook is an American actor. He made his acting debut in the 2008 Gus Van Sant film Milk and had his breakthrough portraying DEA agent Steve Murphy in the Netflix television series Narcos (2015–2016).
extract_id: Robert Boyd Holbrook adalah aktor Amerika. Ia memulai debut aktingnya dalam film Gus Van Sant tahun 2008 berjudul Milk dan menorehkan terobosan dengan memerankan agen DEA Steve Murphy dalam serial Netflix Narcos (2015–2016).

name: Boyd Kirkland
title: Boyd Kirkland
extract: Boyd Douglas Kirkland was an American television director of animated cartoons. He was best known for his work on X-Men: Evolution and Batman: The Animated Series.
extract_id: Boyd Douglas Kirkland adalah sutradara televisi Amerika untuk kartun animasi. Ia dikenal karena karyanya di X-Men: Evolution dan Batman: The Animated Series.

name: Brad Anderson
title: Brad Anderson (director)
extract: Brad Anderson is an American film director, producer and writer.
