A director of thriller and horror films and television projects, he is best known for directing The Machinist (2004), starring Christian Bale, psychological horror film Session 9 (2001) and The Call (2013), starring Halle Berry. He also produced and directed several episodes of the Fox science fiction series Fringe. Earlier in his career he directed the romantic comedies Next Stop Wonderland (1998) and Happy Accidents (2000).
extract_id: Brad Anderson adalah sutradara film, produser, dan penulis Amerika. Sebagai sutradara film thriller dan horor serta proyek televisi, ia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai The Machinist (2004) yang dibintangi Christian Bale, film horor psikologis Session 9 (2001), dan The Call (2013) yang dibintangi Halle Berry. Ia juga memproduksi dan menyutradarai beberapa episode serial fiksi ilmiah Fox, Fringe. Pada awal kariernya, ia menyutradarai komedi romantis Next Stop Wonderland (1998) dan Happy Accidents (2000).

name: Brad Bird
title: Brad Bird
description: American filmmaker, animator, and voice actor (born 1957)
extract: Philip Bradley Bird is an American filmmaker, animator, and voice actor. He developed an interest in the art of animation early on, and completed his first short subject by age 14. Bird sent the film to Walt Disney Productions, leading to an apprenticeship from the studio's Nine Old Men. He attended the California Institute of the Arts in the late 1970s, and worked for Disney shortly thereafter.
extract_id: Philip Bradley Bird adalah pembuat film, animator, dan pengisi suara Amerika. Ia mengembangkan minat dalam seni animasi sejak dini, dan menyelesaikan film pendek pertamanya pada usia 14 tahun. Bird mengirimkan film tersebut ke Walt Disney Productions, yang mengantarkannya mendapatkan magang dari Nine Old Men di studio tersebut. Ia bersekolah di California Institute of the Arts pada akhir 1970-an, dan bekerja untuk Disney tak lama setelahnya.

name: Brad Davis
title: Brad Davis (actor)
extract: Robert Creel Davis, known professionally as Brad Davis, was an American actor. For his debut film role as Billy Hayes in the 1978 film Midnight Express, he won the Golden Globe Award for New Star of the Year – Actor and was nominated for Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama, along with BAFTA Award nominations for Best Actor in a Leading Role and Most Promising Newcomer to Leading Film Roles.
extract_id: Robert Creel Davis, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Brad Davis, adalah aktor Amerika. Untuk peran debut filmnya sebagai Billy Hayes dalam film Midnight Express tahun 1978, ia memenangkan Golden Globe Award untuk New Star of the Year – Actor dan dinominasikan untuk Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama, bersama nominasi BAFTA Award untuk Best Actor in a Leading Role dan Most Promising Newcomer to Leading Film Roles.

name: Brad Dourif
title: Brad Dourif
extract: Bradford Claude Dourif is an American actor. He is known for his Academy Award-nominated role as Billy Bibbit in One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest (1975), portraying Gríma Wormtongue in The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers (2002), and voicing Chucky in the Child's Play franchise (1988–present).
extract_id: Bradford Claude Dourif adalah aktor Amerika. Ia dikenal untuk peran yang dinominasikan Academy Award sebagai Billy Bibbit dalam One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest (1975), memerankan Gríma Wormtongue dalam The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers (2002), dan mengisi suara Chucky dalam franchise Child's Play (1988–sekarang).

name: Brad Garrett
title: Brad Garrett
extract: Brad H. Gerstenfeld, known professionally as Brad Garrett, is an American stand-up comedian and actor.
extract_id: Brad H. Gerstenfeld, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Brad Garrett, adalah komedian stand-up dan aktor Amerika.

name: Brad Pitt
title: Brad Pitt
extract: William Bradley Pitt is an American actor and film producer. In a film career spanning more than thirty-five years, Pitt has received numerous accolades, including two Academy Awards, two British Academy Film Awards, two Golden Globe Awards, two Primetime Emmy Awards, and one Volpi Cup. His films as a leading actor have grossed over $7.5 billion worldwide.
extract_id: William Bradley Pitt adalah aktor dan produser film Amerika. Dalam karier film yang berlangsung lebih dari tiga puluh lima tahun, Pitt telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards, dua British Academy Film Awards, dua Golden Globe Awards, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan satu Volpi Cup. Film-filmnya sebagai aktor utama telah meraih pendapatan lebih dari $7,5 miliar di seluruh dunia.

name: Bradley Cooper
title: Bradley Cooper
extract: Bradley Charles Cooper is an American actor and filmmaker. He is the recipient of various accolades, including a British Academy Film Award and three Grammy Awards. In addition, he has been nominated for twelve Academy Awards, six Golden Globe Awards, and a Tony Award. Cooper appeared on the Forbes Celebrity 100 list three times and on Time's list of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2015. His films have grossed $13 billion worldwide, and he has been placed in annual rankings of the world's highest-paid actors four times.
extract_id: Bradley Charles Cooper adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk British Academy Film Award dan tiga Grammy Awards. Selain itu, ia telah dinominasikan untuk dua belas Academy Awards, enam Golden Globe Awards, dan satu Tony Award. Cooper pernah masuk dalam daftar Forbes Celebrity 100 sebanyak tiga kali dan dalam daftar Time 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia pada 2015. Film-filmnya telah meraih pendapatan sebesar $13 miliar di seluruh dunia, dan ia telah masuk dalam peringkat tahunan aktor dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia sebanyak empat kali.

name: Bradley Whitford
title: Bradley Whitford
extract: Bradley Whitford is an American actor and producer. From 1999 to 2006, Whitford starred as Josh Lyman, White House Deputy Chief of Staff, in NBC's political drama television series The West Wing. He won a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama Series for the role in 2001.
extract_id: Bradley Whitford adalah aktor dan produser Amerika. Dari 1999 hingga 2006, Whitford membintangi sebagai Josh Lyman, Wakil Kepala Staf Gedung Putih, dalam serial drama politik NBC The West Wing. Ia memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award untuk Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama Series atas peran tersebut pada tahun 2001.

name: Brady Corbet
title: Brady Corbet
extract: Brady James Monson Corbet is an American filmmaker and former actor. Since retiring from acting in 2014 to pursue his filmmaking career with his partner Mona Fastvold, Corbet made his directorial debut with the psychological drama The Childhood of a Leader (2015). He has since co-written and directed the musical drama Vox Lux (2018) and the period epic The Brutalist (2024). The latter earned him the Silver Lion, BAFTA, and Golden Globe for Best Director as well as three Academy Award nominations for Best Picture, Director, and Original Screenplay.
extract_id: Brady James Monson Corbet adalah pembuat film dan mantan aktor Amerika. Sejak pensiun dari dunia akting pada 2014 untuk mengejar karier pembuat film bersama pasangannya Mona Fastvold, Corbet membuat debut sebagai sutradara dengan drama psikologis The Childhood of a Leader (2015). Ia kemudian menjadi penulis dan sutradara bersama dalam drama musikal Vox Lux (2018) serta epik periodik The Brutalist (2024). Yang terakhir memberinya Silver Lion, BAFTA, dan Golden Globe untuk Sutradara Terbaik serta tiga nominasi Academy Award untuk Film Terbaik, Sutradara, dan Skenario Asli.

name: Brahim Hadjadj
title: Brahim Hadjadj
extract: Brahim Hadjadj was an Algerian actor. He is most notable for the roles in the films The Battle of Algiers, Patrouille à l'Est and L'opium et le baton.
extract_id: Brahim Hadjadj adalah aktor Aljazair. Ia paling dikenal karena perannya dalam film The Battle of Algiers, Patrouille à l'Est, dan L'opium et le baton.

name: Branka Katic
title: Branka Katić
extract: Branka Katić is a Serbian actress known for appearing in the films Black Cat, White Cat and Public Enemies, and the TV series Big Love.
extract_id: Branka Katić adalah aktris Serbia yang dikenal karena tampil dalam film Black Cat, White Cat dan Public Enemies, serta serial TV Big Love.

name: Branko Djuric
title: Branko Đurić
description: Bosnian actor, comedian, film director and musician (born 1962)
extract: Branko Đurić, commonly known as Đuro, is a Bosnian actor, comedian, film director and musician.
extract_id: Branko Đurić, yang biasa dikenal sebagai Đuro, adalah aktor, komedian, sutradara film, dan musisi Bosnia.

name: Brenda Blethyn
title: Brenda Blethyn
extract: Brenda Blethyn is an English actress. Known for her character work and versatility, she is the recipient of various accolades, including a Golden Globe Award, a British Academy Film Award, and a Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Actress, as well as nominations for two Academy Awards and two Primetime Emmy Awards. She was appointed Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) for services to drama in 2003.
extract_id: Brenda Blethyn adalah aktris Inggris. Dikenal karena keahliannya dalam memerankan karakter dan keberagamannya, dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Golden Globe Award, British Academy Film Award, dan Cannes Film Festival Award untuk Aktris Terbaik, serta nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards. Dia diangkat sebagai Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) atas jasanya di dunia drama pada tahun 2003.

name: Brenda Fricker
title: Brenda Fricker
extract: Brenda Fricker was an Irish actress whose career spanned six decades on stage and screen. She appeared in more than 30 films and television productions. In 1990, Fricker became the first Irish actress to win an Academy Award, earning the award for Best Supporting Actress for the biopic My Left Foot (1989). She also appeared in films such as The Field (1990), Home Alone 2: Lost in New York (1992), So I Married an Axe Murderer (1993), Angels in the Outfield (1994), A Time to Kill (1996), Veronica Guerin (2003), Inside I'm Dancing (2004), and Albert Nobbs (2011).
extract_id: Brenda Fricker adalah aktris Irlandia yang kariernya meliputi enam dekade di panggung dan layar kaca. Dia tampil dalam lebih dari 30 produksi film dan televisi. Pada tahun 1990, Fricker menjadi aktris Irlandia pertama yang memenangkan Academy Award, meraih penghargaan untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik untuk film biopik My Left Foot (1989). Dia juga tampil dalam film-film seperti The Field (1990), Home Alone 2: Lost in New York (1992), So I Married an Axe Murderer (1993), Angels in the Outfield (1994), A Time to Kill (1996), Veronica Guerin (2003), Inside I'm Dancing (2004), dan Albert Nobbs (2011).

name: Brendan Gleeson
title: Brendan Gleeson
extract: Brendan Gleeson is an Irish actor. He has received various accolades, including a Primetime Emmy Award, two British Independent Film Awards and three IFTA Awards, along with nominations for an Academy Award, three BAFTA Awards and five Golden Globe Awards. In 2020, he was listed at number 18 on The Irish Times list of Ireland's greatest film actors. He is the father of actors Domhnall Gleeson and Brian Gleeson.
extract_id: Brendan Gleeson adalah aktor Irlandia. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Primetime Emmy Award, dua British Independent Film Awards, dan tiga IFTA Awards, bersama dengan nominasi untuk Academy Award, tiga BAFTA Awards, dan lima Golden Globe Awards. Pada tahun 2020, dia tercantum di nomor 18 dalam daftar The Irish Times tentang aktor film terbesar Irlandia. Dia adalah ayah dari aktor Domhnall Gleeson dan Brian Gleeson.

name: Bria Vinaite
title: Bria Vinaite
extract: Bria Vinaite is a Lithuanian-born American actress, best known for her debut role as Halley in Sean Baker's 2017 film The Florida Project.
extract_id: Bria Vinaite adalah aktris kelahiran Lithuania yang berkebangsaan Amerika, paling dikenal karena peran debutnya sebagai Halley dalam film The Florida Project (2017) karya Sean Baker.

name: Brian Cox
title: Brian Cox (actor)
extract: Brian Denis Cox is a Scottish actor. A classically trained Shakespearean actor, he is known for his work on stage and screen. His numerous accolades include two Laurence Olivier Awards, a Primetime Emmy Award, and a Golden Globe Award as well as two nominations for a British Academy Television Award. In the 2003 New Year Honours, he was appointed to the Order of the British Empire at the rank of Commander.
extract_id: Brian Denis Cox adalah aktor Skotlandia. Sebagai aktor Shakespeare klasik, dia dikenal karena karyanya di panggung dan layar. Berbagai penghargaan yang diperolehnya termasuk dua Laurence Olivier Awards, Primetime Emmy Award, dan Golden Globe Award serta dua nominasi British Academy Television Award. Dalam New Year Honours 2003, ia diangkat ke Order of the British Empire dengan pangkat Commander.

name: Brian De Palma
title: Brian De Palma
extract: Brian Russell De Palma is an American filmmaker. A major figure of the New Hollywood generation, he is best known for his work in the suspense, crime, and psychological thriller genres in a career spanning more than five decades.
extract_id: Brian Russell De Palma adalah pembuat film Amerika. Sebagai figur utama generasi New Hollywood, ia paling dikenal karena karyanya di genre suspense, kejahatan, dan thriller psikologis dalam karir yang berlangsung lebih dari lima dekade.

name: Brian Dennehy
title: Brian Dennehy
extract: Brian Manion Dennehy was an American actor. Renowned for his performances on stage and screen and once described as "perhaps the foremost living interpreter" of Eugene O'Neill's works, he received two Tony Awards, a Laurence Olivier Award, and a Golden Globe Award, in addition to nominations for six Primetime Emmy Awards and a Grammy Award.
extract_id: Brian Manion Dennehy adalah aktor Amerika. Terkenal karena penampilannya di panggung dan layar dan pernah disebut sebagai "mungkin penafsir karya Eugene O'Neill yang hidup paling utama", ia menerima dua Tony Awards, satu Laurence Olivier Award, dan satu Golden Globe Award, selain nominasi enam Primetime Emmy Awards dan satu Grammy Award.

name: Brian G. Hutton
title: Brian G. Hutton
extract: Brian Geoffrey Hutton was an American film director and actor. As a filmmaker, he was best known for directing the World War II action films Where Eagles Dare (1968) and Kelly's Heroes (1970).
extract_id: Brian Geoffrey Hutton adalah sutradara film dan aktor Amerika. Sebagai pembuat film, dia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai film aksi Perang Dunia II Where Eagles Dare (1968) dan Kelly's Heroes (1970).

name: Brian Henson
title: Brian Henson
extract: Brian David Henson is an American puppeteer, filmmaker, and the chairman of The Jim Henson Company. He is the son of puppeteers Jim and Jane Henson.
extract_id: Brian David Henson adalah dalang, pembuat film Amerika, dan ketua The Jim Henson Company. Ia adalah putra dari dalang Jim dan Jane Henson.

name: Brian Howe
title: Brian Howe (actor)
extract: Brian Howe is an American actor. He is best known for his portrayal of stockbroker Jay Twistle in the film The Pursuit of Happyness.
extract_id: Brian Howe adalah aktor Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai pialang saham Jay Twistle dalam film The Pursuit of Happyness.

name: Brian O'Halloran
title: Brian O'Halloran
extract: Brian Christopher O'Halloran is an American actor, producer and podcaster best known for playing Dante Hicks in Kevin Smith's debut 1994 film Clerks and its 2006 and 2022 sequels Clerks II and Clerks III. He has also made appearances in most of Smith's View Askewniverse films, either as Dante Hicks or one of Dante's cousins.
extract_id: Brian Christopher O'Halloran adalah aktor, produser, dan podcaster Amerika yang paling dikenal karena memerankan Dante Hicks dalam film debut Kevin Smith tahun 1994 Clerks dan sekuelnya Clerks II (2006) dan Clerks III (2022). Ia juga tampil dalam sebagian besar film View Askewniverse karya Smith, baik sebagai Dante Hicks maupun salah satu sepupu Dante.

name: Brian Tyler
title: Brian Tyler
extract: Brian Theodore Tyler is an American composer, conductor, arranger and multi-instrumentalist best known for his film, television, and video game scores. In his 26-year career, Tyler has scored seven installments of the Fast & Furious franchise, Aliens vs. Predator: Requiem, the fourth and fifth films of the Rambo franchise, Eagle Eye, the fourth and fifth films of the Final Destination franchise, the first three films of The Expendables franchise, the Marvel Cinematic Universe films Iron Man 3, Thor: The Dark World, and Avengers: Age of Ultron alongside Danny Elfman, the Now You See Me franchise, Crazy Rich Asians, the fifth and sixth films of the Scream franchise, The Super Mario Bros. Movie, and its sequel, The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, among others.
extract_id: Brian Theodore Tyler adalah komposer, konduktor, arranger, dan multi-instrumentalis Amerika yang paling dikenal untuk skor film, televisi, dan permainan video. Dalam karirnya yang berlangsung 26 tahun, Tyler telah mengaransemen tujuh film dalam franchise Fast & Furious, Aliens vs. Predator: Requiem, film keempat dan kelima dalam franchise Rambo, Eagle Eye, film keempat dan kelima dalam franchise Final Destination, tiga film pertama dalam franchise The Expendables, film Marvel Cinematic Universe Iron Man 3, Thor: The Dark World, dan Avengers: Age of Ultron bersama Danny Elfman, franchise Now You See Me, Crazy Rich Asians, film kelima dan keenam dalam franchise Scream, The Super Mario Bros. Movie, dan sekuelnya, The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, antara lain.

name: Bridget Moynahan
title: Bridget Moynahan
extract: Kathryn Bridget Moynahan is an American actress and former model. She graduated from Longmeadow High School in Massachusetts in 1989 and began pursuing a career in modeling. Moynahan appeared in department-store catalogs and magazines, and after doing television commercials, began taking acting lessons. She made her television debut in a guest appearance in the comedy series Sex and the City in 1999, where she later had a recurring role as Natasha.
extract_id: Kathryn Bridget Moynahan adalah aktris dan mantan model Amerika. Dia lulus dari Longmeadow High School di Massachusetts pada tahun 1989 dan mulai mengejar karir dalam dunia modeling. Moynahan tampil dalam katalog dan majalah department store, dan setelah melakukan iklan televisi, mulai mengambil pelajaran akting. Dia memulai debut televisinya dengan penampilan tamu dalam serial komedi Sex and the City pada tahun 1999, di mana kemudian ia memiliki peran berulang sebagai Natasha.

name: Brie Larson
title: Brie Larson
extract: Brianne Sidonie Desaulniers, known professionally as Brie Larson, is an American actress, singer and filmmaker. She played supporting roles in comedies as a teenager, and has since expanded to leading roles in independent films and blockbusters. Her accolades include an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award. Time magazine named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2019.
extract_id: Brianne Sidonie Desaulniers, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Brie Larson, adalah aktris, penyanyi, dan pembuat film Amerika. Dia memainkan peran pendukung dalam komedi saat remaja, dan sejak itu memperluas ke peran utama dalam film independen dan blockbuster. Penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Primetime Emmy Award. Majalah Time menobatkannya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia pada tahun 2019.

name: Brigitte Helm
title: Brigitte Helm
extract: Brigitte Helm was a German actress, best remembered for her dual role as Maria and her double, the Maschinenmensch, in Fritz Lang's 1927 silent film Metropolis.
extract_id: Brigitte Helm adalah aktris Jerman, paling diingat karena perannya ganda sebagai Maria dan bayangannya, Maschinenmensch, dalam film bisu Fritz Lang tahun 1927, Metropolis.

name: Brigitte Lin
title: Brigitte Lin
extract: Brigitte Lin Ching-hsia is a Taiwanese actress. Regarded as a screen icon, Lin played a key role in boosting Taiwan's film production with her romantic heroine roles in the 1970s before transitioning to Hong Kong, where she achieved great success with her androgynous roles in wuxia films. Following her marriage in 1994, she retired from acting and transitioned to writing in the 2000s, publishing four essay collections. In 2023, she received the Lifetime Achievement Award at the 60th Golden Horse Awards.
extract_id: Brigitte Lin Ching-hsia adalah aktris Taiwan. Dianggap sebagai ikon layar, Lin memainkan peran penting dalam meningkatkan produksi film Taiwan dengan peran pahlawan romantisnya pada tahun 1970-an sebelum beralih ke Hong Kong, di mana ia meraih kesuksesan besar dengan peran androgin dalam film wuxia. Setelah menikah pada tahun 1994, ia pensiun dari dunia akting dan beralih ke menulis pada tahun 2000-an, menerbitkan empat kumpulan esai. Pada tahun 2023, ia menerima Lifetime Achievement Award di Penghargaan Golden Horse ke-60.

name: Brooke Adams
title: Brooke Adams (actress)
extract: Brooke Adams is an American actress, best known for her film roles in Days of Heaven (1978), Invasion of the Body Snatchers (1978) and The Dead Zone (1983).
extract_id: Brooke Adams adalah aktris Amerika, paling dikenal karena perannya dalam film Days of Heaven (1978), Invasion of the Body Snatchers (1978), dan The Dead Zone (1983).

name: Brooklynn Prince
title: Brooklynn Prince
extract: Brooklynn Kimberly Prince is an American actress and filmmaker known for her roles as Moonee in the comedy-drama film The Florida Project (2017) and Hilde Lisko in the Apple TV+ series Home Before Dark (2020–2021).
extract_id: Brooklynn Kimberly Prince adalah aktris dan pembuat film Amerika yang dikenal karena perannya sebagai Moonee dalam film drama-komedi The Florida Project (2017) dan Hilde Lisko dalam serial Apple TV+ Home Before Dark (2020–2021).

name: Bruce Bennett
title: Bruce Bennett
extract: Bruce Bennett was an American film and television actor who was a college athlete in football and in intercollegiate and international track-and-field competitions. In 1928, he won the silver medal for the shot put at the Olympic Games in Amsterdam.
extract_id: Bruce Bennett adalah aktor film dan televisi Amerika yang juga pernah menjadi atlet perguruan tinggi dalam sepak bola dan kompetisi lari dan lompat internasional. Pada tahun 1928, ia memenangkan medali perak untuk lempar peluru pada Olimpiade di Amsterdam.

name: Bruce Cabot
title: Bruce Cabot
extract: Bruce Cabot was an American film actor, best remembered as Jack Driscoll in King Kong (1933) and for his roles in films such as The Last of the Mohicans (1936), Fritz Lang's Fury (1936), and the Western Dodge City (1939). He was also known as one of "Wayne's Regulars", appearing in a number of John Wayne films beginning with Angel and the Badman (1947), and concluding with Big Jake (1971).
extract_id: Bruce Cabot adalah aktor film Amerika, paling diingat sebagai Jack Driscoll dalam King Kong (1933) dan perannya dalam film-film seperti The Last of the Mohicans (1936), Fury karya Fritz Lang (1936), dan Western Dodge City (1939). Ia juga dikenal sebagai salah satu "Wayne's Regulars", tampil dalam sejumlah film John Wayne mulai dari Angel and the Badman (1947) hingga Big Jake (1971).

name: Bruce Campbell
title: Bruce Campbell
extract: Bruce Lorne Campbell is an American actor and filmmaker. He is best known for portraying Ash Williams in Sam Raimi's Evil Dead horror series. He has also featured in many low-budget cult movies, such as Crimewave (1985), Maniac Cop (1988), Sundown: The Vampire in Retreat (1989), and Bubba Ho-Tep (2002). His roles in horror earned him the fame to be known as a scream king, being referred as "the definitive one"..
extract_id: Bruce Lorne Campbell adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena memerankan Ash Williams dalam seri film horor Evil Dead karya Sam Raimi. Ia juga tampil dalam banyak film kultus dengan anggaran rendah, seperti Crimewave (1985), Maniac Cop (1988), Sundown: The Vampire in Retreat (1989), dan Bubba Ho-Tep (2002). Perannya dalam film horor memberinya julukan raja teriakan, dikenal sebagai "yang paling definitif".

name: Bruce Davison
title: Bruce Davison
extract: Bruce Davison is an American actor who has appeared in more than 270 films, television and stage productions since his debut in 1968. His breakthrough role was as Willard Stiles in the 1971 cult horror film Willard. He was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor, and won a Golden Globe Award and an Independent Spirit Award for his performance in Longtime Companion (1989).
extract_id: Bruce Davison adalah aktor Amerika yang telah tampil dalam lebih dari 270 film, produksi televisi, dan panggung sejak debutnya pada tahun 1968. Peran terobosannya adalah sebagai Willard Stiles dalam film horor kultus Willard tahun 1971. Ia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award sebagai Aktor Pendukung Terbaik, dan memenangkan Golden Globe Award serta Independent Spirit Award untuk penampilannya dalam Longtime Companion (1989).

name: Bruce Dern
title: Bruce Dern
extract: Bruce MacLeish Dern is an American actor. He has received several accolades, including the Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Actor for Nebraska (2013), which also earned him a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Actor, and won the Silver Bear for Best Actor for That Championship Season (1982). He was also Oscar nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for Coming Home (1978). He is also a BAFTA Award, two-time Genie Award, and three-time Golden Globe Award nominee.
extract_id: Bruce MacLeish Dern adalah aktor Amerika. Ia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk Cannes Film Festival Award untuk Aktor Terbaik untuk Nebraska (2013), yang juga memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Terbaik, dan memenangkan Silver Bear untuk Aktor Terbaik untuk That Championship Season (1982). Ia juga pernah dinominasikan Oscar untuk Academy Award Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk Coming Home (1978). Ia juga merupakan nominasi BAFTA Award, dua kali Genie Award, dan tiga kali Golden Globe Award.

name: Bruce Lee
title: Bruce Lee
extract: Bruce Lee was a Hong Kong and American martial artist, actor, and filmmaker. He was the founder of Jeet Kune Do, a hybrid martial arts philosophy, which was formed from his experiences in unarmed fighting and self-defense—as well as eclectic, Zen Buddhist, and Taoist philosophies—as a new school of martial arts thought. With a career spanning Hong Kong and the United States, Lee is regarded as the first global Chinese film star and one of the most influential martial artists in the history of cinema. Known for the five feature-length martial arts films that he starred in as an adult, he is credited with helping to popularize martial arts films in the 1970s and promoting Hong Kong action cinema.
extract_id: Bruce Lee adalah seniman bela diri, aktor, dan pembuat film Hong Kong dan Amerika. Dia adalah pendiri Jeet Kune Do, sebuah filosofi seni bela diri hibrida, yang dibentuk dari pengalamannya dalam pertarungan tanpa senjata dan bela diri—serta filosofi eklektik, Zen Buddhis, dan Taoisme—sebagai sekolah baru pemikiran seni bela diri. Dengan karier yang meliputi Hong Kong dan Amerika Serikat, Lee dianggap sebagai bintang film Tionghoa global pertama dan salah satu seniman bela diri paling berpengaruh dalam sejarah sinema. Dikenal karena lima film fitur seni bela diri yang dibintanginya saat dewasa, ia diberi kredit membantu mempopulerkan film seni bela diri pada 1970-an dan mempromosikan sinema aksi Hong Kong.

name: Bruce Reitherman
title: Bruce Reitherman
extract: Bruce Reitherman is an American cameraman, filmmaker, naturalist and former child actor. He voiced Christopher Robin in Winnie the Pooh and the Honey Tree and Mowgli in The Jungle Book.
extract_id: Bruce Reitherman adalah seorang juru kamera, pembuat film, naturalis, dan mantan aktor cilik Amerika. Dia mengisi suara Christopher Robin dalam Winnie the Pooh and the Honey Tree dan Mowgli dalam The Jungle Book.

name: Bruce Robinson
title: Bruce Robinson
extract: Bruce Robinson is an English actor, director, screenwriter and novelist. He wrote and directed Withnail and I (1987), a film with comic and tragic elements set in London in the late 1960s, which drew on his experiences as a struggling actor, living in poverty in Camden Town. He was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Adapted Screenplay for The Killing Fields (1984).
extract_id: Bruce Robinson adalah seorang aktor, sutradara, penulis skenario, dan novelis Inggris. Dia menulis dan menyutradarai Withnail and I (1987), sebuah film dengan unsur komik dan tragis yang berlatar di London pada akhir 1960-an, yang menarik dari pengalamannya sebagai aktor yang berjuang, hidup dalam kemiskinan di Camden Town. Dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Best Adapted Screenplay untuk The Killing Fields (1984).

name: Bruce Spence
title: Bruce Spence
extract: Bruce Robert Spence is a New Zealand-born Australian actor. Spence has amassed over 100 film and television credits and has also acted in theatre.
extract_id: Bruce Robert Spence adalah seorang aktor Australia kelahiran Selandia Baru. Spence telah mengumpulkan lebih dari 100 kredit film dan televisi serta juga berakting di teater.

name: Bruce Willis
title: Bruce Willis
extract: Walter Bruce Willis is a retired American actor. Widely recognized as a Hollywood icon of the action genre, he first achieved fame with a leading role on the comedy-drama series Moonlighting (1985–1989) and has appeared in over one hundred films, gaining widespread recognition as an action hero for his portrayal of John McClane in the Die Hard franchise (1988–2013).
extract_id: Walter Bruce Willis adalah seorang aktor Amerika yang telah pensiun. Secara luas dikenal sebagai ikon Hollywood di genre aksi, dia pertama kali meraih ketenaran dengan peran utama dalam serial drama-komedi Moonlighting (1985–1989) dan telah tampil dalam lebih dari seratus film, mendapatkan pengakuan luas sebagai pahlawan aksi untuk perannya sebagai John McClane dalam franchise Die Hard (1988–2013).

name: Bruno Ganz
title: Bruno Ganz
extract: Bruno Ganz was a Swiss actor whose career in German stage, television and film productions spanned nearly 60 years. He was known for his collaborations with the directors Werner Herzog, Éric Rohmer, Francis Ford Coppola, Theo Angelopoulos and Wim Wenders, earning widespread recognition with his roles as Jonathan Zimmerman in The American Friend (1977), Jonathan Harker in Nosferatu the Vampyre (1979) and Damiel the Angel in Wings of Desire (1987).
extract_id: Bruno Ganz adalah aktor Swiss yang kariernya dalam produksi panggung, televisi, dan film Jerman berlangsung hampir 60 tahun. Ia dikenal karena kolaborasinya dengan sutradara Werner Herzog, Éric Rohmer, Francis Ford Coppola, Theo Angelopoulos, dan Wim Wenders, memperoleh pengakuan luas dengan perannya sebagai Jonathan Zimmerman dalam The American Friend (1977), Jonathan Harker dalam Nosferatu the Vampyre (1979) dan Damiel sang Malaikat dalam Wings of Desire (1987).

name: Bruno Kirby
title: Bruno Kirby
extract: Bruno Kirby was an American actor. He was best known for his roles in: City Slickers, When Harry Met Sally..., Good Morning, Vietnam, The Godfather Part II, The Freshman, Sleepers, Donnie Brasco and This Is Spinal Tap. He voiced Reginald Stout in Stuart Little.
extract_id: Bruno Kirby adalah aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal untuk perannya dalam: City Slickers, When Harry Met Sally..., Good Morning, Vietnam, The Godfather Part II, The Freshman, Sleepers, Donnie Brasco, dan This Is Spinal Tap. Dia mengisi suara Reginald Stout dalam Stuart Little.

name: Bruno Zanin
title: Bruno Zanin
extract: Bruno Zanin was an Italian film, theatre, and television actor and writer.
extract_id: Bruno Zanin adalah aktor dan penulis film, teater, serta televisi asal Italia.

name: Bryan Cranston
title: Bryan Cranston
extract: Bryan Lee Cranston is an American actor. He established himself as a leading actor in both comic and dramatic works on stage and screen. His accolades include seven Primetime Emmy Awards, two Tony Awards, a Laurence Olivier Award, and a Golden Globe Award, as well as nominations for an Academy Award and a British Academy Film Award.
extract_id: Bryan Lee Cranston adalah aktor Amerika. Dia menegaskan dirinya sebagai aktor utama dalam karya-karya komik dan dramatis di panggung dan layar. Penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk tujuh Primetime Emmy Awards, dua Tony Awards, satu Laurence Olivier Award, dan satu Golden Globe Award, serta nominasi untuk Academy Award dan British Academy Film Award.

name: Bryan Singer
title: Bryan Singer
extract: Bryan Jay Singer is an American filmmaker. He is the founder of Bad Hat Harry Productions and has produced almost all of the films he has directed, as well as multiple television series.
extract_id: Bryan Jay Singer adalah pembuat film Amerika. Dia adalah pendiri Bad Hat Harry Productions dan telah memproduksi hampir semua film yang disutradarainya, serta beberapa serial televisi.

name: Bryce Dallas Howard
title: Bryce Dallas Howard
extract: Bryce Dallas Howard is an American actress and director. The eldest child of the filmmaker Ron Howard, she studied acting at the New York University Tisch School of the Arts. While portraying Rosalind in a 2003 production of As You Like It, Howard caught the attention of the director M. Night Shyamalan, who cast her as a blind woman in the thriller film The Village (2004) and a naiad in the fantasy film Lady in the Water (2006).
extract_id: Bryce Dallas Howard adalah aktris dan sutradara Amerika. Anak tertua dari pembuat film Ron Howard, dia belajar akting di New York University Tisch School of the Arts. Saat memerankan Rosalind dalam produksi tahun 2003 dari As You Like It, Howard menarik perhatian sutradara M. Night Shyamalan, yang memilihnya sebagai wanita buta dalam film thriller The Village (2004) dan sebagai naiad dalam film fantasi Lady in the Water (2006).

name: Bud Cort
title: Bud Cort
extract: Walter Edward Cox, known professionally as Bud Cort, was an American actor, known for his unorthodox starring roles in Robert Altman's Brewster McCloud (1970), for which he was nominated for a Golden Laurel Award, and Hal Ashby's Harold and Maude (1971), for which he was nominated for both a Golden Globe Award and a BAFTA Award. He also had supporting roles in films such as M*A*S*H (1970), Electric Dreams (1984), Heat (1995), Dogma (1999), Coyote Ugly (2000), Pollock (2000), and The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou (2004).
extract_id: Walter Edward Cox, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Bud Cort, adalah aktor Amerika, dikenal karena peran utama yang tidak ortodoks dalam Brewster McCloud (1970) karya Robert Altman, yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Golden Laurel Award, serta Harold and Maude (1971) karya Hal Ashby, yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award dan BAFTA Award. Ia juga memiliki peran pendukung dalam film seperti M*A*S*H (1970), Electric Dreams (1984), Heat (1995), Dogma (1999), Coyote Ugly (2000), Pollock (2000), dan The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou (2004).

name: Buddy Ebsen
title: Buddy Ebsen
extract: Buddy Ebsen was an American actor and dancer, widely known for his role as Jed Clampett in the CBS television sitcom The Beverly Hillbillies (1962–1971) as well as his title role in the television detective drama Barnaby Jones (1973–1980). Also known as Frank "Buddy" Ebsen.
extract_id: Buddy Ebsen adalah aktor dan penari Amerika, yang dikenal luas karena perannya sebagai Jed Clampett dalam sitkom televisi CBS The Beverly Hillbillies (1962–1971) serta peran utama dalam drama detektif televisi Barnaby Jones (1973–1980). Juga dikenal sebagai Frank "Buddy" Ebsen.

name: Bulle Ogier
title: Bulle Ogier
extract: Bulle Ogier is a French actress and screenwriter.
extract_id: Bulle Ogier adalah aktris dan penulis skenario Prancis.

name: Bunshi Katsura Vi
title: Katsura Bunshi VI
extract: Shizuya Kawamura , known by his stage name Katsura Bunshi VI , is a Japanese TV presenter and rakugo artist.
extract_id: Shizuya Kawamura, dikenal dengan nama panggungnya Katsura Bunshi VI, adalah pembawa acara TV Jepang dan seniman rakugo.

name: Burl Ives
title: Burl Ives
extract: Burl Icle Ivanhoe Ives was an American singer and actor with a career that spanned more than six decades.
extract_id: Burl Icle Ivanhoe Ives adalah penyanyi dan aktor Amerika dengan karier yang berlangsung lebih dari enam dekade.

name: Burt Lancaster
title: Burt Lancaster
extract: Burton Stephen Lancaster was an American actor. Initially known for playing tough characters with tender hearts, he went on to achieve success with more complex and challenging roles over a 45-year career in films and television series. Lancaster was a four-time nominee for the Academy Award for Best Actor, and he also won two BAFTA Awards, one Golden Globe Award for Best Lead Actor, one Silver Bear, one Volpi Cup and two David di Donatello awards. The American Film Institute ranks Lancaster as #19 of the greatest male stars of classic Hollywood cinema.
extract_id: Burton Stephen Lancaster adalah aktor Amerika. Awalnya dikenal karena memerankan karakter keras dengan hati lembut, ia kemudian meraih kesuksesan dengan peran yang lebih kompleks dan menantang selama kariernya selama 45 tahun di film dan serial televisi. Lancaster dinominasikan empat kali untuk Academy Award sebagai Aktor Terbaik, dan ia juga memenangkan dua BAFTA Awards, satu Golden Globe Award untuk Aktor Utama Terbaik, satu Silver Bear, satu Volpi Cup, dan dua David di Donatello awards. American Film Institute menempatkan Lancaster di posisi #19 dari bintang pria terbesar dalam sinema klasik Hollywood.

name: Burt Reynolds
title: Burt Reynolds
extract: Burton Leon Reynolds Jr. was an American actor. His early work included the television series Gunsmoke (1962–1965), Hawk (1966) and Dan August (1970–1971). Following leading roles in the films Navajo Joe (1966), and 100 Rifles (1969), his breakthrough performance was as Lewis Medlock in Deliverance (1972).
extract_id: Burton Leon Reynolds Jr. adalah aktor Amerika. Karya awalnya termasuk serial televisi Gunsmoke (1962–1965), Hawk (1966), dan Dan August (1970–1971). Setelah mendapatkan peran utama dalam film Navajo Joe (1966), dan 100 Rifles (1969), penampilan terobosannya adalah sebagai Lewis Medlock dalam Deliverance (1972).

name: Burt Young
title: Burt Young
extract: Gerald Tommaso DeLouise, known professionally as Burt Young, was an American actor. He played Rocky Balboa's brother-in-law and best friend Paulie Pennino in the Rocky film series, his performance in the first installment of which earned him a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor.
extract_id: Gerald Tommaso DeLouise, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Burt Young, adalah aktor Amerika. Dia memerankan saudara ipar dan sahabat Rocky Balboa, Paulie Pennino, dalam seri film Rocky, penampilannya dalam film pertama menghasilkan nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Buster Keaton
title: Buster Keaton
extract: Joseph Frank "Buster" Keaton was an American actor, comedian and filmmaker. He is best known for his silent films, in which he performed physical comedy and inventive stunts. He maintained a stoic, deadpan facial expression that became his trademark and earned him the nickname "The Great Stone Face".
extract_id: Joseph Frank "Buster" Keaton adalah aktor, komedian, dan pembuat film Amerika. Dia paling dikenal untuk film bisunya, di mana ia menampilkan komedi fisik dan aksi yang inovatif. Ia mempertahankan ekspresi wajah yang kaku dan datar yang menjadi ciri khasnya dan memberinya julukan "The Great Stone Face".

name: Byron Barr
title: Byron Barr
extract: Byron Barr, sometimes billed as Byron S. Barr, was an American actor. He appeared in 19 films from 1944 to 1951.
extract_id: Byron Barr, kadang-kadang disebut sebagai Byron S. Barr, adalah aktor Amerika. Ia tampil dalam 19 film dari tahun 1944 hingga 1951.

name: Byron Howard
title: Byron Howard
extract: Byron P. Howard is an American animator, character designer, story artist, film director, producer, and screenwriter. He is one of the directors of the Walt Disney Animation Studios films Bolt (2008), Tangled (2010), Zootopia (2016), Encanto (2021), and Zootopia 2 (2025). He received four Academy Award nominations, with the latter two won for Zootopia and Encanto.
extract_id: Byron P. Howard adalah animator, perancang karakter, seniman cerita, sutradara film, produser, dan penulis skenario Amerika. Dia adalah salah satu sutradara film Walt Disney Animation Studios seperti Bolt (2008), Tangled (2010), Zootopia (2016), Encanto (2021), dan Zootopia 2 (2025). Dia menerima empat nominasi Academy Award, dengan dua yang terakhir dimenangkannya untuk Zootopia dan Encanto.

name: Bérénice Bejo
title: Bérénice Bejo
extract: Bérénice Bejo is a French-Argentine actress best known for playing Christiana in A Knight's Tale (2001) and Peppy Miller in The Artist (2011). Her work in the latter earned her a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress and won her the César Award for Best Actress. For her performance in The Past, she won Best Actress at the Cannes Film Festival in 2013 and was nominated for a César. She plays Alice Guy-Blaché, the first female film director, in the upcoming six-part drama series Alice.
extract_id: Bérénice Bejo adalah aktris Prancis-Argentina yang paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Christiana dalam A Knight's Tale (2001) dan Peppy Miller dalam The Artist (2011). Karyanya dalam film terakhir membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik dan memenangkan César Award untuk Aktris Terbaik. Untuk penampilannya dalam The Past, ia memenangkan Aktris Terbaik di Festival Film Cannes 2013 dan dinominasikan untuk César. Dia memerankan Alice Guy-Blaché, sutradara film perempuan pertama, dalam serial drama enam bagian yang akan datang, Alice.

name: Börje Ahlstedt
title: Börje Ahlstedt
extract: Nils Börje Ahlstedt is a Swedish actor who has worked extensively with director Ingmar Bergman in films like Fanny and Alexander (1982), The Best Intentions (1992), Sunday's Children (1992) and Saraband (2003). Ahlstedt has also worked with the directors Bo Widerberg and Kay Pollak.
extract_id: Nils Börje Ahlstedt adalah aktor Swedia yang telah bekerja secara luas dengan sutradara Ingmar Bergman dalam film-film seperti Fanny and Alexander (1982), The Best Intentions (1992), Sunday's Children (1992), dan Saraband (2003). Ahlstedt juga pernah bekerja dengan sutradara Bo Widerberg dan Kay Pollak.

name: Cab Calloway
title: Cab Calloway
description: American jazz singer, songwriter, and bandleader (1907–1994)
extract: Cabell Calloway III was an American jazz singer, songwriter, bandleader, and actor. He was a regular performer at the Cotton Club in Harlem, where he became a popular vocalist of the swing era. His niche of mixing jazz and vaudeville won him acclaim during a career that spanned over 65 years.
extract_id: Cabell Calloway III adalah seorang penyanyi jazz Amerika, penulis lagu, pemimpin band, dan aktor. Dia adalah penampil reguler di Cotton Club di Harlem, di mana dia menjadi vokalis populer era swing. Niche-nya dalam mencampur jazz dan vaudeville membawanya meraih penghargaan selama karier yang berlangsung lebih dari 65 tahun.

name: Caitriona Balfe
title: Caitríona Balfe
extract: Caitríona Mary Balfe is an Irish actress and former model. She began her career as a fashion model in Paris at age 18, working with fashion houses such as Chanel and Louis Vuitton, before transitioning to acting a decade later. Balfe gained early recognition with roles in The Beauty Inside (2012) and H+: The Digital Series (2012–2013), along with appearances in films like Super 8 (2011), Now You See Me (2013), and Escape Plan (2013). Her breakout role was as Claire Fraser in Outlander (2014–2026), for which she has been nominated for four Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Caitríona Mary Balfe adalah seorang aktris Irlandia dan mantan model. Dia memulai kariernya sebagai model fashion di Paris pada usia 18 tahun, bekerja dengan rumah mode seperti Chanel dan Louis Vuitton, sebelum beralih ke dunia peran satu dekade kemudian. Balfe mendapatkan pengakuan awal dengan peran-peran dalam The Beauty Inside (2012) dan H+: The Digital Series (2012–2013), serta penampilan dalam film seperti Super 8 (2011), Now You See Me (2013), dan Escape Plan (2013). Peran terobosannya adalah sebagai Claire Fraser dalam Outlander (2014–2026), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk empat Golden Globe Awards.

name: Caleb Landry Jones
title: Caleb Landry Jones
extract: Caleb Landry Jones is an American actor and musician. He first gained recognition for his supporting roles as Banshee in X-Men: First Class (2011), Jeremy Armitage in Get Out (2017), Jack Hicks in The Florida Project (2017), and Red Welby in Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri (2017). The latter earned him a SAG Award.
extract_id: Caleb Landry Jones adalah seorang aktor dan musisi Amerika. Dia pertama kali dikenal karena peran pendukungnya sebagai Banshee dalam X-Men: First Class (2011), Jeremy Armitage dalam Get Out (2017), Jack Hicks dalam The Florida Project (2017), dan Red Welby dalam Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri (2017). Peran terakhir memberinya penghargaan SAG Award.

name: Callan McAuliffe
title: Callan McAuliffe
extract: Callan Ryan Claude McAuliffe is an Australian actor. He is known for his roles as Bryce Loski in Flipped and Sam Goode in I Am Number Four. He appeared as young Jay Gatsby in the 2013 film The Great Gatsby. From 2017 to 2022 he starred on The Walking Dead as Alden.
extract_id: Callan Ryan Claude McAuliffe adalah aktor Australia. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Bryce Loski dalam Flipped dan Sam Goode dalam I Am Number Four. Ia tampil sebagai Jay Gatsby muda dalam film The Great Gatsby (2013). Dari 2017 hingga 2022 ia membintangi The Walking Dead sebagai Alden.

name: Cameron Crowe
title: Cameron Crowe
extract: Cameron Bruce Crowe is an American filmmaker and journalist. He has received many accolades, including an Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Grammy Award, and a Tony Award nomination. Crowe started his career in 1973 as a contributing editor and writer at Rolling Stone magazine, where he covered many rock bands on tour.
extract_id: Cameron Bruce Crowe adalah pembuat film dan jurnalis Amerika. Dia telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Grammy Award, dan nominasi Tony Award. Crowe memulai kariernya pada 1973 sebagai editor kontributor dan penulis di majalah Rolling Stone, di mana ia meliput banyak band rock yang melakukan tur.

name: Cameron Diaz
title: Cameron Diaz
extract: Cameron Michelle Diaz is an American actress. Prolific in both comedy and drama, her films have grossed over $3 billion at the U.S. box-office. Her output of romantic comedies in the late 1990s and early 2000s established her as a prominent sex symbol and one of Hollywood's most bankable stars, and in 2013, Diaz was named the highest-paid actress over 40. She has received various accolades, including nominations for a British Academy Film Award and four Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Cameron Michelle Diaz adalah aktris Amerika. Produktif dalam komedi dan drama, film-filmnya telah menghasilkan lebih dari $3 miliar di box office AS. Karya rom-com-nya di akhir 1990-an dan awal 2000-an menetapkannya sebagai simbol seks terkemuka dan salah satu bintang Hollywood paling menguntungkan, dan pada 2013, Diaz dinobatkan sebagai aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di atas usia 40 tahun. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk nominasi British Academy Film Award dan empat Golden Globe Awards.

name: Candela Peña
title: Candela Peña
extract: María del Pilar Peña Sánchez, professionally known as Candela Peña, is a Spanish actress. Since her film debut in the 1994 thriller Running Out of Time, she has had a lengthy film career. She won the Goya Award for Best Actress for her performance in Princesses (2005) whereas she won the Goya Award for Best Supporting Actress for Take My Eyes (2003) and A Gun in Each Hand (2012).
extract_id: María del Pilar Peña Sánchez, secara profesional dikenal sebagai Candela Peña, adalah aktris Spanyol. Sejak debut filmnya dalam thriller 1994 Running Out of Time, dia memiliki karier film yang panjang. Dia memenangkan Goya Award untuk Aktris Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam Princesses (2005) serta memenangkan Goya Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik untuk Take My Eyes (2003) dan A Gun in Each Hand (2012).

name: Carey Mulligan
title: Carey Mulligan
extract: Carey Hannah Mulligan is a British actress. Known for her performances on stage and screen, she has received numerous accolades, including a BAFTA Award, in addition to nominations for three Academy Awards, four Golden Globe Awards, two Primetime Emmy Awards and a Tony Award. She was appointed Commander of the Order of the British Empire (CBE) in 2025 for services to drama.
extract_id: Carey Hannah Mulligan adalah aktris Inggris. Dikenal atas penampilannya di panggung dan layar, dia telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk BAFTA Award, serta nominasi untuk tiga Academy Awards, empat Golden Globe Awards, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan Tony Award. Dia diangkat sebagai Commander of the Order of the British Empire (CBE) pada 2025 atas jasa-jasanya dalam dunia drama.

name: Carice van Houten
title: Carice van Houten
extract: Carice Anouk van Houten is a Dutch actress. Her first leading role in the television film Suzy Q (1999) won her the Golden Calf for Best Acting in a Television Drama; two years later, she won the Golden Calf for Best Actress for Miss Minoes (2001).
extract_id: Carice Anouk van Houten adalah aktris Belanda. Peran utama pertamanya dalam film televisi Suzy Q (1999) memberinya Golden Calf untuk Akting Terbaik dalam Drama Televisi; dua tahun kemudian, dia memenangkan Golden Calf untuk Aktris Terbaik untuk Miss Minoes (2001).

name: Carl Benton Reid
title: Carl Benton Reid
extract: Carl Benton Reid was an American actor.
extract_id: Carl Benton Reid adalah aktor Amerika.

name: Carl Miller
title: Carl Miller (actor)
extract: Carl Miller was an American film actor. He appeared in 48 films from 1917 to 1942, including roles in two Charlie Chaplin films: The Kid (1921) and A Woman of Paris (1923).
extract_id: Carl Miller adalah aktor film Amerika. Dia tampil dalam 48 film dari 1917 hingga 1942, termasuk peran dalam dua film Charlie Chaplin: The Kid (1921) dan A Woman of Paris (1923).

name: Carl Möhner
title: Carl Möhner
extract: Carl Martin Rudolf Möhner was an Austrian film actor, director, screenwriter and painter. He appeared in more than 40 films between 1949 and 1976. His most famous roles were as Jo "le Suédois" in the 1955 French heist film Rififi and as Captain of Battleship Bismarck in the film Sink the Bismarck!
extract_id: Carl Martin Rudolf Möhner adalah aktor film, sutradara, penulis skenario, dan pelukis Austria. Ia tampil dalam lebih dari 40 film antara 1949 dan 1976. Peran terkenalnya adalah sebagai Jo "le Suédois" dalam film perampokan Prancis tahun 1955 Rififi dan sebagai Kapten Kapal Perang Bismarck dalam film Sink the Bismarck!

name: Carl Theodor Dreyer
title: Carl Theodor Dreyer
extract: Carl Theodor Dreyer, commonly known as Carl Th. Dreyer, was a Danish film director and screenwriter. Widely considered one of the greatest filmmakers in history, his movies are noted for emotional austerity and slow, stately pacing, frequent themes of social intolerance, the inseparability of fate and death, and the power of evil in earthly life.
extract_id: Carl Theodor Dreyer, yang biasanya dikenal sebagai Carl Th. Dreyer, adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario Denmark. Secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film terbesar dalam sejarah, film-filmnya dikenal karena kesederhanaan emosional dan ritme lambat yang megah, tema-tema intoleransi sosial, keterkaitan antara nasib dan kematian, serta kekuatan kejahatan dalam kehidupan duniawi.

name: Carl Weathers
title: Carl Weathers
extract: Carl Weathers was an American actor, director and football player. His prominent roles included boxer Apollo Creed in the first four Rocky films (1976–1985), Colonel Al Dillon in Predator (1987), Chubbs Peterson in Happy Gilmore (1996), and Combat Carl in the Toy Story franchise. He also starred in the 1988 film Action Jackson and portrayed Det. Beaudreaux in the television series Street Justice (1991–1993) and a fictionalized version of himself in the comedy series Arrested Development, and voiced Omnitraxus Prime in Star vs. the Forces of Evil (2017–2019). He had a recurring role as Greef Karga in the Star Wars series The Mandalorian (2019–2023), for which he was nominated for the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Guest Actor in a Drama Series.
extract_id: Carl Weathers adalah aktor, sutradara, dan pemain sepak bola Amerika. Peran terkenal termasuk petinju Apollo Creed dalam empat film Rocky pertama (1976–1985), Kolonel Al Dillon dalam Predator (1987), Chubbs Peterson dalam Happy Gilmore (1996), dan Combat Carl dalam franchise Toy Story. Dia juga membintangi film Action Jackson (1988), memerankan Det. Beaudreaux dalam serial televisi Street Justice (1991–1993), versi fiktif dirinya dalam seri komedi Arrested Development, serta mengisi suara Omnitraxus Prime dalam Star vs. the Forces of Evil (2017–2019). Ia memiliki peran berulang sebagai Greef Karga dalam seri Star Wars The Mandalorian (2019–2023), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Primetime Emmy Award untuk Outstanding Guest Actor in a Drama Series.

name: Carla Gugino
title: Carla Gugino
extract: Carla Gugino is an American actress. After early roles in the films Troop Beverly Hills (1989), This Boy's Life (1993), Son in Law (1993), and Snake Eyes (1998), Gugino received wider recognition for her starring roles in the Spy Kids trilogy (2001–2003), Sin City (2005), Night at the Museum (2006), American Gangster (2007), Righteous Kill (2008), Race to Witch Mountain (2009), Sally Jupiter in Watchmen (2009), Sucker Punch (2011), Mr. Popper's Penguins (2011), San Andreas (2015), Gunpowder Milkshake (2021), and Lisa Frankenstein (2024).
extract_id: Carla Gugino adalah aktris Amerika. Setelah peran awal dalam film Troop Beverly Hills (1989), This Boy's Life (1993), Son in Law (1993), dan Snake Eyes (1998), Gugino mendapatkan pengakuan lebih luas dengan peran utama dalam trilogi Spy Kids (2001–2003), Sin City (2005), Night at the Museum (2006), American Gangster (2007), Righteous Kill (2008), Race to Witch Mountain (2009), Sally Jupiter dalam Watchmen (2009), Sucker Punch (2011), Mr. Popper's Penguins (2011), San Andreas (2015), Gunpowder Milkshake (2021), dan Lisa Frankenstein (2024).

name: Carla Quevedo
title: Carla Quevedo
extract: Carla Quevedo is an Argentine actress. Her breakthrough came with a supporting role in the classic film The Secret in Their Eyes, in which she played Liliana Coloto.
extract_id: Carla Quevedo adalah aktris Argentina. Terobosannya terjadi dengan peran pendukung dalam film klasik The Secret in Their Eyes, di mana ia berperan sebagai Liliana Coloto.

name: Carlo Buccirosso
title: Carlo Buccirosso
description: Italian actor, theatre director, and playwright
extract: Carlo Buccirosso is an Italian actor, theatre director and playwright.
extract_id: Carlo Buccirosso adalah aktor, sutradara teater, dan penulis drama Italia.

name: Carlo Verdone
title: Carlo Verdone
description: Italian actor, screenwriter and film director
extract: Carlo Gregorio Verdone is an Italian actor, screenwriter and film director. Best known for his comedic roles in Italian classics which he also wrote and directed such as Fun Is Beautiful and Bianco, rosso e Verdone, he has introduced more serious subjects in his work since the 1990s, including Damned the Day I Met You and My Best Enemy.
extract_id: Carlo Gregorio Verdone adalah aktor, penulis skenario, dan sutradara film Italia. Terkenal karena peran komedinya dalam klasik Italia yang juga ia tulis dan sutradarai seperti Fun Is Beautiful dan Bianco, rosso e Verdone, ia telah memperkenalkan tema yang lebih serius dalam karyanya sejak 1990-an, termasuk Damned the Day I Met You dan My Best Enemy.

name: Carol Kane
title: Carol Kane
extract: Carol Kane is an American actress and comedian. She gained recognition for her role in Hester Street (1975), for which she received an Academy Award nomination for Best Actress. She became known in the 1970s and 1980s in films such as Dog Day Afternoon (1975), Annie Hall (1977), When a Stranger Calls (1979), The Princess Bride (1987), Scrooged (1988) and Flashback (1990).
extract_id: Carol Kane adalah aktris dan komedian Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya dalam Hester Street (1975), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik. Dia dikenal pada 1970-an dan 1980-an melalui film-film seperti Dog Day Afternoon (1975), Annie Hall (1977), When a Stranger Calls (1979), The Princess Bride (1987), Scrooged (1988), dan Flashback (1990).

name: Carol Reed
title: Carol Reed
extract: Sir Carol Reed was an English film director and producer. Considered one of the foremost British filmmakers of the post-World War II era, he achieved prominence in the late 1940s for his film noir thrillers Odd Man Out (1947), The Fallen Idol (1948), and The Third Man (1949). Odd Man Out was the first recipient of the BAFTA Award for Best British Film. The Fallen Idol won the second BAFTA Award for Best British Film. The British Film Institute voted The Third Man the greatest British film of the 20th century.
extract_id: Sir Carol Reed adalah sutradara dan produser film Inggris. Dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film Inggris terkemuka pasca Perang Dunia II, ia mencapai ketenaran pada akhir 1940-an dengan thriller noir-nya Odd Man Out (1947), The Fallen Idol (1948), dan The Third Man (1949). Odd Man Out adalah penerima pertama BAFTA Award untuk Film Inggris Terbaik. The Fallen Idol memenangkan BAFTA Award kedua untuk Film Inggris Terbaik. British Film Institute memilih The Third Man sebagai film Inggris terbesar abad ke-20.

name: Carole Lombard
title: Carole Lombard
extract: Carole Lombard was an American actress, particularly noted for her energetic, often off-beat roles in screwball comedies. In 1999, the American Film Institute ranked Lombard 23rd on its list of the greatest female stars of Classic Hollywood Cinema.
extract_id: Carole Lombard adalah aktris Amerika yang terkenal terutama karena peran energik dan sering kali tidak konvensional dalam komedi screwball. Pada 1999, American Film Institute menempatkan Lombard di peringkat ke-23 dalam daftar bintang wanita terbesar dalam Klasik Sinema Hollywood.

name: Caroline Goodall
title: Caroline Goodall
extract: Caroline Goodall is an English–Australian actress, screenwriter and producer. Awards and nominations include Best Actress nominations AFI Awards for her roles in the 1989 miniseries Cassidy and the 1995 film Hotel Sorrento, a Logie Awards Nomination for the mini series A Difficult Woman, and a Best Actress award. Her film appearances include Hook (1991), Cliffhanger (1993), Schindler's List (1993), Disclosure (1994), White Squall (1996), The Princess Diaries (2001) and The Best of Me (2014).
extract_id: Caroline Goodall adalah aktris, penulis skenario, dan produser Inggris-Australia. Penghargaan dan nominasi meliputi nominasi Aktris Terbaik di AFI Awards untuk perannya dalam mini seri Cassidy (1989) dan film Hotel Sorrento (1995), nominasi Logie Awards untuk mini seri A Difficult Woman, dan penghargaan Aktris Terbaik. Penampilan filmnya termasuk Hook (1991), Cliffhanger (1993), Schindler's List (1993), Disclosure (1994), White Squall (1996), The Princess Diaries (2001), dan The Best of Me (2014).

name: Carrie Fisher
title: Carrie Fisher
extract: Carrie Frances Fisher was an American actress and writer. She starred as Princess Leia in the original Star Wars films (1977–1983) and reprised the role in The Force Awakens (2015), The Last Jedi (2017)—a posthumous release that was dedicated to her—and The Rise of Skywalker (2019), the latter using unreleased footage from The Force Awakens. Her other film credits include Shampoo (1975), The Blues Brothers (1980), Hannah and Her Sisters (1986), The 'Burbs (1989), When Harry Met Sally... (1989), Soapdish (1991), and The Women (2008). She was nominated twice for the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Guest Actress in a Comedy Series for her performances in the NBC sitcom 30 Rock (2007) and the Channel 4 series Catastrophe (2017).
extract_id: Carrie Frances Fisher adalah aktris dan penulis Amerika. Dia berperan sebagai Putri Leia dalam film Star Wars asli (1977–1983) dan mengulangi peran tersebut dalam The Force Awakens (2015), The Last Jedi (2017)—rilis pasca wafat yang didedikasikan untuknya—dan The Rise of Skywalker (2019), yang menggunakan rekaman yang belum dirilis dari The Force Awakens. Kredit film lainnya termasuk Shampoo (1975), The Blues Brothers (1980), Hannah and Her Sisters (1986), The 'Burbs (1989), When Harry Met Sally... (1989), Soapdish (1991), dan The Women (2008). Dia dinominasikan dua kali untuk Primetime Emmy Award untuk Outstanding Guest Actress in a Comedy Series atas penampilannya di sitkom NBC 30 Rock (2007) dan serial Channel 4 Catastrophe (2017).

name: Carrie-Anne Moss
title: Carrie-Anne Moss
extract: Carrie-Anne Moss is a Canadian actress. After early roles on television, she rose to international prominence for her role of Trinity in The Matrix series (1999–present). She has starred in Memento (2000), for which she won the Independent Spirit Award for Best Supporting Female, Red Planet (2000), Chocolat (2000), Fido (2006), Snow Cake (2006), for which she won the Genie Award for Best Performance by an Actress in a Supporting Role, Disturbia (2007), Unthinkable (2010), Silent Hill: Revelation (2012), Pompeii (2014), and Die Alone (2024), for which she was nominated for the Canadian Screen Award for Best Lead Performance in a Drama Film. She also portrayed Jeri Hogarth in several television series produced by Marvel Television for Netflix, most notably Jessica Jones (2015–2019).
extract_id: Carrie-Anne Moss adalah aktris Kanada. Setelah peran awal di televisi, dia meraih ketenaran internasional karena perannya sebagai Trinity dalam serial The Matrix (1999–sekarang). Dia membintangi Memento (2000), yang membuatnya memenangkan Independent Spirit Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik, Red Planet (2000), Chocolat (2000), Fido (2006), Snow Cake (2006), yang membuatnya memenangkan Genie Award untuk Penampilan Terbaik oleh Aktris Pendukung, Disturbia (2007), Unthinkable (2010), Silent Hill: Revelation (2012), Pompeii (2014), dan Die Alone (2024), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Canadian Screen Award untuk Penampilan Utama Terbaik dalam Film Drama. Dia juga memerankan Jeri Hogarth dalam beberapa serial televisi yang diproduksi oleh Marvel Television untuk Netflix, terutama Jessica Jones (2015–2019).

name: Carroll Baker
title: Carroll Baker
extract: Carroll Baker is a retired American actress. After studying under Lee Strasberg at the Actors Studio, Baker began performing on Broadway in 1954. From there, she was recruited by director Elia Kazan to play the lead in the adaptation of two Tennessee Williams plays into the film Baby Doll in 1956. Her role in the film as a coquettish but sexually naïve Southern bride earned her a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Actress.
extract_id: Carroll Baker adalah aktris Amerika yang sudah pensiun. Setelah belajar di bawah Lee Strasberg di Actors Studio, Baker mulai tampil di Broadway pada 1954. Dari sana, dia direkrut oleh sutradara Elia Kazan untuk memerankan peran utama dalam adaptasi dua drama Tennessee Williams menjadi film Baby Doll pada 1956. Perannya dalam film sebagai pengantin wanita dari Selatan yang menggoda namun naif secara seksual memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik.

name: Carroll O'Connor
title: Carroll O'Connor
extract: John Carroll O'Connor was an American actor whose television career spanned over four decades. He found widespread fame as Archie Bunker, the main character in the CBS television sitcoms All in the Family (1971–1979) and its continuation, Archie Bunker's Place (1979–1983).
extract_id: John Carroll O'Connor adalah aktor Amerika yang karier televisinya berlangsung lebih dari empat dekade. Dia dikenal luas sebagai Archie Bunker, karakter utama dalam sitkom televisi CBS All in the Family (1971–1979) dan kelanjutannya, Archie Bunker's Place (1979–1983).

name: Cary Elwes
title: Cary Elwes
extract: Ivan Simon Cary Elwes is an English actor. He starred as Westley in The Princess Bride (1987), and also had lead roles in films such as Robin Hood: Men in Tights (1993) and the Saw series. The accolades he has received include nominations for a Screen Actors Guild Award and two Satellite Awards. Elwes's other performances in films include Glory (1989); Days of Thunder (1990); Hot Shots! (1991); Bram Stoker's Dracula (1992); Twister (1996); Kiss the Girls (1997); Liar Liar (1997); Ella Enchanted (2004); No Strings Attached (2011); Hansel & Gretel Get Baked (2013); BlackBerry and Mission: Impossible – Dead Reckoning Part One ; and Mission: Impossible – The Final Reckoning (2025).
extract_id: Ivan Simon Cary Elwes adalah aktor Inggris. Dia berperan sebagai Westley dalam The Princess Bride (1987), dan juga memiliki peran utama dalam film-film seperti Robin Hood: Men in Tights (1993) dan seri Saw. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk nominasi untuk Screen Actors Guild Award dan dua Satellite Awards. Penampilan lain Elwes dalam film termasuk Glory (1989); Days of Thunder (1990); Hot Shots! (1991); Bram Stoker's Dracula (1992); Twister (1996); Kiss the Girls (1997); Liar Liar (1997); Ella Enchanted (2004); No Strings Attached (2011); Hansel & Gretel Get Baked (2013); BlackBerry dan Mission: Impossible – Dead Reckoning Part One ; serta Mission: Impossible – The Final Reckoning (2025).

name: Cary Grant
title: Cary Grant
extract: Cary Grant was a British-American actor. Known for his blended British and American accent, debonair demeanor, lighthearted approach to acting, and sense of comic timing, he was one of classic Hollywood's definitive leading men. He was nominated twice for the Academy Award, received an Academy Honorary Award in 1970, and received the Kennedy Center Honor in 1981. He was named the second-greatest male star of the Golden Age of Hollywood by the American Film Institute in 1999.
extract_id: Cary Grant adalah aktor Inggris-Amerika. Dikenal karena aksen gabungan Inggris dan Amerika, sikap debonair, pendekatan ringan terhadap akting, dan rasa timing komedi, dia adalah salah satu pria utama klasik Hollywood yang paling definitif. Dia dinominasikan dua kali untuk Academy Award, menerima Academy Honorary Award pada 1970, dan menerima Kennedy Center Honor pada 1981. Dia dinobatkan sebagai bintang pria terbesar kedua di Era Keemasan Hollywood oleh American Film Institute pada 1999.

name: Cary Joji Fukunaga
title: Cary Joji Fukunaga
extract: Cary Joji Fukunaga is an American filmmaker. He first attracted attention and acclaim for directing the first season of the HBO series True Detective in 2014, for which he won the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Directing for a Drama Series. His feature films include the thriller Sin nombre (2009), the period drama Jane Eyre (2011), the war drama Beasts of No Nation (2015), and the 25th James Bond film, No Time to Die (2021). Fukunaga also co-wrote the Stephen King horror film adaptation It (2017). He directed and executive produced the Netflix limited series Maniac (2018) and executive produced and directed several episodes of the Apple TV+ miniseries Masters of the Air (2024).
extract_id: Cary Joji Fukunaga adalah pembuat film Amerika. Ia pertama kali menarik perhatian dan pujian karena menyutradarai musim pertama seri HBO True Detective pada 2014, di mana ia memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award untuk Outstanding Directing for a Drama Series. Film fitur yang ditulisnya termasuk thriller Sin nombre (2009), drama periode Jane Eyre (2011), drama perang Beasts of No Nation (2015), dan film James Bond ke-25, No Time to Die (2021). Fukunaga juga ikut menulis adaptasi film horor Stephen King, It (2017). Ia menyutradarai dan menjadi produser eksekutif seri terbatas Netflix Maniac (2018) serta menjadi produser eksekutif dan menyutradarai beberapa episode miniseri Apple TV+ Masters of the Air (2024).

name: Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa
title: Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa
extract: Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa was a Japanese actor and film producer who was best known for his role as the evil shapeshifter sorcerer Shang Tsung in various works of the Mortal Kombat franchise: he first played the character in the 1995 film adaptation, and reprised it in 2013 for the television series Mortal Kombat: Legacy and in 2019 for the video game Mortal Kombat 11. He appeared as Lt. A.J. Shimamura on 15 episodes of the American television series Nash Bridges.
extract_id: Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa adalah aktor dan produser film Jepang yang paling dikenal untuk perannya sebagai penyihir jahat shapeshifter Shang Tsung dalam berbagai karya franchise Mortal Kombat: ia pertama kali memerankan karakter itu dalam adaptasi film 1995, dan memerankannya kembali pada 2013 untuk seri televisi Mortal Kombat: Legacy dan pada 2019 untuk video game Mortal Kombat 11. Ia tampil sebagai Letnan A.J. Shimamura dalam 15 episode seri televisi Amerika Nash Bridges.

name: Casey Affleck
title: Casey Affleck
extract: Casey Affleck is an American actor. He is the recipient of various accolades, including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, and a Golden Globe Award. The younger brother of actor Ben Affleck, he began his career as a child actor, appearing in the PBS television film Lemon Sky (1988). He later appeared in three Gus Van Sant films: To Die For (1995), Good Will Hunting (1997), Gerry (2002), and in Steven Soderbergh's Ocean's film series (2001–2007). His first leading role was in Steve Buscemi's independent comedy-drama Lonesome Jim (2006).
extract_id: Casey Affleck adalah aktor Amerika. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan Golden Globe Award. Adik dari aktor Ben Affleck, ia memulai kariernya sebagai aktor anak-anak dengan muncul dalam film televisi PBS Lemon Sky (1988). Ia kemudian muncul dalam tiga film Gus Van Sant: To Die For (1995), Good Will Hunting (1997), Gerry (2002), dan dalam seri film Ocean's karya Steven Soderbergh (2001–2007). Peran utama pertamanya adalah dalam komedi-drama independen karya Steve Buscemi, Lonesome Jim (2006).

name: Cate Blanchett
title: Cate Blanchett
extract: Catherine Élise Blanchett is an Australian actor and producer. Regarded as one of the best performers of her generation, she is recognised for her versatile work across stage and screen, including independent films and blockbusters. She has received numerous accolades, including two Academy Awards, three Actor Awards, four BAFTAs, and four Golden Globes, as well as nominations for three Primetime Emmy Awards, a Laurence Olivier Award and a Tony Award.
extract_id: Catherine Élise Blanchett adalah aktris dan produser Australia. Dipandang sebagai salah satu pemeran terbaik dari generasinya, ia dikenal karena karya serbagunanya di panggung dan layar, termasuk film independen dan blockbuster. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards, tiga Actor Awards, empat BAFTA, dan empat Golden Globes, serta nominasi untuk tiga Primetime Emmy Awards, Laurence Olivier Award, dan Tony Award.

name: Catherine Deneuve
title: Catherine Deneuve
extract: Catherine Fabienne Dorléac, known professionally as Catherine Deneuve, is a French actress. She is considered one of the greatest European actresses on film. In 2020, The New York Times ranked her as one of the greatest actors of the 21st century.
extract_id: Catherine Fabienne Dorléac, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Catherine Deneuve, adalah aktris Prancis. Ia dianggap sebagai salah satu aktris Eropa terbesar di film. Pada 2020, The New York Times menempatkannya sebagai salah satu aktor terbaik abad ke-21.

name: Catherine Keener
title: Catherine Keener
extract: Catherine Keener is an American actress. Keener is known for her portrayals of disgruntled, melancholic and sympathetic women in independent films, as well as her supporting roles in studio films. Her accolades include nominations for two Academy Awards, a British Academy Film Award, two Golden Globe Awards, and a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Catherine Keener adalah aktris Amerika. Keener dikenal karena perannya sebagai wanita yang kesal, melankolis, dan simpatik dalam film independen, serta peran pendukungnya dalam film studio. Penghargaannya termasuk nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards, British Academy Film Award, dua Golden Globe Awards, dan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Catherine O'Hara
title: Catherine O'Hara
extract: Catherine Anne O'Hara was a Canadian and American actress and comedian, whose career spanned over 50 years. O'Hara started in sketch and improvisational comedy in film and television before taking dramatic roles to expand her career. She received various accolades including two Primetime Emmy Awards, a Golden Globe Award, and four Screen Actors Guild Awards. Her films have grossed more than US$4.3 billion worldwide. She was appointed an Officer of the Order of Canada in 2017.
extract_id: Catherine Anne O'Hara adalah aktris dan komedian Kanada dan Amerika, dengan karier yang berlangsung lebih dari 50 tahun. O'Hara memulai di sketsa dan komedi improvisasi dalam film dan televisi sebelum mengambil peran dramatis untuk memperluas kariernya. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk dua Primetime Emmy Awards, Golden Globe Award, dan empat Screen Actors Guild Awards. Filmnya telah menghasilkan lebih dari US$4,3 miliar di seluruh dunia. Ia diangkat sebagai Officer of the Order of Canada pada 2017.

name: Cathy Moriarty
title: Cathy Moriarty
extract: Cathy Moriarty is an American actress whose career spans five decades. Born in The Bronx borough of New York City and raised in Yonkers, New York, she made her acting debut opposite Robert De Niro in Martin Scorsese's Raging Bull (1980), for which she received nominations for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress, the Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress – Motion Picture, and the British Academy Film Award.
extract_id: Cathy Moriarty adalah aktris Amerika yang kariernya berlangsung lima dekade. Lahir di Bronx, New York City dan dibesarkan di Yonkers, New York, ia memulai debut aktingnya berlawanan dengan Robert De Niro dalam film Martin Scorsese Raging Bull (1980), yang membuatnya menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik, Golden Globe Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik – Film, dan British Academy Film Award.

name: Cathy Rosier
title: Cathy Rosier
extract: Cathy Rosier was a French model and actress.
extract_id: Cathy Rosier adalah model dan aktris Prancis.

name: Cecil B. DeMille
title: Cecil B. DeMille
extract: Cecil Blount DeMille was an American filmmaker and actor. Between 1914 and 1958, he created 70 features including silent and sound films. He is acknowledged as a founding father of American cinema and the most commercially successful producer-director in film history, with many films dominating the box office three or four at a time. His films were distinguished by their epic scale and by his cinematic showmanship. His silent films included social dramas, comedies, Westerns, farces, morality plays, and historical pageants.
extract_id: Cecil Blount DeMille adalah pembuat film dan aktor Amerika. Antara 1914 dan 1958, ia menciptakan 70 film fitur termasuk film bisu dan bersuara. Ia diakui sebagai bapak pendiri sinema Amerika dan produser-sutradara paling sukses secara komersial dalam sejarah film, dengan banyak filmnya mendominasi box office tiga atau empat sekaligus. Film-filmnya dikenal karena skala epiknya dan keahliannya dalam pertunjukan sinematik. Film bisunya mencakup drama sosial, komedi, Western, farce, drama moral, dan pagelaran sejarah.

name: Cecil Parker
title: Cecil Parker
extract: Cecil Parker was an English actor with a distinctively husky voice, who usually played supporting roles, often characters with a supercilious demeanour, in his 91 films made between 1928 and 1969.
extract_id: Cecil Parker adalah aktor Inggris dengan suara serak khas, yang biasanya memainkan peran pendukung, sering karakter dengan sikap sombong, dalam 91 film yang dibuatnya antara 1928 dan 1969.

name: Cecilia Roth
title: Cecilia Roth
extract: Cecilia Edith Rotenberg Gutkin, known professionally as Cecilia Roth is an Argentine actress. She is the winner of two Goya Awards and a European Film Award. She is known for being an "Almodóvar girl" and the "muse" of Fito Páez during the 1990s.
extract_id: Cecilia Edith Rotenberg Gutkin, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Cecilia Roth adalah aktris Argentina. Ia memenangkan dua Goya Awards dan sebuah European Film Award. Ia dikenal sebagai "gadis Almodóvar" dan "muse" Fito Páez selama tahun 1990-an.

name: Celeste Holm
title: Celeste Holm
description: American stage, film and television actress (1917–2012)
extract: Celeste Holm was an American actress. Holm won an Academy Award for her performance in Elia Kazan's Gentleman's Agreement (1947), and was nominated for her roles in Come to the Stable (1949) and All About Eve (1950). She also is known for her performances in The Snake Pit (1948), A Letter to Three Wives (1949), The Tender Trap (1955), and High Society (1956) as well as for originating the role of Ado Annie in the Rodgers and Hammerstein musical Oklahoma! (1943).
extract_id: Celeste Holm adalah aktris Amerika. Holm memenangkan Academy Award untuk penampilannya dalam Gentleman's Agreement karya Elia Kazan (1947), dan dinominasikan untuk perannya dalam Come to the Stable (1949) dan All About Eve (1950). Ia juga dikenal lewat penampilannya di The Snake Pit (1948), A Letter to Three Wives (1949), The Tender Trap (1955), dan High Society (1956) serta sebagai pemeran asli Ado Annie dalam musikal Rodgers dan Hammerstein Oklahoma! (1943).

name: Celia Johnson
title: Celia Johnson
extract: Dame Celia Elizabeth Johnson was an English actress, whose career included stage, television and film. She is especially known for her roles in the films In Which We Serve (1942), This Happy Breed (1944), Brief Encounter (1945) and The Captain's Paradise (1953). For Brief Encounter, she was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actress. A six-time BAFTA Award nominee, she won the BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Supporting Role for The Prime of Miss Jean Brodie (1969).
extract_id: Dame Celia Elizabeth Johnson adalah aktris Inggris, yang kariernya meliputi panggung, televisi, dan film. Ia terutama dikenal karena perannya dalam film In Which We Serve (1942), This Happy Breed (1944), Brief Encounter (1945), dan The Captain's Paradise (1953). Untuk Brief Encounter, ia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award Aktris Terbaik. Dengan enam nominasi BAFTA, ia memenangkan BAFTA Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik untuk The Prime of Miss Jean Brodie (1969).

name: Cem Yilmaz
title: Cem Yılmaz
extract: Cem Yılmaz is a Turkish actor, stand-up comedian, musician, filmmaker, screenwriter, and cartoonist.
