He has four franchise film series: G.O.R.A., Karakomik Filmler, Organize İşler, Vizontele. He is also known for his films Yahşi Batı, Hokkabaz, İftarlık Gazoz, and Av Mevsimi, and has won three Sadri Alışık awards and a Yeşilçam award for his roles. His international films are Russell Crowe's film "Water Diviner" and Ferzan Özpetek's film "Magnifica presenza".
extract_id: Cem Yılmaz adalah aktor, komedian stand-up, musisi, pembuat film, penulis skenario, dan kartunis Turki. Ia memiliki empat seri film franchise: G.O.R.A., Karakomik Filmler, Organize İşler, Vizontele. Ia juga dikenal untuk film-filmnya Yahşi Batı, Hokkabaz, İftarlık Gazoz, dan Av Mevsimi, dan telah memenangkan tiga penghargaan Sadri Alışık dan satu penghargaan Yeşilçam untuk perannya. Film internasionalnya adalah film Russell Crowe "Water Diviner" dan film Ferzan Özpetek "Magnifica presenza".

name: Chan-wook Park
title: Park Chan-wook
extract: Park Chan-wook is a South Korean filmmaker and former film critic. Widely regarded as a leading figure in South Korean and 21st-century world cinema, he is known for films that blend crime, mystery, and thriller elements with other genres. His films are noted for their cinematography, framing, black humor, and often brutal subject matter.
extract_id: Park Chan-wook adalah pembuat film Korea Selatan dan mantan kritikus film. Diakui secara luas sebagai tokoh terkemuka dalam sinema Korea Selatan dan dunia abad ke-21, ia dikenal untuk film-film yang memadukan unsur kejahatan, misteri, dan thriller dengan genre lain. Film-filmnya dikenal karena sinematografinya, framing, humor gelap, dan seringkali tema yang brutal.

name: Charles Bronson
title: Charles Bronson
extract: Charles Bronson was an American actor. He was known for his roles in action films and his "granite features and brawny physique". Bronson was born into extreme poverty in Ehrenfeld, Pennsylvania, a coal mining town in the Allegheny Mountains. Bronson's father, a miner, died when Bronson was young. Bronson himself worked in the mines as well until joining the United States Army Air Forces in 1943 to fight in World War II. After his service, he joined a theatrical troupe and studied acting. During the 1950s, he played various supporting roles in motion pictures and television, including anthology drama TV series in which he would appear as the main character. Near the end of the decade, he had his first cinematic leading role in Machine-Gun Kelly (1958).
extract_id: Charles Bronson adalah aktor Amerika. Ia dikenal karena perannya dalam film aksi dan "wajah granit serta fisik yang kekar". Bronson lahir dalam kemiskinan ekstrim di Ehrenfeld, Pennsylvania, sebuah kota penambangan batu bara di Pegunungan Allegheny. Ayah Bronson, seorang penambang, meninggal saat Bronson masih muda. Bronson sendiri bekerja di tambang sampai bergabung dengan United States Army Air Forces pada 1943 untuk bertempur dalam Perang Dunia II. Setelah dinasnya, ia bergabung dengan kelompok teater dan belajar akting. Pada 1950-an, ia memainkan berbagai peran pendukung dalam film dan televisi, termasuk serial drama antologi TV di mana ia menjadi karakter utama. Menjelang akhir dekade, ia mendapatkan peran utama sinematik pertamanya dalam Machine-Gun Kelly (1958).

name: Charles Chaplin
title: Charlie Chaplin
extract: Sir Charles Spencer Chaplin Jr. was an English comic actor, filmmaker, singer, film editor and composer who rose to fame in the era of silent film. He became a worldwide icon through his screen persona, the Tramp, and is considered one of the film industry's most important figures. His career spanned more than 75 years, from his childhood in the Victorian era until a year before his death in 1977.
extract_id: Sir Charles Spencer Chaplin Jr. adalah aktor komik Inggris, pembuat film, penyanyi, editor film, dan komponis yang terkenal di era film bisu. Ia menjadi ikon dunia melalui persona layar perannya, Tramp, dan dianggap sebagai salah satu tokoh terpenting industri film. Kariernya berlangsung lebih dari 75 tahun, dari masa kecilnya di era Victoria hingga setahun sebelum kematiannya pada 1977.

name: Charles Durning
title: Charles Durning
extract: Charles Edward Durning was an American actor who appeared in over 200 movies, television shows and plays. He received various accolades, including a Golden Globe Award and a Tony Award, in addition to nominations for two Academy Awards and nine Primetime Emmy Awards. In 2008, Durning was awarded with Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award. His best-known films include The Sting (1973), Dog Day Afternoon (1975), The Muppet Movie (1979), True Confessions (1981), Tootsie (1982), Dick Tracy (1990), and O Brother, Where Art Thou? (2000). Prior to his acting career, Durning served in World War II and was decorated for valor in combat.
extract_id: Charles Edward Durning adalah aktor Amerika yang tampil dalam lebih dari 200 film, acara televisi, dan drama panggung. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Golden Globe Award dan Tony Award, selain nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards dan sembilan Primetime Emmy Awards. Pada 2008, Durning dianugerahi Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award. Film paling terkenalnya termasuk The Sting (1973), Dog Day Afternoon (1975), The Muppet Movie (1979), True Confessions (1981), Tootsie (1982), Dick Tracy (1990), dan O Brother, Where Art Thou? (2000). Sebelum kariernya di dunia akting, Durning bertugas dalam Perang Dunia II dan menerima penghargaan untuk keberanian dalam pertempuran.

name: Charles Fleischer
title: Charles Fleischer
extract: Charles Fleischer is an American actor, stand-up comedian, musician, and writer, best known for his recurring role as Carvelli in Welcome Back, Kotter, and for appearing in films such as Who Framed Roger Rabbit, A Nightmare on Elm Street, The Polar Express, Rango, Chip 'n Dale: Rescue Rangers, and We're Back! A Dinosaur's Story. He made a cameo in Back to the Future Part II and also reprised the role of Roger Rabbit in the Roger Rabbit theatrical shorts. After beginning his career on the comedy club circuit, Charles Fleischer's first big break in comedy television came when he made an appearance on Rowan & Martin's Laugh-In.
extract_id: Charles Fleischer adalah aktor, komedian stand-up, musisi, dan penulis Amerika, terkenal karena peran berulangnya sebagai Carvelli dalam Welcome Back, Kotter, serta tampil dalam film seperti Who Framed Roger Rabbit, A Nightmare on Elm Street, The Polar Express, Rango, Chip 'n Dale: Rescue Rangers, dan We're Back! A Dinosaur's Story. Ia membuat penampilan cameo di Back to the Future Part II dan juga mengulangi perannya sebagai Roger Rabbit dalam film-film pendek Roger Rabbit. Setelah memulai kariernya di sirkuit klub komedi, terobosan besar Charles Fleischer di televisi komedi datang saat ia tampil dalam Rowan & Martin's Laugh-In.

name: Charles Laughton
title: Charles Laughton
extract: Charles Laughton was an English actor and director. Over his career he received an Academy Award and a Grammy Award as well as nominations for two BAFTAs and a Golden Globe. He earned a motion picture star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 1960.
extract_id: Charles Laughton adalah aktor dan sutradara Inggris. Sepanjang kariernya ia menerima Academy Award dan Grammy Award serta nominasi untuk dua BAFTA dan Golden Globe. Ia memperoleh bintang film di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada 1960.

name: Charles Martin Smith
title: Charles Martin Smith
extract: Charles Martin Smith is an American actor, film and television director and screenwriter, long based in British Columbia, Canada.
extract_id: Charles Martin Smith adalah aktor Amerika, sutradara film dan televisi, serta penulis skenario, yang telah lama menetap di British Columbia, Kanada.

name: Charles Ruggles
title: Charlie Ruggles
extract: Charles Sherman Ruggles was an American comic character actor. In a career spanning six decades, Ruggles appeared in close to 100 feature films, often in mild-mannered and comic roles. He was also the elder brother of director, producer, and silent film actor Wesley Ruggles (1889–1972).
extract_id: Charles Sherman Ruggles adalah seorang aktor karakter komik Amerika. Dalam karier yang berlangsung selama enam dekade, Ruggles tampil dalam hampir 100 film fitur, sering dalam peran yang lemah lembut dan komik. Dia juga merupakan kakak laki-laki dari sutradara, produser, dan aktor film bisu Wesley Ruggles (1889–1972).

name: Charles Vanel
title: Charles Vanel
extract: Charles-Marie Vanel was a French actor and director. During his 65-year film career, which began in 1923, he appeared in more than 200 films and worked with many prominent directors, including Alfred Hitchcock, Luis Buñuel, Jacques Feyder, and Henri-Georges Clouzot. He is perhaps best remembered for his role as a desperate truck driver in Clouzot's The Wages of Fear, for which he received a Special Mention at the Cannes Film Festival in 1953.
extract_id: Charles-Marie Vanel adalah seorang aktor dan sutradara Prancis. Selama karier filmnya yang berlangsung 65 tahun, yang dimulai pada tahun 1923, ia tampil dalam lebih dari 200 film dan bekerja dengan banyak sutradara terkenal, termasuk Alfred Hitchcock, Luis Buñuel, Jacques Feyder, dan Henri-Georges Clouzot. Ia mungkin paling diingat untuk perannya sebagai sopir truk putus asa dalam The Wages of Fear karya Clouzot, yang membuatnya menerima Mention Khusus di Festival Film Cannes pada tahun 1953.

name: Charles Vidor
title: Charles Vidor
extract: Charles Vidor was a Hungarian-American director. Among his film successes are The Bridge (1929), Double Door (1934), The Tuttles of Tahiti (1942), The Desperadoes (1943), Cover Girl (1944), Together Again (1944), A Song to Remember (1945), Over 21 (1945), Gilda (1946), The Loves of Carmen (1948), Rhapsody (1954), Love Me or Leave Me (1955), The Swan (1956), The Joker Is Wild (1957), and A Farewell to Arms (1957).
extract_id: Charles Vidor adalah seorang sutradara Hungaria-Amerika. Di antara kesuksesan filmnya adalah The Bridge (1929), Double Door (1934), The Tuttles of Tahiti (1942), The Desperadoes (1943), Cover Girl (1944), Together Again (1944), A Song to Remember (1945), Over 21 (1945), Gilda (1946), The Loves of Carmen (1948), Rhapsody (1954), Love Me or Leave Me (1955), The Swan (1956), The Joker Is Wild (1957), dan A Farewell to Arms (1957).

name: Charley Grapewin
title: Charley Grapewin
extract: Charles Ellsworth Grapewin was an American vaudeville and circus performer, writer, and stage and film actor.
extract_id: Charles Ellsworth Grapewin adalah seorang pemain vaudeville dan sirkus Amerika, penulis, serta aktor panggung dan film.

name: Charlie Cox
title: Charlie Cox
extract: Charlie Thomas Cox is an English actor. He is known for portraying Matt Murdock / Daredevil in the Marvel Cinematic Universe since 2015, including in the television series Daredevil (2015–2018) and Daredevil: Born Again (2025–present).
extract_id: Charlie Thomas Cox adalah seorang aktor Inggris. Ia dikenal karena memerankan Matt Murdock / Daredevil dalam Marvel Cinematic Universe sejak 2015, termasuk dalam serial televisi Daredevil (2015–2018) dan Daredevil: Born Again (2025–sekarang).

name: Charlie Hunnam
title: Charlie Hunnam
extract: Charles Matthew Hunnam is an English actor. He portrayed Jax Teller in the FX drama series Sons of Anarchy (2008–2014), for which he was twice nominated for the Critics' Choice Television Award for Best Actor.
extract_id: Charles Matthew Hunnam adalah seorang aktor Inggris. Ia memerankan Jax Teller dalam serial drama FX Sons of Anarchy (2008–2014), yang membuatnya dua kali dinominasikan untuk Critics' Choice Television Award untuk Aktor Terbaik.

name: Charlie Kaufman
title: Charlie Kaufman
extract: Charles Stuart Kaufman is an American filmmaker and novelist. His work is distinguished by postmodernist and surrealist storytelling, with many critics considering him an auteur. Getting his start as a television writer, Kaufman gained prominence for his collaborations with directors Spike Jonze and Michel Gondry on Being John Malkovich (1999), Adaptation (2002), and Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind (2004), before going on to direct films himself with Synecdoche, New York (2008), Anomalisa (2015), and I'm Thinking of Ending Things (2020). In 2020, he released a novel, Antkind.
extract_id: Charles Stuart Kaufman adalah seorang pembuat film dan novelis Amerika. Karyanya dibedakan oleh cerita yang postmodernis dan surealis, dengan banyak kritikus menganggapnya sebagai auteur. Memulai kariernya sebagai penulis televisi, Kaufman naik daun berkat kolaborasinya dengan sutradara Spike Jonze dan Michel Gondry pada Being John Malkovich (1999), Adaptation (2002), dan Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind (2004), sebelum kemudian menyutradarai film sendiri dengan Synecdoche, New York (2008), Anomalisa (2015), dan I'm Thinking of Ending Things (2020). Pada tahun 2020, ia merilis sebuah novel, Antkind.

name: Charlie Sheen
title: Charlie Sheen
extract: Carlos Irwin Estévez, known professionally as Charlie Sheen, is an American actor. A leading man in film and television, his accolades include a Golden Globe as well as nominations for four Primetime Emmy Awards and three Actor Awards. In 1994, Sheen received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
extract_id: Carlos Irwin Estévez, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Charlie Sheen, adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Sebagai pemeran utama dalam film dan televisi, ia meraih penghargaan termasuk Golden Globe serta nominasi untuk empat Primetime Emmy Awards dan tiga Actor Awards. Pada tahun 1994, Sheen menerima bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame.

name: Charlie Yeung
title: Charlie Yeung
extract: Charlie Yeung Choi-nei is a Hong Kong actress. She was first noticed after appearing in a commercial with Aaron Kwok. Since then she has participated in the music videos of artists such as Hacken Lee, Jacky Cheung and made a number of films, most famously with Tsui Hark and Wong Kar-wai. She retired her career in 1997, but has since returned in 2004 in New Police Story.
extract_id: Charlie Yeung Choi-nei adalah seorang aktris Hong Kong. Ia pertama kali diperhatikan setelah tampil dalam sebuah iklan bersama Aaron Kwok. Sejak itu ia telah berpartisipasi dalam video musik artis seperti Hacken Lee, Jacky Cheung dan membintangi sejumlah film, paling terkenal dengan Tsui Hark dan Wong Kar-wai. Ia pensiun dari kariernya pada tahun 1997, tetapi kemudian kembali pada tahun 2004 dalam New Police Story.

name: Charlize Theron
title: Charlize Theron
extract: Charlize Theron is a South African and American actress and producer. One of the world's highest-paid actresses, her accolades include an Academy Award and a Golden Globe Award, in addition to nominations for three BAFTAs and two Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Charlize Theron adalah seorang aktris dan produser Afrika Selatan dan Amerika. Salah satu aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia, pencapaiannya termasuk Academy Award dan Golden Globe Award, selain nominasi untuk tiga BAFTA dan dua Emmy Awards.

name: Charlotte Rampling
title: Charlotte Rampling
extract: Tessa Charlotte Rampling is an English actress. An icon of the Swinging Sixties, she began her career as a model. She was cast in the role of Meredith in the 1966 film Georgy Girl, which starred Lynn Redgrave. She soon began making French and Italian arthouse films, notably Luchino Visconti's The Damned (1969) and Liliana Cavani's The Night Porter (1974). She went on to star in many European and English-language films, including Stardust Memories (1980), The Verdict (1982), Long Live Life (1984), and The Wings of the Dove (1997). In the 2000s, she became the muse of French director François Ozon, appearing in several of his films, notably Under the Sand (2000), Swimming Pool (2003) and Young & Beautiful (2013). On television, she is known for her role as Dr. Evelyn Vogel in Dexter (2013).
extract_id: Tessa Charlotte Rampling adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Sebagai ikon era Swinging Sixties, ia memulai karier sebagai model. Ia berperan sebagai Meredith dalam film Georgy Girl tahun 1966, yang dibintangi Lynn Redgrave. Ia kemudian mulai membuat film arthouse Prancis dan Italia, terutama The Damned (1969) karya Luchino Visconti dan The Night Porter (1974) karya Liliana Cavani. Ia melanjutkan membintangi banyak film Eropa dan berbahasa Inggris, termasuk Stardust Memories (1980), The Verdict (1982), Long Live Life (1984), dan The Wings of the Dove (1997). Pada tahun 2000-an, ia menjadi muse sutradara Prancis François Ozon, tampil dalam beberapa filmnya, terutama Under the Sand (2000), Swimming Pool (2003), dan Young & Beautiful (2013). Di televisi, ia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Dr. Evelyn Vogel dalam Dexter (2013).

name: Charlton Heston
title: Charlton Heston
extract: Charlton Heston was an American actor and political activist. He gained stardom for his leading man roles in numerous Hollywood films including biblical epics, historical drama films, science-fiction films, and action films. He won an Academy Award, a David di Donatello Award, a Laurel Award, a Photoplay Award, a Golden Globe Award, as well as nominations for three Primetime Emmy Awards. He received numerous honorary accolades including a Hollywood Walk of Fame Star in 1960, the Golden Globe Cecil B. DeMille Award in 1967, the Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award in 1971, an honorary Saturn Award in 1975, the Jean Hersholt Humanitarian Academy Award in 1978, the ShoWest Convention Lifetime Achievement Award in 1984, the Kennedy Center Honors in 1997, and the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2003.
extract_id: Charlton Heston adalah seorang aktor dan aktivis politik Amerika. Ia meraih ketenaran melalui peran utama dalam banyak film Hollywood termasuk epik alkitabiah, drama sejarah, film fiksi ilmiah, dan film aksi. Ia memenangkan Academy Award, David di Donatello Award, Laurel Award, Photoplay Award, Golden Globe Award, serta nominasi untuk tiga Primetime Emmy Awards. Ia menerima banyak penghargaan kehormatan termasuk Bintang Hollywood Walk of Fame pada tahun 1960, Golden Globe Cecil B. DeMille Award pada tahun 1967, Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award pada tahun 1971, Saturn Award kehormatan pada tahun 1975, Jean Hersholt Humanitarian Academy Award pada tahun 1978, ShoWest Convention Lifetime Achievement Award pada tahun 1984, Kennedy Center Honors pada tahun 1997, dan Presidential Medal of Freedom pada tahun 2003.

name: Chase Ellison
title: Chase Ellison
extract: Chase Ellison is an American actor. He is best known for his roles in Mysterious Skin, Tooth Fairy, and The Boy Who Cried Werewolf.
extract_id: Chase Ellison adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena perannya dalam Mysterious Skin, Tooth Fairy, dan The Boy Who Cried Werewolf.

name: Chazz Palminteri
title: Chazz Palminteri
description: American actor, producer, screenwriter, and playwright (born 1952)
extract: Calogero Lorenzo "Chazz" Palminteri is an American actor, producer, screenwriter, and playwright. He is best known for his film roles in A Bronx Tale (1993), based on his play of the same name, along with Bullets Over Broadway (1994) for which he was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor, and The Usual Suspects (1995). His recent work includes his recurring role as Shorty in Modern Family (2010–2019).
extract_id: Calogero Lorenzo "Chazz" Palminteri adalah seorang aktor, produser, penulis skenario, dan penulis drama Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena peran filmnya dalam A Bronx Tale (1993), berdasarkan drama karangannya dengan judul sama, bersama dengan Bullets Over Broadway (1994) yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award sebagai Aktor Pendukung Terbaik, dan The Usual Suspects (1995). Karya terbarunya termasuk peran berulang sebagai Shorty dalam Modern Family (2010–2019).

name: Chete Lera
title: Chete Lera
extract: Ramón Mariano Fernández Lera (1949–2022), better known as Chete Lera, was a Spanish actor. With a long on-screen career in addition to a stage career, he featured in films such as The Red Squirrel, Secrets of the Heart, Familia, Barrio, Open Your Eyes, Flores de otro mundo, and Full Moon.
extract_id: Ramón Mariano Fernández Lera (1949–2022), yang lebih dikenal sebagai Chete Lera, adalah seorang aktor Spanyol. Dengan karier panjang di layar serta panggung, ia tampil dalam film-film seperti The Red Squirrel, Secrets of the Heart, Familia, Barrio, Open Your Eyes, Flores de otro mundo, dan Full Moon.

name: Chiara Mastroianni
title: Chiara Mastroianni
extract: Chiara Françoise Charlotte Mastroianni is a French-Italian actress and singer. She is the daughter of actors Marcello Mastroianni and Catherine Deneuve.
extract_id: Chiara Françoise Charlotte Mastroianni adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Prancis-Italia. Ia adalah putri dari aktor Marcello Mastroianni dan Catherine Deneuve.

name: Chico Marx
title: Chico Marx
extract: Leonard "Chico" Marx was an American comedian, actor, and pianist. He was the oldest brother in the Marx Brothers comedy troupe, alongside his brothers Arthur ("Harpo"), Julius ("Groucho"), Milton ("Gummo"), and Herbert ("Zeppo"). His persona in the act was that of a charming, uneducated but crafty con artist, seemingly of rural Italian origin, who wore shabby clothes and sported a curly-haired wig and Tyrolean hat. On screen, Chico is often in alliance with Harpo, usually as partners in crime, and is also frequently seen trying to con or outfox Groucho.
extract_id: Leonard "Chico" Marx adalah seorang komedian, aktor, dan pianis Amerika. Ia adalah kakak tertua di grup komedi Marx Brothers, bersama saudara-saudaranya Arthur ("Harpo"), Julius ("Groucho"), Milton ("Gummo"), dan Herbert ("Zeppo"). Persona-nya dalam pertunjukan adalah seorang penipu yang menawan, berpendidikan rendah namun licik, yang tampak berasal dari Italia pedesaan, mengenakan pakaian compang-camping dengan wig rambut keriting dan topi Tirol. Di layar, Chico sering beraliansi dengan Harpo, biasanya sebagai mitra dalam kejahatan, dan juga sering terlihat mencoba menipu atau mengalahkan Groucho.

name: Chief Dan George
title: Chief Dan George
description: Chief of the Tsleil-Waututh Nation, actor (1899–1981)
extract: Chief Dan George was a chief of the Tsleil-Waututh Nation, a Coast Salish band whose Indian reserve is located on Burrard Inlet in the southeast area of the District of North Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. He also was an actor, musician, poet and author. The Chief's best-known written work is My Heart Soars. As an actor, he is best remembered for portraying Old Lodge Skins opposite Dustin Hoffman in Little Big Man (1970), for which he was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor, and for his role in The Outlaw Josey Wales (1976), as Lone Watie, opposite Clint Eastwood.
extract_id: Chief Dan George adalah kepala suku Tsleil-Waututh Nation, sebuah kelompok Coast Salish yang cadangan Indiannya terletak di Burrard Inlet di daerah tenggara District of North Vancouver, British Columbia, Kanada. Ia juga seorang aktor, musisi, penyair, dan penulis. Karya tertulis paling terkenal dari sang Kepala adalah My Heart Soars. Sebagai aktor, ia paling diingat memerankan Old Lodge Skins di samping Dustin Hoffman dalam Little Big Man (1970), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik, serta perannya dalam The Outlaw Josey Wales (1976) sebagai Lone Watie, berpasangan dengan Clint Eastwood.

name: Chieko Baishô
title: Chieko Baisho
extract: Chieko Baisho is a Japanese actress and singer.
extract_id: Chieko Baisho adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Jepang.

name: Chieko Higashiyama
title: Chieko Higashiyama
extract: Chieko Higashiyama was a Japanese stage and film actress. She appeared in more than 60 films from 1936 to 1967.
extract_id: Chieko Higashiyama adalah seorang aktris panggung dan film Jepang. Ia tampil dalam lebih dari 60 film dari tahun 1936 hingga 1967.

name: Chika Sakamoto
title: Chika Sakamoto
extract: Chika Sakamoto is a Japanese voice actress who is affiliated with Arts Vision. She grew up in Kawasaki City and Totsuka Ward in Yokohama.
extract_id: Chika Sakamoto adalah seorang aktris pengisi suara Jepang yang berafiliasi dengan Arts Vision. Ia dibesarkan di Kota Kawasaki dan Distrik Totsuka di Yokohama.

name: Chishû Ryû
title: Chishū Ryū
extract: Chishū Ryū was a Japanese actor, whose career spanned 65 years and over 230 film and television productions. He was best known for his collaborations with director Yasujirō Ozu, whom he worked with on at least 32 films.
extract_id: Chishū Ryū adalah seorang aktor Jepang, yang kariernya berlangsung selama 65 tahun dan lebih dari 230 produksi film dan televisi. Ia paling dikenal karena kolaborasinya dengan sutradara Yasujirō Ozu, yang bekerja sama dalam setidaknya 32 film.

name: Chiwetel Ejiofor
title: Chiwetel Ejiofor
extract: Chiwetel Umeadi Ejiofor is a British actor and director. He is the recipient of various accolades, including a British Academy Film Award and a Laurence Olivier Award, in addition to nominations for an Academy Award, two Primetime Emmy Awards, and five Golden Globe Awards. In 2008, he was appointed an Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE), and in 2015, he was advanced to Commander (CBE) for his services to the arts.
extract_id: Chiwetel Umeadi Ejiofor adalah seorang aktor dan sutradara Inggris. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk British Academy Film Award dan Laurence Olivier Award, serta nominasi untuk Academy Award, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan lima Golden Globe Awards. Pada tahun 2008, ia diangkat sebagai Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE), dan pada tahun 2015, ia dinaikkan menjadi Commander (CBE) untuk jasanya dalam bidang seni.

name: Chloë Grace Moretz
title: Chloë Grace Moretz
extract: Chloë Grace Moretz is an American actress. She began acting as a child, with early roles in the horror film The Amityville Horror (2005), the drama series Desperate Housewives (2006–2007), the horror film The Eye (2008), the drama film The Poker House (2008), the romantic comedy film 500 Days of Summer (2009), and the children's comedy film Diary of a Wimpy Kid (2010). Her breakthrough came in 2010 with her performance as Hit-Girl in the superhero film Kick-Ass.
extract_id: Chloë Grace Moretz adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Ia mulai berakting sejak kecil, dengan peran awal dalam film horor The Amityville Horror (2005), serial drama Desperate Housewives (2006–2007), film horor The Eye (2008), film drama The Poker House (2008), film komedi romantis 500 Days of Summer (2009), dan film komedi anak-anak Diary of a Wimpy Kid (2010). Terobosan kariernya datang pada tahun 2010 dengan penampilannya sebagai Hit-Girl dalam film superhero Kick-Ass.

name: Cho Jin-woong
title: Cho Jin-woong
extract: Cho Jin-woong, born Cho Won-jun (조원준), is a retired South Korean actor. He gained early recognition for his supporting roles in the films Nameless Gangster: Rules of the Time (2012), The Admiral: Roaring Currents (2014), and Assassination (2015).
extract_id: Cho Jin-woong, lahir dengan nama Cho Won-jun (조원준), adalah seorang aktor Korea Selatan yang telah pensiun. Ia meraih pengakuan awal untuk peran pendukungnya dalam film Nameless Gangster: Rules of the Time (2012), The Admiral: Roaring Currents (2014), dan Assassination (2015).

name: Cho Yeo-jeong
title: Cho Yeo-jeong
extract: Cho Yeo-jeong is a South Korean actress. She is best known internationally for her role in the film Parasite (2019), which won four Academy Awards and became the first non-English language film to win Best Picture.
extract_id: Cho Yeo-jeong adalah seorang aktris Korea Selatan. Dia paling dikenal secara internasional untuk perannya dalam film Parasite (2019), yang memenangkan empat Academy Awards dan menjadi film berbahasa non-Inggris pertama yang memenangkan Best Picture.

name: Choi Min-sik
title: Choi Min-sik
extract: Choi Min-sik is a South Korean actor. Known for his intense and transformative performances, he first gained recognition with the television series The Moon of Seoul (1994). His film breakthrough came with Shiri (1999), which established Choi as a leading actor. However, it was his role in Oldboy (2003) that cemented his status as one of South Korea's greatest actors. His performance was critically acclaimed and won him Best Actor at the Baeksang Arts Awards, the Blue Dragon Film Awards, and the Grand Bell Awards.
extract_id: Choi Min-sik adalah seorang aktor Korea Selatan. Dikenal karena penampilannya yang intens dan transformasi, dia pertama kali mendapatkan pengakuan lewat serial televisi The Moon of Seoul (1994). Terobosan filmnya datang dengan Shiri (1999), yang menetapkan Choi sebagai aktor utama. Namun, perannya dalam Oldboy (2003) yang mengukuhkan statusnya sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar Korea Selatan. Penampilannya mendapat pujian kritis dan memenangkan Best Actor di Baeksang Arts Awards, Blue Dragon Film Awards, dan Grand Bell Awards.

name: Choi Woo-sik
title: Choi Woo-shik
extract: Choi Woo-shik is a Canadian actor based in South Korea. He first gained recognition for starring in the film Set Me Free (2014) and the television series Hogu's Love (2015) before coming to international prominence for his roles in the films Train to Busan (2016) and Parasite (2019) both of which were critical and commercial successes with the latter winning the Palme d'Or at Cannes and the Academy Award for Best Picture. He has since starred in the television series Our Beloved Summer (2021–2022) and A Killer Paradox (2024), as well as the films The Policeman's Lineage (2022) and Wonderland (2024).
extract_id: Choi Woo-shik adalah aktor Kanada yang berbasis di Korea Selatan. Dia pertama kali mendapatkan pengakuan dengan membintangi film Set Me Free (2014) dan serial televisi Hogu's Love (2015) sebelum menjadi terkenal secara internasional lewat perannya dalam film Train to Busan (2016) dan Parasite (2019) yang keduanya sukses kritis dan komersial dengan yang terakhir memenangkan Palme d'Or di Cannes dan Academy Award untuk Best Picture. Sejak itu dia membintangi serial televisi Our Beloved Summer (2021–2022) dan A Killer Paradox (2024), serta film The Policeman's Lineage (2022) dan Wonderland (2024).

name: Chris Columbus
title: Chris Columbus (filmmaker)
extract: Christopher Joseph Columbus is an American filmmaker. Born in Spangler, Pennsylvania, Columbus studied film at New York University's Tisch School of the Arts where he developed an interest in filmmaking. After writing screenplays for several teen comedies in the mid-1980s, including Gremlins, The Goonies, and Young Sherlock Holmes, he made his directorial debut with a teen adventure, Adventures in Babysitting (1987). Columbus gained recognition soon after with the highly successful Christmas comedy Home Alone (1990) and its sequel, Home Alone 2: Lost in New York (1992).
extract_id: Christopher Joseph Columbus adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika. Lahir di Spangler, Pennsylvania, Columbus belajar film di Tisch School of the Arts New York University di mana dia mengembangkan minat dalam pembuatan film. Setelah menulis skenario beberapa komedi remaja pada pertengahan 1980-an, termasuk Gremlins, The Goonies, dan Young Sherlock Holmes, dia membuat debut sutradara dengan petualangan remaja, Adventures in Babysitting (1987). Columbus mendapatkan pengakuan tak lama kemudian dengan komedi Natal yang sangat sukses Home Alone (1990) dan sekuelnya, Home Alone 2: Lost in New York (1992).

name: Chris Cooper
title: Chris Cooper
extract: Christopher Walton Cooper is an American actor. Having debuted as a stage actor, his television breakthrough was as Sheriff July Johnson in the acclaimed Western television miniseries Lonesome Dove (1989). He has appeared in major Hollywood films, including A Time to Kill (1996), October Sky (1999), American Beauty (1999), The Bourne Identity (2002), Adaptation (2002), Seabiscuit (2003), Capote (2005), Syriana (2005), The Kingdom (2007), Where the Wild Things Are (2009), The Town (2010), The Muppets (2011), Live by Night (2016), Cars 3 (2017), A Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood (2019), and Little Women (2019).
extract_id: Christopher Walton Cooper adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Setelah memulai sebagai aktor panggung, terobosan televisinya adalah sebagai Sheriff July Johnson dalam mini seri televisi Barat yang diakui Lonesome Dove (1989). Dia telah tampil dalam film-film Hollywood besar, termasuk A Time to Kill (1996), October Sky (1999), American Beauty (1999), The Bourne Identity (2002), Adaptation (2002), Seabiscuit (2003), Capote (2005), Syriana (2005), The Kingdom (2007), Where the Wild Things Are (2009), The Town (2010), The Muppets (2011), Live by Night (2016), Cars 3 (2017), A Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood (2019), dan Little Women (2019).

name: Chris Elliott
title: Chris Elliott
extract: Christopher Nash Elliott is an American actor, comedian and writer known for his surreal sense of humor. He was a regular performer on Late Night with David Letterman while working as a writer there (1983–1988), created and starred in the comedy series Get a Life (1990–1992) on Fox, and wrote and starred in the film Cabin Boy (1994) and appeared in multiple sequels in the Scary Movie film series, most notably as the character Hanson. His writing for Letterman won four consecutive Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Christopher Nash Elliott adalah seorang aktor, komedian, dan penulis Amerika yang dikenal dengan humor surrealnya. Dia merupakan pemeran reguler di Late Night with David Letterman sambil bekerja sebagai penulis di sana (1983–1988), menciptakan dan membintangi serial komedi Get a Life (1990–1992) di Fox, serta menulis dan membintangi film Cabin Boy (1994) dan tampil di banyak sekuel dalam seri film Scary Movie, terutama sebagai karakter Hanson. Tulisan-tulisannya untuk Letterman memenangkan empat Primetime Emmy Awards secara berturut-turut.

name: Chris Evans
title: Chris Evans (actor)
extract: Christopher Robert Evans is an American actor. His films as a leading performer have grossed $11.4 billion worldwide, making him one of the highest-grossing film stars of all time and one of the world's highest-paid actors. His accolades include nominations for two Critics' Choice Awards and a Drama League Award.
extract_id: Christopher Robert Evans adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Film-filmnya sebagai pemeran utama telah menghasilkan $11,4 miliar di seluruh dunia, menjadikannya salah satu bintang film dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa dan salah satu aktor dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk nominasi untuk dua Critics' Choice Awards dan Drama League Award.

name: Chris Hemsworth
title: Chris Hemsworth
extract: Christopher Hemsworth is an Australian actor and film producer. His films as a leading man have grossed over $12.1 billion worldwide, making him one of the highest-grossing film stars of all time. Hemsworth was one of the world's highest-paid actors annually from 2017 to 2019.
extract_id: Christopher Hemsworth adalah seorang aktor dan produser film Australia. Film-filmnya sebagai pemeran utama telah menghasilkan lebih dari $12,1 miliar di seluruh dunia, menjadikannya salah satu bintang film dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa. Hemsworth adalah salah satu aktor dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia setiap tahun dari 2017 hingga 2019.

name: Chris O'Donnell
title: Chris O'Donnell
extract: Christopher Eugene O'Donnell is an American actor. After modeling and acting in numerous commercials as a teenager, he made his film debut in the comedy-drama film Men Don't Leave (1990). Following supporting roles in the films Fried Green Tomatoes (1991) and School Ties (1992), O'Donnell had his breakout with a starring role in the drama film Scent of a Woman (1992), which earned him a nomination for the Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor – Motion Picture.
extract_id: Christopher Eugene O'Donnell adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Setelah menjadi model dan berakting dalam banyak iklan sebagai remaja, dia memulai debut filmnya dalam film komedi-drama Men Don't Leave (1990). Setelah peran pendukung dalam film Fried Green Tomatoes (1991) dan School Ties (1992), O'Donnell meraih terobosan dengan peran utama dalam film drama Scent of a Woman (1992), yang memberinya nominasi Golden Globe Award untuk Best Supporting Actor – Motion Picture.

name: Chris Owen
title: Chris Owen (actor)
extract: Chris Owen is an American actor. He is best known for his supporting role as Chuck "Sherminator" Sherman in the American Pie franchise (1999–2012), appearing in American Pie, American Pie 2, American Pie Presents: Band Camp and American Reunion. Owen has also appeared in multiple National Lampoon films, including starring as the co-lead in National Lampoon's Gold Diggers (2003).
extract_id: Chris Owen adalah aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal untuk peran pendukungnya sebagai Chuck "Sherminator" Sherman dalam franchise American Pie (1999–2012), tampil di American Pie, American Pie 2, American Pie Presents: Band Camp, dan American Reunion. Owen juga telah tampil di beberapa film National Lampoon, termasuk sebagai pemeran utama pendamping dalam National Lampoon's Gold Diggers (2003).

name: Chris Penn
title: Chris Penn
extract: Christopher Shannon Penn was an American actor. He was the younger brother of both actor and filmmaker Sean Penn and musician Michael Penn. Noted as a skilled character actor, he was typically cast as a tough character, featured as a villain or a working-class thug, or in a comic role.
extract_id: Christopher Shannon Penn adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia adalah adik dari aktor dan pembuat film Sean Penn serta musisi Michael Penn. Dikenal sebagai aktor karakter yang terampil, dia biasanya berperan sebagai karakter keras, ditampilkan sebagai penjahat atau preman kelas pekerja, atau dalam peran komedi.

name: Chris Pine
title: Chris Pine
extract: Christopher Whitelaw Pine is an American actor. He starred as James T. Kirk in the Star Trek reboot film series (2009–2016) and as Steve Trevor in the DC Extended Universe films Wonder Woman (2017) and Wonder Woman 1984 (2020).
extract_id: Christopher Whitelaw Pine adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia berperan sebagai James T. Kirk dalam seri film reboot Star Trek (2009–2016) dan sebagai Steve Trevor dalam film DC Extended Universe Wonder Woman (2017) dan Wonder Woman 1984 (2020).

name: Chris Pratt
title: Chris Pratt
extract: Christopher Michael Pratt is an American actor and producer. His films as a leading actor have grossed over $15.2 billion worldwide, making him one of the highest-grossing film stars of all time. Pratt was one of the world's highest-paid actors annually from 2015 to 2017. Through starring in blockbuster franchises and big-budget films, he has established himself as one of Hollywood's most bankable stars.
extract_id: Christopher Michael Pratt adalah seorang aktor dan produser Amerika. Film-filmnya sebagai pemeran utama telah menghasilkan lebih dari $15,2 miliar di seluruh dunia, menjadikannya salah satu bintang film dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa. Pratt adalah salah satu aktor dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia setiap tahun dari 2015 hingga 2017. Melalui membintangi franchise blockbuster dan film beranggaran besar, dia telah menegaskan diri sebagai salah satu bintang Hollywood yang paling dapat diandalkan.

name: Chris Renaud
title: Chris Renaud
extract: Chris Renaud is an American filmmaker, designer, storyboard artist, and voice actor. He is best known for his work at Illumination, including directing the company's animated films such as the first, second, and fourth films in the Despicable Me franchise (2010–present), the first two of which he co-directed with Pierre Coffin, The Lorax (2012), The Secret Life of Pets (2016) and its sequel The Secret Life of Pets 2 (2019).
extract_id: Chris Renaud adalah seorang pembuat film, desainer, artis storyboard, dan pengisi suara Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena karyanya di Illumination, termasuk menyutradarai film animasi perusahaan seperti film pertama, kedua, dan keempat dalam franchise Despicable Me (2010–sekarang), dua film pertama yang disutradai bersama Pierre Coffin, The Lorax (2012), The Secret Life of Pets (2016), dan sekuelnya The Secret Life of Pets 2 (2019).

name: Chris Sanders
title: Chris Sanders
description: American filmmaker, animator, and voice actor (born 1962)
extract: Christopher Michael Sanders is an American filmmaker, animator, and voice actor. His credits include Lilo & Stitch (2002) for Walt Disney Animation Studios, and How to Train Your Dragon (2010), both of which he co-wrote and directed with Dean DeBlois; The Croods (2013) with Kirk DeMicco; and The Wild Robot (2024) for DreamWorks Animation, receiving nominations for the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature for all of them. In 2020, he made his live-action directorial debut with the adventure-drama The Call of the Wild. He created the popular Disney character Stitch in 1985, wrote the story of Lilo & Stitch, and has voiced Stitch in most of his media appearances.
extract_id: Christopher Michael Sanders adalah seorang pembuat film, animator, dan pengisi suara Amerika. Kreditnya mencakup Lilo & Stitch (2002) untuk Walt Disney Animation Studios, dan How to Train Your Dragon (2010), keduanya ia tulis dan sutradarai bersama Dean DeBlois; The Croods (2013) bersama Kirk DeMicco; dan The Wild Robot (2024) untuk DreamWorks Animation, menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Best Animated Feature untuk semuanya. Pada 2020, ia membuat debut sutradara live-action dengan petualangan-drama The Call of the Wild. Dia menciptakan karakter Disney populer Stitch pada 1985, menulis cerita Lilo & Stitch, dan telah mengisi suara Stitch dalam sebagian besar penampilannya di media.

name: Chris Sarandon
title: Chris Sarandon
extract: Chris Sarandon is an American actor. He is well known for playing Jerry Dandrige in Fright Night (1985), Prince Humperdinck in The Princess Bride (1987), Detective Mike Norris in Child's Play (1988), and Jack Skellington's speaking voice in The Nightmare Before Christmas (1993). He was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for his performance as Leon Shermer in Dog Day Afternoon (1975).
extract_id: Chris Sarandon adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal luas sebagai Jerry Dandrige dalam Fright Night (1985), Pangeran Humperdinck dalam The Princess Bride (1987), Detektif Mike Norris dalam Child's Play (1988), dan suara berbicara Jack Skellington dalam The Nightmare Before Christmas (1993). Dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Best Supporting Actor atas penampilannya sebagai Leon Shermer dalam Dog Day Afternoon (1975).

name: Chris Williams
title: Chris Williams (actor)
extract: Chris Williams is an American actor, voice actor, and comedian. His roles include starring as "Eddie" on the CBS series The Great Indoors.
extract_id: Chris Williams adalah aktor, pengisi suara, dan komedian Amerika. Peran-perannya termasuk berperan sebagai "Eddie" dalam serial CBS The Great Indoors.

name: Christian Bale
title: Christian Bale
extract: Christian Charles Philip Bale is an English actor. Known for his versatility and physical transformations for his roles, he has been a leading man in films of several genres. His accolades include an Academy Award and two Golden Globe Awards, in addition to nominations for four BAFTAs. He was one of the highest-paid actors in 2014, and The Independent later named him one of the greatest actors of the 21st century.
extract_id: Christian Charles Philip Bale adalah seorang aktor Inggris. Dikenal karena kemampuannya yang serba bisa dan transformasi fisik untuk peran-perannya, dia telah menjadi pemeran utama dalam film dari berbagai genre. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk Academy Award dan dua Golden Globe Awards, selain nominasi untuk empat BAFTA. Dia termasuk salah satu aktor dengan bayaran tertinggi pada 2014, dan The Independent kemudian menamainya sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar abad ke-21.

name: Christian Berkel
title: Christian Berkel
extract: Christian Berkel is a German actor. He is known for his appearances in Downfall (2004), Black Book (film) (2006), Valkyrie (2008), Inglourious Basterds (2009) and The Man from U.N.C.L.E. (2015).
extract_id: Christian Berkel adalah aktor Jerman. Dia dikenal karena kemunculannya dalam Downfall (2004), Black Book (film) (2006), Valkyrie (2008), Inglourious Basterds (2009), dan The Man from U.N.C.L.E. (2015).

name: Christian Carion
title: Christian Carion
description: French film director, dialogue writer and screenwriter
extract: Christian Carion is a French film director, dialogue writer and screenwriter, gaining international attention for Joyeux Noël , which was nominated for several awards, including the 2005 Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film.
extract_id: Christian Carion adalah sutradara film, penulis dialog, dan penulis skenario Prancis, mendapatkan perhatian internasional untuk Joyeux Noël, yang dinominasikan untuk beberapa penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award 2005 untuk Best Foreign Language Film.

name: Christian Friedel
title: Christian Friedel
extract: Christian Friedel is a German actor and singer. Having acted in a number of German language productions, he is best known internationally as the teacher in Michael Haneke's The White Ribbon (2009), as part of the main cast of the Netflix television thriller series Babylon Berlin (2017–present), as Rudolf Höss in the 2023 drama The Zone of Interest, and as Fabian in season three of the anthology series The White Lotus (2025).
extract_id: Christian Friedel adalah aktor dan penyanyi Jerman. Setelah berperan dalam sejumlah produksi berbahasa Jerman, dia paling dikenal secara internasional sebagai guru dalam film The White Ribbon (2009) karya Michael Haneke, sebagai bagian dari pemeran utama dalam serial thriller televisi Netflix Babylon Berlin (2017–sekarang), sebagai Rudolf Höss dalam drama The Zone of Interest (2023), dan sebagai Fabian di musim ketiga seri antologi The White Lotus (2025).

name: Christian Slater
title: Christian Slater
extract: Christian Michael Leonard Slater is an American actor. He made his film debut with a leading role in The Legend of Billie Jean (1985) and gained wider recognition for his breakout role as Jason "J.D." Dean, a sociopathic high school student, in the satire Heathers (1989).
extract_id: Christian Michael Leonard Slater adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia membuat debut filmnya dengan peran utama dalam The Legend of Billie Jean (1985) dan mendapatkan pengakuan lebih luas lewat peran terobosan sebagai Jason "J.D." Dean, seorang murid sekolah menengah yang sosiopat, dalam satire Heathers (1989).

name: Christina Hendricks
title: Christina Hendricks
extract: Christina Rene Hendricks is an American actress and former model. She is best known for her role as Joan Holloway on the critically acclaimed AMC period drama series Mad Men (2007–2015). In 2010, a poll of female readers taken by Esquire magazine named her "the sexiest woman in the world". She was also voted "Best Looking Woman in America". Hendricks has received various accolades, including two Actor Awards and two Critics' Choice Awards, as well as nominations for six Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Christina Rene Hendricks adalah seorang aktris dan mantan model Amerika. Dia paling dikenal sebagai Joan Holloway dalam serial drama periode AMC yang diakui, Mad Men (2007–2015). Pada 2010, sebuah jajak pendapat pembaca perempuan oleh majalah Esquire menobatkannya sebagai "wanita terseksi di dunia". Dia juga terpilih sebagai "Wanita Tercantik di Amerika". Hendricks telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Actor Awards dan dua Critics' Choice Awards, serta nominasi untuk enam Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Christine Hargreaves
title: Christine Hargreaves
extract: Christine Hargreaves was an English actress. She was known for her role of Christine Hardman in the ITV soap opera Coronation Street (1960–1963).
extract_id: Christine Hargreaves adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Christine Hardman dalam sinetron ITV Coronation Street (1960–1963).

name: Christoph Waltz
title: Christoph Waltz
extract: Christoph Waltz is an Austrian, German and American actor. Waltz gained international recognition for his portrayal of villainous and supporting roles in English-language films. His accolades include two Academy Awards, two BAFTAs, and two Golden Globes, as well as a nomination for a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Christoph Waltz adalah aktor Austria, Jerman, dan Amerika. Waltz mendapatkan pengakuan internasional untuk pemeranannya dalam peran antagonis dan pendukung dalam film berbahasa Inggris. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk dua Academy Awards, dua BAFTA, dan dua Golden Globes, serta nominasi untuk Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Christophe Barratier
title: Christophe Barratier

extract: Christophe Barratier is a French film producer, director and screenwriter, and lyricist.
extract_id: Christophe Barratier adalah seorang produser film, sutradara, penulis skenario, dan pencipta lirik dari Prancis.

name: Christopher Adamson
title: Christopher Adamson
extract: Christopher Adamson was a British actor. He often portrayed villains, such as Mean Machine Angel in Judge Dredd and Jimmy Legs in Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest and Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End. He attended Webber Douglas Academy of Dramatic Art.
extract_id: Christopher Adamson adalah aktor Inggris. Dia sering memerankan tokoh antagonis, seperti Mean Machine Angel dalam Judge Dredd dan Jimmy Legs dalam Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest dan Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End. Dia menempuh pendidikan di Webber Douglas Academy of Dramatic Art.

name: Christopher Carley
title: Christopher Carley
extract: Christopher Murphy Carley is an American actor who is sometimes credited as Chris Carley. He is best known for portraying Father Janovich in the 2008 film Gran Torino.
extract_id: Christopher Murphy Carley adalah aktor Amerika yang kadang-kadang dikreditkan sebagai Chris Carley. Dia terkenal karena memerankan Father Janovich dalam film Gran Torino tahun 2008.

name: Christopher Eccleston
title: Christopher Eccleston
extract: Christopher Eccleston is an English actor. He is known for his work in various social realist television dramas, as well as for playing the ninth incarnation of the Doctor in the BBC science fiction series Doctor Who (2005).
extract_id: Christopher Eccleston adalah aktor Inggris. Ia dikenal atas karyanya dalam berbagai drama televisi realisme sosial, serta karena memerankan inkarnasi kesembilan Dokter dalam serial fiksi ilmiah BBC Doctor Who (2005).

name: Christopher Guest
title: Christopher Guest
description: American and British director and actor (born 1948)
extract: Christopher Haden-Guest, 5th Baron Haden-Guest, known professionally as Christopher Guest, is an American-British actor, comedian, screenwriter and director. Guest has written, directed, and starred in his series of comedy films shot in mockumentary style. He co-wrote and acted in the rock satire This Is Spinal Tap (1984), and later directed a string of satirical mockumentary films such as Waiting for Guffman (1996), Best in Show (2000), A Mighty Wind (2003), For Your Consideration (2006), and Mascots (2016). He also acted in the films Death Wish (1974), Little Shop of Horrors (1986), The Princess Bride (1987), and A Few Good Men (1992); and was a regular cast member on the 10th season of Saturday Night Live.
extract_id: Christopher Haden-Guest, 5th Baron Haden-Guest, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Christopher Guest, adalah aktor, komedian, penulis skenario dan sutradara Amerika-Inggris. Guest telah menulis, menyutradarai, dan membintangi serangkaian film komedi bergaya mockumentary. Dia ikut menulis dan berperan dalam satire rock This Is Spinal Tap (1984), dan kemudian menyutradarai beberapa film satire mockumentary seperti Waiting for Guffman (1996), Best in Show (2000), A Mighty Wind (2003), For Your Consideration (2006), dan Mascots (2016). Dia juga berakting dalam film Death Wish (1974), Little Shop of Horrors (1986), The Princess Bride (1987), dan A Few Good Men (1992); serta menjadi anggota pemeran reguler pada musim ke-10 Saturday Night Live.

name: Christopher Heyerdahl
title: Christopher Heyerdahl
extract: Christopher Heyerdahl is a Canadian actor who portrayed Alastair in Supernatural, the Wraith Todd and the Athosian Halling in Stargate Atlantis, Sam in Van Helsing, "Swede" in Hell on Wheels, Bigfoot and John Druitt in Sanctuary, and Marcus in The Twilight Saga.
extract_id: Christopher Heyerdahl adalah aktor Kanada yang memerankan Alastair dalam Supernatural, Wraith Todd dan Athosian Halling dalam Stargate Atlantis, Sam dalam Van Helsing, "Swede" dalam Hell on Wheels, Bigfoot dan John Druitt dalam Sanctuary, serta Marcus dalam The Twilight Saga.

name: Christopher Lloyd
title: Christopher Lloyd
extract: Christopher Allen Lloyd is an American actor. He has appeared in many theater productions, films, and television shows since the 1960s. He is known for portraying Emmett "Doc" Brown in the Back to the Future trilogy (1985–1990) and "Reverend" Jim Ignatowski in the comedy series Taxi (1978–1983), for which he won two Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Christopher Allen Lloyd adalah aktor Amerika. Dia telah tampil dalam banyak produksi teater, film, dan acara televisi sejak tahun 1960-an. Dia dikenal karena memerankan Emmett "Doc" Brown dalam trilogi Back to the Future (1985–1990) dan "Reverend" Jim Ignatowski dalam serial komedi Taxi (1978–1983), yang memberinya dua Penghargaan Emmy.

name: Christopher McQuarrie
title: Christopher McQuarrie
extract: Christopher McQuarrie is an American filmmaker. He received the BAFTA Award, Independent Spirit Award, and Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay for the neo-noir mystery film The Usual Suspects (1995). He made his directorial debut with the crime thriller film The Way of the Gun (2000).
extract_id: Christopher McQuarrie adalah pembuat film Amerika. Ia menerima BAFTA Award, Independent Spirit Award, dan Academy Award untuk Best Original Screenplay untuk film misteri neo-noir The Usual Suspects (1995). Ia memulai debut sutradaranya dengan film thriller kejahatan The Way of the Gun (2000).

name: Christopher Mintz-Plasse
title: Christopher Mintz-Plasse
extract: Christopher Charles Mintz-Plasse is an American actor and musician, primarily known for his debut role as Fogell / McLovin in the movie Superbad (2007) and for portraying Chris D'Amico/Red Mist in the Kick-Ass franchise.
extract_id: Christopher Charles Mintz-Plasse adalah aktor dan musisi Amerika, terutama dikenal karena peran debutnya sebagai Fogell/McLovin dalam film Superbad (2007) dan memerankan Chris D'Amico/Red Mist dalam franchise Kick-Ass.

name: Christopher Nolan
title: Christopher Nolan
extract: Sir Christopher Edward Nolan is a British filmmaker. Known for his Hollywood blockbusters with complex storytelling, Nolan is considered a leading filmmaker of the 21st century. His films have earned over $8 billion worldwide, making him the third-highest-grossing film director of all time. Nolan's accolades include two Academy Awards, a Golden Globe Award, and two British Academy Film Awards. He was also appointed a Commander of the British Empire (CBE) in 2019 and was knighted in 2024 for his contributions to film.
extract_id: Sir Christopher Edward Nolan adalah pembuat film Inggris. Dikenal dengan film-film blockbuster Hollywoodnya yang bercerita dengan kompleks, Nolan dianggap sebagai pembuat film terkemuka abad ke-21. Film-filmnya telah meraup lebih dari $8 miliar di seluruh dunia, menjadikannya sutradara film dengan pendapatan tertinggi ketiga sepanjang masa. Penghargaan Nolan meliputi dua Academy Awards, satu Golden Globe Award, dan dua British Academy Film Awards. Ia juga diangkat sebagai Commander of the British Empire (CBE) pada 2019 dan mendapat gelar kesatria pada 2024 atas kontribusinya dalam dunia film.

name: Christopher Plummer
title: Christopher Plummer
extract: Arthur Christopher Orme Plummer was a Canadian actor. His career spanned seven decades, gaining him recognition for his performances in film, stage, and television. His accolades included an Academy Award, two Tony Awards and two Primetime Emmy Awards, making him the only Canadian recipient of the "Triple Crown of Acting". He also received a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award and Screen Actors Guild Award, as well as a nomination for a Grammy Award.
extract_id: Arthur Christopher Orme Plummer adalah aktor Kanada. Kariernya berlangsung selama tujuh dekade, memberinya pengakuan atas penampilannya dalam film, panggung, dan televisi. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk Academy Award, dua Tony Awards, dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards, menjadikannya satu-satunya penerima Kanada yang meraih "Triple Crown of Acting". Dia juga menerima BAFTA Award, Golden Globe Award dan Screen Actors Guild Award, serta nominasi Grammy Award.

name: Christopher Reeve
title: Christopher Reeve
extract: Christopher D'Olier Reeve was an American actor, activist, director, and author. He amassed many stage and screen credits in his 34-year career, including playing the title character in the Superman film series (1978–1987). He won a British Academy Film Award, an Emmy Award, a Grammy Award and a Screen Actors Guild Award. He was also known for his activism.
extract_id: Christopher D'Olier Reeve adalah aktor, aktivis, sutradara, dan penulis Amerika. Ia mengumpulkan banyak kredit pentas dan layar dalam kariernya selama 34 tahun, termasuk memerankan tokoh utama dalam seri film Superman (1978–1987). Ia memenangkan British Academy Film Award, Emmy Award, Grammy Award dan Screen Actors Guild Award. Ia juga dikenal karena aktivismenya.

name: Christopher Walken
title: Christopher Walken
extract: Christopher Walken is an American actor. His work on stage and screen has earned him accolades including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, and an Actor Award, as well as nominations for two Tony Awards, two Primetime Emmy Awards, and a Golden Globe. His films have grossed more than $1.6 billion in the United States.
extract_id: Christopher Walken adalah aktor Amerika. Karyanya di panggung dan layar telah memberinya penghargaan termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan Actor Award, serta nominasi untuk dua Tony Awards, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan Golden Globe. Film-filmnya telah meraup lebih dari $1,6 miliar di Amerika Serikat.

name: Chulpan Khamatova
title: Chulpan Khamatova

name: Ciarán Hinds
title: Ciarán Hinds
extract: Ciarán Hinds is an Irish actor. Born and raised in Belfast, Northern Ireland, Hinds is known for a range of screen and stage roles and has starred in feature films including The Cook, the Thief, His Wife & Her Lover (1989), Persuasion (1995), Oscar and Lucinda (1997), Road to Perdition (2002), The Sum of All Fears (2002), Munich (2005), Amazing Grace (2007), There Will Be Blood (2007), Miss Pettigrew Lives for a Day (2008), Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 2 (2011), Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy (2011), Silence (2016), First Man (2018), and Belfast (2021), the last of which earned him nominations for Academy Award, BAFTA Award, and Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor.
extract_id: Ciarán Hinds adalah aktor Irlandia. Lahir dan dibesarkan di Belfast, Irlandia Utara, Hinds dikenal melalui berbagai peran layar dan panggung dan telah membintangi film-film fitur termasuk The Cook, the Thief, His Wife & Her Lover (1989), Persuasion (1995), Oscar and Lucinda (1997), Road to Perdition (2002), The Sum of All Fears (2002), Munich (2005), Amazing Grace (2007), There Will Be Blood (2007), Miss Pettigrew Lives for a Day (2008), Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 2 (2011), Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy (2011), Silence (2016), First Man (2018), dan Belfast (2021), film terakhir yang memberinya nominasi Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan Golden Globe Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Cillian Murphy
title: Cillian Murphy
extract: Cillian Murphy is an Irish actor and film producer. His works encompass both stage and screen, and his accolades include an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, and a Golden Globe Award.
extract_id: Cillian Murphy adalah aktor dan produser film Irlandia. Karyanya mencakup panggung dan layar, dan penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan Golden Globe Award.

name: Claire Bloom
title: Claire Bloom
extract: Patricia Claire Bloom is an English actress. She is known for leading roles on stage and screen and has received two BAFTA Awards, an Emmy award and a Drama Desk Award, as well as nominations for a Grammy Award and a Tony Award. She was appointed Commander of the Order of the British Empire (CBE) in the 2013 Birthday Honours for services to drama.
extract_id: Patricia Claire Bloom adalah aktris Inggris. Dia dikenal karena peran utama di panggung dan layar serta telah menerima dua BAFTA Awards, Emmy Award, dan Drama Desk Award, serta nominasi untuk Grammy Award dan Tony Award. Dia dianugerahi gelar Commander of the Order of the British Empire (CBE) dalam Birthday Honours 2013 atas jasanya di bidang drama.

name: Claire Danes
title: Claire Danes
extract: Claire Catherine Danes is an American actor. Prolific in film and television since her teens, she is the recipient of three Primetime Emmy Awards and four Golden Globe Awards. In 2012 and 2026, Time named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world.
extract_id: Claire Catherine Danes adalah aktor Amerika. Produktif di film dan televisi sejak remaja, dia menerima tiga Primetime Emmy Awards dan empat Golden Globe Awards. Pada 2012 dan 2026, Time menobatkannya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia.

name: Claire Maurier
title: Claire Maurier
extract: Odette-Michelle-Suzanne Agramon, known professionally as Claire Maurier, was a French actress who appeared in more than 90 films between 1947 and 2013.
extract_id: Odette-Michelle-Suzanne Agramon, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Claire Maurier, adalah aktris Prancis yang tampil dalam lebih dari 90 film antara tahun 1947 dan 2013.

name: Claire Rushbrook
title: Claire Rushbrook
extract: Claire Louise Rushbrook is an English actress. Her films include Secrets & Lies (1996) and Ali & Ava (2021). On television, she is known for her roles in the BBC One series The Sins (2000), Carrie & Barry (2004–2005) and Sherwood (2022–), the ITV series Whitechapel (2009–2013) and Home Fires (2015–2016), the E4 series My Mad Fat Diary (2013–2015), and the Disney+ series Rivals (2024–).
extract_id: Claire Louise Rushbrook adalah aktris Inggris. Film-filmnya termasuk Secrets & Lies (1996) dan Ali & Ava (2021).
