name: Claire Trevor
title: Claire Trevor
extract: Claire Trevor was an American actress. She appeared in 65 feature films from 1933 to 1982, winning the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her role in Key Largo (1948), and received nominations for her roles in The High and the Mighty (1954) and Dead End (1937). Trevor received top billing, ahead of John Wayne, for Stagecoach (1939).
extract_id: Claire Trevor adalah aktris Amerika. Dia tampil dalam 65 film fitur dari tahun 1933 hingga 1982, memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik atas perannya dalam Key Largo (1948), dan menerima nominasi untuk perannya dalam The High and the Mighty (1954) dan Dead End (1937). Trevor mendapat kredit utama, lebih dari John Wayne, dalam Stagecoach (1939).

name: Clark Gable
title: Clark Gable
extract: William Clark Gable was an American actor often referred to as the "King of Hollywood". He appeared in more than 60 motion pictures across a variety of genres during a 37-year career, three decades of which he spent as a leading man. In 1999, the American Film Institute ranked Gable as the seventh-greatest male screen legend of classical Hollywood cinema.
extract_id: William Clark Gable adalah aktor Amerika yang sering disebut "Raja Hollywood". Dia tampil dalam lebih dari 60 film dengan berbagai genre selama karier 37 tahun, yang tiga dekadenya sebagai pemeran utama. Pada 1999, American Film Institute menobatkan Gable sebagai legenda layar pria ketujuh terbesar dalam sinema Hollywood klasik.

name: Claude Rains
title: Claude Rains
extract: William Claude Rains was an English and American character actor whose career spanned almost seven decades. He was the recipient of numerous accolades, including four Academy Award nominations for Best Supporting Actor, and is considered one of the screen's great character stars who played cultured villains during the Golden Age of Hollywood.
extract_id: William Claude Rains adalah aktor karakter Inggris dan Amerika dengan karier yang berlangsung hampir tujuh dekade. Ia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk empat nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik, dan dianggap sebagai salah satu bintang karakter terbesar yang memerankan penjahat berbudaya selama Zaman Keemasan Hollywood.

name: Claudette Colbert
title: Claudette Colbert
extract: Claudette Colbert, also known as Lily Claudette Chauchoin, was an American stage and film actress born in France. She began her career in earnest on Broadway during the late 1920s and progressed to films with the advent of talking pictures. Initially associated with Paramount Pictures, Colbert had a string of successes as she gradually shifted to working as a freelance actress.
extract_id: Claudette Colbert, juga dikenal sebagai Lily Claudette Chauchoin, adalah aktris panggung dan film Amerika yang lahir di Prancis. Dia memulai kariernya dengan sungguh-sungguh di Broadway pada akhir 1920-an dan kemudian beralih ke film dengan munculnya film bersuara. Awalnya terkait dengan Paramount Pictures, Colbert meraih serangkaian kesuksesan saat ia secara bertahap bekerja sebagai aktris lepas.

name: Claudia Cardinale
title: Claudia Cardinale
extract: Claude Joséphine Rose "Claudia" Cardinale was an Italian-Tunisian actress. Regarded as one of the leading female figures of Italian cinema, alongside Sophia Loren, Monica Vitti, Silvana Mangano, Anna Magnani, and Gina Lollobrigida, she achieved international recognition during a career spanning more than six decades. Celebrated in the 1960s as "the most beautiful woman in the world" and widely considered a sex symbol of the era, Cardinale appeared in more than 175 films, primarily in Italy and France, across genres including comedy, drama, spaghetti westerns, and historical epics. She collaborated with acclaimed directors such as Federico Fellini, Sergio Leone, and Werner Herzog, and several of her films are regarded as significant works in the history of cinema. At the time of her death, she was one of the last surviving stars from the Golden Age of European cinema.
extract_id: Claude Joséphine Rose "Claudia" Cardinale adalah aktris Italia-Tunisia. Dianggap sebagai salah satu tokoh perempuan terkemuka dalam sinema Italia, bersama Sophia Loren, Monica Vitti, Silvana Mangano, Anna Magnani, dan Gina Lollobrigida, ia meraih pengakuan internasional selama kariernya yang berlangsung lebih dari enam dekade. Dipuja pada 1960-an sebagai "wanita tercantik di dunia" dan secara luas dianggap sebagai simbol seks era tersebut, Cardinale tampil dalam lebih dari 175 film, terutama di Italia dan Prancis, dalam berbagai genre termasuk komedi, drama, spaghetti western, dan epik sejarah. Ia bekerja sama dengan sutradara ternama seperti Federico Fellini, Sergio Leone, dan Werner Herzog, dan beberapa filmnya dianggap sebagai karya penting dalam sejarah sinema. Pada saat kematiannya, ia adalah salah satu bintang terakhir yang masih hidup dari Zaman Keemasan sinema Eropa.

name: Cleavon Little
title: Cleavon Little
extract: Cleavon Jake Little was an American actor. He began his career in the late 1960s on the stage. In 1970, he starred in the Broadway production of Purlie, for which he earned both a Tony Award and a Drama Desk Award. His first leading television role was that of the irreverent Dr. Jerry Noland on the ABC sitcom Temperatures Rising (1972–1974). While starring in the sitcom, Little appeared in what has become his signature role, portraying Sheriff Bart in the 1974 Mel Brooks comedy film Blazing Saddles.
extract_id: Cleavon Jake Little adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya pada akhir 1960-an di panggung teater. Pada tahun 1970, dia membintangi produksi Broadway Purlie, yang memberinya penghargaan Tony Award dan Drama Desk Award. Peran televisi utama pertamanya adalah sebagai Dr. Jerry Noland yang tidak hormat dalam sitkom ABC Temperatures Rising (1972–1974). Saat membintangi sitkom tersebut, Little tampil dalam peran ikoniknya sebagai Sheriff Bart dalam film komedi Mel Brooks tahun 1974, Blazing Saddles.

name: Clifton Powell
title: Clifton Powell
extract: Clifton Powell is an American actor and comedian who has primarily played supporting roles in films, such as in Ray (2004), for which he received an NAACP Image Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Motion Picture nomination. He is also known for voicing Melvin "Big Smoke" Harris in the action-adventure game Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas (2004).
extract_id: Clifton Powell adalah aktor dan komedian Amerika yang sebagian besar memainkan peran pendukung dalam film, seperti di Ray (2004), yang memberinya nominasi NAACP Image Award untuk Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Motion Picture. Dia juga dikenal sebagai pengisi suara Melvin "Big Smoke" Harris dalam permainan petualangan aksi Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas (2004).

name: Clifton Webb
title: Clifton Webb
extract: Clifton Webb was an American actor, singer, and dancer. Originally trained as a ballroom dancer, he first achieved prominence on Broadway as a star of musicals and revues, and his appearances in the plays of Noël Coward, including Blithe Spirit. He had his film breakthrough at the age of 55 in Otto Preminger's Laura (1944), which earned him an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actor.
extract_id: Clifton Webb adalah aktor, penyanyi, dan penari Amerika. Awalnya dilatih sebagai penari ballroom, ia pertama kali dikenal di Broadway sebagai bintang musikal dan revue, serta tampil dalam drama karya Noël Coward, termasuk Blithe Spirit. Ia mendapatkan terobosan di film pada usia 55 tahun melalui film Otto Preminger, Laura (1944), yang memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Clint Eastwood
title: Clint Eastwood
extract: Clinton Eastwood Jr. is a retired American actor and filmmaker. After achieving success in the Western TV series Rawhide, Eastwood rose to international fame with his role as the "Man with No Name" in Sergio Leone's Dollars Trilogy of spaghetti Westerns during the mid-1960s and as antihero cop Harry Callahan in the five Dirty Harry films throughout the 1970s and 1980s. These roles, among others, have made Eastwood an enduring cultural icon of masculinity. Elected in 1986, Eastwood served for two years as the mayor of Carmel-by-the-Sea, California.
extract_id: Clinton Eastwood Jr. adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika yang sudah pensiun. Setelah sukses dalam serial TV Western Rawhide, Eastwood meraih ketenaran internasional dengan perannya sebagai "Man with No Name" dalam Trilogi Dollars spaghetti Western karya Sergio Leone pada pertengahan 1960-an serta sebagai polisi antihero Harry Callahan dalam lima film Dirty Harry sepanjang 1970-an dan 1980-an. Peran-peran ini, dan lainnya, menjadikan Eastwood ikon budaya maskulinitas yang tahan lama. Terpilih pada tahun 1986, Eastwood menjabat selama dua tahun sebagai walikota Carmel-by-the-Sea, California.

name: Clive Owen
title: Clive Owen
extract: Clive Owen is an English actor. He first gained recognition in the United Kingdom for playing the lead role in the ITV series Chancer from 1990 to 1991. He received critical acclaim for his work in the film Close My Eyes (1991) before earning international attention for his performance as a struggling writer in Croupier (1998). In 2005, he won a Golden Globe and a BAFTA Award and was nominated for an Academy Award for his performance in the drama Closer (2004).
extract_id: Clive Owen adalah aktor Inggris. Ia pertama kali mendapat pengakuan di Inggris dengan memerankan peran utama dalam seri ITV Chancer dari 1990 hingga 1991. Ia menerima pujian kritis atas karyanya dalam film Close My Eyes (1991) sebelum menarik perhatian internasional melalui perannya sebagai penulis yang berjuang dalam Croupier (1998). Pada tahun 2005, ia memenangkan Golden Globe dan BAFTA Award serta dinominasikan untuk Academy Award atas penampilannya dalam drama Closer (2004).

name: Clyde Bruckman
title: Clyde Bruckman
extract: Clyde Adolf Bruckman was an American writer and director of comedy films during the late silent era, who continued working into the 1950s. Bruckman collaborated with such comedians as Buster Keaton, Monty Banks, W. C. Fields, Laurel and Hardy, The Three Stooges, Abbott and Costello, and Harold Lloyd.
extract_id: Clyde Adolf Bruckman adalah penulis dan sutradara film komedi Amerika pada era film bisu akhir, yang terus berkarya hingga 1950-an. Bruckman bekerja sama dengan komedian seperti Buster Keaton, Monty Banks, W. C. Fields, Laurel and Hardy, The Three Stooges, Abbott and Costello, dan Harold Lloyd.

name: Coleen Gray
title: Coleen Gray
extract: Coleen Gray was an American actress, best known for her roles in the films Nightmare Alley (1947), Red River (1948), and Stanley Kubrick's The Killing (1956).
extract_id: Coleen Gray adalah seorang aktris Amerika, paling dikenal dengan perannya dalam film Nightmare Alley (1947), Red River (1948), dan The Killing karya Stanley Kubrick (1956).

name: Colin Clive
title: Colin Clive
extract: Colin Glenn Clive was a British actor. Known for portraying individualistic, tumultuous characters which often mirrored his personal life, he is most famous for his role as Dr. Henry Frankenstein in the 1931 film Frankenstein and its 1935 sequel, Bride of Frankenstein. Clive’s maniacal delivery of the words, "It's alive, it's alive!" when Dr. Frankenstein confirms his creature is moving, was listed by American Film Institute (AFI) as one of the 100 greatest movie quotes of all time.
extract_id: Colin Glenn Clive adalah aktor Inggris. Dikenal karena memerankan karakter individualistik dan penuh gejolak yang sering mencerminkan kehidupan pribadinya, dia paling terkenal sebagai Dr. Henry Frankenstein dalam film Frankenstein tahun 1931 dan sekuelnya pada tahun 1935, Bride of Frankenstein. Penyampaian kata "It's alive, it's alive!" secara maniak oleh Clive saat Dr. Frankenstein mengonfirmasi makhluknya bergerak dicantumkan oleh American Film Institute (AFI) sebagai salah satu dari 100 kutipan film terbaik sepanjang masa.

name: Colin Farrell
title: Colin Farrell
extract: Colin James Farrell is an Irish actor. A leading man in blockbusters and independent films since the 2000s, he has received various accolades, including three Golden Globe Awards, one Actor Award, and one Volpi Cup in addition to nominations for an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award and two Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Colin James Farrell adalah aktor Irlandia. Sebagai pemeran utama dalam film blockbuster dan film independen sejak tahun 2000-an, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk tiga Golden Globe Awards, satu Penghargaan Aktor, dan satu Volpi Cup serta nominasi untuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Colin Firth
title: Colin Firth
extract: Colin Andrew Firth is an English actor and producer. He was identified in the mid-1980s with the "Brit Pack" of rising young British actors before gaining leading roles as well as numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, two BAFTA Film Awards, a Golden Globe Award, and a Volpi Cup as well as nominations for two Primetime Emmy Awards and three BAFTA TV Awards. In 2011, Firth was appointed a CBE for his services to drama, and appeared in Time magazine's 100 most influential people in the world.
extract_id: Colin Andrew Firth adalah aktor dan produser Inggris. Ia dikenal pada pertengahan 1980-an sebagai bagian dari "Brit Pack" para aktor muda Inggris yang sedang naik daun sebelum mendapatkan peran utama serta sejumlah penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, dua BAFTA Film Awards, Golden Globe Award, dan Volpi Cup serta nominasi untuk dua Primetime Emmy Awards dan tiga BAFTA TV Awards. Pada 2011, Firth diangkat menjadi CBE atas jasanya dalam drama, dan masuk dalam daftar 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia versi majalah Time.

name: Colm Feore
title: Colm Feore
extract: Colm Joseph Feore is a Canadian actor. A 15-year veteran of the Stratford Festival, he is known in Canada for his Gemini-winning turn as Prime Minister Pierre Trudeau in the CBC miniseries Trudeau (2002), his portrayal of Glenn Gould in Thirty Two Short Films About Glenn Gould (1993), and for playing Detective Martin Ward in Bon Cop, Bad Cop (2006) and its sequel Bon Cop, Bad Cop 2 (2017).
extract_id: Colm Joseph Feore adalah aktor Kanada. Dengan pengalaman 15 tahun di Festival Stratford, dia dikenal di Kanada karena perannya yang memenangkan Gemini sebagai Perdana Menteri Pierre Trudeau dalam miniseri CBC Trudeau (2002), perannya sebagai Glenn Gould dalam Thirty Two Short Films About Glenn Gould (1993), serta sebagai Detektif Martin Ward dalam Bon Cop, Bad Cop (2006) dan sekuelnya Bon Cop, Bad Cop 2 (2017).

name: Connie Nielsen
title: Connie Nielsen
extract: Connie Inge-Lise Nielsen is a Danish actress. She has starred as Lucilla in the films Gladiator (2000) and Gladiator II (2024) and as Queen Hippolyta in the DC Extended Universe (2017–2021). She has also starred in films such as Soldier (1998), Mission to Mars (2000), One Hour Photo (2002), Basic (2003), The Hunted (2003), The Ice Harvest (2005), Nymphomaniac (2013), 3 Days to Kill (2014), Inheritance (2020), Nobody (2021) and its sequel Nobody 2 (2025).
extract_id: Connie Inge-Lise Nielsen adalah aktris Denmark. Dia membintangi sebagai Lucilla dalam film Gladiator (2000) dan Gladiator II (2024) serta sebagai Ratu Hippolyta dalam DC Extended Universe (2017–2021). Dia juga membintangi film seperti Soldier (1998), Mission to Mars (2000), One Hour Photo (2002), Basic (2003), The Hunted (2003), The Ice Harvest (2005), Nymphomaniac (2013), 3 Days to Kill (2014), Inheritance (2020), Nobody (2021) dan sekuelnya Nobody 2 (2025).

name: Conrad Veidt
title: Conrad Veidt
extract: Hans Walter Conrad Veidt was a German and British character actor. He attracted early attention for his roles in the films Different from the Others (1919), The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari (1920), and The Man Who Laughs (1928). After a successful career in German silent films, where he was one of the best-paid stars of UFA, Veidt and his new Jewish wife Ilona Prager left Germany in 1933 after the Nazis came to power. The couple settled in Britain, where he became a British subject in 1939. Veidt subsequently appeared in many British films, including The Thief of Bagdad (1940). After emigrating to the United States around 1941, he was cast as Major Strasser in Casablanca (1942), his last film role to be released during his lifetime.
extract_id: Hans Walter Conrad Veidt adalah aktor karakter asal Jerman dan Inggris. Ia menarik perhatian awal untuk perannya dalam film Different from the Others (1919), The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari (1920), dan The Man Who Laughs (1928). Setelah karier sukses di film bisu Jerman, di mana ia adalah salah satu bintang berbayar tertinggi di UFA, Veidt dan istrinya yang baru, Ilona Prager yang beragama Yahudi, meninggalkan Jerman pada 1933 setelah Nazi berkuasa. Pasangan itu menetap di Inggris, di mana ia menjadi subjek Inggris pada tahun 1939. Veidt kemudian tampil dalam banyak film Inggris, termasuk The Thief of Bagdad (1940). Setelah pindah ke Amerika Serikat sekitar 1941, ia berperan sebagai Mayor Strasser dalam Casablanca (1942), peran film terakhirnya yang dirilis selama masa hidupnya.

name: Corey Feldman
title: Corey Feldman
extract: Corey Scott Feldman is an American actor. As a youth, he became well known for his roles in popular 1980s films such as Friday the 13th: The Final Chapter (1984), Gremlins (1984), The Goonies (1985) and Stand by Me (1986). Feldman collaborated with Corey Haim starring in numerous films such as the comedy horror The Lost Boys (1987), the teen comedy License to Drive (1988) and the romantic comedy Dream a Little Dream (1989). They reunited for the A&E reality series The Two Coreys, which ran from 2007 to 2008.
extract_id: Corey Scott Feldman adalah aktor Amerika. Saat masih muda, ia dikenal luas melalui perannya dalam film-film populer 1980-an seperti Friday the 13th: The Final Chapter (1984), Gremlins (1984), The Goonies (1985), dan Stand by Me (1986). Feldman bekerja sama dengan Corey Haim membintangi banyak film seperti komedi horor The Lost Boys (1987), komedi remaja License to Drive (1988), dan komedi romantis Dream a Little Dream (1989). Mereka bersatu kembali dalam serial realitas A&E The Two Coreys, yang tayang dari 2007 hingga 2008.

name: Corey Hawkins
title: Corey Hawkins
extract: Corey Antonio Hawkins is an American actor. He rose to prominence for his role in the TV series The Walking Dead (2015–2016), as well as his portrayal of Dr. Dre in the 2015 film Straight Outta Compton, the latter of which earned him a Screen Actors Guild Award nomination. He is also known for his performances on Broadway starring in Six Degrees of Separation (2017) and Topdog/Underdog (2022), both of which earned him nominations for the Tony Award for Best Actor in a Play.
extract_id: Corey Antonio Hawkins adalah aktor Amerika. Ia naik daun lewat perannya dalam serial TV The Walking Dead (2015–2016), serta perannya sebagai Dr. Dre dalam film Straight Outta Compton (2015), yang memberinya nominasi Screen Actors Guild Award. Ia juga dikenal karena penampilannya di Broadway dengan membintangi Six Degrees of Separation (2017) dan Topdog/Underdog (2022), keduanya memberinya nominasi Tony Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Drama.

name: Craig Bierko
title: Craig Bierko
extract: Craig Philip Bierko is an American actor.
extract_id: Craig Philip Bierko adalah aktor Amerika.

name: Craig Ferguson
title: Craig Ferguson
extract: Craig Ferguson is a Scottish and American actor, comedian, writer and television host. He hosted the CBS late-night talk show The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson (2005–2014), for which he won a Peabody Award for his interview with South African archbishop Desmond Tutu in 2009. He is currently the host of Scrabble (2026–present) on The CW Network.
extract_id: Craig Ferguson adalah aktor, komedian, penulis, dan pembawa acara televisi Skotlandia dan Amerika. Ia menjadi pembawa acara talk show malam The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson (2005–2014) di CBS, yang memberinya Peabody Award atas wawancaranya dengan uskup agung Afrika Selatan Desmond Tutu pada 2009. Saat ini ia menjadi pembawa acara Scrabble (2026–sekarang) di jaringan The CW.

name: Craig Parkinson
title: Craig Parkinson
extract: Craig Parkinson is an English actor and podcaster. He has played Shaun in the E4 series Misfits, twins Jimmy and Johnny Kray in the ITV series Whitechapel, and DI Matthew "Dot" Cottan in Line of Duty. He has also acted in several independent films, including Control, Soulboy, The Unloved and Four Lions.
extract_id: Craig Parkinson adalah aktor dan podcaster Inggris. Ia memerankan Shaun dalam seri E4 Misfits, kembar Jimmy dan Johnny Kray dalam seri ITV Whitechapel, serta DI Matthew "Dot" Cottan dalam Line of Duty. Ia juga berperan dalam beberapa film independen, termasuk Control, Soulboy, The Unloved, dan Four Lions.

name: Craig T. Nelson
title: Craig T. Nelson
extract: Craig Theodore Nelson is an American actor. He is known for his roles as Hayden Fox in the ABC sitcom Coach, Deputy Warden Ward Wilson in Stir Crazy (1980), Steve Freeling in Poltergeist (1982), Burt Nickerson in All the Right Moves (1983), Peter Dellaplane in Action Jackson (1988), Chief Howard Hyde in Turner & Hooch (1989), Alex Cullen in The Devil's Advocate (1997), Chief Jack Mannion in the CBS drama The District (2000–2004), Coach Goddard in Blades of Glory (2007), The Warden in the NBC sitcom My Name Is Earl (2007), and the voice of Mr. Incredible in the 2004 film The Incredibles and its 2018 sequel.
extract_id: Craig Theodore Nelson adalah aktor Amerika. Ia dikenal melalui perannya sebagai Hayden Fox dalam sitkom ABC Coach, Wakil Warden Ward Wilson dalam Stir Crazy (1980), Steve Freeling dalam Poltergeist (1982), Burt Nickerson dalam All the Right Moves (1983), Peter Dellaplane dalam Action Jackson (1988), Kepala Howard Hyde dalam Turner & Hooch (1989), Alex Cullen dalam The Devil's Advocate (1997), Kepala Jack Mannion dalam drama CBS The District (2000–2004), Coach Goddard dalam Blades of Glory (2007), Warden dalam sitkom NBC My Name Is Earl (2007), serta pengisi suara Mr. Incredible dalam film The Incredibles (2004) dan sekuelnya pada 2018.

name: Crispin Glover
title: Crispin Glover
extract: Crispin Hellion Glover is an American actor, filmmaker, author, and artist. He is known for portraying eccentric character roles on screen. His breakout role was as George McFly in Back to the Future (1985), which he followed by playing one of the leading roles in River's Edge (1986). Through the 1990s, Glover garnered attention for portraying smaller roles in films such as Wild at Heart (1990), The Doors (1991), What's Eating Gilbert Grape (1993), and Dead Man (1995).
extract_id: Crispin Hellion Glover adalah aktor, pembuat film, penulis, dan seniman Amerika. Ia dikenal karena memerankan karakter eksentrik di layar. Peran terobosannya adalah sebagai George McFly dalam Back to the Future (1985), yang kemudian diikuti dengan salah satu peran utama dalam River's Edge (1986). Sepanjang 1990-an, Glover menarik perhatian melalui peran-peran kecilnya dalam film seperti Wild at Heart (1990), The Doors (1991), What's Eating Gilbert Grape (1993), dan Dead Man (1995).

name: Cristian Mungiu
title: Cristian Mungiu
extract: Cristian Mungiu is a Romanian filmmaker. A figure in the Romanian New Wave, his films usually explore Romania's contemporary society and politics. Mungiu is best known for his Palme d'Or–winning films 4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days (2007) and Fjord (2026). For Beyond the Hills (2012) and Graduation (2016), he won Best Screenplay and Best Director prizes at the 65th and 69th Cannes Film Festivals, respectively.
extract_id: Cristian Mungiu adalah pembuat film Rumania. Sebagai sosok dalam gerakan New Wave Rumania, film-filmnya biasanya mengeksplorasi masyarakat dan politik kontemporer Rumania. Mungiu paling dikenal melalui film-film pemenang Palme d'Or, 4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days (2007) dan Fjord (2026). Untuk Beyond the Hills (2012) dan Graduation (2016), ia memenangkan penghargaan Skenario Terbaik dan Sutradara Terbaik pada Festival Film Cannes ke-65 dan ke-69, secara berurutan.

name: Cuba Gooding Jr.
title: Cuba Gooding Jr.
extract: Cuba Mark Gooding Jr. is an American actor. After his breakthrough role as Tre Styles in Boyz n the Hood (1991), he won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor playing a football star in Jerry Maguire (1996). His other notable films include A Few Good Men (1992), Judgment Night (1993), Lightning Jack (1994), As Good as It Gets (1997), Men of Honor (2000), Pearl Harbor (2001), Snow Dogs (2002), Radio (2003), Norbit (2007), Linewatch (2008), and he played Dr. Ben Carson in the film Gifted Hands (2009). He played in Red Tails (2012), and The Butler (2013). He has done voice acting in Home on the Range (2004) and The Land Before Time XIII: The Wisdom of Friends (2007).
extract_id: Cuba Mark Gooding Jr. adalah aktor Amerika. Setelah peran terobosannya sebagai Tre Styles dalam Boyz n the Hood (1991), ia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik sebagai pemain bola dalam Jerry Maguire (1996). Film-film terkenalnya lainnya termasuk A Few Good Men (1992), Judgment Night (1993), Lightning Jack (1994), As Good as It Gets (1997), Men of Honor (2000), Pearl Harbor (2001), Snow Dogs (2002), Radio (2003), Norbit (2007), Linewatch (2008), dan ia memerankan Dr. Ben Carson dalam film Gifted Hands (2009). Ia juga berperan dalam Red Tails (2012) dan The Butler (2013). Ia melakukan pengisi suara dalam Home on the Range (2004) dan The Land Before Time XIII: The Wisdom of Friends (2007).

name: Curt Bois
title: Curt Bois
extract: Curt Bois was a German actor with a career spanning over 80 years. He is best remembered for his performances as the pickpocket in Casablanca (1942) and the poet Homer in Wings of Desire (1987).
extract_id: Curt Bois adalah aktor Jerman dengan karier yang berlangsung lebih dari 80 tahun. Ia paling dikenang untuk penampilannya sebagai pencopet dalam Casablanca (1942) dan penyair Homer dalam Wings of Desire (1987).

name: Curtis Hanson
title: Curtis Hanson
extract: Curtis Lee Hanson was an American film director, screenwriter, and producer. Born in Reno, Nevada, Hanson grew up in Los Angeles. After dropping out of high school, Hanson worked as photographer and editor for Cinema magazine. In the 1970s, Hanson participated as a writer for the horror film The Dunwich Horror (1970) and made his directorial debut the B-Movie Sweet Kill (1973), where he lacked creative control to fulfill his vision. While Hanson continued directing, he rose to prominence screenwriting critically acclaimed films such as The Silent Partner (1978), White Dog (1982), and Never Cry Wolf (1983).
extract_id: Curtis Lee Hanson adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser Amerika. Lahir di Reno, Nevada, Hanson tumbuh di Los Angeles. Setelah keluar dari sekolah menengah, Hanson bekerja sebagai fotografer dan editor untuk majalah Cinema. Pada 1970-an, Hanson berpartisipasi sebagai penulis untuk film horor The Dunwich Horror (1970) dan membuat debut sutradaranya dengan film B Sweet Kill (1973), di mana ia kehilangan kendali kreatif atas visi dirinya. Meskipun terus menyutradarai, ia meraih ketenaran lewat penulisan skenario film-film yang mendapat pujian kritis seperti The Silent Partner (1978), White Dog (1982), dan Never Cry Wolf (1983).

name: Cy Endfield
title: Cy Endfield
extract: Cyril Raker Endfield was an American film director, who at times also worked as a writer, theatre director, and inventor. Born in Scranton, Pennsylvania, he worked in the New York theatre in the late 1930s before moving to Hollywood in 1940.
extract_id: Cyril Raker Endfield adalah sutradara film Amerika, yang kadang juga bekerja sebagai penulis, sutradara teater, dan penemu. Lahir di Scranton, Pennsylvania, ia bekerja di teater New York pada akhir 1930-an sebelum pindah ke Hollywood pada 1940.

name: Cybill Shepherd
title: Cybill Shepherd
extract: Cybill Lynne Shepherd is an American actress, singer, and former model. Her film debut and breakthrough role came as Jacy Farrow in Peter Bogdanovich's coming-of-age drama The Last Picture Show (1971). Her collaborations with Bogdanovich continued with lead roles in the period piece Daisy Miller (1974), the musical At Long Last Love (1975), and the The Last Picture Show sequel Texasville (1990). She also had roles as Kelly in Elaine May's The Heartbreak Kid (1972), Betsy in Martin Scorsese's Taxi Driver (1976), Corinne Jeffries in the romantic fantasy comedy Chances Are (1989), and Nancy in Woody Allen's Alice (1990).
extract_id: Cybill Lynne Shepherd adalah seorang aktris, penyanyi, dan mantan model asal Amerika. Debut filmnya dan peran terobosannya adalah sebagai Jacy Farrow dalam drama coming-of-age karya Peter Bogdanovich, The Last Picture Show (1971). Kolaborasinya dengan Bogdanovich berlanjut dengan peran utama dalam film periode Daisy Miller (1974), musikal At Long Last Love (1975), dan sekuel The Last Picture Show, Texasville (1990). Ia juga berperan sebagai Kelly dalam The Heartbreak Kid (1972) karya Elaine May, Betsy di Taxi Driver (1976) karya Martin Scorsese, Corinne Jeffries dalam komedi fantasi romantis Chances Are (1989), dan Nancy dalam Alice (1990) karya Woody Allen.

name: Cyril Cusack
title: Cyril Cusack
extract: Cyril James Cusack was an Irish stage and screen actor with a career that spanned more than 70 years. During his lifetime, he was considered one of Ireland's finest thespians, and was renowned for his interpretations of both classical and contemporary theatre, including Shakespearean roles as a member of the Royal Shakespeare Company, and over 60 productions for the Abbey Theatre, of which he was a lifelong member. In 2020, Cusack was ranked at number 14 on The Irish Times' list of Ireland's greatest film actors.
extract_id: Cyril James Cusack adalah aktor panggung dan layar Irlandia dengan karier yang berlangsung lebih dari 70 tahun. Sepanjang hidupnya, ia dianggap sebagai salah satu thespians terbaik Irlandia, dan terkenal atas interpretasinya terhadap teater klasik maupun kontemporer, termasuk peran Shakespeare sebagai anggota Royal Shakespeare Company, serta lebih dari 60 produksi untuk Abbey Theatre, di mana ia menjadi anggota seumur hidup. Pada 2020, Cusack menempati peringkat ke-14 dalam daftar aktor film terbesar Irlandia versi The Irish Times.

name: Céline Sciamma
title: Céline Sciamma
extract: Céline Sciamma is a French filmmaker. A common theme in her films is the study of the French society through fluidity of gender, sexual identity among girls and women, and the female gaze.
extract_id: Céline Sciamma adalah pembuat film asal Prancis. Tema umum dalam film-filmnya adalah studi tentang masyarakat Prancis melalui fluiditas gender, identitas seksual di antara gadis dan wanita, serta pandangan perempuan.

name: Dafne Keen
title: Dafne Keen
extract: Dafne María Keen Fernández is a Spanish and British actress. She became known for playing Laura / X-23 in the films Logan (2017) and Deadpool & Wolverine (2024), earning nominations at the Critics' Choice Awards, the Saturn Awards, and nods from numerous critics associations. She also played Lyra Belacqua in the television series His Dark Materials (2019–2022), receiving a nomination for a British Academy Cymru Award.
extract_id: Dafne María Keen Fernández adalah aktris Spanyol dan Inggris. Ia dikenal karena memerankan Laura / X-23 dalam film Logan (2017) dan Deadpool & Wolverine (2024), mendapatkan nominasi di Critics' Choice Awards, Saturn Awards, dan dari berbagai asosiasi kritikus. name: Dan Gilroy
title: Dan Gilroy
extract: Daniel Christopher Gilroy is an American screenwriter and film director. He is best known for writing and directing Nightcrawler (2014), for which he won Best Screenplay at the 30th Independent Spirit Awards, and was nominated for Best Original Screenplay at the 87th Academy Awards. His other screenwriting credits include Freejack (1992), Two for the Money (2005), The Fall (2006), Real Steel (2011), and The Bourne Legacy (2012)—the last in collaboration with his brother Tony Gilroy. His wife, Rene Russo, has also been his frequent collaborator since the two met in 1992 and married later that year. He wrote six episodes over two seasons of the drama series Andor (2022–2025), and for his work on the second season he won the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Writing For A Drama Series.
extract_id: Daniel Christopher Gilroy adalah penulis skenario dan sutradara film asal Amerika. Ia dikenal terbaik sebagai penulis dan sutradara Nightcrawler (2014), yang membuatnya memenangkan Best Screenplay pada Independent Spirit Awards ke-30, dan mendapatkan nominasi Best Original Screenplay di Academy Awards ke-87. Kredit penulisan skenarionya lainnya meliputi Freejack (1992), Two for the Money (2005), The Fall (2006), Real Steel (2011), dan The Bourne Legacy (2012)—yang terakhir bersama saudaranya Tony Gilroy. Istrinya, Rene Russo, juga sering berkolaborasi dengannya sejak mereka bertemu pada 1992 dan menikah tahun itu juga. Ia menulis enam episode dalam dua musim serial drama Andor (2022–2025), dan untuk musim kedua karyanya memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award untuk Outstanding Writing For A Drama Series.

name: Dana Andrews
title: Dana Andrews
extract: Carver Dana Andrews was an American film actor who became a major star in what is now known as film noir and later in Western films. A leading man during the 1940s, he continued acting in less prestigious roles and character parts into the 1980s. He is best known for his portrayal of obsessed police detective Mark McPherson in the noir mystery Laura (1944) and his critically acclaimed performance as World War II veteran Fred Derry returning home in The Best Years of Our Lives (1946).
extract_id: Carver Dana Andrews adalah aktor film Amerika yang menjadi bintang besar dalam film noir yang kini dikenal dan berikutnya dalam film Barat. Sebagai pemeran utama pada 1940-an, ia terus berakting dalam peran kurang prestisius dan karakter hingga 1980-an. Ia dikenal karena perannya sebagai detektif polisi terobsesi Mark McPherson dalam misteri noir Laura (1944) dan penampilan yang mendapat pujian kritis sebagai veteran Perang Dunia II Fred Derry yang kembali pulang dalam The Best Years of Our Lives (1946).

name: Dana Wynter
title: Dana Wynter
extract: Dana Wynter was a German-born British actress who was raised in the United Kingdom and southern Africa. She appeared in film and television for more than 40 years, beginning in the 1950s. One of her best-known film performances was in Invasion of the Body Snatchers (1956). A tall, dark, elegant beauty, she played both victim and villain. Her characters both in film and on television sometimes faced horrific dangers, which they often did not survive, but she also played scheming, manipulative women on television mysteries and crime procedural dramas.
extract_id: Dana Wynter adalah aktris Inggris kelahiran Jerman yang dibesarkan di Inggris dan Afrika Selatan. Ia tampil di film dan televisi selama lebih dari 40 tahun, mulai tahun 1950-an. Salah satu penampilan filmnya yang paling dikenal adalah dalam Invasion of the Body Snatchers (1956). Sebagai seorang wanita tinggi, gelap, dan elegan, ia memainkan peran korban maupun penjahat. Karakter-karakternya baik di film maupun televisi sering menghadapi bahaya mengerikan, yang seringkali tidak mereka selamatkan, tetapi ia juga bermain sebagai wanita licik dan manipulatif dalam misteri televisi dan drama prosedural kejahatan.

name: Danai Gurira
title: Danai Gurira

Film-filmnya telah menghasilkan pendapatan sebesar $6,98 miliar, menjadikannya sebagai aktris dengan pendapatan tertinggi ketujuh sepanjang masa.

name: Daniel Brühl
title: Daniel Brühl
extract: Daniel César Martín Brühl González is a German and Spanish actor. He has received various accolades, including three European Film Awards and three German Film Awards, along with nominations for two Golden Globe Awards and a BAFTA Award. He received his first German Film Award for Best Actor for his roles in Das Weisse Rauschen (2001), Nichts Bereuen (2001), and Vaya con Dios (2002). His starring role in the German film Good Bye, Lenin! (2003) received widespread recognition and critical acclaim, and garnered him the European Film Award for Best Actor and another German Film Award for Best Actor.
extract_id: Daniel César Martín Brühl González adalah aktor Jerman dan Spanyol. Ia menerima German Film Award pertamanya untuk Aktor Terbaik atas peran-perannya dalam Das Weisse Rauschen (2001), Nichts Bereuen (2001), dan Vaya con Dios (2002). Peran utamanya dalam film Jerman Good Bye, Lenin! (2003) mendapatkan pengakuan luas dan pujian kritis, serta memberinya European Film Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dan German Film Award lain untuk Aktor Terbaik.

name: Daniel Day-Lewis
title: Daniel Day-Lewis
extract: Sir Daniel Michael Blake Day-Lewis is an English actor. Widely considered one of the greatest actors in the history of cinema, he is best known for intense method acting portrayed with eccentric characters in auteurs' films. He is the recipient of numerous accolades, including a record three Academy Awards for Best Actor, as well as four BAFTAs, three Actor Awards and two Golden Globe Awards. In 2014, Day-Lewis received a knighthood for services to drama.
extract_id: Sir Daniel Michael Blake Day-Lewis adalah aktor Inggris. Ia secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar dalam sejarah sinema, terkenal karena akting metode intens yang diperankan dengan karakter eksentrik dalam film-film auteur. Ia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk rekor tiga Academy Awards untuk Aktor Terbaik, serta empat BAFTA, tiga Actor Awards, dan dua Golden Globe Awards. Pada 2014, Day-Lewis menerima gelar kesatria atas jasanya dalam drama.

Dalam karier yang berlangsung selama lima dekade, ia telah berakting dalam lebih dari 190 film sejak 1971. Pada 2003, Denzongpa dianugerahi Padma Shri, penghargaan sipil keempat tertinggi di India.

name: Danny Elfman
title: Danny Elfman

name: Danny Lloyd
title: Danny Lloyd
extract: Daniel Edward Sidney Lloyd is an American former child actor best known for his role as Danny Torrance in Stanley Kubrick's The Shining. After appearing in Will: G. Gordon Liddy, Lloyd retired from acting. He became a professor at the Elizabethtown Community and Technical College in 2004.

name: Dara Singh
title: Dara Singh
extract: Dara Singh was an Indian professional wrestler, actor, and politician. In 1968, Singh became world champion by defeating Lou Thesz.
extract_id: Dara Singh adalah pegulat profesional, aktor, dan politisi India. Dianggap luas sebagai salah satu pegulat terbesar India, Singh memperoleh pengakuan internasional selama 1950-an dan 1960-an atas kemenangannya di sirkuit gulat India dan dunia. Pada 1968, Singh menjadi juara dunia setelah mengalahkan Lou Thesz.

name: Darius Marder
title: Darius Marder
extract: Darius Marder is an American film director, screenwriter, and editor from Massachusetts. He is known for directing and co-writing Sound of Metal, for which he was nominated for Best Original Screenplay at the 93rd Academy Awards. The film received a total of six nominations at the Academy Awards, including Best Picture, winning Best Editing and Best Sound. Marder also edited the Academy Award-winning documentary Freeheld (2007).
extract_id: Darius Marder adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan editor Amerika dari Massachusetts. Ia dikenal karena menyutradarai dan menulis bersama Sound of Metal, yang membawanya mendapat nominasi Best Original Screenplay di Academy Awards ke-93. Film ini menerima total enam nominasi Academy Awards, termasuk Best Picture, memenangkan Best Editing dan Best Sound. Marder juga mengedit dokumenter pemenang Academy Award, Freeheld (2007).

name: Darren Aronofsky
title: Darren Aronofsky
extract: Darren Aronofsky is an American filmmaker. His films are noted for their surreal, dramatic, and often disturbing elements, frequently in the form of psychological realism. His accolades include a Golden Lion and a Primetime Emmy Award as well as nominations for an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award and the British Academy Film Award. Aronofsky studied film and social anthropology at Harvard University before studying directing at the AFI Conservatory. He won several film awards after completing his senior thesis film, Supermarket Sweep, which became a National Student Academy Award finalist. In 1997, he founded the film and TV production company Protozoa Pictures. His feature film debut, the surrealist psychological thriller Pi (1998), earned him the award for Best Director at the Sundance Film Festival and an Independent Spirit Award for Best First Screenplay.
extract_id: Darren Aronofsky adalah pembuat film Amerika. Film-filmnya dikenal karena elemen surreal, dramatis, dan sering mengganggu, sering dalam bentuk realisme psikologis. Penghargaan yang diraih termasuk Golden Lion dan Primetime Emmy Award serta nominasi Academy Award, Golden Globe Award dan British Academy Film Award. Aronofsky belajar film dan antropologi sosial di Harvard University sebelum belajar menyutradarai di AFI Conservatory. Ia memenangkan beberapa penghargaan film setelah menyelesaikan film tesis tingkat akhir Supermarket Sweep, yang menjadi finalis National Student Academy Award. Pada 1997, ia mendirikan perusahaan produksi film dan TV Protozoa Pictures. Debut film fitur-nya, thriller psikologis surealis Pi (1998), memberinya penghargaan Sutradara Terbaik di Sundance Film Festival dan Independent Spirit Award untuk Skenario Pertama Terbaik.

name: Darren McGavin
title: Darren McGavin
extract: Darren McGavin was an American actor.
extract_id: Darren McGavin adalah aktor Amerika.

name: Darryl F. Zanuck
title: Darryl F. Zanuck
extract: Darryl Francis Zanuck was an American film producer and studio executive; he earlier contributed stories for films starting in the silent era. Best known as a co-founder of 20th Century Fox, he played a major part in the Hollywood studio system as one of its longest survivors. Zanuck produced three films that won the Academy Award for Best Picture and won the Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award three times, the only person to receive more than one.
extract_id: Darryl Francis Zanuck adalah produser film dan eksekutif studio Amerika; ia sebelumnya menulis cerita untuk film sejak era bisu. Terkenal sebagai salah satu pendiri 20th Century Fox, ia memainkan peran besar dalam sistem studio Hollywood sebagai salah satu yang bertahan paling lama. Zanuck memproduksi tiga film yang memenangkan Academy Award untuk Best Picture dan memenangkan Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award tiga kali, satu-satunya orang yang menerima lebih dari satu penghargaan tersebut.

name: Darsheel Safary
title: Darsheel Safary
extract: Darsheel Safary is an Indian actor who appears in Hindi, Gujarati films and television. Safary made his film debut with the leading role of a dyslexic student in Aamir Khan's directorial debut, the critically acclaimed drama Taare Zameen Par (2007), for which he won the Filmfare critic's Award for Best Actor.
extract_id: Darsheel Safary adalah aktor India yang tampil dalam film dan televisi berbahasa Hindi dan Gujarati. Safary memulai debut filmnya dengan peran utama sebagai siswa disleksia dalam debut penyutradaraan Aamir Khan, drama yang mendapat pujian kritis Taare Zameen Par (2007), di mana ia memenangkan Filmfare critic's Award untuk Aktor Terbaik.

name: Daryl Hannah
title: Daryl Hannah
extract: Daryl Hannah is an American actress, director, and environmental activist. She has acted in comedic and dramatic roles in more than a hundred film and television productions since the 1970s.
extract_id: Daryl Hannah adalah aktris, sutradara, dan aktivis lingkungan Amerika. Ia telah berakting dalam peran komedi dan drama dalam lebih dari seratus produksi film dan televisi sejak tahun 1970-an.

name: Darío Grandinetti
title: Darío Grandinetti
extract: Darío Alejandro Grandinetti is an Argentine actor. He is known for his numerous roles in television, theater and film, where he participated in films by renowned directors such as Alejandro Doria, Pedro Almodóvar and Damián Szifron.
extract_id: Darío Alejandro Grandinetti adalah aktor Argentina. Ia dikenal karena banyak perannya di televisi, teater, dan film, di mana ia pernah berpartisipasi dalam film dari sutradara ternama seperti Alejandro Doria, Pedro Almodóvar, dan Damián Szifron.

name: Dave Bautista
title: Dave Bautista
extract: David Michael Bautista Jr. is an American actor and retired professional wrestler. Regarded as one of the most popular professional wrestlers of the Ruthless Aggression Era, he rose to fame for his multiple stints in WWE between 2002 and 2019.
extract_id: David Michael Bautista Jr. adalah aktor Amerika dan pegulat profesional yang sudah pensiun. Dianggap sebagai salah satu pegulat profesional paling populer dari Era Ruthless Aggression, ia terkenal melalui beberapa kali beraksi di WWE antara 2002 dan 2019.

name: Dave Johns
title: Dave Johns
extract: David Alan Johns is an English stand-up comedian, actor, and writer. He is best known for his breakthrough role as Daniel Blake in the 2016 Ken Loach film I, Daniel Blake.
extract_id: David Alan Johns adalah seorang komedian stand-up, aktor, dan penulis asal Inggris. Ia paling dikenal melalui peran terobosannya sebagai Daniel Blake dalam film Ken Loach tahun 2016, I, Daniel Blake.

name: Daveigh Chase
title: Daveigh Chase
extract: Daveigh Elizabeth Chase was an American actress. She began her acting career as a child, portraying Samantha Darko in the psychological thriller film Donnie Darko (2001) and Samara Morgan in the American remake of the horror film The Ring (2002). She also provided the United States American English dub voice of Chihiro Ogino in the Studio Ghibli film Spirited Away (2001), Lilo Pelekai in the Disney animated film Lilo & Stitch (2002) and its related media franchise, and Betsy in Betsy's Kindergarten Adventures (2008). She later took on adult roles, including in the HBO drama series Big Love (2006–2011) and independent films such as Yellow (2012) and Jack Goes Home (2016). Chase received three awards from six nominations, including an Annie Award for Outstanding Achievement for Voice Acting and an MTV Movie Award for Best Villain. Chase retired from acting in 2016 and died at the age of 35 from complications associated with AIDS on June 16, 2026.
extract_id: Daveigh Elizabeth Chase adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia memulai karier aktingnya sebagai anak-anak, memerankan Samantha Darko dalam film thriller psikologis Donnie Darko (2001) dan Samara Morgan dalam remake Amerika dari film horor The Ring (2002). Dia juga mengisi suara versi dub bahasa Inggris Amerika Serikat dari Chihiro Ogino dalam film Studio Ghibli Spirited Away (2001), Lilo Pelekai dalam film animasi Disney Lilo & Stitch (2002) dan waralaba media terkaitnya, serta Betsy dalam Betsy's Kindergarten Adventures (2008). Dia kemudian mengambil peran dewasa, termasuk dalam serial drama HBO Big Love (2006–2011) dan film independen seperti Yellow (2012) dan Jack Goes Home (2016). Chase menerima tiga penghargaan dari enam nominasi, termasuk Annie Award untuk Prestasi Luar Biasa dalam Pengisi Suara dan MTV Movie Award untuk Penjahat Terbaik. Chase pensiun dari dunia akting pada 2016 dan meninggal pada usia 35 tahun akibat komplikasi terkait AIDS pada 16 Juni 2026.

name: David Ayer
title: David Ayer
extract: David Ayer is an American filmmaker. Born in Champaign, Illinois, Ayer grew up in Los Angeles, California, where his experiences in South Central Los Angeles became the inspiration for many of his screenplays.
extract_id: David Ayer adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika. Lahir di Champaign, Illinois, Ayer tumbuh di Los Angeles, California, di mana pengalamannya di South Central Los Angeles menjadi inspirasi bagi banyak naskah filmnya.

name: David Carradine
title: David Carradine
extract: John Arthur "David" Carradine Jr. was an American actor and director, whose career included over 200 major and minor roles in film, television and on stage. He was widely known to television audiences as the star of the series Kung Fu (1972–1975), playing Kwai Chang Caine, a peace-loving Shaolin monk traveling through the American Old West.
extract_id: John Arthur "David" Carradine Jr. adalah seorang aktor dan sutradara Amerika, yang kariernya mencakup lebih dari 200 peran utama dan minor di film, televisi, dan panggung. Dia dikenal luas oleh penonton televisi sebagai bintang seri Kung Fu (1972–1975), memerankan Kwai Chang Caine, seorang biksu Shaolin yang mencintai kedamaian yang melakukan perjalanan melalui Amerika Barat Lama.

name: David Cronenberg
title: David Cronenberg
extract: David Paul Cronenberg is a Canadian film director, screenwriter, producer and actor. He is a principal originator of the body horror genre, with his films exploring visceral bodily transformation, infectious diseases, and the intertwining of the psychological, physical, and technological. Cronenberg is best known for exploring these themes through sci-fi horror films such as Shivers (1975), Scanners (1981), Videodrome (1983) and The Fly (1986), though he has also directed dramas, psychological thrillers and gangster films.
extract_id: David Paul Cronenberg adalah seorang sutradara film, penulis skenario, produser, dan aktor Kanada. Dia merupakan pencipta utama genre horor tubuh, dengan film-filmnya mengeksplorasi transformasi tubuh yang visceral, penyakit menular, serta keterkaitan antara aspek psikologis, fisik, dan teknologi. Cronenberg paling dikenal karena mengeksplorasi tema ini melalui film horor sci-fi seperti Shivers (1975), Scanners (1981), Videodrome (1983), dan The Fly (1986), meskipun dia juga telah menyutradarai drama, thriller psikologis, dan film gangster.

name: David Emge
title: David Emge
extract: David Michael Emge was an American actor. He was best known for playing Stephen "Flyboy" Andrews in George A. Romero's horror film Dawn of the Dead (1978).
extract_id: David Michael Emge adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan Stephen "Flyboy" Andrews dalam film horor George A. Romero Dawn of the Dead (1978).

name: David Fincher
title: David Fincher
extract: David Andrew Leo Fincher is an American filmmaker. Often described as one of the pre-eminent directors of his generation, his films have collectively grossed over $2.1 billion worldwide. Fincher has received numerous accolades, including nominations for three Academy Awards as well as a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, four Primetime Emmy Awards, and two Grammy Awards.
extract_id: David Andrew Leo Fincher adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika. Sering digambarkan sebagai salah satu sutradara terunggul di generasinya, film-filmnya secara kolektif menghasilkan pendapatan lebih dari $2,1 miliar di seluruh dunia. Fincher telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk nominasi untuk tiga Academy Awards serta BAFTA Award, Golden Globe Award, empat Primetime Emmy Awards, dan dua Grammy Awards.

name: David Hand
title: David Hand (animator)
extract: David Dodd Hand was an American animator and film director known for his work at Walt Disney Productions. He worked on numerous Disney shorts during the 1930s and eventually became supervising director on the animated features Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs and Bambi.
extract_id: David Dodd Hand adalah seorang animator dan sutradara film Amerika yang dikenal atas karyanya di Walt Disney Productions. Dia bekerja dalam banyak kartun pendek Disney selama tahun 1930-an dan akhirnya menjadi sutradara pengawas untuk film animasi Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs dan Bambi.

name: David Hemmings
title: David Hemmings
extract: David Leslie Edward Hemmings was an English actor, director, and producer of film and television. Originally trained as a boy soprano in operatic roles, he began appearing in films as a child actor in the 1950s. He became an icon of Swinging London for his portrayal of a trendy fashion photographer in the critically acclaimed film Blowup (1966), directed by Michelangelo Antonioni.
extract_id: David Leslie Edward Hemmings adalah seorang aktor, sutradara, dan produser film dan televisi Inggris. Awalnya dilatih sebagai soprano anak laki-laki dalam peran opera, ia mulai muncul dalam film sebagai aktor cilik pada tahun 1950-an. Ia menjadi ikon Swinging London melalui perannya sebagai fotografer mode trendi dalam film yang sangat diapresiasi Blowup (1966), yang disutradarai oleh Michelangelo Antonioni.

name: David Herman
title: David Herman
extract: David Herman is an American actor and comedian. He was an original cast member on MADtv from 1995 to 1997 and played Michael Bolton in Office Space.
extract_id: David Herman adalah seorang aktor dan komedian Amerika. Dia adalah anggota asli pemeran MADtv dari 1995 hingga 1997 dan memerankan Michael Bolton dalam Office Space.

name: David James
title: David James (actor, born 1972)
extract: David James is a South African film, theatre and television actor known mainly for playing the villainous Koobus Venter in the Oscar-nominated science fiction film District 9 (2009). He is also known to South African audiences for his 2004–2006 appearance as "Mad Dog" on the long-running soap opera Isidingo, for his portrayal as Joel Joffe in the 2010 and 2011 stage productions of Rivonia Trial, and for his role as radio station manager Hermanus Meyer on the soap opera Rhythm City (2012–2013).
extract_id: David James adalah seorang aktor film, teater, dan televisi Afrika Selatan yang dikenal terutama karena memerankan antagonis Koobus Venter dalam film fiksi ilmiah yang dinominasikan Oscar, District 9 (2009). Dia juga dikenal oleh penonton Afrika Selatan melalui penampilannya sebagai "Mad Dog" dalam opera sabun Isidingo pada 2004–2006, perannya sebagai Joel Joffe dalam produksi teater Rivonia Trial tahun 2010 dan 2011, serta perannya sebagai manajer stasiun radio Hermanus Meyer dalam opera sabun Rhythm City (2012–2013).

name: David Lean
title: David Lean
extract: Sir David Lean was an English filmmaker and editor, widely considered one of the most important figures of British cinema. He directed the large-scale epics The Bridge on the River Kwai (1957), Lawrence of Arabia (1962), Doctor Zhivago (1965), Ryan's Daughter (1970), and A Passage to India (1984). He also directed the film adaptations of Charles Dickens novels Great Expectations (1946) and Oliver Twist (1948), as well as the romantic drama Brief Encounter (1945).
extract_id: Sir David Lean adalah seorang pembuat film dan penyunting Inggris yang dianggap sebagai salah satu tokoh paling penting dalam sinema Inggris. Dia menyutradarai epik besar The Bridge on the River Kwai (1957), Lawrence of Arabia (1962), Doctor Zhivago (1965), Ryan's Daughter (1970), dan A Passage to India (1984). Dia juga menyutradarai adaptasi film dari novel Charles Dickens Great Expectations (1946) dan Oliver Twist (1948), serta drama romantis Brief Encounter (1945).

name: David Lee Smith
title: David Lee Smith
extract: David Lee Smith is an American actor.
extract_id: David Lee Smith adalah seorang aktor Amerika.

name: David Leitch
title: David Leitch
extract: David Leitch is an American filmmaker, stunt performer, stunt coordinator, and actor. He made his directorial debut on the action film John Wick (2014) with Chad Stahelski, though only Stahelski was credited. He later also directed the films Atomic Blonde (2017), Deadpool 2 (2018), Hobbs & Shaw (2019), Bullet Train (2022), The Fall Guy (2024) and How to Rob a Bank (2026).
extract_id: David Leitch adalah seorang pembuat film, pemeran pengganti, koordinator aksi, dan aktor Amerika. Dia memulai debut penyutradaraannya pada film aksi John Wick (2014) bersama Chad Stahelski, meskipun hanya Stahelski yang mendapat kredit. Dia kemudian juga menyutradarai film Atomic Blonde (2017), Deadpool 2 (2018), Hobbs & Shaw (2019), Bullet Train (2022), The Fall Guy (2024) dan How to Rob a Bank (2026).

name: David Lynch
title: David Lynch
extract: David Keith Lynch was an American filmmaker and artist. He is widely regarded as one of the greatest and most influential filmmakers in the history of cinema, with his films often characterized by a distinctive surrealist sensibility that gave rise to the adjective "Lynchian". In a career spanning more than five decades, he received numerous accolades, including an Academy Honorary Award, a Palme d'Or and Best Director Award at the Cannes Film Festival, the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement at the Venice Film Festival, an Independent Spirit Award, a Saturn Award, two César Awards, and a (posthumous) Laurel Award for Screenwriting Achievement, in addition to nominations for four Academy Awards, two British Academy Film Awards, four Golden Globe Awards, and nine Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: David Keith Lynch adalah seorang pembuat film dan seniman Amerika. Dia dianggap secara luas sebagai salah satu pembuat film terbesar dan paling berpengaruh dalam sejarah sinema, dengan film-filmnya sering dicirikan oleh sensualitas surealis yang khas yang melahirkan istilah "Lynchian". Dalam karier yang membentang lebih dari lima dekade, dia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Academy Honorary Award, Palme d'Or dan Penghargaan Sutradara Terbaik di Festival Film Cannes, Golden Lion untuk Penghargaan Sepanjang Masa di Festival Film Venesia, Independent Spirit Award, Saturn Award, dua César Awards, dan penghargaan posthumous Laurel Award untuk Prestasi Penulisan Skenario, selain nominasi untuk empat Academy Awards, dua British Academy Film Awards, empat Golden Globe Awards, dan sembilan Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: David Mackenzie
title: David Mackenzie (director)
extract: David Hugh Mackenzie is a Scottish film director and co-founder of the Glasgow-based production company Sigma Films. He has made ten feature films including Young Adam (2003), Hallam Foe (2007), Perfect Sense (2011) and Starred Up (2013). In 2016, Mackenzie's film Hell or High Water premiered at Cannes and was theatrically released in the United States in August. The same year he executive produced Damnation, a TV pilot for Universal Content Productions and USA Network. Mackenzie also directed Outlaw King (2018), a historical film for Netflix. Mackenzie and his films have been described as not fitting neatly into any particular genre or type.
extract_id: David Hugh Mackenzie adalah seorang sutradara film Skotlandia dan salah satu pendiri perusahaan produksi Sigma Films yang berbasis di Glasgow. Dia telah membuat sepuluh film fitur termasuk Young Adam (2003), Hallam Foe (2007), Perfect Sense (2011), dan Starred Up (2013). Pada 2016, film Mackenzie, Hell or High Water, tayang perdana di Cannes dan dirilis di bioskop Amerika Serikat pada bulan Agustus. Pada tahun yang sama, dia menjadi produser eksekutif Damnation, sebuah pilot TV untuk Universal Content Productions dan USA Network. Mackenzie juga menyutradarai Outlaw King (2018), sebuah film sejarah untuk Netflix. Mackenzie dan film-filmnya telah dideskripsikan sebagai yang tidak mudah digolongkan ke dalam genre atau tipe tertentu.

name: David Mickey Evans
title: David Mickey Evans
extract: David Mickey Evans is an American film director and screenwriter. His films tend to focus on children and the challenges of childhood. A baseball fan, Evans directed and co-wrote The Sandlot (1993).
extract_id: David Mickey Evans adalah seorang sutradara film dan penulis skenario Amerika. Film-filmnya cenderung berfokus pada anak-anak dan tantangan masa kanak-kanak. Penggemar bisbol, Evans menyutradarai dan menulis bersama film The Sandlot (1993).

name: David Morse
title: David Morse
extract: David Bowditch Morse is an American actor. Morse became widely known for his role as Dr. Jack "Boomer" Morrison in the NBC medical drama series St. Elsewhere (1982–88), and he has had roles in The Negotiator, The Good Son, Horns, Contact, The Green Mile, Dancer in the Dark, Disturbia, The Hurt Locker, The Long Kiss Goodnight, The Rock and 12 Monkeys.
extract_id: David Bowditch Morse adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Morse menjadi terkenal luas karena perannya sebagai Dr. Jack "Boomer" Morrison dalam serial drama medis NBC St. Elsewhere (1982–88), dan dia juga berperan dalam The Negotiator, The Good Son, Horns, Contact, The Green Mile, Dancer in the Dark, Disturbia, The Hurt Locker, The Long Kiss Goodnight, The Rock, dan 12 Monkeys.

name: David O. Russell
title: David O. Russell
extract: David Owen Russell is an American film director, screenwriter and producer. He has earned numerous accolades including two British Academy Film Awards, and a Golden Globe Award as well as nominations for five Academy Awards.
extract_id: David Owen Russell adalah seorang sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser Amerika. Dia telah meraih banyak penghargaan termasuk dua British Academy Film Awards dan Golden Globe Award serta nominasi untuk lima Academy Awards.

name: David Rawle
title: David Rawle
extract: David Rawle is an Irish actor from Carrigallen, County Leitrim. He is best known for starring in the Irish sitcom Moone Boy, co-written by and co-starring Chris O'Dowd. His first audition for acting was for Santa Claus. In 2012, he was nominated at the British Comedy Awards for Best Comedy Breakthrough Artist.
extract_id: David Rawle adalah seorang aktor Irlandia dari Carrigallen, County Leitrim. Dia paling dikenal karena membintangi sitkom Irlandia Moone Boy, yang ditulis bersama dan dibintangi juga oleh Chris O'Dowd. Audisi pertamanya untuk akting adalah peran Santa Claus. Pada 2012, dia dinominasikan di British Comedy Awards untuk Best Comedy Breakthrough Artist.

name: David Silverman
title: David Silverman (animator)
extract: David Silverman is an American animator who has directed numerous episodes of the animated television series The Simpsons, as well as its 2007 film adaptation. Silverman was involved with the series from the very beginning, animating all of the original short Simpsons cartoons that aired on The Tracey Ullman Show. He went on to serve as director of animation for several years. He also did the animation for the 2016 film The Edge of Seventeen, which was produced by Gracie Films.
extract_id: David Silverman adalah seorang animator Amerika yang telah menyutradarai banyak episode dari serial televisi animasi The Simpsons, serta adaptasi filmnya tahun 2007. Silverman terlibat dengan seri ini sejak awal, menganimasi semua kartun pendek The Simpsons asli yang tayang di The Tracey Ullman Show. Dia kemudian menjabat sebagai sutradara animasi selama beberapa tahun. Dia juga mengerjakan animasi untuk film The Edge of Seventeen (2016), yang diproduksi oleh Gracie Films.

name: David Thewlis
title: David Thewlis
extract: David Wheeler, better known by his stage name David Thewlis, is an English actor and filmmaker. He has won one Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Actor and received nominations for two BAFTA Awards, one Golden Globe Award, one Primetime Emmy Award, and one Screen Actors Guild Award.
extract_id: David Wheeler, yang lebih dikenal dengan nama panggung David Thewlis, adalah seorang aktor dan pembuat film Inggris. Dia telah memenangkan satu Penghargaan Festival Film Cannes untuk Aktor Terbaik dan menerima nominasi untuk dua BAFTA Awards, satu Golden Globe Award, satu Primetime Emmy Award, dan satu Screen Actors Guild Award.

name: David Tomlinson
title: David Tomlinson
extract: David Cecil MacAlister Tomlinson was an English stage, film and television actor, singer and comedian. Having been described as both a leading actor and a character actor, he is primarily remembered for his roles with The Walt Disney Company as the patriarch father George Banks in Mary Poppins (1964), hapless antagonist Peter Thorndyke in The Love Bug (1968) and the friendly con man Professor Emelius Browne in Bedknobs and Broomsticks (1971). Tomlinson was posthumously inducted as a Disney Legend in 2002.
extract_id: David Cecil MacAlister Tomlinson adalah seorang aktor, penyanyi, dan komedian panggung, film, serta televisi asal Inggris. Setelah dikenal sebagai aktor utama dan aktor karakter, dia terutama dikenang atas perannya bersama The Walt Disney Company sebagai ayah yang patriarkis, George Banks, dalam Mary Poppins (1964), antagonis malang Peter Thorndyke dalam The Love Bug (1968), dan penipu ramah Professor Emelius Browne dalam Bedknobs and Broomsticks (1971). Tomlinson dianugerahi sebagai Disney Legend secara anumerta pada tahun 2002.

name: David Wenham
title: David Wenham
extract: David Wenham is an Australian actor who has appeared in film, television and theatre. He is known for his roles as Faramir in The Lord of the Rings film trilogy, Friar Carl in Van Helsing and Van Helsing: The London Assignment, Dilios in 300 and its sequel 300: Rise of an Empire, Al Parker in Top of the Lake, Lieutenant John Scarfield in Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales, and Hank Snow in Elvis. He is known in his native Australia for his role as Johnny Spitieri in Gettin' Square, Diver Dan in SeaChange and Price Galese in Les Norton.
extract_id: David Wenham adalah seorang aktor Australia yang telah tampil di film, televisi, dan teater. Dia dikenal atas perannya sebagai Faramir dalam trilogi film The Lord of the Rings, Friar Carl dalam Van Helsing dan Van Helsing: The London Assignment, Dilios dalam 300 dan sekuelnya 300: Rise of an Empire, Al Parker dalam Top of the Lake, Letnan John Scarfield dalam Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales, dan Hank Snow dalam Elvis. Dia dikenal di Australia sebagai Johnny Spitieri dalam Gettin' Square, Diver Dan dalam SeaChange, dan Price Galese dalam Les Norton.

name: David Yates
title: David Yates
extract: David Yates is an English filmmaker, who has directed feature films, short films, and television productions. He is best known for directing the final four films in the Harry Potter series and the three films of its prequel series, Fantastic Beasts. His work on the Harry Potter series brought him critical and commercial success along with accolades, such as the British Academy Britannia Award for Excellence in Directing.
extract_id: David Yates adalah seorang pembuat film Inggris, yang telah menyutradarai film fitur, film pendek, dan produksi televisi. Dia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai empat film terakhir dalam seri Harry Potter dan tiga film dari seri prekuel, Fantastic Beasts. Karyanya dalam seri Harry Potter memberinya kesuksesan kritis dan komersial serta penghargaan, seperti British Academy Britannia Award untuk Keunggulan dalam Penyutradaraan.

name: David Zucker
title: David Zucker
extract: David Samuel Zucker is an American filmmaker. Associated mostly with parody comedies, Zucker is recognized for collaborating with Jim Abrahams and his brother Jerry as part of Zucker, Abrahams and Zucker, with whom he wrote and directed the 1980 film Airplane! and created The Naked Gun franchise. As a solo filmmaker, Zucker has also directed Scary Movie 3 (2003) and Scary Movie 4 (2006).
extract_id: David Samuel Zucker adalah pembuat film Amerika. Terutama dikenal dengan komedi parodi, Zucker diakui karena berkolaborasi dengan Jim Abrahams dan saudaranya Jerry sebagai bagian dari Zucker, Abrahams and Zucker, dengan siapa ia menulis dan menyutradarai film Airplane! tahun 1980 dan menciptakan waralaba The Naked Gun. Sebagai pembuat film solo, Zucker juga menyutradarai Scary Movie 3 (2003) dan Scary Movie 4 (2006).

name: Davor Dujmovic
title: Davor Dujmović
extract: Davor Dujmović was a Yugoslavian actor best known for his memorable roles in Emir Kusturica's movies as Mirza in When Father Was Away on Business, Perhan in Time of the Gypsies and Bata in Underground.
extract_id: Davor Dujmović adalah aktor Yugoslavia yang terkenal karena perannya yang berkesan dalam film-film Emir Kusturica sebagai Mirza dalam When Father Was Away on Business, Perhan dalam Time of the Gypsies, dan Bata dalam Underground.

name: DeForest Kelley
title: DeForest Kelley
extract: Jackson DeForest Kelley was an American actor, screenwriter, poet, and singer. He was known for his roles in film and television Westerns and achieved international fame as Dr. Leonard "Bones" McCoy of the USS Enterprise in the television and film series Star Trek (1966–1991).
extract_id: Jackson DeForest Kelley adalah aktor, penulis skenario, penyair, dan penyanyi Amerika. Ia dikenal untuk perannya dalam film dan televisi Western dan meraih ketenaran internasional sebagai Dr. Leonard "Bones" McCoy dari USS Enterprise dalam serial televisi dan film Star Trek (1966–1991).

name: Dean DeBlois
title: Dean DeBlois
extract: Dean Allan DeBlois is a Canadian filmmaker and animator. He is best known for co-writing and directing the Oscar-nominated animated feature films Lilo & Stitch (2002) for Walt Disney Animation Studios, the How to Train Your Dragon films for DreamWorks Animation, and directing the documentary Heima (2007) about the Icelandic band Sigur Rós.
extract_id: Dean Allan DeBlois adalah pembuat film dan animator Kanada. Ia paling dikenal karena menjadi co-penulis dan penyutradara film animasi nominasi Oscar Lilo & Stitch (2002) untuk Walt Disney Animation Studios, film How to Train Your Dragon untuk DreamWorks Animation, dan menyutradarai film dokumenter Heima (2007) tentang band Islandia Sigur Rós.

name: Dean Martin
title: Dean Martin
extract: Dean Martin was an American singer, actor, comedian and television host. Nicknamed the "King of Cool", he is regarded as one of the most popular entertainers of the 20th century.
extract_id: Dean Martin adalah penyanyi, aktor, komedian, dan pembawa acara televisi Amerika. Dijuluki "King of Cool", ia dianggap sebagai salah satu penghibur paling populer pada abad ke-20.

name: Dean Stockwell
title: Dean Stockwell
extract: Robert Dean Stockwell was an American actor and collage artist, whose career in film and television spanned 70 years. As a child actor under contract to Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer, he appeared in Anchors Aweigh (1945), Song of the Thin Man (1947), The Green Years (1946), Gentleman's Agreement (1947), The Boy with Green Hair (1948), The Secret Garden (1949), and Kim (1950). As a young adult, he played a lead role in the 1957 Broadway play Compulsion and its 1959 film version; and in 1962, he played Edmund Tyrone in the film version of Long Day's Journey into Night, for which he won two Best Actor Awards at the Cannes Film Festival. He was nominated for a Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama for his starring role in the 1960 film version of D. H. Lawrence's Sons and Lovers.
extract_id: Robert Dean Stockwell adalah aktor dan seniman kolase Amerika, dengan karier di film dan televisi yang berlangsung selama 70 tahun. Sebagai aktor anak di bawah kontrak Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer, ia tampil dalam Anchors Aweigh (1945), Song of the Thin Man (1947), The Green Years (1946), Gentleman's Agreement (1947), The Boy with Green Hair (1948), The Secret Garden (1949), dan Kim (1950). Sebagai dewasa muda, ia memerankan peran utama dalam drama Broadway tahun 1957 Compulsion dan versi filmnya pada 1959; dan pada 1962, ia memerankan Edmund Tyrone dalam versi film Long Day's Journey into Night, yang membuatnya memenangkan dua Penghargaan Aktor Terbaik di Festival Film Cannes. Ia dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award untuk Aktor Terbaik – Drama Film atas perannya dalam versi film Sons and Lovers tahun 1960 karya D. H. Lawrence.

name: Dean-Charles Chapman
title: Dean-Charles Chapman
extract: Dean-Charles Chapman is an English actor known for portraying Billy Elliot in the West End theatre production of Billy Elliot the Musical. His notable TV roles include Richard Grey in The White Queen (2013) and Tommen Baratheon in the HBO fantasy series Game of Thrones (2014–2016). He also portrayed Tom Blake in Sam Mendes's film 1917 (2019) and Thomas of Lancaster in David Michôd's The King (2019).
extract_id: Dean-Charles Chapman adalah aktor Inggris yang dikenal memerankan Billy Elliot dalam produksi teater West End Billy Elliot the Musical. Peran TV terkenalnya termasuk Richard Grey dalam The White Queen (2013) dan Tommen Baratheon dalam serial fantasi HBO Game of Thrones (2014–2016). Ia juga memerankan Tom Blake dalam film 1917 (2019) karya Sam Mendes dan Thomas of Lancaster dalam The King (2019) karya David Michôd.

name: Debbie Reynolds
title: Debbie Reynolds
extract: Mary Frances "Debbie" Reynolds was an American actress, singer and dancer. She was nominated for a Golden Globe Award for Most Promising Newcomer with her portrayal of Helen Kane in the 1950 film Three Little Words. Her breakout role was her first leading role, as Kathy Selden in Singin' in the Rain (1952).
extract_id: Mary Frances "Debbie" Reynolds adalah aktris, penyanyi, dan penari Amerika. Ia dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award sebagai Most Promising Newcomer dengan perannya sebagai Helen Kane dalam film Three Little Words tahun 1950. Peran terobosannya adalah peran utama pertamanya, sebagai Kathy Selden dalam Singin' in the Rain (1952).

name: Deborah Kara Unger
title: Deborah Kara Unger
extract: Deborah Kara Unger is a Canadian actress. She is known for her roles in the films Highlander III: The Sorcerer (1994), Crash (1996), The Game (1997), Payback (1999), The Hurricane (1999), White Noise (2005), Silent Hill (2006), 88 Minutes (2008) and The Way (2010).
extract_id: Deborah Kara Unger adalah aktris Kanada. Ia dikenal melalui perannya dalam film Highlander III: The Sorcerer (1994), Crash (1996), The Game (1997), Payback (1999), The Hurricane (1999), White Noise (2005), Silent Hill (2006), 88 Minutes (2008), dan The Way (2010).

name: Deborah Kerr
title: Deborah Kerr
extract: Deborah Jane Trimmer, known professionally as Deborah Kerr, was a British actress. Kerr rose to fame for her portrayals of proper, ladylike women, who often navigated societal expectations and stereotypes. Kerr attracted wide praise for her work, earning six Academy Award nominations for Best Actress. She was regarded as one of the best actresses of her generation. From the 1940s to the 1960s, she was one of the most popular actresses in the world.
extract_id: Deborah Jane Trimmer, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Deborah Kerr, adalah aktris Inggris. Kerr terkenal karena perannya sebagai wanita yang sopan dan anggun, yang sering menghadapi ekspektasi dan stereotip sosial. Kerr mendapat pujian luas atas karyanya, meraih enam nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik. Ia dianggap sebagai salah satu aktris terbaik di generasinya. Dari tahun 1940-an hingga 1960-an, ia adalah salah satu aktris paling populer di dunia.

name: Debra Messing
title: Debra Messing
extract: Debra Lynn Messing is an American actress. After graduating from New York University's Tisch School of the Arts, Messing starred in the television series Ned and Stacey on Fox (1995–1997) and Prey on ABC (1998). She achieved her breakthrough role as Grace Adler, an interior designer, on the NBC sitcom Will & Grace, for which she received seven Golden Globe Award nominations and five Primetime Emmy Award nominations for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series, winning once, in 2003.
extract_id: Debra Lynn Messing adalah aktris Amerika. Setelah lulus dari Tisch School of the Arts, New York University, Messing membintangi serial televisi Ned and Stacey di Fox (1995–1997) dan Prey di ABC (1998). Ia mencapai peran terobosannya sebagai Grace Adler, seorang desainer interior, dalam sitkom NBC Will & Grace, yang memberinya tujuh nominasi Golden Globe Award dan lima nominasi Primetime Emmy Award untuk Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series, dengan satu kemenangan pada 2003.

name: Dee Wallace
title: Dee Wallace
extract: Dee Wallace, also known as Dee Wallace Stone, is an American actress. She is best known for her role as Mary Taylor in the 1982 blockbuster science-fiction film E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial.
extract_id: Dee Wallace, juga dikenal sebagai Dee Wallace Stone, adalah aktris Amerika. Ia paling dikenal untuk perannya sebagai Mary Taylor dalam film fiksi ilmiah blockbuster tahun 1982 E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial.

name: Del Negro
title: Del Negro (actor)
extract: Joseph Nicolas Antonio Del Negro (1929–2015), known professionally as Del Negro, was an American–Spanish film actor and painter. He played Brother Gaspar de Carvajal in Werner Herzog's Aguirre, the Wrath of God.
extract_id: Joseph Nicolas Antonio Del Negro (1929–2015), yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Del Negro, adalah aktor dan pelukis film Amerika-Spanyol. Ia berperan sebagai Brother Gaspar de Carvajal dalam film Aguirre, the Wrath of God karya Werner Herzog.

name: Delphine Seyrig
title: Delphine Seyrig
extract: Delphine Claire Beltiane Seyrig was a Lebanese-born French actress and film director. She came to prominence in Alain Resnais's 1961 film Last Year at Marienbad, and later acted in films by Chantal Akerman, Luis Buñuel, Jacques Demy, Marguerite Duras, Ulrike Ottinger, François Truffaut, Joseph Losey, and Fred Zinneman. She directed three films, including the documentary Sois belle et tais-toi (1981).
extract_id: Delphine Claire Beltiane Seyrig adalah aktris dan sutradara film Prancis kelahiran Lebanon. Ia dikenal luas lewat film Last Year at Marienbad (1961) karya Alain Resnais, dan kemudian berakting dalam film-film oleh Chantal Akerman, Luis Buñuel, Jacques Demy, Marguerite Duras, Ulrike Ottinger, François Truffaut, Joseph Losey, dan Fred Zinneman. Ia menyutradarai tiga film, termasuk dokumenter Sois belle et tais-toi (1981).

name: Delroy Lindo
title: Delroy Lindo
extract: Delroy George Lindo is an American actor. Starting his career in the 1975 stage production of Of Mice and Men, he later earned a nomination for the Tony Award for Best Featured Actor in a Play for his work in the 1988 production of Joe Turner's Come and Gone. He received wider recognition with roles in several Spike Lee films, playing West Indian Archie in Malcolm X (1992), Woody Carmichael in Crooklyn (1994), and Rodney Little in Clockers (1995)
extract_id: Delroy George Lindo adalah aktor Amerika. Memulai kariernya dalam produksi panggung Of Mice and Men tahun 1975, ia kemudian dinominasikan untuk Tony Award sebagai Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam Drama untuk karyanya dalam produksi Joe Turner's Come and Gone tahun 1988. Ia meraih pengakuan luas dengan peran dalam beberapa film Spike Lee, memainkan West Indian Archie dalam Malcolm X (1992), Woody Carmichael dalam Crooklyn (1994), dan Rodney Little dalam Clockers (1995).

name: Demet Akbag
title: Demet Akbağ
extract: Demet Akbağ is a Turkish theatre, film actress and acting trainer.
extract_id: Demet Akbağ adalah aktris teater, film, dan pelatih akting Turki.

name: Demi Moore
title: Demi Moore
extract: Demi Gene Moore is an American actress and producer. After rising to prominence in the 1980s, she became the world's highest-paid actress by 1995. Her accolades include a Golden Globe, a Critics' Choice Award, and an Actor Award, and nominations for an Academy Award, a British Academy Film Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award. In 2025, she appeared on Time's 100 most influential people in the world list, and received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame that year.
extract_id: Demi Gene Moore adalah aktris dan produser Amerika. Setelah meraih ketenaran pada 1980-an, ia menjadi aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia pada 1995. Prestasinya termasuk satu Golden Globe, satu Critics' Choice Award, dan satu Actor Award, serta nominasi Academy Award, British Academy Film Award, dan Primetime Emmy Award.
