Pada 2025, ia masuk dalam daftar 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia versi Time, dan menerima bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada tahun yang sama.

name: Denholm Elliott
title: Denholm Elliott
extract: Denholm Mitchell Elliott was an English actor. He appeared in numerous productions on stage and screen, receiving BAFTA Awards for Best Actor in a Supporting Role for Trading Places (1983), A Private Function (1984) and Defence of the Realm (1986), and a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for his portrayal of Mr. Emerson in A Room with a View (1985). He is also known for his performances in Alfie (1966), A Doll's House (1973), A Bridge Too Far (1977), Maurice (1987), September (1987), and Noises Off (1992). He portrayed Marcus Brody in Raiders of the Lost Ark (1981) and Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989). On television, Elliott won the BAFTA TV Award for Best Actor in 1981 and was nominated for a second for Hotel du Lac (1986).
extract_id: Denholm Mitchell Elliott adalah aktor Inggris. Ia tampil dalam banyak produksi panggung dan layar, menerima Penghargaan BAFTA untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk Trading Places (1983), A Private Function (1984), dan Defence of the Realm (1986), serta nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik atas perannya sebagai Mr. Emerson dalam A Room with a View (1985). Ia juga dikenal melalui penampilannya dalam Alfie (1966), A Doll's House (1973), A Bridge Too Far (1977), Maurice (1987), September (1987), dan Noises Off (1992). Ia memerankan Marcus Brody dalam Raiders of the Lost Ark (1981) dan Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989). Di televisi, Elliott memenangkan BAFTA TV Award untuk Aktor Terbaik pada 1981 dan dinominasikan lagi untuk Hotel du Lac (1986).

name: Denis Villeneuve
title: Denis Villeneuve
extract: Denis Villeneuve is a Canadian film director and screenwriter. He has won seven Canadian Screen Awards as well as nominations for four Academy Awards, five BAFTA Awards, and two Golden Globe Awards. Villeneuve's films have grossed more than $1.8 billion worldwide.
extract_id: Denis Villeneuve adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario Kanada. Ia telah memenangkan tujuh Canadian Screen Awards serta nominasi untuk empat Academy Awards, lima BAFTA Awards, dan dua Golden Globe Awards. Film-film Villeneuve telah meraup lebih dari $1,8 miliar di seluruh dunia.

name: Deniz Baysal
title: Deniz Baysal
extract: Deniz Baysal is a Turkish actress and model. She is best known for her leading roles in Taşacak Bu Deniz, Teşkilat and Söz and the drama series Fazilet Hanım ve Kızları.
extract_id: Deniz Baysal adalah aktris dan model Turki. Ia paling dikenal untuk peran utama dalam Taşacak Bu Deniz, Teşkilat, dan Söz serta serial drama Fazilet Hanım ve Kızları.

name: Deniz Gamze Ergüven
title: Deniz Gamze Ergüven
extract: Deniz Gamze Ergüven is a Turkish-French film director best known for her debut feature film Mustang.
extract_id: Deniz Gamze Ergüven adalah sutradara film Turki-Prancis yang paling dikenal untuk film fitur debutnya Mustang.

name: Dennis Farina
title: Dennis Farina
extract: Donaldo Gugliermo "Dennis" Farina was an American actor and Chicago police detective. Known for his roles as mobsters or police officers, his involvement in the entertainment industry began through his association with filmmaker Michael Mann, who employed Farina as an actor and technical advisor. After supporting parts in Mann's films Thief (1981) and Manhunter (1986), he was cast in the lead role of Lieutenant Mike Torello on the NBC television series Crime Story, produced by Mann.
extract_id: Donaldo Gugliermo "Dennis" Farina adalah aktor Amerika dan detektif polisi di Chicago. Dikenal karena perannya sebagai anggota mafia atau polisi, keterlibatannya di industri hiburan dimulai dari asosiasinya dengan pembuat film Michael Mann, yang mempekerjakan Farina sebagai aktor dan penasihat teknis. Setelah peran pendukung dalam film Mann Thief (1981) dan Manhunter (1986), ia dipilih sebagai pemeran utama Letnan Mike Torello dalam serial televisi NBC Crime Story, yang diproduksi oleh Mann.

name: Dennis Gansel
title: Dennis Gansel
extract: Dennis Gansel is a German film director and screenwriter.
extract_id: Dennis Gansel adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario Jerman.

name: Dennis Hopper
title: Dennis Hopper
extract: Dennis Lee Hopper was an American actor, filmmaker, photographer and visual artist. He is considered one of the key figures of the New Hollywood era. He earned prizes from the Cannes Film Festival and Venice International Film Festival as well as nominations for two Academy Awards, a Primetime Emmy Award and two Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Dennis Lee Hopper adalah aktor, pembuat film, fotografer, dan seniman visual Amerika. Ia dianggap sebagai salah satu tokoh kunci era New Hollywood. Ia meraih penghargaan dari Festival Film Cannes dan Festival Film Internasional Venesia serta nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards, satu Primetime Emmy Award, dan dua Golden Globe Awards.

name: Dennis Price
title: Dennis Price
extract: Dennistoun John Franklyn Rose Price was an English actor. He played Louis Mazzini in the Ealing Studios film Kind Hearts and Coronets (1949) and the omnicompetent valet Jeeves in 1960s television adaptations of P. G. Wodehouse's stories.
extract_id: Dennistoun John Franklyn Rose Price adalah aktor Inggris. Ia memerankan Louis Mazzini dalam film Kind Hearts and Coronets (1949) produksi Ealing Studios dan pelayan serba bisa Jeeves dalam adaptasi televisi tahun 1960-an dari cerita P. G. Wodehouse.

name: Dennis Quaid
title: Dennis Quaid
extract: Dennis William Quaid is an American actor. He is known for his starring roles in many successful films, including Breaking Away (1979), Jaws 3-D (1983), Innerspace (1987), Great Balls of Fire! (1989), Dragonheart (1996), The Parent Trap (1998), Frequency (2000), The Rookie (2002), The Alamo (2004), The Day After Tomorrow (2004), In Good Company (2004), Flight of the Phoenix (2004), Yours, Mine & Ours (2005), and Vantage Point (2008). In 2003, Quaid received a Golden Globe Award nomination for Far from Heaven (2002).
extract_id: Dennis William Quaid adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena peran utamanya dalam banyak film sukses, termasuk Breaking Away (1979), Jaws 3-D (1983), Innerspace (1987), Great Balls of Fire! (1989), Dragonheart (1996), The Parent Trap (1998), Frequency (2000), The Rookie (2002), The Alamo (2004), The Day After Tomorrow (2004), In Good Company (2004), Flight of the Phoenix (2004), Yours, Mine & Ours (2005), dan Vantage Point (2008). Pada tahun 2003, Quaid menerima nominasi Golden Globe Award untuk Far from Heaven (2002).

name: Denzel Washington
title: Denzel Washington
extract: Denzel Hayes Washington Jr. is an American actor and film producer. Known for his dramatic roles on stage and screen, he has received numerous accolades including two Academy Awards, an Actor Award, two Golden Globes, two Silver Bears and a Tony Award, as well as nominations for a Grammy Award and two Primetime Emmy Awards. In 2020, The New York Times named Washington the greatest actor of the 21st century. He has also been honored with the Cecil B. DeMille Award (2016), AFI Life Achievement Award (2019) the Honorary Palme d'Or (2025), and the Presidential Medal of Freedom (2025). Films in which he has appeared have grossed over $5.1 billion worldwide.
extract_id: Denzel Hayes Washington Jr. adalah aktor dan produser film Amerika. Dikenal karena peran dramatisnya di panggung dan layar, dia telah menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk dua Academy Awards, Actor Award, dua Golden Globes, dua Silver Bears, dan Tony Award, serta nominasi untuk Grammy Award dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards. Pada tahun 2020, The New York Times menobatkan Washington sebagai aktor terbesar abad ke-21. Dia juga telah dihormati dengan Cecil B. DeMille Award (2016), AFI Life Achievement Award (2019), Honorary Palme d'Or (2025), dan Presidential Medal of Freedom (2025). Film-film yang dibintanginya meraup pendapatan lebih dari $5,1 miliar di seluruh dunia.

name: Derek Jacobi
title: Derek Jacobi
extract: Sir Derek George Jacobi is an English actor. Known for his roles on stage and screen as well as for his work at the Royal National Theatre, he has received numerous accolades including a Tony Award, a British Academy Television Award, two Laurence Olivier Awards, and two Primetime Emmy Awards. He was given a knighthood for his services to theatre by Queen Elizabeth II in 1994.
extract_id: Sir Derek George Jacobi adalah aktor Inggris. Dikenal karena perannya di panggung dan layar serta untuk karyanya di Royal National Theatre, dia telah menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk Tony Award, British Academy Television Award, dua Laurence Olivier Awards, dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards. Dia dianugerahi gelar ksatria atas jasa-jasanya terhadap teater oleh Ratu Elizabeth II pada tahun 1994.

name: Destin Daniel Cretton
title: Destin Daniel Cretton
extract: Destin Yori Daniel Cretton is an American filmmaker. He is best known for directing the drama films Short Term 12 (2013), The Glass Castle (2017), and Just Mercy (2019) as well as the Marvel Studios films Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings (2021), Spider-Man: Brand New Day (2026), and the television series Wonder Man (2026).
extract_id: Destin Yori Daniel Cretton adalah pembuat film Amerika. Dia paling dikenal sebagai sutradara film drama Short Term 12 (2013), The Glass Castle (2017), dan Just Mercy (2019) serta film Marvel Studios Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings (2021), Spider-Man: Brand New Day (2026), dan serial televisi Wonder Man (2026).

name: Dev Patel
title: Dev Patel
extract: Dev Patel is a British actor and filmmaker. His accolades include a British Academy Film Award, in addition to nominations for an Academy Award and two Golden Globe Awards. Patel was included in Time's list of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2024.
extract_id: Dev Patel adalah aktor dan pembuat film Inggris. Penghargaannya termasuk British Academy Film Award, selain nominasi untuk Academy Award dan dua Golden Globe Awards. Patel termasuk dalam daftar 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia versi Time pada tahun 2024.

name: Dexter Fletcher
title: Dexter Fletcher
extract: Dexter Fletcher is an English film director and actor. He has appeared in Guy Ritchie's Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels, as well as in television shows such as the comedy drama Hotel Babylon and the HBO series Band of Brothers and, earlier in his career, starred as Spike Thomson in the comedy drama Press Gang. His earliest acting role was in the 1973 comedy drama film Steptoe and Son Ride Again.
extract_id: Dexter Fletcher adalah sutradara film dan aktor Inggris. Dia pernah tampil dalam film Guy Ritchie's Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels, serta dalam acara televisi seperti drama komedi Hotel Babylon dan serial HBO Band of Brothers dan, di awal karirnya, berperan sebagai Spike Thomson dalam drama komedi Press Gang. Peran akting pertamanya adalah dalam film drama komedi tahun 1973 Steptoe and Son Ride Again.

name: Dharmendra
title: Dharmendra
extract: Dharmendra was an Indian actor, producer and politician, primarily known for his work in Hindi films. He is regarded as one of the greatest and most commercially successful actors in the history of Indian cinema. Known as the "He-man", he was popular for his handsome looks and leading roles in several blockbusters. In a career spanning 65 years, he worked in over 300 films, holding the record for starring in the highest number of hit films in Hindi cinema. Dharmendra was awarded the Padma Bhushan by the Government of India in 2012, and was later posthumously conferred the Padma Vibhushan in 2026.
extract_id: Dharmendra adalah aktor, produser, dan politisi India yang terutama dikenal atas karyanya dalam film-film Hindi. Dia dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terhebat dan paling sukses secara komersial dalam sejarah sinema India. Dikenal sebagai "He-man", dia populer karena ketampanan dan peran utama dalam beberapa film blockbuster. Dalam karir yang berlangsung 65 tahun, dia bekerja dalam lebih dari 300 film, memegang rekor sebagai aktor dengan film-hit terbanyak dalam sinema Hindi. Dharmendra dianugerahi Padma Bhushan oleh Pemerintah India pada tahun 2012, dan kemudian secara anumerta menerima Padma Vibhushan pada tahun 2026.

name: Diahnne Abbott
title: Diahnne Abbott
extract: Diahnne Abbott is an American actress.
extract_id: Diahnne Abbott adalah seorang aktris Amerika.

name: Diane Keaton
title: Diane Keaton
extract: Diane Keaton was an American actress. Her career spanned more than five decades, during which she rose to prominence in the New Hollywood movement. She collaborated frequently with Woody Allen, appearing in eight of his films. Keaton's accolades include an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, and two Golden Globe Awards, along with nominations for two Emmy Awards and a Tony Award. She was honored with the Film at Lincoln Center Gala Tribute in 2007 and the AFI Life Achievement Award in 2017.
extract_id: Diane Keaton adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Kariernya berlangsung lebih dari lima dekade, selama itu dia naik daun dalam gerakan New Hollywood. Dia sering bekerja sama dengan Woody Allen, tampil dalam delapan filmnya. Penghargaan Keaton meliputi Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan dua Golden Globe Awards, serta nominasi untuk dua Emmy Awards dan Tony Award. Dia dihormati dengan Film at Lincoln Center Gala Tribute pada tahun 2007 dan AFI Life Achievement Award pada tahun 2017.

name: Diane Kruger
title: Diane Kruger
extract: Diane Kruger is a German actress. She is a former model-turned-actress who, early in her film career, gained worldwide recognition and received the Trophée Chopard from the Cannes Film Festival.
extract_id: Diane Kruger adalah aktris Jerman. Dia adalah mantan model yang beralih menjadi aktris yang, di awal karir filmnya, mendapatkan pengakuan dunia dan menerima Trophée Chopard dari Festival Film Cannes.

name: Diane Ladd
title: Diane Ladd
extract: Diane Ladd was an American actress. With a career spanning over 70 years, she appeared in over 200 films and television shows, receiving three Academy Award nominations for her roles in Alice Doesn't Live Here Anymore (1974), Wild at Heart (1990) and Rambling Rose (1991), the first of which won her a BAFTA Award. She was also nominated for three Primetime Emmy Awards and four Golden Globe Awards, winning one for her role in the sitcom Alice (1980–1981).
extract_id: Diane Ladd adalah aktris Amerika. Dengan karier lebih dari 70 tahun, dia tampil dalam lebih dari 200 film dan acara televisi, menerima tiga nominasi Academy Award untuk perannya dalam Alice Doesn't Live Here Anymore (1974), Wild at Heart (1990), dan Rambling Rose (1991), yang pertama memberinya BAFTA Award. Dia juga dinominasikan untuk tiga Primetime Emmy Awards dan empat Golden Globe Awards, memenangkan satu untuk perannya dalam sitkom Alice (1980–1981).

name: Diane Venora
title: Diane Venora
extract: Diane Venora is an American stage, television and film actress. She graduated from the Juilliard School in 1977 and made her film debut in 1981 opposite Albert Finney in Wolfen. She won the New York Film Critics Circle Award for Best Supporting Actress for Bird (1988). Her other films include The Cotton Club (1984), Ironweed (1987), Heat (1995), Romeo + Juliet (1996), The Jackal (1997), The Insider (1999) and Hamlet (2000).
extract_id: Diane Venora adalah aktris panggung, televisi, dan film Amerika. Dia lulus dari Juilliard School pada tahun 1977 dan membuat debut film pada tahun 1981 bersama Albert Finney dalam Wolfen. Dia memenangkan New York Film Critics Circle Award untuk Best Supporting Actress untuk Bird (1988). Film-film lainnya termasuk The Cotton Club (1984), Ironweed (1987), Heat (1995), Romeo + Juliet (1996), The Jackal (1997), The Insider (1999), dan Hamlet (2000).

name: Dianne Wiest
title: Dianne Wiest
extract: Dianne Evelyn Wiest is an American actress. She has won two Academy Awards for Best Supporting Actress for Hannah and Her Sisters (1986) and Bullets Over Broadway (1994), one Golden Globe Award for Bullets Over Broadway, the 1997 Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Guest Actress in a Drama Series for Road to Avonlea, and the 2008 Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Drama Series for In Treatment. In addition, she was nominated for an Academy Award for Parenthood (1989).
extract_id: Dianne Evelyn Wiest adalah aktris Amerika. Dia memenangkan dua Academy Awards untuk Best Supporting Actress untuk Hannah and Her Sisters (1986) dan Bullets Over Broadway (1994), satu Golden Globe Award untuk Bullets Over Broadway, Primetime Emmy Award 1997 untuk Outstanding Guest Actress in a Drama Series untuk Road to Avonlea, dan Primetime Emmy Award 2008 untuk Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Drama Series untuk In Treatment. Selain itu, dia pernah dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Parenthood (1989).

name: Dibyendu Bhattacharya
title: Dibyendu Bhattacharya
extract: Dibyendu Bhattacharya is an Indian actor known for his work in Hindi and Bengali cinema. He is also known for his role as Yeda Yakub Khan In The 2004 Docudrama Black Friday Directed By Anurag Kashyap.
extract_id: Dibyendu Bhattacharya adalah aktor India yang dikenal atas karyanya dalam sinema Hindi dan Bengali. Dia juga dikenal karena perannya sebagai Yeda Yakub Khan dalam Docudrama tahun 2004 Black Friday yang disutradarai oleh Anurag Kashyap.

name: Dick Hogan
title: Dick Hogan
extract: Dixon Howard "Dick" Hogan was an American actor of the 1930s and 1940s. During his 12-year career he appeared in over three dozen films, in roles which varied from unnamed bellhops to featured and starring roles. His final film performance was as the murder victim in Alfred Hitchcock's Rope (1948).
extract_id: Dixon Howard "Dick" Hogan adalah aktor Amerika tahun 1930-an dan 1940-an. Selama kariernya selama 12 tahun, dia tampil dalam lebih dari tiga lusin film, dalam berbagai peran mulai dari bellhop tanpa nama hingga peran utama dan utama. Penampilan film terakhirnya adalah sebagai korban pembunuhan dalam film Alfred Hitchcock Rope (1948).

name: Dick Van Dyke
title: Dick Van Dyke
extract: Richard Wayne Van Dyke is an American actor, comedian, singer, dancer and writer. His work spans screen and stage, and his awards include six Emmy Awards, a Grammy Award, and a Tony Award. He was inducted into the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 1993, and then the Television Hall of Fame in 1995. He was recognized as a Disney Legend in 1998. He has been honored with the Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award in 2013, and the Kennedy Center Honors in 2020.
extract_id: Richard Wayne Van Dyke adalah aktor, komedian, penyanyi, penari, dan penulis Amerika. Karyanya mencakup layar kaca dan panggung, dan penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk enam Emmy Awards, Grammy Award, dan Tony Award. Dia dimasukkan ke dalam Hollywood Walk of Fame pada tahun 1993, dan kemudian Television Hall of Fame pada tahun 1995. Dia diakui sebagai Disney Legend pada tahun 1998. Dia telah dihormati dengan Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award pada tahun 2013, dan Kennedy Center Honors pada tahun 2020.

name: Dick York
title: Dick York
extract: Richard Allen York was an American actor. He was the first actor to play Darrin Stephens on the sitcom Bewitched. He played teacher Bertram Cates in the film Inherit the Wind (1960).
extract_id: Richard Allen York adalah aktor Amerika. Dia adalah aktor pertama yang memerankan Darrin Stephens dalam sitkom Bewitched. Dia berperan sebagai guru Bertram Cates dalam film Inherit the Wind (1960).

name: Diego Luna
title: Diego Luna
extract: Diego Dionisio Luna Alexander is a Mexican actor, director, and producer. He is best known for his portrayal of Cassian Andor in Rogue One (2016) and its prequel series Andor (2022–2025), for which he was nominated twice for a Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Television Series Drama.
extract_id: Diego Dionisio Luna Alexander adalah aktor, sutradara, dan produser Meksiko. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Cassian Andor dalam Rogue One (2016) dan serial praquelnya Andor (2022–2025), yang membuatnya dinominasikan dua kali untuk Golden Globe Award sebagai Aktor Terbaik – Serial Drama Televisi.

name: Diljit Dosanjh
title: Diljit Dosanjh
extract: Diljit Dosanjh is an Indian-born American singer, actor, and film producer who works in Punjabi music as well as Punjabi and Hindi cinema. Dosanjh entered the Social 50 chart by Billboard in 2020. He has been featured in various music charts, including the Canadian Albums Chart, the UK Asian chart by Official Charts Company and the New Zealand Hot Singles. His films, including Jatt & Juliet 2 (2013), Sajjan Singh Rangroot (2018), Honsla Rakh (2021), and Jatt & Juliet 3 (2024) are among the highest grossing Punjabi films in history.
extract_id: Diljit Dosanjh adalah penyanyi, aktor, dan produser film kelahiran India yang bekerja dalam musik Punjabi serta sinema Punjabi dan Hindi. Dosanjh masuk dalam chart Social 50 oleh Billboard pada tahun 2020. Dia juga muncul dalam berbagai chart musik, termasuk Canadian Albums Chart, UK Asian chart oleh Official Charts Company, dan New Zealand Hot Singles. Film-filmnya, termasuk Jatt & Juliet 2 (2013), Sajjan Singh Rangroot (2018), Honsla Rakh (2021), dan Jatt & Juliet 3 (2024) adalah antara film Punjabi dengan pendapatan tertinggi dalam sejarah.

name: Disha Patani
title: Disha Patani
extract: Disha Patani is an Indian actress who works primarily in Hindi films. Known for her fitness and supporting roles in male-dominated films, she has appeared in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list of 2019.
extract_id: Disha Patani adalah aktris India yang bekerja terutama dalam film Hindi. Dikenal karena kebugarannya dan peran pendukung dalam film yang didominasi pria, dia pernah muncul dalam daftar Forbes India Celebrity 100 tahun 2019.

name: Dita Parlo
title: Dita Parlo
extract: Dita Parlo was a German film actress.
extract_id: Dita Parlo adalah aktris film Jerman.

name: Djimon Hounsou
title: Djimon Hounsou
extract: Djimon Gaston Hounsou is a Beninese-American actor. He began his career appearing in music videos and made his film debut in Without You I'm Nothing (1990). He then earned widespread recognition for his role as Cinqué in the Steven Spielberg film Amistad (1997), which earned him a Golden Globe nomination. For his performances in In America (2002) and Blood Diamond (2006), Hounsou was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor.
extract_id: Djimon Gaston Hounsou adalah aktor Beninese-Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya dengan tampil dalam video musik dan membuat debut filmnya dalam Without You I'm Nothing (1990). Kemudian dia mendapatkan pengakuan luas untuk perannya sebagai Cinqué dalam film Steven Spielberg Amistad (1997), yang memberinya nominasi Golden Globe. Untuk penampilannya dalam In America (2002) dan Blood Diamond (2006), Hounsou dinominasikan untuk Academy Award sebagai Aktor Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Dolly Ahluwalia
title: Dolly Ahluwalia
extract: Dolly Ahluwalia is an Indian actress and costume designer who was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2001 for costume design. She has won 3 Filmfare Awards and three National Film Awards, two Best Costume Design awards for Bandit Queen (1993) and Haider (2014), and then as Best Supporting Actress for Vicky Donor (2012), which is also her best known role as an actress.
extract_id: Dolly Ahluwalia adalah aktris dan perancang kostum India yang dianugerahi Sangeet Natak Akademi Award pada tahun 2001 untuk desain kostum. Dia telah memenangkan 3 Filmfare Awards dan tiga National Film Awards, dua di antaranya untuk Best Costume Design untuk Bandit Queen (1993) dan Haider (2014), dan kemudian sebagai Best Supporting Actress untuk Vicky Donor (2012), yang juga merupakan peran terpopulernya sebagai aktris.

name: Dolores Moran
title: Dolores Moran
extract: Dolores Jean Moran was an American film actress and model.
extract_id: Dolores Jean Moran adalah aktris dan model film Amerika.

name: Domhnall Gleeson
title: Domhnall Gleeson
extract: Domhnall Gleeson is an Irish actor, screenwriter and producer. The son of actor Brendan Gleeson, he studied media arts at the Dublin Institute of Technology. He began his career by directing and writing short films, and garnered a Tony Award nomination in 2006 for his role in the Broadway production The Lieutenant of Inishmore. He had a supporting role in Never Let Me Go (2010) and became known to a wider audience for his portrayal of Bill Weasley in the Harry Potter film series (2010–2011).
extract_id: Domhnall Gleeson adalah aktor, penulis skenario, dan produser Irlandia. Putra dari aktor Brendan Gleeson, dia belajar seni media di Dublin Institute of Technology. Dia memulai karier dengan menyutradarai dan menulis film pendek, serta meraih nominasi Tony Award pada tahun 2006 untuk perannya dalam produksi Broadway The Lieutenant of Inishmore. Dia memiliki peran pendukung dalam Never Let Me Go (2010) dan menjadi dikenal oleh audiens yang lebih luas karena perannya sebagai Bill Weasley dalam seri film Harry Potter (2010–2011).

name: Dominic West
title: Dominic West
extract: Dominic Gerard Francis Eagleton West is an English actor, director, producer, and musician. He is best known for playing Jimmy McNulty in HBO's The Wire (2002–2008); Noah Solloway in Showtime's The Affair (2014–2019), for which he was nominated for a Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Television Series Drama; Ebenezer Scrooge's nephew Fred in A Christmas Carol (1999); and Charles, Prince of Wales, in The Crown (2022–2023), for which he was nominated for another Golden Globe Award and a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Dominic Gerard Francis Eagleton West adalah aktor, sutradara, produser, dan musisi Inggris. Ia paling dikenal karena memerankan Jimmy McNulty dalam HBO's The Wire (2002–2008); Noah Solloway dalam Showtime's The Affair (2014–2019), di mana ia dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award untuk Aktor Terbaik – Serial Drama Televisi; keponakan Ebenezer Scrooge, Fred, dalam A Christmas Carol (1999); dan Charles, Prince of Wales, dalam The Crown (2022–2023), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award lainnya dan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Dominique Blanchar
title: Dominique Blanchar
extract: Dominique Blanchar was a French actress in stage, television, and film. She won two Molière Awards.
extract_id: Dominique Blanchar adalah seorang aktris Prancis di panggung, televisi, dan film. Ia memenangkan dua Molière Awards.

name: Dominique McElligott
title: Dominique McElligott
extract: Dominique McElligott is an Irish semi-retired actress. She appeared as a series regular on Raw (2008), Hell on Wheels (2011–2012), The Astronaut Wives Club (2015), House of Cards (2016–2017), and The Last Tycoon (2016). She portrayed Maggie Shaw / Queen Maeve in the superhero series The Boys (2019–2022) and The Boys Presents: Diabolical (2022).
extract_id: Dominique McElligott adalah aktris Irlandia yang semi-pensiun. Dia tampil sebagai pemeran reguler dalam Raw (2008), Hell on Wheels (2011–2012), The Astronaut Wives Club (2015), House of Cards (2016–2017), dan The Last Tycoon (2016). Dia memerankan Maggie Shaw / Queen Maeve dalam serial superhero The Boys (2019–2022) dan The Boys Presents: Diabolical (2022).

name: Dominique Pinon
title: Dominique Pinon
extract: Dominique Pinon is a French actor. He appeared in films directed by Jean-Pierre Jeunet.
extract_id: Dominique Pinon adalah aktor Prancis. Dia tampil dalam film-film yang disutradarai oleh Jean-Pierre Jeunet.

name: Don Cheadle
title: Don Cheadle
extract: Donald Frank Cheadle Jr. is an American actor. Known for his roles in film and television, he has received multiple accolades including two Golden Globe Awards, two Grammy Awards, and a Tony Award as well as nominations for an Academy Award, two BAFTA Awards, and 11 Primetime Emmy Awards. He is one of a few actors to have received nominations for the EGOT.
extract_id: Donald Frank Cheadle Jr. adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal untuk peran-perannya di film dan televisi, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk dua Golden Globe Awards, dua Grammy Awards, dan Tony Award serta nominasi untuk Academy Award, dua BAFTA Awards, dan 11 Primetime Emmy Awards. Dia adalah salah satu dari sedikit aktor yang pernah menerima nominasi untuk EGOT.

name: Don Gordon
title: Don Gordon (actor)
extract: Don Gordon was an American film and television actor. His most notable film roles were those in which he appeared alongside his friend Steve McQueen: Bullitt (1968), Papillon (1973) and The Towering Inferno (1974). Between the first and the last of those films he appeared in The Gamblers (1970), WUSA (1970), Cannon for Cordoba (1970), The Last Movie (1971), Z.P.G. (1972), Fuzz (1972), Slaughter (1972), The Mack (1973), The Education of Sonny Carson (1974) and Omen III: The Final Conflict (1981) as the ill-fated assistant to protagonist Damien Thorn.
extract_id: Don Gordon adalah aktor film dan televisi Amerika. Peran filmnya yang paling terkenal adalah yang muncul bersama temannya Steve McQueen: Bullitt (1968), Papillon (1973), dan The Towering Inferno (1974). Di antara film-film tersebut, ia juga tampil dalam The Gamblers (1970), WUSA (1970), Cannon for Cordoba (1970), The Last Movie (1971), Z.P.G. (1972), Fuzz (1972), Slaughter (1972), The Mack (1973), The Education of Sonny Carson (1974) dan Omen III: The Final Conflict (1981) sebagai asisten protagonis Damien Thorn yang bernasib malang.

name: Don Hall
title: Don Hall (filmmaker)
extract: Donald Lee Hall is an American animation film director, voice actor and screenwriter who is best known for directing the films Winnie the Pooh (2011), Big Hero 6 (2014), Raya and the Last Dragon (2021) and Strange World (2022), and co-directing the film Moana (2016) for Walt Disney Animation Studios. For his work on Big Hero 6, he won an Academy Award for Best Animated Feature, and was again nominated for Raya and the Last Dragon.
extract_id: Donald Lee Hall adalah sutradara film animasi Amerika, pengisi suara, dan penulis skenario yang paling dikenal untuk menyutradarai film Winnie the Pooh (2011), Big Hero 6 (2014), Raya and the Last Dragon (2021), dan Strange World (2022), serta sebagai co-sutradara film Moana (2016) untuk Walt Disney Animation Studios. Untuk karyanya di Big Hero 6, ia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Best Animated Feature, dan kembali dinominasikan untuk Raya and the Last Dragon.

name: Don Rickles
title: Don Rickles
extract: Donald Jay Rickles was an American stand-up comedian and actor, known primarily for his insult comedy. His film roles include Run Silent, Run Deep (1958), Enter Laughing (1967), Kelly's Heroes (1970), and Casino (1995). From 1976 to 1978, he had a two-season starring role in the NBC television sitcom C.P.O. Sharkey, having previously starred in two eponymous half-hour programs, an ABC variety series titled The Don Rickles Show (1968) and a CBS sitcom identically titled The Don Rickles Show (1972).
extract_id: Donald Jay Rickles adalah komedian stand-up dan aktor Amerika, yang terutama dikenal karena komedi hinaannya. Peran filmnya termasuk Run Silent, Run Deep (1958), Enter Laughing (1967), Kelly's Heroes (1970), dan Casino (1995). Dari 1976 hingga 1978, ia memerankan peran utama selama dua musim di sitkom televisi NBC C.P.O. Sharkey, setelah sebelumnya membintangi dua program paruh jam yang berjudul sama, sebuah serial varietas ABC berjudul The Don Rickles Show (1968) dan sitkom CBS dengan judul yang sama The Don Rickles Show (1972).

name: Don Siegel
title: Don Siegel
extract: Donald Siegel was an American film and television director, producer, and editor. He was described by The New York Times as "a director of tough, cynical and forthright action-adventure films whose taut plots centered on individualistic loners".
extract_id: Donald Siegel adalah sutradara, produser, dan editor film dan televisi Amerika. Ia digambarkan oleh The New York Times sebagai "sutradara film aksi-petualangan yang tegas, sinis, dan terus terang dengan alur ketat yang berpusat pada para penyendiri individualis".

name: Don Taylor
title: Don Taylor (American filmmaker)
extract: Donald Ritchie Taylor was an American actor and film director. He co-starred in 1940s and 1950s classics, including the 1948 film noir The Naked City, Battleground, Father of the Bride, Father's Little Dividend and Stalag 17. He later turned to directing films such as Escape from the Planet of the Apes (1971), Tom Sawyer (1973), Echoes of a Summer (1976), and Damien - Omen II (1978).
extract_id: Donald Ritchie Taylor adalah aktor dan sutradara film Amerika. Ia berperan dalam klasik tahun 1940-an dan 1950-an, termasuk film noir 1948 The Naked City, Battleground, Father of the Bride, Father's Little Dividend, dan Stalag 17. Ia kemudian beralih menjadi sutradara film seperti Escape from the Planet of the Apes (1971), Tom Sawyer (1973), Echoes of a Summer (1976), dan Damien - Omen II (1978).

name: Donald O'Connor
title: Donald O'Connor
extract: Donald David Dixon Ronald O'Connor was an American dancer, singer and actor. He came to fame in a series of films in which he co-starred, in succession, with Gloria Jean, Peggy Ryan, and Francis the Talking Mule.
extract_id: Donald David Dixon Ronald O'Connor adalah penari, penyanyi, dan aktor Amerika. Ia terkenal melalui serangkaian film di mana ia berperan bersama, berturut-turut, dengan Gloria Jean, Peggy Ryan, dan Francis the Talking Mule.

name: Donald Pleasence
title: Donald Pleasence
extract: Donald Henry Pleasence was an English actor. He was known for his "bald head and intense, staring eyes," and played more than 250 stage, film, and television roles across a nearly 60-year career.
extract_id: Donald Henry Pleasence adalah aktor Inggris. Ia dikenal dengan "kepala botak dan mata yang intens serta tajam," dan memainkan lebih dari 250 peran panggung, film, dan televisi selama hampir 60 tahun karirnya.

name: Donald Sutherland
title: Donald Sutherland
extract: Donald McNichol Sutherland was a Canadian actor. With a career spanning six decades, he received numerous accolades, including a Primetime Emmy Award and two Golden Globe Awards as well as a BAFTA Award nomination. Considered one of the best actors never nominated for an Academy Award, he received an Academy Honorary Award in 2017.
extract_id: Donald McNichol Sutherland adalah aktor Kanada. Dengan karir yang berlangsung selama enam dekade, ia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Primetime Emmy Award dan dua Golden Globe Awards serta nominasi BAFTA Award. Dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terbaik yang tidak pernah dinominasikan untuk Academy Award, ia menerima Academy Honorary Award pada 2017.

name: Donatas Banionis
title: Donatas Banionis
extract: Donatas Banionis was a Soviet and Lithuanian stage and film actor and theatre director. He has more than 80 credited roles in cinema and is best known for his performance in the lead role of Tarkovsky's Solaris as Kris Kelvin. He was born in Kaunas, Lithuania.
extract_id: Donatas Banionis adalah aktor panggung dan film serta sutradara teater Soviet dan Lithuania. Ia memiliki lebih dari 80 peran yang diakui dalam sinema dan paling dikenal melalui penampilannya sebagai pemeran utama Kris Kelvin dalam Solaris karya Tarkovsky. Ia lahir di Kaunas, Lithuania.

name: Donna Murphy
title: Donna Murphy
extract: Donna Murphy is an American actress and singer, best known for her work in musical theater. A five-time Tony Award nominee for Best Actress in a Musical, she has won twice: for her role as Fosca in Passion (1994–1995) and as Anna Leonowens in The King and I (1996–1997). She was also nominated for her roles as Ruth Sherwood in Wonderful Town (2003), Lotte Lenya in LoveMusik (2007), and Bubbie/Raisel in The People in the Picture (2011).
extract_id: Donna Murphy adalah aktris dan penyanyi Amerika, paling dikenal untuk karyanya di teater musikal. Nominasi Tony Award sebanyak lima kali untuk Best Actress in a Musical, ia memenangkan dua kali: untuk perannya sebagai Fosca dalam Passion (1994–1995) dan sebagai Anna Leonowens dalam The King and I (1996–1997). Ia juga dinominasikan untuk perannya sebagai Ruth Sherwood dalam Wonderful Town (2003), Lotte Lenya dalam LoveMusik (2007), dan Bubbie/Raisel dalam The People in the Picture (2011).

name: Donna Reed
title: Donna Reed
extract: Donna Reed was an American actress. Her career spanned more than 40 years and included appearances in over 40 films. She is best known for playing Mary Hatch Bailey in Frank Capra's Christmas classic It's a Wonderful Life (1946), and for her Academy Award–winning performance as Lorene in Fred Zinnemann's war drama From Here to Eternity (1953).
extract_id: Donna Reed adalah aktris Amerika. Kariernya berlangsung lebih dari 40 tahun dan mencakup lebih dari 40 film. Ia paling dikenal karena memerankan Mary Hatch Bailey dalam klasik Natal Frank Capra It's a Wonderful Life (1946), dan untuk penampilannya yang memenangkan Academy Award sebagai Lorene dalam drama perang Fred Zinnemann From Here to Eternity (1953).

name: Donnie Yen
title: Donnie Yen
description: Hong Kong actor and martial artist (born 1963)
extract: Donnie Yen Chi-tan is a Hong Kong actor, filmmaker, martial artist, and action director. His accolades include three Golden Horse Awards and five Hong Kong Film Awards. He is best known for portraying Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man in the Ip Man film series, namely Ip Man (2008), Ip Man 2 (2010), Ip Man 3 (2015), and Ip Man 4: The Finale (2019). He also served as a co-producer of the spin-off Master Z: Ip Man Legacy (2018).
extract_id: Donnie Yen Chi-tan adalah aktor, pembuat film, seniman bela diri, dan sutradara aksi asal Hong Kong. Penghargaan yang dimilikinya termasuk tiga Golden Horse Awards dan lima Hong Kong Film Awards. Ia paling dikenal karena memerankan grandmaster Wing Chun Ip Man dalam seri film Ip Man, yaitu Ip Man (2008), Ip Man 2 (2010), Ip Man 3 (2015), dan Ip Man 4: The Finale (2019). Ia juga menjadi produser bersama spin-off Master Z: Ip Man Legacy (2018).

name: Donny Alamsyah
title: Donny Alamsyah
extract: Donny Alamsyah or Donny Alamsyah Benjamin is an Indonesian actor and martial artist, best known internationally for his role in action films Merantau (2009) and The Raid (2011). He became well known in Indonesia for his appearance in the 2006 criminal drama film 9 Naga.
extract_id: Donny Alamsyah atau Donny Alamsyah Benjamin adalah aktor dan seniman bela diri Indonesia, paling dikenal secara internasional karena perannya dalam film aksi Merantau (2009) dan The Raid (2011). Ia menjadi terkenal di Indonesia melalui penampilannya dalam film drama kriminal 9 Naga (2006).

name: Dorian Gray
title: Dorian Gray (actress)
extract: Dorian Gray was an Italian actress.
extract_id: Dorian Gray adalah seorang aktris Italia.

name: Dorota Kobiela
title: DK Welchman
extract: Dorota Karolina Welchman is a Polish filmmaker, screenwriter, and producer. She is best known for co-directing her first fully painted animated feature film Loving Vincent (2017) with her husband Hugh Welchman.
extract_id: Dorota Karolina Welchman adalah pembuat film, penulis skenario, dan produser Polandia. Ia paling dikenal karena menjadi co-sutradara film animasi fitur sepenuhnya dilukis Loving Vincent (2017) bersama suaminya Hugh Welchman.

name: Dorothy Comingore
title: Dorothy Comingore
extract: Margaret Louise Comingore, known professionally as Dorothy Comingore, was an American stage and film actress. When starting out in minor film roles, she was billed as Linda Winters. Before that, she appeared on stage and on radio as Kay Winters. Her breakthrough as an actress came when she starred as Susan Alexander Kane in Citizen Kane (1941), the critically acclaimed debut film of Orson Welles. However, her acting career was ended prematurely in 1951 by the Hollywood blacklist. The following year she refused to answer questions or "name names" when called before the House Un-American Activities Committee.
extract_id: Margaret Louise Comingore, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Dorothy Comingore, adalah aktris panggung dan film Amerika. Saat memulai karir dengan peran kecil di film, ia dikenal dengan nama layar Linda Winters. Sebelumnya, ia tampil di panggung dan radio sebagai Kay Winters. Terobosan karirnya sebagai aktris terjadi ketika ia membintangi sebagai Susan Alexander Kane dalam Citizen Kane (1941), film debut Orson Welles yang mendapat pujian kritis. Namun, karir aktingnya berakhir lebih awal pada 1951 akibat daftar hitam Hollywood. Tahun berikutnya ia menolak menjawab pertanyaan atau "menyebut nama" saat dipanggil oleh House Un-American Activities Committee.

name: Dorothy Duffy
title: Dorothy Duffy
extract: Dorothy Duffy is an Irish actress. She is best known for her performance as Rose / Patricia in The Magdalene Sisters.
extract_id: Dorothy Duffy adalah aktris Irlandia. Ia paling dikenal untuk penampilannya sebagai Rose / Patricia dalam The Magdalene Sisters.

name: Dorsey Wright
title: Dorsey Wright
extract: Dorsey Wright is an American actor, best known for his role as Cleon in the 1979 film The Warriors.
extract_id: Dorsey Wright adalah aktor Amerika, paling dikenal untuk perannya sebagai Cleon dalam film The Warriors tahun 1979.

name: Doug Liman
title: Doug Liman
extract: Douglas Eric Liman is an American film director and producer. He is known for directing the films Swingers (1996), Go (1999), The Bourne Identity (2002), Mr. & Mrs. Smith (2005), Jumper (2008), Edge of Tomorrow (2014), American Made (2017), and Road House (2024).
extract_id: Douglas Eric Liman adalah sutradara dan produser film Amerika. Ia dikenal karena menyutradarai film Swingers (1996), Go (1999), The Bourne Identity (2002), Mr. & Mrs. Smith (2005), Jumper (2008), Edge of Tomorrow (2014), American Made (2017), dan Road House (2024).

name: Doug McKeon
title: Doug McKeon
extract: Doug McKeon is an American actor who began his career as a child actor in the 1970s.
extract_id: Doug McKeon adalah aktor Amerika yang memulai karirnya sebagai aktor cilik pada tahun 1970-an.

name: Douglas Booth
title: Douglas Booth
extract: Douglas John Booth is an English actor and musician. He first came to public attention through his performance as Boy George in the BBC Two film Worried About the Boy (2010). He went on to star in the BBC adaptations of Great Expectations and Christopher and His Kind, Carlo Carlei's film adaptation of Romeo & Juliet (2013), and the Netflix biopic The Dirt (2019).
extract_id: Douglas John Booth adalah aktor dan musisi Inggris. Dia pertama kali menarik perhatian publik melalui penampilannya sebagai Boy George dalam film BBC Two Worried About the Boy (2010). Dia kemudian membintangi adaptasi BBC dari Great Expectations dan Christopher and His Kind, adaptasi film Romeo & Juliet (2013) karya Carlo Carlei, serta biopik Netflix The Dirt (2019).

name: Drew Barrymore
title: Drew Barrymore
extract: Drew Blythe Barrymore is an American actress. A member of the Barrymore family of actors, she has received multiple awards and nominations, including a Golden Globe Award, an Emmy Award, and an Actor Award. She was named one of the 100 most influential people in the world by Time in 2023.
extract_id: Drew Blythe Barrymore adalah aktris Amerika. Sebagai anggota keluarga aktor Barrymore, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan dan nominasi, termasuk Golden Globe Award, Emmy Award, dan Actor Award. Dia dinobatkan sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia oleh Time pada tahun 2023.

name: Duane Jones
title: Duane Jones
extract: Duane Lionel Jones was an American actor. He was best known for his lead role as Ben in the 1968 horror film Night of the Living Dead. He was later director of the Maguire Theater at the State University of New York at Old Westbury, and the artistic director of the Richard Allen Center for Culture and Art in Manhattan.
extract_id: Duane Lionel Jones adalah aktor Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena peran utamanya sebagai Ben dalam film horor Night of the Living Dead tahun 1968. Ia kemudian menjadi direktur Maguire Theater di State University of New York di Old Westbury, dan direktur artistik Richard Allen Center for Culture and Art di Manhattan.

name: Duncan Jones
title: Duncan Jones
extract: Duncan Zowie Haywood Jones is a British film director, film producer and screenwriter. He directed the films Moon (2009), Source Code (2011), Warcraft (2016), and Mute (2018). For Moon, he won the BAFTA Award for Outstanding Debut by a British Writer, Director or Producer. He is the son of English singer-songwriter David Bowie and Cypriot-born American model, actress, and journalist Angie Bowie.
extract_id: Duncan Zowie Haywood Jones adalah sutradara film, produser film, dan penulis skenario asal Inggris. Ia menyutradarai film Moon (2009), Source Code (2011), Warcraft (2016), dan Mute (2018). Untuk Moon, ia memenangkan BAFTA Award untuk Debut Luar Biasa oleh Penulis, Sutradara, atau Produser Inggris. Ia adalah putra penyanyi-penulis lagu Inggris David Bowie dan model, aktris, serta jurnalis Amerika kelahiran Siprus Angie Bowie.

name: Dustin Hoffman
title: Dustin Hoffman
extract: Dustin Lee Hoffman is an American actor and filmmaker. As one of the key leading man actors in the formation of New Hollywood, Hoffman is known for his versatile portrayals of antiheroes and emotionally vulnerable characters. Among his numerous accolades are two Academy Awards, four BAFTA Awards, five Golden Globe Awards, and two Emmy Awards as well as a nomination for a Tony Award. He was honored with the Cecil B. DeMille Award in 1997, the AFI Life Achievement Award in 1999, and the Kennedy Center Honors Award in 2012.
extract_id: Dustin Lee Hoffman adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Sebagai salah satu aktor utama penting dalam pembentukan New Hollywood, Hoffman dikenal karena perannya yang beragam sebagai antihero dan karakter yang emosional rentan. Di antara berbagai penghargaan yang diraihnya adalah dua Academy Awards, empat BAFTA Awards, lima Golden Globe Awards, dan dua Emmy Awards serta nominasi Tony Award. Ia dihormati dengan Cecil B. DeMille Award pada tahun 1997, AFI Life Achievement Award pada tahun 1999, dan Kennedy Center Honors Award pada tahun 2012.

name: Dwight Yoakam
title: Dwight Yoakam
extract: Dwight David Yoakam is an American singer-songwriter, actor, and filmmaker. He first achieved mainstream attention in 1986 with the release of his debut album Guitars, Cadillacs, Etc., Etc.. Yoakam had considerable success throughout the late 1980s onward, with a total of ten studio albums for Reprise Records. Later projects have been released on Audium, New West, Warner, Sugar Hill Records, and Thirty Tigers.
extract_id: Dwight David Yoakam adalah penyanyi-penulis lagu, aktor, dan pembuat film Amerika. Ia pertama kali meraih perhatian luas pada tahun 1986 dengan perilisan album debutnya Guitars, Cadillacs, Etc., Etc.. Yoakam meraih kesuksesan besar dari akhir 1980-an dan seterusnya, dengan total sepuluh album studio untuk Reprise Records. Proyek-proyek selanjutnya dirilis di Audium, New West, Warner, Sugar Hill Records, dan Thirty Tigers.

name: Dylan Baker
title: Dylan Baker
extract: Dylan Baker is an American actor. He gained recognition for his roles in films such as Planes, Trains and Automobiles (1987), Happiness (1998), Thirteen Days (2000), Road to Perdition (2002), Spider-Man 2 (2004), Spider-Man 3 (2007), Trick 'r Treat (2007), Revolutionary Road (2008), Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues (2013), and Selma (2014). On television he has had prominent roles in series such as Murder One (1995–1996), The Good Wife (2010–2015), Damages (2011), The Americans (2016), and Homeland (2018). For The Good Wife he earned three Primetime Emmy Award nominations.
extract_id: Dylan Baker adalah aktor Amerika. Ia mendapatkan pengakuan untuk perannya dalam film seperti Planes, Trains and Automobiles (1987), Happiness (1998), Thirteen Days (2000), Road to Perdition (2002), Spider-Man 2 (2004), Spider-Man 3 (2007), Trick 'r Treat (2007), Revolutionary Road (2008), Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues (2013), dan Selma (2014). Di televisi, ia memerankan peran penting dalam serial seperti Murder One (1995–1996), The Good Wife (2010–2015), Damages (2011), The Americans (2016), dan Homeland (2018). Untuk The Good Wife, ia meraih tiga nominasi Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Ed Harris
title: Ed Harris
extract: Edward Allen Harris is an American actor and filmmaker. Harris received nominations for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for his performances in Apollo 13 (1995), The Truman Show (1998), and The Hours (2002). He also directed and starred in Pollock (2000), for which he was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actor, and Appaloosa (2008).
extract_id: Edward Allen Harris adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Harris menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam Apollo 13 (1995), The Truman Show (1998), dan The Hours (2002). Ia juga menyutradarai dan membintangi Pollock (2000), yang membawanya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award Aktor Terbaik, serta Appaloosa (2008).

name: Ed Helms
title: Ed Helms
extract: Edward Parker Helms is an American actor and comedian. From 2002 to 2006, he was a correspondent on Comedy Central's The Daily Show with Jon Stewart. He played paper salesman Andy Bernard in the NBC sitcom The Office (2006–2013), and starred as Stuart "Stu" Price in The Hangover trilogy. He later starred in the comedy series Rutherford Falls (2021–2022), which he co-wrote.
extract_id: Edward Parker Helms adalah aktor dan komedian Amerika. Dari tahun 2002 hingga 2006, ia menjadi koresponden di The Daily Show with Jon Stewart di Comedy Central. Ia memerankan penjual kertas Andy Bernard dalam sitkom NBC The Office (2006–2013), dan membintangi sebagai Stuart “Stu” Price dalam trilogi The Hangover. Ia kemudian membintangi serial komedi Rutherford Falls (2021–2022), yang juga ia tulis bersama.

name: Ed Skrein
title: Ed Skrein
extract: Edward George Skrein is an English actor, filmmaker and rapper. He rose to prominence as the supervillain Francis Freeman / Ajax in the superhero comedy film Deadpool (2016). He also starred in the films The Transporter: Refueled (2015), Alita: Battle Angel (2019), Midway (2019), Rebel Moon – Part One: A Child of Fire (2023), Rebel Moon – Part Two: The Scargiver (2024), and Jurassic World Rebirth (2025).
extract_id: Edward George Skrein adalah aktor, pembuat film, dan rapper Inggris. Ia naik daun sebagai supervillain Francis Freeman / Ajax dalam film komedi superhero Deadpool (2016). Ia juga membintangi film The Transporter: Refueled (2015), Alita: Battle Angel (2019), Midway (2019), Rebel Moon – Part One: A Child of Fire (2023), Rebel Moon – Part Two: The Scargiver (2024), dan Jurassic World Rebirth (2025).

name: Eddie Albert
title: Eddie Albert
extract: Edward Albert Heimberger was an American actor. He is known for his roles on stage and screen and received nominations for two Academy Awards, a BAFTA Award, and two Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Edward Albert Heimberger adalah aktor Amerika. Ia dikenal atas peran-perannya di panggung dan layar serta menerima nominasi dua Academy Awards, satu BAFTA Award, dan dua Golden Globe Awards.

name: Eddie Murphy
title: Eddie Murphy
extract: Edward Regan Murphy is an American comedian, actor, and singer. He is widely recognized as one of the most influential Black artists in the entertainment industry, and one of the greatest comedians of all time. He had his breakthrough as a stand-up comic before gaining stardom for his film roles; He has received several accolades including a Golden Globe Award, a Grammy Award, and an Emmy Award as well as nominations for an Academy Award and a BAFTA Award. He was honored with the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor in 2015, the Cecil B. DeMille Award in 2023, and the 51st AFI Life Achievement Award in 2026.
extract_id: Edward Regan Murphy adalah komedian, aktor, dan penyanyi Amerika. Ia dikenal luas sebagai salah satu artis Kulit Hitam paling berpengaruh di industri hiburan, dan salah satu komedian terbesar sepanjang masa. Ia meraih terobosan sebagai komika panggung sebelum meraih ketenaran lewat peran-perannya di film; ia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Golden Globe Award, Grammy Award, dan Emmy Award serta nominasi Academy Award dan BAFTA Award. Ia dihormati dengan Mark Twain Prize for American Humor pada 2015, Cecil B. DeMille Award pada 2023, dan 51st AFI Life Achievement Award pada 2026.

name: Eddie Redmayne
title: Eddie Redmayne
extract: Edward John David Redmayne is an English actor. His accolades include an Academy Award, a Tony Award, a British Academy Film Award, a Golden Globe Award, and two Olivier Awards.
extract_id: Edward John David Redmayne adalah aktor Inggris. Penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk Academy Award, Tony Award, British Academy Film Award, Golden Globe Award, dan dua Olivier Awards.

name: Edgar Ramírez
title: Édgar Ramírez
extract: Édgar Filiberto Ramírez Arellano is a Venezuelan actor.
extract_id: Édgar Filiberto Ramírez Arellano adalah aktor Venezuela.

name: Edgar Wright
title: Edgar Wright
extract: Edgar Howard Wright is an English filmmaker. He is known for his fast-paced and kinetic, satirical genre films, which feature extensive use of expressive popular music, Steadicam tracking shots, dolly zooms and a signature editing style that includes transitions, whip pans and wipes. He first made independent short films before making his first feature film A Fistful of Fingers in 1995. Wright created and directed the comedy series Asylum in 1996, written with David Walliams. After directing several other television shows, Wright directed the sitcom Spaced (1999–2001), which aired for two series and starred frequent collaborators Simon Pegg and Nick Frost.
extract_id: Edgar Howard Wright adalah pembuat film Inggris. Ia dikenal dengan film-genre satir yang cepat dan kinetik, yang menampilkan penggunaan musik populer ekspresif secara ekstensif, pengambilan gambar Steadicam, dolly zoom, dan gaya penyuntingan khas yang mencakup transisi, whip pans, dan wipes. Ia pertama kali membuat film pendek independen sebelum membuat film fitur pertamanya A Fistful of Fingers pada 1995. Wright menciptakan dan menyutradarai serial komedi Asylum pada 1996, yang ditulis bersama David Walliams. Setelah menyutradarai beberapa acara televisi lainnya, Wright menyutradarai sitkom Spaced (1999–2001), yang tayang selama dua seri dan dibintangi kolaborator seringnya Simon Pegg dan Nick Frost.

name: Edmond O'Brien
title: Edmond O'Brien
extract: Eamon Joseph O'Brien, known professionally as Edmond O'Brien, was an American actor of stage, screen, and television, and film director. His career spanned almost 40 years, and he won an Academy Award, two Golden Globe Awards, two Photoplay Awards, and two stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
extract_id: Eamon Joseph O'Brien, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Edmond O'Brien, adalah aktor Amerika di panggung, layar, dan televisi, serta sutradara film. Kariernya berlangsung hampir 40 tahun, dan ia memenangkan Academy Award, dua Golden Globe Awards, dua Photoplay Awards, dan dua bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame.

name: Edmund Goulding
title: Edmund Goulding
extract: Edmund Goulding was a British screenwriter and film director. As an actor early in his career he was one of the 'Ghosts' in the 1922 silent film Three Live Ghosts alongside Norman Kerry and Cyril Chadwick. Also in the early 1920s he wrote several screenplays for star Mae Murray for films directed by her then-husband Robert Z. Leonard. Goulding is best remembered for directing cultured dramas such as Love (1927), Grand Hotel (1932) with Greta Garbo and Joan Crawford, Dark Victory (1939) with Bette Davis, The Constant Nymph (1943) with Joan Fontaine, and The Razor's Edge (1946) with Gene Tierney and Tyrone Power. He also directed the classic film noir Nightmare Alley (1947) with Tyrone Power and Joan Blondell, and the action drama The Dawn Patrol. He was also a successful songwriter, composer, and producer.
extract_id: Edmund Goulding adalah penulis skenario dan sutradara film Inggris. Sebagai aktor awal dalam kariernya, ia adalah salah satu dari 'Ghosts' dalam film bisu 1922 Three Live Ghosts bersama Norman Kerry dan Cyril Chadwick. Juga pada awal 1920-an ia menulis beberapa skenario untuk bintang Mae Murray untuk film yang disutradarai oleh suaminya saat itu Robert Z. Leonard. Goulding paling dikenang karena menyutradarai drama berkelas seperti Love (1927), Grand Hotel (1932) dengan Greta Garbo dan Joan Crawford, Dark Victory (1939) dengan Bette Davis, The Constant Nymph (1943) dengan Joan Fontaine, dan The Razor's Edge (1946) dengan Gene Tierney dan Tyrone Power. Ia juga menyutradarai film noir klasik Nightmare Alley (1947) dengan Tyrone Power dan Joan Blondell, serta drama aksi The Dawn Patrol. Ia juga merupakan penulis lagu, komponis, dan produser sukses.

name: Edmund Gwenn
title: Edmund Gwenn
extract: Edmund Gwenn was an English actor. On film, he is best remembered for his role as Kris Kringle in the Christmas film Miracle on 34th Street (1947), for which he won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor, the corresponding Golden Globe Award, and a Photoplay Award. He received a second Golden Globe, Photoplay Award, and another Academy Award nomination for the comedy film Mister 880 (1950). He is also remembered for his appearances in four films directed by Alfred Hitchcock.
extract_id: Edmund Gwenn adalah aktor Inggris. Di film, ia paling dikenang atas perannya sebagai Kris Kringle dalam film Natal Miracle on 34th Street (1947), yang membuatnya memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik, Golden Globe Award yang sesuai, dan Photoplay Award. Ia menerima Golden Globe kedua, Photoplay Award, dan nominasi Academy Award lainnya untuk film komedi Mister 880 (1950). Ia juga dikenang atas penampilannya dalam empat film yang disutradarai Alfred Hitchcock.

name: Edna Purviance
title: Edna Purviance
extract: Olga Edna Purviance was an American actress of the silent film era. She was the leading lady in many of Charlie Chaplin's early films and in a span of eight years, she appeared in over 30 films with him.
extract_id: Olga Edna Purviance adalah aktris Amerika pada era film bisu. Ia menjadi pemeran utama wanita dalam banyak film awal Charlie Chaplin dan dalam kurun delapan tahun, ia tampil dalam lebih dari 30 film bersamanya.

name: Edoardo Leo
title: Edoardo Leo
extract: Edoardo Leo is an Italian actor, director and screenwriter.
extract_id: Edoardo Leo adalah aktor, sutradara, dan penulis skenario Italia.

name: Eduard Abalov
title: Eduard Abalov
extract: Eduard Gaikovich Abalov (Abalyan) (Russian: Эдуа́рд Га́йкович Аба́лов (Абаля́н), Armenian: Էդուարդ Աբալյան); 7 October 1927 – 5 August 1987) was a Soviet film actor and director.
extract_id: Eduard Gaikovich Abalov (Abalyan) (Rusia: Эдуа́рд Га́йкович Аба́лов (Абаля́н), Armenia: Էդուարդ Աբալյան); 7 Oktober 1927 – 5 Agustus 1987) adalah aktor dan sutradara film Soviet.

name: Eduardo Noriega
title: Eduardo Noriega (Spanish actor)
extract: Eduardo Noriega Gómez is a Spanish actor. He gained notoriety in Spain for his performance in Thesis (1996), which was followed by roles in Open Your Eyes (1997) and The Wolf (2004).
extract_id: Eduardo Noriega Gómez adalah aktor Spanyol. Ia mendapatkan ketenaran di Spanyol lewat penampilannya dalam Thesis (1996), yang kemudian diikuti oleh peran dalam Open Your Eyes (1997) dan The Wolf (2004).

name: Edward Arnold
title: Edward Arnold (actor)
extract: Günther Edward Arnold Schneider was an American actor of the stage and screen.
extract_id: Günther Edward Arnold Schneider adalah aktor Amerika teater dan layar lebar.

name: Edward Asner
title: Ed Asner
extract: Eddie Asner was an American actor. He is most notable for portraying Lou Grant on the sitcom The Mary Tyler Moore Show (1970–1977) and drama Lou Grant (1977–1982), making him one of the few television actors to portray the same character in both a comedy and a drama.
extract_id: Eddie Asner adalah aktor Amerika. Ia paling terkenal karena memerankan Lou Grant dalam sitkom The Mary Tyler Moore Show (1970–1977) dan drama Lou Grant (1977–1982), menjadikannya salah satu dari sedikit aktor televisi yang memerankan karakter yang sama dalam genre komedi dan drama.

name: Edward Burns
title: Edward Burns
extract: Edward Fitzgerald Burns is an American actor and filmmaker. He rose to fame with The Brothers McMullen (1995), his low-budget independent film that was a worldwide success. His other film appearances include Saving Private Ryan (1998), The Holiday (2006), 27 Dresses (2008), Man on a Ledge (2012), Friends with Kids (2012), and Alex Cross (2012).
extract_id: Edward Fitzgerald Burns adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Ia meraih ketenaran lewat The Brothers McMullen (1995), film independen berbiaya rendahnya yang sukses secara global. Penampilannya di film lain termasuk Saving Private Ryan (1998), The Holiday (2006), 27 Dresses (2008), Man on a Ledge (2012), Friends with Kids (2012), dan Alex Cross (2012).

name: Edward Fox
title: Edward Fox (actor)
extract: Edward Charles Morice Fox is an English actor. He twice won the BAFTA Film Award for Best Actor in a Supporting Role, for his performances in The Go-Between (1971) and A Bridge Too Far (1977), and won the BAFTA TV Award for Best Actor for playing Edward VIII in the television drama serial Edward & Mrs. Simpson (1978).
extract_id: Edward Charles Morice Fox adalah aktor Inggris. Dia dua kali memenangkan BAFTA Film Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik, untuk penampilannya dalam The Go-Between (1971) dan A Bridge Too Far (1977), dan memenangkan BAFTA TV Award untuk Aktor Terbaik karena memerankan Edward VIII dalam drama televisi seri Edward & Mrs. Simpson (1978).

name: Edward Furlong
title: Edward Furlong
extract: Edward Walter Furlong is an American actor. He won a Saturn and an MTV Movie Award for his breakthrough performance at age 13 as John Connor in James Cameron's 1991 science fiction action film Terminator 2: Judgment Day.
extract_id: Edward Walter Furlong adalah aktor Amerika. Dia memenangkan Saturn dan MTV Movie Award untuk penampilan terobosannya pada usia 13 tahun sebagai John Connor dalam film fiksi ilmiah aksi tahun 1991 karya James Cameron, Terminator 2: Judgment Day.

name: Edward G. Robinson
title: Edward G. Robinson
extract: Edward Goldenberg Robinson was an American actor who was popular during Hollywood's Golden Age. After making his stage debut in 1913, he rose to stardom with his performance as the title character in Little Caesar (1931) and became well known for his portrayals of gangsters. He starred in a variety of films, including the biopics Dr. Ehrlich's Magic Bullet and A Dispatch from Reuters and the film noirs Double Indemnity and The Woman in the Window.
extract_id: Edward Goldenberg Robinson adalah aktor Amerika yang populer selama Era Keemasan Hollywood. Setelah melakukan debut panggung pada tahun 1913, ia naik ke puncak ketenaran dengan penampilannya sebagai karakter utama dalam Little Caesar (1931) dan menjadi terkenal karena perannya sebagai gangster. Ia membintangi berbagai film, termasuk biopik Dr. Ehrlich's Magic Bullet dan A Dispatch from Reuters serta film noir Double Indemnity dan The Woman in the Window.

name: Edward James Olmos
title: Edward James Olmos
extract: Edward James Olmos is an American actor and director. He is best known for his roles as Detective Gaff in Blade Runner (1982) and its sequel Blade Runner 2049 (2017), Lieutenant Martin "Marty" Castillo in Miami Vice (1984–1989), high school math teacher Jaime Escalante in Stand and Deliver (1988), Montoya Santana in American Me (1992), and William Adama in the reimagined Battlestar Galactica (2004–2009).
extract_id: Edward James Olmos adalah aktor dan sutradara Amerika. Ia paling dikenal untuk perannya sebagai Detektif Gaff dalam Blade Runner (1982) dan sekuelnya Blade Runner 2049 (2017), Letnan Martin "Marty" Castillo dalam Miami Vice (1984–1989), guru matematika sekolah menengah Jaime Escalante dalam Stand and Deliver (1988), Montoya Santana dalam American Me (1992), dan William Adama dalam Battlestar Galactica yang direimajinasikan (2004–2009).

name: Edward Norton
title: Edward Norton
extract: Edward Harrison Norton is an American actor and filmmaker. He has received various accolades including a Golden Globe Award, an Actor Award, two Critics' Choice Awards and two Satellite Awards in addition to nominations for four Academy Awards, two BAFTA Awards and two Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Edward Harrison Norton adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Golden Globe Award, Actor Award, dua Critics' Choice Awards dan dua Satellite Awards selain nominasi untuk empat Academy Awards, dua BAFTA Awards dan dua Emmy Awards.

name: Edward Zwick
title: Edward Zwick
extract: Edward M. Zwick is an American filmmaker. He has worked primarily in the comedy drama and epic historical film genres and received an Academy Award and a BAFTA Award for his work producing Shakespeare in Love (1998).
extract_id: Edward M. Zwick adalah pembuat film Amerika. Ia terutama bekerja di genre drama komedi dan film sejarah epik serta menerima Academy Award dan BAFTA Award untuk karyanya sebagai produser Shakespeare in Love (1998).

name: Efrem Zimbalist Jr.
title: Efrem Zimbalist Jr.
extract: Efrem Zimbalist Jr. was an American actor and theatre producer. Known for his "mellifluous voice and air of sophistication," he was known to television audiences for his starring roles on the crime drama series 77 Sunset Strip (1958–64) and The F.B.I. (1965–74), his recurring role as "Dandy Jim" Buckley on Maverick (1957–58), and as the voice of Alfred Pennyworth in the DC Animated Universe. He also appeared in numerous films and on the Broadway stage. He was a Golden Globe Award winner and a two-time Primetime Emmy Award nominee.
extract_id: Efrem Zimbalist Jr. adalah aktor dan produser teater Amerika. Dikenal dengan "suara merdu dan aura kecanggihan," ia dikenal oleh penonton televisi melalui peran utamanya dalam serial drama kriminal 77 Sunset Strip (1958–64) dan The F.B.I. (1965–74), peran berulangnya sebagai "Dandy Jim" Buckley dalam Maverick (1957–58), dan sebagai suara Alfred Pennyworth dalam DC Animated Universe. Ia juga muncul dalam berbagai film dan di panggung Broadway. Ia adalah pemenang Golden Globe Award dan dua kali dinominasikan untuk Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Eiji Okada
title: Eiji Okada
extract: Eiji Okada was a Japanese film actor from Chōshi, Chiba. Okada served in the Imperial Japanese Army during World War II and was a miner and traveling salesman before becoming an actor.
extract_id: Eiji Okada adalah aktor film Jepang dari Chōshi, Chiba. Okada bertugas di Tentara Kekaisaran Jepang selama Perang Dunia II dan bekerja sebagai penambang serta penjual keliling sebelum menjadi aktor.

name: Eijirô Tôno
title: Eijirō Tōno
extract: Eijirō Tōno was a Japanese actor who, in a career lasting more than 50 years, appeared in over 400 television shows, nearly 250 films and numerous stage productions. He is best known in the West for his roles in films by Akira Kurosawa, such as Seven Samurai (1954) and Yojimbo (1961), and films by Yasujirō Ozu, such as Tokyo Story (1953) and An Autumn Afternoon (1962). He also appeared in Kill! by Kihachi Okamoto and Tora! Tora! Tora!, a depiction of the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor. His final film was Juzo Itami's A-ge-man in 1990. Tōno also starred as the title character in the long-running television jidaigeki series Mito Kōmon from 1969 to 1983. In the early years of his career he acted under the name of Katsuji Honjo (本庄克二).
extract_id: Eijirō Tōno adalah aktor Jepang yang dalam karier selama lebih dari 50 tahun tampil di lebih dari 400 acara televisi, hampir 250 film, dan berbagai produksi panggung. Ia paling dikenal di Barat untuk perannya dalam film-film karya Akira Kurosawa, seperti Seven Samurai (1954) dan Yojimbo (1961), serta film-film karya Yasujirō Ozu, seperti Tokyo Story (1953) dan An Autumn Afternoon (1962). Ia juga tampil dalam Kill! karya Kihachi Okamoto dan Tora! Tora! Tora!, sebuah penggambaran serangan Jepang di Pearl Harbor. Film terakhirnya adalah A-ge-man karya Juzo Itami pada tahun 1990. Tōno juga berperan sebagai karakter utama dalam seri jidaigeki televisi jangka panjang Mito Kōmon dari 1969 hingga 1983. Pada tahun-tahun awal kariernya, ia berakting dengan nama Katsuji Honjo (本庄克二).

name: Eiko Masuyama
title: Eiko Masuyama
extract: Eiko Masuyama was a Japanese actress and narrator. She was affiliated with Aoni Production at the time of her death. She was most known for originating the roles of Fujiko Mine in Lupin III, Honey Kisaragi in Cutie Honey, and Bakabon's Mama in Tensai Bakabon.
extract_id: Eiko Masuyama adalah pemeran dan narator Jepang. Pada saat kematiannya, ia berafiliasi dengan Aoni Production. Ia paling dikenal karena memerankan peran asli Fujiko Mine dalam Lupin III, Honey Kisaragi dalam Cutie Honey, dan Bakabon's Mama dalam Tensai Bakabon.

name: Eileen Walsh
title: Eileen Walsh
extract: Eileen Walsh is an Irish actress. Her credits include Miss Julie (1999), Janice Beard 45 WPM (1999), When Brendan Met Trudy (2000), The Magdalene Sisters (2002), Pure Mule (2005), Eden (2008), The End (2008), Catastrophe (2015), The Children Act (2017), Maze (2017), Wolf (2021), and Ann (2022).
extract_id: Eileen Walsh adalah aktris Irlandia. Kreditnya termasuk Miss Julie (1999), Janice Beard 45 WPM (1999), When Brendan Met Trudy (2000), The Magdalene Sisters (2002), Pure Mule (2005), Eden (2008), The End (2008), Catastrophe (2015), The Children Act (2017), Maze (2017), Wolf (2021), dan Ann (2022).

name: Eiza González
title: Eiza González
extract: Eiza González Reyna is a Mexican actress and singer. She gained popularity for starring in the Nickelodeon teen sitcom Sueña conmigo (2010–2011). As a singer, she released the albums Contracorriente (2009) and Te Acordarás de Mí (2012).
extract_id: Eiza González Reyna adalah aktris dan penyanyi Meksiko. Ia mendapatkan popularitas karena membintangi sitkom remaja Nickelodeon Sueña conmigo (2010–2011). Sebagai penyanyi, ia merilis album Contracorriente (2009) dan Te Acordarás de Mí (2012).

name: Eleanor Bron
title: Eleanor Bron
extract: Eleanor Bron is an English stage, film and television actress, and an author. Her film roles include Ahme in the Beatles musical Help! (1965), the Doctor in Alfie (1966), Margaret Spencer in Bedazzled (1967) and Hermione Roddice in Women in Love (1969). She has appeared in television series such as Yes Minister, Doctor Who and Absolutely Fabulous.
extract_id: Eleanor Bron adalah aktris panggung, film, dan televisi Inggris, sekaligus penulis. Peran filmnya termasuk Ahme dalam musikal Beatles Help! (1965), Dokter dalam Alfie (1966), Margaret Spencer dalam Bedazzled (1967) dan Hermione Roddice dalam Women in Love (1969). Ia telah tampil dalam serial televisi seperti Yes Minister, Doctor Who, dan Absolutely Fabulous.

name: Eleanor David
title: Eleanor David
extract: Eleanor M. David is a British actress who has worked on projects in the UK, the US and New Zealand. She won positive reviews for her starring role in the biopic Sylvia, in which she played pioneering educator Sylvia Ashton-Warner.
extract_id: Eleanor M. David adalah aktris Inggris yang telah bekerja dalam proyek di Inggris, AS, dan Selandia Baru. Ia menerima ulasan positif untuk peran utamanya dalam biopik Sylvia, di mana ia memerankan pendidik pelopor Sylvia Ashton-Warner.

name: Eleanor Parker
title: Eleanor Parker
extract: Eleanor Jean Parker was an American actress. She was nominated for three Academy Awards, one each for her roles in the films Caged (1950), Detective Story (1951), and Interrupted Melody (1955), the first of which won her the Volpi Cup for Best Actress. She was also known for her roles in the films Of Human Bondage (1946), Scaramouche (1952), The Naked Jungle (1954), The Man with the Golden Arm (1955), A Hole in the Head (1959), The Sound of Music (1965), and The Oscar (1966).
extract_id: Eleanor Jean Parker adalah aktris Amerika. Ia dinominasikan untuk tiga Academy Awards, masing-masing untuk perannya dalam film Caged (1950), Detective Story (1951), dan Interrupted Melody (1955), yang pertama memberikannya Volpi Cup untuk Aktor Terbaik. Ia juga dikenal untuk perannya dalam film Of Human Bondage (1946), Scaramouche (1952), The Naked Jungle (1954), The Man with the Golden Arm (1955), A Hole in the Head (1959), The Sound of Music (1965), dan The Oscar (1966).

name: Elem Klimov
title: Elem Klimov
extract: Elem Germanovich Klimov was a Soviet and Russian filmmaker. He studied at the Gerasimov Institute of Cinematography, and was married to film director Larisa Shepitko. Klimov is best known for his final film, Come and See, which follows a teenage boy in German-occupied Byelorussia during World War Two and which received universal acclaim. His work also includes black comedies, children's movies, and period dramas.
extract_id: Elem Germanovich Klimov adalah pembuat film Soviet dan Rusia. Ia belajar di Institut Sinematografi Gerasimov, dan menikah dengan sutradara film Larisa Shepitko. Klimov paling dikenal untuk film akhirnya, Come and See, yang mengikuti seorang remaja laki-laki di Byelorussia yang diduduki Jerman selama Perang Dunia Dua dan mendapat pujian universal. Karyanya juga meliputi komedi hitam, film anak-anak, dan drama periode.

name: Elena Altieri
title: Elena Altieri
extract: Elena Altieri was an Italian film and stage actress. She appeared in 27 films between 1937 and 1955. She was born in Stresa, the daughter of an Italian father and an English mother. She was mainly cast, both on stage and in films, in roles of haughty and aristocratic women.
extract_id: Elena Altieri adalah aktris film dan panggung Italia. Ia tampil dalam 27 film antara 1937 dan 1955. Ia lahir di Stresa, anak perempuan dari ayah Italia dan ibu Inggris. Ia terutama diperankan dalam peran wanita sombong dan aristokrat baik di panggung maupun di film.

name: Elena Anaya
title: Elena Anaya
extract: Elena Anaya Gutiérrez is a Spanish actress. She garnered public recognition in Spain for her performance in Sex and Lucia (2001), which also earned her a nomination to the Goya Award for Best Supporting Actress. She starred in The Skin I Live In (2011), for which she won the Goya Award for Best Actress. She is also known for her roles as one of Dracula's brides in Van Helsing (2004), the Spanish tourist in Room in Rome (2010) and Doctor Poison in Wonder Woman (2017).
extract_id: Elena Anaya Gutiérrez adalah aktris Spanyol. Ia mendapatkan pengakuan publik di Spanyol untuk penampilannya dalam Sex and Lucia (2001), yang juga memberinya nominasi Penghargaan Goya untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik. Ia membintangi The Skin I Live In (2011), yang memberinya Penghargaan Goya untuk Aktris Terbaik. Ia juga dikenal untuk perannya sebagai salah satu pengantin Dracula dalam Van Helsing (2004), turis Spanyol dalam Room in Rome (2010), dan Dokter Poison dalam Wonder Woman (2017).

name: Elena Lyadova
title: Elena Lyadova
extract: Elena Igorevna Lyadova is a Russian actress. In 2002, she graduated from Mikhail Shchepkin Higher Theatre School in Moscow, Russia. Her film credits include Elena (2011), The Geographer Drank His Globe Away (2013), Leviathan (2014) and Orlean (2015).
extract_id: Elena Igorevna Lyadova adalah aktris Rusia. Pada tahun 2002, ia lulus dari Sekolah Teater Tinggi Mikhail Shchepkin di Moskow, Rusia. Kredit filmnya termasuk Elena (2011), The Geographer Drank His Globe Away (2013), Leviathan (2014), dan Orlean (2015).

name: Eli Marienthal
title: Eli Marienthal
extract: Eli David Marienthal is an American former actor. He won the Annie Award for Outstanding Achievement for Voice Acting in a Feature Production for his vocal performance as Hogarth Hughes in the animated film The Iron Giant (1999).
extract_id: Eli David Marienthal adalah mantan aktor Amerika. Ia memenangkan Annie Award untuk Prestasi Luar Biasa dalam Pengisian Suara dalam Produksi Fitur untuk penampilannya sebagai suara Hogarth Hughes dalam film animasi The Iron Giant (1999).

name: Eli Roth
title: Eli Roth
extract: Eli Raphael Roth is an American film director, screenwriter, producer, and actor. As a director and producer, he is most closely associated with the horror genre, namely splatter films, having directed Cabin Fever (2002) and Hostel (2005).
extract_id: Eli Raphael Roth adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, produser, dan aktor Amerika. Sebagai sutradara dan produser, ia paling erat dikaitkan dengan genre horor, khususnya film splatter, setelah menyutradarai Cabin Fever (2002) dan Hostel (2005).

name: Eli Wallach
title: Eli Wallach
extract: Eli Herschel Wallach was an American film, television, and stage actor from New York City. Known for his character actor roles, his entertainment career spanned over six decades. He received a BAFTA Award, a Tony Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award. He was also inducted into the American Theater Hall of Fame in 1988 and received the Academy Honorary Award in 2010.
extract_id: Eli Herschel Wallach adalah aktor film, televisi, dan panggung Amerika dari New York City. Dikenal karena peran karakter, karier hiburannya berlangsung lebih dari enam dekade. Ia menerima BAFTA Award, Tony Award, dan Primetime Emmy Award. Ia juga dimasukkan ke American Theater Hall of Fame pada tahun 1988 dan menerima Academy Honorary Award pada tahun 2010.

name: Elia Kazan
title: Elia Kazan
extract: Elias Kazantzoglou, known as Elia Kazan, was a Greek-American film and theatre director, producer, screenwriter and actor, described by The New York Times as "one of the most honored and influential directors in Broadway and Hollywood history".
extract_id: Elias Kazantzoglou, dikenal sebagai Elia Kazan, adalah sutradara film dan teater, produser, penulis skenario, dan aktor Yunani-Amerika, yang digambarkan oleh The New York Times sebagai "salah satu sutradara paling dihormati dan berpengaruh dalam sejarah Broadway dan Hollywood".

name: Elijah Wood
title: Elijah Wood
extract: Elijah Jordan Wood is an American actor and producer. A prominent child actor of the 1990s and a prolific figure in major studio features during the 2000s, he has received various accolades including two Saturn Awards, an Actor Award, a Critics' Choice Award and an Empire Award in addition to a nomination for a Daytime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Elijah Jordan Wood adalah aktor dan produser Amerika. Sebagai aktor anak yang menonjol pada 1990-an dan figur produktif dalam film studio besar pada 2000-an, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk dua Saturn Awards, Actor Award, Critics' Choice Award, dan Empire Award selain nominasi Daytime Emmy Award.

name: Elisabeth Shue
title: Elisabeth Shue
extract: Elisabeth Shue is an American actress. She has starred in films such as The Karate Kid (1984), Adventures in Babysitting (1987), Cocktail (1988), Back to the Future Part II (1989), Back to the Future Part III (1990), Soapdish (1991), Leaving Las Vegas (1995), The Saint (1997), Hollow Man (2000), Piranha 3D (2010), Battle of the Sexes (2017), Death Wish (2018), and Greyhound (2020). For her performance in Leaving Las Vegas, she was nominated for the Academy Award, BAFTA, Golden Globe, and SAG Award for Best Actress.
extract_id: Elisabeth Shue adalah aktris Amerika.
