Ia telah membintangi film seperti The Karate Kid (1984), Adventures in Babysitting (1987), Cocktail (1988), Back to the Future Part II (1989), Back to the Future Part III (1990), Soapdish (1991), Leaving Las Vegas (1995), The Saint (1997), Hollow Man (2000), Piranha 3D (2010), Battle of the Sexes (2017), Death Wish (2018), dan Greyhound (2020). Untuk penampilannya dalam Leaving Las Vegas, ia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award, BAFTA, Golden Globe, dan SAG Award untuk Aktris Terbaik.

name: Elissa Knight
title: Elissa Knight
extract: Elissa Knight is an American employee at Pixar and voice actress. As a voice actress, her first major role was in the 2006 film Cars as one of the twins known as Tia and as EVE in WALL-E in 2008.
extract_id: Elissa Knight adalah karyawan Amerika di Pixar dan aktris pengisi suara. Sebagai aktris pengisi suara, peran utamanya yang pertama adalah dalam film Cars tahun 2006 sebagai salah satu dari kembar yang dikenal sebagai Tia dan sebagai EVE dalam WALL-E pada tahun 2008.

name: Elit Iscan
title: Elit İşcan
extract: Elit İşcan is a Turkish actress. Her credits include the film Mustang and the television show Küçük Kadınlar. She has received the IFFI Best Actor Award (Female) at the 46th International Film Festival of India.
extract_id: Elit İşcan adalah aktris Turki. Karyanya termasuk film Mustang dan acara televisi Küçük Kadınlar. Dia menerima IFFI Best Actor Award (Female) di Festival Film Internasional India ke-46.

name: Eliza Scanlen
title: Eliza Scanlen
extract: Eliza Jane Scanlen is an Australian actress. She rose to prominence portraying Tabitha Ford in the Australian soap opera Home and Away (2016), before receiving critical acclaim for playing a troubled teenager in the HBO miniseries Sharp Objects (2018) and the BBC series Dope Girls (2025).
extract_id: Eliza Jane Scanlen adalah aktris Australia. Dia menjadi terkenal saat memerankan Tabitha Ford dalam opera sabun Australia Home and Away (2016), sebelum menerima pujian kritis untuk perannya sebagai remaja bermasalah dalam miniseri HBO Sharp Objects (2018) dan serial BBC Dope Girls (2025).

name: Elizabeth Banks
title: Elizabeth Banks
extract: Elizabeth Banks is an American actress and filmmaker. She is known for playing Effie Trinket in The Hunger Games film series (2012–2015) and an ICCA commentator in the Pitch Perfect film series (2012–2017). She made her directorial film debut with Pitch Perfect 2 (2015), whose $69 million opening-weekend gross set a record for a first-time director. She directed the action comedy Charlie's Angels (2019) and the black comedy horror film Cocaine Bear (2023). Banks founded the film and television production company Brownstone Productions in 2002 with her husband, Max Handelman.
extract_id: Elizabeth Banks adalah aktris dan pembuat film Amerika. Dia dikenal karena memerankan Effie Trinket dalam seri film The Hunger Games (2012–2015) dan komentator ICCA dalam seri film Pitch Perfect (2012–2017). Dia membuat debut sutradara filmnya dengan Pitch Perfect 2 (2015), yang pendapatan pembukaannya sebesar $69 juta menorehkan rekor untuk sutradara pemula. Dia menyutradarai komedi aksi Charlie's Angels (2019) dan film horor komedi hitam Cocaine Bear (2023). Banks mendirikan perusahaan produksi film dan televisi Brownstone Productions pada tahun 2002 bersama suaminya, Max Handelman.

name: Elizabeth Berridge
title: Elizabeth Berridge (actress)
extract: Elizabeth Berridge is an American film and theatre actress. She is best known for playing Constanze Mozart in the Miloš Forman period drama film Amadeus (1984), Melanie in Five Corners (1987), and for her comedic roles as Charlotte on the Norman Lear sitcom The Powers That Be (1992–1993), and Officer Eve Eggers on The John Larroquette Show (1993–1996).
extract_id: Elizabeth Berridge adalah aktris film dan teater Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan Constanze Mozart dalam film drama periode Miloš Forman Amadeus (1984), Melanie dalam Five Corners (1987), serta peran komedinya sebagai Charlotte dalam sitkom Norman Lear The Powers That Be (1992–1993), dan Officer Eve Eggers dalam The John Larroquette Show (1993–1996).

name: Elizabeth Berrington
title: Elizabeth Berrington
extract: Elizabeth Berrington is an English actress. She is best known for her roles as Ruby Fry in Waterloo Road, Paula Kosh in Stella, Mel Debrou in Moving Wallpaper, and Dawn Stevenson in The Syndicate. She has also featured in British television series such as The Bill, Doctor Who, The Office, Casualty, The Lakes, The Grimleys, and Rose and Maloney.
extract_id: Elizabeth Berrington adalah aktris Inggris. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Ruby Fry dalam Waterloo Road, Paula Kosh dalam Stella, Mel Debrou dalam Moving Wallpaper, dan Dawn Stevenson dalam The Syndicate. Dia juga tampil dalam serial televisi Inggris seperti The Bill, Doctor Who, The Office, Casualty, The Lakes, The Grimleys, dan Rose and Maloney.

name: Elizabeth McGovern
title: Elizabeth McGovern
extract: Elizabeth Lee McGovern is an American actress. She has received three Screen Actors Guild Awards, as well as nominations for an Academy Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Satellite Award, and two Golden Globe Awards, among numerous other career plaudits and honors.
extract_id: Elizabeth Lee McGovern adalah aktris Amerika. Dia telah menerima tiga Screen Actors Guild Awards, serta nominasi untuk Academy Award, Primetime Emmy Award, BAFTA Award, Satellite Award, dan dua Golden Globe Awards, di antara berbagai penghargaan dan kehormatan karier lainnya.

name: Elizabeth Taylor
title: Elizabeth Taylor
extract: Dame Elizabeth Rosemond Taylor was a British and American actress. She began her career as a child actress in the early 1940s and was one of the most popular stars of classical Hollywood cinema in the 1950s. She then became the world's highest-paid movie star in the 1960s, remaining a well-known public figure for the rest of her life. In 1999, the American Film Institute ranked her seventh on its list of the greatest female screen legends.
extract_id: Dame Elizabeth Rosemond Taylor adalah aktris Inggris dan Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya sebagai aktris cilik pada awal 1940-an dan menjadi salah satu bintang paling populer dalam sinema klasik Hollywood pada 1950-an. Dia kemudian menjadi bintang film dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia pada 1960-an, dan tetap menjadi tokoh publik yang terkenal sepanjang hidupnya. Pada 1999, American Film Institute menempatkannya di peringkat ketujuh dalam daftar legenda layar perempuan terbesar.

name: Ellar Coltrane
title: Ellar Coltrane
extract: Ellar Coltrane Kinney Salmon is an American actor. He is best known for his role as Mason Evans Jr. in Richard Linklater's film Boyhood, for which he won the Critics' Choice Movie Award for Best Young Performer.
extract_id: Ellar Coltrane Kinney Salmon adalah aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Mason Evans Jr. dalam film Boyhood karya Richard Linklater, yang memberinya penghargaan Critics' Choice Movie Award untuk Best Young Performer.

name: Ellen Burstyn
title: Ellen Burstyn
extract: Ellen Burstyn is an American actress. Known for her portrayals of complex women in dramas, she is the recipient of numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, a Tony Award, and two Primetime Emmy Awards. Burstyn is one of the few performers to achieve the "Triple Crown of Acting". She has also received a BAFTA Award and a Golden Globe Award.
extract_id: Ellen Burstyn adalah aktris Amerika. Dikenal karena perannya sebagai wanita kompleks dalam drama, dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Tony Award, dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards. Burstyn adalah salah satu dari sedikit pemeran yang mencapai "Triple Crown of Acting". Dia juga menerima BAFTA Award dan Golden Globe Award.

name: Ellen Crawford
title: Ellen Crawford
extract: Ellen Crawford is an American actress. She is known for her role as Nurse Lydia Wright on ER from 1994 through 2003 and then again in 2009 for the series finale.
extract_id: Ellen Crawford adalah aktris Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Nurse Lydia Wright di ER dari tahun 1994 hingga 2003 dan kemudian lagi pada tahun 2009 untuk episode terakhir seri tersebut.

name: Ellen DeGeneres
title: Ellen DeGeneres
extract: Ellen Lee DeGeneres is an American comedian, actress, television host, writer, and producer. She began her career in stand-up comedy in the early 1980s, gaining national attention with a 1986 appearance on The Tonight Show Starring Johnny Carson. She starred in the television sitcoms Ellen (1994–1998) and The Ellen Show (2001–2002). She also hosted the syndicated television talk show, The Ellen DeGeneres Show (2003–2022), for which she received 33 Daytime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Ellen Lee DeGeneres adalah pelawak, aktris, pembawa acara televisi, penulis, dan produser Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya di dunia komedi tunggal pada awal 1980-an, mendapatkan perhatian nasional dengan penampilannya pada 1986 di The Tonight Show Starring Johnny Carson. Dia membintangi sitkom televisi Ellen (1994–1998) dan The Ellen Show (2001–2002). Dia juga menjadi pembawa acara talk show televisi sindikasi The Ellen DeGeneres Show (2003–2022), yang memberinya 33 Daytime Emmy Awards.

name: Elliot Page
title: Elliot Page
extract: Elliot Page is a Canadian actor, producer, and activist. He is known for his leading roles across Canadian and American film and television, and for his work as an activist for LGBTQ rights and against discrimination. His accolades include nominations for an Academy Award, three BAFTA Awards, two Primetime Emmy Awards, a Golden Globe Award, and a SAG Award.
extract_id: Elliot Page adalah aktor, produser, dan aktivis Kanada. Dia dikenal karena peran utamanya di film dan televisi Kanada dan Amerika, serta karyanya sebagai aktivis hak-hak LGBTQ dan melawan diskriminasi. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk nominasi Academy Award, tiga BAFTA Awards, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, Golden Globe Award, dan SAG Award.

name: Elliott Gould
title: Elliott Gould
extract: Elliott Gould is an American actor.
extract_id: Elliott Gould adalah aktor Amerika.

name: Elmo Nüganen
title: Elmo Nüganen
description: Estonian actor and director of stage and film
extract: Elmo Nüganen is an Estonian theatre director, film director, and actor. He has been the artistic Director of the Tallinn City Theatre since 1992.
extract_id: Elmo Nüganen adalah sutradara teater, sutradara film, dan aktor Estonia. Dia telah menjadi Direktur Artistik Teater Kota Tallinn sejak tahun 1992.

name: Elpidia Carrillo
title: Elpidia Carrillo
extract: Elpidia Carrillo is a Mexican actress and director. Her career includes roles in both film and television. Internationally she is best known for supporting roles in Predator, Bread and Roses, Nine Lives and Blue Beetle.
extract_id: Elpidia Carrillo adalah aktris dan sutradara Meksiko. Kariernya mencakup peran-peran di film dan televisi. Secara internasional ia paling dikenal untuk peran pendukung dalam Predator, Bread and Roses, Nine Lives, dan Blue Beetle.

name: Elsa Lanchester
title: Elsa Lanchester
extract: Elsa Sullivan Lanchester was a British actress with a long career in theatre, film and television.
extract_id: Elsa Sullivan Lanchester adalah aktris Inggris dengan karier panjang di teater, film, dan televisi.

name: Elya Baskin
title: Elya Baskin
extract: Ilya Zalmanovich Baskin, known professionally as Elya Baskin, is a Latvian-American character actor. He first gained attention for his role in Moscow on the Hudson (1984), as Robin Williams' character's best friend Anatoly. He is best known for playing Peter Parker's landlord, Mr. Ditkovich, in Spider-Man 2 (2004) and Spider-Man 3 (2007). He also played cosmonaut Max Brailovsky in 1984's 2010: The Year We Make Contact.
extract_id: Ilya Zalmanovich Baskin, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Elya Baskin, adalah aktor karakter Latvia-Amerika. Dia pertama kali dikenal karena perannya dalam Moscow on the Hudson (1984), sebagai sahabat karakter Robin Williams, Anatoly. Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan pemilik rumah Peter Parker, Mr. Ditkovich, dalam Spider-Man 2 (2004) dan Spider-Man 3 (2007). Dia juga memerankan kosmonot Max Brailovsky dalam 2010: The Year We Make Contact (1984).

name: Emeric Pressburger
title: Emeric Pressburger
extract: Emeric Pressburger was a Hungarian-British screenwriter, film director, and producer. He is best known for his series of film collaborations with Michael Powell, in a collaboration partnership known as the Archers, and produced a series of films, including 49th Parallel, The Life and Death of Colonel Blimp (1943), A Matter of Life and Death, Black Narcissus (1947), The Red Shoes (1948), and The Tales of Hoffmann (1951).
extract_id: Emeric Pressburger adalah penulis naskah, sutradara film, dan produser Hungaria-Inggris. Dia paling dikenal untuk serangkaian kolaborasi filmnya dengan Michael Powell, dalam kemitraan yang dikenal sebagai the Archers, dan memproduksi serangkaian film termasuk 49th Parallel, The Life and Death of Colonel Blimp (1943), A Matter of Life and Death, Black Narcissus (1947), The Red Shoes (1948), dan The Tales of Hoffmann (1951).

name: Emi Shinohara
title: Emi Shinohara
extract: Emiko Shinohara , known professionally as Emi Shinohara , was a Japanese voice actress from Fukushima Prefecture. At the time of her death, she was affiliated with 81 Produce. She was best known for voicing Sailor Jupiter in the first anime adaptation of Sailor Moon, Kaho Mizuki in Cardcaptor Sakura and its sequel Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card, and Kushina Uzumaki in Naruto: Shippuden. She was married to tokusatsu actor Hiroshi Watari, best known for playing the titular hero in Space Sheriff Sharivan.
extract_id: Emiko Shinohara, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Emi Shinohara, adalah aktris pengisi suara asal Jepang dari Prefektur Fukushima. Pada saat kematiannya, dia berafiliasi dengan 81 Produce. Dia paling dikenal sebagai pengisi suara Sailor Jupiter dalam adaptasi anime pertama Sailor Moon, Kaho Mizuki dalam Cardcaptor Sakura dan sekuelnya Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card, serta Kushina Uzumaki dalam Naruto: Shippuden. Dia menikah dengan aktor tokusatsu Hiroshi Watari, yang paling dikenal karena memerankan pahlawan utama dalam Space Sheriff Sharivan.

name: Emile Hirsch
title: Emile Hirsch
extract: Emile Davenport Hirsch is an American actor. His portrayal of Chris McCandless in Into the Wild (2007) earned him acclaim and multiple award nominations.
extract_id: Emile Davenport Hirsch adalah aktor Amerika. Perannya sebagai Chris McCandless dalam Into the Wild (2007) memberinya pujian dan berbagai nominasi penghargaan.

name: Emilia Fox
title: Emilia Fox
extract: Emilia Rose Elizabeth Fox is an English actress and presenter whose career is primarily in British television. Her feature film debut was in Roman Polanski's film The Pianist (2002). Her other motion pictures include the Italian–French–British romance-drama The Soul Keeper (2002), for which she won the Flaiano Film Award for Best Actress; the drama The Republic of Love (2003); the comedy-drama Things to Do Before You're 30 (2005); the black comedy Keeping Mum (2005); the romantic comedy-drama Cashback (2006); the drama Flashbacks of a Fool (2008); the drama Ways to Live Forever (2010); the drama-thriller A Thousand Kisses Deep (2011); and the fantasy-horror drama Dorian Gray (2009).
extract_id: Emilia Rose Elizabeth Fox adalah aktris dan presenter Inggris yang kariernya terutama di televisi Inggris. Debut film fiturnya adalah dalam film The Pianist (2002) karya Roman Polanski. Film lain yang dibintanginya termasuk drama romantis Italia-Prancis-Inggris The Soul Keeper (2002), yang memberinya penghargaan Flaiano Film Award untuk Aktris Terbaik; drama The Republic of Love (2003); komedi-drama Things to Do Before You're 30 (2005); komedi hitam Keeping Mum (2005); komedi-drama romantis Cashback (2006); drama Flashbacks of a Fool (2008); drama Ways to Live Forever (2010); thriller drama A Thousand Kisses Deep (2011); dan drama fantasi-horor Dorian Gray (2009).

name: Emilio Echevarría
title: Emilio Echevarría
extract: Emilio Antonio Echevarría Noriega was a Mexican actor.
extract_id: Emilio Antonio Echevarría Noriega adalah aktor Meksiko.

name: Emilio Estevez
title: Emilio Estevez
extract: Emilio Estevez is an American actor and filmmaker. The son of actor Martin Sheen and the older brother of Charlie Sheen, he made his film debut with an uncredited role in Badlands (1973). He later received his first credited appearance with a supporting role in the coming-of-age film Tex (1982).
extract_id: Emilio Estevez adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Putra aktor Martin Sheen dan kakak laki-laki Charlie Sheen, ia memulai debut filmnya dengan peran tanpa kredit dalam Badlands (1973). Dia kemudian menerima penampilan pertama yang diberi kredit dengan peran pendukung dalam film coming-of-age Tex (1982).

name: Emily Blunt
title: Emily Blunt
extract: Emily Olivia Laura Blunt is a British actress. She is the recipient of various accolades, including a Golden Globe Award and two Actor Awards, in addition to nominations for an Academy Award and four British Academy Film Awards. Forbes ranked her as one of the highest-paid actresses in the world in 2020.
extract_id: Emily Olivia Laura Blunt adalah aktris Inggris. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Golden Globe Award dan dua Actor Awards, selain nominasi Academy Award dan empat British Academy Film Awards. Forbes menempatkannya sebagai salah satu aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia pada tahun 2020.

name: Emily Mortimer
title: Emily Mortimer
extract: Emily Kathleen Anne Mortimer is an English actress and filmmaker. She began acting in stage productions and has since appeared in several film and television roles. In 2003, she won an Independent Spirit Award for her performance in Lovely and Amazing. She is also known for playing Mackenzie McHale in the HBO series The Newsroom (2012–2014). She co-created and co-wrote the series Doll & Em (2014–2015) and wrote and directed the miniseries The Pursuit of Love (2021), the latter of which earned her a nomination for the British Academy Television Award for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: Emily Kathleen Anne Mortimer adalah seorang aktris dan pembuat film asal Inggris. Dia memulai kariernya dengan berakting di produksi panggung dan sejak itu telah tampil dalam beberapa peran film dan televisi. Pada tahun 2003, dia memenangkan Independent Spirit Award atas penampilannya dalam Lovely and Amazing. Dia juga dikenal karena memerankan Mackenzie McHale dalam serial HBO The Newsroom (2012–2014). Dia ikut menciptakan dan menulis bersama serial Doll & Em (2014–2015) serta menulis dan menyutradarai miniseri The Pursuit of Love (2021), yang terakhir memberinya nominasi British Academy Television Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Emily Watson
title: Emily Watson
extract: Emily Margaret Watson is an English actress. She began her career on stage and joined the Royal Shakespeare Company in 1992. In 2002, she starred in productions of Twelfth Night and Uncle Vanya at the Donmar Warehouse, and was nominated for the Olivier Award for Best Actress for the latter. She was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actress for her debut film role as a newlywed in Lars von Trier's Breaking the Waves (1996) and for her portrayal of Jacqueline du Pré in Anand Tucker's Hilary and Jackie (1998).
extract_id: Emily Margaret Watson adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Dia memulai kariernya di panggung dan bergabung dengan Royal Shakespeare Company pada tahun 1992. Pada tahun 2002, dia membintangi produksi Twelfth Night dan Uncle Vanya di Donmar Warehouse, dan dinominasikan untuk Olivier Award untuk Aktris Terbaik atas peran yang terakhir. Dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik atas peran film debutnya sebagai pengantin baru dalam Breaking the Waves (1996) karya Lars von Trier dan atas perannya sebagai Jacqueline du Pré dalam Hilary and Jackie (1998) garapan Anand Tucker.

name: Emir Kusturica
title: Emir Kusturica
description: Serbian film director, writer, and musician (born 1954)
extract: Emir Kusturica is a Serbian film director, screenwriter, actor, film producer and musician. Kusturica has been an active filmmaker since the 1980s.
extract_id: Emir Kusturica adalah seorang sutradara film, penulis naskah, aktor, produser film, dan musisi asal Serbia. Kusturica telah aktif sebagai pembuat film sejak tahun 1980-an.

name: Emma Stone
title: Emma Stone
extract: Emily Jean "Emma" Stone is an American actress and film producer. Her accolades include two Academy Awards, two BAFTA Awards, two Golden Globe Awards and a Volpi Cup, as well as a nomination for a Primetime Emmy Award. In 2017, she was the world's highest-paid actress and named by Time magazine as one of the 100 most influential people in the world.
extract_id: Emily Jean "Emma" Stone adalah seorang aktris dan produser film Amerika. Prestasinya meliputi dua Academy Awards, dua BAFTA Awards, dua Golden Globe Awards, dan sebuah Volpi Cup, serta nominasi untuk Primetime Emmy Award. Pada tahun 2017, dia menjadi aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia dan dinobatkan oleh majalah Time sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia.

name: Emma Thompson
title: Emma Thompson
extract: Dame Emma Thompson is an English actress and screenwriter. Her work spans over four decades of screen and stage, and her accolades include two Academy Awards, three BAFTA Awards, two Golden Globe Awards, and a Primetime Emmy Award as well as a nomination for two Grammy Awards. In 2018, she was made a dame by Queen Elizabeth II for her contributions to drama.
extract_id: Dame Emma Thompson adalah seorang aktris dan penulis skenario Inggris. Karyanya mencakup lebih dari empat dekade di layar dan panggung, dan prestasinya termasuk dua Academy Awards, tiga BAFTA Awards, dua Golden Globe Awards, dan sebuah Primetime Emmy Award serta nominasi dua Grammy Awards. Pada tahun 2018, dia dianugerahi gelar dame oleh Ratu Elizabeth II atas kontribusinya dalam drama.

name: Emma Watson
title: Emma Watson
extract: Emma Charlotte Duerre Watson is an English actress. In the 2010s, she was ranked among the world's highest-paid actresses by Forbes and Vanity Fair, and was named one of the 100 most influential people in the world by Time magazine in 2015.
extract_id: Emma Charlotte Duerre Watson adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Pada dekade 2010-an, dia masuk dalam daftar aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia menurut Forbes dan Vanity Fair, serta dinamai sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia oleh majalah Time pada tahun 2015.

name: Emmanuelle Riva
title: Emmanuelle Riva
extract: Emmanuelle Riva was a French actress, best known for her roles in the films Hiroshima mon amour (1959) and Amour (2012).
extract_id: Emmanuelle Riva adalah seorang aktris Prancis, paling dikenal karena perannya dalam film Hiroshima mon amour (1959) dan Amour (2012).

name: Emmanuelle Seigner
title: Emmanuelle Seigner
extract: Emmanuelle Seigner is a French actress and singer. She is known for her roles in The Diving Bell and the Butterfly (2007), The Ninth Gate (1999) and Frantic (1988). She has been nominated for a César Award for Best Actress for Venus in Fur (2013), and for two César Awards for Best Supporting Actress in Place Vendôme (1998) and La Vie en Rose (2007). She has been married to Polish film director Roman Polanski since 1989.
extract_id: Emmanuelle Seigner adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Prancis. Dia dikenal karena perannya dalam The Diving Bell and the Butterfly (2007), The Ninth Gate (1999) dan Frantic (1988). Dia pernah dinominasikan untuk César Award untuk Aktris Terbaik atas Venus in Fur (2013), serta dua nominasi César Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik dalam Place Vendôme (1998) dan La Vie en Rose (2007). Dia menikah dengan sutradara film Polandia Roman Polanski sejak tahun 1989.

name: Emmy Rossum
title: Emmy Rossum
extract: Emmanuelle Grey Rossum is an American actress and singer. Her accolades include a Critics' Choice Award and a Saturn Award, in addition to nominations for a Golden Globe Award and an Independent Spirit Award.
extract_id: Emmanuelle Grey Rossum adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Amerika. Prestasinya meliputi Critics' Choice Award dan Saturn Award, selain nominasi untuk Golden Globe Award dan Independent Spirit Award.

name: Enrique Castillo
title: Enrique Castillo
extract: Enrique Castillo is an American actor, writer, director, and producer. He founded Four Brown Hats Entertainment (FBHE) and was a founding member of the Latino Theater Company.
extract_id: Enrique Castillo adalah seorang aktor, penulis, sutradara, dan produser Amerika. Dia mendirikan Four Brown Hats Entertainment (FBHE) dan merupakan anggota pendiri Latino Theater Company.

name: Enrique Rambal
title: Enrique Rambal
extract: Enrique Rambal was a Spanish-Mexican actor. He appeared in more than 60 films between 1952 and 1971. Enrique had married actresses Mercedes Borque and Lucy Gallardo.
extract_id: Enrique Rambal adalah seorang aktor Spanyol-Meksiko. Dia tampil dalam lebih dari 60 film antara tahun 1952 dan 1971. Enrique menikah dengan para aktris Mercedes Borque dan Lucy Gallardo.

name: Enzo Cannavale
title: Enzo Cannavale
extract: Vincenzo "Enzo" Cannavale was an Italian film actor. He appeared in more than 100 films since 1949, including Cinema Paradiso, which won the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film at the 62nd Academy Awards in 1990. He was awarded the Nastro d’Argento for Best Supporting Actor in 32 dicembre by Luciano De Crescenzo.
extract_id: Vincenzo "Enzo" Cannavale adalah seorang aktor film Italia. Dia tampil dalam lebih dari 100 film sejak tahun 1949, termasuk Cinema Paradiso, yang memenangkan Academy Award untuk Film Berbahasa Asing Terbaik pada Academy Awards ke-62 tahun 1990. Dia dianugerahi Nastro d’Argento untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam film 32 dicembre karya Luciano De Crescenzo.

name: Enzo Staiola
title: Enzo Staiola
extract: Enzo Staiola was an Italian actor, best known for playing, at the age of eight, the role of Bruno Ricci in Vittorio De Sica's neorealist 1948 film Bicycle Thieves. He appeared in several other films including, in 1954, the American-produced The Barefoot Contessa with Humphrey Bogart. As an adult he became a mathematics teacher and later also worked as a land registry clerk.
extract_id: Enzo Staiola adalah seorang aktor Italia, paling dikenal karena memerankan, pada usia delapan tahun, peran Bruno Ricci dalam film neorealis 1948 karya Vittorio De Sica, Bicycle Thieves. Dia tampil dalam beberapa film lain termasuk, pada tahun 1954, produksi Amerika The Barefoot Contessa bersama Humphrey Bogart. Sebagai orang dewasa, dia menjadi guru matematika dan kemudian juga bekerja sebagai petugas pendaftaran tanah.

name: Eric Bana
title: Eric Bana
extract: Eric Banadinovich, known professionally as Eric Bana, is an Australian actor and producer. He began his career in the sketch-comedy series Full Frontal before gaining notice in the comedy drama The Castle (1997) and the biographical crime film Chopper (2000) for which he won the AACTA Award for Best Actor in a Leading Role.
extract_id: Eric Banadinovich, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Eric Bana, adalah seorang aktor dan produser Australia. Dia memulai kariernya dalam seri komedi sketsa Full Frontal sebelum dikenal lewat drama komedi The Castle (1997) dan film biografi kriminal Chopper (2000) yang memberinya kemenangan AACTA Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Peran Utama.

name: Eric Bress
title: Eric Bress
extract: Eric Bress is an American screenwriter, film director and producer, best known for his work on the Final Destination series and The Butterfly Effect. He frequently collaborates with J. Mackye Gruber.
extract_id: Eric Bress adalah seorang penulis skenario, sutradara film, dan produser Amerika, paling dikenal untuk karyanya pada seri Final Destination dan The Butterfly Effect. Dia sering berkolaborasi dengan J. Mackye Gruber.

name: Eric Idle
title: Eric Idle
extract: Eric Idle is an English actor, comedian, songwriter, musician, screenwriter and playwright. He was a member of the British comedy group Monty Python and the parody rock band the Rutles. Idle studied English at Pembroke College, Cambridge, and joined Cambridge University Footlights. He has received a Grammy Award as well as nominations for two Tony Awards.
extract_id: Eric Idle adalah seorang aktor, pelawak, penulis lagu, musisi, penulis skenario, dan dramawan Inggris. Dia adalah anggota grup komedi Inggris Monty Python dan band parodi rock the Rutles. Idle belajar bahasa Inggris di Pembroke College, Cambridge, dan bergabung dengan Cambridge University Footlights. Dia telah menerima Grammy Award serta nominasi untuk dua Tony Awards.

name: Eric Radomski
title: Eric Radomski
extract: Eric Radomski is an American television producer, best known as a co-creator of Batman: The Animated Series. He has also acted as producer for Spawn: The Animated Series, Freakazoid!, Xiaolin Showdown, Shaggy & Scooby-Doo Get a Clue!, Ultimate Spider-Man, Avengers Assemble, Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. and Guardians of the Galaxy.
extract_id: Eric Radomski adalah produser televisi Amerika, paling dikenal sebagai salah satu pencipta Batman: The Animated Series. Dia juga berperan sebagai produser untuk Spawn: The Animated Series, Freakazoid!, Xiaolin Showdown, Shaggy & Scooby-Doo Get a Clue!, Ultimate Spider-Man, Avengers Assemble, Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H., dan Guardians of the Galaxy.

name: Eric Schweig
title: Eric Schweig
extract: Eric Schweig is a Canadian Inuvialuk actor perhaps best known for his role as Chingachgook's son Uncas in The Last of the Mohicans (1992) and the hitman Avanti in One Battle After Another (2025). Schweig has played in over 30 movies, including as Pike Dexter in the movie Big Eden (2000), for which he won the Outstanding Actor Award at the Outfest film festival.
extract_id: Eric Schweig adalah aktor Inuvialuk Kanada yang mungkin paling dikenal sebagai putra Chingachgook, Uncas, dalam The Last of the Mohicans (1992) dan pembunuh bayaran Avanti dalam One Battle After Another (2025). Schweig telah bermain dalam lebih dari 30 film, termasuk sebagai Pike Dexter dalam film Big Eden (2000), yang memberinya penghargaan Outstanding Actor Award di festival film Outfest.

name: Eric Sykes
title: Eric Sykes
extract: Eric Sykes was an English radio, stage, television and film writer, comedian, actor and director whose performing career spanned more than 50 years. He frequently wrote for and performed with many other leading comedy performers and writers of the period, including Tony Hancock, Spike Milligan, Tommy Cooper, Peter Sellers, John Antrobus and Johnny Speight. Sykes first came to prominence through his many radio credits as a writer and actor in the 1950s, which include collaboration on some scripts for The Goon Show. He became a television star in his own right in the early 1960s when he appeared with Hattie Jacques in several popular BBC comedy television series.
extract_id: Eric Sykes adalah seorang penulis radio, panggung, televisi, dan film Inggris, pelawak, aktor, dan sutradara dengan karier yang berlangsung lebih dari 50 tahun. Dia sering menulis dan tampil bersama banyak pelawak dan penulis terkemuka pada masanya, termasuk Tony Hancock, Spike Milligan, Tommy Cooper, Peter Sellers, John Antrobus, dan Johnny Speight. Sykes pertama kali dikenal melalui banyak kredit radio sebagai penulis dan aktor pada tahun 1950-an, termasuk kolaborasi pada beberapa naskah untuk The Goon Show. Dia menjadi bintang televisi pada awal 1960-an ketika tampil bersama Hattie Jacques dalam beberapa seri komedi BBC yang populer.

name: Erich von Stroheim
title: Erich von Stroheim
extract: Erich Oswald Hans Carl Maria von Stroheim was an Austrian-American director, screenwriter, actor and producer, most noted as a film star and avant-garde, visionary director of the silent era. His 1924 film Greed, originally over nine hours long, was edited against his wishes to about two-and-a-half hours; despite initial negative reception, the theatrical release is considered one of the greatest films ever made. After clashes with Hollywood studio bosses over budget and workers' rights problems, Stroheim found it difficult to find work as a director and subsequently became a well-respected character actor, particularly in French cinema. As an actor, he was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for his performance as Max von Mayerling in Sunset Boulevard (1950).
extract_id: Erich Oswald Hans Carl Maria von Stroheim adalah sutradara, penulis skenario, aktor, dan produser Austria-Amerika, yang paling terkenal sebagai bintang film dan sutradara visioner avant-garde pada era film bisu. Filmnya tahun 1924, Greed, yang awalnya berdurasi lebih dari sembilan jam, dipotong melawan keinginannya menjadi sekitar dua setengah jam; meskipun penerimaan awalnya negatif, rilis teatrikalnya dianggap sebagai salah satu film terbaik yang pernah dibuat. Setelah bentrokan dengan bos studio Hollywood mengenai anggaran dan masalah hak pekerja, Stroheim kesulitan mendapatkan pekerjaan sebagai sutradara dan kemudian menjadi aktor karakter yang dihormati, khususnya dalam sinema Prancis. Sebagai aktor, dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik atas perannya sebagai Max von Mayerling dalam Sunset Boulevard (1950).

name: Ericson Core
title: Ericson Core
extract: Ericson Core is an American cinematographer and film director.
extract_id: Ericson Core adalah seorang sinematografer dan sutradara film Amerika.

name: Ernest B. Schoedsack
title: Ernest B. Schoedsack
extract: Ernest Beaumont Schoedsack was an American motion picture cinematographer, producer, and director. Schoedsack worked as a cameraman in World War I, where he served in the U.S. Army Signal Corps. At the conclusion of the war, he stayed in Europe to further his career. He worked on several films with Merian C. Cooper including King Kong, Chang: A Drama of the Wilderness, and The Most Dangerous Game. He also collaborated with screenwriter Ruth Rose, whom he later married.
extract_id: Ernest Beaumont Schoedsack adalah seorang sinematografer, produser, dan sutradara film Amerika. Schoedsack bekerja sebagai kameramen dalam Perang Dunia I, di mana dia bertugas di Korps Sinyal Angkatan Darat AS. Setelah perang berakhir, dia tinggal di Eropa untuk mengembangkan kariernya. Dia bekerja dalam beberapa film bersama Merian C. Cooper termasuk King Kong, Chang: A Drama of the Wilderness, dan The Most Dangerous Game. Dia juga berkolaborasi dengan penulis skenario Ruth Rose, yang kemudian dinikahinya.

name: Ernest Borgnine
title: Ernest Borgnine
extract: Ernest Borgnine was an American actor whose career spanned over six decades. He was noted for his gruff but relaxed voice and gap-toothed Cheshire Cat grin. A popular performer, he appeared as a guest on numerous talk shows and as a panelist on several game shows.
extract_id: Ernest Borgnine adalah seorang aktor Amerika yang kariernya berlangsung lebih dari enam dekade. Dia dikenal karena suaranya yang serak namun santai dan senyum gap-toothed seperti Cheshire Cat. Sebagai seorang pemeran populer, ia tampil sebagai tamu di berbagai acara talk show dan sebagai panelis dalam beberapa acara permainan.

name: Ernst Jacobi
title: Ernst Jacobi
extract: Ernst Gerhard Ludwig Jacobi-Scherbening, professionally called Ernst Jacobi, was a German actor. He was known for serious character roles, especially in the 1979 film The Tin Drum, as Hans in Germany, Pale Mother (1980), as Adolf Hitler in Hamsun (1996), and as the narrator in The White Ribbon (2009). He appeared in over 200 television productions and worked at the Burgtheater in Vienna from 1977 to 1987, and at the Schauspielhaus Zürich from 1987 to 1992. In 1975 he won the Berliner Kunstpreis for his portrayal of Alexander März in the television film Das Leben des schizophrenen Dichters Alexander März.
extract_id: Ernst Gerhard Ludwig Jacobi-Scherbening, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Ernst Jacobi, adalah seorang aktor Jerman. Dia dikenal karena peran karakter serius, terutama dalam film The Tin Drum tahun 1979, sebagai Hans di film Jerman Pale Mother (1980), sebagai Adolf Hitler dalam Hamsun (1996), dan sebagai narator dalam The White Ribbon (2009). Dia tampil dalam lebih dari 200 produksi televisi dan bekerja di Burgtheater di Wina dari tahun 1977 hingga 1987, serta di Schauspielhaus Zürich dari tahun 1987 hingga 1992. Pada tahun 1975 dia memenangkan Berliner Kunstpreis atas perannya sebagai Alexander März dalam film televisi Das Leben des schizophrenen Dichters Alexander März.

name: Ernst Lubitsch
title: Ernst Lubitsch
extract: Ernst Lubitsch was a German and American film director, producer, writer, and actor. His urbane comedies of manners gave him the reputation of being Hollywood's most elegant and sophisticated director; as his prestige grew, his films were promoted as having "the Lubitsch touch". Among his best known works are Trouble in Paradise (1932), Design for Living (1933), Ninotchka (1939), The Shop Around the Corner (1940), To Be or Not to Be (1942) and Heaven Can Wait (1943).
extract_id: Ernst Lubitsch adalah seorang sutradara film, produser, penulis, dan aktor Jerman-Amerika. Komedi sopan santunnya memberinya reputasi sebagai sutradara Hollywood yang paling elegan dan canggih; seiring prestisenya meningkat, film-filmnya dipromosikan dengan sebutan "sentuhan Lubitsch". Di antara karya-karya terkenalnya adalah Trouble in Paradise (1932), Design for Living (1933), Ninotchka (1939), The Shop Around the Corner (1940), To Be or Not to Be (1942), dan Heaven Can Wait (1943).

name: Errol Flynn
title: Errol Flynn
extract: Errol Leslie Thomson Flynn was an Australian and American actor who achieved worldwide fame during the Golden Age of Hollywood. He was known for his romantic swashbuckler roles, frequent partnerships with Olivia de Havilland, and reputation for his womanising and hedonistic personal life.
extract_id: Errol Leslie Thomson Flynn adalah aktor Australia dan Amerika yang mencapai ketenaran dunia selama Masa Keemasan Hollywood. Dia dikenal karena peran romantis petualangannya, kemitraannya yang sering dengan Olivia de Havilland, dan reputasinya sebagai pemuja wanita serta kehidupan pribadinya yang hedonistik.

name: Erwin Connelly
title: Erwin Connelly
extract: Erwin Connelly was an American actor, known for his contributions to silent films during the 1920s. Before transitioning to a film career, Connelly was a prominent stage performer, particularly in vaudeville, where he performed alongside his wife, Jane Connelly, for seventeen years.
extract_id: Erwin Connelly adalah aktor Amerika, dikenal atas kontribusinya di film bisu selama tahun 1920-an. Sebelum beralih ke karier film, Connelly adalah pemain panggung terkemuka, terutama dalam vaudeville, di mana ia tampil bersama istrinya, Jane Connelly, selama tujuh belas tahun.

name: Ethan Coen
title: Ethan Coen
extract: Ethan Jesse Coen is an American filmmaker. Working alongside his brother Joel, he has directed, written, edited and produced many feature films, the most acclaimed of which include Blood Simple (1984), Raising Arizona (1987), Miller's Crossing (1990), Barton Fink (1991), Fargo (1996), The Big Lebowski (1998), O Brother, Where Art Thou? (2000), The Ladykillers (2004), No Country for Old Men (2007), Burn After Reading (2008), A Serious Man (2009), True Grit (2010), Inside Llewyn Davis (2013), Hail, Caesar! (2016) and The Ballad of Buster Scruggs (2018).
extract_id: Ethan Jesse Coen adalah pembuat film Amerika. Bekerja bersama saudaranya Joel, ia telah menyutradarai, menulis, mengedit, dan memproduksi banyak film fitur, yang paling diakui termasuk Blood Simple (1984), Raising Arizona (1987), Miller's Crossing (1990), Barton Fink (1991), Fargo (1996), The Big Lebowski (1998), O Brother, Where Art Thou? (2000), The Ladykillers (2004), No Country for Old Men (2007), Burn After Reading (2008), A Serious Man (2009), True Grit (2010), Inside Llewyn Davis (2013), Hail, Caesar! (2016) dan The Ballad of Buster Scruggs (2018).

name: Ethan Hawke
title: Ethan Hawke
extract: Ethan Green Hawke is an American actor, author, and filmmaker whose career on both stage and screen has spanned four decades. Known for his versatility across a range of roles and collaborations with director Richard Linklater, he has worked in both independent films and blockbusters. His accolades include a Daytime Emmy Award, in addition to nominations for five Academy Awards, two British Academy Film Awards, three Golden Globes, and a Tony Award.
extract_id: Ethan Green Hawke adalah aktor, penulis, dan pembuat film Amerika yang kariernya di panggung dan layar telah berlangsung selama empat dekade. Dikenal karena kemampuannya yang serbaguna dalam berbagai peran dan kolaborasi dengan sutradara Richard Linklater, ia telah bekerja di film independen dan blockbuster. Penghargaan yang didapatnya termasuk Daytime Emmy Award, selain nominasi untuk lima Academy Awards, dua British Academy Film Awards, tiga Golden Globes, dan Tony Award.

name: Eugene Silvain
title: Eugène Silvain
extract: Eugène-Charles-Joseph Silvain was a French stage actor, pensionnaire of the Comédie française, sociétaire then dean of the compagny from 1878 to 1928.
extract_id: Eugène-Charles-Joseph Silvain adalah aktor panggung Prancis, pensionnaire dari Comédie française, sociétaire kemudian dekan perusahaan dari tahun 1878 hingga 1928.

name: Eun-ju Lee
title: Lee Eun-ju
extract: Lee Eun-ju was a South Korean actress. She was best known for the films Oh! Soo-jung (2000), Bungee Jumping of Their Own (2001), Lovers' Concerto (2002), Taegukgi: The Brotherhood of War (2004) and The Scarlet Letter (2004) and for the television series KAIST (1999) and Phoenix (2004). Despite a brief career spanning six to eight years, she amassed a filmography of acclaimed performances, quickly becoming one of South Korea's most promising and celebrated young talents. Highly regarded by filmmakers, Lee was considered as a leading actress of the next generation of Chungmuro. Renowned for her emotional depth, versatile acting range and distinctively mysterious aura, she was one of the defining actresses of early-to-mid 2000s South Korean cinema and television. She died by suicide at age 24.
extract_id: Lee Eun-ju adalah aktris Korea Selatan. Dia paling dikenal untuk film-film Oh! Soo-jung (2000), Bungee Jumping of Their Own (2001), Lovers' Concerto (2002), Taegukgi: The Brotherhood of War (2004) dan The Scarlet Letter (2004) serta untuk seri televisi KAIST (1999) dan Phoenix (2004). Meskipun kariernya singkat selama enam hingga delapan tahun, dia mengumpulkan filmografi dengan penampilan yang diakui, dengan cepat menjadi salah satu talenta muda paling menjanjikan dan terkenal di Korea Selatan. Sangat dihormati oleh pembuat film, Lee dianggap sebagai aktris utama generasi berikutnya dari Chungmuro. Dikenal karena kedalaman emosinya, jangkauan akting yang serbaguna dan aura misterius yang khas, dia adalah salah satu aktris penentu dalam perfilman dan televisi Korea Selatan awal hingga pertengahan 2000-an. Dia meninggal karena bunuh diri pada usia 24 tahun.

name: Eva Green
title: Eva Green
extract: Eva Gaëlle Green is a French actress, known for starring in both major studio and independent productions, in which she often portrays eccentric, villainous, and complex characters. The daughter of actress Marlène Jobert, she began her career in theatre before making her film debut in Bernardo Bertolucci's The Dreamers (2003). She portrayed Sibylla, Queen of Jerusalem in Kingdom of Heaven (2005). The following year, she played Bond girl Vesper Lynd in the James Bond film Casino Royale (2006), for which she received the BAFTA Rising Star Award.
extract_id: Eva Gaëlle Green adalah aktris Prancis, dikenal karena membintangi produksi besar maupun independen, di mana dia sering memerankan karakter yang eksentrik, jahat, dan kompleks. Putri aktris Marlène Jobert, ia memulai kariernya di teater sebelum melakukan debut filmnya dalam The Dreamers (2003) karya Bernardo Bertolucci. Dia memerankan Sibylla, Ratu Yerusalem dalam Kingdom of Heaven (2005). Tahun berikutnya, dia berperan sebagai Bond girl Vesper Lynd dalam film James Bond Casino Royale (2006), yang memberinya BAFTA Rising Star Award.

name: Eva Marie Saint
title: Eva Marie Saint
extract: Eva Marie Saint was an American actress. In a career spanning seven decades, she received an Academy Award and a Primetime Emmy Award, as well as nominations for two BAFTAs and a Golden Globe. At the time of her death, Saint was one of the earliest and oldest living Academy Award winners and one of the last surviving stars from the Golden Age of Hollywood.
extract_id: Eva Marie Saint adalah aktris Amerika. Dalam karier yang berlangsung selama tujuh dekade, dia menerima Academy Award dan Primetime Emmy Award, serta nominasi untuk dua BAFTA dan satu Golden Globe. Pada saat kematiannya, Saint adalah salah satu pemenang Academy Award tertua dan awal yang masih hidup serta salah satu bintang terakhir dari Masa Keemasan Hollywood.

name: Evan McGuire
title: Evan McGuire
extract: Evan McGuire is an Irish voice actor.
extract_id: Evan McGuire adalah aktor suara Irlandia.

name: Evan Rachel Wood
title: Evan Rachel Wood
extract: Evan Rachel Wood is an American actress and singer. She is the recipient of a Critics' Choice Television Award as well as nominations for three Primetime Emmy Awards and three Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Evan Rachel Wood adalah aktris dan penyanyi Amerika. Dia menerima Critics' Choice Television Award serta nominasi untuk tiga Primetime Emmy Awards dan tiga Golden Globe Awards.

name: Evgeniy Zharikov
title: Evgeny Zharikov
extract: Evgeny Ilyich Zharikov, also spelt Yevgeniy Ilich Zharikov and variants, was a Soviet and Russian film actor. He was awarded the USSR State Prize in 1978, and the title People's Artist of the RSFSR in 1989.
extract_id: Evgeny Ilyich Zharikov, juga dieja Yevgeniy Ilich Zharikov dan variasi lainnya, adalah aktor film Soviet dan Rusia. Dia dianugerahi USSR State Prize pada tahun 1978, dan gelar People's Artist of the RSFSR pada tahun 1989.

name: Ewa Fröling
title: Ewa Fröling
extract: Ewa Fröling is a Swedish actress who was born in Stockholm. She is internationally most recognized for her leading parts in Gunnel Lindblom's Sally och friheten and Ingmar Bergman's Fanny and Alexander.
extract_id: Ewa Fröling adalah aktris Swedia yang lahir di Stockholm. Dia dikenal secara internasional untuk peran utamanya dalam Sally och friheten karya Gunnel Lindblom dan Fanny and Alexander karya Ingmar Bergman.

name: Ewan McGregor
title: Ewan McGregor
extract: Ewan Gordon McGregor is a Scottish actor and filmmaker. His accolades include a Golden Globe Award and a Primetime Emmy Award. In 2013, he was appointed Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) for his service to drama and charity.
extract_id: Ewan Gordon McGregor adalah aktor dan pembuat film Skotlandia. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk Golden Globe Award dan Primetime Emmy Award. Pada tahun 2013, dia diangkat sebagai Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) atas jasa-jasanya dalam drama dan amal.

name: Ewen Bremner
title: Ewen Bremner
extract: Ewen Bremner is a Scottish actor. His roles have included Shawn Nelson in Black Hawk Down, Julien in Julien Donkey-Boy and Daniel "Spud" Murphy in Trainspotting and its 2017 sequel T2 Trainspotting.
extract_id: Ewen Bremner adalah aktor Skotlandia. Perannya meliputi Shawn Nelson dalam Black Hawk Down, Julien dalam Julien Donkey-Boy, dan Daniel "Spud" Murphy dalam Trainspotting serta sekuelnya tahun 2017 T2 Trainspotting.

name: Ezra Miller
title: Ezra Miller
extract: Ezra Matthew Miller is an American actor. Their feature film debut was in Afterschool (2008), which they followed by starring in the dramas We Need to Talk About Kevin (2011) and The Perks of Being a Wallflower (2012).
extract_id: Ezra Matthew Miller adalah aktor Amerika. Debut film fitur mereka adalah dalam Afterschool (2008), yang diikuti dengan pemeran utama dalam drama We Need to Talk About Kevin (2011) dan The Perks of Being a Wallflower (2012).

name: F. Gary Gray
title: F. Gary Gray
extract: Felix Gary Gray is an American director and producer. Gray began his career as a director on numerous critically acclaimed and award-winning music videos, including "It Was a Good Day" by Ice Cube, "Natural Born Killaz" by Dr. Dre and Ice Cube, "Keep Their Heads Ringin'" by Dr. Dre, "Waterfalls" by TLC, and "Ms. Jackson" by Outkast.
extract_id: Felix Gary Gray adalah sutradara dan produser Amerika. Gray memulai kariernya sebagai sutradara dalam banyak video musik yang diakui secara kritis dan memenangkan penghargaan, termasuk "It Was a Good Day" oleh Ice Cube, "Natural Born Killaz" oleh Dr. Dre dan Ice Cube, "Keep Their Heads Ringin'" oleh Dr. Dre, "Waterfalls" oleh TLC, dan "Ms. Jackson" oleh Outkast.

name: F. Murray Abraham
title: F. Murray Abraham
extract: F. Murray Abraham is an American actor. Known for his roles on stage and screen, he has received an Academy Award and a Golden Globe Award as well as nominations for a BAFTA Award, four Emmy Awards, and a Grammy Award. He came to prominence for his portrayal of Antonio Salieri in the drama film Amadeus (1984) for which he won an Academy Award for Best Actor.
extract_id: F. Murray Abraham adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal untuk perannya di panggung dan layar, dia telah menerima Academy Award dan Golden Globe Award serta nominasi untuk BAFTA Award, empat Emmy Awards, dan Grammy Award. Dia menjadi terkenal karena perannya sebagai Antonio Salieri dalam film drama Amadeus (1984) yang membawanya memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktor Terbaik.

name: F.W. Murnau
title: F. W. Murnau
extract: Friedrich Wilhelm Murnau was a German film director, producer, and screenwriter. He is regarded as one of cinema's most influential filmmakers for his work in the silent era.
extract_id: Friedrich Wilhelm Murnau adalah sutradara film, produser, dan penulis skenario Jerman. Dia dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film paling berpengaruh dalam sejarah sinema untuk karyanya di era film bisu.

name: Fabián Bielinsky
title: Fabián Bielinsky
extract: Fabián Bielinsky was an Argentine film director and screenwriter. After years working in advertising and as an assistant director, he wrote and directed two features, the crime caper Nine Queens (2000) and the neo-noir The Aura (2005). Both won the Silver Condor awards for Best Film, Best Director and Best Original Screenplay from the Argentine Film Critics Association, and The Aura was Argentina's entry for the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film. Nine Queens was sold to some 30 countries and remade in Hollywood as Criminal (2004).
extract_id: Fabián Bielinsky adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film Argentina. Setelah bertahun-tahun bekerja di periklanan dan sebagai asisten sutradara, dia menulis dan menyutradarai dua fitur, film kejahatan Nine Queens (2000) dan neo-noir The Aura (2005). Keduanya meraih penghargaan Silver Condor untuk Film Terbaik, Sutradara Terbaik dan Skenario Asli Terbaik dari Asosiasi Kritikus Film Argentina, dan The Aura menjadi entri Argentina untuk Academy Award untuk Film Berbahasa Asing Terbaik. Nine Queens dijual ke sekitar 30 negara dan dibuat ulang di Hollywood sebagai Criminal (2004).

name: Famke Janssen
title: Famke Janssen
extract: Famke Beumer Janssen is a Dutch actress and former model acting in Hollywood. She played Xenia Onatopp in GoldenEye (1995), Jean Grey / Phoenix in the X-Men film series (2000–2014), and Lenore Mills in the Taken film trilogy (2008–2014). In 2008, she was appointed a Goodwill Ambassador for Integrity by the United Nations. She made her directorial debut with Bringing Up Bobby in 2011. She is also known for her roles in the Netflix original series Hemlock Grove (2013–2015), FX's Nip/Tuck (2003–2010), and ABC's How to Get Away with Murder (2015–2020). Janssen starred in the 2017 NBC crime thriller The Blacklist: Redemption. She starred in the Netflix Dutch crime series Amsterdam Empire (2025).
extract_id: Famke Beumer Janssen adalah aktris Belanda dan mantan model yang berakting di Hollywood. Dia memerankan Xenia Onatopp dalam GoldenEye (1995), Jean Grey / Phoenix dalam seri film X-Men (2000–2014), dan Lenore Mills dalam trilogi film Taken (2008–2014). Pada 2008, dia diangkat sebagai Duta Besar Goodwill untuk Integritas oleh Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa. Dia membuat debut penyutradaraannya dengan Bringing Up Bobby pada 2011. Dia juga dikenal untuk perannya dalam seri Netflix orisinal Hemlock Grove (2013–2015), FX's Nip/Tuck (2003–2010), dan ABC's How to Get Away with Murder (2015–2020). Janssen membintangi thriller kejahatan NBC tahun 2017 The Blacklist: Redemption. Dia membintangi seri kejahatan Belanda Netflix Amsterdam Empire (2025).

name: Farhan Akhtar
title: Farhan Akhtar
extract: Farhan Akhtar is an Indian actor, filmmaker and singer who works in Hindi films. Born to screenwriters Javed Akhtar and Honey Irani, he established the production company Excel Entertainment, along with Ritesh Sidhwani, in 1999.
extract_id: Farhan Akhtar adalah aktor, pembuat film, dan penyanyi India yang bekerja dalam film Hindi. Lahir dari pasangan penulis skenario Javed Akhtar dan Honey Irani, dia mendirikan perusahaan produksi Excel Entertainment, bersama Ritesh Sidhwani, pada tahun 1999.

name: Farida Jalal
title: Farida Jalal
extract: Farida Jalal is an Indian actress who has primarily worked in Hindi films. In a film career spanning almost sixty years, Jalal appeared in over 200 films. Best known for her character-driven roles in independent cinema and supporting work in mainstream Bollywood productions, Jalal has received such accolades as four Filmfare Awards and two Bengal Film Journalists Association Awards.
extract_id: Farida Jalal adalah aktris India yang sebagian besar bekerja dalam film Hindi. Dalam karier filmnya yang berlangsung hampir enam puluh tahun, Jalal tampil dalam lebih dari 200 film. Terkenal untuk peran-peran yang berfokus pada karakter dalam sinema independen dan kerja pendukung dalam produksi Bollywood arus utama, Jalal telah menerima penghargaan seperti empat Filmfare Awards dan dua Bengal Film Journalists Association Awards.

name: Farley Granger
title: Farley Granger
extract: Farley Earle Granger Jr. was an American actor. Granger was first noticed in a small stage production in Hollywood by a Goldwyn casting director, and given a significant role in The North Star (1943), a controversial film praising the Soviet Union at the height of World War II, but later condemned for its political position. Another war film, The Purple Heart (1944), followed, before Granger's naval service in Honolulu, in a unit that arranged troop entertainment in the Pacific. Here he made useful contacts, including Bob Hope, Betty Grable and Rita Hayworth. It was also where he began exploring his bisexuality, which he said he never felt any need to conceal.
extract_id: Farley Earle Granger Jr. adalah aktor Amerika. Granger pertama kali diperhatikan dalam produksi panggung kecil di Hollywood oleh sutradara casting Goldwyn, dan diberi peran penting dalam The North Star (1943), sebuah film kontroversial yang memuji Uni Soviet pada puncak Perang Dunia II, namun kemudian dikecam karena posisi politiknya. Film perang lainnya, The Purple Heart (1944), menyusul, sebelum Granger menjalani dinas angkatan laut di Honolulu, dalam unit yang mengatur hiburan untuk pasukan di Pasifik. Di sini ia menjalin kontak yang berguna, termasuk dengan Bob Hope, Betty Grable, dan Rita Hayworth. Di sinilah juga ia mulai mengeksplorasi biseksualitasnya, yang menurutnya tidak pernah merasa perlu untuk disembunyikan.

name: Fatih Akin
title: Fatih Akin
extract: Fatih Akin is a German and Turkish film director, screenwriter and producer. His films have won numerous awards and accolades, including the Golden Bear at the Berlin Film Festival for his film Head-On (2004), Best Screenplay at the Cannes Film Festival for his film The Edge of Heaven (2007), and the Golden Globe Award for Best Foreign Language Film for his film In the Fade (2017).
extract_id: Fatih Akin adalah sutradara, penulis skenario, dan produser film Jerman-Turki. Film-filmnya telah memenangkan banyak penghargaan dan pengakuan, termasuk Golden Bear di Festival Film Berlin untuk film Head-On (2004), Skenario Terbaik di Festival Film Cannes untuk film The Edge of Heaven (2007), dan Golden Globe Award untuk Film Berbahasa Asing Terbaik untuk film In the Fade (2017).

name: Fatima Sana Shaikh
title: Fatima Sana Shaikh
extract: Fatima Sana Shaikh is an Indian actress, who works in Hindi films. Shaikh started her career as a child artist in such films as Chachi 420 (1997) and One 2 Ka 4 (2001). In 2016, she portrayed wrestler Geeta Phogat in the biopic Dangal, which went on to become the highest-grossing Hindi film of all time. She has since starred in the streaming projects Ludo (2020), Ajeeb Daastaans (2021) and Modern Love Mumbai (2022), and portrayed Indira Gandhi in the biographical drama Sam Bahadur (2023). For her performance in Dhak Dhak (2023), she was nominated for the Filmfare Critics Award for Best Actress.
extract_id: Fatima Sana Shaikh adalah aktris India, yang bekerja dalam film Hindi. Shaikh memulai kariernya sebagai artis cilik dalam film-film seperti Chachi 420 (1997) dan One 2 Ka 4 (2001). Pada 2016, dia memerankan pegulat Geeta Phogat dalam biopik Dangal, yang menjadi film Hindi dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa. Dia sejak itu membintangi proyek streaming Ludo (2020), Ajeeb Daastaans (2021) dan Modern Love Mumbai (2022), serta memerankan Indira Gandhi dalam drama biografi Sam Bahadur (2023). Untuk penampilannya dalam Dhak Dhak (2023), dia dinominasikan untuk Filmfare Critics Award untuk Aktris Terbaik.

name: Fay Wray
title: Fay Wray
extract: Vina Fay Wray was a Canadian-American actress best known for starring as Ann Darrow in the 1933 film King Kong. Through an acting career that spanned nearly six decades, Wray attained international recognition as an actress in horror films.
extract_id: Vina Fay Wray adalah seorang aktris Kanada-Amerika yang paling dikenal karena membintangi sebagai Ann Darrow dalam film King Kong tahun 1933. Melalui karier akting yang berlangsung hampir enam dekade, Wray meraih pengakuan internasional sebagai aktris dalam film horor.

name: Faye Dunaway
title: Faye Dunaway
extract: Dorothy Faye Dunaway is an American actress. She is the recipient of many accolades, including an Academy Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, three Golden Globe Awards, and a BAFTA Award.
extract_id: Dorothy Faye Dunaway adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Primetime Emmy Award, tiga Golden Globe Awards, dan BAFTA Award.

name: Faye Wong
title: Faye Wong
extract: Faye Wong is a Hong Kong singer-songwriter and actress. Early in her career, she briefly used the stage name Shirley Wong (王靖雯). Born in Beijing, she moved to Hong Kong at the age of 18. Her debut album Shirley Wong, released in 1989, was in Cantonese and she broke through with the Cantopop song "Fragile Woman" in 1992. She established her style by blending alternative music with Chinese pop, and since the late 1990s has recorded primarily in her native Mandarin.
extract_id: Faye Wong adalah penyanyi-penulis lagu dan aktris Hong Kong. Pada awal kariernya, dia sempat menggunakan nama panggung Shirley Wong (王靖雯). Lahir di Beijing, ia pindah ke Hong Kong pada usia 18 tahun. Album debutnya Shirley Wong, yang dirilis pada tahun 1989, berbahasa Kanton dan dia mulai dikenal dengan lagu Cantopop "Fragile Woman" pada tahun 1992. Dia membentuk gayanya dengan menggabungkan musik alternatif dengan pop Tiongkok, dan sejak akhir 1990-an, dia merekam terutama dalam bahasa Mandarin aslinya.

name: Federico Fellini
title: Federico Fellini
extract: Federico Fellini was an Italian film director and screenwriter known for his distinctive style that blends fantasy and baroque images with earthiness. Recognized as one of the greatest and most influential filmmakers of all time, his films rank highly in critical polls such as that of Cahiers du Cinéma and Sight & Sound, which lists his 1963 film 8½ as the 10th-greatest film of all time.
extract_id: Federico Fellini adalah seorang sutradara film dan penulis skenario Italia yang dikenal dengan gaya khasnya yang memadukan fantasi dan citra barok dengan kesan alami. Diakui sebagai salah satu pembuat film terbesar dan paling berpengaruh sepanjang masa, film-filmnya menduduki peringkat tinggi dalam jajak pendapat kritis seperti Cahiers du Cinéma dan Sight & Sound, yang menempatkan filmnya tahun 1963 8½ sebagai film ke-10 terbaik sepanjang masa.

name: Fele Martínez
title: Fele Martínez
extract: Rafael "Fele" Martínez is a Spanish actor. He gained notoriety for his performance as Chema in Thesis (1996), his feature film debut and for which he won the Goya Award for Best New Actor.
extract_id: Rafael "Fele" Martínez adalah seorang aktor Spanyol. Dia menjadi terkenal karena penampilannya sebagai Chema dalam Thesis (1996), debut film fitur nya dan di mana ia memenangkan Goya Award untuk Aktor Baru Terbaik.

name: Felicity Jones
title: Felicity Jones
extract: Felicity Rose Hadley Jones is an English actress. She began acting as a child, appearing in The Treasure Seekers (1996) and playing Ethel Hallow for one series of the television series The Worst Witch (1998). She then starred in the Donmar Warehouse production of The Chalk Garden (2008).
extract_id: Felicity Rose Hadley Jones adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Dia mulai berakting sejak kecil, muncul dalam The Treasure Seekers (1996) dan memerankan Ethel Hallow dalam satu seri serial televisi The Worst Witch (1998). Dia kemudian membintangi produksi Donmar Warehouse dari The Chalk Garden (2008).

name: Felix Bressart
title: Felix Bressart
extract: Felix Bressart was a German-born actor of stage and screen whose career spanned both Europe and Hollywood.
extract_id: Felix Bressart adalah aktor kelahiran Jerman yang berkarier di panggung dan layar lebar yang kariernya membentang baik di Eropa maupun Hollywood.

name: Felix van Groeningen
title: Felix van Groeningen
extract: Felix van Groeningen is a Belgian film director and screenwriter. He is most known for the drama film The Broken Circle Breakdown (2012), for which he was nominated for Best International Feature Film at the 86th Academy Awards.
extract_id: Felix van Groeningen adalah seorang sutradara film dan penulis skenario Belgia. Dia paling dikenal untuk film drama The Broken Circle Breakdown (2012), yang mana dia dinominasikan untuk Film Fitur Internasional Terbaik di Academy Awards ke-86.

name: Fengyi Zhang
title: Zhang Fengyi
extract: Zhang Fengyi is a Chinese actor best known for his role as "Duan Xiaolou" in Farewell My Concubine (1993), Jing Ke in The Emperor and the Assassin (1998), and Cao Cao in Red Cliff (2008–2009).
extract_id: Zhang Fengyi adalah seorang aktor Tiongkok yang paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai "Duan Xiaolou" dalam Farewell My Concubine (1993), Jing Ke dalam The Emperor and the Assassin (1998), dan Cao Cao dalam Red Cliff (2008–2009).

name: Ferdia Walsh-Peelo
title: Ferdia Walsh-Peelo
extract: Ferdia Walsh-Peelo is an Irish actor and musician. He made his film debut in the musical Sing Street (2016) and television debut in the History series Vikings (2017–2020). He has since appeared in the films Here Are the Young Men (2020) and CODA (2021).
extract_id: Ferdia Walsh-Peelo adalah aktor dan musisi Irlandia. Dia membuat debut filmnya dalam musikal Sing Street (2016) dan debut televisi dalam serial History Vikings (2017–2020). Sejak itu dia muncul dalam film Here Are the Young Men (2020) dan CODA (2021).

name: Fernanda Montenegro
title: Fernanda Montenegro
extract: Arlette Pinheiro Monteiro Torres, known by her stage name Fernanda Montenegro, is a Brazilian actress. Considered by many as the greatest Brazilian actress of all time, she is often referred to as the grande dame of Brazilian theater, cinema, and performing arts. For her work in Central Station (1998), she became the first Brazilian and first Latin American to be nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actress, as well as the first actress nominated for an Academy Award for a performance in a Portuguese language film. Her daughter, actress Fernanda Torres, was also nominated in 2025. Additionally, she became the first Brazilian to win the Emmy Award for Best Actress, for her performance in Sweet Mother (2014).
extract_id: Arlette Pinheiro Monteiro Torres, yang dikenal dengan nama panggung Fernanda Montenegro, adalah seorang aktris Brasil. Dianggap oleh banyak orang sebagai aktris Brasil terbesar sepanjang masa, ia sering disebut sebagai grande dame teater, sinema, dan seni pertunjukan Brasil. Untuk karyanya dalam Central Station (1998), dia menjadi orang Brasil dan Amerika Latin pertama yang dinominasikan untuk Academy Award sebagai Aktris Terbaik, serta aktris pertama yang dinominasikan untuk Academy Award atas penampilan dalam film berbahasa Portugis. Putrinya, aktris Fernanda Torres, juga dinominasikan pada tahun 2025. Selain itu, ia menjadi orang Brasil pertama yang memenangkan Emmy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik, untuk penampilannya dalam Sweet Mother (2014).

name: Fernando Meirelles
title: Fernando Meirelles
extract: Fernando Ferreira Meirelles is a Brazilian filmmaker. He is best known for co-directing the film City of God, released in 2002 in Brazil and in 2003 in the U.S. by Miramax Films, which received international critical acclaim. For his work in the film, he was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Director. He was also nominated for a Golden Globe Award for Best Director in 2005 for The Constant Gardener, which garnered the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for Rachel Weisz. He also directed the 2008 adaptation of José Saramago's novel Blindness, and the 2011 film 360. In 2019, Meirelles directed The Two Popes for Netflix.
extract_id: Fernando Ferreira Meirelles adalah pembuat film Brasil. Dia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai bersama film City of God, yang dirilis pada 2002 di Brasil dan 2003 di AS oleh Miramax Films, yang mendapat pujian kritis internasional. Untuk karyanya dalam film tersebut, ia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award sebagai Sutradara Terbaik. Ia juga dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award sebagai Sutradara Terbaik pada 2005 untuk The Constant Gardener, yang mendapatkan Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik untuk Rachel Weisz. Ia juga menyutradarai adaptasi novel José Saramago Blindness pada 2008, dan film 360 pada 2011. Pada 2019, Meirelles menyutradarai The Two Popes untuk Netflix.

name: Fernando Rey
title: Fernando Rey
extract: Fernando Casado Arambillet, best known as Fernando Rey, was a Spanish actor of film, theatre, and televisionwho worked in both Europe and the United States. Known for his suave image, Rey was best-known for his roles in the films of surrealist director Luis Buñuel and as the drug lord Alain Charnier in The French Connection (1971) and French Connection II (1975). He appeared in more than 150 films over half a century.
extract_id: Fernando Casado Arambillet, yang lebih dikenal sebagai Fernando Rey, adalah aktor Spanyol di film, teater, dan televisi yang bekerja di Eropa dan Amerika Serikat. Dikenal karena citra penuh gaya, Rey paling dikenal untuk perannya dalam film-film sutradara surealis Luis Buñuel dan sebagai bos narkoba Alain Charnier dalam The French Connection (1971) dan French Connection II (1975). Ia tampil dalam lebih dari 150 film selama setengah abad.

name: Fikret Kuskan
title: Fikret Kuşkan
extract: Mehmet Fikret Kuşkan is a Turkish actor.
extract_id: Mehmet Fikret Kuşkan adalah aktor Turki.

name: Filip Berg
title: Filip Berg
extract: Filip Niclas Berg is a Swedish actor who became known to international audiences for his roles Sebbe in the movies The Ketchup Effect and A Man Called Ove, which was nominated for best foreign-language film at the Academy Awards. He also had a leading role in both series of the TV drama, Black Lake.
extract_id: Filip Niclas Berg adalah aktor Swedia yang dikenal oleh audiens internasional karena perannya sebagai Sebbe dalam film The Ketchup Effect dan A Man Called Ove, yang dinominasikan untuk film berbahasa asing terbaik di Academy Awards. Dia juga memegang peran utama dalam kedua seri drama TV Black Lake.

name: Filip Sovagovic
title: Filip Šovagović
description: Croatian actor, film director, comedian, playwright and journalist
extract: Filip Šovagović is a Croatian actor, film director, comedian, playwright and journalist. At first known simply as the son of renowned actor Fabijan Šovagović, he has established himself as one of the most prolific Croatian actors of the 21st century.
extract_id: Filip Šovagović adalah aktor Kroasia, sutradara film, pelawak, dramawan, dan jurnalis. Awalnya dikenal hanya sebagai putra aktor terkenal Fabijan Šovagović, dia telah memantapkan dirinya sebagai salah satu aktor Kroasia paling produktif di abad ke-21.

name: Filipp Yankovskiy
title: Filipp Yankovsky
extract: Filipp Olegovich Yankovsky is a Russian actor and film director. He was born on 10 October 1968 to actor Oleg Yankovsky.
extract_id: Filipp Olegovich Yankovsky adalah aktor dan sutradara film Rusia. Ia lahir pada 10 Oktober 1968 dari aktor Oleg Yankovsky.

name: Fionn Whitehead
title: Fionn Whitehead
extract: Fionn Whitehead is an English actor. He portrayed the lead role in the 2017 film Dunkirk and the 2018 film Black Mirror: Bandersnatch. His first acting credit was in the 2016 ITV miniseries Him.
extract_id: Fionn Whitehead adalah aktor Inggris. Dia memerankan peran utama dalam film Dunkirk tahun 2017 dan film Black Mirror: Bandersnatch tahun 2018. Kredit akting pertamanya adalah di miniseri ITV Him tahun 2016.

name: Fionnula Flanagan
title: Fionnula Flanagan
extract: Fionnghuala Manon "Fionnula" Flanagan is an Irish actress. Flanagan is best known for her roles in the films James Joyce's Women (1985), Some Mother's Son (1996), Waking Ned (1998), The Others (2001), Four Brothers (2005), Yes Man (2008), The Guard (2011) and Song of the Sea (2014). She is also known for her recurring role as Eloise Hawking in the series Lost (2007–2010). Notable stage productions she has performed in include Ulysses in Nighttown and The Ferryman, both of which earned her Tony Award nominations for Best Featured Actress in a Play.
extract_id: Fionnghuala Manon "Fionnula" Flanagan adalah aktris Irlandia. Flanagan paling dikenal karena perannya dalam film James Joyce's Women (1985), Some Mother's Son (1996), Waking Ned (1998), The Others (2001), Four Brothers (2005), Yes Man (2008), The Guard (2011), dan Song of the Sea (2014). Dia juga dikenal karena peran berulangnya sebagai Eloise Hawking dalam serial Lost (2007–2010). Produksi panggung penting yang pernah ia lakoni termasuk Ulysses in Nighttown dan The Ferryman, keduanya memberinya nominasi Tony Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik dalam Drama.

name: Florence Lee
title: Florence Lee (born 1888)
extract: Florence Lee was an American actress of the silent era, who appeared in 22 films between 1921 and 1929. She was married to Canadian-American actor, director, and writer Dell Henderson and played in many films that he directed.
extract_id: Florence Lee adalah aktris Amerika era film bisu, yang muncul dalam 22 film antara tahun 1921 dan 1929. Dia menikah dengan aktor, sutradara, dan penulis Kanada-Amerika Dell Henderson dan bermain di banyak film yang disutradarainya.

name: Florence Pugh
title: Florence Pugh
extract: Florence Pugh is an English actress. Her accolades include a British Independent Film Award, in addition to nominations for an Academy Award and three BAFTA Awards.
extract_id: Florence Pugh adalah aktris Inggris. Penghargaannya termasuk British Independent Film Award, selain nominasi Academy Award dan tiga BAFTA Awards.

name: Florian Henckel von Donnersmarck
title: Florian Henckel von Donnersmarck
extract: Florian Maria Georg Christian Graf Henckel von Donnersmarck is a German-Austrian film director. He is best known for writing and directing the 2006 dramatic thriller Das Leben der Anderen , which won the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film. He also wrote and directed the 2010 romantic thriller The Tourist starring Angelina Jolie and Johnny Depp, and the 2018 epic drama Never Look Away.
extract_id: Florian Maria Georg Christian Graf Henckel von Donnersmarck adalah sutradara film Jerman-Austria. Ia paling dikenal karena menulis dan menyutradarai thriller drama 2006 Das Leben der Anderen, yang memenangkan Academy Award untuk Film Berbahasa Asing Terbaik. Ia juga menulis dan menyutradarai thriller romantis 2010 The Tourist yang dibintangi Angelina Jolie dan Johnny Depp, serta drama epik 2018 Never Look Away.

name: Florian Lukas
title: Florian Lukas
extract: Florian Lukas is a German actor from Berlin. He has appeared in series and films, and regularly in TV episodes of Tatort. He is also an audiobook narrator. He had his breakthrough as an actor in 2003 as Denis in Good Bye, Lenin!.
extract_id: Florian Lukas adalah aktor Jerman dari Berlin. Ia telah tampil dalam serial dan film, serta secara rutin dalam episode TV Tatort. Ia juga seorang narator buku audio. Kariernya sebagai aktor melejit pada tahun 2003 sebagai Denis dalam Good Bye, Lenin!.

name: Folco Lulli
title: Folco Lulli
extract: Folco Lulli was an Italian partisan and film actor. He appeared in more than 100 films between 1946 and 1970.
extract_id: Folco Lulli adalah seorang partisan dan aktor film Italia. Ia tampil dalam lebih dari 100 film antara tahun 1946 dan 1970.

name: Forest Whitaker
title: Forest Whitaker
extract: Forest Steven Whitaker III is an American actor, filmmaker, and activist. His accolades include an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, a British Academy Film Award, two Screen Actors Guild Awards, the Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Actor and the Honorary Palme d'Or.
extract_id: Forest Steven Whitaker III adalah aktor Amerika, pembuat film, dan aktivis. Penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, British Academy Film Award, dua Screen Actors Guild Awards, Cannes Film Festival Award untuk Aktor Terbaik, dan Honorary Palme d'Or.

name: Franca Marzi
title: Franca Marzi
extract: Franca Marzi was an Italian film actress. She appeared in 80 films between 1943 and 1977.
extract_id: Franca Marzi adalah seorang aktris film Italia. Dia tampil dalam 80 film antara tahun 1943 dan 1977.

name: Frances Conroy
title: Frances Conroy
extract: Frances Hardman Conroy is an American actress. She is best known for playing Ruth Fisher on the television series Six Feet Under (2001–2005), for which she won a Golden Globe and three Screen Actors Guild Awards, and received four Primetime Emmy Awards nominations for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series. She is also known for playing the older version of Moira O'Hara in season one of the television anthology series American Horror Story, which garnered Conroy her first Saturn Award for Best Supporting Actress on Television nomination, and as well a Primetime Emmy Awards nomination for Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Miniseries or a Movie. Conroy subsequently portrayed The Angel of Death, Myrtle Snow, Gloria Mott, Mama Polk, Bebe Babbitt, and Belle Noir on eight further seasons of the show: Asylum, Coven, Freak Show, Roanoke, Cult, Apocalypse, Double Feature and 13, respectively; this makes Conroy, along with Lily Rabe, fourth among the actors who have appeared in most seasons of the show. For her performance in Coven, she was nominated again for a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Miniseries or a Movie.
extract_id: Frances Hardman Conroy adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan Ruth Fisher dalam serial televisi Six Feet Under (2001–2005), yang membuatnya memenangkan Golden Globe dan tiga Screen Actors Guild Awards, serta menerima empat nominasi Primetime Emmy Awards untuk Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series. Dia juga dikenal karena memerankan versi dewasa Moira O'Hara dalam musim pertama serial antologi televisi American Horror Story, yang memberinya nominasi Saturn Award pertama untuk Best Supporting Actress on Television, serta nominasi Primetime Emmy Awards untuk Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Miniseries or a Movie. Selanjutnya Conroy memerankan The Angel of Death, Myrtle Snow, Gloria Mott, Mama Polk, Bebe Babbitt, dan Belle Noir dalam delapan musim lainnya dari acara tersebut: Asylum, Coven, Freak Show, Roanoke, Cult, Apocalypse, Double Feature, dan 13; ini menjadikan Conroy, bersama dengan Lily Rabe, berada di posisi keempat di antara aktor yang tampil di sebagian besar musim acara tersebut. Untuk penampilannya di Coven, dia kembali dinominasikan untuk Primetime Emmy Award untuk Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Miniseries or a Movie.

name: Frances McDormand
title: Frances McDormand
extract: Frances Louise McDormand is an American actress and film producer. In a career spanning over four decades, McDormand has received numerous accolades, including four Academy Awards, two Primetime Emmy Awards, and a Tony Award, making her one of the few performers to achieve the "Triple Crown of Acting". Additionally, she has received three British Academy Film Awards, two Golden Globe Awards and four Actor Awards. Recognized for her roles in small-budget independent films, McDormand's worldwide box office gross exceeds $2.2 billion.
extract_id: Frances Louise McDormand adalah seorang aktris dan produser film Amerika. Dalam karier yang berlangsung lebih dari empat dekade, McDormand telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk empat Academy Awards, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan satu Tony Award, menjadikannya salah satu dari sedikit pemeran yang meraih "Triple Crown of Acting". Selain itu, dia juga menerima tiga British Academy Film Awards, dua Golden Globe Awards, dan empat Actor Awards. Dikenal karena perannya dalam film-film independen beranggaran kecil, pendapatan box office global McDormand melebihi $2,2 miliar.

name: Frances Sternhagen
title: Frances Sternhagen
extract: Frances Hussey Sternhagen was an American actress. She was known as a character actress who appeared on- and off-Broadway, in movies, and on television for over six decades. Sternhagen received numerous accolades, including two Tony Awards, a Drama Desk Award, and a Saturn Award, as well as nominations for three Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Frances Hussey Sternhagen adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia dikenal sebagai aktris karakter yang tampil di atas dan di luar Broadway, di film, dan televisi selama lebih dari enam dekade. Sternhagen menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk dua Tony Awards, Drama Desk Award, dan Saturn Award, serta nominasi untuk tiga Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Francine Racette
title: Francine Racette
extract: Francine Racette is a retired Canadian actress. She is best known for her performances in Au revoir les enfants, Lumière and The Disappearance. She was the third wife of actor Donald Sutherland until his death in 2024 and mother of three of his sons: actor Rossif Sutherland, actor Angus Sutherland, and Roeg Sutherland
