extract_id: Francine Racette adalah seorang aktris Kanada yang telah pensiun. Dia paling dikenal karena penampilannya dalam Au revoir les enfants, Lumière, dan The Disappearance. Dia adalah istri ketiga dari aktor Donald Sutherland sampai kematiannya pada tahun 2024 dan ibu dari tiga anak laki-lakinya: aktor Rossif Sutherland, aktor Angus Sutherland, dan Roeg Sutherland.

name: Francis Capra
title: Francis Capra
extract: Francis Cordero Capra is an American actor. He has played the roles of Max Connor in Kazaam and Eli "Weevil" Navarro in the TV series Veronica Mars.
extract_id: Francis Cordero Capra adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia telah memerankan tokoh Max Connor dalam Kazaam dan Eli "Weevil" Navarro dalam serial TV Veronica Mars.

name: Francis Ford Coppola
title: Francis Ford Coppola
extract: Francis Ford Coppola is an American filmmaker. One of the leading figures of the New Hollywood, Coppola is widely regarded as one of the greatest and most influential filmmakers in the history of cinema. He has received various accolades including five Academy Awards, a BAFTA Award, three Golden Globe Awards, and two Palmes d'Or, as well as nominations for two Emmy Awards and a Grammy Award. Coppola was also honored with the Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award in 2010, the Kennedy Center Honors in 2024, and the AFI Life Achievement Award in 2025. Four of his films have been inducted into the National Film Registry by the Library of Congress.
extract_id: Francis Ford Coppola adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika. Salah satu tokoh terkemuka dari New Hollywood, Coppola secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film terbesar dan paling berpengaruh dalam sejarah perfilman. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk lima Academy Awards, satu BAFTA Award, tiga Golden Globe Awards, dan dua Palmes d'Or, serta nominasi untuk dua Emmy Awards dan satu Grammy Award. Coppola juga dihormati dengan Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award pada tahun 2010, Kennedy Center Honors pada tahun 2024, dan AFI Life Achievement Award pada tahun 2025. Empat filmnya telah dimasukkan ke dalam National Film Registry oleh Library of Congress.

name: Francis Huster
title: Francis Huster
extract: Francis Huster is a French stage, film and television actor, director and scriptwriter.
extract_id: Francis Huster adalah seorang aktor, sutradara, dan penulis naskah asal Prancis untuk panggung, film, dan televisi.

name: Francis Lee
title: Francis Lee (director)
extract: Francis Lee is an English filmmaker known for his debut feature film, God's Own Country (2017), which won the World Cinema Directing Award at the 2017 Sundance Film, and subsequent film, Ammonite (2020).
extract_id: Francis Lee adalah seorang pembuat film Inggris yang dikenal karena film fitur debutnya, God's Own Country (2017), yang memenangkan World Cinema Directing Award di Sundance Film Festival 2017, dan film berikutnya, Ammonite (2020).

name: Francis Veber
title: Francis Veber
description: French director, screenwriter, producer, and playwright
extract: Francis Paul Veber is a French film director, screenwriter and producer, and playwright. He has written and directed both French and American films. Nine French-language films with which he has been involved, as either writer or director or both, have been remade as English-language Hollywood films: Le grand blond avec une chaussure noire, L'emmerdeur, La Cage aux Folles, Le Jouet, Les Compères, La chèvre, Les Fugitifs, Le dîner de cons and La Doublure. He also wrote the screenplay for My Father the Hero, the 1994 American remake of the French-language film Mon père, ce héros.
extract_id: Francis Paul Veber adalah seorang sutradara film, penulis skenario dan produser asal Prancis, serta dramawan. Dia telah menulis dan menyutradarai film-film Prancis dan Amerika. Sembilan film berbahasa Prancis yang dia terlibat, baik sebagai penulis, sutradara, atau keduanya, telah dibuat ulang menjadi film Hollywood berbahasa Inggris: Le grand blond avec une chaussure noire, L'emmerdeur, La Cage aux Folles, Le Jouet, Les Compères, La chèvre, Les Fugitifs, Le dîner de cons, dan La Doublure. Dia juga menulis skenario untuk My Father the Hero, film remake Amerika tahun 1994 dari film berbahasa Prancis Mon père, ce héros.

name: Frank Capra
title: Frank Capra
extract: Frank Russell Capra was an Italian-born American film director, producer, and screenwriter who was the creative force behind several major award-winning films of the 1930s and 1940s. Born in Italy and raised in Los Angeles from the age of five, his rags-to-riches story has led film historians such as Ian Freer to consider him the "American Dream personified".
extract_id: Frank Russell Capra adalah seorang sutradara film, produser, dan penulis skenario Amerika kelahiran Italia yang merupakan kekuatan kreatif di balik sejumlah film besar pemenang penghargaan pada tahun 1930-an dan 1940-an. Lahir di Italia dan dibesarkan di Los Angeles sejak usia lima tahun, kisah dari kemiskinan hingga kekayaan Capra membuat sejarawan film seperti Ian Freer menganggapnya sebagai "personifikasi American Dream".

name: Frank Darabont
title: Frank Darabont
extract: Frank Árpád Darabont is an American screenwriter, director, and producer. He has been nominated for three Academy Awards and a Golden Globe Award.
extract_id: Frank Árpád Darabont adalah seorang penulis naskah, sutradara, dan produser Amerika. Dia telah dinominasikan untuk tiga Academy Awards dan satu Golden Globe Award.

name: Frank Finlay
title: Frank Finlay
extract: Francis Finlay was an English actor. He earned an Academy Award nomination for his performance as Iago in Othello (1965). His first leading television role came in 1971 in Casanova. This led to appearances on The Morecambe and Wise Show. Finlay starred alongside famous Italian actress Stefania Sandrelli in Tinto Brass' The Key, the most successful Italian film of the 1983–1984 season. He also appeared in the drama Bouquet of Barbed Wire. A four-time BAFTA nominee, Finlay won one for his television performances in 1974.
extract_id: Francis Finlay adalah seorang aktor Inggris. Dia memperoleh nominasi Academy Award untuk penampilannya sebagai Iago dalam Othello (1965). Peran drama televisi pertamanya datang pada tahun 1971 dalam Casanova. Ini membawanya tampil dalam The Morecambe and Wise Show. Finlay membintangi bersama aktris Italia terkenal Stefania Sandrelli dalam film karya Tinto Brass, The Key, yang menjadi film Italia terlaris musim 1983–1984. Dia juga muncul dalam drama Bouquet of Barbed Wire. Sebagai nomine BAFTA sebanyak empat kali, Finlay memenangkan salah satunya untuk penampilannya di televisi pada tahun 1974.

name: Frank Giering
title: Frank Giering
extract: Frank Giering was a German actor.
extract_id: Frank Giering adalah seorang aktor Jerman.

name: Frank Langella
title: Frank Langella
extract: Frank Alexander Langella Jr. is an American actor. He has received numerous accolades, including four Tony Awards and an Actor Award, in addition to nominations for an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, and two Golden Globes.
extract_id: Frank Alexander Langella Jr. adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk empat Tony Awards dan satu Actor Award, selain nominasi untuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dan dua Golden Globes.

name: Frank Lovejoy
title: Frank Lovejoy
extract: Frank Andrew Lovejoy Jr. was an American actor in radio, film, and television. He is perhaps best remembered for appearing in the film noir The Hitch-Hiker and for starring in the radio drama Night Beat.
extract_id: Frank Andrew Lovejoy Jr. adalah seorang aktor Amerika yang berperan di radio, film, dan televisi. Dia mungkin paling diingat karena tampil dalam film noir The Hitch-Hiker dan membintangi drama radio Night Beat.

name: Frank Miller
title: Frank Miller
extract: Frank Miller is an American comic book creator, screenwriter, and director known for his comic book stories and graphic novels. He wrote Daredevil from 1979 to 1983, and again in 1986, with the Daredevil: Born Again arc. For Daredevil, he created the femme fatale Elektra and the ninja villains the Hand. Subsequently, he wrote influential Batman stories: The Dark Knight Returns (1986) and Batman: Year One (1987). He also wrote creator-owned series outside the major superhero franchises: Ronin (1983-1984), Sin City (1991-1992), and 300 (1998).
extract_id: Frank Miller adalah seorang pencipta buku komik, penulis skenario, dan sutradara Amerika yang dikenal atas cerita dan novel grafis bukunya. Dia menulis Daredevil dari tahun 1979 hingga 1983, dan kembali pada 1986 dengan arc Daredevil: Born Again. Untuk Daredevil, dia menciptakan femme fatale Elektra dan penjahat ninja the Hand. Selanjutnya dia menulis cerita Batman yang berpengaruh: The Dark Knight Returns (1986) dan Batman: Year One (1987). Dia juga menulis seri miliknya sendiri di luar waralaba superhero besar: Ronin (1983-1984), Sin City (1991-1992), dan 300 (1998).

name: Frank Morgan
title: Frank Morgan
extract: Francis Phillip Wuppermann, known professionally as Frank Morgan, was an American character actor. He was best known for his appearances in films starting in the silent era in 1916, and then numerous sound films throughout the 1930s and 1940s, with a career spanning 35 years mostly as a contract player at Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer. He was also briefly billed early in his career as Frank Wupperman and Francis Morgan.
extract_id: Francis Phillip Wuppermann, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Frank Morgan, adalah seorang aktor karakter Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena penampilannya dalam film-film mulai era bisu pada tahun 1916, dan kemudian banyak film bersuara sepanjang tahun 1930-an dan 1940-an, dengan karier selama 35 tahun sebagian besar sebagai pemain kontrak di Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer. Dia juga sempat menggunakan nama panggung Frank Wupperman dan Francis Morgan pada awal kariernya.

name: Frank Overton
title: Frank Overton
extract: Frank Emmons Overton was an American actor. He was best known for the roles of Major Harvey Stovall in 12 O'Clock High (1964–1967), Sheriff Heck Tate in To Kill a Mockingbird (1962), and General Bogan in Fail Safe (1964).
extract_id: Frank Emmons Overton adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena peran Major Harvey Stovall dalam 12 O'Clock High (1964–1967), Sheriff Heck Tate dalam To Kill a Mockingbird (1962), dan General Bogan dalam Fail Safe (1964).

name: Frank Oz
title: Frank Oz
extract: Frank Richard Oznowicz, known professionally as Frank Oz, is an American puppeteer, filmmaker, and actor. He is best known for his involvement with Jim Henson and George Lucas through The Muppets, Sesame Street, and the Star Wars, as well as his directorial work in feature films and theater.
extract_id: Frank Richard Oznowicz, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Frank Oz, adalah seorang dalang, pembuat film, dan aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal atas keterlibatannya dengan Jim Henson dan George Lucas melalui The Muppets, Sesame Street, dan Star Wars, serta karya penyutradaraannya dalam film layar lebar dan teater.

name: Frank Paur
title: Frank Paur
extract: Frank Paur is an American television director of animated cartoons and storyboard artist. He is best known for his work on Batman: The Animated Series, the Disney animated series Gargoyles, X-Men: Evolution, and The Avengers: Earth's Mightiest Heroes.
extract_id: Frank Paur adalah seorang sutradara televisi Amerika untuk kartun animasi dan artis storyboard. Dia paling dikenal atas karyanya pada Batman: The Animated Series, serial animasi Disney Gargoyles, X-Men: Evolution, dan The Avengers: Earth's Mightiest Heroes.

name: Frank Sinatra
title: Frank Sinatra
extract: Francis Albert Sinatra was an American singer, conductor, and actor. Nicknamed the "Chairman of the Board" and "Ol' Blue Eyes", he is regarded as one of the most influential entertainers of the 20th century.
extract_id: Francis Albert Sinatra adalah seorang penyanyi, konduktor, dan aktor Amerika. Dijuluki "Chairman of the Board" dan "Ol' Blue Eyes", dia dianggap sebagai salah satu penghibur paling berpengaruh abad ke-20.

name: Frank Vincent
title: Frank Vincent
extract: Frank Vincent Gattuso Jr. was an American actor. Known for often portraying violent mobsters and criminals, he was a frequent collaborator of filmmaker Martin Scorsese, appearing as Salvy in Raging Bull (1980), Billy Batts in Goodfellas (1990), and Frank Marino in Casino (1995). On television, he played Phil Leotardo on the fifth and sixth seasons of the HBO crime drama The Sopranos (2004–2007). Vincent voiced Salvatore Leone in the Grand Theft Auto video game series from 2001 to 2005. Vincent also worked as an acting coach, providing assistance and guidance to co-stars who did not have formal acting training.
extract_id: Frank Vincent Gattuso Jr. adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dikenal sering memerankan gangster dan penjahat yang keras, dia merupakan kolaborator sering dari pembuat film Martin Scorsese, tampil sebagai Salvy dalam Raging Bull (1980), Billy Batts dalam Goodfellas (1990), dan Frank Marino dalam Casino (1995). Di televisi, dia memerankan Phil Leotardo pada musim kelima dan keenam drama kriminal HBO The Sopranos (2004–2007). Vincent mengisi suara Salvatore Leone dalam seri video game Grand Theft Auto dari tahun 2001 hingga 2005. Vincent juga bekerja sebagai pelatih akting, memberikan bantuan dan bimbingan kepada rekan pemeran yang tidak memiliki pelatihan akting formal.

name: Franka Potente
title: Franka Potente
extract: Franka Potente is a German actress. She first appeared in the comedy film After Five in the Forest Primeval (1995), for which she won a Bavarian Film Award for Best Young Actress. Her breakthrough came in 1998, when she starred in the acclaimed action thriller Run Lola Run, for which she won a BAMBI Award for Best Actress. She received further critical acclaim and a Bavarian Television Award nomination for her performance in the television film Opernball.
extract_id: Franka Potente adalah seorang aktris Jerman. Dia pertama kali tampil dalam film komedi After Five in the Forest Primeval (1995), yang membuatnya memenangkan Bavarian Film Award untuk Aktor Muda Terbaik. Terobosannya terjadi pada 1998, ketika dia membintangi thriller aksi terkenal Run Lola Run, yang membuatnya memenangkan BAMBI Award untuk Aktris Terbaik. Dia menerima pujian kritikus lebih lanjut dan nominasi Bavarian Television Award atas penampilannya dalam film televisi Opernball.

name: Franklin J. Schaffner
title: Franklin J. Schaffner
extract: Franklin James Schaffner was an American film, television, and stage director. He won the Academy Award for Best Director for Patton (1970), and is known for the films Planet of the Apes (1968), Nicholas and Alexandra (1971), Papillon (1973), and The Boys from Brazil (1978). He served as president of the Directors Guild of America between 1987 and 1989.
extract_id: Franklin James Schaffner adalah seorang sutradara film, televisi, dan panggung Amerika. Dia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik untuk Patton (1970), dan dikenal untuk film-film Planet of the Apes (1968), Nicholas and Alexandra (1971), Papillon (1973), dan The Boys from Brazil (1978). Dia menjabat sebagai presiden Directors Guild of America antara tahun 1987 dan 1989.

name: Franz Rogowski
title: Franz Rogowski
extract: Franz Rogowski is a German actor. He has appeared in films directed by Michael Haneke, Christian Petzold, Andrea Arnold, and Terrence Malick.
extract_id: Franz Rogowski adalah aktor Jerman. Dia telah tampil dalam film yang disutradarai oleh Michael Haneke, Christian Petzold, Andrea Arnold, dan Terrence Malick.

name: François Berléand
title: François Berléand
extract: François Berléand is a French actor.
extract_id: François Berléand adalah aktor Prancis.

name: François Cluzet
title: François Cluzet
extract: François Cluzet is a French film and theatre actor. Cluzet has collaborated with many important European and American directors, including Claude Chabrol, Bertrand Tavernier, Claire Denis, Agnieszka Holland, Robert Altman and Olivier Assayas. In 2007, he won a French César Award after starring as a doctor suspected of double homicide in the thriller Tell No One. Cluzet is best known for his role as Philippe in the film The Intouchables (2011).
extract_id: François Cluzet adalah aktor film dan teater Prancis. Cluzet telah berkolaborasi dengan banyak sutradara penting Eropa dan Amerika, termasuk Claude Chabrol, Bertrand Tavernier, Claire Denis, Agnieszka Holland, Robert Altman, dan Olivier Assayas. Pada tahun 2007, ia memenangkan Penghargaan César Prancis setelah berperan sebagai dokter yang dicurigai melakukan pembunuhan ganda dalam film thriller Tell No One. Cluzet paling dikenal untuk perannya sebagai Philippe dalam film The Intouchables (2011).

name: François Périer
title: François Périer
extract: François Périer was a French actor renowned for his expressiveness and diversity of roles.
extract_id: François Périer adalah aktor Prancis yang terkenal karena ekspresivitas dan keberagaman perannya.

name: François Truffaut
title: François Truffaut
extract: François Roland Truffaut was a French filmmaker, actor, and critic. Widely regarded as one of the founders of the French New Wave, he came under the tutelage of film critic André Bazin as a young man and was hired to write for the latter's Cahiers du Cinéma, where Truffaut became a proponent of the auteur theory, which posits that a film's director is its true author.
extract_id: François Roland Truffaut adalah pembuat film, aktor, dan kritikus Prancis. Dia secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu pendiri French New Wave, dia dibimbing oleh kritikus film André Bazin saat masih muda dan dipekerjakan untuk menulis di Cahiers du Cinéma milik Bazin, di mana Truffaut menjadi pendukung teori auteur, yang menyatakan bahwa sutradara film adalah penulis sebenarnya dari film tersebut.

name: Fred MacMurray
title: Fred MacMurray
extract: Frederick Martin MacMurray was an American actor. He appeared in more than one hundred films and a successful television series in a career that spanned nearly a half-century. His career as a major film leading man began in 1935, but his most renowned role was in Billy Wilder's 1944 film noir Double Indemnity. From 1959 to 1973, MacMurray appeared in numerous Disney films, including The Shaggy Dog, The Absent-Minded Professor, Follow Me, Boys!, and The Happiest Millionaire. He starred as Steve Douglas in the television series My Three Sons.
extract_id: Frederick Martin MacMurray adalah aktor Amerika. Ia tampil dalam lebih dari seratus film dan serial televisi sukses dalam karier yang berlangsung hampir setengah abad. Kariernya sebagai pemeran utama film besar dimulai pada 1935, tetapi peran yang paling dikenal adalah dalam film noir Billy Wilder tahun 1944, Double Indemnity. Dari 1959 hingga 1973, MacMurray muncul dalam banyak film Disney, termasuk The Shaggy Dog, The Absent-Minded Professor, Follow Me, Boys!, dan The Happiest Millionaire. Ia berperan sebagai Steve Douglas dalam serial televisi My Three Sons.

name: Fred Willard
title: Fred Willard
extract: Frederic Charles Willard was an American actor and comedian. He is best known for his work with Christopher Guest in his mockumentary films This Is Spinal Tap (1984), Waiting for Guffman (1996), Best in Show (2000), A Mighty Wind (2003), For Your Consideration (2006), and Mascots (2016). He also appeared in supporting roles in the comedy films Austin Powers: The Spy Who Shagged Me (1999), American Wedding (2003), and Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy (2004). On television, Willard received several Primetime Emmy Award nominations for his work on the sitcoms Everybody Loves Raymond and Modern Family.
extract_id: Frederic Charles Willard adalah aktor dan komedian Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena karyanya dengan Christopher Guest dalam film mockumentary seperti This Is Spinal Tap (1984), Waiting for Guffman (1996), Best in Show (2000), A Mighty Wind (2003), For Your Consideration (2006), dan Mascots (2016). Ia juga tampil dalam peran pendukung di film komedi Austin Powers: The Spy Who Shagged Me (1999), American Wedding (2003), dan Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy (2004). Di televisi, Willard menerima beberapa nominasi Primetime Emmy Award untuk karyanya dalam sitkom Everybody Loves Raymond dan Modern Family.

name: Fred Zinnemann
title: Fred Zinnemann
extract: Alfred Zinnemann was an Austrian and American film director, producer, and screenwriter. Born in Austria-Hungary and educated in France and Germany, Zinnemann began his career in Europe before emigrating to the US, where he specialized in shorts before making 25 feature films during his 50-year career. He won four Academy Awards, both for directing and producing, and made films in a variety of genres including thrillers, westerns, film noir, and stage adaptations.
extract_id: Alfred Zinnemann adalah sutradara film, produser, dan penulis skenario Austria dan Amerika. Lahir di Austria-Hungaria dan dididik di Prancis serta Jerman, Zinnemann memulai kariernya di Eropa sebelum pindah ke AS, di mana ia mengkhususkan diri dalam film pendek sebelum membuat 25 film fitur selama kariernya yang berlangsung 50 tahun. Ia memenangkan empat Academy Awards, baik untuk penyutradaraan maupun produksi, dan membuat film dalam berbagai genre termasuk thriller, western, film noir, dan adaptasi panggung.

name: Frederic Forrest
title: Frederic Forrest
extract: Frederic Fenimore Forrest Jr. was an American actor. A figure of the New Hollywood movement, Forrest was best known for his collaborations with director Francis Ford Coppola, playing featured roles in The Conversation (1974), Apocalypse Now (1979), One from the Heart (1982), and Tucker: The Man and His Dream (1988). He was nominated for an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, a New York Film Critics Circle Award, and received a National Society of Film Critics for Best Supporting Actor for his portrayal of Huston Dyer in the musical drama The Rose (1979), an honor shared with his performance as Jay "Chef" Hicks in Apocalypse Now.
extract_id: Frederic Fenimore Forrest Jr. adalah aktor Amerika. Sebagai figur gerakan New Hollywood, Forrest paling dikenal karena kolaborasinya dengan sutradara Francis Ford Coppola, memainkan peran penting dalam The Conversation (1974), Apocalypse Now (1979), One from the Heart (1982), dan Tucker: The Man and His Dream (1988). Ia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, New York Film Critics Circle Award, dan menerima penghargaan National Society of Film Critics untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik atas perannya sebagai Huston Dyer dalam drama musikal The Rose (1979), sebuah penghargaan yang juga diberikan untuk penampilannya sebagai Jay "Chef" Hicks dalam Apocalypse Now.

name: Frederick Lau
title: Frederick Lau
extract: Frederick Lau is a German actor.
extract_id: Frederick Lau adalah aktor Jerman.

name: Fredric March
title: Fredric March
extract: Fredric March was an American actor, regarded as one of Hollywood's most celebrated stars of the 1930s and 1940s. As a performer he was known for his versatility. He received numerous accolades including two Academy Awards, a Golden Globe Award, two Tony Awards, two Volpi Cups, the Silver Bear, as well as nominations for three BAFTA Awards and three Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Fredric March adalah aktor Amerika, dianggap sebagai salah satu bintang paling terkenal di Hollywood pada 1930-an dan 1940-an. Sebagai seorang pemeran, ia dikenal karena keserbagunaannya. Ia menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk dua Academy Awards, Golden Globe Award, dua Tony Awards, dua Volpi Cups, Silver Bear, serta nominasi untuk tiga BAFTA Awards dan tiga Emmy Awards.

name: Freida Pinto
title: Freida Pinto
extract: Freida Selena Pinto is an Indian actress who has appeared mainly in American and British films. Born and raised in Mumbai, Maharashtra, she resolved at a young age to become an actress. As a student at St. Xavier's College, Mumbai she took part in amateur plays. After graduation, she briefly worked as a model and then as a television presenter.
extract_id: Freida Selena Pinto adalah aktris India yang sebagian besar tampil dalam film Amerika dan Inggris. Lahir dan besar di Mumbai, Maharashtra, dia bertekad sejak muda untuk menjadi aktris. Sebagai mahasiswa di St. Xavier's College, Mumbai, ia ikut serta dalam drama amatir. Setelah lulus, ia sempat bekerja sebagai model dan kemudian sebagai presenter televisi.

name: Friedrich Feher
title: Friedrich Feher
extract: Friedrich Feher was an Austrian actor and film director. He first entered the film business in 1913, starting out as an actor but quickly gravitating toward directing.
extract_id: Friedrich Feher adalah aktor dan sutradara film Austria. Ia pertama kali memasuki dunia film pada tahun 1913, memulai karier sebagai aktor namun cepat beralih fokus ke penyutradaraan.

name: Fritz Lang
title: Fritz Lang
extract: Friedrich Christian Anton Lang, better known as Fritz Lang, was an Austrian film director, screenwriter, and producer, who worked in Germany and later the United States. One of the best-known émigrés from Germany's school of Expressionism, he was dubbed the "Master of Darkness" by the British Film Institute. He has been cited as one of the most influential filmmakers of all time.
extract_id: Friedrich Christian Anton Lang, yang lebih dikenal sebagai Fritz Lang, adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser Austria, yang bekerja di Jerman dan kemudian Amerika Serikat. Salah satu émigré paling terkenal dari aliran Expressionisme Jerman, ia dijuluki "Master of Darkness" oleh British Film Institute. Ia dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film paling berpengaruh sepanjang masa.

name: Gabriel Byrne
title: Gabriel Byrne
extract: Gabriel James Byrne is an Irish actor. He has received a Golden Globe Award as well as nominations for a Grammy Award, two Primetime Emmy Awards and two Tony Awards. Byrne was awarded the Irish Film and Television Academy Lifetime Achievement Award in 2018 and was listed at number 17 on The Irish Times list of Ireland's greatest film actors in 2020. In 2009, The Guardian named him one of the best actors never to have received an Academy Award nomination.
extract_id: Gabriel James Byrne adalah aktor Irlandia. Ia telah menerima Golden Globe Award serta nominasi untuk Grammy Award, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan dua Tony Awards. Byrne dianugerahi Irish Film and Television Academy Lifetime Achievement Award pada 2018 dan tercatat di urutan ke-17 dalam daftar aktor film terbesar Irlandia versi The Irish Times pada 2020. Pada 2009, The Guardian menyebutnya sebagai salah satu aktor terbaik yang tidak pernah menerima nominasi Academy Award.

name: Gabriele Ferzetti
title: Gabriele Ferzetti
extract: Gabriele Ferzetti was an Italian actor with more than 160 credits across film, television and stage. He made his international breakthrough in Michelangelo Antonioni's L'Avventura (1960) as a restless playboy. After a series of romantic performances, he acquired a reputation in Italy as an elegant, debonair, and somewhat aristocratic looking leading man.
extract_id: Gabriele Ferzetti adalah aktor Italia dengan lebih dari 160 kredit di film, televisi, dan panggung. Ia meraih terobosan internasional dalam film L'Avventura (1960) karya Michelangelo Antonioni sebagai playboy gelisah. Setelah serangkaian penampilan romantis, ia memperoleh reputasi di Italia sebagai pria utama yang elegan, berwibawa, dan terlihat agak aristokrat.

name: Gabriele Muccino
title: Gabriele Muccino
extract: Gabriele Muccino is an Italian film director and screenwriter. He has worked his way from making short films only aired on Italian television to become a well-known and successful American filmmaker. He is the elder brother of actor Silvio Muccino, who often appears in his brother's films. Muccino has directed 12 films and is best known for his first American film The Pursuit of Happyness, starring Will Smith. Muccino has been nominated for and won several awards including the David di Donatello Award for Best Director in 2001 for his film The Last Kiss.
extract_id: Gabriele Muccino adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film Italia. Ia memulai dari membuat film pendek yang hanya disiarkan di televisi Italia dan kemudian menjadi pembuat film Amerika yang terkenal dan sukses. Ia adalah kakak dari aktor Silvio Muccino, yang sering muncul dalam film-film saudaranya. Muccino telah menyutradarai 12 film dan paling dikenal untuk film Amerika pertamanya, The Pursuit of Happyness, yang dibintangi Will Smith. Muccino telah dinominasikan dan memenangkan beberapa penghargaan termasuk David di Donatello Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik pada 2001 untuk filmnya The Last Kiss.

name: Gabrielle Anwar
title: Gabrielle Anwar
extract: Gabrielle Anwar is an English actress. She is known for her television roles as Sam Black in the second series of Press Gang, as Margaret Tudor in the first season of The Tudors, as Lady Tremaine in the seventh season of Once Upon a Time, and for her starring role as Fiona Glenanne on the USA network television series Burn Notice (2007–13).
extract_id: Gabrielle Anwar adalah aktris Inggris. Ia dikenal untuk perannya di televisi sebagai Sam Black dalam seri kedua Press Gang, sebagai Margaret Tudor di musim pertama The Tudors, sebagai Lady Tremaine di musim ketujuh Once Upon a Time, dan untuk peran utamanya sebagai Fiona Glenanne dalam serial televisi Burn Notice (2007–13) di jaringan USA.

name: Gael García Bernal
title: Gael García Bernal
extract: Gael García Bernal is a Mexican actor and filmmaker. He has received various accolades including a Golden Globe Award and an Ariel Award. He is known for his performances in the films Amores perros (2000), Y tu mamá también (2001), Bad Education (2004), The Motorcycle Diaries (2004), Babel (2006), Coco (2017), Old (2021), Cassandro (2023) and Magellan (2025).
extract_id: Gael García Bernal adalah aktor dan pembuat film Meksiko. Ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Golden Globe Award dan Ariel Award. Ia dikenal untuk penampilannya dalam film Amores perros (2000), Y tu mamá también (2001), Bad Education (2004), The Motorcycle Diaries (2004), Babel (2006), Coco (2017), Old (2021), Cassandro (2023), dan Magellan (2025).

name: Gajraj Rao
title: Gajraj Rao
extract: Gajraj Rao is an Indian actor who appears predominantly in Hindi films. He is widely known for his performance in the comedy-drama film Badhaai Ho for which he won the Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actor.
extract_id: Gajraj Rao adalah aktor India yang sebagian besar tampil dalam film berbahasa Hindi. Ia dikenal luas atas penampilannya dalam film komedi drama Badhaai Ho yang membuatnya memenangkan Filmfare Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Gareth Edwards
title: Gareth Edwards (filmmaker)
extract: Gareth James Edwards is a British filmmaker. His accolades include three British Independent Film Awards and nominations for the British Academy Film Awards and Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Gareth James Edwards adalah pembuat film Inggris. Penghargaan yang ia raih termasuk tiga British Independent Film Awards dan nominasi untuk British Academy Film Awards serta Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Gareth Evans
title: Gareth Evans (filmmaker)
extract: Gareth Huw Evans is a Welsh film director, screenwriter, editor, and action choreographer. He is best known for the Indonesian action crime films Merantau (2009), The Raid (2011), and The Raid 2 (2014), and for bringing the Indonesian martial art of pencak silat into world cinema through these films. He is also known for co-creating, co-writing, co-directing, and executive producing the Sky Atlantic/AMC action crime drama television series Gangs of London (2020–present), alongside Matt Flannery, based on the 2006 video game of the same name.
extract_id: Gareth Huw Evans adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, editor, dan koreografer aksi asal Wales. Ia paling dikenal untuk film aksi kejahatan Indonesia Merantau (2009), The Raid (2011), dan The Raid 2 (2014), serta untuk membawa seni bela diri Indonesia pencak silat ke layar dunia melalui film-film tersebut. Ia juga dikenal sebagai co-creator, co-writer, co-director, dan executive producer serial drama aksi kejahatan Sky Atlantic/AMC Gangs of London (2020–sekarang), bersama Matt Flannery, yang berdasarkan video game dengan judul yang sama tahun 2006.

name: Garrett M. Brown
title: Garrett M. Brown
extract: Garrett M. Brown is an American character actor best known as John Whitsig in Sisters (1991–1996).
extract_id: Garrett M. Brown adalah aktor karakter Amerika yang paling dikenal sebagai John Whitsig dalam Sister (1991–1996).

name: Garth Davis
title: Garth Davis
extract: Garth Davis is an Australian television, advertising, and film director, best known for directing the films Lion (2016), and biblical drama Mary Magdalene (2018). He earlier directed episodes of the series Top of the Lake (2013).
extract_id: Garth Davis adalah sutradara televisi, iklan, dan film asal Australia, paling dikenal menyutradarai film Lion (2016), dan drama biblikal Mary Magdalene (2018). Sebelumnya ia menyutradarai episode dari seri Top of the Lake (2013).

name: Gary Busey
title: Gary Busey
extract: William Gary Busey is an American actor. He portrayed Buddy Holly in The Buddy Holly Story (1978), for which he was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actor and won the National Society of Film Critics Award for Best Actor. His other starring roles include A Star Is Born (1976), D.C. Cab (1983), Silver Bullet (1985), Eye of the Tiger (1986), Lethal Weapon (1987), Hider in the House (1989), Predator 2 (1990), Point Break (1991), Under Siege (1992), The Firm (1993), Drop Zone (1994), Black Sheep (1996) and Lost Highway (1997).
extract_id: William Gary Busey adalah aktor Amerika. Ia memerankan Buddy Holly dalam The Buddy Holly Story (1978), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award sebagai Aktor Terbaik dan memenangkan National Society of Film Critics Award untuk Aktor Terbaik. Peran utama lainnya termasuk A Star Is Born (1976), D.C. Cab (1983), Silver Bullet (1985), Eye of the Tiger (1986), Lethal Weapon (1987), Hider in the House (1989), Predator 2 (1990), Point Break (1991), Under Siege (1992), The Firm (1993), Drop Zone (1994), Black Sheep (1996), dan Lost Highway (1997).

name: Gary Cooper
title: Gary Cooper
extract: Gary Cooper was an American actor known for his strong, silent screen persona and understated acting style. The American Film Institute (AFI) ranked Cooper at number 11 on its list of the 50 greatest screen legends. He won the Academy Award for Best Actor for Sergeant York (1941) and High Noon (1952) and an Academy Honorary Award in 1961.
extract_id: Gary Cooper adalah aktor Amerika yang dikenal dengan persona layar yang kuat dan pendiam serta gaya akting yang sederhana. American Film Institute (AFI) menempatkan Cooper di nomor 11 dalam daftar 50 legenda layar terbesar. Ia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktor Terbaik untuk Sergeant York (1941) dan High Noon (1952) serta menerima Academy Honorary Award pada 1961.

name: Gary Farmer
title: Gary Farmer
extract: Gary Dale Farmer is a Canadian First Nations (Cayuga) actor and musician. He is best known for his Independent Spirit Award-nominated roles in Powwow Highway (1989), Dead Man (1995) and Smoke Signals (1998). He briefly reprised his role as Nobody from Dead Man in Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai (1999).
extract_id: Gary Dale Farmer adalah aktor dan musisi First Nations (Cayuga) Kanada. Ia dikenal paling baik atas peran-perannya yang dinominasikan Independent Spirit Award dalam Powwow Highway (1989), Dead Man (1995) dan Smoke Signals (1998). Ia sempat mengulangi perannya sebagai Nobody dari Dead Man dalam Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai (1999).

name: Gary Lockwood
title: Gary Lockwood
extract: Gary Lockwood is an American actor. Lockwood is best known for his roles as astronaut Frank Poole in the film 2001: A Space Odyssey (1968), and as Lieutenant Commander Gary Mitchell in the Star Trek second pilot episode "Where No Man Has Gone Before" (1966). He starred in the only American film by French New Wave director Jacques Demy, Model Shop. He played numerous guest television roles from the early 1960s into the mid-1990s, and played the title role in The Lieutenant (1963–1964).
extract_id: Gary Lockwood adalah aktor Amerika. Lockwood dikenal terutama karena perannya sebagai astronot Frank Poole dalam film 2001: A Space Odyssey (1968), dan sebagai Letnan Komandan Gary Mitchell dalam episode pilot kedua Star Trek berjudul "Where No Man Has Gone Before" (1966). Ia membintangi satu-satunya film Amerika arahan sutradara French New Wave Jacques Demy, Model Shop. Ia memainkan berbagai peran tamu di televisi dari awal 1960-an hingga pertengahan 1990-an, dan memerankan peran utama dalam The Lieutenant (1963–1964).

name: Gary Oldman
title: Gary Oldman
extract: Sir Gary Leonard Oldman is an English actor and filmmaker. Known for his versatility and intense acting style, he has received various accolades, including an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award and three BAFTAs, as well as nominations for four Primetime Emmy Awards. His films have grossed over US$11 billion worldwide, making him one of the highest-grossing actors of all time.
extract_id: Sir Gary Leonard Oldman adalah aktor dan pembuat film Inggris. Dikenal karena fleksibilitas dan gaya aktingnya yang intens, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award dan tiga BAFTA, serta nominasi untuk empat Primetime Emmy Awards. Film-filmnya telah meraup lebih dari US$11 miliar secara global, menjadikannya salah satu aktor dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa.

name: Gary Sinise
title: Gary Sinise
extract: Gary Alan Sinise is an American retired actor, director, musician, and activist. He has won a Tony Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, a Golden Globe Award, and three Actor Awards, and has been nominated for an Academy Award. He has received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. Sinise has also received awards and honors for his extensive humanitarian work and involvement with charitable organizations, notably the Gary Sinise Foundation, of which he is the founder and chairman of the board of directors. He also founded the Lt. Dan Band, which plays at U.S. military bases around the world.
extract_id: Gary Alan Sinise adalah aktor, sutradara, musisi, dan aktivis Amerika yang telah pensiun. Ia telah memenangkan Tony Award, Primetime Emmy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan tiga Actor Awards, serta pernah dinominasikan untuk Academy Award. Ia mendapat bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame. Sinise juga menerima penghargaan dan penghormatan atas kerja kemanusiaannya yang luas serta keterlibatannya dengan organisasi amal, khususnya Gary Sinise Foundation, yang didirikannya dan di mana ia menjabat sebagai ketua dewan direksi. Ia juga mendirikan Lt. Dan Band, yang tampil di pangkalan militer AS di seluruh dunia.

name: Gary Stretch
title: Gary Stretch
extract: Gary Stretch is a British boxer, actor, model, producer, and screenwriter. During his boxing career, Stretch won 29 of his 31 fights, 20 of those by KO. He became the WBC International Super Welterweight Champion.
extract_id: Gary Stretch adalah petinju, aktor, model, produser, dan penulis skenario Inggris. Selama karier tinju, Stretch memenangkan 29 dari 31 pertarungannya, 20 di antaranya dengan KO. Ia menjadi Juara Super Welterweight Internasional WBC.

name: Gary Trousdale
title: Gary Trousdale
extract: Gary Trousdale is an American animator, film director, screenwriter and storyboard artist. He is best known for directing films such as Beauty and the Beast (1991), The Hunchback of Notre Dame (1996), and Atlantis: The Lost Empire (2001). He frequently works with Kirk Wise and Don Hahn.
extract_id: Gary Trousdale adalah animator, sutradara film, penulis skenario dan artis storyboard Amerika. Ia dikenal terutama karena menyutradarai film seperti Beauty and the Beast (1991), The Hunchback of Notre Dame (1996), dan Atlantis: The Lost Empire (2001). Ia sering bekerja sama dengan Kirk Wise dan Don Hahn.

name: Gaspard Manesse
title: Gaspard Manesse
extract: Gaspard Manesse is a French actor, composer and musician. He is best known for his starring role as Julien Quentin in the film Au revoir les enfants (1987). He acted in and composed the music for the film Comme il vient. Gaspard is a composer and musician - he tours throughout the heart of France playing the trumpet with a group called "Surnatural Orchestra" from the Ile-de-France.
extract_id: Gaspard Manesse adalah aktor, komposer dan musisi Prancis. Ia dikenal paling baik untuk peran utamanya sebagai Julien Quentin dalam film Au revoir les enfants (1987). Ia berakting dan mengomposisi musik untuk film Comme il vient. Gaspard adalah komposer dan musisi - ia mengadakan tur di seluruh jantung Prancis bermain terompet dengan grup bernama "Surnatural Orchestra" dari Ile-de-France.

name: Gaspard Ulliel
title: Gaspard Ulliel
extract: Gaspard Thomas Ulliel was a French actor and model. He was known for having portrayed the young Hannibal Lecter in Hannibal Rising (2007), fashion designer Yves Saint Laurent in the biopic Saint Laurent (2014), and for being the face of Chanel men's fragrance Bleu de Chanel for twelve years. He also voiced Jack Frost in the French version of Rise of the Guardians (2012) and portrayed Anton Mogart in the Disney+ miniseries Moon Knight (2022).
extract_id: Gaspard Thomas Ulliel adalah aktor dan model Prancis. Ia dikenal karena memerankan Hannibal Lecter muda dalam Hannibal Rising (2007), desainer mode Yves Saint Laurent dalam film biografi Saint Laurent (2014), dan sebagai wajah parfum pria Chanel Bleu de Chanel selama dua belas tahun. Ia juga mengisi suara Jack Frost dalam versi Prancis Rise of the Guardians (2012) dan berperan sebagai Anton Mogart dalam miniseri Disney+ Moon Knight (2022).

name: Gastone Moschin
title: Gastone Moschin
extract: Gastone Moschin was an Italian stage, television and film actor.
extract_id: Gastone Moschin adalah aktor panggung, televisi, dan film Italia.

name: Gastón Pauls
title: Gastón Pauls
description: Argentine actor, TV host and producer (born 1972)
extract: Gastón Pauls is an Argentine actor, TV host and producer.
extract_id: Gastón Pauls adalah aktor, pembawa acara TV, dan produser Argentina.

name: Gattlin Griffith
title: Gattlin Griffith
extract: Gattlin Tadd Griffith is an American actor, best known for portraying Walter Collins in the historical crime drama Changeling (2008), Tim Tyson in the autobiographical civil rights film Blood Done Sign My Name (2010) and for starring in the romantic drama Labor Day (2013). He also had episodic roles on TV series such as Cold Case, Eli Stone, Supernatural, Criminal Minds and the films The New Daughter and Green Lantern.
extract_id: Gattlin Tadd Griffith adalah aktor Amerika, dikenal paling baik karena memerankan Walter Collins dalam drama kriminal sejarah Changeling (2008), Tim Tyson dalam film hak sipil autobiografi Blood Done Sign My Name (2010) dan membintangi drama romantis Labor Day (2013). Ia juga tampil dalam peran episodik di serial TV seperti Cold Case, Eli Stone, Supernatural, Criminal Minds dan film The New Daughter dan Green Lantern.

name: Gauri Shinde
title: Gauri Shinde
extract: Gauri Shinde is an Indian film director and screenwriter. Shinde made her directorial debut with the highly acclaimed English Vinglish (2012), which marked the comeback of actress Sridevi. Shinde featured in the Financial Times 2012 list of '25 Indians To Watch'. She also featured on Rediff's list of 'Bollywood's 5 Best Directors of 2012'.
extract_id: Gauri Shinde adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario India. Shinde memulai debut penyutradaraannya dengan film yang sangat dipuji English Vinglish (2012), yang menandai comeback aktris Sridevi. Shinde masuk dalam daftar Financial Times 2012 '25 Indians To Watch'. Ia juga masuk dalam daftar Rediff '5 Sutradara Bollywood Terbaik 2012'.

name: Gavin O'Connor
title: Gavin O'Connor (actor)
extract: Gavin O'Connor is an Irish actor who has had roles in TV series such as The Hunt for Raoul Moat, Vikings: Valhalla, The Alienist, Taken Down, Charlie, North Sea Connection, The Tudors, Single Handed and films including Dorothy Mills (2008), The Front Line (2006), Headrush (2003) and This Is My Father (1998), This Must Be The Place (2011) and Fifty Dead Men Walking (2008).
extract_id: Gavin O'Connor adalah aktor Irlandia yang memiliki peran dalam serial TV seperti The Hunt for Raoul Moat, Vikings: Valhalla, The Alienist, Taken Down, Charlie, North Sea Connection, The Tudors, Single Handed serta film termasuk Dorothy Mills (2008), The Front Line (2006), Headrush (2003) dan This Is My Father (1998), This Must Be The Place (2011) dan Fifty Dead Men Walking (2008).

name: Gayatri
title: Gayatri (actress)
extract: Gayatri is a former Indian actress from Punjab who is known for heroine roles in Kannada movies like Auto Raja (1980), Vasantha Geetha (1980), Sukha Samsarakke Hanneradu Sutragalu (1984), Jwaalamukhi (1985) and Shwetha Gulabi (1985). She is married to actor Anant Nag.
extract_id: Gayatri adalah mantan aktris India dari Punjab yang dikenal atas peran-peran heroine di film-film Kannada seperti Auto Raja (1980), Vasantha Geetha (1980), Sukha Samsarakke Hanneradu Sutragalu (1984), Jwaalamukhi (1985) dan Shwetha Gulabi (1985). Ia menikah dengan aktor Anant Nag.

name: Gayatri Joshi
title: Gayatri Joshi
extract: Gayatri Joshi is an Indian former actress, video jockey, model and beauty pageant titleholder. She won the title of Femina Miss India International in the year 2000 and represented India at Miss International 2000. She starred in the 2004 film Swades, her only acting credit to date. Following her marriage to businessman Vikas Oberoi in 2005, she quit acting.
extract_id: Gayatri Joshi adalah mantan aktris India, video jockey, model dan pemegang gelar kontes kecantikan. Ia memenangkan gelar Femina Miss India International pada tahun 2000 dan mewakili India di Miss International 2000. Ia membintangi film Swades tahun 2004, satu-satunya kredit aktingnya hingga saat ini. Setelah menikah dengan pengusaha Vikas Oberoi pada 2005, ia berhenti berakting.

name: Gaylen Ross
title: Gaylen Ross
extract: Gaylen Ross is an American director, writer, producer and actress, directing documentaries for over 35 years including her documentary on diamond dealers and New York's 47th Street, Dealers among Dealers and for directing the 2008 documentary Killing Kasztner. She is also known for her brief career in front of the camera for playing Francine Parker in the 1978 horror film Dawn of the Dead.
extract_id: Gaylen Ross adalah sutradara, penulis, produser dan aktris Amerika, mengarahkan film dokumenter selama lebih dari 35 tahun termasuk dokumenternya tentang pedagang berlian dan Jalan ke-47 di New York, Dealers among Dealers serta menyutradarai dokumenter tahun 2008 Killing Kasztner. Ia juga dikenal karena karier singkatnya di depan kamera dengan memerankan Francine Parker dalam film horor tahun 1978 Dawn of the Dead.

name: Gemma Jones
title: Gemma Jones
extract: Jennifer "Gemma" Jones is an English actress. Appearing on both stage and screen, her film appearances include Sense and Sensibility (1995), the Bridget Jones series (2001–2025), the Harry Potter series (2002–2011), You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger (2010), and Ammonite (2020).
extract_id: Jennifer "Gemma" Jones adalah aktris Inggris. Muncul di panggung dan layar, kemunculan filmnya termasuk Sense and Sensibility (1995), seri Bridget Jones (2001–2025), seri Harry Potter (2002–2011), You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger (2010), dan Ammonite (2020).

name: Gena Rowlands
title: Gena Rowlands
extract: Virginia Cathryn "Gena" Rowlands was an American actress, whose career in film, stage, and television spanned nearly seven decades. She was a four-time Emmy Award and two-time Golden Globe winner, and she was twice nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actress.
extract_id: Virginia Cathryn "Gena" Rowlands adalah aktris Amerika, yang kariernya di film, panggung, dan televisi berlangsung hampir tujuh dekade. Ia memenangkan empat Emmy Award dan dua Golden Globe, dan dua kali dinominasikan untuk Academy Award Aktor Terbaik.

name: Gene Bervoets
title: Gene Bervoets
extract: Eugène Joanna Alfons "Gene" Bervoets is a Belgian actor. He has performed in more than 60 films since 1979.
extract_id: Eugène Joanna Alfons "Gene" Bervoets adalah aktor Belgia. Ia telah tampil dalam lebih dari 60 film sejak 1979.

name: Gene Hackman
title: Gene Hackman
extract: Eugene Allen Hackman was an American actor. Considered one of the greatest actors of his generation and a paragon of the New Hollywood movement, Hackman's mainstream acting career spanned over four decades. He received several accolades, including two Academy Awards, two British Academy Film Awards, one Silver Bear and four Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Eugene Allen Hackman adalah aktor Amerika. Dianggap salah satu aktor terbaik di generasinya dan panutan gerakan New Hollywood, karier akting utama Hackman berlangsung lebih dari empat dekade. Ia menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards, dua British Academy Film Awards, satu Silver Bear, dan empat Golden Globe Awards.

name: Gene Kelly
title: Gene Kelly
extract: Eugene Curran Kelly was an American dancer, actor, singer, director and choreographer. He was known for his energetic and athletic dancing style. Kelly sought to create a new form of American dance accessible to the general public, which he called "dance for the common man". He starred in, choreographed, and, with Stanley Donen, co-directed some of the best-regarded musical films of the 1940s and 1950s.
extract_id: Eugene Curran Kelly adalah penari, aktor, penyanyi, sutradara dan koreografer Amerika. Ia dikenal karena gaya menari yang enerjik dan atletis. Kelly berusaha menciptakan bentuk tari Amerika baru yang dapat diakses oleh publik umum, yang disebutnya "tari untuk orang biasa". Ia membintangi, mengoreografikan, dan bersama Stanley Donen, menyutradarai beberapa film musikal yang paling dihormati pada 1940-an dan 1950-an.

name: Gene Lockhart
title: Gene Lockhart
extract: Edwin Eugene Lockhart was a Canadian-American character actor, playwright, singer, and lyricist. He appeared in over 300 films, and received an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actor for his role as Regis in Algiers (1938), the American remake of Pépé le Moko.
extract_id: Edwin Eugene Lockhart adalah aktor karakter Kanada-Amerika, penulis drama, penyanyi, dan penulis lirik. Ia tampil dalam lebih dari 300 film, dan menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk perannya sebagai Regis dalam Algiers (1938), versi remake Amerika dari Pépé le Moko.

name: Gene Saks
title: Gene Saks
extract: Gene Saks was an American director and actor. An inductee of the American Theater Hall of Fame, his acting career began with a Broadway debut in 1949. As a director, he was nominated for seven Tony Awards, winning three for his direction of I Love My Wife, Brighton Beach Memoirs and Biloxi Blues. He also directed a number of films during his career. He was married to Bea Arthur from 1950 until 1978, and subsequently to Keren Saks from 1980 to his death in 2015.
extract_id: Gene Saks adalah sutradara dan aktor Amerika. Anggota American Theater Hall of Fame, karier aktingnya dimulai dengan debut Broadway pada 1949. Sebagai sutradara, ia dinominasikan untuk tujuh Tony Awards, memenangkan tiga untuk penyutradaraannya atas I Love My Wife, Brighton Beach Memoirs dan Biloxi Blues. Ia juga menyutradarai sejumlah film selama kariernya. Ia menikah dengan Bea Arthur dari 1950 hingga 1978, dan kemudian dengan Keren Saks dari 1980 hingga kematiannya pada 2015.

name: Gene Tierney
title: Gene Tierney
extract: Gene Eliza Tierney was an American stage and film actress. Tierney was a prominent leading lady during the Golden Age of Hollywood. She starred as Laura Hunt in Otto Preminger's Laura (1944), a film noir classic, and as Ellen Berent in John M. Stahl's Leave Her to Heaven (1945), which earned her a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Actress. Darryl F. Zanuck, co-founder of 20th Century Fox, said Tierney was "unquestionably, the most beautiful woman in movie history."
extract_id: Gene Eliza Tierney adalah aktris panggung dan film Amerika. Tierney adalah pemeran utama terkemuka selama Era Keemasan Hollywood. Ia membintangi sebagai Laura Hunt dalam film noir klasik Otto Preminger, Laura (1944), dan sebagai Ellen Berent dalam Leave Her to Heaven (1945) karya John M. Stahl, yang memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik. Darryl F. Zanuck, salah satu pendiri 20th Century Fox, mengatakan Tierney adalah "tanpa diragukan lagi, wanita tercantik dalam sejarah film."

name: Gene Wilder
title: Gene Wilder
extract: Gene Wilder was an American actor, comedian, writer and filmmaker. He was most notable for his comedic roles, including his collaborations with Mel Brooks on the films The Producers (1967), Blazing Saddles and Young Frankenstein, and with Richard Pryor in the films Silver Streak (1976), Stir Crazy (1980), See No Evil, Hear No Evil (1989) and Another You (1991), as well as his portrayal of Willy Wonka in Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory (1971).
extract_id: Gene Wilder adalah aktor, komedian, penulis, dan pembuat film Amerika. Dia paling terkenal karena peran komedinya, termasuk kolaborasinya dengan Mel Brooks dalam film The Producers (1967), Blazing Saddles dan Young Frankenstein, serta dengan Richard Pryor dalam film Silver Streak (1976), Stir Crazy (1980), See No Evil, Hear No Evil (1989) dan Another You (1991), serta perannya sebagai Willy Wonka dalam Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory (1971).

name: Geneviève Page
title: Geneviève Page
extract: Geneviève Bonjean, known professionally as Geneviève Page, was a French actress with a film career spanning fifty years and also numerous English-speaking film productions. She was the daughter of French art collector Jacques Paul Bonjean (1899–1990).
extract_id: Geneviève Bonjean, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Geneviève Page, adalah seorang aktris Prancis dengan karier film yang berlangsung lima puluh tahun dan juga berbagai produksi film berbahasa Inggris. Dia adalah putri dari kolektor seni Prancis Jacques Paul Bonjean (1899–1990).

name: Geoffrey Arend
title: Geoffrey Arend
extract: Geoffrey Rashid Arend Jr. is an American actor. He is best known for his role as Ethan Gross on the ABC drama series Body of Proof, Matt Mahoney on the CBS political drama series Madam Secretary, and a young stoner in Super Troopers.
extract_id: Geoffrey Rashid Arend Jr. adalah aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Ethan Gross dalam serial drama ABC Body of Proof, Matt Mahoney dalam serial drama politik CBS Madam Secretary, dan seorang pemuda pemakai ganja dalam Super Troopers.

name: Geoffrey Rush
title: Geoffrey Rush
extract: Geoffrey Roy Rush is an Australian actor. Known for often playing eccentric roles on both stage and screen, he has received numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, a Primetime Emmy Award and a Tony Award, making him the only Australian to achieve the Triple Crown of Acting, in addition to three BAFTA Awards and two Golden Globe Awards. Rush is the founding president of the Australian Academy of Cinema and Television Arts and was named the 2012 Australian of the Year.
extract_id: Geoffrey Roy Rush adalah aktor Australia. Dikenal sering memerankan peran eksentrik di panggung dan layar, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dan Tony Award, menjadikannya satu-satunya orang Australia yang meraih Triple Crown of Acting, selain tiga BAFTA Awards dan dua Golden Globe Awards. Rush adalah presiden pendiri Australian Academy of Cinema and Television Arts dan dinobatkan sebagai Australian of the Year tahun 2012.

name: George A. Romero
title: George A. Romero
extract: George Andrew Romero was an American and Canadian filmmaker, writer, editor, and actor. Regarded as an influential pioneer of the horror film genre, particularly zombie films, he has been described as an "icon" and the "father of the zombie film".
extract_id: George Andrew Romero adalah pembuat film, penulis, editor, dan aktor Amerika dan Kanada. Dianggap sebagai pelopor berpengaruh dalam genre film horor, khususnya film zombie, ia telah disebut sebagai "ikon" dan "bapak film zombie".

name: George C. Scott
title: George C. Scott
extract: George Campbell Scott was an American actor, with a celebrated career on both stage and screen. With a gruff demeanor and commanding presence, Scott became known for his portrayal of stern but complex authority figures.
extract_id: George Campbell Scott adalah aktor Amerika, dengan karier yang dihormati di panggung dan layar. Dengan sikap galak dan kehadiran yang mengesankan, Scott dikenal karena perannya yang menggambarkan tokoh otoritas yang tegas namun kompleks.

name: George Clooney
title: George Clooney
extract: George Timothy Clooney is an American actor and filmmaker. Known for his leading man roles on screen in both blockbuster and independent films, Clooney has received numerous accolades, including two Academy Awards, a BAFTA Award and four Golden Globe Awards as well as nominations for three Primetime Emmy Awards and a Tony Award. His honors include the Cecil B. DeMille Award in 2015, the Honorary César in 2017, the AFI Life Achievement Award in 2018, the Kennedy Center Honor in 2022, and the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement.
extract_id: George Timothy Clooney adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Dikenal karena peran utama di layar dalam film blockbuster maupun independen, Clooney telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards, satu BAFTA Award dan empat Golden Globe Awards serta nominasi untuk tiga Primetime Emmy Awards dan satu Tony Award. Penghargaan yang diterimanya meliputi Cecil B. DeMille Award tahun 2015, Honorary César tahun 2017, AFI Life Achievement Award tahun 2018, Kennedy Center Honor tahun 2022, dan Golden Lion untuk Lifetime Achievement.

name: George Cukor
title: George Cukor
extract: George Dewey Cukor was an American film director and producer. He concentrated primarily on comedies and literary adaptations. His career flourished at RKO when David O. Selznick, the studio's head of production, assigned Cukor to direct several of RKO's major films, including What Price Hollywood? (1932), A Bill of Divorcement (1932), Our Betters (1933), and Little Women (1933). When Selznick moved to Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer in 1933, Cukor followed and directed Dinner at Eight (1933) and David Copperfield (1935) for Selznick, and Romeo and Juliet (1936) and Camille (1936) for Irving Thalberg.
extract_id: George Dewey Cukor adalah sutradara dan produser film Amerika. Ia terutama fokus pada komedi dan adaptasi sastra. Kariernya berkembang di RKO ketika David O. Selznick, kepala produksi studio, menunjuk Cukor untuk menyutradarai beberapa film besar RKO, termasuk What Price Hollywood? (1932), A Bill of Divorcement (1932), Our Betters (1933), dan Little Women (1933). Ketika Selznick pindah ke Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer pada 1933, Cukor mengikuti dan menyutradarai Dinner at Eight (1933) dan David Copperfield (1935) untuk Selznick, serta Romeo and Juliet (1936) dan Camille (1936) untuk Irving Thalberg.

name: George Harrison
title: George Harrison
extract: George Harrison was an English musician who achieved international fame with the Beatles, in which he initially played lead guitar and later adopted rhythm and bass guitar, organ, and non-Western instruments. Known as "the quiet Beatle", Harrison played a significant role in shaping the band's musical direction and established a successful solo career, particularly through his interest in Eastern musical influences.
extract_id: George Harrison adalah musisi Inggris yang meraih ketenaran internasional bersama The Beatles, di mana awalnya ia memainkan gitar utama dan kemudian mengadopsi gitar ritme dan bass, organ, serta alat musik non-Barat. Dikenal sebagai "the quiet Beatle", Harrison memainkan peran penting dalam membentuk arah musik band dan membangun karier solo yang sukses, terutama melalui minatnya pada pengaruh musik Timur.

name: George Kennedy
title: George Kennedy
extract: George Harris Kennedy Jr. was an American actor who appeared in more than 100 film and television productions. He played "Dragline" in Cool Hand Luke (1967), winning the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for the role and being nominated for the corresponding Golden Globe. He received a second Golden Globe nomination for portraying Joe Patroni in Airport (1970).
extract_id: George Harris Kennedy Jr. adalah aktor Amerika yang tampil dalam lebih dari 100 produksi film dan televisi. Ia memerankan "Dragline" dalam Cool Hand Luke (1967), memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk peran tersebut dan dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe yang sesuai. Ia menerima nominasi Golden Globe kedua untuk perannya sebagai Joe Patroni dalam Airport (1970).

name: George Lucas
title: George Lucas
extract: George Walton Lucas Jr. is an American filmmaker, philanthropist, and entrepreneur. He created the Star Wars franchise and its fictional universe, the Indiana Jones franchise, and founded Lucasfilm, LucasArts, Industrial Light & Magic, and THX. Lucas also served as chairman of Lucasfilm before selling it to The Walt Disney Company in 2012. The recipient of two Emmy Awards and nominations for four Academy Awards and two Golden Globe Awards, he is considered to be one of the most significant figures of the 20th-century New Hollywood movement, and a pioneer of the modern blockbuster. Despite this, he has remained an independent filmmaker for most of his career.
extract_id: George Walton Lucas Jr. adalah pembuat film, dermawan, dan pengusaha Amerika. Ia menciptakan waralaba Star Wars dan alam semesta fiksionalnya, waralaba Indiana Jones, serta mendirikan Lucasfilm, LucasArts, Industrial Light & Magic, dan THX. Lucas juga menjabat sebagai ketua Lucasfilm sebelum menjualnya ke The Walt Disney Company pada 2012. Penerima dua Emmy Awards dan nominasi untuk empat Academy Awards dan dua Golden Globe Awards, dia dianggap sebagai salah satu tokoh paling signifikan dari gerakan New Hollywood abad ke-20, dan pelopor blockbuster modern. Meski demikian, ia tetap menjadi pembuat film independen sepanjang sebagian besar kariernya.

name: George MacKay
title: George MacKay (actor)
extract: George Andrew J. MacKay is an English actor. He began his career as a child actor in Peter Pan (2003). He had starring roles in the British war drama Private Peaceful (2012), the romantic film How I Live Now (2013), For Those in Peril (2013), for which he won a BAFTA Scotland Award, and Marrowbone (2017). He gained wider recognition for his leading role in the war film 1917 (2019) and won a British Independent Film Award for his performance in Femme (2023).
extract_id: George Andrew J. MacKay adalah aktor Inggris. Ia memulai kariernya sebagai aktor anak-anak dalam Peter Pan (2003). Ia membintangi drama perang Inggris Private Peaceful (2012), film romantis How I Live Now (2013), For Those in Peril (2013), yang memberinya BAFTA Scotland Award, dan Marrowbone (2017). Ia mendapat pengakuan lebih luas atas perannya dalam film perang 1917 (2019) dan memenangkan British Independent Film Award untuk penampilannya dalam Femme (2023).

name: George Macready
title: George Macready
extract: George Peabody Macready Jr. was an American stage, film, and television actor often cast in roles as polished villains, perhaps most notably in the 1946 film noir classic Gilda.
extract_id: George Peabody Macready Jr. adalah aktor panggung, film, dan televisi Amerika yang sering berperan sebagai penjahat yang halus, terutama dalam film noir klasik tahun 1946 Gilda.

name: George Miller
title: George Miller (filmmaker)
extract: George Miller is an Australian filmmaker. In a career spanning four decades, he has received critical and popular success, and is widely known for creating and directing every film in the Mad Max franchise starting in 1979, including two entries which are considered two of the greatest action films of all time according to Metacritic. Miller has earned numerous accolades, including an Academy Award from six nominations in five different categories.
extract_id: George Miller adalah pembuat film Australia. Dalam karier yang membentang empat dekade, ia telah meraih kesuksesan kritis dan populer, dan dikenal luas karena menciptakan dan menyutradarai setiap film dalam waralaba Mad Max yang dimulai pada 1979, termasuk dua film yang dianggap sebagai dua film aksi terbaik sepanjang masa menurut Metacritic. Miller telah meraih berbagai penghargaan, termasuk satu Academy Award dari enam nominasi di lima kategori berbeda.

name: George O'Brien
title: George O'Brien (actor)
extract: George O'Brien was an American actor, popular during the silent film era and into the sound film era of the 1930s. He is best known today as the lead actor in F. W. Murnau's 1927 Academy Award-winning film Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans. O'Brien also starred in a number of Westerns in the 1930s and 1940s, including roles in 14 films under director David Howard and 10 with acclaimed filmmaker John Ford.
extract_id: George O'Brien adalah aktor Amerika, populer selama era film bisu dan era film bersuara tahun 1930-an. Ia paling dikenal saat ini sebagai aktor utama dalam film pemenang Academy Award tahun 1927 karya F. W. Murnau, Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans. O'Brien juga membintangi sejumlah film Barat pada 1930-an dan 1940-an, termasuk peran dalam 14 film di bawah sutradara David Howard dan 10 film dengan pembuat film terkenal John Ford.

name: George P. Cosmatos
title: George P. Cosmatos
extract: George Pan Cosmatos was a Greek-Italian film director and screenwriter. Following early success in his home country with drama films such as Massacre in Rome with Richard Burton, Cosmatos retooled his career towards mainstream "blockbuster" action and adventure films, including The Cassandra Crossing and Escape to Athena, both of which were British-Italian co-productions. After relocating to North America, he directed the horror film Of Unknown Origin. This was followed by some of his best-known work, including the action films Rambo: First Blood Part II and Cobra, the science-fiction horror film Leviathan, and the critically acclaimed Western movie Tombstone.
extract_id: George Pan Cosmatos adalah sutradara film dan penulis naskah berkebangsaan Yunani-Italia. Setelah sukses awal di negaranya dengan film drama seperti Massacre in Rome dengan Richard Burton, Cosmatos mengarahkan kariernya ke film aksi dan petualangan "blockbuster" arus utama, termasuk The Cassandra Crossing dan Escape to Athena, yang keduanya adalah produksi bersama Inggris-Itali. Setelah pindah ke Amerika Utara, ia menyutradarai film horor Of Unknown Origin. Ini diikuti oleh karya-karya terkenalnya, termasuk film aksi Rambo: First Blood Part II dan Cobra, film horor fiksi ilmiah Leviathan, serta film Barat yang mendapat pujian kritis Tombstone.

name: George Peppard
title: George Peppard
extract: George Peppard was an American actor. He secured a major role as struggling writer Paul Varjak when he starred alongside Audrey Hepburn in Breakfast at Tiffany's (1961), and later portrayed a character based on Howard Hughes in The Carpetbaggers (1964). On television, he played the title role of millionaire insurance investigator and sleuth Thomas Banacek in the early-1970s mystery series Banacek. He played Col. John "Hannibal" Smith, the cigar-smoking leader of a renegade commando squad in the 1980s action television series The A-Team.
extract_id: George Peppard adalah aktor Amerika. Ia mendapatkan peran utama sebagai penulis yang berjuang, Paul Varjak, saat membintangi bersama Audrey Hepburn dalam Breakfast at Tiffany's (1961), dan kemudian memerankan karakter yang didasarkan pada Howard Hughes dalam The Carpetbaggers (1964). Di televisi, ia memerankan tokoh utama penyidik asuransi jutawan dan detektif Thomas Banacek dalam serial misteri awal 1970-an Banacek. Ia memerankan Kolonel John "Hannibal" Smith, pemimpin regu komando pemberontak perokok cerutu dalam serial aksi televisi tahun 1980-an The A-Team.

name: George Raft
title: George Raft
extract: George Raft was an American film actor and dancer identified with portrayals of gangsters in crime melodramas of the 1930s and the 1940s. A stylish leading man in dozens of movies, Raft is remembered for his gangster roles in Quick Millions (1931) with Spencer Tracy, Scarface (1932) with Paul Muni, Each Dawn I Die (1939) with James Cagney, Invisible Stripes (1939) with Humphrey Bogart, and Billy Wilder's comedy Some Like It Hot (1959) with Marilyn Monroe, Tony Curtis and Jack Lemmon; and as a dancer in Bolero (1934) with Carole Lombard and a truck driver in They Drive by Night (1940) with Ann Sheridan, Ida Lupino and again with Bogart.
extract_id: George Raft adalah aktor dan penari film Amerika yang dikenal karena peran-perannya sebagai gangster dalam melodrama kejahatan tahun 1930-an dan 1940-an. Sebagai pria utama yang bergaya dalam puluhan film, Raft dikenang karena peran gangster dalam Quick Millions (1931) bersama Spencer Tracy, Scarface (1932) bersama Paul Muni, Each Dawn I Die (1939) bersama James Cagney, Invisible Stripes (1939) bersama Humphrey Bogart, dan komedi Billy Wilder Some Like It Hot (1959) bersama Marilyn Monroe, Tony Curtis dan Jack Lemmon; serta sebagai penari dalam Bolero (1934) bersama Carole Lombard dan supir truk dalam They Drive by Night (1940) bersama Ann Sheridan, Ida Lupino dan kembali bersama Bogart.

name: George Roy Hill
title: George Roy Hill
extract: George Roy Hill was an American film director, writer, producer and actor. His films include Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid (1969) and The Sting (1973), both starring Paul Newman and Robert Redford. Both films also earned him nominations for the Academy Award for Best Director; he won for the latter.
extract_id: George Roy Hill adalah sutradara, penulis, produser, dan aktor film Amerika. Film-filmnya termasuk Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid (1969) dan The Sting (1973), keduanya dibintangi oleh Paul Newman dan Robert Redford. Kedua film tersebut juga memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik; ia menang untuk yang terakhir.

name: George Sanders
title: George Sanders
extract: George Henry Sanders was a Russian-born British actor and singer whose career spanned over 40 years. His heavy, upper-class English accent and smooth bass voice often led him to be cast as sophisticated but villainous characters. He is remembered for his roles as the wicked Jack Favell in Rebecca (1940), Scott Ffolliott in Foreign Correspondent, The Saran of Gaza in Samson and Delilah, theatre critic Addison DeWitt in All About Eve, Sir Brian De Bois-Guilbert in Ivanhoe (1952), King Richard the Lionheart in King Richard and the Crusaders (1954), Mr. Freeze in a two-part episode of Batman (1966), and the voice of Shere Khan in Disney's The Jungle Book (1967). He also starred as Simon Templar, in five of the eight films in The Saint series (1939–1941), and as a suave Saint-like crimefighter in the first four of the sixteen The Falcon films (1941–1942).
extract_id: George Henry Sanders adalah aktor dan penyanyi Inggris kelahiran Rusia yang kariernya berlangsung lebih dari 40 tahun. Aksen Inggris kelas atas yang berat dan suara bass halusnya sering membuatnya diperankan sebagai karakter yang canggih namun jahat. Ia dikenang melalui peran-perannya sebagai Jack Favell yang jahat dalam Rebecca (1940), Scott Ffolliott dalam Foreign Correspondent, Saran of Gaza dalam Samson and Delilah, kritikus teater Addison DeWitt dalam All About Eve, Sir Brian De Bois-Guilbert dalam Ivanhoe (1952), Raja Richard the Lionheart dalam King Richard and the Crusaders (1954), Mr. Freeze dalam episode dua bagian Batman (1966), dan suara Shere Khan dalam Disney's The Jungle Book (1967). Ia juga membintangi sebagai Simon Templar, dalam lima dari delapan film dalam seri The Saint (1939–1941), dan sebagai petarung kejahatan gaya Saint yang anggun dalam empat film pertama dari enam belas film The Falcon (1941–1942).

name: George Seaton
title: George Seaton
description: American filmmaker, playwright and theater director (1911–1979)
extract: George Seaton was an American screenwriter, playwright, film director and producer, and theater director. Seaton led several industry organizations, serving as a three-time president of the Motion Picture Academy of Arts and Sciences, president of the Writers Guild of America West and the Screen Directors Guild, and vice president of Motion Picture Relief Fund. He won two Academy Awards for his screenplays.
extract_id: George Seaton adalah penulis skenario, dramawan, sutradara dan produser film, serta sutradara teater Amerika. Seaton memimpin beberapa organisasi industri, menjabat sebagai presiden Motion Picture Academy of Arts and Sciences sebanyak tiga kali, presiden Writers Guild of America West dan Screen Directors Guild, serta wakil presiden Motion Picture Relief Fund. Ia memenangkan dua Academy Awards untuk naskah filmnya.

name: George Segal
title: George Segal
extract: George Segal Jr. was an American actor and musician. He became popular in the 1960s and 1970s for playing both dramatic and comedic roles. After first rising to prominence with roles in acclaimed films such as Ship of Fools (1965) and King Rat (1965), he co-starred in the drama Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf? (1966).
extract_id: George Segal Jr. adalah aktor dan musisi Amerika. Ia menjadi populer pada 1960-an dan 1970-an karena memerankan peran dramatis dan komedi. Setelah pertama kali menonjol dengan peran dalam film-film terkenal seperti Ship of Fools (1965) dan King Rat (1965), ia membintangi bersama dalam drama Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf? (1966).

name: George Sluizer
title: George Sluizer
extract: George Sluizer was a Dutch filmmaker whose credits included features as well as documentary films.
extract_id: George Sluizer adalah pembuat film Belanda yang kredensialnya mencakup film fitur serta film dokumenter.

name: George Stevens
title: George Stevens
extract: George Cooper Stevens was an American film director, producer, screenwriter, and cinematographer. He won the Academy Award for Best Director for A Place in the Sun (1951) and Giant (1956).
extract_id: George Cooper Stevens adalah sutradara film, produser, penulis naskah, dan sinematografer Amerika. Ia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik untuk A Place in the Sun (1951) dan Giant (1956).

name: Georges Franju
title: Georges Franju
extract: Georges Franju was a French filmmaker. He was born in Fougères, Ille-et-Vilaine.
extract_id: Georges Franju adalah pembuat film Prancis. Ia lahir di Fougères, Ille-et-Vilaine.

name: Gerald R. Molen
title: Gerald R. Molen
extract: Gerald Robert "Jerry" Molen is an American film producer. He is best known for producing films for Steven Spielberg and Amblin Entertainment, including Hook (1991), Jurassic Park (1993), and The Lost World: Jurassic Park (1997). Molen won the Academy Award for Best Picture for producing Schindler's List (1993), which is widely considered one of the greatest films ever made.
extract_id: Gerald Robert "Jerry" Molen adalah seorang produser film Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena memproduksi film untuk Steven Spielberg dan Amblin Entertainment, termasuk Hook (1991), Jurassic Park (1993), dan The Lost World: Jurassic Park (1997). Molen memenangkan Academy Award untuk Best Picture karena memproduksi Schindler's List (1993), yang secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu film terbaik yang pernah dibuat.

name: Geraldine Chaplin
title: Geraldine Chaplin
extract: Geraldine Leigh Chaplin is an actress whose extensive career has included multilingual roles in English, Spanish, French, Italian, and German films. Born in the United States and raised in the United Kingdom and Switzerland, she holds American, British, and Spanish citizenship. She is the daughter of Charlie Chaplin, the first of his eight children with his fourth wife, Oona O'Neill, and thus a granddaughter of playwright Eugene O'Neill.
extract_id: Geraldine Leigh Chaplin adalah seorang aktris dengan karier luas yang mencakup peran multibahasa dalam film berbahasa Inggris, Spanyol, Prancis, Italia, dan Jerman. Lahir di Amerika Serikat dan dibesarkan di Inggris dan Swiss, ia memegang kewarganegaraan Amerika, Inggris, dan Spanyol. Ia adalah putri Charlie Chaplin, anak pertama dari delapan anaknya dengan istri keempatnya, Oona O'Neill, dan dengan demikian cucu dari penulis drama Eugene O'Neill.

name: Gerard Butler
title: Gerard Butler
extract: Gerard James Butler is a Scottish actor and film producer. After studying law, he turned to acting in the mid-1990s with small roles in productions such as Mrs Brown (1997), the James Bond film Tomorrow Never Dies (1997), and Tale of the Mummy (1998). In 2000, he starred as Count Dracula in the gothic horror film Dracula 2000. He played Attila the Hun in the miniseries Attila (2001), then appeared in the films Reign of Fire (2002) and Lara Croft: Tomb Raider – The Cradle of Life (2003) before starring in the science fiction film Timeline (2003). He played Erik, The Phantom in Joel Schumacher's 2004 movie musical The Phantom of the Opera.
extract_id: Gerard James Butler adalah seorang aktor dan produser film Skotlandia. Setelah mempelajari hukum, ia beralih ke akting pada pertengahan 1990-an dengan peran kecil dalam produksi seperti Mrs Brown (1997), film James Bond Tomorrow Never Dies (1997), dan Tale of the Mummy (1998). Pada tahun 2000, ia berperan sebagai Count Dracula dalam film horor gotik Dracula 2000. Ia memerankan Attila the Hun dalam miniseri Attila (2001), kemudian tampil dalam film Reign of Fire (2002) dan Lara Croft: Tomb Raider – The Cradle of Life (2003) sebelum membintangi film fiksi ilmiah Timeline (2003). Ia berperan sebagai Erik, The Phantom dalam film musikal Joel Schumacher tahun 2004 The Phantom of the Opera.

name: Gerardo Taracena
title: Gerardo Taracena
extract: Gerardo Taracena was a Mexican actor and dancer. He is known for his roles in Apocalypto (2006), Man on Fire (2004), The Violin (2005), and Sin nombre (2009). He is also known for the Netflix series Narcos: Mexico.
extract_id: Gerardo Taracena adalah aktor dan penari asal Meksiko. Ia dikenal lewat perannya dalam Apocalypto (2006), Man on Fire (2004), The Violin (2005), dan Sin nombre (2009). Ia juga dikenal lewat seri Netflix Narcos: Mexico.

name: Gerd Oswald
title: Gerd Oswald
extract: Gerd Oswald was a German director of American films and television.
extract_id: Gerd Oswald adalah sutradara Jerman dari film dan televisi Amerika.

name: Gert Fröbe
title: Gert Fröbe
extract: Karl Gerhart "Gert" Fröbe was a German actor who appeared in over 100, mostly German-produced films. He was best known in English-speaking countries for his work as the title character in the James Bond film Goldfinger (1964). Other international films include his role as Baron Bomburst in Chitty Chitty Bang Bang (1968), as General Dietrich von Choltitz in Is Paris Burning? (1966), as Colonel Manfred von Holstein in Those Magnificent Men in Their Flying Machines (1965), and as Inspector Bauer in Ingmar Bergman's The Serpent's Egg (1977).
