extract_id: Karl Gerhart "Gert" Fröbe adalah aktor Jerman yang tampil dalam lebih dari 100 film, sebagian besar diproduksi di Jerman. Ia paling dikenal di negara berbahasa Inggris untuk perannya sebagai tokoh utama dalam film James Bond Goldfinger (1964). Film internasional lain termasuk perannya sebagai Baron Bomburst dalam Chitty Chitty Bang Bang (1968), sebagai Jenderal Dietrich von Choltitz dalam Is Paris Burning? (1966), sebagai Kolonel Manfred von Holstein dalam Those Magnificent Men in Their Flying Machines (1965), dan sebagai Inspektur Bauer dalam The Serpent's Egg karya Ingmar Bergman (1977).

name: Gian Maria Volontè
title: Gian Maria Volonté
extract: Gian Maria Volonté was an Italian actor and activist. He is known for his roles in Italian Western films: Ramón Rojo in Sergio Leone's A Fistful of Dollars (1964), El Indio in Leone's For a Few Dollars More (1965), El Chuncho Munoz in Damiano Damiani's A Bullet for the General (1966) and Professor Brad Fletcher in Sergio Sollima's Face to Face (1967) as well as high-profile social dramas depicting the political and social stirrings of Italian and European society in the 1960s and 1970s, including four films directed by Elio Petri – We Still Kill the Old Way (1967), Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion (1970), The Working Class Goes to Heaven (1971), and Todo modo (1976). He is also recognized for his performances in Jean-Pierre Melville's Le Cercle Rouge (1970), Giuliano Montaldo's Sacco & Vanzetti (1971) and Giordano Bruno (1973), and Francesco Rosi's Christ Stopped at Eboli (1979).
extract_id: Gian Maria Volonté adalah aktor dan aktivis Italia. Ia dikenal lewat peran-perannya dalam film Western Italia: Ramón Rojo dalam A Fistful of Dollars karya Sergio Leone (1964), El Indio dalam For a Few Dollars More karya Leone (1965), El Chuncho Munoz dalam A Bullet for the General karya Damiano Damiani (1966) dan Profesor Brad Fletcher dalam Face to Face karya Sergio Sollima (1967) serta drama sosial berprofil tinggi yang menggambarkan gejolak politik dan sosial masyarakat Italia dan Eropa pada 1960-an dan 1970-an, termasuk empat film yang disutradarai oleh Elio Petri – We Still Kill the Old Way (1967), Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion (1970), The Working Class Goes to Heaven (1971), dan Todo modo (1976). Ia juga dikenal melalui penampilannya dalam Le Cercle Rouge karya Jean-Pierre Melville (1970), Sacco & Vanzetti dan Giordano Bruno karya Giuliano Montaldo (1971 dan 1973), dan Christ Stopped at Eboli karya Francesco Rosi (1979).

name: Gil Birmingham
title: Gil Birmingham
extract: Gilbert "Gil" Birmingham is an American film and television actor. He is known for his roles as Tribal Chairman Thomas Rainwater on the Paramount Network series Yellowstone (2018–2024) and the CBS series Marshals (2026–present), George Hunter on Banshee (2014), Virgil White on Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt (2015–2017), and Billy Black in The Twilight Saga film series (2008–2012).
extract_id: Gilbert "Gil" Birmingham adalah aktor film dan televisi Amerika. Ia dikenal lewat perannya sebagai Tribal Chairman Thomas Rainwater dalam seri Paramount Network Yellowstone (2018–2024) dan seri CBS Marshals (2026–sekarang), George Hunter dalam Banshee (2014), Virgil White dalam Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt (2015–2017), dan Billy Black dalam seri film The Twilight Saga (2008–2012).

name: Gillian Anderson
title: Gillian Anderson
extract: Gillian Leigh Anderson is an American actress and writer. She received international fame for starring as FBI Special Agent Dana Scully in the Fox science fiction mystery series The X-Files, winning a Primetime Emmy Award for the role. Her other credits include socialite Lily Bart in Terence Davies's film The House of Mirth (2000), DSU Stella Gibson in the BBC/RTÉ crime drama television series The Fall (2013–2016), sex therapist Jean Milburn in the Netflix comedy-drama Sex Education (2019–2023), and British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher in the fourth season of Netflix drama series The Crown (2020), for which she earned her second Golden Globe and Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Gillian Leigh Anderson adalah seorang aktris dan penulis Amerika. Ia meraih ketenaran internasional sebagai FBI Special Agent Dana Scully dalam seri misteri fiksi ilmiah Fox The X-Files, memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award untuk peran tersebut. Kredit lainnya termasuk socialite Lily Bart dalam film Terence Davies The House of Mirth (2000), DSU Stella Gibson dalam drama kriminal televisi BBC/RTÉ The Fall (2013–2016), terapis seks Jean Milburn dalam komedi-drama Netflix Sex Education (2019–2023), dan Perdana Menteri Inggris Margaret Thatcher dalam musim keempat seri drama Netflix The Crown (2020), yang membuatnya meraih Golden Globe dan Primetime Emmy Awards kedua.

name: Gillo Pontecorvo
title: Gillo Pontecorvo
extract: Gilberto Pontecorvo Cavaliere di Gran Croce OMRI was an Italian filmmaker associated with the political cinema movement of the 1960s and '70s. He is best known for directing the landmark war docudrama The Battle of Algiers (1966). It won the Golden Lion at the 27th Venice Film Festival, and earned him Oscar nominations for Best Director and Best Original Screenplay.
extract_id: Gilberto Pontecorvo Cavaliere di Gran Croce OMRI adalah pembuat film Italia yang terkait dengan gerakan sinema politik pada 1960-an dan 1970-an. Ia paling dikenal sebagai sutradara dokudrama perang bersejarah The Battle of Algiers (1966). Film ini memenangkan Golden Lion di Festival Film Venesia ke-27, dan memberinya nominasi Oscar untuk Sutradara Terbaik dan Skenario Asli Terbaik.

name: Gina Torres
title: Gina Torres
extract: Gina Torres is an American actress. Her starring roles include Zoë Washburne in the science fiction series Firefly (2002–2003) and its feature film sequel Serenity (2005), and as Jessica Pearson in the legal drama series Suits (2011–2018) and its spin-off series Pearson (2019). Most recently, she starred on the series 9-1-1: Lone Star (2021–2025).
extract_id: Gina Torres adalah aktris Amerika. Peran utamanya termasuk Zoë Washburne dalam seri fiksi ilmiah Firefly (2002–2003) dan sekuel filmnya Serenity (2005), serta Jessica Pearson dalam drama hukum Suits (2011–2018) dan seri spin-offnya Pearson (2019). Baru-baru ini, ia membintangi seri 9-1-1: Lone Star (2021–2025).

name: Ginnifer Goodwin
title: Ginnifer Goodwin
extract: Ginnifer Goodwin is an American actress. She starred as Margene Heffman in the HBO drama series Big Love (2006–2011), Snow White / Mary Margaret Blanchard in the ABC fantasy series Once Upon a Time (2011–2018), Judy Hopps in Zootopia franchise (2016–present) and Beth Ann Stanton in Why Women Kill (2019).
extract_id: Ginnifer Goodwin adalah aktris Amerika. Ia berperan sebagai Margene Heffman dalam drama HBO Big Love (2006–2011), Snow White / Mary Margaret Blanchard dalam seri fantasi ABC Once Upon a Time (2011–2018), Judy Hopps dalam franchise Zootopia (2016–sekarang) dan Beth Ann Stanton dalam Why Women Kill (2019).

name: Giorgi Nakashidze
title: Giorgi Nakashidze
extract: Giorgi Nakashidze is a Georgian film, television, and stage actor.
extract_id: Giorgi Nakashidze adalah aktor film, televisi, dan panggung asal Georgia.

name: Giorgio Cantarini
title: Giorgio Cantarini
extract: Giorgio Cantarini is an Italian actor who, to date, has appeared in two Academy Award winning films: Life Is Beautiful (1997) and Gladiator (2000).
extract_id: Giorgio Cantarini adalah aktor Italia yang, sampai saat ini, telah tampil dalam dua film pemenang Academy Award: Life Is Beautiful (1997) dan Gladiator (2000).

name: Giovanni Ribisi
title: Giovanni Ribisi
extract: Antonino Giovanni Ribisi is an American actor. He has appeared in the films That Thing You Do! (1996), Saving Private Ryan (1998), Gone in 60 Seconds (2000), Heaven (2002), Flight of the Phoenix (2004), Perfect Stranger (2007), Avatar (2009), Public Enemies (2009), Gangster Squad (2013), A Million Ways to Die in the West (2014), and Papa: Hemingway in Cuba (2015). He had starring roles in the TV sitcom Dads (2013–2014) and the crime drama series Sneaky Pete (2015–2019). He also had recurring roles in television series such as The Wonder Years (1992–1993), Friends, and My Name Is Earl (2005–2008).
extract_id: Antonino Giovanni Ribisi adalah aktor Amerika. Ia tampil dalam film That Thing You Do! (1996), Saving Private Ryan (1998), Gone in 60 Seconds (2000), Heaven (2002), Flight of the Phoenix (2004), Perfect Stranger (2007), Avatar (2009), Public Enemies (2009), Gangster Squad (2013), A Million Ways to Die in the West (2014), dan Papa: Hemingway in Cuba (2015). Ia memegang peran utama dalam sitkom TV Dads (2013–2014) dan seri drama kriminal Sneaky Pete (2015–2019). Ia juga memiliki peran berulang dalam seri televisi seperti The Wonder Years (1992–1993), Friends, dan My Name Is Earl (2005–2008).

name: Giulietta Masina
title: Giulietta Masina
extract: Giulia Anna "Giulietta" Masina was an Italian film actress best known for her performances as Gelsomina in La Strada (1954) and Cabiria in Nights of Cabiria (1957), for which she won the Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Actress at the 1957 Cannes Film Festival.
extract_id: Giulia Anna "Giulietta" Masina adalah aktris film Italia yang paling dikenal lewat penampilannya sebagai Gelsomina dalam La Strada (1954) dan Cabiria dalam Nights of Cabiria (1957), yang membuatnya memenangkan Penghargaan Aktris Terbaik Festival Film Cannes 1957.

name: Giuseppe Battiston
title: Giuseppe Battiston
extract: Giuseppe Battiston is an Italian actor. He has appeared in more than 50 films since 1990.
extract_id: Giuseppe Battiston adalah aktor Italia. Ia telah tampil dalam lebih dari 50 film sejak 1990.

name: Giuseppe Tornatore
title: Giuseppe Tornatore
extract: Giuseppe Tornatore is an Italian film director and screenwriter. He is considered one of the directors who brought critical acclaim back to Italian cinema. In a career spanning over 30 years he is best known for directing and writing drama films such as Everybody's Fine, The Legend of 1900, Malèna, Baarìa and The Best Offer. His most noted film is Cinema Paradiso, for which Tornatore won the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film. He has also directed several advertising campaigns for Dolce & Gabbana.
extract_id: Giuseppe Tornatore adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario Italia. Ia dianggap sebagai salah satu sutradara yang mengembalikan pujian kritis ke sinema Italia. Dalam karier yang berlangsung lebih dari 30 tahun, ia paling dikenal sebagai sutradara dan penulis film drama seperti Everybody's Fine, The Legend of 1900, Malèna, Baarìa, dan The Best Offer. Filmnya yang paling terkenal adalah Cinema Paradiso, yang membuat Tornatore memenangkan Academy Award untuk Best Foreign Language Film. Ia juga menyutradarai beberapa kampanye iklan untuk Dolce & Gabbana.

name: Giustino Durano
title: Giustino Durano
extract: Giustino Durano was an Italian actor best known for his work as Eliseo Orefice in the 1997 film Life Is Beautiful. For his role, he was nominated in part for a Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by a Cast.
extract_id: Giustino Durano adalah aktor Italia yang paling dikenal lewat perannya sebagai Eliseo Orefice dalam film Life Is Beautiful tahun 1997. Untuk perannya tersebut, ia sebagian dinominasikan untuk Screen Actors Guild Award untuk Penampilan Luar Biasa oleh Pemeran.

name: Gladys George
title: Gladys George
extract: Gladys George was an American actress of stage and screen. Though nominated for an Academy Award for her leading role in Valiant Is the Word for Carrie (1936), she spent most of her career in supporting roles in films such as Marie Antoinette (1938), The Roaring Twenties (1939), The Maltese Falcon (1941), The Best Years of Our Lives (1946), Flamingo Road (1949), and Lullaby of Broadway (1951) in which marked her first color film.
extract_id: Gladys George adalah aktris panggung dan layar Amerika. Meskipun dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk peran utamanya dalam Valiant Is the Word for Carrie (1936), ia menghabiskan sebagian besar kariernya dalam peran pendukung dalam film seperti Marie Antoinette (1938), The Roaring Twenties (1939), The Maltese Falcon (1941), The Best Years of Our Lives (1946), Flamingo Road (1949), dan Lullaby of Broadway (1951) yang merupakan film warna pertamanya.

name: Glen Cavender
title: Glen Cavender
extract: Glen W. Cavender was an American film actor. He appeared in more than 250 films between 1914 and 1949.
extract_id: Glen W. Cavender adalah aktor film Amerika. Ia tampil dalam lebih dari 250 film antara tahun 1914 dan 1949.

name: Glen Hansard
title: Glen Hansard
extract: Glen James Hansard was an Irish musician. From Ballymun in northern Dublin, he busked from his teens. In 1990, he co-founded the Irish rock band the Frames, which he fronted. The band released six studio albums, four of which reached the top ten of the Irish Albums Chart. Hansard was also a member of the folk rock duo the Swell Season, founded in 2005, which released three albums. In 2012, he released his debut solo album, Rhythm and Repose. His second album, Didn't He Ramble (2015), was nominated for the Grammy Award for Best Folk Album.
extract_id: Glen James Hansard adalah musisi Irlandia. Dari Ballymun di utara Dublin, ia mengamen sejak remaja. Pada tahun 1990, ia ikut mendirikan band rock Irlandia the Frames, yang dipimpinnya. Band ini merilis enam album studio, empat di antaranya mencapai sepuluh besar di Irish Albums Chart. Hansard juga anggota duo folk rock the Swell Season, yang didirikan pada 2005, dan merilis tiga album. Pada 2012, ia merilis album solo perdananya, Rhythm and Repose. Album keduanya, Didn't He Ramble (2015), dinominasikan untuk Grammy Award untuk Best Folk Album.

name: Glenn Ford
title: Glenn Ford
extract: Gwyllyn Samuel Newton Ford, known as Glenn Ford, was a Canadian-born American actor. He was most prominent during Hollywood's Golden Age as one of the biggest box-office draws of the 1940s, 1950s, and 1960s, and had a career that lasted more than 50 years.
extract_id: Gwyllyn Samuel Newton Ford, dikenal sebagai Glenn Ford, adalah aktor kelahiran Kanada yang berkewarganeraan Amerika. Ia paling menonjol selama Zaman Keemasan Hollywood sebagai salah satu daya tarik box-office terbesar pada 1940-an, 1950-an, dan 1960-an, dengan karier yang berlangsung lebih dari 50 tahun.

name: Gloria Grahame
title: Gloria Grahame
extract: Gloria Grahame was an American actress. She began her acting career in theater and in 1944 made her first film for MGM. Many biographies indicate she was born Gloria Grahame Hallward, but she adopted the surname Grahame, her mother's acting name, as her professional name.
extract_id: Gloria Grahame adalah aktris Amerika. Ia memulai karier aktingnya di teater dan pada 1944 membuat film pertamanya untuk MGM. Banyak biografi menunjukkan bahwa ia lahir dengan nama Gloria Grahame Hallward, namun ia mengadopsi nama belakang Grahame, nama panggung ibunya, sebagai nama profesionalnya.

name: Gloria Stuart
title: Gloria Stuart
extract: Gloria Frances Stuart was an American actress, visual artist and activist. She was known for her roles in pre-code films, and garnered renewed fame late in life for her portrayal of Rose Dawson Calvert in James Cameron's epic romance Titanic (1997), one of the highest-grossing films of all time. Her performance in the film won her a Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by a Female Actor in a Supporting Role and earned her nominations for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress and the Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress – Motion Picture.
extract_id: Gloria Frances Stuart adalah aktris, seniman visual, dan aktivis Amerika. Ia dikenal lewat peran dalam film pra-code dan memperoleh ketenaran kembali di akhir hayatnya karena perannya sebagai Rose Dawson Calvert dalam film epik romantis Titanic karya James Cameron (1997), salah satu film dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa. Penampilannya dalam film tersebut membuatnya memenangkan Screen Actors Guild Award untuk Penampilan Luar Biasa oleh Pemeran Wanita Pendukung dan memperoleh nominasi Academy Award untuk Best Supporting Actress serta Golden Globe Award untuk Best Supporting Actress – Motion Picture.

name: Gloria Swanson
title: Gloria Swanson
extract: Gloria Mae Josephine Swanson was an American actress. She first achieved fame acting in dozens of silent films in the 1920s and was nominated three times for the Academy Award for Best Actress, most famously for her 1950 turn in Billy Wilder's Sunset Boulevard, which also earned her a Golden Globe Award.
extract_id: Gloria Mae Josephine Swanson adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia pertama kali meraih ketenaran dengan berakting dalam banyak film bisu pada tahun 1920-an dan dinominasikan tiga kali untuk Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik, yang paling terkenal untuk peranannya pada tahun 1950 dalam film Billy Wilder berjudul Sunset Boulevard, yang juga memberinya Golden Globe Award.

name: Glynis Johns
title: Glynis Johns
extract: Glynis Margaret Payne Johns was a British actress and singer. In a career exceeding seven decades on stage and screen, Johns appeared in more than 60 films and 30 plays. She received various accolades throughout her career, including a Tony Award and a Drama Desk Award, as well as nominations for an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award and a Laurence Olivier Award. Before her death at age 100, she was considered one of the last surviving stars from the Golden Age of Hollywood and classical years of British cinema.
extract_id: Glynis Margaret Payne Johns adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Inggris. Dalam karier yang berlangsung lebih dari tujuh dekade di panggung dan layar, Johns tampil dalam lebih dari 60 film dan 30 drama. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan sepanjang kariernya, termasuk Tony Award dan Drama Desk Award, serta nominasi untuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Laurence Olivier Award. Sebelum wafat pada usia 100 tahun, dia dianggap sebagai salah satu bintang terakhir yang masih hidup dari Era Keemasan Hollywood dan masa klasik sinema Inggris.

name: Godfrey Tearle
title: Godfrey Tearle
extract: Sir Godfrey Seymour Tearle was a British actor who portrayed the quintessential British gentleman on stage and in both British and US films.
extract_id: Sir Godfrey Seymour Tearle adalah aktor Inggris yang memerankan sosok pria Inggris sejati di panggung serta dalam film-film Inggris dan AS.

name: Golshifteh Farahani
title: Golshifteh Farahani
extract: Rahavard Farahani, known professionally as Golshifteh Farahani, is an Iranian actress. She gained recognition for her performances in The Pear Tree (1998), which won her the Best Actress award at the Fajr International Film Festival, Half Moon (2006), which won the Golden Shell award at the 2006 San Sebastián Film Festival, and M for Mother (2006), which won her a Roshd International Film Festival award and was chosen to represent Iran in the Best Foreign Film Category of that year's Academy Awards.
extract_id: Rahavard Farahani, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Golshifteh Farahani, adalah seorang aktris Iran. Dia mendapatkan pengakuan atas penampilannya dalam The Pear Tree (1998), yang memberinya penghargaan Aktris Terbaik di Festival Film Internasional Fajr, Half Moon (2006), yang memenangkan penghargaan Golden Shell di Festival Film San Sebastián 2006, dan M for Mother (2006), yang memberinya penghargaan Festival Film Internasional Roshd dan dipilih untuk mewakili Iran dalam kategori Film Asing Terbaik pada Academy Awards tahun itu.

name: Gong Li
title: Gong Li
extract: Gong Li is a Chinese-born Singaporean actress. Known for her versatility and naturalistic performances, she is regarded as one of the best actresses in Chinese cinema. She starred in three Chinese-language films that have been nominated for the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film.
extract_id: Gong Li adalah aktris kelahiran China yang menjadi warga Singapura. Dikenal karena kemampuannya yang serba bisa dan penampilan yang naturalistik, dia dianggap sebagai salah satu aktris terbaik dalam sinema China. Dia membintangi tiga film berbahasa China yang pernah dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Film Internasional Terbaik.

name: Gore Verbinski
title: Gore Verbinski
extract: Gregor Justin "Gore" Verbinski is an American film director, screenwriter, producer, and musician. He is best known for directing Mouse Hunt (1997), The Ring (2002), the first three Pirates of the Caribbean films, Rango (2011), and The Lone Ranger (2013). For Rango, Verbinski won both the Academy Award and the BAFTA Award for Best Animated Film.
extract_id: Gregor Justin "Gore" Verbinski adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, produser, dan musisi asal Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai Mouse Hunt (1997), The Ring (2002), tiga film pertama Pirates of the Caribbean, Rango (2011), dan The Lone Ranger (2013). Untuk Rango, Verbinski memenangkan Academy Award dan BAFTA Award untuk Film Animasi Terbaik.

name: Gore Vidal
title: Gore Vidal
extract: Eugene Luther Gore Vidal was an American writer and public intellectual known for his cynical epigrammatic wit. His novels and essays criticized the social and sexual norms he perceived as driving American life. Vidal was heavily involved in politics, and unsuccessfully sought office twice as a Democratic Party candidate, first in 1960 to the United States House of Representatives, and later in 1982 to the United States Senate.
extract_id: Eugene Luther Gore Vidal adalah penulis dan intelektual publik Amerika yang dikenal karena kecerdasan sinisnya yang berupa epigram. Novel dan esainya mengkritik norma sosial dan seksual yang dia pandang menggerakkan kehidupan Amerika. Vidal sangat terlibat dalam politik, dan dua kali tanpa hasil mencalonkan diri sebagai kandidat Partai Demokrat, pertama pada tahun 1960 untuk Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Amerika Serikat, dan kemudian pada tahun 1982 untuk Senat Amerika Serikat.

name: Gorô Naya
title: Gorō Naya
extract: Gorō Naya was a Japanese actor, voice actor, narrator and theatre director from Hakodate, Hokkaidō. He was part of Theatre Echo all his career, and was the older brother of actor and voice actor Rokurō Naya.
extract_id: Gorō Naya adalah aktor, pengisi suara, narator, dan sutradara teater Jepang dari Hakodate, Hokkaidō. Dia menjadi bagian dari Theatre Echo sepanjang kariernya dan merupakan kakak laki-laki dari aktor dan pengisi suara Rokurō Naya.

name: Goya Toledo
title: Goya Toledo
extract: Gregoria Micaela Toledo Machín professionally known as Goya Toledo, is a Spanish actress and model. She has appeared in Amores perros, Killing Words, and 13 Roses.
extract_id: Gregoria Micaela Toledo Machín yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Goya Toledo, adalah aktris dan model Spanyol. Dia tampil dalam film Amores perros, Killing Words, dan 13 Roses.

name: Grace Kelly
title: Grace Kelly
description: American actress, Princess of Monaco from 1956 to 1982
extract: Grace Patricia Kelly was an American actress and Princess of Monaco as the wife of Prince Rainier III from their marriage on April 18, 1956, until her death in 1982. Prior to her marriage, she achieved stardom in several significant Hollywood films in the early to mid-1950s. She received an Academy Award and three Golden Globe Awards, and was ranked 13th on the American Film Institute's 25 Greatest Female Stars list.
extract_id: Grace Patricia Kelly adalah seorang aktris Amerika dan Putri Monako sebagai istri Pangeran Rainier III sejak pernikahan mereka pada 18 April 1956 hingga kematiannya pada 1982. Sebelum menikah, dia meraih ketenaran dalam beberapa film Hollywood penting pada awal hingga pertengahan 1950-an. Dia menerima Academy Award dan tiga Golden Globe Awards, serta menempati peringkat ke-13 dalam daftar 25 Bintang Wanita Terbesar oleh American Film Institute.

name: Gracy Singh
title: Gracy Singh
extract: Gracy Singh is an Indian actress who primarily worked in Hindi and Telugu films. She is best known for her role in the films Lagaan (2001) and Munna Bhai M.B.B.S (2003). Singh is also a trained Bharatnatyam and Odissi dancer.
extract_id: Gracy Singh adalah seorang aktris India yang sebagian besar bekerja di film Hindi dan Telugu. Dia paling dikenal atas perannya dalam film Lagaan (2001) dan Munna Bhai M.B.B.S (2003). Singh juga seorang penari yang terlatih dalam seni tari Bharatnatyam dan Odissi.

name: Graham Chapman
title: Graham Chapman
extract: Graham Chapman was a British actor, comedian and writer. He was one of the six members of the surrealist comedy group Monty Python. He portrayed authority figures such as The Colonel and the lead role in two Python films, Monty Python and the Holy Grail (1975) and Monty Python's Life of Brian (1979).
extract_id: Graham Chapman adalah aktor, komedian, dan penulis asal Inggris. Dia adalah salah satu dari enam anggota kelompok komedi surealis Monty Python. Dia memerankan figur otoritas seperti The Colonel dan peran utama dalam dua film Python, Monty Python and the Holy Grail (1975) dan Monty Python's Life of Brian (1979).

name: Graham Greene
title: Graham Greene
extract: Henry Graham Greene was an English writer and journalist regarded by many as one of the leading novelists of the 20th century.
extract_id: Henry Graham Greene adalah penulis dan jurnalis Inggris yang dianggap oleh banyak orang sebagai salah satu novelis terkemuka pada abad ke-20.

name: Graham Norton
title: Graham Norton
description: Irish comedian, actor, and television host (born 1963)
extract: Graham William Walker, known professionally as Graham Norton, is an Irish comedian, broadcaster, actor, and author. He is best known as a chat show host, having presented The Graham Norton Show since 2007. Norton has won the British Academy Television Award for Best Entertainment Performance a record six times and has an additional BAFTA win for producing. He has been noted for his innuendo-laden dialogue and flamboyant presentation style.
extract_id: Graham William Walker, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Graham Norton, adalah komedian, penyiar, aktor, dan penulis Irlandia. Dia paling dikenal sebagai pembawa acara chat show, yang telah dipandu oleh The Graham Norton Show sejak 2007. Norton telah memenangkan British Academy Television Award untuk Penampilan Hiburan Terbaik sebanyak enam kali, sebuah rekor, dan juga memenangkan BAFTA tambahan sebagai produser. Dia dikenal karena dialog bernuansa kata-kata kiasan dan gaya penyajian flamboyan.

name: Greg Cruttwell
title: Greg Cruttwell
description: English football consultant and former actor
extract: Gregory Jasper Cruttwell is an English filmmaker, former actor and the founder of football club, Balham F.C. He is the son of actress Geraldine McEwan and Hugh Cruttwell, former principal of the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art.
extract_id: Gregory Jasper Cruttwell adalah pembuat film Inggris, mantan aktor, dan pendiri klub sepak bola Balham F.C. Dia adalah putra dari aktris Geraldine McEwan dan Hugh Cruttwell, mantan kepala Royal Academy of Dramatic Art.

name: Greg Grunberg
title: Greg Grunberg
extract: Gregory Phillip Grunberg is an American film and television actor known for starring as Eric Weiss in the ABC series Alias, Matt Parkman in the NBC series Heroes, Temmin "Snap" Wexley in Star Wars: The Force Awakens and Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker, and Phil in A Star Is Born. He has often appeared in works produced and directed by his childhood friend J. J. Abrams, such as Felicity as Sean Blumberg. He was a recurring cast member in the first two seasons of the Showtime American television drama series Masters of Sex.
extract_id: Gregory Phillip Grunberg adalah aktor film dan televisi Amerika yang dikenal karena berperan sebagai Eric Weiss dalam serial ABC Alias, Matt Parkman dalam serial NBC Heroes, Temmin "Snap" Wexley dalam Star Wars: The Force Awakens dan Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker, serta Phil dalam A Star Is Born. Dia sering muncul dalam karya-karya yang diproduksi dan disutradarai oleh teman masa kecilnya J. J. Abrams, seperti di Felicity sebagai Sean Blumberg. Dia adalah anggota pemain yang sering muncul dalam dua musim pertama serial drama televisi Amerika Showtime Masters of Sex.

name: Greg Kinnear
title: Greg Kinnear
extract: Gregory Buck Kinnear is an American actor and former talk show host. He was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for his role in As Good as It Gets (1997).
extract_id: Gregory Buck Kinnear adalah aktor Amerika dan mantan pembawa acara talk show. Dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik atas perannya dalam As Good as It Gets (1997).

name: Gregg Araki
title: Gregg Araki
extract: Gregg Araki is an American filmmaker. He is noted for his involvement with the New Queer Cinema movement. His Teenage Apocalypse film trilogy, consisting of Totally F***ed Up (1993), The Doom Generation (1995) and Nowhere (1997), has been heralded as a cult classic. His film Kaboom (2010) was the inaugural winner of the Queer Palm at the Cannes Film Festival.
extract_id: Gregg Araki adalah pembuat film Amerika. Dia dikenal karena keterlibatannya dengan gerakan New Queer Cinema. Trilogi film Teenage Apocalypse-nya, yang terdiri dari Totally F***ed Up (1993), The Doom Generation (1995), dan Nowhere (1997), telah dianggap sebagai klasik kultus. Filmnya Kaboom (2010) adalah pemenang perdana Queer Palm di Festival Film Cannes.

name: Gregory Hoblit
title: Gregory Hoblit
extract: Gregory Hoblit is an American film director, television director and television producer. He is known for directing the feature films Primal Fear (1996), Fallen (1998), Frequency (2000), Hart's War (2002), Fracture (2007), and Untraceable (2008). He has won nine Emmy Awards for directing and producing, an accolade which includes work on the television series Hill Street Blues, NYPD Blue, L.A. Law, and Hooperman, and the television film Roe vs. Wade.
extract_id: Gregory Hoblit adalah sutradara film, sutradara televisi, dan produser televisi Amerika. Dia dikenal karena menyutradarai film fitur Primal Fear (1996), Fallen (1998), Frequency (2000), Hart's War (2002), Fracture (2007), dan Untraceable (2008). Dia telah memenangkan sembilan Emmy Awards untuk penyutradaraan dan produksi, sebuah penghargaan yang mencakup karya pada seri televisi Hill Street Blues, NYPD Blue, L.A. Law, dan Hooperman, serta film televisi Roe vs. Wade.

name: Gregory Peck
title: Gregory Peck
extract: Eldred Gregory Peck was an American actor. He was one of the most popular film stars from the 1940s to the 1970s. In 1999, the American Film Institute named Peck the 12th-greatest male star of Classic Hollywood Cinema.
extract_id: Eldred Gregory Peck adalah aktor Amerika. Dia adalah salah satu bintang film paling populer dari tahun 1940-an hingga 1970-an. Pada 1999, American Film Institute menobatkan Peck sebagai bintang pria ke-12 terbesar dalam Sinema Klasik Hollywood.

name: Greta Gerwig
title: Greta Gerwig
extract: Greta Celeste Gerwig is an American actress and filmmaker. She was initially known for working on various mumblecore films, such as Baghead (2008) and Yeast (2008), in which she became an important figure in the movement. Since then she has expanded from acting in and co-writing independent films to directing major studio films. Gerwig was included in the annual Time 100 list of the most influential people in the world in 2018.
extract_id: Greta Celeste Gerwig adalah aktris dan pembuat film Amerika. Dia awalnya dikenal karena bekerja pada berbagai film mumblecore, seperti Baghead (2008) dan Yeast (2008), di mana dia menjadi figur penting dalam gerakan tersebut. Sejak itu dia berkembang dari berperan dan menulis bersama film independen menjadi menyutradarai film studio besar. Gerwig dimasukkan dalam daftar Time 100 tahunan orang-orang paling berpengaruh di dunia pada 2018.

name: Greta Schröder
title: Greta Schröder
extract: Greta Schröder was a German actress. She is best known for the role of Ellen Hutter, Thomas Hutter's wife and the cause of Count Orlok's destruction in Nosferatu (1922). In the fictionalized 2000 film Shadow of the Vampire, she is portrayed as having been a famous actress during the making of Nosferatu, but in fact she was little known. The bulk of her career was during the 1920s, and she continued to act well into the 1950s, but by the 1930s her roles had diminished to only occasional appearances. Following a failed marriage with struggling actor Ernst Matray, she was married to actor and film director Paul Wegener.
extract_id: Greta Schröder adalah aktris Jerman. Dia paling dikenal untuk peran Ellen Hutter, istri Thomas Hutter dan penyebab kehancuran Count Orlok dalam Nosferatu (1922). Dalam film fiksi 2000 Shadow of the Vampire, dia digambarkan sebagai aktris terkenal selama pembuatan Nosferatu, padahal sebenarnya dia kurang dikenal. Sebagian besar kariernya berlangsung selama tahun 1920-an, dan dia terus berakting hingga 1950-an, tetapi pada 1930-an perannya berkurang menjadi hanya penampilan sesekali. Setelah pernikahan yang gagal dengan aktor yang berjuang Ernst Matray, dia menikah dengan aktor sekaligus sutradara film Paul Wegener.

name: Griffin Dunne
title: Griffin Dunne
extract: Thomas Griffin Dunne is an American actor, director, and producer. Known for his performances on film and television, he has received nominations for an Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, and Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Thomas Griffin Dunne adalah aktor, sutradara, dan produser Amerika. Dikenal atas penampilannya di film dan televisi, dia telah menerima nominasi untuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Grigoriy Aleksandrov
title: Grigori Aleksandrov
extract: Grigori Vasilyevich Aleksandrov was a Soviet film director who was named a People's Artist of the USSR in 1947 and a Hero of Socialist Labour in 1973. He was awarded the Stalin Prizes for 1941 and 1950.
extract_id: Grigori Vasilyevich Aleksandrov adalah sutradara film Soviet yang dinobatkan sebagai People's Artist of the USSR pada 1947 dan Hero of Socialist Labour pada 1973. Dia dianugerahi Stalin Prizes untuk tahun 1941 dan 1950.

name: Groucho Marx
title: Groucho Marx
extract: Julius Henry "Groucho" Marx was an American comedian, actor, comic vocalist and game show host who performed in vaudeville, Broadway, films, radio, and television. A master of the one-line retort, he is considered one of America's greatest comedians.
extract_id: Julius Henry "Groucho" Marx adalah komedian, aktor, vokalis komik, dan pembawa acara game show Amerika yang tampil di vaudeville, Broadway, film, radio, dan televisi. Sebagai master balasan satu baris, dia dianggap sebagai salah satu komedian terbesar Amerika.

name: Guillaume Canet
title: Guillaume Canet
description: French actor, film director and screenwriter (born 1973)
extract: Guillaume Arthur Jean-Louis Canet is a French actor, film director and screenwriter, and show jumper.
extract_id: Guillaume Arthur Jean-Louis Canet adalah aktor, sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan penunggang kuda loncatan asal Prancis.

name: Guillermo del Toro
title: Guillermo del Toro
extract: Guillermo del Toro Gómez is a Mexican filmmaker and actor. His work has been characterized by a strong connection to fairy tales, gothicism, and horror, often blending the genres, with an effort to infuse visual or poetic beauty in the grotesque. He has had a lifelong fascination with monsters, which he considers symbols of great power. Del Toro is known for pioneering dark fantasy in the film industry and for his use of insectile and religious imagery, his themes of Catholicism, celebrating imperfection, underworld motifs, practical special effects, and dominant amber lighting.
extract_id: Guillermo del Toro Gómez adalah pembuat film dan aktor asal Meksiko. Karyanya ditandai oleh keterkaitan yang kuat dengan dongeng, gotik, dan horor, sering menggabungkan genre tersebut, dengan upaya untuk menyuntikkan keindahan visual atau puitis dalam hal-hal grotesk. Dia memiliki ketertarikan seumur hidup pada monster, yang dia anggap sebagai simbol kekuatan besar. Del Toro dikenal karena perintis fantasi gelap dalam industri film dan penggunaan citra serangga serta religius, tema Katoliknya, merayakan ketidaksempurnaan, motif dunia bawah, efek khusus praktis, dan pencahayaan dominan warna kuning madu.

name: Gunnar Björnstrand
title: Gunnar Björnstrand
extract: Knut Gunnar Johanson was a Swedish actor known for his frequent work with writer and director Ingmar Bergman.
extract_id: Knut Gunnar Johanson adalah aktor Swedia yang dikenal karena sering bekerja dengan penulis dan sutradara Ingmar Bergman.

name: Gunnel Lindblom
title: Gunnel Lindblom
extract: Gunnel Märtha Ingegärd Lindblom was a Swedish film actress and director.
extract_id: Gunnel Märtha Ingegärd Lindblom adalah aktris dan sutradara film Swedia.

name: Gus Van Sant
title: Gus Van Sant
extract: Gus Green Van Sant Jr. is an American filmmaker, photographer, painter, and musician. He has earned acclaim as an independent filmmaker, and is considered to be one of the most prominent auteurs of the new queer cinema movement. His films typically deal with themes of marginalized subcultures, especially within gay culture.
extract_id: Gus Green Van Sant Jr. adalah pembuat film, fotografer, pelukis, dan musisi asal Amerika. Dia mendapatkan pujian sebagai pembuat film independen, dan dianggap sebagai salah satu auteur paling menonjol dalam gerakan sinema queer baru. Film-filmnya biasanya membahas tema subkultur yang terpinggirkan, terutama dalam budaya gay.

name: Gustaf Skarsgård
title: Gustaf Skarsgård
extract: Gustaf Caspar Orm Skarsgård is a Swedish actor. He is known for his roles in Evil (2003), The Way Back (2010), Kon-Tiki (2012), and Oppenheimer (2023). He also appeared in the HBO TV series Westworld (2018), as Merlin in the Netflix TV series Cursed (2020), and as Floki in the History Channel series Vikings (2013–2020).
extract_id: Gustaf Caspar Orm Skarsgård adalah aktor Swedia. Dia dikenal karena perannya dalam Evil (2003), The Way Back (2010), Kon-Tiki (2012), dan Oppenheimer (2023). Dia juga muncul dalam serial TV HBO Westworld (2018), sebagai Merlin dalam serial TV Netflix Cursed (2020), dan sebagai Floki dalam serial History Channel Vikings (2013–2020).

name: Gustav Fröhlich
title: Gustav Fröhlich
extract: Gustav Friedrich Fröhlich was a German actor and film director. He landed secondary roles in a number of films and plays before landing his breakthrough role of Freder Fredersen in Fritz Lang's 1927 film Metropolis. He remained a popular film star in Germany until the 1950s.
extract_id: Gustav Friedrich Fröhlich adalah aktor dan sutradara film Jerman. Dia mendapatkan peran sekunder dalam sejumlah film dan drama sebelum mendapatkan peran terobosannya sebagai Freder Fredersen dalam film Metropolis karya Fritz Lang tahun 1927. Dia tetap menjadi bintang film populer di Jerman hingga tahun 1950-an.

name: Gustav von Wangenheim
title: Gustav von Wangenheim
extract: Ingo Clemens Gustav Adolf Freiherr von Wangenheim was a German actor, screenwriter and director.
extract_id: Ingo Clemens Gustav Adolf Freiherr von Wangenheim adalah aktor, penulis skenario, dan sutradara asal Jerman.

name: Guy Decomble
title: Guy Decomble
extract: Guy Decomble (1910–1964) was a French film and television actor. A character actor he played in a number of supporting parts in postwar cinema. One of his better known roles is as the teacher in The 400 Blows by François Truffaut.
extract_id: Guy Decomble (1910–1964) adalah aktor film dan televisi Prancis. Sebagai aktor karakter, dia memainkan sejumlah peran pendukung dalam sinema pascaperang. Salah satu peran terkenalnya adalah sebagai guru dalam The 400 Blows oleh François Truffaut.

name: Guy Hamilton
title: Guy Hamilton
extract: Mervyn Ian Guy Hamilton was an English film director. He directed 22 films from the 1950s to the 1980s, including four James Bond films.
extract_id: Mervyn Ian Guy Hamilton adalah sutradara film Inggris. Dia menyutradarai 22 film dari tahun 1950-an hingga 1980-an, termasuk empat film James Bond.

name: Guy Pearce
title: Guy Pearce
extract: Guy Edward Pearce is an Australian actor. His accolades include a Primetime Emmy Award, as well as nominations for an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, two Golden Globe Awards and eight AACTA Awards.
extract_id: Guy Edward Pearce adalah aktor Australia. Penghargaannya termasuk Primetime Emmy Award, serta nominasi untuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dua Golden Globe Awards dan delapan AACTA Awards.

name: Guy Ritchie
title: Guy Ritchie
extract: Guy Stuart Ritchie is an English filmmaker known primarily for British comedy gangster films and large-scale action-adventure films.
extract_id: Guy Stuart Ritchie adalah pembuat film Inggris yang dikenal terutama untuk film komedi gangster Inggris dan film aksi petualangan berskala besar.

name: Gwilym Lee
title: Gwilym Lee
extract: Gwilym Lee is a British actor. He is best known for his roles in Midsomer Murders (2013–2016), A Song for Jenny (2015), Jamestown (2017), Top End Wedding (2019), The Great (2020–2023), and for playing guitarist Brian May in the Queen biopic Bohemian Rhapsody (2018).
extract_id: Gwilym Lee adalah aktor Inggris. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya dalam Midsomer Murders (2013–2016), A Song for Jenny (2015), Jamestown (2017), Top End Wedding (2019), The Great (2020–2023), dan sebagai gitaris Brian May dalam film biopik Queen, Bohemian Rhapsody (2018).

name: Gwyneth Paltrow
title: Gwyneth Paltrow
extract: Gwyneth Kate Paltrow is an American actress and businesswoman. The daughter of filmmaker Bruce Paltrow and actress Blythe Danner, she established herself as a leading lady appearing in primarily mid-budget and period films during the 1990s and early 2000s, before transitioning to blockbusters and franchises. Her accolades include an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Gwyneth Kate Paltrow adalah aktris dan pebisnis Amerika. Putri dari pembuat film Bruce Paltrow dan aktris Blythe Danner, dia menempatkan dirinya sebagai pemeran utama yang muncul terutama dalam film dengan anggaran menengah dan film periode selama 1990-an dan awal 2000-an, sebelum beralih ke film blockbuster dan waralaba. Penghargaannya meliputi Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Gérard Jugnot
title: Gérard Jugnot
extract: Gérard Jugnot is a French actor, film director, screenwriter and film producer.
extract_id: Gérard Jugnot adalah aktor, sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser film Prancis.

name: Güven Kiraç
title: Güven Kıraç
extract: Güven Kıraç is a Turkish actor. He won the IFFI Best Actor Award (Male) at the 41st International Film Festival of India.
extract_id: Güven Kıraç adalah aktor Turki. Dia memenangkan Penghargaan Aktor Terbaik IFFI (Pria) di Festival Film Internasional India ke-41.

name: Haaz Sleiman
title: Haaz Sleiman
extract: Haaz Sleiman is a Lebanese actor. He most notably played the role of Tarek in the 2007 film The Visitor for which he was nominated for the Independent Spirit Award for Best Supporting Male and the role of Jesus in the American TV mini-series Killing Jesus, in addition to a number of American TV series.
extract_id: Haaz Sleiman adalah aktor Lebanon. Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan peran Tarek dalam film The Visitor tahun 2007 yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Independent Spirit Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dan peran Yesus dalam mini-seri TV Amerika Killing Jesus, selain sejumlah serial TV Amerika.

name: Hailee Steinfeld
title: Hailee Steinfeld
extract: Hailee Steinfeld is an American actress and singer. She had her breakthrough with the western film True Grit (2010), which earned her various accolades, including nominations for an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Critics' Choice Movie Award and an Actor Award.
extract_id: Hailee Steinfeld adalah aktris dan penyanyi Amerika. Dia mendapatkan terobosan dengan film barat True Grit (2010), yang memberinya berbagai penghargaan, termasuk nominasi untuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Critics' Choice Movie Award, dan Actor Award.

name: Haing S. Ngor
title: Haing S. Ngor
extract: Haing Somnang Ngor was a Cambodian and American actor, physician, and activist. He made his acting debut in the biographical drama film The Killing Fields (1984) as journalist Dith Pran, for which he won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor, becoming the first actor of Asian descent to win the award and one of the only two amateur actors to win an Academy Award, following Harold Russell.
extract_id: Haing Somnang Ngor adalah aktor, dokter, dan aktivis asal Kamboja dan Amerika. Dia memulai debut aktingnya dalam film drama biografi The Killing Fields (1984) sebagai jurnalis Dith Pran, yang membuatnya memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik, menjadi aktor keturunan Asia pertama yang memenangkan penghargaan tersebut dan salah satu dari hanya dua aktor amatir yang memenangkan Academy Award, setelah Harold Russell.

name: Hal Ashby
title: Hal Ashby
extract: William Hal Ashby was an American film director and editor. His work exemplified the countercultural attitude of the era. He directed wide-ranging films featuring iconic performances. He is associated with the New Hollywood wave of filmmaking with filmmakers such as Martin Scorsese, Woody Allen, Mike Nichols and Sidney Lumet.
extract_id: William Hal Ashby adalah sutradara dan editor film Amerika. Karyanya mencerminkan sikap kontra-kultural pada masa itu. Dia menyutradarai film-film beragam dengan penampilan ikonik. Dia dikaitkan dengan gelombang New Hollywood dari pembuatan film bersama pembuat film seperti Martin Scorsese, Woody Allen, Mike Nichols, dan Sidney Lumet.

name: Haley Joel Osment
title: Haley Joel Osment
extract: Haley Joel Osment is an American actor. Beginning his career as a child actor, Osment's role in the comedy-drama film Forrest Gump (1994) won him a Young Artist Award. His breakthrough came with the psychological thriller film The Sixth Sense (1999), for which he won a Saturn Award and was nominated for an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a Screen Actors Guild Award. Osment achieved further success with the drama film Pay It Forward (2000), the science fiction film A.I. Artificial Intelligence (2001), which won him a second Saturn Award, the comedy film Secondhand Lions (2003), which won him a Critics Choice Award, and the animated film The Jungle Book 2 (2003).
extract_id: Haley Joel Osment adalah aktor Amerika. Memulai karier sebagai aktor cilik, perannya dalam film komedi-drama Forrest Gump (1994) memberinya Young Artist Award. Terobosannya datang dengan film thriller psikologis The Sixth Sense (1999), yang membuatnya memenangkan Saturn Award dan dinominasikan untuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Screen Actors Guild Award. Osment meraih kesuksesan lebih lanjut dengan film drama Pay It Forward (2000), film fiksi ilmiah A.I. Artificial Intelligence (2001), yang memberinya Saturn Award kedua, film komedi Secondhand Lions (2003), yang memberinya Critics Choice Award, dan film animasi The Jungle Book 2 (2003).

name: Halina Reijn
title: Halina Reijn
extract: Halina Reijn is a Dutch filmmaker, writer and former actress.
extract_id: Halina Reijn adalah pembuat film, penulis, dan mantan aktris Belanda.

name: Haluk Bilginer
title: Haluk Bilginer
extract: Nihat Haluk Bilginer is a Turkish actor. For his role in Şahsiyet (2018), Bilginer won the Best Actor award at the 47th International Emmy Awards. His movie Kış Uykusu won the Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival. In addition to his acting career in Turkey, he has also worked in the United Kingdom and remains best known there for his role as Mehmet Osman in the television soap opera EastEnders during the 1980s. He has also starred in Hollywood movies as a character actor, including The International (2009), W.E. (2011), Ben-Hur (2016), Halloween (2018) and Maria (2024). He often plays villains and unsympathetic characters.
extract_id: Nihat Haluk Bilginer adalah aktor Turki. Untuk perannya dalam Şahsiyet (2018), Bilginer memenangkan penghargaan Aktor Terbaik di International Emmy Awards ke-47. Filmnya Kış Uykusu memenangkan Palme d'Or di Festival Film Cannes. Selain karier aktingnya di Turki, dia juga bekerja di Inggris dan paling dikenal di sana sebagai Mehmet Osman dalam opera sabun televisi EastEnders pada 1980-an. Dia juga membintangi film Hollywood sebagai aktor karakter, termasuk The International (2009), W.E. (2011), Ben-Hur (2016), Halloween (2018) dan Maria (2024). Dia sering memainkan peran penjahat dan karakter yang tidak simpatik.

name: Halvar Björk
title: Halvar Björk
extract: Erik Halvar Bertil Björk was a Swedish actor. He worked at the Malmö City Theatre from 1962 to 1986, and he had many substantial film and TV roles; for example, he acted in Autumn Sonata (1978) and Sunday's Children (1992) by Ingmar Bergman and The Emigrants (1971) and The New Land (1972) by Jan Troell.
extract_id: Erik Halvar Bertil Björk adalah aktor Swedia. Dia bekerja di Malmö City Theatre dari tahun 1962 hingga 1986, dan memiliki banyak peran penting di film dan TV; misalnya, dia berakting dalam Autumn Sonata (1978) dan Sunday's Children (1992) oleh Ingmar Bergman serta The Emigrants (1971) dan The New Land (1972) oleh Jan Troell.

name: Hannes Holm
title: Hannes Holm
extract: Hannes Martin Holm, is a Swedish director and screenwriter. He makes almost all of his films with Måns Herngren.
extract_id: Hannes Martin Holm, adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario Swedia. Dia hampir selalu membuat film bersama Måns Herngren.

name: Hanno Pöschl
title: Hanno Pöschl
extract: Hanno Pöschl is an Austrian actor.
extract_id: Hanno Pöschl adalah seorang aktor Austria.

name: Hardy Krüger
title: Hardy Krüger
extract: Hardy Krüger was a German actor and author who appeared in more than 60 films from 1944 onwards. After becoming a film star in Germany in the 1950s, Krüger increasingly turned to roles in international films such as The One That Got Away (1957), Hatari!, Sundays and Cybèle, The Flight of the Phoenix (1965), Battle of Neretva, The Secret of Santa Vittoria, The Red Tent, Barry Lyndon (1975), A Bridge Too Far (1977), and The Wild Geese (1978).
extract_id: Hardy Krüger adalah seorang aktor dan penulis Jerman yang tampil di lebih dari 60 film sejak tahun 1944. Setelah menjadi bintang film di Jerman pada tahun 1950-an, Krüger semakin banyak mengambil peran dalam film internasional seperti The One That Got Away (1957), Hatari!, Sundays and Cybèle, The Flight of the Phoenix (1965), Battle of Neretva, The Secret of Santa Vittoria, The Red Tent, Barry Lyndon (1975), A Bridge Too Far (1977), dan The Wild Geese (1978).

name: Harold Ramis
title: Harold Ramis
extract: Harold Allen Ramis was an American actor, comedian, and filmmaker. His film acting roles include Egon Spengler in Ghostbusters (1984) and Ghostbusters II (1989), and as Russell Ziskey in Stripes (1981); he also co-wrote those films. As a director, his films include the comedies Caddyshack (1980), National Lampoon's Vacation (1983), Groundhog Day (1993), Analyze This (1999) and Analyze That (2002). Ramis was the original head writer of the television series SCTV, on which he also performed, as well as a co-writer of Groundhog Day and National Lampoon's Animal House (1978). The final film that he wrote, produced, directed, and acted in was Year One (2009).
extract_id: Harold Allen Ramis adalah seorang aktor, komedian, dan pembuat film Amerika. Peran akting filmnya termasuk Egon Spengler dalam Ghostbusters (1984) dan Ghostbusters II (1989), serta sebagai Russell Ziskey dalam Stripes (1981); dia juga ikut menulis film-film tersebut. Sebagai sutradara, film-filmnya meliputi komedi Caddyshack (1980), National Lampoon's Vacation (1983), Groundhog Day (1993), Analyze This (1999) dan Analyze That (2002). Ramis adalah kepala penulis asli dari serial televisi SCTV, di mana dia juga tampil, serta co-penulis Groundhog Day dan National Lampoon's Animal House (1978). Film terakhir yang dia tulis, produksi, sutradarai, dan bintangi adalah Year One (2009).

name: Harpo Marx
title: Harpo Marx
extract: Arthur "Harpo" Marx was an American comedian, actor and harpist, and the second-oldest of the Marx Brothers. In contrast to the mainly verbal comedy of his brothers Groucho and Chico, Harpo's comic style was visual, being an example of vaudeville, clown and pantomime traditions. In all of his movie appearances, he wore a curly reddish blonde wig and did not speak, instead blowing a horn or whistling to communicate. Marx frequently employed props such as a horn cane constructed from a lead pipe, tape, and a bulbhorn.
extract_id: Arthur "Harpo" Marx adalah seorang komedian, aktor, dan pemain harpa Amerika, serta yang kedua tertua dari Marx Brothers. Berbeda dengan komedi verbal utama dari saudara-saudaranya Groucho dan Chico, gaya komedi Harpo bersifat visual, yang merupakan contoh dari tradisi vaudeville, badut, dan pantomim. Di semua penampilannya di film, dia mengenakan wig pirang kemerahan keriting dan tidak berbicara, melainkan meniup terompet atau bersiul untuk berkomunikasi. Marx sering menggunakan properti seperti tongkat terompet yang dibuat dari pipa timah, pita, dan bulbhorn.

name: Harriet Andersson
title: Harriet Andersson
extract: Harriet Andersson is a Swedish actress, best known outside Sweden for being part of director Ingmar Bergman's stock company. She often plays impulsive, working class characters.
extract_id: Harriet Andersson adalah seorang aktris Swedia, yang paling dikenal di luar Swedia karena menjadi bagian dari perusahaan stok sutradara Ingmar Bergman. Dia sering memerankan karakter impulsif dari kelas pekerja.

name: Harrison Ford
title: Harrison Ford
extract: Harrison Ford is an American actor. Regarded as a cinematic cultural icon, Ford's accolades include nominations for an Academy Award, a British Academy Film Award, two Emmy Awards, five Golden Globes and two SAG-AFTRA's Actor Awards. He is also the recipient of the AFI Life Achievement Award, Cecil B. DeMille Award, Honorary César, Honorary Palme d'Or and SAG-AFTRA Life Achievement Award.
extract_id: Harrison Ford adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dianggap sebagai ikon budaya sinematik, penghargaan Ford mencakup nominasi untuk Academy Award, British Academy Film Award, dua Emmy Awards, lima Golden Globes, dan dua SAG-AFTRA's Actor Awards. Dia juga penerima AFI Life Achievement Award, Cecil B. DeMille Award, Honorary César, Honorary Palme d'Or, dan SAG-AFTRA Life Achievement Award.

name: Harry Connick Jr.
title: Harry Connick Jr.
extract: Joseph Harry Fowler Connick Jr. is an American singer, pianist, composer, actor, and former television host. As of 2019, he has sold over 30 million albums worldwide. Connick is ranked among the top 60 best-selling male artists in the United States by the Recording Industry Association of America, with 16 million in certified sales. He has had seven top 20 U.S. albums, and ten number-one U.S. jazz albums, earning more number-one albums than any other artist in U.S. jazz chart history as of 2009.
extract_id: Joseph Harry Fowler Connick Jr. adalah seorang penyanyi, pianis, komposer, aktor, dan mantan pembawa acara televisi Amerika. Hingga 2019, ia telah menjual lebih dari 30 juta album di seluruh dunia. Connick termasuk dalam daftar 60 artis pria terlaris di Amerika Serikat oleh Recording Industry Association of America, dengan 16 juta penjualan bersertifikat. Dia memiliki tujuh album U.S. Top 20, dan sepuluh album jazz nomor satu di U.S., memperoleh lebih banyak album nomor satu daripada artis lain dalam sejarah tangga lagu jazz AS hingga 2009.

name: Harry Crocker
title: Harry Crocker
extract: Henry Joseph Crocker II was an American journalist, film actor, and member of the wealthy Crocker family.
extract_id: Henry Joseph Crocker II adalah seorang jurnalis, aktor film, dan anggota keluarga kaya Crocker asal Amerika.

name: Harry Dean Stanton
title: Harry Dean Stanton
extract: Harry Dean Stanton was an American actor and musician. In a career that spanned more than six decades, Stanton played supporting roles in films including Cool Hand Luke (1967), Kelly's Heroes (1970), Dillinger (1973), The Godfather Part II (1974), Alien (1979), Escape from New York (1981), Christine (1983), Repo Man (1984), One Magic Christmas (1985), Pretty in Pink (1986), The Last Temptation of Christ (1988), Dream a Little Dream (1989), Wild at Heart (1990), The Straight Story (1999), The Green Mile (1999), The Man Who Cried (2000), Alpha Dog (2006), Inland Empire (2006), Rango (2011), The Avengers (2012), and Seven Psychopaths (2012). He had rare lead roles in Paris, Texas (1984) and Lucky (2017).
extract_id: Harry Dean Stanton adalah seorang aktor dan musisi Amerika. Dalam karir yang berlangsung lebih dari enam dekade, Stanton memerankan peran pendukung dalam film-film termasuk Cool Hand Luke (1967), Kelly's Heroes (1970), Dillinger (1973), The Godfather Part II (1974), Alien (1979), Escape from New York (1981), Christine (1983), Repo Man (1984), One Magic Christmas (1985), Pretty in Pink (1986), The Last Temptation of Christ (1988), Dream a Little Dream (1989), Wild at Heart (1990), The Straight Story (1999), The Green Mile (1999), The Man Who Cried (2000), Alpha Dog (2006), Inland Empire (2006), Rango (2011), The Avengers (2012), dan Seven Psychopaths (2012). Dia memiliki peran utama yang jarang terjadi dalam Paris, Texas (1984) dan Lucky (2017).

name: Harry Guardino
title: Harry Guardino
extract: Harold Vincent Guardino was an American actor whose career ran from the early 1950s to the early 1990s.
extract_id: Harold Vincent Guardino adalah seorang aktor Amerika yang kariernya berlangsung dari awal 1950-an hingga awal 1990-an.

name: Harry Myers
title: Harry C. Myers
extract: Harry C. Myers was an American film actor and director, sometimes credited as Henry Myers. He performed in many short comedy films with his wife Rosemary Theby. Myers appeared in 330 films between 1908 and 1939, and directed more than 50 films between 1913 and 1917.
extract_id: Harry C. Myers adalah seorang aktor dan sutradara film Amerika, kadang-kadang disebut Henry Myers. Dia tampil dalam banyak film komedi pendek bersama istrinya Rosemary Theby. Myers tampil dalam 330 film antara 1908 dan 1939, dan menyutradarai lebih dari 50 film antara 1913 dan 1917.

name: Harshaali Malhotra
title: Harshaali Malhotra
extract: Harshaali Malhotra is an Indian actress and model who works in Hindi films and television series. She is best known for her role as Munni in Kabir Khan's drama film Bajrangi Bhaijaan (2015) which earned her nomination for a Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut.
extract_id: Harshaali Malhotra adalah seorang aktris dan model India yang bekerja dalam film dan serial televisi Hindi. Dia paling dikenal untuk perannya sebagai Munni dalam film drama Kabir Khan Bajrangi Bhaijaan (2015) yang memberinya nominasi Filmfare Award untuk Debut Perempuan Terbaik.

name: Hartley Power
title: Hartley Power
extract: Hartley Power was an American-born British film and television actor, who made his Broadway debut in Dolly Jordan in 1922. He is best remembered for two roles: "Sylvester Kee" the ventriloquist who is shot and almost killed by "Maxwell Frere" as a rival for his dummy's "affections" in Dead of Night and Mr. Hennessy, the chief of the news agency that Gregory Peck worked for in Roman Holiday.
extract_id: Hartley Power adalah seorang aktor film dan televisi kelahiran Amerika yang membuat debut Broadway-nya di Dolly Jordan pada tahun 1922. Dia paling diingat untuk dua peran: "Sylvester Kee" ventriloquist yang ditembak dan hampir dibunuh oleh "Maxwell Frere" sebagai saingan untuk "kasih sayang" boneka ventriloquistnya dalam Dead of Night dan Mr. Hennessy, kepala agen berita tempat Gregory Peck bekerja dalam Roman Holiday.

name: Haru Kuroki
title: Haru Kuroki
extract: Haru Kuroki is a Japanese actress. She won the Silver Bear for Best Actress for her performance in the film The Little House.
extract_id: Haru Kuroki adalah seorang aktris Jepang. Dia memenangkan Silver Bear untuk Aktris Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam film The Little House.

name: Haruo Tanaka
title: Haruo Tanaka
extract: Haruo Tanaka was a Japanese film actor noted for his supporting roles in a career that spanned seven decades.
extract_id: Haruo Tanaka adalah seorang aktor film Jepang yang dikenal dengan peran pendukungnya dalam karier yang berlangsung tujuh dekade.

name: Harvey Keitel
title: Harvey Keitel
extract: Harvey Johannes Keitel is an American actor and producer. Known for his portrayal of morally ambiguous and "tough guy" characters, he rose to prominence during the New Hollywood movement.
extract_id: Harvey Johannes Keitel adalah seorang aktor dan produser Amerika. Dikenal karena peran-perannya sebagai karakter moral ambigu dan "tough guy", dia naik daun selama gerakan New Hollywood.

name: Harvey Korman
title: Harvey Korman
extract: Harvey Herschel Korman was an American actor and comedian who performed in television and film productions. He is most notable as a main cast member alongside Carol Burnett, Tim Conway and Vicki Lawrence on the CBS sketch comedy series The Carol Burnett Show (1967–1977) for which he won four Primetime Emmy Awards and a Golden Globe Award.
extract_id: Harvey Herschel Korman adalah seorang aktor dan komedian Amerika yang tampil dalam produksi televisi dan film. Dia paling terkenal sebagai anggota pemeran utama bersama Carol Burnett, Tim Conway, dan Vicki Lawrence dalam seri komedi sketsa CBS The Carol Burnett Show (1967–1977) yang memberinya empat Primetime Emmy Awards dan satu Golden Globe Award.

name: Haya Harareet
title: Haya Harareet
extract: Haya Harareet was an Israeli actress and screenwriter. She made her film acting debut in Hill 24 Doesn't Answer (1955), Israel's first feature length film. One of her major film roles was playing Esther, Ben Hur's love interest in the 1959 Hollywood-made film Ben-Hur.In signing a multi-year contract with MGM, she became the first Israeli actress attached to the Hollywood studio system.
extract_id: Haya Harareet adalah seorang aktris dan penulis skenario Israel. Dia memulai debut akting filmnya dalam Hill 24 Doesn't Answer (1955), film fitur pertama Israel. Salah satu peran film utamanya adalah memerankan Esther, kekasih Ben Hur dalam film Ben-Hur produksi Hollywood tahun 1959. Dengan menandatangani kontrak multi-tahun dengan MGM, dia menjadi aktris Israel pertama yang terikat pada sistem studio Hollywood.

name: Hayao Miyazaki
title: Hayao Miyazaki
extract: Hayao Miyazaki is a Japanese animator, filmmaker, and manga artist. He co-founded Studio Ghibli and serves as its honorary chairman. Throughout his career, Miyazaki has attained international acclaim as a masterful storyteller and creator of Japanese animated feature films, and is widely regarded as one of the greatest and most accomplished filmmakers in the history of animation.
extract_id: Hayao Miyazaki adalah seorang animator, pembuat film, dan seniman manga Jepang. Dia ikut mendirikan Studio Ghibli dan menjabat sebagai ketua kehormatan. Sepanjang kariernya, Miyazaki meraih pengakuan internasional sebagai pendongeng ulung dan pembuat film animasi fitur Jepang, dan secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu sutradara terbesar dan paling berprestasi dalam sejarah animasi.

name: Hayley Squires
title: Hayley Squires
extract: Hayley Squires is an English actress and playwright. She is the recipient of a number of accolades, including an International Emmy Award and nominations for a British Academy Film Award, a British Academy Television Award and a Laurence Olivier Award.
extract_id: Hayley Squires adalah seorang aktris dan penulis drama Inggris. Dia menerima sejumlah penghargaan, termasuk International Emmy Award dan nominasi untuk British Academy Film Award, British Academy Television Award, dan Laurence Olivier Award.

name: Heath Ledger
title: Heath Ledger
extract: Heath Andrew Ledger was an Australian actor. Known for his versatility across independent and major studio films, his work consisted of 20 films in a variety of genres. His accolades included an Academy Award, an Actor Award, a BAFTA Award, and a Golden Globe Award.
extract_id: Heath Andrew Ledger adalah seorang aktor Australia. Dikenal karena kemampuannya berperan dalam berbagai jenis film independen dan studio besar, karyanya terdiri dari 20 film dalam berbagai genre. Penghargaannya mencakup Academy Award, Actor Award, BAFTA Award, dan Golden Globe Award.

name: Hector Elizondo
title: Héctor Elizondo
extract: Héctor Elizondo is an American character actor. He is known for playing Phillip Watters in the television series Chicago Hope (1994–2000) and Ed Alzate in the television series Last Man Standing (2011–2021). His film roles include Pocket Money (1972), The Taking of Pelham One Two Three (1974), Cuba (1979), American Gigolo (1980), The Flamingo Kid (1984), Taking Care of Business (1990), Pretty Woman (1990), Beverly Hills Cop III (1994), The Princess Diaries (2001), and Love in the Time of Cholera (2007).
extract_id: Héctor Elizondo adalah seorang aktor karakter Amerika. Dia dikenal karena memerankan Phillip Watters dalam seri televisi Chicago Hope (1994–2000) dan Ed Alzate dalam seri televisi Last Man Standing (2011–2021). Peran filmnya termasuk Pocket Money (1972), The Taking of Pelham One Two Three (1974), Cuba (1979), American Gigolo (1980), The Flamingo Kid (1984), Taking Care of Business (1990), Pretty Woman (1990), Beverly Hills Cop III (1994), The Princess Diaries (2001), dan Love in the Time of Cholera (2007).

name: Helen Hunt
title: Helen Hunt
extract: Helen Elizabeth Hunt is an American actress. Her accolades include an Academy Award, four Primetime Emmy Awards, and four Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Helen Elizabeth Hunt adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Penghargaannya mencakup Academy Award, empat Primetime Emmy Awards, dan empat Golden Globe Awards.

name: Helena Bonham Carter
title: Helena Bonham Carter
extract: Helena Bonham Carter is a British actress. She is known for her character roles as eccentric women in blockbusters and independent films, particularly period dramas. Bonham Carter rose to prominence by playing Lucy Honeychurch in A Room with a View (1985) and the title character in Lady Jane (1986). Her early period roles saw her typecast as a virginal "English rose", a label with which she was uncomfortable. Bonham Carter is recognized for her unconventional fashion choices and dark aesthetic. For her role as Kate Croy in The Wings of the Dove (1997), Bonham Carter received a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Actress, and for her portrayal of Queen Elizabeth in The King's Speech (2010), she won the BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Supporting Role, and was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: Helena Bonham Carter adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Dia dikenal karena peran karakternya sebagai wanita eksentrik dalam film blockbuster dan independen, khususnya drama periode. Bonham Carter naik daun dengan memerankan Lucy Honeychurch dalam A Room with a View (1985) dan karakter utama dalam Lady Jane (1986). Peran periode awalnya membuatnya dikategorikan sebagai "English rose" yang perawan, label yang membuatnya tidak nyaman. Bonham Carter dikenal karena pilihan busana yang tidak konvensional dan estetika gelapnya. Untuk perannya sebagai Kate Croy dalam The Wings of the Dove (1997), Bonham Carter menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik, dan untuk perannya sebagai Ratu Elizabeth dalam The King's Speech (2010), dia memenangkan BAFTA Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik, serta dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Helena Rojo
title: Helena Rojo
extract: María Elena Enríquez Ruiz, known as Helena Rojo, was a Mexican actress.
extract_id: María Elena Enríquez Ruiz, dikenal sebagai Helena Rojo, adalah seorang aktris Meksiko.

name: Helmut Griem
title: Helmut Griem
extract: Helmut Griem was a German film, television and stage actor, and director.
extract_id: Helmut Griem adalah aktor dan sutradara film, televisi, dan panggung asal Jerman.

name: Helmut Qualtinger
title: Helmut Qualtinger
extract: Helmut Gustav Friedrich Qualtinger was an Austrian actor, cabaret performer, writer and reciter.
extract_id: Helmut Gustav Friedrich Qualtinger adalah aktor, pengisi suara kabaret, penulis, dan pembaca asal Austria.

name: Henning Moritzen
title: Henning Moritzen
extract: Henning Moritzen was a Danish film actor. He appeared in more than 70 films between 1950 and 2010. He was born in Taarbæk, Denmark.
extract_id: Henning Moritzen adalah aktor film asal Denmark. Ia tampil dalam lebih dari 70 film antara tahun 1950 dan 2010. Ia lahir di Taarbæk, Denmark.

name: Henri Serre
title: Henri Serre
extract: Henri Serre was a French actor who was best known for his role as Jim, a "vivid, melancholy, and finally tragic figure" in François Truffaut's Jules and Jim. Other appearances include The Fire Within, Section spéciale and Mister Frost. Serre died on 9 October 2023, at the age of 92.
extract_id: Henri Serre adalah aktor Prancis yang paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Jim, sebuah "tokoh hidup, melankolis, dan akhirnya tragis" dalam Jules and Jim karya François Truffaut. Penampilan lainnya termasuk The Fire Within, Section spéciale, dan Mister Frost. Serre meninggal pada 9 Oktober 2023, pada usia 92 tahun.

name: Henri-Georges Clouzot
title: Henri-Georges Clouzot
extract: Henri-Georges Clouzot was a French film director, screenwriter, and producer. He is best remembered for his work in the thriller film genre, having directed The Wages of Fear (1953) and Les Diaboliques (1955), which are critically recognized as among the greatest films of the 1950s. He also directed documentary films, including The Mystery of Picasso (1956), which was declared a national treasure by the government of France.
extract_id: Henri-Georges Clouzot adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser asal Prancis. Ia paling dikenal atas karyanya dalam genre film thriller, dengan telah menyutradarai The Wages of Fear (1953) dan Les Diaboliques (1955), yang diakui secara kritis sebagai salah satu film terbaik tahun 1950-an. Ia juga menyutradarai film dokumenter, termasuk The Mystery of Picasso (1956), yang dinyatakan sebagai harta nasional oleh pemerintah Prancis.

name: Henrik Lundström
title: Henrik Lundström
extract: Per Henrik Lundström is a Swedish actor. He was educated at Sankt Eriks gymnasium in Stockholm.
extract_id: Per Henrik Lundström adalah aktor Swedia. Ia dididik di Sankt Eriks gymnasium di Stockholm.

name: Henry Bergman
title: Henry Bergman
extract: Henry Bergman was an American actor of stage and film, known for his long association with Charlie Chaplin.
extract_id: Henry Bergman adalah aktor panggung dan film Amerika, dikenal karena asosiasinya yang lama dengan Charlie Chaplin.

name: Henry Cavill
title: Henry Cavill
extract: Henry William Dalgliesh Cavill is a British actor. He gained wide recognition for portraying Superman in the DC Extended Universe (2013–2023), beginning with the film Man of Steel (2013) and reprising the role in Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice (2016), Justice League (2017), and Black Adam (2022).
extract_id: Henry William Dalgliesh Cavill adalah aktor asal Inggris. Ia dikenal luas karena memerankan Superman dalam DC Extended Universe (2013–2023), dimulai dengan film Man of Steel (2013) dan mengulangi peran tersebut dalam Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice (2016), Justice League (2017), dan Black Adam (2022).

name: Henry Fonda
title: Henry Fonda
extract: Henry Jaynes Fonda was an American actor whose career spanned five decades on Broadway and in Hollywood. Known for his work on screen and stage, he often portrayed characters who embodied an everyman image.
extract_id: Henry Jaynes Fonda adalah aktor Amerika yang kariernya berlangsung selama lima dekade di Broadway dan Hollywood. Dikenal atas karya-karyanya di layar kaca dan panggung, ia sering memerankan karakter yang menggambarkan citra orang biasa.

name: Henry Koster
title: Henry Koster
extract: Henry Koster was a German-born film director. He was the husband of actress Peggy Moran.
extract_id: Henry Koster adalah sutradara film kelahiran Jerman. Ia adalah suami dari aktris Peggy Moran.

name: Henry Selick
title: Henry Selick
extract: Charles Henry Selick Jr. is an American filmmaker and animator. He is known for his pioneering work in stop-motion animation and for directing the films The Nightmare Before Christmas (1993), James and the Giant Peach (1996), Monkeybone (2001), Coraline (2009), and Wendell & Wild (2022). Selick has been recognized for his distinctively Gothic visual style, meticulous craftsmanship, metaphysical terror, with dark fantasy and surrealist elements describing his work as “scary films for brave children of all ages”, he is also known for his collaborations with the late voice actor and artist Joe Ranft and filmmaker Tim Burton. For Coraline, Selick received an Academy Award nomination for the Best Animated Feature.
extract_id: Charles Henry Selick Jr. adalah pembuat film dan animator Amerika. Ia dikenal atas karya perintisnya dalam animasi stop-motion dan menyutradarai film The Nightmare Before Christmas (1993), James and the Giant Peach (1996), Monkeybone (2001), Coraline (2009), dan Wendell & Wild (2022). Selick diakui karena gaya visual Gotiknya yang khas, ketelitian pengerjaan, teror metafisik, dengan elemen fantasi gelap dan surealis, menggambarkan karyanya sebagai “film menakutkan untuk anak-anak pemberani dari segala usia”. Ia juga dikenal atas kolaborasinya dengan mendiang aktor suara dan seniman Joe Ranft serta pembuat film Tim Burton. Untuk Coraline, Selick menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Film Animasi Terbaik.

name: Henry Thomas
title: Henry Thomas
extract: Henry Jackson Thomas is an American actor. He began his career as a child actor and had the lead role of Elliott Taylor in the film E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial (1982), for which he won a Young Artist Award and received Golden Globe Award, BAFTA Award, and Saturn Award nominations. Thomas also had roles in other films, including Cloak & Dagger (1984), Frog Dreaming (1986), Valmont (1989), Fire in the Sky (1993), Legends of the Fall (1994), Suicide Kings (1997), All the Pretty Horses (2000), Gangs of New York (2002), 11:14 (2003), and Dear John (2010). Thomas was nominated for the Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor – Series, Miniseries or Television Film for his role in the television film Indictment: The McMartin Trial (1997).
extract_id: Henry Jackson Thomas adalah aktor Amerika. Ia memulai kariernya sebagai aktor cilik dan memegang peran utama sebagai Elliott Taylor dalam film E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial (1982), yang membuatnya memenangkan Young Artist Award dan menerima nominasi Golden Globe Award, BAFTA Award, serta Saturn Award. Thomas juga memiliki peran dalam film lain, termasuk Cloak & Dagger (1984), Frog Dreaming (1986), Valmont (1989), Fire in the Sky (1993), Legends of the Fall (1994), Suicide Kings (1997), All the Pretty Horses (2000), Gangs of New York (2002), 11:14 (2003), dan Dear John (2010). Thomas juga dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik – Seri, Miniseri, atau Film Televisi atas perannya dalam film televesi Indictment: The McMartin Trial (1997).

name: Henry Travers
title: Henry Travers
extract: Travers John Heagerty, known professionally as Henry Travers, was an English film and stage character actor who specialised in portraying slightly bumbling but amiable and likeable older men. His best known role to today's audiences was the guardian angel Clarence Odbody in the 1946 film It's a Wonderful Life. He also received an Academy Award nomination for his supporting role in Mrs. Miniver (1942). Other notable films include The Invisible Man (1933), Dark Victory (1939), High Sierra (1941), and The Bells of St. Mary's (1945).
extract_id: Travers John Heagerty, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Henry Travers, adalah aktor karakter film dan panggung Inggris yang mengkhususkan diri dalam memerankan pria tua yang sedikit kikuk tetapi ramah dan disukai. Peran terbaiknya yang dikenal oleh penonton saat ini adalah malaikat pelindung Clarence Odbody dalam film It's a Wonderful Life tahun 1946. Ia juga menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk peran pendukungnya dalam Mrs. Miniver (1942). Film terkenal lainnya termasuk The Invisible Man (1933), Dark Victory (1939), High Sierra (1941), dan The Bells of St. Mary's (1945).

name: Herb Edelman
title: Herb Edelman
extract: Herbert Edelman was an American actor of stage, film and television. He was twice nominated for an Emmy Award for his television work. His best-known role was as Stanley Zbornak, the ex-husband of Dorothy Zbornak on The Golden Girls. He also had a recurring role on the 1980s medical drama St. Elsewhere.
extract_id: Herbert Edelman adalah aktor Amerika panggung, film, dan televisi. Ia dua kali dinominasikan untuk Emmy Award atas karya televisinya. Peran yang paling dikenal adalah sebagai Stanley Zbornak, mantan suami Dorothy Zbornak di The Golden Girls. Ia juga memiliki peran berulang di drama medis 1980-an St. Elsewhere.

name: Herbert Grönemeyer
title: Herbert Grönemeyer
extract: Herbert Arthur Wiglev Clamor Grönemeyer is a German singer, musician, producer, composer and actor, popular in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
extract_id: Herbert Arthur Wiglev Clamor Grönemeyer adalah penyanyi, musikus, produser, komposer, dan aktor Jerman yang populer di Jerman, Austria, dan Swiss.

name: Herbert Knaup
title: Herbert Knaup
extract: Herbert Knaup is a German film and television actor. He is perhaps best-known to international audiences for his supporting roles in Run Lola Run (1998) and The Lives of Others (2006).
extract_id: Herbert Knaup adalah aktor film dan televisi Jerman. Ia mungkin paling dikenal oleh penonton internasional karena peran pendukungnya dalam Run Lola Run (1998) dan The Lives of Others (2006).

name: Herbert Lom
title: Herbert Lom
extract: Herbert Charles Angelo Kuchačevič ze Schluderpacheru, known professionally as Herbert Lom, was a Czech-British actor with a career spanning over 60 years. His cool demeanour and precise, elegant elocution saw him cast as criminals or suave villains in his younger years, and professional men and nobles as he aged. Highly versatile, he was also known to legions of comedy fans as the beleaguered Chief Inspector Charles Dreyfus in the Pink Panther film series.
extract_id: Herbert Charles Angelo Kuchačevič ze Schluderpacheru, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Herbert Lom, adalah aktor Ceko-Inggris dengan karier yang berlangsung lebih dari 60 tahun. Sikapnya yang tenang dan elokusi yang tepat serta elegan membuatnya sering keperankan penjahat atau penjahat yang halus di masa muda, dan pria profesional serta bangsawan saat menua. Sangat serba bisa, ia juga dikenal oleh banyak penggemar komedi sebagai Inspektur Kepala Charles Dreyfus yang tertekan dalam seri film Pink Panther.

name: Hiam Abbass
title: Hiam Abbass
description: Palestinian actress with Israeli and French citizenship (born 1960)
extract: Hiam Abbass, also spelled Hiyam Abbas, is a Palestinian actress and film director with French citizenship. She is known for her roles in films such as The Syrian Bride (2004), Paradise Now (2005), Free Zone (2005), Munich (2005), The Visitor (2007), Lemon Tree (2008), Insyriated (2017), and Blade Runner 2049 (2017).
