She gained prominence for her role as Marcia Roy in the HBO drama series Succession (2018–2023) for which she was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Guest Actress in a Drama Series. She has also acted in the Channel 4 series The Promise (2011), the Lifetime miniseries The Red Tent (2014), the Hulu comedy series Ramy (2019–2022), and the Hulu drama series The Old Man (2022).
extract_id: Hiam Abbass, juga dieja Hiyam Abbas, adalah aktris dan sutradara film asal Palestina dengan kewarganegaraan Prancis. Ia dikenal dari peran-perannya dalam film seperti The Syrian Bride (2004), Paradise Now (2005), Free Zone (2005), Munich (2005), The Visitor (2007), Lemon Tree (2008), Insyriated (2017), dan Blade Runner 2049 (2017). Ia mendapatkan ketenaran atas perannya sebagai Marcia Roy dalam seri drama HBO Succession (2018–2023) yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Primetime Emmy Award untuk Aktris Tamu Terbaik dalam Seri Drama. Ia juga berakting dalam seri Channel 4 The Promise (2011), miniseri Lifetime The Red Tent (2014), seri komedi Hulu Ramy (2019–2022), dan seri drama Hulu The Old Man (2022).

name: Hideaki Anno
title: Hideaki Anno
description: Japanese animator, filmmaker, producer, and seiyū (born 1960)
extract: Hideaki Anno is a Japanese animator, filmmaker, and actor. His most celebrated creation, the Evangelion franchise, has had a significant influence on the anime television industry and Japanese popular culture. Anno's style is defined by his postmodernist approach and the extensive portrayal of characters' thoughts and emotions.
extract_id: Hideaki Anno adalah animator, pembuat film, dan aktor Jepang. Karya paling terkenalnya, waralaba Evangelion, memiliki pengaruh signifikan pada industri televisi anime dan budaya populer Jepang. Gaya Anno ditandai oleh pendekatan postmodern dan penggambaran mendalam tentang pikiran dan emosi karakter.

name: Hidetoshi Nishijima
title: Hidetoshi Nishijima (actor)
extract: Hidetoshi Nishijima is a Japanese actor and model. He is widely regarded as one of Japan's leading actors, having appeared in a wide range of films from science fiction films such as Shin Ultraman (2022) to small-scale art films such as Dolls (2002). He gained international recognition for his critically acclaimed leading role in the 2021 film Drive My Car, for which he received the Japan Academy Film Prize for Best Actor.
extract_id: Hidetoshi Nishijima adalah aktor dan model Jepang. Ia dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terkemuka di Jepang, dengan penampilan dalam berbagai film mulai dari film fiksi ilmiah seperti Shin Ultraman (2022) hingga film seni berskala kecil seperti Dolls (2002). Ia mendapatkan pengakuan internasional atas perannya yang sangat diapresiasi dalam film 2021 Drive My Car, yang membuatnya menerima Penghargaan Film Akademi Jepang untuk Aktor Terbaik.

name: Hilary Swank
title: Hilary Swank
extract: Hilary Ann Swank is an American actress and film producer. Known for her leading roles in film, she has received numerous accolades including two Academy Awards, an Actor Award, two Critics' Choice Awards, and two Golden Globe Awards as well as nomination for a BAFTA Award. She was named by Time as one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2005.
extract_id: Hilary Ann Swank adalah aktris dan produser film Amerika. Dikenal dengan peran utamanya dalam film, ia telah menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk dua Academy Awards, sebuah Penghargaan Aktor, dua Critics' Choice Awards, dan dua Golden Globe Awards serta nominasi BAFTA Award. Ia dinobatkan oleh Time sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia pada tahun 2005.

name: Hiromasa Yonebayashi
title: Hiromasa Yonebayashi
extract: Hiromasa Yonebayashi , nicknamed Maro (麻呂), is a Japanese animator and director, formerly for Studio Ghibli. After his directorial debut with Studio Ghibli, he became the youngest director of a theatrical film produced by the studio. He was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature in 2015 for his second film, When Marnie Was There.
extract_id: Hiromasa Yonebayashi, dijuluki Maro (麻呂), adalah animator dan sutradara Jepang, sebelumnya untuk Studio Ghibli. Setelah debut sutradaranya dengan Studio Ghibli, ia menjadi sutradara termuda dari sebuah film teatrikal yang diproduksi oleh studio tersebut. Ia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Film Animasi Terbaik pada tahun 2015 untuk film keduanya, When Marnie Was There.

name: Hiroyuki Okiura
title: Hiroyuki Okiura
extract: Hiroyuki Okiura is a Japanese anime director and animator working for Production I.G.
extract_id: Hiroyuki Okiura adalah sutradara anime dan animator Jepang yang bekerja untuk Production I.G.

name: Hisako Kyôda
title: Hisako Kyōda
extract: Hisako Kyōda is a Japanese actress and voice actress. Some of her major voice roles include Genkai in Yu Yu Hakusho, Omusubiman in Soreike! Anpanman and Yukari Godai in Maison Ikkoku. Kyōda is affiliated with the talent agency Haikyō.
extract_id: Hisako Kyōda adalah aktris dan pengisi suara Jepang. Beberapa peran suaranya yang terkenal termasuk Genkai dalam Yu Yu Hakusho, Omusubiman dalam Soreike! Anpanman, dan Yukari Godai dalam Maison Ikkoku. Kyōda berafiliasi dengan agen bakat Haikyō.

name: Hitoshi Takagi
title: Hitoshi Takagi
extract: Hitoshi Takagi was a Japanese actor and voice actor who was last affiliated with 81 Produce.
extract_id: Hitoshi Takagi adalah aktor dan pengisi suara Jepang yang terakhir berafiliasi dengan 81 Produce.

name: Holly Hunter
title: Holly Hunter
extract: Holly Hunter is an American actress. Born in Conyers, Georgia, her first acting role was as Helen Keller in a fifth-grade play, before appearing in Rockdale County High School stagings of Oklahoma!, Man of La Mancha, and Fiddler on the Roof. In Pittsburgh, she graduated with a drama degree at Carnegie Mellon University and performed in local theater.
extract_id: Holly Hunter adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Lahir di Conyers, Georgia, peran akting pertamanya adalah sebagai Helen Keller dalam sebuah drama kelas lima, sebelum tampil dalam pertunjukan Oklahoma!, Man of La Mancha, dan Fiddler on the Roof di Rockdale County High School. Di Pittsburgh, ia lulus dengan gelar drama dari Carnegie Mellon University dan tampil di teater lokal.

name: Holmes Osborne
title: Holmes Osborne
extract: Holmes Osborne is an American character actor who has worked in film and television, including notable roles in That Thing You Do! (1996), Donnie Darko (2001) and Southland Tales (2007).
extract_id: Holmes Osborne adalah aktor karakter Amerika yang telah bekerja di film dan televisi, termasuk peran penting dalam That Thing You Do! (1996), Donnie Darko (2001) dan Southland Tales (2007).

name: Honor Blackman
title: Honor Blackman
extract: Honor Blackman was an English actress and singer, known for the roles of Cathy Gale in The Avengers (1962–1964), "Bond girl" Pussy Galore in Goldfinger (1964), Julia Daggett in Shalako (1968), and Hera in Jason and the Argonauts (1963). She is also known for her role as Laura West in the ITV sitcom The Upper Hand (1990–1996).
extract_id: Honor Blackman adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi asal Inggris, dikenal untuk peran Cathy Gale dalam The Avengers (1962–1964), "Bond girl" Pussy Galore dalam Goldfinger (1964), Julia Daggett dalam Shalako (1968), dan Hera dalam Jason and the Argonauts (1963). Ia juga dikenal karena perannya sebagai Laura West dalam sitkom ITV The Upper Hand (1990–1996).

name: Horacio Salinas
title: Horacio Salinas
extract: Horacio Salinas Álvarez is a Chilean guitarist and composer. He is cofounder and musical director of the Chilean group Inti-Illimani Histórico. He has a huge repertory of compositions that involves folk, Andean music, protest music, world music, contemporary classical music and many Latin American styles and fusions. In 1973, his group was touring in Europe when Augusto Pinochet seized power in Chile, after which they had to stay in exile for years. He has played with many international musicians notably the Australian classical guitarist John Williams.
extract_id: Horacio Salinas Álvarez adalah gitaris dan komposer asal Chili. Ia adalah salah satu pendiri dan direktur musik dari grup Chili Inti-Illimani Histórico. Ia memiliki repertoar komposisi yang luas yang melibatkan musik folk, musik Andes, musik protes, musik dunia, musik klasik kontemporer dan banyak gaya serta fusi musik Amerika Latin. Pada tahun 1973, kelompoknya sedang tur di Eropa ketika Augusto Pinochet mengambil alih kekuasaan di Chili, setelah itu mereka harus tinggal di pengasingan selama bertahun-tahun. Ia telah bermain dengan banyak musisi internasional, terutama gitaris klasik Australia John Williams.

name: Howard Da Silva
title: Howard da Silva
extract: Howard da Silva was an American actor, singer, and theatre director. He was cast in dozens of productions on the New York stage, appeared in more than two dozen television programs, and acted in more than 50 feature films.
extract_id: Howard da Silva adalah seorang aktor, penyanyi, dan sutradara teater Amerika. Ia berperan dalam puluhan produksi di panggung New York, muncul dalam lebih dari dua lusin program televisi, dan berakting dalam lebih dari 50 film fitur.

name: Howard Hawks
title: Howard Hawks
extract: Howard Winchester Hawks was an American film director, producer, and screenwriter of the classic Hollywood era. The critic Leonard Maltin called him "the greatest American director who is not a household name." Roger Ebert called Hawks "one of the greatest American directors of pure movies, and a hero of auteur critics because he found his own laconic values in so many different kinds of genre material." He was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Director for Sergeant York (1941) and earned the Honorary Academy Award in 1974.
extract_id: Howard Winchester Hawks adalah sutradara film, produser, dan penulis naskah Amerika dari era klasik Hollywood. Kritikus Leonard Maltin menyebutnya "sutradara Amerika terbesar yang tidak dikenal luas." Roger Ebert menyebut Hawks sebagai "salah satu sutradara Amerika terbesar dari film murni, dan pahlawan para kritikus auteur karena ia menemukan nilai laconicnya sendiri dalam banyak jenis bahan genre yang berbeda." Ia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik untuk Sergeant York (1941) dan menerima Honorary Academy Award pada tahun 1974.

name: Hrishikesh Mukherjee
title: Hrishikesh Mukherjee
extract: Hrishikesh Mukherjee was an Indian film director, editor and writer. He is regarded as one of the greatest filmmakers of Indian cinema. Popularly known as Hrishi-da, he directed 42 films during his career spanning over four decades, and is named the pioneer of the 'middle cinema' of India. Renowned for his social films that reflected the changing middle-class ethos, Mukherjee "carved a middle path between the extravagance of mainstream cinema and the stark realism of art cinema".
extract_id: Hrishikesh Mukherjee adalah sutradara film, editor, dan penulis India. Ia dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film terbesar dalam sinema India. Populer dikenal sebagai Hrishi-da, ia menyutradarai 42 film selama kariernya yang berlangsung lebih dari empat dekade, dan dikenal sebagai pelopor 'middle cinema' di India. Dikenal karena film-film sosialnya yang mencerminkan etos kelas menengah yang berubah, Mukherjee "mengukir jalan tengah antara kemewahan sinema arus utama dan realisme keras sinema seni."

name: Hrithik Roshan
title: Hrithik Roshan
extract: Hritik Rakesh Nagrath, known professionally as Hrithik Roshan, is an Indian actor and producer who works in Hindi cinema. Referred to as the millennial superstar, he has portrayed a variety of characters and is known for his dancing skills. One of the highest-paid actors in India, he has won many awards, including six Filmfare Awards, of which four were for Best Actor. Starting from 2012, he has appeared in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 several times based on his income and popularity.
extract_id: Hritik Rakesh Nagrath, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Hrithik Roshan, adalah aktor dan produser India yang bekerja di sinema Hindi. Dijuluki superstar millennial, ia telah memerankan berbagai karakter dan dikenal karena keterampilan menarinya. Sebagai salah satu aktor dengan bayaran tertinggi di India, ia telah memenangkan banyak penghargaan, termasuk enam Filmfare Awards, empat di antaranya sebagai Aktor Terbaik. Sejak 2012, ia telah beberapa kali muncul dalam Celebrity 100 Forbes India berdasarkan pendapatan dan popularitasnya.

name: Hubert Koundé
title: Hubert Koundé
extract: Hubert Koundé is a French actor and film director. He is best known for his role as Hubert in the film La Haine written and directed by Mathieu Kassovitz.
extract_id: Hubert Koundé adalah aktor dan sutradara film asal Prancis. Ia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Hubert dalam film La Haine yang ditulis dan disutradarai oleh Mathieu Kassovitz.

name: Hubertus Bengsch
title: Hubertus Bengsch
extract: Hubertus Bengsch is a German actor, best known for his role as the German First Officer (1WO) in Das Boot. His role in the 1981 film and 1985 serialized long version and director’s cut, is noted for being the only character clearly devoted to Nazism.
extract_id: Hubertus Bengsch adalah aktor Jerman, paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Perwira Pertama Jerman (1WO) dalam Das Boot. Perannya dalam film tahun 1981 dan versi serial panjang serta director’s cut tahun 1985, dikenal sebagai satu-satunya karakter yang jelas-jelas menganut Nazisme.

name: Huck Milner
title: Huck Milner
extract: Huckleberry Milner is an American actor. He is best known for being the voice of Dash Parr in the Pixar animated film Incredibles 2.
extract_id: Huckleberry Milner adalah aktor Amerika. Ia paling dikenal sebagai pengisi suara Dash Parr dalam film animasi Pixar Incredibles 2.

name: Hugh Bonneville
title: Hugh Bonneville
extract: Hugh Richard Bonniwell Williams, known professionally as Hugh Bonneville, is a British actor. He is best known for portraying Robert Crawley, Earl of Grantham, in the ITV historical drama series Downton Abbey from 2010 to 2015. His performance on the show earned him a nomination at the Golden Globes and two consecutive Primetime Emmy Award nominations, as well as three Actor Awards. He reprised his role in the feature films Downton Abbey (2019), Downton Abbey: A New Era (2022), and Downton Abbey: The Grand Finale (2025). He also acted in the films Notting Hill (1999), Iris (2001), The Monuments Men (2014), and the Paddington films (2014–present).
extract_id: Hugh Richard Bonniwell Williams, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Hugh Bonneville, adalah aktor Inggris. Ia paling dikenal karena memerankan Robert Crawley, Earl of Grantham, dalam seri drama sejarah ITV Downton Abbey dari 2010 hingga 2015. Penampilannya dalam acara tersebut memberinya nominasi di Golden Globes dan dua nominasi Primetime Emmy Awards berturut-turut, serta tiga Penghargaan Aktor. Ia mengulangi perannya dalam film fitur Downton Abbey (2019), Downton Abbey: A New Era (2022), dan Downton Abbey: The Grand Finale (2025). Ia juga berakting dalam film Notting Hill (1999), Iris (2001), The Monuments Men (2014), dan film-film Paddington (2014–sekarang).

name: Hugh Grant
title: Hugh Grant
extract: Hugh John Mungo Grant is an English actor. He established himself early in his career as a charming and vulnerable romantic leading man, and has since transitioned into a character actor. He has received several accolades including a British Academy Film Award and a Golden Globe Award as well as nominations for two Primetime Emmy Awards. He received an Honorary César in 2006. In 2022, Time Out magazine listed Grant as one of Britain's 50 greatest actors of all time. As of 2025, his films have grossed over US$4 billion worldwide.
extract_id: Hugh John Mungo Grant adalah aktor Inggris. Ia membangun reputasinya sejak awal karier sebagai pria utama romantis yang menawan dan rentan, dan sejak itu bertransformasi menjadi aktor karakter. Ia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan termasuk British Academy Film Award dan Golden Globe Award serta nominasi untuk dua Primetime Emmy Awards. Ia menerima Honorary César pada tahun 2006. Pada 2022, majalah Time Out mencantumkan Grant sebagai salah satu dari 50 aktor terbaik Inggris sepanjang masa. Hingga 2025, film-filmnya telah meraup lebih dari US$4 miliar di seluruh dunia.

name: Hugh Jackman
title: Hugh Jackman
extract: Hugh Michael Jackman is an Australian and British actor, singer, and producer. Prominent on both screen and stage, he has received various accolades, including a Primetime Emmy Award, a Grammy Award and two Tony Awards, along with nominations for an Academy Award and a British Academy Film Award. Jackman was appointed a Companion of the Order of Australia in 2019.
extract_id: Hugh Michael Jackman adalah aktor, penyanyi, dan produser asal Australia dan Inggris. Menonjol di layar dan panggung, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Primetime Emmy Award, Grammy Award, dan dua Tony Awards, serta nominasi untuk Academy Award dan British Academy Film Award. Jackman diangkat sebagai Companion of the Order of Australia pada 2019.

name: Hugh Marlowe
title: Hugh Marlowe
extract: Hugh Marlowe was an American film, television, stage, and radio actor.
extract_id: Hugh Marlowe adalah aktor film, televisi, panggung, dan radio Amerika.

name: Hugh Welchman
title: Hugh Welchman
extract: Hugh Stewart Jasper Welchman is a British filmmaker, screenwriter, and producer.
extract_id: Hugh Stewart Jasper Welchman adalah pembuat film, penulis skenario, dan produser asal Inggris.

name: Hugo Silva
title: Hugo Silva (actor)
extract: Rafael Hugo Fernández Silva is a Spanish actor. He attained notoriety for his portrayal of vulgar cop Lucas in television series Los hombres de Paco from 2005 to 2009.
extract_id: Rafael Hugo Fernández Silva adalah aktor Spanyol. Ia dikenal luas atas perannya sebagai polisi vulgar Lucas dalam serial televisi Los hombres de Paco dari 2005 hingga 2009.

name: Hugo Weaving
title: Hugo Weaving
extract: Hugo Wallace Weaving is a stage, screen, and voice actor. Born in Colonial Nigeria to British parents, Weaving has lived in Australia since 1976, although he retains British citizenship. He undertook his acting training at NIDA in Sydney. He became known internationally for his appearances in the Australian films Proof (1991) and The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert (1994), and more widely known as Agent Smith in the first three The Matrix films (1999–2003) and Elrond in The Lord of the Rings trilogy (2001–2003).
extract_id: Hugo Wallace Weaving adalah aktor panggung, layar, dan pengisi suara. Lahir di Nigeria Kolonial dari orang tua Inggris, Weaving telah tinggal di Australia sejak 1976, meskipun ia mempertahankan kewarganegaraan Inggris. Ia menjalani pelatihan akting di NIDA, Sydney. Ia dikenal secara internasional melalui penampilannya dalam film-film Australia Proof (1991) dan The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert (1994), dan lebih dikenal luas sebagai Agent Smith dalam tiga film The Matrix pertama (1999–2003) serta Elrond dalam trilogi The Lord of the Rings (2001–2003).

name: Humphrey Bogart
title: Humphrey Bogart
extract: Humphrey DeForest Bogart, nicknamed Bogie, was an American actor. Often known for his leading roles as both gangsters and detectives in film noirs, his performances in classic Hollywood cinema made him an American cultural icon. He won an Academy Award and was honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 1960.
extract_id: Humphrey DeForest Bogart, dijuluki Bogie, adalah aktor Amerika. Sering dikenal atas peran utamanya sebagai gangster dan detektif dalam film noir, penampilannya dalam sinema klasik Hollywood menjadikannya ikon budaya Amerika. Ia memenangkan Academy Award dan dihormati dengan bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada 1960.

name: Hümeyra
title: Hümeyra
extract: Fatma Hümeyra Akbay is a Turkish actress, singer, composer, and lyricist. In the 1970s she was a noted singer and actress. Her popularity with the new generation rose in the 2000s with the hit sitcom Avrupa Yakası, Yalan Dünya by Gülse Birsel. She played in popular youth series "Melekler Korusun" and "Şahsiyet" which won International Emmy Awards. She played in Çağan Irmak's many films like Babam ve Oğlum, Unutursam Fısılda.
extract_id: Fatma Hümeyra Akbay adalah aktris, penyanyi, komposer, dan penulis lirik Turki. Pada tahun 1970-an ia adalah penyanyi dan aktris ternama. Popularitasnya dengan generasi baru meningkat pada 2000-an dengan sitkom hit Avrupa Yakası, Yalan Dünya oleh Gülse Birsel. Ia berperan dalam serial remaja populer "Melekler Korusun" dan "Şahsiyet" yang memenangkan International Emmy Awards. Ia membintangi banyak film karya Çağan Irmak seperti Babam ve Oğlum dan Unutursam Fısılda.

name: Ian Hart
title: Ian Hart
extract: Ian Davies, known professionally as Ian Hart, is an English actor. His most notable screen roles have been in One Summer (1983), Land and Freedom (1995), Nothing Personal, Michael Collins (1996), Liam (2000), as Professor Quirrell in Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (2001), as Ludwig van Beethoven in Eroica (2003), as Brian Keenan in Blind Flight, as Kester Gill on My Mad Fat Diary (2013–15), as Father Beocca on The Last Kingdom (2015–20), and as Carl on The Responder (2022). He is also known for playing musician John Lennon in multiple productions, including the 1994 biopic Backbeat.
extract_id: Ian Davies, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Ian Hart, adalah aktor Inggris. Peran layar paling terkenalnya adalah dalam One Summer (1983), Land and Freedom (1995), Nothing Personal, Michael Collins (1996), Liam (2000), sebagai Profesor Quirrell dalam Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (2001), sebagai Ludwig van Beethoven dalam Eroica (2003), sebagai Brian Keenan dalam Blind Flight, sebagai Kester Gill di My Mad Fat Diary (2013–15), sebagai Father Beocca di The Last Kingdom (2015–20), dan sebagai Carl di The Responder (2022). Ia juga dikenal karena memerankan musisi John Lennon dalam berbagai produksi, termasuk biopic Backbeat tahun 1994.

name: Ian Hendry
title: Ian Hendry
extract: Ian Mackendrick Hendry was an English actor. He worked on several British TV series of the 1960s and 1970s, including the lead in the first series of The Avengers and The Lotus Eaters. He was nominated for two BAFTA Awards for his film work: Most Promising Newcomer to Leading Film Roles for Live Now – Pay Later (1962) and Best Actor in a Supporting Role for Get Carter (1971).
extract_id: Ian Mackendrick Hendry adalah aktor Inggris. Ia bekerja pada beberapa serial TV Inggris tahun 1960-an dan 1970-an, termasuk peran utama dalam seri pertama The Avengers dan The Lotus Eaters. Ia dinominasikan untuk dua BAFTA Awards untuk karya filmnya: Most Promising Newcomer to Leading Film Roles untuk Live Now – Pay Later (1962) dan Best Actor in a Supporting Role untuk Get Carter (1971).

name: Ian Holm
title: Ian Holm
extract: Sir Ian Holm Cuthbert was an English actor. After graduating from RADA and beginning his career on the British stage as a member of the Royal Shakespeare Company, he became a successful and prolific performer on television and in film. He received numerous accolades including two BAFTA Awards and a Tony Award, along with a nomination for an Academy Award. He was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 1998 for services to drama.
extract_id: Sir Ian Holm Cuthbert adalah aktor Inggris. Setelah lulus dari RADA dan memulai kariernya di panggung Inggris sebagai anggota Royal Shakespeare Company, ia menjadi pemain yang sukses dan produktif di televisi dan film. Ia menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk dua BAFTA Awards dan Tony Award, serta nominasi Academy Award. Ia dianugerahi gelar kebangsawanan oleh Ratu Elizabeth II pada 1998 atas jasa-jasanya di bidang drama.

name: Ian McKellen
title: Ian McKellen
extract: Sir Ian Murray McKellen is an English actor. Widely considered one of Britain's greatest actors, he is noted for his versatile roles on stage and screen, in genres ranging from Shakespearean dramas and modern theatre to popular fantasy and science fiction. He is regarded as a British cultural icon and was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 1991. He has received numerous accolades, including a Tony Award, six Laurence Olivier Awards, two Actor Awards and a Golden Globe Award, in addition to nominations for two Academy Awards, five BAFTAs and five Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Sir Ian Murray McKellen adalah aktor Inggris. Banyak dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar Inggris, ia dikenal karena perannya yang serbaguna di panggung dan layar, dalam genre mulai dari drama Shakespearean dan teater modern hingga fantasi populer dan fiksi ilmiah. Ia dianggap sebagai ikon budaya Inggris dan dianugerahi gelar kebangsawanan oleh Ratu Elizabeth II pada 1991. Ia telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Tony Award, enam Laurence Olivier Awards, dua Actor Awards, dan Golden Globe Award, selain nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards, lima BAFTA, dan lima Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Ida Engvoll
title: Ida Engvoll
extract: Ida Engvoll is a Swedish actress. She has appeared in more than fifteen films since 2009.
extract_id: Ida Engvoll adalah aktris Swedia. Ia telah tampil dalam lebih dari lima belas film sejak 2009.

name: Iemasa Kayumi
title: Iemasa Kayumi
extract: Iemasa Kayumi was a Japanese actor, voice actor and narrator from the Tokyo Metropolitan area.
extract_id: Iemasa Kayumi adalah seorang aktor, pengisi suara, dan narator Jepang dari daerah Metropolitan Tokyo.

name: Iko Uwais
title: Iko Uwais
extract: Uwais Qorny, known professionally as Iko Uwais, is an Indonesian actor, stuntman, fight choreographer, and martial artist. He is best known for acting in the action films Merantau (2009), The Raid (2011), The Raid 2 (2014), Headshot (2016), Mile 22 (2018), The Night Comes for Us (2018), Stuber (2019), and the Netflix series Wu Assassins (2019–22).
extract_id: Uwais Qorny, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Iko Uwais, adalah aktor, pemeran pengganti, koreografer pertarungan, dan seniman bela diri Indonesia. Dia paling dikenal karena berakting dalam film aksi Merantau (2009), The Raid (2011), The Raid 2 (2014), Headshot (2016), Mile 22 (2018), The Night Comes for Us (2018), Stuber (2019), dan seri Netflix Wu Assassins (2019–22).

name: Ileana D'Cruz
title: Ileana D'Cruz
extract: Ileana D'Cruz is an Indian-born Portuguese actress who primarily appears in Hindi and Telugu films. She is the recipient of several accolades including a Filmfare Award and a Filmfare Awards South.
extract_id: Ileana D'Cruz adalah aktris Portugis kelahiran India yang terutama tampil dalam film Hindi dan Telugu. Dia menerima beberapa penghargaan termasuk Filmfare Award dan Filmfare Awards South.

name: Ilker Kizmaz
title: İlker Kızmaz
extract: İlker Kızmaz is a Turkish actor.
extract_id: İlker Kızmaz adalah aktor Turki.

name: Imelda Staunton
title: Imelda Staunton
extract: Dame Imelda Mary Philomena Bernadette Staunton is an English actress and singer. After training at the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art, Staunton began her career in repertory theatre in 1976 and appeared in various stage productions in the West End and across the UK. Throughout her career, she has received numerous accolades including a British Academy Film Award, and five Laurence Olivier Awards as well as nominations for an Academy Award, three British Academy Television Awards, three Golden Globes, and three Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Dame Imelda Mary Philomena Bernadette Staunton adalah aktris dan penyanyi Inggris. Setelah menjalani pelatihan di Royal Academy of Dramatic Art, Staunton memulai kariernya di teater repertori pada tahun 1976 dan tampil dalam berbagai produksi panggung di West End dan seluruh Inggris. Sepanjang kariernya, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk British Academy Film Award, lima Laurence Olivier Awards serta nominasi untuk Academy Award, tiga British Academy Television Awards, tiga Golden Globes, dan tiga Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Imtiaz Ali
title: Imtiaz Ali (director)
extract: Imtiaz Ali is an Indian filmmaker. He is best known for writing and directing the romantic comedies Socha Na Tha (2005), Jab We Met (2007) and Love Aaj Kal (2009), and the dramas Rockstar (2011), Highway (2014), Tamasha (2015), Jab Harry Met Sejal (2017), Amar Singh Chamkila (2024), and Main Vaapas Aaunga (2026).
extract_id: Imtiaz Ali adalah pembuat film India. Dia paling dikenal sebagai penulis dan sutradara komedi romantis Socha Na Tha (2005), Jab We Met (2007) dan Love Aaj Kal (2009), serta drama Rockstar (2011), Highway (2014), Tamasha (2015), Jab Harry Met Sejal (2017), Amar Singh Chamkila (2024), dan Main Vaapas Aaunga (2026).

name: Indraneil Sengupta
title: Indraneil Sengupta
extract: Indraniel Sengupta, is an Indian actor and model who works in Hindi and Bengali films and television.
extract_id: Indraniel Sengupta adalah aktor dan model India yang bekerja di film dan televisi Hindi serta Bengali.

name: Inge Landgut
title: Inge Landgut
extract: Inge Landgut was a German actress. She is probably best-remembered for playing Pony Hütchen in Emil and the Detectives and as the child murder victim Elsie Beckmann in Fritz Lang's classic M, both films were released in 1931. Landgut continued her acting career into adulthood, making both film and television appearances.
extract_id: Inge Landgut adalah aktris Jerman. Dia mungkin paling dikenang karena memerankan Pony Hütchen dalam Emil and the Detectives dan sebagai korban pembunuhan anak Elsie Beckmann dalam film klasik Fritz Lang, M, keduanya dirilis pada tahun 1931. Landgut melanjutkan karier aktingnya hingga dewasa dengan tampil di film dan televisi.

name: Ingmar Bergman
title: Ingmar Bergman
extract: Ernst Ingmar Bergman was a Swedish filmmaker and theatre director. He is considered one of the greatest and most important filmmakers in the history of cinema, most notably as a prominent figure of both European film industry and Swedish cinema. His films have been described as "profoundly personal meditations into the myriad struggles facing the psyche and the soul."
extract_id: Ernst Ingmar Bergman adalah pembuat film dan sutradara teater Swedia. Ia dianggap salah satu pembuat film terbesar dan terpenting dalam sejarah perfilman, terutama sebagai sosok terkemuka dalam industri film Eropa dan perfilman Swedia. Film-filmnya digambarkan sebagai "meditasi yang sangat pribadi tentang berbagai perjuangan batin dan jiwa."

name: Ingrid Bergman
title: Ingrid Bergman
extract: Ingrid Bergman was a Swedish actress with a career spanning five decades, Bergman is often regarded as one of the most influential actresses in the history of cinema. She won numerous accolades, including three Academy Awards, two Primetime Emmy Awards, and a Tony Award; which made her the youngest performer to achieve the Triple Crown of Acting and one of four actresses to have received at least three acting Academy Awards.
extract_id: Ingrid Bergman adalah aktris Swedia dengan karier yang berlangsung selama lima dekade. Bergman sering dianggap sebagai salah satu aktris paling berpengaruh dalam sejarah perfilman. Dia memenangkan berbagai penghargaan, termasuk tiga Academy Awards, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan sebuah Tony Award; yang menjadikannya pemeran termuda yang mencapai Triple Crown of Acting dan salah satu dari empat aktris yang menerima setidaknya tiga Academy Awards untuk akting.

name: Ingrid Thulin
title: Ingrid Thulin
extract: Ingrid Lilian Thulin was a Swedish actress and director who collaborated with filmmaker Ingmar Bergman. She was often cast as harrowing and desperate characters, and earned acclaim from both Swedish and international critics. She won the Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Actress for her performance in Brink of Life (1958) and the inaugural Guldbagge Award for Best Actress in a Leading Role for The Silence (1963), and was nominated for a Best Supporting Actress BAFTA for Cries and Whispers (1972).
extract_id: Ingrid Lilian Thulin adalah aktris dan sutradara Swedia yang bekerja sama dengan pembuat film Ingmar Bergman. Dia sering berperan sebagai karakter yang penuh penderitaan dan putus asa, dan mendapat pujian dari kritikus Swedia dan internasional. Dia memenangkan Penghargaan Aktor Terbaik Festival Film Cannes untuk penampilannya dalam Brink of Life (1958) dan Penghargaan Guldbagge pertama untuk Aktris Terbaik dalam Peran Utama untuk The Silence (1963), serta dinominasikan untuk BAFTA Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk Cries and Whispers (1972).

name: Irandhir Santos
title: Irandhir Santos
extract: Irandhir Santos Pinto is a Brazilian actor.
extract_id: Irandhir Santos Pinto adalah aktor Brasil.

name: Irene Miracle
title: Irene Miracle
extract: Irene Miracle is an American film and television actress and director.
extract_id: Irene Miracle adalah aktris dan sutradara film dan televisi Amerika.

name: Irene Papas
title: Irene Papas
extract: Irene Papas or Pappas was a Greek actress and singer who starred in over 70 films in a career spanning more than 50 years. She gained international recognition through such popular award-winning films as The Guns of Navarone (1961), Zorba the Greek (1964) and Z (1969). She was a powerful protagonist in films including The Trojan Women (1971) and Iphigenia (1977). She played the title roles in Antigone (1961) and Electra (1962). She had a fine singing voice, on display in the 1968 recording Songs of Theodorakis.
extract_id: Irene Papas atau Pappas adalah aktris dan penyanyi Yunani yang membintangi lebih dari 70 film dalam karier lebih dari 50 tahun. Dia mendapatkan pengakuan internasional melalui film-film populer pemenang penghargaan seperti The Guns of Navarone (1961), Zorba the Greek (1964) dan Z (1969). Dia adalah protagonis kuat dalam film-film termasuk The Trojan Women (1971) dan Iphigenia (1977). Dia memerankan peran utama dalam Antigone (1961) dan Electra (1962). Dia memiliki suara nyanyi yang indah, yang ditampilkan dalam rekaman 1968 Songs of Theodorakis.

name: Irrfan Khan
title: Irrfan Khan
extract: Irrfan Khan was an Indian actor who worked in Indian cinema as well as British and American films. Widely regarded as one of the finest actors in world cinema, Khan's career spanned over 30 years and earned him numerous accolades, including a National Film Award, an Asian Film Award, and six Filmfare Awards. In 2011, he was awarded the Padma Shri, India's fourth highest civilian honour. In 2021, he was posthumously awarded the Filmfare Lifetime Achievement Award.
extract_id: Irrfan Khan adalah aktor India yang bekerja di perfilman India serta film Inggris dan Amerika. Secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terbaik di dunia perfilman, karier Khan berlangsung lebih dari 30 tahun dan memberinya berbagai penghargaan, termasuk National Film Award, Asian Film Award, dan enam Filmfare Awards. Pada 2011, ia dianugerahi Padma Shri, penghargaan sipil tertinggi keempat di India. Pada 2021, ia dianugerahi Filmfare Lifetime Achievement Award secara anumerta.

name: Irvin Kershner
title: Irvin Kershner
extract: Irvin Kershner was an American director for film and television. Early in his career as a filmmaker he directed quirky, independent drama films, while working as a lecturer at the University of Southern California. Later, he began making high-budget blockbusters such as The Empire Strikes Back, the James Bond adaptation Never Say Never Again and RoboCop 2. Through the course of his career, he received numerous accolades, including being nominated for both a Primetime Emmy Award and a Palme d'Or.
extract_id: Irvin Kershner adalah sutradara film dan televisi Amerika. Di awal karier sebagai pembuat film, ia menyutradarai film drama independen yang unik sambil menjadi dosen di University of Southern California. Kemudian, ia mulai membuat blockbuster berbiaya besar seperti The Empire Strikes Back, adaptasi James Bond Never Say Never Again, dan RoboCop 2. Sepanjang kariernya, ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk nominasi Primetime Emmy Award dan Palme d'Or.

name: Irène Jacob
title: Irène Jacob
extract: Irène Marie Jacob is a French-Swiss actress known for her work with Polish film director Krzysztof Kieślowski. She won the 1991 Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Actress for the Kieślowski film The Double Life of Veronique, and was nominated for the BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Leading Role for her 1994 film Three Colours: Red. Her other film appearances include The Secret Garden (1993), Beyond the Clouds (1995), U.S. Marshals (1998), and Eternity (2016).
extract_id: Irène Marie Jacob adalah aktris Prancis-Swiss yang dikenal melalui karyanya dengan sutradara film Polandia Krzysztof Kieślowski. Dia memenangkan Penghargaan Aktris Terbaik Festival Film Cannes 1991 untuk film Kieślowski The Double Life of Veronique, dan dinominasikan untuk BAFTA Award untuk Aktris Terbaik dalam Peran Utama untuk filmnya Three Colours: Red (1994). Penampilan film lainnya termasuk The Secret Garden (1993), Beyond the Clouds (1995), U.S. Marshals (1998), dan Eternity (2016).

name: Isa Danieli
title: Isa Danieli
extract: Isa Danieli is an Italian film actress. She has appeared in 32 films since 1962.
extract_id: Isa Danieli adalah aktris film Italia. Dia telah tampil dalam 32 film sejak 1962.

name: Isaac Hayes
title: Isaac Hayes
extract: Isaac Lee Hayes Jr. was an American singer, songwriter, composer, and actor. He was one of the creative forces behind the Southern soul music label Stax Records in the 1960s, serving as an in-house songwriter with his partner David Porter, as well as a session musician and record producer. Hayes and Porter were inducted into the Songwriters Hall of Fame in 2005 in recognition of writing scores of songs for themselves, the duo Sam & Dave, Carla Thomas, and others. In 2002, Hayes was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.
extract_id: Isaac Lee Hayes Jr. adalah penyanyi, penulis lagu, komposer, dan aktor Amerika. Dia adalah salah satu kekuatan kreatif di balik label musik jiwa Selatan Stax Records pada 1960-an, berperan sebagai penulis lagu internal bersama rekannya David Porter, serta musisi sesi dan produser rekaman. Hayes dan Porter dimasukkan ke dalam Songwriters Hall of Fame pada 2005 sebagai pengakuan atas penulisan banyak lagu untuk diri mereka sendiri, duo Sam & Dave, Carla Thomas, dan lainnya. Pada 2002, Hayes dimasukkan ke dalam Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

name: Isabella Rossellini
title: Isabella Rossellini
extract: Isabella Fiorella Elettra Giovanna Rossellini is an Italian and American actress and model. The daughter of Swedish actress Ingrid Bergman and Italian film director Roberto Rossellini, she is noted for her successful tenure as a Lancôme model and an established career in American and European cinema. She has received nominations for an Academy Award, two Golden Globe Awards, a British Academy Film Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Isabella Fiorella Elettra Giovanna Rossellini adalah aktris dan model Italia-Amerika. Putri aktris Swedia Ingrid Bergman dan sutradara film Italia Roberto Rossellini, dia dikenal karena masa suksesnya sebagai model Lancôme dan karier yang mapan dalam perfilman Amerika dan Eropa. Dia telah menerima nominasi Academy Award, dua Golden Globe Awards, British Academy Film Award, dan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Isabelle Adjani
title: Isabelle Adjani
extract: Isabelle Yasmine Adjani is a French actress and singer, known for portraying tragic and emotionally complex characters across various genres, particularly psychological films. She has received various accolades, including five César Awards, a Lumière Award and a Best Actress Award at the Cannes Film Festival, along with nominations for two Academy Awards. Adjani was made a Chevalier of the Légion d'honneur in 2010 and a Commandeur of the Ordre des Arts et des Lettres in 2014.
extract_id: Isabelle Yasmine Adjani adalah aktris dan penyanyi Prancis, dikenal karena memerankan karakter tragis dan emosional kompleks dalam berbagai genre, terutama film psikologis. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk lima César Awards, Lumière Award, dan Penghargaan Aktris Terbaik di Festival Film Cannes, serta nominasi dua Academy Awards. Adjani dianugerahi gelar Chevalier dari Légion d'honneur pada 2010 dan Commandeur dari Ordre des Arts et des Lettres pada 2014.

name: Isabelle Huppert
title: Isabelle Huppert
extract: Isabelle Anne Madeleine Huppert is a French actress who has appeared in more than 120 feature films, mostly in starring roles. Regarded as one of the most respected actresses in French cinema, she has appeared in films directed by Claude Chabrol, Jean-Luc Godard and Michael Haneke. She has also starred in numerous stage productions, in Paris and around the world.
extract_id: Isabelle Anne Madeleine Huppert adalah aktris Prancis yang telah tampil dalam lebih dari 120 film fitur, sebagian besar peran utama. Dianggap sebagai salah satu aktris paling dihormati dalam perfilman Prancis, dia telah tampil dalam film yang disutradarai oleh Claude Chabrol, Jean-Luc Godard, dan Michael Haneke. Dia juga telah membintangi banyak produksi teater di Paris dan seluruh dunia.

name: Isao Takahata
title: Isao Takahata
extract: Isao Takahata was a Japanese director, screenwriter and producer. A co-founder of Studio Ghibli, he earned international critical acclaim for his work as a director of Japanese animated feature films.
extract_id: Isao Takahata adalah sutradara, penulis skenario, dan produser Jepang. Sebagai salah satu pendiri Studio Ghibli, ia mendapatkan pengakuan internasional sebagai sutradara film animasi fitur Jepang.

name: Ismail Hacioglu
title: İsmail Hacıoğlu
extract: İsmail Hacıoğlu is a Turkish actor and son of Turkey national under-18 football team coach Mehmet Hacıoğlu and brother of actress Kardelen Hacıoğlu. Since the beginning his career, he is cited as one of the best actors of his generation.
extract_id: İsmail Hacıoğlu adalah aktor Turki dan putra pelatih tim nasional sepak bola U-18 Turki Mehmet Hacıoğlu serta saudara dari aktris Kardelen Hacıoğlu. Sejak awal kariernya, ia disebut sebagai salah satu aktor terbaik dari generasinya.

name: Issey Takahashi
title: Issey Takahashi
extract: Issey Takahashi is a Japanese actor and singer.
extract_id: Issey Takahashi adalah aktor dan penyanyi Jepang.

name: Isuzu Yamada
title: Isuzu Yamada
extract: Isuzu Yamada was a Japanese stage and screen actress whose career spanned seven decades.
extract_id: Isuzu Yamada adalah seorang aktris panggung dan layar Jepang yang kariernya berlangsung selama tujuh dekade.

name: Ivan Dobronravov
title: Ivan Dobronravov
extract: Ivan Fyodorovich Dobronravov is a Russian actor best known for his lead role in the 2003 film The Return. His father is actor Fyodor Dobronravov.
extract_id: Ivan Fyodorovich Dobronravov adalah aktor Rusia yang paling dikenal karena peran utama dalam film tahun 2003 The Return. Ayahnya adalah aktor Fyodor Dobronravov.

name: Ivan Lapikov
title: Ivan Lapikov
extract: Ivan Gerasimovich Lapikov was a Soviet and Russian actor and People's Artist of the USSR for the year 1982.
extract_id: Ivan Gerasimovich Lapikov adalah aktor Soviet dan Rusia serta Artis Rakyat Uni Soviet pada tahun 1982.

name: Ivan Reitman
title: Ivan Reitman
extract: Ivan Reitman was a Canadian film director and producer. He was known for his comedy films, especially in the 1980s and 1990s. Reitman was the owner of The Montecito Picture Company, founded in 1998.
extract_id: Ivan Reitman adalah sutradara dan produser film Kanada. Dia dikenal karena film-film komedinya, terutama pada tahun 1980-an dan 1990-an. Reitman adalah pemilik The Montecito Picture Company, yang didirikan pada tahun 1998.

name: Ivana Baquero
title: Ivana Baquero
extract: Ivana Baquero Macías is a Spanish actress. At the age of 11, she was chosen to star as Ofelia in Pan's Labyrinth, for which she won critical acclaim and the Goya Award for Best New Actress. In 2015, she was cast as Eretria in the television series The Shannara Chronicles.
extract_id: Ivana Baquero Macías adalah seorang aktris Spanyol. Pada usia 11 tahun, dia dipilih untuk berperan sebagai Ofelia dalam Pan's Labyrinth, yang membawanya mendapatkan pujian kritis dan Penghargaan Goya untuk Aktris Pendatang Baru Terbaik. Pada tahun 2015, dia berperan sebagai Eretria dalam serial televisi The Shannara Chronicles.

name: Izabela Vidovic
title: Izabela Vidovic
extract: Izabela Vidovic is an American actress. She began as a child actress, and is known for her roles in the films Homefront and Wonder, and for her recurring role as Taylor Shaw in the Freeform television series The Fosters.
extract_id: Izabela Vidovic adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia memulai karier sebagai aktris cilik, dan dikenal karena perannya dalam film Homefront dan Wonder, serta peran berulangnya sebagai Taylor Shaw dalam serial televisi Freeform The Fosters.

name: J. Lee Thompson
title: J. Lee Thompson
extract: John Lee Thompson was an English film director, screenwriter, producer and playwright. Initially an exponent of social realism, he became known as a versatile and prolific director of thrillers, action, and adventure films.
extract_id: John Lee Thompson adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, produser, dan penulis drama Inggris. Awalnya sebagai pendukung realisme sosial, dia menjadi dikenal sebagai sutradara serba bisa dan produktif untuk film thriller, aksi, dan petualangan.

name: J. Mackye Gruber
title: J. Mackye Gruber
extract: Jonathan Gruber, more commonly known as J. Mackye Gruber, is an American screenwriter and film director, best known for co-writing Final Destination 2 and co-writing and co-directing The Butterfly Effect.
extract_id: Jonathan Gruber, yang lebih dikenal sebagai J. Mackye Gruber, adalah penulis skenario dan sutradara film Amerika, terkenal karena menulis bersama Final Destination 2 dan menulis serta menyutradarai bersama The Butterfly Effect.

name: J.D. Cannon
title: J. D. Cannon
extract: John Donovan Cannon was an American actor. An alumnus of the American Academy of Dramatic Arts in New York City, he is best known for his co-starring role of Chief of Detectives Peter B. Clifford in the television series McCloud with Dennis Weaver from 1970 until 1977, and for his part as the witness Lloyd Chandler who cleared Dr. Richard Kimble in "The Judgment", the series finale of The Fugitive.
extract_id: John Donovan Cannon adalah aktor Amerika. Alumni American Academy of Dramatic Arts di New York City, ia paling dikenal karena peran utama bersama sebagai Chief of Detectives Peter B. Clifford dalam serial televisi McCloud bersama Dennis Weaver dari tahun 1970 sampai 1977, dan perannya sebagai saksi Lloyd Chandler yang membersihkan Dr. Richard Kimble dalam “The Judgment”, episode terakhir serial The Fugitive.

name: J.J. Abrams
title: J. J. Abrams
extract: Jeffrey Jacob Abrams is an American filmmaker. He is best known for his work in the genres of action, drama, and science fiction. Abrams wrote and produced films such as Regarding Henry (1991), Forever Young (1992), Armageddon (1998), Cloverfield (2008), Star Trek (2009), Super 8 (2011), and the Star Wars sequels The Force Awakens (2015) and The Rise of Skywalker (2019). Abrams's films have grossed more than $4 billion.
extract_id: Jeffrey Jacob Abrams adalah pembuat film Amerika. Dia paling dikenal untuk karyanya dalam genre aksi, drama, dan fiksi ilmiah. Abrams menulis dan memproduksi film seperti Regarding Henry (1991), Forever Young (1992), Armageddon (1998), Cloverfield (2008), Star Trek (2009), Super 8 (2011), serta sekuel Star Wars The Force Awakens (2015) dan The Rise of Skywalker (2019). Film-film Abrams telah menghasilkan lebih dari $4 miliar.

name: J.K. Simmons
title: J. K. Simmons
extract: Jonathan Kimble Simmons is an American actor. Considered among the most established and enduring character actors of his generation, he has amassed over 200 screen and stage credits since his 1986 debut. He won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for playing Terence Fletcher, an abusive jazz instructor, in Damien Chazelle's Whiplash (2014), and received a second nomination for portraying William Frawley in Aaron Sorkin's Being the Ricardos (2021). His other various accolades include a British Academy Film Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a Screen Actors Guild Award.
extract_id: Jonathan Kimble Simmons adalah aktor Amerika. Dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor karakter paling mapan dan bertahan lama dari generasinya, ia telah mengumpulkan lebih dari 200 kredit layar dan panggung sejak debutnya pada tahun 1986. Ia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik sebagai Terence Fletcher, seorang instruktur jazz yang kasar, dalam Whiplash karya Damien Chazelle (2014), dan menerima nominasi kedua untuk memerankan William Frawley dalam Being the Ricardos karya Aaron Sorkin (2021). Penghargaan lainnya termasuk British Academy Film Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Screen Actors Guild Award.

name: J.T. Walsh
title: J. T. Walsh
extract: James Thomas Patrick Walsh was an American character actor. He starred in many films of the 1980s and 1990s, which include Tin Men (1987), Good Morning, Vietnam (1987), A Few Good Men (1992), Hoffa (1992), Nixon (1995), Sling Blade (1996), Breakdown (1997) and Pleasantville (1998).
extract_id: James Thomas Patrick Walsh adalah aktor karakter Amerika. Dia membintangi banyak film pada tahun 1980-an dan 1990-an, termasuk Tin Men (1987), Good Morning, Vietnam (1987), A Few Good Men (1992), Hoffa (1992), Nixon (1995), Sling Blade (1996), Breakdown (1997) dan Pleasantville (1998).

name: JB Blanc
title: JB Blanc
extract: Jean-Benoît "JB" Blanc is a French actor who has worked on animations and video games in Los Angeles, coming from a drama education at the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art and with an extensive background in British theatre. He is most recognised for his recurring role on Breaking Bad and its spinoff, Better Call Saul as Gus Fring's Mexican cartel doctor, nicknamed unofficially "Dr. Barry Goodman", as well as for lending his voice to Caustic in the long-running video game franchise, Apex Legends and Vander/Warwick in the highly-acclaimed Netflix animated series, Arcane where both the production team and cast have garnered positive attention.
extract_id: Jean-Benoît "JB" Blanc adalah aktor Prancis yang bekerja di animasi dan permainan video di Los Angeles, berasal dari pendidikan drama di Royal Academy of Dramatic Art dan dengan latar belakang teater Inggris yang luas. Dia paling dikenal untuk peran berulangnya dalam Breaking Bad dan spin-off-nya, Better Call Saul sebagai dokter kartel Meksiko Gus Fring, yang secara tidak resmi dijuluki "Dr. Barry Goodman", serta memberikan suara untuk Caustic dalam franchise permainan video jangka panjang Apex Legends dan Vander/Warwick dalam serial animasi Netflix yang sangat dihargai, Arcane, di mana tim produksi dan pemeran mendapatkan perhatian positif.

name: Jack Albertson
title: Jack Albertson
extract: Harold "Jack" Albertson was an American actor, comedian, dancer and singer who also performed in vaudeville. Albertson was a Tony, Oscar, and Emmy winning actor, which ranks him among a rare stature of 24 actors who have been awarded the "Triple Crown of Acting".
extract_id: Harold "Jack" Albertson adalah aktor, komedian, penari, dan penyanyi Amerika yang juga tampil di vaudeville. Albertson adalah aktor pemenang Tony, Oscar, dan Emmy, yang menempatkannya di antara 24 aktor langka yang meraih "Triple Crown of Acting".

name: Jack Benny
title: Jack Benny
extract: Jack Benny was an American entertainer who evolved from a modest success as a violinist on the vaudeville circuit to one of the leading entertainers of the twentieth century with a highly popular comedic career in radio, television, and film.
extract_id: Jack Benny adalah seorang penghibur Amerika yang berkembang dari keberhasilan sederhana sebagai pemain biola di sirkuit vaudeville menjadi salah satu penghibur terkemuka abad kedua puluh dengan karier komedi yang sangat populer di radio, televisi, dan film.

name: Jack Carson
title: Jack Carson
extract: John Elmer Carson, known as Jack Carson, was a Canadian-born American film actor. Carson often played the role of comedic friend in films of the 1940s and 1950s, including The Strawberry Blonde (1941) with James Cagney and Arsenic and Old Lace (1944) with Cary Grant. He appeared in such dramas as Mildred Pierce (1945), A Star Is Born (1954), and Cat on a Hot Tin Roof (1958). He worked for RKO and MGM, but most of his notable work was for Warner Bros.
extract_id: John Elmer Carson, dikenal sebagai Jack Carson, adalah aktor film kelahiran Kanada yang menjadi warga Amerika. Carson sering memerankan peran teman komedi dalam film tahun 1940-an dan 1950-an, termasuk The Strawberry Blonde (1941) bersama James Cagney dan Arsenic and Old Lace (1944) bersama Cary Grant. Dia tampil dalam drama seperti Mildred Pierce (1945), A Star Is Born (1954), dan Cat on a Hot Tin Roof (1958). Dia bekerja untuk RKO dan MGM, tetapi sebagian besar karya terkenalnya adalah untuk Warner Bros.

name: Jack Clayton
title: Jack Clayton
extract: Jack Isaac Clayton was an English film director and producer, known for his skill directing literary adaptations. He was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Director for his feature-length debut, Room at the Top (1959), and three of his films were nominated for the Palme d'Or.
extract_id: Jack Isaac Clayton adalah sutradara dan produser film Inggris, dikenal karena keahliannya mengarahkan adaptasi sastra. Dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik untuk debut panjang fitur filmnya, Room at the Top (1959), dan tiga filmnya dinominasikan untuk Palme d'Or.

name: Jack Hawkins
title: Jack Hawkins
extract: John Edward Hawkins was an English actor, who worked on stage and in film from the 1930s until the 1970s. He was known for his portrayal of military men, said to "endow the countless figures of authority he played with a formidable screen presence." One of the most popular British film stars of the 1950s, he was nominated for four BAFTA Awards for Best British Actor.
extract_id: John Edward Hawkins adalah aktor Inggris, yang bekerja di panggung dan film dari tahun 1930-an hingga 1970-an. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai tentara, yang dikatakan "memberikan wibawa layar yang mengesankan pada banyak figur otoritas yang diperankannya." Salah satu bintang film Inggris paling populer pada tahun 1950-an, ia dinominasikan untuk empat BAFTA Awards untuk Aktor Inggris Terbaik.

name: Jack Kehoe
title: Jack Kehoe
extract: Jack Kehoe was an American film actor appearing in a wide variety of films, including the crime dramas Serpico (1973), The Sting (1973), The Pope of Greenwich Village (1984) and Brian De Palma's The Untouchables (1987), as well as the cult favorites The Friends of Eddie Coyle (1973), Car Wash (1976) and Midnight Run (1988), the popular Western Young Guns II (1990), and On the Nickel (1980).
extract_id: Jack Kehoe adalah aktor film Amerika yang muncul dalam berbagai macam film, termasuk drama kriminal Serpico (1973), The Sting (1973), The Pope of Greenwich Village (1984), dan The Untouchables karya Brian De Palma (1987), serta film kultus The Friends of Eddie Coyle (1973), Car Wash (1976), dan Midnight Run (1988), Western populer Young Guns II (1990), dan On the Nickel (1980).

name: Jack Lemmon
title: Jack Lemmon
extract: John Uhler Lemmon III was an American actor. Considered proficient in both dramatic and comic roles, he was known for his anxious, middle-class everyman screen persona in comedy-drama films. He received numerous accolades including two Academy Awards, five Golden Globe Awards, three BAFTA Awards, two Primetime Emmy Awards and one Volpi Cup. He also received the AFI Life Achievement Award in 1988, the Cecil B. DeMille Award in 1991, and the Kennedy Center Honors in 1996. The Guardian labeled him as "the most successful tragi-comedian of his age".
extract_id: John Uhler Lemmon III adalah aktor Amerika. Dianggap mahir dalam peran dramatis dan komik, dia dikenal dengan persona layar setiap pria kelas menengah yang cemas dalam film komedi-drama. Dia menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk dua Academy Awards, lima Golden Globe Awards, tiga BAFTA Awards, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan satu Volpi Cup. Dia juga menerima AFI Life Achievement Award pada 1988, Cecil B. DeMille Award pada 1991, dan Kennedy Center Honors pada 1996. The Guardian menyebutnya sebagai "tragikomedi paling sukses di zamannya."

name: Jack McBrayer
title: Jack McBrayer
extract: Jack McBrayer is an American actor and comedian. He gained national exposure for his portrayal of Kenneth Parcell in 30 Rock. For his role in 30 Rock, McBrayer was nominated for Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series at the 61st Primetime Emmy Awards. He voiced characters such as Fix-It Felix Jr. in the 2012 film Wreck-It Ralph and its 2018 sequel, as well as the title character in the Disney XD series Wander Over Yonder. He has had recurring roles on Phineas and Ferb, Puppy Dog Pals, Amphibia, The Middle, Star Trek: Lower Decks, and the Netflix series Big Mouth.
extract_id: Jack McBrayer adalah aktor dan komedian Amerika. Dia mendapatkan eksposur nasional karena perannya sebagai Kenneth Parcell dalam 30 Rock. Untuk perannya di 30 Rock, McBrayer dinominasikan untuk Primetime Emmy Award sebagai Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam Seri Komedi pada Primetime Emmy Awards ke-61. Dia mengisi suara karakter seperti Fix-It Felix Jr. dalam film 2012 Wreck-It Ralph dan sekuelnya tahun 2018, serta karakter utama dalam seri Disney XD Wander Over Yonder. Dia memiliki peran berulang di Phineas and Ferb, Puppy Dog Pals, Amphibia, The Middle, Star Trek: Lower Decks, dan serial Netflix Big Mouth.

name: Jack Nicholson
title: Jack Nicholson
extract: John Joseph Nicholson is an American retired actor and filmmaker. Nicholson is widely regarded as one of the greatest actors of the 20th century, often playing charismatic rebels fighting against the social structure. Over his five-decade-long career, he received numerous accolades, including three Academy Awards, three BAFTAs, six Golden Globe Awards, and a Grammy Award.
extract_id: John Joseph Nicholson adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika yang sudah pensiun. Nicholson dianggap secara luas sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar abad ke-20, sering memerankan pemberontak karismatik yang berjuang melawan struktur sosial. Sepanjang kariernya yang berlangsung lima dekade, ia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk tiga Academy Awards, tiga BAFTA, enam Golden Globe Awards, dan satu Grammy Award.

name: Jack Oakie
title: Jack Oakie
extract: Jack Oakie was an American actor, starring mostly in films, but also working on stage, radio and television. He portrayed Napaloni in Chaplin's The Great Dictator (1940), receiving a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor.
extract_id: Jack Oakie adalah aktor Amerika, yang sebagian besar membintangi film, tetapi juga bekerja di panggung, radio, dan televisi. Dia memerankan Napaloni dalam The Great Dictator karya Chaplin (1940), menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Jack Reynor
title: Jack Reynor
extract: Jack Reynor is an American-born Irish actor. He won the IFTA Award for Best Lead Actor – Film for his performance in What Richard Did (2012), and Best Supporting Actor for Sing Street (2016). His other notable films include Transformers: Age of Extinction (2014), Glassland (2014), Macbeth (2015), Midsommar (2019) and Lee Cronin's The Mummy (2026), as well as the television series Strange Angel (2018–19) and The Peripheral (2022).
extract_id: Jack Reynor adalah aktor Irlandia kelahiran Amerika. Dia memenangkan IFTA Award untuk Aktor Utama Terbaik – Film untuk penampilannya dalam What Richard Did (2012), dan Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk Sing Street (2016). Film penting lainnya termasuk Transformers: Age of Extinction (2014), Glassland (2014), Macbeth (2015), Midsommar (2019) dan The Mummy karya Lee Cronin (2026), serta serial televisi Strange Angel (2018–19) dan The Peripheral (2022).

name: Jack Thibeau
title: Jack Thibeau
extract: Jack Thibeau is an American former film and television actor best known for playing the prisoner Clarence Anglin in the 1979 film Escape from Alcatraz. During his career, he frequently appeared in other movies, such as Any Which Way You Can (1980), Sudden Impact (1983), and City Heat (1984).
extract_id: Jack Thibeau adalah mantan aktor film dan televisi Amerika yang paling dikenal karena memerankan tahanan Clarence Anglin dalam film Escape from Alcatraz tahun 1979. Selama kariernya, dia sering muncul di film lain, seperti Any Which Way You Can (1980), Sudden Impact (1983), dan City Heat (1984).

name: Jack Warden
title: Jack Warden
extract: Jack Warden was an American actor who worked in film and television. He was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for Shampoo (1975) and Heaven Can Wait (1978). He received a BAFTA nomination for Shampoo, and won a Primetime Emmy Award for his performance in Brian's Song (1971).
extract_id: Jack Warden adalah seorang aktor Amerika yang bekerja di film dan televisi. Dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk Shampoo (1975) dan Heaven Can Wait (1978). Dia menerima nominasi BAFTA untuk Shampoo, dan memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award untuk penampilannya dalam Brian's Song (1971).

name: Jacki Weaver
title: Jacki Weaver
extract: Jacqueline Ruth Weaver is an Australian theatre, film, and television actress. She emerged in the 1970s during the Australian New Wave through her work in Ozploitation films such as Stork (1971), Alvin Purple (1973), and Petersen (1974). She later starred in Picnic at Hanging Rock (1975), Caddie (1976), Squizzy Taylor (1982), and a number of television films and miniseries. She also starred in Australian productions of plays such as Death of a Salesman and A Streetcar Named Desire.
extract_id: Jacqueline Ruth Weaver adalah seorang aktris teater, film, dan televisi asal Australia. Dia muncul pada tahun 1970-an selama Australian New Wave melalui karyanya di film Ozploitation seperti Stork (1971), Alvin Purple (1973), dan Petersen (1974). Dia kemudian membintangi Picnic at Hanging Rock (1975), Caddie (1976), Squizzy Taylor (1982), dan sejumlah film televisi serta miniseri. Dia juga membintangi produksi Australia dari drama seperti Death of a Salesman dan A Streetcar Named Desire.

name: Jackie Coogan
title: Jackie Coogan
extract: John Leslie Coogan was an American actor and comedian who began his film career as a child actor in silent films. Coogan's title role in Charlie Chaplin's film The Kid (1921) made him one of the first child stars in the history of Hollywood.
extract_id: John Leslie Coogan adalah seorang aktor dan komedian Amerika yang memulai karier filmnya sebagai aktor cilik di film bisu. Peran judul Coogan dalam film Charlie Chaplin The Kid (1921) menjadikannya salah satu bintang cilik pertama dalam sejarah Hollywood.

name: Jackie Earle Haley
title: Jackie Earle Haley
extract: Jack Earle Haley is an American actor. His earliest roles included Moocher in Breaking Away (1979) and Kelly Leak in The Bad News Bears (1976), The Bad News Bears in Breaking Training (1977) and The Bad News Bears Go to Japan (1978). After spending many years as a producer and director of television commercials, he revived his acting career with a supporting role in All the King's Men (2006). This was followed by his performance in Little Children (2006), for which he was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor.
extract_id: Jack Earle Haley adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Peran-peran awalnya termasuk Moocher dalam Breaking Away (1979) dan Kelly Leak dalam The Bad News Bears (1976), The Bad News Bears in Breaking Training (1977), dan The Bad News Bears Go to Japan (1978). Setelah menghabiskan bertahun-tahun sebagai produser dan sutradara iklan televisi, dia menghidupkan kembali karier aktingnya dengan peran pendukung dalam All the King's Men (2006). Ini diikuti oleh penampilannya dalam Little Children (2006), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Jackie Gleason
title: Jackie Gleason
extract: Herbert John Gleason, known as Jackie Gleason, was an American comedian, actor, writer, and composer also known as "The Great One".
extract_id: Herbert John Gleason, yang dikenal sebagai Jackie Gleason, adalah seorang komedian, aktor, penulis, dan komponis Amerika yang juga dikenal sebagai "The Great One".

name: Jaco Van Dormael
title: Jaco Van Dormael
extract: Jaco Van Dormael is a Belgian film director, screenwriter and playwright. Regarded as one of the most distinctive voices in contemporary European cinema, he is known for his narrative experimentation, blending elements of realism and fantasy while exploring the human condition.
extract_id: Jaco Van Dormael adalah seorang sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan penulis drama Belgia. Dianggap sebagai salah satu suara paling khas dalam sinema kontemporer Eropa, dia dikenal dengan eksperimen narasinya, menggabungkan elemen realisme dan fantasi sambil mengeksplorasi kondisi manusia.

name: Jacob Tremblay
title: Jacob Tremblay
extract: Jacob Tremblay is a Canadian actor. Beginning his career as a child actor in the 2010s, he expanded to voice acting in mainstream animated media and mature roles in independent films.
extract_id: Jacob Tremblay adalah seorang aktor Kanada. Memulai kariernya sebagai aktor cilik pada 2010-an, dia memperluas ke pengisi suara di media animasi utama dan peran dewasa di film independen.

name: Jacqueline Andere
title: Jacqueline Andere
extract: María Esperanza Jacqueline Andere Aguilar is a Mexican actress.
extract_id: María Esperanza Jacqueline Andere Aguilar adalah seorang aktris Meksiko.

name: Jacques Audiard
title: Jacques Audiard
extract: Jacques Audiard is a French filmmaker. One of the most awarded auteurs in history of French cinema, his international accolades include an Academy Award, three BAFTAs, and three Golden Globes. He holds the record for most individual wins in the history of the César Awards, France's national film awards, with thirteen wins between 1995 and 2025 including three separate Best Film/Best Director/Best Screenplay trifectas, and won four prizes from the Cannes Film Festival.
extract_id: Jacques Audiard adalah seorang pembuat film Prancis. Salah satu auteur paling banyak penghargaan dalam sejarah sinema Prancis, penghargaan internasionalnya termasuk Academy Award, tiga BAFTA, dan tiga Golden Globes. Dia memegang rekor kemenangan individu terbanyak dalam sejarah César Awards, penghargaan film nasional Prancis, dengan tiga belas kemenangan antara 1995 dan 2025 termasuk tiga laga terpisah Best Film/Best Director/Best Screenplay, dan memenangkan empat hadiah dari Festival Film Cannes.

name: Jacques Tourneur
title: Jacques Tourneur
extract: Jacques Tourneur was a French and American filmmaker, active during the Golden Age of Hollywood. He was known as an auteur of stylish and atmospheric genre films, many of them for RKO Pictures, including the supernatural horror films Cat People (1942), I Walked with a Zombie (1943) and The Leopard Man (1943), and the film noir Out of the Past (1947). He is also known for directing the war film Days of Glory (1944), which marked Gregory Peck's debut film role, and the British horror film Night of the Demon (1957), which was released by Columbia Pictures as Curse of the Demon.
extract_id: Jacques Tourneur adalah seorang pembuat film Prancis dan Amerika, aktif selama Zaman Keemasan Hollywood. Dia dikenal sebagai auteur film genre yang bergaya dan atmosferik, banyak di antaranya untuk RKO Pictures, termasuk film horor supernatural Cat People (1942), I Walked with a Zombie (1943) dan The Leopard Man (1943), serta film noir Out of the Past (1947). Dia juga dikenal mengarahkan film perang Days of Glory (1944), yang menandai peran debut film Gregory Peck, dan film horor Inggris Night of the Demon (1957), yang dirilis oleh Columbia Pictures sebagai Curse of the Demon.

name: Jacques Villeret
title: Jacques Villeret
extract: Jacques Villeret was a French actor, best known internationally for his role as François Pignon in the comedy Le Dîner de Cons. During his career, he earned many awards including the prestigious medal and title of Chevalier de la Légion d'Honneur.
extract_id: Jacques Villeret adalah seorang aktor Prancis, yang paling dikenal secara internasional untuk perannya sebagai François Pignon dalam komedi Le Dîner de Cons. Selama kariernya, dia memperoleh banyak penghargaan termasuk medali bergengsi dan gelar Chevalier de la Légion d'Honneur.

name: Jaden Smith
title: Jaden Smith
extract: Jaden Christopher Syre Smith is an American rapper, singer, songwriter, actor, and dancer. The son of Jada Pinkett-Smith and Will Smith, he made his film debut alongside his father in the 2006 film The Pursuit of Happyness, and appeared with his father once more in the film After Earth (2013). Smith also co-starred in the remake films The Day the Earth Stood Still (2008), alongside Keanu Reeves, and The Karate Kid (2010), with Jackie Chan. He is also known for his work in the two-part Netflix television series The Get Down (2016) and for voicing the character Kaz Kaan in the anime series, Neo Yokio.
extract_id: Jaden Christopher Syre Smith adalah seorang rapper, penyanyi, penulis lagu, aktor, dan penari Amerika. Putra dari Jada Pinkett-Smith dan Will Smith, dia membuat debut filmnya bersama ayahnya dalam film The Pursuit of Happyness (2006), dan muncul kembali dengan ayahnya dalam film After Earth (2013). Smith juga membintangi film remake The Day the Earth Stood Still (2008), bersama Keanu Reeves, dan The Karate Kid (2010), bersama Jackie Chan. Dia juga dikenal karena karyanya dalam serial televisi dua bagian Netflix The Get Down (2016) dan karena mengisi suara karakter Kaz Kaan dalam serial anime, Neo Yokio.

name: Jae Head
title: Jae Head
extract: Jae Head is an American actor. He is best known for portraying Sean Junior (S.J.) Tuohy, son of Sean and Leigh Anne Tuohy, in the 2009 film The Blind Side, directed by John Lee Hancock.
extract_id: Jae Head adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan Sean Junior (S.J.) Tuohy, putra Sean dan Leigh Anne Tuohy, dalam film The Blind Side (2009), yang disutradarai oleh John Lee Hancock.

name: Jae-young Kwak
title: Kwak Jae-yong
extract: Kwak Jae-yong is a South Korean film director and screenwriter. He studied physics at Kyung Hee University. He achieved success with his debut film Watercolor Painting in a Rainy Day in 1989, but the failure of his next two movies led to eight years of unemployment before a comeback with the smash-hit film My Sassy Girl in 2001. He is known for his fondness of love stories set in a mix of different genres.
extract_id: Kwak Jae-yong adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film Korea Selatan. Dia belajar fisika di Universitas Kyung Hee. Dia meraih kesuksesan dengan film debutnya Watercolor Painting in a Rainy Day pada 1989, tetapi kegagalan dua film berikutnya menyebabkan delapan tahun pengangguran sebelum comeback dengan film hit My Sassy Girl pada 2001. Dia dikenal karena kecintaannya pada cerita cinta yang berlatar campuran genre berbeda.

name: Jake Gyllenhaal
title: Jake Gyllenhaal
extract: Jacob Benjamin Gyllenhaal is an American actor. Known for his performances on screen and stage, he has received numerous accolades, including a BAFTA Award, as well as nominations for an Academy Award, three Golden Globe Awards, three Tony Awards, and a Primetime Emmy Award. Born into the Gyllenhaal family, he is the son of film director Stephen Gyllenhaal and screenwriter Naomi Foner, and the younger brother of actress Maggie Gyllenhaal.
extract_id: Jacob Benjamin Gyllenhaal adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal untuk penampilannya di layar dan panggung, dia telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk BAFTA Award, serta nominasi untuk Academy Award, tiga Golden Globe Awards, tiga Tony Awards, dan Primetime Emmy Award. Lahir dalam keluarga Gyllenhaal, dia adalah putra sutradara film Stephen Gyllenhaal dan penulis skenario Naomi Foner, serta adik aktor Maggie Gyllenhaal.

name: Jake Johnson
title: Jake Johnson
extract: Mark Jake Johnson Weinberger is an American actor. He starred as Nick Miller in the Fox sitcom New Girl (2011–2018), for which he was nominated for the Critics' Choice Television Award for Best Actor in a Comedy Series in 2013. He is also known for voicing Peter B. Parker/Spider-Man in the animated film Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse (2018) and its 2023 sequel.
extract_id: Mark Jake Johnson Weinberger adalah aktor Amerika. Dia membintangi sebagai Nick Miller dalam sitkom Fox New Girl (2011–2018), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Critics' Choice Television Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Seri Komedi pada 2013. Dia juga dikenal mengisi suara Peter B. Parker/Spider-Man dalam film animasi Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse (2018) dan sekuelnya tahun 2023.

name: James Algar
title: James Algar
extract: James Algar was an American film director, animator, screenwriter, and producer. He worked at Walt Disney Productions for 43 years and received the Disney Legends award in 1998. He was born in Modesto, California and died in Carmel, California.
extract_id: James Algar adalah seorang sutradara film, animator, penulis skenario, dan produser Amerika. Dia bekerja di Walt Disney Productions selama 43 tahun dan menerima penghargaan Disney Legends pada 1998. Dia lahir di Modesto, California dan meninggal di Carmel, California.

name: James Booth
title: James Booth
extract: James Booth was an English film, stage and television actor and screenwriter. He is best known for his role as Private Henry Hook in Zulu.
extract_id: James Booth adalah seorang aktor dan penulis skenario film, panggung, dan televisi Inggris. Dia paling dikenal untuk perannya sebagai Private Henry Hook dalam film Zulu.

name: James Caan
title: James Caan
extract: James Edmund Caan was an American actor. He came to prominence playing Sonny Corleone in The Godfather (1972), for which he was nominated for an Academy Award and Golden Globe for Best Supporting Actor. He received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 1978.
extract_id: James Edmund Caan adalah aktor Amerika. Dia terkenal karena perannya sebagai Sonny Corleone dalam The Godfather (1972), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award dan Golden Globe untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik. Dia menerima bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada 1978.

name: James Cagney
title: James Cagney
extract: James Francis Cagney Jr. was an American actor and dancer. On stage and in film, he was known for his consistently energetic performances, distinctive vocal style, and deadpan comic timing. He won acclaim and major awards for a wide variety of performances.
extract_id: James Francis Cagney Jr. adalah aktor dan penari Amerika. Di panggung dan film, dia dikenal karena penampilan yang penuh energi secara konsisten, gaya vokal yang khas, dan timing komedi yang deadpan. Dia mendapatkan pujian dan penghargaan besar untuk berbagai macam penampilan.

name: James Cameron
title: James Cameron
extract: James Francis Cameron is a Canadian and New Zealand filmmaker and explorer. His films combine cutting-edge film technology with classical filmmaking techniques and have grossed over $10 billion worldwide, making him the second highest-grossing film director of all time. A major figure in the post-New Hollywood era, Cameron has received numerous accolades including three Academy Awards, two Primetime Emmy Awards, and four Golden Globe Awards, as well as nominations for six British Academy Film Awards.
extract_id: James Francis Cameron adalah pembuat film dan penjelajah Kanada dan Selandia Baru. Film-filmnya menggabungkan teknologi film mutakhir dengan teknik produksi klasik dan telah menghasilkan lebih dari $10 miliar di seluruh dunia, menjadikannya sutradara film dengan pendapatan tertinggi kedua sepanjang masa. Sebagai figur utama dalam era pasca-New Hollywood, Cameron telah menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk tiga Academy Awards, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan empat Golden Globe Awards, serta nominasi untuk enam British Academy Film Awards.

name: James Coburn
title: James Coburn
extract: James Harrison Coburn III was an American actor who featured in more than 70 films, largely action roles, and made 100 television appearances during a 45-year career.
extract_id: James Harrison Coburn III adalah aktor Amerika yang membintangi lebih dari 70 film, kebanyakan dalam peran aksi, dan membuat 100 penampilan televisi selama kariernya yang berlangsung 45 tahun.

name: James Cromwell
title: James Cromwell
extract: James Oliver Cromwell is an American actor. He has received a Primetime Emmy Award as well as a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for Babe (1995). Other film roles include Star Trek: First Contact (1996), L.A. Confidential (1997), Deep Impact (1998), The Green Mile (1999), Space Cowboys (2000), I, Robot (2004), The Longest Yard (2005), The Queen (2006), Spider-Man 3 (2007), W. (2008), Secretariat (2010), The Artist (2011), Still Mine (2012), The Promise (2016), Marshall (2017), Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom (2018), and Emperor (2020). He has also voiced characters in several animated films and TV shows, including Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron (2002) and Big Hero 6 (2014).
extract_id: James Oliver Cromwell adalah aktor Amerika. Dia menerima Primetime Emmy Award serta nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk Babe (1995). Peran film lainnya termasuk Star Trek: First Contact (1996), L.A. Confidential (1997), Deep Impact (1998), The Green Mile (1999), Space Cowboys (2000), I, Robot (2004), The Longest Yard (2005), The Queen (2006), Spider-Man 3 (2007), W. (2008), Secretariat (2010), The Artist (2011), Still Mine (2012), The Promise (2016), Marshall (2017), Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom (2018), dan Emperor (2020). Dia juga mengisi suara karakter dalam beberapa film animasi dan acara TV, termasuk Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron (2002) dan Big Hero 6 (2014).

name: James Dean
title: James Dean
extract: James Byron Dean was an American actor. He became one of the most influential figures in Hollywood in the 1950s, and his impact on cinema and popular culture was profound, although his career lasted only five years. He appeared in just three major films: East of Eden (1955), which showcased his intense emotional range; Rebel Without a Cause (1955), in which he portrayed a disillusioned and rebellious teenager; and Giant (1956), a sprawling drama. These have been preserved in the United States National Film Registry by the Library of Congress for their "cultural, historical, or aesthetic significance". He was killed in a car accident in 1955 at the age of 24, leaving him a lasting symbol of rebellion, youthful defiance, and the restless spirit.
extract_id: James Byron Dean adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia menjadi salah satu figur paling berpengaruh di Hollywood pada 1950-an, dan dampaknya pada sinema dan budaya populer sangat besar, meskipun kariernya hanya berlangsung lima tahun. Dia hanya tampil dalam tiga film utama: East of Eden (1955), yang menampilkan rentang emosional intensnya; Rebel Without a Cause (1955), di mana dia memerankan remaja kecewa dan pemberontak; dan Giant (1956), sebuah drama luas.
