Film-film ini telah dilestarikan dalam United States National Film Registry oleh Library of Congress karena "signifikansi budaya, sejarah, atau estetika" mereka. Dia meninggal dalam kecelakaan mobil pada 1955 pada usia 24 tahun, menjadikannya simbol abadi pemberontakan, pembangkangan muda, dan semangat gelisah.

name: James Doohan
title: James Doohan
extract: James Montgomery Doohan was a Canadian actor, best known for his role as Montgomery "Scotty" Scott in the television and film series Star Trek. Doohan's characterization of the Scottish chief engineer of the Starship Enterprise has become one of the most recognizable elements in the Star Trek franchise, and inspired many fans to pursue careers in engineering and other technical fields. He also made contributions behind the scenes, such as the initial development of the Klingon and Vulcan constructed languages.
extract_id: James Montgomery Doohan adalah aktor Kanada, paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Montgomery "Scotty" Scott dalam seri televisi dan film Star Trek. Karakterisasi Doohan sebagai kepala teknisi Skotlandia dari Starship Enterprise telah menjadi salah satu elemen paling dikenal dalam franchise Star Trek, dan menginspirasi banyak penggemar untuk mengejar karier di bidang teknik dan bidang teknis lainnya. Dia juga memberikan kontribusi di balik layar, seperti pengembangan awal bahasa buatan Klingon dan Vulcan.

name: James Earl Jones
title: James Earl Jones
extract: James Earl Jones was an American actor. A pioneer for Black actors in the entertainment industry, he was acclaimed for his performances on stage and screen. Jones is one of the few performers to achieve the EGOT. He was inducted into the American Theater Hall of Fame in 1985 and was honored with the National Medal of Arts in 1992, the Kennedy Center Honor in 2002, the Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award in 2009, and the Academy Honorary Award in 2011.
extract_id: James Earl Jones adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Sebagai pelopor bagi aktor Kulit Hitam di industri hiburan, ia dipuji atas penampilannya di panggung dan layar. Jones adalah salah satu dari sedikit pemeran yang mencapai EGOT. Dia diangkat ke dalam American Theater Hall of Fame pada tahun 1985 dan dihormati dengan National Medal of Arts pada tahun 1992, Kennedy Center Honor pada tahun 2002, Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award pada tahun 2009, dan Academy Honorary Award pada tahun 2011.

name: James Fleet
title: James Fleet
extract: James Edward Fleet is a British actor of theatre, radio and screen. He is most famous for his roles as the bumbling and well-meaning Tom in the 1994 British romantic comedy film Four Weddings and a Funeral and the dim-witted but kind-hearted Hugo Horton in the BBC sitcom television series The Vicar of Dibley. Since 2020, he has played King George III in the Netflix series Bridgerton.
extract_id: James Edward Fleet adalah aktor Inggris di teater, radio, dan layar. Dia paling terkenal karena perannya sebagai Tom yang kikuk dan baik hati dalam film komedi romantis Inggris tahun 1994 Four Weddings and a Funeral dan Hugo Horton yang bodoh tetapi berhati baik dalam serial televisi sitkom BBC The Vicar of Dibley. Sejak 2020, dia memerankan Raja George III dalam seri Netflix Bridgerton.

name: James Foley
title: James Foley (director)
extract: James Foley was an American director of film, television and music videos. His notable works included At Close Range (1986), After Dark, My Sweet (1990), Glengarry Glen Ross (1992), Fear (1996), Fifty Shades Darker (2017), and Fifty Shades Freed (2018). He was a regular collaborator of Madonna during the 1980s, directing her in the film Who's That Girl (1987) and in several music videos.
extract_id: James Foley adalah sutradara film, televisi, dan video musik asal Amerika. Karya terkenalnya termasuk At Close Range (1986), After Dark, My Sweet (1990), Glengarry Glen Ross (1992), Fear (1996), Fifty Shades Darker (2017), dan Fifty Shades Freed (2018). Dia secara rutin bekerja sama dengan Madonna selama tahun 1980-an, menyutradarainya dalam film Who's That Girl (1987) dan dalam beberapa video musik.

name: James Frawley
title: James Frawley
extract: James Joseph Frawley was an American director and actor. He was a member of the Actors Studio since around 1961. He was best known for directing The Muppet Movie (1979), and The Monkees television series.
extract_id: James Joseph Frawley adalah sutradara dan aktor Amerika. Dia adalah anggota Actors Studio sejak sekitar tahun 1961. Dia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai The Muppet Movie (1979) dan serial televisi The Monkees.

name: James Garner
title: James Garner
extract: James Scott Garner was an American actor and producer of film and television. He was an Academy Award nominee, and won three Golden Globe Awards and two Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: James Scott Garner adalah aktor dan produser film dan televisi Amerika. Dia adalah nomine Academy Award, dan memenangkan tiga Golden Globe Awards serta dua Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: James Gleason
title: James Gleason
extract: James Austin Gleason was an American actor, playwright, and screenwriter born in New York City. Gleason often portrayed "tough-talking, world-weary guys with a secret heart-of-gold."
extract_id: James Austin Gleason adalah aktor, penulis drama, dan penulis naskah Amerika kelahiran New York City. Gleason sering memerankan "pria yang fasih bicara, lelah dengan dunia, namun memiliki hati emas yang tersembunyi."

name: James Gunn
title: James Gunn
extract: James Francis Gunn Jr. is an American filmmaker. He began his career as a screenwriter in the mid-1990s, starting at Troma Entertainment with Tromeo and Juliet (1996). He then began to work as a director, starting with the horror-comedy film Slither (2006), and moving to the superhero genre with Super (2010), Guardians of the Galaxy (2014), Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2 (2017), The Suicide Squad (2021), and Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 (2023).
extract_id: James Francis Gunn Jr. adalah pembuat film Amerika. Ia memulai kariernya sebagai penulis skenario pada pertengahan 1990-an, dimulai di Troma Entertainment dengan Tromeo and Juliet (1996). Kemudian ia mulai bekerja sebagai sutradara, diawali dengan film horor-komedi Slither (2006), dan beralih ke genre pahlawan super dengan Super (2010), Guardians of the Galaxy (2014), Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2 (2017), The Suicide Squad (2021), dan Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 (2023).

name: James Ivory
title: James Ivory
extract: James Francis Ivory is an American film director, screenwriter, and producer. He was a principal in Merchant Ivory Productions along with Indian film producer Ismail Merchant and screenwriter Ruth Prawer Jhabvala. The trio made film adaptations of stories by authors such as E.M. Forster and Henry James. Their body of work is celebrated for its elegance, sophistication, literary fidelity, strong performances, complex themes, and rich characters.
extract_id: James Francis Ivory adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser Amerika. Dia adalah tokoh utama di Merchant Ivory Productions bersama produser film India Ismail Merchant dan penulis skenario Ruth Prawer Jhabvala. Trio ini mengadaptasi cerita dari penulis seperti E.M. Forster dan Henry James. Karya mereka dirayakan karena keanggunan, kecanggihan, kesetiaan sastra, penampilan kuat, tema kompleks, dan karakter yang kaya.

name: James L. Brooks
title: James L. Brooks
extract: James Lawrence Brooks is an American filmmaker. He is the founder of Gracie Films and co-created the sitcoms The Mary Tyler Moore Show and Taxi, as well as co-developed The Simpsons. He also directed the films Terms of Endearment (1983), Broadcast News (1987), and As Good as It Gets (1997). In a career spanning six decades, Brooks received numerous accolades including three Academy Awards, 22 Emmy Awards, and a Golden Globe Award.
extract_id: James Lawrence Brooks adalah pembuat film Amerika. Dia adalah pendiri Gracie Films dan ikut menciptakan sitkom The Mary Tyler Moore Show dan Taxi, serta ikut mengembangkan The Simpsons. Dia juga menyutradarai film Terms of Endearment (1983), Broadcast News (1987), dan As Good as It Gets (1997). Dalam karier yang berlangsung selama enam dekade, Brooks menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk tiga Academy Awards, 22 Emmy Awards, dan satu Golden Globe Award.

name: James Laurenson
title: James Laurenson
description: New Zealand stage and screen actor (1940–2024)
extract: James Philip Laurenson was a New Zealand stage and screen actor based in the United Kingdom.
extract_id: James Philip Laurenson adalah aktor panggung dan layar asal Selandia Baru yang berbasis di Inggris.

name: James Mangold
title: James Mangold
extract: James Allen Mangold is an American filmmaker. Noted for his versatility in tackling a range of genres, Mangold made his debut as a film director with Heavy (1995), and gained recognition for the films Cop Land (1997), Girl, Interrupted (1999), Identity (2003), Walk the Line (2005), 3:10 to Yuma (2007), Knight and Day (2010), and two films in the X-Men franchise with The Wolverine (2013) and Logan (2017), the latter of which earned him a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Adapted Screenplay.
extract_id: James Allen Mangold adalah pembuat film Amerika. Dikenal karena kemampuannya menangani berbagai genre, Mangold memulai debutnya sebagai sutradara film dengan Heavy (1995), dan meraih pengakuan lewat film Cop Land (1997), Girl, Interrupted (1999), Identity (2003), Walk the Line (2005), 3:10 to Yuma (2007), Knight and Day (2010), serta dua film dalam waralaba X-Men dengan The Wolverine (2013) dan Logan (2017), yang terakhir memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Best Adapted Screenplay.

name: James Marsden
title: James Marsden
extract: James Paul Marsden is an American actor. His accolades include nominations for two Emmy Awards and one Golden Globe. He began his acting career guest starring on the television shows Saved by the Bell: The New Class (1993), Touched by an Angel (1995), and Party of Five (1995). Marsden gained fame for his portrayal of Cyclops in four films of the X-Men film series (2000–2014), and for his roles in the films The Notebook (2004), Superman Returns (2006), Hairspray (2007), Enchanted (2007), 27 Dresses (2008), Hop (2011), and Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues (2013). He portrayed John F. Kennedy in the drama film The Butler (2013), Tom Wachowski in the action-adventure comedy film series Sonic the Hedgehog (2020–present) and is set to reprise his role as Cyclops in the upcoming Marvel Cinematic Universe film Avengers: Doomsday (2026).
extract_id: James Paul Marsden adalah aktor Amerika. Prestasinya termasuk nominasi untuk dua Emmy Awards dan satu Golden Globe. Dia memulai karier aktingnya sebagai bintang tamu di acara televisi Saved by the Bell: The New Class (1993), Touched by an Angel (1995), dan Party of Five (1995). Marsden terkenal karena perannya sebagai Cyclops dalam empat film seri X-Men (2000–2014), serta perannya di film The Notebook (2004), Superman Returns (2006), Hairspray (2007), Enchanted (2007), 27 Dresses (2008), Hop (2011), dan Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues (2013). Dia memerankan John F. Kennedy dalam film drama The Butler (2013), Tom Wachowski dalam seri film komedi petualangan aksi Sonic the Hedgehog (2020–sekarang), dan dijadwalkan mengulang perannya sebagai Cyclops dalam film Marvel Cinematic Universe yang akan datang Avengers: Doomsday (2026).

name: James Marsh
title: James Marsh (director)
extract: James Marsh is a British film and documentary director best known for his work on Man on Wire, which won the 2008 Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature, and The Theory of Everything, the biopic of physicist Stephen Hawking released in 2014.
extract_id: James Marsh adalah sutradara film dan dokumenter Inggris yang paling dikenal atas karyanya pada Man on Wire, yang memenangkan Academy Award 2008 untuk Best Documentary Feature, dan The Theory of Everything, film biografi fisikawan Stephen Hawking yang dirilis tahun 2014.

name: James Mason
title: James Mason
extract: James Neville Mason was an English actor. He achieved considerable success in British cinema before becoming a star in Hollywood. He was nominated for three Academy Awards, three Golden Globes and two BAFTA Awards in his career.
extract_id: James Neville Mason adalah aktor Inggris. Dia meraih kesuksesan besar di perfilman Inggris sebelum menjadi bintang di Hollywood. Dalam kariernya, ia dinominasikan untuk tiga Academy Awards, tiga Golden Globes, dan dua BAFTA Awards.

name: James McAvoy
title: James McAvoy
extract: James McAvoy is a Scottish actor and director. He made his acting debut as a teen in The Near Room (1995) and appeared mostly on television until 2003, when his film career began. His television work includes the thriller State of Play (2003), the science fiction miniseries Frank Herbert's Children of Dune (2003), and the drama series Shameless (2004–2005).
extract_id: James McAvoy adalah aktor dan sutradara Skotlandia. Dia memulai debut aktingnya sebagai remaja dalam The Near Room (1995) dan sebagian besar berperan di televisi hingga 2003, ketika karier filmnya dimulai. Karya televisinya meliputi thriller State of Play (2003), miniseri fiksi ilmiah Frank Herbert's Children of Dune (2003), dan serial drama Shameless (2004–2005).

name: James McTeigue
title: James McTeigue
extract: James McTeigue is an Australian film and television director. He has been an assistant director on many films, including Dark City (1998), the Matrix trilogy (1999–2003) and Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones (2002), and made his directorial debut with the 2005 film V for Vendetta to critical acclaim. Since Vendetta he has collaborated with the Wachowskis an additional four times as director on The Invasion, Ninja Assassin and Sense8, and as producer of The Matrix Resurrections.
extract_id: James McTeigue adalah sutradara film dan televisi Australia. Dia pernah menjadi asisten sutradara pada banyak film, termasuk Dark City (1998), trilogi Matrix (1999–2003), dan Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones (2002), dan memulai debut penyutradaraannya dengan film V for Vendetta tahun 2005 yang mendapatkan pujian kritis. Sejak Vendetta, dia telah bekerja sama dengan Wachowskis tambahan empat kali sebagai sutradara dalam The Invasion, Ninja Assassin, dan Sense8, serta sebagai produser The Matrix Resurrections.

name: James Rebhorn
title: James Rebhorn
extract: James Robert Rebhorn was an American character actor. Rebhorn appeared in over 100 films, television series, and plays.
extract_id: James Robert Rebhorn adalah aktor karakter Amerika. Rebhorn tampil dalam lebih dari 100 film, serial televisi, dan drama panggung.

name: James Remar
title: James Remar
extract: William James Remar is an American actor. Highlights of his career in film include his portrayals of Ajax in The Warriors (1979), Albert Ganz in 48 Hrs. (1982), Dutch Schultz in The Cotton Club (1984), and Jack Duff in Miracle on 34th Street (1994). In television, he is best known for playing Richard Wright in Sex and the City (2001–2004), and Harry Morgan, the father of the title character, in Dexter (2006–2013) and Dexter: Resurrection (2025). Since 2009, he has done voice-over work in ads for Lexus luxury cars. Remar studied acting at the Neighborhood Playhouse School of the Theatre in New York City.
extract_id: William James Remar adalah aktor Amerika. Sorotan karier filmnya termasuk perannya sebagai Ajax dalam The Warriors (1979), Albert Ganz dalam 48 Hrs. (1982), Dutch Schultz dalam The Cotton Club (1984), dan Jack Duff dalam Miracle on 34th Street (1994). Di televisi, ia dikenal karena memerankan Richard Wright dalam Sex and the City (2001–2004), dan Harry Morgan, ayah dari karakter utama, dalam Dexter (2006–2013) dan Dexter: Resurrection (2025). Sejak 2009, ia melakukan pekerjaan sulih suara dalam iklan mobil mewah Lexus. Remar belajar akting di Neighborhood Playhouse School of the Theatre di New York City.

name: James Stewart
title: James Stewart
extract: James Maitland Stewart was an American actor and military aviator. Known for his distinctive drawl and everyman screen persona, Stewart appeared in 80 films from 1935 to 1991. His films are considered among the greatest of all time. In 1999, the American Film Institute (AFI) ranked him third on its list of the greatest American male actors; he received numerous honors including the AFI Life Achievement Award in 1980, the Kennedy Center Honor in 1983, as well as the Academy Honorary Award and Presidential Medal of Freedom, both in 1985.
extract_id: James Maitland Stewart adalah aktor dan pilot militer Amerika. Dikenal karena suara khasnya dan persona pria biasa di layar, Stewart tampil dalam 80 film dari tahun 1935 hingga 1991. Film-filmnya dianggap sebagai salah satu yang terbaik sepanjang masa. Pada tahun 1999, American Film Institute (AFI) menempatkannya di posisi ketiga dalam daftar aktor pria Amerika terhebat; ia menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk AFI Life Achievement Award pada tahun 1980, Kennedy Center Honor pada tahun 1983, serta Academy Honorary Award dan Presidential Medal of Freedom, keduanya pada tahun 1985.

name: James Wan
title: James Wan
extract: James Wan is a Malaysian-born Australian filmmaker. He has primarily worked in the horror genre as the co-creator of the Saw and Insidious franchises and the creator of The Conjuring Universe, the highest-grossing horror franchise at over $2.9 billion. Wan is also the founder of film and television production company Atomic Monster.
extract_id: James Wan adalah pembuat film kelahiran Malaysia yang kini berkewarganegaraan Australia. Ia sebagian besar bekerja dalam genre horor sebagai pencipta bersama waralaba Saw dan Insidious serta pencipta The Conjuring Universe, waralaba horor dengan pendapatan tertinggi lebih dari $2,9 miliar. Wan juga adalah pendiri perusahaan produksi film dan televisi Atomic Monster.

name: James Whale
title: James Whale
extract: James Whale was an English film director, theatre director and actor, who spent the greater part of his career in Hollywood. He is best remembered for several horror films: Frankenstein (1931), The Old Dark House (1932), The Invisible Man (1933) and Bride of Frankenstein (1935), all considered classics. Whale also directed films in other genres, including the 1936 film version of the musical Show Boat.
extract_id: James Whale adalah sutradara film, sutradara teater, dan aktor Inggris, yang menghabiskan sebagian besar kariernya di Hollywood. Ia paling diingat melalui beberapa film horor: Frankenstein (1931), The Old Dark House (1932), The Invisible Man (1933), dan Bride of Frankenstein (1935), yang semuanya dianggap klasik. Whale juga menyutradarai film dari genre lain, termasuk versi film musikal Show Boat tahun 1936.

name: James Woods
title: James Woods
extract: James Howard Woods is an American actor. Known for fast-talking, intense roles on screen and stage, he has received numerous accolades, including three Emmy Awards and a Golden Globe Award, as well as nominations for two Academy Awards and three Actor Awards. Woods made his Broadway debut in the Elliott Baker play The Penny Wars (1969). His early films roles include The Visitors (1972), The Way We Were (1973) and The Gambler (1974), before starring with Meryl Streep in the NBC miniseries Holocaust (1978).
extract_id: James Howard Woods adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal karena peran-peran dialog cepat dan intens di layar dan panggung, ia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk tiga Emmy Awards dan satu Golden Globe Award, serta nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards dan tiga Actor Awards. Woods memulai debut Broadway-nya dalam drama Elliott Baker berjudul The Penny Wars (1969). Peran film awalnya meliputi The Visitors (1972), The Way We Were (1973), dan The Gambler (1974), sebelum membintangi bersama Meryl Streep dalam miniseri NBC Holocaust (1978).

name: Jamie Bell
title: Jamie Bell
extract: Andrew James Matfin Bell is an English actor. He rose to prominence with his debut performance in Billy Elliot (2000), for which he won the BAFTA Award for Best Actor, becoming the youngest-ever winner in the category. He is also known for his portrayals of Tintin in The Adventures of Tintin (2011) and Ben Grimm/The Thing in Fantastic Four (2015).
extract_id: Andrew James Matfin Bell adalah aktor Inggris. Ia meraih ketenaran melalui penampilan debutnya dalam Billy Elliot (2000), yang membuatnya memenangkan BAFTA Award untuk Aktor Terbaik, menjadi pemenang termuda dalam kategori tersebut. Ia juga dikenal karena perannya sebagai Tintin dalam The Adventures of Tintin (2011) dan Ben Grimm/The Thing dalam Fantastic Four (2015).

name: Jamie Chung
title: Jamie Chung
extract: Jamie Jilynn Chung is an American actress and former reality television personality. She began her career in 2004 as a cast member on the MTV reality series The Real World: San Diego and subsequently through her appearances on its spin-off series, Real World/Road Rules Challenge: The Inferno II.
extract_id: Jamie Jilynn Chung adalah aktris Amerika dan mantan pribadi televisi realitas. Ia memulai kariernya pada tahun 2004 sebagai anggota pemeran dalam seri realitas MTV The Real World: San Diego dan kemudian melalui penampilannya dalam serial spin-off Real World/Road Rules Challenge: The Inferno II.

name: Jamie Foxx
title: Jamie Foxx
extract: Jamie Foxx, is an American actor, comedian, singer, and film producer. He gained his career breakthrough as a featured player in the sketch comedy show In Living Color from 1991 to 1994. Following this success, he was given his own sitcom, The Jamie Foxx Show, in which he starred, co-created and produced from 1996 to 2001.
extract_id: Jamie Foxx adalah aktor, komedian, penyanyi, dan produser film Amerika. Ia meraih terobosan karier sebagai pemain unggulan dalam acara komedi sketsa In Living Color dari 1991 hingga 1994. Setelah kesuksesan ini, ia diberi sitkom sendiri, The Jamie Foxx Show, di mana ia membintangi, ikut menciptakan, dan memproduksi dari 1996 hingga 2001.

name: Jamie Lee Curtis
title: Jamie Lee Curtis
extract: Jamie Lee Curtis is an American actress, producer, and children's author. Known for her performances in the horror and slasher genres, alongside multiple comedies, she is regarded as a "scream queen". As of 2023, her films have grossed over $2.5 billion at the box office. Curtis has received numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, two Golden Globes, and two Actor Awards, as well as a nomination for a Grammy Award.
extract_id: Jamie Lee Curtis adalah seorang aktris, produser, dan penulis buku anak-anak Amerika. Dikenal karena penampilannya dalam genre horor dan slasher, serta beberapa komedi, dia dianggap sebagai "ratu teriakan". Hingga tahun 2023, film-filmnya telah menghasilkan lebih dari $2,5 miliar di box office. Curtis telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dua Golden Globes, dan dua Actor Awards, serta nominasi untuk Grammy Award.

name: Jan Cornet
title: Jan Cornet
extract: Jan Cornet Galí is a Spanish actor.
extract_id: Jan Cornet Galí adalah seorang aktor Spanyol.

name: Jan Josef Liefers
title: Jan Josef Liefers
description: German actor, producer, director and musician
extract: Jan Josef Liefers is a German actor, producer, director and musician.
extract_id: Jan Josef Liefers adalah seorang aktor, produser, sutradara, dan musisi Jerman.

name: Jan Pinkava
title: Jan Pinkava
extract: Jan Jaroslav Pinkava is a Czech-British-American producer, director, writer, and animator. He directed the Pixar short film Geri's Game and served as co-director and co-wrote the story for Ratatouille, both of which went on to win Oscars.
extract_id: Jan Jaroslav Pinkava adalah produser, sutradara, penulis, dan animator Ceko-Britania-Amerika. Dia menyutradarai film pendek Pixar Geri's Game dan menjadi co-director serta ikut menulis cerita untuk Ratatouille, keduanya memenangkan Oscar.

name: Jan Sterling
title: Jan Sterling
extract: Jan Sterling was an American film, television and stage actress. At her most active in films during the 1950s, Sterling received a Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress for her performance in The High and the Mighty (1954) as well as an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress nomination. Her best performance is often considered to be opposite Kirk Douglas, as the opportunistic wife in Billy Wilder's 1951 Ace in the Hole. Although her career declined during the 1960s, she continued to play occasional television and theatre roles.
extract_id: Jan Sterling adalah seorang aktris film, televisi, dan panggung Amerika. Pada masa aktifnya di film selama tahun 1950-an, Sterling menerima Golden Globe Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam The High and the Mighty (1954) serta nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik. Penampilannya yang terbaik sering dianggap saat berperan berlawanan dengan Kirk Douglas, sebagai istri oportunis dalam film Ace in the Hole karya Billy Wilder tahun 1951. Meskipun kariernya menurun pada 1960-an, ia terus memainkan peran sesekali di televisi dan teater.

name: Jane Adams
title: Jane Adams (actress, born 1965)
extract: Jane Adams is an American actress and screenwriter. Known for her work in independent cinema, her acting credits include Light Sleeper (1992), Happiness (1998), Mumford (1999), Songcatcher (2000), The Anniversary Party (2001), Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind (2004), Little Children (2006), All the Light in the Sky (2012), and She Dies Tomorrow (2020).
extract_id: Jane Adams adalah seorang aktris dan penulis skenario Amerika. Dikenal karena karyanya dalam sinema independen, kredit aktingnya termasuk Light Sleeper (1992), Happiness (1998), Mumford (1999), Songcatcher (2000), The Anniversary Party (2001), Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind (2004), Little Children (2006), All the Light in the Sky (2012), dan She Dies Tomorrow (2020).

name: Jane Alexander
title: Jane Alexander
extract: Jane Alexander is an American-Canadian actress and author. She is the recipient of two Primetime Emmy Awards, a Tony Award, and nominations for four Academy Awards, and three Golden Globe Awards. From 1993 to 1997, Alexander served as the chairwoman of the National Endowment for the Arts.
extract_id: Jane Alexander adalah seorang aktris dan penulis Amerika-Kanada. Dia menerima dua Primetime Emmy Awards, satu Tony Award, dan nominasi untuk empat Academy Awards serta tiga Golden Globe Awards. Dari tahun 1993 hingga 1997, Alexander menjabat sebagai ketua National Endowment for the Arts.

name: Jane Darwell
title: Jane Darwell
extract: Jane Darwell was an American actress of stage, film, and television. With appearances in more than 100 major movies spanning half a century, Darwell is perhaps best remembered for her poignant portrayal of the matriarch and leader of the Joad family in the film adaptation of John Steinbeck's The Grapes of Wrath, for which she received the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress. She has a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
extract_id: Jane Darwell adalah seorang aktris panggung, film, dan televisi Amerika. Dengan penampilan di lebih dari 100 film besar selama setengah abad, Darwell mungkin paling dikenang karena perannya yang menyentuh hati sebagai matriark dan pemimpin keluarga Joad dalam adaptasi film The Grapes of Wrath karya John Steinbeck, yang memberinya Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik. Dia memiliki bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame.

name: Jane Fonda
title: Jane Fonda
extract: Jane Seymour Fonda is an American actress and activist. Fonda's work spans several genres and over seven decades of film and television. She is the recipient of numerous accolades, including two Academy Awards, two British Academy Film Awards, seven Golden Globe Awards, and a Primetime Emmy Award as well as nominations for four Actor Awards, a Grammy Award, and two Tony Awards. Fonda is also the recipient of various honorary awards including the Honorary Palme d'Or in 2007, the AFI Life Achievement Award in 2014, the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement in 2017, the Cecil B. DeMille Award in 2021, and the Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award in 2025.
extract_id: Jane Seymour Fonda adalah seorang aktris dan aktivis Amerika. Karya Fonda meliputi berbagai genre dan lebih dari tujuh dekade film dan televisi. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards, dua British Academy Film Awards, tujuh Golden Globe Awards, dan satu Primetime Emmy Award serta nominasi untuk empat Actor Awards, satu Grammy Award, dan dua Tony Awards. Fonda juga menerima berbagai penghargaan kehormatan seperti Honorary Palme d'Or pada 2007, AFI Life Achievement Award pada 2014, Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement pada 2017, Cecil B. DeMille Award pada 2021, dan Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award pada 2025.

name: Jane Greer
title: Jane Greer
extract: Jane Greer was an American film and television actress best known for her role as femme fatale Kathie Moffat in the 1947 film noir Out of the Past. In 2009, The Guardian named her one of the best actors never to have received an Academy Award nomination.
extract_id: Jane Greer adalah seorang aktris film dan televisi Amerika yang paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai femme fatale Kathie Moffat dalam film noir 1947 Out of the Past. Pada 2009, The Guardian menyebutnya sebagai salah satu aktor terbaik yang tidak pernah menerima nominasi Academy Award.

name: Jane Lynch
title: Jane Lynch
extract: Jane Marie Lynch is an American actress, comedian, and singer. Known for playing starring and recurring roles in comedic television, her accolades include one Golden Globe, six Primetime Emmys and two Screen Actors Guild Awards. In 2013, Lynch received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
extract_id: Jane Marie Lynch adalah seorang aktris, komedian, dan penyanyi Amerika. Dikenal karena memainkan peran utama dan berulang dalam televisi komedi, penghargaan yang dimilikinya termasuk satu Golden Globe, enam Primetime Emmys, dan dua Screen Actors Guild Awards. Pada 2013, Lynch menerima bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame.

name: Jane Wyman
title: Jane Wyman
extract: Jane Wyman, TOSD was an American actress. A star of both movies and television, she received an Academy Award for Best Actress, four Golden Globe Awards and nominations for two Primetime Emmy Awards. In 1960 she received stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame for both motion pictures and television. She was the first wife of actor and future U.S. President Ronald Reagan.
extract_id: Jane Wyman, TOSD adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Sebagai bintang film dan televisi, dia menerima Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik, empat Golden Globe Awards, dan nominasi untuk dua Primetime Emmy Awards. Pada 1960 dia menerima bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame untuk film dan televisi. Dia adalah istri pertama aktor dan calon Presiden AS Ronald Reagan.

name: Janelle Monáe
title: Janelle Monáe
extract: Janelle Monáe Robinson is an American singer, songwriter, rapper and actress. She has received ten Grammy Award nominations, and is the recipient of a Screen Actors Guild Award and a Children's and Family Emmy Award. Monáe has also been honored with the ASCAP Vanguard Award; as well as the Rising Star Award (2015) and the Trailblazer of the Year Award (2018) from Billboard Women in Music.
extract_id: Janelle Monáe Robinson adalah penyanyi, penulis lagu, rapper, dan aktris Amerika. Dia telah menerima sepuluh nominasi Grammy Award, dan meraih Screen Actors Guild Award serta Children's and Family Emmy Award. Monáe juga dihormati dengan ASCAP Vanguard Award; serta Rising Star Award (2015) dan Trailblazer of the Year Award (2018) dari Billboard Women in Music.

name: Janet Gaynor
title: Janet Gaynor
extract: Janet Gaynor was an American actress. She began her career as an extra in shorts and silent films. After signing with Fox Film in 1926, she rose to fame and became one of the biggest box office draws of the era. In 1929, she became the first recipient of the Academy Award for Best Actress for her performances in 7th Heaven, Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans and Street Angel (1928), the only occasion an actress won one Oscar for multiple film roles. Her success continued into the sound film era; for A Star Is Born (1937), she received a second Best Actress Academy Award nomination.
extract_id: Janet Gaynor adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya sebagai figuran dalam film pendek dan film bisu. Setelah menandatangani kontrak dengan Fox Film pada 1926, ia meraih ketenaran dan menjadi salah satu daya tarik box office terbesar pada masanya. Pada 1929, dia menjadi penerima pertama Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam 7th Heaven, Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans, dan Street Angel (1928), satu-satunya kejadian seorang aktris memenangkan satu Oscar untuk beberapa peran film. Keberhasilannya berlanjut di era film bersuara; untuk A Star Is Born (1937), dia menerima nominasi kedua Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik.

name: Janet Leigh
title: Janet Leigh
extract: Jeanette Helen Morrison, known professionally as Janet Leigh, was an American actress, businesswoman and author. Leigh was established as one of the earliest scream queens for starring in horror films, and is also known for starring in dramatic productions for Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer (MGM). She amassed several screen and stage credits over five decades, and received accolades such as a Golden Globe Award, a Laurel Award, and a nomination for an Academy Award.
extract_id: Jeanette Helen Morrison, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Janet Leigh, adalah seorang aktris, pengusaha, dan penulis Amerika. Leigh dikenal sebagai salah satu scream queen awal karena berperan dalam film horor, dan juga dikenal berperan dalam produksi drama Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer (MGM). Dia mengumpulkan berbagai kredit layar dan panggung selama lima dekade, serta menerima penghargaan seperti Golden Globe Award, Laurel Award, dan nominasi Academy Award.

name: Jang Dong-Gun
title: Jang Dong-gun
extract: Jang Dong-gun is a South Korean actor. He is best known for his leading roles in the films Friend (2001) and Taegukgi: The Brotherhood of War (2004). Jang is one of the highest-paid actors and celebrity endorsers in Korea, consistently topping surveys by industry insiders of most bankable stars.
extract_id: Jang Dong-gun adalah aktor Korea Selatan. Dia paling dikenal karena peran utamanya dalam film Friend (2001) dan Taegukgi: The Brotherhood of War (2004). Jang adalah salah satu aktor dan endorsers selebriti dengan bayaran tertinggi di Korea, secara konsisten menduduki peringkat teratas survei dari para ahli industri sebagai bintang paling berdaya jual.

name: Janine Darcey
title: Janine Darcey
extract: Janine Darcey was a French film actress. She appeared in 60 films between 1936 and 1993.
extract_id: Janine Darcey adalah seorang aktris film Prancis. Dia tampil dalam 60 film antara tahun 1936 dan 1993.

name: Janusz Gajos
title: Janusz Gajos
extract: Janusz Gajos is a Polish film, television and theatre actor as well as pedagogue and photographer. Professor of Theatre Arts and an Honorary Doctor of the National Film School in Łódź, he is considered one of the greatest Polish actors.
extract_id: Janusz Gajos adalah aktor film, televisi, dan teater Polandia serta pendidik dan fotografer. Profesor Seni Teater dan Doktor Kehormatan Sekolah Film Nasional di Łódź, dia dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor Polandia terbesar.

name: Jared Bush
title: Jared Bush
extract: Jared Bush is an American filmmaker serving as the chief creative officer of Walt Disney Animation Studios since 2024. He is best known for co-writing and co-directing the company's animated films Zootopia (2016), its sequel Zootopia 2 (2025), and Encanto (2021), the latter of which won an Academy Award for Best Animated Feature. He also wrote the screenplays for Moana (2016), its sequel Moana 2 (2024), and its 2026 live-action remake. He also co-created and executive produced the Disney XD animated series Penn Zero: Part-Time Hero (2014–17).
extract_id: Jared Bush adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika yang menjabat sebagai chief creative officer Walt Disney Animation Studios sejak 2024. Dia paling dikenal karena menjadi co-writer dan co-director film animasi perusahaan Zootopia (2016), sekuelnya Zootopia 2 (2025), dan Encanto (2021), yang terakhir memenangkan Academy Award untuk Best Animated Feature. Dia juga menulis naskah untuk Moana (2016), sekuelnya Moana 2 (2024), dan remake live-action 2026-nya. Dia juga co-creator dan executive producer seri animasi Disney XD Penn Zero: Part-Time Hero (2014–17).

name: Jared Gilman
title: Jared Gilman
extract: Jared T. Raynor Gilman is an American actor best known for his role as Sam Shakusky in the 2012 Wes Anderson film Moonrise Kingdom, which earned him a 2014 Young Artist Award nomination as Best Leading Young Actor in a Feature Film.
extract_id: Jared T. Raynor Gilman adalah aktor Amerika yang paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Sam Shakusky dalam film Wes Anderson tahun 2012 Moonrise Kingdom, yang memberinya nominasi Young Artist Award 2014 sebagai Best Leading Young Actor in a Feature Film.

name: Jared Leto
title: Jared Leto
extract: Jared Joseph Leto is an American actor and musician. Known for his method acting in a variety of roles, he has received various accolades over a career spanning three decades, including an Academy Award and a Golden Globe. He is also the frontman of the rock band Thirty Seconds to Mars.
extract_id: Jared Joseph Leto adalah aktor dan musisi Amerika. Dikenal karena metode aktingnya dalam berbagai peran, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan selama karier tiga dekade, termasuk Academy Award dan Golden Globe. Dia juga frontman band rock Thirty Seconds to Mars.

name: Jason Bateman
title: Jason Bateman
extract: Jason Kent Bateman is an American actor. He is known for his roles as Michael Bluth in the Fox/Netflix sitcom Arrested Development (2003–2019), Nick Wilde in Disney’s Zootopia franchise (2016–present), and Marty Byrde in the Netflix crime drama series Ozark (2017–2022), as well as for his work in numerous comedy films. His accolades include a Golden Globe Award and two Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Jason Kent Bateman adalah aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Michael Bluth dalam sitkom Fox/Netflix Arrested Development (2003–2019), Nick Wilde dalam waralaba Zootopia Disney (2016–sekarang), dan Marty Byrde dalam seri drama kejahatan Netflix Ozark (2017–2022), serta karyanya dalam berbagai film komedi. Penghargaannya termasuk Golden Globe Award dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Jason Cope
title: Jason Cope
extract: Jason Cope is a British and South African actor. He starred and played multiple roles in the 2009 Academy Award-nominated science fiction film District 9.
extract_id: Jason Cope adalah aktor Inggris dan Afrika Selatan. Dia membintangi dan memainkan beberapa peran dalam film fiksi ilmiah District 9 (2009) yang dinominasikan Academy Award.

name: Jason Flemyng
title: Jason Flemyng
extract: Jason Iain Flemyng is an English actor. He is known for his work with British filmmakers Guy Ritchie and Matthew Vaughn appearing in the Ritchie films Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels (1998) and Snatch (2000), and appearing in Vaughn's films Layer Cake (2004), Kick-Ass (2010), and X-Men: First Class (2011).
extract_id: Jason Iain Flemyng adalah aktor Inggris. Dia dikenal karena karyanya dengan sutradara Inggris Guy Ritchie dan Matthew Vaughn, tampil dalam film Ritchie Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels (1998) dan Snatch (2000), serta tampil dalam film Vaughn Layer Cake (2004), Kick-Ass (2010), dan X-Men: First Class (2011).

name: Jason Lee
title: Jason Lee
extract: Jason Michael Lee is an American actor, filmmaker, photographer, and former professional skateboarder. He is known for playing Earl Hickey in the television comedy series My Name Is Earl, for which he was nominated for the Golden Globe Award for Best Actor in a Television Series – Musical or Comedy in 2005 and 2006. He is also known for his roles in Kevin Smith films such as Mallrats (1995), Chasing Amy (1997), Dogma (1999), Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back (2001), Jersey Girl (2004), Clerks II (2006), Cop Out (2010), and Jay and Silent Bob Reboot (2019). Lee won the Independent Spirit Award for Best Supporting Male for his performance in Chasing Amy.
extract_id: Jason Michael Lee adalah aktor, pembuat film, fotografer, dan mantan skateboarder profesional Amerika. Dia dikenal karena memerankan Earl Hickey dalam seri komedi televisi My Name Is Earl, yang membuatnya dinominasikan Golden Globe Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Serial Televisi – Musik atau Komedi pada 2005 dan 2006. Dia juga dikenal karena perannya dalam film-film Kevin Smith seperti Mallrats (1995), Chasing Amy (1997), Dogma (1999), Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back (2001), Jersey Girl (2004), Clerks II (2006), Cop Out (2010), dan Jay and Silent Bob Reboot (2019). Lee memenangkan Independent Spirit Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam Chasing Amy.

name: Jason London
title: Jason London
extract: Jason Paul London is an American actor. Since his breakout role as Reese Witherspoon's love interest Court Foster in The Man In the Moon , he has often featured as a leading man, with notable roles as Randall "Pink" Floyd in director Richard Linklater's film Dazed and Confused (1993), Bobby Ray in To Wong Foo, Thanks for Everything! Julie Newmar (1995), Tom Meyer in Broken Vessels (1998), Jesse in The Rage: Carrie 2 (1999), Todd Boomer in My Teacher's Wife (1999), Jason in Jason and the Argonauts (2000), Rick Rambis in Out Cold (2001), skateboard professional Jimmy Wilson in Grind (2003), Mike in Killer Movie (2008), Chet in The Martini Shot (2023), and Deacon in Neglected (2026).
extract_id: Jason Paul London adalah aktor Amerika. Sejak peran terobosannya sebagai kekasih Reese Witherspoon, Court Foster, dalam The Man In the Moon, dia sering tampil sebagai pemeran utama, dengan peran penting sebagai Randall "Pink" Floyd dalam film sutradara Richard Linklater, Dazed and Confused (1993), Bobby Ray dalam To Wong Foo, Thanks for Everything! Julie Newmar (1995), Tom Meyer dalam Broken Vessels (1998), Jesse dalam The Rage: Carrie 2 (1999), Todd Boomer dalam My Teacher's Wife (1999), Jason dalam Jason and the Argonauts (2000), Rick Rambis dalam Out Cold (2001), profesional skateboard Jimmy Wilson dalam Grind (2003), Mike dalam Killer Movie (2008), Chet dalam The Martini Shot (2023), dan Deacon dalam Neglected (2026).

name: Jason Mitchell
title: Jason Mitchell
extract: Jason Mitchell is an American actor. Mitchell started his career acting in minor roles in films such as the action-thriller Contraband (2012), and the neo‑noir Broken City (2013). He is best known for portraying rapper Eazy-E in the 2015 biopic Straight Outta Compton. The film is considered his career breakthrough, for which he received numerous award nominations including the Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Ensemble Cast in a Motion Picture. Mitchell has also appeared in the Key and Peele comedy film Keanu (2016), the Netflix film Barry (2016), James Franco's The Disaster Artist (2017), and the blockbuster Kong: Skull Island (2017). He has also appeared in critically acclaimed films such as Kathryn Bigelow's crime drama Detroit (2017), Dee Rees' historical drama Mudbound (2017) and Janicza Bravo's black comedy Zola (2021).
extract_id: Jason Mitchell adalah aktor Amerika. Mitchell memulai kariernya dengan berperan dalam peran kecil di film-film seperti aksi-thriller Contraband (2012), dan neo-noir Broken City (2013). Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan rapper Eazy-E dalam film biografi tahun 2015 Straight Outta Compton. Film ini dianggap sebagai terobosan kariernya, yang membuatnya menerima banyak nominasi penghargaan termasuk Screen Actors Guild Award untuk Outstanding Ensemble Cast dalam Motion Picture. Mitchell juga tampil dalam film komedi Key and Peele, Keanu (2016), film Netflix Barry (2016), The Disaster Artist karya James Franco (2017), dan blockbuster Kong: Skull Island (2017). Dia juga tampil dalam film-film yang sangat diapresiasi kritik seperti drama kriminal Kathryn Bigelow, Detroit (2017), drama sejarah Dee Rees, Mudbound (2017), dan komedi gelap Janicza Bravo, Zola (2021).

name: Jason Patric
title: Jason Patric
extract: John Anthony Miller III, better known by his stage name Jason Patric is an American film, television and stage actor. He is known for his roles in films such as The Lost Boys (1987), Rush (1991), Geronimo: An American Legend (1993), Sleepers (1996), Speed 2: Cruise Control (1997), Your Friends & Neighbors (1998), Narc (2002), The Alamo (2004), My Sister's Keeper (2009), and The Losers (2010). His father was actor and playwright Jason Miller, and his maternal grandfather was actor Jackie Gleason.
extract_id: John Anthony Miller III, lebih dikenal dengan nama panggungnya Jason Patric, adalah aktor film, televisi, dan panggung Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya dalam film-film seperti The Lost Boys (1987), Rush (1991), Geronimo: An American Legend (1993), Sleepers (1996), Speed 2: Cruise Control (1997), Your Friends & Neighbors (1998), Narc (2002), The Alamo (2004), My Sister's Keeper (2009), dan The Losers (2010). Ayahnya adalah aktor dan dramawan Jason Miller, dan kakek dari pihak ibu adalah aktor Jackie Gleason.

name: Jason Robards
title: Jason Robards
extract: Jason Nelson Robards Jr. was an American actor. Known for his roles on stage and screen, he gained a reputation as an interpreter of the works of playwright Eugene O'Neill. Robards received numerous accolades and is one of 24 performers to have achieved the Triple Crown of Acting having earned competitive wins for two Academy Awards, a Tony Award and a Primetime Emmy Award. In addition to these plaudits, Robards was nominated for five Golden Globes, two BAFTAs, an Actor Award, a Laurel Award and a Grammy Award. He was inducted into the American Theatre Hall of Fame in 1979, earned the National Medal of Arts in 1997, and the Kennedy Center Honors in 1999.
extract_id: Jason Nelson Robards Jr. adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal karena perannya di panggung dan layar, ia mendapatkan reputasi sebagai penafsir karya dramawan Eugene O'Neill. Robards menerima banyak penghargaan dan merupakan salah satu dari 24 pemeran yang berhasil meraih Triple Crown of Acting dengan memenangkan secara kompetitif dua Academy Awards, satu Tony Award, dan satu Primetime Emmy Award. Selain penghargaan ini, Robards juga dinominasikan untuk lima Golden Globes, dua BAFTA, sebuah Actor Award, sebuah Laurel Award, dan sebuah Grammy Award. Ia dimasukkan ke dalam American Theatre Hall of Fame pada tahun 1979, meraih National Medal of Arts pada tahun 1997, dan Kennedy Center Honors pada tahun 1999.

name: Jason Schwartzman
title: Jason Schwartzman
extract: Jason Schwartzman is an American actor and musician. A member of the Coppola family, Schwartzman made his film debut in Wes Anderson's 1998 film Rushmore, and has since appeared in six other Anderson films: The Darjeeling Limited (2007), Fantastic Mr. Fox (2009), Moonrise Kingdom (2012), The Grand Budapest Hotel (2014), The French Dispatch (2021), and Asteroid City (2023). He also has a co-writing credit on The Darjeeling Limited.
extract_id: Jason Schwartzman adalah aktor dan musisi Amerika. Sebagai anggota keluarga Coppola, Schwartzman memulai debut filmnya dalam film Wes Anderson tahun 1998, Rushmore, dan sejak itu telah tampil dalam enam film Anderson lainnya: The Darjeeling Limited (2007), Fantastic Mr. Fox (2009), Moonrise Kingdom (2012), The Grand Budapest Hotel (2014), The French Dispatch (2021), dan Asteroid City (2023). Ia juga memiliki kredit co-penulis dalam The Darjeeling Limited.

name: Jason Segel
title: Jason Segel
extract: Jason Jordan Segel is an American actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer. He is best known for his role as Marshall Eriksen in the CBS sitcom How I Met Your Mother from 2005 to 2014. He began his career with director and producer Judd Apatow on the television series Freaks and Geeks (1999–2000) and Undeclared (2001–2002) before gaining prominence for his leading roles in various successful comedy films which he has starred in, written, and produced.
extract_id: Jason Jordan Segel adalah aktor, komedian, penulis skenario, dan produser Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Marshall Eriksen dalam sitkom CBS How I Met Your Mother dari tahun 2005 hingga 2014. Dia memulai kariernya bersama sutradara dan produser Judd Apatow dalam serial televisi Freaks and Geeks (1999–2000) dan Undeclared (2001–2002) sebelum meraih ketenaran lewat peran utama dalam berbagai film komedi sukses yang juga ia bintangi, tulis, dan produksi.

name: Jason Statham
title: Jason Statham
extract: Jason Statham is an English actor. He is known for being typecast as tough, gritty, or violent characters in action thriller films, and has been credited for leading the resurgence of action films during the 2000s and 2010s. By 2017, his films had grossed over £1.1 billion, making him one of the industry's most bankable stars. Films in which he has appeared have grossed over $6.25 billion worldwide.
extract_id: Jason Statham adalah aktor Inggris. Dia dikenal sering berperan sebagai karakter kasar, keras, atau keras dalam film aksi-thriller, dan diberi kredit karena memimpin kebangkitan film aksi selama tahun 2000-an dan 2010-an. Hingga 2017, film-filmnya telah meraup pendapatan lebih dari £1,1 miliar, menjadikannya salah satu bintang paling menguntungkan di industri ini. Film-film yang ia bintangi telah meraup lebih dari $6,25 miliar di seluruh dunia.

name: Javier Bardem
title: Javier Bardem
extract: Javier Ángel Encinas Bardem is a Spanish actor. In a career spanning over three decades, he has received various accolades, including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, a Critics' Choice Movie Award, two Actor Awards, and seven Goya Awards, in addition to a Cannes Film Festival Award and two Volpi Cups.
extract_id: Javier Ángel Encinas Bardem adalah aktor Spanyol. Dalam karier yang berlangsung lebih dari tiga dekade, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Golden Globe Award, Critics' Choice Movie Award, dua Actor Awards, dan tujuh Goya Awards, selain Penghargaan Festival Film Cannes dan dua Volpi Cups.

name: Javier Cámara
title: Javier Cámara
extract: Javier Cámara Rodríguez is a Spanish actor. He is the recipient of multiple accolades, including two Goya Awards.
extract_id: Javier Cámara Rodríguez adalah aktor Spanyol. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Goya Awards.

name: Jay Baruchel
title: Jay Baruchel
extract: Jonathan Adam Saunders "Jay" Baruchel is a Canadian actor and filmmaker. He voiced Hiccup Haddock in the How to Train Your Dragon franchise (2010–2019) and had lead roles in the comedies Fanboys (2009), She's Out of My League (2010), and This Is the End (2013). Baruchel was the co-lead in the Disney action-fantasy film The Sorcerer's Apprentice (2010). Films in which Baruchel has had a starring role have grossed over $1.28 billion at the worldwide box office as of 2024.
extract_id: Jonathan Adam Saunders "Jay" Baruchel adalah aktor dan pembuat film Kanada. Dia mengisi suara Hiccup Haddock dalam franchise How to Train Your Dragon (2010–2019) dan memegang peran utama dalam komedi Fanboys (2009), She's Out of My League (2010), dan This Is the End (2013). Baruchel menjadi co-lead dalam film aksi-fantasi Disney The Sorcerer's Apprentice (2010). Film-film yang dibintangi Baruchel telah meraup lebih dari $1,28 miliar di box office dunia hingga tahun 2024.

name: Jay C. Flippen
title: Jay C. Flippen
extract: John Constantine Flippen Jr. was an American character actor who often played crusty sergeants, police officers or weary criminals in many 1940s and 1950s pictures, particularly in film noir. Before his motion-picture career he was a leading vaudeville comedian and master of ceremonies.
extract_id: John Constantine Flippen Jr. adalah aktor karakter Amerika yang sering memerankan sersan kasar, petugas polisi, atau penjahat lelah dalam banyak film era 1940-an dan 1950-an, terutama dalam film noir. Sebelum karier filmnya, ia adalah komedian vaudeville terkemuka dan master of ceremonies.

name: Jaya Bachchan
title: Jaya Bachchan
extract: Jaya Bachchan is an Indian actress and politician. She has served as a Member of Parliament in the Rajya Sabha from the Samajwadi Party since 2004. Known for her work in many Hindi films, she is noted for reinforcing a natural style of acting in both mainstream and "middle-of-the-road" cinema. Bachchan has received several accolades, including ten Filmfare Awards and the Padma Shri, the fourth-highest civilian honour awarded by the Government of India.
extract_id: Jaya Bachchan adalah aktris dan politikus India. Dia telah menjabat sebagai Anggota Parlemen di Rajya Sabha dari Partai Samajwadi sejak 2004. Dikenal karena karyanya dalam banyak film Hindi, dia dikenal memperkuat gaya akting alami dalam sinema arus utama maupun sinema "tengah-tengah". Bachchan telah menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk sepuluh Filmfare Awards dan Padma Shri, penghargaan sipil tertinggi keempat yang diberikan Pemerintah India.

name: Jean Arthur
title: Jean Arthur
extract: Jean Arthur was an American film and theater actress whose career began in silent films in the early 1920s and lasted until the early 1950s.
extract_id: Jean Arthur adalah aktris film dan teater Amerika yang kariernya dimulai pada film bisu di awal 1920-an dan berlangsung hingga awal 1950-an.

name: Jean Dujardin
title: Jean Dujardin
extract: Jean Edmond Dujardin is a French actor and comedian. He began his career as a stand-up comedian in Paris before guest starring in comedic television programmes and films. He first came to prominence with the popular TV series Un gars, une fille (1999–2003), in which he starred alongside his partner Alexandra Lamy, before becoming a popular film actor with comedies such as Brice de Nice (2005), Michel Hazanavicius's OSS 117: Cairo, Nest of Spies (2006), its sequel OSS 117: Lost in Rio (2009) and OSS 117: From Africa with Love (2021), and 99 Francs (2007).
extract_id: Jean Edmond Dujardin adalah aktor dan komedian Perancis. Ia memulai karier sebagai komedian stand-up di Paris sebelum tampil tamu di program televisi komedi dan film-film. Ia mulai terkenal lewat serial TV populer Un gars, une fille (1999–2003), di mana ia berperan bersama pasangannya Alexandra Lamy, sebelum menjadi aktor film populer dengan komedi seperti Brice de Nice (2005), OSS 117: Cairo, Nest of Spies (2006) karya Michel Hazanavicius, sekuelnya OSS 117: Lost in Rio (2009) dan OSS 117: From Africa with Love (2021), serta 99 Francs (2007).

name: Jean Gabin
title: Jean Gabin
extract: Jean Gabin Alexis Moncorgé, known as Jean Gabin, was a French actor and singer. Considered a key figure in French cinema, he starred in several classic films, including Pépé le Moko (1937), La grande illusion (1937), Le Quai des brumes (1938), La bête humaine (1938), Le jour se lève (1939), and Le plaisir (1952). During his career, he twice won the Silver Bear for Best Actor from the Berlin International Film Festival and the Volpi Cup for Best Actor from the Venice Film Festival, respectively. Gabin was made a member of the Légion d'honneur in recognition of the important role he played in French cinema.
extract_id: Jean Gabin Alexis Moncorgé, dikenal sebagai Jean Gabin, adalah aktor dan penyanyi Perancis. Dianggap sebagai figur kunci dalam sinema Perancis, ia membintangi beberapa film klasik, termasuk Pépé le Moko (1937), La grande illusion (1937), Le Quai des brumes (1938), La bête humaine (1938), Le jour se lève (1939), dan Le plaisir (1952). Selama kariernya, ia dua kali memenangkan Silver Bear untuk Aktor Terbaik dari Festival Film Internasional Berlin dan Volpi Cup untuk Aktor Terbaik dari Festival Film Venesia. Gabin dianugerahi Légion d'honneur sebagai pengakuan atas peran pentingnya dalam sinema Perancis.

name: Jean Heywood
title: Jean Heywood
extract: Jean Heywood was an English actress.
extract_id: Jean Heywood adalah seorang aktris Inggris.

name: Jean Martin
title: Jean Martin
extract: Jean Martin was a French actor of stage and screen. Martin served in the French Resistance during World War II and later fought with the French paratroopers in Indochina. Theatrically, he is perhaps best known for originating two roles in Samuel Beckett's most famous plays: Lucky in Waiting for Godot, and Clov in Endgame. During the 1950s, he was a performer at the Théâtre National Populaire and also worked for radio plays.
extract_id: Jean Martin adalah aktor Prancis panggung dan layar. Martin bertugas dalam Perlawanan Prancis selama Perang Dunia II dan kemudian bertempur dengan pasukan terjun payung Prancis di Indocina. Di dunia teater, ia mungkin paling dikenal karena memulai dua peran dalam drama paling terkenal Samuel Beckett: Lucky dalam Waiting for Godot dan Clov dalam Endgame. Pada tahun 1950-an, ia tampil di Théâtre National Populaire dan juga bekerja untuk drama radio.

name: Jean Reno
title: Jean Reno
extract: Juan Moreno y Herrera-Jiménez, commonly known as Jean Reno, is a French and Spanish actor. He established himself as a leading man of French cinema through his collaborations with director Luc Besson, and has worked in numerous international productions. He is a three-time César Award nominee - Best Actor for Les Visiteurs (1993) and Léon: The Professional (1994), and Best Supporting Actor for The Big Blue (1988).
extract_id: Juan Moreno y Herrera-Jiménez, yang dikenal sebagai Jean Reno, adalah aktor Prancis dan Spanyol. Ia memantapkan dirinya sebagai pemeran utama dalam sinema Perancis melalui kolaborasinya dengan sutradara Luc Besson, dan telah bekerja dalam banyak produksi internasional. Ia tiga kali dinominasikan untuk César Award - Aktor Terbaik untuk Les Visiteurs (1993) dan Léon: The Professional (1994), serta Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk The Big Blue (1988).

name: Jean Renoir
title: Jean Renoir
extract: Jean Renoir was a French filmmaker, actor, producer and author. His La Grande Illusion (1937) and The Rules of the Game (1939) are often cited by critics as among the greatest films ever made. In 2002, he was ranked fourth on the BFI's Sight & Sound poll of the greatest directors. Among numerous honours accrued during his lifetime, he received a Lifetime Achievement Academy Award in 1975. Renoir was the son of the painter Pierre-Auguste Renoir and the uncle of the cinematographer Claude Renoir. With Claude, he made The River (1951), the first color film shot in India. A lifelong lover of theater, Renoir turned to the stage for The Golden Coach (1952) and French Cancan (1955). He was one of the first filmmakers to be known as an auteur; the critic Penelope Gilliatt said a Renoir shot could be identified "in a thousand miles of film."
extract_id: Jean Renoir adalah pembuat film, aktor, produser, dan penulis Prancis. La Grande Illusion (1937) dan The Rules of the Game (1939) sering disebut oleh kritikus sebagai salah satu film terbesar yang pernah dibuat. Pada 2002, ia menempati peringkat keempat dalam jajak pendapat Sight & Sound BFI tentang sutradara terbesar. Di antara banyak penghargaan yang ia peroleh selama hidupnya, ia menerima Academy Award Lifetime Achievement pada tahun 1975. Renoir adalah putra pelukis Pierre-Auguste Renoir dan paman sinematografer Claude Renoir. Bersama Claude, ia membuat The River (1951), film berwarna pertama yang diproduksi di India. Sebagai pecinta teater seumur hidup, Renoir beralih ke panggung untuk The Golden Coach (1952) dan French Cancan (1955). Ia adalah salah satu pembuat film pertama yang dikenal sebagai auteur; kritikus Penelope Gilliatt mengatakan tembakan Renoir dapat dikenali "dalam seribu mil film."

name: Jean Seberg
title: Jean Seberg
extract: Jean Dorothy Seberg was an American actress. She is considered an icon of the French New Wave as a result of her performance in Jean-Luc Godard's 1960 film Breathless.
extract_id: Jean Dorothy Seberg adalah aktris Amerika. Dia dianggap ikon French New Wave sebagai hasil dari penampilannya dalam film Jean-Luc Godard tahun 1960, Breathless.

name: Jean Servais
title: Jean Servais
extract: Jean Servais was a Belgian film and stage actor. He acted in many 20th century French cinema productions, from the 1930s through the early 1970s.
extract_id: Jean Servais adalah aktor film dan panggung Belgia. Ia berakting dalam banyak produksi sinema Perancis abad ke-20, dari tahun 1930-an hingga awal 1970-an.

name: Jean Simmons
title: Jean Simmons
extract: Jean Merilyn Simmons was a British actress and singer. One of J. Arthur Rank's "well-spoken young starlets", she appeared predominantly in films, beginning with those made in Britain during and after the Second World War, followed mainly by Hollywood films from 1950 onwards.
extract_id: Jean Merilyn Simmons adalah aktris dan penyanyi Inggris. Salah satu "bintang muda berbahasa baik" J. Arthur Rank, ia tampil terutama dalam film, dimulai dengan film-film yang dibuat di Inggris selama dan setelah Perang Dunia II, kemudian sebagian besar dalam film Hollywood sejak 1950-an.

name: Jean Sorel
title: Jean Sorel
extract: Jean Bernard Antoine de Chieusses de Combaud de Roquebrune CAL, known professionally as Jean Sorel, is a French actor. He was a leading man of European cinema during the 1960s and '70s, with a screen persona that often drew comparisons with Alain Delon.
extract_id: Jean Bernard Antoine de Chieusses de Combaud de Roquebrune CAL, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Jean Sorel, adalah aktor Prancis. Ia merupakan pemeran utama dalam sinema Eropa selama 1960-an dan 1970-an, dengan persona layar yang sering dibandingkan dengan Alain Delon.

name: Jean Topart
title: Jean Topart
extract: Jean Topart was a French actor. He was considered one of the best known voices on French television for decades. In addition to providing the voices and narration for television series and animated films, Topart often dubbed American and other foreign films into French.
extract_id: Jean Topart adalah aktor Prancis. Ia dianggap sebagai salah satu suara paling dikenal di televisi Perancis selama beberapa dekade. Selain menyediakan suara dan narasi untuk serial televisi dan film animasi, Topart juga sering mengisi dub film-film Amerika dan film asing lainnya ke dalam bahasa Prancis.

name: Jean-Baptiste Maunier
title: Jean-Baptiste Maunier
extract: Jean-Baptiste Maunier is a French actor and singer. He is best known for his role in the 2004 French film Les Choristes.
extract_id: Jean-Baptiste Maunier adalah aktor dan penyanyi Prancis. Ia paling dikenal karena perannya dalam film Prancis tahun 2004 Les Choristes.

name: Jean-Jacques Annaud
title: Jean-Jacques Annaud
description: French film director, screenwriter and producer (born 1943)
extract: Jean-Jacques Annaud is a French film director, screenwriter and producer. He directed Black and White in Color (1976), Quest for Fire (1981), The Name of the Rose (1986), The Bear (1988), The Lover (1992), Seven Years in Tibet (1997), Enemy at the Gates (2001), Black Gold (2011), and Wolf Totem (2015).
extract_id: Jean-Jacques Annaud adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser asal Prancis. Dia menyutradarai Black and White in Color (1976), Quest for Fire (1981), The Name of the Rose (1986), The Bear (1988), The Lover (1992), Seven Years in Tibet (1997), Enemy at the Gates (2001), Black Gold (2011), dan Wolf Totem (2015).

name: Jean-Louis Trintignant
title: Jean-Louis Trintignant
extract: Jean-Louis Xavier Trintignant was a French actor. He made his theatrical debut in 1951, and went on to be regarded as one of the best French dramatic actors of the post-war era. He starred in many classic films of European cinema, and worked with many prominent auteur directors, including Roger Vadim, Costa-Gavras, Claude Lelouch, Claude Chabrol, Bernardo Bertolucci, Éric Rohmer, François Truffaut, Dino Risi, Krzysztof Kieślowski, and Michael Haneke.
extract_id: Jean-Louis Xavier Trintignant adalah aktor Prancis. Dia memulai debut teaternya pada tahun 1951, dan kemudian dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor drama Prancis terbaik pada era pasca-perang. Dia membintangi banyak film klasik sinema Eropa, dan bekerja dengan banyak sutradara terkenal, termasuk Roger Vadim, Costa-Gavras, Claude Lelouch, Claude Chabrol, Bernardo Bertolucci, Éric Rohmer, François Truffaut, Dino Risi, Krzysztof Kieślowski, dan Michael Haneke.

name: Jean-Luc Godard
title: Jean-Luc Godard
extract: Jean-Luc Godard was a French and Swiss film director, screenwriter, and film critic. He rose to prominence as a pioneer of the French New Wave film movement of the 1960s, alongside such filmmakers as François Truffaut, Agnès Varda, Éric Rohmer and Jacques Demy. He was arguably the most influential French filmmaker of the post-war era. According to AllMovie, his work "revolutionized the motion picture form" through its experimentation with narrative, continuity, sound, and camerawork.
extract_id: Jean-Luc Godard adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan kritikus film asal Prancis dan Swiss. Dia menjadi terkenal sebagai pelopor gerakan film French New Wave pada 1960-an, bersama dengan pembuat film seperti François Truffaut, Agnès Varda, Éric Rohmer, dan Jacques Demy. Dia bisa dibilang merupakan pembuat film Prancis paling berpengaruh pada era pasca-perang. Menurut AllMovie, karyanya "merevolusi bentuk film" melalui eksperimen dengan narasi, kontinuitas, suara, dan pengambilan gambar.

name: Jean-Marc Barr
title: Jean-Marc Barr
extract: Jean-Marc Barr is a French-American film actor and director. He is best known for working on several films from Danish film director and frequent collaborator Lars von Trier since Europa (1991).
extract_id: Jean-Marc Barr adalah aktor dan sutradara film Prancis-Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena bekerja pada beberapa film sutradara film Denmark dan kolaborator sering Lars von Trier sejak Europa (1991).

name: Jean-Marc Vallée
title: Jean-Marc Vallée
extract: Jean-Marc Vallée was a Canadian filmmaker. After studying film at the Université de Montréal, Vallée went on to make a number of critically acclaimed short films, including Stéréotypes (1991), Les Fleurs magiques (1995), and Les Mots magiques (1998).
extract_id: Jean-Marc Vallée adalah pembuat film asal Kanada. Setelah belajar film di Université de Montréal, Vallée melanjutkan membuat sejumlah film pendek yang mendapat pujian kritis, termasuk Stéréotypes (1991), Les Fleurs magiques (1995), dan Les Mots magiques (1998).

name: Jean-Paul Belmondo
title: Jean-Paul Belmondo
extract: Jean-Paul Charles Belmondo was a French actor, producer and distributor. Initially associated with the New Wave of the 1960s thanks to the success of the film Breathless (1960), he also acted in other films that modernized cinema such as Two Women (1960), Le Doulos (1962), That Man from Rio (1964), Greed in the Sun (1964), and Weekend at Dunkirk (1964). With the film That Man from Rio, he also became a stuntman.
extract_id: Jean-Paul Charles Belmondo adalah aktor, produser, dan distributor asal Prancis. Awalnya terkait dengan New Wave tahun 1960-an berkat keberhasilan film Breathless (1960), dia juga berakting dalam film lain yang memodernisasi sinema seperti Two Women (1960), Le Doulos (1962), That Man from Rio (1964), Greed in the Sun (1964), dan Weekend at Dunkirk (1964). Dengan film That Man from Rio, ia juga menjadi pemeran pengganti (stuntman).

name: Jean-Pierre Jeunet
title: Jean-Pierre Jeunet
extract: Jean-Pierre Jeunet is a French director and screenwriter.
extract_id: Jean-Pierre Jeunet adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario asal Prancis.

name: Jean-Pierre Lorit
title: Jean-Pierre Lorit
extract: Jean-Pierre Lorit is a French actor.
extract_id: Jean-Pierre Lorit adalah aktor asal Prancis.

name: Jean-Pierre Léaud
title: Jean-Pierre Léaud
extract: Jean-Pierre Léaud is a French actor best known for being an important figure of the French New Wave and his portrayal of Antoine Doinel in a series of films by François Truffaut, beginning with The 400 Blows (1959). He has worked with Jean-Luc Godard, Agnès Varda, and Jacques Rivette, as well as other notable directors such as Jean Cocteau, Pier Paolo Pasolini, Bernardo Bertolucci, Jean Eustache, Catherine Breillat, Jerzy Skolimowski, and Aki Kaurismäki.
extract_id: Jean-Pierre Léaud adalah aktor Prancis yang paling dikenal sebagai tokoh penting dari French New Wave dan perannya sebagai Antoine Doinel dalam serangkaian film karya François Truffaut, dimulai dengan The 400 Blows (1959). Dia telah bekerja dengan Jean-Luc Godard, Agnès Varda, dan Jacques Rivette, serta sutradara terkenal lainnya seperti Jean Cocteau, Pier Paolo Pasolini, Bernardo Bertolucci, Jean Eustache, Catherine Breillat, Jerzy Skolimowski, dan Aki Kaurismäki.

name: Jean-Pierre Melville
title: Jean-Pierre Melville
extract: Jean-Pierre Grumbach, known professionally as Jean-Pierre Melville, was a French filmmaker. Considered a spiritual godfather of the French New Wave, he was one of the first fully-independent French filmmakers to achieve commercial and critical success. His works include the crime dramas Bob le flambeur (1956), Le Doulos (1962), Le Samouraï (1967), and Le Cercle Rouge (1970), and the war films Le Silence de la mer (1949) and Army of Shadows (1969).
extract_id: Jean-Pierre Grumbach, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Jean-Pierre Melville, adalah pembuat film asal Prancis. Dianggap sebagai spiritual godfather dari French New Wave, dia adalah salah satu pembuat film Prancis independen pertama yang meraih kesuksesan komersial dan kritis. Karyanya meliputi drama kriminal Bob le flambeur (1956), Le Doulos (1962), Le Samouraï (1967), dan Le Cercle Rouge (1970), serta film perang Le Silence de la mer (1949) dan Army of Shadows (1969).

name: Jeanne Bates
title: Jeanne Bates
extract: Jeanne Bates was an American radio, film and television actress. After performing in radio serials, she signed a contract with Columbia Pictures in 1942 which began her career in films both in small parts and larger roles in a series of horror films and noirs, including The Return of the Vampire (1943) and Shadows in the Night (1946).
extract_id: Jeanne Bates adalah aktris radio, film, dan televisi asal Amerika. Setelah tampil dalam serial radio, dia menandatangani kontrak dengan Columbia Pictures pada tahun 1942 yang memulai karirnya di film baik dalam peran kecil maupun lebih besar dalam serangkaian film horor dan noir, termasuk The Return of the Vampire (1943) dan Shadows in the Night (1946).

name: Jeanne Moreau
title: Jeanne Moreau
description: French actress, singer, screenwriter, director and socialite (1928–2017)
extract: Jeanne Moreau was a French actress, singer, screenwriter, director, and socialite. She made her theatrical debut in 1947, and established herself as one of the leading actresses of the Comédie-Française.
extract_id: Jeanne Moreau adalah aktris, penyanyi, penulis skenario, sutradara, dan sosialita asal Prancis. Dia memulai debut teatrikalnya pada tahun 1947, dan menetapkan dirinya sebagai salah satu aktris utama Comédie-Française.

name: Jee-woon Kim
title: Kim Jee-woon
extract: Kim Jee-woon is a South Korean film director, screenwriter, and producer. He was a theater actor and playwright before debuting with his self-written and directed film, The Quiet Family in 1998. Kim has worked with increasing levels of success in cinema, showing accomplished acting and a detailed stylization in his films. He is currently one of the most recognized screenwriters/directors in the Korean film industry.
extract_id: Kim Jee-woon adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser asal Korea Selatan. Dia adalah aktor teater dan penulis naskah sebelum debut dengan film yang ia tulis dan sutradarai sendiri, The Quiet Family pada tahun 1998. Kim telah bekerja dengan tingkat keberhasilan yang meningkat dalam sinema, menunjukkan akting yang mahir dan stilisasi detail dalam film-filmnya. Dia saat ini adalah salah satu penulis skenario/sutradara paling dikenal di industri film Korea.

name: Jeethu Joseph
title: Jeethu Joseph
extract: Jeethu Joseph is an Indian film director, screenwriter, and producer who predominantly works in Malayalam cinema. He has also worked in a few Tamil, Hindi and Telugu films, a few of which are remade from his own Malayalam films. He made his directional debut with the 2007 suspense thriller Detective. He is best known for directing the 2013 crime thriller Drishyam starring Mohanlal, which was the highest-grossing Malayalam film at the time of its release. Its sequel Drishyam 2 (2021) was released on Amazon Prime Video, due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Like its prequel, it was highly acclaimed and appreciated worldwide.
extract_id: Jeethu Joseph adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser asal India yang sebagian besar bekerja di sinema Malayalam. Dia juga pernah bekerja di beberapa film Tamil, Hindi, dan Telugu, beberapa di antaranya diadaptasi ulang dari film Malayalam buatannya sendiri. Dia memulai debut penyutradaraannya dengan thriller suspense Detective (2007). Dia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai thriller kriminal Drishyam (2013) yang dibintangi Mohanlal, yang merupakan film Malayalam dengan pendapatan tertinggi saat dirilis. Sekuelnya, Drishyam 2 (2021), dirilis di Amazon Prime Video karena pandemi COVID-19. Seperti film pertamanya, sekuel tersebut sangat diapresiasi dan mendapatkan pujian di seluruh dunia.

name: Jeff Anderson
title: Jeff Anderson
description: American film actor, film director, and screenwriter
extract: Jeffrey Allan Anderson is an American film & television actor, director, and screenwriter best known for starring as Randal Graves in Clerks, Clerks II, and Clerks III. In between, he has appeared in other Kevin Smith-directed films and has written, directed, and starred in Now You Know.
extract_id: Jeffrey Allan Anderson adalah aktor, sutradara, dan penulis skenario film & televisi asal Amerika yang paling dikenal karena memerankan Randal Graves dalam Clerks, Clerks II, dan Clerks III. Di antaranya, dia juga muncul dalam film yang disutradarai Kevin Smith lainnya serta menulis, menyutradarai, dan membintangi Now You Know.

name: Jeff Bridges
title: Jeff Bridges
extract: Jeffrey Leon Bridges is an American actor and singer. Bridges describes himself as an actor, musician, photographer, painter, sculptor, campaigner, and storyteller.
extract_id: Jeffrey Leon Bridges adalah aktor dan penyanyi asal Amerika. Bridges menggambarkan dirinya sebagai aktor, musisi, fotografer, pelukis, pematung, aktivis, dan pendongeng.

name: Jeff Cohen
title: Jeff Cohen (actor)
description: American attorney and retired child actor (born 1974)
extract: Jeffrey Bertan Cohen is an American attorney and retired child actor best remembered for appearing as Chunk in the 1985 Steven Spielberg production The Goonies. He is a founding partner of law firm Cohen & Gardner.
extract_id: Jeffrey Bertan Cohen adalah pengacara Amerika dan mantan aktor cilik yang paling diingat karena tampil sebagai Chunk dalam produksi Steven Spielberg tahun 1985, The Goonies. Dia adalah mitra pendiri firma hukum Cohen & Gardner.

name: Jeff Daniels
title: Jeff Daniels
extract: Jeffrey Warren Daniels is an American actor and musician. He is known for his work on stage and screen playing diverse characters switching between comedy and drama. He is the recipient of several accolades, including two Primetime Emmy Awards, in addition to nominations for five Golden Globe Awards, five Screen Actors Guild Awards, and three Tony Awards.
extract_id: Jeffrey Warren Daniels adalah aktor dan musisi Amerika. Dia dikenal karena karyanya di panggung dan layar yang memerankan karakter beragam yang berganti antara komedi dan drama. Dia menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk dua Primetime Emmy Awards, serta nominasi untuk lima Golden Globe Awards, lima Screen Actors Guild Awards, dan tiga Tony Awards.

name: Jeff Garlin
title: Jeff Garlin
extract: Jeffrey Garlin is an American stand-up comedian and actor. He played Jeff Greene on the HBO sitcom Curb Your Enthusiasm, and Murray Goldberg, patriarch of the eponymous family in the ABC sitcom The Goldbergs. Garlin also played Marvin on Mad About You and Mort Meyers on Arrested Development for Fox and Netflix.
extract_id: Jeffrey Garlin adalah komedian stand-up dan aktor asal Amerika. Dia memerankan Jeff Greene dalam sitkom HBO Curb Your Enthusiasm, dan Murray Goldberg, kepala keluarga dalam sitkom ABC The Goldbergs. Garlin juga memainkan peran Marvin di Mad About You dan Mort Meyers di Arrested Development untuk Fox dan Netflix.

name: Jeff Goldblum
title: Jeff Goldblum
extract: Jeffrey Lynn Goldblum is an American actor and musician. He has starred in some of the highest-grossing films of all time, such as Jurassic Park (1993) and Independence Day (1996), as well as their sequels.
extract_id: Jeffrey Lynn Goldblum adalah aktor dan musisi asal Amerika. Dia telah membintangi beberapa film dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa, seperti Jurassic Park (1993) dan Independence Day (1996), serta sekuel-sekuelnya.

name: Jeffrey Hunter
title: Jeffrey Hunter
extract: Jeffrey Hunter was an American film and television actor and producer known for his roles in films such as The Searchers and King of Kings. On television, Hunter is known for his 1965 role as Captain Christopher Pike in the original pilot episode of Star Trek: The Original Series.
extract_id: Jeffrey Hunter adalah aktor dan produser film serta televisi asal Amerika yang dikenal karena perannya dalam film seperti The Searchers dan King of Kings. Di televisi, Hunter dikenal karena perannya pada tahun 1965 sebagai Kapten Christopher Pike dalam episode pilot asli Star Trek: The Original Series.

name: Jeffrey Jones
title: Jeffrey Jones
extract: Jeffrey Duncan Jones is an American actor. He is known for his roles as Emperor Joseph II in Amadeus (1984), Edward R. Rooney in Ferris Bueller's Day Off (1986), Charles Deetz in Beetlejuice (1988), Dr. Skip Tyler in The Hunt for Red October (1990), Eddie Barzoon in The Devil's Advocate (1997), and A. W. Merrick in both Deadwood (2004–2006) and Deadwood: The Movie (2019).
extract_id: Jeffrey Duncan Jones adalah aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Kaisar Joseph II dalam Amadeus (1984), Edward R. Rooney dalam Ferris Bueller's Day Off (1986), Charles Deetz dalam Beetlejuice (1988), Dr. Skip Tyler dalam The Hunt for Red October (1990), Eddie Barzoon dalam The Devil's Advocate (1997), dan A. W. Merrick dalam Deadwood (2004–2006) serta Deadwood: The Movie (2019).

name: Jeffrey Wright
title: Jeffrey Wright
extract: Jeffrey Charles Wright is an American actor. His accolades include a British Academy Games Award, a Golden Globe Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, and a Tony Award, in addition to a nomination for an Academy Award.
extract_id: Jeffrey Charles Wright adalah aktor Amerika. Penghargaan yang diterimanya meliputi British Academy Games Award, Golden Globe Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dan Tony Award, selain nominasi Academy Award.

name: Jemaine Clement
title: Jemaine Clement
description: New Zealand actor, musician and filmmaker (born 1974)
extract: Jemaine Atea Mahana Clement is a New Zealand actor, comedian, musician, and filmmaker.
