He has released several albums with Bret McKenzie as the musical comedy duo Flight of the Conchords, and created the comedy television series of the same name (2007–2009) for both the BBC and HBO, for which he received six Primetime Emmy nominations.
extract_id: Jemaine Atea Mahana Clement adalah aktor, komedian, musisi, dan pembuat film asal Selandia Baru. Dia telah merilis beberapa album bersama Bret McKenzie sebagai duo komedi musik Flight of the Conchords, dan membuat serial televisi komedi dengan nama yang sama (2007–2009) untuk BBC dan HBO, yang telah mendapat enam nominasi Primetime Emmy.

name: Jena Malone
title: Jena Malone
extract: Jena Malone is an American actress and musician. Malone spent her early life in Sparks, Nevada, and in Las Vegas, while her mother acted in local theater productions. Inspired to become an actress herself, Malone convinced her mother to relocate to Los Angeles. After a series of auditions, Malone was cast in the television film Bastard Out of Carolina (1996), for which she received Independent Spirit and Screen Actors Guild Award nominations, and the television film Hope (1997), for which she received a Golden Globe Award nomination. She next appeared in the feature films Contact (1997) and Stepmom (1998), winning a Saturn Award for the former.
extract_id: Jena Malone adalah aktris dan musisi asal Amerika. Malone menghabiskan masa kecilnya di Sparks, Nevada, dan di Las Vegas, sementara ibunya berperan dalam produksi teater lokal. Terinspirasi untuk menjadi aktris, Malone meyakinkan ibunya untuk pindah ke Los Angeles. Setelah serangkaian audisi, Malone dipilih dalam film televisi Bastard Out of Carolina (1996), yang membawanya mendapat nominasi Independent Spirit dan Screen Actors Guild Award, serta film televisi Hope (1997), yang memberinya nominasi Golden Globe Award. Selanjutnya dia tampil di film layar lebar Contact (1997) dan Stepmom (1998), memenangkan Saturn Award untuk film yang pertama.

name: Jennifer Aniston
title: Jennifer Aniston
extract: Jennifer Joanna Aniston is an American actress. Her accolades include a Primetime Emmy Award, a Golden Globe Award, and two Screen Actors Guild Awards. Aniston has consistently ranked among the world's highest-paid actresses, as of 2023.
extract_id: Jennifer Joanna Aniston adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk Primetime Emmy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan dua Screen Actors Guild Awards. Aniston secara konsisten masuk dalam daftar aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia, per tahun 2023.

name: Jennifer Connelly
title: Jennifer Connelly
extract: Jennifer Lynn Connelly is an American actress. She began her career as a child model before making her acting debut in the 1984 crime film Once Upon a Time in America. After a few more years of modeling, she began to concentrate on acting, starring in a variety of films including the horror film Phenomena (1985), the musical fantasy film Labyrinth (1986), the romantic thriller The Hot Spot (1990), the romantic comedy Career Opportunities (1991), and the period superhero film The Rocketeer (1991). She received praise for her performance in the science fiction film Dark City (1998) and playing a drug addict in Darren Aronofsky's drama film Requiem for a Dream (2000).
extract_id: Jennifer Lynn Connelly adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya sebagai model anak sebelum melakukan debut akting dalam film kriminal tahun 1984 Once Upon a Time in America. Setelah beberapa tahun sebagai model, dia mulai fokus pada akting, membintangi berbagai film termasuk film horor Phenomena (1985), film fantasi musikal Labyrinth (1986), thriller romantis The Hot Spot (1990), komedi romantis Career Opportunities (1991), dan film superhero periode The Rocketeer (1991). Dia mendapat pujian atas penampilannya dalam film fiksi ilmiah Dark City (1998) dan memerankan pecandu obat dalam film drama Darren Aronofsky Requiem for a Dream (2000).

name: Jennifer Garner
title: Jennifer Garner
extract: Jennifer Anne Garner is an American actress. Born in Houston, Texas and raised in Charleston, West Virginia, Garner studied theater at Denison University and began acting as an understudy for the Roundabout Theatre Company in New York City. She had a starring role on the Fox teen drama series Time of Your Life (1999–2000) and supporting roles in the films Pearl Harbor (2001) and Catch Me If You Can (2002).
extract_id: Jennifer Anne Garner adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Lahir di Houston, Texas dan dibesarkan di Charleston, West Virginia, Garner belajar teater di Denison University dan mulai berakting sebagai pemeran pembantu untuk Roundabout Theatre Company di New York City. Dia memerankan peran utama dalam serial drama remaja Fox Time of Your Life (1999–2000) dan peran pendukung dalam film Pearl Harbor (2001) dan Catch Me If You Can (2002).

name: Jennifer Jason Leigh
title: Jennifer Jason Leigh
extract: Jennifer Jason Leigh is an American actress. She began her career on television during the 1970s before making her film breakthrough in the teen film Fast Times at Ridgemont High (1982). She received critical praise for her performances in Last Exit to Brooklyn (1989), Miami Blues (1990), Backdraft (1991), Single White Female (1992), and The Hudsucker Proxy (1994), and was nominated for a Golden Globe Award for her portrayal of Dorothy Parker in Mrs. Parker and the Vicious Circle (1994). For her role as fugitive Daisy Domergue in The Hateful Eight (2015), she was nominated for the Golden Globe and Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: Jennifer Jason Leigh adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya di televisi pada 1970-an sebelum mencapai terobosan film dalam film remaja Fast Times at Ridgemont High (1982). Dia mendapat pujian kritis atas penampilannya dalam Last Exit to Brooklyn (1989), Miami Blues (1990), Backdraft (1991), Single White Female (1992), dan The Hudsucker Proxy (1994), serta dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award atas perannya sebagai Dorothy Parker dalam Mrs. Parker and the Vicious Circle (1994). Untuk perannya sebagai buronan Daisy Domergue dalam The Hateful Eight (2015), ia dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe dan Academy Award sebagai Pemeran Pendukung Wanita Terbaik.

name: Jennifer Lawrence
title: Jennifer Lawrence
extract: Jennifer Lawrence Maroney is an American actress and producer. She has starred in both action film franchises and independent dramas, and her films have grossed over $6 billion worldwide. Lawrence was the world's highest-paid actress in 2015 and 2016 and Time named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world.
extract_id: Jennifer Lawrence Maroney adalah seorang aktris dan produser Amerika. Dia telah membintangi baik franchise film aksi maupun drama independen, dan film-filmnya telah menghasilkan lebih dari $6 miliar di seluruh dunia. Lawrence adalah aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia pada 2015 dan 2016, dan Time menobatkannya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia.

name: Jennifer Lien
title: Jennifer Lien
extract: Jennifer Anne Lien is an American former actress known for playing Kes on the television series Star Trek: Voyager.
extract_id: Jennifer Anne Lien adalah mantan aktris Amerika yang dikenal karena memerankan Kes dalam serial televisi Star Trek: Voyager.

name: Jennifer Morrison
title: Jennifer Morrison
extract: Jennifer Marie Morrison is an American actress and director. She played the roles of Dr. Allison Cameron in the medical-drama series House (2004–2012) and Emma Swan in the ABC adventure-fantasy series Once Upon a Time (2011–2018). She has also portrayed Zoey Pierson, one of Ted Mosby's love interests, on the comedy series How I Met Your Mother; Winona Kirk, mother of James T. Kirk in the 2009 science-fiction film Star Trek; and Tess Conlon in the 2011 sports drama film Warrior. She made her feature-film directorial debut with Sun Dogs (2017).
extract_id: Jennifer Marie Morrison adalah seorang aktris dan sutradara Amerika. Dia memerankan Dr. Allison Cameron dalam serial drama medis House (2004–2012) dan Emma Swan dalam serial petualangan fantasi ABC Once Upon a Time (2011–2018). Dia juga memerankan Zoey Pierson, salah satu kekasih Ted Mosby, dalam serial komedi How I Met Your Mother; Winona Kirk, ibu James T. Kirk dalam film fiksi ilmiah Star Trek (2009); dan Tess Conlon dalam film drama olahraga Warrior (2011). Dia membuat debut sebagai sutradara film panjang dengan film Sun Dogs (2017).

name: Jennifer Saunders
title: Jennifer Saunders
extract: Jennifer Jane Saunders is an English comedian, actress, singer, impressionist, satirist and screenwriter. Saunders originally found attention in the 1980s, when she became a member of The Comic Strip after graduating from the Royal Central School of Speech and Drama with her best friend and comedy partner, Dawn French. With French, Saunders co-wrote and starred in their eponymous sketch show, French and Saunders and later received acclaim in the 1990s for writing and playing her character Edina Monsoon in her sitcom Absolutely Fabulous. She received a BAFTA Fellowship in 2009 with French.
extract_id: Jennifer Jane Saunders adalah komedian, aktris, penyanyi, pemeran imitasi, satiris dan penulis naskah asal Inggris. Saunders mulai dikenal pada 1980-an, saat ia menjadi anggota The Comic Strip setelah lulus dari Royal Central School of Speech and Drama bersama sahabat dan mitra komedinya, Dawn French. Bersama French, Saunders menulis dan membintangi acara sketsa mereka yang bernama French and Saunders dan kemudian menerima pujian pada 1990-an untuk menulis sekaligus memerankan karakter Edina Monsoon dalam sitkomnya Absolutely Fabulous. Dia menerima BAFTA Fellowship pada 2009 bersama French.

name: Jennifer Ulrich
title: Jennifer Ulrich
extract: Jennifer Ulrich is a German actress who has starred in such films as The Wave and We Are The Night. She was born in Lichtenberg, Berlin.
extract_id: Jennifer Ulrich adalah seorang aktris Jerman yang telah membintangi film seperti The Wave dan We Are The Night. Dia lahir di Lichtenberg, Berlin.

name: Jeremy Irons
title: Jeremy Irons
extract: Jeremy John Irons is an English actor. Known for his roles on stage and screen, he has received numerous accolades including an Academy Award, a Tony Award, three Primetime Emmy Awards, and two Golden Globe Awards, being one of just 24 actors who have achieved the Triple Crown of Acting.
extract_id: Jeremy John Irons adalah seorang aktor Inggris. Dikenal karena perannya di panggung dan layar, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Academy Award, Tony Award, tiga Primetime Emmy Awards, dan dua Golden Globe Awards, menjadi salah satu dari hanya 24 aktor yang meraih Triple Crown of Acting.

name: Jeremy Renner
title: Jeremy Renner
extract: Jeremy Lee Renner is an American actor, author, singer, and producer. He began his career by appearing in independent films such as Dahmer (2002) and Neo Ned (2005), then supporting roles in bigger films, such as S.W.A.T. (2003) and 28 Weeks Later (2007). Renner gained Academy Award nominations for Best Actor for his performance as an Iraq War soldier in The Hurt Locker (2009) and for Best Supporting Actor for playing a hot-headed robber in The Town (2010).
extract_id: Jeremy Lee Renner adalah seorang aktor, penulis, penyanyi, dan produser Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya dengan tampil di film independen seperti Dahmer (2002) dan Neo Ned (2005), kemudian memegang peran pendukung di film yang lebih besar, seperti S.W.A.T. (2003) dan 28 Weeks Later (2007). Renner memperoleh nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Terbaik atas perannya sebagai tentara Perang Irak dalam The Hurt Locker (2009) dan nominasi Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk memerankan perampok yang mudah marah dalam The Town (2010).

name: Jeremy Strong
title: Jeremy Strong
extract: Jeremy Strong is an American actor. Known for his intense method acting style in roles across both stage and screen, he has received accolades including a Tony Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, and a Golden Globe Award as well as nominations for an Academy Award and a BAFTA Award. In 2022, Strong was featured on Time's list of the 100 most influential people in the world.
extract_id: Jeremy Strong adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dikenal dengan gaya akting metode intensnya dalam berbagai peran di panggung dan layar, ia telah menerima penghargaan termasuk Tony Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dan Golden Globe Award serta nominasi Academy Award dan BAFTA Award. Pada 2022, Strong masuk dalam daftar Time sebagai 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia.

name: Jerome Flynn
title: Jerome Flynn
extract: Jerome Patrick Flynn is a British actor and singer. He is best known for his role as Bronn in the HBO fantasy series Game of Thrones (2011–2019). His other roles include Paddy Garvey of the King's Fusiliers in the ITV series Soldier Soldier (1991–1995), Bennet Drake in the BBC mystery series Ripper Street (2012–2016), Hector in the Black Mirror episode "Shut Up and Dance" (2016), Banner Creighton in the Paramount+ western series 1923 (2022–2025) and Boris Oliver in L2: Empuraan (2025).
extract_id: Jerome Patrick Flynn adalah aktor dan penyanyi Inggris. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Bronn dalam serial fantasi HBO Game of Thrones (2011–2019). Peran lainnya termasuk Paddy Garvey dari King's Fusiliers dalam serial ITV Soldier Soldier (1991–1995), Bennet Drake dalam serial misteri BBC Ripper Street (2012–2016), Hector dalam episode Black Mirror "Shut Up and Dance" (2016), Banner Creighton dalam serial western Paramount+ 1923 (2022–2025) dan Boris Oliver dalam L2: Empuraan (2025).

name: Jerry Lewis
title: Jerry Lewis
extract: Jerry Lewis was an American comedian, actor, singer, filmmaker and humanitarian. Known as "The King of Comedy", "The Total Filmmaker" and in France as "Le Roi du Crazy" across his seven-decade career, Lewis was regarded as one of the greatest comedians of the 20th century.
extract_id: Jerry Lewis adalah seorang komedian, aktor, penyanyi, pembuat film, dan dermawan Amerika. Dikenal sebagai "The King of Comedy", "The Total Filmmaker" dan di Prancis sebagai "Le Roi du Crazy" sepanjang kariernya yang berlangsung selama tujuh dekade, Lewis dianggap sebagai salah satu komedian terbesar abad ke-20.

name: Jerry O'Connell
title: Jerry O'Connell
description: American actor and TV show host (born 1974)
extract: Michael Jeremiah Witkowski "Jerry" O'Connell is an American actor and TV show host. He is known for his roles as Quinn Mallory in the television series Sliders, Andrew Clements in My Secret Identity, Vern Tessio in the film Stand by Me (1986), Joe in Joe's Apartment (1996), Frank Cushman in Jerry Maguire (1996), Derek in Scream 2 (1997), Michael in Tomcats (2001), Charlie Carbone in Kangaroo Jack (2003), and Detective Woody Hoyt on the NBC drama Crossing Jordan. He starred as Pete Kaczmarek in The Defenders (2010–2011), which lasted one season. He also had a starring role in the comedy horror film Piranha 3D (2010). O'Connell voiced Commander Jack Ransom on the animated series Star Trek: Lower Decks and hosted a version of Pictionary syndicated on Fox stations.
extract_id: Michael Jeremiah Witkowski "Jerry" O'Connell adalah aktor dan pembawa acara TV Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Quinn Mallory dalam serial televisi Sliders, Andrew Clements dalam My Secret Identity, Vern Tessio dalam film Stand by Me (1986), Joe dalam Joe's Apartment (1996), Frank Cushman dalam Jerry Maguire (1996), Derek dalam Scream 2 (1997), Michael dalam Tomcats (2001), Charlie Carbone dalam Kangaroo Jack (2003), dan Detektif Woody Hoyt dalam drama NBC Crossing Jordan. Dia membintangi sebagai Pete Kaczmarek dalam The Defenders (2010–2011), yang hanya berlangsung satu musim. Dia juga memerankan peran utama dalam film horor komedi Piranha 3D (2010). O'Connell mengisi suara Commander Jack Ransom dalam serial animasi Star Trek: Lower Decks dan menjadi pembawa acara versi Pictionary yang disiarkan di stasiun Fox.

name: Jerry Zucker
title: Jerry Zucker
description: American film director, producer, and screenwriter (born 1950)
extract: Jerry Gordon Zucker is an American filmmaker. With his brother David and Jim Abrahams, he is part of the filmmaking trio Zucker, Abrahams and Zucker.
extract_id: Jerry Gordon Zucker adalah pembuat film Amerika. Bersama saudaranya David dan Jim Abrahams, dia merupakan bagian dari trio pembuat film Zucker, Abrahams and Zucker.

name: Jerzy Stuhr
title: Jerzy Stuhr
extract: Jerzy Oskar Stuhr was a Polish film and theatre actor. Considered one of the most popular, influential and versatile Polish actors and an icon of Polish cinema, he also worked as a screenwriter, film director, voice actor and drama professor. He served as the rector of the Ludwik Solski Academy for the Dramatic Arts in Kraków for two terms: from 1990 to 1996 and again from 2002 to 2008.
extract_id: Jerzy Oskar Stuhr adalah aktor film dan teater Polandia. Dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor Polandia yang paling populer, berpengaruh, dan serba bisa serta ikon sinema Polandia, dia juga bekerja sebagai penulis skenario, sutradara film, pengisi suara dan profesor drama. Dia menjabat sebagai rektor Akademi Seni Drama Ludwik Solski di Kraków selama dua periode: dari 1990 sampai 1996 dan lagi dari 2002 sampai 2008.

name: Jesse Borrego
title: Jesse Borrego
extract: Jesse Borrego is an American actor best known for his roles as Cruz Candelaria in Blood In Blood Out, Jesse V. Velasquez in Fame, Gael Ortega in 24, and George King in Dexter.
extract_id: Jesse Borrego adalah aktor Amerika yang paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Cruz Candelaria dalam Blood In Blood Out, Jesse V. Velasquez dalam Fame, Gael Ortega dalam 24, dan George King dalam Dexter.

name: Jesse Corti
title: Jesse Corti
extract: Jesse Corti is an American actor and theater director known for playing Courfeyrac in the original Broadway show Les Misérables and for voicing LeFou in Beauty and the Beast.
extract_id: Jesse Corti adalah aktor dan sutradara teater Amerika yang dikenal karena memerankan Courfeyrac dalam pertunjukan Broadway asli Les Misérables dan mengisi suara LeFou dalam Beauty and the Beast.

name: Jesse Eisenberg
title: Jesse Eisenberg
extract: Jesse Adam Eisenberg is a Polish-American actor, playwright, and filmmaker. Recognized for playing smart but socially awkward characters in both comedies and dramas, his accolades include a BAFTA Award as well as nominations for two Academy Awards, and three Golden Globes.
extract_id: Jesse Adam Eisenberg adalah aktor, penulis drama, dan pembuat film keturunan Polandia-Amerika. Dikenal karena memerankan karakter cerdas tapi canggung secara sosial dalam komedi dan drama, penghargaan yang diterimanya antara lain BAFTA Award serta nominasi dua Academy Awards dan tiga Golden Globes.

name: Jessica Biel
title: Jessica Biel
extract: Jessica Claire Timberlake is an American actress. Biel began her career as a vocalist appearing in musical productions until she was cast as Mary Camden in the family drama series 7th Heaven (1996–2007).
extract_id: Jessica Claire Timberlake adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Biel memulai kariernya sebagai vokalis yang tampil dalam produksi musikal sampai dia dipilih sebagai Mary Camden dalam serial drama keluarga 7th Heaven (1996–2007).

name: Jessica Chastain
title: Jessica Chastain
extract: Jessica Michelle Chastain is an American actress and producer. Known primarily for starring in projects with feminist themes, she has received various accolades, including an Academy Award and a Golden Globe Award, in addition to nominations for a Primetime Emmy Award, two Tony Awards and two BAFTAs. Time magazine named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2012.
extract_id: Jessica Michelle Chastain adalah seorang aktris dan produser Amerika. Dikenal terutama karena membintangi proyek dengan tema feminis, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award dan Golden Globe Award, selain nominasi Primetime Emmy Award, dua Tony Awards, dan dua BAFTA. Majalah Time menobatkannya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia pada 2012.

name: Jessica Lange
title: Jessica Lange
extract: Jessica Phyllis Lange is an American actress and photographer. With a career spanning five decades, she is known for her roles on stage and screen. Her accolades include two Academy Awards, five Golden Globe Awards, three Primetime Emmy Awards, and a Tony Award, in addition to nominations for a BAFTA Award and a Laurence Olivier Award. Lange is one of few performers to achieve Triple Crown of Acting status.
extract_id: Jessica Phyllis Lange adalah seorang aktris dan fotografer Amerika. Dengan karier yang membentang lima dekade, dia dikenal karena perannya di panggung dan layar. Penghargaannya mencakup dua Academy Awards, lima Golden Globe Awards, tiga Primetime Emmy Awards, dan sebuah Tony Award, serta nominasi untuk BAFTA Award dan Laurence Olivier Award. Lange adalah salah satu dari sedikit pemeran yang mencapai status Triple Crown of Acting.

name: Jessica Tandy
title: Jessica Tandy
extract: Jessie Alice Tandy, known professionally as Jessica Tandy, was an English and American actress. She appeared in over 100 stage productions and had more than 60 roles in film and TV, receiving an Academy Award, four Tony Awards, a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award. Tandy is one of few performers to achieve Triple Crown of Acting status.
extract_id: Jessie Alice Tandy, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Jessica Tandy, adalah aktris Inggris dan Amerika. Dia tampil dalam lebih dari 100 produksi panggung dan memiliki lebih dari 60 peran di film dan TV, menerima Academy Award, empat Tony Awards, BAFTA Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Primetime Emmy Award. Tandy adalah salah satu dari sedikit pemeran yang mencapai status Triple Crown of Acting.

name: Jessie Nelson
title: Jessie Nelson
extract: Jessie Nelson is an American film producer, director, actress and writer.
extract_id: Jessie Nelson adalah produser film, sutradara, aktris, dan penulis Amerika.

name: Jessie Royce Landis
title: Jessie Royce Landis
extract: Jessie Royce Landis, also known as Jesse Royce-Landis, was an American actress known for her mother roles in the Hitchcock films To Catch a Thief (1955) and North by Northwest (1959).
extract_id: Jessie Royce Landis, juga dikenal sebagai Jesse Royce-Landis, adalah seorang aktris Amerika yang dikenal karena peran ibu dalam film Hitchcock To Catch a Thief (1955) dan North by Northwest (1959).

name: Jet Li
title: Jet Li
extract: Jet Li Lianjie is a martial artist, actor, and philanthropist. With a career spanning more than forty years, he is widely regarded as one of the most influential martial artists in cinema history. Li's early work in mainland China during the 1980s is credited with introducing the Shaolin Temple to a global audience. During the 1990s, his collaborations with filmmaker Tsui Hark spearheaded wushu representation in Hong Kong action cinema, establishing him as its most prominent practitioner. He simultaneously popularised the wuxia genre before transitioning to Hollywood in the late 1990s. His crossover success brought global recognition, solidifying his place alongside Jackie Chan as one of the two biggest names in contemporary martial arts cinema.
extract_id: Jet Li Lianjie adalah seorang seniman bela diri, aktor, dan dermawan. Dengan karier yang berlangsung lebih dari empat puluh tahun, dia secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu seniman bela diri paling berpengaruh dalam sejarah sinema. Karya awal Li di daratan Tiongkok pada 1980-an dianggap telah memperkenalkan Shaolin Temple kepada khalayak global. Pada 1990-an, kolaborasinya dengan pembuat film Tsui Hark mempelopori representasi wushu dalam sinema aksi Hong Kong, yang menjadikannya praktisi paling menonjol. Dia secara bersamaan mempopulerkan genre wuxia sebelum beralih ke Hollywood pada akhir 1990-an. Keberhasilan lintas batasnya membawa pengakuan global, mengukuhkan tempatnya bersama Jackie Chan sebagai dua nama terbesar dalam sinema seni bela diri kontemporer.

name: Jim Abrahams
title: Jim Abrahams
extract: James Steven Abrahams was an American filmmaker. With David and Jerry Zucker, he was best known as a member of Zucker, Abrahams and Zucker.
extract_id: James Steven Abrahams adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika. Bersama David dan Jerry Zucker, dia paling dikenal sebagai anggota Zucker, Abrahams and Zucker.

name: Jim Backus
title: Jim Backus
extract: James Gilmore Backus was an American actor. Among his most famous roles were Thurston Howell III on the 1960s sitcom Gilligan's Island, the father of James Dean's character in Rebel Without a Cause, the voice of the near-sighted cartoon character Mr. Magoo, the rich Hubert Updike III on the radio version of The Alan Young Show, and Joan Davis' character's husband on TV's I Married Joan. He also starred in his own show of one season, The Jim Backus Show, also known as Hot Off the Wire.
extract_id: James Gilmore Backus adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Di antara peran terkenalnya adalah Thurston Howell III dalam sitkom tahun 1960-an Gilligan's Island, ayah karakter James Dean dalam Rebel Without a Cause, suara karakter kartun rabun Mr. Magoo, Hubert Updike III yang kaya dalam versi radio The Alan Young Show, dan suami karakter Joan Davis dalam serial TV I Married Joan. Dia juga membintangi acara sendiri selama satu musim, The Jim Backus Show, juga dikenal sebagai Hot Off the Wire.

name: Jim Carrey
title: Jim Carrey
extract: James Eugene Carrey is a Canadian and American actor, comedian, and visual artist. Known primarily for his energetic slapstick performances, he is regarded as one of the most prominent comedic actors of his generation.
extract_id: James Eugene Carrey adalah aktor, komedian, dan seniman visual Kanada dan Amerika. Terkenal terutama karena penampilan slapsticknya yang energik, dia dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor komedi paling menonjol dari generasinya.

name: Jim Caviezel
title: Jim Caviezel
extract: James Patrick Caviezel Jr. is an American actor. He played Jesus in The Passion of the Christ (2004) and Tim Ballard in Sound of Freedom (2023), and starred as John Reese on the CBS series Person of Interest (2011–2016). He also played Slov in G.I. Jane (1997), Private Witt in The Thin Red Line (1998), Detective John Sullivan in Frequency (2000), Catch in Angel Eyes (2001), and Edmond Dantès in The Count of Monte Cristo (2002).
extract_id: James Patrick Caviezel Jr. adalah aktor Amerika. Dia memerankan Yesus dalam The Passion of the Christ (2004) dan Tim Ballard dalam Sound of Freedom (2023), serta membintangi sebagai John Reese di serial CBS Person of Interest (2011–2016). Dia juga memerankan Slov dalam G.I. Jane (1997), Private Witt dalam The Thin Red Line (1998), Detektif John Sullivan dalam Frequency (2000), Catch dalam Angel Eyes (2001), dan Edmond Dantès dalam The Count of Monte Cristo (2002).

name: Jim Jarmusch
title: Jim Jarmusch
extract: James Robert Jarmusch is an American filmmaker and musician.
extract_id: James Robert Jarmusch adalah pembuat film dan musisi Amerika.

name: Jim Kelly
title: Jim Kelly (martial artist)
description: American athlete, actor, and martial artist (1946–2013)
extract: James Milton Kelly was an American athlete, martial artist, actor, and professional tennis player. After winning several karate championships, he rose to fame in the early 1970s appearing in action films within the martial arts and blaxploitation genres. Kelly played opposite Bruce Lee in 1973's Enter the Dragon, and had lead roles in 1974's Black Belt Jones as the title character and Three the Hard Way as Mister Keyes.
extract_id: James Milton Kelly adalah seorang atlet Amerika, seniman bela diri, aktor, dan pemain tenis profesional. Setelah memenangkan beberapa kejuaraan karate, dia meraih ketenaran pada awal 1970-an dengan membintangi film aksi dalam genre seni bela diri dan blaxploitation. Kelly beradu akting dengan Bruce Lee dalam film Enter the Dragon tahun 1973, dan memegang peran utama dalam Black Belt Jones tahun 1974 sebagai karakter utama dan Three the Hard Way sebagai Mister Keyes.

name: Jim Sheridan
title: Jim Sheridan
extract: Jim Sheridan is an Irish filmmaker. Between 1989 and 1993, Sheridan directed three critically acclaimed films set in Ireland, My Left Foot (1989), The Field (1990), and In the Name of the Father (1993), and later directed the films The Boxer (1997), In America (2003), and Brothers (2009). Sheridan has received six Academy Award nominations for his work.
extract_id: Jim Sheridan adalah pembuat film Irlandia. Antara 1989 dan 1993, Sheridan menyutradarai tiga film yang dipuji secara kritis yang berlatar di Irlandia, yaitu My Left Foot (1989), The Field (1990), dan In the Name of the Father (1993), dan kemudian menyutradarai film The Boxer (1997), In America (2003), dan Brothers (2009). Sheridan menerima enam nominasi Academy Award atas karyanya.

name: Jim Sturgess
title: Jim Sturgess
extract: James Anthony Sturgess is an English actor and singer-songwriter. His first major role was as Jude in the musical romance drama film Across the Universe (2007). He played the male lead role of Ben Campbell in 21 (2008), Gavin Kossef in Crossing Over (2009), The Way Back (2010), and co-starred in the epic science fiction film Cloud Atlas (2012).
extract_id: James Anthony Sturgess adalah aktor dan penyanyi-penulis lagu Inggris. Peran besarnya yang pertama adalah sebagai Jude dalam film drama musikal romantis Across the Universe (2007). Dia memerankan peran utama laki-laki Ben Campbell dalam 21 (2008), Gavin Kossef dalam Crossing Over (2009), The Way Back (2010), dan menjadi pemeran pendamping dalam film epik fiksi ilmiah Cloud Atlas (2012).

name: Jim Varney
title: Jim Varney
extract: James Albert Varney Jr. was an American actor and comedian. He is best known for his Emmy Award winning comedic role as Ernest P. Worrell, originating in a series of television commercial advertising campaigns, and later growing into a film and television franchise. He played Jed Clampett in the 1993 The Beverly Hillbillies film adaptation, and also covered a song for the film titled "Hot Rod Lincoln". He voiced Slinky Dog in the first two films of the Toy Story franchise (1995–1999). He died of lung cancer on February 10, 2000, leaving two posthumous releases, Daddy and Them and Atlantis: The Lost Empire.
extract_id: James Albert Varney Jr. adalah aktor dan komedian Amerika. Dia paling dikenal dengan peran komedi pemenang Emmy sebagai Ernest P. Worrell, yang berasal dari serangkaian kampanye iklan televisi, dan kemudian menjadi franchise film dan televisi. Dia memerankan Jed Clampett dalam adaptasi film The Beverly Hillbillies tahun 1993, dan juga menyanyikan lagu untuk film berjudul "Hot Rod Lincoln". Dia mengisi suara Slinky Dog dalam dua film pertama franchise Toy Story (1995–1999). Dia meninggal karena kanker paru-paru pada 10 Februari 2000, meninggalkan dua rilis pasca kematian, Daddy and Them dan Atlantis: The Lost Empire.

name: Jimmy Sheirgill
title: Jimmy Sheirgill
extract: Jimmy Sheirgill, also known as Jimmy Shergill, is an Indian actor and producer who primarily works in Hindi and Punjabi films.
extract_id: Jimmy Sheirgill, juga dikenal sebagai Jimmy Shergill, adalah aktor dan produser India yang terutama bekerja di film Hindi dan Punjabi.

name: Jin Goo
title: Jin Goo
extract: Jin Goo is a South Korean actor. He won Best Supporting Actor at the Grand Bell Awards and Blue Dragon Film Awards for his role in Bong Joon-ho's 2009 noir thriller Mother. He is also known for his role in the critically and commercially successful series Descendants of the Sun.
extract_id: Jin Goo adalah aktor Korea Selatan. Dia memenangkan Best Supporting Actor di Grand Bell Awards dan Blue Dragon Film Awards untuk perannya dalam film thriller noir Bong Joon-ho tahun 2009, Mother. Dia juga dikenal karena perannya dalam serial Descendants of the Sun yang sukses secara kritis dan komersial.

name: Jinpachi Nezu
title: Jinpachi Nezu
extract: Jinpachi Nezu was a Japanese actor. He appeared in more than 50 films and television shows between 1974 and 2010. He starred in the 1982 film Farewell to the Land, which was entered into the 32nd Berlin International Film Festival.
extract_id: Jinpachi Nezu adalah aktor Jepang. Dia tampil dalam lebih dari 50 film dan acara televisi antara 1974 dan 2010. Dia membintangi film Farewell to the Land tahun 1982, yang masuk dalam Festival Film Internasional Berlin ke-32.

name: Jo Hartley
title: Jo Hartley
extract: Jo Hartley is an English actress. She is known for her roles in the films Dead Man's Shoes (2004), This Is England (2006), The Young Victoria (2009), Torvill & Dean (2018), Slaughterhouse Rulez (2018), Eddie the Eagle (2016), Sweetheart (2021), and Bank of Dave (2023). Television credits include This Is England '86 (2010), Not Safe For Work (2015), In My Skin (2018), After Life (2019–2022), Mandy (2021), Das Boot (2022), Death in Paradise (2023), Passenger (2024), and Adolescence (2025).
extract_id: Jo Hartley adalah aktris Inggris. Dia dikenal karena perannya dalam film Dead Man's Shoes (2004), This Is England (2006), The Young Victoria (2009), Torvill & Dean (2018), Slaughterhouse Rulez (2018), Eddie the Eagle (2016), Sweetheart (2021), dan Bank of Dave (2023). Kredit televisinya termasuk This Is England '86 (2010), Not Safe For Work (2015), In My Skin (2018), After Life (2019–2022), Mandy (2021), Das Boot (2022), Death in Paradise (2023), Passenger (2024), dan Adolescence (2025).

name: Jo Van Fleet
title: Jo Van Fleet
extract: Jo Van Fleet was an American stage, film, and television actress. During her long career, which spanned over four decades, she often played characters much older than her actual age. Van Fleet won a Tony Award in 1954 for her performance in the Broadway production The Trip to Bountiful, and the next year she won an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her role in East of Eden.
extract_id: Jo Van Fleet adalah aktris panggung, film, dan televisi Amerika. Selama karier panjangnya yang berlangsung lebih dari empat dekade, dia sering memerankan karakter yang jauh lebih tua dari usianya sebenarnya. Van Fleet memenangkan Tony Award pada tahun 1954 untuk penampilannya dalam produksi Broadway The Trip to Bountiful, dan tahun berikutnya dia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik untuk perannya dalam East of Eden.

name: Joan Allen
title: Joan Allen
extract: Joan Allen is an American actress. Known for her work on stage and screen, she has received various accolades, including a Tony Award, in addition to nominations for three Academy Awards, a BAFTA Award, three Primetime Emmy Awards, and three Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Joan Allen adalah aktris Amerika. Dikenal karena karyanya di panggung dan layar, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Tony Award, selain nominasi untuk tiga Academy Awards, BAFTA Award, tiga Primetime Emmy Awards, dan tiga Golden Globe Awards.

name: Joan Chen
title: Joan Chen
extract: Joan Chen is a Chinese-born American actress and film director. She is the recipient of numerous accolades, including four Taipei Golden Horse Awards and an AACTA Award. She made her film debut in the Chinese film Youth (1977) before starring in the film Little Flower (1979). She came to the attention of American audiences for her portrayal of Wanrong in the Bernardo Bertolucci historical epic film The Last Emperor (1987), which won nine Academy Awards including Best Picture.
extract_id: Joan Chen adalah aktris kelahiran Tiongkok dan sutradara film Amerika. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk empat Taipei Golden Horse Awards dan AACTA Award. Dia membuat debut filmnya dalam film Tiongkok Youth (1977) sebelum membintangi film Little Flower (1979). Dia mendapat perhatian penonton Amerika karena perannya sebagai Wanrong dalam film epik sejarah karya Bernardo Bertolucci, The Last Emperor (1987), yang memenangkan sembilan Academy Awards termasuk Best Picture.

name: Joan Crawford
title: Joan Crawford
extract: Joan Crawford was an American actress. She began her career as a dancer in traveling theatrical companies before debuting on Broadway. Crawford was signed to a motion-picture contract by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer in 1925. Initially frustrated by the size and quality of her roles, Crawford launched a publicity campaign and built an image as a nationally known flapper by the end of the 1920s. By the 1930s, Crawford's fame rivaled MGM colleagues Norma Shearer and Greta Garbo. Crawford often played hardworking young women who manage to find romance and financial success. These "rags-to-riches" stories were well received by Depression-era audiences and were popular with women. Crawford became one of Hollywood's most prominent movie stars and one of the highest paid women in the United States, but her films began losing money. By the end of the 1930s, she was labeled "box office poison".
extract_id: Joan Crawford adalah aktris Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya sebagai penari dalam perusahaan teater keliling sebelum debut di Broadway. Crawford ditandatangani kontrak film oleh Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer pada tahun 1925. Awalnya frustrasi dengan ukuran dan kualitas perannya, Crawford meluncurkan kampanye publisitas dan membangun citra sebagai flapper terkenal secara nasional pada akhir 1920-an. Pada 1930-an, ketenaran Crawford menyaingi rekan-rekan MGM Norma Shearer dan Greta Garbo. Crawford sering memerankan wanita muda pekerja keras yang berhasil menemukan romansa dan kesuksesan finansial. Kisah "dari kemiskinan ke kekayaan" ini diterima baik oleh penonton masa Depresi dan populer di kalangan wanita. Crawford menjadi salah satu bintang film paling menonjol di Hollywood dan salah satu wanita dengan bayaran tertinggi di Amerika Serikat, tetapi film-filmnya mulai merugi. Pada akhir 1930-an, dia dijuluki "box office poison".

name: Joan Cusack
title: Joan Cusack
extract: Joan Mary Cusack is an American actress. She is known for her distinctive voice and offbeat comedic timing, and her portrayals of neurotic, endearing characters have earned her numerous accolades, including a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Joan Mary Cusack adalah aktris Amerika. Dia dikenal karena suara khasnya dan waktu komedi yang unik, serta penggambarannya terhadap karakter neurotik yang menggemaskan yang memberinya berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Joan Fontaine
title: Joan Fontaine
extract: Joan de Beauvoir de Havilland, known professionally as Joan Fontaine, was a British-American actress best known for her film roles during the Golden Age of Hollywood. Fontaine appeared in more than 45 films in a career that spanned five decades. She was the younger sister of actress Olivia de Havilland. Their rivalry was well documented in the media at the height of Fontaine's career.
extract_id: Joan de Beauvoir de Havilland, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Joan Fontaine, adalah aktris Inggris-Amerika yang paling dikenal karena peran filmnya selama Zaman Keemasan Hollywood. Fontaine tampil dalam lebih dari 45 film dalam karier yang berlangsung lima dekade. Dia adalah adik perempuan dari aktris Olivia de Havilland. Rivalitas mereka sangat terdokumentasi di media pada puncak karier Fontaine.

name: Joan Greenwood
title: Joan Greenwood
extract: Joan Mary Waller Greenwood Mesritz was an English actress. Her husky voice, coupled with her slow, precise elocution, was her trademark. She played Sibella in the 1949 film Kind Hearts and Coronets, and also appeared in The Man in the White Suit, Young Wives' Tale, The Importance of Being Earnest (1952), Stage Struck (1958), Tom Jones (1963) and Little Dorrit (1987).
extract_id: Joan Mary Waller Greenwood Mesritz adalah aktris Inggris. Suara parau yang unik, dipadukan dengan pengucapan lambat dan tepat, adalah ciri khasnya. Dia memerankan Sibella dalam film Kind Hearts and Coronets tahun 1949, dan juga tampil dalam The Man in the White Suit, Young Wives' Tale, The Importance of Being Earnest (1952), Stage Struck (1958), Tom Jones (1963), dan Little Dorrit (1987).

name: Joanna Cassidy
title: Joanna Cassidy
extract: Joanna Cassidy is an American actress and former model. She began working as a model in the 1960s and made her professional acting debut in 1973, appearing in the thriller films The Laughing Policeman and The Outfit. She later starred in the films Bank Shot (1974) and The Late Show (1977), the short-lived television series The Roller Girls (1978), and 240-Robert (1979). In 1982, she played replicant Zhora Salome in the science-fiction film Blade Runner.
extract_id: Joanna Cassidy adalah aktris Amerika dan mantan model. Dia mulai bekerja sebagai model pada 1960-an dan membuat debut akting profesionalnya pada 1973, tampil dalam film thriller The Laughing Policeman dan The Outfit. Dia kemudian membintangi film Bank Shot (1974) dan The Late Show (1977), serial televisi singkat The Roller Girls (1978), dan 240-Robert (1979). Pada 1982, dia memerankan replikant Zhora Salome dalam film fiksi ilmiah Blade Runner.

name: Joanne Dru
title: Joanne Dru
extract: Joanne Dru was an American film and television actress, known for such films as Red River, She Wore a Yellow Ribbon, All the King's Men, and Wagon Master.
extract_id: Joanne Dru adalah aktris film dan televisi Amerika, dikenal karena film-film seperti Red River, She Wore a Yellow Ribbon, All the King's Men, dan Wagon Master.

name: Joaquin Phoenix
title: Joaquin Phoenix
extract: Joaquin Rafael Phoenix is an American actor. Widely described as one of the preeminent actors of his generation and known for his roles as dark, unconventional and eccentric characters in independent film, he has received various accolades, including an Academy Award, an Actor Award, a BAFTA Award, a Grammy Award, a Volpi Cup, and two Golden Globes.
extract_id: Joaquin Rafael Phoenix adalah aktor Amerika. Secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terkemuka dari generasinya dan dikenal karena perannya sebagai karakter gelap, tidak konvensional, dan eksentrik dalam film independen, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Actor Award, BAFTA Award, Grammy Award, Volpi Cup, dan dua Golden Globes.

name: Jodi Benson
title: Jodi Benson
extract: Jodi Benson is an American actress and singer. She is best known for providing the voice of Ariel in Disney's The Little Mermaid (1989), as well as in its sequel, prequel, and television series spin-off, along with many other Disney works. Benson is also known for her portrayal of Barbie in the second and third films of the Toy Story franchise, and in the Toy Story Toons short Hawaiian Vacation (2011). For her contributions to Disney, Benson was named a "Disney Legend" in 2011.
extract_id: Jodi Benson adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena memberikan suara Ariel dalam film Disney The Little Mermaid (1989), serta dalam sekuel, prekuel, dan serial televisi spin-off-nya, bersama banyak karya Disney lainnya. Benson juga dikenal karena perannya sebagai Barbie dalam film kedua dan ketiga dari waralaba Toy Story, dan dalam film pendek Toy Story Toons Hawaiian Vacation (2011). Atas kontribusinya pada Disney, Benson diberi gelar "Disney Legend" pada tahun 2011.

name: Jodie Foster
title: Jodie Foster
extract: Alicia Christian "Jodie" Foster is an American actress and filmmaker. Foster started her career as a child actor before establishing herself as a leading actress in film. As a performer, she is known for her versatility. She has received several accolades, including two Academy Awards, three BAFTA Awards, four Golden Globe Awards, a Primetime Emmy Award, the Cecil B. DeMille Award, and the Honorary Palme d'Or.
extract_id: Alicia Christian "Jodie" Foster adalah seorang aktris dan pembuat film Amerika. Foster memulai kariernya sebagai aktor cilik sebelum menempatkan dirinya sebagai aktris utama di film. Sebagai seorang pemeran, dia dikenal karena fleksibilitasnya. Dia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards, tiga BAFTA Awards, empat Golden Globe Awards, satu Primetime Emmy Award, Cecil B. DeMille Award, dan Honorary Palme d'Or.

name: Joe Johnston
title: Joe Johnston
description: American film director and visual effects artist (born 1950)
extract: Joseph Eggleston Johnston II is an American filmmaker. He is best known for directing visual effects-driven films, including Honey, I Shrunk the Kids (1989), The Rocketeer (1991), Jumanji (1995), Jurassic Park III (2001), The Wolfman (2010), and Captain America: The First Avenger (2011).
extract_id: Joseph Eggleston Johnston II adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena mengarahkan film-film yang didorong oleh efek visual, termasuk Honey, I Shrunk the Kids (1989), The Rocketeer (1991), Jumanji (1995), Jurassic Park III (2001), The Wolfman (2010), dan Captain America: The First Avenger (2011).

name: Joe Keaton
title: Joe Keaton
extract: Joseph Hallie Keaton was an American vaudeville performer, eccentric dancer and silent film actor. He was the father of actor Buster Keaton and appeared with his son in several films.
extract_id: Joseph Hallie Keaton adalah seorang penampil vaudeville Amerika, penari eksentrik dan aktor film bisu. Dia adalah ayah dari aktor Buster Keaton dan muncul bersama putranya dalam beberapa film.

name: Joe Pantoliano
title: Joe Pantoliano
extract: Joseph Peter Pantoliano is an American actor who has played more than 150 roles across film, television, and theater. He won an Emmy for his portrayal of the sadistic gangster Ralph Cifaretto in HBO's The Sopranos. His film roles include Francis Fratelli in The Goonies (1985), Captain Conrad Howard in the Bad Boys film series (1995–2024), Cypher in the Wachowskis' sci-fi action film The Matrix (1999), and Teddy in Christopher Nolan's psychological thriller film Memento (2000).
extract_id: Joseph Peter Pantoliano adalah seorang aktor Amerika yang telah memerankan lebih dari 150 peran dalam film, televisi, dan teater. Dia memenangkan Emmy untuk perannya sebagai gangster sadis Ralph Cifaretto dalam seri HBO The Sopranos. Peran filmnya termasuk Francis Fratelli dalam The Goonies (1985), Kapten Conrad Howard dalam seri film Bad Boys (1995–2024), Cypher dalam film aksi sci-fi karya Wachowskis The Matrix (1999), dan Teddy dalam film thriller psikologis karya Christopher Nolan Memento (2000).

name: Joe Pesci
title: Joe Pesci
extract: Joseph Frank Pesci is an American actor and musician. He is best known for portraying tough, volatile characters in a variety of genres and for his collaborations with Martin Scorsese and Robert De Niro in the films Raging Bull (1980), Goodfellas (1990), Casino (1995), and The Irishman (2019).
extract_id: Joseph Frank Pesci adalah seorang aktor dan musisi Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan karakter keras dan mudah meledak dalam berbagai genre dan karena kolaborasinya dengan Martin Scorsese dan Robert De Niro dalam film-film Raging Bull (1980), Goodfellas (1990), Casino (1995), dan The Irishman (2019).

name: Joe Russo
title: Russo brothers
extract: Anthony J. Russo and Joseph Vincent Russo, collectively known as the Russo brothers, are American filmmakers. They are best known for directing four films in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU): Captain America: The Winter Soldier (2014), Captain America: Civil War (2016), Avengers: Infinity War (2018), and Avengers: Endgame (2019). The pair are the fourth-highest-grossing directors of all time, with Endgame grossing over $2.937 billion worldwide and becoming the highest-grossing film of all time.
extract_id: Anthony J. Russo dan Joseph Vincent Russo, secara kolektif dikenal sebagai bersaudara Russo, adalah pembuat film Amerika. Mereka paling dikenal karena mengarahkan empat film dalam Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU): Captain America: The Winter Soldier (2014), Captain America: Civil War (2016), Avengers: Infinity War (2018), dan Avengers: Endgame (2019). Mereka adalah sutradara keempat dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa, dengan Endgame menghasilkan lebih dari $2.937 miliar di seluruh dunia dan menjadi film dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa.

name: Joe Wright
title: Joe Wright
extract: Joseph Wright is an English filmmaker. He began his career directing music videos and television series, before making his feature directorial debut with Pride & Prejudice (2005), based on the Jane Austen novel. His subsequent works include the period drama adaptations Atonement (2007), Anna Karenina (2012), and Cyrano (2021), the action thriller Hanna (2011), the Peter Pan origin story Pan (2015), and the Winston Churchill biopic Darkest Hour (2017). He also directed the historical drama television series Mussolini: Son of the Century (2025).
extract_id: Joseph Wright adalah seorang pembuat film Inggris. Dia memulai kariernya dengan menyutradarai video musik dan serial televisi, sebelum membuat debut penyutradaraan film panjang dengan Pride & Prejudice (2005), yang didasarkan pada novel karya Jane Austen. Karya-karya berikutnya termasuk adaptasi drama periode Atonement (2007), Anna Karenina (2012), dan Cyrano (2021), thriller aksi Hanna (2011), kisah asal Peter Pan Pan (2015), dan biopik Winston Churchill Darkest Hour (2017). Dia juga menyutradarai serial televisi drama sejarah Mussolini: Son of the Century (2025).

name: Joel Basman
title: Joel Basman
extract: Joel Basman is a Swiss-Israeli actor best known for having played Franz Kafka in the ARD Miniseries Kafka (2024).
extract_id: Joel Basman adalah aktor Swiss-Israel yang paling dikenal karena memerankan Franz Kafka dalam miniseri ARD Kafka (2024).

name: Joel Coen
title: Joel Coen

Working alongside his brother Ethan, he has directed, written, edited and produced many feature films, the most acclaimed of which include Blood Simple (1984), Raising Arizona (1987), Miller's Crossing (1990), Barton Fink (1991), Fargo (1996), The Big Lebowski (1998), O Brother, Where Art Thou? (2000), The Ladykillers (2004), No Country for Old Men (2007), Burn After Reading (2008), A Serious Man (2009), True Grit (2010), Inside Llewyn Davis (2013), Hail, Caesar! (2000), The Ladykillers (2004), No Country for Old Men (2007), Burn After Reading (2008), A Serious Man (2009), True Grit (2010), Inside Llewyn Davis (2013), Hail, Caesar! (2016) dan The Ballad of Buster Scruggs (2018).

name: Joel Edgerton
title: Joel Edgerton
extract: Joel Edgerton is an Australian actor and filmmaker. He is known for his portrayal of Will McGill on the first two seasons of the Australian drama series The Secret Life of Us (2001–2002), and for playing Owen Lars in the Star Wars films Attack of the Clones (2002) and Revenge of the Sith (2005), a role he reprised in the Disney+ series Obi-Wan Kenobi (2022). He also voiced Metal Beak from Warner Bros. Pictures' fantasy adventure film Legend of the Guardians: The Owls of Ga'Hoole (2010). For his portrayal of Richard Loving in the 2016 historical drama Loving, he received a nomination for the Golden Globe Award for Best Actor in a Motion Picture – Drama, and a further nomination in the same category for his critically acclaimed performance in Train Dreams (2025).
extract_id: Joel Edgerton adalah aktor dan pembuat film Australia. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Will McGill pada dua musim pertama serial drama Australia The Secret Life of Us (2001–2002), dan karena memerankan Owen Lars dalam film Star Wars Attack of the Clones (2002) dan Revenge of the Sith (2005), peran yang dia ulangi dalam serial Disney+ Obi-Wan Kenobi (2022). Dia juga mengisi suara Metal Beak dalam film petualangan fantasi Warner Bros. Pictures Legend of the Guardians: The Owls of Ga'Hoole (2010). Untuk perannya sebagai Richard Loving dalam drama sejarah Loving (2016), dia menerima nominasi Golden Globe Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Film Drama, dan nominasi lebih lanjut dalam kategori yang sama untuk penampilannya yang mendapatkan pujian kritis dalam Train Dreams (2025).

name: Joel Grey
title: Joel Grey
description: American actor, singer, dancer, director, and photographer (born 1932)
extract: Joel Grey is an American actor, singer, dancer, photographer, and theatre director. He is best known for portraying the Master of Ceremonies in the musical Cabaret on Broadway and in Bob Fosse's 1972 film adaptation. He has won an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a Tony Award for his performances in the Cabaret stage musical and film. He was presented a Lifetime Achievement Tony Award at the 76th Tony Awards in 2023.
extract_id: Joel Grey adalah aktor, penyanyi, penari, fotografer, dan sutradara teater Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan Master of Ceremonies dalam musikal Cabaret di Broadway dan dalam adaptasi film Bob Fosse tahun 1972. Dia telah memenangkan Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Tony Award untuk penampilannya dalam musikal panggung dan film Cabaret. Dia dianugerahi Lifetime Achievement Tony Award pada Tony Awards ke-76 tahun 2023.

name: Joel Schumacher
title: Joel Schumacher
extract: Joel T. Schumacher was an American filmmaker. During a four-decade career, he directed more than 20 feature length films that spanned various genres. His films were commercially successful, grossing over a combined $1 billion.
extract_id: Joel T. Schumacher adalah pembuat film Amerika. Selama karier empat dekade, dia menyutradarai lebih dari 20 film panjang yang mencakup berbagai genre. Film-filmnya sukses secara komersial, menghasilkan lebih dari $1 miliar secara gabungan.

name: Johan Heldenbergh
title: Johan Heldenbergh
extract: Johan Heldenbergh is a Belgian actor, playwright, screenwriter, theatre director and film director. He gained international fame by starring in films, including A Day in a Life (2007), Moscow, Belgium (2008), The Misfortunates (2009), The Broken Circle Breakdown (2012) and The Zookeeper's Wife (2017).
extract_id: Johan Heldenbergh adalah aktor, dramawan, penulis skenario, sutradara teater, dan sutradara film Belgia. Dia meraih ketenaran internasional dengan membintangi film-film seperti A Day in a Life (2007), Moscow, Belgium (2008), The Misfortunates (2009), The Broken Circle Breakdown (2012) dan The Zookeeper's Wife (2017).

title: Johanna ter Steege

name: John Belushi
title: John Belushi

Belushi had a working partnership with Dan Aykroyd; they had first met while at Chicago's the Second City comedy club, remaining together as cast members on Saturday Night Live.
extract_id: John Adam Belushi adalah seorang komedian, aktor, dan musisi Amerika. Dia adalah salah satu dari tujuh anggota pemeran musim pertama Saturday Night Live. Belushi memiliki kemitraan kerja dengan Dan Aykroyd; mereka pertama kali bertemu saat di klub komedi The Second City di Chicago dan tetap bersama sebagai anggota pemeran Saturday Night Live.

title: John Billingsley

title: John Boles (actor)

name: John Boorman
title: John Boorman
