He is best known for directing feature films such as Point Blank (1967), Hell in the Pacific (1968), Deliverance (1972), Zardoz (1974), Exorcist II: The Heretic (1977), Excalibur (1981), The Emerald Forest (1985), Hope and Glory (1987), The General (1998), The Tailor of Panama (2001) and Queen and Country (2014).
extract_id: Sir John Boorman adalah pembuat film Inggris. Dia paling dikenal sebagai sutradara film-film seperti Point Blank (1967), Hell in the Pacific (1968), Deliverance (1972), Zardoz (1974), Exorcist II: The Heretic (1977), Excalibur (1981), The Emerald Forest (1985), Hope and Glory (1987), The General (1998), The Tailor of Panama (2001) dan Queen and Country (2014).

name: John Boyega
title: John Boyega
extract: John Adedayo Bamidele Adegboyega, known professionally as John Boyega, is an English actor and producer. He first gained recognition in Britain for his role as a teenage gang leader in the comedy horror film Attack the Block (2011) before he had his international breakthrough playing Finn in Star Wars: The Force Awakens (2015). During his time as a cast member of the Star Wars sequel trilogy, Boyega received the BAFTA Rising Star Award in 2016, and the Trophée Chopard at the 2016 Cannes Film Festival.
extract_id: John Adedayo Bamidele Adegboyega, dikenal secara profesional sebagai John Boyega, adalah aktor dan produser Inggris. Dia pertama kali mendapatkan pengakuan di Inggris untuk perannya sebagai pemimpin geng remaja dalam film komedi horor Attack the Block (2011) sebelum mendapatkan terobosan internasional dengan memerankan Finn dalam Star Wars: The Force Awakens (2015). Selama menjadi anggota pemeran trilogi sekuel Star Wars, Boyega menerima BAFTA Rising Star Award pada 2016, dan Trophée Chopard di Festival Film Cannes 2016.

name: John C. Reilly
title: John C. Reilly
extract: John Christopher Reilly is an American actor. A character actor, he is known for his work with leading and supporting roles in both independent films and major studio features. The recipient of various accolades, Reilly is one of only two people to have been nominated for an Emmy Award, a Grammy Award, an Academy Award, and a Tony Award (EGOT) without winning any.
extract_id: John Christopher Reilly adalah aktor Amerika. Sebagai aktor karakter, dia dikenal untuk pekerjaan dengan peran utama dan pendukung baik di film independen maupun film studio besar. Sebagai penerima berbagai penghargaan, Reilly adalah salah satu dari hanya dua orang yang pernah dinominasikan untuk Emmy Award, Grammy Award, Academy Award, dan Tony Award (EGOT) tanpa memenangkan satupun.

name: John Cameron Mitchell
title: John Cameron Mitchell
extract: John Cameron Mitchell is a Tony Award-winning American actor, director, playwright, screenwriter, singer, songwriter and producer. He is known as the writer, director and star of the 2001 film Hedwig and the Angry Inch, which is based on the stage musical of the same name. He also co-created the 2019 musical audio series Anthem: Homunculus and portrayed the role of Joe Exotic in the Peacock limited series Joe vs. Carole in 2022.
extract_id: John Cameron Mitchell adalah aktor, sutradara, dramawan, penulis skenario, penyanyi, penulis lagu dan produser Amerika yang memenangkan Tony Award. Dia dikenal sebagai penulis, sutradara, dan bintang film Hedwig and the Angry Inch (2001), yang didasarkan pada musikal panggung dengan nama yang sama. Dia juga ikut menciptakan seri audio musikal Anthem: Homunculus tahun 2019 dan memerankan peran Joe Exotic dalam serial terbatas Peacock Joe vs. Carole pada tahun 2022.

name: John Candy
title: John Candy
extract: John Franklin Candy was a Canadian actor and comedian best known for his work in Hollywood comedy films.
extract_id: John Franklin Candy adalah aktor dan komedian Kanada yang paling dikenal untuk karyanya dalam film komedi Hollywood.

name: John Carney
title: John Carney (director)
extract: John Carney is an Irish film director, producer, screenwriter, composer, and musician who specialises in musical films. He is best known as the showrunner and executive producer of Modern Love on Amazon Prime Video, for his films Once, Begin Again, and Sing Street. He is also a co-creator of the Irish TV drama series Bachelors Walk.
extract_id: John Carney adalah sutradara film, produser, penulis skenario, komposer, dan musisi Irlandia yang mengkhususkan diri dalam film musikal. Dia paling dikenal sebagai showrunner dan produser eksekutif serial Modern Love di Amazon Prime Video, untuk film-filmnya Once, Begin Again, dan Sing Street. Dia juga merupakan salah satu pencipta serial drama TV Irlandia Bachelors Walk.

name: John Carpenter
title: John Carpenter
extract: John Howard Carpenter is an American filmmaker, composer, and actor. Most commonly associated with horror, action, and science fiction films of the 1970s and 1980s, he is generally recognized as a master of the horror genre. At the 2019 Cannes Film Festival, the French Directors' Guild gave him the Golden Coach Award and lauded him as "a creative genius of raw, fantastic, and spectacular emotions". On April 3, 2025, he received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
extract_id: John Howard Carpenter adalah pembuat film, komponis, dan aktor Amerika. Paling sering dikaitkan dengan film horor, aksi, dan fiksi ilmiah dari tahun 1970-an dan 1980-an, dia umumnya diakui sebagai master genre horor. Pada Festival Film Cannes 2019, French Directors' Guild memberinya Penghargaan Golden Coach dan memuji dia sebagai "jenius kreatif dari emosi yang mentah, fantastis, dan spektakuler". Pada tanggal 3 April 2025, dia menerima bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame.

name: John Carradine
title: John Carradine
extract: John Carradine was an American character actor, who was considered one of the greatest in American cinema. He was a member of Cecil B. DeMille's stock company and later John Ford's company, known for his roles in horror films, Westerns, and Shakespearean theater, most notably portraying Count Dracula in House of Frankenstein (1944), House of Dracula (1945), Billy the Kid Versus Dracula (1966), and Nocturna: Granddaughter of Dracula (1979). Among his other notable roles was "Preacher Casy" in John Ford's The Grapes of Wrath. In later decades of his career, he starred mostly in low-budget B-movies.
extract_id: John Carradine adalah aktor karakter Amerika, yang dianggap sebagai salah satu yang terhebat dalam sinema Amerika. Ia adalah anggota dari perusahaan stok Cecil B. DeMille dan kemudian perusahaan John Ford, dikenal karena perannya dalam film horor, Western, dan teater Shakespeare, terutama memerankan Count Dracula dalam House of Frankenstein (1944), House of Dracula (1945), Billy the Kid Versus Dracula (1966), dan Nocturna: Granddaughter of Dracula (1979). Di antara peran pentingnya lainnya adalah "Preacher Casy" dalam The Grapes of Wrath karya John Ford. Dalam dekade-dekade terakhir kariernya, ia lebih sering membintangi film B dengan anggaran rendah.

name: John Cassavetes
title: John Cassavetes
extract: John Nicholas Cassavetes was a Greek-American filmmaker and actor. He began as an actor in film and television before helping to pioneer modern American independent cinema as a writer and director, often self-financing, producing, and distributing his own films. He received nominations for three Academy Awards, two BAFTA Awards, four Golden Globe Awards, and an Emmy Award.
extract_id: John Nicholas Cassavetes adalah seorang pembuat film dan aktor keturunan Yunani-Amerika. Ia memulai karier sebagai aktor dalam film dan televisi sebelum membantu mempelopori sinema independen Amerika modern sebagai penulis dan sutradara, sering kali membiayai sendiri, memproduksi, dan mendistribusikan film-filmnya sendiri. Ia menerima nominasi untuk tiga Academy Awards, dua BAFTA Awards, empat Golden Globe Awards, dan satu Emmy Award.

name: John Castle
title: John Castle
extract: John Michael Frederick Castle is an English actor. He is best known for his film and television work, most notably playing Bill in Michelangelo Antonioni's Blowup (1966) and Geoffrey in The Lion in Winter (1968). Other significant credits include Man of La Mancha (1972), I, Claudius (1976) and RoboCop 3 (1993). He is also a noted voice actor and has recorded an audiobook version of Vanity Fair.
extract_id: John Michael Frederick Castle adalah aktor Inggris. Ia dikenal terutama karena karya film dan televisinya, terutama memerankan Bill dalam Blowup karya Michelangelo Antonioni (1966) dan Geoffrey dalam The Lion in Winter (1968). Kredit penting lainnya termasuk Man of La Mancha (1972), I, Claudius (1976), dan RoboCop 3 (1993). Ia juga merupakan aktor suara ternama dan telah merekam versi audiobook dari Vanity Fair.

name: John Cazale
title: John Cazale
extract: John Holland Cazale was an American actor. He appeared in five films over seven years. Cazale started as a theater actor in Boston, ranging from regional, to off-Broadway, to Broadway acting alongside Al Pacino, Meryl Streep, and Sam Waterston. Cazale soon became one of Hollywood's premier character actors, starting with his role as the doomed, weak-minded Fredo Corleone alongside longtime friend Pacino in Francis Ford Coppola's The Godfather (1972) and The Godfather Part II (1974). He also appeared in Coppola's The Conversation (1974) and Sidney Lumet's Dog Day Afternoon (1975), the latter of which earned him a Golden Globe Award nomination. In 1977, Cazale was diagnosed with lung cancer, but chose to complete his role in The Deer Hunter (1978). Shortly after filming was completed, he died in New York City on March 13, 1978, aged 42. Archive footage of Cazale in the role of Fredo appears in The Godfather Part III (1990).
extract_id: John Holland Cazale adalah aktor Amerika. Ia tampil dalam lima film selama tujuh tahun. Cazale memulai kariernya sebagai aktor teater di Boston, mulai dari teater regional, off-Broadway, hingga Broadway bersama Al Pacino, Meryl Streep, dan Sam Waterston. Cazale segera menjadi salah satu aktor karakter utama Hollywood, dimulai dengan perannya sebagai Fredo Corleone yang malang dan lemah jiwa bersama sahabat lamanya Pacino dalam The Godfather (1972) dan The Godfather Part II (1974) karya Francis Ford Coppola. Ia juga tampil dalam The Conversation (1974) karya Coppola dan Dog Day Afternoon (1975) karya Sidney Lumet, yang terakhir memberinya nominasi Golden Globe. Pada 1977, Cazale didiagnosis menderita kanker paru-paru, tetapi memilih untuk menyelesaikan perannya dalam The Deer Hunter (1978). Tak lama setelah syuting selesai, ia meninggal di New York City pada 13 Maret 1978, pada usia 42 tahun. Rekaman arsip Cazale sebagai Fredo muncul dalam The Godfather Part III (1990).

name: John Cho
title: John Cho
extract: John Yo-Han Cho is an American actor. As a performer, he is noted for his subtle and understated style of acting. He is known for his roles as Harold Lee in the Harold & Kumar film series (2004–2011), John/MILF guy #2 in the American Pie film series (1999–2012), and Hikaru Sulu in the Star Trek reboot film series (2009–2016).
extract_id: John Yo-Han Cho adalah aktor Amerika. Sebagai seorang pemeran, ia dikenal dengan gaya aktingnya yang halus dan tidak berlebihan. Ia terkenal karena perannya sebagai Harold Lee dalam seri film Harold & Kumar (2004–2011), John/MILF guy #2 dalam seri film American Pie (1999–2012), dan Hikaru Sulu dalam seri film reboot Star Trek (2009–2016).

name: John Cleese
title: John Cleese
extract: John Marwood Cleese is an English actor, comedian, screenwriter, producer, and television presenter. Emerging from the Cambridge Footlights in the 1960s, he first achieved success at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe and as a scriptwriter and performer on The Frost Report (1966–1967). In the late 1960s, he cofounded Monty Python, the comedy troupe that created the surreal sketch comedy series Monty Python's Flying Circus (1969–1974). Along with his Python costars Graham Chapman, Terry Gilliam, Eric Idle, Terry Jones and Michael Palin, Cleese starred in the films Monty Python and the Holy Grail (1975), Life of Brian (1979), and The Meaning of Life (1983).
extract_id: John Marwood Cleese adalah aktor, komedian, penulis skenario, produser, dan pembawa acara televisi asal Inggris. Muncul dari Cambridge Footlights pada 1960-an, ia pertama kali meraih sukses di Edinburgh Festival Fringe dan sebagai penulis skenario serta pemeran dalam The Frost Report (1966–1967). Pada akhir 1960-an, ia ikut mendirikan Monty Python, kelompok komedi yang menciptakan serial komedi sketsa surealis Monty Python's Flying Circus (1969–1974). Bersama rekan-rekan Monty Python Graham Chapman, Terry Gilliam, Eric Idle, Terry Jones, dan Michael Palin, Cleese membintangi film Monty Python and the Holy Grail (1975), Life of Brian (1979), dan The Meaning of Life (1983).

name: John Cusack
title: John Cusack
extract: John Paul Cusack is an American actor and screenwriter. With a career spanning over four decades, he has appeared in over ninety films. He began acting in films during the 1980s, appearing in coming-of-age dramedies such as Sixteen Candles (1984), Better Off Dead (1985), The Sure Thing (1985), Stand by Me (1986), and Say Anything... (1989). Moving away from his teen idol image, he went on to appear in a variety of genres, such as the crime thrillers The Grifters (1990) and The Paperboy (2012), the black comedies Bullets Over Broadway (1994) and Grosse Pointe Blank (1997), the romantic comedy Serendipity (2001), the time-traveling comedy Hot Tub Time Machine (2010), psychological thriller Identity (2003), the action thriller Con Air (1997), and the psychological horror film 1408 (2007).
extract_id: John Paul Cusack adalah aktor dan penulis skenario Amerika. Dengan karier yang berlangsung lebih dari empat dekade, ia telah tampil dalam lebih dari sembilan puluh film. Ia mulai berakting dalam film pada 1980-an, tampil dalam dramedy coming-of-age seperti Sixteen Candles (1984), Better Off Dead (1985), The Sure Thing (1985), Stand by Me (1986), dan Say Anything... (1989). Menjauh dari citra idola remaja, ia kemudian tampil dalam berbagai genre, seperti thriller kriminal The Grifters (1990) dan The Paperboy (2012), komedi gelap Bullets Over Broadway (1994) dan Grosse Pointe Blank (1997), komedi romantis Serendipity (2001), komedi perjalanan waktu Hot Tub Time Machine (2010), thriller psikologis Identity (2003), thriller aksi Con Air (1997), dan film horor psikologis 1408 (2007).

name: John Dall
title: John Dall
extract: John Dall was an American actor. Primarily a stage actor, he is best remembered today for portraying the cool-minded intellectual killer in Alfred Hitchcock's Rope (1948), and the companion of trigger-happy femme fatale Peggy Cummins in the 1950 film noir Gun Crazy. He also had a substantial role in Stanley Kubrick's Spartacus (1960). He first came to fame as the young Welsh mining prodigy who comes alive under the tutelage of Bette Davis in The Corn Is Green (1945), for which he was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor.
extract_id: John Dall adalah aktor Amerika. Utamanya adalah aktor panggung, ia paling dikenang hari ini karena memerankan pembunuh intelektual yang tenang dalam Rope karya Alfred Hitchcock (1948), dan teman dari femme fatale yang suka menembak Peggy Cummins dalam film noir Gun Crazy (1950). Ia juga memiliki peran besar dalam Spartacus (1960) karya Stanley Kubrick. Ia pertama kali terkenal sebagai anak ajaib penambang Welsh muda yang hidup di bawah bimbingan Bette Davis dalam The Corn Is Green (1945), yang memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik.

name: John Fiedler
title: John Fiedler
extract: John Donald Fiedler was an American actor. Recognizable for his distinctive voice, Fiedler's career lasted more than 55 years in stage, film, television and radio.
extract_id: John Donald Fiedler adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal karena suaranya yang khas, karier Fiedler berlangsung lebih dari 55 tahun di panggung, film, televisi, dan radio.

name: John Ford
title: John Ford
extract: John Martin Feeney, better known as John Ford, was an American film director and producer. He is regarded as one of the most important and influential filmmakers during the Golden Age of Hollywood, and was one of the first American directors to be recognized as an auteur. In a career of more than 50 years, he directed over 130 films between 1917 and 1970, and received a record four Academy Awards for Best Director for The Informer (1935), The Grapes of Wrath (1940), How Green Was My Valley (1941), and The Quiet Man (1952).
extract_id: John Martin Feeney, yang lebih dikenal sebagai John Ford, adalah sutradara dan produser film Amerika. Ia dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film terpenting dan paling berpengaruh selama Era Keemasan Hollywood, dan merupakan salah satu sutradara Amerika pertama yang diakui sebagai seorang auteur. Dalam karier lebih dari 50 tahun, ia menyutradarai lebih dari 130 film antara 1917 dan 1970, dan menerima empat Academy Awards rekornya untuk Sutradara Terbaik untuk The Informer (1935), The Grapes of Wrath (1940), How Green Was My Valley (1941), dan The Quiet Man (1952).

name: John Frankenheimer
title: John Frankenheimer
extract: John Michael Frankenheimer was an American film and television director, known both for his social dramas and his action/suspense pictures. Among his best-known theatrical film credits are Birdman of Alcatraz, The Manchurian Candidate, Seven Days in May, The Train, Seconds, Grand Prix, The Fixer (1968), The Iceman Cometh (1973), French Connection II (1975), Black Sunday (1977), 52 Pick-Up (1986), and Ronin (1998).
extract_id: John Michael Frankenheimer adalah sutradara film dan televisi Amerika, dikenal baik untuk drama sosial maupun film aksi/suspensinya. Di antara kredit film teater paling terkenal adalah Birdman of Alcatraz, The Manchurian Candidate, Seven Days in May, The Train, Seconds, Grand Prix, The Fixer (1968), The Iceman Cometh (1973), French Connection II (1975), Black Sunday (1977), 52 Pick-Up (1986), dan Ronin (1998).

name: John Fraser
title: John Fraser (actor)
extract: John Alexander Fraser was a Scottish actor and author. He is best known for his performances in the films The Dam Busters (1955), The Good Companions (1957), The Trials of Oscar Wilde (1960), El Cid (1961), Repulsion (1965) and Isadora (1968).
extract_id: John Alexander Fraser adalah aktor dan penulis Skotlandia. Ia paling dikenal karena penampilannya dalam film The Dam Busters (1955), The Good Companions (1957), The Trials of Oscar Wilde (1960), El Cid (1961), Repulsion (1965), dan Isadora (1968).

name: John G. Avildsen
title: John G. Avildsen
extract: John Guilbert Avildsen was an American film director. He is best known for directing Rocky (1976), which earned him the Academy Award for Best Director. He is also known for directing the first three films in The Karate Kid franchise (1984–1989). Other films he directed include Joe (1970), Save the Tiger (1973), The Formula (1980), Neighbors (1981), Lean on Me (1989), Rocky V (1990), 8 Seconds (1994), and Inferno (1999).
extract_id: John Guilbert Avildsen adalah sutradara film Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai Rocky (1976), yang memberinya Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik. Ia juga dikenal karena menyutradarai tiga film pertama dalam waralaba The Karate Kid (1984–1989). Film lain yang disutradarainya termasuk Joe (1970), Save the Tiger (1973), The Formula (1980), Neighbors (1981), Lean on Me (1989), Rocky V (1990), 8 Seconds (1994), dan Inferno (1999).

name: John Gallagher Jr.
title: John Gallagher Jr.
extract: John Howard Gallagher Jr. is an American actor and musician. He broke out onto the scene with his originating role as Moritz Stiefel in Duncan Sheik's Broadway mega-hit Spring Awakening, which would earn him a Tony Award for Best Featured Actor in a Musical. He has since starred in Green Day's Grammy Award-winning rock opera American Idiot and The Avett Brothers' critically acclaimed musical Swept Away. Notable film and TV roles include Jim Harper in Aaron Sorkin's HBO series The Newsroom, Short Term 12, 10 Cloverfield Lane, and Hush among many others. His music has been described as "emo folk rock".
extract_id: John Howard Gallagher Jr. adalah aktor dan musisi Amerika. Ia memulai karier lewat peran asli sebagai Moritz Stiefel dalam megahit Broadway karya Duncan Sheik Spring Awakening, yang membawanya memenangkan Tony Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam sebuah Musikal. Ia kemudian membintangi opera rock pemenang Grammy American Idiot milik Green Day dan musikal kritis Swept Away milik The Avett Brothers. Peran film dan TV yang menonjol termasuk Jim Harper dalam serial HBO karya Aaron Sorkin The Newsroom, Short Term 12, 10 Cloverfield Lane, dan Hush di antara banyak lainnya. Musiknya telah digambarkan sebagai "emo folk rock".

name: John Gavin
title: John Gavin
extract: John Gavin was an American actor and diplomat who was the president of the Screen Actors Guild (1971–1973) and the United States Ambassador to Mexico (1981–1986). Among the films in which he appeared were A Time to Love and a Time to Die (1958), Imitation of Life (1959), Spartacus (1960), Psycho (1960), Midnight Lace (1960), and Thoroughly Modern Millie (1967), playing leading roles for producer Ross Hunter.
extract_id: John Gavin adalah aktor dan diplomat Amerika yang pernah menjadi presiden Screen Actors Guild (1971–1973) dan Duta Besar Amerika Serikat untuk Meksiko (1981–1986). Di antara film-film yang dibintanginya adalah A Time to Love and a Time to Die (1958), Imitation of Life (1959), Spartacus (1960), Psycho (1960), Midnight Lace (1960), dan Thoroughly Modern Millie (1967), memainkan peran utama untuk produser Ross Hunter.

name: John Getz
title: John Getz
extract: John Getz is an American character actor. After starting his acting career on stage, he has appeared in numerous television series and films, most notably Blood Simple, The Fly, and The Social Network.
extract_id: John Getz adalah aktor karakter Amerika. Setelah memulai karier aktingnya di panggung, ia tampil dalam banyak serial televisi dan film, terutama Blood Simple, The Fly, dan The Social Network.

name: John Gielgud
title: John Gielgud
extract: Sir Arthur John Gielgud was an English actor and theatre director. With his contemporaries Laurence Olivier, Michael Redgrave and Ralph Richardson, he made up a quartet of male actors who dominated the British stage of the mid-20th century. A member of the Terry family theatrical dynasty, his career spanned eight decades. He gained his first paid acting work as a junior member of his cousin Phyllis Neilson-Terry's company in 1922. After studying at the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art (RADA), Gielgud worked in repertory theatre and in the West End before establishing himself at the Old Vic as an exponent of Shakespeare from 1929 to 1931.
extract_id: Sir Arthur John Gielgud adalah aktor dan sutradara teater Inggris. Bersama rekan sezamannya Laurence Olivier, Michael Redgrave, dan Ralph Richardson, ia membentuk kuartet aktor pria yang mendominasi panggung Inggris pertengahan abad ke-20. Sebagai anggota dinasti teater keluarga Terry, kariernya membentang delapan dekade. Ia mendapatkan pekerjaan akting berbayarnya yang pertama sebagai anggota junior dalam perusahaan sepupunya Phyllis Neilson-Terry pada 1922. Setelah belajar di Royal Academy of Dramatic Art (RADA), Gielgud bekerja di teater repertori dan di West End sebelum menegaskan dirinya di Old Vic sebagai pengusung Shakespeare dari 1929 hingga 1931.

name: John Goodman
title: John Goodman
extract: John Stephen Goodman is an American actor. He rose to prominence in television before becoming an acclaimed and popular film actor, with Vanity Fair calling him "among our very finest actors".
extract_id: John Stephen Goodman adalah aktor Amerika. Ia menjadi terkenal di televisi sebelum menjadi aktor film yang diakui dan populer, dengan Vanity Fair menyebutnya "di antara aktor terbaik kita".

name: John Heard
title: John Heard (actor)
extract: John Matthew Heard Jr. was an American actor. He made his debut appearance in film with the ensemble Between the Lines (1977). He appeared in a number of successful films, including Heart Beat (1980), Cutter's Way (1981), Cat People (1982), After Hours (1985), Beaches (1988), Deceived (1991), and as Peter McCallister in Home Alone (1990) and its sequel Home Alone 2: Lost in New York (1992). He was nominated for an Emmy Award in 1999 for his recurring role as corrupt police detective Vin Makazian on The Sopranos (1999–2004).
extract_id: John Matthew Heard Jr. adalah aktor Amerika. Ia melakukan debut filmnya dalam film ensemble Between the Lines (1977). Ia tampil dalam sejumlah film sukses, termasuk Heart Beat (1980), Cutter's Way (1981), Cat People (1982), After Hours (1985), Beaches (1988), Deceived (1991), dan sebagai Peter McCallister dalam Home Alone (1990) dan sekuelnya Home Alone 2: Lost in New York (1992). Ia dinominasikan untuk Emmy Award pada 1999 untuk perannya yang berulang sebagai detektif polisi korup Vin Makazian dalam The Sopranos (1999–2004).

name: John Hillerman
title: John Hillerman
extract: John Benedict Hillerman was an American actor best known for his starring role as Jonathan Quayle Higgins III on the television series Magnum, P.I. that aired from 1980 to 1988. For his role as Higgins, Hillerman earned five Golden Globe nominations, winning in 1981, and four Emmy nominations, winning in 1987. He retired from acting in 1999.
extract_id: John Benedict Hillerman adalah aktor Amerika yang paling dikenal karena peran utama sebagai Jonathan Quayle Higgins III dalam serial televisi Magnum, P.I. yang tayang dari 1980 hingga 1988. Untuk perannya sebagai Higgins, Hillerman meraih lima nominasi Golden Globe, memenangkan pada 1981, dan empat nominasi Emmy, memenangkan pada 1987. Ia pensiun dari dunia akting pada 1999.

name: John Hodgman
title: John Hodgman
extract: John Kellogg Hodgman is an American author, actor, and humorist. In addition to his published written works, such as his satirical trilogy The Areas of My Expertise, More Information Than You Require, and That Is All, he is known for his personification of a PC in contrast to Justin Long's personification of a Mac in Apple's "Get a Mac" advertising campaign, and for his work as a contributor on Comedy Central's The Daily Show with Jon Stewart.
extract_id: John Kellogg Hodgman adalah penulis, aktor, dan humoris Amerika. Selain karya tulis yang diterbitkan, seperti trilogi satirnya The Areas of My Expertise, More Information Than You Require, dan That Is All, ia dikenal karena personifikasinya sebagai PC berlawanan dengan personifikasi Mac oleh Justin Long dalam kampanye iklan "Get a Mac" milik Apple, dan sebagai kontributor di The Daily Show with Jon Stewart di Comedy Central.

name: John Hodiak
title: John Hodiak
extract: John Hodiak was an American actor who worked in radio, stage and film.
extract_id: John Hodiak adalah aktor Amerika yang bekerja di radio, panggung, dan film.

name: John Hubley
title: John Hubley
description: American film director, producer, and screenwriter (1914–1977)
extract: John Kirkham Hubley was an American animated film director, art director, producer, and writer, known for his work with the United Productions of America (UPA) and his own independent studio, Storyboard, Inc.. A pioneer and innovator in the American animation industry, Hubley pushed for more visually and emotionally complex films than the productions at that time of Walt Disney Productions and Warner Bros. Cartoons. He and his second wife, Faith Hubley, worked side by side from 1953 onward, earning seven Academy Award nominations, of which they won three.
extract_id: John Kirkham Hubley adalah sutradara film animasi Amerika, sutradara seni, produser, dan penulis, dikenal karena karyanya dengan United Productions of America (UPA) dan studio independennya sendiri, Storyboard, Inc.. Sebagai pelopor dan inovator dalam industri animasi Amerika, Hubley mendorong pembuatan film yang lebih kompleks secara visual dan emosional dibanding produksi Walt Disney Productions dan Warner Bros. Cartoons pada saat itu. Ia dan istri keduanya, Faith Hubley, bekerja berdampingan sejak 1953, meraih tujuh nominasi Academy Award dan memenangkan tiga di antaranya.

name: John Hughes
title: John Hughes
extract: Jonathan Wilden Hughes Jr. was an American filmmaker, writer, and producer. He is best known for writing, directing, and producing the films Sixteen Candles (1984), The Breakfast Club (1985), Weird Science (1985), Ferris Bueller's Day Off (1986), Planes, Trains and Automobiles (1987), and Uncle Buck (1989), in addition to writing the films Pretty in Pink (1986), National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation (1989), Home Alone (1990), 101 Dalmatians (1996), and Flubber (1997).
extract_id: Jonathan Wilden Hughes Jr. adalah pembuat film, penulis, dan produser Amerika. Ia paling dikenal sebagai penulis, sutradara, dan produser film Sixteen Candles (1984), The Breakfast Club (1985), Weird Science (1985), Ferris Bueller's Day Off (1986), Planes, Trains and Automobiles (1987), dan Uncle Buck (1989), selain menulis film Pretty in Pink (1986), National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation (1989), Home Alone (1990), 101 Dalmatians (1996), dan Flubber (1997).

name: John Hurt
title: John Hurt
extract: Sir John Vincent Hurt was an English actor. Regarded as one of the finest actors of his generation and described as having the "most distinctive voice in Britain", he was referred to by David Lynch as "simply the greatest actor in the world". John Hurt's career spanned more than five decades. During that time, he was the recipient of numerous accolades, including four BAFTAs and a Golden Globe, in addition to nominations for two Academy Awards. John Hurt was knighted in 2015 for his services to drama.
extract_id: Sir John Vincent Hurt adalah aktor Inggris. Dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terbaik dari generasinya dan dikenal memiliki "suara paling khas di Inggris", ia disebut oleh David Lynch sebagai "sederhana aktor terbesar di dunia". Karier John Hurt berlangsung lebih dari lima dekade. Selama waktu itu, ia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk empat BAFTA dan satu Golden Globe, selain nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards. John Hurt dianugerahi gelar kebangsawanan pada 2015 atas jasa-jasanya dalam drama.

name: John Huston
title: John Huston
extract: John Marcellus Huston was an American and Irish filmmaker and actor. In a career spanning five decades, he wrote the screenplays for many of the 37 feature films he directed, many of which are today considered classics. He received numerous accolades including two Academy Awards and three Golden Globe Awards, as well as a nomination for a BAFTA Award. He also received the BAFTA Fellowship in 1980, a Special Lion for the Overall Work in 1985, and a Silver Lion in 1953.
extract_id: John Marcellus Huston adalah seorang pembuat film dan aktor Amerika dan Irlandia. Dalam kariernya yang berlangsung selama lima dekade, ia menulis skenario untuk banyak dari 37 film panjang yang disutradarainya, banyak di antaranya sekarang dianggap sebagai klasik. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk dua Academy Awards dan tiga Golden Globe Awards, serta nominasi untuk BAFTA Award. Ia juga menerima BAFTA Fellowship pada 1980, Special Lion untuk Karya Keseluruhan pada 1985, dan Silver Lion pada 1953.

name: John Landis
title: John Landis
extract: John Landis is an American filmmaker and actor. He is best known for directing comedy films such as The Kentucky Fried Movie (1977), National Lampoon's Animal House (1978), The Blues Brothers (1980), Trading Places (1983), Three Amigos (1986), Coming to America (1988), and Beverly Hills Cop III (1994), as well as horror films such as An American Werewolf in London (1981), Twilight Zone: The Movie (1983), and Innocent Blood (1992). He also directed the music videos for Michael Jackson's "Thriller" (1983) and "Black or White" (1991).
extract_id: John Landis adalah pembuat film dan aktor Amerika. Ia terkenal karena menyutradarai film komedi seperti The Kentucky Fried Movie (1977), National Lampoon's Animal House (1978), The Blues Brothers (1980), Trading Places (1983), Three Amigos (1986), Coming to America (1988), dan Beverly Hills Cop III (1994), serta film horor seperti An American Werewolf in London (1981), Twilight Zone: The Movie (1983), dan Innocent Blood (1992). Ia juga menyutradarai video musik untuk "Thriller" (1983) dan "Black or White" (1991) oleh Michael Jackson.

name: John Lasseter
title: John Lasseter
extract: John Alan Lasseter is an American film director, producer, screenwriter, and animator. He was previously the chief creative officer of Pixar Animation Studios, Walt Disney Animation Studios, and Disneytoon Studios, as well as the principal creative advisor for Walt Disney Imagineering, and has served as the head of animation at Skydance Animation since 2019.
extract_id: John Alan Lasseter adalah sutradara film, produser, penulis skenario, dan animator Amerika. Ia sebelumnya menjabat sebagai chief creative officer Pixar Animation Studios, Walt Disney Animation Studios, dan Disneytoon Studios, serta penasihat kreatif utama untuk Walt Disney Imagineering, dan telah menjabat sebagai kepala animasi di Skydance Animation sejak 2019.

name: John Lee Hancock
title: John Lee Hancock
extract: John Lee Hancock Jr. is an American filmmaker. He is best known for directing the films The Rookie (2002), The Alamo (2004), The Blind Side (2009), Saving Mr. Banks (2013), The Founder (2016), The Highwaymen (2019), The Little Things (2021), and Mr. Harrigan's Phone (2022). He also wrote the screenplay for the film A Perfect World (1993).
extract_id: John Lee Hancock Jr. adalah pembuat film Amerika. Ia dikenal karena menyutradarai film The Rookie (2002), The Alamo (2004), The Blind Side (2009), Saving Mr. Banks (2013), The Founder (2016), The Highwaymen (2019), The Little Things (2021), dan Mr. Harrigan's Phone (2022). Ia juga menulis skenario film A Perfect World (1993).

name: John Leguizamo
title: John Leguizamo
description: Colombian and American comedian, actor and filmmaker (born 1960 or 1964)
extract: John Alberto Leguizamo Peláez is a Colombian and American comedian, actor and filmmaker. He has received various accolades, including a Special Tony Award in 2018 for his body of theatre work and for bringing diverse stories to Broadway theatre.

name: John Wayne
title: John Wayne
extract: Marion Robert Morrison, known professionally as John Wayne, was an American actor. Nicknamed "Duke", he became a popular icon through his starring roles in films which were produced during Hollywood's Golden Age, especially in Western and war movies. His career flourished from the silent film era of the 1920s to the American New Wave in the 1970s, as he appeared in a total of 179 film and television productions. He was among the top box-office draws for three decades, and appeared with many other important Hollywood stars of his era. In 1999, the American Film Institute selected Wayne as one of the greatest male stars of classic American cinema.
extract_id: Marion Robert Morrison, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai John Wayne, adalah aktor Amerika. Dijuluki "Duke", ia menjadi ikon populer melalui perannya sebagai pemeran utama dalam film-film yang diproduksi selama Masa Keemasan Hollywood, terutama dalam film Barat dan perang. Kariernya berkembang dari era film bisu tahun 1920-an hingga American New Wave di tahun 1970-an, dengan total penampilan dalam 179 produksi film dan televisi. Ia menjadi salah satu daya tarik box-office teratas selama tiga dekade, dan tampil bersama banyak bintang Hollywood penting di masanya. Pada tahun 1999, American Film Institute memilih Wayne sebagai salah satu bintang pria terbesar dalam sinema klasik Amerika.

name: John Williams
title: John Williams
extract: John Towner Williams is an American composer and conductor. Over his seven-decade career, he has composed many of the best-known scores in film history. His style blends romanticism and impressionism with complex orchestration. Best known for his collaborations with George Lucas and Steven Spielberg, he has received numerous accolades, including 27 Grammy Awards, five Academy Awards, seven BAFTA Awards, three Emmy Awards and four Golden Globe Awards. With a total of 54 Academy Award nominations, he is the second-most-nominated person in the award's history, after Walt Disney. He is also the oldest Academy Award nominee in any category, receiving a nomination at 91 years old.
extract_id: John Towner Williams adalah komponis dan konduktor Amerika. Selama kariernya yang berlangsung lebih dari tujuh dekade, ia telah menciptakan banyak skor film yang paling dikenal dalam sejarah sinema. Gaya musiknya memadukan romantisisme dan impresionisme dengan orkestrasi yang kompleks. Terkenal karena kolaborasinya dengan George Lucas dan Steven Spielberg, ia telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk 27 Grammy Awards, lima Academy Awards, tujuh BAFTA Awards, tiga Emmy Awards, dan empat Golden Globe Awards. Dengan total 54 nominasi Academy Award, ia adalah orang dengan nominasi terbanyak kedua dalam sejarah penghargaan tersebut, setelah Walt Disney. Ia juga merupakan nomine Academy Award tertua di segala kategori, menerima nominasi pada usia 91 tahun.

title: John Woo

He is known for his highly chaotic "bullet ballet" action sequences, stylized imagery, Mexican standoffs, frequent use of slow motion and allusions to wuxia, film noir and Western cinema.

Ia dikenal dengan adegan aksi "bullet ballet" yang sangat kacau, citra bergaya, pertarungan ala Meksiko, penggunaan gerakan lambat yang sering, serta alusi pada wuxia, film noir, dan sinema Barat.

name: Jonathan Levine

name: Jonathan Lynn
title: Jonathan Lynn

name: Jonathan Pryce
title: Jonathan Pryce
extract: Sir Jonathan Pryce is a Welsh actor. He is known for his performances on stage and in film and television. name: Jonathan Rhys Meyers
title: Jonathan Rhys Meyers

name: Jonny Lee Miller
title: Jonny Lee Miller

He has appeared in several theatrical productions, most notably After Miss Julie and Frankenstein, the latter of which earned him an Olivier Award for Best Actor.

Ia telah tampil dalam beberapa produksi teater, terutama After Miss Julie dan Frankenstein, yang terakhir memberinya Olivier Award untuk Aktor Terbaik.

title: José Coronado

name: Josef Altin
title: Josef Altin
extract: Josef Altin is a British television and film actor who had the role of Pypar in the HBO fantasy TV series Game of Thrones. Moore The Empire di Royal Court Theatre di London. Altin juga memerankan Darren dalam Him & Her, sebuah seri TV BBC.

name: Joseph Calleia
title: Joseph Calleia
extract: Joseph Calleia was a Maltese-born American actor and singer on the stage and in films, radio and television. After serving in the British Transport Service during World War I, he travelled to the United States and began his career on the stage, initially in musical comedy, but later in original Broadway productions such as Broadway (1926), The Front Page (1928), The Last Mile (1930), and Grand Hotel (1930). Calleia became a star with the play Small Miracle (1934), his first real role as a villain, and he was put under contract by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer.
extract_id: Joseph Calleia adalah aktor dan penyanyi Amerika kelahiran Malta di atas panggung, film, radio, dan televisi. Setelah bertugas di British Transport Service selama Perang Dunia I, ia pergi ke Amerika Serikat dan memulai kariernya di panggung, awalnya dalam komedi musikal, tetapi kemudian dalam produksi Broadway asli seperti Broadway (1926), The Front Page (1928), The Last Mile (1930), dan Grand Hotel (1930). Calleia menjadi bintang dengan drama Small Miracle (1934), peran pertamanya sebagai penjahat, dan ia kemudian dikontrak oleh Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer.

name: Joseph Cotten
title: Joseph Cotten
extract: Joseph Cheshire Cotten Jr. was an American film, stage, radio and television actor. Cotten achieved prominence on Broadway, starring in the original stage productions of The Philadelphia Story (1939) and Sabrina Fair (1953). He gained worldwide fame for his collaborations with Orson Welles on films Citizen Kane (1941), The Magnificent Ambersons (1942), and Journey into Fear (1943). Cotten starred in the latter and was also credited with the screenplay.
extract_id: Joseph Cheshire Cotten Jr. adalah aktor film, panggung, radio, dan televisi Amerika. name: Joseph Kosinski
title: Joseph Kosinski

name: Joseph L. Mankiewicz
title: Joseph L. Mankiewicz
extract: Joseph Leo Mankiewicz was an American filmmaker. A four-time Academy Award winner, he is best known for his witty and literate dialogue and his preference for voice-over narration and narrative flashbacks. Also known as an actor's director, Mankiewicz directed several prominent actors, including Bette Davis, Gene Tierney, Humphrey Bogart and Elizabeth Taylor, to several of their memorable onscreen performances.
extract_id: Joseph Leo Mankiewicz adalah pembuat film Amerika. Pemenang empat Academy Award, ia dikenal karena dialognya yang cerdas dan berwawasan serta preferensinya untuk narasi suara dan kilas balik naratif. Dikenal sebagai sutradara aktor, Mankiewicz mengarahkan beberapa aktor terkenal, termasuk Bette Davis, Gene Tierney, Humphrey Bogart, dan Elizabeth Taylor, dalam beberapa penampilan mereka yang berkesan di layar.

name: Joseph Sargent
title: Joseph Sargent

title: Joyce Carey

name: Judi Dench
title: Judi Dench
extract: Dame Judith Olivia Dench is an English retired actress. Widely considered one of Britain's greatest actresses, she is noted for her versatile roles on stage and screen. Dench has garnered various accolades throughout a career that spans seven decades, including an Academy Award, a Tony Award, two Golden Globe Awards, four British Academy Television Awards, six British Academy Film Awards (BAFTAs), and seven Olivier Awards.
extract_id: Dame Judith Olivia Dench adalah aktris Inggris yang sudah pensiun. Dianggap sebagai salah satu aktris terbaik Inggris, ia dikenal dengan peran-peran serbagunanya di panggung dan layar. Dench telah menerima berbagai penghargaan selama karier yang berlangsung tujuh dekade, termasuk Academy Award, Tony Award, dua Golden Globe Awards, empat British Academy Television Awards, enam British Academy Film Awards (BAFTA), dan tujuh Olivier Awards.

name: Judith Anderson
title: Judith Anderson
extract: Dame Frances Margaret Anderson, known professionally as Judith Anderson, was an Australian actress who had a successful career in stage, film, and television.
extract_id: Dame Frances Margaret Anderson, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Judith Anderson, adalah aktris Australia yang memiliki karier sukses di panggung, film, dan televisi.

name: Judith O'Dea
title: Judith O'Dea
extract: Judith O'Dea is an American actress. She portrayed Barbra in the 1968 George A. Romero classic horror film Night of the Living Dead and Vampira in the 2024 cult comedy Vampire Zombies... from Space!
extract_id: Judith O'Dea adalah aktris Amerika. Dia memerankan Barbra dalam film horor klasik George A. Romero tahun 1968 Night of the Living Dead dan Vampira dalam film komedi kultus tahun 2024 Vampire Zombies... from Space!

name: Judy Davis
title: Judy Davis
description: Australian film, television, and stage actress (born 1955)
extract: Judith Davis is an Australian actress. Regarded as one of the finest actresses of her generation, she is known for her work across both screen and stage, often in roles of brittle, neurotic women in independent media. Her accolades include a record nine AACTA Awards, three Primetime Emmy Awards, two British Academy Film Awards and two Golden Globe Awards, in addition to nominations for two Academy Awards and a Laurence Olivier Award. Her frequent collaborator, director Woody Allen, has described her as "one of the most exciting actresses in the world".
extract_id: Judith Davis adalah aktris Australia. Dianggap sebagai salah satu aktris terbaik di generasinya, dia dikenal atas karyanya di layar dan panggung, sering kali memerankan wanita rapuh dan neurotik dalam media independen. Penghargaan yang diperolehnya termasuk rekornya sembilan AACTA Awards, tiga Primetime Emmy Awards, dua British Academy Film Awards, dan dua Golden Globe Awards, selain nominasi dua Academy Awards dan satu Laurence Olivier Award. Kolaboratornya yang sering, sutradara Woody Allen, menyebutnya sebagai "salah satu aktris paling mengasyikkan di dunia."

name: Jules Dassin
title: Jules Dassin
description: American filmmaker, theatre director and actor (1911–2008)
extract: Julius "Jules" Dassin was an American film and theatre director, producer, writer and actor. A subject of the Hollywood blacklist, he subsequently moved to France, and later Greece, where he continued his career. He was best-known for his noir and crime films, though he also worked in other genres. He won the Best Director Award at the 1955 Cannes Film Festival for his pioneering heist film Rififi, and received Academy Award nominations for Best Director and Best Original Screenplay for Never on Sunday (1960).
extract_id: Julius "Jules" Dassin adalah sutradara, produser, penulis, dan aktor film serta teater Amerika. Sebagai bagian dari daftar hitam Hollywood, dia kemudian pindah ke Prancis, dan kemudian ke Yunani, di mana dia melanjutkan kariernya. Dia paling dikenal untuk film-film noir dan kriminalnya, meskipun juga bekerja di genre lain. Dia memenangkan Penghargaan Sutradara Terbaik di Festival Film Cannes 1955 untuk film perampokan perintisnya Rififi, dan menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik dan Skenario Asli Terbaik untuk Never on Sunday (1960).

name: Julia Jones
title: Julia Jones
extract: Julia Jones is an American actress. She is best known for playing Leah Clearwater in The Twilight Saga film series and Angela Bishop in the television series Dexter: New Blood, and for guest starring as Kohana in "Kiksuya", acclaimed as one of the best episodes in the four-year run of the series Westworld.
extract_id: Julia Jones adalah aktris Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan Leah Clearwater dalam seri film The Twilight Saga dan Angela Bishop dalam seri televisi Dexter: New Blood, serta tampil sebagai tamu sebagai Kohana dalam episode "Kiksuya", yang diakui sebagai salah satu episode terbaik selama empat tahun perjalanan seri Westworld.

name: Julia Ormond
title: Julia Ormond
extract: Julia Karin Ormond is an English actress. She rose to prominence during the 1990s by appearing in Legends of the Fall (1994), First Knight (1995) and Sabrina (1995). She won the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Limited or Anthology Series or Movie for her role in the HBO film Temple Grandin (2010). She is also known for her role in The Walking Dead: World Beyond (2020) as a main antagonist.
extract_id: Julia Karin Ormond adalah aktris Inggris. Dia menjadi terkenal pada tahun 1990-an dengan tampil dalam Legends of the Fall (1994), First Knight (1995), dan Sabrina (1995). Dia memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik dalam Seri Terbatas atau Antologi atau Film untuk perannya dalam film HBO Temple Grandin (2010). Dia juga dikenal untuk perannya dalam The Walking Dead: World Beyond (2020) sebagai antagonis utama.

name: Julia Roberts
title: Julia Roberts
extract: Julia Fiona Roberts is an American actress. Known for her leading roles across several genres, she has received various accolades, including an Academy Award, a British Academy Film Award, and three Golden Globes. She became known for playing charming and relatable characters in romantic comedies and blockbusters, before expanding into dramas, thrillers, and independent films.
extract_id: Julia Fiona Roberts adalah aktris Amerika. Dikenal karena peran utama dalam beberapa genre, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, British Academy Film Award, dan tiga Golden Globes. Dia dikenal memainkan karakter-karakter yang memikat dan mudah dihubungkan dalam komedi romantis dan film blockbuster, sebelum berkembang ke drama, thriller, dan film independen.

name: Julia Stiles
title: Julia Stiles
extract: Julia O'Hara Stiles is an American actress and director. Stiles began acting at the age of 11 as part of New York's La MaMa Experimental Theatre Club. Her film debut was a small role at age 15 in I Love You, I Love You Not (1996), followed by a lead role in Wicked (1998) for which she received the Karlovy Vary Film Festival Award for Best Actress. Stiles co-starred in the made-for-TV mini-series The '60s (1999) as a teenage daughter in a middle-class American family from Chicago. She rose to prominence with leading roles in teen films such as 10 Things I Hate About You (1999), Down to You (2001), and Save the Last Dance (2001). Her accolades include a Teen Choice Award and two MTV Movie Awards, as well as nominations for a Golden Globe Award, and Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Julia O'Hara Stiles adalah aktris dan sutradara Amerika. Stiles memulai akting pada usia 11 tahun sebagai bagian dari La MaMa Experimental Theatre Club di New York. Debut filmnya adalah peran kecil pada usia 15 tahun dalam I Love You, I Love You Not (1996), diikuti oleh peran utama dalam Wicked (1998) yang membuatnya menerima Karlovy Vary Film Festival Award untuk Aktris Terbaik. Stiles membintangi mini-seri TV The '60s (1999) sebagai putri remaja dalam keluarga kelas menengah Amerika dari Chicago. Dia meraih ketenaran dengan peran utama dalam film remaja seperti 10 Things I Hate About You (1999), Down to You (2001), dan Save the Last Dance (2001). Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk Teen Choice Award dan dua MTV Movie Awards, serta nominasi Golden Globe Award dan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Julian Arahanga
title: Julian Arahanga
extract: Julian Arahanga is a New Zealand actor and filmmaker.
extract_id: Julian Arahanga adalah aktor dan pembuat film asal Selandia Baru.

name: Julian Dennison
title: Julian Dennison
extract: Julian Bailey Dennison is a New Zealand actor. He starred in the 2013 film Shopping for which he won the Rialto Channel New Zealand Film Award for Best Supporting Actor in that year. He is known for his roles as Ricky Baker in Hunt for the Wilderpeople (2016), the highest-grossing New Zealand film in history, Russell "Firefist" Collins in Deadpool 2 (2018), and Belsnickel in The Christmas Chronicles 2. He also played Josh Valentine in Godzilla vs. Kong in 2021 and had a leading role in the film Uproar (2023). He also played Fishlegs in How to Train Your Dragon (2025).
extract_id: Julian Bailey Dennison adalah aktor asal Selandia Baru. Dia membintangi film Shopping tahun 2013 yang membuatnya memenangkan Rialto Channel New Zealand Film Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik tahun itu. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Ricky Baker dalam Hunt for the Wilderpeople (2016), film Selandia Baru dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang sejarah, Russell "Firefist" Collins dalam Deadpool 2 (2018), dan Belsnickel dalam The Christmas Chronicles 2. Dia juga memerankan Josh Valentine dalam Godzilla vs. Kong pada 2021 dan memiliki peran utama dalam film Uproar (2023). Dia juga memerankan Fishlegs dalam How to Train Your Dragon (2025).

name: Julian Sands
title: Julian Sands
extract: Julian Richard Morley Sands was an English actor. He had co-starring roles in Oxford Blues and The Killing Fields in 1984. The following year, Sands played George Emerson in A Room with a View; this became his breakout role. He then went on to appear in Gothic (1986); Warlock (1989); Arachnophobia (1990); Naked Lunch (1991); Leaving Las Vegas (1995); and The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo (2011). His television roles included Nick Hardaway in Rose Red (2002), Vladimir Bierko in 24 (2006) and Jor-El in Smallville (2009–2010); he also voiced the character of Valmont in Jackie Chan Adventures (2000–2002).
extract_id: Julian Richard Morley Sands adalah aktor Inggris. Dia memiliki peran pendukung dalam Oxford Blues dan The Killing Fields pada 1984. Tahun berikutnya, Sands memerankan George Emerson dalam A Room with a View; ini menjadi peran terobosannya. Dia kemudian tampil dalam Gothic (1986); Warlock (1989); Arachnophobia (1990); Naked Lunch (1991); Leaving Las Vegas (1995); dan The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo (2011). Peran televisinya termasuk Nick Hardaway dalam Rose Red (2002), Vladimir Bierko dalam 24 (2006), dan Jor-El dalam Smallville (2009–2010); dia juga menyuarakan karakter Valmont dalam Jackie Chan Adventures (2000–2002).

name: Julian Schnabel
title: Julian Schnabel
extract: Julian Schnabel is an American painter and filmmaker. In the 1980s, he received international attention for his "plate paintings"—with broken ceramic plates set onto large-scale paintings. Since the 1990s, he has been a proponent of independent arthouse cinema. Schnabel directed Before Night Falls, which became Javier Bardem's breakthrough Academy Award-nominated role, and The Diving Bell and the Butterfly, which was nominated for four Academy Awards. For the latter, he won the Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Director, as well as the Golden Globe Award for Best Director, and also received nominations for the Academy Award for Best Director and the César Award for Best Director.
extract_id: Julian Schnabel adalah pelukis dan pembuat film Amerika. Pada 1980-an, dia mendapatkan perhatian internasional untuk "plate paintings"-nya—lukisan skala besar yang dihiasi pecahan piring keramik. Sejak 1990-an, dia menjadi pendukung sinema arthouse independen. Schnabel menyutradarai Before Night Falls, yang menjadi peran terobosan Javier Bardem yang dinominasikan Academy Award, dan The Diving Bell and the Butterfly, yang dinominasikan dalam empat kategori Academy Awards. Untuk yang terakhir, dia memenangkan Penghargaan Sutradara Terbaik Festival Film Cannes, Golden Globe Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik, dan juga menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik serta César Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik.

name: Juliane Köhler
title: Juliane Köhler
extract: Juliane Köhler is a German theatre, television and film actress. She was born in Göttingen to a puppeteer. During the period from 1985 to 1988, she studied under Uta Hagen in New York City and attended HB Studio. She also received ballet instruction in Munich. Since her first appearance at Hanover's Lower Saxon State Theatre in 1988, she has regularly appeared in German theatre productions. She performed in an ensemble cast of the Bavarian State Theatre during 1993–1997. She left the company because her filming of Aimée & Jaguar interfered with rehearsals for a production of Das Käthchen von Heilbronn. She later returned to Munich to participate with the Munich Kammerspiele.
extract_id: Juliane Köhler adalah aktris teater, televisi, dan film asal Jerman. Dia lahir di Göttingen dari orang tua seorang dalang. Antara 1985 hingga 1988, dia belajar di bawah bimbingan Uta Hagen di New York City dan menghadiri HB Studio. Dia juga menerima instruksi balet di Munich. Sejak penampilannya pertama di Hanover's Lower Saxon State Theatre pada 1988, dia secara rutin tampil dalam produksi teater Jerman. Dia tampil dalam kast ansambel Bavarian State Theatre selama 1993–1997. Dia meninggalkan perusahaan tersebut karena syuting film Aimée & Jaguar mengganggu latihan produksi Das Käthchen von Heilbronn. Kemudian dia kembali ke Munich untuk bergabung dengan Munich Kammerspiele.

name: Julianne Moore
title: Julianne Moore
extract: Julie Anne Smith, known professionally as Julianne Moore, is an American actress. Prolific in independent films and blockbusters since the early 1990s, she is particularly known for her portrayals of emotionally troubled and vulnerable women. She is the recipient of numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, two Golden Globe Awards, and two Emmy Awards. Additionally, she is one of only two women to have won an acting award at each of the world's three major film festivals.
extract_id: Julie Anne Smith, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Julianne Moore, adalah aktris Amerika. Produktif dalam film independen dan blockbuster sejak awal 1990-an, dia terkenal karena perannya yang menggambarkan wanita yang mengalami gangguan emosional dan rentan. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dua Golden Globe Awards, dan dua Emmy Awards. Selain itu, dia adalah salah satu dari dua wanita yang memenangkan penghargaan akting pada ketiga festival film terbesar di dunia.

name: Julianne Nicholson
title: Julianne Nicholson
extract: Julianne Nicholson is an American actress. She is known for her roles in the film August: Osage County (2013) and the television series Law & Order: Criminal Intent (2006–2009), Masters of Sex (2013–2014), Eyewitness (2016), Mare of Easttown (2021), Paradise and Hacks, the latter three of which earned her nominations for Primetime Emmy Awards, winning two for Mare of Easttown and Hacks.
extract_id: Julianne Nicholson adalah aktris Amerika. Dia dikenal untuk perannya dalam film August: Osage County (2013) dan serial televisi Law & Order: Criminal Intent (2006–2009), Masters of Sex (2013–2014), Eyewitness (2016), Mare of Easttown (2021), Paradise dan Hacks, tiga yang terakhir memberinya nominasi Primetime Emmy Awards, memenangkan dua untuk Mare of Easttown dan Hacks.

name: Julie Andrews
title: Julie Andrews
extract: Dame Julie Andrews is an English actress, singer, author and theater director. Her accolades include an Academy Award, a British Academy Film Award, two Grammy Awards, four Emmy Awards, seven Golden Globe Awards and nominations for three Tony Awards. One of the biggest box office draws of the 1960s, Andrews has been honoured with the Kennedy Center Honors in 2001, the Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award in 2007, and the AFI Life Achievement Award in 2022. She was made a Dame (DBE) by Queen Elizabeth II in the 2000 New Year Honours.
extract_id: Dame Julie Andrews adalah aktris, penyanyi, penulis, dan sutradara teater Inggris. Penghargaannya meliputi Academy Award, British Academy Film Award, dua Grammy Awards, empat Emmy Awards, tujuh Golden Globe Awards, dan nominasi untuk tiga Tony Awards. Sebagai salah satu bintang box office terbesar tahun 1960-an, Andrews telah dianugerahi Kennedy Center Honors pada 2001, Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award pada 2007, dan AFI Life Achievement Award pada 2022. Dia diangkat menjadi Dame (DBE) oleh Ratu Elizabeth II dalam penghargaan Tahun Baru 2000.

name: Julie Christie
title: Julie Christie
extract: Julie Frances Christie is a British actress. Christie's accolades include an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe, and a Screen Actors Guild Award. She has appeared in six films ranked in the British Film Institute's BFI Top 100 British films of the 20th century, and in 1997, she received the BAFTA Fellowship for lifetime achievement.
extract_id: Julie Frances Christie adalah aktris Inggris. Penghargaan Christie meliputi Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Golden Globe, dan Screen Actors Guild Award. Dia tampil dalam enam film yang masuk daftar BFI Top 100 British films of the 20th century, dan pada 1997, dia menerima BAFTA Fellowship untuk pencapaian seumur hidup.

name: Julie Delpy
title: Julie Delpy
extract: Julie Delpy is a French actress, screenwriter, film director, and musician. She studied filmmaking at NYU's Tisch School of the Arts and has directed, written, and acted in more than 30 films, including Europa Europa (1990), Voyager (1991), Three Colours: White (1993), the Before trilogy, An American Werewolf in Paris (1997), and 2 Days in Paris (2007).
extract_id: Julie Delpy adalah aktris, penulis skenario, sutradara film, dan musisi Prancis. Dia belajar pembuatan film di Tisch School of the Arts NYU dan telah menyutradarai, menulis, serta berakting dalam lebih dari 30 film, termasuk Europa Europa (1990), Voyager (1991), Three Colours: White (1993), trilogi Before, An American Werewolf in Paris (1997), dan 2 Days in Paris (2007).

name: Julie Hagerty
title: Julie Hagerty
extract: Julie Beth Hagerty is an American actress. She starred as Elaine Dickinson in the films Airplane! (1980) and Airplane II: The Sequel (1982). Her other film roles include A Midsummer Night's Sex Comedy (1982), Lost in America (1985), What About Bob? (1991), She's the Man (2006), A Master Builder (2014), Instant Family (2018), Noelle, Marriage Story, and A Christmas Story Christmas (2022).
extract_id: Julie Beth Hagerty adalah aktris Amerika. Dia membintangi sebagai Elaine Dickinson dalam film Airplane! (1980) dan Airplane II: The Sequel (1982). Peran film lainnya termasuk A Midsummer Night's Sex Comedy (1982), Lost in America (1985), What About Bob? (1991), She's the Man (2006), A Master Builder (2014), Instant Family (2018), Noelle, Marriage Story, dan A Christmas Story Christmas (2022).

name: Julie Harris
title: Julie Harris
extract: Julia Ann Harris was an American actress. Widely regarded as one of the greatest actresses of the American theater, she earned numerous accolades including a record five Tony Awards for Best Lead Actress in a Play, as well as three Primetime Emmy Awards and a Grammy Award, in addition to nominations for an Academy Award and a BAFTA Award. She was inducted into the American Theater Hall of Fame in 1979, received the National Medal of Arts in 1994, the Special Lifetime Achievement Tony Award in 2002, and the Kennedy Center Honor in 2005.
extract_id: Julia Ann Harris adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu aktris terbesar dalam teater Amerika, ia meraih berbagai penghargaan termasuk rekor lima Tony Awards untuk Best Lead Actress in a Play, serta tiga Primetime Emmy Awards dan satu Grammy Award, selain nominasi untuk Academy Award dan BAFTA Award. Ia dimasukkan ke American Theater Hall of Fame pada tahun 1979, menerima National Medal of Arts pada tahun 1994, Special Lifetime Achievement Tony Award pada tahun 2002, dan Kennedy Center Honor pada tahun 2005.

name: Julie Kavner
title: Julie Kavner
extract: Julie Deborah Kavner is an American actress. Before becoming well known for her voice role as Marge Simpson on the animated television series The Simpsons, Kavner attracted notice for her role as Brenda Morgenstern, the younger sister of Valerie Harper's title character in the sitcom Rhoda, for which she won a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Comedy Series. She also voices other characters for The Simpsons, including Marge's mother, Jacqueline Bouvier, sisters Patty and Selma Bouvier, and half-step-great-aunt Eunice Bouvier.
extract_id: Julie Deborah Kavner adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Sebelum dikenal luas karena peran suaranya sebagai Marge Simpson dalam serial televisi animasi The Simpsons, Kavner menarik perhatian karena perannya sebagai Brenda Morgenstern, adik perempuan karakter utama Valerie Harper dalam sitkom Rhoda, yang membuatnya memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award untuk Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Comedy Series. Ia juga mengisi suara karakter lain dalam The Simpsons, termasuk ibu Marge, Jacqueline Bouvier, saudara perempuan Patty dan Selma Bouvier, dan bibinya yang setengah saudara Eunice Bouvier.

name: Julie Walters
title: Julie Walters
extract: Dame Julia Mary Walters, known professionally as Julie Walters, is an English actress and comedian. She is the recipient of four British Academy Television Awards, two British Academy Film Awards, two International Emmy Awards, a Golden Globe Award, and an Olivier Award. Walters has been nominated for two Academy Awards across acting categories—once for Best Actress and once for Best Supporting Actress. She was honoured with the BAFTA Fellowship for lifetime achievement in 2014. She was made a Dame (DBE) by Queen Elizabeth II in 2017 for services to drama.
extract_id: Dame Julia Mary Walters, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Julie Walters, adalah seorang aktris dan komedian Inggris. Ia menerima empat British Academy Television Awards, dua British Academy Film Awards, dua International Emmy Awards, satu Golden Globe Award, dan satu Olivier Award. Walters pernah dinominasikan untuk dua Academy Awards dalam kategori akting—sekali untuk Best Actress dan sekali untuk Best Supporting Actress. Ia dianugerahi BAFTA Fellowship untuk pencapaian seumur hidup pada tahun 2014. Ia diangkat menjadi Dame (DBE) oleh Ratu Elizabeth II pada tahun 2017 atas jasanya dalam dunia drama.

name: Juliette Binoche
title: Juliette Binoche
extract: Juliette Binoche is a French actress. She has appeared in more than 60 films, particularly in French and English, and has been the recipient of numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award and a César Award, and is one of only two women to have won an acting award at each of the world's three major film festivals.
extract_id: Juliette Binoche adalah seorang aktris Prancis. Ia telah tampil dalam lebih dari 60 film, terutama dalam bahasa Prancis dan Inggris, dan menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan César Award, serta merupakan salah satu dari hanya dua perempuan yang memenangkan penghargaan akting di ketiga festival film besar dunia.

name: Juliette Lewis
title: Juliette Lewis
extract: Juliette Lake Lewis is an American actress, singer, and musician. She is known for her portrayals of offbeat characters, often in films with dark plots, themes, and settings. Lewis gained prominence in American cinema during the early 1990s, appearing in various independent and arthouse films. Lewis's accolades include nominations for an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, and two Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Juliette Lake Lewis adalah seorang aktris, penyanyi, dan musisi Amerika. Ia dikenal karena perannya yang unik, sering kali dalam film dengan plot, tema, dan latar yang gelap. Lewis meraih ketenaran dalam sinema Amerika pada awal 1990-an, tampil dalam berbagai film independen dan arthouse. Penghargaan Lewis termasuk nominasi untuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Juliette Mayniel
title: Juliette Mayniel
extract: Juliette Mayniel was a French actress. She appeared in more than 30 films and television shows between 1958 and 1978. At the 10th Berlin International Film Festival, she won the Silver Bear for Best Actress for her role in the film The Fair.
extract_id: Juliette Mayniel adalah seorang aktris Prancis. Ia tampil dalam lebih dari 30 film dan acara televisi antara tahun 1958 dan 1978. Pada Festival Film Internasional Berlin ke-10, ia memenangkan Silver Bear untuk Best Actress atas perannya dalam film The Fair.

name: Jun Ji-Hyun
title: Jun Ji-hyun
extract: Wang Ji-hyun, known professionally as Jun Ji-hyun (전지현) and Gianna Jun, is a South Korean actress and model. She rose to fame with her role in the romantic comedy film My Sassy Girl (2001), which was popular in several Asian countries. She has also starred in Il Mare (2000), Windstruck (2004), The Thieves (2012), The Berlin File (2013), and Assassination (2015). Jun also found success in television with dramas My Love from the Star (2013–2014) and The Legend of the Blue Sea (2016–2017).
extract_id: Wang Ji-hyun, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Jun Ji-hyun (전지현) dan Gianna Jun, adalah seorang aktris dan model Korea Selatan. Ia menjadi terkenal lewat perannya dalam film komedi romantis My Sassy Girl (2001), yang populer di beberapa negara Asia. Ia juga membintangi Il Mare (2000), Windstruck (2004), The Thieves (2012), The Berlin File (2013), dan Assassination (2015). Jun juga sukses di televisi dengan drama My Love from the Star (2013–2014) dan The Legend of the Blue Sea (2016–2017).

name: June Squibb
title: June Squibb
extract: June Louise Squibb is an American actress. She began her career by making her Broadway debut in the musical Gypsy (1959). Her film debut was in Woody Allen's romantic comedy Alice (1990). She later had supporting roles in the films The Age of Innocence (1993), In & Out (1997), Meet Joe Black (1998), About Schmidt (2002), and Far from Heaven (2002). For her role in Alexander Payne's road film Nebraska (2013), she was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: June Louise Squibb adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Ia memulai kariernya dengan debut Broadway dalam musikal Gypsy (1959). Debut filmnya adalah dalam komedi romantis Woody Allen berjudul Alice (1990). Ia kemudian mendapatkan peran pendukung dalam film The Age of Innocence (1993), In & Out (1997), Meet Joe Black (1998), About Schmidt (2002), dan Far from Heaven (2002). Untuk perannya dalam film perjalanan Alexander Payne, Nebraska (2013), ia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Best Supporting Actress.

name: Jung-woo Ha
title: Ha Jung-woo
extract: Kim Sung-hoon, better known as Ha Jung-woo (하정우), is a South Korean actor and filmmaker. One of the highest grossing actors in South Korea, Ha's starring films have accumulated more than 100 million tickets. Only 3 other actors have reached this milestone, with Ha being nearly a decade younger than the rest when achieving this.
extract_id: Kim Sung-hoon, lebih dikenal sebagai Ha Jung-woo (하정우), adalah aktor dan pembuat film Korea Selatan. Sebagai salah satu aktor dengan pendapatan tertinggi di Korea Selatan, film-film utama Ha telah mengumpulkan penjualan tiket lebih dari 100 juta. Hanya 3 aktor lain yang mencapai pencapaian ini, dengan Ha hampir satu dekade lebih muda daripada mereka saat mencapainya.

name: Junko Iwao
title: Junko Iwao
extract: Junko Iwao is a Japanese voice actress and singer. Her most notable role is in Cardcaptor Sakura, providing the voice to Sakura's best friend and cousin, Tomoyo Daidōji. She also voiced lead character Mima Kirigoe in Perfect Blue, Ceres in Ceres, Celestial Legend, and Kikyo in Hunter x Hunter. In video games, she voiced Pai Chan in Virtua Fighter, Carole Pepper in Honkai Impact 3rd, Mint in Tales of Phantasia and Serika in To Heart.
extract_id: Junko Iwao adalah seorang pengisi suara dan penyanyi Jepang. Peran paling terkenalnya adalah di Cardcaptor Sakura, memberikan suara untuk sahabat dan sepupu Sakura, Tomoyo Daidōji. Ia juga mengisi suara karakter utama Mima Kirigoe dalam Perfect Blue, Ceres dalam Ceres, Celestial Legend, dan Kikyo dalam Hunter x Hunter. Dalam permainan video, ia mengisi suara Pai Chan dalam Virtua Fighter, Carole Pepper dalam Honkai Impact 3rd, Mint dalam Tales of Phantasia, dan Serika dalam To Heart.

name: Justin Bartha
title: Justin Bartha
extract: Justin Lee Bartha is an American actor. In film, Bartha has played Riley Poole in the National Treasure film series and Doug Billings in The Hangover trilogy. His television roles include David Sawyer in the NBC comedy series The New Normal as well as Colin Morrello in the CBS All Access legal and political drama The Good Fight.
extract_id: Justin Lee Bartha adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dalam film, Bartha berperan sebagai Riley Poole dalam seri film National Treasure dan Doug Billings dalam trilogi The Hangover. Peran televisinya termasuk David Sawyer dalam serial komedi NBC The New Normal serta Colin Morrello dalam drama hukum dan politik CBS All Access The Good Fight.

name: Justin Henry
title: Justin Henry
extract: Justin Henry is an American actor and businessman, known for playing Billy Kramer in the 1979 film Kramer vs. Kramer, a debut role which earned him an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor nomination at just eight years old. As of 2025, he remains the youngest Oscar nominee in any category. The performance later earned him a spot on VH1's list of 100 Greatest Kid Stars. Most of his film and television credits came as a child or teenager, although he has continued acting as an adult.
extract_id: Justin Henry adalah seorang aktor dan pebisnis Amerika, dikenal karena memerankan Billy Kramer dalam film 1979 Kramer vs. Kramer, peran debut yang memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Best Supporting Actor pada usia hanya delapan tahun. Hingga tahun 2025, ia tetap menjadi nominasi Oscar termuda dalam semua kategori. Penampilannya kemudian memberinya tempat dalam daftar VH1 100 Greatest Kid Stars. Sebagian besar kredit film dan televisinya berasal dari masa kanak-kanak atau remaja, meski ia terus berakting hingga dewasa.

name: Justin Theroux
title: Justin Theroux
extract: Justin Paul Theroux is an American actor. He gained recognition for his partnership with David Lynch on the surrealist art films Mulholland Drive (2001) and Inland Empire (2006). He also appeared in films such as Romy and Michele's High School Reunion (1997), American Psycho (2000), Zoolander (2001), Charlie's Angels: Full Throttle (2003), Miami Vice (2006), The Girl on the Train (2016), Bumblebee (2018), Beetlejuice Beetlejuice (2024), and The Devil Wears Prada 2 (2026).
extract_id: Justin Paul Theroux adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Ia dikenal atas kerjasamanya dengan David Lynch dalam film seni surealis Mulholland Drive (2001) dan Inland Empire (2006). Ia juga tampil dalam film-film seperti Romy and Michele's High School Reunion (1997), American Psycho (2000), Zoolander (2001), Charlie's Angels: Full Throttle (2003), Miami Vice (2006), The Girl on the Train (2016), Bumblebee (2018), Beetlejuice Beetlejuice (2024), dan The Devil Wears Prada 2 (2026).

name: Justin Timberlake
title: Justin Timberlake
extract: Justin Randall Timberlake is an American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer. Dubbed the "Prince of Pop", he is known for his showmanship, tenor vocal range, versatility across the entertainment industry, and frequent collaborations with hip-hop producers such as The Neptunes and Timbaland.
extract_id: Justin Randall Timberlake adalah seorang penyanyi, penulis lagu, aktor, dan produser rekaman Amerika. Dijuluki "Prince of Pop", ia dikenal karena kemampuan panggungnya, jangkauan vokal tenor, fleksibilitasnya di industri hiburan, dan kolaborasi sering dengan produser hip-hop seperti The Neptunes dan Timbaland.

name: Justine Waddell
title: Justine Waddell
extract: Justine Waddell is a South African-British film producer and actress. She played roles in the 2006 film The Fall and 2005 film Chaos as well as Tess in the 1998 LWT adaptation of Tess of the d'Urbervilles and Estella in the 1999 BBC adaptation of Great Expectations. Justine is also the founder and director of the streaming platform Klassiki.
extract_id: Justine Waddell adalah seorang produser film dan aktris asal Afrika Selatan-Britania. Ia berperan dalam film The Fall (2006) dan Chaos (2005) serta sebagai Tess dalam adaptasi LWT tahun 1998 dari Tess of the d'Urbervilles dan Estella dalam adaptasi BBC tahun 1999 dari Great Expectations. Justine juga pendiri dan direktur platform streaming Klassiki.

name: Jürgen Prochnow
title: Jürgen Prochnow
extract: Jürgen Prochnow is a German actor. His international breakthrough was his portrayal of the good-hearted and sympathetic U-boat Commander "Der Alte" in the 1981 war film Das Boot.
extract_id: Jürgen Prochnow adalah seorang aktor Jerman. Terobosan internasionalnya adalah perannya sebagai Komandan U-boat yang baik hati dan simpatik "Der Alte" dalam film perang Das Boot tahun 1981.

name: Jürgen Vogel
title: Jürgen Vogel
extract: Jürgen Peter Vogel is a German actor and producer. One of the most successful character actors in German cinema, he first broke out in 1992 with his role in Little Sharks.
extract_id: Jürgen Peter Vogel adalah seorang aktor dan produser Jerman. Salah satu aktor karakter paling sukses dalam perfilman Jerman, ia pertama kali dikenal luas pada tahun 1992 lewat perannya dalam film Little Sharks.

name: Jüri Järvet
title: Jüri Järvet
extract: Jüri Järvet, born Georgi Kuznetsov, was an Estonian actor.
extract_id: Jüri Järvet, lahir dengan nama Georgi Kuznetsov, adalah seorang aktor Estonia.

name: Kabir Khan
title: Kabir Khan (director)
extract: Kabir Khan is an Indian film director, screenwriter and cinematographer who works in Hindi cinema. He started his career working in documentary films, and then made his feature film directorial debut in 2006 with the thriller Kabul Express. He is best known for directing Ek Tha Tiger (2012) and Bajrangi Bhaijaan (2015)
extract_id: Kabir Khan adalah seorang sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan sinematografer India yang bekerja di sinema Hindi. Ia memulai kariernya dengan mengerjakan film dokumenter, kemudian melakukan debut penyutradaraan film fitur pada tahun 2006 dengan thriller Kabul Express. Ia dikenal luas karena menyutradarai Ek Tha Tiger (2012) dan Bajrangi Bhaijaan (2015).

name: Kad Merad
title: Kad Merad
extract: Kad Merad is a French-Algerian writer and actor.
extract_id: Kad Merad adalah seorang penulis dan aktor Prancis-Aljazair.

name: Kaige Chen
title: Chen Kaige
extract: Chen Kaige is a Chinese filmmaker. A leading figure of the fifth generation of Chinese directors, Chen is known for his visual flair and epic storytelling. For Farewell My Concubine (1993), Chen became the first Chinese director to win the Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival.
extract_id: Chen Kaige adalah seorang pembuat film China. Sebagai tokoh utama generasi kelima sutradara China, Chen dikenal karena gaya visualnya dan penceritaan epiknya. Untuk Farewell My Concubine (1993), Chen menjadi sutradara China pertama yang memenangkan Palme d'Or di Festival Film Cannes.

name: Kaitlyn Dever
title: Kaitlyn Dever
extract: Kaitlyn Rochelle Dever is an American actress. She is best known for her roles in the television series Justified (2011–2015), Last Man Standing (2011–2021), Unbelievable (2019), Dopesick (2021), Apple Cider Vinegar (2025), and The Last of Us (2025–present). She earned two Golden Globe Award nominations for Unbelievable and Dopesick, in addition to two Primetime Emmy Award nominations for Dopesick and The Last of Us.
extract_id: Kaitlyn Rochelle Dever adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Ia dikenal karena perannya dalam serial televisi Justified (2011–2015), Last Man Standing (2011–2021), Unbelievable (2019), Dopesick (2021), Apple Cider Vinegar (2025), dan The Last of Us (2025–sekarang). Ia memperoleh dua nominasi Golden Globe Awards untuk Unbelievable dan Dopesick, serta dua nominasi Primetime Emmy Awards untuk Dopesick dan The Last of Us.

name: Kajol
title: Kajol
extract: Kajol Devgan, known mononymously as Kajol, is an Indian actress who appears in Hindi films. Described in the media as one of the most successful actresses of Hindi cinema, she is the recipient of numerous accolades, including seven Filmfare Awards. In 2011, Kajol received Padma Shri, the fourth-highest civilian award by the government of India.
extract_id: Kajol Devgan, yang dikenal dengan nama depan saja Kajol, adalah seorang aktris India yang tampil dalam film-film Hindi. Digambarkan oleh media sebagai salah satu aktris paling sukses dalam sinema Hindi, ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk tujuh Filmfare Awards. Pada tahun 2011, Kajol menerima Padma Shri, penghargaan sipil tertinggi keempat dari pemerintah India.

name: Kalina Jedrusik
title: Kalina Jędrusik
extract: Kalina Jędrusik was a Polish singer and actress. She performed in more than thirty films from 1953 to 1991. Jędrusik was married to writer Stanisław Dygat.
extract_id: Kalina Jędrusik adalah seorang penyanyi dan aktris Polandia. Ia tampil dalam lebih dari tiga puluh film dari tahun 1953 hingga 1991. Jędrusik menikah dengan penulis Stanisław Dygat.

name: Kalki Koechlin
title: Kalki Koechlin
extract: Kalki Koechlin is a French actress who works in films and stage. Known for her unconventional body of work, primarily in Hindi films, she is the recipient of several accolades, including a National Film Award and a Filmfare Award.
