Although a French citizen, she has been raised and lived most of her life in India.
extract_id: Kalki Koechlin adalah seorang aktris Prancis yang berkarya di film dan panggung. Dikenal karena karya-karyanya yang tidak konvensional, terutama dalam film Hindi, ia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk National Film Award dan Filmfare Award. Meskipun berkebangsaan Prancis, ia dibesarkan dan menghabiskan sebagian besar hidupnya di India.

name: Kamatari Fujiwara
title: Kamatari Fujiwara
extract: Shigeo Yasui , better known by his stage name Kamatari Fujiwara and also known during wartime as Keita Fujiwara , was a Japanese stage and film actor who appeared in over 200 films between 1933 and 1984. In addition to regular appearances in the films of Akira Kurosawa, he worked for directors such as Mikio Naruse, Yasujirō Ozu, Heinosuke Gosho and others.
extract_id: Shigeo Yasui, yang lebih dikenal dengan nama panggungnya Kamatari Fujiwara dan juga dikenal selama masa perang sebagai Keita Fujiwara, adalah aktor panggung dan film Jepang yang tampil dalam lebih dari 200 film antara tahun 1933 dan 1984. Selain sering tampil dalam film-film Akira Kurosawa, ia bekerja untuk sutradara seperti Mikio Naruse, Yasujirō Ozu, Heinosuke Gosho, dan lainnya.

name: Kang Hye-jeong
title: Kang Hye-jung
extract: Kang Hye-jung is a South Korean actress. Making her film debut in arthouse film Nabi (2001), she rose to stardom and critical acclaim in Park Chan-wook's 2003 revenge thriller Oldboy. A rising star early in her career, she gained acting awards for Han Jae-rim's relationship drama Rules of Dating (2005), and Park Kwang-hyun's Korean War comedy Welcome to Dongmakgol (2005).
extract_id: Kang Hye-jung adalah seorang aktris Korea Selatan. Memulai debut filmnya dalam film arthouse Nabi (2001), dia naik daun dan mendapat pujian kritis dalam thriller balas dendam Park Chan-wook tahun 2003 Oldboy. Sebagai bintang yang sedang naik daun di awal kariernya, dia meraih penghargaan akting untuk drama hubungan Han Jae-rim Rules of Dating (2005), dan komedi Perang Korea Park Kwang-hyun Welcome to Dongmakgol (2005).

name: Kang-ho Song
title: Song Kang-ho
extract: Song Kang-ho is a South Korean actor. Widely regarded as one of the most influential actors in Korean cinema, he has appeared in critically acclaimed films across various genres. He is the recipient of numerous accolades, including a Cannes Film Festival Award, three Baeksang Arts Awards, four Blue Dragon Film Awards, and five Grand Bell Awards. In 2020, The New York Times named him one of the greatest actors of the 21st century.
extract_id: Song Kang-ho adalah aktor Korea Selatan. Secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor paling berpengaruh dalam sinema Korea, dia telah tampil dalam berbagai film yang mendapat pujian kritis di berbagai genre. Dia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Penghargaan Festival Film Cannes, tiga Baeksang Arts Awards, empat Blue Dragon Film Awards, dan lima Grand Bell Awards. Pada tahun 2020, The New York Times menamainya sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar abad ke-21.

name: Kangana Ranaut
title: Kangana Ranaut
extract: Kangna Amardeep Ranaut is an Indian actress, filmmaker, and politician serving as a Member of Parliament, Lok Sabha from Mandi since June 2024. Known for her portrayals of strong-willed, unconventional women in female-led Hindi films, she is the recipient of several awards, including four National Film Awards and four Filmfare Awards, and has featured six times in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list. In 2020, the Government of India honoured her with the Padma Shri, the country's fourth-highest civilian award.
extract_id: Kangna Amardeep Ranaut adalah seorang aktris, pembuat film, dan politikus India yang menjabat sebagai Anggota Parlemen, Lok Sabha dari Mandi sejak Juni 2024. Dikenal karena perannya memerankan wanita kuat dan tidak konvensional dalam film Hindi yang dipimpin wanita, dia menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk empat National Film Awards dan empat Filmfare Awards, serta telah masuk daftar Forbes India Celebrity 100 sebanyak enam kali. Pada tahun 2020, Pemerintah India menghonorinya dengan Padma Shri, penghargaan sipil keempat tertinggi di negara itu.

name: Kappei Yamaguchi
title: Kappei Yamaguchi
extract: Mitsuo Yamaguchi , known professionally as Kappei Yamaguchi , is a Japanese actor, voice actor, and rakugoka currently affiliated with Gokū and formerly with 21st Century Fox. After making his voice acting debut in 1989 as the male version of the titular character Ranma Saotome in the Ranma ½ television anime, he went on to perform other notable roles such as the titular character in Inuyasha and in its sequel Yashahime, and L in Death Note. He currently voices Shinichi Kudo and Kaito Kid in Great Detective Conan, Usopp in One Piece and Teddie in Persona 4. He is married and has a son named Ryūnosuke and a daughter named Akane. Ryūnosuke and Akane are also voice actors, while the latter is also a rakugoka.
extract_id: Mitsuo Yamaguchi, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Kappei Yamaguchi, adalah aktor, pengisi suara, dan rakugoka Jepang yang saat ini berafiliasi dengan Gokū dan sebelumnya dengan 21st Century Fox. Setelah memulai debut pengisi suara pada tahun 1989 sebagai versi laki-laki dari karakter utama Ranma Saotome dalam anime televisi Ranma ½, ia melanjutkan memerankan peran penting seperti karakter utama dalam Inuyasha dan sekuelnya Yashahime, serta L dalam Death Note. Saat ini ia mengisi suara Shinichi Kudo dan Kaito Kid dalam Great Detective Conan, Usopp dalam One Piece, dan Teddie dalam Persona 4. Ia menikah dan memiliki seorang putra bernama Ryūnosuke dan seorang putri bernama Akane. Ryūnosuke dan Akane juga pengisi suara, sementara yang terakhir juga seorang rakugoka.

name: Kar-Wai Wong
title: Wong Kar-wai
extract: Wong Kar-wai is a Hong Kong filmmaker. His films are characterised by nonlinear narratives, atmospheric music, and vivid cinematography with bold, saturated colours. An auteur of Hong Kong cinema, Wong frequently appears at international film festivals.
extract_id: Wong Kar-wai adalah pembuat film Hong Kong. Film-filmnya ditandai dengan narasi nonlinier, musik atmosferik, dan sinematografi yang hidup dengan warna-warna berani dan jenuh. Sebagai seorang auteur dalam sinema Hong Kong, Wong sering tampil di festival film internasional.

name: Kara Hayward
title: Kara Hayward
extract: Kara Hayward is an American actress. She is known for her lead role as Suzy Bishop in the 2012 feature film Moonrise Kingdom, which earned her a nomination for the Young Artist Award for Best Leading Young Actress in a Feature Film in 2013. Two years later, she played Emily Parris, one of the lead roles in The Sisterhood of Night.
extract_id: Kara Hayward adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia dikenal karena peran utamanya sebagai Suzy Bishop dalam film fitur tahun 2012 Moonrise Kingdom, yang memberinya nominasi Young Artist Award untuk Aktris Muda Terbaik dalam Film Fitur pada tahun 2013. Dua tahun kemudian, dia bermain sebagai Emily Parris, salah satu peran utama dalam The Sisterhood of Night.

name: Karan Johar
title: Karan Johar
extract: Karan Kumar Johar, often informally referred to as KJo, is an Indian filmmaker, producer and television personality who primarily works in Hindi cinema. He has launched the careers of several successful actors and filmmakers under his company Dharma Productions. The recipient of several accolades, including four National Film Awards and eight Filmfare Awards, he has been honoured with the Padma Shri by the Government of India in 2020.
extract_id: Karan Kumar Johar, yang sering disebut secara informal sebagai KJo, adalah pembuat film, produser, dan figur televisi India yang sebagian besar bekerja dalam sinema Hindi. Dia telah meluncurkan karier beberapa aktor dan pembuat film sukses di bawah perusahaannya Dharma Productions. Penerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk empat National Film Awards dan delapan Filmfare Awards, dia menerima penghargaan Padma Shri dari Pemerintah India pada tahun 2020.

name: Kareena Kapoor
title: Kareena Kapoor
extract: Kareena Kapoor Khan is an Indian actress. She has been known for her leading roles in Hindi cinema since 2000. Kapoor is the recipient of several awards, including six Filmfare Awards, and as of 2024, is one of Hindi cinema's highest-paid actresses.
extract_id: Kareena Kapoor Khan adalah seorang aktris India. Dia dikenal karena peran utamanya dalam sinema Hindi sejak tahun 2000. Kapoor adalah penerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk enam Filmfare Awards, dan per tahun 2024, dia adalah salah satu aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di sinema Hindi.

name: Karen Allen
title: Karen Allen
extract: Karen Jane Allen is an American film, television and stage actress. She made her film debut in the comedy film Animal House (1978), which was soon followed by a small role in Woody Allen's romantic comedy-drama Manhattan (1979) and a co-lead role in Philip Kaufman's coming-of-age film The Wanderers (1979), before co-starring opposite Al Pacino in William Friedkin's crime thriller Cruising (1980).
extract_id: Karen Jane Allen adalah aktris film, televisi, dan panggung Amerika. Dia memulai debut filmnya dalam film komedi Animal House (1978), yang segera diikuti dengan peran kecil dalam komedi romantis-drama Woody Allen, Manhattan (1979), dan peran co-lead dalam film coming-of-age garapan Philip Kaufman, The Wanderers (1979), sebelum bermain berdampingan dengan Al Pacino dalam thriller kriminal William Friedkin, Cruising (1980).

name: Karen Morley
title: Karen Morley
extract: Karen Morley was an American film actress.
extract_id: Karen Morley adalah seorang aktris film Amerika.

name: Karina Arroyave
title: Karina Arroyave
extract: Karina Arroyave is a Colombian-American actress. She began her career starring as Bianca Marquez Walsh in the CBS daytime soap opera As the World Turns (1989–1994), and later made her big screen debut appearing in the biographical drama film Lean On Me (1989). Arroyave later had supporting roles in a number of movies and played recurring roles on television series 24 (2001–2002) as Jamey Farrell, Orange Is the New Black (2019) as Karla Cordova, and The Blacklist (2021–2022) as Mierce Xiu.
extract_id: Karina Arroyave adalah aktris Kolombia-Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya dengan berperan sebagai Bianca Marquez Walsh dalam opera sabun siang CBS As the World Turns (1989–1994), dan kemudian membuat debut layar lebarnya dalam film drama biografi Lean On Me (1989). Arroyave kemudian memiliki peran pendukung dalam sejumlah film dan memerankan peran berulang dalam serial televisi 24 (2001–2002) sebagai Jamey Farrell, Orange Is the New Black (2019) sebagai Karla Cordova, dan The Blacklist (2021–2022) sebagai Mierce Xiu.

name: Karisma Kapoor
title: Karisma Kapoor
extract: Karisma Kapoor is an Indian actress who primarily appears in Hindi films. One of the leading and highest-paid actresses of the 1990s, she became the first female member of the Kapoor family by birth to pursue a career in acting. Kapoor is the recipient of several accolades, including a National Film Award and four Filmfare Awards.
extract_id: Karisma Kapoor adalah aktris India yang sebagian besar tampil dalam film Hindi. Salah satu aktris terkemuka dan dengan bayaran tertinggi di tahun 1990-an, dia menjadi anggota perempuan pertama dari keluarga Kapoor secara kelahiran yang mengejar karier akting. Kapoor adalah penerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk National Film Award dan empat Filmfare Awards.

name: Karl Malden
title: Karl Malden
extract: Karl Malden was an American stage, movie, and television actor who first achieved acclaim in the original Broadway productions of Arthur Miller's All My Sons and Tennessee Williams' A Streetcar Named Desire in 1946 and 1947. Recreating the role of Mitch in the 1951 film of Streetcar, he won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor.
extract_id: Karl Malden adalah aktor panggung, film, dan televisi Amerika yang pertama kali meraih pujian dalam produksi Broadway asli Arthur Miller All My Sons dan Tennessee Williams A Streetcar Named Desire pada tahun 1946 dan 1947. Mengulangi peran Mitch dalam film Streetcar tahun 1951, ia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Karlheinz Böhm
title: Karlheinz Böhm
extract: Karlheinz Böhm was a German-born Austrian actor and philanthropist. He took part in 45 films and became well known in Austria and Germany for his role as Emperor Franz Joseph I of Austria in the Sissi film trilogy and internationally for his role as Mark Lewis, the psychopathic protagonist of Peeping Tom, directed by Michael Powell. He was the founder of the trust Menschen für Menschen, which helps people in need in Ethiopia. He also received honorary Ethiopian citizenship in 2003.
extract_id: Karlheinz Böhm adalah aktor Austria kelahiran Jerman sekaligus dermawan. Ia tampil dalam 45 film dan menjadi terkenal di Austria dan Jerman karena perannya sebagai Kaisar Franz Joseph I dari Austria dalam trilogi film Sissi dan secara internasional untuk perannya sebagai Mark Lewis, protagonis psikopat dalam Peeping Tom, disutradarai oleh Michael Powell. Ia adalah pendiri yayasan Menschen für Menschen, yang membantu orang-orang yang membutuhkan di Ethiopia. Ia juga menerima kewarganegaraan kehormatan Ethiopia pada tahun 2003.

name: Kasi Lemmons
title: Kasi Lemmons
extract: Kasi Lemmons is an American film director, screenwriter, and actress. She made her directorial debut with Eve's Bayou (1997), followed by The Caveman's Valentine (2001), Talk to Me (2007), Black Nativity (2013), Harriet (2019), and Whitney Houston: I Wanna Dance with Somebody (2022). In 2007, film scholar Wheeler Winston Dixon called her first three films "deeply resonant personal statements ... Lemmons's work is an ongoing testament to the creative possibilities of film."
extract_id: Kasi Lemmons adalah sutradara film, penulis naskah, dan aktris Amerika. Dia memulai debut penyutradaraannya dengan Eve's Bayou (1997), diikuti oleh The Caveman's Valentine (2001), Talk to Me (2007), Black Nativity (2013), Harriet (2019), dan Whitney Houston: I Wanna Dance with Somebody (2022). Pada tahun 2007, cendekiawan film Wheeler Winston Dixon menyebut tiga film pertamanya sebagai "pernyataan pribadi yang sangat resonan ... karya Lemmons adalah sebuah bukti berkelanjutan tentang kemungkinan kreatif film."

name: Kassie Wesley DePaiva
title: Kassie DePaiva
extract: Katherine Virginia "Kassie" DePaiva is an American actress and singer. She is best known for playing the roles of Chelsea Reardon on the CBS soap opera Guiding Light, Blair Cramer on the ABC soap opera One Life to Live, and Eve Donovan on the NBC soap opera Days of Our Lives. She received one Daytime Emmy Award nomination for her role on One Life to Live and two nominations for her role on Days Of Our Lives. DePaiva also starred as Bobby Joe in the horror film Evil Dead II (1986). As a singer, she has released three albums, Naked (2000), No Regrets (2005), and I Want to Love You (2007).
extract_id: Katherine Virginia "Kassie" DePaiva adalah aktris dan penyanyi Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan Chelsea Reardon dalam opera sabun CBS Guiding Light, Blair Cramer dalam opera sabun ABC One Life to Live, dan Eve Donovan dalam opera sabun NBC Days of Our Lives. Dia menerima satu nominasi Daytime Emmy Award untuk perannya di One Life to Live dan dua nominasi untuk perannya di Days Of Our Lives. DePaiva juga membintangi sebagai Bobby Joe dalam film horor Evil Dead II (1986). Sebagai penyanyi, ia telah merilis tiga album, Naked (2000), No Regrets (2005), dan I Want to Love You (2007).

name: Kasumi Arimura
title: Kasumi Arimura
extract: Kasumi Arimura , is a Japanese actress. Her television roles have included the young Haruko Amano in the 2013 NHK asadora Amachan and the lead role in the 2017 asadora Hiyokko. She has also appeared in several films, including Flying Colors, for which she won a 39th Japan Academy Film Prize for Newcomer of the Year, and We Made A Beautiful Bouquet, for which she won the 45th Japan Academy Film Prize for Best Actress.
extract_id: Kasumi Arimura adalah aktris Jepang. Peran televisinya termasuk sebagai Haruko Amano muda dalam asadora NHK tahun 2013 Amachan dan peran utama dalam asadora 2017 Hiyokko. Dia juga tampil dalam beberapa film, termasuk Flying Colors, yang mengantarkannya memenangkan Penghargaan Film Akademi Jepang ke-39 untuk Pendatang Baru Terbaik, dan We Made A Beautiful Bouquet, yang membuatnya memenangkan Penghargaan Film Akademi Jepang ke-45 untuk Aktris Terbaik.

name: Kate Ashfield
title: Kate Ashfield
extract: Kate Ashfield is an English actress and screenwriter, who has appeared in stage, television, and film roles. She is best known for her role as Liz in the 2004 zombie comedy Shaun of the Dead. Ashfield is the co-writer of the 2017 TV series Born to Kill.
extract_id: Kate Ashfield adalah aktris dan penulis skenario Inggris, yang telah tampil dalam peran panggung, televisi, dan film. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Liz dalam komedi zombie tahun 2004 Shaun of the Dead. Ashfield adalah penulis bersama serial TV tahun 2017 Born to Kill.

name: Kate Hudson
title: Kate Hudson
extract: Kate Garry Hudson is an American actress and singer-songwriter. Born to singer Bill Hudson and actress Goldie Hawn, Hudson made her film debut in the 1998 drama Desert Blue, which was followed by supporting roles in several films. She rose to prominence with her portrayal of Penny Lane in Cameron Crowe's musical drama Almost Famous (2000), for which she won the Golden Globe for Best Supporting Actress and received a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: Kate Garry Hudson adalah aktris dan penyanyi-penulis lagu Amerika. Lahir dari penyanyi Bill Hudson dan aktris Goldie Hawn, Hudson memulai debut filmnya dalam drama Desert Blue tahun 1998, yang diikuti oleh peran pendukung dalam beberapa film. Dia menjadi terkenal berkat perannya sebagai Penny Lane dalam drama musikal Cameron Crowe Almost Famous (2000), yang memberinya Golden Globe untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik dan nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Kate Mara
title: Kate Mara
extract: Kate Rooney Mara is an American actress. She is known for her work in television, playing reporter Zoe Barnes in the Netflix political drama House of Cards, computer analyst Shari Rothenberg in the Fox thriller series 24 (2006), wronged mistress Hayden McClaine in the FX miniseries American Horror Story: Murder House (2011), Patty Bowes in the first season of the FX drama series Pose (2018), and a teacher involved with an underage student in the FX miniseries A Teacher (2020).
extract_id: Kate Rooney Mara adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia dikenal karena karyanya di televisi, memerankan reporter Zoe Barnes dalam drama politik Netflix House of Cards, analis komputer Shari Rothenberg dalam seri thriller Fox 24 (2006), selingkuhan yang dizalimi Hayden McClaine dalam miniseri FX American Horror Story: Murder House (2011), Patty Bowes dalam musim pertama seri drama FX Pose (2018), dan seorang guru yang terlibat dengan murid di bawah umur dalam miniseri FX A Teacher (2020).

name: Kate Winslet
title: Kate Winslet
extract: Kate Elizabeth Winslet is an English actress. Primarily known for her roles as headstrong women in independent films, particularly period dramas, she has received numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, two Primetime Emmy Awards, five BAFTA Awards and five Golden Globe Awards. She was appointed Commander of the Order of the British Empire (CBE) in 2012.
extract_id: Kate Elizabeth Winslet adalah aktris Inggris. Terutama dikenal karena perannya sebagai wanita kuat dalam film independen, khususnya drama periode, dia telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, lima BAFTA Awards dan lima Golden Globe Awards. Dia diangkat menjadi Commander of the Order of the British Empire (CBE) pada tahun 2012.

name: Katharine Hepburn
title: Katharine Hepburn
extract: Katharine Houghton Hepburn was an American actress whose career as a leading lady on stage and screen spanned six decades. Known for her headstrong independence, spirited personality, and outspokenness, she cultivated a screen persona that matched this public image, and regularly played strong-willed, sophisticated women. She worked in a varied range of genres, from screwball comedy to literary drama. Her accolades include a record four Academy Awards for Best Actress, two British Academy Film Awards and a Primetime Emmy Award, in addition to nominations for two Tony Awards, two Grammy Awards and eight Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Katharine Houghton Hepburn adalah aktris Amerika yang kariernya sebagai wanita utama di panggung dan layar membentang selama enam dekade. Dikenal karena kemerdekaannya yang kuat, kepribadian bersemangat, dan keterusterangan, ia mengembangkan persona layar yang sesuai dengan citra publik ini, dan secara rutin memerankan wanita yang berkehendak kuat dan canggih. Ia bekerja dalam berbagai genre, dari komedi screwball hingga drama sastra. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk rekor empat Academy Awards untuk Aktris Terbaik, dua British Academy Film Awards, dan satu Primetime Emmy Award, selain nominasi untuk dua Tony Awards, dua Grammy Awards, dan delapan Golden Globe Awards.

name: Katharine Houghton
title: Katharine Houghton
extract: Katharine Houghton is an American actress and playwright. She portrayed Joanna "Joey" Drayton, a white woman who brings home her black fiancé to meet her parents, in the 1967 film Guess Who's Coming to Dinner. Katharine Hepburn, who played the mother of Houghton's character in the film, was Houghton's aunt. Houghton was nominated for a Golden Globe Award for her performance. She is also known for her role as Kanna, the grandmother of Katara and Sokka in the film The Last Airbender (2010).
extract_id: Katharine Houghton adalah aktris dan penulis drama Amerika. Dia memerankan Joanna "Joey" Drayton, seorang wanita kulit putih yang membawa pulang tunangannya yang berkulit hitam untuk bertemu orang tuanya, dalam film tahun 1967 Guess Who's Coming to Dinner. Katharine Hepburn, yang memerankan ibu karakter Houghton dalam film tersebut, adalah bibi Houghton. Houghton dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award atas penampilannya. Dia juga dikenal karena perannya sebagai Kanna, nenek dari Katara dan Sokka dalam film The Last Airbender (2010).

name: Katharine Ross
title: Katharine Ross
extract: Katharine Juliet Ross is an American retired actress. Her accolades include an Academy Award nomination, a BAFTA Award, and two Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Katharine Juliet Ross adalah aktris Amerika yang telah pensiun. Penghargaannya meliputi nominasi Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan dua Golden Globe Awards.

name: Katherine Helmond
title: Katherine Helmond
extract: Katherine Marie Helmond was an American actress. Over an acting career spanning six decades, she was best known for her starring role as Jessica Tate on the sitcom Soap (1977–1981) and her co-starring role as Mona Robinson on Who's the Boss? (1984–1992). Helmond also played Doris Sherman on Coach (1995–1997) and Lois Whelan on Everybody Loves Raymond (1996–2004). She also appeared as a guest on several talk and variety shows.
extract_id: Katherine Marie Helmond adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Selama karier aktingnya yang berlangsung enam dekade, dia paling dikenal karena peran utamanya sebagai Jessica Tate dalam sitkom Soap (1977–1981) dan peran pendukungnya sebagai Mona Robinson dalam Who's the Boss? (1984–1992). Helmond juga memerankan Doris Sherman dalam Coach (1995–1997) dan Lois Whelan dalam Everybody Loves Raymond (1996–2004). Dia juga tampil sebagai tamu di beberapa acara bincang-bincang dan varietas.

name: Kathryn McGuire
title: Kathryn McGuire
extract: Kathryn McGuire was an American dancer and actress.
extract_id: Kathryn McGuire adalah seorang penari dan aktris Amerika.

name: Kathy Bates
title: Kathy Bates
extract: Kathleen Doyle Bates is an American actress and director. Her work spans over five decades, and her accolades include an Academy Award, two Emmy Awards, and two Golden Globe Awards, in addition to nominations for a Tony Award and two BAFTA Awards.
extract_id: Kathleen Doyle Bates adalah seorang aktris dan sutradara Amerika. Karyanya meliputi lebih dari lima dekade, dan penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk Academy Award, dua Emmy Awards, dan dua Golden Globe Awards, selain nominasi untuk Tony Award dan dua BAFTA Awards.

name: Katie A. Keane
title: Katie A. Keane
extract: Katie A. Keane is an American actress.
extract_id: Katie A. Keane adalah seorang aktris Amerika.

name: Katrin Cartlidge
title: Katrin Cartlidge
extract: Katrin Juliet Cartlidge was an English actress. She first appeared on screen as Lucy Collins in the Channel 4 soap opera Brookside (1982–1983), before going on to win the 1997 Evening Standard Film Award for Best Actress for the Mike Leigh film Career Girls. Her other film appearances included Leigh's Naked (1993), as well as the films Before the Rain (1994), Breaking the Waves (1996), and From Hell (2001).
extract_id: Katrin Juliet Cartlidge adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Dia pertama kali muncul di layar sebagai Lucy Collins dalam opera sabun Channel 4 Brookside (1982–1983), sebelum memenangkan Evening Standard Film Award untuk Aktris Terbaik pada 1997 untuk film Mike Leigh Career Girls. Penampilan filmnya yang lain termasuk Naked (1993) karya Leigh, serta film Before the Rain (1994), Breaking the Waves (1996), dan From Hell (2001).

name: Katrin Saß
title: Katrin Sass
extract: Katrin Sass is a German actress. She became known internationally for playing the idealistic socialist mother Christiane Kerner in the 2003 tragicomedy Good Bye, Lenin!
extract_id: Katrin Sass adalah seorang aktris Jerman. Dia dikenal secara internasional karena memerankan ibu sosialis idealis Christiane Kerner dalam film tragicomedy Good Bye, Lenin! tahun 2003.

name: Katrina Kaif
title: Katrina Kaif
extract: Katrina Kaif is a British actress and businesswoman who works in Hindi-language films. One of India's highest-paid actresses, her accolades include four Screen Awards and four Zee Cine Awards, alongside three Filmfare Awards nominations. Although critical reception to her acting has varied, she is noted for her roles in action films and her dancing ability.
extract_id: Katrina Kaif adalah seorang aktris dan pengusaha Inggris yang bekerja di film berbahasa Hindi. Sebagai salah satu aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di India, penghargaan yang diraih termasuk empat Screen Awards dan empat Zee Cine Awards, serta tiga nominasi Filmfare Awards. Meskipun penerimaan kritis terhadap aktingnya bervariasi, dia dikenal karena perannya dalam film aksi dan kemampuan menarinya.

name: Katsuhiro Ôtomo
title: Katsuhiro Otomo
extract: Katsuhiro Otomo is a Japanese manga artist, screenwriter, animator, and film director. He first rose to prominence as a pioneer founder of the New Wave in the 1970s. He is best known as the creator of Akira, both the original 1982 manga series and the 1988 animated film adaptation. In 2005, Otomo was decorated a Chevalier of the French Ordre des Arts et des Lettres, promoted to Officier of the order in 2014, and became the fourth manga artist ever inducted into the American Eisner Award Hall of Fame in 2012. Celebrated in Japan, he was also awarded the Purple Medal of Honor from the national government in 2013.
extract_id: Katsuhiro Otomo adalah seorang artis manga Jepang, penulis skenario, animator, dan sutradara film. Dia pertama kali dikenal sebagai pelopor pendiri New Wave pada tahun 1970-an. Dia paling dikenal sebagai pencipta Akira, baik seri manga asli tahun 1982 maupun adaptasi film animasi tahun 1988. Pada tahun 2005, Otomo dianugerahi gelar Chevalier dari Ordre des Arts et des Lettres Prancis, dipromosikan menjadi Officier pada 2014, dan menjadi artis manga keempat yang masuk ke Hall of Fame Eisner Award Amerika pada 2012. Dirayakan di Jepang, dia juga dianugerahi Medali Kehormatan Ungu dari pemerintah nasional pada 2013.

name: Katsunosuke Hori
title: Katsunosuke Hori
description: Japanese actor, voice actor and narrator
extract: Katsunosuke Hori is a Japanese actor, voice actor and narrator from the Tokyo Metropolitan area. He is a member of 81 Produce. He is known for dubbing for Harvey Keitel, Robert De Niro, Jon Voight, Charles Dance and many more. He was also the first dubbing voice actor of Alain Delon and Harrison Ford in their early days.
extract_id: Katsunosuke Hori adalah aktor, pemeran suara, dan narator Jepang dari wilayah Metropolitan Tokyo. Dia adalah anggota 81 Produce. Dia dikenal karena mengisi suara pengganti untuk Harvey Keitel, Robert De Niro, Jon Voight, Charles Dance, dan banyak lagi. Dia juga merupakan pemeran suara pengganti pertama untuk Alain Delon dan Harrison Ford pada awal karier mereka.

name: Kay Kay Menon
title: Kay Kay Menon
extract: Krishna Kumar Menon, known professionally as Kay Kay Menon, is an Indian actor who works predominantly in Hindi cinema, and occasionally in Gujarati, Tamil, Marathi and Telugu films. He is best known for his roles in films such as Black Friday (2004), Deewar (2004), Sarkar (2005), Shaurya (2008), Gulaal (2009), Haider (2014), Baby (2015), The Ghazi Attack (2017). He has starred in web series such as Special Ops, Farzi, The Railway Men and Citadel: Honey Bunny. He is regarded as one of the most influential actors in cinema of India.
extract_id: Krishna Kumar Menon, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Kay Kay Menon, adalah aktor India yang bekerja terutama di sinema Hindi, dan kadang-kadang di film Gujarati, Tamil, Marathi, dan Telugu. Dia dikenal atas perannya dalam film seperti Black Friday (2004), Deewar (2004), Sarkar (2005), Shaurya (2008), Gulaal (2009), Haider (2014), Baby (2015), The Ghazi Attack (2017). Dia membintangi serial web seperti Special Ops, Farzi, The Railway Men, dan Citadel: Honey Bunny. Dia dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor paling berpengaruh dalam sinema India.

name: Kayoko Kishimoto
title: Kayoko Kishimoto
extract: Kayoko Kishimoto is an actress.
extract_id: Kayoko Kishimoto adalah seorang aktris.

name: Kazuko Yoshiyuki
title: Kazuko Yoshiyuki
extract: Kazuko Yoshiyuki was a Japanese actress, voice actress, and essayist. Having grown up with the burgeoning Japanese film and TV industry during post-war period, her career bridged traditional storytelling with modern cinematic expressions, making her a quintessential figure of her era in Japanese entertainment.
extract_id: Kazuko Yoshiyuki adalah seorang aktris, pemeran suara, dan esais Jepang. Karena tumbuh bersama berkembangnya industri film dan TV Jepang selama masa pascaperang, kariernya menjembatani penceritaan tradisional dengan ekspresi sinematik modern, menjadikannya sosok penting pada masanya dalam dunia hiburan Jepang.

name: Kazunari Ninomiya
title: Kazunari Ninomiya
extract: Kazunari Ninomiya , often called Nino (ニノ), is a Japanese singer, songwriter, actor, voice actor, presenter and radio host. He is a former member of the Japanese idol group Arashi, and with which he remained until the group's end of activities. He became independent from the agency in 2023 for individual activities.
extract_id: Kazunari Ninomiya, sering dipanggil Nino (ニノ), adalah penyanyi, penulis lagu, aktor, pemeran suara, pembawa acara, dan pembawa acara radio Jepang. Dia adalah mantan anggota grup idola Jepang Arashi, dan tetap bersama grup tersebut hingga berakhirnya aktivitas grup. Dia menjadi independen dari agensi pada 2023 untuk kegiatan individu.

name: Kazuya Tsurumaki
title: Kazuya Tsurumaki
extract: Kazuya Tsurumaki is a Japanese anime director. He was born on February 2, 1966, in the city of Gosen, located in Niigata Prefecture.
extract_id: Kazuya Tsurumaki adalah sutradara anime Jepang. Dia lahir pada 2 Februari 1966 di kota Gosen, yang terletak di Prefektur Niigata.

name: Keanu Reeves
title: Keanu Reeves
extract: Keanu Charles Reeves is a Canadian actor and musician. The recipient of numerous accolades in a career on screen spanning four decades, he is known for his leading roles in action films, his amiable public image, and his philanthropic efforts. In 2020, The New York Times ranked him as the fourth-greatest actor of the 21st century, and in 2022, Time magazine named him one of the 100 most influential people in the world.
extract_id: Keanu Charles Reeves adalah aktor dan musisi asal Kanada. Penerima banyak penghargaan dalam karier layar yang berlangsung selama empat dekade, dia dikenal karena peran utama dalam film aksi, citra publiknya yang ramah, dan upaya filantropinya. Pada 2020, The New York Times menempatkannya sebagai aktor terbesar keempat di abad ke-21, dan pada 2022, majalah Time menyebutnya salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia.

name: Keenan Wynn
title: Keenan Wynn
extract: Francis Xavier Aloysius James Jeremiah Keenan Wynn was an American character actor. Well-known for his highly expressive face, he was rarely cast as a leading actor, although he did receive prominent cast member billing for most of his film and television roles.
extract_id: Francis Xavier Aloysius James Jeremiah Keenan Wynn adalah seorang aktor karakter Amerika. Terkenal karena ekspresi wajahnya yang sangat ekspresif, dia jarang dipilih sebagai aktor utama, meskipun ia sering mendapatkan kredit sebagai pemeran penting dalam sebagian besar peran film dan televisinya.

name: Keiju Kobayashi
title: Keiju Kobayashi
extract: Keiju Kobayashi was a Japanese actor who appeared in 253 films in a career spanning 67 years.
extract_id: Keiju Kobayashi adalah aktor Jepang yang tampil dalam 253 film dalam karier yang berlangsung selama 67 tahun.

name: Keiko Tsushima
title: Keiko Tsushima
extract: Keiko Tsushima was a Japanese actress, whose real name was Naoko Mori . She was notable for her prominent role in Akira Kurosawa's 1954 film Seven Samurai. She also starred in Japanese television series such as Sakura and Kimi ga Jinsei no Toki.
extract_id: Keiko Tsushima adalah aktris Jepang, dengan nama asli Naoko Mori. Dia dikenal karena peran pentingnya dalam film Akira Kurosawa tahun 1954, Seven Samurai. Dia juga membintangi serial televisi Jepang seperti Sakura dan Kimi ga Jinsei no Toki.

name: Keiko Yokozawa
title: Keiko Yokozawa
extract: Keiko Nanba née Yokozawa, born September 2, 1952 in Chūō-ku, Niigata, Niigata Prefecture, Japan, better known by the stage name Keiko Yokozawa , is a Japanese voice actress, actress, and narrator. She is also the founder and executive vice president of the Japanese talent agency YU-RIN PRO.CO.ltd. She also runs The Keiko Yokozawa Voice Acting and Narration School. Her former stage name was Keiko Yokozawa .
extract_id: Keiko Nanba née Yokozawa, lahir pada 2 September 1952 di Chūō-ku, Niigata, Prefektur Niigata, Jepang, lebih dikenal dengan nama panggung Keiko Yokozawa, adalah seorang pemeran suara Jepang, aktris, dan narator. Dia juga merupakan pendiri dan wakil presiden eksekutif dari agensi bakat Jepang YU-RIN PRO.CO.ltd. Dia juga menjalankan Sekolah Akting dan Narasi Suara Keiko Yokozawa. Nama panggungnya sebelumnya adalah Keiko Yokozawa.

name: Keir Dullea
title: Keir Dullea
extract: Keir Atwood Dullea is an American actor. He is known for his portrayal of astronaut David Bowman in the 1968 film 2001: A Space Odyssey and its 1984 sequel, 2010: The Year We Make Contact.
extract_id: Keir Atwood Dullea adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai astronaut David Bowman dalam film 2001: A Space Odyssey tahun 1968 dan sekuelnya tahun 1984, 2010: The Year We Make Contact.

name: Keira Knightley
title: Keira Knightley
extract: Keira Christina Knightley is a British actress. Known for her work in independent films and blockbusters, particularly period dramas, she has received numerous accolades, including nominations for two Academy Awards, two British Academy Film Awards, four Golden Globes, and a Laurence Olivier Award. In 2018, she was appointed an OBE for services to drama and charity.
extract_id: Keira Christina Knightley adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Dikenal atas karyanya dalam film independen dan blockbuster, terutama drama periode, dia telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards, dua British Academy Film Awards, empat Golden Globes, dan Laurence Olivier Award. Pada 2018, dia diangkat sebagai OBE untuk jasa-jasa dalam dunia drama dan amal.

name: Keith David
title: Keith David
extract: Keith David Williams is an American actor. He is mostly known for his distinctive, deep bass voice, distinctive face and screen presence in over 400 roles across film, stage, television, voice work and interactive media.
extract_id: Keith David Williams adalah aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena suaranya yang khas dan dalam, wajah yang unik, dan kehadiran layar dalam lebih dari 400 peran di film, teater, televisi, pekerjaan suara, dan media interaktif.

name: Kelsey Asbille
title: Kelsey Asbille
extract: Kelsey Asbille Chow, known as her stage name Kelsey Asbille, is an American actress. In 2024, Asbille played the lead role of Iris in the Netflix movie Don't Move. She has played Mikayla in the Disney XD sitcom Pair of Kings. From 2005 to 2009, she had a recurring role as Gigi Silveri on the drama One Tree Hill. She portrayed Tracy Stewart in MTV's Teen Wolf from 2015 to 2016. Asbille had a supporting role in the film Wind River and a recurring role in the television series Fargo, and played main character Monica Long Dutton in the Paramount Network western drama series Yellowstone (2018–2024).
extract_id: Kelsey Asbille Chow, dikenal dengan nama panggung Kelsey Asbille, adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Pada 2024, Asbille memerankan peran utama Iris dalam film Netflix Don't Move. Dia pernah berperan sebagai Mikayla dalam sitkom Disney XD Pair of Kings. Dari 2005 hingga 2009, dia memiliki peran berulang sebagai Gigi Silveri dalam drama One Tree Hill. Dia memerankan Tracy Stewart dalam Teen Wolf MTV dari 2015 hingga 2016. Asbille memiliki peran pendukung dalam film Wind River dan peran berulang dalam serial televisi Fargo, serta memainkan karakter utama Monica Long Dutton dalam serial drama western Paramount Network Yellowstone (2018–2024).

name: Kemp Powers
title: Kemp Powers
extract: Kemp Powers is an American playwright, screenwriter, and director. He is best known for his play One Night in Miami and the 2020 film adaptation of the same name, as well as for co-directing the animated films Soul (2020) and Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse (2023). His screenplay for One Night in Miami... earned him a Best Adapted Screenplay nomination at the 93rd Academy Awards, while his work on Soul made him the first African-American to co-direct a Walt Disney Animation Studios and Pixar feature. Powers was also nominated for the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature at the 96th Academy Awards.
extract_id: Kemp Powers adalah seorang dramawan, penulis skenario, dan sutradara Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena drama One Night in Miami dan adaptasi filmnya pada 2020, serta karena turut menyutradarai film animasi Soul (2020) dan Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse (2023). Skenarionya untuk One Night in Miami... memberinya nominasi Best Adapted Screenplay di Academy Awards ke-93, sementara karyanya pada Soul menjadikannya orang Afrika-Amerika pertama yang ikut menyutradarai film fitur Walt Disney Animation Studios dan Pixar. Powers juga dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Best Animated Feature di Academy Awards ke-96.

name: Ken Annakin
title: Ken Annakin
extract: Kenneth Cooper Annakin, was an English filmmaker. His career spanned half a century, beginning in the early 1940s and ending in 1992, and in the 1960s he was noticed by critics with large-scale adventure epic and comedies films, like Swiss Family Robinson, The Longest Day, Those Magnificent Men in Their Flying Machines, Battle of the Bulge, The Biggest Bundle of Them All and Monte Carlo or Bust!. He was an Academy Award and Directors Guild of America Award nominee, and received the Order of the British Empire in 2002.
extract_id: Kenneth Cooper Annakin adalah seorang pembuat film Inggris. Kariernya berlangsung selama setengah abad, dimulai pada awal tahun 1940-an dan berakhir pada 1992, dan pada 1960-an dia dikenal oleh para kritikus dengan film epik petualangan skala besar dan komedi, seperti Swiss Family Robinson, The Longest Day, Those Magnificent Men in Their Flying Machines, Battle of the Bulge, The Biggest Bundle of Them All, dan Monte Carlo or Bust!. Dia pernah dinominasikan Academy Award dan Directors Guild of America Award, serta menerima Order of the British Empire pada 2002.

name: Ken Foree
title: Ken Foree
extract: Kentotis Alvin Foree is an American actor, best known as the protagonist Peter from the horror film Dawn of the Dead (1978), Roger Rockmore on the Nickelodeon television sitcom Kenan & Kel (1996–2000), and Joe Grizzly from the horror film Halloween (2007).
extract_id: Kentotis Alvin Foree adalah aktor Amerika, paling dikenal sebagai protagonis Peter dari film horor Dawn of the Dead (1978), Roger Rockmore dalam sitkom televisi Nickelodeon Kenan & Kel (1996–2000), dan Joe Grizzly dari film horor Halloween (2007).

name: Ken Leung
title: Ken Leung
extract: Kenneth Leung is an American actor. Known for his roles on stage and screen, he has gained attention for playing Miles Straume in the ABC drama series Lost (2008–10) and Eric Tao in the HBO drama series Industry (2020–present).
extract_id: Kenneth Leung adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal karena perannya di panggung dan layar, ia mendapatkan perhatian dengan memerankan Miles Straume dalam serial drama ABC Lost (2008–10) dan Eric Tao dalam serial drama HBO Industry (2020–sekarang).

name: Ken Loach
title: Ken Loach
extract: Kenneth Charles Loach is a retired English filmmaker. His socially critical directing style and socialist views are evident in his film treatment of social issues such as poverty, homelessness, and labour rights.
extract_id: Kenneth Charles Loach adalah pembuat film Inggris yang sudah pensiun. Gaya penyutradaraan yang kritis sosial dan pandangan sosialisnya terlihat jelas dalam perlakuannya terhadap isu-isu sosial seperti kemiskinan, tunawisma, dan hak pekerja.

name: Ken Stott
title: Ken Stott
extract: Kenneth Campbell Stott is a Scottish stage, television, and film actor. His most notable roles include the title character DI John Rebus in the crime fiction-mystery series Rebus (2006–2007) and DCI Red Metcalfe in Messiah (2001–2005). Stott also appeared as the dwarf Balin in The Hobbit film trilogy (2012–2014).
extract_id: Kenneth Campbell Stott adalah aktor panggung, televisi, dan film asal Skotlandia. Peran paling terkenal termasuk karakter utama DI John Rebus dalam serial fiksi kriminal-misteri Rebus (2006–2007) dan DCI Red Metcalfe dalam Messiah (2001–2005). Stott juga tampil sebagai kurcaci Balin dalam trilogi film The Hobbit (2012–2014).

name: Ken Watanabe
title: Ken Watanabe
extract: Ken Watanabe is a Japanese actor. He is best known for playing tragic hero characters, such as General Tadamichi Kuribayashi in Letters from Iwo Jima and Lord Katsumoto Moritsugu in The Last Samurai, for which he was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor. Among other awards, Watanabe has won the Japan Academy Film Prize for Best Actor twice, in 2007 for Memories of Tomorrow and in 2010 for The Unbroken. He is also known for his roles in Christopher Nolan's films Batman Begins and Inception, as well as Memoirs of a Geisha, and Pokémon Detective Pikachu.
extract_id: Ken Watanabe adalah aktor Jepang. Ia paling dikenal karena memerankan karakter pahlawan tragis, seperti Jenderal Tadamichi Kuribayashi dalam Letters from Iwo Jima dan Lord Katsumoto Moritsugu dalam The Last Samurai, yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik. Di antara penghargaan lainnya, Watanabe telah memenangkan Japan Academy Film Prize untuk Aktor Terbaik dua kali, pada tahun 2007 untuk Memories of Tomorrow dan pada tahun 2010 untuk The Unbroken. Ia juga dikenal karena perannya dalam film Christopher Nolan Batman Begins dan Inception, serta Memoirs of a Geisha dan Pokémon Detective Pikachu.

name: Ken'ichi Hagiwara
title: Kenichi Hagiwara
extract: Kenichi Hagiwara was a Japanese singer and actor.
extract_id: Kenichi Hagiwara adalah penyanyi dan aktor Jepang.

name: Ken'ichi Matsuyama
title: Kenichi Matsuyama
extract: Kenichi Matsuyama is a Japanese actor. He is known for his affinity for strange character roles, and he is best known internationally for playing L in the 2006 films Death Note, Death Note 2: The Last Name, and L: Change the World in 2008. He played the main character Toru Watanabe in the film adaptation of Haruki Murakami's novel Norwegian Wood.
extract_id: Kenichi Matsuyama adalah aktor Jepang. Ia dikenal karena kecenderungannya memainkan karakter aneh, dan paling dikenal secara internasional untuk memerankan L dalam film-film Death Note tahun 2006, Death Note 2: The Last Name, dan L: Change the World pada tahun 2008. Ia memerankan tokoh utama Toru Watanabe dalam adaptasi film dari novel Norwegian Wood karya Haruki Murakami.

name: Kenneth Branagh
title: Kenneth Branagh
extract: Sir Kenneth Charles Branagh is a British actor and filmmaker. Born in Belfast and raised primarily in Reading, Branagh trained at Royal Academy of Dramatic Art in London and served as its president from 2015 to 2024. His accolades include an Academy Award, four BAFTAs, two Emmy Awards, a Golden Globe Award, and an Olivier Award. He was knighted in 2012, and was given Freedom of the City in his native Belfast in 2018. In 2020, he was ranked in 20th place on The Irish Times's list of Ireland's greatest film actors.
extract_id: Sir Kenneth Charles Branagh adalah aktor dan pembuat film Inggris. Lahir di Belfast dan dibesarkan terutama di Reading, Branagh menempuh pelatihan di Royal Academy of Dramatic Art di London dan menjabat sebagai presidennya dari 2015 hingga 2024. Penghargaan yang ia raih termasuk Academy Award, empat BAFTA, dua Emmy Awards, Golden Globe Award, dan Olivier Award. Ia diberi gelar kebangsawanan pada 2012, dan dianugerahi Freedom of the City di Belfast asalnya pada 2018. Pada 2020, ia menempati peringkat ke-20 dalam daftar aktor film terbesar Irlandia menurut The Irish Times.

name: Kenneth Lonergan
title: Kenneth Lonergan
description: American film director, playwright, and screenwriter (born 1962)
extract: Kenneth Lonergan is an American playwright, screenwriter and film director, and actor. He is known for his works which explore complex emotional and interpersonal dynamics. He has received several awards including an Academy Award and a BAFTA Award as well as nominations for three Golden Globe Awards, a Pulitzer Prize, a Laurence Olivier Award, and a Tony Award.
extract_id: Kenneth Lonergan adalah dramawan, penulis skenario, sutradara film, dan aktor Amerika. Ia dikenal dengan karya-karyanya yang mengeksplorasi dinamika emosional dan interpersonal yang kompleks. Ia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan termasuk Academy Award dan BAFTA Award serta nominasi untuk tiga Golden Globe Awards, Pulitzer Prize, Laurence Olivier Award, dan Tony Award.

name: Kenshô Ono
title: Kensho Ono
extract: Kensho Ono is a Japanese actor and singer. His most well-known characters are Tetsuya Kuroko, the titular protagonist in the anime series Kuroko's Basketball, Riku Nanase in Idolish7, Ryuunosuke Akutagawa in Bungo Stray Dogs, Giorno Giovanna in JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Slaine Troyard in Aldnoah.Zero, Yuya Sakaki in Yu-Gi-Oh! Arc-V, Hakuryu Ren in Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic, and Mikaela Hyakuya in Seraph of the End. He is also known as the Japanese dub voice of Harry Potter in the Harry Potter film series, and Miles Morales in Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse and Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse. He also plays Muromachi Tōji in the Prince of Tennis musical.
extract_id: Kensho Ono adalah aktor dan penyanyi Jepang. Karakter yang paling dikenal adalah Tetsuya Kuroko, protagonis utama dalam seri anime Kuroko's Basketball, Riku Nanase dalam Idolish7, Ryuunosuke Akutagawa dalam Bungo Stray Dogs, Giorno Giovanna dalam JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Slaine Troyard dalam Aldnoah.Zero, Yuya Sakaki dalam Yu-Gi-Oh! Arc-V, Hakuryu Ren dalam Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic, dan Mikaela Hyakuya dalam Seraph of the End. Ia juga dikenal sebagai pengisi suara dub bahasa Jepang untuk Harry Potter dalam seri film Harry Potter, dan Miles Morales dalam Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse dan Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse. Ia juga memerankan Muromachi Tōji dalam musikal Prince of Tennis.

name: Keri Russell
title: Keri Russell
extract: Keri Lynn Russell is an American actress. Working mainly in dramatic television since the 1990s, she has received eight nominations for the Critics' Choice Television Award for Best Actress in a Drama Series. She won a Golden Globe Award in 1999 for her lead role in the drama series Felicity, and has received eight Primetime Emmy Award nominations and four additional Golden Globe Award nominations for her roles in The Americans and The Diplomat. In 2017, she was honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame for her contributions to television.
extract_id: Keri Lynn Russell adalah aktris Amerika. Bekerja terutama di televisi drama sejak 1990-an, ia telah menerima delapan nominasi Critics' Choice Television Award untuk Aktris Terbaik dalam Serial Drama. Ia memenangkan Golden Globe Award pada 1999 untuk peran utama dalam serial drama Felicity, dan menerima delapan nominasi Primetime Emmy Award serta empat nominasi Golden Globe Award tambahan untuk perannya dalam The Americans dan The Diplomat. Pada 2017, ia dianugerahi bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame atas kontribusinya pada televisi.

name: Kerry Washington
title: Kerry Washington
extract: Kerry Marisa Washington is an American actress. She has received several accolades, including a Primetime Emmy Award as well as nominations for two Golden Globe Awards and two Tony Awards. She was included in Time's 100 list of most influential people in 2014, and Forbes named her the eighth-highest-paid television actress in 2018.
extract_id: Kerry Marisa Washington adalah aktris Amerika. Ia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk Primetime Emmy Award serta nominasi untuk dua Golden Globe Awards dan dua Tony Awards. Ia masuk dalam daftar 100 orang paling berpengaruh oleh Time pada 2014, dan Forbes menamakannya sebagai aktris televisi berpenghasilan tertinggi kedelapan pada 2018.

name: Kevin Altieri
title: Kevin Altieri
extract: Kevin Altieri is an American television director of animated cartoons. Altieri's directorial works include episodes of C.O.P.S., Batman: The Animated Series and Stripperella.
extract_id: Kevin Altieri adalah sutradara televisi Amerika untuk kartun animasi. Karya penyutradaraannya mencakup episode C.O.P.S., Batman: The Animated Series, dan Stripperella.

name: Kevin Bacon
title: Kevin Bacon
extract: Kevin Norwood Bacon is an American actor. Known for various roles, including leading man characters, Bacon has received numerous accolades such as a Golden Globe Award and two Actor Awards.
extract_id: Kevin Norwood Bacon adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal karena berbagai peran, termasuk karakter utama, Bacon telah menerima banyak penghargaan seperti Golden Globe Award dan dua Actor Awards.

name: Kevin Costner
title: Kevin Costner
extract: Kevin Michael Costner is an American actor, filmmaker, and musician. In a career spanning more than five decades, he has received various accolades, including two Academy Awards, three Golden Globe Awards, and a Primetime Emmy Award as well as nominations for three British Academy Film Awards.
extract_id: Kevin Michael Costner adalah aktor, pembuat film, dan musisi Amerika. Dalam karier yang berlangsung lebih dari lima dekade, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards, tiga Golden Globe Awards, dan Primetime Emmy Award serta nominasi untuk tiga British Academy Film Awards.

name: Kevin Jarre
title: Kevin Jarre
extract: Kevin Noel Jarre was an American screenwriter, actor, and film producer. He adopted the last name of his adoptive father, Maurice Jarre.
extract_id: Kevin Noel Jarre adalah penulis skenario, aktor, dan produser film Amerika. Ia mengadopsi nama belakang ayah angkatnya, Maurice Jarre.

name: Kevin Macdonald
title: Kevin Macdonald (director)
extract: Kevin Macdonald is a Scottish film director. His films include One Day in September (1999), a documentary about the 1972 murder of 11 Israeli athletes, which won him the Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature, the climbing documentary Touching the Void (2003), the drama The Last King of Scotland (2006), the political thriller State of Play (2009), the Bob Marley documentary Marley (2012), the post-apocalyptic drama How I Live Now (2013), the thriller Black Sea (2014), the Whitney Houston documentary Whitney (2018), and the legal drama film The Mauritanian (2021).
extract_id: Kevin Macdonald adalah sutradara film Skotlandia. Film-filmnya termasuk One Day in September (1999), sebuah film dokumenter tentang pembunuhan 11 atlet Israel pada 1972, yang membuatnya memenangkan Academy Award untuk Dokumenter Fitur Terbaik, dokumenter memanjat Touching the Void (2003), drama The Last King of Scotland (2006), thriller politik State of Play (2009), dokumenter Bob Marley Marley (2012), drama pasca-apokaliptik How I Live Now (2013), thriller Black Sea (2014), dokumenter Whitney Houston Whitney (2018), dan film drama hukum The Mauritanian (2021).

name: Kevin McCarthy
title: Kevin McCarthy (actor)
extract: Kevin McCarthy was an American stage, film and television actor, remembered as the male lead in the horror science fiction film Invasion of the Body Snatchers (1956).
extract_id: Kevin McCarthy adalah aktor panggung, film, dan televisi Amerika, dikenang sebagai pemeran utama pria dalam film horor fiksi ilmiah Invasion of the Body Snatchers (1956).

name: Kevin McKidd
title: Kevin McKidd
extract: Kevin Robert McKidd is a Scottish actor and television director best known for portraying Dr. Owen Hunt in Grey's Anatomy (2008–2026), Lucius Vorenus in Rome (2005–2007) and Tommy Mackenzie in Danny Boyle's Trainspotting (1996). His voice acting work includes portraying John "Soap" MacTavish in the video games Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009) and its 2011 sequel; and as Lord MacGuffin and his son in the Pixar film Brave (2012).
extract_id: Kevin Robert McKidd adalah aktor dan sutradara televisi Skotlandia yang paling dikenal karena memerankan Dr. Owen Hunt dalam Grey's Anatomy (2008–2026), Lucius Vorenus dalam Rome (2005–2007) dan Tommy Mackenzie dalam Trainspotting karya Danny Boyle (1996). Karya pengisi suaranya meliputi pemeran John "Soap" MacTavish dalam permainan video Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009) dan sekuel 2011-nya; serta sebagai Lord MacGuffin dan putranya dalam film Pixar Brave (2012).

name: Kevin Peter Hall
title: Kevin Peter Hall
extract: Kevin Peter Hall was an American actor. Standing 7 ft 2 in (2.18 m) tall, he frequently played monster characters. He was the original title character in the science fiction Predator franchise, appearing in the first 1987 film and its 1990 sequel. Hall also portrayed the eponymous Harry in the fantasy comedy film Harry and the Hendersons (1987), a role he reprised for the first season of the syndicated television adaptation (1990–1991). His human roles included Dr. Elvin "El" Lincoln on the NBC science fiction series Misfits of Science (1985–1986) and Warren Merriwether on the sitcom 227 (1989–1990).
extract_id: Kevin Peter Hall adalah aktor Amerika. Dengan tinggi badan 7 ft 2 in (2,18 m), ia sering memainkan karakter monster. Ia adalah pemeran asli karakter utama dalam franchise fiksi ilmiah Predator, muncul dalam film pertama tahun 1987 dan sekuelnya pada 1990. Hall juga memerankan tokoh utama Harry dalam film komedi fantasi Harry and the Hendersons (1987), sebuah peran yang ia ulangi untuk musim pertama adaptasi televisi sindikasi (1990–1991). Peran manusianya termasuk Dr. Elvin "El" Lincoln dalam serial fiksi ilmiah NBC Misfits of Science (1985–1986) dan Warren Merriwether dalam sitkom 227 (1989–1990).

name: Kevin Reynolds
title: Kevin Reynolds (director)
extract: Kevin Hal Reynolds is an American film director and screenwriter. He directed Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves, Waterworld, The Count of Monte Cristo, Fandango, and the 2016 film Risen. He was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award for the History miniseries Hatfields & McCoys.
extract_id: Kevin Hal Reynolds adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario Amerika. Ia menyutradarai Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves, Waterworld, The Count of Monte Cristo, Fandango, dan film tahun 2016 Risen. Ia dinominasikan untuk Primetime Emmy Award untuk miniseri History Hatfields & McCoys.

name: Kevin Smith
title: Kevin Smith
extract: Kevin Patrick Smith is an American filmmaker, actor, and podcaster. He came to prominence with the low-budget comedy film Clerks (1994), which he wrote, directed, co-produced, co-edited, and acted in as the character Silent Bob. Silent Bob and his partner in delinquency, Jay, also appear in Smith's later films Mallrats (1995), Chasing Amy (1997), Dogma (1999), Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back (2001), Clerks II (2006), Jay and Silent Bob Reboot (2019), and Clerks III (2022), which are set primarily in his home state of New Jersey. While not strictly sequential, the films have crossover plot elements, character references, and a shared canon known as the "View Askewniverse", named after Smith's production company View Askew Productions, which he co-founded with Scott Mosier.
extract_id: Kevin Patrick Smith adalah pembuat film, aktor, dan podcaster Amerika. Ia menjadi terkenal dengan film komedi berbiaya rendah Clerks (1994), yang ia tulis, sutradarai, coproduksi, sunting bersama, dan berakting sebagai karakter Silent Bob. Silent Bob dan rekannya dalam kenakalan, Jay, juga muncul dalam film-film Smith berikutnya Mallrats (1995), Chasing Amy (1997), Dogma (1999), Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back (2001), Clerks II (2006), Jay and Silent Bob Reboot (2019), dan Clerks III (2022), yang sebagian besar berlatar di negara bagian asalnya New Jersey. Meski tidak berurutan secara ketat, film-film itu memiliki elemen plot silang, referensi karakter, dan kanon bersama yang dikenal sebagai "View Askewniverse", dinamai dari perusahaan produksinya View Askew Productions yang didirikannya bersama Scott Mosier.

name: Kevin Spacey
title: Kevin Spacey
extract: Kevin Spacey Fowler is an American actor. Known for his work on stage and screen, he has received numerous accolades, including two Academy Awards, a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, a Tony Award, and two Laurence Olivier Awards as well as nominations for twelve Primetime Emmy Awards. He was named an honorary Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire in 2015.
extract_id: Kevin Spacey Fowler adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal untuk karyanya di panggung dan layar, ia telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards, BAFTA Award, Golden Globe Award, Tony Award, dan dua Laurence Olivier Awards serta nominasi untuk dua belas Primetime Emmy Awards. Ia dianugerahi gelar kehormatan Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire pada 2015.

name: Ki-duk Kim
title: Kim Ki-duk
extract: Kim Ki-duk was a South Korean filmmaker, noted for his idiosyncratic art-house cinematic works. His films have received many distinctions in the festival circuit, rendering him one of the most important contemporary Asian film directors.
extract_id: Kim Ki-duk adalah pembuat film Korea Selatan, terkenal karena karya sinema art-house-nya yang khas. Film-filmnya menerima banyak penghargaan di ajang festival, menjadikannya salah satu sutradara film Asia kontemporer terpenting.

name: Kiara Advani
title: Kiara Advani
extract: Kiara Advani is an Indian actress who works primarily in Hindi films. One of the highest-paid actresses in India, Advani is a recipient of several accolades including an IIFA Award and two Zee Cine Awards, alongside nominations for two Filmfare Awards.
extract_id: Kiara Advani adalah aktris asal India yang bekerja terutama di film Hindi. Salah satu aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di India, Advani adalah penerima beberapa penghargaan termasuk IIFA Award dan dua Zee Cine Awards, serta nominasi untuk dua Filmfare Awards.

name: Kiefer Sutherland
title: Kiefer Sutherland
extract: Kiefer William Frederick Dempsey George Rufus Sutherland is a British and Canadian actor. He is best known for his starring role as Jack Bauer in the Fox drama series 24, for which he won a Primetime Emmy Award and a Golden Globe Award, and President Tom Kirkman in the ABC political drama series Designated Survivor.
extract_id: Kiefer William Frederick Dempsey George Rufus Sutherland adalah aktor Inggris dan Kanada. Ia paling dikenal karena peran utamanya sebagai Jack Bauer dalam serial drama Fox 24, di mana ia memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award dan Golden Globe Award, serta Presiden Tom Kirkman dalam serial drama politik ABC Designated Survivor.

name: Kim Basinger
title: Kim Basinger
extract: Kimila Ann Basinger is an American actress. She has garnered acclaim for her work in film, for which she has received various accolades including an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, a Screen Actors Guild Award, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. Initially a TV starlet, she shot to fame as a Bond girl in 1983 and enjoyed a long heyday over the next two decades.
extract_id: Kimila Ann Basinger adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia mendapatkan pujian atas karyanya di film, yang membuatnya menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, Screen Actors Guild Award, dan sebuah bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame. Awalnya seorang bintang TV, dia meraih ketenaran sebagai Bond girl pada tahun 1983 dan menikmati masa kejayaan yang panjang selama dua dekade berikutnya.

name: Kim Byeong-Ok
title: Kim Byeong-ok
extract: Kim Byeong-ok is a South Korean actor. A veteran supporting actor, he is best known for his role as Mr. Han in Oldboy.
extract_id: Kim Byeong-ok adalah aktor Korea Selatan. Sebagai aktor pendukung veteran, dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Mr. Han dalam Oldboy.

name: Kim Greist
title: Kim Greist
extract: Kim Greist is a retired American actress and model. Her credits include C.H.U.D. (1984), Miami Vice (1985), Brazil (1985), Manhunter (1986), Throw Momma from the Train (1987), Punchline (1988), Homeward Bound: The Incredible Journey (1993), Roswell (1994) Houseguest (1995), and Judging Amy (2001).
extract_id: Kim Greist adalah mantan aktris dan model Amerika. Kreditnya meliputi C.H.U.D. (1984), Miami Vice (1985), Brazil (1985), Manhunter (1986), Throw Momma from the Train (1987), Punchline (1988), Homeward Bound: The Incredible Journey (1993), Roswell (1994), Houseguest (1995), dan Judging Amy (2001).

name: Kim Hunter
title: Kim Hunter
extract: Kim Hunter was an American theatre, film, and television actress. She achieved prominence for portraying Stella Kowalski in the original production of Tennessee Williams' A Streetcar Named Desire, which she reprised for the 1951 film adaptation, and won both an Academy Award and a Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: Kim Hunter adalah seorang aktris teater, film, dan televisi Amerika. Ia mencapai ketenaran karena memerankan Stella Kowalski dalam produksi asli A Streetcar Named Desire karya Tennessee Williams, yang juga ia mainkan kembali dalam adaptasi film tahun 1951, dan memenangkan Academy Award serta Golden Globe Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Kim Min-hee
title: Kim Min-hee (actress, born 1982)
extract: Kim Min-hee is a South Korean actress and model. She first gained recognition in the films Hellcats (2008), Helpless (2012), and Very Ordinary Couple (2013). Kim rose to international fame for her role as Lady Hideko in Park Chan-wook's 2016 film The Handmaiden. Since then, she has solely acted in the films of her partner, Hong Sang-soo. She won the Silver Bear for Best Actress for her performance in Hong's 2017 film On the Beach at Night Alone, and the Pardo for Best Performance at the 77th Locarno Film Festival in 2024 for her role in Hong's By the Stream and then again for her performance in Hong's Nowhere to Lay My Eyes at the 79th Locarno Film Festival.
extract_id: Kim Min-hee adalah aktris dan model Korea Selatan. Ia pertama kali dikenal melalui film Hellcats (2008), Helpless (2012), dan Very Ordinary Couple (2013). Kim naik ke ketenaran internasional lewat perannya sebagai Lady Hideko dalam film Park Chan-wook tahun 2016 The Handmaiden. Sejak itu, dia hanya berakting di film-film pasangannya, Hong Sang-soo. Dia memenangkan Silver Bear untuk Aktris Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam film Hong tahun 2017 On the Beach at Night Alone, dan Pardo untuk Penampilan Terbaik di Festival Film Locarno ke-77 tahun 2024 untuk perannya dalam film Hong By the Stream dan sekali lagi untuk penampilannya dalam film Hong Nowhere to Lay My Eyes di Festival Film Locarno ke-79.

name: Kim Novak
title: Kim Novak
extract: Marilyn Pauline "Kim" Malloy is a retired American actress. Her contributions to cinema have been honored with two Golden Globe Awards, an Honorary Golden Bear, a Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
extract_id: Marilyn Pauline "Kim" Malloy adalah seorang aktris Amerika yang sudah pensiun. Kontribusinya pada sinema telah dihormati dengan dua Penghargaan Golden Globe, Honorary Golden Bear, Golden Lion untuk Prestasi Seumur Hidup, dan sebuah bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame.

name: Kim Sang-kyung
title: Kim Sang-kyung
extract: Kim Sang-kyung is a South Korean actor. He is best known for his leading roles in Memories of Murder (2003), May 18 (2007), and The Tower (2012). Kim is also known for his collaborations with filmmaker Hong Sang-soo in On the Occasion of Remembering the Turning Gate (2002), Tale of Cinema (2005), and Ha Ha Ha (2010). He has starred in numerous television dramas, notably the period epic The Great King, Sejong (2008), the family comedy What Happens to My Family? (2014), and the historical drama The Crowned Clown (2019).
extract_id: Kim Sang-kyung adalah aktor Korea Selatan. Ia paling dikenal karena peran utama dalam Memories of Murder (2003), May 18 (2007), dan The Tower (2012). Kim juga dikenal karena kolaborasinya dengan sutradara Hong Sang-soo dalam On the Occasion of Remembering the Turning Gate (2002), Tale of Cinema (2005), dan Ha Ha Ha (2010). Dia juga tampil dalam banyak drama televisi, terutama epik periode The Great King, Sejong (2008), komedi keluarga What Happens to My Family? (2014), dan drama sejarah The Crowned Clown (2019).

name: Kim Tae-Woo
title: Kim Tae-woo (singer)
extract: Kim Tae-woo is a South Korean singer, best known as the lead vocalist of boy band g.o.d. He debuted in 1999 as a member of g.o.d and continued as a solo artist after the group went on hiatus in 2005. In addition to his solo career, Kim has also sung the OSTs of award-winning popular dramas and performed in musicals.
extract_id: Kim Tae-woo adalah penyanyi Korea Selatan, paling dikenal sebagai vokalis utama boy band g.o.d. Dia memulai debut pada tahun 1999 sebagai anggota g.o.d dan melanjutkan sebagai solois setelah grup tersebut hiatus pada tahun 2005. Selain karier solo, Kim juga menyanyikan OST dari drama populer pemenang penghargaan serta tampil dalam musikal.

name: Kim Yoon-seok
title: Kim Yoon-seok
extract: Kim Yoon-seok is a South Korean actor, film director and screenwriter. Kim began his career in theater and it subsequently led him to be cast in minor roles in films and television dramas. His breakout role came as the villain in gambling film Tazza: The High Rollers (2006), but it was his performance as an ex-cop turned pimp in surprise hit The Chaser (2008) that brought him wider recognition.
extract_id: Kim Yoon-seok adalah aktor, sutradara film, dan penulis skenario Korea Selatan. Kim memulai kariernya di teater yang kemudian membawanya mendapatkan peran kecil di film dan drama televisi. Peran terobosan datang sebagai penjahat dalam film perjudian Tazza: The High Rollers (2006), namun penampilannya sebagai mantan polisi yang menjadi mucikari dalam film hit The Chaser (2008) memberinya pengakuan yang lebih luas.

name: Kim Young-Min
title: Kim Young-min (actor)
extract: Kim Young-min is a South Korean actor. He is best known for his roles in television series My Mister (2018), Crash Landing on You (2019), The World of the Married (2020), and Military Prosecutor Doberman (2022).
extract_id: Kim Young-min adalah aktor Korea Selatan. Ia paling dikenal karena perannya dalam serial televisi My Mister (2018), Crash Landing on You (2019), The World of the Married (2020), dan Military Prosecutor Doberman (2022).

name: King Donovan
title: King Donovan
extract: Francis King Donovan was an American film, stage, and television actor, as well as a film and television director.
extract_id: Francis King Donovan adalah aktor film, panggung, dan televisi Amerika, serta sutradara film dan televisi.

name: Kinji Fukasaku
title: Kinji Fukasaku
extract: Kinji Fukasaku was a Japanese filmmaker. Known for his "broad range and innovative filmmaking", he worked in many different genres and styles, but was best known for his gritty yakuza films, typified by the Battles Without Honor and Humanity series (1973–1976). According to the Berkeley Art Museum and Pacific Film Archive, his "turbulent energy and at times extreme violence express a cynical critique of social conditions and genuine sympathy for those left out of Japan's postwar prosperity". He used a cinema verite-inspired shaky camera technique in many of his films from the early 1970s.
extract_id: Kinji Fukasaku adalah pembuat film Jepang. Dikenal karena "jangkauan luas dan pembuatan film yang inovatif", ia bekerja dalam banyak genre dan gaya berbeda, tetapi paling dikenal atas film yakuza yang keras, yang dicontohkan oleh seri Battles Without Honor and Humanity (1973–1976). Menurut Berkeley Art Museum and Pacific Film Archive, "energi turbulen dan kekerasan ekstremnya pada waktu tertentu mengekspresikan kritik sinis terhadap kondisi sosial dan simpati tulus kepada mereka yang ditinggalkan dari kemakmuran pascaperang Jepang". Ia menggunakan teknik kamera menggoyang yang terinspirasi oleh cinema verite dalam banyak filmnya sejak awal 1970-an.

name: Kirin Kiki
title: Kirin Kiki
extract: Kirin Kiki was a Japanese actress for Japanese cinema and television.
extract_id: Kirin Kiki adalah aktris Jepang untuk sinema dan televisi Jepang.

name: Kirk Acevedo
title: Kirk Acevedo
extract: Kirkland M. Acevedo is an American actor best known as Miguel Alvarez in Oz, Joe Toye in Band of Brothers, and FBI Agent Charlie Francis on Fringe. His best-known films are The Thin Red Line, Dinner Rush and Dawn of the Planet of the Apes. He also was José Ramse on 12 Monkeys (2015–18), as well as Ricardo Diaz / The Dragon on Arrow (2017–19).
extract_id: Kirkland M. Acevedo adalah aktor Amerika yang paling dikenal sebagai Miguel Alvarez di Oz, Joe Toye di Band of Brothers, dan Agen FBI Charlie Francis di Fringe. Film-film terkenalnya adalah The Thin Red Line, Dinner Rush, dan Dawn of the Planet of the Apes. Dia juga berperan sebagai José Ramse di 12 Monkeys (2015–18), serta Ricardo Diaz / The Dragon di Arrow (2017–19).

name: Kirk Douglas
title: Kirk Douglas
extract: Kirk Douglas was an American actor and filmmaker. After an impoverished childhood, he made his film debut in The Strange Love of Martha Ivers (1946) with Barbara Stanwyck. Douglas soon developed into a leading box-office star throughout the 1950s, known for serious dramas, including westerns and war films. During his career, he appeared in more than 90 films and was known for his explosive acting style. He was named by the American Film Institute the 17th-greatest male star of Classic Hollywood cinema.
extract_id: Kirk Douglas adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Setelah masa kecil yang miskin, dia memulai debut filmnya dalam The Strange Love of Martha Ivers (1946) bersama Barbara Stanwyck. Douglas segera berkembang menjadi bintang box-office utama sepanjang 1950-an, dikenal lewat drama serius, termasuk film koboi dan perang. Selama kariernya, dia tampil dalam lebih dari 90 film dan dikenal atas gaya aktingnya yang eksplosif. Dia dinobatkan oleh American Film Institute sebagai bintang pria ke-17 terbesar dalam sinema Hollywood klasik.

name: Kirk Wise
title: Kirk Wise
extract: Kirk Wise is an American film director, animator and screenwriter best known for his work at Walt Disney Animation Studios. Wise has directed Disney animated films such as Beauty and the Beast (1991), The Hunchback of Notre Dame (1996), and Atlantis: The Lost Empire (2001). He also directed the English-language translation of Hayao Miyazaki's Spirited Away (2001). He frequently works with Gary Trousdale and Don Hahn.
extract_id: Kirk Wise adalah sutradara film, animator, dan penulis naskah Amerika yang paling dikenal atas karyanya di Walt Disney Animation Studios. Wise telah menyutradarai film animasi Disney seperti Beauty and the Beast (1991), The Hunchback of Notre Dame (1996), dan Atlantis: The Lost Empire (2001). Ia juga menyutradarai terjemahan bahasa Inggris dari Spirited Away karya Hayao Miyazaki (2001). Dia sering bekerja sama dengan Gary Trousdale dan Don Hahn.

name: Kirron Kher
title: Kirron Kher
extract: Kirron Anupam Kher is an Indian politician, former actress, television personality, singer, and entertainment producer known for her work in Hindi films and television. She is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party and was a Member of Parliament in the Lok Sabha, the lower house of Indian Parliament, from Chandigarh, from 2014 to 2024. Through her film career, she is the recipient of two National Film Awards and a Lux Style Award, and has received four Filmfare Award nominations.
extract_id: Kirron Anupam Kher adalah politikus India, mantan aktris, tokoh televisi, penyanyi, dan produser hiburan yang dikenal karena karyanya di film dan televisi Hindi. Dia adalah anggota Bharatiya Janata Party dan pernah menjadi Anggota Parlemen di Lok Sabha, majelis rendah Parlemen India, dari Chandigarh, dari 2014 hingga 2024. Melalui karir filmnya, dia menerima dua National Film Awards dan satu Lux Style Award, serta mendapat empat nominasi Filmfare Award.

name: Kirsten Dunst
title: Kirsten Dunst
extract: Kirsten Caroline Dunst is an American actress and singer. She made her acting debut in the anthology film New York Stories (1989) and has since starred in many film and television productions. Dunst has been praised for her nuanced performances playing widely different characters across multiple genres, working with auteur filmmakers in both blockbuster and art house fare.
extract_id: Kirsten Caroline Dunst adalah aktris dan penyanyi Amerika. Dia melakukan debut aktingnya dalam film antologi New York Stories (1989) dan sejak itu telah membintangi banyak produksi film dan televisi. Dunst dipuji atas penampilan bernuansa yang memerankan karakter yang sangat berbeda di berbagai genre, bekerja dengan sutradara auteur baik dalam film blockbuster maupun arthouse.

name: Kirsten Sheridan
title: Kirsten Sheridan
extract: Kirsten Sheridan is an Irish film director and screenwriter. She is best known for co-writing the semi-autobiographical film In America with her father, director Jim Sheridan, and her sister, Naomi Sheridan, for which she was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay and a Golden Globe Award for and Best Screenplay.
extract_id: Kirsten Sheridan adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario Irlandia. Dia paling dikenal karena menulis skenario bersama untuk film semi-autobiografis In America bersama ayahnya, sutradara Jim Sheridan, dan saudara perempuannya, Naomi Sheridan, yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Best Original Screenplay dan Golden Globe Award untuk Best Screenplay.

name: Kirti Kulhari
title: Kirti Kulhari
extract: Kirti Kulhari is an Indian actress who works in Hindi-language films and series. She made her acting debut with the film Khichdi: The Movie in 2010 and then starred in Shaitan in 2011. She then appeared in the films Jal (2013), Pink (2016), Indu Sarkar (2017), Uri: The Surgical Strike (2019), and Mission Mangal (2019). Kulhari has starred in several streaming series, which includes Four More Shots Please! (2019–present), Criminal Justice (2020) and Human (2022).
extract_id: Kirti Kulhari adalah aktris India yang bekerja di film dan serial berbahasa Hindi. Dia memulai debut aktingnya dengan film Khichdi: The Movie pada tahun 2010 dan kemudian membintangi Shaitan pada tahun 2011. Dia kemudian tampil dalam film Jal (2013), Pink (2016), Indu Sarkar (2017), Uri: The Surgical Strike (2019), dan Mission Mangal (2019). Kulhari juga membintangi beberapa serial streaming, termasuk Four More Shots Please! (2019–sekarang), Criminal Justice (2020), dan Human (2022).

name: Kishori Ballal
title: Kishori Ballal
extract: Kishori Ballal was an Indian actress who was known for her works in Kannada cinema.
extract_id: Kishori Ballal adalah aktris India yang dikenal atas karyanya di sinema Kannada.

name: Kiyoshi Kobayashi
title: Kiyoshi Kobayashi
extract: Kiyoshi Kobayashi was a Japanese actor, voice actor and narrator from Tokyo. He was attached to the Tokyo Actor's Consumer's Cooperative Society. He was a graduate of the arts department of Nihon University.
extract_id: Kiyoshi Kobayashi adalah aktor Jepang, pengisi suara, dan narator dari Tokyo. Dia tergabung dalam Tokyo Actor's Consumer's Cooperative Society. Dia lulus dari departemen seni Nihon University.

name: Klaus Kinski
title: Klaus Kinski
extract: Klaus Kinski was a German actor. Equally renowned for his intense performance style and his notoriously eccentric and volatile personality off-screen, he appeared in over 130 film roles in a career that spanned 41 years, from 1948 to 1989. He is best known for starring in five films directed by Werner Herzog from 1972 to 1987, who would later chronicle their tumultuous relationship in the documentary My Best Fiend.
extract_id: Klaus Kinski adalah aktor Jerman. Sama terkenalnya karena gaya aktingnya yang intens dan kepribadiannya yang eksentrik dan mudah berubah di luar layar, ia tampil dalam lebih dari 130 peran film dalam karier yang berlangsung 41 tahun, dari 1948 hingga 1989. Ia paling dikenal karena membintangi lima film yang disutradarai Werner Herzog dari 1972 hingga 1987, yang kemudian mendokumentasikan hubungan mereka yang rumit dalam film dokumenter My Best Fiend.

name: Klaus Wennemann
title: Klaus Wennemann
extract: Klaus Wennemann was a German television and film actor.
extract_id: Klaus Wennemann adalah aktor televisi dan film Jerman.

name: Kodi Smit-McPhee
title: Kodi Smit-McPhee
extract: Kodi Smit-McPhee is an Australian actor. He gained recognition as a child actor for his leading roles in The Road (2009) and Let Me In (2010). He provided the voice of Norman Babcock in stop-motion animations ParaNorman (2012) and Gilbert Pudel in Memoir of a Snail (2024), and appeared in Dawn of the Planet of the Apes (2014), Slow West (2015), Alpha (2018), and played Nightcrawler in X-Men: Apocalypse (2016) and Dark Phoenix (2019).
extract_id: Kodi Smit-McPhee adalah seorang aktor Australia. Dia mendapatkan pengakuan sebagai aktor cilik untuk peran utama dalam The Road (2009) dan Let Me In (2010).
