Dia memberikan suara Norman Babcock dalam animasi stop-motion ParaNorman (2012) dan Gilbert Pudel dalam Memoir of a Snail (2024), serta tampil dalam Dawn of the Planet of the Apes (2014), Slow West (2015), Alpha (2018), dan berperan sebagai Nightcrawler dalam X-Men: Apocalypse (2016) dan Dark Phoenix (2019).

name: Konkona Sen Sharma
title: Konkona Sen Sharma
extract: Konkona Sen Sharma is an Indian actress and filmmaker who works in Bengali and Hindi films. She has received several awards, including two National Film Awards and three Filmfare Awards. The child of filmmaker and actress Aparna Sen, she is primarily known for her work in independent films, in addition to working in mainstream films.
extract_id: Konkona Sen Sharma adalah seorang aktris dan pembuat film India yang bekerja di film Bengali dan Hindi. Dia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk dua Penghargaan Film Nasional dan tiga Penghargaan Filmfare. Anak dari pembuat film dan aktris Aparna Sen, dia terutama dikenal karena karyanya di film independen, selain bekerja di film arus utama.

name: Konstantin Lavronenko
title: Konstantin Lavronenko
extract: Konstantin Nikolaevich Lavronenko is a Soviet and Russian actor known for his role as the mysterious father of two boys in 2003 film Vozvrashcheniye. Lavronenko won the Best Actor prize at the 2007 Cannes Film Festival for The Banishment.
extract_id: Konstantin Nikolaevich Lavronenko adalah aktor Soviet dan Rusia yang dikenal karena perannya sebagai ayah misterius dari dua anak laki-laki dalam film Vozvrashcheniye tahun 2003. Lavronenko memenangkan penghargaan Aktor Terbaik di Festival Film Cannes 2007 untuk film The Banishment.

name: Kristen Wiig
title: Kristen Wiig
extract: Kristen Carroll Wiig is an American actress, comedian, screenwriter, and producer. First breaking through as a performer with the Los Angeles comedy troupe The Groundlings, Wiig achieved stardom in the late 2000s for her seven-season tenure on the NBC sketch comedy series Saturday Night Live (SNL) from 2005 to 2012.
extract_id: Kristen Carroll Wiig adalah seorang aktris, komedian, penulis skenario, dan produser Amerika. Pertama kali dikenal sebagai pemain dengan kelompok komedi Los Angeles The Groundlings, Wiig meraih ketenaran pada akhir 2000-an karena masa tujuh musimnya di serial komedi sketsa NBC Saturday Night Live (SNL) dari 2005 hingga 2012.

name: Kristina Adolphson
title: Kristina Adolphson
extract: Kristina Adolphson is a Swedish film actress. She was born in Stockholm, Sweden. She is the daughter of the actor Edvin Adolphson and the actress Mildred Mehle, and the sister of the singer Olle Adolphson. She was married to the actor Erland Josephson.
extract_id: Kristina Adolphson adalah seorang aktris film Swedia. Dia lahir di Stockholm, Swedia. Dia adalah putri dari aktor Edvin Adolphson dan aktris Mildred Mehle, serta saudara perempuan penyanyi Olle Adolphson. Dia pernah menikah dengan aktor Erland Josephson.

name: Krzysztof Kieslowski
title: Krzysztof Kieślowski
extract: Krzysztof Kieślowski was a Polish film director and screenwriter. He is known internationally for Dekalog (1989), The Double Life of Veronique (1991), and the Three Colours trilogy (1993–1994).
extract_id: Krzysztof Kieślowski adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film Polandia. Dia dikenal secara internasional untuk Dekalog (1989), The Double Life of Veronique (1991), dan trilogi Three Colours (1993–1994).

name: Kumud Mishra
title: Kumud Mishra
extract: Kumud Mishra is an Indian actor who works in Hindi cinema. He is known for playing supporting and antagonist roles.
extract_id: Kumud Mishra adalah seorang aktor India yang bekerja di sinema Hindi. Dia dikenal karena memainkan peran pendukung dan antagonis.

name: Kurt Fuller
title: Kurt Fuller
extract: Kurt Fuller is an American character actor. He has appeared in a number of television, film, and stage projects. He is known for his roles in the films No Holds Barred and Ghostbusters II, Wayne's World (1992), and Scary Movie (2000), as well as for his television roles playing Coroner Woody Strode in the USA Network television series Psych (2009–2014) and Zachariah in Supernatural (2009–2019).
extract_id: Kurt Fuller adalah seorang aktor karakter Amerika. Dia telah tampil di sejumlah proyek televisi, film, dan panggung. Dia dikenal untuk perannya dalam film No Holds Barred dan Ghostbusters II, Wayne's World (1992), dan Scary Movie (2000), serta peran televisinya sebagai Coroner Woody Strode dalam serial televisi USA Network Psych (2009–2014) dan Zachariah dalam Supernatural (2009–2019).

name: Kurt Russell
title: Kurt Russell
extract: Kurt Vogel Russell is an American actor. He began his career as a child actor before transitioning to leading roles as an adult in various genres such as action adventures, science-fiction, westerns, romance films, comedic films, and family dramas. He is known for collaborating with filmmakers such as John Carpenter and Quentin Tarantino, and has received a Critics' Choice Super Award as well as various award nominations, including for a Primetime Emmy Award and a Golden Globe Award.
extract_id: Kurt Vogel Russell adalah aktor Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya sebagai aktor cilik sebelum beralih ke peran utama sebagai dewasa dalam berbagai genre seperti petualangan aksi, fiksi ilmiah, barat, film romansa, film komedi, dan drama keluarga. Dia dikenal karena kolaborasinya dengan pembuat film seperti John Carpenter dan Quentin Tarantino, dan telah menerima Critics' Choice Super Award serta berbagai nominasi penghargaan, termasuk Primetime Emmy Award dan Golden Globe Award.

name: Kyle Chandler
title: Kyle Chandler
extract: Kyle Martin Chandler is an American actor. He received critical acclaim for his performance as Eric Taylor in the NBC series Friday Night Lights (2006–2011), winning the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Drama Series in 2011.
extract_id: Kyle Martin Chandler adalah aktor Amerika. Dia menerima pujian kritis atas penampilannya sebagai Eric Taylor dalam serial NBC Friday Night Lights (2006–2011), memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award untuk Aktor Utama Terbaik dalam Serial Drama pada 2011.

name: Kyle MacLachlan
title: Kyle MacLachlan
extract: Kyle MacLachlan is an American actor. He is best known for his collaborations with David Lynch, having portrayed the role of Dale Cooper thrice in Twin Peaks, which won him a Golden Globe and nominations for two Primetime Emmy Awards, and its film prequel Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me (1992), as well as playing Paul Atreides in Dune (1984) and Jeffrey Beaumont in Blue Velvet (1986). MacLachlan's other film roles include Lloyd Gallagher in The Hidden (1987), Ray Manzarek in The Doors (1991), Cliff Vandercave in The Flintstones (1994), Zack Carey in Showgirls (1995), and Riley's father in the two films of the Inside Out film series.
extract_id: Kyle MacLachlan adalah aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal untuk kolaborasinya dengan David Lynch, dengan memerankan peran Dale Cooper tiga kali dalam Twin Peaks, yang memberinya Golden Globe dan nominasi untuk dua Primetime Emmy Awards, serta film prekuel Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me (1992), juga memerankan Paul Atreides dalam Dune (1984) dan Jeffrey Beaumont dalam Blue Velvet (1986). Peran film MacLachlan lainnya termasuk Lloyd Gallagher dalam The Hidden (1987), Ray Manzarek dalam The Doors (1991), Cliff Vandercave dalam The Flintstones (1994), Zack Carey dalam Showgirls (1995), dan ayah Riley dalam dua film seri Inside Out.

name: Kyôko Kagawa
title: Kyōko Kagawa
extract: Kyōko Kagawa is a Japanese actress. During her career spanning 70 years, she has worked with directors like Akira Kurosawa, Kenji Mizoguchi, Yasujirō Ozu and Mikio Naruse, appearing in films such as Tokyo Story, Sansho the Bailiff, The Bad Sleep Well, Mothra, and High and Low.
extract_id: Kyōko Kagawa adalah seorang aktris Jepang. Selama kariernya yang berlangsung 70 tahun, dia telah bekerja dengan sutradara seperti Akira Kurosawa, Kenji Mizoguchi, Yasujirō Ozu, dan Mikio Naruse, tampil dalam film-film seperti Tokyo Story, Sansho the Bailiff, The Bad Sleep Well, Mothra, dan High and Low.

name: Kátia Lund
title: Kátia Lund
extract: Kátia Lund is a Brazilian film director and screenwriter. Her most notable work was as co-director of the film City of God.
extract_id: Kátia Lund adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film Brasil. Karya terpentingnya adalah sebagai sutradara bersama film City of God.

name: Kåre Hedebrant
title: Kåre Hedebrant
extract: Kåre Hedebrant is a Swedish actor.
extract_id: Kåre Hedebrant adalah seorang aktor Swedia.

name: Kôichi Yamadera
title: Koichi Yamadera
extract: Koichi Yamadera is a Japanese actor, narrator and singer from Shiogama, Miyagi Prefecture. He graduated from Tohoku Gakuin University's economics school and is currently affiliated with Across Entertainment. Before that, he was affiliated with the Tokyo Actor's Consumer's Cooperative Society.
extract_id: Koichi Yamadera adalah aktor, pencerita, dan penyanyi Jepang dari Shiogama, Prefektur Miyagi. Dia lulus dari sekolah ekonomi Universitas Tohoku Gakuin dan saat ini berafiliasi dengan Across Entertainment. Sebelumnya, dia berafiliasi dengan Tokyo Actor's Consumer's Cooperative Society.

name: Lady Gaga
title: Lady Gaga
extract: Stefani Joanne Angelina Germanotta, known professionally as Lady Gaga, is an American singer, songwriter, and actress. An influential figure in popular music, she is known for her image reinventions, flamboyant fashion, and versatility across the entertainment industry. With estimated sales of 124 million records, she is one of the best-selling music artists of all time.
extract_id: Stefani Joanne Angelina Germanotta, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Lady Gaga, adalah penyanyi, penulis lagu, dan aktris Amerika. Sebagai figur berpengaruh dalam musik populer, dia dikenal dengan perubahan citra, mode flamboyan, dan fleksibilitasnya di berbagai industri hiburan. Dengan perkiraan penjualan sebanyak 124 juta rekaman, dia adalah salah satu artis musik dengan penjualan terbaik sepanjang masa.

name: Laia Costa
title: Laia Costa
extract: Laia Costa Bertrán is a Spanish actress from Catalonia. Known for her work in international film and television productions, Costa has won several accolades, including a Goya Award, two Platino Awards and a German Film Award, in addition to nominations for a British Academy Film Award and a European Film Award.
extract_id: Laia Costa Bertrán adalah seorang aktris Spanyol dari Catalonia. Dikenal untuk karyanya dalam produksi film dan televisi internasional, Costa telah memenangkan beberapa penghargaan, termasuk Penghargaan Goya, dua Penghargaan Platino dan Penghargaan Film Jerman, selain nominasi untuk British Academy Film Award dan European Film Award.

name: Laila Robins
title: Laila Robins
extract: Laila Robins is an American stage, film and television actress. She has appeared in films including Planes, Trains and Automobiles (1987), An Innocent Man (1989), Live Nude Girls (1995), True Crime (1999), She's Lost Control (2014), Eye in the Sky (2015), and A Call to Spy (2019). Her television credits include regular roles on Gabriel's Fire, Homeland, and Murder in the First, playing Pamela Milton in the final season of The Walking Dead (2022), and Colonel Grace Mallory in The Boys (2019–2024) and Gen V (2023).
extract_id: Laila Robins adalah seorang aktris panggung, film, dan televisi Amerika. Dia telah tampil dalam film seperti Planes, Trains and Automobiles (1987), An Innocent Man (1989), Live Nude Girls (1995), True Crime (1999), She's Lost Control (2014), Eye in the Sky (2015), dan A Call to Spy (2019). Kredit televisinya termasuk peran reguler di Gabriel's Fire, Homeland, dan Murder in the First, memerankan Pamela Milton di musim terakhir The Walking Dead (2022), dan Kolonel Grace Mallory di The Boys (2019–2024) dan Gen V (2023).

name: Lamberto Maggiorani
title: Lamberto Maggiorani
extract: Lamberto Maggiorani was an Italian actor remembered for his portrayal of Antonio Ricci in the 1948 Vittorio De Sica film Bicycle Thieves.
extract_id: Lamberto Maggiorani adalah aktor Italia yang diingat karena perannya sebagai Antonio Ricci dalam film Vittorio De Sica tahun 1948 Bicycle Thieves.

name: Lana Wachowski
title: The Wachowskis
extract: Lana Wachowski and Lilly Wachowski are American film and television directors, writers and producers. Together known as the Wachowskis, the sisters are both trans women and have worked as a writing and directing team throughout most of their careers. They made their directing debut with Bound (1996), and achieved fame with The Matrix (1999), a major box-office success for which they won the Saturn Award for Best Director. They wrote and directed two sequels, The Matrix Reloaded and The Matrix Revolutions, and were involved in the writing and production of other works in the Matrix franchise.
extract_id: Lana Wachowski dan Lilly Wachowski adalah sutradara film dan televisi Amerika, penulis, dan produser. Bersama-sama dikenal sebagai Wachowskis, kedua saudara perempuan ini adalah wanita transgender dan telah bekerja sebagai tim penulis dan sutradara sepanjang sebagian besar karier mereka. Mereka membuat debut penyutradaraan dengan Bound (1996), dan meraih ketenaran dengan The Matrix (1999), sebuah sukses besar di box-office yang membuat mereka memenangkan Saturn Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik. Mereka menulis dan menyutradarai dua sekuel, The Matrix Reloaded dan The Matrix Revolutions, serta terlibat dalam penulisan dan produksi karya lain dalam franchise Matrix.

name: Lance Henriksen
title: Lance Henriksen
extract: Lance Henriksen is an American actor. He is known for his roles in various science fiction, action and horror genre productions, including Bishop in the Alien film franchise and Frank Black in the television series Millennium (1996–99) and The X-Files (1999).
extract_id: Lance Henriksen adalah aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya dalam berbagai produksi genre fiksi ilmiah, aksi, dan horor, termasuk Bishop dalam franchise film Alien dan Frank Black dalam serial televisi Millennium (1996–99) dan The X-Files (1999).

name: Lari White
title: Lari White
description: American country musician, singer, songwriter, producer, and actress (1965–2018)
extract: Lari Michele White Cannon was an American country musician, singer, songwriter, record producer, and actress. She made her debut in 1988 after winning You Can Be a Star, a televised talent competition on The Nashville Network. After an unsuccessful stint on Capitol Records Nashville, she signed to RCA Records Nashville in 1993.
extract_id: Lari Michele White Cannon adalah musisi country Amerika, penyanyi, penulis lagu, produser rekaman, dan aktris. Dia memulai debutnya pada 1988 setelah memenangkan You Can Be a Star, kompetisi bakat yang disiarkan di The Nashville Network. Setelah masa yang kurang berhasil di Capitol Records Nashville, dia menandatangani kontrak dengan RCA Records Nashville pada tahun 1993.

name: Larry Gates
title: Larry Gates
extract: Lawrence Wheaton Gates was an American actor.
extract_id: Lawrence Wheaton Gates adalah aktor Amerika.

name: Lars Ranthe
title: Lars Ranthe

name: Lars von Trier
title: Lars von Trier
extract: Lars von Trier is a Danish film director and screenwriter widely known for his provocative and highly polarizing style. His most notable works include Breaking the Waves (1996), The Idiots (1998), Dancer in the Dark (2000), Dogville (2003), Antichrist (2009), Melancholia (2011) and Nymphomaniac (2013), as well as The Kingdom miniseries trilogy (1994–2022).
extract_id: Lars von Trier adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario Denmark yang sangat dikenal karena gaya kontroversial dan sangat memecah belahnya. Karya terkenalnya termasuk Breaking the Waves (1996), The Idiots (1998), Dancer in the Dark (2000), Dogville (2003), Antichrist (2009), Melancholia (2011), dan Nymphomaniac (2013), serta trilogi mini seri The Kingdom (1994–2022).

name: Lasse Hallström
title: Lasse Hallström
extract: Lars Sven "Lasse" Hallström is a Swedish film director. He first became known for directing almost all music videos by the pop group ABBA, and came to international attention with My Life as a Dog (1985). He is also known for What's Eating Gilbert Grape (1993), The Cider House Rules (1999), and Chocolat (2000). He has been nominated for the Academy Award for Best Adapted Screenplay, as well as the Academy Award for Best Director twice.
extract_id: Lars Sven "Lasse" Hallström adalah seorang sutradara film asal Swedia. Ia pertama kali dikenal karena mengarahkan hampir semua video musik oleh grup pop ABBA, dan mendapatkan perhatian internasional lewat film My Life as a Dog (1985). Ia juga dikenal lewat film What's Eating Gilbert Grape (1993), The Cider House Rules (1999), dan Chocolat (2000). Ia pernah dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Best Adapted Screenplay, serta Academy Award untuk Best Director dua kali.

name: Laura Dern
title: Laura Dern
extract: Laura Elizabeth Dern is an American actress. She is the recipient of numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, an Actor Award, a BAFTA Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, and five Golden Globes.
extract_id: Laura Elizabeth Dern adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Actor Award, BAFTA Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dan lima Golden Globe.

name: Laura Harring
title: Laura Harring
extract: Laura Elena Harring is a Mexican and American actress and beauty pageant titleholder who won Miss USA 1985 and later began acting in television and film. She is best known for her lead role as Rita in the 2001 movie Mulholland Drive. Her other films include The Forbidden Dance (1990), John Q (2002), Willard (2003), The Punisher (2004), The King (2005), Love in the Time of Cholera (2007), Ghost Son (2007), The Caller (2008), Drool (2009), Sex Ed (2014), and Inside (2016). She also played Carla Greco in General Hospital (1990–1991), Paula Stevens on Sunset Beach (1997), and Rebecca "Becca" Doyle in The Shield (2006).
extract_id: Laura Elena Harring adalah seorang aktris dan pemegang gelar kecantikan Meksiko dan Amerika yang memenangkan Miss USA 1985 dan kemudian mulai berakting di televisi dan film. Ia paling dikenal untuk peran utamanya sebagai Rita dalam film Mulholland Drive tahun 2001. Film-film lainnya termasuk The Forbidden Dance (1990), John Q (2002), Willard (2003), The Punisher (2004), The King (2005), Love in the Time of Cholera (2007), Ghost Son (2007), The Caller (2008), Drool (2009), Sex Ed (2014), dan Inside (2016). Ia juga memerankan Carla Greco di General Hospital (1990–1991), Paula Stevens di Sunset Beach (1997), dan Rebecca "Becca" Doyle di The Shield (2006).

name: Laura Linney
title: Laura Linney
extract: Laura Leggett Linney is an American actress and director. She is the recipient of several awards, including four Primetime Emmy Awards, two Golden Globe Awards, and a Screen Actors Guild Award, in addition to nominations for three Academy Awards, five Tony Awards, and a BAFTA.
extract_id: Laura Leggett Linney adalah seorang aktris dan sutradara asal Amerika. Ia memperoleh beberapa penghargaan, termasuk empat Primetime Emmy Awards, dua Golden Globe Awards, dan Screen Actors Guild Award, serta mendapat nominasi untuk tiga Academy Awards, lima Tony Awards, dan satu BAFTA.

name: Laura Vasiliu
title: Laura Vasiliu
extract: Laura Vasiliu is a Romanian actress.
extract_id: Laura Vasiliu adalah seorang aktris asal Rumania.

name: Lauren Bacall
title: Lauren Bacall
extract: Betty Joan Perske, known professionally as Lauren Bacall, was an American actress. She was named the 20th-greatest female star of classic Hollywood cinema by the American Film Institute and was one of the last surviving major stars from the Golden Age of Hollywood cinema. She received an Academy Honorary Award in 2009 in recognition of her contribution to the Golden Age of motion pictures.
extract_id: Betty Joan Perske, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Lauren Bacall, adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Ia dinobatkan sebagai bintang wanita ke-20 terbesar di sinema klasik Hollywood oleh American Film Institute dan merupakan salah satu bintang utama terakhir yang masih hidup dari Era Keemasan sinema Hollywood. Ia menerima Academy Honorary Award pada tahun 2009 sebagai penghargaan atas kontribusinya pada Era Keemasan film.

name: Lauren Ridloff
title: Lauren Ridloff
extract: Lauren Ridloff is a deaf American actress known for her roles in the TV series The Walking Dead and the film Eternals. She gained prominence in 2018 with a lead role in the Broadway revival of Children of a Lesser God, earning her a Tony Award nomination for Best Actress in a Play. Ridloff was born in Chicago, Illinois. She attended California State University, Northridge and later earned a master's degree in education from Hunter College. She initially worked as a teacher before pursuing acting, and she was also crowned Miss Deaf America.
extract_id: Lauren Ridloff adalah seorang aktris Amerika tuli yang dikenal melalui perannya di serial TV The Walking Dead dan film Eternals. Ia menjadi terkenal pada tahun 2018 dengan peran utama dalam kebangkitan Broadway Children of a Lesser God, yang memberikannya nominasi Tony Award untuk Best Actress in a Play. Ridloff lahir di Chicago, Illinois. Ia bersekolah di California State University, Northridge dan kemudian meraih gelar magister pendidikan dari Hunter College. Awalnya ia bekerja sebagai guru sebelum mengejar karier akting, dan ia juga dinobatkan sebagai Miss Deaf America.

name: Laurence Fishburne
title: Laurence Fishburne
extract: Laurence John Fishburne III is an American actor. Throughout his career, he has gained recognition for his roles on stage and screen as militant and authoritative characters. Fishburne first came to prominence appearing in Apocalypse Now (1979) and achieved further recognition for his supporting role in Boyz n the Hood (1991). Later, he became known for portraying Morpheus in The Matrix trilogy (1999–2003) and the Bowery King in the John Wick film series (2017–).
extract_id: Laurence John Fishburne III adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Sepanjang kariernya, ia dikenal karena peran-peran sebagai karakter militan dan otoritatif di panggung dan layar. Fishburne pertama kali dikenal melalui peran dalam Apocalypse Now (1979) dan semakin terkenal lewat peran pendukung di Boyz n the Hood (1991). Kemudian, ia dikenal sebagai Morpheus dalam trilogi The Matrix (1999–2003) dan Bowery King dalam seri film John Wick (2017–).

name: Laurence Harvey
title: Laurence Harvey
extract: Laurence Harvey was a Lithuanian-born British actor and film director. He was born to Lithuanian Jewish parents and immigrated to South Africa at an early age, before later settling in the United Kingdom after World War II. In a career that spanned a quarter of a century, Harvey appeared in stage, film and television productions primarily in the United Kingdom and the United States.
extract_id: Laurence Harvey adalah aktor dan sutradara film kelahiran Lithuania yang berkebangsaan Inggris. Ia lahir dari orang tua Yahudi Lithuania dan bermigrasi ke Afrika Selatan pada usia dini, sebelum akhirnya menetap di Inggris setelah Perang Dunia II. Dalam karier yang berlangsung selama seperempat abad, Harvey berperan dalam pertunjukan panggung, film, dan televisi terutama di Inggris dan Amerika Serikat.

name: Laurence Olivier
title: Laurence Olivier
extract: Laurence Kerr Olivier, Baron Olivier was an English actor and director. He and his contemporaries John Gielgud, Michael Redgrave and Ralph Richardson made up a quartet of male actors who dominated the British stage of the mid-20th century. He also worked in films throughout his six-decade career, playing more than fifty cinema roles. Late in his career, Olivier had considerable success in television roles.
extract_id: Laurence Kerr Olivier, Baron Olivier adalah seorang aktor dan sutradara Inggris. Ia dan rekan-rekannya John Gielgud, Michael Redgrave, dan Ralph Richardson membentuk kuartet aktor pria yang mendominasi panggung Inggris pada pertengahan abad ke-20. Ia juga bekerja di film sepanjang karier enam dekadenya, memerankan lebih dari lima puluh peran di layar lebar. Di penghujung kariernya, Olivier meraih kesuksesan besar dalam peran televisi.

name: Lazar Ristovski
title: Lazar Ristovski
description: Serbian actor, director, producer and writer
extract: Lazar "Laza" Ristovski is a Serbian former actor, director, producer and writer. He has appeared on stage about 4,000 times, and starred in over 90 films and 30 TV series, mostly in lead roles. He briefly served as a member of the National Assembly from 1 August 2022 until his resignation on 9 August 2022.
extract_id: Lazar "Laza" Ristovski adalah mantan aktor, sutradara, produser, dan penulis asal Serbia. Ia telah tampil di panggung sekitar 4.000 kali, dan membintangi lebih dari 90 film serta 30 serial TV, sebagian besar dalam peran utama. Ia secara singkat menjabat sebagai anggota Majelis Nasional dari 1 Agustus 2022 hingga mengundurkan diri pada 9 Agustus 2022.

name: Lea Massari
title: Lea Massari
extract: Anna Maria Massatani, known professionally as Lea Massari, was an Italian actress and singer. Her international breakout role as Anna in Michelangelo Antonioni's L'Avventura (1960) established her as an icon of European art cinema. She won the Nastro d'Argento for Best Supporting Actress twice, and was nominated for the David di Donatello for Best Actress once.
extract_id: Anna Maria Massatani, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Lea Massari, adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Italia. Peran internasionalnya yang melejit sebagai Anna dalam film L'Avventura (1960) karya Michelangelo Antonioni menetapkannya sebagai ikon sinema seni Eropa. Ia memenangkan Nastro d'Argento untuk Best Supporting Actress dua kali, dan pernah dinominasikan untuk David di Donatello untuk Best Actress sekali.

name: Lea Thompson
title: Lea Thompson
extract: Lea Katherine Thompson is an American actress, singer, dancer and director.
extract_id: Lea Katherine Thompson adalah seorang aktris, penyanyi, penari, dan sutradara asal Amerika.

name: Leandro Firmino
title: Leandro Firmino
extract: Leandro Firmino da Hora is a Brazilian actor. He is best known for his role as drug lord Li'l Zé in the Academy Award nominated film City of God. He also had a main role in one episode of spin-off series City of Men. He played the role of Thiago in Trash with Wagner Moura and Rooney Mara. Firmino starred as Goitaca Chief in Rodrigo Rodrigues`s Goitaca with Marlon Blue and Lady Francisco. He was cast as Gilmar in Impuros with Rui Ricardo Dias and Cyria Coentro.
extract_id: Leandro Firmino da Hora adalah seorang aktor Brasil. Ia paling dikenal untuk perannya sebagai bos narkoba Li'l Zé dalam film yang dinominasikan untuk Academy Award, City of God. Ia juga memiliki peran utama dalam satu episode seri spin-off City of Men. Ia memerankan peran Thiago dalam Trash bersama Wagner Moura dan Rooney Mara. Firmino berperan sebagai Kepala suku Goitaca dalam Goitaca karya Rodrigo Rodrigues bersama Marlon Blue dan Lady Francisco. Ia juga berperan sebagai Gilmar dalam Impuros bersama Rui Ricardo Dias dan Cyria Coentro.

name: Lee Byung-Hun
title: Lee Byung-hun
extract: Lee Byung-hun is a South Korean actor. He has received acclaim for his work in a wide range of genres, most notably Joint Security Area (2000); A Bittersweet Life (2005); The Good, the Bad, the Weird (2008); I Saw the Devil (2010); Masquerade (2012); and the television series All In (2003), Iris (2009), Mr. Sunshine (2018), Our Blues (2022), and Squid Game (2021–2025). His other notable South Korean films include Inside Men (2015), Master (2016), Ashfall (2019), The Man Standing Next (2020), and No Other Choice (2025), for which he was nominated for a Golden Globe.
extract_id: Lee Byung-hun adalah seorang aktor Korea Selatan. Ia mendapat pujian untuk karyanya dalam berbagai genre, terutama Joint Security Area (2000); A Bittersweet Life (2005); The Good, the Bad, the Weird (2008); I Saw the Devil (2010); Masquerade (2012); serta serial televisi All In (2003), Iris (2009), Mr. Sunshine (2018), Our Blues (2022), dan Squid Game (2021–2025). Film Korea Selatan terkenal lainnya termasuk Inside Men (2015), Master (2016), Ashfall (2019), The Man Standing Next (2020), dan No Other Choice (2025), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe.

name: Lee Grant
title: Lee Grant
extract: Lee Grant is an American actress, documentarian, and director. In a career spanning over eight decades, she won an Academy Award, two Primetime Emmy Awards, and a Directors Guild of America Award, in addition to nominations for five Golden Globe Awards. She is one of the last surviving actors of the Hollywood blacklist era.
extract_id: Lee Grant adalah seorang aktris, dokumenter, dan sutradara Amerika. Dalam karier yang telah berlangsung selama lebih dari delapan dekade, ia memenangkan Academy Award, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan Directors Guild of America Award, serta mendapat nominasi untuk lima Golden Globe Awards. Ia adalah salah satu aktor terakhir yang masih hidup dari era blacklist Hollywood.

name: Lee J. Cobb
title: Lee J. Cobb
extract: Lee J. Cobb was an American actor, known both for film roles and his work on the Broadway stage, as well as for his starring role on the television series The Virginian. He often played arrogant, intimidating, and abrasive characters, but he also acted as respectable figures such as judges and police officers. He was nominated for two Academy Awards and two Golden Globe Awards, all in the Best Supporting Actor category.
extract_id: Lee J. Cobb adalah seorang aktor Amerika, dikenal baik melalui peran film maupun di panggung Broadway, serta peran utamanya di serial televisi The Virginian. Ia sering memerankan karakter yang arogan, mengintimidasi, dan kasar, namun juga berperan sebagai tokoh terhormat seperti hakim dan polisi. Ia dinominasikan untuk dua Academy Awards dan dua Golden Globe Awards, semuanya dalam kategori Best Supporting Actor.

name: Lee Marvin
title: Lee Marvin
extract: Lamont Warren "Lee" Marvin Jr. was an American actor. Known for his bass voice and prematurely white hair, he is best remembered for playing hardboiled "tough guy" characters. He received various accolades including an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, and two BAFTA Awards. He was also a decorated United States Marine during the Second World War. He was also a descendant of the Lee family of Virginia.
extract_id: Lamont Warren "Lee" Marvin Jr. adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dikenal dengan suara bass dan rambut putihnya yang dini, ia paling diingat karena memerankan karakter "tough guy" yang keras. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan dua BAFTA Awards. Ia juga merupakan seorang Marinir Amerika Serikat yang dihormati selama Perang Dunia Kedua. Ia juga merupakan keturunan dari keluarga Lee di Virginia.

name: Lee Pace
title: Lee Pace
extract: Lee Grinner Pace is an American actor. He starred as Thranduil the Elvenking in The Hobbit trilogy and as Joe MacMillan in the period drama television series Halt and Catch Fire. He has appeared in the Marvel Cinematic Universe as Ronan the Accuser, a role he first played in Guardians of the Galaxy and reprised in Captain Marvel. Pace earned a 2008 Emmy nomination for his portrayal of Ned in the comedy drama television series Pushing Daisies. Since 2021, he has starred as the galactic emperor Brother Day in the science fiction television series Foundation.
extract_id: Lee Grinner Pace adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Ia membintangi sebagai Thranduil si Raja Elf dalam trilogi The Hobbit dan sebagai Joe MacMillan dalam serial drama periode televisi Halt and Catch Fire. Ia tampil dalam Marvel Cinematic Universe sebagai Ronan the Accuser, peran yang pertama kali dimainkannya dalam Guardians of the Galaxy dan diulang dalam Captain Marvel. Pace memperoleh nominasi Emmy 2008 untuk perannya sebagai Ned dalam serial komedi drama televisi Pushing Daisies. Sejak 2021, ia membintangi sebagai kaisar galaktik Brother Day dalam serial fiksi ilmiah televisi Foundation.

name: Lee Remick
title: Lee Remick
extract: Lee Ann Remick was an American actress. She was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actress for the film Days of Wine and Roses (1962) and was nominated for the Tony Award for Best Actress in a Play for her role in Wait Until Dark (1966) in addition to earning seven Emmy Award nominations.
extract_id: Lee Ann Remick adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Ia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Best Actress untuk film Days of Wine and Roses (1962) dan dinominasikan untuk Tony Award untuk Best Actress in a Play untuk perannya dalam Wait Until Dark (1966), selain mendapatkan tujuh nominasi Emmy Award.

name: Lee Sun-kyun
title: Lee Sun-kyun
extract: Lee Sun-kyun was a South Korean actor. Internationally, he was best known for his role in Bong Joon-ho's Academy Award–winning film Parasite (2019), for which he won an Actor Award along with his castmates. He received several other awards, including a nomination for an International Emmy Award.
extract_id: Lee Sun-kyun adalah seorang aktor Korea Selatan. Secara internasional, ia paling dikenal lewat perannya dalam film pemenang Academy Award karya Bong Joon-ho, Parasite (2019), yang memberinya penghargaan Actor Award bersama para pemain lain. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan lainnya, termasuk nominasi untuk International Emmy Award.

name: Lee Tamahori
title: Lee Tamahori
extract: Warren Lee Tamahori was a New Zealand film director. His feature directorial debut, Once Were Warriors (1994), was a widespread critical and commercial success. It is considered one of the greatest New Zealand films ever made.
extract_id: Warren Lee Tamahori adalah seorang sutradara film asal Selandia Baru. Debut penyutradaraan fitur pertamanya, Once Were Warriors (1994), adalah kesuksesan kritis dan komersial yang luas. Film tersebut dianggap sebagai salah satu film Selandia Baru terbaik yang pernah dibuat.

name: Lee Unkrich
title: Lee Unkrich
extract: Lee Edward Unkrich is an American film director, editor and writer. He is best known for his work with animation studio Pixar, which he joined in 1994 as an editor before being credited as a co-director on Toy Story 2 (1999).
extract_id: Lee Edward Unkrich adalah seorang sutradara film, editor, dan penulis Amerika. Ia paling dikenal untuk karyanya dengan studio animasi Pixar, yang ia masuki pada tahun 1994 sebagai editor sebelum mendapatkan kredit sebagai co-director pada Toy Story 2 (1999).

name: Lee Van Cleef
title: Lee Van Cleef
extract: Clarence LeRoy Van Cleef Jr. was an American actor. He appeared in over 170 film and television roles in a career spanning nearly 40 years, but is best known as a star of spaghetti Westerns, holding starring roles in the Sergio Leone-directed Dollars Trilogy films, For a Few Dollars More (1965) and The Good, the Bad and the Ugly (1966). In 1983, he received a Golden Boot Award for his contribution to the Western film and television genre.
extract_id: Clarence LeRoy Van Cleef Jr. adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Ia tampil dalam lebih dari 170 film dan peran televisi dalam karier yang berlangsung hampir 40 tahun, namun paling dikenal sebagai bintang spaghetti Western, memegang peran utama dalam trilogi Dollars yang disutradarai Sergio Leone, For a Few Dollars More (1965) dan The Good, the Bad and the Ugly (1966). Pada 1983, ia menerima Golden Boot Award atas kontribusinya pada genre film dan televisi Western.

name: Leigh Whannell
title: Leigh Whannell
extract: Leigh Whannell is an Australian filmmaker and actor. He has written multiple films that were directed by his friend James Wan, including Saw (2004), Dead Silence (2007), Insidious (2010), and Insidious: Chapter 2 (2013). Whannell made his directorial debut with Insidious: Chapter 3 (2015), and has since directed three more films: Upgrade (2018), The Invisible Man (2020), and Wolf Man (2025).
extract_id: Leigh Whannell adalah seorang pembuat film dan aktor asal Australia. Ia menulis beberapa film yang disutradarai oleh temannya James Wan, termasuk Saw (2004), Dead Silence (2007), Insidious (2010), dan Insidious: Chapter 2 (2013). Whannell melakukan debut penyutradaraannya dengan Insidious: Chapter 3 (2015), dan sejak itu menyutradarai tiga film lagi: Upgrade (2018), The Invisible Man (2020), dan Wolf Man (2025).

name: Leila Hatami
title: Leila Hatami
extract: Leila Hatami is an Iranian actress. Regarded as amongst the finest actresses of Iranian cinema and one of the most prominent performers in the 21st century, she is recognized for her realistic acting in drama films; gaining international fame for her role as Simin in Academy Award-winning film A Separation (2011), for which she received the Silver Bear for Best Actress.
extract_id: Leila Hatami adalah seorang aktris Iran. Dianggap sebagai salah satu aktris terbaik dalam perfilman Iran dan salah satu pemeran paling menonjol di abad ke-21, dia dikenal karena akting realistisnya dalam film drama; mendapatkan ketenaran internasional untuk perannya sebagai Simin dalam film pemenang Academy Award A Separation (2011), yang memberinya Silver Bear untuk Aktris Terbaik.

name: Leila Hyams
title: Leila Hyams
extract: Leila Hyams was an American actress who came from a show business family. Her relatively short film career began in 1924 during the era of silent films and ended in 1936. The blonde blue-eyed ingenue and leading lady appeared in more than 50 film roles and remained a press favourite, with numerous magazine covers.
extract_id: Leila Hyams adalah seorang aktris Amerika yang berasal dari keluarga bisnis pertunjukan. Karier filmnya yang relatif singkat dimulai pada tahun 1924 selama era film bisu dan berakhir pada tahun 1936. Aktris berambut pirang dan bermata biru ini muncul dalam lebih dari 50 peran film dan tetap menjadi favorit pers, dengan banyak sampul majalah.

name: Leland Orser
title: Leland Orser
extract: Leland Jones Orser is an American actor, director and writer. He has appeared in numerous film and television roles since his debut in 1991, notably as Lucien Dubenko on the television series ER (2004–09), Father Romero on Ray Donovan (2015–16), Richard Stratton on American Gigolo (2022), and Sam Gilroy in the Taken film series (2008–14).
extract_id: Leland Jones Orser adalah seorang aktor, sutradara, dan penulis Amerika. Dia telah muncul dalam berbagai peran film dan televisi sejak debutnya pada tahun 1991, terutama sebagai Lucien Dubenko dalam serial televisi ER (2004–09), Father Romero dalam Ray Donovan (2015–16), Richard Stratton dalam American Gigolo (2022), dan Sam Gilroy dalam seri film Taken (2008–14).

name: Leland Palmer
title: Leland Palmer (actress)
extract: Leland Palmer is an American actress, dancer, and singer who has appeared on stage, in motion pictures, and on television. She appeared on Broadway in Bajour (1964), A Joyful Noise (1966) Hello, Dolly!, Applause, and Pippin (1972). Palmer received two Tony Award nominations: in 1967 for featured actress in a musical, and in 1973 for actress in a musical.
extract_id: Leland Palmer adalah seorang aktris, penari, dan penyanyi Amerika yang telah tampil di panggung, film, dan televisi. Dia tampil di Broadway dalam Bajour (1964), A Joyful Noise (1966), Hello, Dolly!, Applause, dan Pippin (1972). Palmer menerima dua nominasi Tony Award: pada tahun 1967 untuk pemeran pendukung dalam musikal, dan pada tahun 1973 untuk pemeran dalam musikal.

name: Lembit Ulfsak
title: Lembit Ulfsak
extract: Lembit Ulfsak was an Estonian stage and film actor. Ulfsak starred in the 2014 film Tangerines which was nominated for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 87th Academy Awards. It was also among the five nominated films at the 72nd Golden Globe Awards for Best Foreign Language Film. Ulfsak died on 22 March 2017, at the age of 69.
extract_id: Lembit Ulfsak adalah seorang aktor panggung dan film Estonia. Ulfsak membintangi film Tangerines tahun 2014 yang dinominasikan untuk Film Berbahasa Asing Terbaik di Academy Awards ke-87. Film tersebut juga termasuk dalam lima film yang dinominasikan di Golden Globe Awards ke-72 untuk Film Berbahasa Asing Terbaik. Ulfsak meninggal pada 22 Maret 2017, pada usia 69 tahun.

name: Lena Endre
title: Lena Endre
extract: Lena Endre is a Swedish actress of film and television, primarily in the Swedish and Norwegian markets, known for her parts in the Liv Ullmann film Trolösa (2000), and the Millennium series of films, based on the Stieg Larsson books. Endre made her English-language debut in 2012, in Paul Thomas Anderson's movie The Master, starring Joaquin Phoenix and Philip Seymour Hoffman.
extract_id: Lena Endre adalah aktris film dan televisi Swedia, terutama di pasar Swedia dan Norwegia, dikenal karena perannya dalam film Liv Ullmann Trolösa (2000), dan seri film Millennium, yang berdasarkan buku-buku Stieg Larsson. Endre membuat debut berbahasa Inggris pada tahun 2012, dalam film Paul Thomas Anderson The Master, yang dibintangi Joaquin Phoenix dan Philip Seymour Hoffman.

name: Lena Headey
title: Lena Headey
extract: Lena Kathren Headey is a British actress. She gained international recognition and acclaim for her portrayal of Cersei Lannister on the HBO fantasy drama series Game of Thrones (2011–2019), for which she received five Emmy Award nominations and a Golden Globe Award nomination. She was also nominated for a Saturn Award for her portrayal of Gorgo, Queen of Sparta, in 300 (2006) and a BAFTA Award for directing the short film The Trap (2019).
extract_id: Lena Kathren Headey adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Dia mendapatkan pengakuan internasional dan pujian atas perannya sebagai Cersei Lannister dalam serial drama fantasi HBO Game of Thrones (2011–2019), yang memberinya lima nominasi Emmy Award dan satu nominasi Golden Globe Award. Dia juga dinominasikan untuk Saturn Award atas perannya sebagai Gorgo, Ratu Sparta, dalam film 300 (2006) dan BAFTA Award untuk mengarahkan film pendek The Trap (2019).

name: Lena Nyman
title: Lena Nyman
extract: Anna Lena Elisabet Nyman was a Swedish film and stage actress.
extract_id: Anna Lena Elisabet Nyman adalah seorang aktris film dan panggung Swedia.

name: Lenny Abrahamson
title: Lenny Abrahamson
extract: Leonard Ian Abrahamson is an Irish film and television director. He is best known for directing the independent films Adam & Paul (2004), Garage (2007), What Richard Did (2012), Frank (2014), and Room (2015), all of which contributed to Abrahamson's six Irish Film and Television Awards.
extract_id: Leonard Ian Abrahamson adalah sutradara film dan televisi Irlandia. Dia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai film independen Adam & Paul (2004), Garage (2007), What Richard Did (2012), Frank (2014), dan Room (2015), yang kesemuanya memberikan kontribusi terhadap enam Irish Film and Television Awards yang diterima Abrahamson.

name: Leo G. Carroll
title: Leo G. Carroll
extract: Leo Grattan Carroll was an English actor. In a career of more than 40 years, he appeared in six Hitchcock films including Spellbound, Strangers on a Train and North by Northwest and in three television series, Topper, Going My Way, and The Man from U.N.C.L.E.
extract_id: Leo Grattan Carroll adalah seorang aktor Inggris. Dalam karier lebih dari 40 tahun, dia muncul dalam enam film Hitchcock termasuk Spellbound, Strangers on a Train, dan North by Northwest serta dalam tiga serial televisi, Topper, Going My Way, dan The Man from U.N.C.L.E.

name: Leo McCarey
title: Leo McCarey
extract: Thomas Leo McCarey was an American film director, screenwriter, and producer. He was involved in nearly 200 films, including the critically acclaimed Duck Soup, Make Way for Tomorrow, The Awful Truth, Going My Way, The Bells of St. Mary's, My Son John, and An Affair to Remember. Nine of his films were selected for preservation in the United States National Film Registry by the Library of Congress as being "culturally, historically or aesthetically significant."
extract_id: Thomas Leo McCarey adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser Amerika. Dia terlibat dalam hampir 200 film, termasuk Duck Soup, Make Way for Tomorrow, The Awful Truth, Going My Way, The Bells of St. Mary's, My Son John, dan An Affair to Remember yang mendapat pujian kritis. Sembilan filmnya dipilih untuk pelestarian dalam National Film Registry Amerika Serikat oleh Library of Congress sebagai "bermakna secara budaya, sejarah, atau estetis."

name: Leo McKern
title: Leo McKern
extract: Reginald "Leo" McKern was an Australian actor who appeared in numerous British, Australian and American television programmes and films, and in more than 200 stage roles. His notable roles include Clang in Help! (1965), Thomas Cromwell in A Man for All Seasons (1966), Tom Ryan in Ryan's Daughter (1970), Harry Bundage in Candleshoe (1977), Paddy Button in The Blue Lagoon (1980), Dr. Grogan in The French Lieutenant's Woman (1981), Father Imperius in Ladyhawke (1985), and the role that made him a household name as an actor, Horace Rumpole, whom he played in the British television series Rumpole of the Bailey. He also portrayed Carl Bugenhagen in the first and second installments of The Omen series and Number Two in the TV series The Prisoner.
extract_id: Reginald "Leo" McKern adalah aktor Australia yang muncul dalam banyak program televisi dan film Inggris, Australia, dan Amerika, serta lebih dari 200 peran panggung. Peran terkenalnya meliputi Clang dalam Help! (1965), Thomas Cromwell dalam A Man for All Seasons (1966), Tom Ryan dalam Ryan's Daughter (1970), Harry Bundage dalam Candleshoe (1977), Paddy Button dalam The Blue Lagoon (1980), Dr. Grogan dalam The French Lieutenant's Woman (1981), Father Imperius dalam Ladyhawke (1985), dan peran yang membuatnya terkenal sebagai aktor, Horace Rumpole, yang dia mainkan dalam serial televisi Inggris Rumpole of the Bailey. Dia juga memerankan Carl Bugenhagen dalam dua seri pertama The Omen dan Number Two dalam serial TV The Prisoner.

name: Leon Lai
title: Leon Lai
extract: Leon Lai Ming SBS BBS MH, is a Hong Kong actor, singer, film director, and businessman. He is one of the "Four Heavenly Kings" of Hong Kong pop music.
extract_id: Leon Lai Ming SBS BBS MH, adalah seorang aktor, penyanyi, sutradara film, dan pengusaha Hong Kong. Dia adalah salah satu dari "Empat Raja Langit" musik pop Hong Kong.

name: Leonard Frey
title: Leonard Frey
extract: Leonard Frey was an American actor. Frey received a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for his role in the 1971 musical film Fiddler on the Roof. He made his stage debut in an Off-Broadway production of Little Mary Sunshine and received a nomination for the Tony Award for Best Featured Actor in a Play for The National Health.
extract_id: Leonard Frey adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Frey menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik atas perannya dalam film musikal Fiddler on the Roof (1971). Dia memulai debut panggungnya dalam produksi Off-Broadway Little Mary Sunshine dan menerima nominasi Tony Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam Drama untuk The National Health.

name: Leonard Nimoy
title: Leonard Nimoy
extract: Leonard Simon Nimoy was an American actor and director, famous for playing Spock in the Star Trek franchise for over 40 years. This includes originating Spock in the original Star Trek series in 1966, then Star Trek: The Animated Series, the first six Star Trek films, Star Trek: The Next Generation, the 2009 Star Trek film, and Star Trek Into Darkness. Nimoy also directed films, including Star Trek III: The Search for Spock (1984), Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home (1986), and Three Men and a Baby (1987), and his career included roles in music videos and video games. In addition to acting and filmmaking, Nimoy was a photographer, author, singer, and songwriter.
extract_id: Leonard Simon Nimoy adalah aktor dan sutradara Amerika, terkenal karena memerankan Spock dalam franchise Star Trek selama lebih dari 40 tahun. Ini termasuk memulai peran Spock dalam seri Star Trek asli pada 1966, kemudian Star Trek: The Animated Series, enam film Star Trek pertama, Star Trek: The Next Generation, film Star Trek 2009, dan Star Trek Into Darkness. Nimoy juga menyutradarai film, termasuk Star Trek III: The Search for Spock (1984), Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home (1986), dan Three Men and a Baby (1987), dan kariernya mencakup peran dalam video musik dan permainan video. Selain akting dan pembuatan film, Nimoy adalah fotografer, penulis, penyanyi, dan penulis lagu.

name: Leonardo DiCaprio
title: Leonardo DiCaprio
extract: Leonardo Wilhelm DiCaprio is an American actor and film producer. Regarded as one of Hollywood’s defining leading men, his work spans character-driven cinema and major blockbusters across genres, exploring themes of ambition, corruption, and moral decline. He is the recipient of numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, an Actor Award, a BAFTA Award, an Emmy Award, a Silver Bear and three Golden Globes. With his starring films grossing $7 billion worldwide, he has placed eight times in annual rankings of the world's highest-paid actors.
extract_id: Leonardo Wilhelm DiCaprio adalah aktor dan produser film Amerika. Dianggap sebagai salah satu pria utama terpenting di Hollywood, karyanya mencakup sinema berorientasi karakter dan blockbuster utama di berbagai genre, mengeksplorasi tema ambisi, korupsi, dan kemerosotan moral. Dia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Actor Award, BAFTA Award, Emmy Award, Silver Bear, dan tiga Golden Globe. Dengan film-film utama yang dibintanginya menghasilkan $7 miliar di seluruh dunia, dia telah delapan kali masuk dalam peringkat tahunan aktor dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia.

name: Leonie Benesch
title: Leonie Benesch
extract: Leonie Benesch is a German actress. She has played roles in various film and TV productions including Babylon Berlin, The Crown, Around the World in 80 Days and The Teachers' Lounge. For her role in the latter, in 2023, she received the award for Best Performance in a Leading Role at the German Film Awards.
extract_id: Leonie Benesch adalah aktris Jerman. Dia telah memainkan berbagai peran dalam produksi film dan TV termasuk Babylon Berlin, The Crown, Around the World in 80 Days, dan The Teachers' Lounge. Untuk perannya di yang terakhir, pada tahun 2023, dia menerima penghargaan untuk Penampilan Terbaik dalam Peran Utama di German Film Awards.

name: Leonor Watling
title: Leonor Watling
extract: Leonor Elizabeth Ceballos Watling is a Spanish film actress and singer.
extract_id: Leonor Elizabeth Ceballos Watling adalah aktris film dan penyanyi Spanyol.

name: Lesley Sharp
title: Lesley Sharp
extract: Lesley Sharp is a British actress. She became widely known for her role as Detective Constable Janet Scott in the ITV crime series Scott & Bailey (2011–2016). Her other credits include Rita, Sue and Bob Too (1987), The Rachel Papers (1989), Naked (1993), Priest (1994), The Moonstone (1996), Great Expectations (1999), Daylight Robbery (1999), Clocking Off (2000–2001), From Hell (2001), Vera Drake (2004), Afterlife (2005–2006), This Cop Life (2022), The Full Monty (2023).and Pillion (2025).
extract_id: Lesley Sharp adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Dia menjadi terkenal luas berkat perannya sebagai Detective Constable Janet Scott dalam serial kriminal ITV Scott & Bailey (2011–2016). Kredit lainnya termasuk Rita, Sue and Bob Too (1987), The Rachel Papers (1989), Naked (1993), Priest (1994), The Moonstone (1996), Great Expectations (1999), Daylight Robbery (1999), Clocking Off (2000–2001), From Hell (2001), Vera Drake (2004), Afterlife (2005–2006), This Cop Life (2022), The Full Monty (2023), dan Pillion (2025).

name: Leslie Cheung
title: Leslie Cheung
extract: Leslie Cheung Kwok-wing was a Hong Kong singer-songwriter and actor. One of the most influential cultural icons in the Sinophone world, Cheung was known for his debonair demeanour, flamboyant screen characters, and avant-garde, androgynous stage presence. Throughout his 26-year career, he released over 40 music albums and acted in 56 films.
extract_id: Leslie Cheung Kwok-wing adalah penyanyi-penulis lagu dan aktor Hong Kong. Salah satu ikon budaya paling berpengaruh di dunia Sinofon, Cheung dikenal karena perilaku mempesona, karakter layar flamboyan, dan penampilan panggung yang avant-garde dan androgini. Sepanjang karier selama 26 tahun, dia merilis lebih dari 40 album musik dan berperan dalam 56 film.

name: Leslie Nielsen
title: Leslie Nielsen
extract: Leslie William Nielsen was a Canadian-American actor and comedian. With a career spanning 60 years, he appeared in more than 100 films and 150 television programs, portraying more than 220 characters.
extract_id: Leslie William Nielsen adalah aktor dan komedian Kanada-Amerika. Dengan karier yang meliputi 60 tahun, dia muncul dalam lebih dari 100 film dan 150 program televisi, memerankan lebih dari 220 karakter.

name: Leslie Odom Jr.
title: Leslie Odom Jr.
extract: Leslie Lloyd Odom Jr. is an American actor, singer and songwriter. He made his acting debut on Broadway in 1998 and first gained recognition for his portrayal of Aaron Burr in the musical Hamilton, which earned him a Tony Award for Best Actor in a Musical and a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album in the same year. His performance was captured in the Disney+ live stage recording of Hamilton which earned him a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Actor in a Leading Role in a Limited Series or Movie nomination.
extract_id: Leslie Lloyd Odom Jr. adalah aktor, penyanyi, dan penulis lagu Amerika. Dia memulai debut aktingnya di Broadway pada 1998 dan pertama kali mendapat pengakuan atas perannya sebagai Aaron Burr dalam musikal Hamilton, yang memberinya Tony Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Musikal dan Grammy Award untuk Album Teater Musikal Terbaik pada tahun yang sama. Penampilannya tertangkap dalam rekaman panggung langsung Hamilton di Disney+ yang memberinya nominasi Primetime Emmy Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Peran Utama di Seri Terbatas atau Film.

name: Lew Ayres
title: Lew Ayres
extract: Lewis Frederick Ayres III was an American actor whose film and television career spanned 65 years. He is best known for starring as German soldier Paul Bäumer in the film All Quiet on the Western Front (1930) and for playing Dr. Kildare in nine films. He was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Actor for his performance in Johnny Belinda (1948).
extract_id: Lewis Frederick Ayres III adalah aktor Amerika yang karier film dan televisinya berlangsung selama 65 tahun. Dia paling dikenal sebagai tentara Jerman Paul Bäumer dalam film All Quiet on the Western Front (1930) dan memerankan Dr. Kildare dalam sembilan film. Dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktor Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam Johnny Belinda (1948).

name: Lewis Black
title: Lewis Black
extract: Lewis Niles Black is an American stand-up comedian and actor. His comedy routines often escalate into angry rants about history, politics, religion and cultural trends.
extract_id: Lewis Niles Black adalah komedian stand-up dan aktor Amerika. Rutinitas komedinya sering meningkat menjadi kemarahan tentang sejarah, politik, agama, dan tren budaya.

name: Lewis Milestone
title: Lewis Milestone
extract: Lewis Milestone was a Russian-American film director, screenwriter, and producer active during the Golden Age of Hollywood. He twice won the Academy Award for Best Director, for Two Arabian Knights (1927) and All Quiet on the Western Front (1930), with a third nomination for The Front Page (1931).
extract_id: Lewis Milestone adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser Rusia-Amerika yang aktif selama Era Keemasan Hollywood. Dia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik dua kali, untuk Two Arabian Knights (1927) dan All Quiet on the Western Front (1930), dengan nominasi ketiga untuk The Front Page (1931).

name: Liam Aiken
title: Liam Aiken
extract: Liam Pádraic Aiken is an American actor. He has starred in films such as Stepmom (1998), Road to Perdition (2002), and Good Boy! (2003), and played Klaus Baudelaire in Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events (2004), based on the series of books. He also starred in the films Nor'easter (2012), Ned Rifle (2014), The Bloodhound (2020), Bashira (2021), and V13 (2025).
extract_id: Liam Pádraic Aiken adalah aktor Amerika. Dia telah membintangi film seperti Stepmom (1998), Road to Perdition (2002), dan Good Boy! (2003), serta memerankan Klaus Baudelaire dalam Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events (2004), berdasarkan seri buku tersebut. Ia juga membintangi film Nor'easter (2012), Ned Rifle (2014), The Bloodhound (2020), Bashira (2021), dan V13 (2025).

name: Liam Cunningham
title: Liam Cunningham
extract: Liam Cunningham is an Irish actor. He is known for playing Davos Seaworth in the HBO epic-fantasy series Game of Thrones.
extract_id: Liam Cunningham adalah aktor Irlandia. Ia dikenal karena memerankan Davos Seaworth dalam serial epik-fantasi HBO Game of Thrones.

name: Liam Neeson
title: Liam Neeson
extract: William John Neeson is an actor from Northern Ireland. He has received several accolades, including nominations for an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, three Golden Globe Awards, two Tony Awards and one Volpi Cup. With a film career spanning more than 40 years, Neeson is regarded as one of Ireland's greatest film actors. Films in which he has appeared have grossed over US$11.7 billion worldwide. Neeson was appointed Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) in 2000.
extract_id: William John Neeson adalah aktor dari Irlandia Utara. Ia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk nominasi untuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, tiga Golden Globe Awards, dua Tony Awards, dan satu Volpi Cup. Dengan karier film yang berlangsung lebih dari 40 tahun, Neeson dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor film terbesar Irlandia. Film-film yang dibintanginya telah meraih pendapatan lebih dari US$11,7 miliar di seluruh dunia. Neeson diangkat sebagai Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) pada tahun 2000.

name: Lianella Carell
title: Lianella Carell
extract: Lianella Carell was an Italian film actress and screenwriter. She appeared in 18 films between 1948 and 1958. She is best known for playing Maria Ricci, the wife of the protagonist in the 1948 film Bicycle Thieves, which was also her acting debut.
extract_id: Lianella Carell adalah aktris film dan penulis skenario asal Italia. Dia tampil dalam 18 film antara tahun 1948 dan 1958. Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan Maria Ricci, istri protagonis dalam film 1948 Bicycle Thieves, yang juga merupakan debut aktingnya.

name: Liesel Matthews
title: Liesel Pritzker Simmons
extract: Liesel Pritzker Simmons, stage name Liesel Matthews, is an American heiress and former child actress. She starred as Sara Crewe in A Little Princess, a 1995 film adaptation of the Frances Hodgson Burnett classic, and as Alice Marshall in Air Force One. She is a member of the wealthy Pritzker family. She is now known as a leader in impact investing and founded the Blue Haven Initiative in 2012 to that end.
extract_id: Liesel Pritzker Simmons, nama panggung Liesel Matthews, adalah pewaris asal Amerika dan mantan aktris cilik. Ia membintangi Sara Crewe dalam A Little Princess, sebuah adaptasi film tahun 1995 dari karya klasik Frances Hodgson Burnett, dan sebagai Alice Marshall dalam Air Force One. Dia adalah anggota keluarga Pritzker yang kaya. Kini ia dikenal sebagai pemimpin dalam investasi berdampak dan mendirikan Blue Haven Initiative pada tahun 2012 untuk tujuan tersebut.

name: Liev Schreiber
title: Liev Schreiber
extract: Isaac Liev Schreiber is an American actor. He has received several accolades including a Tony Award as well as nominations for nine Primetime Emmy Awards and five Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Isaac Liev Schreiber adalah aktor Amerika. Ia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan termasuk Tony Award serta nominasi untuk sembilan Primetime Emmy Awards dan lima Golden Globe Awards.

name: Lil Dagover
title: Lil Dagover
extract: Lil Dagover was a German actress whose film career spanned from 1913 to 1979. She was a popular film actress in the Weimar Republic.
extract_id: Lil Dagover adalah aktris Jerman dengan karier film yang berlangsung dari tahun 1913 hingga 1979. Dia adalah aktris film populer di Republik Weimar.

name: Lillete Dubey
title: Lillete Dubey
extract: Lillete Dubey is an Indian actress and theatre director. She has worked in Indian and international theatre, television and films in Hindi and English languages. Dubey began her career with Barry John in Delhi and was the founding member of his group – Theatre Action Group in 1973. In 1991 she set up her own theatre company – The Primetime Theatre Company.
extract_id: Lillete Dubey adalah aktris dan sutradara teater asal India. Dia telah bekerja di teater India dan internasional, televisi, serta film dalam bahasa Hindi dan Inggris. Dubey memulai kariernya dengan Barry John di Delhi dan merupakan anggota pendiri kelompoknya – Theatre Action Group pada tahun 1973. Pada tahun 1991, dia mendirikan perusahaan teaternya sendiri – The Primetime Theatre Company.

name: Lillian Gish
title: Lillian Gish
extract: Lillian Diana Gish was an American actress best known for her work in movies of the silent era. Her film-acting career spanned 75 years, from 1912, in silent film shorts, to 1987. Gish was dubbed the "First Lady of the Screen" by Vanity Fair in 1927 and is credited with pioneering fundamental film performance techniques. In 1999, the American Film Institute ranked Gish as the 17th-greatest female movie star of classical Hollywood cinema.
extract_id: Lillian Diana Gish adalah aktris Amerika yang paling dikenal atas karyanya dalam film era bisu. Karier akting filmnya berlangsung selama 75 tahun, dari 1912, dalam film pendek bisu, hingga 1987. Gish dijuluki "First Lady of the Screen" oleh Vanity Fair pada tahun 1927 dan dianggap sebagai pelopor teknik dasar dalam penampilan film. Pada tahun 1999, American Film Institute menempatkan Gish sebagai aktris wanita ke-17 terbaik dalam sinema Hollywood klasik.

name: Lillo Brancato
title: Lillo Brancato
extract: Lillo Brancato Jr. is an American actor. He is best known for his portrayal of Calogero in Robert De Niro's 1993 directorial debut, A Bronx Tale. He also portrayed Matthew Bevilaqua, a young aspiring mobster, on The Sopranos.
extract_id: Lillo Brancato Jr. adalah aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Calogero dalam debut penyutradaraan Robert De Niro pada tahun 1993, A Bronx Tale. Ia juga memerankan Matthew Bevilaqua, seorang calon mafia muda, dalam The Sopranos.

name: Lilly Wachowski
title: The Wachowskis
extract: Lana Wachowski and Lilly Wachowski are American film and television directors, writers and producers. Together known as the Wachowskis, the sisters are both trans women and have worked as a writing and directing team throughout most of their careers. They made their directing debut with Bound (1996), and achieved fame with The Matrix (1999), a major box-office success for which they won the Saturn Award for Best Director. They wrote and directed two sequels, The Matrix Reloaded and The Matrix Revolutions, and were involved in the writing and production of other works in the Matrix franchise.
extract_id: Lana Wachowski dan Lilly Wachowski adalah sutradara, penulis, dan produser film dan televisi asal Amerika. Bersama-sama dikenal sebagai Wachowskis, kedua saudara perempuan ini adalah wanita trans dan telah bekerja sebagai tim penulis dan sutradara sepanjang hampir seluruh karier mereka. Mereka memulai debut sutradara dengan Bound (1996), dan meraih ketenaran dengan The Matrix (1999), sebuah kesuksesan besar di box-office yang membuat mereka memenangkan Saturn Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik. Mereka menulis dan menyutradarai dua sekuel, The Matrix Reloaded dan The Matrix Revolutions, serta terlibat dalam penulisan dan produksi karya lain dalam waralaba Matrix.

name: Lily Franky
title: Lily Franky
extract: Masaya Nakagawa , known professionally as Lily Franky , is a Japanese illustrator, writer, and actor. He has appeared in more than 40 films since 2001.
extract_id: Masaya Nakagawa, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Lily Franky, adalah ilustrator, penulis, dan aktor Jepang. Ia telah tampil dalam lebih dari 40 film sejak tahun 2001.

name: Lin-Manuel Miranda
title: Lin-Manuel Miranda
description: American songwriter, actor, filmmaker and librettist (born 1980)
extract: Lin-Manuel Miranda is an American songwriter, actor, filmmaker, librettist, and producer. He created the Broadway musicals In the Heights and Hamilton, and the soundtracks for the animated films Moana, Vivo, and Encanto. He has received numerous accolades including a Pulitzer Prize for Drama, three Tony Awards, two Laurence Olivier Awards, two Emmy Awards, and five Grammy Awards, along with nominations for two Academy Awards. He received the Kennedy Center Honor in 2018.
extract_id: Lin-Manuel Miranda adalah penulis lagu, aktor, pembuat film, librettist, dan produser asal Amerika. Ia menciptakan musikal Broadway In the Heights dan Hamilton, serta soundtrack untuk film animasi Moana, Vivo, dan Encanto. Ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Pulitzer Prize untuk Drama, tiga Tony Awards, dua Laurence Olivier Awards, dua Emmy Awards, dan lima Grammy Awards, serta nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards. Ia menerima Kennedy Center Honor pada tahun 2018.

name: Lina Leandersson
title: Lina Leandersson
extract: Lina Leandersson is a Swedish-Iranian actress. She is best known for playing the lead role of Eli in the 2008 Swedish romantic vampire film Let the Right One In, based on the novel by the same name.
extract_id: Lina Leandersson adalah aktris Swedia-Iran. Ia paling dikenal karena memerankan peran utama Eli dalam film romantis vampir Swedia tahun 2008, Let the Right One In, berdasarkan novel dengan judul yang sama.

name: Linda Blair
title: Linda Blair
extract: Linda Denise Blair is an American actress and activist. She is known for playing Regan MacNeil in the horror film The Exorcist (1973), which established her as a prominent figure in horror popular culture. Her performance netted her a Golden Globe and a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress. She reprised the role in two sequels: Exorcist II: The Heretic (1977) and The Exorcist: Believer (2023).
extract_id: Linda Denise Blair adalah aktris dan aktivis asal Amerika. Dia dikenal karena memerankan Regan MacNeil dalam film horor The Exorcist (1973), yang membuatnya menjadi tokoh terkenal dalam budaya populer horor. Penampilannya memberinya Golden Globe dan nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik. Ia mengulangi peran tersebut dalam dua sekuel: Exorcist II: The Heretic (1977) dan The Exorcist: Believer (2023).

name: Linda Cardellini
title: Linda Cardellini
extract: Linda Edna Cardellini is an American actress. In television, she is known for her starring roles in the teen drama Freaks and Geeks (1999–2000), the medical drama ER (2003–2009), and the thriller Bloodline (2015–2017), as well as for her guest role as Sylvia Rosen on AMC's Mad Men (2013–2015). Her starring role in the Netflix dark comedy series Dead to Me (2019–2022) earned her a nomination for a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series. Cardellini also portrayed Pamela Voorhees in Crystal Lake (2026).
extract_id: Linda Edna Cardellini adalah aktris Amerika. Di televisi, ia dikenal karena peran utama dalam drama remaja Freaks and Geeks (1999–2000), drama medis ER (2003–2009), dan thriller Bloodline (2015–2017), serta peran tamu sebagai Sylvia Rosen di AMC's Mad Men (2013–2015). Peran utamanya dalam serial komedi gelap Netflix Dead to Me (2019–2022) memberinya nominasi Primetime Emmy Award untuk Aktris Utama Terbaik dalam Serial Komedi. Cardellini juga memerankan Pamela Voorhees dalam Crystal Lake (2026).

name: Linda Hamilton
title: Linda Hamilton
extract: Linda Carroll Hamilton is an American actress. Known for portraying tough, resilient characters, she made her film debut in 1979 before achieving fame with her starring role as Sarah Connor in The Terminator (1984) and two of its sequels, Terminator 2: Judgment Day (1991) and Terminator: Dark Fate (2019). She is the recipient of various accolades, including two Saturn Awards, two MTV Movie Awards, a Satellite Award and a Romy Award, as well as nominations for three Golden Globes and one Primetime Emmy.
extract_id: Linda Carroll Hamilton adalah aktris Amerika. Dikenal karena memerankan karakter yang tangguh dan ulet, ia memulai debut filmnya pada tahun 1979 sebelum meraih ketenaran dengan peran utamanya sebagai Sarah Connor dalam The Terminator (1984) dan dua sekuelnya, Terminator 2: Judgment Day (1991) dan Terminator: Dark Fate (2019). Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Saturn Awards, dua MTV Movie Awards, Satellite Award, dan Romy Award, serta nominasi untuk tiga Golden Globes dan satu Primetime Emmy.

name: Linda Larkin
title: Linda Larkin
extract: Linda Larkin is an American actress, best known for her role as the speaking voice of Princess Jasmine in Disney's 1992 animated feature film Aladdin.
extract_id: Linda Larkin adalah aktris Amerika, paling dikenal sebagai pengisi suara Putri Jasmine dalam film animasi Disney tahun 1992, Aladdin.

name: Linda Manz
title: Linda Manz
extract: Linda Ann Manz was an American actress. She made her feature film debut at age 15 in Terrence Malick's period drama Days of Heaven (1978), playing an adolescent girl growing up in rural Texas in 1916. She followed this with a supporting role in The Wanderers (1979). Manz earned critical acclaim for her portrayal of a troubled teenage girl from a dysfunctional family in Dennis Hopper's drama film Out of the Blue (1980).
extract_id: Linda Ann Manz adalah aktris Amerika. Ia memulai debut film fitur pada usia 15 tahun dalam drama periodik karya Terrence Malick Days of Heaven (1978), memerankan gadis remaja yang tumbuh di pedesaan Texas pada tahun 1916. Ia kemudian memerankan peran pendukung dalam The Wanderers (1979). Manz mendapat pujian kritis atas perannya sebagai gadis remaja bermasalah dari keluarga disfungsional dalam film drama Dennis Hopper, Out of the Blue (1980).

name: Linda Zilliacus
title: Linda Zilliacus
extract: Linda Elvira Zilliacus is a Swedish-speaking Finnish actress and director. She became the director of Wasa Theatre in 2025.
extract_id: Linda Elvira Zilliacus adalah aktris dan sutradara berbahasa Swedia asal Finlandia. Ia menjadi direktur Teater Wasa pada tahun 2025.

name: Lindsay Duncan
title: Lindsay Duncan
extract: Lindsay Vere Duncan is a Scottish actress. She is the recipient of three BAFTA nominations and one Scottish BAFTA nomination, as well as two Olivier Awards and a Tony Award for her work on stage.
extract_id: Lindsay Vere Duncan adalah aktris asal Skotlandia. Ia menerima tiga nominasi BAFTA dan satu nominasi Scottish BAFTA, serta dua Olivier Awards dan satu Tony Award untuk karyanya di panggung teater.

name: Linh Dan Pham
title: Linh Dan Pham
extract: Linh Dan Pham is a Vietnamese-French actress.
extract_id: Linh Dan Pham adalah aktris Vietnam-Prancis.

name: Lionel Barrymore
title: Lionel Barrymore
extract: Lionel Barrymore was an American actor of stage, screen and radio as well as a film director. He won an Academy Award for Best Actor for his performance in A Free Soul (1931) and is known to modern audiences for the role of villainous Mr. Potter in Frank Capra's 1946 film It's a Wonderful Life.
extract_id: Lionel Barrymore adalah aktor Amerika yang berkarier di panggung, layar, dan radio serta sutradara film. Ia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktor Terbaik atas perannya dalam A Free Soul (1931) dan dikenal oleh penonton modern sebagai Mr. Potter yang antagonis dalam film Frank Capra 1946, It's a Wonderful Life.

name: Lisa Hannigan
title: Lisa Hannigan
extract: Lisa Margaret Hannigan is an Irish musician, singer, composer, and voice actress. She began her musical career as a member of Damien Rice's band. Since beginning her solo career in 2007, she has released three albums: Sea Sew (2008), Passenger (2011), and At Swim (2016). Hannigan's music has received award nominations in Ireland and the United States. Hannigan drew attention in North America for her role as Blue Diamond in Steven Universe, an animated television series created by Rebecca Sugar.
extract_id: Lisa Margaret Hannigan adalah musisi, penyanyi, komponis, dan aktris suara Irlandia. Ia memulai karier musiknya sebagai anggota band Damien Rice. Sejak memulai karier solo pada tahun 2007, ia telah merilis tiga album: Sea Sew (2008), Passenger (2011), dan At Swim (2016). Musik Hannigan telah menerima nominasi penghargaan di Irlandia dan Amerika Serikat. Hannigan menarik perhatian di Amerika Utara untuk perannya sebagai Blue Diamond dalam Steven Universe, serial televisi animasi yang dibuat oleh Rebecca Sugar.

name: Lisa Haydon
title: Lisa Haydon
description: Indian actress, TV presenter and model (born 1986)
extract: Elisabeth Marie Haydon, better known as Lisa Haydon Lalvani, is an Indian-Australian actress, TV presenter and model, who mainly appears in Hindi films. Haydon made her acting debut with the ensemble romantic comedy-drama Aisha (2010) and received critical praise for her performance in the comedy-drama Queen, which fetched her wide recognition and a Best Supporting Actress nomination at Filmfare, among other accolades. Haydon later starred in the commercially successful comedy Housefull 3 (2016) and had a brief role in the Karan Johar-directed musical romantic drama Ae Dil Hai Mushkil (2016).
extract_id: Elisabeth Marie Haydon, lebih dikenal sebagai Lisa Haydon Lalvani, adalah aktris, presenter TV, dan model India-Australia yang sebagian besar tampil dalam film berbahasa Hindi. Haydon memulai debut aktingnya dengan komedi romantis drama ensemble Aisha (2010) dan menerima pujian kritis untuk penampilannya dalam komedi drama Queen, yang memberinya pengakuan luas dan nominasi Aktris Pendukung Terbaik di Filmfare, di samping penghargaan lainnya. Haydon kemudian membintangi komedi sukses secara komersial Housefull 3 (2016) dan memiliki peran singkat di drama musikal romantis Arahan Karan Johar, Ae Dil Hai Mushkil (2016).

name: Lisa Spoonauer
title: Lisa Spoonauer
extract: Lisa Ann Spoonauer was an American character actress best known for the role of Caitlin Bree in Clerks, which she reprised for an episode of Clerks: The Animated Series.
extract_id: Lisa Ann Spoonauer adalah seorang aktris karakter Amerika yang paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Caitlin Bree dalam Clerks, yang ia ulangi untuk sebuah episode Clerks: The Animated Series.

name: Lisanne Falk
title: Lisanne Falk
extract: Lisanne Falk is an American actress. She is best known for her role as Heather McNamara in the dark comedy film Heathers (1988).
extract_id: Lisanne Falk adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Heather McNamara dalam film komedi gelap Heathers (1988).

name: Liubomiras Laucevicius
title: Liubomiras Laucevičius
extract: Liubomiras Laucevičius is a Lithuanian actor. He has appeared in more than fifty films since 1979.
extract_id: Liubomiras Laucevičius adalah seorang aktor Lithuania. Dia telah tampil dalam lebih dari lima puluh film sejak 1979.

name: Liv Ullmann
title: Liv Ullmann
extract: Liv Johanne Ullmann is a Norwegian actress and filmmaker. Recognised as one of the greatest European actresses of all time, Ullmann is known as the muse and frequent collaborator of filmmaker Ingmar Bergman, whom she dated for five years. She acted in many of his films, including Persona (1966), The Passion of Anna (1969), Cries and Whispers (1972), Scenes from a Marriage (1973), and Autumn Sonata (1978).
extract_id: Liv Johanne Ullmann adalah seorang aktris dan pembuat film asal Norwegia. Diakui sebagai salah satu aktris Eropa terbesar sepanjang masa, Ullmann dikenal sebagai muse dan kolaborator sering dari pembuat film Ingmar Bergman, yang dia pacari selama lima tahun. Dia berperan dalam banyak filmnya, termasuk Persona (1966), The Passion of Anna (1969), Cries and Whispers (1972), Scenes from a Marriage (1973), dan Autumn Sonata (1978).

name: Liza Minnelli
title: Liza Minnelli
extract: Liza May Minnelli is an American actress, singer, and dancer. Known for her commanding stage presence and powerful alto singing voice, Minnelli has received numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, an Emmy Award, two Golden Globe Awards, and four Tony Awards. She is one of the few performers awarded a non-competitive EGOT having received an honorary Grammy Award. Minnelli is a Knight of the French Legion of Honour.
extract_id: Liza May Minnelli adalah seorang aktris, penyanyi, dan penari Amerika. Dikenal karena kehadiran panggungnya yang memukau dan suara nyanyian alto yang kuat, Minnelli telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Emmy Award, dua Golden Globe Awards, dan empat Tony Awards. Dia adalah salah satu dari sedikit artis yang dianugerahi EGOT non-kompetitif setelah menerima Grammy Award penghormatan. Minnelli adalah seorang Ksatria Legion of Honour Prancis.

name: Ljubica Adzovic
title: Ljubica Adžović
extract: Ljubica Adžović was a Romani actress, known for her roles in Emir Kusturica's films: Time of the Gypsies (1989), and Black Cat, White Cat (1998).
extract_id: Ljubica Adžović adalah seorang aktris Romani, dikenal karena perannya dalam film-film Emir Kusturica: Time of the Gypsies (1989), dan Black Cat, White Cat (1998).

name: Lloyd Avery II
title: Lloyd Avery II
extract: Lloyd Fernandez Avery II was an American actor. He appeared in John Singleton's Oscar-nominated film Boyz n the Hood (1991) as one of the Bloods who murdered high school football star Ricky Baker and was later killed by Doughboy in retaliation.
extract_id: Lloyd Fernandez Avery II adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia tampil dalam film John Singleton yang dinominasikan Oscar, Boyz n the Hood (1991) sebagai salah satu Bloods yang membunuh bintang sepak bola sekolah menengah Ricky Baker dan kemudian dibunuh oleh Doughboy sebagai balasan.

name: Lloyd Bridges
title: Lloyd Bridges
extract: Lloyd Vernet Bridges Jr. was an American film, stage and television actor who starred in a number of television series and appeared in more than 150 feature films. He was the father of four children, including the actors Beau Bridges and Jeff Bridges. He started his career as a contract performer for Columbia Pictures, appearing in films such as Sahara (1943), A Walk in the Sun (1945), Little Big Horn (1951) and High Noon (1952). On television, he starred in Sea Hunt (1958–1961). By the end of his career, he had re-invented himself and demonstrated a comedic talent in such parody films as Airplane! (1980), Hot Shots! (1991), and Jane Austen's Mafia! (1998). Among other honors, Bridges was a two-time Emmy Award nominee. He received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on February 1, 1994.
extract_id: Lloyd Vernet Bridges Jr. adalah seorang aktor film, panggung, dan televisi Amerika yang membintangi sejumlah serial televisi dan tampil dalam lebih dari 150 film fitur. Dia adalah ayah dari empat anak, termasuk aktor Beau Bridges dan Jeff Bridges. Dia memulai karirnya sebagai pemain kontrak untuk Columbia Pictures, muncul dalam film seperti Sahara (1943), A Walk in the Sun (1945), Little Big Horn (1951) dan High Noon (1952).
