Di televisi, ia membintangi Sea Hunt (1958–1961). Menjelang akhir kariernya, ia telah mengubah dirinya sendiri dan menunjukkan bakat komedi dalam film parodi seperti Airplane! (1980), Hot Shots! (1991), dan Jane Austen's Mafia! (1998). Di antara penghargaan lainnya, Bridges dinominasikan dua kali untuk Emmy Award. Dia menerima bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada 1 Februari 1994.

name: Logan Lerman
title: Logan Lerman
extract: Logan Wade Lerman is an American actor. He appeared in commercials in the mid-1990s, before starring in the series Jack & Bobby (2004–2005) and the movies The Butterfly Effect (2004) and Hoot (2006). Lerman gained further recognition for playing the title character in the Percy Jackson film series (2010–2013) and d'Artagnan in The Three Musketeers (2011), as well as for starring in the coming-of-age drama The Perks of Being a Wallflower (2012). He had major roles in the films Noah (2014), Fury (2014) and Indignation (2016), and returned to television with the thriller series Hunters (2020–2023).
extract_id: Logan Wade Lerman adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia muncul dalam iklan pada pertengahan 1990-an, sebelum membintangi serial Jack & Bobby (2004–2005) dan film The Butterfly Effect (2004) dan Hoot (2006). Lerman mendapat pengakuan lebih lanjut untuk memainkan karakter utama dalam seri film Percy Jackson (2010–2013) dan d'Artagnan dalam The Three Musketeers (2011), serta untuk membintangi drama coming-of-age The Perks of Being a Wallflower (2012). Dia memiliki peran utama dalam film Noah (2014), Fury (2014) dan Indignation (2016), dan kembali ke televisi dengan serial thriller Hunters (2020–2023).

name: Lola Dueñas
title: Lola Dueñas
extract: María Dolores Dueñas Navarro, better known as Lola Dueñas, is a Spanish actress. She is the recipient of several accolades, including two Goya Awards for Best Actress. In addition to her contributions to Spanish cinema and television, she has also worked in the French film industry.
extract_id: María Dolores Dueñas Navarro, lebih dikenal sebagai Lola Dueñas, adalah seorang aktris Spanyol. Dia adalah penerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Goya Awards untuk Aktris Terbaik. Selain kontribusinya pada perfilman dan televisi Spanyol, dia juga bekerja di industri film Prancis.

name: Lorelei Linklater
title: Lorelei Linklater
extract: Lorelei Grace Linklater is an American actress and multimedia artist. She is the oldest daughter of director Richard Linklater and Christina Harrison.
extract_id: Lorelei Grace Linklater adalah seorang aktris dan artis multimedia Amerika. Dia adalah putri tertua dari sutradara Richard Linklater dan Christina Harrison.

name: Lorella Cravotta
title: Lorella Cravotta
extract: Lorella Cravotta is a French comedian and actress.
extract_id: Lorella Cravotta adalah seorang komedian dan aktris Prancis.

name: Lori Martin
title: Lori Martin
extract: Dawn Catherine Menzer, known professionally as Lori Martin, was an American actress. A child actress for most of her career, she first achieved recognition as the title character of the NBC drama series National Velvet (1960–1962). Her most prominent film role was in the 1962 thriller Cape Fear, where she portrayed Gregory Peck's daughter.
extract_id: Dawn Catherine Menzer, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Lori Martin, adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Sebagian besar kariernya sebagai aktris anak-anak, dia pertama kali mendapatkan pengakuan sebagai karakter utama dari serial drama NBC National Velvet (1960–1962). Peran film terpentingnya adalah dalam thriller tahun 1962 Cape Fear, di mana dia memerankan putri Gregory Peck.

name: Lorraine Bracco
title: Lorraine Bracco
extract: Lorraine Bracco is an American actress best known for her performance as psychiatrist Jennifer Melfi on the HBO crime drama series The Sopranos (1999–2007) and for her breakthrough role portraying Karen Hill in the Martin Scorsese film Goodfellas (1990). Bracco began her career modeling in France and appeared in Italian-language films in the 1980s. Her English-language debut came in The Pick-up Artist (1987), which was followed by roles in Someone to Watch Over Me (1987), Sing (1989), and The Dream Team (1989). She has been nominated for an Academy Award, three Actor Awards, four Emmy Awards, and four Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Lorraine Bracco adalah seorang aktris Amerika yang paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai psikiater Jennifer Melfi dalam serial drama kriminal HBO The Sopranos (1999–2007) dan untuk peran terobosannya memerankan Karen Hill dalam film Martin Scorsese Goodfellas (1990). Bracco memulai kariernya sebagai model di Prancis dan tampil dalam film berbahasa Italia pada 1980-an. Debut bahasa Inggrisnya adalah di The Pick-up Artist (1987), yang kemudian diikuti oleh peran dalam Someone to Watch Over Me (1987), Sing (1989), dan The Dream Team (1989). Dia telah dinominasikan untuk Academy Award, tiga Actor Awards, empat Emmy Awards, dan empat Golden Globe Awards.

name: Lorraine Gary
title: Lorraine Gary
extract: Lorraine Gottfried, better known by her stage name Lorraine Gary, is a retired American actress, best known for her role as Ellen Brody in the Jaws film series. She also appeared in 1941 and Car Wash.
extract_id: Lorraine Gottfried, lebih dikenal dengan nama panggungnya Lorraine Gary, adalah seorang aktris Amerika yang telah pensiun, paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Ellen Brody dalam seri film Jaws. Dia juga tampil dalam 1941 dan Car Wash.

name: Lou Romano
title: Lou Romano
extract: Lou Romano is an American animator and voice actor. He did design work on Monsters, Inc. and The Incredibles, and provided the voices of Bernie Kropp in The Incredibles, Snot Rod in Cars, and Alfredo Linguini in Ratatouille.
extract_id: Lou Romano adalah seorang animator dan pemeran suara Amerika. Dia melakukan desain pada Monsters, Inc. dan The Incredibles, serta memberikan suara Bernie Kropp dalam The Incredibles, Snot Rod dalam Cars, dan Alfredo Linguini dalam Ratatouille.

name: Louis Calhern
title: Louis Calhern
extract: Carl Henry Vogt, known by his stage name Louis Calhern, was an American actor. Described by one film historian as a “star leading man of the theater and a star character actor of the screen,” he appeared in over 100 roles on the Broadway stage and in films and television, between 1923 and 1956. He was nominated for the Academy Award and the Golden Globe Award for Best Actor for portraying U.S. Supreme Court Justice Oliver Wendell Holmes in the 1950 film The Magnificent Yankee.
extract_id: Carl Henry Vogt, dikenal dengan nama panggungnya Louis Calhern, adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dijuluki oleh seorang sejarawan film sebagai “bintang utama panggung teater dan aktor karakter bintang di layar,” dia muncul dalam lebih dari 100 peran di panggung Broadway serta film dan televisi, antara 1923 dan 1956. Dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award dan Golden Globe Award untuk Aktor Terbaik atas perannya sebagai Hakim Mahkamah Agung AS Oliver Wendell Holmes dalam film The Magnificent Yankee tahun 1950.

name: Louis Hofmann
title: Louis Hofmann
extract: Louis Hofmann is a German actor. He first gained attention as the lead in the 2011 German film Tom Sawyer and won the Bodil Award for Best Supporting Actor for his role as a teenage German prisoner of war in the 2015 Danish film Land of Mine. Internationally, he is known for playing Jonas Kahnwald in the 2017 German Netflix series Dark (2017–2020).
extract_id: Louis Hofmann adalah seorang aktor Jerman. Dia pertama kali mendapat perhatian sebagai pemeran utama dalam film Jerman tahun 2011 Tom Sawyer dan memenangkan Bodil Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik atas perannya sebagai tahanan perang Jerman remaja dalam film Denmark Land of Mine tahun 2015. Secara internasional, dia dikenal karena memerankan Jonas Kahnwald dalam serial Netflix Jerman Dark (2017–2020).

name: Louis Malle
title: Louis Malle
extract: Louis Marie Malle was a French filmmaker who worked in France and Hollywood. Described as "eclectic" and "difficult to pin down", his works often depict provocative or controversial subject matter.
extract_id: Louis Marie Malle adalah seorang pembuat film Prancis yang bekerja di Prancis dan Hollywood. Digambarkan sebagai "eklektik" dan "sulit dipastikan", karya-karyanya sering menggambarkan materi yang provokatif atau kontroversial.

name: Louis Prima
title: Louis Prima
extract: Louis Leo Prima was an American trumpeter, singer, entertainer, and bandleader. While rooted in New Orleans jazz, swing music, and jump blues, Prima touched on various genres throughout his career: he formed a seven-piece New Orleans–style jazz band in the late 1920s, fronted a swing combo in the 1930s and a big band group in the 1940s, helped to popularize jump blues in the late 1940s and early to mid 1950s, and performed frequently as a Vegas lounge act beginning in the 1950s.
extract_id: Louis Leo Prima adalah seorang pemain terompet, penyanyi, penghibur, dan pemimpin band Amerika. Meskipun berakar pada jazz New Orleans, musik swing, dan jump blues, Prima menyentuh berbagai genre sepanjang kariernya: dia membentuk sebuah band jazz gaya New Orleans tujuh anggota pada akhir 1920-an, memimpin combo swing pada 1930-an dan grup big band pada 1940-an, membantu mempopulerkan jump blues pada akhir 1940-an dan awal hingga pertengahan 1950-an, dan sering tampil sebagai aksi lounge Vegas mulai tahun 1950-an.

name: Louis Wolheim
title: Louis Wolheim
extract: Louis Robert Wolheim was an American actor, of both stage and screen, whose rough physical appearance relegated him to roles mostly of thugs, villains and occasionally a soldier with a heart of gold in the movies, but whose talent allowed him to flourish on stage. His career was mostly contained during the silent era of the film industry, due to his death at the age of 50 in 1931.
extract_id: Louis Robert Wolheim adalah seorang aktor Amerika, baik di panggung maupun layar, dengan penampilan fisik kasar yang menempatkannya pada peran-peran seperti preman, penjahat, dan terkadang tentara berhati emas dalam film, tetapi bakatnya memungkinkan dia berkembang di panggung. Kariernya sebagian besar berakhir selama era film bisu, karena kematiannya pada usia 50 tahun pada tahun 1931.

name: Louise Fletcher
title: Louise Fletcher
extract: Estelle Louise Fletcher was an American actress. She is best known for her portrayal of the antagonist Nurse Ratched in the film One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest (1975), which earned her numerous accolades, including the Academy Award, BAFTA Award, and Golden Globe Award for Best Actress.
extract_id: Estelle Louise Fletcher adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai antagonis Nurse Ratched dalam film One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest (1975), yang memberinya berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan Golden Globe Award untuk Aktris Terbaik.

name: Loveleen Tandan
title: Loveleen Tandan
extract: Loveleen Tandan is an Indian film and casting director. She is the co-director (India) of Slumdog Millionaire along with Danny Boyle. She has also been the casting director for several other films, including Monsoon Wedding (2001) and Brick Lane (2007). She has been a casting consultant for The Namesake (2007).
extract_id: Loveleen Tandan adalah seorang sutradara film dan casting director India. Dia adalah co-director (India) dari Slumdog Millionaire bersama Danny Boyle. Dia juga pernah menjadi casting director untuk beberapa film lain, termasuk Monsoon Wedding (2001) dan Brick Lane (2007). Dia pernah menjadi konsultan casting untuk The Namesake (2007).

name: Lubna Azabal
title: Lubna Azabal
extract: Lubna Azabal is a Belgian actress. She is known for her performances in Paradise Now and Incendies.
extract_id: Lubna Azabal adalah seorang aktris Belgia. Dia dikenal karena penampilannya dalam Paradise Now dan Incendies.

name: Luc Besson
title: Luc Besson
extract: Luc Paul Maurice Besson is a French filmmaker. He has been involved in the creation of more than 50 films as a writer, director, or producer. Associated with the Cinéma du look film movement, he founded the production company Les Films du Loup and co-founded EuropaCorp with Pierre-Ange Le Pogam.
extract_id: Luc Paul Maurice Besson adalah seorang pembuat film Prancis. Dia telah terlibat dalam pembuatan lebih dari 50 film sebagai penulis, sutradara, atau produser. Dikaitkan dengan gerakan film Cinéma du look, dia mendirikan perusahaan produksi Les Films du Loup dan ikut mendirikan EuropaCorp bersama Pierre-Ange Le Pogam.

name: Luca Guadagnino
title: Luca Guadagnino
extract: Luca Guadagnino is an Italian film director and producer. His films are characterized by their emotional complexity, eroticism, and lavish visuals. Guadagnino has received numerous accolades, including a Silver Lion and an Independent Spirit Award, alongside nominations for an Academy Award, three Golden Globes, and three BAFTAs.
extract_id: Luca Guadagnino adalah sutradara dan produser film asal Italia. Film-filmnya ditandai oleh kompleksitas emosional, erotisisme, dan visual yang mewah. Guadagnino telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Silver Lion dan Independent Spirit Award, serta nominasi untuk Academy Award, tiga Golden Globes, dan tiga BAFTA.

name: Lucas Hedges
title: Lucas Hedges
extract: Lucas Hedges is an American actor. A son of filmmaker Peter Hedges, he studied theater at the University of North Carolina School of the Arts. Hedges began his acting career with a supporting role in Wes Anderson's comedy-drama Moonrise Kingdom (2012). He had his breakthrough in 2016 playing a sardonic teenager in Kenneth Lonergan's drama Manchester by the Sea, which earned him a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor, among other accolades. Hedges then starred as an aggressive youth in an off-Broadway production of Yen and had supporting roles in the coming-of-age film Lady Bird and the drama Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri in 2017.
extract_id: Lucas Hedges adalah aktor Amerika. Putra dari pembuat film Peter Hedges, ia belajar teater di University of North Carolina School of the Arts. Hedges memulai karier aktingnya dengan peran pendukung dalam komedi-drama Wes Anderson, Moonrise Kingdom (2012). Ia meraih terobosan pada 2016 dengan memainkan remaja sinis dalam drama Kenneth Lonergan, Manchester by the Sea, yang memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik, selain penghargaan lainnya. Hedges kemudian membintangi peran sebagai pemuda agresif dalam produksi off-Broadway Yen dan mengambil peran pendukung dalam film coming-of-age Lady Bird dan drama Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri pada 2017.

name: Lucie Mannheim
title: Lucie Mannheim
extract: Lucie Mannheim was a German singer and actress.
extract_id: Lucie Mannheim adalah penyanyi dan aktris asal Jerman.

name: Lucy Boynton
title: Lucy Boynton
extract: Lucy Boynton is a British actress. Born in New York City and raised in London, she made her professional debut as the young Beatrix Potter in Miss Potter (2006).
extract_id: Lucy Boynton adalah aktris Inggris. Lahir di New York City dan dibesarkan di London, dia memulai debut profesionalnya sebagai Beatrix Potter muda dalam Miss Potter (2006).

name: Lucy Davis
title: Lucy Davis
extract: Lucy Clare Davis is an English actress and comedian known for playing Dawn Tinsley in the BBC mockumentary television sitcom The Office (2001–2003), Hilda Spellman in the Netflix supernatural horror television series Chilling Adventures of Sabrina (2018–2020), Dianne in the zombie comedy film Shaun of the Dead (2004), and Etta Candy in the superhero film Wonder Woman (2017). She played Eva in Disney Channel's comedy television series The Villains of Valley View (2022–2023).
extract_id: Lucy Clare Davis adalah aktris dan komedian Inggris yang dikenal karena memerankan Dawn Tinsley dalam sitkom televisi mockumentary BBC The Office (2001–2003), Hilda Spellman dalam seri televisi horor supernatural Netflix Chilling Adventures of Sabrina (2018–2020), Dianne dalam film komedi zombie Shaun of the Dead (2004), dan Etta Candy dalam film superhero Wonder Woman (2017). Dia memerankan Eva dalam seri televisi komedi Disney Channel The Villains of Valley View (2022–2023).

name: Lucy Liu
title: Lucy Liu
extract: Lucy Alexis Liu is an American actress, producer, and artist. Regarded as a Hollywood icon and a trailblazer for Asian American representation in Hollywood, she is the recipient of numerous accolades, including two Critics' Choice Awards, two Screen Actors Guild Awards, and nominations for two Primetime Emmy Awards. A prominent sex symbol in the late 1990s and early 2000s, she has been recognized for shifting Western mainstream beauty standards. In 2019, Liu became the second Chinese American woman to be honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
extract_id: Lucy Alexis Liu adalah aktris, produser, dan seniman Amerika. Dianggap sebagai ikon Hollywood dan pelopor representasi Asia Amerika di Hollywood, dia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk dua Critics' Choice Awards, dua Screen Actors Guild Awards, dan nominasi untuk dua Primetime Emmy Awards. Sebagai simbol seks terkenal pada akhir 1990-an dan awal 2000-an, dia diakui telah mengubah standar kecantikan arus utama Barat. Pada 2019, Liu menjadi wanita Cina-Amerika kedua yang dianugerahi bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame.

name: Luis Buñuel
title: Luis Buñuel
extract: Luis Buñuel Portolés was a Spanish and Mexican filmmaker who worked in France, Mexico, and Spain. He has been widely considered by many film critics, historians, and directors to be one of the greatest and most influential filmmakers of all time. Buñuel's works are known for their avant-garde surrealism which was also infused with political commentary.
extract_id: Luis Buñuel Portolés adalah pembuat film Spanyol dan Meksiko yang bekerja di Prancis, Meksiko, dan Spanyol. Ia secara luas dianggap oleh banyak kritikus film, sejarawan, dan sutradara sebagai salah satu pembuat film terbesar dan paling berpengaruh sepanjang masa. Karya-karya Buñuel dikenal karena surealisme avant-garde yang juga memuat komentar politik.

name: Luis Guzmán
title: Luis Guzmán
extract: Luis Guzmán is a Puerto Rican actor. His career spans over 40 years and includes a number of films and television series. He has appeared in Paul Thomas Anderson's films Boogie Nights (1997), Magnolia (1999), and Punch-Drunk Love (2002), and Steven Soderbergh's films Out of Sight (1998), The Limey (1999) and Traffic (2000). His other film credits include Q & A (1990), The Hard Way (1991), Carlito's Way (1993), Snake Eyes (1998), and Keanu (2016). For his role in The Limey, he received a nomination for the Independent Spirit Award for Best Supporting Male.
extract_id: Luis Guzmán adalah aktor Puerto Rico. Kariernya telah berlangsung lebih dari 40 tahun dan mencakup sejumlah film dan serial televisi. Ia tampil dalam film-film Paul Thomas Anderson seperti Boogie Nights (1997), Magnolia (1999), dan Punch-Drunk Love (2002), serta film-film Steven Soderbergh seperti Out of Sight (1998), The Limey (1999), dan Traffic (2000). Kredit film lainnya termasuk Q & A (1990), The Hard Way (1991), Carlito's Way (1993), Snake Eyes (1998), dan Keanu (2016). Untuk perannya dalam The Limey, ia menerima nominasi Independent Spirit Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Luis Tosar
title: Luis Tosar
extract: Luis López Tosar is a Spanish actor from Galicia. He is one of the most recognizable and versatile actors in Spain.
extract_id: Luis López Tosar adalah aktor Spanyol asal Galicia. Ia adalah salah satu aktor paling dikenal dan serba bisa di Spanyol.

name: Lukas Moodysson
title: Lukas Moodysson
extract: Karl Fredrik Lukas Moodysson is a Swedish filmmaker, novelist, and short story writer. First coming to prominence as an ambitious poet in the 1980s, he had his big domestic and international breakthrough directing the 1998 romantic film Show Me Love. He has since directed a string of films with different styles and public appeal, as well as continued to write both poetry and novels. In 2007, The Guardian ranked Moodysson eleventh in its list of the world’s best directors, describing his directorial style as “heartfelt and uncompromising.”
extract_id: Karl Fredrik Lukas Moodysson adalah pembuat film, novelis, dan penulis cerita pendek Swedia. Awalnya dikenal sebagai penyair ambisius pada 1980-an, ia meraih terobosan besar di dalam dan luar negeri dengan menyutradarai film romantis Show Me Love pada 1998. Sejak saat itu, ia menyutradarai sejumlah film dengan gaya dan daya tarik publik yang berbeda, serta terus menulis puisi dan novel. Pada 2007, The Guardian menempatkan Moodysson di peringkat kesebelas dalam daftar sutradara terbaik dunia, menggambarkan gaya penyutradaraannya sebagai “penuh perasaan dan tanpa kompromi.”

name: Luke Bracey
title: Luke Bracey
extract: Luke Bracey is an Australian actor. He is known for his work in films such as Monte Carlo (2011), G.I. Joe: Retaliation (2013), The November Man (2014), Point Break (2015), Hacksaw Ridge (2016), and Elvis (2022); and for television series such as Home and Away, which was his first appearance on screen.
extract_id: Luke Bracey adalah aktor Australia. Ia dikenal lewat film-film seperti Monte Carlo (2011), G.I. Joe: Retaliation (2013), The November Man (2014), Point Break (2015), Hacksaw Ridge (2016), dan Elvis (2022); serta serial televisi seperti Home and Away, yang merupakan penampilan pertamanya di layar.

name: Luàna Bajrami
title: Luàna Bajrami
extract: Luàna Bajrami-Rahmani is a French-Albanian actress from Kosovo. She is known for her roles in the films Portrait of a Lady on Fire (2019) and School's Out (2018). She made her directorial debut with The Hill Where Lionesses Roar (2021).
extract_id: Luàna Bajrami-Rahmani adalah aktris Prancis-Albania dari Kosovo. Dia dikenal lewat perannya dalam film Portrait of a Lady on Fire (2019) dan School's Out (2018). Ia membuat debut penyutradaraan dengan The Hill Where Lionesses Roar (2021).

name: Lydia Wilson
title: Lydia Wilson
extract: Lydia Wilson is an English-American actress. Since graduating in 2009 from the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art, she has performed in numerous television and theatre productions including the Olivier Award-winning Blasted by Sarah Kane in 2010 at the Lyric Theatre, and as Kate Middleton in the Olivier Award winning King Charles III at the Almeida Theatre, Wyndham's Theatre and Music Box Theatre on Broadway.
extract_id: Lydia Wilson adalah aktris Inggris-Amerika. Sejak lulus pada 2009 dari Royal Academy of Dramatic Art, ia telah tampil dalam banyak produksi televisi dan teater termasuk Blasted karya Sarah Kane yang memenangkan Olivier Award pada 2010 di Lyric Theatre, dan sebagai Kate Middleton dalam King Charles III yang memenangkan Olivier Award di Almeida Theatre, Wyndham's Theatre, dan Music Box Theatre di Broadway.

name: Léa Seydoux
title: Léa Seydoux
extract: Léa Hélène Seydoux-Fornier de Clausonne is a French actress who has appeared in both French cinema and Hollywood productions. She has been nominated for five César Awards, two Lumière Awards, a Palme d'Or and a BAFTA Award. In 2009, she won the Trophée Chopard Award for Female Revelation of the Year at the Cannes Film Festival. In 2016, she was honoured with appointment as a Dame of the Order of Arts and Letters. In 2022, the French government made her a Dame of the National Order of Merit. In 2026, the Académie des César announced that she will be the president of the 52nd César Awards ceremony, to be held on February 25, 2027.
extract_id: Léa Hélène Seydoux-Fornier de Clausonne adalah aktris Prancis yang telah tampil di sinema Prancis dan produksi Hollywood. Ia telah dinominasikan untuk lima César Awards, dua Lumière Awards, sebuah Palme d'Or, dan sebuah BAFTA Award. Pada 2009, ia memenangkan Trophée Chopard Award untuk Female Revelation of the Year di Festival Film Cannes. Pada 2016, ia dianugerahi gelar Dame dari Order of Arts and Letters. Pada 2022, pemerintah Prancis mengangkatnya sebagai Dame dari National Order of Merit. Pada 2026, Académie des César mengumumkan bahwa ia akan menjadi presiden upacara César Awards ke-52 yang akan diadakan pada 25 Februari 2027.

name: M. Night Shyamalan
title: M. Night Shyamalan
extract: Manoj Nelliyattu Shyamalan, known professionally as M. Night Shyamalan, is an American filmmaker and actor. His films often employ supernatural plots and twist endings. The cumulative gross of his films exceeds $3.3 billion globally. Shyamalan has received various accolades, including nominations for two Academy Awards, two BAFTA Awards and a Golden Globe.
extract_id: Manoj Nelliyattu Shyamalan, dikenal secara profesional sebagai M. Night Shyamalan, adalah pembuat film dan aktor Amerika. Film-filmnya sering menggunakan plot supernatural dan akhir yang berbelok. Total pendapatan film-filmnya melebihi $3,3 miliar secara global. Shyamalan telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards, dua BAFTA Awards, dan satu Golden Globe.

name: Mabel Rivera
title: Mabel Rivera
extract: María Isabel Rivera Torres better known as Mabel Rivera is a Spanish actress from Galicia.
extract_id: María Isabel Rivera Torres yang lebih dikenal sebagai Mabel Rivera adalah aktris Spanyol asal Galicia.

name: Macaulay Culkin
title: Macaulay Culkin
extract: Macaulay Macaulay Culkin Culkin is an American actor and musician. Considered one of the most successful child actors of the 1990s, Culkin has received several accolades including a Golden Globe Award nomination. In 2005, he was ranked second on VH1's list of the "100 Greatest Kid-Stars". In 2023, he received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
extract_id: Macaulay Macaulay Culkin Culkin adalah aktor dan musisi Amerika. Dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor anak-anak paling sukses pada 1990-an, Culkin telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk nominasi Golden Globe Award. Pada 2005, ia menempati peringkat kedua dalam daftar "100 Greatest Kid-Stars" versi VH1. Pada 2023, ia menerima bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame.

name: Macdonald Carey
title: Macdonald Carey
extract: Edward Macdonald Carey was an American actor. He first made his career starring in various B-movies from the 1940s through the 1960s,, and was known in many Hollywood circles as "King of the Bs". Beginning in 1965, he portrayed patriarch Dr. Tom Horton on NBC's soap opera Days of Our Lives. For almost three decades, he was the show's central cast member, winning two Daytime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Edward Macdonald Carey adalah aktor Amerika. Ia mulai berkarier dengan membintangi berbagai film B dari tahun 1940-an hingga 1960-an, dan dikenal di banyak kalangan Hollywood sebagai "King of the Bs". Mulai 1965, ia memerankan patriark Dr. Tom Horton dalam opera sabun NBC, Days of Our Lives. Selama hampir tiga dekade, ia adalah anggota utama pemeran acara tersebut, memenangkan dua Daytime Emmy Awards.

name: Machiko Kyô
title: Machiko Kyō
extract: Motoko Yano, better known as Machiko Kyō , was a Japanese actress who was active primarily in the 1950s. Considered one of Japan's first sex symbols and one of its greatest screen actresses, Kyō is best known for her critically acclaimed work with directors Akira Kurosawa, Yasujirō Ozu, Kenji Mizoguchi, Mikio Naruse, Kon Ichikawa, Teinosuke Kinugasa, Kōzaburō Yoshimura, Shirō Toyoda and Hiroshi Teshigahara, appearing in films such as Rashomon, Ugetsu, Gate of Hell, Street of Shame, Floating Weeds, Odd Obsession and The Face of Another.
extract_id: Motoko Yano, yang lebih dikenal sebagai Machiko Kyō, adalah aktris Jepang yang aktif terutama pada 1950-an. Dianggap sebagai salah satu simbol seks pertama Jepang dan salah satu aktris layar terbesar, Kyō dikenal karena karyanya yang sangat diakui dengan sutradara Akira Kurosawa, Yasujirō Ozu, Kenji Mizoguchi, Mikio Naruse, Kon Ichikawa, Teinosuke Kinugasa, Kōzaburō Yoshimura, Shirō Toyoda, dan Hiroshi Teshigahara, tampil dalam film seperti Rashomon, Ugetsu, Gate of Hell, Street of Shame, Floating Weeds, Odd Obsession, dan The Face of Another.

name: Mack Swain
title: Mack Swain
extract: Mack Swain was a prolific early American film actor, who appeared in many of Mack Sennett’s comedies at Keystone Studios, including the Keystone Cops series. He also appeared in major features by Charlie Chaplin and starred in both the world's first feature length comedy and first film to feature a "movie-within-a-movie" premise.
extract_id: Mack Swain adalah aktor film Amerika awal yang sangat produktif, yang muncul dalam banyak komedi Mack Sennett di Keystone Studios, termasuk seri Keystone Cops. Ia juga tampil dalam film-film besar oleh Charlie Chaplin dan membintangi film komedi panjang pertama di dunia serta film pertama yang menggunakan premis "film dalam film".

name: Mackenzie Foy
title: Mackenzie Foy
extract: Mackenzie Christine Foy is an American actress and model. Her breakout role was as Renesmee Cullen in the 2012 film The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn – Part 2, which earned her a Young Artist Award nomination for Best Supporting Young Actress in a Feature Film. She is also known for portraying Cindy Perron in The Conjuring Universe and young Murph in Interstellar (2014), the latter earning her a Saturn Award for Best Performance by a Younger Actor, among other awards nominations. She has also starred in The Nutcracker and the Four Realms (2018) and Black Beauty (2020).
extract_id: Mackenzie Christine Foy adalah aktris dan model Amerika. Peran terobosannya adalah sebagai Renesmee Cullen dalam film The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn – Part 2 (2012), yang memberinya nominasi Young Artist Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Muda Terbaik dalam Film Fitur. Ia juga dikenal karena memerankan Cindy Perron dalam Universe The Conjuring dan Murph muda dalam Interstellar (2014), yang memberinya Saturn Award untuk Penampilan Terbaik oleh Aktor Muda, serta nominasi penghargaan lainnya. Ia juga membintangi The Nutcracker and the Four Realms (2018) dan Black Beauty (2020).

name: Madeleine Carroll
title: Madeleine Carroll
extract: Edith Madeleine Carroll was an English actress, popular both in Britain and in America in the 1930s and 1940s. At the peak of her success in 1938, she was the world's highest-paid actress.
extract_id: Edith Madeleine Carroll adalah aktris Inggris yang populer baik di Inggris maupun Amerika pada 1930-an dan 1940-an. Pada puncak kesuksesannya pada 1938, ia adalah aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia.

name: Madeleine Stowe
title: Madeleine Stowe
extract: Madeleine Stowe is an American actress. She appeared mostly on television before her role in the 1987 crime-comedy film Stakeout. She went on to star in the films Revenge (1990), Unlawful Entry (1992), The Last of the Mohicans (1992), Blink (1993), 12 Monkeys (1995), The General's Daughter (1999), and We Were Soldiers (2002). For her role in the 1993 independent film Short Cuts, she won the National Society of Film Critics Award for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: Madeleine Stowe adalah aktris Amerika. Ia tampil terutama di televisi sebelum perannya dalam film komedi kriminal 1987, Stakeout. Ia kemudian membintangi film Revenge (1990), Unlawful Entry (1992), The Last of the Mohicans (1992), Blink (1993), 12 Monkeys (1995), The General's Daughter (1999), dan We Were Soldiers (2002). Untuk perannya dalam film independen 1993, Short Cuts, ia memenangkan National Society of Film Critics Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Madeline Carroll
title: Madeline Carroll
extract: Madeline Carroll is an American actress known for starring as Molly Johnson in Swing Vote, as Farren in The Spy Next Door, as Juli Baker in Flipped, as Janie Popper in Mr. Popper's Penguins and as Willow O'Neil in The Magic of Belle Isle.
extract_id: Madeline Carroll adalah aktris Amerika yang dikenal karena memerankan Molly Johnson dalam Swing Vote, Farren dalam The Spy Next Door, Juli Baker dalam Flipped, Janie Popper dalam Mr. Popper's Penguins, dan Willow O'Neil dalam The Magic of Belle Isle.

name: Madeline Kahn
title: Madeline Kahn
extract: Madeline Gail Kahn was an American actress, comedian, and singer. She was known for her comedic roles in films directed by Peter Bogdanovich and Mel Brooks, including What's Up, Doc? (1972), Young Frankenstein (1974), High Anxiety (1977), History of the World, Part I (1981), and her Academy Award–nominated roles in Paper Moon (1973) and Blazing Saddles (1974).
extract_id: Madeline Gail Kahn adalah aktris, komedian, dan penyanyi Amerika. Ia dikenal karena peran komedinya dalam film yang disutradarai Peter Bogdanovich dan Mel Brooks, termasuk What's Up, Doc? (1972), Young Frankenstein (1974), High Anxiety (1977), History of the World, Part I (1981), serta peran yang dinominasikan untuk Academy Award dalam Paper Moon (1973) dan Blazing Saddles (1974).

name: Madhavan
title: R. Madhavan
extract: Ranganathan Madhavan is an Indian actor, screenwriter, film producer, and film director who predominantly works in Tamil and Hindi cinema. Madhavan has appeared in over 70 films, he has won one National Film Award, five Filmfare Awards South, two Tamil Nadu State Film Awards, and five SIIMA Awards. He was awarded Padma Shri by Government of India in 2026 in field of Art. Since September 2023, Madhavan is the President of FTII, Pune.
extract_id: Ranganathan Madhavan adalah aktor, penulis skenario, produser film, dan sutradara film India yang sebagian besar bekerja di sinema Tamil dan Hindi. Madhavan telah tampil dalam lebih dari 70 film, ia memenangkan satu Penghargaan Film Nasional, lima Penghargaan Filmfare Selatan, dua Penghargaan Film Negara Bagian Tamil Nadu, dan lima Penghargaan SIIMA. Ia dianugerahi Padma Shri oleh Pemerintah India pada tahun 2026 di bidang Seni. Sejak September 2023, Madhavan menjabat sebagai Presiden FTII, Pune.

name: Mads Mikkelsen
title: Mads Mikkelsen
extract: Mads Dittmann Mikkelsen is a Danish actor. He rose to fame in Denmark as an actor for his roles such as Tonny in the first two films of the Pusher film trilogy, Detective Sergeant Allan Fischer in the television series Rejseholdet (2000–2004), Niels in Open Hearts (2002), Svend in The Green Butchers (2003), Ivan in Adam's Apples (2005) and Jacob Petersen in After the Wedding (2006).
extract_id: Mads Dittmann Mikkelsen adalah aktor Denmark. Ia menjadi terkenal di Denmark sebagai aktor untuk perannya seperti Tonny dalam dua film pertama dari trilogi film Pusher, Detective Sergeant Allan Fischer dalam serial televisi Rejseholdet (2000–2004), Niels dalam Open Hearts (2002), Svend dalam The Green Butchers (2003), Ivan dalam Adam's Apples (2005) dan Jacob Petersen dalam After the Wedding (2006).

name: Mae Clarke
title: Mae Clarke
extract: Mae Clarke was an American actress. She is widely remembered for playing Henry Frankenstein's bride Elizabeth, who is chased by Boris Karloff in Frankenstein, and for being on the receiving end of James Cagney's halved grapefruit in The Public Enemy. Both films were released in 1931.
extract_id: Mae Clarke adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Ia dikenal luas karena memerankan Elizabeth, istri Henry Frankenstein, yang dikejar oleh Boris Karloff dalam Frankenstein, serta karena menjadi korban posisi setengah jeruk bali James Cagney dalam The Public Enemy. Kedua film tersebut dirilis pada tahun 1931.

name: Magali Noël
title: Magali Noël
extract: Magali Noëlle Guiffray, better known as Magali Noël, was a French actress and singer.
extract_id: Magali Noëlle Guiffray, yang lebih dikenal sebagai Magali Noël, adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Prancis.

name: Maggie Cheung
title: Maggie Cheung
extract: Maggie Cheung is a Hong Kong actress. She is considered to be one of the most successful and internationally acclaimed actresses in Asia. Cheung is the recipient of numerous accolades, including six Hong Kong Film Awards and five Golden Horse Awards, holding the record for most awards in the Best Actress category. Internationally, she is best known for winning the Silver Bear for Center Stage (1991) and the Cannes Film Festival Award for Clean (2004), making her the first Asian actress to receive the latter and the only Asian actress to have won Best Actress awards at two of the three major European film festivals.
extract_id: Maggie Cheung adalah aktris Hong Kong. Dia dianggap sebagai salah satu aktris paling sukses dan diakui secara internasional di Asia. Cheung menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk enam Penghargaan Film Hong Kong dan lima Golden Horse Awards, memegang rekor untuk penghargaan terbanyak dalam kategori Aktris Terbaik. Secara internasional, ia dikenal karena memenangkan Silver Bear untuk Center Stage (1991) dan Penghargaan Festival Film Cannes untuk Clean (2004), menjadikannya aktris Asia pertama yang menerima penghargaan terakhir tersebut dan satu-satunya aktris Asia yang memenangkan penghargaan Aktris Terbaik di dua dari tiga festival film utama Eropa.

name: Maggie Grace
title: Maggie Grace
extract: Margaret Grace Denig is an American actress. Grace earned a Young Artist Award nomination in 2002 with her portrayal of 15-year-old murder victim Martha Moxley in the television movie Murder in Greenwich. In 2004, she was cast as Shannon Rutherford in the television series Lost, on which she was a main cast member for the first two seasons, winning a Screen Actors Guild Award shared with the ensemble cast. Leaving the series, Grace was keen to work more prominently in film. She appeared in The Jane Austen Book Club (2007), and as Kim Mills in Taken in 2008. She reprised the role of Kim in Taken 2 (2012) and Taken 3 (2014).
extract_id: Margaret Grace Denig adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Grace meraih nominasi Young Artist Award pada 2002 dengan perannya sebagai korban pembunuhan berusia 15 tahun Martha Moxley dalam film televisi Murder in Greenwich. Pada 2004, ia berperan sebagai Shannon Rutherford dalam serial televisi Lost, di mana dia menjadi anggota utama selama dua musim pertama, memenangkan Screen Actors Guild Award bersama seluruh pemeran. Setelah meninggalkan serial tersebut, Grace ingin berperan lebih menonjol di film. Ia tampil dalam The Jane Austen Book Club (2007), dan sebagai Kim Mills dalam Taken pada 2008. Ia mengulangi perannya sebagai Kim dalam Taken 2 (2012) dan Taken 3 (2014).

name: Maggie Smith
title: Maggie Smith
extract: Dame Margaret Natalie Smith was a British actress. Known for her wit in both comedic and dramatic roles, she had an extensive career on stage and screen spanning eight decades and was one of Britain's most recognisable and prolific actresses. She received numerous accolades, including two Academy Awards, five BAFTA Awards, four Emmy Awards, three Golden Globe Awards and a Tony Award, as well as nominations for six Olivier Awards. Smith was one of the few performers to earn the Triple Crown of Acting.
extract_id: Dame Margaret Natalie Smith adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Dikenal karena kepintarannya dalam peran komedi dan drama, ia memiliki karier luas di panggung dan layar yang berlangsung selama delapan dekade dan merupakan salah satu aktris paling dikenal dan produktif di Inggris. Ia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards, lima BAFTA Awards, empat Emmy Awards, tiga Golden Globe Awards dan Tony Award, serta nominasi untuk enam Olivier Awards. Smith adalah salah satu dari sedikit pemeran yang meraih Triple Crown of Acting.

name: Magnus Millang
title: Magnus Millang
description: Danish screenwriter, actor, comedian and film director
extract: Magnus Millang is a Danish screenwriter, actor, comedian, and film director. He has appeared in Danish TV shows such as Brian Mørk Show, Mørk og Jul, Silat Ninjaen, and Zulu Gumball. In Dark & Christmas, Millang is best known for his activist character, Basher Henrik, a character who in 2008 had a great life on YouTube.
extract_id: Magnus Millang adalah penulis skenario, aktor, komedian, dan sutradara film Denmark. Ia tampil dalam acara TV Denmark seperti Brian Mørk Show, Mørk og Jul, Silat Ninjaen, dan Zulu Gumball. Dalam Dark & Christmas, Millang dikenal sebagai karakter aktivisnya, Basher Henrik, karakter yang pada tahun 2008 menikmati kesuksesan besar di YouTube.

name: Mahershala Ali
title: Mahershala Ali
extract: Mahershala Ali is an American actor. He has received multiple accolades, including two Academy Awards, a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award. Films in which he has appeared have grossed over $3.3 billion worldwide. In 2020, The New York Times ranked him among the 25 greatest actors of the 21st century. Time magazine named him one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2019.
extract_id: Mahershala Ali adalah aktor Amerika. Ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards, satu BAFTA Award, satu Golden Globe Award, dan satu Primetime Emmy Award. Film-film yang ia bintangi telah meraup lebih dari $3,3 miliar di seluruh dunia. Pada 2020, The New York Times menempatkannya di antara 25 aktor terbesar abad ke-21. Majalah Time menobatkannya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia pada 2019.

name: Mahesh Manjrekar
title: Mahesh Manjrekar
extract: Mahesh Vaman Manjrekar is an Indian actor, film director, screenwriter and producer who works primarily in Hindi, Marathi and Telugu films. He is best known for directing Vaastav: The Reality (1999), Astitva (2000) and Viruddh... Family Comes First (2005). He won a National Film Award, seven Maharashtra State Film Awards, four Filmfare Awards Marathi, a Filmfare Award, four Zee Chitra Gaurav Puraskar, four MFK Awards and two Star Screen Awards. In 2023, He was honoured with the V. Shantaram Award, Maharashtra's highest award in the field of cinema. He was also the host of the reality show, Bigg Boss Marathi from 2018 until 2023.
extract_id: Mahesh Vaman Manjrekar adalah aktor, sutradara film, penulis skenario dan produser India yang terutama bekerja di film Hindi, Marathi, dan Telugu. Ia terkenal karena menyutradarai Vaastav: The Reality (1999), Astitva (2000) dan Viruddh... Family Comes First (2005). Ia memenangkan Penghargaan Film Nasional, tujuh Penghargaan Film Negara Bagian Maharashtra, empat Filmfare Awards Marathi, satu Filmfare Award, empat Zee Chitra Gaurav Puraskar, empat MFK Awards dan dua Star Screen Awards. Pada 2023, ia dianugerahi Penghargaan V. Shantaram, penghargaan tertinggi Maharashtra di bidang perfilman. Ia juga menjadi pembawa acara reality show, Bigg Boss Marathi dari 2018 hingga 2023.

name: Mahie Gill
title: Mahie Gill
extract: Rimpy Kaur Gill, known professionally as Mahie Gill, is an Indian actress who works primarily in Hindi and Punjabi-language films. She began her acting career in Punjabi cinema before making her Hindi film debut with Dev.D (2009), directed by Anurag Kashyap.
extract_id: Rimpy Kaur Gill, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Mahie Gill, adalah aktris India yang sebagian besar bekerja dalam film berbahasa Hindi dan Punjabi. Ia memulai karier aktingnya di sinema Punjabi sebelum membuat debut film Hindi dengan Dev.D (2009), yang disutradarai oleh Anurag Kashyap.

name: Mahito Tsujimura
title: Mahito Tsujimura
extract: Mahito Tsujimura was a Japanese actor and voice actor who was represented by 81 Produce. Tsujimura died on November 27, 2018.
extract_id: Mahito Tsujimura adalah aktor dan pengisi suara Jepang yang diwakili oleh 81 Produce. Tsujimura meninggal pada 27 November 2018.

name: Majid Majidi
title: Majid Majidi
extract: Majid Majidi is an Iranian filmmaker and producer. His films often feature child or adolescent protagonists; explore themes such as childhood innocence, family bonds, poverty, social issues, and solidarity; and are characterized by a humanistic sensibility. His important films include Children of Heaven (1997), The Color of Paradise (1999), Baran (2001) and The Song of Sparrows (2008). Children of Heaven was nominated for the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film. More recently, Majidi directed Muhammad: The Messenger of God (2015), an epic film dealing with the childhood of the Islamic prophet Muhammad, whose face is obscured and never shown onscreen.
extract_id: Majid Majidi adalah pembuat film dan produser Iran. Film-filmnya sering menampilkan protagonis anak-anak atau remaja; mengeksplorasi tema seperti kepolosan masa kecil, ikatan keluarga, kemiskinan, isu sosial, dan solidaritas; serta ditandai oleh kepekaan humanistik. Film-film pentingnya meliputi Children of Heaven (1997), The Color of Paradise (1999), Baran (2001) dan The Song of Sparrows (2008). Children of Heaven dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Film Berbahasa Asing Terbaik. Baru-baru ini, Majidi menyutradarai Muhammad: The Messenger of God (2015), sebuah film epik yang membahas masa kecil nabi Islam Muhammad, yang wajahnya disamarkan dan tidak pernah ditampilkan di layar.

name: Makio Inoue
title: Makio Inoue
extract: Takao Inoue November 30, 1938 – November 29, 2019, known professionally by his stage name Makio Inoue , was a Japanese actor and voice actor.
extract_id: Takao Inoue 30 November 1938 – 29 November 2019, dikenal secara profesional dengan nama panggungnya Makio Inoue, adalah aktor dan pengisi suara Jepang.

name: Makoto Shinkai
title: Makoto Shinkai
extract: Makoto Niitsu , known as Makoto Shinkai , is a Japanese filmmaker and novelist. A founder of CoMix Wave Films, he is known for his anime feature films enriched with visually-appealing animation and romantic stories depicting teenagers and high school students.
extract_id: Makoto Niitsu, yang dikenal sebagai Makoto Shinkai, adalah pembuat film dan novelis Jepang. Pendiri CoMix Wave Films, ia dikenal dengan film anime fitur yang kaya akan animasi visual menarik dan cerita romantis yang menggambarkan remaja dan pelajar sekolah menengah.

name: Malcolm McDowell
title: Malcolm McDowell
extract: Malcolm McDowell is an English actor. He first became known for portraying Mick Travis in Lindsay Anderson's If.... (1968), a role he later reprised in O Lucky Man! (1973) and Britannia Hospital (1982). His performance in If.... prompted Stanley Kubrick to cast him as Alex in A Clockwork Orange (1971), the role for which McDowell became best known.
extract_id: Malcolm McDowell adalah aktor Inggris. Ia pertama kali dikenal karena memerankan Mick Travis dalam film If.... (1968) karya Lindsay Anderson, peran yang kemudian ia ulangi dalam O Lucky Man! (1973) dan Britannia Hospital (1982). Penampilannya dalam If.... membuat Stanley Kubrick memilihnya sebagai Alex dalam A Clockwork Orange (1971), peran yang paling dikenang dari McDowell.

name: Malin Akerman
title: Malin Akerman
extract: Malin Maria Åkerman, often anglicised to Malin Akerman, is a Swedish and American actress. She first appeared in smaller parts in both Canadian and American productions, including The Utopian Society (2003) and Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle (2004). Following a main role on the HBO mockumentary series The Comeback (2005), Akerman co-starred in the commercially successful romantic comedies The Heartbreak Kid (2007) and 27 Dresses (2008). She gained wider recognition for her role as Silk Spectre II in the 2009 superhero film Watchmen, for which she received a Saturn Award nomination for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: Malin Maria Åkerman, yang sering dianglikan menjadi Malin Akerman, adalah aktris Swedia dan Amerika. Ia pertama kali muncul dalam peran kecil di produksi Kanada dan Amerika, termasuk The Utopian Society (2003) dan Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle (2004). Setelah peran utama dalam serial mockumentary HBO The Comeback (2005), Akerman berperan dalam komedi romantis yang sukses secara komersial The Heartbreak Kid (2007) dan 27 Dresses (2008). Ia mendapatkan pengakuan lebih luas untuk perannya sebagai Silk Spectre II dalam film superhero Watchmen (2009), yang memberinya nominasi Saturn Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Mamaengaroa Kerr-Bell
title: Mamaengaroa Kerr-Bell
extract: Mamaengaroa Kerr-Bell is a former New Zealand actress.
extract_id: Mamaengaroa Kerr-Bell adalah mantan aktris dari Selandia Baru.

name: Mami Koyama
title: Mami Koyama
extract: Mami Koyama is a Japanese actress, voice actress and narrator affiliated with Aoni Production. Her best-known voice roles include Ophiuchus Shaina in Saint Seiya, Arale Norimaki in Dr. Slump, Minky Momo in Magical Princess Minky Momo, Lunch in Dragon Ball, Kaguya Ōtsutsuki in Naruto: Shippuden, Korosuke in Kiteretsu Daihyakka, Ryoko Mendo in Urusei Yatsura, and Charlotte Linlin in One Piece, Vermouth in Detective Conan. Some of her notable roles in the 1990s and 2000s anime include Balalaika in Black Lagoon, Talia Gladys in Gundam Seed Destiny, Eva Heinemann in Monster, and Yōko Itoigawa in Hyōka. In feature films, she voiced Kei in Akira, and the adult Chiyoko Fujiwara in Millennium Actress.
extract_id: Mami Koyama adalah aktris, pengisi suara dan narator Jepang yang berafiliasi dengan Aoni Production. Peran suara terkenalnya termasuk Ophiuchus Shaina dalam Saint Seiya, Arale Norimaki dalam Dr. Slump, Minky Momo dalam Magical Princess Minky Momo, Lunch dalam Dragon Ball, Kaguya Ōtsutsuki dalam Naruto: Shippuden, Korosuke dalam Kiteretsu Daihyakka, Ryoko Mendo dalam Urusei Yatsura, dan Charlotte Linlin dalam One Piece, Vermouth dalam Detective Conan. Beberapa peran pentingnya di anime tahun 1990-an dan 2000-an termasuk Balalaika dalam Black Lagoon, Talia Gladys dalam Gundam Seed Destiny, Eva Heinemann dalam Monster, dan Yōko Itoigawa dalam Hyōka. Dalam film layar lebar, ia mengisi suara Kei dalam Akira, dan Chiyoko Fujiwara dewasa dalam Millennium Actress.

name: Mamoru Hosoda
title: Mamoru Hosoda
extract: Mamoru Hosoda is a Japanese filmmaker and animator. He is known for the short films that made up Digimon: The Movie (2000), The Girl Who Leapt Through Time (2006) and Summer Wars (2009). He was nominated for an Academy Award in the category Best Animated Feature Film at the 91st Academy Awards for his seventh film Mirai (2018).
extract_id: Mamoru Hosoda adalah pembuat film dan animator Jepang. Ia dikenal karena film pendek yang membentuk Digimon: The Movie (2000), The Girl Who Leapt Through Time (2006) dan Summer Wars (2009). Ia mendapat nominasi Academy Award dalam kategori Film Animasi Terbaik di Academy Awards ke-91 untuk film ketujuhnya Mirai (2018).

name: Mamoru Oshii
title: Mamoru Oshii
description: Japanese filmmaker, television director, and writer (born 1951)
extract: Mamoru Oshii is a Japanese filmmaker, television director and writer. Famous for his philosophy-oriented storytelling, Oshii has directed a number of acclaimed anime films, including Urusei Yatsura 2: Beautiful Dreamer (1984), Angel's Egg (1985), Patlabor 2: The Movie (1993), and Ghost in the Shell (1995). He also holds the distinction of directing the first ever OVA, Dallos (1983). As a writer, Oshii has worked as a screenwriter, and occasionally as a manga writer and novelist. His most notable works as a writer include the manga Kerberos Panzer Cop (1988–2000) and its feature film adaptation Jin-Roh: The Wolf Brigade (1999).
extract_id: Mamoru Oshii adalah pembuat film Jepang, sutradara televisi, dan penulis. Terkenal karena penceritaan berorientasi filosofi, Oshii telah menyutradarai sejumlah film anime yang diakui, termasuk Urusei Yatsura 2: Beautiful Dreamer (1984), Angel's Egg (1985), Patlabor 2: The Movie (1993), dan Ghost in the Shell (1995). Ia juga memegang rekor sebagai sutradara OVA pertama, Dallos (1983). Sebagai penulis, Oshii telah bekerja sebagai penulis skenario, dan kadang-kadang sebagai penulis manga dan novelis. Karya paling terkenal sebagai penulis termasuk manga Kerberos Panzer Cop (1988–2000) dan adaptasi filmnya Jin-Roh: The Wolf Brigade (1999).

name: Mandy Moore
title: Mandy Moore
extract: Amanda Leigh Moore is an American singer-songwriter and actress. She rose to fame with her 1999 debut single "Candy", which peaked at number 41 on the Billboard Hot 100. Her debut album, So Real (1999), received Platinum certification from the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA). The song "I Wanna Be with You" from the reissue album I Wanna Be With You (2000), became Moore's first Top 40 single, peaking at 24. Moore then released the albums Mandy Moore (2001), Coverage (2003), Wild Hope (2007), Amanda Leigh (2009), Silver Landings (2020), and In Real Life (2022).
extract_id: Amanda Leigh Moore adalah penyanyi-penulis lagu dan aktris Amerika. Ia meraih ketenaran dengan single debutnya tahun 1999 "Candy", yang mencapai puncak nomor 41 di Billboard Hot 100. Album debutnya, So Real (1999), memperoleh sertifikasi Platinum dari Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA). Lagu "I Wanna Be with You" dari album reissue I Wanna Be With You (2000), menjadi single Top 40 pertama Moore, mencapai posisi 24. Moore kemudian merilis album Mandy Moore (2001), Coverage (2003), Wild Hope (2007), Amanda Leigh (2009), Silver Landings (2020), dan In Real Life (2022).

name: Mandy Patinkin
title: Mandy Patinkin
extract: Mandel Bruce "Mandy" Patinkin is an American actor and singer in musical theatre, television, and film. As a Broadway performer, he has collaborated with Stephen Sondheim and Andrew Lloyd Webber.
extract_id: Mandel Bruce "Mandy" Patinkin adalah aktor dan penyanyi Amerika dalam teater musikal, televisi, dan film. Sebagai pemeran Broadway, ia telah bekerja sama dengan Stephen Sondheim dan Andrew Lloyd Webber.

name: Manjot Singh
title: Manjot Singh
extract: Manjot Singh is an Indian Bollywood actor, best known for his role in films like Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye!, Student Of The Year and Fukrey. He won Filmfare Critics Award for Best Actor for his performance in Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye!.
extract_id: Manjot Singh adalah aktor Bollywood India, terkenal karena perannya dalam film-film seperti Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye!, Student Of The Year dan Fukrey. Ia memenangkan Filmfare Critics Award untuk Aktor Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye!.

name: Manoj Bajpayee
title: Manoj Bajpayee
extract: Manoj Bajpayee, also transliterated as Manoj Bajpai, is an Indian actor who predominantly works in Hindi cinema. He has appeared in over 70 films. A prolific actor of Indian cinema, he is the recipient of numerous accolades including four National Film Awards, four Filmfare Awards, and two Asia Pacific Screen Awards, making him one of the finest actors in Indian cinema. 2019, he was awarded the Padma Shri by the Government of India.
extract_id: Manoj Bajpayee, yang juga ditransliterasikan sebagai Manoj Bajpai, adalah aktor India yang sebagian besar bekerja di sinema Hindi. Ia telah tampil dalam lebih dari 70 film. Sebagai aktor produktif di sinema India, ia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk empat Penghargaan Film Nasional, empat Filmfare Awards, dan dua Asia Pacific Screen Awards, menjadikannya salah satu aktor terbaik dalam sinema India. Pada 2019, ia dianugerahi Padma Shri oleh Pemerintah India.

name: Marc Caro
title: Marc Caro
extract: Marc Caro is a French filmmaker and comics artist, best known for his projects with Jean-Pierre Jeunet.
extract_id: Marc Caro adalah seorang pembuat film dan seniman komik asal Prancis, yang paling dikenal dengan proyek-proyeknya bersama Jean-Pierre Jeunet.

name: Marc Forster
title: Marc Forster
extract: Marc Forster is a German-Swiss filmmaker. He is best known for directing the feature films Monster's Ball, Finding Neverland, Stranger than Fiction, Quantum of Solace, World War Z, and Christopher Robin, and has additionally directed numerous television commercials. He is a BAFTA, Golden Globe, and Independent Spirit Award nominee.
extract_id: Marc Forster adalah pembuat film Jerman-Swiss. Dia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai film fitur Monster's Ball, Finding Neverland, Stranger than Fiction, Quantum of Solace, World War Z, dan Christopher Robin, serta telah menyutradarai berbagai iklan televisi. Dia adalah nominator BAFTA, Golden Globe, dan Independent Spirit Award.

name: Marc Webb
title: Marc Webb
extract: Marc Preston Webb is an American filmmaker and music video director. He made his feature film directorial debut in 2009 with the romantic comedy 500 Days of Summer. He then directed The Amazing Spider-Man (2012) and The Amazing Spider-Man 2 (2014), which later were dubbed the "Webb-Verse" by Marvel Studios in 2021. He also directed the 2017 dramas Gifted and The Only Living Boy in New York and the Disney live-action remake of Snow White (2025). His next planned film is Day Drinker (2027).
extract_id: Marc Preston Webb adalah pembuat film dan sutradara video musik asal Amerika. Dia membuat debut penyutradaraan film fitur pada tahun 2009 dengan komedi romantis 500 Days of Summer. Dia kemudian menyutradarai The Amazing Spider-Man (2012) dan The Amazing Spider-Man 2 (2014), yang kemudian disebut sebagai "Webb-Verse" oleh Marvel Studios pada 2021. Dia juga menyutradarai drama tahun 2017 Gifted dan The Only Living Boy in New York serta remake live-action Disney Snow White (2025). Film berikutnya yang direncanakan adalah Day Drinker (2027).

name: Marc-André Grondin
title: Marc-André Grondin
extract: Marc-André Grondin is a Canadian actor, known for his role as Xavier Laflamme in the 2011 ice hockey film Goon. He also played Zachary Beaulieu in Jean-Marc Vallée's film C.R.A.Z.Y. (2005), for which he won a Jutra Award for best actor.
extract_id: Marc-André Grondin adalah aktor asal Kanada, dikenal karena perannya sebagai Xavier Laflamme dalam film hoki es tahun 2011 berjudul Goon. Dia juga memainkan Zachary Beaulieu dalam film Jean-Marc Vallée C.R.A.Z.Y. (2005), yang membuatnya meraih Jutra Award untuk aktor terbaik.

name: Marcel Dalio
title: Marcel Dalio
extract: Marcel Dalio, sometimes credited mononymously as Dalio, was a French actor. He began his career in the 1930s as a leading man, notably starring in Jean Renoir's La Grande Illusion (1937) and The Rules of the Game (1939), before becoming known as in-demand character actor. His film career spanned nearly 200 productions released between 1931 and 1982, both in France and the United States.
extract_id: Marcel Dalio, kadang dikreditkan secara mononim sebagai Dalio, adalah aktor Prancis. Dia memulai karirnya pada 1930-an sebagai pemeran utama, terutama membintangi film Jean Renoir La Grande Illusion (1937) dan The Rules of the Game (1939), sebelum dikenal sebagai aktor karakter yang banyak dicari. Karir filmnya mencakup hampir 200 produksi antara 1931 dan 1982, baik di Prancis maupun Amerika Serikat.

name: Marcello Mastroianni
title: Marcello Mastroianni
extract: Marcello Vincenzo Domenico Mastroianni was an Italian actor. He is generally regarded as one of Italy's most iconic male performers of the 20th century. He played leading roles for many of the country's top directors, in a career spanning 147 films between 1939 and 1996, garnering many international honours including two BAFTA Awards, two Cannes Film Festival Awards for Best Actor, two Volpi Cups, two Golden Globes, and three Academy Award nominations.
extract_id: Marcello Vincenzo Domenico Mastroianni adalah aktor Italia. Dia secara umum dianggap sebagai salah satu pemeran pria paling ikonik di Italia pada abad ke-20. Dia memerankan peran utama untuk banyak sutradara top negara tersebut, dalam karir yang mencakup 147 film antara 1939 dan 1996, meraih banyak penghargaan internasional termasuk dua BAFTA Awards, dua Cannes Film Festival Awards untuk Aktor Terbaik, dua Volpi Cups, dua Golden Globes, dan tiga nominasi Academy Award.

name: Marcia Gay Harden
title: Marcia Gay Harden
extract: Marcia Gay Harden is an American actress. Her breakthrough came in 1990 with the Coen brothers' film Miller's Crossing. She received nominations for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for Pollock (2000) and Mystic River (2003), winning for her portrayal of artist Lee Krasner in the former. Her other notable film credits include The First Wives Club (1996), Flubber (1997), Space Cowboys (2000), Mona Lisa Smile (2003), The Mist (2007), and the Fifty Shades film series (2015–2018).
extract_id: Marcia Gay Harden adalah aktris Amerika. Terobosan karirnya terjadi pada tahun 1990 dengan film Miller's Crossing karya Coen bersaudara. Dia menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik untuk Pollock (2000) dan Mystic River (2003), memenangkan penghargaan untuk perannya sebagai seniman Lee Krasner dalam film yang pertama. Kredit film penting lainnya termasuk The First Wives Club (1996), Flubber (1997), Space Cowboys (2000), Mona Lisa Smile (2003), The Mist (2007), dan seri film Fifty Shades (2015–2018).

name: Marco Giallini
title: Marco Giallini
extract: Marco Giallini is an Italian actor.
extract_id: Marco Giallini adalah aktor Italia.

name: Mare Winningham
title: Mare Winningham
extract: Mary Megan "Mare" Winningham is an American actress and singer-songwriter. Her accolades include two Primetime Emmy Awards, alongside nominations for an Academy Award, two Golden Globe Awards, and two Tony Awards.
extract_id: Mary Megan "Mare" Winningham adalah aktris dan penyanyi-penulis lagu Amerika. Penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk dua Primetime Emmy Awards, bersama dengan nominasi Academy Award, dua Golden Globe Awards, dan dua Tony Awards.

name: Margaret Avery
title: Margaret Avery
extract: Margaret Avery is an American actress. She began her career appearing on stage and later had starring roles in films including Cool Breeze (1972), Which Way Is Up? (1977), Scott Joplin (1977) which earned her an NAACP Image Award nomination, and The Fish That Saved Pittsburgh (1979). She was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her portrayal of Shug Avery in the period drama film The Color Purple (1985).
extract_id: Margaret Avery adalah aktris Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya dengan tampil di panggung dan kemudian memegang peran utama dalam film-film termasuk Cool Breeze (1972), Which Way Is Up? (1977), Scott Joplin (1977) yang membawanya mendapat nominasi NAACP Image Award, dan The Fish That Saved Pittsburgh (1979). Dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik atas perannya sebagai Shug Avery dalam film drama periode The Color Purple (1985).

name: Margaret Livingston
title: Margaret Livingston
extract: Margaret Livingston, sometimes credited as Marguerite Livingstone or Margaret Livingstone, was an American film actress and businesswoman during the silent film era. She is remembered today as "the Woman from the City" in F. W. Murnau's 1927 film Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans.
extract_id: Margaret Livingston, kadang dikreditkan sebagai Marguerite Livingstone atau Margaret Livingstone, adalah aktris film dan pengusaha Amerika pada era film bisu. Dia diingat saat ini sebagai "the Woman from the City" dalam film F. W. Murnau tahun 1927 Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans.

name: Margaret Lockwood
title: Margaret Lockwood
extract: Margaret Mary Day Lockwood was a British actress. One of Britain's most popular film stars of the 1930s and 1940s, her film appearances included The Lady Vanishes (1938), Night Train to Munich (1940), The Man in Grey (1943), and The Wicked Lady (1945). She was nominated for the BAFTA Award for Best British Actress for the 1955 film Cast a Dark Shadow. She also starred in the television series Justice (1971–1974). Ronald Bergan of The Guardian called her "one of the most beautiful, energetic, and spirited actresses in the history of British cinema."
extract_id: Margaret Mary Day Lockwood adalah aktris Inggris. Salah satu bintang film paling populer di Inggris pada 1930-an dan 1940-an, penampilannya dalam film mencakup The Lady Vanishes (1938), Night Train to Munich (1940), The Man in Grey (1943), dan The Wicked Lady (1945). Dia dinominasikan untuk BAFTA Award untuk Aktris Inggris Terbaik untuk film tahun 1955 Cast a Dark Shadow. Dia juga membintangi serial televisi Justice (1971–1974). Ronald Bergan dari The Guardian menyebutnya "salah satu aktris tercantik, paling energik, dan bersemangat dalam sejarah sinema Inggris."

name: Margaret Sullavan
title: Margaret Sullavan
extract: Margaret Brooke Sullavan was an American stage and film actress. She began her career onstage in 1929 with the University Players on Cape Cod, Massachusetts. In 1933, she caught the attention of film director John M. Stahl and made her screen debut that same year in Only Yesterday. She continued to be successful on stage and film, best known for The Shop Around the Corner.
extract_id: Margaret Brooke Sullavan adalah aktris panggung dan film Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya di panggung pada 1929 dengan University Players di Cape Cod, Massachusetts. Pada tahun 1933, dia menarik perhatian sutradara film John M. Stahl dan melakukan debut layar lebar pada tahun yang sama dalam Only Yesterday. Dia terus sukses di panggung dan film, paling dikenal untuk The Shop Around the Corner.

name: Margaret Wycherly
title: Margaret Wycherly
extract: Margaret De Wolfe Wycherly was an English actress. A prolific stage and screen performer, she spent many years in the United States and is best remembered for her Broadway roles and Hollywood character parts. On screen she played mother to Gary Cooper and James Cagney. She was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her role in Sergeant York (1941) but lost to Mary Astor for The Great Lie (1941).
extract_id: Margaret De Wolfe Wycherly adalah aktris Inggris. Seorang pemeran panggung dan layar yang produktif, dia menghabiskan bertahun-tahun di Amerika Serikat dan paling diingat untuk peran-peran Broadwaynya serta bagian karakter di Hollywood. Di layar, dia memainkan peran ibu bagi Gary Cooper dan James Cagney. Dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik atas perannya dalam Sergeant York (1941) tetapi kalah dari Mary Astor untuk The Great Lie (1941).

name: Margaretha Krook
title: Margaretha Krook
extract: Margaretha Knutsdotter Krook was a Swedish stage and film actress. She won the Eugene O'Neill Award in 1974. In 1976, she won the Guldbagge Award for Best Actress for the film Release the Prisoners to Spring. She was awarded the Illis quorum in 1995 for her performance of Gertrude Stein at the Royal Dramatic Theatre.
extract_id: Margaretha Knutsdotter Krook adalah aktris panggung dan film Swedia. Dia memenangkan Eugene O'Neill Award pada 1974. Pada 1976, dia memenangkan Guldbagge Award untuk Aktris Terbaik atas film Release the Prisoners to Spring. Dia dianugerahi Illis quorum pada 1995 atas penampilannya sebagai Gertrude Stein di Royal Dramatic Theatre.

name: Margarita Terekhova
title: Margarita Terekhova
extract: Margarita Borisovna Terekhova is a Soviet and Russian film and theatre actress. She was awarded the title People's Artist of Russia in 1996.
extract_id: Margarita Borisovna Terekhova adalah aktris film dan teater Soviet dan Rusia. Dia dianugerahi gelar People's Artist of Russia pada 1996.

name: Margot Robbie
title: Margot Robbie
extract: Margot Elise Ackerley is an Australian actress and film producer. The world's highest-paid actress in 2023, she is known for her performances in both blockbuster and independent films. Robbie's accolades include seven AACTA Awards and three Critics' Choice Awards in addition to nominations for three Academy Awards, six British Academy Film Awards and four Golden Globes.
extract_id: Margot Elise Ackerley adalah aktris dan produser film Australia. Sebagai aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia pada 2023, dia dikenal atas penampilannya dalam film blockbuster dan film independen. Robbie meraih tujuh AACTA Awards dan tiga Critics' Choice Awards selain nominasi untuk tiga Academy Awards, enam British Academy Film Awards, dan empat Golden Globes.

name: Maria Doyle Kennedy
title: Maria Doyle Kennedy
extract: Maria Josephine Doyle Kennedy is an Irish singer and actress. With a singing and acting career that has spanned more than 30 years, she has established herself as one of Ireland's most prolific artists and entertainers. As an actress, she is best known for her extensive television roles as Patsy in Father Ted (1998), Catherine of Aragon in The Tudors (2007–2010), Vera Bates in Downton Abbey (2011), Siobhán Sadler in Orphan Black (2013–2017), and Jocasta Cameron in Outlander (2018–2022). More recently in 2022, she starred as the Scottish journalist Tannie Maria in the series Recipes for Love and Murder, set in the Karoo in South Africa and adapted for the screen from the book of the same name by Sally Andrew.
extract_id: Maria Josephine Doyle Kennedy adalah penyanyi dan aktris Irlandia. Dengan karier bernyanyi dan berakting yang telah berlangsung lebih dari 30 tahun, dia telah menempatkan dirinya sebagai salah satu seniman dan penghibur paling produktif di Irlandia. Sebagai seorang aktris, dia paling dikenal untuk peran televisinya yang luas sebagai Patsy dalam Father Ted (1998), Catherine of Aragon dalam The Tudors (2007–2010), Vera Bates dalam Downton Abbey (2011), Siobhán Sadler dalam Orphan Black (2013–2017), dan Jocasta Cameron dalam Outlander (2018–2022). Baru-baru ini pada 2022, dia membintangi sebagai jurnalis Skotlandia Tannie Maria dalam seri Recipes for Love and Murder, yang berlatar di Karoo di Afrika Selatan dan diadaptasi untuk layar dari buku dengan judul yang sama karya Sally Andrew.

name: Maria Falconetti
title: Renée Jeanne Falconetti
extract: Renée Jeanne Falconetti, sometimes credited as Maria Falconetti, Marie Falconetti, Renée Maria Falconetti, or simply Falconetti, was a French stage and film actress, notable for her acclaimed role as Joan of Arc in Carl Theodor Dreyer's 1928 silent The Passion of Joan of Arc and subsequent mysterious and enigmatic death. There is little recorded information about her life and career on the internet, and much of the existing information about her life is contradictory.
extract_id: Renée Jeanne Falconetti, kadang dikreditkan sebagai Maria Falconetti, Marie Falconetti, Renée Maria Falconetti, atau hanya Falconetti, adalah aktris panggung dan film Prancis, terkenal atas perannya yang diakui sebagai Joan of Arc dalam film bisu tahun 1928 The Passion of Joan of Arc karya Carl Theodor Dreyer dan kematiannya yang misterius dan penuh teka-teki. Ada sedikit informasi yang tercatat tentang hidup dan kariernya di internet, dan banyak informasi yang ada tentang hidupnya saling bertentangan.

name: Maria Grazia Cucinotta
title: Maria Grazia Cucinotta
extract: Maria Grazia Cucinotta is an Italian actress who has featured in films and television series since 1990. Internationally she is best known for her roles in Il Postino and The World Is Not Enough.
extract_id: Maria Grazia Cucinotta adalah aktris Italia yang telah tampil dalam film dan serial televisi sejak 1990. Secara internasional, dia paling dikenal karena perannya dalam Il Postino dan The World Is Not Enough.

name: Maria Monti
title: Maria Monti
extract: Maria Monti is an Italian film actress and singer.
extract_id: Maria Monti adalah aktris film dan penyanyi Italia.

name: Marianne Koch
title: Marianne Koch
extract: Marianne Koch is a German retired actress, best known for her appearances in Spaghetti Westerns and adventure films of the 1960s. She later worked as a television host and as a physician.
extract_id: Marianne Koch adalah aktris Jerman yang telah pensiun, paling dikenal untuk penampilannya dalam Spaghetti Western dan film petualangan tahun 1960-an. Dia kemudian bekerja sebagai pembawa acara televisi dan sebagai dokter.

name: Maribel Verdú
title: Maribel Verdú
extract: María Isabel Verdú Rollán, better known as Maribel Verdú, is a Spanish actress. She is the recipient of numerous accolades throughout her career spanning nearly four decades, including two Goya Awards for Best Actress, an Ariel Award for Best Actress, the Gold Medal of the Academy of Cinematographic Arts and Sciences of Spain in 2008 and the National Cinematography Award in 2009.
extract_id: María Isabel Verdú Rollán, lebih dikenal sebagai Maribel Verdú, adalah aktris Spanyol. Dia menerima banyak penghargaan sepanjang kariernya yang hampir empat dekade, termasuk dua Goya Awards untuk Aktris Terbaik, Ariel Award untuk Aktris Terbaik, Medali Emas dari Akademi Seni dan Ilmu Sinematografi Spanyol pada 2008, dan Penghargaan Sinematografi Nasional pada 2009.

name: Marie-Josée Croze
title: Marie-Josée Croze
extract: Marie-Josée Croze is a Canadian actress. She also holds French nationality, which she obtained in December 2012.
extract_id: Marie-Josée Croze adalah aktris Kanada. Dia juga memiliki kewarganegaraan Prancis, yang diperolehnya pada Desember 2012.

name: Marie-Laure Dougnac
title: Marie-Laure Dougnac
extract: Marie-Laure Dougnac is a French actress specializing in the dubbing of English films and TV shows into French.
extract_id: Marie-Laure Dougnac adalah aktris Prancis yang mengkhususkan diri dalam pengalihan suara film dan acara televisi berbahasa Inggris ke bahasa Prancis.

name: Mariel Hemingway
title: Mariel Hemingway
extract: Mariel Hemingway is an American actress, author, and mental health activist. She made her film debut at age 14 with a Golden Globe Award-nominated part in Lipstick (1976). For her performance in Woody Allen's Manhattan (1979), Hemingway received a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: Mariel Hemingway adalah seorang aktris, penulis, dan aktivis kesehatan mental asal Amerika. Dia memulai debut filmnya pada usia 14 tahun dengan peran yang dinominasikan Golden Globe dalam Lipstick (1976). Untuk penampilannya dalam film Woody Allen, Manhattan (1979), Hemingway menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Marilyn Eastman
title: Marilyn Eastman
extract: Marilyn Eastman was an American actress.
extract_id: Marilyn Eastman adalah seorang aktris asal Amerika.

name: Marilyn Ghigliotti
title: Marilyn Ghigliotti
extract: Marilyn Ghigliotti is an American actress, producer, director, and make-up artist best known for playing Veronica Loughran in Clerks.
extract_id: Marilyn Ghigliotti adalah seorang aktris, produser, sutradara, dan artis make-up asal Amerika yang paling dikenal karena memerankan Veronica Loughran dalam Clerks.

name: Marilyn Monroe
title: Marilyn Monroe
extract: Marilyn Monroe was an American actress and model. Known for playing comic "Blonde bombshell" characters, she became one of the most popular sex symbols of the 1950s and early 1960s, as well as an emblem of the era's sexual revolution. She was a top-billed actress for a decade, and her films grossed $200 million by her death in 1962.
extract_id: Marilyn Monroe adalah seorang aktris dan model asal Amerika. Dikenal karena memerankan karakter komik "Blonde bombshell," ia menjadi salah satu simbol seks paling populer pada 1950-an dan awal 1960-an, sekaligus menjadi lambang revolusi seksual era tersebut. Ia menjadi aktris utama selama satu dekade, dan film-filmnya menghasilkan $200 juta pada saat kematiannya tahun 1962.

name: Marina de Tavira
title: Marina de Tavira
extract: Marina de Tavira Servitje is a Mexican actress. She is internationally known for her role in the film Roma (2018), for which she received widespread acclaim and a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: Marina de Tavira Servitje adalah seorang aktris Meksiko. Ia dikenal secara internasional untuk perannya dalam film Roma (2018), yang memberinya pujian luas dan nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Mario Casas
title: Mario Casas
extract: Mario Casas Sierra is a Spanish film and television actor. Known for his roles in Spanish cinema and television, he has received various accolades including a Goya Award, two Gaudí Awards, and three Feroz Awards.
extract_id: Mario Casas Sierra adalah seorang aktor film dan televisi Spanyol. Dikenal karena perannya di sinema dan televisi Spanyol, ia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Goya Award, dua Gaudí Awards, dan tiga Feroz Awards.

name: Marion Cotillard
title: Marion Cotillard
extract: Marion Cotillard is a French actress who has appeared in both mainstream and independent European and Hollywood productions. She is the recipient of various accolades, including an Academy Award, a British Academy Film Award, two César Awards, and a Golden Globe Award. She became a Knight of the Order of Arts and Letters in France in 2010 and was promoted to Officer in 2016, the same year she was named a Knight of the Legion of Honour.
extract_id: Marion Cotillard adalah seorang aktris Prancis yang telah tampil dalam produksi utama dan independen Eropa serta Hollywood. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, British Academy Film Award, dua César Awards, dan Golden Globe Award. Ia diangkat menjadi Knight of the Order of Arts and Letters di Prancis pada 2010 dan dipromosikan menjadi Officer pada 2016, tahun yang sama saat ia dinobatkan sebagai Knight of the Legion of Honour.

name: Marion Mack
title: Marion Mack
extract: Joey Marion McCreery Lewyn, known professionally as Marion Mack, was an American film actress and screenwriter. Mack is best known for co-starring with Buster Keaton in the 1926 silent comedy film The General. After retiring from acting in 1928, she wrote several short screenplays and took up a career in real estate.
extract_id: Joey Marion McCreery Lewyn, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Marion Mack, adalah seorang aktris dan penulis skenario film Amerika. Mack paling dikenal karena berperan bersama Buster Keaton dalam film komedi bisu The General tahun 1926. Setelah pensiun dari akting pada 1928, ia menulis beberapa skenario pendek dan menekuni karier di bidang real estate.

name: Marisa Berenson
title: Marisa Berenson
extract: Vittoria Marisa Schiaparelli Berenson is an American model and actress. A granddaughter of designer Elsa Schiaparelli, she rose to international prominence in the late 1960s and 1970s. Berenson was a model, appearing on the covers of Vogue and Harper's Bazaar. Known as the "Queen of the Scene," she became a style icon known for her eclectic and bohemian-chic aesthetic.
extract_id: Vittoria Marisa Schiaparelli Berenson adalah seorang model dan aktris Amerika. Cucu dari desainer Elsa Schiaparelli, ia meraih ketenaran internasional pada akhir 1960-an dan 1970-an. Berenson adalah seorang model yang muncul di sampul majalah Vogue dan Harper's Bazaar. Dikenal sebagai "Queen of the Scene," ia menjadi ikon gaya dengan estetika eklektik dan bohemian-chic.

name: Marisa Paredes
title: Marisa Paredes
extract: María Luisa Paredes Bartolomé, known professionally as Marisa Paredes, was a Spanish actress with a 60-year-long career. She acted in more than 75 films, 80 TV shows, and 15 plays.
extract_id: María Luisa Paredes Bartolomé, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Marisa Paredes, adalah seorang aktris Spanyol dengan karier selama 60 tahun. Ia berakting dalam lebih dari 75 film, 80 acara TV, dan 15 drama panggung.

name: Marisa Tomei
title: Marisa Tomei
extract: Marisa Tomei is an American actress. She gained prominence for her comedic performance in My Cousin Vinny (1992), which earned her the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress. She received further nominations in the category for In the Bedroom (2001) and The Wrestler (2008).
extract_id: Marisa Tomei adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Ia mendapatkan ketenaran lewat penampilan komedinya dalam My Cousin Vinny (1992), yang memberinya Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik. Ia menerima nominasi lebih lanjut di kategori yang sama untuk In the Bedroom (2001) dan The Wrestler (2008).

name: Marius Goring
title: Marius Goring
extract: Marius Re Goring was an English stage and screen actor.
