He often portrayed urbane and morally grey characters, and is best remembered for the four films he made with Powell & Pressburger, particularly as Conductor 71 in A Matter of Life and Death and as Julian Craster in The Red Shoes. He is also known for playing the titular role in the long-running TV drama series, The Expert.
extract_id: Marius Re Goring adalah aktor panggung dan layar asal Inggris. Ia sering memerankan karakter urbane dan moral abu-abu, dan paling diingat melalui empat film yang dibuat bersama Powell & Pressburger, khususnya sebagai Conductor 71 dalam A Matter of Life and Death dan Julian Craster dalam The Red Shoes. Ia juga dikenal karena memerankan peran utama dalam serial drama TV jangka panjang, The Expert.

name: Marjane Satrapi
title: Marjane Satrapi
description: French and Iranian author and director (1969–2026)
extract: Marjane Satrapi was an Iranian-French comic book author, film director, and children's book author. Her best-known works include the graphic novel Persepolis and its film adaptation; the graphic novel Chicken with Plums; Woman, Life, Freedom; and the Marie Curie biopic Radioactive.
extract_id: Marjane Satrapi adalah penulis buku komik, sutradara film, dan penulis buku anak-anak asal Iran-Prancis. Karya-karyanya yang paling dikenal termasuk novel grafis Persepolis dan adaptasi filmnya; novel grafis Chicken with Plums; Woman, Life, Freedom; dan biopik Marie Curie, Radioactive.

name: Mark Boone Junior
title: Mark Boone Junior
extract: Mark Boone Junior is an American character actor, best known for his television roles as Bobby Munson in Sons of Anarchy (2008–2014) and Patrick "Pat" Brown in The Last Man on Earth (2016–2017), as well as his film roles in Die Hard 2 (1990), Memento (2000), 2 Fast 2 Furious (2003) and Batman Begins (2005).
extract_id: Mark Boone Junior adalah aktor karakter Amerika, yang paling dikenal melalui perannya di televisi sebagai Bobby Munson dalam Sons of Anarchy (2008–2014) dan Patrick "Pat" Brown dalam The Last Man on Earth (2016–2017), serta perannya dalam film Die Hard 2 (1990), Memento (2000), 2 Fast 2 Furious (2003) dan Batman Begins (2005).

name: Mark Hamill
title: Mark Hamill
extract: Mark Richard Hamill is an American actor. He rose to fame as Luke Skywalker in the original Star Wars trilogy (1977–1983), leading to further lead parts in films like Corvette Summer (1978) and Samuel Fuller's The Big Red One (1980).
extract_id: Mark Richard Hamill adalah aktor Amerika. Ia menjadi terkenal sebagai Luke Skywalker dalam trilogi asli Star Wars (1977–1983), yang membuka jalan untuk peran utama lebih lanjut dalam film seperti Corvette Summer (1978) dan The Big Red One karya Samuel Fuller (1980).

name: Mark Herman
title: Mark Herman
extract: Mark Herman is a British film director and screenwriter, best known for writing and directing the 1996 film Brassed Off and the 2008 film The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas. Film critic Paul Wells offers this assessment of Herman's work in the 2019 book Directors in British and Irish Cinema: "Herman has attracted little critical attention but his preoccupation with the underdog and personal and social injustice makes him a pertinent commentator on the decline of the English working class and its strategies for survival."
extract_id: Mark Herman adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film Inggris, yang paling dikenal karena menulis dan menyutradarai film Brassed Off tahun 1996 dan film The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas tahun 2008. Kritikus film Paul Wells memberikan penilaian tentang karya Herman dalam buku Directors in British and Irish Cinema (2019): "Herman menarik sedikit perhatian kritis tetapi obsesi-nya pada pihak yang tertindas serta ketidakadilan personal dan sosial menjadikannya komentator yang relevan mengenai kemunduran kelas pekerja Inggris dan strategi mereka untuk bertahan."

name: Mark Margolis
title: Mark Margolis
extract: Mark Margolis was an American actor best known for his portrayal of the character Héctor Salamanca in Breaking Bad (2009–2011) and Better Call Saul (2016–2022). His performance in Breaking Bad was nominated for an Emmy Award in 2012.
extract_id: Mark Margolis adalah aktor Amerika yang paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Héctor Salamanca dalam Breaking Bad (2009–2011) dan Better Call Saul (2016–2022). Penampilannya dalam Breaking Bad dinominasikan untuk Emmy Award pada 2012.

name: Mark Osborne
title: Mark Osborne (filmmaker)
extract: Mark Randolph Osborne is an American film director, producer, screenwriter, and animator. He is best known for directing the animated films Kung Fu Panda (2008) and The Little Prince (2015), the former of which was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature. He also directed the stop-motion short film More (1998), which was nominated for Academy Award for Best Animated Short Film.
extract_id: Mark Randolph Osborne adalah sutradara film, produser, penulis skenario, dan animator Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai film animasi Kung Fu Panda (2008) dan The Little Prince (2015), yang pertama dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Fitur Animasi Terbaik. Ia juga menyutradarai film pendek stop-motion More (1998), yang dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Film Animasi Pendek Terbaik.

name: Mark Ruffalo
title: Mark Ruffalo
extract: Mark Alan Ruffalo is an American actor and producer who began his career in the late 1980s and first gained recognition for his work in Kenneth Lonergan's play This Is Our Youth (1996) and drama film You Can Count on Me (2000). He went on to star in the romantic comedies 13 Going on 30 (2004) and Just like Heaven (2005), and the thrillers In the Cut (2003), Zodiac (2007), and Shutter Island (2010). He received a Tony Award nomination for his supporting role in the Broadway revival of Awake and Sing! in 2006. Ruffalo has gained international recognition for playing Bruce Banner / Hulk in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, beginning with the film The Avengers (2012).
extract_id: Mark Alan Ruffalo adalah aktor dan produser Amerika yang memulai kariernya pada akhir 1980-an dan pertama kali dikenal melalui karyanya dalam drama panggung karya Kenneth Lonergan, This Is Our Youth (1996) dan film drama You Can Count on Me (2000). Ia lalu membintangi komedi romantis 13 Going on 30 (2004) dan Just like Heaven (2005), serta thriller In the Cut (2003), Zodiac (2007), dan Shutter Island (2010). Ia menerima nominasi Tony Award untuk peran pendukung dalam kebangkitan Broadway Awake and Sing! pada 2006. Ruffalo meraih pengakuan internasional berkat perannya sebagai Bruce Banner / Hulk dalam Marvel Cinematic Universe, dimulai dengan film The Avengers (2012).

name: Mark Rydell
title: Mark Rydell
extract: Mortimer H. "Mark" Rydell was an American film director, producer and actor. He directed several Academy Award-nominated films including The Fox (1967), The Reivers (1969), Cinderella Liberty (1973), The Rose (1979), and The River (1984). He was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Director for On Golden Pond (1981).
extract_id: Mortimer H. "Mark" Rydell adalah sutradara, produser, dan aktor film Amerika. Ia menyutradarai beberapa film yang dinominasikan Academy Award termasuk The Fox (1967), The Reivers (1969), Cinderella Liberty (1973), The Rose (1979), dan The River (1984). Ia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award sebagai Sutradara Terbaik untuk On Golden Pond (1981).

name: Mark Rylance
title: Mark Rylance
description: English actor, playwright and theatre director (born 1960)
extract: Sir David Mark Rylance Waters is an English actor, playwright and theatre director. Known for his work on stage and screen, he has received numerous awards including an Academy Award, three BAFTAs, two Olivier Awards and three Tony Awards. In 2016 he was included in the Time 100 list of the world's most influential people. In 2017 he was made a knight by Queen Elizabeth II.
extract_id: Sir David Mark Rylance Waters adalah aktor, dramawan, dan sutradara teater Inggris. Dikenal atas karyanya di panggung dan layar, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Academy Award, tiga BAFTA, dua Olivier Awards, dan tiga Tony Awards. Pada 2016 ia masuk dalam daftar Time 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia. Pada 2017 ia diangkat menjadi knight oleh Ratu Elizabeth II.

name: Mark Strong
title: Mark Strong
extract: Mark Strong is an English actor. Strong is known for his starring roles on stage as well as for his villainous roles in historical dramas and franchise films. He has received accolades including a Laurence Olivier Award and a BAFTA TV Award as well as nominations for two Tony Awards, a Drama Desk Award and an Actor Award.
extract_id: Mark Strong adalah aktor Inggris. Strong dikenal karena peran utama di panggung serta peran antagonisnya dalam drama bersejarah dan film waralaba. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Laurence Olivier Award dan BAFTA TV Award serta nominasi untuk dua Tony Awards, Drama Desk Award, dan Actor Award.

name: Mark Wahlberg
title: Mark Wahlberg
extract: Mark Robert Michael Wahlberg, formerly known by his stage name Marky Mark, is an American actor, producer, and former rapper. His work as a leading man spans the comedy, drama, and action genres. He has received multiple accolades, including a BAFTA TV Award and a Sports Emmy Award, and nominations for two Academy Awards, three Golden Globes, and nine Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Mark Robert Michael Wahlberg, sebelumnya dikenal dengan nama panggung Marky Mark, adalah aktor, produser, dan mantan rapper asal Amerika. Karya utamanya sebagai pemeran utama mencakup genre komedi, drama, dan aksi. Ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk BAFTA TV Award dan Sports Emmy Award, serta nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards, tiga Golden Globes, dan sembilan Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Markéta Irglová
title: Markéta Irglová
description: Czech and Icelandic musician and actress (born 1988)
extract: Markéta Irglová is a Czech and Icelandic singer-songwriter, musician, and actress. She starred in the 2007 film Once, which earned her a number of major awards, including the Academy Award for Best Original Song for "Falling Slowly", with co-writer and co-star Glen Hansard. In 2005, she and Hansard formed the duo the Swell Season, which released three studio albums. She has also published four solo records.
extract_id: Markéta Irglová adalah penyanyi-penulis lagu, musisi, dan aktris asal Ceko dan Islandia. Ia membintangi film Once tahun 2007, yang memberinya sejumlah penghargaan utama, termasuk Academy Award untuk Lagu Orisinal Terbaik untuk "Falling Slowly," bersama penulis lagu dan rekan pemeran Glen Hansard. Pada 2005, ia dan Hansard membentuk duo the Swell Season, yang merilis tiga album studio. Ia juga telah menerbitkan empat rekaman solo.

name: Marlene Dietrich
title: Marlene Dietrich
extract: Marie Magdalene "Marlene" Dietrich was a German and American actress and singer whose career spanned nearly seven decades. In 1920s Berlin, she performed on the stage and in silent films. Her performance as Lola Lola in Josef von Sternberg's The Blue Angel (1930) brought her international acclaim and a contract with Paramount Pictures. Dietrich starred in many Hollywood films, including six roles directed by Sternberg: Morocco (1930), Dishonored (1931), Shanghai Express and Blonde Venus, The Scarlet Empress (1934), and The Devil Is a Woman (1935). Throughout World War II, she was a high-profile entertainer in the United States. Although she delivered notable performances in several post-war films, including Billy Wilder's A Foreign Affair (1948), Alfred Hitchcock's Stage Fright (1950), Billy Wilder's Witness for the Prosecution (1957), Orson Welles's Touch of Evil (1958), and Stanley Kramer's Judgment at Nuremberg (1961), she spent most of the 1950s to the 1970s touring the world as a marquee live-show performer.
extract_id: Marie Magdalene "Marlene" Dietrich adalah aktris dan penyanyi Jerman-Amerika yang kariernya berlangsung hampir tujuh dekade. Pada 1920-an di Berlin, ia tampil di panggung dan film bisu. Penampilannya sebagai Lola Lola dalam film Josef von Sternberg The Blue Angel (1930) membawanya ketenaran internasional dan kontrak dengan Paramount Pictures. Dietrich membintangi banyak film Hollywood, termasuk enam peran yang disutradarai Sternberg: Morocco (1930), Dishonored (1931), Shanghai Express dan Blonde Venus, The Scarlet Empress (1934), dan The Devil Is a Woman (1935). Selama Perang Dunia II, ia menjadi penghibur papan atas di Amerika Serikat. Meskipun memberikan penampilan mencolok dalam beberapa film pascaperang, termasuk A Foreign Affair (1948) karya Billy Wilder, Stage Fright (1950) karya Alfred Hitchcock, Witness for the Prosecution (1957) karya Billy Wilder, Touch of Evil (1958) karya Orson Welles, dan Judgment at Nuremberg (1961) karya Stanley Kramer, ia menghabiskan sebagian besar 1950-an hingga 1970-an berkeliling dunia sebagai penyanyi dan penampil live papan atas.

name: Marlon Brando
title: Marlon Brando
extract: Marlon Brando was an American actor. Widely regarded as one of the greatest and most influential performers in the history of cinema, he received numerous accolades, including two Academy Awards, two Golden Globe Awards, three BAFTAs, a Cannes Film Festival Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award. Brando is credited with being one of the first actors to bring the Stanislavski system of acting and method acting to mainstream audiences.
extract_id: Marlon Brando adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu pemeran terhebat dan paling berpengaruh dalam sejarah perfilman, ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards, dua Golden Globe Awards, tiga BAFTA, sebuah Penghargaan Festival Film Cannes, dan sebuah Primetime Emmy Award. Brando diakui sebagai salah satu aktor pertama yang membawa sistem akting Stanislavski dan metode akting ke khalayak luas.

name: Marlon Wayans
title: Marlon Wayans
extract: Marlon Lamont Wayans is an American actor, comedian, writer, and producer. He is best known for his work with his brother Shawn Wayans on The WB sitcom The Wayans Bros. (1995–1999) and the comedy films Don't Be a Menace (1996), Scary Movie (2000), Scary Movie 2 (2001), White Chicks (2004), Little Man (2006), Dance Flick (2009), and Scary Movie (2026).
extract_id: Marlon Lamont Wayans adalah seorang aktor, komedian, penulis, dan produser Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena karyanya bersama saudaranya Shawn Wayans dalam sitkom The WB The Wayans Bros. (1995–1999) dan film komedi Don't Be a Menace (1996), Scary Movie (2000), Scary Movie 2 (2001), White Chicks (2004), Little Man (2006), Dance Flick (2009), dan Scary Movie (2026).

name: Martha Vickers
title: Martha Vickers
extract: Martha Vickers was an American model and actress.
extract_id: Martha Vickers adalah seorang model dan aktris Amerika.

name: Martin Balsam
title: Martin Balsam
extract: Martin Henry Balsam was an American actor. He had a prolific career in character roles in film, theatre, and television. An early member of the Actors Studio, he began his career on the New York stage, winning a Tony Award for Best Actor in a Play for Robert Anderson's You Know I Can't Hear You When the Water's Running (1968). He won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for his performance in A Thousand Clowns (1965).
extract_id: Martin Henry Balsam adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Ia memiliki karier produktif dalam peran karakter di film, teater, dan televisi. Sebagai anggota awal Actors Studio, ia memulai kariernya di panggung New York, memenangkan Tony Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam sebuah Drama untuk You Know I Can't Hear You When the Water's Running karya Robert Anderson (1968). Ia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam A Thousand Clowns (1965).

name: Martin Brest
title: Martin Brest
extract: Martin Brest is an American film director, screenwriter, and producer. After his feature debut, Going in Style (1979), he directed the action comedies Beverly Hills Cop (1984) and Midnight Run (1988), which were critical and commercial hits. He then directed Scent of a Woman (1992), starring Al Pacino, who won the Academy Award for Best Actor for his performance, and earned Brest nominations for Best Director and Best Picture.
extract_id: Martin Brest adalah seorang sutradara, penulis skenario, dan produser film Amerika. Setelah debut fitur, Going in Style (1979), ia menyutradarai komedi aksi Beverly Hills Cop (1984) dan Midnight Run (1988), yang menjadi sukses secara kritis dan komersial. Ia kemudian menyutradarai Scent of a Woman (1992), yang dibintangi Al Pacino, yang memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktor Terbaik atas penampilannya, dan menghasilkan nominasi bagi Brest untuk Sutradara Terbaik dan Film Terbaik.

name: Martin Campbell
title: Martin Campbell
description: New Zealand film and television director (born 1943)
extract: Martin Campbell is a New Zealand film and television director and producer, long based in the United Kingdom. He is best known for his works in the action and thriller film genres, including the James Bond films GoldenEye (1995) and Casino Royale (2006), The Mask of Zorro (1998) and its sequel The Legend of Zorro (2005), Vertical Limit (2000), and The Foreigner (2017).
extract_id: Martin Campbell adalah sutradara dan produser film serta televisi asal Selandia Baru, yang lama berdomisili di Inggris Raya. Ia paling dikenal atas karya-karyanya dalam genre film aksi dan thriller, termasuk film James Bond GoldenEye (1995) dan Casino Royale (2006), The Mask of Zorro (1998) dan sekuelnya The Legend of Zorro (2005), Vertical Limit (2000), dan The Foreigner (2017).

name: Martin Freeman
title: Martin Freeman
extract: Martin John Christopher Freeman is an English actor. Known for his performances on stage and screen, he has received various accolades, including two Emmy Awards, and a British Academy Television Award, as well as nominations for a Golden Globe Award and a Critics' Choice Television Award.
extract_id: Martin John Christopher Freeman adalah aktor Inggris. Dikenal atas penampilannya di panggung dan layar, ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Emmy Awards, dan British Academy Television Award, serta nominasi untuk Golden Globe Award dan Critics' Choice Television Award.

name: Martin Landau
title: Martin Landau
extract: Martin James Landau was an American actor. His career began in the late 1950s, with early film appearances including a supporting role in Alfred Hitchcock's North by Northwest (1959). His career breakthrough came with leading roles in the television series Mission: Impossible (1966–1969) and Space: 1999 (1975–1977).
extract_id: Martin James Landau adalah aktor Amerika. Kariernya dimulai pada akhir 1950-an, dengan penampilan film awal termasuk peran pendukung dalam film Alfred Hitchcock North by Northwest (1959). Kariernya menonjol dengan peran utama dalam serial televisi Mission: Impossible (1966–1969) dan Space: 1999 (1975–1977).

name: Martin McDonagh
title: Martin McDonagh
extract: Martin Faranan McDonagh is a British-born Irish playwright and filmmaker. Known for his absurdist dark humour and provocative style, he has received numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, six BAFTAs, two Golden Globes, and three Laurence Olivier Awards in addition to nominations for five Tony Awards.
extract_id: Martin Faranan McDonagh adalah penulis drama dan pembuat film Irlandia kelahiran Inggris. Dikenal atas humor gelap absurd dan gaya provokatifnya, ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, enam BAFTA, dua Golden Globes, dan tiga Laurence Olivier Awards serta nominasi untuk lima Tony Awards.

name: Martin Milner
title: Martin Milner
extract: Martin Sam Milner was an American actor. He was best known for his starring roles on two popular television series, as Tod Stiles on Route 66 (1960–64) and as Officer Pete Malloy on Adam-12 (1968–75).
extract_id: Martin Sam Milner adalah aktor Amerika. Ia paling dikenal melalui peran utamanya dalam dua serial televisi populer, sebagai Tod Stiles di Route 66 (1960–64) dan sebagai Petugas Pete Malloy di Adam-12 (1968–75).

name: Martin Rosen
title: Martin Rosen (director)
extract: Martin Gerald Rosen is an American-British filmmaker and theater producer. He directed the animated film adaptations of Watership Down (1978) and The Plague Dogs (1982), both from the Richard Adams novels.
extract_id: Martin Gerald Rosen adalah pembuat film dan produser teater Amerika-Inggris. Ia menyutradarai adaptasi film animasi Watership Down (1978) dan The Plague Dogs (1982), keduanya dari novel karya Richard Adams.

name: Martin Scorsese
title: Martin Scorsese
extract: Martin Charles Scorsese is an American filmmaker. One of the major figures of the New Hollywood era, he is widely considered one of the greatest and most influential directors in the history of cinema. He has received numerous accolades including an Academy Award, four BAFTA Awards, three Emmy Awards, a Grammy Award, and three Golden Globe Awards. Scorsese has also been honored with the AFI Life Achievement Award in 1997, the Film Society of Lincoln Center tribute in 1998, the Kennedy Center Honor in 2007, the Cecil B. DeMille Award in 2010, and the BAFTA Fellowship in 2012. Five of his films have been inducted into the National Film Registry by the Library of Congress as "culturally, historically or aesthetically significant".
extract_id: Martin Charles Scorsese adalah pembuat film Amerika. Salah satu figur utama era New Hollywood, ia secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu sutradara terhebat dan paling berpengaruh dalam sejarah perfilman. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Academy Award, empat BAFTA Awards, tiga Emmy Awards, Grammy Award, dan tiga Golden Globe Awards. Scorsese juga menerima AFI Life Achievement Award pada 1997, penghormatan Film Society of Lincoln Center pada 1998, Kennedy Center Honor pada 2007, Cecil B. DeMille Award pada 2010, dan BAFTA Fellowship pada 2012. Lima filmnya dimasukkan ke dalam National Film Registry oleh Library of Congress sebagai "kultural, historis, atau estetis signifikan".

name: Martin Sheen
title: Martin Sheen
extract: Ramón Antonio Gerardo Estévez, known professionally as Martin Sheen, is an American actor. His work spans more than six decades of television and film, and his accolades include three Emmy Awards, a Golden Globe Award, and four Actor Awards. In 1989, he received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. In 2025, The Independent ranked Sheen as the greatest actor never to have been nominated for an Academy Award.
extract_id: Ramón Antonio Gerardo Estévez, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Martin Sheen, adalah aktor Amerika. Karyanya meliputi lebih dari enam dekade televisi dan film, dan penghargaan yang diterima termasuk tiga Emmy Awards, satu Golden Globe Award, dan empat Actor Awards. Pada 1989, ia menerima bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame. Pada 2025, The Independent menobatkan Sheen sebagai aktor terbaik yang tidak pernah dinominasikan untuk Academy Award.

name: Martin Zandvliet
title: Martin Zandvliet
extract: Martin Pieter Zandvliet is a Danish film director and screenwriter.
extract_id: Martin Pieter Zandvliet adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario Denmark.

name: Martina Gedeck
title: Martina Gedeck
extract: Martina Gedeck is a German actress. She achieved international recognition due to her roles in films such as Mostly Martha (2001), The Lives of Others (2006), and The Baader Meinhof Complex (2008). She has won several awards, including two Deutscher Filmpreis, in 1997 for Supporting Actress in Life is All You Get, and in 2002 for Actress in Mostly Martha.
extract_id: Martina Gedeck adalah aktris Jerman. Ia memperoleh pengakuan internasional melalui perannya dalam film seperti Mostly Martha (2001), The Lives of Others (2006), dan The Baader Meinhof Complex (2008). Ia telah memenangkan beberapa penghargaan, termasuk dua Deutscher Filmpreis, pada 1997 untuk Aktris Pendukung dalam Life is All You Get, dan pada 2002 untuk Aktris dalam Mostly Martha.

name: Marty Feldman
title: Marty Feldman
extract: Martin Alan Feldman was a British actor, comedian and writer. He was known for his prominent, misaligned eyes.
extract_id: Martin Alan Feldman adalah aktor, komedian, dan penulis Inggris. Ia dikenal karena matanya yang menonjol dan tidak sejajar.

name: Mary Astor
title: Mary Astor
extract: Mary Astor was an American actress. Although her career spanned several decades, she may be best remembered for her performance as Brigid O'Shaughnessy in The Maltese Falcon (1941).
extract_id: Mary Astor adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Meski kariernya berlangsung beberapa dekade, ia mungkin paling diingat atas penampilannya sebagai Brigid O'Shaughnessy dalam The Maltese Falcon (1941).

name: Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio
title: Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio
extract: Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio is an American actress and singer. She made her Broadway debut as an understudy in the 1980 revival of West Side Story, and went on to appear in the 1983 film Scarface as Al Pacino's character's sister, Gina Montana, which proved to be her breakout role. For her role as Carmen in the 1986 film The Color of Money, she was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress. Her other film roles include The Abyss (1989), Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves (1991), and The Perfect Storm (2000). In 2003, she was nominated for the Tony Award for Best Actress in a Musical for the Broadway revival of Man of La Mancha.
extract_id: Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio adalah aktris dan penyanyi Amerika. Ia melakukan debut Broadway sebagai understudy dalam pertunjukan ulang West Side Story tahun 1980, dan kemudian tampil dalam film Scarface tahun 1983 sebagai Gina Montana, saudari karakter Al Pacino, yang menjadi peran penentunya. Untuk perannya sebagai Carmen dalam film The Color of Money (1986), ia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award sebagai Aktris Pendukung Terbaik. Peran film lainnya termasuk The Abyss (1989), Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves (1991), dan The Perfect Storm (2000). Pada 2003, ia dinominasikan untuk Tony Award sebagai Aktris Terbaik dalam sebuah Musikal untuk pertunjukan ulang Broadway Man of La Mancha.

name: Mary Harron
title: Mary Harron
extract: Mary Harron is a Canadian film director and screenwriter. She is best known for directing and co-writing American Psycho, The Notorious Bettie Page and I Shot Andy Warhol.
extract_id: Mary Harron adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film Kanada. Ia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai dan menulis bersama American Psycho, The Notorious Bettie Page, dan I Shot Andy Warhol.

name: Mary Kay Bergman
title: Mary Kay Bergman
description: American voice actress and voice-over teacher (1961–1999)
extract: Mary Kay Bergman, also briefly credited as Shannen Cassidy, was an American voice actress and voice-over teacher. She was the official voice of the Disney character Snow White from 1989 to 1999 and the lead female voice actress on the adult animated television series South Park from the show's debut in 1997 until her death in 1999. Bergman was also the voice actress of Claudette and Laurette in Beauty and the Beast, Dr. Blight in Captain Planet and the Planeteers, Katie in Family Dog, and Daphne Blake in the Scooby-Doo franchise from 1997 to 1999. Throughout her career, Bergman performed voice work for every aspect in media, including over 400 television commercials.
extract_id: Mary Kay Bergman, yang juga sesaat dikreditkan sebagai Shannen Cassidy, adalah aktris suara dan guru pengisi suara Amerika. Ia adalah suara resmi karakter Disney Snow White dari 1989 hingga 1999 dan pemeran suara utama wanita di serial animasi dewasa South Park dari debutnya tahun 1997 sampai kematiannya pada 1999. Bergman juga merupakan pengisi suara Claudette dan Laurette dalam Beauty and the Beast, Dr. Blight dalam Captain Planet and the Planeteers, Katie dalam Family Dog, dan Daphne Blake dalam franchise Scooby-Doo dari 1997 sampai 1999. Sepanjang kariernya, Bergman mengisi suara untuk berbagai media, termasuk lebih dari 400 iklan televisi.

name: Mary McDonnell
title: Mary McDonnell
extract: Mary Eileen McDonnell is an American film, stage, and television actress. She received Academy Award nominations for her roles as Stands With A Fist in Dances With Wolves and May-Alice Culhane in Passion Fish. McDonnell is well known for her performances as President Laura Roslin in Battlestar Galactica, First Lady Marilyn Whitmore in Independence Day, and Rose in Donnie Darko. She was featured as Captain Sharon Raydor during seasons 5–7 of the TNT series The Closer and starred as Commander Sharon Raydor in the spin-off series Major Crimes on the same network. In 2023, she played Madeleine Usher in the miniseries The Fall of the House of Usher on Netflix.
extract_id: Mary Eileen McDonnell adalah aktris film, panggung, dan televisi Amerika. Ia menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk peran sebagai Stands With A Fist dalam Dances With Wolves dan May-Alice Culhane dalam Passion Fish. McDonnell dikenal luas melalui perannya sebagai Presiden Laura Roslin dalam Battlestar Galactica, Ibu Negara Marilyn Whitmore dalam Independence Day, dan Rose dalam Donnie Darko. Ia tampil sebagai Kapten Sharon Raydor selama musim 5–7 serial TNT The Closer dan membintangi sebagai Komandan Sharon Raydor dalam serial spin-off Major Crimes di jaringan yang sama. Pada 2023, ia berperan sebagai Madeleine Usher dalam mini seri The Fall of the House of Usher di Netflix.

name: Mary Steenburgen
title: Mary Steenburgen
extract: Mary Nell Steenburgen is an American actress, comedian, singer, and songwriter. After studying at New York's Neighborhood Playhouse in the 1970s, she made her professional acting debut in the Western comedy film Goin' South (1978). Steenburgen went on to earn critical acclaim for her role in Time After Time (1979) and Jonathan Demme's comedy-drama film Melvin and Howard (1980), for which she received the Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress – Motion Picture and the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: Mary Nell Steenburgen adalah aktris, komedian, penyanyi, dan penulis lagu Amerika. Setelah belajar di Neighborhood Playhouse New York pada 1970-an, ia memulai debut profesional akting dalam film komedi Barat Goin' South (1978). Steenburgen mendapat pujian kritis atas perannya dalam Time After Time (1979) dan film komedi-drama karya Jonathan Demme Melvin and Howard (1980), yang membuatnya memenangkan Golden Globe Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik – Film dan Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Mary Stuart Masterson
title: Mary Stuart Masterson
extract: Mary Stuart Masterson is an American actress, producer, and director. After making her acting debut as a child in The Stepford Wives (1975), Masterson took a ten-year hiatus to focus on her education. Her early film roles include Heaven Help Us (1985), At Close Range (1986), Some Kind of Wonderful (1987), and Chances Are (1989). Her performance in the film Immediate Family (1989) won her the National Board of Review Award for Best Supporting Actress, and she earned additional praise for her roles in Fried Green Tomatoes (1991) and Benny & Joon (1993).
extract_id: Mary Stuart Masterson adalah aktris, produser, dan sutradara Amerika. Setelah debut akting sebagai anak-anak dalam The Stepford Wives (1975), Masterson mengambil hiatus selama sepuluh tahun untuk fokus pada pendidikannya. Peran film awalnya termasuk Heaven Help Us (1985), At Close Range (1986), Some Kind of Wonderful (1987), dan Chances Are (1989). Penampilannya dalam film Immediate Family (1989) memberinya National Board of Review Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik, dan ia menerima pujian lebih lanjut untuk perannya dalam Fried Green Tomatoes (1991) dan Benny & Joon (1993).

name: Mary Tyler Moore
title: Mary Tyler Moore
extract: Mary Tyler Moore was an American actress, producer, and social advocate. She is best known for her television roles on The Dick Van Dyke Show (1961–1966) and The Mary Tyler Moore Show (1970–1977), which "helped define a new vision of American womanhood" and "appealed to an audience facing the new trials of modern-day existence". She won seven Primetime Emmy Awards, three Golden Globe Awards, and two Tony Awards.
extract_id: Mary Tyler Moore adalah aktris, produser, dan advokat sosial Amerika. Ia paling dikenal atas peran televisinya dalam The Dick Van Dyke Show (1961–1966) dan The Mary Tyler Moore Show (1970–1977), yang "membantu mendefinisikan visi baru tentang keperempuanan Amerika" dan "menarik perhatian penonton yang menghadapi tantangan kehidupan modern masa kini". Ia memenangkan tujuh Primetime Emmy Awards, tiga Golden Globe Awards, dan dua Tony Awards.

name: Mary Ure
title: Mary Ure
extract: Mary Eileen Ure was a British actress. She was the second Scottish-born actress to be nominated for an Academy Award, for her role in the 1960 film Sons and Lovers.
extract_id: Mary Eileen Ure adalah aktris Inggris. Ia adalah aktris kelahiran Skotlandia kedua yang dinominasikan untuk Academy Award, untuk perannya dalam film Sons and Lovers tahun 1960.

name: Mary-Louise Parker
title: Mary-Louise Parker
extract: Mary-Louise Parker is an American actress. She is known for her roles on stage and screen and has received various accolades including two Golden Globe Awards, a Primetime Emmy Award and two Tony Awards.
extract_id: Mary-Louise Parker adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya di panggung dan layar serta telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk dua Golden Globe Awards, satu Primetime Emmy Award, dan dua Tony Awards.

name: Maryana Spivak
title: Maryana Spivak
extract: Maryana Timofeevna Spivak is a Russian film and television actress known for the 2017 film Loveless.
extract_id: Maryana Timofeevna Spivak adalah seorang aktris film dan televisi Rusia yang dikenal untuk film tahun 2017 Loveless.

name: Marília Pêra
title: Marília Pêra
extract: Marília Soares Pêra was a Brazilian actress, singer and theater director. Throughout her career, she won around 80 awards, acting in 49 plays, 29 telenovelas and more than 20 films.
extract_id: Marília Soares Pêra adalah seorang aktris, penyanyi, dan sutradara teater Brasil. Sepanjang kariernya, dia memenangkan sekitar 80 penghargaan, berperan dalam 49 drama, 29 telenovela, dan lebih dari 20 film.

name: Masahiko Nishimura
title: Masahiko Nishimura
extract: Masahiko Nishimura is a Japanese theatre and film actor. He is best known for his comedic portrayals.
extract_id: Masahiko Nishimura adalah seorang aktor teater dan film Jepang. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya yang bersifat komedi.

name: Masahiro Motoki
title: Masahiro Motoki
extract: Masahiro Motoki is a Japanese actor. He portrayed protagonist Daigo Kobayashi in Departures, which won the 81st Academy Awards for Best Foreign Language Film. His performance earned him the Award for Best Actor at the 2009 Asia Pacific Screen Awards, at the 3rd Asian Film Awards and at the 32nd Japan Academy Prize.
extract_id: Masahiro Motoki adalah seorang aktor Jepang. Dia memerankan tokoh utama Daigo Kobayashi dalam Departures, yang memenangkan Academy Awards ke-81 untuk Film Berbahasa Asing Terbaik. Penampilannya membawanya meraih Penghargaan Aktor Terbaik di Asia Pacific Screen Awards 2009, di Asian Film Awards ke-3, dan di Japan Academy Prize ke-32.

name: Masaki Kobayashi
title: Masaki Kobayashi
extract: Masaki Kobayashi was a Japanese filmmaker. He is best remembered for directing the epic war trilogy The Human Condition (1959–1961), the samurai films Harakiri (1962) and Samurai Rebellion (1967), and the horror anthology epic Kwaidan (1964). Senses of Cinema described him as "one of the finest depicters of Japanese society in the 1950s and 1960s." Although overshadowed by other Japanese filmmakers like Akira Kurosawa and Yasujirō Ozu in his lifetime, his work has gained wider traction in the 21st century with several of his films being ranked as some of the greatest films ever made.
extract_id: Masaki Kobayashi adalah seorang pembuat film Jepang. Dia paling dikenang sebagai sutradara trilogi perang epik The Human Condition (1959–1961), film samurai Harakiri (1962) dan Samurai Rebellion (1967), serta antologi horor epik Kwaidan (1964). Senses of Cinema menggambarkannya sebagai "salah satu pelukis masyarakat Jepang terbaik di tahun 1950-an dan 1960-an." Meskipun terhalang oleh sutradara Jepang lain seperti Akira Kurosawa dan Yasujirō Ozu semasa hidupnya, karyanya makin dikenal luas di abad ke-21 dengan beberapa filmnya dianggap sebagai film terbaik yang pernah dibuat.

name: Masaki Okada
title: Masaki Okada
extract: Masaki Okada is a Japanese actor.
extract_id: Masaki Okada adalah seorang aktor Jepang.

name: Masayuki Mori
title: Masayuki Mori (actor)
extract: Masayuki Mori was a Japanese actor and son of novelist Takeo Arishima. Mori appeared in many of Akira Kurosawa's films such as Rashomon, The Idiot and The Bad Sleep Well. He also starred in pictures by Kenji Mizoguchi (Ugetsu), Mikio Naruse and other prominent directors.
extract_id: Masayuki Mori adalah seorang aktor Jepang dan putra novelis Takeo Arishima. Mori tampil dalam banyak film Akira Kurosawa seperti Rashomon, The Idiot, dan The Bad Sleep Well. Dia juga membintangi film-film karya Kenji Mizoguchi (Ugetsu), Mikio Naruse, dan sutradara terkenal lainnya.

name: Massimo Troisi
title: Massimo Troisi
description: Italian actor, film director, and poet (1953–1994)
extract: Massimo Troisi was an Italian actor, cabaret performer, comedian, screenwriter and film director. He is best known for his works in the films I'm Starting back from Three (1981) and Il Postino: The Postman (1994), for which he was posthumously nominated for two Oscars. He won the Volpi Cup for Best Actor for his performance in the film What Time Is It? (1989). Nicknamed "the comedian of feelings", he is considered one of the most important actors of Italian theater and cinema.
extract_id: Massimo Troisi adalah seorang aktor Italia, pemain kabaret, komedian, penulis skenario, dan sutradara film. Dia paling dikenal untuk karyanya dalam film I'm Starting back from Three (1981) dan Il Postino: The Postman (1994), yang untuk keduanya dia dinominasikan secara anumerta untuk dua Oscar. Dia memenangkan Volpi Cup untuk Aktor Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam film What Time Is It? (1989). Dijuluki "komedian perasaan", dia dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terpenting dalam teater dan perfilman Italia.

name: Matheus Nachtergaele
title: Matheus Nachtergaele
extract: Matheus Nachtergaele is a Brazilian actor, film director, and screenwriter. He has starred in numerous Brazilian films and is best known for his performances in Four Days in September (1997), O Auto da Compadecida (2000) and City of God (2002). Nachtergaele is widely regarded as one of the most versatile Brazilian actors of his generation.
extract_id: Matheus Nachtergaele adalah seorang aktor, sutradara film, dan penulis skenario Brasil. Dia telah membintangi banyak film Brasil dan paling dikenal karena penampilannya dalam Four Days in September (1997), O Auto da Compadecida (2000), dan City of God (2002). Nachtergaele secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor Brasil paling serba bisa dari generasinya.

name: Mathieu Amalric
title: Mathieu Amalric
extract: Mathieu Amalric is a French actor and filmmaker. He has won several César Awards and the Lumière Awards.
extract_id: Mathieu Amalric adalah seorang aktor dan pembuat film Prancis. Dia telah memenangkan beberapa César Awards dan Lumière Awards.

name: Mathieu Kassovitz
title: Mathieu Kassovitz
extract: Mathieu Kassovitz is a French actor, film director, film producer and screenwriter. He has won three César Awards: Most Promising Actor for See How They Fall (1994), and Best Film and Best Editing for La Haine (1995). He also received Best Director and Best Original Screenplay or Adaptation nominations.
extract_id: Mathieu Kassovitz adalah seorang aktor, sutradara film, produser film, dan penulis skenario Prancis. Dia memenangkan tiga César Awards: Aktor Paling Menjanjikan untuk See How They Fall (1994), serta Film Terbaik dan Penyuntingan Terbaik untuk La Haine (1995). Dia juga menerima nominasi Sutradara Terbaik dan Skenario Asli atau Adaptasi Terbaik.

name: Matt Damon
title: Matt Damon
extract: Matthew Paige Damon is an American actor, film producer, and screenwriter. He was ranked among Forbes's most bankable stars in 2007, and in 2010 was one of the highest-grossing actors of all time. He has received various awards and nominations, including an Academy Award, an Actor Award, and two Golden Globe Awards, in addition to nominations for three British Academy Film Awards and seven Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Matthew Paige Damon adalah seorang aktor, produser film, dan penulis skenario Amerika. Dia masuk dalam daftar bintang dengan pendapatan terbesar menurut Forbes pada 2007, dan pada 2010 menjadi salah satu aktor dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan dan nominasi, termasuk Academy Award, Actor Award, dan dua Golden Globe Awards, selain nominasi untuk tiga British Academy Film Awards dan tujuh Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Matt Reeves
title: Matt Reeves
extract: Matt Reeves is an American filmmaker. He first gained recognition for the WB drama series Felicity (1998–2002), which he co-created with J. J. Abrams. Reeves came to widespread attention for directing the hit monster-film Cloverfield (2008). He also directed the vampire drama Let Me In (2010), and the critically acclaimed science-fiction sequels Dawn of the Planet of the Apes (2014) and War for the Planet of the Apes (2017). He directed the superhero film The Batman (2022), which stars Robert Pattinson as the titular character; its sequel, The Batman: Part II, is scheduled for release in 2028.
extract_id: Matt Reeves adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika. Dia pertama kali dikenal luas melalui serial drama WB Felicity (1998–2002), yang dia ciptakan bersama J. J. Abrams. Reeves mendapat perhatian luas dengan menyutradarai film monster hits Cloverfield (2008). Dia juga menyutradarai drama vampir Let Me In (2010), serta sekuel fiksi ilmiah yang mendapat pujian Dawn of the Planet of the Apes (2014) dan War for the Planet of the Apes (2017). Dia menyutradarai film superhero The Batman (2022), yang dibintangi Robert Pattinson sebagai karakter utama; sekuelnya, The Batman: Part II, dijadwalkan tayang pada 2028.

name: Matt Ross
title: Matt Ross (actor)
extract: Matthew Brandon Ross is an American actor and filmmaker. He is known for his roles as Alby Grant on the television series Big Love (2006–11) and Gavin Belson on Silicon Valley (2014–19), as well as his performances in the films The Last Days of Disco (1998), American Psycho (2000), and The Aviator (2004). He wrote and directed the 2016 comedy-drama film Captain Fantastic.
extract_id: Matthew Brandon Ross adalah seorang aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Alby Grant dalam serial televisi Big Love (2006–11) dan Gavin Belson dalam Silicon Valley (2014–19), serta penampilannya dalam film The Last Days of Disco (1998), American Psycho (2000), dan The Aviator (2004). Dia menulis dan menyutradarai film komedi-drama tahun 2016 Captain Fantastic.

name: Matt Stone
title: Matt Stone
description: American animator, filmmaker, songwriter and actor (born 1971)
extract: Matthew Richard Stone is an American animator, filmmaker, songwriter and actor. He studied film and mathematics at the University of Colorado Boulder, where he met his creative partner Trey Parker. As students, they made the independent film Cannibal! The Musical (1993). They found fame with the animated satire South Park and the film South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut (1999). Their satirical action film Team America: World Police (2004) stars a cast of marionettes. With Robert Lopez, they co-created the musical The Book of Mormon (2011).
extract_id: Matthew Richard Stone adalah seorang animator, pembuat film, penulis lagu, dan aktor Amerika. Dia belajar film dan matematika di University of Colorado Boulder, tempat dia bertemu dengan mitra kreatifnya Trey Parker. Saat menjadi mahasiswa, mereka membuat film independen Cannibal! The Musical (1993). Mereka menjadi terkenal lewat satire animasi South Park dan film South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut (1999). Film aksi satir mereka Team America: World Police (2004) dibintangi oleh para marionette. Bersama Robert Lopez, mereka menciptakan musikal The Book of Mormon (2011).

name: Matthew Broderick
title: Matthew Broderick
extract: Matthew Broderick is an American actor. Known for his roles on stage and screen, he has received two Tony Awards as well as nominations for two Primetime Emmy Awards, a Grammy Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a Screen Actors Guild Award. Broderick was inducted into the Hollywood Walk of Fame with a motion pictures star in 2006 and the American Theater Hall of Fame in 2017.
extract_id: Matthew Broderick adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dikenal karena perannya di panggung dan layar, dia telah menerima dua Tony Awards serta nominasi untuk dua Primetime Emmy Awards, Grammy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Screen Actors Guild Award. Broderick dianugerahi bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame untuk kategori film pada 2006 dan masuk American Theater Hall of Fame pada 2017.

name: Matthew Edison
title: Matthew Edison
extract: Matthew Edison is a Canadian actor known for his roles in Fortunate Son, The Detail, and Nero Wolfe, and as Cameron Coleman in The Boys franchise, appearing in a web series, Vought News Network: Seven on 7 with Cameron Coleman, and in connected television series, The Boys and Gen V.
extract_id: Matthew Edison adalah seorang aktor Kanada yang dikenal karena perannya dalam Fortunate Son, The Detail, dan Nero Wolfe, serta sebagai Cameron Coleman dalam franchise The Boys, muncul dalam serial web Vought News Network: Seven on 7 with Cameron Coleman, dan dalam serial televisi terkait The Boys dan Gen V.

name: Matthew Goode
title: Matthew Goode
extract: Matthew William Goode is an English actor. He made his screen debut in 2002 with ABC's television film Confessions of an Ugly Stepsister. His breakthrough role was in the romantic comedy Chasing Liberty (2004), for which he received a nomination at the Teen Choice Awards for Choice Breakout Movie Star – Male. He then appeared in a string of supporting roles in films, such as Woody Allen's Match Point (2005), the romantic comedy Imagine Me and You (2006), and the period drama Copying Beethoven (2006). He earned praise for his performances as Charles Ryder in the 2008 film adaptation of the novel Brideshead Revisited and as Ozymandias in the superhero film Watchmen (2009). He then starred in the romantic comedy Leap Year (2010) and the Australian drama Burning Man (2011), the latter earning him nominations for Best Actor at both the Film Critics Circle of Australia Awards and the AACTA Awards.
extract_id: Matthew William Goode adalah seorang aktor Inggris. Dia membuat debut layar pada 2002 dengan film televisi ABC Confessions of an Ugly Stepsister. Peran terobosannya adalah dalam komedi romantis Chasing Liberty (2004), yang membawanya mendapat nominasi Teen Choice Awards untuk Choice Breakout Movie Star – Male. Setelah itu, dia muncul dalam berbagai peran pendukung di film-film seperti Match Point (2005) karya Woody Allen, komedi romantis Imagine Me and You (2006), dan drama periode Copying Beethoven (2006). Dia dipuji atas penampilannya sebagai Charles Ryder dalam adaptasi film 2008 dari novel Brideshead Revisited dan sebagai Ozymandias dalam film superhero Watchmen (2009). Dia kemudian membintangi komedi romantis Leap Year (2010) dan drama Australia Burning Man (2011), yang membuatnya mendapat nominasi Aktor Terbaik di Film Critics Circle of Australia Awards dan AACTA Awards.

name: Matthew Macfadyen
title: Matthew Macfadyen
extract: David Matthew Macfadyen is an British actor. Known for his roles on stage and screen, he gained prominence for his role as Mr. Darcy in Joe Wright's Pride & Prejudice (2005) before gaining wider recognition for playing Tom Wambsgans in the HBO drama series Succession (2018–2023), for which he received two Primetime Emmy Awards, two BAFTA TV Awards, and a Golden Globe Award.
extract_id: David Matthew Macfadyen adalah seorang aktor Inggris. Dikenal karena perannya di panggung dan layar, dia meraih ketenaran sebagai Mr. Darcy dalam Pride & Prejudice (2005) karya Joe Wright sebelum mendapat pengakuan lebih luas sebagai Tom Wambsgans dalam serial drama HBO Succession (2018–2023), yang membuatnya meraih dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dua BAFTA TV Awards, dan satu Golden Globe Award.

name: Matthew McConaughey
title: Matthew McConaughey
extract: Matthew David McConaughey is an American actor. He achieved his breakthrough with a supporting performance in the coming-of-age comedy Dazed and Confused (1993). After a number of supporting roles, his first success as a leading man came in the legal drama A Time to Kill (1996). His career progressed with lead roles in the science fiction film Contact (1997), the historical drama Amistad (1997), the war film U-571 (2000), and the epic science fiction film Interstellar (2014).
extract_id: Matthew David McConaughey adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia meraih terobosan lewat peran pendukung dalam komedi coming-of-age Dazed and Confused (1993). Setelah sejumlah peran pendukung, keberhasilan pertamanya sebagai pemeran utama datang dalam drama hukum A Time to Kill (1996). Kariernya berkembang dengan peran utama dalam film fiksi ilmiah Contact (1997), drama sejarah Amistad (1997), film perang U-571 (2000), dan film fiksi ilmiah epik Interstellar (2014).

name: Matthew Modine
title: Matthew Modine
extract: Matthew Avery Modine is an American actor and filmmaker. He shared the Venice Film Festival‘s Volpi Cup for Best Actor as part of the ensemble cast of Robert Altman’s film Streamers (1983). He went on to play lead roles in several high-profile films throughout the 1980s, including Birdy (1984), Vision Quest (1985), and Married to the Mob (1988). He gained further prominence for playing U.S. Marine James T. "Joker" Davis in Stanley Kubrick's Full Metal Jacket (1987).
extract_id: Matthew Avery Modine adalah seorang aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Dia berbagi Volpi Cup Aktor Terbaik di Venice Film Festival sebagai bagian dari pemeran ensemble film Streamers (1983) karya Robert Altman. Dia kemudian memerankan peran utama dalam beberapa film berprofil tinggi sepanjang 1980-an, termasuk Birdy (1984), Vision Quest (1985), dan Married to the Mob (1988). Dia semakin dikenal karena perannya sebagai Marinir AS James T. "Joker" Davis dalam Full Metal Jacket (1987) karya Stanley Kubrick.

name: Matthew Vaughn
title: Matthew Vaughn
extract: Sir Matthew Allard de Vere Drummond, also known as Sir Matthew Vaughn, is an English filmmaker. He has produced films including Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels (1998) and Snatch (2000), and directed Layer Cake (2004), Stardust (2007), Kick-Ass (2010), X-Men: First Class (2011), and Argylle (2024). Vaughn also co-created the Kingsman comic book series and resulting franchise, directing, producing and co-writing the films from Kingsman: The Secret Service (2014), Kingsman: The Golden Circle (2017), and The King's Man (2021).
extract_id: Sir Matthew Allard de Vere Drummond, juga dikenal sebagai Sir Matthew Vaughn, adalah seorang pembuat film Inggris. Dia memproduksi film-film termasuk Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels (1998) dan Snatch (2000), serta menyutradarai Layer Cake (2004), Stardust (2007), Kick-Ass (2010), X-Men: First Class (2011), dan Argylle (2024). Vaughn juga ikut menciptakan seri komik Kingsman dan waralabanya, menyutradarai, memproduksi, dan menulis bersama film-film Kingsman: The Secret Service (2014), Kingsman: The Golden Circle (2017), dan The King's Man (2021).

name: Matthew Warchus
title: Matthew Warchus
extract: Matthew Warchus is an English theatre director, playwright, and filmmaker. He was the Artistic Director of London's The Old Vic from September 2015 to 2026.
extract_id: Matthew Warchus adalah seorang sutradara teater, penulis drama, dan pembuat film Inggris. Dia menjabat sebagai Direktur Artistik The Old Vic di London dari September 2015 hingga 2026.

name: Maureen O'Hara
title: Maureen O'Hara
description: Irish and American actress and singer (1920–2015)
extract: Maureen O'Hara was an Irish and American actress and singer who became successful in Hollywood from the 1940s through to the 1960s. She was a natural redhead who was known for playing passionate but sensible heroines, often in Westerns and adventure films. She worked with director John Ford and long-time friend John Wayne on numerous projects.
extract_id: Maureen O'Hara adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Irlandia dan Amerika yang sukses di Hollywood dari tahun 1940-an hingga 1960-an. Dia adalah seorang wanita berambut merah alami yang dikenal karena memerankan pahlawan wanita yang penuh semangat namun bijaksana, sering dalam film Barat dan petualangan. Dia bekerja dengan sutradara John Ford dan teman dekatnya John Wayne dalam berbagai proyek.

name: Maureen O'Sullivan
title: Maureen O'Sullivan
extract: Maureen Paula O'Sullivan was an Irish and American actress. She played Jane in the Tarzan series of films during the era of Johnny Weissmuller. She also starred in dozens of feature films across a span of more than half a century and performed with such stars as Laurence Olivier, Greta Garbo, Fredric March, William Powell, Myrna Loy, Marie Dressler, Wallace Beery, Lionel Barrymore, the Marx Brothers and Woody Allen. In 2020, she was listed at number eight on The Irish Times list of Ireland's greatest film actors.
extract_id: Maureen Paula O'Sullivan adalah seorang aktris Irlandia dan Amerika. Dia memerankan Jane dalam seri film Tarzan pada era Johnny Weissmuller. Dia juga membintangi puluhan film fitur selama lebih dari setengah abad dan tampil bersama bintang-bintang seperti Laurence Olivier, Greta Garbo, Fredric March, William Powell, Myrna Loy, Marie Dressler, Wallace Beery, Lionel Barrymore, the Marx Brothers dan Woody Allen. Pada tahun 2020, dia masuk dalam daftar The Irish Times sebagai aktor film terbesar Irlandia di posisi kedelapan.

name: Maurice Evans
title: Maurice Evans (actor)
extract: Maurice Herbert Evans was an English actor, noted for his interpretations of Shakespearean characters. His best-known screen roles include Dr. Zaius in the 1968 film Planet of the Apes and Maurice on Bewitched.
extract_id: Maurice Herbert Evans adalah aktor Inggris yang dikenal karena interpretasinya terhadap karakter Shakespearean. Peran layar terkenalnya termasuk Dr. Zaius dalam film Planet of the Apes tahun 1968 dan Maurice dalam Bewitched.

name: Maurice Schutz
title: Maurice Schutz
extract: Maurice Schutz was a French film actor.
extract_id: Maurice Schutz adalah aktor film asal Prancis.

name: Max Phipps
title: Max Phipps
extract: Maxwell John Phipps was an Australian actor, director and singer known for a number of roles in theatre, films and television during the 1960s until the end of the 1990s.
extract_id: Maxwell John Phipps adalah aktor, sutradara, dan penyanyi asal Australia yang dikenal karena sejumlah peran di teater, film, dan televisi dari tahun 1960-an hingga akhir 1990-an.

name: Max Riemelt
title: Max Riemelt
extract: Max Riemelt is a German actor. He is known internationally for playing Wolfgang Bogdanow in the Netflix series Sense8. In Germany, he is known for his many appearances on television and in films, including Before the Fall, Free Fall and the 2023 series Bonn. He has appeared in many productions directed by Dennis Gansel and Dominik Graf.
extract_id: Max Riemelt adalah aktor Jerman. Dia dikenal secara internasional karena memerankan Wolfgang Bogdanow dalam serial Netflix Sense8. Di Jerman, dia dikenal karena banyak tampil di televisi dan film, termasuk Before the Fall, Free Fall, dan serial Bonn tahun 2023. Dia telah tampil dalam banyak produksi yang disutradarai oleh Dennis Gansel dan Dominik Graf.

name: Max Schreck
title: Max Schreck
extract: Friedrich Gustav Maximilian Schreck was a German actor, best known for his lead role as the vampire Count Orlok in the film Nosferatu (1922).
extract_id: Friedrich Gustav Maximilian Schreck adalah aktor Jerman yang paling dikenal karena peran utamanya sebagai vampir Count Orlok dalam film Nosferatu (1922).

name: Max von Sydow
title: Max von Sydow
extract: Max von Sydow was a Swedish and French actor. He had a 70-year career in European and American cinema, television, and theatre, appearing in more than 150 films and several television series in multiple languages. Capable in roles ranging from stolid, contemplative protagonists to sardonic artists and menacing, often gleeful villains, von Sydow received numerous accolades including honors from the Cannes Film Festival and the Venice Film Festival. He was nominated for two Academy Awards: for Best Actor for Pelle the Conqueror (1987) and for Best Supporting Actor for Extremely Loud & Incredibly Close (2011).
extract_id: Max von Sydow adalah aktor Swedia dan Prancis. Dia memiliki karier selama 70 tahun di sinema Eropa dan Amerika, televisi, dan teater, tampil dalam lebih dari 150 film dan beberapa serial televisi dalam berbagai bahasa. Mampu memerankan peran mulai dari protagonis yang tenang dan penuh perenungan hingga seniman sardonik dan penjahat yang menakutkan sekaligus ceria, von Sydow menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk kehormatan dari Festival Film Cannes dan Festival Film Venesia. Dia dinominasikan untuk dua Academy Awards: untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Pelle the Conqueror (1987) dan Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam Extremely Loud & Incredibly Close (2011).

name: Maxim Gaudette
title: Maxim Gaudette
extract: Maxim Gaudette is a Canadian actor from Quebec. He won both the Genie Award for Best Supporting Actor and the Jutra Award for Best Supporting Actor in 2010 for his role as Marc Lépine in the 2009 film Polytechnique.
extract_id: Maxim Gaudette adalah aktor Kanada dari Quebec. Dia memenangkan Genie Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dan Jutra Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik pada tahun 2010 untuk perannya sebagai Marc Lépine dalam film Polytechnique tahun 2009.

name: Maxine Audley
title: Maxine Audley
extract: Maxine Audley was an English theatre and film actress. She made her professional stage debut in July 1940 at the Open Air Theatre. Audley performed with the Old Vic company and the Royal Shakespeare Company many times. She appeared in more than 20 films, the first of which was the 1948 adaptation of Leo Tolstoy's novel Anna Karenina.
extract_id: Maxine Audley adalah aktris teater dan film Inggris. Dia melakukan debut panggung profesionalnya pada Juli 1940 di Open Air Theatre. Audley tampil bersama perusahaan Old Vic dan Royal Shakespeare Company berkali-kali. Dia tampil dalam lebih dari 20 film, yang pertama adalah adaptasi novel Anna Karenina karya Leo Tolstoy tahun 1948.

name: May Whitty
title: May Whitty
extract: Dame Mary Louise Webster, known professionally as May Whitty and later, for her charity work, Dame May Whitty, was an English stage and film actress. She was one of the first two women entertainers to become a Dame. The British actors' union Equity was established in her home in 1930.
extract_id: Dame Mary Louise Webster, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai May Whitty dan kemudian untuk karya amalnya sebagai Dame May Whitty, adalah aktris panggung dan film Inggris. Dia adalah salah satu dari dua wanita penghibur pertama yang menjadi Dame. Serikat aktor Inggris Equity didirikan di rumahnya pada tahun 1930.

name: Mayu Matsuoka
title: Mayu Matsuoka
extract: Mayu Matsuoka is a Japanese actress.
extract_id: Mayu Matsuoka adalah aktris asal Jepang.

name: Mayumi Izuka
title: Mayumi Iizuka
extract: Mayumi Iizuka is a Japanese actress, voice actress, singer and disc jockey who was born in Tokyo. She is currently affiliated with Across Entertainment and her label is Lantis. She is an instructor at the Stay Luck training school Follow-Up. For her singing activities, she uses the alias Hoshi Mai .
extract_id: Mayumi Iizuka adalah aktris, pengisi suara, penyanyi, dan disc jockey asal Jepang yang lahir di Tokyo. Dia saat ini berafiliasi dengan Across Entertainment dan labelnya adalah Lantis. Dia adalah instruktur di sekolah pelatihan Stay Luck Follow-Up. Untuk kegiatan menyanyinya, dia menggunakan nama alias Hoshi Mai.

name: Mayumi Tanaka
title: Mayumi Tanaka
extract: Mayumi Tanaka is a Japanese actress, voice actress and narrator. She voices Monkey D. Luffy in One Piece, Krillin, Yajirobe and Uranai Baba in Dragon Ball, Ryunosuke Fujinami in Urusei Yatsura, Koenma in Yu Yu Hakusho; Pazu in Laputa: Castle in the Sky, Kirimaru Setsuno in Nintama Rantarō, Kanna Kirishima in the Sakura Wars series, the titular role of TwinBee in Konami's shoot-'em-up series TwinBee, and MegaMan Volnutt in the Mega Man Legends series and related Capcom crossovers. She received the Kazue Takahashi Award at the 5th Seiyu Awards.
extract_id: Mayumi Tanaka adalah aktris, pengisi suara, dan narator asal Jepang. Dia mengisi suara Monkey D. Luffy dalam One Piece, Krillin, Yajirobe, dan Uranai Baba dalam Dragon Ball, Ryunosuke Fujinami dalam Urusei Yatsura, Koenma dalam Yu Yu Hakusho; Pazu dalam Laputa: Castle in the Sky, Kirimaru Setsuno dalam Nintama Rantarō, Kanna Kirishima dalam seri Sakura Wars, peran utama TwinBee dalam seri tembak-tembakan TwinBee karya Konami, dan MegaMan Volnutt dalam seri Mega Man Legends dan crossover terkait Capcom. Dia menerima Penghargaan Kazue Takahashi pada acara Seiyu Awards ke-5.

name: Mckenna Grace
title: Mckenna Grace
extract: Mckenna Grace Burge is an American actress and singer. Her earliest roles included Jasmine Bernstein in the Disney XD sitcom Crash & Bernstein (2012–2014) and Faith Newman in the soap opera The Young and the Restless (2013–2015). After several small roles, she starred as a child prodigy in Gifted (2017), a breakthrough for which she received a nomination for the Critics' Choice Movie Award for Best Young Performer.
extract_id: Mckenna Grace Burge adalah aktris dan penyanyi Amerika. Peran-peran awalnya termasuk Jasmine Bernstein dalam sitkom Disney XD Crash & Bernstein (2012–2014) dan Faith Newman dalam opera sabun The Young and the Restless (2013–2015). Setelah beberapa peran kecil, dia membintangi sebagai anak jenius dalam Gifted (2017), terobosan yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Critics' Choice Movie Award sebagai Pemeran Muda Terbaik.

name: Meat Loaf
title: Meat Loaf
extract: Michael Lee Aday, known professionally as Meat Loaf, was an American singer and actor. He was known for his powerful, wide-ranging voice and theatrical live shows. His Bat Out of Hell album trilogy—Bat Out of Hell (1977), Bat Out of Hell II: Back into Hell (1993), and Bat Out of Hell III: The Monster Is Loose (2006)—has sold more than 100 million records worldwide, making him one of the best-selling music artists of all time. The first album stayed on the charts for over nine years and is one of the best-selling albums in history, still selling an estimated 200,000 copies annually as of 2016.
extract_id: Michael Lee Aday, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Meat Loaf, adalah penyanyi dan aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena suara yang kuat dan luas serta pertunjukan panggung teaterikalnya. Trilogi albumnya Bat Out of Hell—Bat Out of Hell (1977), Bat Out of Hell II: Back into Hell (1993), dan Bat Out of Hell III: The Monster Is Loose (2006)—telah terjual lebih dari 100 juta rekaman di seluruh dunia, menjadikannya salah satu artis musik dengan penjualan terbaik sepanjang masa. Album pertama tetap berada di tangga lagu selama lebih dari sembilan tahun dan merupakan salah satu album terlaris dalam sejarah, masih memperkirakan penjualan 200.000 kopi setiap tahun hingga 2016.

name: Meena
title: Meena (actress)
extract: Meena Sagar is an Indian actress known for her works in Tamil, Telugu and Malayalam films in addition to a few Kannada and Hindi films. Widely regarded as one of South Indian cinema's most successful and accomplished actresses, Meena is known for natural acting, expressive eyes, and successful collaborations with superstars. She became one of the most sought-after actresses in the South Indian film industry in the '90s. She has received numerous accolades, including two Filmfare Awards South, three Tamil Nadu State Film Awards, two Nandi Awards and two Cinema Express Awards. In 1998, she was honoured with the Kalaimamani Award by Government of Tamil Nadu.
extract_id: Meena Sagar adalah aktris India yang dikenal karena karya-karyanya dalam film Tamil, Telugu, dan Malayalam selain beberapa film Kannada dan Hindi. Secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu aktris paling sukses dan berprestasi di sinema India Selatan, Meena dikenal karena akting alami, mata ekspresif, dan kolaborasi sukses dengan para superstar. Dia menjadi salah satu aktris paling dicari di industri film India Selatan pada tahun 1990-an. Dia telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk dua Filmfare Awards South, tiga Tamil Nadu State Film Awards, dua Nandi Awards, dan dua Cinema Express Awards. Pada tahun 1998, dia dianugerahi Penghargaan Kalaimamani oleh Pemerintah Tamil Nadu.

name: Meg Ryan
title: Meg Ryan
extract: Margaret Mary Emily Anne Hyra, known professionally as Meg Ryan, is an American actress. Known for playing quirky, charismatic women since the late 1980s, Ryan is particularly recognized for her leading roles in romantic comedies, a genre she dominated during the 1990s. Dubbed "America's Sweetheart" by the media, she became one of Hollywood's most bankable stars of the latter decade.
extract_id: Margaret Mary Emily Anne Hyra, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Meg Ryan, adalah aktris Amerika. Dikenal karena memerankan wanita unik dan karismatik sejak akhir 1980-an, Ryan khususnya dikenal karena peran utamanya dalam komedi romantis, genre yang dia kuasai selama tahun 1990-an. Dijuluki "America's Sweetheart" oleh media, dia menjadi salah satu bintang Hollywood yang paling menguntungkan pada dekade tersebut.

name: Meghna Gulzar
title: Meghna Gulzar
extract: Meghna Gulzar is an Indian writer, director and producer. She is best known for directing critically acclaimed films; Talvar (2015) and Raazi (2018). Born to Gulzar and actress Raakhee, Gulzar joined her father as an assistant to his films and became a screenwriter for her father's 1999 directorial Hu Tu Tu. Meghna later became an independent director and directed her first film, the drama Filhaal... (2002), though she did not achieve directorial success that decade.
extract_id: Meghna Gulzar adalah penulis, sutradara, dan produser India. Dia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai film-film sukses secara kritis; Talvar (2015) dan Raazi (2018). Lahir dari Gulzar dan aktris Raakhee, Meghna bergabung dengan ayahnya sebagai asisten pada film-filmnya dan menjadi penulis skenario untuk film arahan ayahnya Hu Tu Tu tahun 1999. Meghna kemudian menjadi sutradara mandiri dan menyutradarai film pertamanya, drama Filhaal... (2002), meskipun dia tidak mencapai kesuksesan sutradara pada dekade itu.

name: Megs Jenkins
title: Megs Jenkins
extract: Muguette Mary "Megs" Jenkins was an English character actress who appeared in British films and television programmes.
extract_id: Muguette Mary "Megs" Jenkins adalah aktris karakter Inggris yang tampil dalam film dan program televisi Inggris.

name: Megumi Hayashibara
title: Megumi Hayashibara
description: Japanese voice actress, singer, and radio personality (born 1967)
extract: Megumi Hayashibara is a Japanese voice actress, singer, lyricist and radio personality from Kita ward in Tokyo and is affiliated with self-founded Woodpark Office. One of the most prominent Japanese voice actresses since the 1990s, Hayashibara is best known for her roles in Neon Genesis Evangelion, Saber Marionette J, Magical Princess Minky Momo, Mashin Hero Wataru, Ranma ½, Cowboy Bebop, Slayers, Detective Conan, Pokémon, All Purpose Cultural Catgirl Nuku Nuku, Hello Kitty, Video Girl Ai, and Shaman King for which she also performed various OP and ED themes in both the 2001 and 2021 adaptations.
extract_id: Megumi Hayashibara adalah pengisi suara, penyanyi, penulis lirik, dan personalitas radio asal Jepang dari distrik Kita di Tokyo dan berafiliasi dengan Woodpark Office yang didirikannya sendiri. Salah satu pengisi suara Jepang paling terkenal sejak 1990-an, Hayashibara paling dikenal atas perannya dalam Neon Genesis Evangelion, Saber Marionette J, Magical Princess Minky Momo, Mashin Hero Wataru, Ranma ½, Cowboy Bebop, Slayers, Detective Conan, Pokémon, All Purpose Cultural Catgirl Nuku Nuku, Hello Kitty, Video Girl Ai, dan Shaman King yang mana dia juga membawakan berbagai tema OP dan ED di adaptasi tahun 2001 dan 2021.

name: Megumi Ogata
title: Megumi Ogata
extract: Megumi Ogata is a Japanese actress and singer from the Greater Tokyo Area. As a singer, she goes by the name em:óu. She is best known for voicing Shinji Ikari in Neon Genesis Evangelion, Yugi Mutou and Dark Yugi in the Toei version of Yu-Gi-Oh!, Makoto Naegi and Nagito Komaeda in the Danganronpa series, Ken Amada in Persona 3, Kurama in YuYu Hakusho, Sailor Uranus in the Sailor Moon series, Yuta Okkotsu in Jujutsu Kaisen, Hanako and Tsukasa in Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun and Yukito Tsukishiro/Yue in Cardcaptor Sakura.
extract_id: Megumi Ogata adalah aktris dan penyanyi Jepang dari Area Greater Tokyo. Sebagai penyanyi, dia menggunakan nama em:óu. Dia paling dikenal sebagai pengisi suara Shinji Ikari dalam Neon Genesis Evangelion, Yugi Mutou dan Dark Yugi dalam versi Toei dari Yu-Gi-Oh!, Makoto Naegi dan Nagito Komaeda dalam seri Danganronpa, Ken Amada dalam Persona 3, Kurama dalam YuYu Hakusho, Sailor Uranus dalam seri Sailor Moon, Yuta Okkotsu dalam Jujutsu Kaisen, Hanako dan Tsukasa dalam Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun, serta Yukito Tsukishiro/Yue dalam Cardcaptor Sakura.

name: Mehdi Nebbou
title: Mehdi Nebbou
extract: Mehdi Nebbou is a French actor.
extract_id: Mehdi Nebbou adalah aktor Prancis.

name: Mel Brooks
title: Mel Brooks
extract: Melvin James Brooks is an American actor, comedian, filmmaker, songwriter and playwright. With a career spanning nine decades, he is known for a variety of successful farces and parodies. A recipient of numerous accolades, he is one of the few people to win the EGOT awards. He received a Kennedy Center Honor in 2009, a Hollywood Walk of Fame star in 2010, the AFI Life Achievement Award in 2013, a British Film Institute Fellowship in 2015, a National Medal of Arts in 2016 and a BAFTA Fellowship in 2017.
extract_id: Melvin James Brooks adalah aktor, komedian, pembuat film, penulis lagu, dan dramawan Amerika. Dengan karier yang berlangsung selama sembilan dekade, dia dikenal karena berbagai farce dan parodi yang sukses. Penerima banyak penghargaan, dia adalah salah satu dari sedikit orang yang memenangkan penghargaan EGOT. Dia menerima Kennedy Center Honor pada 2009, bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada 2010, AFI Life Achievement Award pada 2013, Fellowship British Film Institute tahun 2015, National Medal of Arts pada 2016, dan BAFTA Fellowship pada 2017.

name: Mel Gibson
title: Mel Gibson
extract: Mel Colm-Cille Gerard Gibson is an American actor and filmmaker. The recipient of multiple accolades, he is known for directing historical films as well for his action hero roles, particularly his breakout role as Max Rockatansky in the first three films of the post-apocalyptic series Mad Max (1979–1985) and as Martin Riggs in the buddy cop series Lethal Weapon (1987–1998).
extract_id: Mel Colm-Cille Gerard Gibson adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Penerima berbagai penghargaan, dia dikenal karena menyutradarai film-film sejarah serta peran pahlawan aksinya, khususnya peran terobosannya sebagai Max Rockatansky dalam tiga film pertama seri post-apokaliptik Mad Max (1979–1985) dan sebagai Martin Riggs dalam seri polisi teman Lethal Weapon (1987–1998).

name: Mel Stuart
title: Mel Stuart
extract: Mel Stuart was an American film director and producer who often worked with producer David L. Wolper, at whose production firm he worked for 17 years, before going freelance.
extract_id: Mel Stuart adalah sutradara dan produser film Amerika yang sering bekerja dengan produser David L. Wolper, di perusahaan produksinya tempat dia bekerja selama 17 tahun sebelum menjadi freelancer.

name: Melinda Dillon
title: Melinda Dillon
extract: Melinda Dillon was an American actress. She was nominated for a 1963 Tony Award for her Broadway debut in the original production of Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf? and was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her roles in Close Encounters of the Third Kind (1977) and Absence of Malice (1981).
extract_id: Melinda Dillon adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia dinominasikan untuk Tony Award 1963 untuk debut Broadway-nya dalam produksi asli Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf? dan dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik atas perannya dalam Close Encounters of the Third Kind (1977) dan Absence of Malice (1981).

name: Melisa Sözen
title: Melisa Sözen
extract: Melisa Sözen is a Turkish actress.
extract_id: Melisa Sözen adalah seorang aktris Turki.

name: Melissa Benoist
title: Melissa Benoist
extract: Melissa Marie Benoist is an American actress and singer. Her first major role was as Marley Rose on the Fox musical comedy-drama Glee (2012–2014), in which she was a series regular during the fifth season. She rose to widespread prominence for portraying Kara Danvers on the CBS/CW superhero series Supergirl (2015–2021).
extract_id: Melissa Marie Benoist adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Amerika. Peran besarnya yang pertama adalah sebagai Marley Rose dalam drama musikal komedi Fox Glee (2012–2014), di mana dia menjadi pemeran reguler selama musim kelima. Dia menjadi terkenal luas karena memerankan Kara Danvers dalam serial superhero CBS/CW Supergirl (2015–2021).

name: Melissa Leo
title: Melissa Leo
extract: Melissa Chessington Leo is an American actress. She is the recipient of several accolades, including an Academy Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, a Golden Globe Award, an Actor Award, and two Critics' Choice Awards.
extract_id: Melissa Chessington Leo adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Primetime Emmy Award, Golden Globe Award, Actor Award, dan dua Critics' Choice Awards.

name: Melora Walters
title: Melora Walters
extract: Melora Walters is an American actress and filmmaker, best known for her starring roles as Wanda Henrickson on HBO's Big Love (2006–2010) and Kathy Kone on Hulu's Pen15 (2019–2021). She has frequently collaborated with Paul Thomas Anderson, earning two Screen Actors Guild nominations for her work in Boogie Nights (1997) and Magnolia (1999), respectively. Her other film credits include Dead Poets Society (1989), Eraser (1996), Matchstick Men, Cold Mountain, The Butterfly Effect (2004), Short Term 12 (2013), Cam, Venom, and Offseason (2021). Walters's directorial credits include Waterlily Jaguar (2018) and Drowning (2019), both of which she wrote and co-produced.
extract_id: Melora Walters adalah seorang aktris dan pembuat film Amerika, paling dikenal karena peran utamanya sebagai Wanda Henrickson di Big Love HBO (2006–2010) dan Kathy Kone di Pen15 Hulu (2019–2021). Dia sering bekerja sama dengan Paul Thomas Anderson, meraih dua nominasi Screen Actors Guild untuk pekerjaannya dalam Boogie Nights (1997) dan Magnolia (1999). Kredit film lainnya termasuk Dead Poets Society (1989), Eraser (1996), Matchstick Men, Cold Mountain, The Butterfly Effect (2004), Short Term 12 (2013), Cam, Venom, dan Offseason (2021). Kredit sutradaranya termasuk Waterlily Jaguar (2018) dan Drowning (2019), yang keduanya dia tulis dan produksi bersama.

name: Melvyn Douglas
title: Melvyn Douglas
extract: Melvyn Douglas was an American actor, whose stage and screen careers spanned from the late 1920s until the early 1980s. He was one of 24 performers to win the Triple Crown of Acting – winning two Academy Awards, a Primetime Emmy Award, and a Tony Award.
extract_id: Melvyn Douglas adalah seorang aktor Amerika, yang karier panggung dan layar lebarnya berlangsung sejak akhir 1920-an hingga awal 1980-an. Dia adalah salah satu dari 24 pemeran yang memenangkan Triple Crown of Acting – memenangkan dua Academy Awards, satu Primetime Emmy Award, dan satu Tony Award.

name: Mercedes Morán
title: Mercedes Morán
extract: Mercedes Beatriz Morán is an Argentine actress, known for her role in the television miniseries Culpables.
extract_id: Mercedes Beatriz Morán adalah seorang aktris Argentina, dikenal karena perannya dalam miniseri televisi Culpables.

name: Merian C. Cooper
title: Merian C. Cooper
extract: Merian Caldwell Cooper was an American filmmaker, actor, producer and military aviator. In film, his most famous work was the 1933 movie King Kong, and he is credited as co-inventor of the Cinerama film projection process. He was awarded an honorary Oscar for lifetime achievement in 1952 and received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 1960. He was a passionate anti-communist.
extract_id: Merian Caldwell Cooper adalah seorang pembuat film, aktor, produser, dan penerbang militer Amerika. Dalam film, karya terkenalnya adalah film tahun 1933 King Kong, dan dia dikreditkan sebagai salah satu penemu proses proyeksi film Cinerama. Dia dianugerahi Oscar kehormatan untuk pencapaian seumur hidup pada 1952 dan menerima bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada 1960. Dia adalah seorang anti-komunis yang bersemangat.

name: Merila Zare'i
title: Merila Zarei
extract: Merila Zarei is an Iranian actress. She has received various accolades, including a Silver Bear, three Crystal Simorghs, four Hafez Awards, four Iran Cinema Celebration Awards and an Iran's Film Critics and Writers Association Award.
extract_id: Merila Zarei adalah seorang aktris Iran. Ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Silver Bear, tiga Crystal Simorghs, empat Hafez Awards, empat Iran Cinema Celebration Awards, dan satu penghargaan dari Iran's Film Critics and Writers Association.

name: Merna Kennedy
title: Merna Kennedy
extract: Merna Kennedy was an American actress of the late silent era and the transitional period into talkies.
extract_id: Merna Kennedy adalah seorang aktris Amerika dari era bisu akhir dan periode transisi ke film bersuara.

name: Mervyn LeRoy
title: Mervyn LeRoy
extract: Mervyn LeRoy was an American film director and producer. During the 1930s, he was one of the two great practitioners of economical and effective film directing at Warner Brothers studios, the other being his colleague Michael Curtiz. LeRoy's most acclaimed films of his tenure at Warners include Little Caesar (1931), I Am a Fugitive From a Chain Gang (1932), Gold Diggers of 1933 (1933), Anthony Adverse (1936), and They Won't Forget (1937). LeRoy left Warners and moved to Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer studios in 1939 to serve as both director and producer. He is best known for producing the 1939 film The Wizard of Oz, as well as for directing the 1951 Oscar-nominated film Quo Vadis.
extract_id: Mervyn LeRoy adalah seorang sutradara dan produser film Amerika. Selama 1930-an, dia adalah salah satu dari dua praktisi hebat dalam penyutradaraan film yang ekonomis dan efektif di Warner Brothers studios, yang lainnya adalah rekannya Michael Curtiz.
