Film-film paling terkenal selama masa jabatannya di Warners mencakup Little Caesar (1931), I Am a Fugitive From a Chain Gang (1932), Gold Diggers of 1933 (1933), Anthony Adverse (1936), dan They Won't Forget (1937). LeRoy meninggalkan Warners dan pindah ke Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer studios pada 1939 untuk menjabat sebagai sutradara dan produser. Dia paling dikenal memproduksi film The Wizard of Oz (1939), serta menyutradarai film Quo Vadis (1951) yang dinominasikan Oscar.

name: Meryl Streep
title: Meryl Streep
extract: Mary Louise "Meryl" Streep is an American actress. Widely regarded by peers and critics as the greatest actress of her generation, and by many with the affectionate epitaph "Greatest of All Time", she is recognized as one of the most versatile performers in cinema, noted for her technical precision, nuanced emotional depth, command of dialects, and professional longevity. Streep is an alumna of Vassar College and the Yale School of Drama, holding a Bachelor of Arts and a Master of Fine Arts. Her artistic process often includes refining her characters' dialogue so that their motivations possess a psychological depth and agency that transcend traditional archetypes. Beyond her creative work, she is a prominent advocate for gender parity, labor protections, and challenging the influence of the male gaze in film criticism and production.
extract_id: Mary Louise "Meryl" Streep adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Secara luas dianggap oleh rekan sejawat dan kritikus sebagai aktris terbesar di generasinya, dan oleh banyak orang dengan epitaph penuh kasih "Greatest of All Time", dia diakui sebagai salah satu pemeran paling serbaguna di sinema, dikenal karena presisi teknisnya, kedalaman emosional yang bernuansa, penguasaan dialek, dan masa profesional yang panjang. Streep adalah alumni Vassar College dan Yale School of Drama, memegang gelar Bachelor of Arts dan Master of Fine Arts. Proses artistiknya sering melibatkan penyempurnaan dialog karakternya sehingga motivasi mereka memiliki kedalaman psikologis dan agensi yang melampaui arketipe tradisional. Di luar karya kreatifnya, dia adalah advokat terkemuka untuk kesetaraan gender, perlindungan tenaga kerja, dan menantang pengaruh pandangan laki-laki dalam kritik dan produksi film.

name: Mia Farrow
title: Mia Farrow
extract: Maria de Lourdes Villiers "Mia" Farrow is an American actress and activist. She first gained notice for her role as Allison MacKenzie in the prime-time television soap opera Peyton Place and gained further recognition for her subsequent short-lived marriage to Frank Sinatra. She achieved her career breakthrough and international acclaim as the titular character Rosemary in Roman Polanski's psychological horror film Rosemary's Baby (1968), receiving nominations for a BAFTA Award and a Golden Globe Award for Best Actress. She went on to appear in several films throughout the 1970s, such as Follow Me! (1972), The Great Gatsby (1974), and Death on the Nile (1978). Her younger sister is Prudence Farrow.

name: Michael Berryman
title: Michael Berryman
extract: Michael John Berryman is an American character actor. He first came to prominence for his roles in Miloš Forman's One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest (1975) and Wes Craven's The Hills Have Eyes (1977). He has appeared in a wide range of feature films and television series, including Star Trek, The X-Files, and Highway to Heaven, in which he portrayed Satan.

Dia tampil dalam berbagai film fitur dan serial televisi, termasuk Star Trek, The X-Files, dan Highway to Heaven, di mana dia memerankan Satan.

name: Michael Caine
title: Michael Caine
extract: Sir Michael Caine is an English retired actor. Known for his distinctive Cockney accent, he has appeared in more than 130 films over a career that spanned eight decades and is considered a British cultural icon. He has received numerous awards including two Academy Awards, a BAFTA Award, three Golden Globe Awards, and a Screen Actors Guild Award. As of 2017, the films in which Caine has appeared have grossed over $7.8 billion worldwide. Caine is one of only five male actors to be nominated for an Academy Award for acting in five different decades. In 2000, he received a BAFTA Fellowship and was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II.

Pada tahun 2000, dia menerima BAFTA Fellowship dan dianugerahi gelar kebangsawanan oleh Ratu Elizabeth II.

title: Michael Murphy (actor)
extract: Michael George Murphy is an American actor. Dia sering memerankan karakter yang tidak etis atau moralnya ambigu dalam posisi berkuasa, termasuk eksekutif, politikus, diplomat, agen penegak hukum, pengacara, hakim, komandan militer, akademisi, dokter, dan rohaniawan. Dia juga dikenal karena kolaborasinya yang sering dengan sutradara Robert Altman, telah tampil dalam dua belas produksi film dan televisi yang disutradarai oleh Altman antara 1963 dan 2004, termasuk peran utama dalam miniseri kabel HBO Tanner '88.

name: Michael Nyqvist
title: Michael Nyqvist
extract: Rolf Åke Mikael Nyqvist was a Swedish actor. Educated at the Malmö Theatre Academy, he rose to prominence domestically for playing police officer John Banck in Beck (1997-1998) and for his leading role in the 2002 film Grabben i graven bredvid.
extract_id: Rolf Åke Mikael Nyqvist adalah aktor Swedia. Dia belajar di Malmö Theatre Academy dan menjadi terkenal secara domestik karena memerankan polisi John Banck dalam Beck (1997-1998) dan untuk peran utama dalam film 2002 Grabben i graven bredvid.

name: Michael Palin
title: Michael Palin
extract: Sir Michael Edward Palin is an English actor, writer and television presenter. He was a member of the Monty Python comedy group. He received the BAFTA Fellowship in 2013 and was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 2019.
extract_id: Sir Michael Edward Palin adalah aktor, penulis, dan presenter televisi Inggris. Dia adalah anggota kelompok komedi Monty Python. Dia menerima BAFTA Fellowship pada tahun 2013 dan ditahbiskan oleh Ratu Elizabeth II pada tahun 2019.

name: Michael Peña
title: Michael Peña
extract: Michael Peña is an American actor. He has starred in many films, including Crash (2004), World Trade Center (2006), Shooter (2007), Observe and Report (2009), Tower Heist (2011), Battle: Los Angeles (2011), End of Watch (2012), and Gangster Squad (2013). He has also acted in films such as American Hustle (2013), The Martian (2015), Ant-Man (2015) and its sequel Ant-Man and the Wasp (2018), and Extinction (2018). Peña had the title role in Cesar Chavez (2014), played DEA agent Kiki Camarena in season one of the Netflix series Narcos: Mexico (2018), and CIA agent Domingo Chavez in season 4 of the Prime Video series Jack Ryan (2023). He also starred in A Million Miles Away (2023).
extract_id: Michael Peña adalah aktor Amerika. Dia telah membintangi banyak film, termasuk Crash (2004), World Trade Center (2006), Shooter (2007), Observe and Report (2009), Tower Heist (2011), Battle: Los Angeles (2011), End of Watch (2012), dan Gangster Squad (2013). Dia juga berperan dalam film seperti American Hustle (2013), The Martian (2015), Ant-Man (2015) dan sekuelnya Ant-Man and the Wasp (2018), serta Extinction (2018). Peña memerankan peran utama dalam Cesar Chavez (2014), berperan sebagai agen DEA Kiki Camarena di musim pertama seri Netflix Narcos: Mexico (2018), dan agen CIA Domingo Chavez dalam musim 4 seri Prime Video Jack Ryan (2023). Dia juga membintangi A Million Miles Away (2023).

name: Michael Powell
title: Michael Powell
extract: Michael Latham Powell was an English filmmaker. He is celebrated for his partnership with Emeric Pressburger and through their production company, The Archers, they together wrote, produced and directed a series of classic British films, notably The Life and Death of Colonel Blimp (1943), A Canterbury Tale (1944), I Know Where I'm Going! (1945), A Matter of Life and Death, Black Narcissus (1947), The Red Shoes (1948), and The Tales of Hoffmann (1951).
extract_id: Michael Latham Powell adalah pembuat film Inggris. Dia dikenal karena kemitraannya dengan Emeric Pressburger dan melalui perusahaan produksi mereka, The Archers, mereka bersama-sama menulis, memproduksi, dan menyutradarai serangkaian film klasik Inggris, terutama The Life and Death of Colonel Blimp (1943), A Canterbury Tale (1944), I Know Where I'm Going! (1945), A Matter of Life and Death, Black Narcissus (1947), The Red Shoes (1948), dan The Tales of Hoffmann (1951).

name: Michael Preston
title: Michael Preston
extract: Michael Preston was an English-born singer and television and film character actor who worked in his native United Kingdom, Australia, and the United States. He is sometimes credited as Mike Preston.
extract_id: Michael Preston adalah penyanyi kelahiran Inggris serta aktor karakter televisi dan film yang bekerja di Inggris, Australia, dan Amerika Serikat. Dia terkadang dikreditkan sebagai Mike Preston.

name: Michael Radford
title: Michael Radford
extract: Michael James Radford is an English film director and screenwriter. He began his career as a documentary director and television comedy writer before transitioning into features in the early 1980s.
extract_id: Michael James Radford adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario Inggris. Dia memulai karir sebagai sutradara dokumenter dan penulis komedi televisi sebelum beralih ke film fitur pada awal 1980-an.

name: Michael Redgrave
title: Michael Redgrave
extract: Sir Michael Scudamore Redgrave was an English actor and filmmaker. Beginning his career in theatre, he first appeared in the West End in 1937. He made his film debut in Alfred Hitchcock's The Lady Vanishes in 1938. He and his contemporaries John Gielgud, Laurence Olivier and Ralph Richardson made up a quartet of male actors who dominated the British stage of the mid-20th century.
extract_id: Sir Michael Scudamore Redgrave adalah aktor dan pembuat film Inggris. Memulai karir di teater, dia pertama kali tampil di West End pada tahun 1937. Dia membuat debut filmnya dalam The Lady Vanishes karya Alfred Hitchcock pada tahun 1938. Dia dan rekan-rekannya John Gielgud, Laurence Olivier, dan Ralph Richardson membentuk kuartet aktor pria yang mendominasi panggung Inggris pada pertengahan abad ke-20.

name: Michael Rennie
title: Michael Rennie
extract: Michael Rennie was a British film, television and stage actor, who had leading roles in a number of Hollywood films, including his portrayal of the space visitor Klaatu in the science fiction film The Day the Earth Stood Still (1951). In a career spanning more than 30 years, Rennie appeared in more than 50 films and in several American television series.
extract_id: Michael Rennie adalah aktor film, televisi, dan panggung Britania yang memiliki peran utama dalam sejumlah film Hollywood, termasuk perannya sebagai pengunjung luar angkasa Klaatu dalam film fiksi ilmiah The Day the Earth Stood Still (1951). Dalam karirnya yang berlangsung lebih dari 30 tahun, Rennie tampil dalam lebih dari 50 film dan beberapa seri televisi Amerika.

name: Michael Sheen
title: Michael Sheen
extract: Michael Christopher Sheen is a Welsh actor and presenter. After training at London's Royal Academy of Dramatic Art (RADA), he worked mainly in theatre throughout the 1990s with stage roles in Romeo and Juliet (1992), Don't Fool with Love (1993), Peer Gynt (1994), The Seagull (1995), The Homecoming (1997), and Henry V (1997). He received Olivier Awards nominations for his performances in Amadeus (1998) at the Old Vic, Look Back in Anger (1999) at the National Theatre and Caligula (2003) at the Donmar Warehouse.
extract_id: Michael Christopher Sheen adalah aktor dan presenter Wales. Setelah berlatih di Royal Academy of Dramatic Art (RADA) London, dia bekerja terutama di teater sepanjang 1990-an dengan peran panggung dalam Romeo and Juliet (1992), Don't Fool with Love (1993), Peer Gynt (1994), The Seagull (1995), The Homecoming (1997), dan Henry V (1997). Dia menerima nominasi Olivier Awards untuk penampilannya dalam Amadeus (1998) di Old Vic, Look Back in Anger (1999) di National Theatre dan Caligula (2003) di Donmar Warehouse.

name: Michael Strong
title: Michael Strong
extract: Michael Strong was an American stage, film and television actor.
extract_id: Michael Strong adalah aktor panggung, film, dan televisi Amerika.

name: Michael Stuhlbarg
title: Michael Stuhlbarg
extract: Michael Stuhlbarg is an American actor. Known for his character roles on stage and screen, he has received numerous accolades, including a Drama Desk Award, an Obie Award, and two Screen Actors Guild Awards, in addition to nominations for two Tony Awards, two Emmy Awards, and a Golden Globe Award.
extract_id: Michael Stuhlbarg adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal karena peran karakternya di panggung dan layar, dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Drama Desk Award, Obie Award, dan dua Screen Actors Guild Awards, serta nominasi untuk dua Tony Awards, dua Emmy Awards, dan satu Golden Globe Award.

name: Michael York
title: Michael York
extract: Michael York, OBE is an English actor. After performing on stage with the Royal National Theatre, he had a breakthrough in films by playing Tybalt in Franco Zeffirelli's Romeo and Juliet (1968). He played leading roles in several major British and Hollywood films, especially in the 1970s.
extract_id: Michael York, OBE adalah aktor Inggris. Setelah tampil di panggung Royal National Theatre, dia meraih kesuksesan dalam film dengan memerankan Tybalt dalam Romeo and Juliet karya Franco Zeffirelli (1968). Dia memerankan peran utama dalam beberapa film besar Inggris dan Hollywood, khususnya pada tahun 1970-an.

name: Michel Auclair
title: Michel Auclair
extract: Michel Auclair was an actor of Serbian and French ancestry, known best for his roles in French cinema.
extract_id: Michel Auclair adalah seorang aktor keturunan Serbia dan Perancis, dikenal terutama untuk perannya dalam sinema Perancis.

name: Michel Côté
title: Michel Côté (actor)
extract: Michel Côté was a Canadian actor from Quebec. He is known for his performances in the films Cruising Bar, Life After Love and C.R.A.Z.Y., the theatrical show Broue and the television series Omertà.
extract_id: Michel Côté adalah seorang aktor Kanada dari Quebec. Ia dikenal untuk penampilannya dalam film Cruising Bar, Life After Love dan C.R.A.Z.Y., pertunjukan teater Broue dan serial televisi Omertà.

name: Michel Gondry
title: Michel Gondry
extract: Michel Gondry is a French filmmaker and producer. He is known for directing the 2004 film Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind, which he co-wrote with Charlie Kaufman, winning an Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay. His other films include the music documentary Dave Chappelle's Block Party (2005), the surrealistic science fantasy comedy The Science of Sleep (2006), the comedy Be Kind Rewind (2008), the superhero comedy The Green Hornet (2011), the drama The We and the I (2012), and the romantic science fantasy tragedy Mood Indigo (2013).
extract_id: Michel Gondry adalah pembuat film dan produser Perancis. Ia dikenal karena menyutradarai film tahun 2004 Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind, yang ditulis bersama Charlie Kaufman, memenangkan Academy Award untuk Skenario Asli Terbaik. Film-film lainnya termasuk dokumenter musik Dave Chappelle's Block Party (2005), komedi fantasi ilmiah surealis The Science of Sleep (2006), komedi Be Kind Rewind (2008), komedi superhero The Green Hornet (2011), drama The We and the I (2012), dan tragedi romantis fantasi ilmiah Mood Indigo (2013).

name: Michel Hazanavicius
title: Michel Hazanavicius
extract: Michel Hazanavicius is a French film director, screenwriter, editor, and producer. He is best known for his 2011 film, The Artist, that won the Best Picture and the Best Director at the 84th Academy Awards. He also directed spy film parodies OSS 117: Cairo, Nest of Spies (2006) and OSS 117: Lost in Rio (2009).
extract_id: Michel Hazanavicius adalah sutradara film, penulis naskah, editor, dan produser Perancis. Ia paling dikenal untuk film tahun 2011, The Artist, yang memenangkan Film Terbaik dan Sutradara Terbaik di Academy Awards ke-84. Ia juga menyutradarai parodi film mata-mata OSS 117: Cairo, Nest of Spies (2006) dan OSS 117: Lost in Rio (2009).

name: Michel Piccoli
title: Michel Piccoli
extract: Jacques Daniel Michel Piccoli was a French actor, producer and film director with a career spanning 70 years. He was lauded as one of the greatest French character actors of his generation who played a wide variety of roles and worked with many acclaimed directors, being awarded with a Best Actor Award at the Cannes Film Festival and a Silver Bear for Best Actor at the Berlin Film Festival.
extract_id: Jacques Daniel Michel Piccoli adalah aktor, produser, dan sutradara film Perancis dengan karier selama 70 tahun. Ia dipuji sebagai salah satu aktor karakter Perancis terbesar dari generasinya yang memerankan berbagai macam peran dan bekerja dengan banyak sutradara ternama, dianugerahi Penghargaan Aktor Terbaik di Festival Film Cannes dan Silver Bear untuk Aktor Terbaik di Festival Film Berlin.

name: Michel Robin
title: Michel Robin
extract: Michel Robin was a French film, stage, and television actor. A sociétaire of the Comédie-Française since 1996, he also appeared in 120 films from 1966 to 2018. He won several awards for his acting, including the Moliere Award for Best Supporting Actor and the Grand Jury Prize winner at the Locarno Festival in 1979.
extract_id: Michel Robin adalah aktor film, panggung, dan televisi Perancis. Seorang anggota Comédie-Française sejak 1996, ia juga tampil dalam 120 film dari tahun 1966 hingga 2018. Ia memenangkan beberapa penghargaan untuk aktingnya, termasuk Penghargaan Moliere untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dan Grand Jury Prize di Festival Locarno tahun 1979.

name: Michelangelo Antonioni
title: Michelangelo Antonioni
extract: Michelangelo Antonioni was an Italian film director, screenwriter, and editor. He is best known for a trio of films often dubbed the "alienation trilogy": L'Avventura (1960), La Notte (1961), and L'Eclisse (1962); the English-language film Blowup (1966); and the multilingual The Passenger (1975). His films have been described as "enigmatic and intricate mood pieces" that feature striking visual composition, subdued narratives, and a preoccupation with modern landscapes. His work substantially influenced subsequent world art cinema, including the slow cinema movement.
extract_id: Michelangelo Antonioni adalah sutradara film, penulis naskah, dan editor Italia. Ia paling dikenal untuk trilogi film yang sering disebut "trilogi alienasi": L'Avventura (1960), La Notte (1961), dan L'Eclisse (1962); film berbahasa Inggris Blowup (1966); dan film multibahasa The Passenger (1975). Film-filmnya digambarkan sebagai "karya suasana yang penuh teka-teki dan rumit" yang menampilkan komposisi visual mencolok, narasi yang meredam, dan ketertarikan pada lanskap modern. Karyanya sangat memengaruhi sinema seni dunia berikutnya, termasuk gerakan sinema lambat.

name: Michelle Dockery
title: Michelle Dockery
extract: Michelle Suzanne Dockery is an English actress, best known for starring as Lady Mary Crawley in the ITV television period drama series Downton Abbey (2010–2015), for which she was nominated for a Golden Globe Award and three consecutive Primetime Emmy Awards for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series. She reprised her role in the films Downton Abbey (2019), Downton Abbey: A New Era (2022) and Downton Abbey: The Grand Finale (2025).
extract_id: Michelle Suzanne Dockery adalah seorang aktris Inggris, paling dikenal karena berperan sebagai Lady Mary Crawley dalam serial drama televisi periode ITV Downton Abbey (2010–2015), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award dan tiga Primetime Emmy Awards berturut-turut untuk Aktris Utama Terbaik dalam Serial Drama. Ia mengulangi perannya dalam film Downton Abbey (2019), Downton Abbey: A New Era (2022) dan Downton Abbey: The Grand Finale (2025).

name: Michelle Monaghan
title: Michelle Monaghan
extract: Michelle Lynn Monaghan is an American actress. She has starred in the films Kiss Kiss Bang Bang (2005), Gone Baby Gone (2007), Made of Honor (2008), Eagle Eye (2008), Trucker (2008), Source Code (2011), Pixels (2015) and Patriots Day (2016). She also received recognition for her role in the action spy film series Mission: Impossible, making appearances in Mission: Impossible III (2006), Ghost Protocol (2011) and Fallout (2018).
extract_id: Michelle Lynn Monaghan adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Ia membintangi film Kiss Kiss Bang Bang (2005), Gone Baby Gone (2007), Made of Honor (2008), Eagle Eye (2008), Trucker (2008), Source Code (2011), Pixels (2015) dan Patriots Day (2016). Ia juga mendapatkan pengakuan untuk perannya dalam seri film mata-mata aksi Mission: Impossible, dengan penampilan di Mission: Impossible III (2006), Ghost Protocol (2011) dan Fallout (2018).

name: Michelle Pfeiffer
title: Michelle Pfeiffer
extract: Michelle Marie Pfeiffer is an American actress and producer. One of Hollywood's most bankable stars of the 1980s and 1990s, her work has earned her numerous accolades, including a BAFTA Award and a Golden Globe, in addition to nominations for three Academy Awards and three Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Michelle Marie Pfeiffer adalah seorang aktris dan produser Amerika. Salah satu bintang paling laris Hollywood pada 1980-an dan 1990-an, karyanya telah memberinya banyak penghargaan, termasuk BAFTA Award dan Golden Globe, serta nominasi untuk tiga Academy Awards dan tiga Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Michelle Reis
title: Michele Reis
extract: Michele Monique Reis, often misspelled Michelle, is a Macau and Hong Kong former actress, model and beauty pageant titleholder. In 1988, she won the Miss Chinese International Pageant and Miss Hong Kong beauty pageants. Afterwards, she became a prominent actress in 1990s Hong Kong, often appearing in introspective and independent fare rather than mainstream releases.
extract_id: Michele Monique Reis, yang sering salah eja menjadi Michelle, adalah mantan aktris, model, dan pemegang gelar kecantikan Macau dan Hong Kong. Pada tahun 1988, ia memenangkan kontes Miss Chinese International dan Miss Hong Kong. Setelah itu, ia menjadi aktris terkemuka di Hong Kong pada 1990-an, sering tampil dalam karya introspektif dan independen daripada rilisan utama.

name: Michelle Rodriguez
title: Michelle Rodriguez
extract: Mayte Michelle Rodríguez is an American actress. She began her career in 2000, playing a troubled boxer in the independent sports drama film Girlfight (2000), where she won the Independent Spirit Award and Gotham Award for Best Debut Performance. Rodriguez played Letty Ortiz in the Fast & Furious franchise and Rain Ocampo in the Resident Evil franchise. She has starred in the crime thriller S.W.A.T. (2003), James Cameron's science fiction epic Avatar (2009), and in the action film Battle: Los Angeles (2011).
extract_id: Mayte Michelle Rodríguez adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Ia memulai kariernya pada tahun 2000, berperan sebagai petinju bermasalah dalam film drama olahraga independen Girlfight (2000), yang membuatnya memenangkan Independent Spirit Award dan Gotham Award untuk Penampilan Debut Terbaik. Rodríguez memerankan Letty Ortiz dalam franchise Fast & Furious dan Rain Ocampo dalam franchise Resident Evil. Ia juga membintangi thriller kriminal S.W.A.T. (2003), epik fiksi ilmiah James Cameron Avatar (2009), dan film aksi Battle: Los Angeles (2011).

name: Michelle Williams
title: Michelle Williams (actress)
extract: Michelle Ingrid Williams is an American actress. Known primarily for starring in small-scale independent films with dark or tragic themes, she has received various accolades, including three Golden Globe Awards, two Actor Awards and a Primetime Emmy Award, in addition to nominations for five Academy Awards, four BAFTA Awards and a Tony Award.
extract_id: Michelle Ingrid Williams adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Terkenal terutama karena membintangi film-film independen kecil dengan tema gelap atau tragis, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk tiga Golden Globe Awards, dua Actor Awards dan satu Primetime Emmy Award, serta nominasi untuk lima Academy Awards, empat BAFTA Awards, dan satu Tony Award.

name: Michelle Yeoh
title: Michelle Yeoh
extract: Michelle Yeoh Choo Kheng is a Malaysian actress. In a career spanning over four decades, she has acted in film and television productions covering a wide range of genres and received various accolades, including an Academy Award and a Golden Globe Award, along with nominations for two British Academy Film Awards. Credited as Michelle Khan in her early films, she rose to fame in the 1980s and 1990s after starring in Hong Kong action and martial arts films where she performed her own stunts. These roles included Yes, Madam (1985), Magnificent Warriors (1987), Police Story 3: Supercop (1992), The Heroic Trio and Tai Chi Master, and Wing Chun (1994).
extract_id: Michelle Yeoh Choo Kheng adalah seorang aktris Malaysia. Dalam karier yang berlangsung lebih dari empat dekade, ia telah berakting dalam produksi film dan televisi yang mencakup berbagai genre dan menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award dan Golden Globe Award, bersama nominasi untuk dua British Academy Film Awards. Dikenal sebagai Michelle Khan dalam film-film awalnya, ia dikenal luas pada 1980-an dan 1990-an setelah membintangi film aksi dan seni bela diri Hong Kong di mana ia melakukan aksinya sendiri. Peran-peran itu termasuk Yes, Madam (1985), Magnificent Warriors (1987), Police Story 3: Supercop (1992), The Heroic Trio dan Tai Chi Master, serta Wing Chun (1994).

name: Mick Lally
title: Mick Lally
extract: Michael Lally was an Irish stage, film, and television actor. He left a teaching career for acting during the 1970s. Though best known in Ireland for his role as Miley Byrne in the television soap Glenroe, Lally's stage career spanned several decades, and he was involved in feature films such as Alexander and the Academy Award-nominated The Secret of Kells. He died in August 2010 of emphysema. Many reports cited him as one of Ireland's finest and most recognisable actors.
extract_id: Michael Lally adalah aktor panggung, film, dan televisi Irlandia. Ia meninggalkan karier mengajar untuk menjadi aktor pada 1970-an. Meskipun paling dikenal di Irlandia sebagai Miley Byrne dalam sinetron televisi Glenroe, karier panggungnya berlangsung selama beberapa dekade, dan ia terlibat dalam film fitur seperti Alexander dan The Secret of Kells yang dinominasikan Academy Award. Ia meninggal pada Agustus 2010 karena emfisema. Banyak laporan menyebutnya sebagai salah satu aktor terbaik dan paling dikenal di Irlandia.

name: Mickey Rourke
title: Mickey Rourke
extract: Philip Andre "Mickey" Rourke Jr. is an American actor who has appeared primarily as a leading man in drama, action, and thriller films. In a film career spanning more than forty years, films in which he has appeared have grossed over $1.9 billion worldwide.
extract_id: Philip Andre "Mickey" Rourke Jr. adalah aktor Amerika yang sebagian besar tampil sebagai pemeran utama dalam film drama, aksi, dan thriller. Dalam karier film yang berlangsung lebih dari empat puluh tahun, film-film yang dibintanginya menghasilkan lebih dari $1,9 miliar di seluruh dunia.

name: Mikael Håfström
title: Mikael Håfström
extract: Jan Mikael Håfström is a Swedish film director and screenwriter. His films include the 2003 film Evil, and the movie adaptation of Stephen King's short story 1408.
extract_id: Jan Mikael Håfström adalah sutradara dan penulis naskah film Swedia. Film-filmnya termasuk film tahun 2003 Evil, dan adaptasi film dari cerita pendek Stephen King 1408.

name: Mikael Persbrandt
title: Mikael Persbrandt
extract: Mikael Åke Persbrandt is a Swedish actor. In Swedish films, he is perhaps best known for playing Gunvald Larsson in the Beck series of movies. He is internationally known for his starring role in the Academy Award-winning feature, In a Better World, directed by Susanne Bier. His performance earned him a 2011 European Film Award nomination for Best Actor. Other parts include the role of Carl Hamilton from the novels by Jan Guillou, Beorn in The Hobbit, as well as Jakob Nyman in the English TV series Sex Education.
extract_id: Mikael Åke Persbrandt adalah aktor Swedia. Dalam film Swedia, ia mungkin paling dikenal karena memerankan Gunvald Larsson dalam seri film Beck. Ia dikenal secara internasional untuk peran utamanya dalam film pemenang Academy Award, In a Better World, yang disutradarai Susanne Bier. Penampilannya membuatnya mendapatkan nominasi European Film Award untuk Aktor Terbaik tahun 2011. Peran lainnya termasuk Carl Hamilton dari novel oleh Jan Guillou, Beorn dalam The Hobbit, serta Jakob Nyman dalam serial TV berbahasa Inggris Sex Education.

name: Mike Judge
title: Mike Judge
extract: Michael Craig Judge is an American actor, animator, writer, producer, and director. He is the creator of the animated television series Beavis and Butt-Head, and co-created the television series King of the Hill, The Goode Family (2009), Silicon Valley (2014–2019), and Mike Judge Presents: Tales from the Tour Bus (2017–2018). He wrote and directed the films Beavis and Butt-Head Do America (1996), Office Space (1999), Idiocracy (2006), and Extract (2009), and co-wrote the screenplay to Beavis and Butt-Head Do the Universe (2022).
extract_id: Michael Craig Judge adalah aktor, animator, penulis, produser, dan sutradara Amerika. Ia adalah pencipta serial televisi animasi Beavis and Butt-Head, dan juga menciptakan bersama serial televisi King of the Hill, The Goode Family (2009), Silicon Valley (2014–2019), dan Mike Judge Presents: Tales from the Tour Bus (2017–2018). Ia menulis dan menyutradarai film Beavis and Butt-Head Do America (1996), Office Space (1999), Idiocracy (2006), dan Extract (2009), serta menulis bersama skenario Beavis and Butt-Head Do the Universe (2022).

name: Mike Leigh
title: Mike Leigh
extract: Mike Leigh is an English screenwriter, producer, director and former actor with a film, theatre, and television career spanning more than 60 years. His accolades include prizes at the Cannes Film Festival, the Berlin International Film Festival, and the Venice International Film Festival, three BAFTA Awards, and nominations for seven Academy Awards. He also received the BAFTA Fellowship in 2014, and was appointed an Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) in the 1993 Birthday Honours for services to the film industry.
extract_id: Mike Leigh adalah penulis naskah, produser, sutradara, dan mantan aktor Inggris dengan karier film, teater, dan televisi yang berlangsung lebih dari 60 tahun. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk hadiah di Festival Film Cannes, Festival Film Internasional Berlin, dan Festival Film Internasional Venesia, tiga BAFTA Awards, dan nominasi tujuh Academy Awards. Ia juga menerima BAFTA Fellowship pada 2014, dan diangkat sebagai Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) dalam Birthday Honours 1993 untuk jasa di industri film.

name: Mike Myers
title: Mike Myers
description: Canadian-American actor, comedian, filmmaker, musician, and singer (born 1963)
extract: Michael John Myers is a Canadian and American actor, comedian, filmmaker, musician, and singer. His accolades include seven MTV Movie & TV Awards, a Primetime Emmy Award, and a Screen Actors Guild Award. In 2002, he was awarded a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. In 2017, he was named an Officer of the Order of Canada for his "extensive and acclaimed body of comedic work as an actor, writer, and producer".
extract_id: Michael John Myers adalah aktor, komedian, pembuat film, musisi, dan penyanyi Kanada dan Amerika. Penghargaan yang dimilikinya termasuk tujuh MTV Movie & TV Awards, sebuah Primetime Emmy Award, dan Screen Actors Guild Award. Pada 2002, ia dianugerahi bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame. Pada 2017, ia dinobatkan sebagai Officer of the Order of Canada untuk "badan karya komedi yang luas dan sangat diapresiasi sebagai aktor, penulis, dan produser".

name: Mike Newell
title: Mike Newell (director)
extract: Michael Cormac Newell is an English director and producer of film and television. He won BAFTA Awards for Best Direction and Best Film for Four Weddings and a Funeral (1994). His other films include Dance with a Stranger (1985), Enchanted April (1991), Donnie Brasco (1997), Mona Lisa Smile (2003), Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire (2005), Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time (2010), and Great Expectations (2012).
extract_id: Michael Cormac Newell adalah sutradara dan produser Inggris film dan televisi. Ia memenangkan BAFTA Awards untuk Sutradara Terbaik dan Film Terbaik untuk Four Weddings and a Funeral (1994). Film-film lain yang ia sutradarai termasuk Dance with a Stranger (1985), Enchanted April (1991), Donnie Brasco (1997), Mona Lisa Smile (2003), Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire (2005), Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time (2010), dan Great Expectations (2012).

name: Mike Nichols
title: Mike Nichols
extract: Mike Nichols was an American film and theatre director and comedian. He worked across a range of genres and had an aptitude for getting the best out of actors regardless of their experience. He is one of 28 people to have won all four of the major American entertainment awards: Emmy, Grammy, Oscar, and Tony (EGOT). His other honors included three BAFTA Awards, the Lincoln Center Gala Tribute in 1999, the National Medal of Arts in 2001, the Kennedy Center Honors in 2003 and the AFI Life Achievement Award in 2010. His films received a total of 42 Academy Award nominations, and seven wins.
extract_id: Mike Nichols adalah sutradara film dan teater Amerika serta komedian. Ia bekerja melintasi berbagai genre dan memiliki kemampuan untuk mendapatkan hasil terbaik dari para aktor terlepas dari pengalaman mereka. Ia adalah salah satu dari 28 orang yang telah memenangkan keempat penghargaan utama hiburan Amerika: Emmy, Grammy, Oscar, dan Tony (EGOT). Penghargaan lainnya termasuk tiga BAFTA Awards, Lincoln Center Gala Tribute tahun 1999, National Medal of Arts tahun 2001, Kennedy Center Honors tahun 2003, dan AFI Life Achievement Award tahun 2010. Film-filmnya menerima total 42 nominasi Academy Award, dan tujuh kemenangan.

name: Mike Vitar
title: Mike Vitar
extract: Michael Anthony Vitar is an American former actor who appeared as Benjamin Franklin "Benny the Jet" Rodriguez in The Sandlot (1993) and Luis Mendoza in the final two Mighty Ducks films. He started acting as a teenager when a casting manager spotted him in line for a ride at a school carnival. Vitar retired from acting after 1997.
extract_id: Michael Anthony Vitar adalah mantan aktor Amerika yang tampil sebagai Benjamin Franklin "Benny the Jet" Rodriguez dalam The Sandlot (1993) dan Luis Mendoza dalam dua film final Mighty Ducks. Ia mulai berakting ketika masih remaja saat manajer casting melihatnya sedang antre untuk naik wahana di karnaval sekolah. Vitar pensiun dari dunia akting setelah 1997.

name: Miki Imai
title: Miki Imai (singer)
extract: Miki Imai is a female Japanese pop singer and actress. She won the award for best newcomer at the 8th Yokohama Film Festival for Inuji ni Seshi Mono.
extract_id: Miki Imai adalah penyanyi pop dan aktris wanita Jepang. Ia memenangkan penghargaan pendatang baru terbaik di Yokohama Film Festival ke-8 untuk Inuji ni Seshi Mono.

name: Mikkel Boe Følsgaard
title: Mikkel Boe Følsgaard
extract: Mikkel Boe Følsgaard is a Danish actor. He graduated from the Danish National School of Performing Arts and has appeared in films and television series such as A Royal Affair (2012), The Legacy (2014–2017), Summer of '92 (2015), Land of Mine (2015), Walk with Me (2016), A Perfectly Normal Family (2020), The Chestnut Man (2021–2026), and Borgen (2022). He played Gérard de Villefort in the English-language series The Count of Monte Cristo (2024). He has received several awards for his performances, including the Bodil and Robert awards, and became the first Danish actor to win the Silver Bear for Best Actor at the Berlin International Film Festival.
extract_id: Mikkel Boe Følsgaard adalah aktor Denmark. Ia lulus dari Danish National School of Performing Arts dan telah tampil dalam film serta serial televisi seperti A Royal Affair (2012), The Legacy (2014–2017), Summer of '92 (2015), Land of Mine (2015), Walk with Me (2016), A Perfectly Normal Family (2020), The Chestnut Man (2021–2026), dan Borgen (2022). Ia memerankan Gérard de Villefort dalam serial berbahasa Inggris The Count of Monte Cristo (2024). Ia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan atas penampilannya, termasuk penghargaan Bodil dan Robert, dan menjadi aktor Denmark pertama yang memenangkan Silver Bear untuk Aktor Terbaik di Festival Film Internasional Berlin.

name: Mila Kunis
title: Mila Kunis
extract: Milena Markovna "Mila" Kunis is an American actress. Born in Chernivtsi, Ukrainian SSR, Soviet Union, and raised in Los Angeles, she began acting with minor television roles in the early 1990s. She starred as Jackie Burkhart on That '70s Show from 1998 to 2006 and has voiced Meg Griffin on Family Guy since 1999.
extract_id: Milena Markovna "Mila" Kunis adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Lahir di Chernivtsi, SSR Ukraina, Uni Soviet, dan dibesarkan di Los Angeles, ia memulai karier akting dengan peran-peran televisi kecil pada awal 1990-an. Ia berperan sebagai Jackie Burkhart di That '70s Show dari 1998 hingga 2006 dan telah menjadi pengisi suara Meg Griffin di Family Guy sejak 1999.

name: Mila Parély
title: Mila Parély
extract: Mila Parély, born Olga Colette Peszynski, was a French actress of Polish ancestry best known for the roles of Félicie, Belle's eldest sister, in Jean Cocteau's La Belle et la Bête (1946), and as Geneviève in La Règle du jeu (1939).
extract_id: Mila Parély, lahir dengan nama Olga Colette Peszynski, adalah seorang aktris Prancis keturunan Polandia yang paling dikenal melalui peran sebagai Félicie, kakak perempuan tertua Belle, dalam film La Belle et la Bête (1946) karya Jean Cocteau, dan sebagai Geneviève dalam La Règle du jeu (1939).

name: Miles Teller
title: Miles Teller
extract: Miles Teller is an American actor. He made his feature film debut with the independent drama Rabbit Hole (2010), and gained wider recognition for his roles in the coming-of-age film The Spectacular Now (2013) and the Divergent film trilogy (2014–2016). His breakthrough role came in the drama Whiplash (2014), which earned him critical acclaim, and led him to garner a nomination for the BAFTA Rising Star Award.
extract_id: Miles Teller adalah aktor Amerika. Ia memulai debut film panjangnya dengan drama independen Rabbit Hole (2010), dan mendapatkan pengakuan luas lewat perannya dalam film coming-of-age The Spectacular Now (2013) dan trilogi film Divergent (2014–2016). Peran terobosannya datang dalam drama Whiplash (2014), yang memberinya pujian kritis dan membawa nominasi untuk BAFTA Rising Star Award.

name: Milhem Cortaz
title: Milhem Cortaz
extract: Milhem Cortaz is a Brazilian actor.
extract_id: Milhem Cortaz adalah aktor Brasil.

name: Milla Jovovich
title: Milla Jovovich
extract: Milica Bogdanovna Jovović, known professionally as Milla Jovovich, is an American actress and former model. Her starring roles in numerous science fiction and action films led the music channel VH1 to deem her the "reigning queen of kick-butt" in 2006. In 2004, Forbes determined that she was the highest-paid model in the world.
extract_id: Milica Bogdanovna Jovović, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Milla Jovovich, adalah seorang aktris Amerika dan mantan model. Peran utamanya dalam berbagai film fiksi ilmiah dan aksi membuat saluran musik VH1 menobatkannya sebagai "ratu bertarung" pada tahun 2006. Pada tahun 2004, Forbes menentukan bahwa ia adalah model dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia.

name: Milos Forman
title: Miloš Forman
extract: Jan Tomáš "Miloš" Forman was a Czech and American film director, screenwriter, actor, and professor. He rose to fame in his native Czechoslovakia before emigrating to the United States in 1968. Over a career spanning six decades, Forman won two Academy Awards, a BAFTA Award, three Golden Globe Awards, a Golden Bear, a César Award, and the Czech Lion.
extract_id: Jan Tomáš "Miloš" Forman adalah seorang sutradara film, penulis naskah, aktor, dan profesor berkebangsaan Ceko dan Amerika. Ia menjadi terkenal di tanah kelahirannya, Cekoslowakia, sebelum pindah ke Amerika Serikat pada tahun 1968. Dalam kariernya yang berlangsung selama enam dekade, Forman memenangkan dua Academy Awards, satu BAFTA Award, tiga Golden Globe Awards, satu Golden Bear, satu César Award, dan satu Czech Lion.

name: Mina Sadati
title: Mina Sadati
extract: Mina Sadati is an Iranian actress. She is best known for her role as Leila in Loneliness of Leila (2015).
extract_id: Mina Sadati adalah aktris Iran. Ia paling dikenal melalui perannya sebagai Leila dalam Loneliness of Leila (2015).

name: Minami Takayama
title: Minami Takayama
extract: Minami Takayama is a Japanese voice actress, narrator and singer who is currently affiliated with 81 Produce. She is also the main vocalist of Two-Mix and ES CONNEXION when it was active. Her uncle was former New Japan Pro-Wrestling managing director Hisashi Shinma.
extract_id: Minami Takayama adalah pengisi suara, narrator, dan penyanyi Jepang yang saat ini berafiliasi dengan 81 Produce. Ia juga merupakan vokalis utama dari Two-Mix dan ES CONNEXION saat aktif. Pamannya adalah mantan direktur pelaksana New Japan Pro-Wrestling, Hisashi Shinma.

name: Ming-Na Wen
title: Ming-Na Wen
extract: Ming-Na Wen is an American actress and model. She has won multiple awards throughout her career, including an Annie Award and a Saturn Award, in addition to a nomination for a Screen Actors Guild Award. She was honored as a Disney Legend in 2019 and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 2023.
extract_id: Ming-Na Wen adalah aktris dan model Amerika. Ia telah memenangkan berbagai penghargaan sepanjang kariernya, termasuk Annie Award dan Saturn Award, serta mendapatkan nominasi Screen Actors Guild Award. Ia dianugerahi Disney Legend pada 2019 dan memiliki bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada 2023.

name: Minori Terada
title: Minori Terada
extract: Minori Terada was a Japanese actor and voice artist.
extract_id: Minori Terada adalah aktor dan pengisi suara Jepang.

name: Minoru Chiaki
title: Minoru Chiaki
extract: Minoru Chiaki was a Japanese actor who appeared in eleven of Akira Kurosawa's films, including Rashomon, Seven Samurai, Throne of Blood, and The Hidden Fortress. He was also one of Kon Ichikawa's favourite actors.
extract_id: Minoru Chiaki adalah aktor Jepang yang tampil dalam sebelas film karya Akira Kurosawa, termasuk Rashomon, Seven Samurai, Throne of Blood, dan The Hidden Fortress. Ia juga merupakan salah satu aktor favorit Kon Ichikawa.

name: Miori Takimoto
title: Miori Takimoto
extract: Miori Takimoto is a Japanese actress and a former singer. She debuted in 2003 as a singer of the girl group Sweets, where she performed under the name Miori. After Sweets disbanded, she appeared on television as an actress.
extract_id: Miori Takimoto adalah aktris Jepang dan mantan penyanyi. Ia memulai debut pada 2003 sebagai penyanyi grup perempuan Sweets, di mana ia tampil dengan nama Miori. Setelah Sweets bubar, ia tampil di televisi sebagai aktris.

name: Mirai Shida
title: Mirai Shida
extract: Mirai Shida is a Japanese actress. She became recognized after her breakthrough role as Kazumi Kanda in "Joō no Kyōshitsu" leading her to more prominent roles, such as Miki Ichinose in 14-year-old Mother.
extract_id: Mirai Shida adalah aktris Jepang. Ia dikenal setelah peran terobosannya sebagai Kazumi Kanda dalam "Joō no Kyōshitsu" yang membawanya ke peran-peran utama lainnya, seperti Miki Ichinose dalam 14-year-old Mother.

name: Miranda Richardson
title: Miranda Richardson
extract: Miranda Jane Richardson is an English actress. Known for her performances on stage and screen across a wide range of dramatic and comedic roles, she has received numerous accolades, including a British Academy Film Award and two Golden Globes, as well as nominations for two Academy Awards, three British Academy Television Awards, a Laurence Olivier Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Miranda Jane Richardson adalah aktris Inggris. Dikenal atas penampilannya di panggung dan layar dalam berbagai peran dramatis dan komedi, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk British Academy Film Award dan dua Golden Globes, serta nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards, tiga British Academy Television Awards, satu Laurence Olivier Award, dan satu Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Miriam Shor
title: Miriam Shor
extract: Miriam Shor is an American actress. She gained prominence for her performance in the Off-Broadway rock musical Hedwig and the Angry Inch (1998–2000) and in the 2001 film adaptation of the same name. She later starred in a number of short-lived television series, including Swingtown (2008) and GCB (2012).
extract_id: Miriam Shor adalah aktris Amerika. Ia meraih ketenaran melalui penampilannya dalam musikal rock Off-Broadway Hedwig and the Angry Inch (1998–2000) dan dalam film adaptasi tahun 2001 dengan judul yang sama. Ia kemudian membintangi sejumlah serial televisi yang tayang singkat, termasuk Swingtown (2008) dan GCB (2012).

name: Mirjana Jokovic
title: Mirjana Joković
extract: Mirjana Joković is a Serbian film and stage actress, best known for her role as Natalija Zovkov in Emir Kusturica's Underground (1995). She currently is Director of Performance for Acting and an acting teacher in the Theater Faculty of the California Institute of the Arts near Los Angeles.
extract_id: Mirjana Joković adalah aktris film dan panggung Serbia, paling dikenal melalui perannya sebagai Natalija Zovkov dalam film Underground (1995) karya Emir Kusturica. Saat ini ia menjabat sebagai Direktur Performance untuk Acting dan pengajar akting di Fakultas Teater California Institute of the Arts dekat Los Angeles.

name: Misa Uehara
title: Misa Uehara
extract: Misa Uehara was a Japanese actress. She appeared in a few Japanese films from the late 1950s, most notably starring as Princess Yuki in Akira Kurosawa's The Hidden Fortress. Following a brief career, she left acting to raise a family.
extract_id: Misa Uehara adalah aktris Jepang. Ia tampil dalam beberapa film Jepang pada akhir 1950-an, yang paling terkenal adalah sebagai Putri Yuki dalam film The Hidden Fortress karya Akira Kurosawa. Setelah karier singkat, ia meninggalkan dunia akting untuk membesarkan keluarga.

name: Mitchell Ryan
title: Mitchell Ryan
extract: Mitchell Ryan was an American actor and comedian. With six decades of television credits, he is best known for playing Burke Devlin in the 1960s gothic soap opera Dark Shadows, and later for his co-starring role as Greg Montgomery 's father Edward Montgomery on Dharma & Greg. He also played the villainous General Peter McAllister in the 1987 buddy cop action film Lethal Weapon.
extract_id: Mitchell Ryan adalah aktor dan komedian Amerika. Dengan enam dekade kredit televisi, ia paling dikenal memerankan Burke Devlin dalam opera sabun gothic tahun 1960-an Dark Shadows, dan kemudian sebagai ayah Greg Montgomery, Edward Montgomery, dalam Dharma & Greg. Ia juga berperan sebagai jenderal Peter McAllister yang jahat dalam film aksi buddy cop tahun 1987, Lethal Weapon.

name: Mitchell Whitfield
title: Mitchell Whitfield
extract: Mitchell Whitfield is an American actor. He is best known for his roles as Barry Farber in Friends (1994–2000), Dr. Bruce Hampton in Minor Adjustments (1995–1996), and Stan Rothenstein in My Cousin Vinny (1992). He is also known for voice roles including Donatello in the 2007 film TMNT, Prince Phobos in W.I.T.C.H., and Fixit in Transformers: Robots in Disguise.
extract_id: Mitchell Whitfield adalah aktor Amerika. Ia paling dikenal lewat perannya sebagai Barry Farber di Friends (1994–2000), Dr. Bruce Hampton di Minor Adjustments (1995–1996), dan Stan Rothenstein di My Cousin Vinny (1992). Ia juga dikenal lewat peran suara termasuk Donatello di film TMNT 2007, Prince Phobos di W.I.T.C.H., dan Fixit di Transformers: Robots in Disguise.

name: Mithun Chakraborty
title: Mithun Chakraborty
extract: Mithun Chakraborty is an Indian actor, film producer, entrepreneur and politician. In a career spanning over five decades, he has done 350 films, mostly in Hindi and Bengali languages, and a few in Bhojpuri, Telugu, Odia, Tamil, Kannada, and Punjabi. Referred to as "Mahaguru", he is a former Rajya Sabha Member of Parliament. He is the recipient of three National Film Awards and four Filmfare Awards. In January 2024, Chakraborty was awarded the Padma Bhushan, the third-highest civilian honour by the Government of India. He was also awarded India's highest accolade in the field of cinema, the Dadasaheb Phalke Award for the year 2022, whose announcement came from the Union Ministry of Information and Broadcasting in September 2024.
extract_id: Mithun Chakraborty adalah aktor India, produser film, pengusaha, dan politikus. Dalam karier yang berlangsung lebih dari lima dekade, ia telah membintangi 350 film, kebanyakan dalam bahasa Hindi dan Bengali, serta beberapa dalam Bhojpuri, Telugu, Odia, Tamil, Kannada, dan Punjabi. Dijuluki "Mahaguru", ia adalah mantan anggota Parlemen Rajya Sabha. Ia menerima tiga Penghargaan Film Nasional dan empat Penghargaan Filmfare. Pada Januari 2024, Chakraborty dianugerahi Padma Bhushan, penghargaan sipil tertinggi ketiga oleh Pemerintah India. Ia juga menerima penghargaan tertinggi India dalam bidang perfilman, Dadasaheb Phalke Award untuk tahun 2022, yang diumumkan oleh Kementerian Informasi dan Penyiaran pada September 2024.

name: Mitsuo Iwata
title: Mitsuo Iwata
extract: Mitsuo Iwata is a Japanese actor, voice actor, and singer who was born in Tokorozawa, Saitama. He is previously married to voice actress Rikako Aikawa. Mania.com praised him as "truly one of the greatest seiyuu". Otakunews.com complimented him for the role of Tetsuya from Outlanders. Mania.com comments on his role of Kintaro Oe that he "practiced months before hand [sic], to the point of going hoarse from overwork, to perfect Kintaro's voice" and "there's no one who could replace him for this role". He is also known for the role of Kaneda in the 1988 anime film Akira and won the 7th Seiyu Awards for Best Personality in 2013. He was previously affiliated with Office Osawa and Across Entertainment, but is currently affiliated with Aoni Production.
extract_id: Mitsuo Iwata adalah aktor, pengisi suara, dan penyanyi Jepang yang lahir di Tokorozawa, Saitama. Ia pernah menikah dengan pengisi suara Rikako Aikawa. Mania.com memuji dia sebagai "benar-benar salah satu seiyuu terbaik". Otakunews.com memuji perannya sebagai Tetsuya dari Outlanders. Mania.com berkomentar tentang perannya sebagai Kintaro Oe bahwa ia "berlatih berbulan-bulan sebelumnya sampai suara serak akibat kerja keras, untuk menyempurnakan suara Kintaro" dan "tidak ada yang bisa menggantikannya dalam peran ini". Ia juga dikenal melalui peran Kaneda dalam film anime Akira tahun 1988 dan memenangkan Seiyu Awards ke-7 untuk Kepribadian Terbaik pada 2013. Ia sebelumnya berafiliasi dengan Office Osawa dan Across Entertainment, tetapi saat ini berafiliasi dengan Aoni Production.

name: Miyu Irino
title: Miyu Irino
extract: Miyu Irino is a Japanese actor, voice actor and singer.
extract_id: Miyu Irino adalah aktor, pengisi suara, dan penyanyi Jepang.

name: Mohammad Amir Naji
title: Reza Naji
extract: Mohamad Reza Amir Naji is an Iranian theatre, film and TV actor and an iconic figure of Iranian cinema.
extract_id: Mohamad Reza Amir Naji adalah aktor teater, film, dan TV Iran serta sosok ikonik dalam perfilman Iran.

name: Mohanlal
title: Mohanlal
description: Indian actor, producer, and playback singer (born 1960)
extract: Mohanlal Viswanathan, known mononymously as Mohanlal, is an Indian actor, producer, and playback singer who predominantly works in Malayalam cinema and has also occasionally appeared in Tamil, Hindi, Telugu and Kannada films. Mohanlal has a prolific career spanning over four decades, during which he has acted in more than 400 films. The Government of India honoured him with Padma Shri in 2001 and Padma Bhushan in 2019, India's fourth and third highest civilian honours, for his contributions to Indian cinema. In 2009, he became the first actor in India to be awarded the honorary rank of lieutenant colonel in the Territorial Army. Mohanlal was named as one of "the men who changed the face of the Indian Cinema" by CNN. In 2025, the Government of India honoured him with the Dadasaheb Phalke Award, the highest award in the field of Indian cinema, for his "outstanding contribution to the growth and development of Indian cinema."
extract_id: Mohanlal Viswanathan, dikenal dengan nama tunggal Mohanlal, adalah aktor, produser, dan penyanyi playback India yang sebagian besar bekerja dalam perfilman Malayalam dan juga sesekali tampil dalam film Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, dan Kannada. Mohanlal memiliki karier produktif lebih dari empat dekade, di mana ia telah berakting dalam lebih dari 400 film. Pemerintah India menghormatinya dengan Padma Shri pada 2001 dan Padma Bhushan pada 2019, penghargaan sipil tertinggi keempat dan ketiga di India, atas kontribusinya terhadap perfilman India. Pada 2009, ia menjadi aktor pertama di India yang dianugerahi pangkat kehormatan letnan kolonel di Territorial Army. Mohanlal dinobatkan sebagai salah satu "pria yang mengubah wajah perfilman India" oleh CNN. Pada 2025, Pemerintah India menganugerahkan kepadanya Dadasaheb Phalke Award, penghargaan tertinggi di bidang perfilman India, untuk "kontribusi luar biasa dalam pertumbuhan dan pengembangan perfilman India."

name: Mohit Raina
title: Mohit Raina
extract: Mohit Raina is an Indian actor who appears in Hindi films and television. He started his acting career with a science fiction show Antariksh (2004) and later went on to play a role in Don Muthu Swami (2008). He is best known for the lead role of the Hindu god Shiva in the television series Devon Ke Dev – Mahadev and Mahabharat, prior to which he is known for the roles as lead in Chehra, Ganga Kii Dheej and supporting role in Bandini.
extract_id: Mohit Raina adalah seorang aktor India yang tampil dalam film dan televisi Hindi. Dia memulai karier aktingnya dengan sebuah acara fiksi ilmiah Antariksh (2004) dan kemudian memainkan peran dalam Don Muthu Swami (2008). Dia paling dikenal untuk peran utama sebagai dewa Hindu Shiva dalam serial televisi Devon Ke Dev – Mahadev dan Mahabharat, sebelumnya dia dikenal untuk peran utama dalam Chehra, Ganga Kii Dheej dan peran pendukung dalam Bandini.

name: Moira Shearer
title: Moira Shearer
extract: Moira Shearer King, Lady Kennedy was a Scottish ballet dancer and actress. She was famous for her performances in Powell and Pressburger's The Red Shoes (1948) and The Tales of Hoffman (1951), and Michael Powell's Peeping Tom (1960).
extract_id: Moira Shearer King, Lady Kennedy adalah seorang penari balet dan aktris Skotlandia. Dia terkenal karena penampilannya dalam film Powell dan Pressburger The Red Shoes (1948) dan The Tales of Hoffman (1951), serta Peeping Tom karya Michael Powell (1960).

name: Molly Picon
title: Molly Picon
extract: Molly Picon was an American actress of stage, screen, radio and television. She was also a lyricist and dramatic storyteller.
extract_id: Molly Picon adalah seorang aktris Amerika yang berperan di panggung, layar, radio, dan televisi. Dia juga seorang penulis lirik dan pendongeng dramatis.

name: Molly Ringwald
title: Molly Ringwald
extract: Molly Kathleen Ringwald is an American actress, writer, and translator. She began her career as a child actress on the sitcoms Diff'rent Strokes and The Facts of Life before being nominated for a Golden Globe Award for her starring role in the drama film Tempest (1982). Ringwald became a teen idol following her lead roles in filmmaker John Hughes's teenage films Sixteen Candles (1984), The Breakfast Club (1985), and Pretty in Pink (1986). These films led to the media referring to her as a member of a group of actors known as the "Brat Pack."
extract_id: Molly Kathleen Ringwald adalah seorang aktris, penulis, dan penerjemah Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya sebagai aktris cilik dalam sitkom Diff'rent Strokes dan The Facts of Life sebelum dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award atas peran utamanya dalam film drama Tempest (1982). Ringwald menjadi idola remaja setelah peran utamanya dalam film remaja karya sutradara John Hughes Sixteen Candles (1984), The Breakfast Club (1985), dan Pretty in Pink (1986). Film-film ini membuat media menyebutnya sebagai anggota kelompok aktor yang dikenal sebagai "Brat Pack."

name: Mona Singh
title: Mona Singh
extract: Mona Singh is an Indian actress who works in Hindi films and series. Singh is recognised for her role in the soap opera Jassi Jaissi Koi Nahin (2003–2006). She is the recipient of two ITA Awards and one Filmfare OTT Award.
extract_id: Mona Singh adalah seorang aktris India yang bekerja dalam film dan serial Hindi. Singh dikenal untuk perannya dalam sinetron Jassi Jaissi Koi Nahin (2003–2006). Dia menerima dua ITA Awards dan satu Filmfare OTT Award.

name: Mone Kamishiraishi
title: Mone Kamishiraishi
extract: Mone Kamishiraishi is a Japanese actress, voice actress, television personality, and singer. She is the older sister of actress Moka Kamishiraishi.
extract_id: Mone Kamishiraishi adalah seorang aktris Jepang, pengisi suara, tokoh televisi, dan penyanyi. Dia adalah kakak perempuan dari aktris Moka Kamishiraishi.

name: Monica Vitti
title: Monica Vitti
extract: Maria Luisa Ceciarelli, known professionally as Monica Vitti, was an Italian actress who starred in several award-winning films directed by Michelangelo Antonioni during the 1960s. She appeared with Marcello Mastroianni, Alain Delon, Richard Harris, Terence Stamp, and Dirk Bogarde. On her death, Italian culture minister Dario Franceschini called her "the Queen of Italian cinema".
extract_id: Maria Luisa Ceciarelli, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Monica Vitti, adalah seorang aktris Italia yang membintangi beberapa film pemenang penghargaan yang disutradarai oleh Michelangelo Antonioni selama tahun 1960-an. Dia tampil bersama Marcello Mastroianni, Alain Delon, Richard Harris, Terence Stamp, dan Dirk Bogarde. Saat meninggal, menteri kebudayaan Italia Dario Franceschini menyebutnya sebagai "Ratu sinema Italia."

name: Montgomery Clift
title: Montgomery Clift
extract: Edward Montgomery Clift was an American actor. A four-time Academy Award nominee, he was known for his portrayal of "moody, sensitive young men", according to The New York Times.
extract_id: Edward Montgomery Clift adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Empat kali dinominasikan untuk Academy Award, ia dikenal karena penggambaran "pria muda yang moody dan sensitif", menurut The New York Times.

name: Moon So-Ri
title: Moon So-ri
extract: Moon So-ri is a South Korean actress and filmmaker. She began her career on stage as part of the theater company Hangang and made her feature film debut in Lee Chang-dong's Peppermint Candy (1999). Moon gained international recognition for the romantic drama Oasis (2002), which earned her the Marcello Mastroianni Award at the 59th Venice International Film Festival, making her the second South Korean recipient.
extract_id: Moon So-ri adalah seorang aktris dan pembuat film Korea Selatan. Dia memulai kariernya di panggung sebagai bagian dari perusahaan teater Hangang dan membuat debut film fitur dalam Peppermint Candy karya Lee Chang-dong (1999). Moon memperoleh pengakuan internasional untuk drama romantis Oasis (2002), yang memberinya Marcello Mastroianni Award di Festival Film Internasional Venesia ke-59, menjadikannya penerima kedua asal Korea Selatan.

name: Morena Baccarin
title: Morena Baccarin
extract: Morena Silva de Vaz Setta Baccarin is a Brazilian-American actress. Known for her lead role as Mickey Fox in the CBS television series Sheriff Country since 2025, Baccarin has played multiple television and film roles. She portrayed Adria in season 10 of the TV series Stargate SG-1, Inara Serra in the sci-fi television series Firefly (2002–2003) and its follow-up film Serenity (2005), Vanessa in the superhero comedy films Deadpool (2016), Deadpool 2 (2018), and Deadpool & Wolverine (2024), Jessica Brody in the thriller series Homeland (2011–2013), and Leslie Thompkins in the superhero series Gotham (2015–2019). For Homeland, Baccarin was nominated for the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Drama Series in 2013. Born in Brazil, she immigrated to the United States as a child.
extract_id: Morena Silva de Vaz Setta Baccarin adalah seorang aktris Brasil-Amerika. Dikenal untuk peran utama sebagai Mickey Fox dalam serial televisi CBS Sheriff Country sejak 2025, Baccarin telah memainkan berbagai peran dalam televisi dan film. Dia memerankan Adria di musim 10 serial TV Stargate SG-1, Inara Serra dalam serial fiksi ilmiah Firefly (2002–2003) dan film lanjutan Serenity (2005), Vanessa dalam film komedi superhero Deadpool (2016), Deadpool 2 (2018), dan Deadpool & Wolverine (2024), Jessica Brody dalam seri thriller Homeland (2011–2013), dan Leslie Thompkins dalam serial superhero Gotham (2015–2019). Untuk Homeland, Baccarin dinominasikan untuk Primetime Emmy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik dalam Seri Drama pada 2013. Lahir di Brasil, ia pindah ke Amerika Serikat saat masih kecil.

name: Morgan Freeman
title: Morgan Freeman
extract: Morgan Freeman is an American actor, producer, and narrator. In a career spanning six decades, he has received numerous accolades, including an Academy Award and a Golden Globe Award, as well as a nomination for a Grammy Award and a Tony Award. He was honored with the Kennedy Center Honor in 2008, an AFI Life Achievement Award in 2011, the Cecil B. DeMille Award in 2012, and Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award in 2018. In a 2022 readers' poll by Empire, he was voted one of the 50 greatest actors of all time.
extract_id: Morgan Freeman adalah aktor, produser, dan narator Amerika. Dalam karier yang berlangsung selama enam dekade, ia telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award dan Golden Globe Award, serta nominasi Grammy Award dan Tony Award. Dia dianugerahi Kennedy Center Honor pada 2008, penghargaan AFI Life Achievement Award pada 2011, Cecil B. DeMille Award pada 2012, dan Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award pada 2018. Dalam jajak pendapat pembaca Empire pada 2022, dia dipilih sebagai salah satu dari 50 aktor terbesar sepanjang masa.

name: Moritz Bleibtreu
title: Moritz Bleibtreu
extract: Moritz Johann Bleibtreu (German: [ˈmoːʁɪts ˈblaɪptʁɔʏ] is a German film actor, voice actor, and film director. After coming to prominence with his role in the 1997 gangster film Knockin' on Heaven's Door, he went on to appear in films such as Run Lola Run, Das Experiment, The Baader Meinhof Complex, and Elementary Particles.
extract_id: Moritz Johann Bleibtreu (Jerman: [ˈmoːʁɪts ˈblaɪptʁɔʏ]) adalah aktor film, pengisi suara, dan sutradara film asal Jerman. Setelah dikenal melalui perannya dalam film gangster tahun 1997 Knockin' on Heaven's Door, ia kemudian tampil dalam film seperti Run Lola Run, Das Experiment, The Baader Meinhof Complex, dan Elementary Particles.

name: Morten Tyldum
title: Morten Tyldum
extract: Morten Tyldum is a Norwegian film director. He is best known in his native Norway for directing the thriller film Headhunters (2011), based on the novel by Jo Nesbø, and internationally for directing the historical drama The Imitation Game (2014), for which he was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Director, and the science fiction drama Passengers (2016).
extract_id: Morten Tyldum adalah sutradara film Norwegia. Dia paling dikenal di negaranya sebagai sutradara film thriller Headhunters (2011), yang didasarkan pada novel karya Jo Nesbø, dan secara internasional untuk mengarahkan drama sejarah The Imitation Game (2014), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award Sutradara Terbaik, serta drama fiksi ilmiah Passengers (2016).

name: Moustapha Akkad
title: Moustapha Akkad
extract: Moustapha al Akkad was a Syrian-American film producer and director, best known for producing the original series of Halloween films and directing The Message and Lion of the Desert. He was killed along with his daughter Rima Al Akkad Monla in the 2005 Amman bombings. He is also the cousin of television personality star Tareq Salahi.
extract_id: Moustapha al Akkad adalah produser dan sutradara film Suriah-Amerika, terkenal karena memproduksi seri film Halloween asli dan menyutradarai The Message dan Lion of the Desert. Dia tewas bersama putrinya Rima Al Akkad Monla dalam pemboman Amman 2005. Dia juga merupakan sepupu dari bintang tokoh televisi Tareq Salahi.

name: Muhammet Uzuner
title: Muhammet Uzuner
extract: Muhammet Uzuner is a Turkish actor. He is best known for his performance as Doctor Cemal in Once Upon a Time in Anatolia.
extract_id: Muhammet Uzuner adalah aktor Turki. Ia paling dikenal atas penampilannya sebagai Doctor Cemal dalam Once Upon a Time in Anatolia.

name: Mukesh Chhabra
title: Mukesh Chhabra
extract: Mukesh Chhabra is an Indian casting director, filmmaker and actor. Some of his notable works include Bajrangi Bhaijan (2015), Bombay Velvet (2015), Dangal (2016), Dil Bechara (2020), Scam 1992 (2020), Laal Singh Chaddha (2022), Commando (2023), Jawan (2023), Dunki (2023), Chamak (2023), Kafas (2023), Dhurandhar (2025) and Dhurandhar: The Revenge (2026).
extract_id: Mukesh Chhabra adalah seorang casting director, pembuat film, dan aktor India. Beberapa karya terkenalnya meliputi Bajrangi Bhaijan (2015), Bombay Velvet (2015), Dangal (2016), Dil Bechara (2020), Scam 1992 (2020), Laal Singh Chaddha (2022), Commando (2023), Jawan (2023), Dunki (2023), Chamak (2023), Kafas (2023), Dhurandhar (2025) dan Dhurandhar: The Revenge (2026).

name: Myrna Loy
title: Myrna Loy
extract: Myrna Loy was an American film, television, and stage actress. As a performer, she was known for her ability to adapt to her screen partner's acting style.
extract_id: Myrna Loy adalah seorang aktris film, televisi, dan panggung Amerika. Sebagai seorang pemeran, dia dikenal karena kemampuannya beradaptasi dengan gaya akting pasangan mainnya.

name: Mélanie Laurent
title: Mélanie Laurent
extract: Mélanie Laurent is a French actress, filmmaker, and singer. She has received two César Awards and a Lumière Award. Internationally, Laurent is known for her roles in Inglourious Basterds (2009), Now You See Me (2013), Operation Finale (2018) 6 Underground (2019) and Fauda season 5 (2026)
extract_id: Mélanie Laurent adalah seorang aktris, pembuat film, dan penyanyi Prancis. Dia telah menerima dua César Awards dan satu Lumière Award. Secara internasional, Laurent dikenal karena perannya dalam Inglourious Basterds (2009), Now You See Me (2013), Operation Finale (2018), 6 Underground (2019), dan Fauda musim 5 (2026).

name: Mélanie Thierry
title: Mélanie Thierry
extract: Mélanie Thierry is a French actress, model, film director, and screenwriter.
extract_id: Mélanie Thierry adalah seorang aktris, model, sutradara film, dan penulis skenario Prancis.

name: Mélissa Désormeaux-Poulin
title: Mélissa Désormeaux-Poulin
extract: Mélissa Désormeaux-Poulin, is a French Canadian actress.
extract_id: Mélissa Désormeaux-Poulin adalah seorang aktris Kanada Prancis.

name: Mía Maestro
title: Mía Maestro
extract: Mía Maestro is an Argentine actress and singer. She is known for her roles as Nora Martinez on The Strain, as Nadia Santos on the television drama Alias, as Cristina Kahlo in Frida, as Chichina Ferreyra in The Motorcycle Diaries, and as Carmen in The Twilight Saga.
extract_id: Mía Maestro adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Argentina. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Nora Martinez dalam The Strain, sebagai Nadia Santos dalam drama televisi Alias, sebagai Cristina Kahlo dalam Frida, sebagai Chichina Ferreyra dalam The Motorcycle Diaries, dan sebagai Carmen dalam The Twilight Saga.

name: Mónica Villa
title: Mónica Villa
extract: Mónica Villa is an Argentine actress of stage, screen, and TV, as well as a researcher and educator. She earned a Best Actress award for her role as "Susana" in cult classic Waiting for the Hearse at the 1985 Festival de Cine Iberoamericano, in Huelva, Spain. She won an ACE Golden award for best leading actress in the 2002 comedy "Ojos traidores", a 2004 Premios Trinidad Guevara for best Actress of a Repertoire Company, a Premios Carlos de Oro for her 2011 performance as best lead actress in the theater production "Jardín De Otoño", and in 2015 a Premios Estrella de Mar for Best Female Performance in a Repertoire Company for "La Nona". In addition, she has been nominated for a Best Actress in a TV Special for the 2003 Premios Martín Fierro, making her acting work recognized in all three major media.
extract_id: Mónica Villa adalah seorang aktris Argentina di panggung, layar, dan televisi, serta seorang peneliti dan pendidik. Dia meraih penghargaan Aktris Terbaik untuk perannya sebagai "Susana" dalam film kultus Waiting for the Hearse pada Festival de Cine Iberoamericano 1985 di Huelva, Spanyol. Dia memenangkan penghargaan ACE Golden untuk aktris utama terbaik dalam komedi "Ojos traidores" (2002), Premios Trinidad Guevara 2004 untuk Aktris Terbaik Perusahaan Repertoar, penghargaan Premios Carlos de Oro untuk penampilannya sebagai aktris utama terbaik dalam produksi teater "Jardín De Otoño" (2011), dan pada 2015 Premios Estrella de Mar untuk Penampilan Wanita Terbaik di Perusahaan Repertoar untuk "La Nona". Selain itu, dia dinominasikan untuk Aktris Terbaik dalam TV Special pada Premios Martín Fierro 2003, sehingga karya aktingnya diakui di ketiga media utama.

name: Nadine Labaki
title: Nadine Labaki
extract: Nadine Labaki is a Lebanese actress, director, and activist. Labaki first came into the spotlight as an actress in the early 2000s. Her filmmaking career began in 2007 after the release of her debut film, Caramel, which premiered at the Cannes Film Festival. She is known for demonstrating everyday aspects of Lebanese life and covering a range of political issues such as war, poverty, and feminism. She is the first female Arab director to be nominated for an Oscar in the category for Best Foreign Language Film for her third directorial effort, Capernaum (2018).
extract_id: Nadine Labaki adalah seorang aktris, sutradara, dan aktivis Lebanon. Labaki pertama kali dikenal sebagai aktris pada awal 2000-an. Karier pembuat filmnya dimulai pada 2007 setelah rilis film debutnya, Caramel, yang tayang perdana di Festival Film Cannes. Dia dikenal karena menggambarkan aspek kehidupan sehari-hari di Lebanon dan membahas berbagai isu politik seperti perang, kemiskinan, dan feminisme. Dia adalah sutradara wanita Arab pertama yang dinominasikan untuk Oscar di kategori Film Berbahasa Asing Terbaik untuk karya sutradara ketiganya, Capernaum (2018).

name: Nakul Roshan Sahdev
title: Nakul Roshan Sahdev
extract: Nakul Roshan Sahdev is an Indian actor and producer who works primarily in Hindi films, web series, and television. He is best known for his roles in the critically acclaimed films Gully Boy (2019) and Pagglait (2021), and the web series Candy (2021), for which he received a nomination at the Indian Television Academy Awards.
extract_id: Nakul Roshan Sahdev adalah aktor dan produser India yang bekerja terutama di film Hindi, serial web, dan televisi. Ia paling dikenal untuk perannya dalam film-film yang mendapat pujian kritis seperti Gully Boy (2019) dan Pagglait (2021), serta serial web Candy (2021), yang membuatnya mendapatkan nominasi di Indian Television Academy Awards.

name: Nanako Matsushima
title: Nanako Matsushima
extract: Nanako Matsushima is a Japanese actress and model. She is best known for starring in the horror film Ring (1998) and the drama series A Story of Love (1997) and I'm Mita, Your Housekeeper. (2011). The latter's final episode reached a viewer rating of 40%, making it one of the highest rated Japanese television dramas of all time.
extract_id: Nanako Matsushima adalah aktris dan model Jepang. Dia paling dikenal karena membintangi film horor Ring (1998) dan serial drama A Story of Love (1997) dan I'm Mita, Your Housekeeper. (2011). Episode terakhir serial terakhir mencapai rating penonton sebesar 40%, menjadikannya salah satu drama televisi Jepang dengan rating tertinggi sepanjang masa.

name: Nancy Kyes
title: Nancy Kyes
extract: Nancy Kyes, known professionally as Nancy Loomis, is an American actress. A frequent collaborator of filmmaker John Carpenter, she portrayed Annie Brackett in Halloween (1978) and also appeared in his films Assault on Precinct 13 (1976) and The Fog (1980). She reprised her role as Annie in Halloween II (1981) and made an appearance as a different character in the stand-alone Halloween III: Season of the Witch (1982), her last film role until Hauntology in 2024.
extract_id: Nancy Kyes, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Nancy Loomis, adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Kolaborator sering pembuat film John Carpenter, ia memerankan Annie Brackett dalam Halloween (1978) dan juga tampil dalam film-filmnya Assault on Precinct 13 (1976) dan The Fog (1980). Ia mengulang perannya sebagai Annie dalam Halloween II (1981) dan tampil sebagai karakter berbeda dalam film mandiri Halloween III: Season of the Witch (1982), peran film terakhirnya hingga Hauntology pada 2024.

name: Nancy Olson
title: Nancy Olson
extract: Nancy Ann Olson is an American retired actress. She made her film debut Canadian Pacific (1949), before gaining prominence as Betty Schaefer in Billy Wilder's Sunset Boulevard (1950), for which she earned a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress. She later co-starred with William Holden in three more films Union Station (1950), Force of Arms (1951), and Submarine Command (1951).
extract_id: Nancy Ann Olson adalah seorang aktris Amerika yang telah pensiun. Ia memulai debut filmnya di Canadian Pacific (1949), sebelum menjadi terkenal sebagai Betty Schaefer dalam Sunset Boulevard (1950) karya Billy Wilder, yang membuatnya mendapat nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik. Dia kemudian menjadi pemeran bersama William Holden dalam tiga film lainnya, Union Station (1950), Force of Arms (1951), dan Submarine Command (1951).

name: Naoko Yamada
title: Naoko Yamada
extract: Naoko Yamada is a Japanese animator and director. Working at Kyoto Animation until 2020, she has directed the anime series K-On! (2009–2010) and Tamako Market (2013), and the anime films A Silent Voice (2016), Liz and the Blue Bird (2018) and The Colors Within (2024). In 2021, she directed the original net animation (ONA) The Heike Story under Science Saru. The series premiered on Japanese television in January 2022.
extract_id: Naoko Yamada adalah animator dan sutradara asal Jepang. Bekerja di Kyoto Animation hingga 2020, dia pernah menyutradarai serial anime K-On! (2009–2010) dan Tamako Market (2013), serta film anime A Silent Voice (2016), Liz and the Blue Bird (2018) dan The Colors Within (2024). Pada 2021, dia menyutradarai original net animation (ONA) The Heike Story di bawah Science Saru. Serial ini tayang perdana di televisi Jepang pada Januari 2022.

name: Naomi Watts
title: Naomi Watts
extract: Naomi Ellen Watts is a British actress. Known for her work in predominantly independent films, she has received various accolades, including an Actor Award, a Critics' Choice Award and two Saturn Awards, as well as nominations for two Academy Awards, a Primetime Emmy Award, and two Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Naomi Ellen Watts adalah aktris Inggris. Dikenal karena karyanya terutama dalam film independen, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Actor Award, Critics' Choice Award, dan dua Saturn Awards, serta nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards, satu Primetime Emmy Award, dan dua Golden Globe Awards.

name: Naomie Harris
title: Naomie Harris
extract: Naomie Melanie Harris is a British actress. She started her career when she was a child, appearing in the television series Simon and the Witch in 1987. In 2016, she starred in the film Moonlight, a performance that earned her a number of accolades, including nominations for the Golden Globe, BAFTA, and Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress. Harris was appointed an Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) in the 2017 New Year Honours for services to drama.
extract_id: Naomie Melanie Harris adalah aktris Inggris. Dia memulai karirnya saat masih anak-anak, tampil dalam serial televisi Simon and the Witch pada 1987. Pada 2016, dia membintangi film Moonlight, sebuah penampilan yang memberinya sejumlah penghargaan, termasuk nominasi Golden Globe, BAFTA, dan Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik. Harris diangkat sebagai Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) dalam Penghargaan Tahun Baru 2017 atas jasanya di bidang drama.

name: Nargis Fakhri
title: Nargis Fakhri
extract: Nargis Fakhri is an American actress and model who primarily works in the Hindi cinema.
extract_id: Nargis Fakhri adalah aktris dan model Amerika yang sebagian besar bekerja di sinema Hindi.

name: Naseeruddin Shah
title: Naseeruddin Shah
extract: Naseeruddin Shah is an Indian actor who works primarily in Hindi films. One of the most prolific actors of Indian cinema, especially in the parallel cinema movement, he has also starred in various international productions. He is the recipient of several accolades, including three National Film Awards, three Filmfare Awards and the Volpi Cup for Best Actor at the Venice Film Festival. The Government of India honoured him with the Padma Shri in 1987 and the Padma Bhushan in 2003 for his contributions to Indian cinema.
extract_id: Naseeruddin Shah adalah aktor India yang sebagian besar bekerja dalam film Hindi. Salah satu aktor paling produktif dalam sinema India, terutama dalam gerakan sinema paralel, ia juga pernah membintangi berbagai produksi internasional. Dia menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk tiga National Film Awards, tiga Filmfare Awards, dan Volpi Cup untuk Aktor Terbaik di Festival Film Venesia. Pemerintah India menghormatinya dengan Padma Shri pada 1987 dan Padma Bhushan pada 2003 atas kontribusinya di sinema India.

name: Nastassja Kinski
title: Nastassja Kinski
extract: Nastassja Aglaia Kinski is a German actress and former model. She has appeared in more than 60 films in Europe and the United States. Her worldwide breakthrough was with Stay as You Are (1978). Kinski then came to global prominence with her Golden Globe Award-winning performance as the title character in the Roman Polanski-directed film Tess (1979). Her other films include the Francis Ford Coppola musical romance film One from the Heart (1982), Paul Schrader's supernatural horror film Cat People (1982), and the Wim Wenders films Paris, Texas (1984) and Faraway, So Close! (1993). She also appeared in the biographical drama film An American Rhapsody (2001). Kinski is the daughter of German actor Klaus Kinski.
extract_id: Nastassja Aglaia Kinski adalah aktris dan mantan model Jerman. Dia telah tampil dalam lebih dari 60 film di Eropa dan Amerika Serikat. Terobosan globalnya terjadi melalui Stay as You Are (1978). Kinski kemudian meraih ketenaran global dengan penampilan pemenang Golden Globe sebagai karakter utama dalam film Tess (1979) yang disutradarai oleh Roman Polanski.
