Film-film lainnya termasuk film musikal romantis karya Francis Ford Coppola, One from the Heart (1982), film horor supernatural Paul Schrader, Cat People (1982), dan film-film Wim Wenders Paris, Texas (1984) dan Faraway, So Close! (1993). Dia juga tampil dalam film drama biografi An American Rhapsody (2001). Kinski adalah putri aktor Jerman Klaus Kinski.

name: Nat Pendleton
title: Nat Pendleton
extract: Nathaniel Greene Pendleton was an American Olympic wrestler, film actor, and stage performer. His younger brother, Edmund J. Pendleton (1899–1987), was a well-known music composer and choir master and organist for the American Church in Paris.
extract_id: Nathaniel Greene Pendleton adalah pegulat Olimpiade Amerika, aktor film, dan pemain panggung. Adik laki-lakinya, Edmund J. Pendleton (1899–1987), adalah seorang komposer musik ternama serta konduktor paduan suara dan organis untuk Gereja Amerika di Paris.

name: Nat Wolff
title: Nat Wolff
extract: Nathaniel Marvin Wolff is an American actor, musician, and singer-songwriter. He initially gained recognition for composing the music for The Naked Brothers Band (2007–2009), a Nickelodeon television series he starred in with his younger brother, Alex, that was created by his actress mother, Polly Draper. Wolff's jazz musician father, Michael Wolff, co-produced the series' soundtrack albums The Naked Brothers Band (2007) and I Don't Want to Go to School (2008), both of which placed the 23rd spot on the Billboard 200 charts.
extract_id: Nathaniel Marvin Wolff adalah aktor, musisi, dan penyanyi-penulis lagu Amerika. Dia awalnya terkenal karena mengomposisi musik untuk The Naked Brothers Band (2007–2009), sebuah serial televisi Nickelodeon yang ia bintangi bersama adik laki-lakinya, Alex, dan dibuat oleh ibunya, Polly Draper, yang seorang aktris. Ayahnya yang merupakan musisi jazz, Michael Wolff, ikut memproduksi album soundtrack serial tersebut, The Naked Brothers Band (2007) dan I Don't Want to Go to School (2008), yang keduanya mencapai posisi ke-23 di tangga lagu Billboard 200.

name: Natalie Dessay
title: Natalie Dessay
extract: Natalie Dessay is a French soprano, best known as an opera singer before her retirement from the opera stage in 2013. She gained wide recognition after her portrayal of Olympia in The Tales of Hoffmann in 1992, and then performing at leading stages, such as the Paris Opera, Vienna State Opera, and the Metropolitan Opera.
extract_id: Natalie Dessay adalah seorang soprano Prancis, paling dikenal sebagai penyanyi opera sebelum pensiun dari panggung opera pada 2013. Dia meraih pengakuan luas setelah memerankan Olympia dalam The Tales of Hoffmann pada 1992, lalu tampil di panggung-panggung utama seperti Paris Opera, Vienna State Opera, dan Metropolitan Opera.

name: Natalie Portman
title: Natalie Portman
extract: Natalie Hershlag, known professionally as Natalie Portman, is an actress and filmmaker with dual Israeli and American citizenship. She has had a screen career from her teenage years and has starred in various blockbusters and independent films. Her accolades include an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, and two Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Natalie Hershlag, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Natalie Portman, adalah aktris dan pembuat film dengan kewarganegaraan ganda Israel dan Amerika. Dia memiliki karir layar lebar sejak masa remaja dan telah membintangi berbagai film blockbuster dan film independen. Penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan dua Golden Globe Awards.

name: Natalie Wood
title: Natalie Wood
extract: Natalie Wood was an American actress. She began acting at age four and co-starred at age eight in Miracle on 34th Street (1947). As a teenager, she was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her performance in Rebel Without a Cause (1955), followed by a role in John Ford's The Searchers (1956).
extract_id: Natalie Wood adalah aktris Amerika. Dia mulai berakting pada usia empat tahun dan tampil bersama pada usia delapan tahun dalam Miracle on 34th Street (1947). Saat remaja, dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam Rebel Without a Cause (1955), diikuti oleh peran dalam The Searchers (1956) karya John Ford.

name: Nataliya Vdovina
title: Natalia Vdovina
extract: Natalia Gennadievna Vdovina is a Russian film and stage actress. She is best known for her performance as mother in The Return. She also won several awards for her performance on stage.
extract_id: Natalia Gennadievna Vdovina adalah aktris film dan panggung Rusia. Dia paling dikenal karena penampilannya sebagai ibu dalam The Return. Dia juga memenangkan beberapa penghargaan untuk penampilannya di panggung.

name: Natalya Bondarchuk
title: Natalya Bondarchuk
extract: Natalya Sergeyevna Bondarchuk is a Soviet and Russian actress and film director, best known for her appearance in Andrei Tarkovsky's Solaris as "Hari". She is the daughter of Soviet director and actor Sergei Bondarchuk and Russian actress Inna Makarova. Her half-brother is film director and actor Fyodor Bondarchuk; her half-sister is actress Yelena Bondarchuk.
extract_id: Natalya Sergeyevna Bondarchuk adalah aktris dan sutradara film Soviet dan Rusia, paling dikenal karena penampilannya dalam Solaris karya Andrei Tarkovsky sebagai "Hari". Dia adalah putri sutradara dan aktor Soviet Sergei Bondarchuk dan aktris Rusia Inna Makarova. Saudara tirinya adalah sutradara film dan aktor Fyodor Bondarchuk; saudari tirinya adalah aktris Yelena Bondarchuk.

name: Nathalie Boltt
title: Nathalie Boltt
extract: Nat Boltt is a South African actress, director and writer, whose debut feature film, Holy Days, which she wrote and directed, was released in 2026. She started out as a writer and actor. She is known for her role in District 9 and as Penelope Blossom for seven seasons on The CW’s teen drama series Riverdale from 2017 to 2023. In 2026, her directorial debut, Holy Days, was released.
extract_id: Nat Boltt adalah aktris, sutradara, dan penulis asal Afrika Selatan, yang film fitur debutnya, Holy Days, yang ia tulis dan sutradarai, dirilis pada 2026. Dia memulai karir sebagai penulis dan aktor. Dia dikenal karena perannya dalam District 9 dan sebagai Penelope Blossom selama tujuh musim di serial drama remaja Riverdale di The CW dari 2017 hingga 2023. Pada 2026, debut sutradaranya, Holy Days, dirilis.

name: Nathalie Delon
title: Nathalie Delon
extract: Nathalie Delon was a French actress, model, film director and writer. In the 1960s, she was regarded as one of the most beautiful women in the world and in the 1970s, she was considered a French sex symbol. She is well known for her first acting role, appearing opposite her husband, actor Alain Delon, in the neo-noir film Le Samouraï directed by Jean-Pierre Melville (1967). She appeared in 30 films and directed two others.
extract_id: Nathalie Delon adalah aktris, model, sutradara film, dan penulis asal Prancis. Pada 1960-an, dia dianggap sebagai salah satu wanita tercantik di dunia dan pada 1970-an, dia dianggap sebagai simbol seks Prancis. Dia dikenal luas karena peran pertamanya sebagai lawan main suaminya, aktor Alain Delon, dalam film neo-noir Le Samouraï yang disutradarai oleh Jean-Pierre Melville (1967). Dia tampil dalam 30 film dan menyutradarai dua lainnya.

name: Nathan Fillion
title: Nathan Fillion
extract: Nathan Fillion is a Canadian-American actor. He played the leading roles, Captain Malcolm "Mal" Reynolds on Firefly and its film continuation Serenity, and Richard Castle on Castle. Beginning in 2018, he has starred as Officer John Nolan on The Rookie. He is also an executive producer on the show, as well as its spin-off series, The Rookie: Feds. He is set to produce an upcoming spin-off, The Rookie: North.
extract_id: Nathan Fillion adalah aktor Kanada-Amerika. Dia memerankan peran utama, Kapten Malcolm "Mal" Reynolds dalam Firefly dan kelanjutannya di film Serenity, serta Richard Castle dalam Castle. Mulai 2018, dia membintangi sebagai Petugas John Nolan dalam The Rookie. Dia juga produser eksekutif dalam acara tersebut, serta seri spin-off-nya, The Rookie: Feds. Dia dijadwalkan menjadi produser spin-off berikutnya, The Rookie: North.

name: Nathan Greno
title: Nathan Greno
extract: Nathan Greno is an American film director, story artist, and writer. He is best known for directing Walt Disney Animation Studios' Tangled (2010) and Skydance Animation's Swapped (2026).
extract_id: Nathan Greno adalah sutradara film, ilustrator cerita, dan penulis Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai Tangled (2010) dari Walt Disney Animation Studios dan Swapped (2026) dari Skydance Animation.

name: Nawazuddin Siddiqui
title: Nawazuddin Siddiqui
extract: Nawazuddin Siddiqui is an Indian actor known for his work in Hindi cinema. He is the recipient of various accolades, including a National Film Award, an IIFA Award, and two Filmfare Awards, as well as a nomination for an International Emmy. After studying acting at the National School of Drama, Siddiqui had minor roles in films such as Sarfarosh (1999), Shool (1999), and Munna Bhai M.B.B.S (2003).
extract_id: Nawazuddin Siddiqui adalah aktor India yang dikenal atas karyanya di sinema Hindi. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk National Film Award, IIFA Award, dan dua Filmfare Awards, serta nominasi International Emmy. Setelah belajar akting di National School of Drama, Siddiqui memiliki peran kecil dalam film-film seperti Sarfarosh (1999), Shool (1999), dan Munna Bhai M.B.B.S (2003).

name: Ned Beatty
title: Ned Beatty
extract: Ned Thomas Beatty was an American actor. In a career that spanned five decades, he appeared in more than 160 film and television roles. Throughout his career, Beatty gained a reputation for being "the busiest actor in Hollywood".
extract_id: Ned Thomas Beatty adalah aktor Amerika. Dalam karir yang meliputi lima dekade, ia tampil dalam lebih dari 160 peran film dan televisi. Sepanjang kariernya, Beatty dikenal sebagai "aktor tersibuk di Hollywood".

name: Neena Gupta
title: Neena Gupta
extract: Neena Gupta is an Indian actress and television director who works in Hindi films and other language films alongside TV series. Gupta has received several awards including three National Film Awards, a Filmfare Award and two Filmfare OTT Awards.
extract_id: Neena Gupta adalah aktris dan sutradara televisi India yang bekerja di film-film Hindi dan film dalam bahasa lain serta serial TV. Gupta telah menerima beberapa penghargaan termasuk tiga National Film Awards, satu Filmfare Award, dan dua Filmfare OTT Awards.

name: Neeraj Kabi
title: Neeraj Kabi
extract: Neeraj Kabi is an Indian film and theatre actor, theatre director, and acting coach known for his works in International films and Hindi cinema, theatre, and television.
extract_id: Neeraj Kabi adalah aktor film dan teater India, sutradara teater, dan pelatih akting yang dikenal atas karyanya dalam film internasional serta sinema Hindi, teater, dan televisi.

name: Neeraj Pandey
title: Neeraj Pandey
extract: Neeraj Pandey is an Indian film director, producer, screenwriter and novelist. He is known for directing and creating thriller, espionage and crime-based films and OTT series and movies including A Wednesday!, Special 26, Baby, M.S. Dhoni: The Untold Story, the Special Ops franchise, The Freelancer, the Khakee franchise and Taskaree. He is the co-founder of Friday Filmworks and Friday Storytellers.
extract_id: Neeraj Pandey adalah sutradara film, produser, penulis skenario, dan novelis India. Ia dikenal dalam mengarahkan dan membuat film serta serial OTT bergenre thriller, spionase, dan kriminal termasuk A Wednesday!, Special 26, Baby, M.S. Dhoni: The Untold Story, waralaba Special Ops, The Freelancer, waralaba Khakee, dan Taskaree. Ia adalah salah satu pendiri Friday Filmworks dan Friday Storytellers.

name: Neil Brown Jr.
title: Neil Brown Jr.
extract: Cornelius C. "Neil" Brown Jr., is an American actor. His notable roles include Felix in South Beach (2006), Guillermo in The Walking Dead (2010), Clifford Danner in Suits (2011–2013), Chad Kerr in Insecure (2016–2021), and Ray Perry in SEAL Team (2017–2024). He also played DJ Yella in the 2015 biopic, Straight Outta Compton.
extract_id: Cornelius C. "Neil" Brown Jr. adalah aktor Amerika. Peran-peran terkenalnya termasuk Felix dalam South Beach (2006), Guillermo dalam The Walking Dead (2010), Clifford Danner dalam Suits (2011–2013), Chad Kerr dalam Insecure (2016–2021), dan Ray Perry dalam SEAL Team (2017–2024). Dia juga berperan sebagai DJ Yella dalam film biografi Straight Outta Compton (2015).

name: Neil Burger
title: Neil Burger
extract: Neil Norman Burger is an American filmmaker. He is known for the fake-documentary Interview with the Assassin (2002), the period drama The Illusionist (2006), Limitless (2011), and the sci-fi action film Divergent (2014).
extract_id: Neil Norman Burger adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika. Ia dikenal karena film dokumenter palsu Interview with the Assassin (2002), drama periode The Illusionist (2006), Limitless (2011), dan film aksi fiksi ilmiah Divergent (2014).

name: Neil Patrick Harris
title: Neil Patrick Harris
extract: Neil Patrick Harris is an American actor, singer, writer, producer, television host, comedian and magician. Primarily known for his comedic television roles and dramatic and musical stage roles, he has received multiple accolades throughout his career, including a Tony Award and five Primetime Emmy Awards, and nominations for a Grammy Award and three Actor Awards.
extract_id: Neil Patrick Harris adalah aktor, penyanyi, penulis, produser, pembawa acara televisi, komedian, dan pesulap Amerika. Terutama dikenal karena peran komedi televisinya serta peran dramatis dan musikal di panggung, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan sepanjang kariernya, termasuk Tony Award dan lima Primetime Emmy Awards, serta nominasi Grammy Award dan tiga Actor Awards.

name: Neill Blomkamp
title: Neill Blomkamp
extract: Neill Blomkamp is a South African-born Canadian film director and screenwriter. He is best known as the co-writer and director of the science fiction action film District 9 (2009), for which he was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Adapted Screenplay. He also directed the dystopian science fiction action film Elysium (2013), the science fiction action film Chappie (2015), and the sports drama film Gran Turismo (2023). He is known for his collaborations with actor Sharlto Copley, who played the lead in District 9.
extract_id: Neill Blomkamp adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film kelahiran Afrika Selatan yang kini berkewarganegaraan Kanada. Ia paling dikenal sebagai co-writer dan sutradara film aksi fiksi ilmiah District 9 (2009), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award for Best Adapted Screenplay. Ia juga menyutradarai film aksi fiksi ilmiah dystopian Elysium (2013), film aksi fiksi ilmiah Chappie (2015), dan film drama olahraga Gran Turismo (2023). Ia dikenal karena kolaborasinya dengan aktor Sharlto Copley, yang memerankan tokoh utama di District 9.

name: Nicholas Hoult
title: Nicholas Hoult
extract: Nicholas Caradoc Hoult is an English actor. His filmography includes work in big-budget mainstream productions and starring roles in independent projects in American and British films. His accolades include nominations for a British Academy Film Award, two Golden Globe Awards, and a Primetime Emmy Award. He was included in Forbes 30 Under 30 in 2012.
extract_id: Nicholas Caradoc Hoult adalah aktor Inggris. Filmografinya mencakup karya dalam produksi mainstream beranggaran besar dan peran utama di proyek independen dalam film Amerika dan Inggris. Penghargaannya mencakup nominasi British Academy Film Award, dua Golden Globe Awards, dan Primetime Emmy Award. Ia masuk dalam Forbes 30 Under 30 pada tahun 2012.

name: Nicholas Meyer
title: Nicholas Meyer
description: American screenwriter, producer, author, and director (born 1945)
extract: Nicholas Meyer is an American screenwriter, director and author known for his best-selling novel The Seven-Per-Cent Solution, and for directing the films Time After Time, two of the Star Trek feature films, the 1983 television film The Day After, and the 1999 HBO original film Vendetta.
extract_id: Nicholas Meyer adalah penulis skenario, sutradara, dan penulis Amerika yang dikenal untuk novel best-seller The Seven-Per-Cent Solution, serta menyutradarai film Time After Time, dua film fitur Star Trek, film televisi tahun 1983 The Day After, dan film asli HBO tahun 1999 Vendetta.

name: Nicholas Ray
title: Nicholas Ray
extract: Nicholas Ray was an American film director, screenwriter, and actor. Considered one of postwar American's most gifted, and ultimately, tragic filmmakers, he often clashed with the Hollywood studio system of the 1940s and 1950s, but would ultimately, influence future generations of filmmakers.
extract_id: Nicholas Ray adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan aktor Amerika. Dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film Amerika pascaperang yang paling berbakat dan tragis, ia sering bentrok dengan sistem studio Hollywood pada 1940-an dan 1950-an, tetapi akhirnya memberikan pengaruh bagi generasi pembuat film berikutnya.

name: Nick Cassavetes
title: Nick Cassavetes
extract: Nicholas David Rowland Cassavetes is an American actor, director, and writer. He has directed such films as She's So Lovely (1997), John Q. (2002), The Notebook (2004), Alpha Dog (2006), and My Sister's Keeper (2009). His acting credits include an uncredited role in Husbands (1970)—which was directed by his father, John Cassavetes—as well as roles in the films The Wraith (1986), Face/Off (1997), and Blow (2001).
extract_id: Nicholas David Rowland Cassavetes adalah aktor, sutradara, dan penulis Amerika. Ia menyutradarai film-film seperti She's So Lovely (1997), John Q. (2002), The Notebook (2004), Alpha Dog (2006), dan My Sister's Keeper (2009). Kredensial aktingnya termasuk peran tanpa kredit dalam Husbands (1970) — yang disutradarai oleh ayahnya, John Cassavetes — serta peran dalam film The Wraith (1986), Face/Off (1997), dan Blow (2001).

name: Nick Frost
title: Nick Frost
extract: Nicholas John "Nick" Frost is an English actor, comedian and screenwriter. He has appeared in the Three Flavours Cornetto trilogy of films, consisting of Shaun of the Dead (2004), Hot Fuzz (2007), and The World's End (2013), and the television comedy Spaced (1999–2001). He also appeared in Joe Cornish's film Attack the Block (2011). He co-starred in the 2011 film Paul, which he co-wrote with friend and frequent collaborator Simon Pegg. He has also portrayed various roles in the sketch show Man Stroke Woman. In 2020, he co-created and starred in the paranormal comedy horror series Truth Seekers with Pegg.
extract_id: Nicholas John "Nick" Frost adalah aktor, komedian, dan penulis skenario Inggris. Ia tampil dalam trilogi film Three Flavours Cornetto, yang terdiri dari Shaun of the Dead (2004), Hot Fuzz (2007), dan The World's End (2013), serta komedi televisi Spaced (1999–2001). Ia juga tampil dalam film Attack the Block (2011) karya Joe Cornish. Ia ikut membintangi film Paul (2011), yang juga ia tulis bersama sahabat dan kolaboratornya Simon Pegg. Ia juga memerankan berbagai peran dalam acara sketch Man Stroke Woman. Pada tahun 2020, ia membuat dan membintangi bersama Pegg seri horor komedi paranormal Truth Seekers.

name: Nick Moran
title: Nick Moran
description: British actor, writer, producer and director
extract: Nick Moran is an English actor and filmmaker. His roles include Eddie the card sharp in Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels (1998) and Scabior in Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 1 (2010) and Part 2 (2011).
extract_id: Nick Moran adalah aktor dan pembuat film Inggris. Perannya termasuk Eddie si penipu kartu dalam Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels (1998) dan Scabior dalam Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 1 (2010) dan Part 2 (2011).

name: Nick Nolte
title: Nick Nolte
extract: Nicholas King Nolte is an American actor. Known for his leading man roles in both dramas and romances, he has received a Golden Globe Award as well as nominations for three Academy Awards and a Primetime Emmy Award. Nolte first came to prominence for his role in the ABC miniseries Rich Man, Poor Man (1976) for which he received a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Limited Series or Movie nomination. He won the Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama for The Prince of Tides (1991). He has received three Academy Award nominations for The Prince of Tides (1991), Affliction (1998), and Warrior (2011).
extract_id: Nicholas King Nolte adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal karena peran utama dalam drama dan roman, ia menerima Golden Globe Award serta nominasi untuk tiga Academy Awards dan Primetime Emmy Award. Nolte pertama kali dikenal lewat perannya dalam mini seri ABC Rich Man, Poor Man (1976) yang memberinya nominasi Primetime Emmy Award untuk Aktor Utama Terbaik dalam Seri atau Film Terbatas. Ia memenangkan Golden Globe Award untuk Aktor Terbaik – Drama Film untuk The Prince of Tides (1991). Ia menerima tiga nominasi Academy Award untuk The Prince of Tides (1991), Affliction (1998), dan Warrior (2011).

name: Nick Offerman
title: Nick Offerman
extract: Nicholas David Offerman is an American actor, comedian, carpenter, and writer. He became known for his role as Ron Swanson in the NBC sitcom Parks and Recreation (2009–2015), for which he received the Television Critics Association Award for Individual Achievement in Comedy and was twice nominated for the Critics' Choice Television Award for Best Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series.
extract_id: Nicholas David Offerman adalah aktor, komedian, tukang kayu, dan penulis Amerika. Ia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Ron Swanson dalam sitkom NBC Parks and Recreation (2009–2015), yang membuatnya menerima Television Critics Association Award untuk Pencapaian Individu dalam Komedi dan dua kali dinominasikan untuk Critics' Choice Television Award sebagai Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam Serial Komedi.

name: Nicolas Bro
title: Nicolas Bro
extract: Nicolas Bro is a Danish actor of stage and screen, and a playwright. He played a German soldier in Steven Spielberg's 2011 film War Horse. On television, he is known for his role as Thomas Buch in the TV series The Killing (2009), as Ditlev Gothardt Monrad in 1864 (2014), and as Freddie in The Bridge (2015). He appears as Folke in the 2025 Netflix series The Asset.
extract_id: Nicolas Bro adalah aktor panggung dan layar Denmark sekaligus penulis drama. Ia memerankan tentara Jerman dalam film War Horse (2011) karya Steven Spielberg. Di televisi, ia dikenal lewat perannya sebagai Thomas Buch dalam serial TV The Killing (2009), Ditlev Gothardt Monrad dalam 1864 (2014), dan Freddie dalam The Bridge (2015). Ia tampil sebagai Folke dalam seri Netflix 2025 The Asset.

name: Nicolas Cage
title: Nicolas Cage
extract: Nicolas Cage is an American actor and film producer. He is the recipient of various accolades, including an Academy Award, a Screen Actors Guild Award, and a Golden Globe Award as well as nominations for two BAFTA Awards. Known for his versatility as an actor, Cage's work across diverse film genres has gained him a significant cult following.
extract_id: Nicolas Cage adalah aktor dan produser film Amerika. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Screen Actors Guild Award, dan Golden Globe Award serta nominasi dua BAFTA Awards. Dikenal karena fleksibilitasnya sebagai aktor, karya Cage dalam berbagai genre film telah membuatnya memiliki pengikut cult yang signifikan.

name: Nicolas Winding Refn
title: Nicolas Winding Refn
extract: Nicolas Winding Refn is a Danish film director, screenwriter, and producer.
extract_id: Nicolas Winding Refn adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser Denmark.

name: Nicole Kidman
title: Nicole Kidman
extract: Nicole Mary Kidman is an Australian and American actress and producer. Known for her work in blockbusters and independent films across many genres, she has consistently ranked among the world's highest-paid actresses since the late 1990s. Her accolades include an Academy Award, an Actor Award, a British Academy Film Award, six Golden Globe Awards, two Primetime Emmy Awards, and a Volpi Cup.
extract_id: Nicole Mary Kidman adalah aktris dan produser Australia dan Amerika. Dikenal karena karyanya dalam film blockbuster dan independen di berbagai genre, ia secara konsisten masuk dalam jajaran aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia sejak akhir 1990-an. Penghargaannya meliputi Academy Award, Actor Award, British Academy Film Award, enam Golden Globe Awards, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan Volpi Cup.

name: Nicoletta Braschi
title: Nicoletta Braschi
extract: Nicoletta Braschi is an Italian actress and producer, best known for her work with her husband, actor and director Roberto Benigni.
extract_id: Nicoletta Braschi adalah aktris dan produser Italia, paling dikenal karena karyanya bersama suaminya, aktor dan sutradara Roberto Benigni.

name: Niels Arden Oplev
title: Niels Arden Oplev
extract: Niels Arden Oplev is a Danish film director and screenwriter.
extract_id: Niels Arden Oplev adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario Denmark.

name: Niels Arestrup
title: Niels Arestrup
description: French-Danish actor, film director and screenwriter (1949–2024)
extract: Niels Arestrup was a French-Danish actor, film director and screenwriter.
extract_id: Niels Arestrup adalah aktor, sutradara film, dan penulis skenario Prancis-Danmark.

name: Nigel Havers
title: Nigel Havers
extract: Nigel Allan Havers is an English actor and presenter. In 1981 he earned a BAFTA nomination for Best Actor in a Supporting Role, for portraying Lord Andrew Lindsay in the British sports film Chariots of Fire (1981). Other credits include A Passage to India (1984), Empire of the Sun (1987), Farewell to the King (1989), Don't Wait Up (1983–1990), Sleepers (1991) Coronation Street, (2009–2019), Brothers & Sisters (2009), Doctor Who spin-off The Sarah Jane Adventures, Downton Abbey (2011), The Life of Rock with Brian Pern (2014), Benidorm (2017), Finding Alice (2021), The Gentlemen (2024), and A Cruel Love: The Ruth Ellis Story (2025).
extract_id: Nigel Allan Havers adalah aktor dan pembawa acara Inggris. Pada tahun 1981 ia mendapatkan nominasi BAFTA untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik, karena memerankan Lord Andrew Lindsay dalam film olahraga Inggris Chariots of Fire (1981). Kredit lainnya termasuk A Passage to India (1984), Empire of the Sun (1987), Farewell to the King (1989), Don't Wait Up (1983–1990), Sleepers (1991), Coronation Street (2009–2019), Brothers & Sisters (2009), spin-off Doctor Who The Sarah Jane Adventures, Downton Abbey (2011), The Life of Rock with Brian Pern (2014), Benidorm (2017), Finding Alice (2021), The Gentlemen (2024), dan A Cruel Love: The Ruth Ellis Story (2025).

name: Nikkhil Advani
title: Nikkhil Advani
extract: Nikkhil Advani is an Indian director, producer and screenwriter who works in Hindi cinema. He along with his sister, Monisha Advani and Madhu Bhojwani, co-founded the entertainment company Emmay Entertainment.
extract_id: Nikkhil Advani adalah sutradara, produser, dan penulis skenario India yang bekerja dalam perfilman Hindi. Bersama saudara perempuannya, Monisha Advani dan Madhu Bhojwani, ia mendirikan perusahaan hiburan Emmay Entertainment.

name: Nikolay Burlyaev
title: Nikolai Burlyayev
extract: Nikolai Petrovich Burlyayev is a Soviet and Russian actor, film director and politician from Moscow. Born into a family of actors, Burlyayev started his career in film and theatre when he was still a child. He is best known for his title role in Andrei Tarkovsky's Ivan's Childhood. He worked with Tarkovsky again four years later, as Boriska in Andrei Rublev.
extract_id: Nikolai Petrovich Burlyayev adalah aktor Soviet dan Rusia, sutradara film, dan politisi dari Moskow. Lahir dalam keluarga aktor, Burlyayev memulai kariernya di film dan teater saat masih anak-anak. Ia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai tokoh utama dalam Ivan's Childhood karya Andrei Tarkovsky. Ia bekerja lagi dengan Tarkovsky empat tahun kemudian sebagai Boriska dalam Andrei Rublev.

name: Nikolay Grinko
title: Nikolai Grinko
extract: Nikolai Grigoryevich Grinko or Mykola Hryhorovych Hrynko was a Soviet actor.
extract_id: Nikolai Grigoryevich Grinko atau Mykola Hryhorovych Hrynko adalah aktor Soviet.

name: Nils Poppe
title: Nils Poppe
extract: Nils Poppe was a Swedish actor, comedian, director, screenwriter and theatre manager. He is internationally most famous for his part in Ingmar Bergman's The Seventh Seal, but in Sweden he was much loved and participated in over 50 films on cinema and TV.
extract_id: Nils Poppe adalah aktor, komedian, sutradara, penulis skenario, dan manajer teater Swedia. Ia paling terkenal secara internasional karena perannya dalam The Seventh Seal karya Ingmar Bergman, tetapi di Swedia ia sangat dicintai dan tampil dalam lebih dari 50 film di bioskop dan TV.

name: Nimrat Kaur
title: Nimrat Kaur
extract: Nimrat Kaur is an Indian actress who appears in Hindi films and in American television. She began her career as a print model and went on to act in theatre. After brief appearances in a few films, Kaur starred in Anurag Kashyap's production Peddlers (2012). She followed it with her breakthrough role in the critically acclaimed drama The Lunchbox (2014).
extract_id: Nimrat Kaur adalah aktris India yang tampil dalam film Hindi dan televisi Amerika. Ia memulai karier sebagai model cetak dan kemudian berakting di teater. Setelah penampilan singkat dalam beberapa film, Kaur membintangi produksi Anurag Kashyap Peddlers (2012). Ia kemudian mendapatkan peran terobosan dalam drama yang dipuji kritis The Lunchbox (2014).

name: Nina Petri
title: Nina Petri
extract: Nina Petri is a German actress. She has appeared in more than one hundred films since 1983.
extract_id: Nina Petri adalah aktris Jerman. Ia telah tampil dalam lebih dari seratus film sejak 1983.

name: Nina van Pallandt
title: Nina van Pallandt
extract: Nina, Baroness van Pallandt is a retired Danish singer and actress.
extract_id: Nina, Baroness van Pallandt adalah penyanyi dan aktris Denmark yang sudah pensiun.

name: Nishikant Kamat
title: Nishikant Kamat
extract: Nishikant Kamat was an Indian filmmaker and actor. His debut film, Dombivali Fast earned him accolades in Marathi cinema, as it went on to become the biggest Marathi film of the year. He remade his film, in Tamil with R. Madhavan in the lead as Evano Oruvan, which opened to rave reviews. He also acted in the Marathi film Saatchya Aat Gharat.
extract_id: Nishikant Kamat adalah pembuat film dan aktor India. Film debutnya, Dombivali Fast memberinya pengakuan dalam sinema Marathi, karena film tersebut menjadi film Marathi terbesar tahun itu. Dia membuat ulang filmnya dalam bahasa Tamil dengan R. Madhavan sebagai pemeran utama berjudul Evano Oruvan, yang mendapat ulasan sangat positif. Dia juga berakting dalam film Marathi Saatchya Aat Gharat.

name: Nitesh Tiwari
title: Nitesh Tiwari
extract: Nitesh Tiwari is an Indian film director, screenwriter, and lyricist known for his works in Hindi films. He debuted as a co-writer and co-director in Chillar Party (2011) which won him two National Film Awards, including Best Children's Film and Best Screenplay. He made his solo directorial debut with the supernatural political drama Bhoothnath Returns (2014).
extract_id: Nitesh Tiwari adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan penulis lirik India yang dikenal melalui karya-karyanya di film Hindi. Dia memulai debutnya sebagai co-writer dan co-director dalam Chillar Party (2011) yang memberinya dua Penghargaan Film Nasional, termasuk Film Anak Terbaik dan Skenario Terbaik. Dia membuat debut solo sebagai sutradara dengan drama politik supranatural Bhoothnath Returns (2014).

name: Noah Baumbach
title: Noah Baumbach
extract: Noah Baumbach is an American filmmaker. He is known for making films set in New York City and his works are inspired by filmmakers such as Woody Allen and Whit Stillman. His frequent collaborators include Wes Anderson, Adam Driver, and his wife, Greta Gerwig. He has received various accolades including a Critics' Choice Awards, two Independent Spirit Awards and three Gotham Awards as well as award nominations for four Academy Awards, two BAFTA Awards and two Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Noah Baumbach adalah pembuat film Amerika. Dia dikenal karena membuat film yang berlatar di New York City dan karyanya terinspirasi oleh pembuat film seperti Woody Allen dan Whit Stillman. Kolaborator seringnya termasuk Wes Anderson, Adam Driver, dan istrinya, Greta Gerwig. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Critics' Choice Awards, dua Independent Spirit Awards dan tiga Gotham Awards serta nominasi penghargaan untuk empat Academy Awards, dua BAFTA Awards dan dua Golden Globe Awards.

name: Noah Emmerich
title: Noah Emmerich
extract: Noah Nicholas Emmerich is an American actor. He is best known for his roles in films such as Beautiful Girls (1996), The Truman Show (1998), Frequency (2000), Miracle (2004), Little Children (2006), and Super 8 (2011). From 2013 to 2018 he starred as FBI agent Stan Beeman on the FX series The Americans, for which he won the Critics' Choice Television Award for Best Supporting Actor in a Drama Series in 2019.
extract_id: Noah Nicholas Emmerich adalah aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya dalam film seperti Beautiful Girls (1996), The Truman Show (1998), Frequency (2000), Miracle (2004), Little Children (2006), dan Super 8 (2011). Dari 2013 hingga 2018 dia berperan sebagai agen FBI Stan Beeman dalam serial FX The Americans, yang memberinya Critics' Choice Television Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam Serial Drama pada 2019.

name: Nobuo Kaneko
title: Nobuo Kaneko
extract: Nobuo Kaneko was a Japanese actor. His wife was actress Yatsuko Tanami. He appeared in more than 200 films between 1946 and 1993.
extract_id: Nobuo Kaneko adalah aktor Jepang. Istrinya adalah aktris Yatsuko Tanami. Dia tampil dalam lebih dari 200 film antara tahun 1946 dan 1993.

name: Noomi Rapace
title: Noomi Rapace
extract: Noomi Rapace is a Swedish actress. She achieved international fame with her portrayal of Lisbeth Salander in the Swedish film adaptations of the Millennium series (2009): The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo, The Girl Who Played with Fire, and The Girl Who Kicked the Hornets' Nest. For her performance in the Millennium series, Rapace won two Nymphe d'Ors, a Guldbagge Award, and a Satellite Award as Best Actress amongst others, and was nominated for a BAFTA Award, an International Emmy Award, a Critics' Choice Movie Award, and a European Film Award. Following the success of the Millennium series, Rapace has gone on to star in many international movies.
extract_id: Noomi Rapace adalah aktris Swedia. Dia mencapai ketenaran internasional melalui perannya sebagai Lisbeth Salander dalam adaptasi film Swedia dari seri Millennium (2009): The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo, The Girl Who Played with Fire, dan The Girl Who Kicked the Hornets' Nest. Untuk penampilannya di seri Millennium, Rapace memenangkan dua Nymphe d'Ors, sebuah Penghargaan Guldbagge, dan Penghargaan Satellite sebagai Aktris Terbaik antara lain, serta dinominasikan untuk BAFTA Award, International Emmy Award, Critics' Choice Movie Award, dan European Film Award. Setelah sukses seri Millennium, Rapace telah membintangi banyak film internasional.

name: Nora Gregor
title: Nora Gregor
extract: Nora Gregor was an Austrian stage and film actress.
extract_id: Nora Gregor adalah aktris panggung dan film Austria.

name: Nora Twomey
title: Nora Twomey
description: Irish animator, director, screenwriter, producer and voice actress
extract: Nora Twomey is an Irish animator, director, screenwriter, producer and voice actress. She is best known as the co-founder of Cartoon Saloon, alongside Tomm Moore and Paul Young, an animation studio and production company, based in Kilkenny City, Ireland. She is best known for co-directing The Secret of Kells and directing The Breadwinner. Her work on both films earned Academy Award nominations for Best Animated Feature.
extract_id: Nora Twomey adalah animator, sutradara, penulis skenario, produser, dan pengisi suara Irlandia. Dia paling dikenal sebagai salah satu pendiri Cartoon Saloon, bersama Tomm Moore dan Paul Young, sebuah studio animasi dan perusahaan produksi yang berbasis di Kilkenny City, Irlandia. Dia terkenal karena menjadi co-director The Secret of Kells dan sutradara The Breadwinner. Karyanya pada kedua film tersebut mendapatkan nominasi Academy Award untuk Film Animasi Terbaik.

name: Nora-Jane Noone
title: Nora-Jane Noone
extract: Nora-Jane Noone is an Irish actress. In 2020, The Irish Times ranked her 47th on its list of the greatest Irish film actors of all time. She made her screen debut in her breakthrough role film The Magdalene Sisters (2002), and has since been nominated three times at the IFTA Film & Drama Awards for her work in 3 films: The Descent (2005), Savage (2009) and Wildfire (2020).
extract_id: Nora-Jane Noone adalah aktris Irlandia. Pada 2020, The Irish Times menempatkannya di posisi ke-47 dalam daftar aktor film Irlandia terbesar sepanjang masa. Dia memulai debut layar lebarnya dalam peran terobosannya di film The Magdalene Sisters (2002), dan sejak itu telah dinominasikan tiga kali pada IFTA Film & Drama Awards untuk karyanya di 3 film: The Descent (2005), Savage (2009) dan Wildfire (2020).

name: Noriko Hidaka
title: Noriko Hidaka
extract: Noriko Itō , better known by the stage name of Noriko Hidaka , is a Japanese actress, voice actress, singer and narrator. She played Minami Asakura in Touch, Akane Tendo in Ranma ½, Satsuki Kusakabe in My Neighbor Totoro, Near in Death Note, Jean Roque Raltique in Nadia: The Secret of Blue Water, Kikyō in Inuyasha,Yuki Tsukumo in Jujutsu Kaisen, Patricia O'Sullivan in Mischievous Twins: The Tales of St. Clare's, Erica Fontaine in Sakura Wars and Masumi Sera in Detective Conan. She is also the dub actress for Jayma Mays in the American TV series Glee, as well as in The Smurfs film series.
extract_id: Noriko Itō, yang lebih dikenal dengan nama panggungnya Noriko Hidaka, adalah aktris, pengisi suara, penyanyi, dan narator Jepang. Dia memerankan Minami Asakura dalam Touch, Akane Tendo dalam Ranma ½, Satsuki Kusakabe dalam My Neighbor Totoro, Near dalam Death Note, Jean Roque Raltique dalam Nadia: The Secret of Blue Water, Kikyō dalam Inuyasha, Yuki Tsukumo dalam Jujutsu Kaisen, Patricia O'Sullivan dalam Mischievous Twins: The Tales of St. Clare's, Erica Fontaine dalam Sakura Wars dan Masumi Sera dalam Detective Conan. Dia juga pengisi suara dubbing untuk Jayma Mays dalam serial TV Amerika Glee, serta dalam seri film The Smurfs.

name: Norma Crane
title: Norma Crane
description: American stage, film and television actress (1928–1973)
extract: Norma Crane was an American actress of stage, film, and television best known for her role as Golde in the 1971 film adaptation of Fiddler on the Roof, a role which earned her a nomination for a Photoplay Award. She also starred in They Call Me Mister Tibbs! and Penelope. Crane was born in New York City, but raised in El Paso, Texas.
extract_id: Norma Crane adalah aktris Amerika dari panggung, film, dan televisi yang paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Golde dalam adaptasi film Fiddler on the Roof tahun 1971, sebuah peran yang memberinya nominasi Photoplay Award. Dia juga membintangi They Call Me Mister Tibbs! dan Penelope. Crane lahir di New York City, tetapi dibesarkan di El Paso, Texas.

name: Norman Jewison
title: Norman Jewison
extract: Norman Frederick Jewison was a Canadian filmmaker. He is known for directing films which addressed topical social and political issues, often making controversial or complicated subjects accessible to mainstream audiences. Among numerous other accolades, he was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Director three times in three separate decades, for In the Heat of the Night (1967), Fiddler on the Roof (1971) and Moonstruck (1987). He was nominated for an additional four Oscars, three Golden Globe Awards and a Primetime Emmy Award, and won a BAFTA Award. He received the Academy of Motion Pictures Arts and Sciences's Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award in 1999.
extract_id: Norman Frederick Jewison adalah pembuat film Kanada. Dia dikenal karena menyutradarai film yang membahas isu sosial dan politik terkini, sering kali membuat subjek yang kontroversial atau rumit dapat diakses oleh audiens mainstream. Di antara berbagai penghargaan lain, ia dinominasikan tiga kali untuk Academy Award sebagai Sutradara Terbaik dalam tiga dekade yang berbeda, untuk In the Heat of the Night (1967), Fiddler on the Roof (1971), dan Moonstruck (1987). Ia juga dinominasikan untuk empat Oscar tambahan, tiga Golden Globe Awards dan Primetime Emmy Award, serta memenangkan BAFTA Award. Ia menerima Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award dari Academy of Motion Pictures Arts and Sciences pada 1999.

name: Norman Reedus
title: Norman Reedus
extract: Norman Mark Reedus is an American actor. Starting his career as a model, he first rose to prominence as an actor for his role as Murphy MacManus in The Boondock Saints (1999), which he reprised in The Boondock Saints II: All Saints Day (2009). Aside from an occasional supporting role in larger budget films such as Blade II (2002) and American Gangster (2007), Reedus mostly starred in independent film productions until being cast as Daryl Dixon in the AMC horror drama series The Walking Dead (2010–2022). Regarded as one of the series' most popular characters, he currently stars as Dixon in the spin-off series The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon (2023–present).
extract_id: Norman Mark Reedus adalah aktor Amerika. Memulai karirnya sebagai model, dia pertama kali dikenal luas sebagai aktor untuk perannya sebagai Murphy MacManus dalam The Boondock Saints (1999), yang ia ulangi dalam The Boondock Saints II: All Saints Day (2009). Selain sesekali tampil dalam peran pendukung di film dengan anggaran lebih besar seperti Blade II (2002) dan American Gangster (2007), Reedus sebagian besar berperan dalam produksi film independen sampai dipilih sebagai Daryl Dixon dalam serial drama horor AMC The Walking Dead (2010–2022). Dianggap sebagai salah satu karakter paling populer dalam seri, ia saat ini membintangi sebagai Dixon dalam serial spin-off The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon (2023–sekarang).

name: Norman Taurog
title: Norman Taurog
extract: Norman Rae Taurog was an American film director and screenwriter. From 1920 to 1968, Taurog directed 180 films. At the age of 32, he received the Academy Award for Best Director for Skippy (1931), becoming the youngest person to win the award for eight and a half decades. He was later nominated for Best Director for the film Boys Town (1938). He directed some of the best-known actors of the twentieth century, including his nephew Jackie Cooper, Spencer Tracy, Mickey Rooney, Judy Garland, Deanna Durbin, Fred Astaire, Gene Kelly, Deborah Kerr, Peter Lawford, Dean Martin, Jerry Lewis, Elvis Presley and Vincent Price. Taurog directed six Martin and Lewis films, and nine Elvis Presley films, more than any other director.
extract_id: Norman Rae Taurog adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario Amerika. Dari 1920 hingga 1968, Taurog menyutradarai 180 film. Pada usia 32 tahun, ia menerima Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik untuk Skippy (1931), menjadi orang termuda yang memenangkan penghargaan tersebut selama delapan setengah dekade. Ia kemudian dinominasikan untuk Sutradara Terbaik untuk film Boys Town (1938). Ia menyutradarai beberapa aktor paling terkenal abad ke-20, termasuk keponakannya Jackie Cooper, Spencer Tracy, Mickey Rooney, Judy Garland, Deanna Durbin, Fred Astaire, Gene Kelly, Deborah Kerr, Peter Lawford, Dean Martin, Jerry Lewis, Elvis Presley, dan Vincent Price. Taurog menyutradarai enam film Martin dan Lewis, dan sembilan film Elvis Presley, lebih banyak daripada sutradara lain manapun.

name: Nozomu Sasaki
title: Nozomu Sasaki
extract: Nozomu Sasaki is a Japanese voice actor and singer. He is represented by the voice actor management firm Aoni Production, and was previously represented by Arts Vision and 81 Produce. In 1988, he voiced the character Tetsuo Shima in the movie Akira, which was adapted from the manga of the same name. He also provided the voice of Yusuke Urameshi in the anime adaptation of the manga YuYu Hakusho and reprised the role in video games for the franchise. He is sometimes mistaken for fellow voice actress Nozomi Sasaki, whose name is written the same way. Sasaki has emerged the victor of the Seiyū Grand Prix more times than any other voice actor.
extract_id: Nozomu Sasaki adalah pengisi suara dan penyanyi Jepang. Dia diwakili oleh perusahaan manajemen pengisi suara Aoni Production, dan sebelumnya diwakili oleh Arts Vision dan 81 Produce. Pada 1988, dia mengisi suara karakter Tetsuo Shima dalam film Akira, yang diadaptasi dari manga dengan nama yang sama. Dia juga mengisi suara Yusuke Urameshi dalam adaptasi anime dari manga YuYu Hakusho dan mengulangi peran itu dalam permainan video untuk waralaba tersebut. Dia kadang-kadang disangka sebagai pengisi suara perempuan Nozomi Sasaki, yang namanya ditulis dengan cara yang sama. Sasaki telah memenangkan Seiyū Grand Prix lebih banyak kali daripada pengisi suara lain manapun.

name: Noémie Merlant
title: Noémie Merlant
extract: Noémie Merlant is a French actress and filmmaker. She has been nominated for her performances three times at the César Awards, including a nomination for her breakout role in Portrait of a Lady on Fire (2019) and a win for The Innocent (2022).
extract_id: Noémie Merlant adalah aktris dan pembuat film Prancis. Dia telah dinominasikan tiga kali atas penampilannya dalam César Awards, termasuk nominasi untuk peran terobosannya dalam Portrait of a Lady on Fire (2019) dan menang untuk The Innocent (2022).

name: Nurgül Yesilçay
title: Nurgül Yeşilçay
extract: Nurgül Yeşilçay is a Turkish actress.
extract_id: Nurgül Yeşilçay adalah aktris Turki.

name: Nuri Bilge Ceylan
title: Nuri Bilge Ceylan
description: Turkish film director, screenwriter, film producer and photographer (born 1959)
extract: Nuri Bilge Ceylan is a Turkish filmmaker and actor. His films usually explore Turkish society in the 21st century, featuring long takes and lengthy runtime.
extract_id: Nuri Bilge Ceylan adalah pembuat film dan aktor Turki. Film-filmnya biasanya mengeksplorasi masyarakat Turki di abad ke-21, dengan pengambilan gambar panjang dan durasi yang panjang.

name: Nursel Köse
title: Nursel Köse
extract: Nursel Köse is a Turkish-German actress. She studied and worked in Germany. Köse starred in the internationally acclaimed film The Edge of Heaven. She played Keriman Akçatepe in the TV series Paramparça.
extract_id: Nursel Köse adalah aktris Turki-Jerman. Dia belajar dan bekerja di Jerman. Köse membintangi film yang mendapatkan pujian internasional The Edge of Heaven. Dia memainkan peran Keriman Akçatepe dalam serial TV Paramparça.

name: O'Shea Jackson Jr.
title: O'Shea Jackson Jr.
extract: O'Shea Jackson Jr. (born February 24, 1991), also known by the stage name OMG, is an American actor, rapper and songwriter. He is the second born child of Ice Cube and Kimberly Woodruff. In his feature film debut, he portrayed his father in the 2015 biopic film Straight Outta Compton.
extract_id: O'Shea Jackson Jr. (lahir 24 Februari 1991), yang juga dikenal dengan nama panggung OMG, adalah aktor, rapper, dan penulis lagu Amerika. Dia adalah anak kedua dari Ice Cube dan Kimberly Woodruff. Dalam debut film layar lebarnya, dia memerankan ayahnya dalam film biografi Straight Outta Compton (2015).

name: O.J. Simpson
title: O. J. Simpson
extract: Orenthal James Simpson, nicknamed "the Juice", was an American football player, actor, and media personality. He played in the National Football League (NFL) for 11 seasons—nine with the Buffalo Bills—and is regarded as one of the greatest running backs of all time. His success is widely considered to be overshadowed by his two criminal charges for the 1994 murders of his ex-wife Nicole Brown and her friend Ron Goldman, and the contentious criminal trial in which he was acquitted on both counts.
extract_id: Orenthal James Simpson, dijuluki "the Juice", adalah pemain sepak bola Amerika, aktor, dan tokoh media. Dia bermain di National Football League (NFL) selama 11 musim—sembilan dengan Buffalo Bills—dan dianggap sebagai salah satu running back terbaik sepanjang masa. Kesuksesannya secara luas dianggap ternoda oleh dua tuduhan kriminal atas pembunuhan mantan istrinya Nicole Brown dan temannya Ron Goldman pada 1994, serta pengadilan kriminal yang kontroversial di mana dia dinyatakan tidak bersalah atas kedua tuduhan tersebut.

name: Octavia Spencer
title: Octavia Spencer
extract: Octavia Lenora Spencer is an American actress and author. She is the recipient of various accolades, including an Academy Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, a British Academy Film Award, and a Golden Globe Award.
extract_id: Octavia Lenora Spencer adalah aktris dan penulis Amerika. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Primetime Emmy Award, British Academy Film Award, dan Golden Globe Award.

name: Oka Antara
title: Oka Antara
extract: Oka Antara is an Indonesian actor of Balinese descent. He is best known for starring in the films The Dancer (2011), V/H/S/2 (2013), Killers (2014), and The Raid 2 (2014).
extract_id: Oka Antara adalah aktor Indonesia keturunan Bali. Dia paling dikenal karena membintangi film The Dancer (2011), V/H/S/2 (2013), Killers (2014), dan The Raid 2 (2014).

name: Oksana Akinshina
title: Oksana Akinshina
extract: Oksana Sergeevna Akinshina is a Russian actress. She is known for her roles in the films Sisters (2001), Lilya 4-ever (2002), The Bourne Supremacy (2004), Hipsters (2008) and Sputnik (2020).
extract_id: Oksana Sergeevna Akinshina adalah aktris Rusia. Dia dikenal karena perannya dalam film Sisters (2001), Lilya 4-ever (2002), The Bourne Supremacy (2004), Hipsters (2008), dan Sputnik (2020).

name: Oleg Yankovskiy
title: Oleg Yankovsky
extract: Oleg Ivanovich Yankovsky was a Soviet and Russian actor who excelled in psychologically sophisticated roles of modern intellectuals. In 1991, he became, together with Sofia Pilyavskaya, the last person to be named a People's Artist of the USSR.
extract_id: Oleg Ivanovich Yankovsky adalah seorang aktor Soviet dan Rusia yang unggul dalam peran-peran yang secara psikologis canggih tentang intelektual modern. Pada tahun 1991, ia menjadi, bersama dengan Sofia Pilyavskaya, orang terakhir yang diberi gelar Seniman Rakyat Uni Soviet.

name: Olga Baclanova
title: Olga Baclanova
description: Russian-American actress, radio host, and singer (1893–1974)
extract: Olga Vladimirovna Baklanova, known professionally as Olga Baclanova, was a Russian-born actress who found success in Hollywood films, as well as stage roles in the US and the United Kingdom, she was mainly billed as an exotic blonde temptress, who was given the title of the "Russian Tigress".
extract_id: Olga Vladimirovna Baklanova, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Olga Baclanova, adalah seorang aktris kelahiran Rusia yang menemukan kesuksesan dalam film-film Hollywood, serta peran panggung di AS dan Inggris, dia terutama dikenal sebagai wanita eksotis berambut pirang yang diberi julukan "Harimau Betina Rusia".

name: Oliver Hirschbiegel
title: Oliver Hirschbiegel
extract: Oliver Hirschbiegel is a German film and television director. His feature works include the award-winning Das Experiment and the Oscar-nominated film about Adolf Hitler, Downfall. His television work includes the German series 4 Blocks, Netflix's Criminal: Germany and Apple TV's Constellation.
extract_id: Oliver Hirschbiegel adalah seorang sutradara film dan televisi Jerman. Karya-karya fitur yang ia buat termasuk Das Experiment yang memenangkan penghargaan dan film yang dinominasikan Oscar tentang Adolf Hitler, Downfall. Karya televisinya meliputi serial Jerman 4 Blocks, Criminal: Germany dari Netflix, dan Constellation dari Apple TV.

name: Oliver Reed
title: Oliver Reed
extract: Robert Oliver Reed was an English actor, known for his macho, upper-middle class image and his heavy-drinking, "hellraiser" lifestyle. His screen career spanned over 40 years, between 1955 and 1999. At the peak of his career, in 1971, British exhibitors voted Reed fifth-most-popular star at the box office.
extract_id: Robert Oliver Reed adalah seorang aktor Inggris, dikenal dengan citra macho kelas menengah atas dan gaya hidupnya yang suka minum berat dan "hellraiser". Karier layar peraknya berlangsung lebih dari 40 tahun, antara 1955 dan 1999. Pada puncak kariernya, pada tahun 1971, para pemilik bioskop Inggris memilih Reed sebagai bintang paling populer kelima di box office.

name: Oliver Stokowski
title: Oliver Stokowski
extract: Oliver Stokowski is a German film and stage actor. He is best known for his per formance as Schütte - Prisoner No. 82 in Das Experiment. In 2014 he won the Grimme-Preis.
extract_id: Oliver Stokowski adalah aktor film dan panggung Jerman. Dia paling dikenal karena penampilannya sebagai Schütte - Narapidana No. 82 dalam Das Experiment. Pada 2014 dia memenangkan Grimme-Preis.

name: Oliver Stone
title: Oliver Stone
extract: William Oliver Stone is an American filmmaker and author. An acclaimed director who tackled subjects ranging from the Vietnam War and American politics to musical biopics and crime dramas, Stone has received numerous accolades including three Academy Awards, a BAFTA Award, a Primetime Emmy, a Satellite Award, a Sant Jordi Award, three Jupiter Awards, three Independent Spirit Awards, and six Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: William Oliver Stone adalah seorang pembuat film dan penulis asal Amerika. Seorang sutradara terkenal yang membahas berbagai subjek mulai dari Perang Vietnam dan politik Amerika hingga biopik musikal dan drama kriminal, Stone telah menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk tiga Academy Awards, satu BAFTA Award, satu Primetime Emmy, satu Satellite Award, satu Sant Jordi Award, tiga Jupiter Awards, tiga Independent Spirit Awards, dan enam Golden Globe Awards.

name: Olivia Cooke
title: Olivia Cooke
extract: Olivia Kate Cooke is an English actress. She has appeared as Alicent Hightower in the fantasy drama television series House of the Dragon (2022–present), Emma Decody in the thriller Bates Motel (2013–2017), Becky Sharp in the period drama Vanity Fair (2018), spy Sidonie "Sid" Baker in the Apple TV thriller Slow Horses (2022–present), and Cherry Laine in the psychological thriller The Girlfriend (2025).
extract_id: Olivia Kate Cooke adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Dia tampil sebagai Alicent Hightower dalam serial drama fantasi televisi House of the Dragon (2022–sekarang), Emma Decody dalam thriller Bates Motel (2013–2017), Becky Sharp dalam drama periode Vanity Fair (2018), mata-mata Sidonie "Sid" Baker dalam thriller Apple TV Slow Horses (2022–sekarang), dan Cherry Laine dalam thriller psikologis The Girlfriend (2025).

name: Olivia Wilde
title: Olivia Wilde
extract: Olivia Wilde is an American actress and filmmaker. She played Remy "Thirteen" Hadley on the medical-drama television series House (2007–2012), and appeared in the action films Tron: Legacy (2010) and Cowboys & Aliens (2011), the romantic drama film Her (2013), the comedy film The Incredible Burt Wonderstone (2013), and the horror film The Lazarus Effect (2015). She made her Broadway debut playing Julia in 1984 (2017).
extract_id: Olivia Wilde adalah seorang aktris dan pembuat film Amerika. Dia memerankan Remy "Thirteen" Hadley dalam serial drama medis televisi House (2007–2012), dan tampil dalam film aksi Tron: Legacy (2010) dan Cowboys & Aliens (2011), film drama romantis Her (2013), film komedi The Incredible Burt Wonderstone (2013), dan film horor The Lazarus Effect (2015). Dia memulai debut Broadwaynya dengan memerankan Julia dalam 1984 (2017).

name: Olivia Williams
title: Olivia Williams
extract: Olivia Haigh Williams is an English actress who appears in British and American films and television. Williams studied drama at the Bristol Old Vic Theatre School for two years followed by three years at the Royal Shakespeare Company. Her first significant screen role was as Jane Fairfax in the British television film Emma (1996), based on Jane Austen's novel.
extract_id: Olivia Haigh Williams adalah seorang aktris Inggris yang tampil dalam film dan televisi Inggris dan Amerika. Williams belajar drama di Bristol Old Vic Theatre School selama dua tahun diikuti dengan tiga tahun di Royal Shakespeare Company. Peran layar penting pertamanya adalah sebagai Jane Fairfax dalam film televisi Inggris Emma (1996), yang didasarkan pada novel Jane Austen.

name: Olivia de Havilland
title: Olivia de Havilland
extract: Dame Olivia Mary de Havilland was a British, American, and French actress. She appeared in 49 feature films throughout her career, with the major works of her cinematic career spanning from 1935 to 1988. Before her death in 2020 at the age of 104, she was the oldest living and earliest surviving Academy Award winner and was one of the last surviving major stars from the Golden Age of Hollywood cinema. Her younger sister, with whom she had a noted rivalry that was well documented in the media, was the Oscar-winning actress Joan Fontaine.
extract_id: Dame Olivia Mary de Havilland adalah seorang aktris Inggris, Amerika, dan Prancis. Dia tampil dalam 49 film fitur sepanjang kariernya, dengan karya besar karier sinematiknya berlangsung dari tahun 1935 hingga 1988. Sebelum kematiannya pada tahun 2020 pada usia 104 tahun, dia adalah pemenang Academy Award tertua yang masih hidup dan yang paling awal bertahan serta merupakan salah satu bintang besar terakhir yang masih hidup dari Era Keemasan sinema Hollywood. Adik perempuannya, yang memiliki persaingan yang terkenal dan didokumentasikan dengan baik di media, adalah aktris pemenang Oscar Joan Fontaine.

name: Olivier Dahan
title: Olivier Dahan
extract: Olivier Dahan is a French film director and screenwriter. His third directed film, La Vie en Rose, was one of the only French cinema films to win two Academy Awards, including the first acting Oscar in the French language.
extract_id: Olivier Dahan adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film asal Prancis. Film ketiga yang disutradarainya, La Vie en Rose, adalah salah satu dari sedikit film sinema Prancis yang memenangkan dua Academy Awards, termasuk Oscar akting pertama dalam bahasa Prancis.

name: Omar Sharif
title: Omar Sharif
extract: Omar Sharif was an Egyptian actor, generally regarded as his country's greatest male film star. He began his career in Egypt in the early 1950s. He is best known for his appearances in American, British, French, and Italian productions, and has been described as "the first Egyptian and Arab to conquer Hollywood". His career encompassed over 100 films spanning 50 years, and brought him many accolades including three Golden Globe Awards and a César Award for Best Actor.
extract_id: Omar Sharif adalah aktor Mesir yang secara umum dianggap sebagai bintang film pria terbesar di negaranya. Ia memulai kariernya di Mesir pada awal 1950-an. Dia paling dikenal karena penampilannya dalam produksi Amerika, Inggris, Prancis, dan Italia, dan sering disebut sebagai "orang Mesir dan Arab pertama yang menaklukkan Hollywood". Kariernya mencakup lebih dari 100 film selama 50 tahun, dan membawanya banyak penghargaan termasuk tiga Golden Globe Awards dan César Award untuk Aktor Terbaik.

name: Omar Sy
title: Omar Sy
extract: Omar Sy is a French actor. Sy was initially best known in France for his comedy sketches with Fred Testot on the Service après-vente des émissions television show on Canal+ (2005–2012). He gained wider international recognition for his role in the 2011 comedy-drama film The Intouchables, which earned him the César Award for Best Actor, making him the first black recipient.
extract_id: Omar Sy adalah aktor Prancis. Sy awalnya paling dikenal di Prancis untuk sketsa komedinya bersama Fred Testot di acara televisi Service après-vente des émissions di Canal+ (2005–2012). Ia mendapatkan pengakuan internasional yang lebih luas untuk perannya dalam film komedi-drama tahun 2011 The Intouchables, yang memberinya César Award untuk Aktor Terbaik, menjadikannya penerima kulit hitam pertama.

name: Oprah Winfrey
title: Oprah Winfrey
extract: Oprah Gail Winfrey is an American media mogul, actress, executive producer, author, and television personality. She is best known for her talk show, The Oprah Winfrey Show, broadcast from Chicago, which ran in national syndication for 25 years, from 1986 to 2011. Globally, she is the richest Black woman and the wealthiest female celebrity. Dubbed the "Queen of All Media", she was the richest African-American of the 20th century and was once the world's only Black billionaire. By 2007, she was often ranked as the most influential woman in the world and in 2026 was named the greatest living self-made American.
extract_id: Oprah Gail Winfrey adalah seorang mogul media Amerika, aktris, produser eksekutif, penulis, dan pribadi televisi. Dia paling dikenal dengan acara bincangnya, The Oprah Winfrey Show, yang disiarkan dari Chicago, yang berjalan di sindikasi nasional selama 25 tahun, dari 1986 hingga 2011. Secara global, dia adalah wanita kulit hitam terkaya dan selebriti wanita terkaya. Dijuluki "Ratu Semua Media", dia adalah Afrika-Amerika terkaya pada abad ke-20 dan pernah menjadi satu-satunya miliarder kulit hitam di dunia. Pada 2007, dia sering dinobatkan sebagai wanita paling berpengaruh di dunia dan pada 2026 dinobatkan sebagai orang Amerika mandiri terbesar yang masih hidup.

name: Oriol Paulo
title: Oriol Paulo
extract: Oriol Paulo is a Spanish screenwriter and director. He is known for crime thriller movies such as The Body (2012) and The Invisible Guest (2016). Both films garnered international acclaim and were remade in several languages.
extract_id: Oriol Paulo adalah seorang penulis skenario dan sutradara asal Spanyol. Dia dikenal untuk film thriller kriminal seperti The Body (2012) dan The Invisible Guest (2016). Kedua film tersebut mendapatkan pujian internasional dan dibuat ulang dalam beberapa bahasa.

name: Orlando Bloom
title: Orlando Bloom
extract: Orlando Jonathan Blanchard Copeland Bloom is an English actor. He made his breakthrough as the character Legolas in The Lord of the Rings film series (2001–03), earning him three Actors Award nominations, winning once. He reprised his role in The Hobbit film series (2013–14). Considered by some to be the Errol Flynn of his time, he gained further notice appearing in epic fantasy, historical, and adventure films, including as Will Turner in the Pirates of the Caribbean film series, Paris in Troy (2004), Balian de Ibelin in Kingdom of Heaven (2005), and the Duke of Buckingham in The Three Musketeers (2011).
extract_id: Orlando Jonathan Blanchard Copeland Bloom adalah aktor Inggris. Dia memulai terobosan sebagai karakter Legolas dalam seri film The Lord of the Rings (2001–03), yang memberinya tiga nominasi Actors Award dan menang satu kali. Dia mengulangi perannya dalam seri film The Hobbit (2013–14). Dianggap oleh sebagian sebagai Errol Flynn masa kini, dia semakin dikenal setelah tampil dalam film fantasi epik, sejarah, dan petualangan, termasuk sebagai Will Turner dalam seri film Pirates of the Caribbean, Paris dalam Troy (2004), Balian de Ibelin dalam Kingdom of Heaven (2005), dan Duke of Buckingham dalam The Three Musketeers (2011).

name: Orson Welles
title: Orson Welles
extract: George Orson Welles was an American actor and filmmaker. Remembered for his innovative work in film, radio, and theatre, he is considered among the greatest and most influential filmmakers of all time.
extract_id: George Orson Welles adalah seorang aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Dikenang karena karya inovatifnya dalam film, radio, dan teater, dia dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film terbesar dan paling berpengaruh sepanjang masa.

name: Osamu Saka
title: Osamu Saka
extract: Osamu Saka is a Japanese actor and voice actor affiliated with Aoni Production. He was married to voice actress Yoshiko Ōta until her death in 2021.
extract_id: Osamu Saka adalah aktor dan pengisi suara Jepang yang berafiliasi dengan Aoni Production. Dia menikah dengan pengisi suara Yoshiko Ōta hingga kematiannya pada tahun 2021.

name: Oscar Isaac
title: Oscar Isaac
extract: Óscar Isaac Hernández Estrada is an American actor. Recognized for his versatility, he has been credited with breaking stereotypes about Latino characters in Hollywood. He was named the best actor of his generation by Vanity Fair in 2017 and one of the 25 greatest actors of the 21st century by The New York Times in 2020. His accolades include a Golden Globe Award, a nomination for a Primetime Emmy Award and an honorary Doctor of Fine Arts degree from Juilliard. In 2016, he featured on Time's list of the 100 most influential people in the world.
extract_id: Óscar Isaac Hernández Estrada adalah aktor Amerika. Diakui karena fleksibilitasnya, ia dikenal telah mematahkan stereotip tentang karakter Latino di Hollywood. Dia dinobatkan sebagai aktor terbaik dari generasinya oleh Vanity Fair pada tahun 2017 dan salah satu dari 25 aktor terbesar abad ke-21 oleh The New York Times pada tahun 2020. Penghargaannya meliputi Golden Globe Award, nominasi Primetime Emmy Award, dan gelar kehormatan Doctor of Fine Arts dari Juilliard. Pada 2016, ia masuk daftar Time sebagai 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia.

name: Oskar Werner
title: Oskar Werner
extract: Oskar Werner was an Austrian stage and cinema actor who reached international fame. His most prominent roles include two 1965 films, The Spy Who Came In from the Cold and Ship of Fools. For the former, Werner won a Golden Globe Award. For the latter, Werner received an Oscar nomination. Other notable films include Decision Before Dawn (1951), Lola Montès (1955), Jules and Jim (1962), Fahrenheit 451 (1966), The Shoes of the Fisherman (1968), and Voyage of the Damned (1976).
extract_id: Oskar Werner adalah aktor panggung dan film Austria yang mencapai ketenaran internasional. Peran terpentingnya termasuk dua film tahun 1965, The Spy Who Came In from the Cold dan Ship of Fools. Untuk yang pertama, Werner memenangkan Golden Globe Award. Untuk yang kedua, Werner menerima nominasi Oscar. Film penting lainnya termasuk Decision Before Dawn (1951), Lola Montès (1955), Jules and Jim (1962), Fahrenheit 451 (1966), The Shoes of the Fisherman (1968), dan Voyage of the Damned (1976).

name: Ossie Davis
title: Ossie Davis
description: American actor, director, writer, and activist (1917–2005)
extract: Ossie Davis was an American actor, director, writer, and activist. He was married to Ruby Dee, with whom he frequently performed, from 1948 until his death. He received numerous accolades, including an Emmy, a Grammy and a Writers Guild of America Award as well as nominations for four additional Emmy Awards, a Golden Globe Award, and Tony Award. Davis was inducted into the American Theater Hall of Fame in 1994 and received the National Medal of Arts in 1995 and the Kennedy Center Honors in 2004.
extract_id: Ossie Davis adalah aktor, sutradara, penulis, dan aktivis Amerika. Dia menikah dengan Ruby Dee, dengan siapa dia sering tampil, dari 1948 hingga kematiannya. Dia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Emmy, Grammy, dan Writers Guild of America Award serta nominasi untuk empat Emmy Awards tambahan, Golden Globe Award, dan Tony Award. Davis dimasukkan ke dalam American Theater Hall of Fame pada 1994 dan menerima National Medal of Arts pada 1995 dan Kennedy Center Honors pada 2004.

name: Otto Preminger
title: Otto Preminger
extract: Otto Ludwig Preminger was an Austrian-American film and theatre director, film producer and actor. He directed more than 35 feature films in a five-decade career after leaving the theatre, and was one of the most influential directors in Hollywood during the 1940s and 1950s. He was nominated for three Academy Awards, twice for Best Director and once for Best Picture, among many other accolades.
extract_id: Otto Ludwig Preminger adalah sutradara film dan teater, produser film, dan aktor Austria-Amerika. Dia menyutradarai lebih dari 35 film fitur dalam karier lima dekade setelah meninggalkan teater, dan merupakan salah satu sutradara paling berpengaruh di Hollywood selama 1940-an dan 1950-an. Dia dinominasikan untuk tiga Academy Awards, dua kali sebagai Sutradara Terbaik dan sekali untuk Film Terbaik, di antara banyak penghargaan lainnya.

name: Otto Sander
title: Otto Sander
extract: Otto Sander was a German film, theater, and voice actor.
extract_id: Otto Sander adalah aktor film, teater, dan pengisi suara Jerman.

name: Otto Wernicke
title: Otto Wernicke
extract: Otto Karl Robert Wernicke was a German actor. He is best known for his role as police inspector Karl Lohmann in the two Fritz Lang films M and The Testament of Dr. Mabuse.
extract_id: Otto Karl Robert Wernicke adalah seorang aktor Jerman. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai inspektur polisi Karl Lohmann dalam dua film Fritz Lang yaitu M dan The Testament of Dr. Mabuse.

name: Owen Wilson
title: Owen Wilson
extract: Owen Cunningham Wilson is an American actor and screenwriter. His accolades include nominations for an Academy Award, two Actor Awards, a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, and an Independent Spirit Award.
extract_id: Owen Cunningham Wilson adalah aktor dan penulis skenario Amerika. Penghargaannya meliputi nominasi untuk Academy Award, dua Actor Awards, BAFTA Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Independent Spirit Award.

name: Ozan Güven
title: Ozan Güven
extract: Ozan Muharrem Güven is a Turkish film, TV series, and theatre actor and screenwriter. He is best known for playing the role of Rüstem Pasha in the historical series Muhteşem Yüzyıl and other hit series including İkinci Bahar, Koçum Benim, Bir İstanbul Masalı, Canım Ailem, Fi, and Aslı ile Kerem.
extract_id: Ozan Muharrem Güven adalah aktor dan penulis naskah film, serial TV, dan teater asal Turki. Dia dikenal luas karena memerankan peran Rüstem Pasha dalam serial sejarah Muhteşem Yüzyıl dan serial hits lainnya termasuk İkinci Bahar, Koçum Benim, Bir İstanbul Masalı, Canım Ailem, Fi, dan Aslı ile Kerem.

name: Pablo Rago
title: Pablo Rago
extract: Pablo Rago is an Argentine actor. He has acted in the films The Official Story and The Secret in Their Eyes; both Argentine films have won the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film, and he has acted in many other films and productions.
extract_id: Pablo Rago adalah aktor Argentina. Dia telah berperan dalam film The Official Story dan The Secret in Their Eyes; kedua film Argentina tersebut memenangkan Academy Award untuk Film Berbahasa Asing Terbaik, dan dia juga berperan dalam banyak film dan produksi lainnya.

name: Paddy Considine
title: Paddy Considine
description: English actor, director, screenwriter, and musician (born 1973)
extract: Patrick George Considine is an English actor, director, screenwriter and musician. He is known for playing antiheroes in independent films. He has received two British Academy Film Awards, three Evening Standard British Film Awards, British Independent Film Awards, and a Silver Lion for Best Short Film at the 2007 Venice Film Festival.
extract_id: Patrick George Considine adalah aktor, sutradara, penulis skenario, dan musisi asal Inggris. Dia dikenal karena memerankan antihero dalam film independen. Dia telah menerima dua British Academy Film Awards, tiga Evening Standard British Film Awards, British Independent Film Awards, dan Silver Lion untuk Film Pendek Terbaik di Festival Film Venesia 2007.

name: Paige O'Hara
title: Paige O'Hara
extract: Paige O'Hara is an American actress, singer, and painter. O'Hara began her career as a Broadway actress in 1975 when she portrayed Della in The Gift of the Magi. In 1991, she made her motion picture debut in Disney's Beauty and the Beast, in which she voiced the film's heroine, Belle. Following the critical and commercial success of Beauty and the Beast, O'Hara reprised her role as Belle in the film's three direct-to-video follow-ups, Beauty and the Beast: The Enchanted Christmas (1997), Belle's Magical World (1998), Belle's Tales of Friendship (1999), and for cameo appearances in Ralph Breaks the Internet (2018) and Once Upon a Studio (2023).
extract_id: Paige O'Hara adalah aktris, penyanyi, dan pelukis Amerika. O'Hara memulai kariernya sebagai aktris Broadway pada tahun 1975 ketika ia memerankan Della dalam The Gift of the Magi. Pada tahun 1991, dia membuat debut filmnya di Disney's Beauty and the Beast, di mana dia mengisi suara pahlawan wanita film tersebut, Belle. Setelah kesuksesan kritis dan komersial Beauty and the Beast, O'Hara mengulangi perannya sebagai Belle dalam tiga sekuel video langsung film tersebut, Beauty and the Beast: The Enchanted Christmas (1997), Belle's Magical World (1998), Belle's Tales of Friendship (1999), dan untuk penampilan cameo di Ralph Breaks the Internet (2018) dan Once Upon a Studio (2023).

name: Pamela Adlon
title: Pamela Adlon
extract: Pamela Adlon is an American actress, writer, and director. She is known for voicing Bobby Hill in the animated comedy series King of the Hill, for which she won a Primetime Emmy Award. She also voiced Baloo in Jungle Cubs (1996–1998), the title role in the Pajama Sam video game series (1996–2001), Lucky in 101 Dalmatians: The Series (1997–1998), Margaret "Moose" Pearson in Pepper Ann (1997–2001), Ashley Spinelli in Recess (1997–2001), Otto Osworth in Time Squad (2001–2003), Vidia in the Tinker Bell franchise and Brigette Murphy in Milo Murphy's Law (2016–2019), among numerous others.
extract_id: Pamela Adlon adalah aktris, penulis, dan sutradara Amerika. Dia dikenal karena mengisi suara Bobby Hill dalam serial komedi animasi King of the Hill, yang membuatnya memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award. Dia juga mengisi suara Baloo dalam Jungle Cubs (1996–1998), peran utama dalam seri video game Pajama Sam (1996–2001), Lucky dalam 101 Dalmatians: The Series (1997–1998), Margaret "Moose" Pearson dalam Pepper Ann (1997–2001), Ashley Spinelli dalam Recess (1997–2001), Otto Osworth dalam Time Squad (2001–2003), Vidia dalam franchise Tinker Bell dan Brigette Murphy dalam Milo Murphy's Law (2016–2019), serta banyak lainnya.

name: Paolo Bonacelli
title: Paolo Bonacelli
extract: Paolo Bonacelli was an Italian stage and film actor.
extract_id: Paolo Bonacelli adalah aktor panggung dan film asal Italia.

name: Paolo Genovese
title: Paolo Genovese
extract: Paolo Genovese is an Italian director and screenwriter.
extract_id: Paolo Genovese adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario asal Italia.

name: Paolo Sorrentino
title: Paolo Sorrentino
extract: Paolo Sorrentino is an Italian film director, screenwriter, and writer. He is considered one of the most prominent filmmakers of Italian cinema working today. He is known for visually striking and complex dramas and has often been compared to Federico Fellini and Michelangelo Antonioni. He has received numerous accolades, including an Academy Award accepted for Best International Film, a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe, two Cannes Film Festival prizes, four Venice Film Festival Awards and four European Film Awards. In Italy he was honoured with eight David di Donatello and six Nastro d'Argento awards.
extract_id: Paolo Sorrentino adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan penulis asal Italia. Dia dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film paling menonjol dari sinema Italia yang aktif saat ini. Dia dikenal karena drama yang mencolok secara visual dan kompleks serta sering dibandingkan dengan Federico Fellini dan Michelangelo Antonioni. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award untuk Film Internasional Terbaik, BAFTA Award, Golden Globe, dua penghargaan Festival Film Cannes, empat penghargaan Festival Film Venesia, dan empat European Film Awards. Di Italia dia dihormati dengan delapan penghargaan David di Donatello dan enam Nastro d'Argento.

name: Paprika Steen
title: Paprika Steen
extract: Kirstine "Paprika" Steen is a Danish actress and director best known for her performances in Dogme 95 films Festen, The Idiots, Mifune, and Open Hearts. Steen was the first Danish actress since Karin Nellemose to win both Best Actress and Best Supporting Actress in the same year at the Robert Festival, the Danish equivalent of the Oscars.
extract_id: Kirstine "Paprika" Steen adalah aktris dan sutradara asal Denmark yang paling dikenal atas penampilannya dalam film-film Dogme 95 seperti Festen, The Idiots, Mifune, dan Open Hearts. Steen adalah aktris Denmark pertama sejak Karin Nellemose yang memenangkan penghargaan Best Actress dan Best Supporting Actress di tahun yang sama pada Festival Robert, setara dengan Oscar di Denmark.

name: Parambrata Chattopadhyay
title: Parambrata Chattopadhyay
extract: Parambrata Chattopadhyay is an Indian actor and director. Parambrata started his career with Bengali television and films. He has acted as the fictional character Topshe from Feluda under Sandip Ray's direction. His notable works include Bhalo Theko (2003), Baishe Srabon (2011), Bhooter Bhabishyat (2012), Sold (2014), Kadambari (2017), Anukul (2017), Pari (2018), Ramprasad Ki Tehrvi (2019), Dwitiyo Purush (2020), Bulbbul (2020) and Doctor Bakshi (2023). He made his Hindi debut in Kahaani (2012), starring with Vidya Balan and Nawazuddin Siddiqui.
extract_id: Parambrata Chattopadhyay adalah aktor dan sutradara India. Parambrata memulai kariernya dengan televisi dan film Bengali. Dia berperan sebagai karakter fiktif Topshe dari Feluda di bawah arahan Sandip Ray. Karya terkenalnya meliputi Bhalo Theko (2003), Baishe Srabon (2011), Bhooter Bhabishyat (2012), Sold (2014), Kadambari (2017), Anukul (2017), Pari (2018), Ramprasad Ki Tehrvi (2019), Dwitiyo Purush (2020), Bulbbul (2020) dan Doctor Bakshi (2023). Dia membuat debut berbahasa Hindi dalam Kahaani (2012), bersama Vidya Balan dan Nawazuddin Siddiqui.

name: Paresh Rawal
title: Paresh Rawal
extract: Paresh Rawal is an Indian actor film producer and former politician, known for his works primarily in Hindi films. Considered as one of the finest actors of Hindi cinema, he has appeared in over 240 films and is the recipient of various accolades including a National Film Awards and three Filmfare Awards. He was honoured with Padma Shri from the Government of India in 2014.
extract_id: Paresh Rawal adalah aktor film, produser, dan mantan politisi India, yang dikenal terutama atas karyanya dalam film-film Hindi. Dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terbaik sinema Hindi, dia telah tampil dalam lebih dari 240 film dan menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk National Film Awards dan tiga Filmfare Awards. Ia dihormati dengan Padma Shri dari Pemerintah India pada tahun 2014.

name: Pascal Greggory
title: Pascal Greggory
extract: Pascal Greggory is a French actor.
extract_id: Pascal Greggory adalah aktor Prancis.

name: Patricia Arquette
title: Patricia Arquette
extract: Patricia Arquette is an American actress. Known for her roles on film and television, she has received an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, two Primetime Emmy Awards, three Golden Globe Awards, and two Screen Actors Guild Awards.
