extract_id: Patricia Arquette adalah aktris Amerika. Dikenal atas perannya di film dan televisi, dia telah menerima Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, tiga Golden Globe Awards, dan dua Screen Actors Guild Awards.

name: Patricia Clarkson
title: Patricia Clarkson
extract: Patricia Davies Clarkson is an American actress. She has starred in numerous leading and supporting roles in a variety of films ranging from independent film features to major film studio productions. Her accolades include a Golden Globe Award and three Primetime Emmy Awards, in addition to nominations for an Academy Award and a Tony Award.
extract_id: Patricia Davies Clarkson adalah aktris Amerika. Dia telah berperan dalam banyak peran utama dan pendukung dalam berbagai film dari fitur film independen hingga produksi studio film besar. Penghargaan yang diterimanya meliputi Golden Globe Award dan tiga Primetime Emmy Awards, selain nominasi untuk Academy Award dan Tony Award.

name: Patricia Neal
title: Patricia Neal
extract: Patricia Neal was an American actress of stage and screen. She is well known for, among other roles, playing World War II widow Helen Benson in The Day the Earth Stood Still (1951), radio journalist Marcia Jeffries in A Face in the Crowd (1957), wealthy matron Emily Eustace Failenson in Breakfast at Tiffany's (1961), and the worn-out housekeeper Alma Brown in Hud (1963). She also featured as the matriarch in the television film The Homecoming: A Christmas Story (1971); her role as Olivia Walton was re-cast for the series it inspired, The Waltons. A major star of the 1950s and 1960s, she was the recipient of an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, a Tony Award, and two British Academy Film Awards, and was nominated for three Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Patricia Neal adalah aktris Amerika panggung dan layar. Dia dikenal karena beberapa peran, termasuk janda Perang Dunia II Helen Benson dalam The Day the Earth Stood Still (1951), jurnalis radio Marcia Jeffries dalam A Face in the Crowd (1957), sosialita kaya Emily Eustace Failenson dalam Breakfast at Tiffany's (1961), dan pembantu rumah tangga yang lelah Alma Brown dalam Hud (1963). Dia juga tampil sebagai matriark dalam film TV The Homecoming: A Christmas Story (1971); perannya sebagai Olivia Walton di-casting ulang untuk serial yang dihasilkannya, The Waltons. Sebagai bintang besar tahun 1950-an dan 1960-an, dia menerima Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, Tony Award, dan dua British Academy Film Awards, serta dinominasikan untuk tiga Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Patrick Fugit
title: Patrick Fugit
extract: Patrick Raymond Fugit is an American actor. His breakout role was William Miller in the comedy-drama film Almost Famous (2000), which earned him a Screen Actors Guild Award nomination.
extract_id: Patrick Raymond Fugit adalah aktor Amerika. Peran terobosannya adalah William Miller dalam film komedi-drama Almost Famous (2000), yang memberinya nominasi Screen Actors Guild Award.

name: Patrick Horgan
title: Patrick Horgan (actor)
extract: John Patrick Horgan was a British-American actor of Irish descent. He was known for playing Dr. John Morrison in the NBC soap opera television series The Doctors. He completed an unabridged reading of Finnegans Wake in 1985 for the Library of Congress. He also recorded a number of audiobooks for the National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled from 1970 onward.
extract_id: John Patrick Horgan adalah aktor British-Amerika berdarah Irlandia. Dia dikenal karena memerankan Dr. John Morrison dalam serial soap opera televisi NBC The Doctors. Dia menyelesaikan pembacaan tanpa suntingan Finnegans Wake pada tahun 1985 untuk Library of Congress. Dia juga merekam sejumlah buku audio untuk National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled sejak tahun 1970 dan seterusnya.

name: Patrick Huard
title: Patrick Huard
extract: Patrick Huard is a Canadian actor, writer and comedian from Quebec.
extract_id: Patrick Huard adalah aktor, penulis, dan komedian Kanada dari Quebec.

name: Patrick Magee
title: Patrick Magee (actor)
extract: Patrick George Magee was an Irish actor and theatre director. He was noted for his collaborations with playwrights Samuel Beckett and Harold Pinter as well as for creating the role of the Marquis de Sade in the original stage and screen productions of Marat/Sade.
extract_id: Patrick George Magee adalah aktor dan sutradara teater Irlandia. Dia terkenal karena kolaborasinya dengan dramawan Samuel Beckett dan Harold Pinter serta karena menciptakan peran Marquis de Sade dalam produksi panggung dan layar asli Marat/Sade.

name: Patrick McGoohan
title: Patrick McGoohan
extract: Patrick Joseph McGoohan was an American actor, director, producer, and writer. Born in New York City to Irish parents, he was raised in Ireland and the United Kingdom. He began his career in Britain during the 1950s and became well known for the titular role of secret agent John Drake in the ITC espionage programme Danger Man (1960–68). He then created and produced the surrealistic ITV series The Prisoner (1967–68), in which he starred as former British intelligence agent Number Six.
extract_id: Patrick Joseph McGoohan adalah aktor, sutradara, produser, dan penulis Amerika. Lahir di New York City dari orang tua Irlandia, dia dibesarkan di Irlandia dan Inggris. Dia memulai kariernya di Inggris pada tahun 1950-an dan menjadi terkenal karena peran utama agen rahasia John Drake dalam program mata-mata ITC Danger Man (1960–68). Dia kemudian menciptakan dan memproduseri serial ITV surrealistik The Prisoner (1967–68), di mana dia membintangi sebagai mantan agen intelijen Inggris Number Six.

name: Patrick Renna
title: Patrick Renna
extract: Patrick Maxwell Renna is an American actor and film producer best known for his role as Hamilton "Ham" Porter in the 1993 baseball film The Sandlot. Some of his later projects include Bad Roomies, his first film as a producer; a recurring role on Netflix's hit series GLOW; and the independent film Monster Summer, which released in 2024.
extract_id: Patrick Maxwell Renna adalah aktor dan produser film Amerika yang paling dikenal sebagai Hamilton "Ham" Porter dalam film bisbol 1993 The Sandlot. Beberapa proyek terbarunya termasuk Bad Roomies, film pertamanya sebagai produser; peran berulang dalam serial hit Netflix GLOW; dan film independen Monster Summer, yang dirilis pada 2024.

name: Patrick Stewart
title: Patrick Stewart
extract: Sir Patrick Stewart is an English actor. With a career spanning over 60 years on stage and screen, he has received various accolades, including two Olivier Awards and a Grammy Award, as well as nominations for a Tony Award, three Golden Globe Awards, four Emmy Awards, and three Screen Actors Guild Awards. He was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II for services to drama in 2010.
extract_id: Sir Patrick Stewart adalah aktor Inggris. Dengan karier yang meliputi lebih dari 60 tahun di panggung dan layar, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Olivier Awards dan Grammy Award, serta nominasi untuk Tony Award, tiga Golden Globe Awards, empat Emmy Awards, dan tiga Screen Actors Guild Awards. Dia dinobatkan oleh Ratu Elizabeth II atas jasanya di bidang drama pada tahun 2010.

name: Patrick Wilson
title: Patrick Wilson
extract: Patrick Joseph Wilson is an American actor. He began his career in 1995, starring in Broadway musicals. He received nominations for three Tony Awards, two for his roles in The Full Monty (2000–2001) and Oklahoma! (2002) and the third one as a producer of the musical The Lost Boys (2026). He co-starred in the HBO miniseries Angels in America (2003), for which he was nominated for a Golden Globe Award and a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Patrick Joseph Wilson adalah aktor Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya pada tahun 1995, membintangi musikal Broadway. Dia menerima nominasi untuk tiga Tony Awards, dua untuk perannya dalam The Full Monty (2000–2001) dan Oklahoma! (2002), dan yang ketiga sebagai produser musikal The Lost Boys (2026). Dia juga membintangi miniseri HBO Angels in America (2003), yang memberinya nominasi Golden Globe Award dan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Patrick Wymark
title: Patrick Wymark
extract: Patrick Wymark was an English stage, film and television actor.
extract_id: Patrick Wymark adalah aktor panggung, film, dan televisi Inggris.

name: Patton Oswalt
title: Patton Oswalt
extract: Patton Peter Oswalt is an American stand-up comedian and actor. His acting roles include Spence Olchin in the sitcom The King of Queens (1998–2007) and narrating the sitcom The Goldbergs (2013–2023) as adult Adam F. Goldberg. After making his acting debut in the Seinfeld episode "The Couch", he has appeared in a variety of television series, such as Parks and Recreation, Community, Two and a Half Men, Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D., Drunk History, Reno 911!, Mystery Science Theater 3000, Archer, Veep, Justified, Kim Possible, WordGirl, Modern Family, Brooklyn Nine-Nine and We Bare Bears. He portrayed Principal Ralph Durbin in A.P. Bio (2018–2021) and voiced Matthew the Raven in the TV series The Sandman (2022–2025)
extract_id: Patton Peter Oswalt adalah komedian stand-up dan aktor Amerika. Peran aktingnya termasuk Spence Olchin dalam sitkom The King of Queens (1998–2007) dan narasi sitkom The Goldbergs (2013–2023) sebagai Adam F. Goldberg dewasa. Setelah debut aktingnya dalam episode Seinfeld "The Couch", dia telah tampil dalam berbagai serial televisi seperti Parks and Recreation, Community, Two and a Half Men, Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D., Drunk History, Reno 911!, Mystery Science Theater 3000, Archer, Veep, Justified, Kim Possible, WordGirl, Modern Family, Brooklyn Nine-Nine, dan We Bare Bears. Dia memerankan Kepala Sekolah Ralph Durbin dalam A.P. Bio (2018–2021) dan mengisi suara Matthew the Raven dalam serial TV The Sandman (2022–2025).

name: Paul Benjamin
title: Paul Benjamin
extract: Paul Benjamin was an American actor known for his work in film and television during the 1970s and 1980s, particularly in gritty crime dramas and socially grounded stories. He was respected for portraying streetwise, morally complex characters whose actions often set larger events into motion.
extract_id: Paul Benjamin adalah aktor Amerika yang dikenal karena karyanya dalam film dan televisi pada tahun 1970-an dan 1980-an, terutama dalam drama kriminal yang keras dan cerita yang berlandaskan sosial. Dia dihormati karena memerankan karakter yang cerdas di jalanan dan bermoral kompleks yang tindakannya sering memicu peristiwa yang lebih besar.

name: Paul Bettany
title: Paul Bettany
extract: Paul Bettany is an English actor. He has portrayed the roles J.A.R.V.I.S. and Vision in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, including the Disney+ series WandaVision (2021) and VisionQuest (2026), the prior of which garnered him a Primetime Emmy Award nomination.
extract_id: Paul Bettany adalah aktor Inggris. Dia memerankan peran J.A.R.V.I.S. dan Vision dalam Marvel Cinematic Universe, termasuk seri Disney+ WandaVision (2021) dan VisionQuest (2026), yang sebelumnya memberinya nominasi Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Paul Dano
title: Paul Dano
extract: Paul Franklin Dano is an American actor and filmmaker. His work includes both independent film and blockbusters, and his accolades include nominations for a British Academy Film Award, a Golden Globe Award and two Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Paul Franklin Dano adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Karyanya meliputi film independen dan blockbuster, dan penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk nominasi British Academy Film Award, Golden Globe Award, dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Paul Frankeur
title: Paul Frankeur
extract: Paul Frankeur was a French actor who had a successful Hollywood career and appeared in films by Jacques Tati, such as Jour de fête and Luis Buñuel, including The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie and The Phantom of Liberty). He was sometimes credited as Paul Francoeur.
extract_id: Paul Frankeur adalah aktor Prancis yang memiliki karier Hollywood yang sukses dan tampil dalam film-film karya Jacques Tati, seperti Jour de fête dan Luis Buñuel, termasuk The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie dan The Phantom of Liberty). Dia kadang-kadang dikreditkan sebagai Paul Francoeur.

name: Paul Freeman
title: Paul Freeman (actor)
extract: Paul Freeman is an English actor who has appeared in theatre, television and film. Internationally, he is known for playing the rival archaeologist René Belloq in Raiders of the Lost Ark (1981), evil wine baron Gustav Riebmann on season 4 of the soap opera Falcon Crest (1984–85), and supervillain Ivan Ooze in Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: The Movie (1995). His other credits include Morlang (2001), When I'm 64 (2004), Hot Fuzz (2007) and Hard Boiled Sweets (2012). In the UK, he had a leading role in the television series Yesterday's Dreams (1987) as Martin Daniels.
extract_id: Paul Freeman adalah aktor Inggris yang telah tampil di teater, televisi, dan film. Secara internasional, dia dikenal karena memerankan arkeolog saingan René Belloq dalam Raiders of the Lost Ark (1981), penjahat pemilik bar anggur Gustav Riebmann di musim 4 sinetron Falcon Crest (1984–85), dan penjahat super Ivan Ooze dalam Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: The Movie (1995). Kredit lainnya termasuk Morlang (2001), When I'm 64 (2004), Hot Fuzz (2007) dan Hard Boiled Sweets (2012). Di Inggris, dia memegang peran utama dalam serial televisi Yesterday's Dreams (1987) sebagai Martin Daniels.

name: Paul Giamatti
title: Paul Giamatti
extract: Paul Edward Valentine Giamatti is an American actor and producer. Beginning as a varied character actor, his roles evolved into portraying everyman protagonists that balance sardonic humor and flawed humanity. His accolades include a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Drama Series, three Golden Globe Awards, four Actor Awards, three Critics' Choice Awards, as well as nominations for two Academy Awards and a British Academy Film Award.
extract_id: Paul Edward Valentine Giamatti adalah aktor dan produser Amerika. Awalnya sebagai aktor karakter bervariasi, perannya berkembang menjadi protagonis setiap orang yang menyeimbangkan humor sarkastik dan kemanusiaan yang cacat. Penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk Primetime Emmy Award untuk Outstanding Lead Actor in a Drama Series, tiga Golden Globe Awards, empat Actor Awards, tiga Critics' Choice Awards, serta nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards dan British Academy Film Award.

name: Paul Greengrass
title: Paul Greengrass
extract: Paul Greengrass is an English filmmaker and former journalist. Known for his documentary style realism and distinctive shaky-cam technique, he has received various accolades including a BAFTA Award and an Empire Award in addition to a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Director.
extract_id: Paul Greengrass adalah pembuat film Inggris dan mantan jurnalis. Dikenal karena realisme gaya dokumenternya dan teknik shaky-cam yang khas, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk BAFTA Award dan Empire Award selain nominasi Academy Award untuk Best Director.

name: Paul Haggis
title: Paul Haggis
extract: Paul Edward Haggis is a Canadian screenwriter, film producer, and director of film and television. He is best known as screenwriter and producer for consecutive Best Picture Oscar winners Million Dollar Baby (2004) and Crash (2005), the latter of which he also directed. Haggis also co-wrote the war film Flags of Our Fathers (2006) and the James Bond films Casino Royale (2006) and Quantum of Solace (2008). He is the creator of the television series Due South (1994–1999) and co-creator of Walker, Texas Ranger (1993–2001), among others. Haggis is a two-time Academy Award winner, two-time Emmy Award winner, and seven-time Gemini Award winner. He also assisted in the making of "We Are the World 25 for Haiti".
extract_id: Paul Edward Haggis adalah penulis skenario Kanada, produser film, dan sutradara film serta televisi. Dia paling dikenal sebagai penulis skenario dan produser untuk pemenang Oscar Best Picture berturut-turut, Million Dollar Baby (2004) dan Crash (2005), yang terakhir juga dia sutradarai. Haggis juga menulis bersama film perang Flags of Our Fathers (2006) dan film James Bond Casino Royale (2006) dan Quantum of Solace (2008). Dia adalah pencipta serial televisi Due South (1994–1999) dan pencipta bersama Walker, Texas Ranger (1993–2001), di antara lainnya. Haggis adalah pemenang Academy Award dua kali, Emmy Award dua kali, dan Gemini Award tujuh kali. Dia juga membantu pembuatan "We Are the World 25 for Haiti".

name: Paul Henreid
title: Paul Henreid
extract: Paul Georg Julius Freiherr von Hernreid, Ritter von Wasel-Waldingau was an Austrian and American actor and filmmaker. He had a successful stage and film career in German-language productions, before moving to Great Britain and the United States as a refugee from Nazi Germany. Some of his best-known film roles included Capt. Karl Marsen in Night Train to Munich (1940), Victor Laszlo in Casablanca (1942) and Jerry Durrance in Now, Voyager (1942).
extract_id: Paul Georg Julius Freiherr von Hernreid, Ritter von Wasel-Waldingau adalah aktor dan pembuat film Austria dan Amerika. Dia memiliki karier panggung dan film yang sukses dalam produksi berbahasa Jerman, sebelum pindah ke Inggris Raya dan Amerika Serikat sebagai pengungsi dari Nazi Jerman. Beberapa peran filmnya yang paling dikenal termasuk Capt. Karl Marsen dalam Night Train to Munich (1940), Victor Laszlo dalam Casablanca (1942), dan Jerry Durrance dalam Now, Voyager (1942).

name: Paul King
title: Paul King (director)
extract: Paul Thomas King is an English writer, director and producer. He works in television, film and theatre. He directed all 20 episodes of the surreal BBC Three comedy series The Mighty Boosh (2004–2007), and in 2005 he earned a British Academy Television Award nomination for Best New Director.
extract_id: Paul Thomas King adalah penulis, sutradara, dan produser Inggris. Dia bekerja di televisi, film, dan teater. Dia menyutradarai semua 20 episode seri komedi surreal BBC Three The Mighty Boosh (2004–2007), dan pada 2005 dia meraih nominasi British Academy Television Award untuk Best New Director.

name: Paul Lukas
title: Paul Lukas
extract: Paul Lukas was a Hungarian actor. He won the Academy Award for Best Actor, and the first Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama, as well as a Photoplay Award and a New York Film Critics Circle Award for his performance in the film Watch on the Rhine (1943), reprising the role he created on the Broadway stage.
extract_id: Paul Lukas adalah aktor Hungaria. Dia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Best Actor, dan Golden Globe Award pertama untuk Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama, serta Photoplay Award dan New York Film Critics Circle Award atas penampilannya dalam film Watch on the Rhine (1943), mengulangi peran yang dibuatnya di panggung Broadway.

name: Paul McCartney
title: Paul McCartney
extract: Sir James Paul McCartney is an English musician and songwriter. He gained global fame with the Beatles, for whom he was the bassist and keyboardist, and shared primary songwriting and lead vocal duties with John Lennon. McCartney is known for his melodic approach to bass-playing, versatile tenor vocal range and musical eclecticism, exploring genres ranging from pre–rock and roll pop to classical, ballads and electronica. His songwriting partnership with Lennon remains the most successful in music history.
extract_id: Sir James Paul McCartney adalah musisi dan penulis lagu Inggris. Dia meraih ketenaran global bersama Beatles, di mana dia adalah bassist dan keyboardist, serta berbagi tugas utama penulisan lagu dan vokal utama dengan John Lennon. McCartney dikenal dengan pendekatan melodis dalam bermain bass, rentang vokal tenor yang serbaguna, dan eklektisisme musiknya, menjelajahi genre mulai dari pop pra-rock and roll hingga klasik, balada, dan elektronika. Kemitraan penulisan lagunya dengan Lennon tetap menjadi yang paling sukses dalam sejarah musik.

name: Paul McGann
title: Paul McGann
extract: Paul John McGann is an English actor. He is known for starring in the 1987 black comedy film Withnail and I, and for portraying the eighth incarnation of the Doctor in the 1996 television film Doctor Who; he reprised the role from 2001 in licensed audio dramas, as well as on screen in 2013 and 2022.
extract_id: Paul John McGann adalah aktor Inggris. Dia dikenal karena membintangi film komedi hitam tahun 1987 Withnail and I, dan karena memerankan inkarnasi kedelapan dari Doctor dalam film televisi Doctor Who tahun 1996; dia mengulangi peran tersebut sejak 2001 dalam drama audio berlisensi, serta di layar pada tahun 2013 dan 2022.

name: Paul McGuigan
title: Paul McGuigan (director)
extract: Paul McGuigan is a Scottish film and television director, best known for directing films such as Lucky Number Slevin, Gangster No. 1 and Push. He has also directed episodes of Sherlock, Scandal, Monroe and Smash. He was born in Bellshill Maternity Hospital, Scotland.
extract_id: Paul McGuigan adalah sutradara film dan televisi Skotlandia, paling dikenal karena menyutradarai film seperti Lucky Number Slevin, Gangster No. 1 dan Push. Dia juga telah menyutradarai episode Sherlock, Scandal, Monroe, dan Smash. Dia lahir di Rumah Sakit Bersalin Bellshill, Skotlandia.

name: Paul Meurisse
title: Paul Meurisse
extract: Paul Meurisse was a French actor who appeared in over 60 films and many stage productions. Meurisse was noted for the elegance of his acting style, and for his versatility. He was equally adept in comedic and dramatic roles. His screen roles ranged from the droll and drily humorous to the menacing and disturbing. His most celebrated role was that of the sadistic and vindictive headmaster in the 1955 film Les Diaboliques.
extract_id: Paul Meurisse adalah aktor Prancis yang tampil dalam lebih dari 60 film dan banyak produksi panggung. Meurisse dikenal karena keanggunan gaya aktingnya dan karena kemampuannya yang serbaguna. Dia mahir dalam peran komedi maupun dramatis. Peran peranannya di layar berkisar dari yang jenaka dan humor kering hingga yang mengancam dan mengganggu. Peran yang paling terkenal adalah kepala sekolah sadis dan pendendam dalam film Les Diaboliques tahun 1955.

name: Paul Muni
title: Paul Muni
extract: Paul Muni was an American stage and film actor from Chicago. He started his acting career in the Yiddish theater and during the 1930s, he was considered one of the most prestigious actors at the Warner Bros. studio and was given the rare privilege of choosing his own parts.
extract_id: Paul Muni adalah aktor panggung dan film Amerika dari Chicago. Dia memulai karier aktingnya di teater Yiddish dan selama tahun 1930-an, dia dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor paling bergengsi di studio Warner Bros. dan diberikan hak istimewa langka untuk memilih perannya sendiri.

name: Paul Newman
title: Paul Newman
extract: Paul Leonard Newman was an American actor, filmmaker, racecar driver, philanthropist, and entrepreneur. He has been described as "one of the last of the great 20th-century movie stars". He was the recipient of numerous awards, including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, seven Golden Globe Awards, an Actor Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, a Silver Bear for Best Actor, a Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Actor, and nominations for two Grammy Awards and a Tony Award. Along with his Best Actor Academy Award win, Newman also received the Academy Honorary Award and the Jean Hersholt Humanitarian Award.
extract_id: Paul Leonard Newman adalah aktor, pembuat film, pembalap mobil, dermawan, dan pengusaha Amerika. Dia pernah digambarkan sebagai "salah satu bintang film besar abad ke-20 terakhir". Dia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, tujuh Golden Globe Awards, Actor Award, Primetime Emmy Award, Silver Bear untuk Best Actor, Cannes Film Festival Award untuk Best Actor, dan nominasi untuk dua Grammy Awards serta satu Tony Award. Selain memenangkan Academy Award untuk Best Actor, Newman juga menerima Academy Honorary Award dan Jean Hersholt Humanitarian Award.

name: Paul Raci
title: Paul Raci
extract: Paul Raci is an American character actor. A veteran of stage, film and television, he has appeared in a variety of projects, including small roles in Baskets and Parks and Recreation. In 2021, he was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for his performance in Sound of Metal (2019).
extract_id: Paul Raci adalah aktor karakter Amerika. Veteran panggung, film, dan televisi, dia telah tampil dalam berbagai proyek, termasuk peran kecil di Baskets dan Parks and Recreation. Pada 2021, dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Best Supporting Actor atas penampilannya dalam Sound of Metal (2019).

name: Paul Reiser
title: Paul Reiser
extract: Paul Reiser is an American actor, comedian, and writer. He played the roles of Michael Taylor in the 1980s sitcom My Two Dads, Paul Buchman in the NBC sitcom Mad About You, Modell in the 1982 film Diner, and Detective Jeffrey Friedman in the Beverly Hills Cop franchise. He has gained recognition for his roles as Jim Neiman in the 2014 film Whiplash and Dr. Sam Owens in the Netflix series Stranger Things.
extract_id: Paul Reiser adalah aktor, komedian, dan penulis Amerika. Dia memainkan peran Michael Taylor dalam sitkom My Two Dads pada tahun 1980-an, Paul Buchman dalam sitkom NBC Mad About You, Modell dalam film Diner tahun 1982, dan Detektif Jeffrey Friedman dalam waralaba Beverly Hills Cop. Dia mendapatkan pengakuan atas perannya sebagai Jim Neiman dalam film Whiplash (2014) dan Dr. Sam Owens dalam serial Netflix Stranger Things.

name: Paul Rudd
title: Paul Rudd
extract: Paul Stephen Rudd is an American actor. Rudd studied theatre at the University of Kansas and the American Academy of Dramatic Arts before making his acting debut in 1991. He was included on the Forbes Celebrity 100 list in 2019, and was named People magazine's "Sexiest Man Alive" in 2021. The accolades he has received include a Critics' Choice Television Award, alongside nominations for two Actor Awards, a Golden Globe Award, and two Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Paul Stephen Rudd adalah aktor Amerika. Rudd belajar teater di University of Kansas dan American Academy of Dramatic Arts sebelum membuat debut aktingnya pada tahun 1991. Dia masuk dalam daftar Forbes Celebrity 100 pada 2019, dan dinobatkan sebagai "Sexiest Man Alive" oleh majalah People pada 2021. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk Critics' Choice Television Award, bersama dengan nominasi untuk dua Actor Awards, satu Golden Globe Award, dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Paul Sanchez
title: Paul Sanchez
extract: Paul Sanchez is a New Orleans–based American guitarist and a singer-songwriter. Sanchez was a founding member of the New Orleans band Cowboy Mouth. He was a guitarist and one of the primary singers and songwriters for the band from 1990 to 2006. Sanchez's songs have appeared in films and on television and have been performed by various artists such as Darius Rucker, Irma Thomas, Michael Cerveris, Susan Cowsill, Kevin Griffin and The Eli Young Band, Hootie and the Blowfish, John Boutté, Shamarr Allen, Glen Andrews and Kim Carson.
extract_id: Paul Sanchez adalah gitaris dan penyanyi-penulis lagu Amerika yang berbasis di New Orleans. Sanchez adalah anggota pendiri band New Orleans Cowboy Mouth. Dia menjadi gitaris sekaligus salah satu vokalis dan penulis lagu utama band dari tahun 1990 hingga 2006. Lagu-lagu Sanchez muncul dalam film dan televisi serta telah dibawakan oleh berbagai artis seperti Darius Rucker, Irma Thomas, Michael Cerveris, Susan Cowsill, Kevin Griffin dan The Eli Young Band, Hootie and the Blowfish, John Boutté, Shamarr Allen, Glen Andrews dan Kim Carson.

name: Paul Scofield
title: Paul Scofield
extract: David Paul Scofield was an English actor. During a six-decade career, Scofield achieved the Triple Crown of Acting, winning an Academy Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, and a Tony Award for his work. Completing the feat in just seven years, no actor has achieved the Triple Crown faster than Scofield. He is celebrated for his reputation as one of the greatest Shakespearean performers. He declined the honour of a knighthood on three separate occasions, but was appointed CBE in 1956 and became a CH in 2001.
extract_id: David Paul Scofield adalah aktor Inggris. Selama karier selama enam dekade, Scofield meraih Triple Crown of Acting, memenangkan Academy Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dan Tony Award atas karyanya. Menyelesaikan prestasi tersebut hanya dalam tujuh tahun, tidak ada aktor lain yang mencapai Triple Crown lebih cepat dari Scofield. Dia dikenal karena reputasinya sebagai salah satu pemeran Shakespeare terbesar. Dia menolak gelar kebangsawanan pada tiga kesempatan berbeda, tetapi diangkat menjadi CBE pada 1956 dan menjadi CH pada 2001.

name: Paul Thomas Anderson
title: Paul Thomas Anderson
extract: Paul Thomas Anderson, also known by his initials PTA, is an American filmmaker. Often described as one of the preeminent filmmakers of his generation, he is the recipient of numerous accolades, including three Academy Awards, three Golden Globe Awards and four BAFTAs, as well as a nomination for a Grammy Award. He is the only person to have won the Academy Award for Best Director and directorial prizes at Europe's three major film festivals: Cannes Film Festival, Venice Film Festival, and the Berlin International Film Festival. In addition to those accolades, he won the Golden Bear at the Berlin International Film Festival.
extract_id: Paul Thomas Anderson, yang juga dikenal dengan inisial PTA, adalah pembuat film Amerika. Sering digambarkan sebagai salah satu pembuat film terkemuka dari generasinya, dia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk tiga Academy Awards, tiga Golden Globe Awards dan empat BAFTA, serta nominasi untuk Grammy Award. Dia adalah satu-satunya orang yang telah memenangkan Academy Award untuk Best Director dan penghargaan sutradara di tiga festival film besar Eropa: Cannes Film Festival, Venice Film Festival, dan Berlin International Film Festival. Selain penghargaan tersebut, dia memenangkan Golden Bear di Berlin International Film Festival.

name: Paul Verhoeven
title: Paul Verhoeven
extract: Paul Verhoeven is a Dutch filmmaker, who has worked variously in the Netherlands, the United States, and in France. He is known for directing genre films with strong satirical elements, often featuring graphic violence and explicit sexual content and nudity. Many of his films are considered provocative, and were controversial when released.
extract_id: Paul Verhoeven adalah pembuat film Belanda, yang telah bekerja di Belanda, Amerika Serikat, dan Prancis. Dia dikenal karena menyutradarai film genre dengan elemen satir kuat, sering menampilkan kekerasan grafis dan konten seksual eksplisit serta ketelanjangan. Banyak filmnya dianggap provokatif, dan kontroversial saat dirilis.

name: Paul Winfield
title: Paul Winfield
extract: Paul Edward Winfield was an American actor. He was known for his portrayal of a Louisiana sharecropper who struggles to support his family during the Great Depression in the landmark film Sounder (1972), which earned him an Academy Award for Best Actor nomination, making him the first openly gay nominee. Winfield portrayed Martin Luther King Jr. in the 1978 television miniseries King, for which he was nominated for an Emmy Award. Winfield was also known for his roles in Star Trek: The Next Generation, Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan, The Terminator, L.A. Law,, the Magic Mirror in The Charmings, and Julian c. Barlow in the final season of 227. Winfield received four Emmy nominations overall, winning in 1995 for his 1994 guest role in Picket Fences.
extract_id: Paul Edward Winfield adalah aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai petani sharecropper Louisiana yang berjuang untuk mendukung keluarganya selama Depresi Besar dalam film penting Sounder (1972), yang memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Best Actor, menjadikannya nominee terbuka gay pertama. Winfield memerankan Martin Luther King Jr. dalam miniseri televisi King tahun 1978, yang memberinya nominasi Emmy Award. Winfield juga dikenal karena perannya dalam Star Trek: The Next Generation, Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan, The Terminator, L.A. Law, Magic Mirror dalam The Charmings, dan Julian c. Barlow di musim terakhir 227. Winfield menerima empat nominasi Emmy secara keseluruhan, dan memenangkan satu pada 1995 untuk peran tamunya pada 1994 di Picket Fences.

name: Paulette Dubost
title: Paulette Dubost
extract: Paulette Dubost was a French actress who began her career at the age of 7 at the Paris Opera.
extract_id: Paulette Dubost adalah seorang aktris Prancis yang memulai kariernya pada usia 7 tahun di Paris Opera.

name: Paulette Goddard
title: Paulette Goddard
extract: Paulette Goddard was an American actress and socialite. She was a prominent leading actress during the Golden Age of Hollywood.
extract_id: Paulette Goddard adalah seorang aktris dan sosialita Amerika. Dia adalah seorang aktris utama yang menonjol selama Era Keemasan Hollywood.

name: Pauline Burlet
title: Pauline Burlet
extract: Pauline Burlet is a Belgian actress, who starred as 'Lili Franchet' in the French TV series Résistance.
extract_id: Pauline Burlet adalah seorang aktris Belgia, yang membintangi sebagai 'Lili Franchet' dalam serial TV Prancis Résistance.

name: Pawan Malhotra
title: Pavan Malhotra
extract: Pavan Malhotra is an Indian actor who works in Hindi films and television alongside Punjabi and a few Telugu films. He has received several awards, including a Filmfare OTT Award and a Filmfare Award South.
extract_id: Pavan Malhotra adalah seorang aktor India yang bekerja di film dan televisi Hindi bersama dengan film Punjabi dan beberapa film Telugu. Dia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk Filmfare OTT Award dan Filmfare Award South.

name: Payman Maadi
title: Payman Maadi
extract: Payman Maadi, also known as Peyman Moadi, is an Iranian-American actor, screenwriter, and director. He is best known for starring in the films A Separation (2011) and About Elly (2009) by Iranian Academy Award-winning director Asghar Farhadi, Last Knights (2015) and the independent drama film Camp X-Ray (2014). For his role in A Separation, he won the Silver Bear for Best Actor at the 61st Berlin International Film Festival (2011).
extract_id: Payman Maadi, juga dikenal sebagai Peyman Moadi, adalah seorang aktor, penulis skenario, dan sutradara Iran-Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena membintangi film A Separation (2011) dan About Elly (2009) oleh sutradara pemenang Penghargaan Akademi Iran Asghar Farhadi, Last Knights (2015), dan film drama independen Camp X-Ray (2014). Untuk perannya dalam A Separation, dia memenangkan Silver Bear untuk Aktor Terbaik di Festival Film Internasional Berlin ke-61 (2011).

name: Pedro Almodóvar
title: Pedro Almodóvar
extract: Pedro Almodóvar Caballero is a Spanish film director, screenwriter and author. His films are distinguished by melodrama, irreverent humour, bold colour, glossy décor, quotations from popular culture, and complex narratives. Desire, LGBTQ issues, passion, family, motherhood, and identity are among Almodóvar's most frequently explored subjects. As one of the most internationally successful Spanish filmmakers, Almodóvar and his films have developed a cult following.
extract_id: Pedro Almodóvar Caballero adalah seorang sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan penulis Spanyol. Film-filmnya ditandai dengan melodrama, humor tak kenal hormat, warna yang berani, dekorasi mengkilap, kutipan dari budaya populer, dan narasi yang kompleks. Hasrat, isu LGBTQ, keluarga, keibuan, dan identitas adalah beberapa subjek yang paling sering dieksplorasi oleh Almodóvar. Sebagai salah satu pembuat film Spanyol yang paling sukses secara internasional, Almodóvar dan film-filmnya telah mengembangkan pengikut kultus.

name: Penelope Allen
title: Penelope Allen
extract: Penelope Allen, also known as Penny Allen, is an American stage and film actress and acting coach. She is best known as the head bank teller being held hostage in the film Dog Day Afternoon. She also played Annie, the ex-wife of Francis Lionel "Lion" Delbuchi in the film Scarecrow.
extract_id: Penelope Allen, juga dikenal sebagai Penny Allen, adalah seorang aktris panggung dan film Amerika serta pelatih akting. Dia paling dikenal sebagai kepala teller bank yang disandera dalam film Dog Day Afternoon. Dia juga memerankan Annie, mantan istri Francis Lionel "Lion" Delbuchi dalam film Scarecrow.

name: Penelope Ann Miller
title: Penelope Ann Miller
extract: Penelope Ann Miller, sometimes credited as Penelope Miller, is an American actress. She began her career on Broadway in the original run of Biloxi Blues (1985–1986), later appearing in the 1988 film adaptation of the same name. After playing small roles in the comedies Adventures in Babysitting (1987) and Big Top Pee-wee (1988), and receiving a Tony Award nomination for her leading role in the Broadway revival of Our Town (1988–1989), Miller came to prominence with a succession of major parts in films such as The Freshman, Awakenings, Kindergarten Cop, Other People's Money (1991), Chaplin (1992), The Shadow (1994), and The Relic (1997). For her portrayal of exotic dancer Gail in Carlito's Way (1993), she was nominated for the Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: Penelope Ann Miller, kadang-kadang dikreditkan sebagai Penelope Miller, adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya di Broadway dalam produksi asli Biloxi Blues (1985–1986), kemudian muncul dalam adaptasi film tahun 1988 dengan judul yang sama. Setelah memainkan peran kecil dalam komedi Adventures in Babysitting (1987) dan Big Top Pee-wee (1988), serta menerima nominasi Tony Award untuk peran utama dalam kebangkitan Broadway Our Town (1988–1989), Miller menjadi terkenal dengan serangkaian peran besar dalam film seperti The Freshman, Awakenings, Kindergarten Cop, Other People's Money (1991), Chaplin (1992), The Shadow (1994), dan The Relic (1997). Untuk perannya sebagai penari eksotik Gail dalam Carlito's Way (1993), dia dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Penny Marshall
title: Penny Marshall
extract: Carole Penny Marshall was an American actress, film director, and producer. She starred as Laverne DeFazio on the television sitcom Laverne & Shirley from 1976 to 1983, and received three nominations for the Golden Globe Award for Best Actress – Television Series Musical or Comedy for her portrayal.
extract_id: Carole Penny Marshall adalah seorang aktris, sutradara film, dan produser Amerika. Dia membintangi sebagai Laverne DeFazio dalam sitkom televisi Laverne & Shirley dari 1976 hingga 1983, dan menerima tiga nominasi untuk Golden Globe Award untuk Aktris Terbaik – Serial Televisi Musikal atau Komedi atas perannya tersebut.

name: Penélope Cruz
title: Penélope Cruz
extract: Penélope Cruz Sánchez is a Spanish actress who performs in both Spanish and English-language films. Her accolades include an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Grammy Award, three Goya Awards and a David di Donatello.
extract_id: Penélope Cruz Sánchez adalah seorang aktris Spanyol yang tampil dalam film berbahasa Spanyol dan Inggris. Penghargaan yang diterimanya meliputi Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Grammy Award, tiga Goya Awards, dan David di Donatello.

name: Per Ragnar
title: Per Ragnar
extract: Per Ragnar, Per-Erik Ragnar, is a Swedish actor, director and author.
extract_id: Per Ragnar, Per-Erik Ragnar, adalah seorang aktor, sutradara, dan penulis Swedia.

name: Perry Lopez
title: Perry Lopez
extract: Perry Lopez was an American film and television actor. His acting career spanned 40 years.
extract_id: Perry Lopez adalah seorang aktor film dan televisi Amerika. Karier aktingnya berlangsung selama 40 tahun.

name: Pete Docter
title: Pete Docter
extract: Peter Hans Docter is an American filmmaker and animator. He has served as chief creative officer (CCO) of Pixar since 2018. He has directed the company's animated films Monsters, Inc. (2001), Up (2009), Inside Out (2015), and Soul (2020). He was also a writer on Toy Story (1995) and Toy Story 2 (1999). From his nine Academy Award nominations, he is a record three-time recipient of Best Animated Feature for Up, Inside Out and Soul. Docter has also won six Annie Awards from nine nominations, two Critics' Choice Awards, a BAFTA Award, a Satellite Award and a Hochi Film Award. He often describes himself as a "geeky kid from Minnesota who likes to draw cartoons".
extract_id: Peter Hans Docter adalah seorang pembuat film dan animator Amerika. Dia telah menjabat sebagai chief creative officer (CCO) Pixar sejak 2018. Dia telah menyutradarai film animasi perusahaan seperti Monsters, Inc. (2001), Up (2009), Inside Out (2015), dan Soul (2020). Dia juga menjadi penulis dalam Toy Story (1995) dan Toy Story 2 (1999). Dari sembilan nominasi Academy Award-nya, dia mencatat rekor sebagai penerima penghargaan Best Animated Feature sebanyak tiga kali untuk Up, Inside Out, dan Soul. Docter juga memenangkan enam Annie Awards dari sembilan nominasi, dua Critics' Choice Awards, satu BAFTA Award, satu Satellite Award, dan satu Hochi Film Award. Dia sering menggambarkan dirinya sebagai "anak geek dari Minnesota yang suka menggambar kartun".

name: Pete Postlethwaite
title: Pete Postlethwaite
extract: Peter William Postlethwaite was an English character actor. After various stage and minor television appearances, Postlethwaite's first major success arose through the film Distant Voices, Still Lives (1988), directed by Terence Davies. He had a breakthrough in Hollywood when he portrayed David in Alien 3 (1992), and his international reputation was further solidified when he was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for his role as Giuseppe Conlon, father of Gerry Conlon, in In the Name of the Father (1993).
extract_id: Peter William Postlethwaite adalah seorang aktor karakter Inggris. Setelah berbagai penampilan di panggung dan televisi minor, kesuksesan besar Postlethwaite datang melalui film Distant Voices, Still Lives (1988), yang disutradarai oleh Terence Davies. Dia mengalami terobosan di Hollywood ketika memerankan David dalam Alien 3 (1992), dan reputasinya secara internasional semakin kuat ketika dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award sebagai Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk perannya sebagai Giuseppe Conlon, ayah Gerry Conlon, dalam film In the Name of the Father (1993).

name: Peter Billingsley
title: Peter Billingsley
extract: Peter Billingsley, also known as Peter Michaelsen and Peter Billingsley-Michaelsen, is an American actor and filmmaker. He is best known for portraying Ralphie Parker in A Christmas Story and A Christmas Story Christmas. He also played Jack Simmons in The Dirt Bike Kid, Billy in Death Valley, and Messy Marvin in a series of commercials for Hershey's Syrup in the 1980s. While an infant, he began acting in television commercials.
extract_id: Peter Billingsley, juga dikenal sebagai Peter Michaelsen dan Peter Billingsley-Michaelsen, adalah seorang aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan Ralphie Parker dalam A Christmas Story dan A Christmas Story Christmas. Dia juga memerankan Jack Simmons dalam The Dirt Bike Kid, Billy dalam Death Valley, dan Messy Marvin dalam serangkaian iklan untuk Hershey's Syrup pada tahun 1980-an. Saat masih bayi, dia mulai berakting dalam iklan televisi.

name: Peter Bogdanovich
title: Peter Bogdanovich
extract: Peter Bogdanovich was an American filmmaker, actor, critic, and film historian. He started out his career as a young actor studying under Stella Adler before working as a journalist for Film Culture and Esquire and finally becoming a prominent filmmaker of the New Hollywood movement. He received accolades including a BAFTA Award and Grammy Award, as well as nominations for two Academy Awards and two Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Peter Bogdanovich adalah seorang pembuat film, aktor, kritikus, dan sejarawan film Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya sebagai aktor muda yang belajar di bawah Stella Adler sebelum bekerja sebagai jurnalis untuk Film Culture dan Esquire dan akhirnya menjadi pembuat film terkemuka dalam gerakan New Hollywood. Dia menerima beberapa penghargaan termasuk BAFTA Award dan Grammy Award, serta nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards dan dua Golden Globe Awards.

name: Peter Boyle
title: Peter Boyle
extract: Peter Richard Boyle was an American actor. He is known for his work as a character actor on film and television and received several awards including a Primetime Emmy Award and a Screen Actors Guild Award.
extract_id: Peter Richard Boyle adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena karyanya sebagai aktor karakter di film dan televisi dan menerima beberapa penghargaan termasuk Primetime Emmy Award dan Screen Actors Guild Award.

name: Peter Brocco
title: Peter Brocco
extract: Carl Peter Brocco was an American screen and stage actor. He appeared in over 300 credits, notably Spartacus (1960) and One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest (1975), during his career spanning over 60 years.
extract_id: Carl Peter Brocco adalah seorang aktor layar dan panggung Amerika. Dia tampil dalam lebih dari 300 kredit, termasuk Spartacus (1960) dan One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest (1975), selama kariernya yang berlangsung lebih dari 60 tahun.

name: Peter Bull
title: Peter Bull
extract: Peter Cecil Bull was a British actor who appeared on the stage and in supporting roles in such films as The African Queen, Tom Jones and Dr. Strangelove; he wrote twelve books.
extract_id: Peter Cecil Bull adalah seorang aktor Inggris yang tampil di panggung dan dalam peran pendukung di film-film seperti The African Queen, Tom Jones, dan Dr. Strangelove; dia menulis dua belas buku.

name: Peter Coyote
title: Peter Coyote
extract: Peter Coyote is an American actor, director, screenwriter, author, and narrator of films, theater, television, and audiobooks. He is known for his appearances in films such as E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial (1982), Cross Creek (1983), Jagged Edge (1985), Bitter Moon (1992), Kika (1993), Patch Adams (1998), Erin Brockovich (2000), A Walk to Remember (2002), and Femme Fatale (2002).
extract_id: Peter Coyote adalah seorang aktor, sutradara, penulis skenario, penulis, dan narator Amerika untuk film, teater, televisi, dan buku audio. Dia dikenal karena penampilannya dalam film-film seperti E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial (1982), Cross Creek (1983), Jagged Edge (1985), Bitter Moon (1992), Kika (1993), Patch Adams (1998), Erin Brockovich (2000), A Walk to Remember (2002), dan Femme Fatale (2002).

name: Peter Dinklage
title: Peter Dinklage
extract: Peter Hayden Dinklage is an American actor. Portraying Tyrion Lannister on the HBO television series Game of Thrones (2011–2019), he won the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama Series a record four times. Dinklage also received a Golden Globe Award in 2011 and an Actor Award in 2020 for the role.
extract_id: Peter Hayden Dinklage adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Memerankan Tyrion Lannister dalam serial televisi HBO Game of Thrones (2011–2019), dia memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam Serial Drama sebanyak empat kali, yang merupakan rekor. Dinklage juga menerima Golden Globe Award pada 2011 dan Actor Award pada 2020 atas peran tersebut.

name: Peter Farrelly
title: Peter Farrelly
extract: Peter John Farrelly is an American film director, screenwriter, producer and novelist. Along with his brother Bobby, the Farrelly brothers are mostly famous for directing and producing quirky comedy and romantic comedy films such as Dumb and Dumber; Shallow Hal; Me, Myself and Irene; There's Something About Mary; and the 2007 remake of The Heartbreak Kid.
extract_id: Peter John Farrelly adalah seorang sutradara film, penulis skenario, produser, dan novelis Amerika. Bersama dengan saudaranya Bobby, Farrelly brothers paling dikenal karena menyutradarai dan memproduksi film komedi unik dan komedi romantis seperti Dumb and Dumber; Shallow Hal; Me, Myself and Irene; There's Something About Mary; dan remake The Heartbreak Kid tahun 2007.

name: Peter Finch
title: Peter Finch
extract: Frederick George Peter Ingle Finch was an English and Australian actor.
extract_id: Frederick George Peter Ingle Finch adalah seorang aktor Inggris dan Australia.

name: Peter Jackson
title: Peter Jackson
extract: Sir Peter Robert Jackson is a New Zealand filmmaker, entrepreneur and visual effects pioneer. He is best known as the director, screen-writer, and producer of the Lord of the Rings trilogy (2001–2003) and the Hobbit trilogy (2012–2014), both of which are adapted from the novels of the same name by J. R. R. Tolkien. Other notable films include the critically lauded drama Heavenly Creatures (1994), the horror comedy The Frighteners (1996), the epic monster remake film King Kong (2005), District 9 (2009), the World War I documentary film They Shall Not Grow Old (2018) and the documentary The Beatles: Get Back (2021). He is the fifth-highest-grossing film director of all-time, with his films having made over $6.5 billion worldwide.
extract_id: Sir Peter Robert Jackson adalah pembuat film, pengusaha, dan pelopor efek visual dari Selandia Baru. Dia paling dikenal sebagai sutradara, penulis skenario, dan produser trilogi Lord of the Rings (2001–2003) dan trilogi Hobbit (2012–2014), keduanya diadaptasi dari novel dengan judul yang sama oleh J. R. R. Tolkien. Film penting lainnya termasuk drama yang mendapat pujian kritis Heavenly Creatures (1994), komedi horor The Frighteners (1996), film remake monster epik King Kong (2005), District 9 (2009), film dokumenter Perang Dunia I They Shall Not Grow Old (2018), dan dokumenter The Beatles: Get Back (2021). Dia adalah sutradara film dengan pendapatan tertinggi kelima sepanjang masa, dengan film-filmnya menghasilkan lebih dari $6,5 miliar di seluruh dunia.

name: Peter Lorre
title: Peter Lorre
extract: Peter Lorre was a Hungarian and American actor, active first in Europe and later in the United States. Known for his timidly devious characters, appearance, and accented voice, he was frequently typecast as a sinister foreigner. He was caricatured throughout his life and his cultural legacy remains in the media today.
extract_id: Peter Lorre adalah seorang aktor Hungaria dan Amerika, yang aktif pertama di Eropa dan kemudian di Amerika Serikat. Dikenal karena karakter yang licik dan penampilannya yang tertutup serta suara dengan aksen, dia sering diketik sebagai orang asing yang menyeramkan. Dia sering dijadikan karikatur sepanjang hidupnya dan warisan budayanya tetap ada dalam media hingga hari ini.

name: Peter Mullan
title: Peter Mullan
extract: Peter Mullan is a Scottish actor and filmmaker. His credits include Riff-Raff (1991), Shallow Grave (1994), Braveheart (1995), Trainspotting (1996), My Name Is Joe (1998), The Claim (2000), Neds (2010), War Horse (2011), The Fixer (2008), Top of the Lake (2013), Mum (2016–2019), Ozark (2017–2018), Westworld (2018–2020), Cursed (2020), The North Water (2021), The Underground Railroad (2021), The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power (2022–2024), After the Party (2023), Baghead (2023) and I Swear (2025).
extract_id: Peter Mullan adalah aktor dan pembuat film Skotlandia. Kreditnya termasuk Riff-Raff (1991), Shallow Grave (1994), Braveheart (1995), Trainspotting (1996), My Name Is Joe (1998), The Claim (2000), Neds (2010), War Horse (2011), The Fixer (2008), Top of the Lake (2013), Mum (2016–2019), Ozark (2017–2018), Westworld (2018–2020), Cursed (2020), The North Water (2021), The Underground Railroad (2021), The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power (2022–2024), After the Party (2023), Baghead (2023) dan I Swear (2025).

name: Peter O'Toole
title: Peter O'Toole
extract: Peter James O'Toole was an English and Irish actor. Known for his work on stage and screen, he received various accolades, including an Academy Honorary Award, a BAFTA Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, and four Golden Globe Awards, in addition to nominations for a Grammy Award and a Laurence Olivier Award.
extract_id: Peter James O'Toole adalah aktor Inggris dan Irlandia. Dikenal karena karyanya di panggung dan layar, ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Honorary Award, BAFTA Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dan empat Golden Globe Awards, selain nominasi untuk Grammy Award dan Laurence Olivier Award.

name: Peter Ostrum
title: Peter Ostrum
extract: Peter Gardner Ostrum is an American retired veterinarian and former child actor, whose only film role was as Charlie Bucket in the 1971 motion picture Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory.
extract_id: Peter Gardner Ostrum adalah dokter hewan Amerika yang telah pensiun dan mantan aktor cilik, yang satu-satunya peran filmnya adalah sebagai Charlie Bucket dalam film tahun 1971 Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory.

name: Peter Ramsey
title: Peter Ramsey
description: American illustrator, storyboard artist, and filmmaker (born 1962)
extract: Peter A. Ramsey is an American illustrator, storyboard artist, and filmmaker. He is best known for directing DreamWorks Animation's Rise of the Guardians (2012), becoming the first African American to direct a computer-animated film and the second to direct a major American animated film, and co-directing Sony Pictures Animation's Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse (2018). For Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, he became the first African American to be nominated for and win an Academy Award for Best Animated Feature.
extract_id: Peter A. Ramsey adalah ilustrator, artis storyboard, dan pembuat film Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai DreamWorks Animation's Rise of the Guardians (2012), menjadi orang Afrika Amerika pertama yang menyutradarai film animasi komputer dan kedua yang menyutradarai film animasi Amerika besar, serta sebagai co-direktur Sony Pictures Animation's Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse (2018). Untuk Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, ia menjadi orang Afrika Amerika pertama yang dinominasikan dan memenangkan Academy Award untuk Best Animated Feature.

name: Peter Sellers
title: Peter Sellers
extract: Peter Sellers was an English actor and comedian. He first came to prominence with his performances on the BBC Radio comedy series The Goon Show. Sellers was featured on a number of hit comic songs and became internationally acclaimed for his film roles, most notably as Chief Inspector Clouseau in The Pink Panther series.
extract_id: Peter Sellers adalah aktor dan komedian Inggris. Ia pertama kali dikenal melalui pertunjukannya dalam serial komedi BBC Radio The Goon Show. Sellers tampil dalam sejumlah lagu komik populer dan menjadi terkenal secara internasional untuk peran filmnya, terutama sebagai Chief Inspector Clouseau dalam seri The Pink Panther.

name: Peter Stormare
title: Peter Stormare
extract: Rolf Peter Ingvar Stormare is a Swedish and American actor. He rose to prominence in Sweden for playing Hamlet for Ingmar Bergman in his 1988 production of the play, and in America for portraying Gaear Grimsrud in the film Fargo (1996). He has appeared in films including The Lost World: Jurassic Park (1997), The Big Lebowski (1998), Armageddon (1998), Dancer in the Dark (2000), Minority Report (2002), Bad Boys II (2003), Birth (2004), Constantine (2005), Nacho Libre (2006), 22 Jump Street (2014), John Wick: Chapter 2 (2017), and Until Dawn (2025).
extract_id: Rolf Peter Ingvar Stormare adalah aktor Swedia dan Amerika. Ia menjadi terkenal di Swedia karena memerankan Hamlet untuk Ingmar Bergman dalam produksi drama tahun 1988, dan di Amerika karena memerankan Gaear Grimsrud dalam film Fargo (1996). Ia tampil dalam film-film termasuk The Lost World: Jurassic Park (1997), The Big Lebowski (1998), Armageddon (1998), Dancer in the Dark (2000), Minority Report (2002), Bad Boys II (2003), Birth (2004), Constantine (2005), Nacho Libre (2006), 22 Jump Street (2014), John Wick: Chapter 2 (2017), dan Until Dawn (2025).

name: Peter Weir
title: Peter Weir
extract: Peter Lindsay Weir AM is an Australian retired film director, screenwriter, and producer. He directed films crossing various genres over forty years, such as Homesdale (1971), Picnic at Hanging Rock (1975), The Plumber (1979), Gallipoli (1981), The Year of Living Dangerously (1982), Witness (1985), The Mosquito Coast (1986), Dead Poets Society (1989), Fearless (1993), The Truman Show (1998), Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World (2003), and The Way Back (2010). He has received six Academy Award nominations and he has won two AACTA Award for Best Direction and two BAFTA Award for Best Direction. In 2022, he was awarded the Academy Honorary Award for his lifetime career achievement. In 2024, he received an honorary life-time achievement award at the Venice Film Festival.
extract_id: Peter Lindsay Weir AM adalah sutradara film, penulis naskah, dan produser Australia yang telah pensiun. Ia menyutradarai film-film dengan berbagai genre selama empat puluh tahun, seperti Homesdale (1971), Picnic at Hanging Rock (1975), The Plumber (1979), Gallipoli (1981), The Year of Living Dangerously (1982), Witness (1985), The Mosquito Coast (1986), Dead Poets Society (1989), Fearless (1993), The Truman Show (1998), Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World (2003), dan The Way Back (2010). Ia menerima enam nominasi Academy Award dan memenangkan dua AACTA Award untuk Best Direction dan dua BAFTA Award untuk Best Direction. Pada 2022, ia dianugerahi Academy Honorary Award untuk pencapaian karier seumur hidupnya. Pada 2024, ia menerima penghargaan pencapaian seumur hidup kehormatan di Festival Film Venice.

name: Peter Wyngarde
title: Peter Wyngarde
extract: Peter Paul Wyngarde, until 1945 called Cyril Louis Goldbert, was a British actor who spent his early life in the Far East. He had a successful career on stage from the mid-1940s and slowly gained screen roles, especially in television in the 1950s and 1960s, before becoming well known for portraying the character of Jason King in the television series Department S (1969) and Jason King (1971). His acting career came to an end in the 1990s, but he had occasional appearances in the 21st century.
extract_id: Peter Paul Wyngarde, hingga 1945 dikenal sebagai Cyril Louis Goldbert, adalah aktor Inggris yang menghabiskan masa kecilnya di Timur Jauh. Ia memiliki karier sukses di panggung sejak pertengahan 1940-an dan perlahan mendapat peran layar, terutama di televisi pada 1950-an dan 1960-an, sebelum dikenal luas karena memerankan karakter Jason King dalam serial televisi Department S (1969) dan Jason King (1971). Karier aktingnya berakhir pada 1990-an, tetapi ia kadang-kadang tampil kembali di abad ke-21.

name: Peter van Eyck
title: Peter van Eyck
extract: Peter van Eyck was a German and American actor. Born in Prussian Pomerania, he moved to the United States in the 1930s and established a career as a character actor. After World War II, he returned to his native country and became a leading man in West German cinema.
extract_id: Peter van Eyck adalah aktor Jerman dan Amerika. Lahir di Pomerania Prusia, ia pindah ke Amerika Serikat pada 1930-an dan membangun karier sebagai aktor karakter. Setelah Perang Dunia II, ia kembali ke negaranya dan menjadi pemeran utama dalam perfilman Jerman Barat.

name: Phil Harris
title: Phil Harris
extract: Wonga Philip Harris was an American: actor, comedian, bandleader and musician. He was an orchestra leader and a pioneer in radio situation comedy, first with The Jack Benny Program, then in The Phil Harris-Alice Faye Show in which he co-starred with his wife, singer-actress Alice Faye, for eight years. Harris is also noted for his voice acting in animated films. As a voice actor, he voiced: Baloo in The Jungle Book (1967), Thomas O'Malley in The Aristocats (1970), Little John in Robin Hood (1973) and Patou in Rock-a-Doodle (1991). As a singer, he recorded a number one novelty hit record: "The Thing" (1950).
extract_id: Wonga Philip Harris adalah aktor, komedian, pemimpin band, dan musisi Amerika. Ia adalah pemimpin orkestra dan pelopor dalam komedi situasi radio, pertama dengan The Jack Benny Program, kemudian di The Phil Harris-Alice Faye Show di mana ia tampil bersama istrinya, penyanyi-aktris Alice Faye, selama delapan tahun. Harris juga dikenal sebagai pengisi suara dalam film animasi. Sebagai pengisi suara, ia mengisi suara: Baloo di The Jungle Book (1967), Thomas O'Malley di The Aristocats (1970), Little John di Robin Hood (1973) dan Patou di Rock-a-Doodle (1991). Sebagai penyanyi, ia merekam lagu novelty hit nomor satu: "The Thing" (1950).

name: Philip Chan
title: Philip Chan (actor)
extract: Philip Chan Yan-kin is a Hong Kong actor, filmmaker, music composer, and former police officer.
extract_id: Philip Chan Yan-kin adalah aktor, pembuat film, komposer musik, dan mantan petugas polisi Hong Kong.

name: Philip Kaufman
title: Philip Kaufman
extract: Philip Kaufman is an American film director and screenwriter who has directed fifteen films over a career spanning nearly five decades. He has received numerous accolades including a BAFTA Award along with nominations for an Academy Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award. He has been described as a "maverick" and an "iconoclast," notable for his versatility and independence, often directing eclectic and controversial films. He is considered an "auteur" whose films have always expressed his personal vision. Kaufman's works have included genres such as realism, horror, fantasy, erotica, western, and crime.
extract_id: Philip Kaufman adalah sutradara film dan penulis naskah Amerika yang telah menyutradarai lima belas film selama kariernya hampir lima dekade. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk BAFTA Award beserta nominasi Academy Award dan Primetime Emmy Award. Ia digambarkan sebagai "maverick" dan "iconoclast," dikenal karena fleksibilitas dan kemandiriannya, sering menyutradarai film eklektik dan kontroversial. Dia dianggap sebagai "auteur" yang film-filmnya selalu mengungkapkan visi pribadinya. Karya Kaufman mencakup genre seperti realisme, horor, fantasi, erotika, western, dan kriminal.

name: Philip King
title: Philip King (playwright)
extract: Philip King was an English playwright and actor, born in Yorkshire. He is best known as the author of the farce See How They Run (1944). He lived in Brighton and many of his plays were first produced in nearby Worthing. He continued to act throughout his writing career, often appearing in his own plays.
extract_id: Philip King adalah dramawan dan aktor Inggris, lahir di Yorkshire. Ia paling dikenal sebagai penulis sandiwara farse See How They Run (1944). Ia tinggal di Brighton dan banyak karyanya pertama kali diproduksi di Worthing yang dekat. Ia terus berakting sepanjang karier menulisnya, sering tampil dalam drama karyanya sendiri.

name: Philip Seymour Hoffman
title: Philip Seymour Hoffman
extract: Philip Seymour Hoffman was an American actor. He was known for his distinctive supporting character roles and his memorable leading roles in many films and theatrical productions from the early 1990s until his death in 2014. He was voted the greatest film actor of the 21st century in a 2024 ranking by The Independent.
extract_id: Philip Seymour Hoffman adalah aktor Amerika. Ia dikenal karena peran pendukungnya yang khas dan peran utama yang berkesan dalam banyak film dan produksi teater dari awal 1990-an hingga kematiannya pada 2014. Ia dipilih sebagai aktor film terbesar abad ke-21 dalam peringkat tahun 2024 oleh The Independent.

name: Philippe Noiret
title: Philippe Noiret
extract: Philippe Noiret was a French film actor.
extract_id: Philippe Noiret adalah aktor film Prancis.

name: Phillip Terry
title: Phillip Terry
extract: Phillip Terry was an American actor.
extract_id: Phillip Terry adalah aktor Amerika.

name: Phillipa Soo
title: Phillipa Soo
extract: Phillipa Anne Soo is an American actress and singer. Known for her leading roles on Broadway primarily in musicals, she has received two Grammy Awards along with nominations for a Tony Award and a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Phillipa Anne Soo adalah aktris dan penyanyi Amerika. Dikenal atas peran utama di Broadway terutama dalam musik, ia menerima dua Grammy Awards beserta nominasi Tony Award dan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Phylicia Rashad
title: Phylicia Rashad
extract: Phylicia Rashad is an American actress. She was most recently dean of the College of Fine Arts at Howard University before her three-year contract ended in May 2024. Known for her roles on stage and screen, she has received two Tony Awards as well as nominations for six Primetime Emmy Awards and a Screen Actors Guild Award.
extract_id: Phylicia Rashad adalah aktris Amerika. Ia terakhir kali menjabat sebagai dekan College of Fine Arts di Howard University sebelum kontraknya selama tiga tahun berakhir pada Mei 2024. Dikenal atas peran di panggung dan layar, ia menerima dua Tony Awards serta nominasi enam Primetime Emmy Awards dan Screen Actors Guild Award.

name: Phyllis Logan
title: Phyllis Logan
extract: Phyllis Logan is a Scottish actress, widely known for her roles as Lady Jane Felsham in Lovejoy (1986–1993) and Mrs Hughes in Downton Abbey (2010–2015). She won the BAFTA Award for Most Promising Newcomer for the 1983 film Another Time, Another Place and was nominated for BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Leading Role for the same film. Her other film appearances include Secrets & Lies (1996), Shooting Fish (1997), Downton Abbey (2019) and Misbehaviour (2020).
extract_id: Phyllis Logan adalah aktris Skotlandia, dikenal luas untuk perannya sebagai Lady Jane Felsham dalam Lovejoy (1986–1993) dan Mrs Hughes dalam Downton Abbey (2010–2015). Ia memenangkan BAFTA Award untuk Most Promising Newcomer untuk film 1983 Another Time, Another Place dan dinominasikan untuk BAFTA Award untuk Best Actress in a Leading Role untuk film yang sama. Penampilan film lainnya termasuk Secrets & Lies (1996), Shooting Fish (1997), Downton Abbey (2019) dan Misbehaviour (2020).

name: Pierre Brasseur
title: Pierre Brasseur
extract: Pierre Brasseur, born Pierre-Albert Espinasse, was a French actor.
extract_id: Pierre Brasseur, lahir sebagai Pierre-Albert Espinasse, adalah aktor Prancis.

name: Pierre Coffin
title: Pierre Coffin
extract: Pierre-Louis Padang Coffin is a French animator, director, producer, writer, and voice actor. He is best known for co-directing the first four installments in the Despicable Me franchise and being the co-creator and primary voice of all of the Minions, which won him the Kids Family Award at the 10th Seiyu Awards. He also received a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature for Despicable Me 2.
extract_id: Pierre-Louis Padang Coffin adalah animator, sutradara, produser, penulis, dan pengisi suara Prancis. Ia paling dikenal sebagai co-direktur empat film pertama dalam waralaba Despicable Me dan sebagai pencipta bersama serta suara utama semua Minions, yang memberinya Kids Family Award di 10th Seiyu Awards. Ia juga menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Best Animated Feature untuk Despicable Me 2.

name: Pierre Fresnay
title: Pierre Fresnay
extract: Pierre Fresnay was a French stage and film actor.
extract_id: Pierre Fresnay adalah aktor panggung dan film Prancis.

name: Pierre Morel
title: Pierre Morel
extract: Pierre Morel is a French film director and cinematographer. His work includes District 13, From Paris with Love, and Taken.
extract_id: Pierre Morel adalah sutradara film dan sinematografer Prancis. Karyanya termasuk District 13, From Paris with Love, dan Taken.

name: Piper Laurie
title: Piper Laurie
extract: Piper Laurie was an American actress. She is known for her roles in the films The Hustler (1961), Carrie (1976), and Children of a Lesser God (1986), and the miniseries The Thorn Birds (1983). She played Kirsten Arnesen in the original TV production of Days of Wine and Roses, and Catherine Martell in the television series Twin Peaks.
extract_id: Piper Laurie adalah aktris Amerika. Ia dikenal untuk perannya dalam film The Hustler (1961), Carrie (1976), dan Children of a Lesser God (1986), serta miniseri The Thorn Birds (1983). Ia berperan sebagai Kirsten Arnesen dalam produksi TV asli Days of Wine and Roses, dan Catherine Martell dalam serial televisi Twin Peaks.

name: Polly Bergen
title: Polly Bergen
extract: Polly Bergen was an American actress and singer. She won an Emmy Award in 1958 for her performance as Helen Morgan in Helen Morgan . For her stage work, she was nominated for the Tony Award for Best Featured Actress in a Musical for her performance as Carlotta Campion in Follies in 2001. Her film work included Cape Fear (1962) and The Caretakers (1963), for which she was nominated for the Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Drama. She hosted her own weekly variety show for one season, was a regular panelist on the TV game show To Tell the Truth, and later in life had roles in The Sopranos and Desperate Housewives. She wrote three books on beauty, fashion, and charm. She is also the inspiration behind Mother Goose in The Land of Stories.
extract_id: Polly Bergen adalah aktris dan penyanyi Amerika. Ia memenangkan Emmy Award pada 1958 untuk penampilannya sebagai Helen Morgan dalam Helen Morgan. Untuk karyanya di panggung, ia dinominasikan untuk Tony Award untuk Best Featured Actress in a Musical untuk perannya sebagai Carlotta Campion dalam Follies pada 2001. Karya filmnya meliputi Cape Fear (1962) dan The Caretakers (1963), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award untuk Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Drama. Ia memandu acara variety mingguan sendiri selama satu musim, menjadi panelis reguler di program game TV To Tell the Truth, dan kemudian memiliki peran dalam The Sopranos dan Desperate Housewives. Ia menulis tiga buku tentang kecantikan, mode, dan pesona. Ia juga menjadi inspirasi di balik Mother Goose dalam The Land of Stories.

name: Porter Hall
title: Porter Hall
extract: Clifford Porter Hall was an American character actor known for appearing in a number of films in the 1930s and 1940s. Hall typically played villains or comedic incompetent characters.
extract_id: Clifford Porter Hall adalah aktor karakter Amerika yang dikenal karena tampil dalam sejumlah film pada tahun 1930-an dan 1940-an. Hall biasanya memerankan penjahat atau karakter komedi yang tidak kompeten.

name: Prabhas
title: Prabhas
extract: Uppalapati Venkata Suryanarayana Prabhas Raju , known mononymously as Prabhas, is an Indian actor who predominantly works in Telugu cinema. He is one of the highest-paid actors in Indian cinema and has been featured in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list since 2015. Referred to in the media as Rebel Star, he has appeared in over 24 films, and has received seven Filmfare Awards nominations, a Nandi Award, and a SIIMA Award.
extract_id: Uppalapati Venkata Suryanarayana Prabhas Raju, yang dikenal secara mononim sebagai Prabhas, adalah aktor India yang sebagian besar bekerja di sinema Telugu. Dia adalah salah satu aktor dengan bayaran tertinggi di sinema India dan telah masuk dalam daftar Forbes India Celebrity 100 sejak 2015. Dikenal di media sebagai Rebel Star, dia telah muncul dalam lebih dari 24 film, dan telah menerima tujuh nominasi Filmfare Awards, satu Nandi Award, dan satu SIIMA Award.

name: Prakash Belawadi
title: Prakash Belawadi
extract: Prakash Belawadi is an Indian actor, director and screenwriter, who works predominantly in English, Kannada and Hindi theatre, films and television. He is also a theatre teacher, activist and a journalist. He hails from Bengaluru. He has participated in many seminars, conferences and festivals in India and abroad. He is a motivational speaker at events and TEDx conferences. He is also a mentor with the founding team of BISFF since 2010.
extract_id: Prakash Belawadi adalah aktor, sutradara, dan penulis skenario India yang bekerja terutama dalam teater, film, dan televisi berbahasa Inggris, Kannada, dan Hindi. Dia juga seorang guru teater, aktivis, dan jurnalis. Dia berasal dari Bengaluru. Dia telah berpartisipasi dalam banyak seminar, konferensi, dan festival di India dan luar negeri. Dia adalah pembicara motivasi di berbagai acara dan konferensi TEDx. Dia juga menjadi mentor dengan tim pendiri BISFF sejak 2010.

name: Prashanth Neel
title: Prashanth Neel
extract: Prashanth Neelakantapuram, commonly known as Prashanth Neel, is an Indian film director and screenwriter who works in Kannada and Telugu films. He debuted with the action-thriller Ugramm (2014) and later directed the KGF franchise (2018–2022), whose second part became the highest-grossing Kannada film of all-time.
extract_id: Prashanth Neelakantapuram, yang dikenal sebagai Prashanth Neel, adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario India yang bekerja dalam film Kannada dan Telugu. Dia memulai debutnya dengan film aksi-thriller Ugramm (2014) dan kemudian menyutradarai waralaba KGF (2018–2022), yang bagian keduanya menjadi film Kannada dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa.

name: Preity Zinta
title: Preity Zinta
extract: Preity G. Zinta is an Indian actress and entrepreneur primarily known for her work in Hindi films. After graduating with degrees in English honours and criminal psychology, Zinta made her acting debut in Dil Se in 1998, followed by a role in Soldier in the same year. These performances earned her the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut, and she was later recognised for her role as a teenage single mother in Kya Kehna (2000). She established a career as a leading Hindi film actress of the decade with a variety of character types. Her roles, often deemed culturally defiant, along with her unconventional screen persona won her recognition and several accolades.
extract_id: Preity G. Zinta adalah aktris dan pengusaha India yang terutama dikenal karena karyanya dalam film Hindi. Setelah lulus dengan gelar kehormatan Bahasa Inggris dan psikologi kriminal, Zinta memulai debut aktingnya dalam Dil Se pada 1998, diikuti dengan peran dalam Soldier pada tahun yang sama. Penampilan tersebut memberinya Filmfare Award untuk Best Female Debut, dan dia kemudian dikenal karena perannya sebagai ibu tunggal remaja dalam Kya Kehna (2000). Dia membangun karier sebagai aktris terkemuka film Hindi dekade itu dengan beragam jenis karakter. Perannya, yang sering dianggap menantang budaya, bersama dengan persona layar yang tidak konvensional, membawanya pada pengakuan dan beberapa penghargaan.

name: Priscilla Lane
title: Priscilla Lane
extract: Priscilla Lane was an American actress, and the youngest sibling in the Lane Sisters' family of singers and actresses. She is best remembered for her roles in the films The Roaring Twenties (1939) co-starring with James Cagney and Humphrey Bogart; Saboteur (1942), an Alfred Hitchcock film in which she plays the heroine; and Arsenic and Old Lace (1944), in which she portrays Cary Grant's fiancée and bride.
extract_id: Priscilla Lane adalah aktris Amerika dan saudara termuda dalam keluarga Lane Sisters yang terdiri dari penyanyi dan aktris. Dia paling dikenang untuk perannya dalam film The Roaring Twenties (1939) bersama James Cagney dan Humphrey Bogart; Saboteur (1942), film Alfred Hitchcock di mana dia memerankan tokoh heroine; dan Arsenic and Old Lace (1944), di mana dia memerankan tunangan dan istri Cary Grant.

name: Priscilla Presley
title: Priscilla Presley
extract: Priscilla Ann Presley is an American businesswoman and actress. She is the former wife of Elvis Presley, to whom she was married from 1967 to 1973 and with whom she shared one daughter, Lisa Marie Presley. Priscilla later co-founded and chaired Elvis Presley Enterprises (EPE), which oversaw the public opening of her previous home, Graceland, as a museum.
extract_id: Priscilla Ann Presley adalah pebisnis dan aktris Amerika. Dia adalah mantan istri Elvis Presley, yang menikah dari 1967 hingga 1973 dan bersama-sama mereka memiliki satu putri, Lisa Marie Presley. Priscilla kemudian ikut mendirikan dan menjadi ketua Elvis Presley Enterprises (EPE), yang mengawasi pembukaan rumah lamanya, Graceland, sebagai museum untuk umum.

name: Priya Anand
title: Priya Anand
extract: Priya Anand is an Indian actress and model who predominantly appears in Tamil films. She has also appeared in a few Telugu, Hindi, Kannada and Malayalam films.
extract_id: Priya Anand adalah aktris dan model India yang sebagian besar tampil dalam film Tamil. Dia juga pernah tampil dalam beberapa film Telugu, Hindi, Kannada, dan Malayalam.

name: Priyadarshan
title: Priyadarshan
extract: Priyadarshan Soman Nair is an Indian film director and screenwriter. He has worked primarily in Malayalam and Hindi cinema since 1982, directing over 90 films in multiple Indian languages, with notable works in Tamil and Telugu. Known for variety of genre films, he has received several accolades, including three National Film Awards, multiple Kerala State Film Awards, and the Padma Shri in 2012.
extract_id: Priyadarshan Soman Nair adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario India. Dia telah bekerja terutama di sinema Malayalam dan Hindi sejak 1982, menyutradarai lebih dari 90 film dalam berbagai bahasa India, dengan karya-karya terkenal dalam film Tamil dan Telugu. Dikenal dengan berbagai genre film, dia telah menerima sejumlah penghargaan, termasuk tiga National Film Awards, beberapa Kerala State Film Awards, dan Padma Shri pada 2012.

name: Priyanka Chopra
title: Priyanka Chopra
extract: Priyanka Chopra Jonas is an Indian actress, film producer and singer. The winner of the Miss World 2000 pageant and the fifth woman from India to win the Miss World pageant, she is India's highest-paid actress and her accolades include two National Film Awards and five Filmfare Awards. In 2016, the Government of India honoured her with the Padma Shri, and Time named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world. Forbes listed her among the World's 100 Most Powerful Women, and in 2022, she was named in the BBC 100 Women list.
extract_id: Priyanka Chopra Jonas adalah aktris, produser film, dan penyanyi India. Pemenang kontes Miss World 2000 dan wanita kelima dari India yang memenangkan kontes Miss World, dia adalah aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di India dan penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk dua National Film Awards dan lima Filmfare Awards. Pada 2016, Pemerintah India memberi penghargaan Padma Shri kepadanya, dan Time menamainya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia. Forbes memasukkannya dalam daftar 100 Wanita Paling Berkuasa di Dunia, dan pada 2022, dia masuk daftar BBC 100 Women.

name: Pruitt Taylor Vince
title: Pruitt Taylor Vince
extract: Pruitt Taylor Vince is an American actor. Often classified as a character actor, he made his film debut with a supporting role in Angel Heart (1987) with his most famous role playing J.J. LaRoche in the series The Mentalist.
extract_id: Pruitt Taylor Vince adalah aktor Amerika. Sering diklasifikasikan sebagai aktor karakter, dia memulai debut filmnya dengan peran pendukung dalam Angel Heart (1987) dengan peran paling terkenalnya memerankan J.J. LaRoche dalam seri The Mentalist.

name: Pupella Maggio
title: Pupella Maggio
extract: Pupella Maggio was an Italian film actress.
extract_id: Pupella Maggio adalah aktris film Italia.

name: Qiu Yuen
title: Yuen Qiu
description: Hong Kong actress, martial artist, and stuntwoman
