extract: Cheung Cheun-Nam, known professionally as Yuen Qiu, is a Hong Kong actress and martial artist. She is an expert of both Chinese martial arts and Beijing-opera skills, and was apprenticed at the Peking Opera School under Yu Jim-yuen, the same master as Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung.
extract_id: Cheung Cheun-Nam, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Yuen Qiu, adalah aktris dan ahli seni bela diri Hong Kong. Dia adalah ahli dari seni bela diri Tiongkok dan keterampilan opera Beijing, dan belajar di Peking Opera School di bawah bimbingan Yu Jim-yuen, guru yang sama dengan Jackie Chan dan Sammo Hung.

name: Quentin Tarantino
title: Quentin Tarantino
extract: Quentin Jerome Tarantino is an American filmmaker, actor, and author. His works are characterized by graphic violence, extended dialogue often featuring much profanity, and references to popular culture. His films have earned a cult following alongside critical and commercial success, and he has been named by some as the most influential director of his generation. Tarantino has received numerous accolades including two Academy Awards, two BAFTA Awards, and four Golden Globe Awards, as well as nominations for a Primetime Emmy Award and five Grammy Awards. His films have collectively grossed more than $1.9 billion worldwide.
extract_id: Quentin Jerome Tarantino adalah pembuat film, aktor, dan penulis Amerika. Karya-karyanya dikenal dengan kekerasan grafis, dialog panjang yang sering mengandung bahasa kasar, dan referensi ke budaya populer. Film-filmnya mendapat pengikut kultus selain sukses kritis dan komersial, dan dia dianggap oleh beberapa orang sebagai sutradara paling berpengaruh di generasinya. Tarantino telah menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk dua Academy Awards, dua BAFTA Awards, dan empat Golden Globe Awards, serta nominasi untuk Primetime Emmy Award dan lima Grammy Awards. Film-filmnya secara kolektif meraih pendapatan lebih dari $1,9 miliar di seluruh dunia.

name: Quinton Aaron
title: Quinton Aaron
extract: Quinton Aaron is an American actor. He made his film debut in Michel Gondry's Be Kind Rewind. He is best known for his lead role as Michael Oher in the 2009 film The Blind Side.
extract_id: Quinton Aaron adalah aktor Amerika. Dia memulai debut filmnya dalam Be Kind Rewind karya Michel Gondry. Dia paling dikenal untuk peran utamanya sebagai Michael Oher dalam film The Blind Side (2009).

name: R. Lee Ermey
title: R. Lee Ermey
extract: Ronald Lee Ermey was an American actor and U.S. Marine drill instructor. He achieved fame for his role as Gunnery Sergeant Hartman in the 1987 film Full Metal Jacket, which earned him a Golden Globe nomination for Best Supporting Actor. Ermey was also a United States Marine Corps staff sergeant and an honorary gunnery sergeant.
extract_id: Ronald Lee Ermey adalah aktor Amerika dan instruktur pelatihan Marines AS. Dia meraih ketenaran untuk perannya sebagai Gunnery Sergeant Hartman dalam film Full Metal Jacket (1987), yang memberinya nominasi Golden Globe untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik. Ermey juga pernah menjadi staff sergeant di Korps Marinir Amerika Serikat dan Gunnery Sergeant kehormatan.

name: RJ Cyler
title: RJ Cyler
extract: Ronald "RJ" Cyler II is an American actor. His films include Me and Earl and the Dying Girl (2015), Power Rangers (2017), The Harder They Fall (2021), and Emergency (2022). On television, he is known for his roles in the Showtime series I'm Dying Up Here (2017–2018) and Scream: Resurrection (2019).
extract_id: Ronald "RJ" Cyler II adalah aktor Amerika. Film-filmnya termasuk Me and Earl and the Dying Girl (2015), Power Rangers (2017), The Harder They Fall (2021), dan Emergency (2022). Di televisi, dia dikenal untuk perannya dalam seri Showtime I'm Dying Up Here (2017–2018) dan Scream: Resurrection (2019).

name: Rachel Griffiths
title: Rachel Griffiths
extract: Rachel Anne Griffiths is an Australian actress. Raised primarily in Melbourne, she began her acting career appearing on the Australian series Secrets before being cast in a supporting role in the comedy Muriel's Wedding (1994), which earned her an AACTA Award for Best Actress in a Supporting Role. In 1997, she was the lead in Nadia Tass's drama Amy, followed by her portrayal of Hilary du Pré in Hilary and Jackie (1998), for which she received a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: Rachel Anne Griffiths adalah aktris Australia. Dibesarkan terutama di Melbourne, dia memulai karier aktingnya dengan tampil di seri Australia Secrets sebelum mendapat peran pendukung dalam komedi Muriel's Wedding (1994), yang memberinya AACTA Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik. Pada 1997, dia memerankan tokoh utama dalam drama Nadia Tass, Amy, diikuti dengan perannya sebagai Hilary du Pré dalam Hilary and Jackie (1998), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award sebagai Aktris Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Rachel House
title: Rachel House
extract: Rachel Jessica Te Ao Maarama House is a New Zealand actress and director. She is best known for her roles in the films of Taika Waititi. She has received numerous accolades including an Arts Laureate, NZ Order of Merit, "Mana Wahine" from WIFT NZ and Te Waipuna a Rangi for her contributions as an actor and director.
extract_id: Rachel Jessica Te Ao Maarama House adalah aktris dan sutradara Selandia Baru. Dia paling dikenal untuk perannya dalam film-film karya Taika Waititi. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Arts Laureate, NZ Order of Merit, "Mana Wahine" dari WIFT NZ, dan Te Waipuna a Rangi untuk kontribusinya sebagai aktor dan sutradara.

name: Rachel McAdams
title: Rachel McAdams
extract: Rachel Anne McAdams is a Canadian actress. A graduate of York University in 2001 with a BFA degree in theatre, she is known for her starring roles in comedy and drama films as well as her work in television and theater. Her accolades include nominations for an Academy Award, a British Academy Film Award, and a Tony Award. In 2026, she was honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. As a leading actress, her films have grossed over $3.4 billion worldwide.
extract_id: Rachel Anne McAdams adalah aktris Kanada. Lulusan York University pada 2001 dengan gelar BFA dalam bidang teater, dia dikenal karena peran utama dalam film komedi dan drama serta karyanya di televisi dan teater. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk nominasi untuk Academy Award, British Academy Film Award, dan Tony Award. Pada 2026, dia dianugerahi bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame. Sebagai aktris utama, film-filmnya telah meraih pendapatan lebih dari $3,4 miliar di seluruh dunia.

name: Rachel Shelley
title: Rachel Shelley
extract: Rachel Shelley is an English actress, audio producer and model. She is best known for playing Helena Peabody in the Showtime series The L Word and Elizabeth Russell in the Oscar-nominated Bollywood epic Lagaan.
extract_id: Rachel Shelley adalah aktris Inggris, produser audio, dan model. Dia paling dikenal untuk perannya sebagai Helena Peabody dalam seri Showtime The L Word dan Elizabeth Russell dalam epik Bollywood Lagaan yang dinominasikan untuk Oscar.

name: Rachel Ticotin
title: Rachel Ticotin
extract: Rachel Ticotin Strauss is an American actress and dancer. She has played prominent roles in films such as Fort Apache, The Bronx (1981), Total Recall (1990), Falling Down (1993), Don Juan DeMarco (1994), Con Air (1997), Man on Fire (2004), and The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants (2005). She is also known for her television work, notably as Lt. Arleen Gonzales on Law & Order: LA (2010–11) and the voice of Capt. Maria Chavez on the animated series Gargoyles (1994–97).
extract_id: Rachel Ticotin Strauss adalah aktris dan penari Amerika. Dia telah memerankan peran penting dalam film seperti Fort Apache, The Bronx (1981), Total Recall (1990), Falling Down (1993), Don Juan DeMarco (1994), Con Air (1997), Man on Fire (2004), dan The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants (2005). Dia juga dikenal untuk karyanya di televisi, khususnya sebagai Letnan Arleen Gonzales dalam Law & Order: LA (2010–11) dan suara Capt. Maria Chavez dalam seri animasi Gargoyles (1994–97).

name: Rachel Weisz
title: Rachel Weisz
extract: Rachel Hannah Weisz is a British actress. Known for her performances on stage and screen, she has received several awards, including an Academy Award, an Actor Award, a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a Laurence Olivier Award.
extract_id: Rachel Hannah Weisz adalah aktris Inggris. Dikenal karena penampilannya di panggung dan layar, dia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Aktor Award, BAFTA Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Laurence Olivier Award.

name: Radha Mitchell
title: Radha Mitchell
extract: Radha Rani Amber Indigo Ananda Mitchell is an Australian actress. She began her career on television, playing Catherine O'Brien on the Australian soap opera Neighbours (1996–97), before transitioning to working in Hollywood. Known for her work in the action and thriller genres, she is the recipient of an FCCA Award, as well as nominations for Fangoria Chainsaw, AFI, and Screen Actors Guild Awards.
extract_id: Radha Rani Amber Indigo Ananda Mitchell adalah aktris Australia. Dia memulai kariernya di televisi dengan memainkan karakter Catherine O'Brien dalam opera sabun Australia Neighbours (1996–97), sebelum beralih bekerja di Hollywood. Dikenal karena karyanya di genre aksi dan thriller, dia adalah penerima FCCA Award, serta nominasi untuk Fangoria Chainsaw, AFI, dan Screen Actors Guild Awards.

name: Radhika Apte
title: Radhika Apte
extract: Radhika Charudutt Apte is an Indian actress who works predominantly in Hindi films and television along with films in Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, and Malayalam. She began acting in theatre and made her film debut with a brief role in the fantasy drama Vaah! Life Ho Toh Aisi! (2005). Her first lead role was in the 2009 Bengali drama Antaheen. She gained attention for her supporting roles in three of her 2015 Bollywood productions: the revenge drama Badlapur, the comedy Hunterrr, and the biographical film Manjhi - The Mountain Man. Her leading roles in the 2016 independent films Phobia and Parched earned her acclaim.
extract_id: Radhika Charudutt Apte adalah aktris India yang sebagian besar bekerja dalam film dan televisi Hindi serta film dalam bahasa Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, dan Malayalam. Dia memulai akting di teater dan debut filmnya dengan peran singkat dalam drama fantasi Vaah! Life Ho Toh Aisi! (2005). Peran utama pertamanya adalah dalam drama Bengali Antaheen (2009). Dia menarik perhatian untuk peran pendukungnya dalam tiga produksi Bollywood 2015: drama balas dendam Badlapur, komedi Hunterrr, dan film biografi Manjhi - The Mountain Man. Peran utamanya dalam film independen 2016 Phobia dan Parched memberinya pujian.

name: Raghuvir Yadav
title: Raghubir Yadav
extract: Raghubir Yadav is an Indian actor, music composer, singer and set designer who works in Hindi films. He made his film debut with Massey Sahib (1985), in which he played the title role. He has won two International Awards as Best Actor for Massey Sahib, FIPRESCI Critic's Award, Venice Film Festival, 1986 and the IFFI Best Actor Award (Male): Silver Peacock Award at the 11th International Film Festival of India, 1987. The film also featured writer and social activist in National School of Drama, New Delhi until 1977.
extract_id: Raghubir Yadav adalah seorang aktor, komposer musik, penyanyi, dan desainer set asal India yang bekerja di film-film Hindi. Ia membuat debut filmnya dengan Massey Sahib (1985), di mana ia memerankan peran utama. Ia telah memenangkan dua Penghargaan Internasional sebagai Aktor Terbaik untuk Massey Sahib, Penghargaan Kritikus FIPRESCI, Festival Film Venesia, 1986 dan Penghargaan Aktor Terbaik (Pria) IFFI: Penghargaan Merak Perak di Festival Film Internasional India ke-11, 1987. Film ini juga menampilkan penulis dan aktivis sosial di National School of Drama, New Delhi sampai tahun 1977.

name: Rajat Barmecha
title: Rajat Barmecha
extract: Rajat Barmecha is an Indian actor who is best known for his lead role in the 2010 film Udaan.
extract_id: Rajat Barmecha adalah aktor India yang paling dikenal untuk peran utamanya dalam film Udaan tahun 2010.

name: Rajat Kapoor
title: Rajat Kapoor
extract: Rajat Kapoor is an Indian actor, filmmaker and playwright who works in Hindi cinema.
extract_id: Rajat Kapoor adalah seorang aktor, pembuat film, dan penulis drama India yang bekerja di sinema Hindi.

name: Rajesh Khanna
title: Rajesh Khanna
description: Indian actor, film producer and politician (1942–2012)
extract: Rajesh Khanna was an Indian actor, film producer and politician who worked in Hindi films. Regarded as one of the greatest and most successful actors in the history of Indian cinema, he is considered the first Superstar of Hindi cinema. His accolades include five Filmfare Awards, and in 2013, he was posthumously awarded the Padma Bhushan, India's third highest civilian honour.
extract_id: Rajesh Khanna adalah seorang aktor, produser film, dan politikus India yang bekerja di film-film Hindi. Dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar dan paling sukses dalam sejarah sinema India, ia dianggap sebagai Superstar pertama sinema Hindi. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk lima Filmfare Awards, dan pada tahun 2013, ia dianugerahi secara anumerta Padma Bhushan, penghargaan sipil tertinggi ketiga di India.

name: Rajit Kapoor
title: Rajit Kapur
extract: Rajit Kapur is an Indian film and theatre actor and director. He is known for his portrayal of Mahatma Gandhi in the 1996 film, The Making of the Mahatma for which he won the National Film Award for Best Actor. Other notable roles are as the protagonist Unni in the Malayalam film Agnisakshi, and the fictional detective Byomkesh Bakshi in the eponymous television series, directed by Basu Chatterjee and broadcast on Doordarshan. His debut film was Suraj Ka Satvan Ghoda (1992), directed by Shyam Benegal.
extract_id: Rajit Kapur adalah aktor dan sutradara film serta teater India. Ia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Mahatma Gandhi dalam film tahun 1996, The Making of the Mahatma yang membuatnya memenangkan Penghargaan Film Nasional untuk Aktor Terbaik. Peran penting lainnya adalah sebagai protagonis Unni dalam film Malayalam Agnisakshi, dan detektif fiksi Byomkesh Bakshi dalam serial televisi eponim yang disutradarai oleh Basu Chatterjee dan disiarkan di Doordarshan. Film debutnya adalah Suraj Ka Satvan Ghoda (1992), disutradarai oleh Shyam Benegal.

name: Rajkumar Hirani
title: Rajkumar Hirani
extract: Rajkumar "Raju" Hirani is an Indian filmmaker known for his works in Hindi films. Hirani's films have won several accolades, including four National Film Awards and 11 Filmfare Awards. A prolific director of Hindi cinema, his movies are often lighthearted but revolve around significant societal issues with humour and emotional intelligence.
extract_id: Rajkumar "Raju" Hirani adalah pembuat film India yang dikenal dengan karya-karyanya di film-film Hindi. Film Hirani telah memenangkan berbagai penghargaan, termasuk empat Penghargaan Film Nasional dan 11 Filmfare Awards. Sebagai sutradara produktif dalam sinema Hindi, film-filmnya seringkali ringan namun berputar di sekitar isu sosial penting dengan humor dan kecerdasan emosional.

name: Rajkumar Santoshi
title: Rajkumar Santoshi
extract: Rajkumar Santoshi is an Indian film director, screenwriter and producer, who works in Hindi cinema. A recipient of several accolades including three National Film Awards and six Filmfare Awards, he made his directorial debut with the action drama Ghayal (1990), starring Sunny Deol, Meenakshi Sheshadri and Amrish Puri. The film emerged as a blockbuster and critical success, making Santoshi a household name in the industry. The film also won him the National Film Award for Best Popular Film Providing Wholesome Entertainment as well as his first Filmfare Award for Best Director.
extract_id: Rajkumar Santoshi adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser India yang bekerja di sinema Hindi. Penerima sejumlah penghargaan termasuk tiga Penghargaan Film Nasional dan enam Filmfare Awards, ia memulai debut penyutradaraannya dengan drama aksi Ghayal (1990), dibintangi Sunny Deol, Meenakshi Sheshadri, dan Amrish Puri. Film ini menjadi blockbuster dan sukses kritis, menjadikan Santoshi nama besar di industri. Film ini juga memberinya Penghargaan Film Nasional untuk Film Populer Terbaik yang Memberikan Hiburan Sehat serta Filmfare Award pertamanya untuk Sutradara Terbaik.

name: Rajkummar Rao
title: Rajkummar Rao
extract: Rajkummar Rao is an Indian actor. Known for his work across a wide spectrum of genres, he has starred in over thirty films in Hindi cinema, spanning both independent and commercial films. He is the recipient of several accolades, including a National Film Award, five Filmfare Awards, and an Asia Pacific Screen Award. In 2017, he was featured on Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list.
extract_id: Rajkummar Rao adalah aktor India. Dikenal atas karyanya di berbagai genre, ia telah membintangi lebih dari tiga puluh film dalam sinema Hindi, mencakup film independen dan komersial. Ia menerima sejumlah penghargaan, termasuk Penghargaan Film Nasional, lima Filmfare Awards, dan Asia Pacific Screen Award. Pada 2017, ia masuk dalam daftar Celebrity 100 Forbes India.

name: Rakeysh Omprakash Mehra
title: Rakeysh Omprakash Mehra
extract: Rakeysh Omprakash Mehra is an Indian film director, occasional actor and screenwriter. He is best known for writing and directing the drama Rang De Basanti (2006) and the biographical sports film Bhaag Milkha Bhaag (2013), winning two Filmfare Awards for Best Director. He also wrote and directed the supernatural action thriller Aks (2001) and the drama Delhi-6 (2009).
extract_id: Rakeysh Omprakash Mehra adalah sutradara film, aktor kadang-kadang, dan penulis skenario India. Ia dikenal terutama karena menulis dan menyutradarai drama Rang De Basanti (2006) dan film biografi olahraga Bhaag Milkha Bhaag (2013), memenangkan dua Filmfare Awards untuk Sutradara Terbaik. Ia juga menulis dan menyutradarai thriller aksi supernatural Aks (2001) dan drama Delhi-6 (2009).

name: Ralph Bellamy
title: Ralph Bellamy
extract: Ralph Rexford Bellamy was an American actor whose career spanned 65 years on stage, film, and television. During his career, he played leading roles as well as supporting roles, garnering acclaim and awards, including a Tony Award for Best Actor in a Play for Sunrise at Campobello as well as Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor nomination for The Awful Truth (1937). In 1986, Bellamy was awarded with an Academy Honorary Award.
extract_id: Ralph Rexford Bellamy adalah aktor Amerika yang kariernya berlangsung selama 65 tahun di panggung, film, dan televisi. Selama kariernya, ia memerankan peran utama maupun pendukung, meraih pengakuan dan penghargaan, termasuk Tony Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Drama untuk Sunrise at Campobello serta nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk The Awful Truth (1937). Pada 1986, Bellamy dianugerahi Academy Honorary Award.

name: Ralph Brown
title: Ralph Brown
extract: Ralph William John Brown is an English actor and writer, known for playing Danny the drug dealer in Withnail and I, the security guard Aaron in Alien 3, DJ Bob Silver in The Boat That Rocked aka Pirate Radio, super-roadie Del Preston in Wayne's World 2, the pilot Ric Olié in Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace, President Lyndon Johnson in Godfather of Harlem and Henry Clinton in Turn: Washington's Spies. He won the Samuel Beckett Award for his first play Sanctuary written for Joint Stock Theatre Company in 1987, and the Raindance and Sapporo Film Festival awards for his first screenplay for the British film New Year's Day in 2001.
extract_id: Ralph William John Brown adalah aktor dan penulis Inggris, dikenal karena memerankan Danny, pengedar narkoba di Withnail and I, penjaga keamanan Aaron di Alien 3, DJ Bob Silver di The Boat That Rocked alias Pirate Radio, super-roadie Del Preston di Wayne's World 2, pilot Ric Olié di Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace, Presiden Lyndon Johnson di Godfather of Harlem dan Henry Clinton di Turn: Washington's Spies. Ia memenangkan Samuel Beckett Award untuk drama pertamanya Sanctuary yang ditulis untuk Joint Stock Theatre Company pada 1987, serta penghargaan Raindance dan Festival Film Sapporo untuk skenario pertamanya untuk film Inggris New Year's Day pada 2001.

name: Ralph Fiennes
title: Ralph Fiennes
extract: Ralph Nathaniel Twisleton-Wykeham-Fiennes is an English actor and director. Recognised for his work on stage and screen, his accolades include a BAFTA Award and a Tony Award, in addition to nominations for three Academy Awards, seven Golden Globe Awards, and a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Ralph Nathaniel Twisleton-Wykeham-Fiennes adalah aktor dan sutradara Inggris. Diakui atas karyanya di panggung dan layar, penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk BAFTA Award dan Tony Award, selain nominasi untuk tiga Academy Awards, tujuh Golden Globe Awards, dan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Ralph Macchio
title: Ralph Macchio
extract: Ralph George Macchio Jr. is an American actor. He is best known for portraying Daniel LaRusso in four Karate Kid films (1984–2025) and in Cobra Kai (2018–2025), a sequel television series. For his work in the latter, Macchio was nominated for two Critics' Choice Awards and a Primetime Emmy Award. He is also known for portraying Johnny Cade in Francis Ford Coppola's ensemble 1983 film, The Outsiders, and Bill Gambini in Joe Pesci's 1992 film My Cousin Vinny. Additional notable performances were in Eight Is Enough (1980–1981), Crossroads (1986), Ugly Betty (2008–2009), and The Deuce (2017–2019). He has also worked as a director and has produced two short films. Macchio received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 2024.
extract_id: Ralph George Macchio Jr. adalah aktor Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena memerankan Daniel LaRusso dalam empat film Karate Kid (1984–2025) dan dalam Cobra Kai (2018–2025), serial televisi sekuel. Untuk karyanya dalam serial tersebut, Macchio dinominasikan untuk dua Critics' Choice Awards dan Primetime Emmy Award. Ia juga dikenal sebagai Johnny Cade dalam film 1983 garapan Francis Ford Coppola, The Outsiders, dan Bill Gambini dalam film Joe Pesci 1992 My Cousin Vinny. Penampilan penting lainnya termasuk dalam Eight Is Enough (1980–1981), Crossroads (1986), Ugly Betty (2008–2009), dan The Deuce (2017–2019). Ia juga pernah menjadi sutradara dan memproduksi dua film pendek. Macchio mendapatkan bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada 2024.

name: Ralph Meeker
title: Ralph Meeker
extract: Ralph Meeker was an American film, stage, and television actor. He first rose to prominence for his roles in the Broadway productions of Mister Roberts (1948–1951) and Picnic (1953), the former of which earned him a Theatre World Award for his performance. In film, Meeker is known for his portrayal of Mike Hammer in Robert Aldrich's 1955 Kiss Me Deadly and as condemned infantryman Cpl. Philippe Paris in Stanley Kubrick’s Paths of Glory.
extract_id: Ralph Meeker adalah aktor film, panggung, dan televisi Amerika. Ia pertama kali dikenal luas melalui perannya dalam produksi Broadway Mister Roberts (1948–1951) dan Picnic (1953), yang membuatnya meraih Theatre World Award untuk penampilannya. Dalam film, Meeker dikenal karena memerankan Mike Hammer dalam Kiss Me Deadly karya Robert Aldrich tahun 1955 dan sebagai prajurit kaki Cpl. Philippe Paris yang dihukum mati dalam Paths of Glory karya Stanley Kubrick.

name: Ralph Richardson
title: Ralph Richardson
extract: Sir Ralph David Richardson was an English actor. Along with his contemporaries John Gielgud, Michael Redgrave, and Laurence Olivier, he made up a quartet of male actors who dominated the British stage of the mid-20th century. Neverthless, he worked in films throughout most of his career, playing more than sixty cinema roles. From an artistic but not theatrical background, Richardson had no thought of a stage career until a production of Hamlet in Brighton inspired him to become an actor. He learned his craft in the 1920s with a touring company and later the Birmingham Repertory Theatre. In 1931 he joined the Old Vic, playing mostly Shakespearean roles. He led the company the following season, succeeding Gielgud, who had taught him much about stage technique. After he left the company, a series of leading roles took him to stardom in the West End and on Broadway.
extract_id: Sir Ralph David Richardson adalah aktor Inggris. Bersama rekan sederajatnya John Gielgud, Michael Redgrave, dan Laurence Olivier, ia membentuk kuartet aktor pria yang mendominasi panggung Inggris pada pertengahan abad ke-20. Meski demikian, ia bekerja dalam film sepanjang sebagian besar kariernya, memerankan lebih dari enam puluh peran di sinema. Berasal dari latar belakang artistik bukan teater, Richardson tidak berencana menjadi aktor panggung sampai sebuah produksi Hamlet di Brighton menginspirasinya untuk menjadi aktor. Ia mempelajari keterampilannya pada tahun 1920-an dengan sebuah perusahaan tur dan kemudian di Birmingham Repertory Theatre. Pada 1931, ia bergabung dengan Old Vic, memainkan kebanyakan peran Shakespeare sebelum memimpin perusahaan tersebut musim berikutnya setelah menggantikan Gielgud yang mengajarinya banyak hal tentang teknik panggung. Setelah meninggalkan perusahaan, serangkaian peran utama membawanya menjadi bintang di West End dan Broadway.

name: Ram Kapoor
title: Ram Kapoor
extract: Ram Kapoor is an Indian actor who primarily works in Hindi-language films and television. One of the highest-paid television actors in India, he is known for portraying Jai Walia in Kasamh Se and Ram Kapoor in Bade Achhe Lagte Hain. He is a recipient of several awards including three ITA Awards and three Indian Telly Awards.
extract_id: Ram Kapoor adalah aktor India yang terutama bekerja di film dan televisi berbahasa Hindi. Salah satu aktor televisi berpenghasilan tertinggi di India, ia dikenal karena memerankan Jai Walia dalam Kasamh Se dan Ram Kapoor dalam Bade Achhe Lagte Hain. Ia penerima sejumlah penghargaan termasuk tiga ITA Awards dan tiga Indian Telly Awards.

name: Ramachandra Raju
title: Ramachandra Raju
extract: Ramachandra Raju, popularly known as Garuda Ram, is an Indian actor who primarily appears in Tamil, Telugu and Kannada films. He rose to fame for his role as the antagonist Garuda in KGF: Chapter 1.
extract_id: Ramachandra Raju, yang dikenal luas sebagai Garuda Ram, adalah aktor India yang sebagian besar tampil dalam film Tamil, Telugu, dan Kannada. Ia terkenal karena perannya sebagai antagonis Garuda dalam KGF: Chapter 1.

name: Ramesh Deo
title: Ramesh Deo
extract: Ramesh Deo was an Indian film actor who worked in more than 285 Hindi films, 190 Marathi films and 30 Marathi dramas with over 200 showings in his long career. He also produced feature films, television serials and over 250 ad films. He directed a number of films, documentaries and television serials. He is recipient of a Maharashtra State Film Award. In 2007, Deo honoured with the V. Shantaram Lifetime Achievement Award, Maharashtra's highest award in the field of cinema. He also received Filmfare Marathi Lifetime Achievement Award for his Contribution in Marathi cinema.
extract_id: Ramesh Deo adalah aktor film India yang telah bekerja dalam lebih dari 285 film Hindi, 190 film Marathi, dan 30 drama Marathi dengan lebih dari 200 pertunjukan dalam karier panjangnya. Ia juga memproduksi film fitur, serial televisi, dan lebih dari 250 iklan. Ia menyutradarai sejumlah film, dokumenter, dan serial televisi. Ia penerima Penghargaan Film Negara Bagian Maharashtra. Pada 2007, Deo dianugerahi Penghargaan Penghargaan Seumur Hidup V. Shantaram, penghargaan tertinggi Maharashtra di bidang perfilman. Ia juga menerima Penghargaan Penghargaan Seumur Hidup Filmfare Marathi atas kontribusinya dalam perfilman Marathi.

name: Ramesh Sippy
title: Ramesh Sippy
extract: Ramesh Sippy is an Indian film director, actor and producer in Hindi cinema. He is particularly known for being the director of Sholay (1975), often regarded as one of the most influential films ever made in India. The Government of India honoured him with Padma Shri in 2013. In 2017, he founded the Ramesh Sippy Academy of Cinema & Entertainment in Mumbai.
extract_id: Ramesh Sippy adalah sutradara film, aktor, dan produser India dalam sinema Hindi. Ia dikenal terutama sebagai sutradara film Sholay (1975), yang sering dianggap sebagai salah satu film paling berpengaruh yang pernah dibuat di India. Pemerintah India memberinya penghargaan Padma Shri pada 2013. Pada 2017, ia mendirikan Akademi Perfilman & Hiburan Ramesh Sippy di Mumbai.

name: Rami Malek
title: Rami Malek
extract: Rami Said Malek is an American actor. He gained recognition for portraying Queen lead singer Freddie Mercury in the biographical film Bohemian Rhapsody (2018), for which he won numerous accolades, including the Academy Award for Best Actor in 2019, becoming the first actor of Egyptian heritage to win in that category. He played computer hacker Elliot Alderson in the USA Network television series Mr. Robot (2015–2019), for which he received the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Drama Series.
extract_id: Rami Said Malek adalah aktor Amerika. Ia meraih pengakuan karena memerankan vokalis Queen, Freddie Mercury, dalam film biografi Bohemian Rhapsody (2018), yang memberinya berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award untuk Aktor Terbaik pada 2019, menjadikannya aktor keturunan Mesir pertama yang memenangkan kategori tersebut. Ia memerankan hacker komputer Elliot Alderson dalam serial televisi USA Network Mr. Robot (2015–2019), yang membuatnya menerima Primetime Emmy Award untuk Aktor Utama Terbaik dalam Seri Drama.

name: Ramon Bieri
title: Ramon Bieri
extract: Ramon Arens Bieri was an American film and television actor.
extract_id: Ramon Arens Bieri adalah aktor film dan televisi Amerika.

name: Ramya Krishnan
title: Ramya Krishnan
extract: Ramya Krishnan, also credited as Ramya Krishna, is an Indian actress known predominantly for her work in Telugu and Tamil films, along with appearances in Kannada, Malayalam and Hindi films.
extract_id: Ramya Krishnan, juga dikenal sebagai Ramya Krishna, adalah aktris India yang dikenal terutama atas karyanya dalam film Telugu dan Tamil, serta penampilan dalam film Kannada, Malayalam, dan Hindi.

name: Rana Daggubati
title: Rana Daggubati
extract: Ramanaidu "Rana" Daggubati is an Indian actor, film producer, and entrepreneur who primarily works in Telugu cinema, in addition to Tamil and Hindi films. He is a recipient of several accolades including a National Film Award, two Nandi Award, six SIIMA Awards and three Filmfare Awards South.
extract_id: Ramanaidu "Rana" Daggubati adalah aktor, produser film, dan pengusaha India yang terutama bekerja di sinema Telugu, selain juga di film Tamil dan Hindi. Ia menerima sejumlah penghargaan termasuk Penghargaan Film Nasional, dua Penghargaan Nandi, enam Penghargaan SIIMA, dan tiga Filmfare Awards South.

name: Ranbir Kapoor
title: Ranbir Kapoor
extract: Ranbir Raj Kapoor is an Indian actor who works in Hindi-language films. He has received several accolades, including seven Filmfare Awards, and is known for his work across a range of film genres. Kapoor has featured in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list and was included in the annual Time 100 list of the most influential people in the world in 2026
extract_id: Ranbir Raj Kapoor adalah aktor India yang bekerja dalam film berbahasa Hindi. Ia menerima sejumlah penghargaan, termasuk tujuh Filmfare Awards, dan dikenal karena karyanya di berbagai genre film. Kapoor masuk dalam daftar Celebrity 100 Forbes India dan termasuk dalam daftar Time 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia pada 2026.

name: Randy Quaid
title: Randy Quaid
extract: Randy Randall Rudy Quaid is an American actor.
extract_id: Randy Randall Rudy Quaid adalah aktor Amerika.

name: Rani Mukerji
title: Rani Mukerji
extract: Rani Mukerji is an Indian actress who works in Hindi films. One of the highest-paid actresses of the 2000s, She is the recipient of multiple accolades, including a National Film Award and eight Filmfare Awards.
extract_id: Rani Mukerji adalah aktris India yang bekerja dalam film-film Hindi. Salah satu aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi pada tahun 2000-an, dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk National Film Award dan delapan Filmfare Awards.

name: Ranveer Singh
title: Ranveer Singh
extract: Ranveer Singh Bhavnani is an Indian actor who predominantly works in Hindi films. Known for his work in a variety of genres, he has received several accolades, including five Filmfare Awards. Singh is among India's highest-paid actors and has been featured in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list since 2012.
extract_id: Ranveer Singh Bhavnani adalah aktor India yang sebagian besar bekerja dalam film-film Hindi. Dikenal karena karyanya dalam berbagai genre, dia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk lima Filmfare Awards. Singh termasuk salah satu aktor dengan bayaran tertinggi di India dan telah masuk dalam daftar Forbes India Celebrity 100 sejak 2012.

name: Raoul Max Trujillo
title: Raoul Trujillo
extract: Raoul Max Trujillo is an American actor, dancer, choreographer and theatre director. A former soloist with the Nikolais Dance Theatre, he is the original choreographer and co-director for the American Indian Dance Theatre. His career spans more than 45 years in film, television and theatre. He has also hosted a series of dancing programs, and is a Critics' Choice Award nominee.
extract_id: Raoul Max Trujillo adalah aktor, penari, koreografer, dan sutradara teater asal Amerika. Mantan solis di Nikolais Dance Theatre, ia adalah koreografer asli dan co-director untuk American Indian Dance Theatre. Kariernya meliputi lebih dari 45 tahun dalam film, televisi, dan teater. Ia juga menjadi pembawa acara berbagai program tari, dan merupakan nominasi Critics' Choice Award.

name: Raoul Walsh
title: Raoul Walsh
extract: Raoul Walsh was an American film director, actor, founding member of the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS), and the brother of silent cinema actor George Walsh. He portrayed John Wilkes Booth in the silent film The Birth of a Nation (1915). He directed numerous films: the widescreen epic The Big Trail (1930), starring John Wayne in his first leading role; The Roaring Twenties starring James Cagney, Gladys George, Priscilla Lane and Humphrey Bogart; High Sierra (1941) starring Ida Lupino and Humphrey Bogart; and White Heat (1949) starring James Cagney, Edmond O'Brien, Virginia Mayo and Margaret Wycherly. He directed his last film in 1964. His work has been noted as influencing such directors as Rainer Werner Fassbinder and Martin Scorsese.
extract_id: Raoul Walsh adalah sutradara film Amerika, aktor, anggota pendiri Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS), dan saudara dari aktor bioskop bisu George Walsh. Dia memerankan John Wilkes Booth dalam film bisu The Birth of a Nation (1915). Ia menyutradarai banyak film: epik widescreen The Big Trail (1930) yang menampilkan John Wayne dalam peran utama pertamanya; The Roaring Twenties yang dibintangi James Cagney, Gladys George, Priscilla Lane dan Humphrey Bogart; High Sierra (1941) yang dibintangi Ida Lupino dan Humphrey Bogart; dan White Heat (1949) yang dibintangi James Cagney, Edmond O'Brien, Virginia Mayo dan Margaret Wycherly. Ia menyutradarai film terakhirnya pada 1964. Karyanya dicatat memengaruhi sutradara seperti Rainer Werner Fassbinder dan Martin Scorsese.

name: Raphael Fejtö
title: Raphaël Fejtö
extract: Raphaël Fejtő is a French actor, director, and author. He is most famous for co-starring in Louis Malle's semi-autobiographical 1987 motion picture Au revoir les enfants.
extract_id: Raphaël Fejtő adalah aktor, sutradara, dan penulis Prancis. Ia paling dikenal karena berperan bersama dalam film semi-autobiografi Louis Malle tahun 1987, Au revoir les enfants.

name: Rashida Jones
title: Rashida Jones
extract: Rashida Leah Jones is an American actress and filmmaker. In television, she has starred as Louisa Fenn on the Fox drama series Boston Public (2000–2002), Karen Filippelli on the NBC comedy series The Office, Ann Perkins on the NBC comedy series Parks and Recreation (2009–2015), and as the eponymous lead role in the TBS comedy series Angie Tribeca (2016–2019). Her accolades include a Grammy Award win and nominations for a Golden Globe Award and two Primetime Emmy Awards. In 2025, she was named one of Time's 100 most influential people in the world.
extract_id: Rashida Leah Jones adalah aktris dan pembuat film Amerika. Di televisi, dia pernah berperan sebagai Louisa Fenn dalam serial drama Boston Public (2000–2002) di Fox, Karen Filippelli dalam serial komedi The Office di NBC, Ann Perkins dalam serial komedi Parks and Recreation (2009–2015) di NBC, dan sebagai tokoh utama eponim dalam serial komedi Angie Tribeca (2016–2019) di TBS. Penghargaan yang diterimanya meliputi kemenangan Grammy Award dan nominasi untuk Golden Globe Award serta dua Primetime Emmy Awards. Pada 2025, dia dinobatkan sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia oleh Time.

name: Raveena Tandon
title: Raveena Tandon
extract: Raveena Tandon is an Indian actress primarily known for her work in Hindi films. One of the leading actresses of the 1990s, Tandon is known for her versatility and is the recipient of several awards, including a National Film Award, two Filmfare Awards and a Filmfare OTT Award. In 2023, she was awarded the Padma Shri, the fourth highest Indian civilian honour.
extract_id: Raveena Tandon adalah aktris India yang terutama dikenal karena karyanya dalam film Hindi. Salah satu aktris terkemuka pada tahun 1990-an, Tandon dikenal karena kemampuannya beradaptasi dan penerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk National Film Award, dua Filmfare Awards dan Filmfare OTT Award. Pada 2023, dia dianugerahi Padma Shri, penghargaan sipil tertinggi keempat di India.

name: Ray Liotta
title: Ray Liotta
extract: Raymond Allen Liotta was an American actor. He first gained attention for his role in the film Something Wild (1986), which earned him a Golden Globe Award nomination. He was best known for his portrayals of Shoeless Joe Jackson in the film Field of Dreams (1989) and Henry Hill in the film Goodfellas (1990). Liotta appeared in numerous other films, including Unlawful Entry (1992), Cop Land (1997), Hannibal, Heartbreakers, John Q., Narc, Identity (2003), Wild Hogs (2007), Killing Them Softly, The Place Beyond the Pines, and Marriage Story (2019). He was also known for providing the voice for Tommy Vercetti, the playable protagonist in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City (2002).
extract_id: Raymond Allen Liotta adalah aktor Amerika. Ia pertama kali mendapat perhatian untuk perannya dalam film Something Wild (1986), yang memberinya nominasi Golden Globe Award. Ia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Shoeless Joe Jackson dalam film Field of Dreams (1989) dan Henry Hill dalam film Goodfellas (1990). Liotta muncul dalam banyak film lain, termasuk Unlawful Entry (1992), Cop Land (1997), Hannibal, Heartbreakers, John Q., Narc, Identity (2003), Wild Hogs (2007), Killing Them Softly, The Place Beyond the Pines, dan Marriage Story (2019). Ia juga dikenal sebagai pengisi suara Tommy Vercetti, protagonis yang dapat dimainkan dalam Grand Theft Auto: Vice City (2002).

name: Ray Milland
title: Ray Milland
extract: Ray Milland was a Welsh and American actor. Initially known as a star of light comedies, he achieved a dramatic breakthrough with his portrayal of an alcoholic writer in Billy Wilder's The Lost Weekend (1945). His performance earned him the Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Actor, a Golden Globe Award, and ultimately an Academy Award—the first such accolades for any Welsh-born actor.
extract_id: Ray Milland adalah aktor Welsh dan Amerika. Awalnya dikenal sebagai bintang komedi ringan, ia mencapai terobosan dramatis dengan perannya sebagai penulis pemabuk dalam Billy Wilder's The Lost Weekend (1945). Penampilannya memberinya Cannes Film Festival Award untuk Aktor Terbaik, Golden Globe Award, dan akhirnya Academy Award—penghargaan pertama bagi aktor kelahiran Welsh.

name: Ray Walston
title: Ray Walston
extract: Herman Ray Walston was an American actor. He started his career on Broadway earning the Tony Award for Best Actor in a Musical for his performance as Mr. Applegate in Damn Yankees (1956).
extract_id: Herman Ray Walston adalah aktor Amerika. Ia memulai kariernya di Broadway dan meraih Tony Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam sebuah Musikal untuk penampilannya sebagai Mr. Applegate dalam Damn Yankees (1956).

name: Raymond Massey
title: Raymond Massey
extract: Raymond Hart Massey was a Canadian and American actor. Known for his commanding stage-trained voice, he was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Actor for his portrayal of the title role in Abe Lincoln in Illinois (1940), a role he later reprised on television and in the film How the West Was Won (1962). Among his other well-known roles were Dr. Gillespie on the NBC television series Dr. Kildare (1961–66), John Brown in Santa Fe Trail (1940) and Seven Angry Men (1955), Abraham Farlan in A Matter of Life and Death (1946), and Jonathan Brewster in Arsenic and Old Lace (1944).
extract_id: Raymond Hart Massey adalah aktor Kanada dan Amerika. Dikenal dengan suara yang kuat berlatih panggung, ia dinominasikan Academy Award untuk Aktor Terbaik atas perannya sebagai tokoh utama dalam Abe Lincoln in Illinois (1940), sebuah peran yang kemudian ia ulangi di televisi dan film How the West Was Won (1962). Peran terkenalnya lainnya termasuk Dr. Gillespie dalam serial televisi NBC Dr. Kildare (1961–66), John Brown dalam Santa Fe Trail (1940) dan Seven Angry Men (1955), Abraham Farlan dalam A Matter of Life and Death (1946), dan Jonathan Brewster dalam Arsenic and Old Lace (1944).

name: Rebecca De Mornay
title: Rebecca De Mornay
extract: Rebecca De Mornay is an American actress who has appeared in more than 60 films and television shows. Her breakthrough film role came in 1983, when she starred in Risky Business. De Mornay is also known for her roles in The Slugger's Wife (1985), Runaway Train (1985), The Trip to Bountiful (1985), Backdraft (1991), and The Hand That Rocks the Cradle (1992).
extract_id: Rebecca De Mornay adalah aktris Amerika yang telah tampil dalam lebih dari 60 film dan acara televisi. Peran terobosannya dalam film datang pada 1983, ketika ia membintangi Risky Business. De Mornay juga dikenal karena perannya dalam The Slugger's Wife (1985), Runaway Train (1985), The Trip to Bountiful (1985), Backdraft (1991), dan The Hand That Rocks the Cradle (1992).

name: Reda Kateb
title: Reda Kateb
extract: Reda Kateb is a French actor.
extract_id: Reda Kateb adalah aktor Prancis.

name: Reese Witherspoon
title: Reese Witherspoon
extract: Laura Jeanne Reese Witherspoon is an American actress and producer. She is the recipient of various accolades, including an Academy Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, and two Golden Globe Awards. In 2021, Forbes named her the world's highest-paid actress, and in 2023, she was named one of the wealthiest celebrities in the U.S. with an estimated net worth of $440 million.
extract_id: Laura Jeanne Reese Witherspoon adalah aktris dan produser Amerika. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dan dua Golden Globe Awards. Pada 2021, Forbes menobatkannya sebagai aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia, dan pada 2023, dia dinobatkan sebagai salah satu selebritas terkaya di AS dengan perkiraan kekayaan bersih sebesar $440 juta.

name: Regina King
title: Regina King
extract: Regina Rene King is an American actress, director and producer. She has received various accolades, including an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, and four Primetime Emmy Awards. In 2019, Time magazine named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world.
extract_id: Regina Rene King adalah aktris, sutradara, dan produser Amerika. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan empat Primetime Emmy Awards. Pada 2019, majalah Time menamainya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia.

name: Reginald Gardiner
title: Reginald Gardiner
extract: William Reginald Gardiner was an English actor on the stage, in films and on television.
extract_id: William Reginald Gardiner adalah aktor Inggris yang tampil di panggung, film, dan televisi.

name: Reginald VelJohnson
title: Reginald VelJohnson
extract: Reginald VelJohnson is an American actor. He is best known for portraying police officers on screen, such as Sergeant Al Powell in the Die Hard franchise and Carl Winslow in the television sitcom Family Matters (1989–1998).
extract_id: Reginald VelJohnson adalah aktor Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena memerankan petugas polisi di layar, seperti Sersan Al Powell dalam franchise Die Hard dan Carl Winslow dalam sitkom televisi Family Matters (1989–1998).

name: Rei Sakuma
title: Rei Sakuma
extract: Rei Sakuma is a Japanese actress, voice actress, singer and narrator from Setagaya District, Tokyo. She was formerly married to actor and talent Yū Mizushima.
extract_id: Rei Sakuma adalah aktris, pengisi suara, penyanyi, dan narator Jepang dari Distrik Setagaya, Tokyo. Dia sebelumnya menikah dengan aktor dan talenta Yū Mizushima.

name: Ren Osugi
title: Ren Osugi
extract: Ren Osugi , born Takashi Osugi was a Japanese actor. For his work in Cure, Hana-bi and other films, Osugi was given the Best Supporting Actor award at the 1999 Yokohama Film Festival. He often worked alongside Takeshi Kitano and Susumu Terajima. In the DVD commentary to the MPD Psycho television series, director Takashi Miike said that he admired Osugi's experience to shift quickly from comic and imbecilic to authoritative and earnest. He died of heart failure at the age of 66 on February 21, 2018.
extract_id: Ren Osugi, lahir dengan nama Takashi Osugi, adalah aktor Jepang. Untuk karyanya dalam Cure, Hana-bi, dan film lainnya, Osugi diberikan penghargaan Aktor Pendukung Terbaik di Yokohama Film Festival 1999. Dia sering bekerja bersama Takeshi Kitano dan Susumu Terajima. Dalam komentar DVD serial televisi MPD Psycho, sutradara Takashi Miike mengatakan bahwa ia mengagumi kemampuan Osugi dalam beralih cepat dari karakter komik dan bodoh ke karakter yang otoritatif dan serius. Dia meninggal karena gagal jantung pada usia 66 tahun pada 21 Februari 2018.

name: Rena Owen
title: Rena Owen
extract: Maria Makarena Owen, known professionally as Rena Owen, is a New Zealand actress in theatre, television and film. Owen is best known for her leading role as Beth Heke in Lee Tamahori's Once Were Warriors and as Taun We in George Lucas's Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones.
extract_id: Maria Makarena Owen, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Rena Owen, adalah aktris Selandia Baru di teater, televisi, dan film. Owen paling dikenal untuk peran utamanya sebagai Beth Heke dalam film Once Were Warriors karya Lee Tamahori dan sebagai Taun We dalam Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones karya George Lucas.

name: Rene Auberjonois
title: René Auberjonois
extract: René Marie Murat Auberjonois was an American actor. He was a Tony Award and Drama Desk Award winner, and a three-time Emmy Award nominee, among other accolades.
extract_id: René Marie Murat Auberjonois adalah aktor Amerika. Dia memenangkan Tony Award dan Drama Desk Award, serta memperoleh tiga nominasi Emmy Award, di antara berbagai penghargaan lainnya.

name: Rene Bitorajac
title: Rene Bitorajac
extract: Rene Bitorajac is a Croatian actor, director, screenwriter, and TV host. He earned acclaim for his dramatic and comedic roles in film and television. His notable film roles include the Academy Award-winning No Man's Land (2001), Metastases (2009) and Vegetarian Cannibal (2012). He won three Golden Arenas for Best Actor at the Pula Film Festival, as well as the Vladimir Nazor Award for Film Art.
extract_id: Rene Bitorajac adalah aktor, sutradara, penulis skenario, dan pembawa acara TV Kroasia. Ia mendapat pujian untuk peran dramatis dan komedinya di film dan televisi. Peran film terkenalnya termasuk No Man's Land (2001) yang memenangkan Academy Award, Metastases (2009), dan Vegetarian Cannibal (2012). Ia memenangkan tiga Golden Arenas untuk Aktor Terbaik di Festival Film Pula, serta Penghargaan Vladimir Nazor untuk Seni Film.

name: Rene Russo
title: Rene Russo
extract: Rene Marie Russo is an American actress and model. She began her career as a fashion model in the 1970s, appearing on magazine covers such as Vogue and Cosmopolitan. She made her film debut in the 1989 comedy Major League, and rose to international prominence in a number of thrillers and action films throughout the 1990s, including Lethal Weapon 3 (1992), In the Line of Fire (1993), Outbreak (1995), Get Shorty (1995), Ransom (1996), Lethal Weapon 4 (1998), and The Thomas Crown Affair (1999).
extract_id: Rene Marie Russo adalah aktris dan model Amerika. Ia memulai kariernya sebagai model fesyen pada 1970-an, muncul di sampul majalah seperti Vogue dan Cosmopolitan. Ia melakukan debut filmnya dalam komedi Major League tahun 1989, dan meraih ketenaran internasional melalui sejumlah film thriller dan aksi sepanjang 1990-an, termasuk Lethal Weapon 3 (1992), In the Line of Fire (1993), Outbreak (1995), Get Shorty (1995), Ransom (1996), Lethal Weapon 4 (1998), dan The Thomas Crown Affair (1999).

name: Reni Santoni
title: Reni Santoni
extract: Renaldo Santoni was an American film, television and voice actor. He was noted for playing Poppie on the television sitcom Seinfeld, Tony Gonzales in Cobra, and Chico González in Dirty Harry.
extract_id: Renaldo Santoni adalah aktor film, televisi, dan pengisi suara Amerika. Ia dikenal karena memerankan Poppie dalam sitkom televisi Seinfeld, Tony Gonzales dalam Cobra, dan Chico González dalam Dirty Harry.

name: René Laloux
title: René Laloux
extract: René Laloux was a French animator, screenwriter and film director.
extract_id: René Laloux adalah animator, penulis skenario, dan sutradara film Prancis.

name: Renée Elise Goldsberry
title: Renée Elise Goldsberry
extract: Renée Elise Goldsberry is an American actress and singer. Known for her roles on stage and screen she has received a Tony Award, a Drama Desk Award, and a Grammy Award as well as a nomination for a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Renée Elise Goldsberry adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Amerika. Dikenal karena perannya di panggung dan layar, dia telah menerima Tony Award, Drama Desk Award, dan Grammy Award serta sebuah nominasi untuk Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Renée Zellweger
title: Renée Zellweger
extract: Renée Kathleen Zellweger is an American actress. Her accolades include two Academy Awards, two British Academy Film Awards, and four Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Renée Kathleen Zellweger adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Penghargaan yang ia raih termasuk dua Academy Awards, dua British Academy Film Awards, dan empat Golden Globe Awards.

name: Rex Harrison
title: Rex Harrison
extract: Sir Reginald Carey Harrison was an English actor. Harrison began his career on the stage at the Liverpool Playhouse in 1924. He made his West End debut in 1936 appearing in the Terence Rattigan play French Without Tears, in what was his breakthrough role. He won his first Tony Award for Best Actor in a Play for his performance as Henry VIII in the Broadway play Anne of the Thousand Days in 1949. He returned to Broadway portraying Professor Henry Higgins in My Fair Lady (1956) where he won the Tony Award for Best Actor in a Musical.
extract_id: Sir Reginald Carey Harrison adalah seorang aktor Inggris. Harrison memulai karirnya di panggung di Liverpool Playhouse pada tahun 1924. Ia membuat debut West End-nya pada tahun 1936 dengan tampil dalam drama Terence Rattigan, French Without Tears, yang menjadi peran terobosannya. Ia memenangkan Tony Award pertama untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Drama berkat penampilannya sebagai Henry VIII dalam drama Broadway Anne of the Thousand Days pada tahun 1949. Ia kembali ke Broadway memerankan Profesor Henry Higgins dalam My Fair Lady (1956) di mana ia memenangkan Tony Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Musikal.

name: Rhonda Fleming
title: Rhonda Fleming
extract: Rhonda Fleming was an American film and television actress and singer. She acted in more than 40 films, mostly in the 1940s and 1950s, and became renowned as one of the most glamorous actresses of her day, nicknamed the "Queen of Technicolor" because she photographed so well in that medium.
extract_id: Rhonda Fleming adalah seorang aktris film dan televisi Amerika serta penyanyi. Ia berperan dalam lebih dari 40 film, terutama di era 1940-an dan 1950-an, dan dikenal sebagai salah satu aktris paling glamor pada zamannya, dijuluki "Queen of Technicolor" karena tampil sangat baik dalam medium tersebut.

name: Rian Johnson
title: Rian Johnson
extract: Rian Craig Johnson is an American filmmaker. He made his directorial debut with the neo-noir mystery film Brick (2005), which received positive reviews and grossed nearly $4 million on a $450,000 budget. Going on to make higher-profile films, Johnson achieved mainstream recognition for writing and directing the science-fiction thriller Looper (2012) to critical and commercial success. Johnson landed his largest project when he wrote and directed the space opera Star Wars: The Last Jedi (2017), which grossed over $1 billion. He returned to the mystery genre with the Knives Out film series (2019–present), which earned him Academy Award nominations for Best Original Screenplay and Best Adapted Screenplay.
extract_id: Rian Craig Johnson adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika. Ia membuat debut penyutradaraannya dengan film misteri neo-noir Brick (2005), yang mendapat ulasan positif dan meraih hampir $4 juta dari anggaran $450.000. Melanjutkan membuat film dengan profil lebih tinggi, Johnson mencapai pengakuan mainstream dengan menulis dan menyutradarai thriller fiksi ilmiah Looper (2012) yang sukses secara kritis dan komersial. Johnson mendapatkan proyek terbesarnya saat menulis dan menyutradarai opera ruang angkasa Star Wars: The Last Jedi (2017), yang meraih pendapatan lebih dari $1 miliar. Ia kembali ke genre misteri dengan seri film Knives Out (2019–sekarang), yang memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Skenario Asli Terbaik dan Skenario Adaptasi Terbaik.

name: Rica Matsumoto
title: Rica Matsumoto
extract: Rica Matsumoto is a Japanese actress, voice actress, and singer who was born in Yokohama, Japan. Her name is also sometimes romanized as Rika Matsumoto. She was one of the founders of the anison band JAM Project.
extract_id: Rica Matsumoto adalah seorang aktris, pengisi suara, dan penyanyi Jepang yang lahir di Yokohama, Jepang. Namanya juga kadang-kadang diromicakan sebagai Rika Matsumoto. Ia adalah salah satu pendiri band anison JAM Project.

name: Ricardo Darín
title: Ricardo Darín
extract: Ricardo Alberto Darín is an Argentine actor, film director and film producer, considered one of the best and most prolific actors of Argentine cinema.
extract_id: Ricardo Alberto Darín adalah seorang aktor, sutradara film, dan produser film Argentina, yang dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terbaik dan paling produktif dalam perfilman Argentina.

name: Ricardo Montalban
title: Ricardo Montalbán
extract: Ricardo Gonzalo Pedro Montalbán y Merino was a Mexican and American film and television actor. Montalbán's career spanned seven decades, during which he became widely known for performances in genres from crime and drama to musicals and comedy.
extract_id: Ricardo Gonzalo Pedro Montalbán y Merino adalah aktor film dan televisi Meksiko dan Amerika. Karir Montalbán berlangsung selama tujuh dekade, di mana ia dikenal luas melalui penampilan dalam berbagai genre mulai dari kejahatan dan drama hingga musikal dan komedi.

name: Rich Moore
title: Rich Moore
extract: Rich Moore is an American film and television animation director, screenwriter, producer and voice actor. He is best known for serving as a director on primetime animated television series such as The Simpsons, The Critic and Futurama as well as directing the films Wreck-It Ralph (2012), Zootopia (2016) and Ralph Breaks the Internet (2018) for Walt Disney Animation Studios. He is a two-time Emmy Award winner, a three-time Annie Award winner and an Academy Award winner.
extract_id: Rich Moore adalah seorang sutradara animasi film dan televisi Amerika, penulis skenario, produser, dan pengisi suara. Ia paling dikenal sebagai sutradara pada serial animasi prime time seperti The Simpsons, The Critic, dan Futurama serta mengarahkan film Wreck-It Ralph (2012), Zootopia (2016), dan Ralph Breaks the Internet (2018) untuk Walt Disney Animation Studios. Dia adalah pemenang dua kali Emmy Award, tiga kali Annie Award, dan pemenang Academy Award.

name: Richa Chadha
title: Richa Chadha
extract: Richa Chadha is an Indian actress who works in Hindi cinema. She made her acting debut with a small role in the comedy film Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye! (2008). Chadha's breakthrough came in 2012 with the crime film Gangs of Wasseypur, in which her role as the foul-tongued wife of a gangster earned her the Filmfare Critics Award for Best Actress. In 2023, the Government of France awarded her with the Order of Arts and Letters.
extract_id: Richa Chadha adalah seorang aktris India yang bekerja di perfilman Hindi. Ia membuat debut akting dengan peran kecil dalam film komedi Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye! (2008). Terobosannya terjadi pada tahun 2012 dengan film kriminal Gangs of Wasseypur, di mana perannya sebagai istri gangster yang kasar membawanya meraih Filmfare Critics Award untuk Aktris Terbaik. Pada tahun 2023, Pemerintah Prancis menganugerahinya dengan Order of Arts and Letters.

name: Richard Armitage
title: Richard Armitage (actor)
extract: Richard Crispin Armitage is an English actor and author. He received recognition in the UK with his first leading role as John Thornton in the British television programme North & South (2004). His role as dwarf king and leader Thorin Oakenshield in Peter Jackson's film trilogy adaptation of The Hobbit brought him international recognition.
extract_id: Richard Crispin Armitage adalah seorang aktor dan penulis Inggris. Ia mendapatkan pengakuan di Inggris dengan peran utama pertamanya sebagai John Thornton dalam program televisi Inggris North & South (2004). Perannya sebagai raja kurcaci dan pemimpin Thorin Oakenshield dalam trilogi film adaptasi The Hobbit karya Peter Jackson membawanya pengakuan internasional.

name: Richard Attenborough
title: Richard Attenborough
extract: Richard Samuel Attenborough, Baron Attenborough was an English actor, film director, and producer. He won a total of two Academy Awards, four BAFTA Awards, and six Golden Globe Awards for his directing and acting career spanning seven decades. He was knighted in 1976 for services to film and in 1983 he received the BAFTA Fellowship for lifetime achievement.
extract_id: Richard Samuel Attenborough, Baron Attenborough adalah seorang aktor, sutradara film, dan produser Inggris. Ia memenangkan total dua Academy Awards, empat BAFTA Awards, dan enam Golden Globe Awards atas karir penyutradaraan dan akting yang berlangsung selama tujuh dekade. Ia mendapatkan gelar kebangsawanan pada tahun 1976 atas jasa dalam perfilman dan menerima BAFTA Fellowship untuk prestasi seumur hidup pada tahun 1983.

name: Richard Basehart
title: Richard Basehart
extract: John Richard Basehart was an American actor. Known for his "deep, resonant baritone voice and craggy good looks," he was active in film, theatre and television from 1947 until 1983. He won two National Board of Review Awards, for his performances in Fourteen Hours (1951) and Moby Dick (1956), and was nominated for a BAFTA Award for Time Limit (1957).
extract_id: John Richard Basehart adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dikenal dengan "suara bariton dalam dan resonan serta wajah yang berlekuk-lekuk," ia aktif di film, teater, dan televisi dari tahun 1947 hingga 1983. Ia memenangkan dua National Board of Review Awards atas penampilannya dalam Fourteen Hours (1951) dan Moby Dick (1956), serta dinominasikan untuk BAFTA Award untuk Time Limit (1957).

name: Richard Briers
title: Richard Briers
extract: Richard David Briers was an English actor whose five-decade career encompassed film, radio, stage and television.
extract_id: Richard David Briers adalah seorang aktor Inggris yang karirnya berlangsung selama lima dekade mencakup film, radio, panggung, dan televisi.

name: Richard Brooks
title: Richard Brooks
extract: Richard Brooks was an American film director, screenwriter, journalist and novelist. He directed 24 feature films between 1950 and 1985, and was known for his portrayals of hard-hitting subject matter, psychologically complex characters, and his independently minded auteurist approach to filmmaking.
extract_id: Richard Brooks adalah seorang sutradara film Amerika, penulis skenario, jurnalis, dan novelis. Ia menyutradarai 24 film fitur antara tahun 1950 dan 1985, dan dikenal dengan penggambaran tema berat, karakter yang kompleks secara psikologis, serta pendekatan auteuris independennya terhadap pembuatan film.

name: Richard Burton
title: Richard Burton
extract: Richard Walter Burton was a Welsh actor.
extract_id: Richard Walter Burton adalah seorang aktor Welsh.

name: Richard Crenna
title: Richard Crenna
extract: Richard Donald Crenna was an American actor and television director.
extract_id: Richard Donald Crenna adalah seorang aktor dan sutradara televisi Amerika.

name: Richard Curtis
title: Richard Curtis
extract: Richard Whalley Anthony Curtis is a British screenwriter, producer and director. One of Britain's most successful comedy screenwriters, he is known for romantic comedy-drama films, including Four Weddings and a Funeral (1994), Notting Hill (1999), Bridget Jones's Diary (2001), Love Actually (2003), Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason (2004), About Time (2013) and Yesterday (2019), as well as the war drama film War Horse (2011), and for having co-written the sitcoms Blackadder, Mr. Bean and The Vicar of Dibley. His early career saw him write material for the comedy sketch shows Not the Nine O'Clock News and Spitting Image.
extract_id: Richard Whalley Anthony Curtis adalah seorang penulis skenario, produser, dan sutradara Inggris. Salah satu penulis skenario komedi paling sukses di Inggris, ia dikenal berkat film komedi romantis-drama, termasuk Four Weddings and a Funeral (1994), Notting Hill (1999), Bridget Jones's Diary (2001), Love Actually (2003), Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason (2004), About Time (2013) dan Yesterday (2019), serta film drama perang War Horse (2011), dan sebagai salah satu penulis bersama sitkom Blackadder, Mr. Bean dan The Vicar of Dibley. Karir awalnya melibatkan penulisan materi untuk acara komedi sketch Not the Nine O'Clock News dan Spitting Image.

name: Richard Donner
title: Richard Donner
extract: Richard Donner was an American filmmaker. Described as "one of Hollywood's most reliable makers of action blockbusters", Donner directed some of the most financially successful films of the 1970s and 1980s. His career spanning more than six decades crossed genres and influenced trends among filmmakers across the world.
extract_id: Richard Donner adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika. Dijuluki sebagai "salah satu pembuat blockbuster aksi paling andal di Hollywood", Donner menyutradarai beberapa film yang sukses secara finansial pada tahun 1970-an dan 1980-an. Karirnya yang berlangsung lebih dari enam dekade melintasi berbagai genre dan mempengaruhi tren di kalangan pembuat film di seluruh dunia.

name: Richard Dormer
title: Richard Dormer
extract: Richard Dormer is an actor and playwright from Northern Ireland. He is best known for his roles as Beric Dondarrion in the HBO television series Game of Thrones and Dan Anderssen in Sky Atlantic's Fortitude.
extract_id: Richard Dormer adalah seorang aktor dan penulis drama dari Irlandia Utara. Ia paling dikenal untuk perannya sebagai Beric Dondarrion dalam serial televisi HBO Game of Thrones dan Dan Anderssen dalam Fortitude dari Sky Atlantic.

name: Richard Dreyfuss
title: Richard Dreyfuss
extract: Richard Stephen Dreyfuss is an American actor. He emerged from the New Hollywood wave of American cinema, finding fame with a succession of leading man parts in the 1970s. He has received numerous acting honors, including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Satellite Award, a David di Donatello Award, a Saturn Award, and a Golden Globe Award, as well as nominations for two Actor Awards, two Photoplay Awards, and a Grammy Award.
extract_id: Richard Stephen Dreyfuss adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Ia muncul dari gelombang New Hollywood dalam perfilman Amerika, memperoleh ketenaran lewat sejumlah peran utama di tahun 1970-an. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan akting, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Satellite Award, David di Donatello Award, Saturn Award, dan Golden Globe Award, juga nominasi untuk dua Actor Awards, dua Photoplay Awards, dan Grammy Award.

name: Richard E. Grant
title: Richard E. Grant
extract: Richard E. Grant is a Swazi and English actor and presenter. He made his film debut as Withnail in the comedy Withnail and I (1987). Grant received critical acclaim for his role as Jack Hock in Marielle Heller's drama film Can You Ever Forgive Me? (2018), winning various awards including the Independent Spirit Award for Best Supporting Male. He also received Academy Award, Actor Award, BAFTA Award, Critics' Choice Movie Award, and Golden Globe Award nominations for Best Supporting Actor.
extract_id: Richard E. Grant adalah seorang aktor dan presenter asal Swaziland dan Inggris. Ia membuat debut film sebagai Withnail dalam komedi Withnail and I (1987). Grant menerima pujian kritis atas perannya sebagai Jack Hock dalam film drama Marielle Heller, Can You Ever Forgive Me? (2018), memenangkan berbagai penghargaan termasuk Independent Spirit Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik. Ia juga menerima nominasi Academy Award, Actor Award, BAFTA Award, Critics' Choice Movie Award, dan Golden Globe Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Richard Edson
title: Richard Edson
extract: Richard Edson is an American actor and musician.
extract_id: Richard Edson adalah seorang aktor dan musisi Amerika.

name: Richard Farnsworth
title: Richard Farnsworth
extract: Richard William Farnsworth was an American actor and stuntman. He was twice nominated for an Academy Award: in 1978 for Best Supporting Actor for Comes a Horseman, and in 2000 for Best Actor in The Straight Story, making him the second-oldest nominee for the award for the latter. Farnsworth was also known for his performances in The Grey Fox (1982), for which he received a Golden Globe Award nomination for Best Actor in a Motion Picture – Drama, as well as Anne of Green Gables (1985), Sylvester (1985), and Misery (1990).
extract_id: Richard William Farnsworth adalah seorang aktor dan pemeran pengganti Amerika. Ia dua kali dinominasikan untuk Academy Award: pada tahun 1978 untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam Comes a Horseman, dan tahun 2000 untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam The Straight Story, menjadikannya nominasi tertua kedua untuk penghargaan tersebut untuk peran terakhir. Farnsworth juga dikenal atas penampilannya dalam The Grey Fox (1982), yang membawanya nominasi Golden Globe Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Film Drama, serta Anne of Green Gables (1985), Sylvester (1985), dan Misery (1990).

name: Richard Gere
title: Richard Gere
extract: Richard Tiffany Gere is an American actor. He began appearing in films in the 1970s, playing a supporting role in Looking for Mr. Goodbar (1977) and a starring role in Days of Heaven (1978). Gere came to prominence with his role in the film American Gigolo (1980), which established him as a leading man and a sex symbol. Gere's other films include An Officer and a Gentleman (1982), The Cotton Club (1984), Internal Affairs (1990), Pretty Woman (1990), Sommersby (1993), First Knight (1995), Primal Fear (1996), The Jackal (1997), Red Corner (1997), Runaway Bride (1999), Unfaithful (2002), Shall We Dance? (2004), I'm Not There (2007), Hachi: A Dog's Tale (2009), Arbitrage (2012) and Norman (2016). For portraying Billy Flynn in the musical Chicago (2002), he won a Golden Globe Award.
extract_id: Richard Tiffany Gere adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Ia mulai tampil di film pada tahun 1970-an, memainkan peran pendukung dalam Looking for Mr. Goodbar (1977) dan peran utama dalam Days of Heaven (1978). Gere menjadi terkenal lewat perannya dalam film American Gigolo (1980), yang menetapkan dirinya sebagai aktor utama dan simbol seks. Film lainnya termasuk An Officer and a Gentleman (1982), The Cotton Club (1984), Internal Affairs (1990), Pretty Woman (1990), Sommersby (1993), First Knight (1995), Primal Fear (1996), The Jackal (1997), Red Corner (1997), Runaway Bride (1999), Unfaithful (2002), Shall We Dance? (2004), I'm Not There (2007), Hachi: A Dog's Tale (2009), Arbitrage (2012), dan Norman (2016). Untuk memerankan Billy Flynn dalam musikal Chicago (2002), ia memenangkan Golden Globe Award.

name: Richard Griffiths
title: Richard Griffiths
extract: Richard Thomas Griffiths was an English actor. He was known for his portrayals of Vernon Dursley in the Harry Potter films (2001–2011), Uncle Monty in Withnail and I (1987), and Henry Crabbe in Pie in the Sky (1994–1997). He received numerous accolades in his career and was appointed an Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) by Queen Elizabeth II in 2008.
extract_id: Richard Thomas Griffiths adalah seorang aktor Inggris. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Vernon Dursley dalam film Harry Potter (2001–2011), Paman Monty dalam Withnail and I (1987), dan Henry Crabbe dalam Pie in the Sky (1994–1997). Dia menerima banyak penghargaan dalam kariernya dan diangkat menjadi Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) oleh Ratu Elizabeth II pada tahun 2008.

name: Richard Harris
title: Richard Harris
extract: Richard St John Francis Harris was an Irish actor and singer. Having studied at the London Academy of Music and Dramatic Art, he rose to prominence as an icon of the British New Wave. He received numerous accolades including the Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Actor, a Grammy Award, and a Golden Globe. In 2020 he was listed at number 3 on The Irish Times's list of Ireland's greatest film actors.
extract_id: Richard St John Francis Harris adalah seorang aktor dan penyanyi Irlandia. Setelah belajar di London Academy of Music and Dramatic Art, ia naik daun sebagai ikon British New Wave. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Cannes Film Festival Award untuk Aktor Terbaik, Grammy Award, dan Golden Globe. Pada tahun 2020, ia berada di nomor 3 dalam daftar aktor film terbesar Irlandia versi The Irish Times.

name: Richard Haydn
title: Richard Haydn
extract: George Richard Haydn was a British actor.
extract_id: George Richard Haydn adalah seorang aktor Inggris.

name: Richard Jenkins
title: Richard Jenkins
extract: Richard Dale Jenkins is an American actor. He began his career in theater at the Trinity Repertory Company and made his film debut in 1974. He has worked steadily in film and television since the 1980s, mostly in supporting roles.
extract_id: Richard Dale Jenkins adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Ia memulai kariernya di teater di Trinity Repertory Company dan membuat debut film pada tahun 1974. Ia telah bekerja secara konsisten di film dan televisi sejak tahun 1980-an, sebagian besar dalam peran pendukung.

name: Richard Kelly
title: Richard Kelly (filmmaker)
extract: James Richard Kelly is an American film director, screenwriter and producer. He wrote and directed the films Donnie Darko (2001), Southland Tales (2006), and The Box (2009).
extract_id: James Richard Kelly adalah seorang sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser asal Amerika. Dia menulis dan menyutradarai film Donnie Darko (2001), Southland Tales (2006), dan The Box (2009).

name: Richard Lester
title: Richard Lester
extract: Richard Lester Liebman is a retired American film director. He spent the majority of his professional life in the United Kingdom and is known for the fast-paced, flamboyant directing he brought to his comedy films, most notably the Beatles' vehicles A Hard Day's Night (1964) and Help! (1965), and The Knack ...and How to Get It (1965).
extract_id: Richard Lester Liebman adalah seorang sutradara film Amerika yang sudah pensiun. Ia menghabiskan sebagian besar karier profesionalnya di Inggris dan dikenal karena gaya penyutradaraannya yang cepat dan flamboyan dalam film komedi, terutama film-film Beatles seperti A Hard Day's Night (1964) dan Help! (1965), serta The Knack ...and How to Get It (1965).

name: Richard Linklater
title: Richard Linklater
extract: Richard Linklater is an American filmmaker. He is known for making films which deal thematically with suburban culture and the effects of the passage of time. His accolades include a Golden Globe Award, a Silver Bear, a César Award, and five Academy Award nominations.
extract_id: Richard Linklater adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika. Ia dikenal karena membuat film yang temanya berkaitan dengan budaya pinggiran kota dan efek perjalanan waktu. Penghargaannya meliputi Golden Globe Award, Silver Bear, César Award, dan lima nominasi Academy Award.

name: Richard Marquand
title: Richard Marquand
extract: Richard Alfred Marquand was a Welsh film and television director active in both American and British film productions, best known for directing the 1983 space opera Return of the Jedi, the final film in the original Star Wars trilogy. He also directed the 1981 drama film Eye of the Needle, the critically panned romance film Until September, and the 1985 thriller Jagged Edge.
extract_id: Richard Alfred Marquand adalah sutradara film dan televisi asal Wales yang aktif di produksi film Amerika dan Inggris, terkenal karena menyutradarai opera ruang angkasa Return of the Jedi pada tahun 1983, film terakhir dalam trilogi Star Wars asli. Ia juga menyutradarai film drama Eye of the Needle (1981), film romantis Until September yang mendapat kritikan negatif, dan thriller Jagged Edge (1985).

name: Richard Masur
title: Richard Masur
extract: Richard Masur is an American character actor who has appeared in more than 40 films. From 1995 to 1999, he served two terms as president of the Screen Actors Guild (SAG). He is best known for playing David Kane on One Day at a Time (1975–1976), Nick Lobo on Rhoda (1974–1977), Clark in The Thing (1982), adult Stanley Uris in the miniseries It (1990), and Edward L. L. Moore on Younger (2016–2018).
extract_id: Richard Masur adalah aktor karakter Amerika yang telah muncul dalam lebih dari 40 film. Dari tahun 1995 hingga 1999, ia menjabat dua periode sebagai presiden Screen Actors Guild (SAG). Ia dikenal karena memerankan David Kane di One Day at a Time (1975–1976), Nick Lobo di Rhoda (1974–1977), Clark dalam The Thing (1982), Stanley Uris dewasa dalam miniseri It (1990), dan Edward L. L. Moore di Younger (2016–2018).

name: Richard Rosson
title: Richard Rosson
extract: Richard Rosson was an American film director and actor. As an actor, he was known for the nearly 100 films he was in during the silent era. As a director, he directed the logging sequences in the 1936 film Come and Get It.
extract_id: Richard Rosson adalah seorang sutradara film dan aktor Amerika. Sebagai aktor, ia dikenal karena hampir 100 film yang dibintanginya pada era bisu. Sebagai sutradara, ia mengarahkan adegan penebangan kayu dalam film Come and Get It tahun 1936.

name: Richard Schenkman
title: Richard Schenkman
extract: Richard Schenkman is an American screenwriter, film producer, film director, and occasional actor. He has also been credited as director under the names George Axmith and R.D. Braunstein.
extract_id: Richard Schenkman adalah penulis skenario Amerika, produser film, sutradara film, dan sesekali aktor. Ia juga dikenal sebagai sutradara dengan nama George Axmith dan R.D. Braunstein.

name: Richard Thorpe
title: Richard Thorpe
extract: Richard Thorpe was an American film director best known for his long career at Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer.
extract_id: Richard Thorpe adalah seorang sutradara film Amerika yang paling dikenal karena karier panjangnya di Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer.

name: Richard Widmark
title: Richard Widmark
extract: Richard Weedt Widmark was an American actor and film producer. For his debut film role as the villainous Tommy Udo in the film noir Kiss of Death (1947), he was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor and won the inaugural Golden Globe Award for Most Promising Newcomer.
extract_id: Richard Weedt Widmark adalah seorang aktor dan produser film Amerika. Untuk peran debut filmnya sebagai penjahat Tommy Udo dalam film noir Kiss of Death (1947), ia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award sebagai Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dan memenangkan Golden Globe Award Perdana untuk Most Promising Newcomer.

name: Ricky Nelson
title: Ricky Nelson
extract: Eric Hilliard "Ricky" or "Rick" Nelson was an American musician and actor. From age eight, he starred alongside his family in the radio and television series The Adventures of Ozzie and Harriet. In 1957, he began a long and successful career as a popular recording artist.
extract_id: Eric Hilliard "Ricky" atau "Rick" Nelson adalah musisi dan aktor Amerika. Sejak usia delapan tahun, ia membintangi bersama keluarganya dalam serial radio dan televisi The Adventures of Ozzie and Harriet. Pada tahun 1957, ia memulai karier panjang dan sukses sebagai artis rekaman populer.

name: Ridley Scott
title: Ridley Scott
extract: Sir Ridley Scott is an English filmmaker. His work includes science fiction, crime, and historical epic films, with an atmospheric and highly concentrated visual style. Scott is the eighth-highest-grossing director of all time, with his films grossing a cumulative $5 billion worldwide. He has received numerous accolades including two Golden Globe Awards and two Primetime Emmy Awards, as well as nominations for four Academy Awards, eight BAFTA Awards, and a Grammy Award. He has also been honoured with the BAFTA Fellowship for Lifetime Achievement in 2018 and the Academy Honorary Award in 2026. Scott was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 2003, and appointed a Knight Grand Cross by King Charles III in 2024.
extract_id: Sir Ridley Scott adalah pembuat film Inggris. Karya-karyanya meliputi film fiksi ilmiah, kejahatan, dan epik sejarah, dengan gaya visual yang atmosferik dan sangat terkonsentrasi. Scott adalah sutradara dengan penghasilan tertinggi kedelapan sepanjang masa, dengan film-filmnya menghasilkan total $5 miliar secara global. Ia menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk dua Golden Globe Awards dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards, serta nominasi untuk empat Academy Awards, delapan BAFTA Awards, dan satu Grammy Award. Ia juga dianugerahi BAFTA Fellowship untuk Penghargaan Seumur Hidup pada 2018 dan Academy Honorary Award pada 2026. Scott diangkat menjadi kesatria oleh Ratu Elizabeth II pada 2003 dan diangkat menjadi Knight Grand Cross oleh Raja Charles III pada 2024.

name: Riisa Naka
title: Riisa Naka
extract: Riisa Naka is a Japanese actress. She was given a Best New Talent award at the 2009 Yokohama Film Festival. Naka became famous by appearing in Hachi One Diver (2008) and played the lead, Hana Adachi, in Yankee-kun to Megane-chan (2010).
