Naka also portrayed cousins Makoto Konno and Akari Yoshiyama who are the protagonists in respectively the 2006 anime film The Girl Who Leapt Through Time and the 2010 live action movie Time Traveller: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time, both of which are based on the 1967 novel Toki wo Kakeru Shoujo by Yasutaka Tsutsui.
extract_id: Riisa Naka adalah aktris Jepang. Ia menerima penghargaan Best New Talent di Yokohama Film Festival 2009. Naka menjadi terkenal lewat penampilannya di Hachi One Diver (2008) dan memerankan tokoh utama, Hana Adachi, dalam Yankee-kun to Megane-chan (2010). Naka juga memerankan sepupu Makoto Konno dan Akari Yoshiyama yang merupakan protagonis dalam film anime 2006 The Girl Who Leapt Through Time dan film live action 2010 Time Traveller: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time, keduanya diadaptasi dari novel tahun 1967 berjudul Toki wo Kakeru Shoujo karya Yasutaka Tsutsui.

name: Rima Te Wiata
title: Rima Te Wiata
description: New Zealand singer, comedian and actress
extract: Heather Rima Te Wiata is a New Zealand actress, comedian, singer and voice artist, who is also notable for her career in Australia. Her career in stage, TV and film has spanned over 50 years and she is especially known her long-running recurring role in TV soap opera Sons and Daughters as Janice Reid in 204 episodes.
extract_id: Heather Rima Te Wiata adalah aktris, komedian, penyanyi, dan pengisi suara Selandia Baru yang juga dikenal lewat kariernya di Australia. Kariernya di panggung, TV, dan film telah berlangsung lebih dari 50 tahun dan ia terutama dikenal karena peran berulangnya yang panjang di sinetron Sons and Daughters sebagai Janice Reid dalam 204 episode.

name: Ringo Starr
title: Ringo Starr
extract: Sir Richard Starkey, known as Ringo Starr, is an English musician, singer, songwriter and actor who achieved international fame as the drummer for the Beatles. He sometimes sang lead vocals on the group's recordings, usually for one song on each album; these include "Yellow Submarine" and "With a Little Help from My Friends". He also wrote and sang the Beatles songs "Don't Pass Me By" and "Octopus's Garden", and is credited as a co-writer of three others.
extract_id: Sir Richard Starkey, dikenal sebagai Ringo Starr, adalah musisi, penyanyi, penulis lagu, dan aktor Inggris yang meraih ketenaran internasional sebagai drummer The Beatles. Ia terkadang menyanyikan vokal utama pada rekaman grup ini, biasanya untuk satu lagu di setiap album; di antaranya "Yellow Submarine" dan "With a Little Help from My Friends". Ia juga menulis dan menyanyikan lagu-lagu Beatles "Don't Pass Me By" dan "Octopus's Garden", serta dikreditkan sebagai penulis bersama tiga lagu lainnya.

name: Rita Hayworth
title: Rita Hayworth
extract: Rita Hayworth was an American actress, dancer and pin-up girl. She achieved fame in the 1940s as one of the top stars of the Golden Age of Hollywood, and appeared in 61 films over 38 years. The press nicknamed her "The Love Goddess" during the peak of her fame in the 1940s. She was the second favorite pin-up girl for GIs during World War II, after Betty Grable.
extract_id: Rita Hayworth adalah seorang aktris, penari, dan gadis pin-up Amerika. Ia meraih ketenaran pada tahun 1940-an sebagai salah satu bintang utama Era Keemasan Hollywood, dan tampil dalam 61 film selama 38 tahun. Pers menjulukinya "The Love Goddess" selama puncak ketenarannya di tahun 1940-an. Dia adalah gadis pin-up favorit kedua bagi tentara AS selama Perang Dunia II, setelah Betty Grable.

name: Ritesh Batra
title: Ritesh Batra
extract: Ritesh Batra is an Indian film director and screenwriter. Batra's Hindi-language debut feature film The Lunchbox premiered at the 2013 Cannes Film Festival and won the Rail d'Or. Batra also won the Toronto Film Critics Association Award for Best First Feature Film in 2014. The Lunchbox was the highest-grossing foreign film in North America, Europe and Australia for 2014 grossing over US$25 Million. The film was also nominated for a BAFTA Award for Best Film Not in the English Language in 2015.
extract_id: Ritesh Batra adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario India. Film fitur debut berbahasa Hindi-nya The Lunchbox tayang perdana di Festival Film Cannes 2013 dan memenangkan Rail d'Or. Batra juga memenangkan Toronto Film Critics Association Award untuk Film Fitur Pertama Terbaik pada 2014. The Lunchbox merupakan film asing dengan pendapatan tertinggi di Amerika Utara, Eropa, dan Australia tahun 2014 dengan penghasilan lebih dari US$25 juta. Film ini juga dinominasikan untuk BAFTA Award untuk Film Terbaik Non-Inggris pada 2015.

name: River Phoenix
title: River Phoenix
extract: River Jude Phoenix was an American actor and musician. The older brother of actor Joaquin Phoenix, he was known as a teen actor before taking on leading roles in critically acclaimed films, becoming one of the preeminent acting talents of his generation. Phoenix's numerous accolades include the Volpi Cup and the Independent Spirit Award, as well as nominations for an Academy Award and Golden Globe Award.
extract_id: River Jude Phoenix adalah aktor dan musisi Amerika. Kakak laki-laki dari aktor Joaquin Phoenix, ia dikenal sebagai aktor remaja sebelum memegang peran utama dalam film-film yang dipuji kritis, menjadi salah satu bakat akting terkemuka di generasinya. sejumlah penghargaan River Phoenix termasuk Volpi Cup dan Independent Spirit Award, serta nominasi untuk Academy Award dan Golden Globe Award.

name: Riz Ahmed
title: Riz Ahmed
extract: Rizwan Ahmed is a British actor and rapper. He has received several awards, including an Academy Award and a Primetime Emmy Award, and nominations for two Golden Globe Awards and two British Academy Film Awards. In 2017, he was named by Time as one of the most influential people in the world. He also created the TV series Englistan in 2018 for the BBC, which was also his writing debut.
extract_id: Rizwan Ahmed adalah aktor dan rapper Inggris. Ia menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award dan Primetime Emmy Award, serta nominasi untuk dua Golden Globe Awards dan dua British Academy Film Awards. Pada tahun 2017, ia dinobatkan oleh Time sebagai salah satu orang paling berpengaruh di dunia. Ia juga menciptakan serial TV Englistan pada 2018 untuk BBC, yang juga merupakan debut tulisannya.

name: Rob Minkoff
title: Rob Minkoff
extract: Robert Ralph Minkoff is an American director, animator, and producer. He is best known for co-directing The Lion King, and live-action films including Stuart Little (1999), Stuart Little 2 (2002), The Haunted Mansion (2003), and The Forbidden Kingdom (2008). In recent decades, he returned to feature animation with Mr. Peabody & Sherman (2014) and Paws of Fury: The Legend of Hank (2022). His wife, Crystal Kung Minkoff, was a cast member on The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills.
extract_id: Robert Ralph Minkoff adalah sutradara, animator, dan produser Amerika. Ia paling dikenal sebagai sutradara bersama film The Lion King, dan film live-action termasuk Stuart Little (1999), Stuart Little 2 (2002), The Haunted Mansion (2003), dan The Forbidden Kingdom (2008). Dalam beberapa dekade terakhir, ia kembali ke animasi fitur dengan Mr. Peabody & Sherman (2014) dan Paws of Fury: The Legend of Hank (2022). Istrinya, Crystal Kung Minkoff, adalah anggota pemeran dalam The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills.

name: Rob Reiner
title: Rob Reiner
extract: Robert Reiner was an American filmmaker, actor, and political activist. He directed a series of acclaimed studio films in a career that spanned comedy, drama, romance, and documentary. Reiner received numerous accolades, including winning three Primetime Emmy Awards and a Hugo Award, as well as nominations for an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, and nine Golden Globe Awards. He was honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 1999 and received the Chaplin Gala Tribute at the Film at Lincoln Center in 2014. Three of his films have been inducted into the National Film Registry.
extract_id: Robert Reiner adalah pembuat film, aktor, dan aktivis politik Amerika. Ia menyutradarai serangkaian film studio yang diakui secara luas dalam kariernya yang meliputi komedi, drama, romansa, dan dokumenter. Reiner menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk tiga Primetime Emmy Awards dan Hugo Award, serta nominasi Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan sembilan Golden Globe Awards. Ia dianugerahi bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada 1999 dan menerima Chaplin Gala Tribute di Film at Lincoln Center pada 2014. Tiga filmnya telah dimasukkan dalam National Film Registry.

name: Robby Benson
title: Robby Benson
extract: Robby Benson is an American actor, director, and musician. He rose to prominence as a teen idol in the late 1970s, appearing in the films Ode to Billy Joe (1976), One on One (1977) and Ice Castles (1978). He subsequently voiced the Beast in the Disney animated film Beauty and the Beast (1991) and its numerous sequels, spin-offs and most Disney media. Benson has directed in television, including six episodes of the sitcom Friends. He recently appeared in a recurring role as Dr. Mauer in Apple TV+'s Severance.
extract_id: Robby Benson adalah aktor, sutradara, dan musisi Amerika. Ia naik daun sebagai idola remaja pada akhir 1970-an, tampil dalam film Ode to Billy Joe (1976), One on One (1977), dan Ice Castles (1978). Ia kemudian mengisi suara Beast dalam film animasi Disney Beauty and the Beast (1991) dan sekuel, spin-off, serta sebagian besar media Disney lainnya. Benson telah menyutradarai di televisi, termasuk enam episode sitcom Friends. Baru-baru ini ia tampil dalam peran berulang sebagai Dr. Mauer di Severance di Apple TV+.

name: Robert Aldrich
title: Robert Aldrich
extract: Robert Burgess Aldrich was an American film director, producer, and screenwriter. An iconoclastic and maverick auteur working in many genres during the Golden Age of Hollywood, he directed mainly films noir, war movies, westerns and dark melodramas with Gothic overtones. His most notable credits include Vera Cruz (1954), Kiss Me Deadly (1955), The Big Knife (1955), Autumn Leaves (1956), Attack (1956), What Ever Happened to Baby Jane? (1962), Hush...Hush, Sweet Charlotte (1964), The Flight of the Phoenix (1965), The Dirty Dozen (1967), and The Longest Yard (1974).
extract_id: Robert Burgess Aldrich adalah seorang sutradara film Amerika, produser, dan penulis skenario. Sebagai seorang auteur ikonoklastik dan pembelot yang bekerja dalam berbagai genre selama Zaman Keemasan Hollywood, ia terutama menyutradarai film noir, film perang, western, dan melodrama gelap dengan nuansa Gothic. Kreditnya yang paling terkenal termasuk Vera Cruz (1954), Kiss Me Deadly (1955), The Big Knife (1955), Autumn Leaves (1956), Attack (1956), What Ever Happened to Baby Jane? (1962), Hush...Hush, Sweet Charlotte (1964), The Flight of the Phoenix (1965), The Dirty Dozen (1967), dan The Longest Yard (1974).

name: Robert Altman
title: Robert Altman
extract: Robert Bernard Altman was an American filmmaker. He is considered an enduring figure from the New Hollywood era, known for directing subversive and satirical films with overlapping dialogue and ensemble casts. Over his career he received numerous accolades, including an Academy Honorary Award, two BAFTAs, three Independent Spirit Awards, a Primetime Emmy Award, a David di Donatello Award, and a Golden Globe, as well as nominations for seven competitive Academy Awards.
extract_id: Robert Bernard Altman adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika. Dia dianggap sebagai sosok yang bertahan lama dari era New Hollywood, dikenal karena menyutradarai film subversif dan satir dengan dialog yang tumpang tindih dan pemeran ansambel. Sepanjang kariernya ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Honorary Award, dua BAFTA, tiga Independent Spirit Awards, Primetime Emmy Award, David di Donatello Award, dan Golden Globe, serta nominasi untuk tujuh Academy Awards kompetitif.

name: Robert Armstrong
title: Robert Armstrong (actor)
extract: Robert William Armstrong was an American film and television actor, best known to today's audiences for playing Carl Denham in the 1933 version of King Kong from RKO Pictures. He delivered the film's famous final line: "Oh no, it wasn't the airplanes. It was Beauty killed the Beast."
extract_id: Robert William Armstrong adalah aktor film dan televisi Amerika, yang paling dikenal oleh penonton saat ini karena memerankan Carl Denham dalam versi King Kong tahun 1933 dari RKO Pictures. Dia mengucapkan kalimat terakhir yang terkenal dalam film itu: "Oh no, it wasn't the airplanes. It was Beauty killed the Beast."

name: Robert Arthur
title: Robert Arthur (actor)
extract: Robert Paul Arthur was an American motion picture actor who appeared in dozens of films in the 1940s and 1950s.
extract_id: Robert Paul Arthur adalah aktor film Amerika yang tampil dalam puluhan film pada tahun 1940-an dan 1950-an.

name: Robert Benton
title: Robert Benton
extract: Robert Douglas Benton was an American film director and screenwriter. He and David Newman were nominated for the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay for the 1967 film Bonnie and Clyde. In 1979, he wrote and directed the film Kramer vs. Kramer, winning the Academy Awards for Best Director and Best Adapted Screenplay. He won another Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay for the 1984 film Places in the Heart.
extract_id: Robert Douglas Benton adalah seorang sutradara dan penulis skenario film Amerika. Dia dan David Newman dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Best Original Screenplay untuk film Bonnie and Clyde tahun 1967. Pada tahun 1979, dia menulis dan menyutradarai film Kramer vs. Kramer, memenangkan Academy Awards untuk Best Director dan Best Adapted Screenplay. Dia memenangkan Academy Award lain untuk Best Original Screenplay untuk film Places in the Heart tahun 1984.

name: Robert Clouse
title: Robert Clouse
extract: Robert Clouse was an American film director and producer, known primarily for his work in the action/adventure and martial arts genres. He died on February 4, 1997, in Oregon of kidney failure.
extract_id: Robert Clouse adalah sutradara dan produser film Amerika, yang dikenal terutama untuk karyanya di genre aksi/petualangan dan seni bela diri. Dia meninggal pada 4 Februari 1997, di Oregon karena gagal ginjal.

name: Robert Cummings
title: Robert Cummings
extract: Charles Clarence Robert Orville Cummings was an American film and television actor who appeared in roles in comedy films such as The Devil and Miss Jones (1941) and Princess O'Rourke (1943), and in dramatic films, especially two of Alfred Hitchcock's thrillers, Saboteur (1942) and Dial M for Murder (1954). He received five Primetime Emmy Award nominations, and won the Primetime Emmy Award for Best Actor in a Single Performance in 1955. On February 8, 1960, he received two stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame for his contributions to the motion picture and television industries, at 6816 Hollywood Boulevard and 1718 Vine Street. He used the stage name Robert Cummings from mid-1935 until the end of 1954 and was credited as Bob Cummings from 1955 until his death.
extract_id: Charles Clarence Robert Orville Cummings adalah aktor film dan televisi Amerika yang tampil dalam peran di film komedi seperti The Devil and Miss Jones (1941) dan Princess O'Rourke (1943), serta di film drama, terutama dua thriller Alfred Hitchcock, Saboteur (1942) dan Dial M for Murder (1954). Dia menerima lima nominasi Primetime Emmy Award, dan memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award untuk Best Actor in a Single Performance pada 1955. Pada 8 Februari 1960, dia menerima dua bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame atas kontribusinya pada industri film dan televisi, di 6816 Hollywood Boulevard dan 1718 Vine Street. Dia menggunakan nama panggung Robert Cummings dari pertengahan 1935 sampai akhir 1954 dan dikreditkan sebagai Bob Cummings dari 1955 sampai kematiannya.

name: Robert De Niro
title: Robert De Niro
extract: Robert Anthony De Niro is an American actor and producer. Widely regarded as one of the greatest and most influential actors of his generation, he has received various accolades, including two Academy Awards and a Golden Globe Award as well as nominations for eight BAFTA Awards and four Emmy Awards. He was honored with the AFI Life Achievement Award in 2003, the Kennedy Center Honors in 2009, the Cecil B. DeMille Award in 2011, the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2016, the Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award in 2019, and the Honorary Palme d'Or in 2025.
extract_id: Robert Anthony De Niro adalah aktor dan produser Amerika. Secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar dan paling berpengaruh di generasinya, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards dan Golden Globe Award serta nominasi untuk delapan BAFTA Awards dan empat Emmy Awards. Dia dihormati dengan AFI Life Achievement Award pada 2003, Kennedy Center Honors pada 2009, Cecil B. DeMille Award pada 2011, Presidential Medal of Freedom pada 2016, Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award pada 2019, dan Honorary Palme d'Or pada 2025.

name: Robert Donat
title: Robert Donat
extract: Friedrich Robert Donat was an English actor. Making his breakthrough film role in Alexander Korda's The Private Life of Henry VIII (1933), today he is best remembered for his roles in The Count of Monte Cristo (1934), Alfred Hitchcock's The 39 Steps (1935), and Goodbye, Mr. Chips (1939), for which he won the Academy Award for Best Actor as the gentle English schoolmaster Mr. Chips.
extract_id: Friedrich Robert Donat adalah aktor Inggris. Memulai peran terobosannya dalam film Alexander Korda The Private Life of Henry VIII (1933), hari ini dia paling diingat untuk perannya dalam The Count of Monte Cristo (1934), The 39 Steps karya Alfred Hitchcock (1935), dan Goodbye, Mr. Chips (1939), yang membuatnya memenangkan Academy Award untuk Best Actor sebagai guru sekolah Inggris yang lemah lembut, Mr. Chips.

name: Robert Downey Jr.
title: Robert Downey Jr.
extract: Robert John Downey Jr. is an American actor and producer. His films as a leading actor have grossed over $14.3 billion worldwide, making him one of the highest-grossing actors of all time. Downey was the highest-paid actor in the world annually from 2013 to 2015. Known for his versatility across roles, he is the recipient of various accolades, including an Academy Award, a Daytime Emmy Award, three Golden Globe Awards, and two British Academy Film Awards.
extract_id: Robert John Downey Jr. adalah aktor dan produser Amerika. Film-filmnya sebagai pemeran utama telah meraup lebih dari $14,3 miliar di seluruh dunia, menjadikannya salah satu aktor dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa. Downey adalah aktor dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia setiap tahun dari 2013 hingga 2015. Dikenal karena versatilitasnya di berbagai peran, dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Daytime Emmy Award, tiga Golden Globe Awards, dan dua British Academy Film Awards.

name: Robert Duvall
title: Robert Duvall
extract: Robert Selden Duvall was an American actor and filmmaker, best known for his roles in films of the later 20th century. Duvall began acting professionally on stage in 1952, performing in summer plays at the Gateway Playhouse in Bellport on Long Island until 1959, with a one-year break while serving in the U.S. Army. In his early theater career, he made contacts that then led to a career on television in the 1960s on shows such as The Defenders, Playhouse 90, and Armstrong Circle Theatre. He made his Broadway debut in the play Wait Until Dark in 1966, and, in 1977, he returned from screen acting to the stage in David Mamet's play American Buffalo, earning a Drama Desk Award for Outstanding Actor in a Play nomination.
extract_id: Robert Selden Duvall adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika, paling dikenal untuk perannya dalam film-film era akhir abad ke-20. Duvall mulai berakting secara profesional di panggung pada tahun 1952, tampil dalam pertunjukan musim panas di Gateway Playhouse di Bellport, Long Island sampai 1959, dengan jeda satu tahun saat menjalani tugas di Angkatan Darat AS. Dalam karier teater awalnya, dia membuat koneksi yang kemudian membawanya ke karier televisi pada 1960-an di acara seperti The Defenders, Playhouse 90, dan Armstrong Circle Theatre. Dia memulai debut Broadway-nya dalam drama Wait Until Dark pada 1966, dan pada 1977, dia kembali dari layar ke panggung dalam drama David Mamet, American Buffalo, mendapatkan nominasi Drama Desk Award untuk Outstanding Actor in a Play.

name: Robert Hamer
title: Robert Hamer
extract: Robert Hamer was a British film director and screenwriter best known for the 1949 black comedy Kind Hearts and Coronets and the now acknowledged 1947 classic It Always Rains on Sunday.
extract_id: Robert Hamer adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film Inggris yang paling dikenal untuk komedi gelap tahun 1949 Kind Hearts and Coronets dan klasik yang kini diakui, It Always Rains on Sunday tahun 1947.

name: Robert Hays
title: Robert Hays
extract: Robert Hays is an American actor, known for a variety of television and film roles since the 1970s. He came to prominence around 1980, co-starring in the two-season domestic sitcom Angie, and playing the central role of pilot Ted Striker in the comedy film Airplane! and its sequel. Other film roles include the lead role in the comedy Take This Job and Shove It (1981), and Bob Seaver, one of the main human characters in Homeward Bound: The Incredible Journey (1993). On television, he starred in the science fiction series Starman (1986–1987) and the short-lived workplace sitcom FM (1989–1990), voiced Iron Man in Iron Man (1994), and had a guest role as Bud Hyde on That '70s Show (2000).
extract_id: Robert Hays adalah aktor Amerika, dikenal untuk berbagai peran televisi dan film sejak tahun 1970-an. Dia menjadi terkenal sekitar tahun 1980, berperan sebagai bintang tamu di sitcom domestik dua musim Angie, dan memerankan peran utama pilot Ted Striker dalam film komedi Airplane! dan sekuelnya. Peran film lain termasuk peran utama dalam komedi Take This Job and Shove It (1981), dan Bob Seaver, salah satu manusia utama dalam Homeward Bound: The Incredible Journey (1993). Di televisi, dia bintang dalam serial fiksi ilmiah Starman (1986–1987) dan sitcom tempat kerja singkat FM (1989–1990), menjadi suara Iron Man dalam Iron Man (1994), dan tampil sebagai tamu sebagai Bud Hyde di That '70s Show (2000).

name: Robert Manuel
title: Robert Manuel (actor)
extract: Robert Manuel was a 20th-century French stage, television, and film actor, and film director.
extract_id: Robert Manuel adalah aktor panggung, televisi, dan film Prancis abad ke-20, serta sutradara film.

name: Robert Mitchum
title: Robert Mitchum
extract: Robert Charles Durman Mitchum was an American actor and singer. He is known for his antihero roles and film noir appearances. He received nominations for an Academy Award and a BAFTA Award. He received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 1984 and the Golden Globe Cecil B. DeMille Award in 1992. Mitchum is rated number 23 on the American Film Institute's list of the greatest male stars of classic American cinema.
extract_id: Robert Charles Durman Mitchum adalah aktor dan penyanyi Amerika. Dia dikenal karena peran antihero dan penampilannya dalam film noir. Dia menerima nominasi Academy Award dan BAFTA Award. Dia menerima bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada 1984 dan Golden Globe Cecil B. DeMille Award pada 1992. Mitchum menempati peringkat ke-23 dalam daftar American Film Institute tentang bintang pria terhebat dalam sinema klasik Amerika.

name: Robert Morley
title: Robert Morley
extract: Robert Adolph Wilton Morley was an English actor who enjoyed a lengthy career in both Britain and the United States. He was frequently cast as a pompous English gentleman representing the Establishment, often in supporting roles. In 1939 he received an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actor for his portrayal of King Louis XVI in Marie Antoinette.
extract_id: Robert Adolph Wilton Morley adalah aktor Inggris yang menjalani karier panjang di Inggris dan Amerika Serikat. Dia sering diperankan sebagai pria Inggris angkuh yang mewakili Establishment, sering dalam peran pendukung. Pada 1939 ia menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Best Supporting Actor atas perannya sebagai Raja Louis XVI dalam Marie Antoinette.

name: Robert Mulligan
title: Robert Mulligan
extract: Robert Patrick Mulligan was an American director and producer. His dramas include To Kill a Mockingbird (1962), Summer of '42 (1971), The Other (1972), Same Time, Next Year (1978), and The Man in the Moon (1991). He collaborated with producer Alan J. Pakula in the 1960s.
extract_id: Robert Patrick Mulligan adalah sutradara dan produser Amerika. Dramanya termasuk To Kill a Mockingbird (1962), Summer of '42 (1971), The Other (1972), Same Time, Next Year (1978), dan The Man in the Moon (1991). Dia bekerja sama dengan produser Alan J. Pakula pada 1960-an.

name: Robert Patrick
title: Robert Patrick
extract: Robert Hammond Patrick is an American actor. Known for portraying villains and authority figures, Patrick is a Saturn Award winner with four other nominations.
extract_id: Robert Hammond Patrick adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal karena memerankan penjahat dan figur otoritas, Patrick adalah pemenang Saturn Award dengan empat nominasi lainnya.

name: Robert Redford
title: Robert Redford
extract: Charles Robert Redford Jr. was an American actor, director, and producer, celebrated for his magnetic presence as a leading man during the American New Wave. Across a career spanning more than six decades, Redford earned widespread recognition and numerous awards, including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award and five Golden Globe Awards, including a Cecil B. DeMille Award in 1994. He also earned various other honors, including the Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award in 1996, the Academy Honorary Award in 2002, the Kennedy Center Honors in 2005, the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2016, and the Honorary César in 2019.
extract_id: Charles Robert Redford Jr. adalah aktor, sutradara, dan produser Amerika, terkenal karena kehadirannya yang memikat sebagai pemeran utama selama Gelombang Baru Amerika. Dalam karier yang berlangsung lebih dari enam dekade, Redford mendapatkan pengakuan luas dan berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan lima Golden Globe Awards, termasuk Cecil B. DeMille Award pada 1994. Dia juga menerima berbagai penghargaan lainnya, termasuk Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award pada 1996, Academy Honorary Award pada 2002, Kennedy Center Honors pada 2005, Presidential Medal of Freedom pada 2016, dan Honorary César pada 2019.

name: Robert Rodriguez
title: Robert Rodriguez
extract: Robert Anthony Rodriguez is an American filmmaker, composer, actor, chef and visual effects supervisor. He shoots, edits, produces, and scores many of his films in Mexico and in his home state of Texas. Rodriguez directed the 1992 action film El Mariachi, which was a commercial success after grossing $2.6 million against a budget of $7,000. The film spawned two sequels known collectively as the Mexico Trilogy: Desperado (1995) and Once Upon a Time in Mexico (2003).
extract_id: Robert Anthony Rodriguez adalah pembuat film, komponis, aktor, koki, dan supervisor efek visual Amerika. Dia mengambil gambar, mengedit, memproduksi, dan menyusun banyak filmnya di Meksiko dan di negara asalnya Texas. Rodriguez menyutradarai film aksi tahun 1992 El Mariachi, yang sukses secara komersial setelah meraup $2,6 juta dari anggaran $7.000. Film ini melahirkan dua sekuel yang dikenal secara kolektif sebagai Mexico Trilogy: Desperado (1995) dan Once Upon a Time in Mexico (2003).

name: Robert Rossen
title: Robert Rossen
extract: Robert Rossen was an American screenwriter, film director, and producer whose film career spanned almost three decades.
extract_id: Robert Rossen adalah penulis skenario, sutradara film, dan produser Amerika yang karier filmnya berlangsung hampir tiga dekade.

name: Robert Ryan
title: Robert Ryan
extract: Robert Bushnell Ryan was an American actor and activist. He became known for his roles in films noir and Westerns, gaining fame for his portrayals of both hardened anti-heroes and ruthless villains. He was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for his role in Crossfire (1947), and a BAFTA Award for his performance in Billy Budd (1962). He was also an accomplished stage actor, winning a Drama Desk Award for a 1971 revival of Long Day's Journey into Night.
extract_id: Robert Bushnell Ryan adalah aktor dan aktivis Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya dalam film noir dan Western, meraih ketenaran untuk peran-peran sebagai antihero keras dan penjahat kejam. Dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Best Supporting Actor untuk perannya dalam Crossfire (1947), dan BAFTA Award untuk penampilannya dalam Billy Budd (1962). Dia juga aktor panggung yang handal, memenangkan Drama Desk Award untuk revival tahun 1971 dari Long Day's Journey into Night.

name: Robert Sean Leonard
title: Robert Sean Leonard
extract: Robert Lawrence Leonard, known as Robert Sean Leonard, is an American actor. He has received a Tony Award and a Obie Award over the course of a career on both stage and screen that started in the 1980s. He is best known for his portrayal of Neil Perry in the drama film Dead Poets Society (1989) and Dr. James Wilson in the medical drama series House (2004–2012).
extract_id: Robert Lawrence Leonard, dikenal sebagai Robert Sean Leonard, adalah aktor Amerika. Dia telah menerima Tony Award dan Obie Award selama kariernya di panggung dan layar yang dimulai pada 1980-an. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Neil Perry dalam film drama Dead Poets Society (1989) dan Dr. James Wilson dalam serial drama medis House (2004–2012).

name: Robert Shaw
title: Robert Shaw
extract: Robert Archibald Shaw was an English actor and writer. Beginning his career in theatre, Shaw joined the Shakespeare Memorial Theatre after the Second World War and appeared in productions of Macbeth, Henry VIII, Cymbeline, and other Shakespeare plays. With the Old Vic company (1951–52), he continued primarily in Shakespearean roles. In 1959, he starred in a West End production of The Long and the Short and the Tall.
extract_id: Robert Archibald Shaw adalah aktor dan penulis Inggris. Memulai kariernya di teater, Shaw bergabung dengan Shakespeare Memorial Theatre setelah Perang Dunia II dan tampil dalam produksi Macbeth, Henry VIII, Cymbeline, dan drama Shakespeare lainnya. Dengan perusahaan Old Vic (1951–52), dia terus terutama dalam peran Shakespearean. Pada 1959, dia membintangi produksi West End The Long and the Short and the Tall.

name: Robert Stack
title: Robert Stack
extract: Robert Stack was an American actor and television host. Known for his deep voice and commanding presence, he appeared in over 40 feature films. He starred in the ABC television series The Untouchables (1959–1963), for which he won the 1960 Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Performance by an Actor in a Series, and later hosted/narrated the true-crime series Unsolved Mysteries (1987–2002). He was also nominated for an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for his role in the film Written on the Wind (1956). Later in his career, Stack was known for his deadpan comedy roles that lampooned his dramatic on-screen persona, most notably as Captain Rex Kramer in Airplane! (1980).
extract_id: Robert Stack adalah aktor dan pembawa acara televisi Amerika. Dikenal karena suara dalam dan kehadiran yang memerintah, dia tampil dalam lebih dari 40 film fitur. Dia membintangi seri televisi ABC The Untouchables (1959–1963), yang membuatnya memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award 1960 untuk Outstanding Performance by an Actor in a Series, dan kemudian menjadi pembawa/narator serial kejahatan nyata Unsolved Mysteries (1987–2002). Dia juga dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Best Supporting Actor untuk perannya dalam film Written on the Wind (1956). Di akhir kariernya, Stack dikenal karena peran komedi tanpa ekspresi yang mengolok-olok persona dramatisnya di layar, terutama sebagai Kapten Rex Kramer dalam Airplane! (1980).

name: Robert Stevenson
title: Robert Stevenson (filmmaker)
extract: Robert Edward Stevenson was a British-American screenwriter and film director.
extract_id: Robert Edward Stevenson adalah seorang penulis skenario dan sutradara film asal Inggris-Amerika.

name: Robert Strauss
title: Robert Strauss (actor)
extract: Robert Strauss was an American actor. He became most familiar in Hollywood films of the 1950s such as Stalag 17 (1953), for which he was nominated for an Academy Award in the category of Best Supporting Actor.
extract_id: Robert Strauss adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Ia menjadi paling dikenal dalam film-film Hollywood tahun 1950-an seperti Stalag 17 (1953), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award dalam kategori Aktor Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Robert Walker
title: Robert Walker (actor, born 1918)
extract: Robert Hudson Walker was an American actor who starred as the villain in Alfred Hitchcock's thriller Strangers on a Train (1951), which was released shortly before his premature death.
extract_id: Robert Hudson Walker adalah seorang aktor Amerika yang membintangi sebagai penjahat dalam thriller Alfred Hitchcock Strangers on a Train (1951), yang dirilis tak lama sebelum kematiannya yang prematur.

name: Robert Wiene
title: Robert Wiene
extract: Robert Wiene was a German film director, screenwriter and producer, active during the silent era. He is widely-known for directing the landmark 1920 film The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari and a succession of other expressionist films. Wiene also directed a variety of other films of varying styles and genres. Following the Nazi rise to power in Germany, Wiene, who was of Jewish descent, fled into exile.
extract_id: Robert Wiene adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser Jerman yang aktif di era film bisu. Dia dikenal luas karena menyutradarai film landmark tahun 1920 The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari dan beberapa film ekspresionis lainnya. Wiene juga menyutradarai berbagai film lain dengan gaya dan genre yang beragam. Setelah Nazi naik ke tampuk kekuasaan di Jerman, Wiene, yang keturunan Yahudi, melarikan diri ke pengasingan.

name: Robert Wise
title: Robert Wise
description: American film director, film producer and film editor (1914–2005)
extract: Robert Earl Wise was an American filmmaker. He won the Academy Awards for Best Director and Best Picture for his musical films West Side Story (1961) and The Sound of Music (1965). He was also nominated for Best Film Editing for Citizen Kane (1941) and directed and produced The Sand Pebbles (1966), which was nominated for Best Picture.
extract_id: Robert Earl Wise adalah pembuat film Amerika. Ia memenangkan Academy Awards untuk Sutradara Terbaik dan Film Terbaik untuk film musikalnya West Side Story (1961) dan The Sound of Music (1965). Ia juga dinominasikan untuk Penyuntingan Film Terbaik untuk Citizen Kane (1941) dan menyutradarai serta memproduksi The Sand Pebbles (1966), yang dinominasikan untuk Film Terbaik.

name: Robert Zemeckis
title: Robert Zemeckis
extract: Robert Lee Zemeckis, sometimes called Bob Zemeckis, is an American filmmaker. Known for directing and producing a range of successful and influential films that often blend cutting-edge visual effects with storytelling in the late 20th century, he has received accolades such as an Academy Award and a Golden Globe Award, as well as nominations for five British Academy Film Awards and a Daytime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Robert Lee Zemeckis, kadang disebut Bob Zemeckis, adalah pembuat film Amerika. Terkenal karena menyutradarai dan memproduksi berbagai film sukses dan berpengaruh yang sering memadukan efek visual mutakhir dengan penceritaan di akhir abad ke-20, ia telah menerima penghargaan seperti Academy Award dan Golden Globe Award, serta beberapa nominasi untuk lima British Academy Film Awards dan Daytime Emmy Award.

name: Roberta Maxwell
title: Roberta Maxwell
extract: Roberta Farnham Maxwell is a Canadian actress.
extract_id: Roberta Farnham Maxwell adalah seorang aktris Kanada.

name: Roberto Benigni
title: Roberto Benigni
description: Italian actor, comedian, screenwriter, and film director (born 1952)
extract: Roberto Remigio Benigni is an Italian actor, comedian, screenwriter, and film director. He gained international recognition for writing, directing, and starring in the Holocaust comedy drama film Life Is Beautiful (1997), for which he received the Academy Awards for Best Actor and Best International Feature Film. Benigni is the first, and only, recipient of an Academy Award for Best Actor for a non-English language performance.
extract_id: Roberto Remigio Benigni adalah aktor, komedian, penulis skenario, dan sutradara film Italia. Ia mendapatkan pengakuan internasional karena menulis, menyutradarai, dan membintangi film drama komedi Holocaust Life Is Beautiful (1997), yang memberikannya Academy Awards untuk Aktor Terbaik dan Film Fitur Internasional Terbaik. Benigni adalah penerima pertama dan satu-satunya Academy Award untuk Aktor Terbaik untuk penampilan dalam bahasa non-Inggris.

name: Roberts Blossom
title: Roberts Blossom
extract: Roberts Scott Blossom was an American poet and character actor of theater, film, and television. He is best known for his roles as Old Man Marley in Home Alone (1990) and as Ezra Cobb in the horror film Deranged (1974). Blossom is also remembered for his supporting roles in films such as The Great Gatsby (1974), Close Encounters of the Third Kind (1977), Escape from Alcatraz (1979), Christine (1983), and The Last Temptation of Christ (1988).
extract_id: Roberts Scott Blossom adalah penyair dan aktor karakter Amerika dalam teater, film, dan televisi. Ia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Old Man Marley dalam Home Alone (1990) dan sebagai Ezra Cobb dalam film horor Deranged (1974). Blossom juga dikenang karena peran pendukungnya dalam film seperti The Great Gatsby (1974), Close Encounters of the Third Kind (1977), Escape from Alcatraz (1979), Christine (1983), dan The Last Temptation of Christ (1988).

name: Robin Williams
title: Robin Williams
extract: Robin McLaurin Williams was an American actor and comedian. Known for his improvisational skills and the wide variety of characters he created spontaneously and portrayed in drama and comedy films, he is regarded as one of the greatest comedians of all time. Williams received numerous accolades including an Academy Award, two Primetime Emmy Awards, and six Golden Globe Awards, as well as five Grammy Awards and two Screen Actors Guild Awards. He was awarded the Cecil B. DeMille Award in 2005.
extract_id: Robin McLaurin Williams adalah aktor dan komedian Amerika. Dikenal karena kemampuan improvisasinya dan beragam karakter yang ia ciptakan secara spontan serta perankan dalam film drama dan komedi, ia dianggap sebagai salah satu komedian terbesar sepanjang masa. Williams menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk Academy Award, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan enam Golden Globe Awards, serta lima Grammy Awards dan dua Screen Actors Guild Awards. Ia dianugerahi Cecil B. DeMille Award pada tahun 2005.

name: Robin Wright
title: Robin Wright
extract: Robin Gayle Wright is an American actress, producer and director. She has received accolades including a Golden Globe Award, and nominations for eight Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Robin Gayle Wright adalah seorang aktris, produser, dan sutradara Amerika. Dia telah menerima penghargaan termasuk Golden Globe Award, serta nominasi untuk delapan Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Rock Hudson
title: Rock Hudson
extract: Rock Hudson was an American actor. One of the most popular film stars of his time, he had a screen career spanning more than three decades, and was a prominent figure in the Golden Age of Hollywood.
extract_id: Rock Hudson adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Salah satu bintang film paling populer pada masanya, ia memiliki karier layar selama lebih dari tiga dekade, dan merupakan figur terkenal di Era Keemasan Hollywood.

name: Rod Steiger
title: Rod Steiger
extract: Rodney Stephen Steiger was an American actor, noted for his portrayal of offbeat, often volatile and crazed characters. Ranked as "one of Hollywood's most charismatic and dynamic stars", he is closely associated with the art of method acting, embodying the characters he played, which at times led to clashes with directors and co-stars. In films, he starred as Marlon Brando's mobster brother, Charley, in On the Waterfront (1954); the title character, Sol Nazerman, in The Pawnbroker (1964), which won him the Silver Bear for Best Actor; and as police chief Bill Gillespie, opposite Sidney Poitier, in the film In the Heat of the Night (1967), which won him the Academy Award for Best Actor.
extract_id: Rodney Stephen Steiger adalah aktor Amerika, terkenal karena penggambaran karakter yang tidak biasa, seringkali mudah marah dan gila. Dianggap sebagai "salah satu bintang Hollywood yang paling karismatik dan dinamis," ia sangat terkait dengan seni method acting, menghidupkan karakter yang diperankannya, yang kadang memicu bentrokan dengan sutradara dan rekan aktor. Dalam film, ia berperan sebagai saudara mafia Marlon Brando, Charley, dalam On the Waterfront (1954); karakter utama, Sol Nazerman, dalam The Pawnbroker (1964), yang memberinya Silver Bear untuk Aktor Terbaik; dan sebagai kepala polisi Bill Gillespie, berlawanan dengan Sidney Poitier, dalam film In the Heat of the Night (1967), yang memberinya Academy Award untuk Aktor Terbaik.

name: Rod Taylor
title: Rod Taylor
extract: Rodney Sturt Taylor was an Australian actor. He appeared in more than 50 feature films, including Young Cassidy (1965), Nobody Runs Forever (1968), The Train Robbers (1973), and A Matter of Wife... and Death (1975).
extract_id: Rodney Sturt Taylor adalah aktor Australia. Ia tampil dalam lebih dari 50 film fitur, termasuk Young Cassidy (1965), Nobody Runs Forever (1968), The Train Robbers (1973), dan A Matter of Wife... and Death (1975).

name: Roddy McDowall
title: Roddy McDowall

name: Rodney A. Grant
title: Rodney A. Grant

title: Rodney Rothman
extract: Rodney Rothman is an American filmmaker and author. He has been nominated for five Primetime Emmy Awards for Outstanding Writing for a Variety Series.
extract_id: Rodney Rothman adalah pembuat film dan penulis Amerika. Ia telah dinominasikan untuk lima Primetime Emmy Awards untuk Penulisan Terbaik dalam Serial Variety.

name: Rodrigo De la Serna
title: Rodrigo de la Serna
extract: Lionel Rodrigo de la Serna is an Argentine actor. He is known for playing Alberto Granado in the 2004 biopic The Motorcycle Diaries and Palermo in the Netflix series Money Heist.
extract_id: Lionel Rodrigo de la Serna adalah aktor Argentina. Ia dikenal karena memerankan Alberto Granado dalam film biopik 2004 The Motorcycle Diaries dan Palermo dalam serial Netflix Money Heist.

name: Roe-ha Kim
title: Kim Roi-ha
extract: Kim Roi-ha is a South Korean actor. Notable roles include a detective in Memories of Murder (2003), and a gangster in A Bittersweet Life (2005).
extract_id: Kim Roi-ha adalah aktor Korea Selatan. Peran penting termasuk sebagai detektif dalam Memories of Murder (2003), dan gangster dalam A Bittersweet Life (2005).

name: Roger Allers
title: Roger Allers
extract: Roger Allers was an American filmmaker, animator, storyboard artist and playwright. He was best known for co-directing Disney Animation's The Lion King (1994), the highest-grossing traditionally animated film of all time, and for writing the Broadway adaptation of the same name. He also directed Sony Pictures Animation's first feature-length animated film, Open Season (2006) and the animated adaptation of The Prophet.
extract_id: Roger Allers adalah pembuat film, animator, seniman storyboard, dan dramawan Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena menjadi co-direktur Disney Animation's The Lion King (1994), film animasi tradisional dengan penghasilan tertinggi sepanjang masa, dan menulis adaptasi Broadway dengan judul yang sama. Ia juga menyutradarai film animasi fitur pertama Sony Pictures Animation, Open Season (2006) dan adaptasi animasi The Prophet.

name: Roger Donaldson
title: Roger Donaldson
extract: Roger Lindsey Donaldson is an Australian and New Zealand film director, screenwriter, and producer. His 1977 debut film, Sleeping Dogs, is considered a landmark work of New Zealand cinema, as one of the country’s first films to attract large-scale critical and commercial success. He has subsequently directed 17 feature films, working in Hollywood and the United Kingdom, as well as his native country.
extract_id: Roger Lindsey Donaldson adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan produser Australia dan Selandia Baru. Film debutnya tahun 1977, Sleeping Dogs, dianggap karya penting dalam sinema Selandia Baru, sebagai salah satu film pertama negara itu yang meraih kesuksesan kritis dan komersial skala besar. Ia kemudian menyutradarai 17 film fitur, bekerja di Hollywood dan Inggris, serta di negara asalnya.

name: Rohini Hattangadi
title: Rohini Hattangadi
extract: Rohini Hattangadi is an Indian actress, known for her work in films in many languages including Marathi, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, and Gujarati, and in Marathi soap operas and theatre. She has won two Filmfare Awards, one National Film Award, and is the only Indian actress to win the BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Supporting Role for her performance as Kasturba Gandhi in Gandhi (1982).
extract_id: Rohini Hattangadi adalah aktris India, dikenal karena karyanya dalam berbagai bahasa film termasuk Marathi, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, dan Gujarati, serta dalam opera sabun Marathi dan teater. Ia memenangkan dua Filmfare Awards, satu National Film Award, dan merupakan satu-satunya aktris India yang memenangkan BAFTA Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik atas penampilannya sebagai Kasturba Gandhi dalam Gandhi (1982).

name: Roland Joffé
title: Roland Joffé
extract: Roland Joffé is an English film and television director, producer and screenwriter. He is known for directing the critically-acclaimed films The Killing Fields (1984) and The Mission (1986), both of which earned him Academy Award nominations for Best Director, and the latter winning the Palme d'Or at the 1986 Cannes Film Festival.
extract_id: Roland Joffé adalah sutradara film dan televisi, produser, dan penulis skenario Inggris. Ia dikenal sebagai sutradara film-film yang mendapat pujian kritis The Killing Fields (1984) dan The Mission (1986), keduanya membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award Sutradara Terbaik, dan yang terakhir memenangkan Palme d'Or di Festival Film Cannes 1986.

name: Roland Møller
title: Roland Møller
extract: Roland Møller is a Danish actor. He won the Bodil Award for Best Actor in a Leading Role for Land of Mine (2015), and Best Actor in a Supporting Role for Nordvest (2013). He has appeared in high-profile films like A Hijacking, Darkland, Atomic Blonde, Papillon, and Skyscraper.
extract_id: Roland Møller adalah aktor Denmark. Ia memenangkan Bodil Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Peran Utama untuk Land of Mine (2015), dan Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk Nordvest (2013). Ia telah tampil dalam film-film besar seperti A Hijacking, Darkland, Atomic Blonde, Papillon, dan Skyscraper.

name: Rolf Lassgård
title: Rolf Lassgård
extract: Rolf Holger Lassgård is a Swedish actor. He is known for his many roles in crime dramas.
extract_id: Rolf Holger Lassgård adalah aktor Swedia. Ia dikenal karena banyak perannya dalam drama kriminal.

name: Roman Griffin Davis
title: Roman Griffin Davis
extract: Roman Griffin Davis is an English actor. He is best known for his title role in the film Jojo Rabbit (2019), for which he was nominated for a Golden Globe Award and won a Critics' Choice Award.
extract_id: Roman Griffin Davis adalah aktor Inggris. Ia paling dikenal karena peran utamanya dalam film Jojo Rabbit (2019), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award dan memenangkan Critics' Choice Award.

name: Roman Madyanov
title: Roman Madyanov
extract: Roman Sergeevich Madyanov was a Soviet and Russian actor. Madyanov's career in cinema began as a child actor when he starred as Huckleberry Finn in Hopelessly Lost (1973). He was best known in the West for portraying the corrupt mayor Vadim in the 2014 film Leviathan.
extract_id: Roman Sergeevich Madyanov adalah aktor Soviet dan Rusia. Karier Madyanov di dunia sinema dimulai sebagai aktor cilik ketika ia berperan sebagai Huckleberry Finn dalam Hopelessly Lost (1973). Ia paling dikenal di Barat karena memerankan walikota korup Vadim dalam film Leviathan (2014).

name: Roman Polanski
title: Roman Polanski
extract: Raymond Roman Thierry Polański is a Polish and French filmmaker and actor. He is the recipient of numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, three British Academy Film Awards, ten César Awards, and two Golden Globe Awards as well as a Golden Bear and a Palme d'Or.
extract_id: Raymond Roman Thierry Polański adalah pembuat film dan aktor Polandia dan Prancis. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, tiga British Academy Film Awards, sepuluh César Awards, dua Golden Globe Awards serta Golden Bear dan Palme d'Or.

name: Romolo Valli
title: Romolo Valli
extract: Romolo Valli was an Italian actor.
extract_id: Romolo Valli adalah aktor Italia.

name: Ron Clements
title: Ron Clements
extract: Ronald Francis Clements is an American animator, film director, screenwriter, and film producer. He often collaborates with fellow director John Musker and is best known for writing and directing the Disney animated films The Great Mouse Detective (1986), The Little Mermaid (1989), Aladdin (1992), Hercules (1997), Treasure Planet (2002), The Princess and the Frog (2009), and Moana (2016).
extract_id: Ronald Francis Clements adalah animator, sutradara film, penulis naskah, dan produser film asal Amerika. Ia sering bekerja sama dengan sutradara John Musker dan paling dikenal menulis dan menyutradarai film animasi Disney The Great Mouse Detective (1986), The Little Mermaid (1989), Aladdin (1992), Hercules (1997), Treasure Planet (2002), The Princess and the Frog (2009), dan Moana (2016).

name: Ron Howard
title: Ron Howard
extract: Ronald William Howard is an American filmmaker and actor. He started his career as a child actor before transitioning to directing films. Over his six-decade career, he has received multiple accolades, including two Academy Awards, seven Emmy Awards, two Golden Globe Awards, and two Grammy Awards as well as nominations for seven British Academy Film Awards. He was also awarded the National Medal of Arts in 2003 and was inducted into the Television Hall of Fame in 2013. Howard has two stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame for his contributions in film and television.
extract_id: Ronald William Howard adalah pembuat film dan aktor Amerika. Ia memulai kariernya sebagai aktor cilik sebelum beralih menjadi sutradara film. Sepanjang kariernya yang berlangsung enam dekade, ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Academy Awards, tujuh Emmy Awards, dua Golden Globe Awards, dan dua Grammy Awards serta nominasi untuk tujuh British Academy Film Awards. Ia juga dianugerahi National Medal of Arts pada tahun 2003 dan masuk ke Television Hall of Fame pada 2013. Howard memiliki dua bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame atas kontribusinya di film dan televisi.

name: Ron Livingston
title: Ron Livingston
extract: Ronald Joseph Livingston is an American actor. He is best known for playing Peter Gibbons in Office Space (1999) and Captain Lewis Nixon III in the miniseries Band of Brothers (2001). Livingston's other roles include the films Swingers (1996), Adaptation. (2002), The Conjuring (2013), James White (2015), Tully (2018); and the television series Loudermilk (2017–2020), and Boardwalk Empire (2013).
extract_id: Ronald Joseph Livingston adalah aktor Amerika. Ia paling dikenal berperan sebagai Peter Gibbons dalam Office Space (1999) dan Kapten Lewis Nixon III dalam miniseri Band of Brothers (2001). Peran lain Livingston termasuk dalam film Swingers (1996), Adaptation. (2002), The Conjuring (2013), James White (2015), Tully (2018); dan serial televisi Loudermilk (2017–2020), dan Boardwalk Empire (2013).

name: Ronit Roy
title: Ronit Roy
extract: Ronit Bose Roy is an Indian actor who works primarily in Hindi television and films and Bengali films. He gained immense popularity for playing Mihir Virani in the hugely successful soap opera Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi and Rishabh Bajaj in Kasautii Zindagii Kay. One of the highest paid television actors in India, he has earned numerous accolades including a Filmfare Award, five ITA Awards, and six Indian Telly Awards.
extract_id: Ronit Bose Roy adalah aktor India yang bekerja terutama di televisi dan film Hindi serta film Bengali. Ia sangat populer karena memerankan Mihir Virani dalam opera sabun Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi yang sangat sukses dan Rishabh Bajaj dalam Kasautii Zindagii Kay. Salah satu aktor televisi dengan bayaran tertinggi di India, ia telah meraih banyak penghargaan termasuk Filmfare Award, lima ITA Awards, dan enam Indian Telly Awards.

name: Ronny Cox
title: Ronny Cox
extract: Daniel Ronald Cox is an American actor and musician. He has appeared in numerous films and television series since his acting debut in Deliverance (1972). He is best known for his roles in Beverly Hills Cop (1984), RoboCop (1987), and Total Recall (1990). He is also active as a musician, performing over 100 times per year at festivals and theaters as of 2012.
extract_id: Daniel Ronald Cox adalah aktor dan musisi Amerika. Ia telah tampil dalam banyak film dan serial televisi sejak debut aktingnya dalam Deliverance (1972). Ia paling dikenal karena perannya dalam Beverly Hills Cop (1984), RoboCop (1987), dan Total Recall (1990). Ia juga aktif sebagai musisi, tampil lebih dari 100 kali per tahun di festival dan teater hingga 2012.

name: Ronny Yu
title: Ronny Yu
extract: Ronny Yu Yan-Tai is a Hong Kong film director, producer, and screenwriter. He has worked on both Hong Kong and American films. He is mostly known for his work in the American horror genre, such as Bride of Chucky (1998) and Freddy vs. Jason (2003).
extract_id: Ronny Yu Yan-Tai adalah sutradara film, produser, dan penulis skenario asal Hong Kong. Ia bekerja pada film-film Hong Kong dan Amerika. Ia paling dikenal untuk karya-karyanya dalam genre horor Amerika, seperti Bride of Chucky (1998) dan Freddy vs. Jason (2003).

name: Rooney Mara
title: Rooney Mara
extract: Patricia Rooney Mara is an American actress. Her accolades include nominations for two Academy Awards, two Golden Globe Awards, and a British Academy Film Award.
extract_id: Patricia Rooney Mara adalah aktris Amerika. Penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards, dua Golden Globe Awards, dan satu British Academy Film Award.

name: Rory Cochrane
title: Rory Cochrane
extract: Rory Cochrane is an American actor. He is known for playing Ron Slater in Dazed and Confused, Lucas in Empire Records, Lee Schatz in Argo, Freck in A Scanner Darkly, and Tim Speedle in CSI: Miami.
extract_id: Rory Cochrane adalah aktor Amerika. Ia dikenal karena berperan sebagai Ron Slater dalam Dazed and Confused, Lucas dalam Empire Records, Lee Schatz dalam Argo, Freck dalam A Scanner Darkly, dan Tim Speedle dalam CSI: Miami.

name: Rosalind Russell
title: Rosalind Russell
description: American actress, model, comedian, screenwriter and singer (1907–1976)
extract: Catherine Rosalind Russell was an American actress, model, comedian, screenwriter, and singer, known for her role as fast-talking newspaper reporter Hildy Johnson in the Howard Hawks screwball comedy His Girl Friday (1940), opposite Cary Grant, as well as for her role of catty Sylvia Fowler in George Cukor's The Women (1939), opposite Joan Crawford and Norma Shearer, and for her portrayals of Mame Dennis in the 1956 stage and 1958 film adaptations of Auntie Mame, and Rose in Gypsy (1962). A noted comedienne, she received various accolades, including five Golden Globe Awards and a Tony Award, in addition to nominations for four Academy Awards and a BAFTA Award. Russell has been honored with a Jean Hersholt Humanitarian Award in 1973 and Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award in 1975.
extract_id: Catherine Rosalind Russell adalah aktris, model, komedian, penulis naskah, dan penyanyi Amerika, dikenal karena perannya sebagai reporter surat kabar yang cerewet Hildy Johnson dalam komedi screwball Howard Hawks His Girl Friday (1940), berlawanan dengan Cary Grant, serta sebagai Sylvia Fowler yang tajam dalam The Women (1939) karya George Cukor, berlawanan dengan Joan Crawford dan Norma Shearer, dan peran Mame Dennis dalam adaptasi panggung 1956 dan film 1958 Auntie Mame, serta Rose dalam Gypsy (1962). Sebagai komedian terkenal, ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk lima Golden Globe Awards dan Tony Award, selain nominasi empat Academy Awards dan BAFTA Award. Russell dianugerahi Jean Hersholt Humanitarian Award pada 1973 dan Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award pada 1975.

name: Rosamund Pike
title: Rosamund Pike
extract: Rosamund Mary Ellen Pike is a British actress and producer. Known for her portrayals of complex and morally ambiguous women in independent cinema and psychological thrillers, her accolades include a Primetime Emmy Award, a Golden Globe Award and a Laurence Olivier Award, in addition to nominations for an Academy Award and two BAFTAs.
extract_id: Rosamund Mary Ellen Pike adalah aktris dan produser Inggris. Dikenal untuk peran-perannya sebagai wanita kompleks dan bermoral ambigu dalam sinema independen dan thriller psikologis, penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk Primetime Emmy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Laurence Olivier Award, selain nominasi Academy Award dan dua BAFTA.

name: Rosanna Arquette
title: Rosanna Arquette
extract: Rosanna Lisa Arquette is an American actress. She was nominated for an Emmy Award for her performance in the television film The Executioner's Song (1982) and won the BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Supporting Role for the film Desperately Seeking Susan (1985). Her other notable film credits include Baby It's You (1983), After Hours (1985), The Big Blue (1988), Nowhere to Run (1993), Pulp Fiction (1994), Crash (1996), The Whole Nine Yards (2000), and Joe Dirt (2001). She also directed the documentary Searching for Debra Winger (2002).
extract_id: Rosanna Lisa Arquette adalah aktris Amerika. Ia dinominasikan untuk Emmy Award atas penampilannya dalam film televisi The Executioner's Song (1982) dan memenangkan BAFTA Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik untuk film Desperately Seeking Susan (1985). Kredit film penting lainnya termasuk Baby It's You (1983), After Hours (1985), The Big Blue (1988), Nowhere to Run (1993), Pulp Fiction (1994), Crash (1996), The Whole Nine Yards (2000), dan Joe Dirt (2001). Ia juga menyutradarai film dokumenter Searching for Debra Winger (2002).

name: Rosario Dawson
title: Rosario Dawson
extract: Rosario Isabel Dawson is an American actress and activist. She made her feature-film debut in the 1995 independent drama Kids. Her subsequent film roles include He Got Game (1998), Josie and the Pussycats (2001), 25th Hour (2002), Men in Black II (2002), The Rundown (2003), Rent (2005), Sin City (2005), Clerks II (2006), Death Proof (2007), Seven Pounds (2008), Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief (2010), Unstoppable (2010), Zookeeper (2011), Trance (2013), Top Five (2014), Zombieland: Double Tap (2019), Clerks 3 (2022), and Haunted Mansion (2023). Dawson has provided voice-over work for Disney/Marvel Comics, and Skydance Corporation/DC Comics/Nickelodeon. She is also recognized for her portrayal of the live-action Ahsoka Tano in the Star Wars franchise.
extract_id: Rosario Isabel Dawson adalah aktris dan aktivis Amerika. Debut film fitur-nya dalam drama independen Kids (1995). Peran film berikutnya termasuk He Got Game (1998), Josie and the Pussycats (2001), 25th Hour (2002), Men in Black II (2002), The Rundown (2003), Rent (2005), Sin City (2005), Clerks II (2006), Death Proof (2007), Seven Pounds (2008), Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief (2010), Unstoppable (2010), Zookeeper (2011), Trance (2013), Top Five (2014), Zombieland: Double Tap (2019), Clerks 3 (2022), dan Haunted Mansion (2023). Dawson juga memberikan suara dalam produksi Disney/Marvel Comics dan Skydance Corporation/DC Comics/Nickelodeon. Ia dikenal juga karena memerankan Ahsoka Tano versi live-action dalam waralaba Star Wars.

name: Roscoe Ates
title: Roscoe Ates
extract: Roscoe Blevel Ates was an American vaudeville performer, actor of stage and screen, comedian and musician who primarily featured in western films and television. He was best known as western character Soapy Jones. He was also billed as Rosco Ates.
extract_id: Roscoe Blevel Ates adalah pemain vaudeville Amerika, aktor panggung dan layar, komedian, dan musisi yang terutama tampil dalam film dan televisi genre western. Ia paling dikenal sebagai karakter western Soapy Jones. Ia juga dikenal dengan nama Rosco Ates.

name: Roscoe Karns
title: Roscoe Karns
extract: Roscoe Karns was an American actor who appeared in nearly 150 films between 1915 and 1964. He specialized in cynical, wise-cracking characters, and his rapid-fire delivery enlivened many comedies and crime thrillers in the 1930s and 1940s.
extract_id: Roscoe Karns adalah aktor Amerika yang tampil dalam hampir 150 film antara 1915 dan 1964. Ia mengkhususkan diri dalam peran karakter sinis dan tukang becanda cerdas, dan penyampaian cepatnya menghidupkan banyak komedi dan thriller kejahatan pada 1930-an dan 1940-an.

name: Rosemarie DeWitt
title: Rosemarie DeWitt
extract: Rosemarie Braddock DeWitt is an American actress. DeWitt played Emily Lehman in the Fox television series Standoff (2006–07), co-starring with her future husband Ron Livingston. She appeared as Charmaine Craine on United States of Tara. She also was the title character in 2008's Rachel Getting Married, garnering several awards and nominations for best supporting actress. She starred as Ryan Gosling's character Sebastian's sister Laura Wilder in the Oscar-winning movie La La Land. She also starred in the horror/thriller Poltergeist (2015), a remake of the 1982 film of the same name.
extract_id: Rosemarie Braddock DeWitt adalah aktris Amerika. DeWitt memerankan Emily Lehman dalam serial televisi Fox Standoff (2006–07), beradu peran dengan Ron Livingston yang kemudian menjadi suaminya. Ia tampil sebagai Charmaine Craine dalam United States of Tara. Ia juga menjadi karakter utama dalam Rachel Getting Married (2008), memperoleh berbagai penghargaan dan nominasi sebagai aktris pendukung terbaik. Ia membintangi sebagai Laura Wilder, saudara Sebastian yang diperankan Ryan Gosling dalam film pemenang Oscar La La Land. Ia juga berperan dalam film horor/thriller Poltergeist (2015), remake dari film tahun 1982 dengan judul yang sama.

name: Rosemary Murphy
title: Rosemary Murphy
extract: Rosemary Murphy was an American actress of stage, film, and television. She was nominated for three Tony Awards for her stage work, as well as two Emmy Awards for television work, winning once, for her performance in Eleanor and Franklin (1976).
extract_id: Rosemary Murphy adalah aktris Amerika panggung, film, dan televisi. Ia dinominasikan untuk tiga Tony Awards untuk karya panggungnya, serta dua Emmy Awards untuk karya televisi, dan memenangkan satu kali atas penampilannya dalam Eleanor and Franklin (1976).

name: Roshan Seth
title: Roshan Seth
description: British-Indian actor, writer and theatre director (born 1942)
extract: Roshan Seth is a British-Indian actor, writer and theatre director who has worked in the United Kingdom, United States and India. He began his acting career in the early 1960s in the UK, but left acting the following decade and moved to India to work as a journalist. In the 1980s, he rose to prominence for his comeback performance as Jawaharlal Nehru in Richard Attenborough's Academy Award-winning film Gandhi, which brought him a BAFTA Award nomination for Best Actor in a Supporting Role and reignited his interest in acting.
extract_id: Roshan Seth adalah aktor, penulis, dan sutradara teater Inggris-India yang telah bekerja di Inggris, Amerika Serikat, dan India. Ia memulai karier aktingnya pada awal 1960-an di Inggris, namun meninggalkan dunia akting pada dekade berikutnya dan pindah ke India untuk bekerja sebagai jurnalis. Pada 1980-an, ia menjadi terkenal kembali berkat penampilan comeback-nya sebagai Jawaharlal Nehru dalam film Gandhi karya Richard Attenborough yang memenangkan Academy Award, yang membawanya nominasi BAFTA Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dan menghidupkan kembali minatnya pada akting.

name: Roy Dotrice
title: Roy Dotrice
extract: Roy Dotrice was a British stage and screen actor. He played the antiquarian John Aubrey in the solo play Brief Lives. He won a Tony Award for his performance in the 2000 Broadway revival of A Moon for the Misbegotten, also appearing as Leopold Mozart in the film version of Amadeus (1984), Charles Dickens in Dickens of London (1976), and Jacob Wells/Father in the TV series Beauty and the Beast.
extract_id: Roy Dotrice adalah aktor panggung dan layar Inggris. Ia memerankan ahli antik John Aubrey dalam drama solo Brief Lives. Ia memenangkan Tony Award untuk penampilannya dalam kebangkitan Broadway A Moon for the Misbegotten tahun 2000, juga tampil sebagai Leopold Mozart dalam versi film Amadeus (1984), Charles Dickens dalam Dickens of London (1976), dan Jacob Wells/Bapak dalam serial TV Beauty and the Beast.

name: Roy Kinnear
title: Roy Kinnear
extract: Roy Mitchell Kinnear was an English character actor and comedian. He was known for playing Algernon in The Beatles' Help! (1965), Clapper in How I Won the War (1967), Henry Salt in Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory (1971), and Planchet in The Three Musketeers (1973) and its two sequels. On television, Kinnear starred in No Appointment Necessary, The Dick Emery Show (1979–1981), Man About the House (1974–1975), George and Mildred (1976–1979), and Cowboys (1980–1981).
extract_id: Roy Mitchell Kinnear adalah aktor karakter dan komedian Inggris. Ia dikenal karena memerankan Algernon dalam film The Beatles' Help! (1965), Clapper dalam How I Won the War (1967), Henry Salt dalam Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory (1971), dan Planchet dalam The Three Musketeers (1973) dan dua sekuelnya. Di televisi, Kinnear membintangi No Appointment Necessary, The Dick Emery Show (1979–1981), Man About the House (1974–1975), George and Mildred (1976–1979), dan Cowboys (1980–1981).

name: Roy Scheider
title: Roy Scheider
extract: Roy Richard Scheider was an American actor who achieved fame with his leading and supporting roles in celebrated films from the 1970s to the mid-1980s including the lead role in Jaws. He was nominated for two Academy Awards, one Golden Globe, and one BAFTA Award, and won both an Obie and Drama League Award for his stage performances.
extract_id: Roy Richard Scheider adalah aktor Amerika yang meraih ketenaran lewat peran utama dan pendukung dalam film-film terkenal dari era 1970-an hingga pertengahan 1980-an termasuk peran utama dalam Jaws. Ia dinominasikan untuk dua Academy Awards, satu Golden Globe, dan satu BAFTA Award, serta memenangkan Obie dan Drama League Award untuk penampilan panggungnya.

name: Ruben Fleischer
title: Ruben Fleischer
extract: Ruben Samuel Fleischer is an American film director, film producer, television producer, music video director, and commercial director. He is best known as the director of Zombieland (2009), his first feature film, and its sequel Zombieland: Double Tap (2019). He has also directed the films 30 Minutes or Less, Gangster Squad, Uncharted, and 2018's Venom featuring the Marvel Comics character of the same name. Prior to features, he directed television commercials for such brands as Cisco, Eurostar, ESPN, and Burger King, and music videos for artists such as M.I.A., Electric Six, DJ Format and Gold Chains.
extract_id: Ruben Samuel Fleischer adalah sutradara film, produser film, produser televisi, sutradara video musik, dan sutradara iklan Amerika. Ia paling dikenal sebagai sutradara Zombieland (2009), film fitur pertamanya, dan sekuelnya Zombieland: Double Tap (2019). Ia juga menyutradarai film 30 Minutes or Less, Gangster Squad, Uncharted, dan Venom (2018) yang menampilkan karakter Marvel Comics dengan nama yang sama. Sebelum film fitur, ia menyutradarai iklan televisi untuk merek seperti Cisco, Eurostar, ESPN, dan Burger King, serta video musik untuk artis seperti M.I.A., Electric Six, DJ Format, dan Gold Chains.

name: Ruby Dee
title: Ruby Dee
extract: Ruby Dee was an American actress. She was married to Ossie Davis, with whom she frequently performed until his death in 2005. She received numerous accolades, including an Emmy Award, a Grammy Award, an Obie Award, and a Drama Desk Award, as well as a nomination for an Academy Award. She was honored with the National Medal of Arts in 1995, the Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award in 2000, and the Kennedy Center Honors in 2004.
extract_id: Ruby Dee adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia menikah dengan Ossie Davis, yang sering dia ajak tampil bersama hingga kematiannya pada tahun 2005. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Emmy Award, Grammy Award, Obie Award, dan Drama Desk Award, serta nominasi untuk Academy Award. Dia dihormati dengan National Medal of Arts pada tahun 1995, Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award pada tahun 2000, dan Kennedy Center Honors pada tahun 2004.

name: Rudolf Klein-Rogge
title: Rudolf Klein-Rogge
extract: Friedrich Rudolf Klein, better known as Rudolf Klein-Rogge, was a German film actor, best known for playing sinister figures in films in the 1920s and 1930s as well as being a mainstay in director Fritz Lang's Weimar-era films. He is probably best known in popular culture, particularly to English-speaking audiences, for playing the archetypal mad scientist role of C. A. Rotwang in Lang's Metropolis and as the criminal genius Doctor Mabuse. Klein-Rogge also appeared in several important French films in the late 1920s and early 1930s.
extract_id: Friedrich Rudolf Klein, lebih dikenal sebagai Rudolf Klein-Rogge, adalah aktor film Jerman yang paling dikenal karena memainkan tokoh jahat dalam film-film tahun 1920-an dan 1930-an serta menjadi pemeran tetap dalam film era Weimar sutradara Fritz Lang. Dia mungkin paling dikenal dalam budaya populer, terutama bagi penonton berbahasa Inggris, karena memerankan peran ilmuwan gila arketipal C. A. Rotwang dalam film Metropolis karya Lang dan sebagai jenius kriminal Doctor Mabuse. Klein-Rogge juga tampil dalam beberapa film penting Prancis pada akhir 1920-an dan awal 1930-an.

name: Rudy Youngblood
title: Rudy Youngblood
extract: Rudy Youngblood is an American actor.
extract_id: Rudy Youngblood adalah seorang aktor Amerika.

name: Rufus
title: Rufus (actor)
extract: Jacques Narcy, better known by his stage name Rufus, is a French actor best known to international film audiences for his performance as Raphaël, the father of Amélie Poulain in Amélie (2001).
extract_id: Jacques Narcy, lebih dikenal dengan nama panggungnya Rufus, adalah aktor Prancis yang paling dikenal oleh penonton film internasional karena penampilannya sebagai Raphaël, ayah Amélie Poulain dalam film Amélie (2001).

name: Rufus Sewell
title: Rufus Sewell
extract: Rufus Frederik Sewell is a British actor. He has been described as a character actor and has also worked in lead roles. He has acted in film, television, and theatrical work.
extract_id: Rufus Frederik Sewell adalah aktor Inggris. Dia digambarkan sebagai aktor karakter dan juga telah bekerja dalam peran utama. Dia telah berakting dalam film, televisi, dan teater.

name: Rumi Hiiragi
title: Rumi Hiiragi
extract: Rumi Hiiragi is a Japanese actress. She is best known for voicing the lead character Chihiro in the Japanese version of the Studio Ghibli film Spirited Away (2001).
extract_id: Rumi Hiiragi adalah aktris Jepang. Dia paling dikenal karena mengisi suara karakter utama Chihiro dalam versi Jepang film Studio Ghibli Spirited Away (2001).

name: Ruocheng Ying
title: Ying Ruocheng
extract: Ying Ruocheng was a Chinese actor, director, playwright and vice minister of culture from 1986 to 1990. He first came to the attention of Western audiences for his portrayal of Kublai Khan in the 1982 miniseries Marco Polo. He played the part of the governor of the detention camp in the Bernardo Bertolucci's film The Last Emperor, and the role of the Tibetan Buddhist Lama Norbu in Little Buddha. He also worked as a theater translator, director, and actor for the Beijing People's Art Theatre, particularly for his role as Pockmark Liu in Lao She's Teahouse and as Willy Loman in Death of a Salesman in 1983, directed by Arthur Miller.
extract_id: Ying Ruocheng adalah aktor, sutradara, dramawan Tiongkok dan wakil menteri kebudayaan dari tahun 1986 hingga 1990. Dia pertama kali dikenal oleh penonton Barat karena perannya sebagai Kublai Khan dalam miniseri Marco Polo tahun 1982. Dia memainkan peran gubernur kamp penahanan dalam film Bernardo Bertolucci The Last Emperor, dan peran Lama Norbu, biksu Buddha Tibet dalam Little Buddha. Dia juga bekerja sebagai penerjemah teater, sutradara, dan aktor untuk Beijing People's Art Theatre, terutama untuk perannya sebagai Pockmark Liu dalam Teahouse karya Lao She dan sebagai Willy Loman dalam Death of a Salesman tahun 1983, disutradarai oleh Arthur Miller.

name: Rupert Friend
title: Rupert Friend
extract: Rupert William Anthony Friend is an English actor. He first gained recognition for his roles in The Libertine (2004) and Mrs. Palfrey at the Claremont (2005), both of which won him awards for best newcomer. He portrayed George Wickham in Pride & Prejudice (2005), Lieutenant Kurt Kotler in The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas (2008), Albert, Prince Consort in The Young Victoria (2009), psychologist Oliver Baumer in Starred Up (2013), CIA operative Peter Quinn in the political thriller series Homeland (2012–2017), Vasily Stalin in The Death of Stalin (2017), Theo van Gogh in At Eternity's Gate (2018), and Ernest Donovan in the series Strange Angel (2018–2019).
extract_id: Rupert William Anthony Friend adalah aktor Inggris. Dia pertama kali dikenal melalui perannya dalam The Libertine (2004) dan Mrs. Palfrey at the Claremont (2005), yang keduanya memberinya penghargaan sebagai pendatang baru terbaik. Dia memerankan George Wickham dalam Pride & Prejudice (2005), Letnan Kurt Kotler dalam The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas (2008), Albert, Pangeran Konsor dalam The Young Victoria (2009), psikolog Oliver Baumer dalam Starred Up (2013), agen CIA Peter Quinn dalam serial thriller politik Homeland (2012–2017), Vasily Stalin dalam The Death of Stalin (2017), Theo van Gogh dalam At Eternity's Gate (2018), dan Ernest Donovan dalam serial Strange Angel (2018–2019).

name: Rupert Graves
title: Rupert Graves
extract: Rupert Graves is an English film, television, and theatre actor. He is known for his roles in A Room with a View, Maurice, The Madness of King George, and The Forsyte Saga. From 2010 to 2017 he starred as DI Lestrade in the BBC television series Sherlock.
extract_id: Rupert Graves adalah aktor film, televisi, dan teater Inggris. Dia dikenal karena perannya dalam A Room with a View, Maurice, The Madness of King George, dan The Forsyte Saga. Dari tahun 2010 hingga 2017 dia membintangi sebagai DI Lestrade dalam serial televisi BBC Sherlock.

name: Rupert Grint
title: Rupert Grint
extract: Rupert Alexander Lloyd Grint is an English actor. He rose to fame for his role as Ron Weasley in the Harry Potter film series, for which he was cast at age eleven, having previously acted only in school plays and his local theatre group. Grint portrayed Weasley in all eight films in the series, beginning with Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (2001) and concluding with Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 2 (2011). Since then, he has continued to work in film, television, and theatre.
extract_id: Rupert Alexander Lloyd Grint adalah aktor Inggris. Dia terkenal karena perannya sebagai Ron Weasley dalam seri film Harry Potter, di mana dia dipilih saat berusia sebelas tahun, setelah sebelumnya hanya berakting dalam pentas sekolah dan kelompok teater lokalnya. Grint memerankan Weasley dalam delapan film dalam seri tersebut, dimulai dengan Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (2001) dan berakhir dengan Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 2 (2011). Sejak itu, dia terus bekerja di film, televisi, dan teater.

name: Russell Brand
title: Russell Brand
extract: Russell Edward Brand is an English comedian, actor, podcaster, and media personality. He was initially a stand-up comedian and radio and television presenter in the UK, where he rose to prominence as the host of Big Brother's Big Mouth, a spin-off of the reality television series Big Brother broadcast on E4.
extract_id: Russell Edward Brand adalah komedian, aktor, podcaster, dan tokoh media asal Inggris. Dia awalnya merupakan komedian stand-up serta pembawa acara radio dan televisi di Inggris, di mana dia dikenal sebagai pembawa acara Big Brother's Big Mouth, spin-off dari seri realitas televisi Big Brother yang disiarkan di E4.

name: Russell Crowe
title: Russell Crowe
extract: Russell Ira Crowe is a New Zealand–born actor and film director. His work on screen has earned him various accolades, including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award and two Golden Globes.
extract_id: Russell Ira Crowe adalah aktor dan sutradara film kelahiran Selandia Baru. Karyanya di layar telah memberinya berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan dua Golden Globes.

name: Rusty Schwimmer
title: Rusty Schwimmer
extract: Rusty Schwimmer is an American character actress and singer. She has appeared in films such as A Little Princess (1995), Twister (1996), The Perfect Storm (2000), Runaway Jury (2003), North Country (2005), The Informant! (2009), and The Sessions (2012).
extract_id: Rusty Schwimmer adalah aktris karakter dan penyanyi Amerika. Dia telah tampil dalam film-film seperti A Little Princess (1995), Twister (1996), The Perfect Storm (2000), Runaway Jury (2003), North Country (2005), The Informant! (2009), dan The Sessions (2012).

name: Rutger Hauer
title: Rutger Hauer
extract: Rutger Oelsen Hauer was a Dutch actor, with a career that spanned over 170 roles across nearly 50 years, beginning in 1969. In 1999, he was named by the Dutch public as the Best Dutch Actor of the Century.
extract_id: Rutger Oelsen Hauer adalah aktor Belanda, dengan karir yang mencakup lebih dari 170 peran selama hampir 50 tahun, dimulai pada tahun 1969. Pada tahun 1999, dia dinobatkan oleh publik Belanda sebagai Aktor Belanda Terbaik Abad Ini.

name: Ruth Gordon
title: Ruth Gordon
extract: Ruth Gordon Jones was an American actress, playwright, screenwriter and novelist, widely known for a career that spanned seven decades, beginning by performing on Broadway at age 19. Known for her nasal voice and distinctive personality, Gordon gained international recognition and critical acclaim for film roles that continued into her 70s and 80s. Her later work included performances in Rosemary's Baby (1968), What Ever Happened to Aunt Alice? (1969), Where's Poppa? (1970), Harold and Maude (1971), Every Which Way but Loose (1978), Any Which Way You Can (1980), and My Bodyguard (1980).
