extract_id: Ruth Gordon Jones adalah seorang aktris, dramawan, penulis skenario, dan novelis Amerika yang dikenal luas melalui karir yang berlangsung selama tujuh dekade, dimulai dengan tampil di Broadway pada usia 19 tahun. Dikenal dengan suara hidung dan kepribadiannya yang khas, Gordon mendapat pengakuan internasional dan pujian kritis untuk peran filmnya yang berlanjut hingga usia 70-an dan 80-an. Karyanya di kemudian hari termasuk penampilan dalam Rosemary's Baby (1968), What Ever Happened to Aunt Alice? (1969), Where's Poppa? (1970), Harold and Maude (1971), Every Which Way but Loose (1978), Any Which Way You Can (1980), dan My Bodyguard (1980).

name: Ruth Hussey
title: Ruth Hussey
extract: Ruth Carol Hussey was an American actress best known for her Academy Award-nominated role as photographer Elizabeth Imbrie in The Philadelphia Story.
extract_id: Ruth Carol Hussey adalah seorang aktris Amerika yang paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai fotografer Elizabeth Imbrie dalam The Philadelphia Story yang mendapatkan nominasi Academy Award.

name: Ruth Nelson
title: Ruth Nelson (actress)
extract: Ruth Gloria Nelson was an American stage and film actress. She is known for her roles in films such as Wilson, A Tree Grows in Brooklyn, Humoresque, 3 Women, The Late Show and Awakenings. She was the fourth wife of John Cromwell, with whom she acted on multiple occasions.
extract_id: Ruth Gloria Nelson adalah seorang aktris panggung dan film Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya dalam film-film seperti Wilson, A Tree Grows in Brooklyn, Humoresque, 3 Women, The Late Show, dan Awakenings. Dia adalah istri keempat dari John Cromwell, yang juga sering diajak berakting bersama.

name: Ruth Roman
title: Ruth Roman
extract: Ruth Roman was an American actress of film, stage, and television.
extract_id: Ruth Roman adalah aktris Amerika yang berkiprah di film, panggung, dan televisi.

name: Ruy Guerra
title: Ruy Guerra
extract: Ruy Alexandre Guerra Coelho Pereira is a Portuguese-Brazilian film director and screenwriter. Guerra was born a Portuguese citizen in Lourenço Marques in Mozambique, when it was still a Portuguese colony.
extract_id: Ruy Alexandre Guerra Coelho Pereira adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario Portugal-Brasil. Guerra lahir sebagai warga negara Portugal di Lourenço Marques di Mozambik, ketika masih merupakan koloni Portugal.

name: Ryan Coogler
title: Ryan Coogler
extract: Ryan Kyle Coogler is an American filmmaker. His accolades include an Academy Award, a British Academy Film Award, a Grammy Award, a Golden Globe Award, ten Black Reel Awards, and fourteen NAACP Image Awards.
extract_id: Ryan Kyle Coogler adalah pembuat film Amerika. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk Academy Award, British Academy Film Award, Grammy Award, Golden Globe Award, sepuluh Black Reel Awards, dan empat belas NAACP Image Awards.

name: Ryan Gosling
title: Ryan Gosling
extract: Ryan Thomas Gosling is a Canadian actor, singer, and musician. Known for his work in both independent films and major studio features, his films as a leading actor have grossed over US$4 billion worldwide. He has received various accolades including a Golden Globe Award, in addition to nominations for three Academy Awards, nine Critics' Choice Awards, two British Academy Film Awards and a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Ryan Thomas Gosling adalah aktor, penyanyi, dan musisi Kanada. Dikenal karena karyanya dalam film independen dan fitur studio besar, filmnya sebagai pemeran utama telah menghasilkan pendapatan lebih dari US$4 miliar di seluruh dunia. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Golden Globe Award, serta nominasi untuk tiga Academy Awards, sembilan Critics' Choice Awards, dua British Academy Film Awards, dan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Ryan Hurst
title: Ryan Hurst
extract: Ryan Douglas Hurst is an American actor. He is best known for his roles as Gerry Bertier in Remember the Titans (2000) and Opie Winston in the FX drama series Sons of Anarchy (2008–2012). He provided the voice for the Norse god Thor in the 2022 video game God of War Ragnarök, for which he received a BAFTA Award nomination. He also portrayed "Lil Foster" Farrell in the Outsiders (2016–2017) and Beta in the AMC horror drama series The Walking Dead (2019–2020).
extract_id: Ryan Douglas Hurst adalah aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Gerry Bertier dalam Remember the Titans (2000) dan Opie Winston dalam serial drama FX Sons of Anarchy (2008–2012). Dia memberikan suara untuk dewa Norse Thor dalam permainan video God of War Ragnarök tahun 2022, yang membuatnya menerima nominasi BAFTA Award. Dia juga memerankan "Lil Foster" Farrell dalam Outsiders (2016–2017) dan Beta dalam serial drama horor AMC The Walking Dead (2019–2020).

name: Ryan O'Neal
title: Ryan O'Neal
extract: Charles Patrick Ryan O'Neal was an American actor. Born in Los Angeles, he trained as an amateur boxer before beginning a career in acting in 1960.
extract_id: Charles Patrick Ryan O'Neal adalah aktor Amerika. Lahir di Los Angeles, dia berlatih sebagai petinju amatir sebelum memulai karir di dunia akting pada tahun 1960.

name: Ryan Potter
title: Ryan Potter
extract: Ryan Potter is an American actor and martial artist. He made his acting debut as the lead of the Nickelodeon action comedy series Supah Ninjas (2011–2013). As a voice actor, he voiced Hiro Hamada in the animated superhero film Big Hero 6 (2014), its television series sequel (2017–2021) and the Disney+ series Baymax! (2022). Potter also portrayed Gar Logan / Beast Boy on the DC Universe / HBO Max superhero series Titans (2018–2023).
extract_id: Ryan Potter adalah aktor dan seniman bela diri Amerika. Dia memulai debut aktingnya sebagai pemeran utama dalam serial aksi komedi Nickelodeon Supah Ninjas (2011–2013). Sebagai pengisi suara, dia mengisi suara Hiro Hamada dalam film animasi superhero Big Hero 6 (2014), sekuel serial televisinya (2017–2021), dan serial Disney+ Baymax! (2022). Potter juga memerankan Gar Logan / Beast Boy dalam serial superhero DC Universe / HBO Max Titans (2018–2023).

name: Ryan Reynolds
title: Ryan Reynolds
extract: Ryan Rodney Reynolds is a Canadian and American actor and film producer. Frequently starring in comedic and superhero films, he was the world's second-highest-paid actor in 2020 and 2024. Reynolds has received numerous accolades, including two Primetime Emmy Awards and nominations for two Grammy Awards and a Golden Globe Award. His films as a leading actor have grossed $6.6 billion worldwide.
extract_id: Ryan Rodney Reynolds adalah aktor dan produser film Kanada dan Amerika. Sering tampil dalam film komedi dan superhero, dia adalah aktor dengan bayaran tertinggi kedua di dunia pada tahun 2020 dan 2024. Reynolds telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua Primetime Emmy Awards dan nominasi untuk dua Grammy Awards serta Golden Globe Award. Film-filmnya sebagai pemeran utama telah menghasilkan pendapatan $6,6 miliar di seluruh dunia.

name: Ryô Kase
title: Ryo Kase
extract: Ryo Kase is a Japanese actor.
extract_id: Ryo Kase adalah aktor Jepang.

name: Ryô Narita
title: Ryo Narita
extract: Ryo Narita is a Japanese actor and model. He is represented by Sony Music Artists. Narita started his career as a model for the magazine Men's Non-no. He made his acting debut in the film Flashback.
extract_id: Ryo Narita adalah aktor dan model Jepang. Dia diwakili oleh Sony Music Artists. Narita memulai kariernya sebagai model untuk majalah Men's Non-no. Dia membuat debut aktingnya dalam film Flashback.

name: Ryôko Hirosue
title: Ryōko Hirosue
extract: Ryōko Hirosue is a Japanese actress and singer, best known to international audiences for her roles in the Luc Besson-produced Wasabi (2001) and the Academy Award-winning Japanese film Departures (2008). She also starred in the 2008 comedy series Yasuko to Kenji.
extract_id: Ryōko Hirosue adalah aktris dan penyanyi Jepang, yang dikenal oleh penonton internasional untuk perannya dalam film yang diproduksi Luc Besson Wasabi (2001) dan film Jepang pemenang Academy Award Departures (2008). Dia juga membintangi serial komedi 2008 Yasuko to Kenji.

name: Ryûnosuke Kamiki
title: Ryunosuke Kamiki
extract: Ryunosuke Kamiki is a Japanese actor. Starting his career as a child prodigy, he has garnered critical acclaim and numerous awards for his performances across 25 years in the industry.
extract_id: Ryunosuke Kamiki adalah aktor Jepang. Memulai kariernya sebagai anak jenius, dia telah mendapatkan pujian kritis dan berbagai penghargaan atas penampilannya selama 25 tahun di industri ini.

name: S.S. Rajamouli
title: S. S. Rajamouli
extract: Koduri Srisaila Sri Rajamouli, is an Indian film director and screenwriter who works in Telugu cinema. Known for his epic, action drama, and fantasy genre films, he is one of the most prolific and the highest-paid directors in Indian cinema. Rajamouli is a recipient of various national and international honours including a New York Film Critics Circle award, a Critics' Choice Movie Award, two Saturn Awards, four National Film Awards, five Nandi Awards, and five Filmfare Awards. In 2016, the Government of India honoured him with the Padma Shri, for his contributions in the field of art. In 2023, he was included on the Time's list of the 100 most influential people in the world. In 2026, his name was permanently added to the Mur des Cinéastes at the prestigious Institut Lumière in Lyon, France, known as the birthplace of cinema.
extract_id: Koduri Srisaila Sri Rajamouli adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film India yang bekerja di sinema Telugu. Dikenal dengan film-film bergenre epik, drama aksi, dan fantasi, dia adalah salah satu sutradara paling produktif dan dengan bayaran tertinggi di sinema India. Rajamouli menerima berbagai penghargaan nasional dan internasional termasuk penghargaan New York Film Critics Circle, Critics' Choice Movie Award, dua Saturn Awards, empat National Film Awards, lima Nandi Awards, dan lima Filmfare Awards. Pada 2016, Pemerintah India menganugerahi dia Padma Shri atas kontribusinya di bidang seni. Pada 2023, dia masuk dalam daftar Time sebagai 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia. Pada 2026, namanya ditambahkan secara permanen ke Mur des Cinéastes di Institut Lumière yang prestisius di Lyon, Prancis, yang dikenal sebagai tempat kelahiran sinema.

name: Sabrina Ferilli
title: Sabrina Ferilli
extract: Sabrina Ferilli is an Italian theatre and film actress. She has won five Nastro d'Argento, a Globo d'oro, six Ciak d'oro and received four David di Donatello nominations. In 2013, she was a protagonist of the Oscar-winning film The Great Beauty directed by Paolo Sorrentino.
extract_id: Sabrina Ferilli adalah aktris teater dan film Italia. Dia telah memenangkan lima Nastro d'Argento, satu Globo d'oro, enam Ciak d'oro dan menerima empat nominasi David di Donatello. Pada 2013, dia menjadi pemeran utama dalam film pemenang Oscar The Great Beauty yang disutradarai oleh Paolo Sorrentino.

name: Sacha Baron Cohen
title: Sacha Baron Cohen
extract: Sacha Noam Baron Cohen is an English actor, filmmaker, comedian and advocate. Known for his creation and portrayal of the fictional satirical characters Ali G, Borat Sagdiyev, Brüno Gehard, and Admiral General Haffaz Aladeen, he has received various accolades, including two British Academy Television Awards and three Golden Globes, as well as nominations for three Academy Awards and six Primetime Emmy Awards. For his character work, Baron Cohen has been described as a performance artist.
extract_id: Sacha Noam Baron Cohen adalah aktor, pembuat film, komedian, dan advokat asal Inggris. Dikenal atas penciptaan dan pemeranannya tokoh-tokoh satir fiktif Ali G, Borat Sagdiyev, Brüno Gehard, dan Admiral General Haffaz Aladeen, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk dua British Academy Television Awards dan tiga Golden Globes, serta nominasi untuk tiga Academy Awards dan enam Primetime Emmy Awards. Untuk karya karakternya, Baron Cohen telah digambarkan sebagai seniman pertunjukan.

name: Sady Rebbot
title: Sady Rebbot
extract: Sady Rebbot was a French actor. He appeared in 68 films and television shows between 1959 and 1994. He starred with Anna Karina in the 1962 film Vivre sa vie. and the following year he starred in Chi lavora è perduto, the directorial debut of Tinto Brass.
extract_id: Sady Rebbot adalah aktor Prancis. Dia tampil di 68 film dan acara televisi antara 1959 dan 1994. Dia berperan bersama Anna Karina dalam film 1962 Vivre sa vie. dan tahun berikutnya dia membintangi Chi lavora è perduto, debut penyutradaraan Tinto Brass.

name: Sae-ron Kim
title: Kim Sae-ron
extract: Kim Sae-ron was a South Korean actress. Kim began her career in 2001 as a child model and transitioned to acting in 2009 with the film A Brand New Life (2009). She gained recognition through The Man from Nowhere (2010), earning herself a Baeksang Arts Awards for Best New Actress nomination. She later starred in the television series Listen to My Heart (2011), The Queen's Classroom (2013), and Hi! School: Love On (2014), along with the film A Girl at My Door (2014). Her first adult lead role was in the series Secret Healer (2016).
extract_id: Kim Sae-ron adalah aktris Korea Selatan. Kim memulai kariernya pada 2001 sebagai model anak-anak dan beralih ke akting pada 2009 dengan film A Brand New Life (2009). Dia mendapatkan pengakuan melalui The Man from Nowhere (2010), meraih nominasi Baeksang Arts Awards untuk Aktris Pendatang Baru Terbaik. Dia kemudian membintangi serial televisi Listen to My Heart (2011), The Queen's Classroom (2013), dan Hi! School: Love On (2014), serta film A Girl at My Door (2014). Peran utama dewasanya yang pertama ada di serial Secret Healer (2016).

name: Saeed Jaffrey
title: Saeed Jaffrey
extract: Saeed Jaffrey was a British-Indian actor. His career covered film, radio, stage and television roles over six decades and more than 150 British, American, and Indian movies. During the 1980s and 1990s, he was considered to be Britain's highest-profile Asian actor, thanks to his leading roles in the film My Beautiful Laundrette (1985) and television series The Jewel in the Crown (1984), Tandoori Nights (1985–1987) and Little Napoleons (1994). He played an instrumental part in bringing together filmmakers James Ivory and Ismail Merchant, and acted in several of their Merchant Ivory Productions films such as The Guru (1969), Hullabaloo Over Georgie and Bonnie's Pictures (1978), The Courtesans of Bombay (1983) and The Deceivers (1988).
extract_id: Saeed Jaffrey adalah aktor Inggris-India. Kariernya meliputi peran film, radio, panggung, dan televisi selama enam dekade dan lebih dari 150 film Inggris, Amerika, dan India. Pada 1980-an dan 1990-an, ia dianggap sebagai aktor Asia paling terkenal di Inggris, berkat peran utama dalam film My Beautiful Laundrette (1985) dan serial televisi The Jewel in the Crown (1984), Tandoori Nights (1985–1987) dan Little Napoleons (1994). Dia memainkan peran penting dalam mempertemukan pembuat film James Ivory dan Ismail Merchant, dan berakting dalam beberapa film Merchant Ivory Productions seperti The Guru (1969), Hullabaloo Over Georgie and Bonnie's Pictures (1978), The Courtesans of Bombay (1983) dan The Deceivers (1988).

name: Safak Sezer
title: Şafak Sezer
extract: Erol Şafak Sezer is a Turkish actor who usually appears in comedic roles.
extract_id: Erol Şafak Sezer adalah aktor Turki yang biasanya muncul dalam peran komedi.

name: Sagarika Ghatge
title: Sagarika Ghatge
extract: Sagarika Ghatge is an Indian actress and model who primarily works in Hindi films. She is known for her role of Preeti Sabharwal in Chak De! India. In 2015, she participated in Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 6 and emerged as a finalist. Ghatge is a national-level field hockey player.
extract_id: Sagarika Ghatge adalah aktris dan model India yang terutama bekerja di film Hindi. Dia dikenal untuk perannya sebagai Preeti Sabharwal dalam Chak De! India. Pada 2015, dia berpartisipasi dalam Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 6 dan berhasil menjadi finalis. Ghatge adalah pemain hoki lapangan tingkat nasional.

name: Sahil Vaid
title: Sahil Vaid
extract: Sahil Satish Vaid is an Indian actor who is known for his roles in Bittoo Boss (2012), Humpty Sharma Ki Dulhania (2014), Bank Chor (2017), Badrinath Ki Dulhania (2017), Dil Bechara (2020) and Coolie No. 1 (2020) and the remake of the 2005 Telugu film Chatrapathi (2023).
extract_id: Sahil Satish Vaid adalah aktor India yang dikenal untuk perannya dalam Bittoo Boss (2012), Humpty Sharma Ki Dulhania (2014), Bank Chor (2017), Badrinath Ki Dulhania (2017), Dil Bechara (2020) dan Coolie No. 1 (2020) serta remake film Telugu 2005 Chatrapathi (2023).

name: Saif Ali Khan
title: Saif Ali Khan
extract: Saif Ali Mansur Ali Khan Pataudi is an Indian actor and film producer who primarily works in Hindi films. The titular head of the Pataudi family since 2011, he is the son of actress Sharmila Tagore and cricketer Mansoor Ali Khan Pataudi. Khan has won several awards, including a National Film Award and seven Filmfare Awards, and received the Padma Shri, the fourth highest Indian civilian award in 2010.
extract_id: Saif Ali Mansur Ali Khan Pataudi adalah aktor dan produser film India yang terutama bekerja di film Hindi. Kepala keluarga Pataudi sejak 2011, dia adalah putra aktris Sharmila Tagore dan pemain kriket Mansoor Ali Khan Pataudi. Khan telah memenangkan beberapa penghargaan, termasuk National Film Award dan tujuh Filmfare Awards, serta menerima Padma Shri, penghargaan sipil tertinggi keempat di India pada 2010.

name: Sakshi Tanwar
title: Sakshi Tanwar
extract: Sakshi Tanwar is an Indian actress and presenter, who primarily works in Hindi films and television. Known for her portrayals of strong-willed, unconventional women in Indian television, Tanwar is considered among the highest-paid television actresses in India. She is a recipient of several awards including two ITA Awards and one Filmfare OTT Award. She has appeared in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list of 2012.
extract_id: Sakshi Tanwar adalah aktris dan presenter India yang terutama bekerja di film dan televisi Hindi. Dikenal dengan perannya sebagai wanita berkemauan kuat dan tidak konvensional dalam televisi India, Tanwar dianggap sebagai salah satu aktris televisi dengan bayaran tertinggi di India. Dia menerima beberapa penghargaan termasuk dua ITA Awards dan satu Filmfare OTT Award. Dia pernah masuk dalam daftar Forbes India Celebrity 100 tahun 2012.

name: Sakura Andô
title: Sakura Ando
extract: Sakura Ando is a Japanese actress. She is best known for appearing in critically-acclaimed films such as Sion Sono's Love Exposure, Hirokazu Koreeda's Shoplifters (2018) and Monster (2023), as well as Takashi Yamazaki's Academy Award–winning kaiju epic Godzilla Minus One (2023).
extract_id: Sakura Ando adalah aktris Jepang. Dia paling dikenal karena tampil dalam film-film yang mendapat pujian kritis seperti Love Exposure karya Sion Sono, Shoplifters (2018) dan Monster (2023) karya Hirokazu Koreeda, serta epik kaiju pemenang Academy Award Godzilla Minus One (2023) karya Takashi Yamazaki.

name: Sal Mineo
title: Sal Mineo
extract: Salvatore Mineo Jr. was an American actor. He was best known for his role as John "Plato" Crawford in the coming-of-age drama film Rebel Without a Cause (1955), which earned him a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor at age 17, making him the fifth-youngest nominee in the category.
extract_id: Salvatore Mineo Jr. adalah aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal untuk perannya sebagai John "Plato" Crawford dalam film drama coming-of-age Rebel Without a Cause (1955), yang membuatnya mendapatkan nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik pada usia 17 tahun, menjadikannya nominasi termuda kelima dalam kategori tersebut.

name: Salim Kechiouche
title: Salim Kechiouche
extract: Salim Kechiouche is a French actor.
extract_id: Salim Kechiouche adalah aktor Prancis.

name: Sally Field
title: Sally Field
extract: Sally Margaret Field is an American actress. Known for her roles on screen and stage, she has received various accolades including two Academy Awards, two Golden Globe Awards, and four Primetime Emmy Awards, as well as nominations for two British Academy Film Awards and a Tony Award. She was honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 2014, the National Medal of Arts in 2014, the Kennedy Center Honor in 2019, and the Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award in 2023.
extract_id: Sally Margaret Field adalah aktris Amerika. Dikenal atas perannya di layar dan panggung, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk dua Academy Awards, dua Golden Globe Awards, dan empat Primetime Emmy Awards, serta nominasi untuk dua British Academy Film Awards dan Tony Award. Dia dianugerahi bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada 2014, National Medal of Arts pada 2014, Kennedy Center Honor pada 2019, dan Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award pada 2023.

name: Sally Hawkins
title: Sally Hawkins
extract: Sally Cecilia Hawkins is an English actress of stage and screen. She began her career on stage and then moved into film, for which she has received several accolades.
extract_id: Sally Cecilia Hawkins adalah aktris Inggris panggung dan layar. Dia memulai kariernya di panggung kemudian beralih ke film, di mana dia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan.

name: Sally Yeh
title: Sally Yeh
description: Hong Kong and Canadian singer and actress
extract: Sally Yeh, sometimes credited as Sally Yip or Yip Sin-man, is a former singer and actress. She has been described as a cultural icon and a voice of unparalleled grace in Hong Kong during the 1980s and 1990s, when Cantopop music reigned supreme across the region and the city's cinema captivated the world.
extract_id: Sally Yeh, kadang-kadang dikreditkan sebagai Sally Yip atau Yip Sin-man, adalah mantan penyanyi dan aktris. Dia telah digambarkan sebagai ikon budaya dan suara dengan keanggunan tiada tara di Hong Kong selama 1980-an dan 1990-an, ketika musik Cantopop mendominasi wilayah tersebut dan sinema kota itu memukau dunia.

name: Salman Khan
title: Salman Khan
extract: Salman Khan is an Indian actor, film producer, and television personality who works primarily in Hindi cinema. In a career spanning over three decades, his awards include two National Film Awards as a film producer, and two Filmfare Awards as an actor. He has acted in over 80 films. He has been cited as one of the most popular and commercially successful actors of Indian cinema, and was included in Forbes lists of the world's highest-paid celebrities in 2015 and 2018. Khan has a large following in India and among the Indian diaspora worldwide. His popularity has been particularly associated with commercially successful Hindi-language films, with his work spanning genres including action, comedy, romance and drama.
extract_id: Salman Khan adalah aktor, produser film, dan kepribadian televisi India yang terutama bekerja di sinema Hindi. Dalam karier lebih dari tiga dekade, penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk dua National Film Awards sebagai produser film, dan dua Filmfare Awards sebagai aktor. Dia telah berakting dalam lebih dari 80 film. Dia disebut sebagai salah satu aktor paling populer dan sukses secara komersial di sinema India, dan termasuk dalam daftar Forbes selebritas dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia pada 2015 dan 2018. Khan memiliki pengikut besar di India dan diaspora India di seluruh dunia. Popularitasnya khususnya terkait dengan film bahasa Hindi yang komersial sukses, dengan karya yang mencakup genre aksi, komedi, romansa, dan drama.

name: Sam Elliott
title: Sam Elliott
extract: Samuel Pack Elliott is an American actor. With a career spanning nearly six decades of film and television, he is recognized for his deep sonorous voice. Elliott has received various accolades, including a Screen Actors Guild Award and a National Board of Review Award, in addition to nominations for an Academy Award, two Primetime Emmy Awards and two Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Samuel Pack Elliott adalah aktor Amerika. Dengan karier yang hampir mencakup enam dekade di film dan televisi, dia dikenal karena suaranya yang dalam dan merdu. Elliott telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Screen Actors Guild Award dan National Board of Review Award, serta nominasi Academy Award, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan dua Golden Globe Awards.

name: Sam Jaffe
title: Sam Jaffe
extract: Shalom "Sam" Jaffe was an American actor and teacher, known for his portrayals of intelligent but eccentric characters. He achieved prominence in Hollywood for his portrayal of the titular character in the adventure film Gunga Din (1939). He was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor and won the Volpi Cup for Best Actor for his performance in the classic film noir The Asphalt Jungle (1950).
extract_id: Shalom "Sam" Jaffe adalah aktor dan guru Amerika, dikenal karena memerankan karakter cerdas tapi eksentrik. Dia mencapai ketenaran di Hollywood atas perannya sebagai karakter utama dalam film petualangan Gunga Din (1939). Dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dan memenangkan Volpi Cup sebagai Aktor Terbaik untuk penampilannya dalam film noir klasik The Asphalt Jungle (1950).

name: Sam Mendes
title: Sam Mendes
extract: Sir Samuel Alexander Mendes is an English filmmaker and stage director. In 2000, Mendes was appointed a CBE for his services to drama, and he was knighted in the 2020 New Years Honours List. In 2000, Mendes was awarded the Shakespeare Prize by the Alfred Toepfer Foundation in Hamburg, Germany. In 2005, he received a lifetime achievement award from the Directors Guild of Great Britain. In 2008, The Daily Telegraph ranked him number 15 in their list of the "100 most powerful people in British culture".
extract_id: Sir Samuel Alexander Mendes adalah pembuat film dan sutradara panggung Inggris. Pada 2000, Mendes diangkat sebagai CBE atas jasanya di bidang drama, dan dia mendapat gelar kebangsawanan dalam Daftar Penghargaan Tahun Baru 2020. Pada 2000, Mendes menerima Shakespeare Prize dari Alfred Toepfer Foundation di Hamburg, Jerman. Pada 2005, dia menerima penghargaan prestasi seumur hidup dari Directors Guild of Great Britain. Pada 2008, The Daily Telegraph menempatkannya di peringkat ke-15 dalam daftar "100 orang paling berpengaruh dalam budaya Inggris".

name: Sam Neill
title: Sam Neill
extract: Sir Nigel John Dermot "Sam" Neill was a New Zealand actor. Known as a leading man in film and television, he received nominations for three Primetime Emmy Awards and three Golden Globe Awards. He was appointed an Officer of the Order of the British Empire in the 1991 Queen's Birthday Honours for services as an actor.
extract_id: Sir Nigel John Dermot "Sam" Neill adalah seorang aktor asal Selandia Baru. Dikenal sebagai pemeran utama dalam film dan televisi, ia menerima nominasi untuk tiga Primetime Emmy Awards dan tiga Golden Globe Awards. Ia diangkat sebagai Officer of the Order of the British Empire dalam Queen's Birthday Honours 1991 atas jasanya sebagai aktor.

name: Sam Peckinpah
title: Sam Peckinpah
extract: David Samuel Peckinpah was an American filmmaker and actor. He was known for his revisionist approach to the Western genre, employing a visually innovative and explicit depiction of action and violence. His 1969 film The Wild Bunch received two Academy Award nominations and was ranked No. 80 on the American Film Institute's Top 100 list.
extract_id: David Samuel Peckinpah adalah pembuat film dan aktor asal Amerika. Ia dikenal karena pendekatannya yang revisionis terhadap genre Western, menggunakan penggambaran aksi dan kekerasan yang inovatif secara visual dan eksplisit. Filmnya tahun 1969, The Wild Bunch, menerima dua nominasi Academy Award dan ditempatkan di nomor 80 dalam daftar Top 100 American Film Institute.

name: Sam Raimi
title: Sam Raimi
extract: Samuel M. Raimi is an American filmmaker. He is best known for writing and directing the Evil Dead trilogy (1981–1993) and directing the Spider-Man trilogy (2002–2007). He also directed Darkman (1990), The Quick and the Dead (1995), A Simple Plan (1998), The Gift (2000), Drag Me to Hell (2009), Oz the Great and Powerful (2013), Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022) and Send Help (2026).
extract_id: Samuel M. Raimi adalah pembuat film asal Amerika. Ia paling dikenal sebagai penulis dan sutradara trilogi Evil Dead (1981–1993) dan sutradara trilogi Spider-Man (2002–2007). Ia juga menyutradarai Darkman (1990), The Quick and the Dead (1995), A Simple Plan (1998), The Gift (2000), Drag Me to Hell (2009), Oz the Great and Powerful (2013), Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022) dan Send Help (2026).

name: Sam Riley
title: Sam Riley
extract: Samuel Peter W. Riley is an English actor and singer. He is best known for his performance in the 2007 biographical film Control about the life of Ian Curtis, as protagonist Sal Paradise in the 2012 adaptation of the Jack Kerouac novel On the Road, and as Diaval in the 2014 film Maleficent. Riley received renown for his portrayal of Fitzwilliam Darcy in the 2016 film Pride and Prejudice and Zombies.
extract_id: Samuel Peter W. Riley adalah aktor dan penyanyi asal Inggris. Ia paling dikenal karena perannya dalam film biografi tahun 2007 Control tentang kehidupan Ian Curtis, sebagai protagonis Sal Paradise dalam adaptasi novel On the Road karya Jack Kerouac tahun 2012, dan sebagai Diaval dalam film Maleficent tahun 2014. Riley mendapatkan ketenaran berkat perannya sebagai Fitzwilliam Darcy dalam film Pride and Prejudice and Zombies tahun 2016.

name: Sam Rockwell
title: Sam Rockwell
extract: Samuel Rockwell is an American actor. In a career spanning over three decades of stage and screen, he is known for his offbeat and charismatic character roles in independent films, and has received various accolades including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a Silver Bear, in addition to nominations for three Primetime Emmy Awards and a Tony Award.
extract_id: Samuel Rockwell adalah aktor asal Amerika. Dalam kariernya yang berlangsung lebih dari tiga dekade di panggung dan layar, ia dikenal karena peran karakter yang unik dan karismatik dalam film independen, dan telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Silver Bear, selain nominasi untuk tiga Primetime Emmy Awards dan Tony Award.

name: Sam Shepard
title: Sam Shepard
extract: Samuel Shepard Rogers III was an American playwright, actor, director, screenwriter, author and musician whose career spanned half a century. He wrote 58 plays and several books of short stories, essays, and memoirs. His accolades include the Pulitzer Prize for Drama, the Drama Desk Award, the PEN/Laura Pels Theater Award, and a record 10 Obie Awards, in addition to nominations for two Tony Awards, an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, a Laurence Olivier Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award. He was inducted into the American Theater Hall of Fame in 1994. The New York magazine described Shepard as "the greatest American playwright of his generation."
extract_id: Samuel Shepard Rogers III adalah seorang penulis drama, aktor, sutradara, penulis skenario, penulis, dan musisi asal Amerika yang kariernya berlangsung setengah abad. Ia menulis 58 drama dan beberapa buku cerita pendek, esai, dan memoar. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk Pulitzer Prize for Drama, Drama Desk Award, PEN/Laura Pels Theater Award, dan rekor 10 Obie Awards, selain nominasi untuk dua Tony Awards, Academy Award, BAFTA Award, Golden Globe Award, Laurence Olivier Award, dan Primetime Emmy Award. Ia dimasukkan ke dalam American Theater Hall of Fame pada 1994. Majalah New York menggambarkan Shepard sebagai "penulis drama Amerika terbesar dari generasinya."

name: Sam Waterston
title: Sam Waterston
extract: Samuel Atkinson Waterston is an American actor. Waterston is known for his work in theater, television, and film. He has received numerous accolades including a Primetime Emmy Award, Golden Globe Award, and Screen Actors Guild Award as well as nominations for an Academy Award, a Tony Award, and two BAFTA Awards. His acting career has spanned over five decades acting on stage and screen. Waterston received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 2010 and was inducted into the American Theater Hall of Fame in 2012.
extract_id: Samuel Atkinson Waterston adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Waterston dikenal karena karyanya di teater, televisi, dan film. Ia telah menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk Primetime Emmy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Screen Actors Guild Award serta nominasi untuk Academy Award, Tony Award, dan dua BAFTA Awards. Karier aktingnya telah berlangsung lebih dari lima dekade dengan bermain di panggung dan layar. Waterston menerima bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada 2010 dan dimasukkan ke dalam American Theater Hall of Fame pada 2012.

name: Sam Wood
title: Sam Wood
extract: Samuel Grosvenor Wood was an American film director and producer who is best known for having directed such Hollywood hits as A Night at the Opera, A Day at the Races, Goodbye, Mr. Chips, The Pride of the Yankees, and For Whom the Bell Tolls and for his uncredited work directing parts of Gone with the Wind. He was also involved in a few acting and writing projects.
extract_id: Samuel Grosvenor Wood adalah sutradara dan produser film Amerika yang paling dikenal karena menyutradarai sejumlah film hits Hollywood seperti A Night at the Opera, A Day at the Races, Goodbye, Mr. Chips, The Pride of the Yankees, dan For Whom the Bell Tolls serta untuk karyanya yang tak tercatat menyutradarai bagian dari Gone with the Wind. Ia juga terlibat dalam beberapa proyek akting dan penulisan.

name: Sam Worthington
title: Sam Worthington
extract: Samuel Henry John Worthington is an Australian actor who has worked in both independent Australian cinema and Hollywood. He rose to prominence in Australia with performances in the films Bootmen (2000) and Somersault (2004), receiving Australia Film Institute Award for Best Actor in a Leading Role nominations for both films and winning the latter, and gained further recognition through his role in the TV series Love My Way. Worthington achieved international fame as protagonist Jake Sully in James Cameron’s Avatar (2009), the highest-grossing film of all time, and received a second AFI award for the film; he reprised his role in its sequels.
extract_id: Samuel Henry John Worthington adalah aktor Australia yang telah bekerja di sinema independen Australia dan Hollywood. Ia meraih ketenaran di Australia dengan penampilan dalam film Bootmen (2000) dan Somersault (2004), menerima nominasi Penghargaan Australia Film Institute untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Peran Utama untuk kedua film tersebut dan memenangkan yang terakhir, serta mendapatkan pengakuan lebih lanjut melalui perannya dalam serial TV Love My Way. Worthington meraih ketenaran internasional sebagai protagonis Jake Sully dalam film Avatar (2009) karya James Cameron, film dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa, dan menerima penghargaan AFI kedua untuk film tersebut; ia mengulang perannya dalam sekuel-sekuelnya.

name: Samantha Isler
title: Samantha Isler
extract: Samantha Isler is an American actress. She starred as Ellie in the NBC sitcom Sean Saves the World. Isler started her career in 2009, where she took part in NBC's Today as a kid reporter. She then played the role of teenage Amara/The Darkness on The CW series Supernatural.
extract_id: Samantha Isler adalah aktris Amerika. Ia berperan sebagai Ellie dalam sitkom NBC Sean Saves the World. Isler memulai kariernya pada 2009, di mana ia tampil di NBC's Today sebagai reporter anak-anak. Ia kemudian memerankan remaja Amara/The Darkness dalam serial The CW Supernatural.

name: Samantha Morton
title: Samantha Morton
extract: Samantha Jane Morton is an English actress and musician. Known for her work in independent films, particularly period dramas with dark and tragic themes, she has received various accolades including a British Academy Television Award and a Golden Globe Award, with nominations for two Academy Awards, a British Academy Film Award and a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Samantha Jane Morton adalah aktris dan musisi Inggris. Dikenal karena karyanya dalam film independen, terutama drama periode dengan tema gelap dan tragis, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk British Academy Television Award dan Golden Globe Award, dengan nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards, British Academy Film Award, dan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Samuel E. Wright
title: Samuel E. Wright
extract: Samuel Ernest Wright was an American actor. He was best known as the voice of Sebastian in Disney's The Little Mermaid, for which he provided the lead vocals to "Under the Sea", which won the Academy Award for Best Original Song. He played Dizzy Gillespie in Bird, the biographical film about Charlie Parker. Wright also played the part of Mufasa in the original cast of The Lion King on Broadway and voiced Kron the Iguanodon in the 2000 CGI film Dinosaur.
extract_id: Samuel Ernest Wright adalah aktor Amerika. Ia paling dikenal sebagai suara Sebastian dalam film Disney The Little Mermaid, di mana ia menjadi vokalis utama lagu "Under the Sea" yang memenangkan Academy Award untuk Lagu Orisinal Terbaik. Ia memerankan Dizzy Gillespie dalam Bird, film biografi tentang Charlie Parker. Wright juga memerankan Mufasa dalam pemeran asli The Lion King di Broadway dan mengisi suara Kron sang Iguanodon dalam film CGI tahun 2000 Dinosaur.

name: Samuel L. Jackson
title: Samuel L. Jackson
extract: Samuel Leroy Jackson is an American actor and film producer. He is one of the most widely recognized actors of his generation. The films in which he has appeared have collectively grossed more than $27 billion worldwide, making him the highest-grossing actor of all time. In 2022, he received the Academy Honorary Award as "a cultural icon whose dynamic work has resonated across genres and generations and audiences worldwide".
extract_id: Samuel Leroy Jackson adalah aktor dan produser film Amerika. Ia adalah salah satu aktor yang paling dikenal dari generasinya. Film-film yang dibintanginya secara kolektif menghasilkan lebih dari $27 miliar di seluruh dunia, menjadikannya aktor dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa. Pada 2022, ia menerima Academy Honorary Award sebagai "ikon budaya yang karyanya yang dinamis telah beresonansi lintas genre, generasi, dan penonton di seluruh dunia."

name: Sandra Bernhard
title: Sandra Bernhard
extract: Sandra Bernhard is an American actress, comedian, and singer. She first gained attention in the late 1970s with her stand-up comedy, where she often critiqued celebrity culture and political figures. Bernhard is also well known as the ex-best friend of Madonna.
extract_id: Sandra Bernhard adalah aktris, komedian, dan penyanyi Amerika. Ia pertama kali mendapatkan perhatian pada akhir 1970-an dengan komedi stand-up-nya, di mana ia sering mengkritik budaya selebriti dan tokoh politik. Bernhard juga dikenal sebagai mantan sahabat terbaik Madonna.

name: Sandra Bullock
title: Sandra Bullock
extract: Sandra Annette Bullock is an American actress and film producer. The world's highest-paid actress of 2010 and 2014, Bullock's filmography spans both comedy and drama, and her accolades include an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, two Screen Actors Guild Awards, and three Critics' Choice Movie Awards. She was named one of Time's 100 most influential people in the world in 2010.
extract_id: Sandra Annette Bullock adalah aktris dan produser film Amerika. Aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia pada 2010 dan 2014, filmografi Bullock meliputi komedi dan drama, dan penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, dua Screen Actors Guild Awards, dan tiga Critics' Choice Movie Awards. Ia dinobatkan sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia oleh majalah Time pada 2010.

name: Sandra Milo
title: Sandra Milo
extract: Salvatrice Elena Greco, known professionally as Sandra Milo, was an Italian actress, television personality, author, and musician. She won a Nastro d'Argento for Best Supporting Actress for each of her roles in Federico Fellini's 8½ and Juliet of the Spirits.
extract_id: Salvatrice Elena Greco, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Sandra Milo, adalah aktris Italia, kepribadian televisi, penulis, dan musisi. Ia memenangkan Nastro d'Argento untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik untuk setiap perannya dalam film Federico Fellini 8½ dan Juliet of the Spirits.

name: Sandy Dennis
title: Sandy Dennis
extract: Sandra Dale Dennis was an American actress. She made her film debut in the drama Splendor in the Grass (1961). For her performance in the comedy-drama film Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf? (1966), she received the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: Sandra Dale Dennis adalah aktris Amerika. Ia melakukan debut filmnya dalam drama Splendor in the Grass (1961). Untuk penampilannya dalam film komedi-drama Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf? (1966), ia menerima Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Sanjana Sanghi
title: Sanjana Sanghi
extract: Sanjana Sanghi is an Indian actress and model who works in Hindi films. She made her acting debut as a child artist in the 2011 film Rockstar and after appearing in a few supporting roles, she had her breakthrough with the romantic drama film Dil Bechara (2020). Sanghi has since starred in Rashtra Kavach Om (2022), Dhak Dhak (2023) and Kadak Singh (2023).
extract_id: Sanjana Sanghi adalah aktris dan model India yang berkarier di film-film Hindi. Ia memulai karier aktingnya sebagai artis cilik dalam film Rockstar tahun 2011 dan setelah tampil dalam beberapa peran pendukung, ia mencapai terobosan dengan film drama romantis Dil Bechara (2020). Sanghi kemudian membintangi Rashtra Kavach Om (2022), Dhak Dhak (2023), dan Kadak Singh (2023).

name: Sanjay Dutt
title: Sanjay Dutt
extract: Sanjay Balraj Dutt is an Indian actor and film producer who works primarily in Hindi cinema, and has also appeared in some Telugu, Kannada, Tamil, Marathi and Punjabi films. He has acted in over 135 films. Known for his versatile roles, style, and intensity, he has often portrayed flawed heroes on screen. Dutt has received awards such as two Filmfare Awards, three Screen Awards and a Global Indian Film Award.
extract_id: Sanjay Balraj Dutt adalah aktor dan produser film India yang bekerja terutama di sinema Hindi, dan juga muncul di beberapa film Telugu, Kannada, Tamil, Marathi, dan Punjabi. Ia telah berakting dalam lebih dari 135 film. Dikenal karena perannya yang serba bisa, gaya, dan intensitasnya, ia sering menggambarkan pahlawan yang cacat di layar. Dutt telah menerima penghargaan seperti dua Filmfare Awards, tiga Screen Awards, dan Global Indian Film Award.

name: Sanjay Leela Bhansali
title: Sanjay Leela Bhansali
extract: Sanjay Navin Bhansali, known professionally as Sanjay Leela Bhansali, is an Indian filmmaker and music composer, who works in Hindi cinema. He is the recipient of several awards, including seven National Film Awards and thirteen Filmfare Awards, in addition to a BAFTA Award nomination. In 2015, the Government of India honoured him with the Padma Shri, the fourth-highest civilian award. Bhansali is best known for his use of aesthetics and musical vision, particularly in period dramas.
extract_id: Sanjay Navin Bhansali, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Sanjay Leela Bhansali, adalah pembuat film dan komposer musik India yang bekerja di sinema Hindi. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk tujuh National Film Awards dan tiga belas Filmfare Awards, selain nominasi BAFTA Award. Pada 2015, Pemerintah India memberinya penghargaan Padma Shri, penghargaan sipil tertinggi keempat. Bhansali paling dikenal karena penggunaan estetika dan visi musikalnya, khususnya dalam drama periode.

name: Sanjeev Kumar
title: Sanjeev Kumar
extract: Sanjeev Kumar was an Indian actor who worked in Hindi and Gujarati cinema. Regarded as one of the greatest and finest actors in the history of Indian cinema, Kumar was known for his acting versatility. He acted in a wide variety of genres ranging from romantic drama to thriller. He was voted seventh among the "Greatest Actors of Indian cinema of All Time" in a poll conducted by Rediff.com. His double role in Angoor was listed among the "25 Iconic Performances of Indian cinema" by Forbes India on the occasion of celebrating 100 years of Indian Cinema.
extract_id: Sanjeev Kumar adalah aktor India yang bekerja di sinema Hindi dan Gujarati. Dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar dan terhebat dalam sejarah sinema India, Kumar dikenal karena kemampuan aktingnya yang serba bisa. Ia berakting dalam berbagai genre mulai dari drama romantis hingga thriller. Ia dipilih sebagai aktor ketujuh terhebat dalam "Greatest Actors of Indian cinema of All Time" dalam polling yang dilakukan oleh Rediff.com. Perannya dalam dua peran dalam film Angoor masuk dalam "25 Penampilan Ikonik sinema India" oleh Forbes India pada peringatan 100 tahun Sinema India.

name: Sanya Malhotra
title: Sanya Malhotra
extract: Sanya Malhotra is an Indian actress who primarily works in Hindi films. She has had supporting roles in the sports film Dangal (2016) and the action film Jawan (2023), both of which rank among the highest-grossing Indian films. Malhotra's other commercially successful films were the comedy Badhaai Ho (2018) and the biopic Sam Bahadur (2023).
extract_id: Sanya Malhotra adalah aktris India yang terutama bekerja di film Hindi. Ia memiliki peran pendukung dalam film olahraga Dangal (2016) dan film aksi Jawan (2023), keduanya termasuk dalam film India dengan pendapatan tertinggi. Film sukses komersial Malhotra lainnya adalah komedi Badhaai Ho (2018) dan biopik Sam Bahadur (2023).

name: Saoirse Ronan
title: Saoirse Ronan
extract: Saoirse Una Ronan is an Irish actress. Primarily known for her work in period dramas, she has received various accolades, including a Golden Globe Award and a Scottish BAFTA, with nominations for four Academy Awards and seven British Academy Film Awards.
extract_id: Saoirse Una Ronan adalah aktris Irlandia. Terutama dikenal karena karyanya dalam drama periode, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Golden Globe Award dan Scottish BAFTA, dengan nominasi untuk empat Academy Awards dan tujuh British Academy Film Awards.

name: Saori Hayami
title: Saori Hayami
extract: Saori Hayami is a Japanese voice actress and singer affiliated with I'm Enterprise. As a singer, she is signed to Warner Bros. Home Entertainment. Hayami won the 10th Seiyu Awards for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: Saori Hayami adalah pengisi suara dan penyanyi Jepang yang berafiliasi dengan I'm Enterprise. Sebagai penyanyi, ia bernaung di Warner Bros. Home Entertainment. Hayami memenangkan Seiyu Awards ke-10 untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Sara Takatsuki
title: Sara Takatsuki
extract: Sara Takatsuki is a Japanese actress from Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. She is represented by the agency Sweet Power.
extract_id: Sara Takatsuki adalah aktris Jepang dari Prefektur Kanagawa, Jepang. Ia diwakili oleh agensi Sweet Power.

name: Sarah Berry
title: Sarah Uriarte Berry
extract: Sarah Uriarte Berry is an American actress and singer.
extract_id: Sarah Uriarte Berry adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Amerika.

name: Sarah Bolger
title: Sarah Bolger
extract: Sarah Lee Bolger is an Irish actress. She starred in the films In America (2003), Stormbreaker (2006), The Spiderwick Chronicles (2008), The Moth Diaries (2011), The Lazarus Effect (2015), Emelie (2015), and A Good Woman Is Hard to Find (2019). On television, she portrayed Princess Mary Tudor in The Tudors (2008–2010), for which she won an IFTA award, and Princess Aurora in Once Upon a Time (2012–2015). Bolger also appeared on the series Into the Badlands (2015–2017) and The Westies (2026) and starred on Mayans M.C. (2018–2023).
extract_id: Sarah Lee Bolger adalah seorang aktris Irlandia. Dia membintangi film-film In America (2003), Stormbreaker (2006), The Spiderwick Chronicles (2008), The Moth Diaries (2011), The Lazarus Effect (2015), Emelie (2015), dan A Good Woman Is Hard to Find (2019). Di televisi, dia memerankan Putri Mary Tudor dalam The Tudors (2008–2010), yang membuatnya memenangkan penghargaan IFTA, dan Putri Aurora dalam Once Upon a Time (2012–2015). Bolger juga tampil di seri Into the Badlands (2015–2017) dan The Westies (2026) serta membintangi Mayans M.C. (2018–2023).

name: Sarah Jessica Parker
title: Sarah Jessica Parker
extract: Sarah Jessica Parker is an American actress and television producer. In a career spanning over five decades, she has performed across several productions of both screen and stage. Her accolades include six Golden Globe Awards and two Primetime Emmy Awards. Time magazine named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2022.
extract_id: Sarah Jessica Parker adalah seorang aktris dan produser televisi Amerika. Dalam karirnya yang membentang lebih dari lima dekade, dia telah tampil di berbagai produksi layar dan panggung. Penghargaannya termasuk enam Golden Globe Awards dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards. Majalah Time menamainya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia pada tahun 2022.

name: Sarah Miles
title: Sarah Miles
extract: Sarah Miles is a retired English actress. She is known for her roles in films The Servant (1963), Blowup (1966), Ryan's Daughter (1970), The Man Who Loved Cat Dancing (1973), White Mischief (1987), and Hope and Glory (1987). For her performance in Ryan's Daughter, Miles received a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Actress.
extract_id: Sarah Miles adalah seorang aktris Inggris yang telah pensiun. Dia dikenal atas perannya dalam film The Servant (1963), Blowup (1966), Ryan's Daughter (1970), The Man Who Loved Cat Dancing (1973), White Mischief (1987), dan Hope and Glory (1987). Untuk penampilannya dalam Ryan's Daughter, Miles menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik.

name: Sarah Polley
title: Sarah Polley
description: Canadian actress, film director, and screenwriter (born 1979)
extract: Sarah Ellen Polley is a Canadian filmmaker, writer, political activist and actress. She first garnered attention as a child actress for her role as Ramona Quimby in the television series Ramona, based on Beverly Cleary's books. This subsequently led to her role as Sara Stanley in the Canadian television series Road to Avonlea (1990–1996). She has starred in many feature films, including The Adventures of Baron Munchausen (1988), Exotica (1994), The Sweet Hereafter (1997), Guinevere (1999), Go (1999), The Weight of Water (2000), No Such Thing (2001), My Life Without Me (2003), Dawn of the Dead (2004), Splice (2009), and Mr. Nobody (2009).
extract_id: Sarah Ellen Polley adalah pembuat film, penulis, aktivis politik, dan aktris asal Kanada. Dia pertama kali menarik perhatian sebagai aktris cilik melalui perannya sebagai Ramona Quimby dalam serial televisi Ramona, yang didasarkan pada buku-buku Beverly Cleary. Ini kemudian mengantarkannya pada peran sebagai Sara Stanley dalam serial televisi Kanada Road to Avonlea (1990–1996). Dia telah membintangi banyak film fitur, termasuk The Adventures of Baron Munchausen (1988), Exotica (1994), The Sweet Hereafter (1997), Guinevere (1999), Go (1999), The Weight of Water (2000), No Such Thing (2001), My Life Without Me (2003), Dawn of the Dead (2004), Splice (2009), dan Mr. Nobody (2009).

name: Sarah Roemer
title: Sarah Roemer
extract: Sarah Christine Roemer is an American actress. One of her best-known roles was a supporting character in Disturbia, and she has also starred in a number of films including Asylum, Hachi: A Dog's Tale, Fired Up!, Waking Madison, and The Con Artist, as well as the television series The Event and Chosen.
extract_id: Sarah Christine Roemer adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Salah satu peran terkenal darinya adalah karakter pendukung dalam Disturbia, dan dia juga telah membintangi sejumlah film termasuk Asylum, Hachi: A Dog's Tale, Fired Up!, Waking Madison, dan The Con Artist, serta serial televisi The Event dan Chosen.

name: Sarah Silverman
title: Sarah Silverman
extract: Sarah Kate Silverman is an American stand-up comedian, actress and writer. She first rose to prominence for her brief stint as a writer and cast member on the NBC sketch comedy series Saturday Night Live during its 19th season, between 1993 and 1994. She then starred in and produced The Sarah Silverman Program, which ran from 2007 to 2010 on Comedy Central. For her work on the program, Silverman was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series.
extract_id: Sarah Kate Silverman adalah seorang komedian tunggal Amerika, aktris, dan penulis. Dia pertama kali dikenal luas melalui perannya sebagai penulis dan anggota pemeran di seri komedi sketsa NBC Saturday Night Live selama musim ke-19, antara tahun 1993 dan 1994. Dia kemudian membintangi dan memproduksi The Sarah Silverman Program, yang tayang dari 2007 hingga 2010 di Comedy Central. Untuk karyanya dalam program tersebut, Silverman dinominasikan untuk Primetime Emmy Award untuk Aktris Utama Terbaik dalam Seri Komedi.

name: Sarah Vowell
title: Sarah Vowell
description: American author, journalist and voice actress (born 1969)
extract: Sarah Jane Vowell is an American historian, writer, journalist, radio personality, social commentator, and actress. She has written seven nonfiction books on American history and culture. Vowell was a contributing editor for the radio program This American Life on Public Radio International from 1996 to 2008, where she produced commentaries and documentaries. She was the voice of Violet Parr in the 2004 animated film The Incredibles and its 2018 sequel.
extract_id: Sarah Jane Vowell adalah seorang sejarawan, penulis, jurnalis, penyiar radio, komentator sosial, dan aktris Amerika. Dia telah menulis tujuh buku nonfiksi tentang sejarah dan budaya Amerika. Vowell merupakan editor kontributor untuk program radio This American Life di Public Radio International dari tahun 1996 hingga 2008, di mana dia memproduksi komentar dan dokumenter. Dia adalah suara Violet Parr dalam film animasi The Incredibles tahun 2004 dan sekuelnya pada tahun 2018.

name: Sareh Bayat
title: Sareh Bayat
extract: Sareh Bayat is an Iranian actress. She began her career in theatre in 2001 and, after studying acting, appeared in the television series A Fistful of Eagle Feathers in 2007. Her first cinematic role was in the film Imitator of Satan.
extract_id: Sareh Bayat adalah seorang aktris Iran. Dia memulai kariernya di teater pada tahun 2001 dan setelah belajar akting, tampil dalam serial televisi A Fistful of Eagle Feathers pada tahun 2007. Peran sinematik pertamanya adalah dalam film Imitator of Satan.

name: Saswata Chatterjee
title: Saswata Chatterjee
extract: Saswata Chatterjee is an Indian actor known for his work in Bengali cinema and television, with appearances in Hindi films. The son of actor Subhendu Chatterjee, he began his career with a Hindi television series directed by Saibal Mitra, based on Samaresh Majumdar's Kaalpurush. He gained recognition for portraying in detective series such as Byomkesh Bakshi and in a Feluda-based television series directed by Sandip Ray.
extract_id: Saswata Chatterjee adalah aktor India yang dikenal karena karyanya di sinema dan televisi Bengali, dengan beberapa penampilan di film-film Hindi. Putra aktor Subhendu Chatterjee ini memulai kariernya dengan serial televisi Hindi yang disutradarai Saibal Mitra, berdasarkan karya Samaresh Majumdar berjudul Kaalpurush. Dia dikenal atas perannya dalam serial detektif seperti Byomkesh Bakshi dan serial televisi berbasis Feluda yang disutradarai Sandip Ray.

name: Sathyaraj
title: Sathyaraj
description: Indian actor, film producer and media personality (born 1954)
extract: Rangaraj Subbiah, known professionally as Sathyaraj, is an Indian actor, film producer and media personality who appears predominantly in Tamil films. He also appears in works in Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam and Kannada. He has acted in more than 260 films. He is a recipient of three Filmfare Award South and three Tamil Nadu State Film Awards.
extract_id: Rangaraj Subbiah, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Sathyaraj, adalah aktor, produser film, dan pribadi media India yang tampil terutama dalam film Tamil. Dia juga tampil dalam karya-karya berbahasa Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam, dan Kannada. Dia telah berakting dalam lebih dari 260 film. Dia menerima tiga Filmfare Award South dan tiga Tamil Nadu State Film Awards.

name: Satoshi Kon
title: Satoshi Kon
description: Japanese anime director and manga artist (1963–2010)
extract: Satoshi Kon was a Japanese film director, animator, screenwriter and manga artist from Sapporo, Hokkaido, and a member of the Japanese Animation Creators Association (JAniCA). He was a graduate of the Graphic Design department of the Musashino Art University. He is best known for his acclaimed anime films Perfect Blue (1997), Millennium Actress (2001), Tokyo Godfathers (2003), and Paprika (2006), and the TV series Paranoia Agent (2004). In 2010, Kon died of pancreatic cancer at age 46.
extract_id: Satoshi Kon adalah sutradara film Jepang, animator, penulis skenario, dan seniman manga dari Sapporo, Hokkaido, serta anggota Japanese Animation Creators Association (JAniCA). Dia lulus dari departemen Desain Grafis Universitas Seni Musashino. Dia paling dikenal karena film anime terkenalnya Perfect Blue (1997), Millennium Actress (2001), Tokyo Godfathers (2003), dan Paprika (2006), serta serial TV Paranoia Agent (2004). Pada tahun 2010, Kon meninggal karena kanker pankreas pada usia 46 tahun.

name: Saurabh Shukla
title: Saurabh Shukla
extract: Saurabh Shukla is an Indian actor, screenwriter, and film director who works in Hindi and a few Tamil and Telugu films. He is best known for his roles in Satya (1998), Nayak: The Real Hero (2001), Yuva (2004), Lage Raho Munna Bhai (2006), Barfi! (2012), Jolly LLB (2013); for the latter, he won the National Film Award for Best Supporting Actor. Other notable films are Kick (2014), PK (2014), Jolly LLB 2 (2017) and Raid (2018). He has also worked in a short documentary with Ruth Agnihotri and Rachael Agnihotri in Goa.
extract_id: Saurabh Shukla adalah aktor, penulis skenario, dan sutradara film India yang bekerja dalam film-film Hindi serta beberapa film Tamil dan Telugu. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya dalam Satya (1998), Nayak: The Real Hero (2001), Yuva (2004), Lage Raho Munna Bhai (2006), Barfi! (2012), Jolly LLB (2013); untuk yang terakhir, dia memenangkan Penghargaan Film Nasional untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik. Film penting lainnya adalah Kick (2014), PK (2014), Jolly LLB 2 (2017) dan Raid (2018). Dia juga bekerja dalam sebuah film dokumenter pendek bersama Ruth Agnihotri dan Rachael Agnihotri di Goa.

name: Saïd Taghmaoui
title: Saïd Taghmaoui
extract: Saïd Taghmaoui is a French actor. One of his major screen roles was that of Saïd in the 1995 French film La Haine, directed by Mathieu Kassovitz. Taghmaoui has also appeared in a number of English-language films, with roles such as Captain Said in Three Kings (1999), Breaker in G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra (2009), Sameer in Wonder Woman (2017), and The Elder in John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum (2019).
extract_id: Saïd Taghmaoui adalah aktor Prancis. Salah satu peran besarnya adalah sebagai Saïd dalam film Prancis tahun 1995, La Haine, yang disutradarai oleh Mathieu Kassovitz. Taghmaoui juga tampil dalam sejumlah film berbahasa Inggris, dengan peran seperti Kapten Said dalam Three Kings (1999), Breaker dalam G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra (2009), Sameer dalam Wonder Woman (2017), dan The Elder dalam John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum (2019).

name: Scarlett Johansson
title: Scarlett Johansson
extract: Scarlett Ingrid Johansson is an American actress, singer, producer, and director. Her films as a leading actress have grossed over $15.4 billion worldwide, making her the third-highest-grossing actor in history. Her accolades include a British Academy Film Award and a Tony Award, as well as nominations for two Academy Awards and five Golden Globe Awards. She was the world's highest-paid actress in 2018, 2019, and 2025.
extract_id: Scarlett Ingrid Johansson adalah aktris, penyanyi, produser, dan sutradara Amerika. Film-filmnya sebagai pemeran utama telah menghasilkan pendapatan lebih dari $15,4 miliar di seluruh dunia, menjadikannya aktris dengan pendapatan tertinggi ketiga dalam sejarah. Penghargaannya termasuk British Academy Film Award dan Tony Award, serta nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards dan lima Golden Globe Awards. Dia adalah aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di dunia pada 2018, 2019, dan 2025.

name: Scatman Crothers
title: Scatman Crothers
extract: Benjamin Sherman "Scatman" Crothers was an American actor and musician. He is known for playing Louie the Garbage Man on the TV show Chico and the Man, and Dick Hallorann in Stanley Kubrick's The Shining (1980). He was also a prolific voice actor who provided the voices of Meadowlark Lemon in the Harlem Globetrotters animated TV series, Jazz the Autobot in The Transformers and The Transformers: The Movie (1986), the title character in Hong Kong Phooey, and Scat Cat in the Disney animated film The Aristocats (1970).
extract_id: Benjamin Sherman "Scatman" Crothers adalah aktor dan musisi Amerika. Dia dikenal karena memerankan Louie the Garbage Man dalam acara TV Chico and the Man, dan Dick Hallorann dalam The Shining (1980) karya Stanley Kubrick. Dia juga seorang pengisi suara yang prolifik yang mengisi suara Meadowlark Lemon dalam serial animasi Harlem Globetrotters, Jazz the Autobot dalam The Transformers dan The Transformers: The Movie (1986), karakter utama dalam Hong Kong Phooey, dan Scat Cat dalam film animasi Disney The Aristocats (1970).

name: Scott Adsit
title: Scott Adsit
extract: Robert Scott Adsit is an American actor, comedian, and writer. Born and raised in the Chicago suburbs, Adsit joined the mainstage cast of Chicago's The Second City in 1994 after attending Columbia College Chicago. He appeared in several revues, including Paradigm Lost for which he won The Joseph Jefferson Award for Best Actor in a Comedy.
extract_id: Robert Scott Adsit adalah aktor, komedian, dan penulis Amerika. Lahir dan dibesarkan di pinggiran kota Chicago, Adsit bergabung dengan pemeran utama The Second City Chicago pada tahun 1994 setelah menghadiri Columbia College Chicago. Dia tampil dalam beberapa pertunjukan, termasuk Paradigm Lost yang membuatnya memenangkan Joseph Jefferson Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Komedi.

name: Scott Glenn
title: Scott Glenn
extract: Theodore Scott Glenn is an American actor. His roles have included Bill Lester in She Came to the Valley (1979), Pfc Glenn Kelly in Nashville (1975), Wes Hightower in Urban Cowboy (1980), astronaut Alan Shepard in The Right Stuff (1983), Emmett in Silverado (1985), Captain Bart Mancuso in The Hunt for Red October (1990), Jack Crawford in The Silence of the Lambs (1991), John Adcox in Backdraft (1991), Bill Burton in Absolute Power (1997), Roger in Training Day (2001), Ezra Kramer in The Bourne Ultimatum (2007), and Chris Chenery in Secretariat (2010).
extract_id: Theodore Scott Glenn adalah aktor Amerika. Perannya termasuk Bill Lester dalam She Came to the Valley (1979), Pfc Glenn Kelly dalam Nashville (1975), Wes Hightower dalam Urban Cowboy (1980), astronot Alan Shepard dalam The Right Stuff (1983), Emmett dalam Silverado (1985), Kapten Bart Mancuso dalam The Hunt for Red October (1990), Jack Crawford dalam The Silence of the Lambs (1991), John Adcox dalam Backdraft (1991), Bill Burton dalam Absolute Power (1997), Roger dalam Training Day (2001), Ezra Kramer dalam The Bourne Ultimatum (2007), dan Chris Chenery dalam Secretariat (2010).

name: Scott H. Reiniger
title: Scott Reiniger
extract: Scott Hale Reiniger, Harlan Sahib Bahadur, Prince of Ghor is an American actor. He is a professor at the American Academy of Dramatic Arts (AADA) in Los Angeles, California. He is best known as one of the stars of the 1978 classic horror film Dawn of the Dead.
extract_id: Scott Hale Reiniger, Harlan Sahib Bahadur, Pangeran Ghor adalah aktor Amerika. Dia adalah profesor di American Academy of Dramatic Arts (AADA) di Los Angeles, California. Dia paling dikenal sebagai salah satu bintang film horor klasik tahun 1978, Dawn of the Dead.

name: Scott Hicks
title: Scott Hicks (director)
extract: Robert Scott Hicks is an Australian film director, producer and screenwriter. He is best known as the director of Shine, the biopic of pianist David Helfgott, for which he was nominated for two Academy Awards. Other films he has directed include the film adaptations of Stephen King's Hearts in Atlantis and Nicholas Sparks' The Lucky One.
extract_id: Robert Scott Hicks adalah sutradara film, produser, dan penulis skenario asal Australia. Dia paling dikenal sebagai sutradara Shine, biopik pianis David Helfgott, yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk dua Academy Awards. Film lainnya yang telah disutradarainya termasuk adaptasi dari Hearts in Atlantis karya Stephen King dan The Lucky One karya Nicholas Sparks.

name: Scott Schwartz
title: Scott Schwartz
extract: Scott Schwartz is an American actor best known for his roles in the films The Toy (1982), A Christmas Story (1983) and A Christmas Story Christmas (2022), and Kidco (1984).
extract_id: Scott Schwartz adalah aktor Amerika yang paling dikenal untuk perannya dalam film The Toy (1982), A Christmas Story (1983) dan A Christmas Story Christmas (2022), serta Kidco (1984).

name: Scott Weinger
title: Scott Weinger
extract: Scott Weinger is an American actor, screenwriter and television producer. He is the voice of the Disney character Aladdin in the 1992 animated film and various follow-ups, and played Steve Hale on the ABC sitcom Full House and its Netflix sequel Fuller House. For ABC, he wrote and produced for the television sitcoms Galavant and Black-ish and was a co-executive producer of The Muppets. He is a writer and co-executive producer on the Hulu show Paradise, for which he received Emmy nominations in 2025 and 2026.
extract_id: Scott Weinger adalah aktor, penulis skenario, dan produser televisi Amerika. Dia adalah pengisi suara karakter Disney Aladdin dalam film animasi tahun 1992 dan berbagai sekuelnya, serta berperan sebagai Steve Hale dalam sitkom ABC Full House dan sekuelnya di Netflix, Fuller House. Untuk ABC, dia menulis dan memproduksi sitkom Galavant dan Black-ish dan menjadi produser eksekutif bersama untuk The Muppets. Dia adalah penulis dan produser eksekutif bersama dalam acara Hulu Paradise, yang membuatnya menerima nominasi Emmy pada 2025 dan 2026.

name: Seamus Davey-Fitzpatrick
title: Seamus Davey-Fitzpatrick
extract: Seamus Liam Davey-Fitzpatrick is an American actor. His first feature film role was as Damien Thorn in the 2006 remake of the horror film The Omen.
extract_id: Seamus Liam Davey-Fitzpatrick adalah aktor Amerika. Peran film fitur pertamanya adalah sebagai Damien Thorn dalam pembuatan ulang film horor The Omen tahun 2006.

name: Sean Astin
title: Sean Astin
extract: Sean Patrick Astin is an American actor and trade union leader who serves as the fourth national president of SAG-AFTRA. He began his career as a child actor, making his film debut as Mikey Walsh in The Goonies (1985), followed by significant roles as Billy Tepper in Toy Soldiers (1991), Dave Morgan in Encino Man (1992), Daniel Ruettiger in Rudy (1993), and Samwise Gamgee in The Lord of the Rings trilogy (2001–2003).
extract_id: Sean Patrick Astin adalah aktor Amerika dan pemimpin serikat kerja yang menjabat sebagai presiden nasional keempat SAG-AFTRA. Dia memulai karier sebagai aktor cilik, memulai debut filmnya sebagai Mikey Walsh dalam The Goonies (1985), diikuti oleh peran penting sebagai Billy Tepper dalam Toy Soldiers (1991), Dave Morgan dalam Encino Man (1992), Daniel Ruettiger dalam Rudy (1993), dan Samwise Gamgee dalam trilogi The Lord of the Rings (2001–2003).

name: Sean Baker
title: Sean Baker
extract: Sean Baker is an American filmmaker. He is a director, writer, editor, and producer of independent narrative feature films which are most often about the lives of marginalized people, especially immigrants and sex workers. He made his directorial film debut with Four Letter Words (2000) and co-created the television character Greg the Bunny. Baker has since directed seven feature films: Take Out (2004), Prince of Broadway (2008), Starlet (2012), Tangerine (2015), The Florida Project (2017), Red Rocket (2021), and Anora (2024).
extract_id: Sean Baker adalah pembuat film Amerika. Dia adalah sutradara, penulis, editor, dan produser film naratif independen yang sering kali tentang kehidupan orang-orang terpinggirkan, terutama imigran dan pekerja seks. Dia membuat debut sutradaranya dengan Four Letter Words (2000) dan ikut menciptakan karakter televisi Greg the Bunny. Baker sejak itu menyutradarai tujuh film fitur: Take Out (2004), Prince of Broadway (2008), Starlet (2012), Tangerine (2015), The Florida Project (2017), Red Rocket (2021), dan Anora (2024).

name: Sean Bean
title: Sean Bean
extract: Sean Bean is an English actor. Recognised for his work in both film and television, he has received various accolades including three BAFTA TV Awards, a Critics' Choice Award, an Actor Award and an International Emmy Award.
extract_id: Sean Bean adalah aktor Inggris. Dikenal atas karyanya di film dan televisi, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk tiga BAFTA TV Awards, Critics' Choice Award, Actor Award, dan International Emmy Award.

name: Sean Bridgers
title: Sean Bridgers
extract: Sean MacKenzie Bridgers is an American actor, screenwriter, and producer, known for his role as Johnny Burns on the HBO series Deadwood and as Trey Willis on the SundanceTV original series Rectify. In addition to many roles in television and film since 1991, Bridgers received acclaim and awards for the independent film Carolina Low, which he wrote and produced.
extract_id: Sean MacKenzie Bridgers adalah aktor, penulis skenario, dan produser Amerika, dikenal karena perannya sebagai Johnny Burns dalam serial HBO Deadwood dan sebagai Trey Willis dalam serial asli SundanceTV Rectify. Selain banyak peran dalam televisi dan film sejak 1991, Bridgers mendapat pengakuan dan penghargaan untuk film independen Carolina Low yang ia tulis dan produksi.

name: Sean Connery
title: Sean Connery
extract: Sir Thomas Sean Connery was a Scottish actor and film producer. Connery was the first actor to portray the fictional British secret agent James Bond in motion pictures, starring in seven Bond films between 1962 and 1983. He originated the role in Dr. No (1962) and continued starring as Bond in the Eon Productions films From Russia with Love (1963), Goldfinger (1964), Thunderball (1965), You Only Live Twice (1967) and Diamonds Are Forever (1971). His final appearance in the role was with Never Say Never Again (1983), a non-Eon-produced Bond film.
extract_id: Sir Thomas Sean Connery adalah aktor dan produser film Skotlandia. Connery adalah aktor pertama yang memerankan agen rahasia Inggris fiktif James Bond dalam film, membintangi tujuh film Bond antara 1962 dan 1983. Ia memulai peran tersebut di Dr. No (1962) dan terus membintangi Bond dalam film Eon Productions From Russia with Love (1963), Goldfinger (1964), Thunderball (1965), You Only Live Twice (1967), dan Diamonds Are Forever (1971). Penampilan terakhirnya dalam peran ini adalah di Never Say Never Again (1983), sebuah film Bond yang tidak diproduksi oleh Eon.

name: Sean Patrick Flanery
title: Sean Patrick Flanery
extract: Sean Patrick Flanery is an American actor. He is known for playing Connor MacManus in The Boondock Saints (1999) and its sequel The Boondock Saints II: All Saints Day (2009), Greg Stillson in the television series The Dead Zone, Jeremy "Powder" Reed in Powder (1995), Indiana Jones in the George Lucas television series The Young Indiana Jones Chronicles, as well as Bobby Dagen in Saw 3D (2010). He is also known for his role as Sam Gibson on the CBS soap opera The Young and the Restless in 2011. He starred in Devil's Carnival, a short film which was screened on tour beginning in April 2012.
extract_id: Sean Patrick Flanery adalah aktor Amerika. Ia dikenal memerankan Connor MacManus dalam The Boondock Saints (1999) dan sekuelnya The Boondock Saints II: All Saints Day (2009), Greg Stillson dalam serial televisi The Dead Zone, Jeremy "Powder" Reed dalam Powder (1995), Indiana Jones dalam serial televisi George Lucas The Young Indiana Jones Chronicles, serta Bobby Dagen dalam Saw 3D (2010). Ia juga dikenal atas perannya sebagai Sam Gibson dalam sinetron CBS The Young and the Restless pada 2011. Ia membintangi Devil's Carnival, film pendek yang diputar dalam tur mulai April 2012.

name: Sean Penn
title: Sean Penn
extract: Sean Justin Penn is an American actor and filmmaker. He is known for his intense leading man roles in film. His accolades include three Academy Awards, a BAFTA Award, and a Golden Globe Award, in addition to nominations for an Emmy Award and a Grammy Award. He received the Honorary César in 2015 and the Bob Hope Humanitarian Award in 2022.
extract_id: Sean Justin Penn adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Ia dikenal dengan peran utama yang intens dalam film. Penghargaannya meliputi tiga Academy Awards, BAFTA Award, dan Golden Globe Award, selain nominasi Emmy Award dan Grammy Award. Ia menerima Honorary César pada 2015 dan Bob Hope Humanitarian Award pada 2022.

name: Sean Young
title: Sean Young
extract: Sean Young is an American actress. She is notable for starring in science-fiction and comedy films throughout the 1980s and 1990s, although she has performed in many genres.
extract_id: Sean Young adalah aktris Amerika. Ia terkenal karena membintangi film fiksi ilmiah dan komedi sepanjang 1980-an dan 1990-an, meskipun ia telah tampil dalam berbagai genre.

name: Sebastian Cabot
title: Sebastian Cabot (actor)
extract: Charles Sebastian Thomas Cabot was a British actor. He is best remembered as the gentleman's gentleman Giles French in the CBS-TV sitcom Family Affair (1966–1971). He was also known for playing the Wazir in the film Kismet (1955) and Dr. Carl Hyatt in the CBS-TV series Checkmate (1960–1962).
extract_id: Charles Sebastian Thomas Cabot adalah aktor Inggris. Ia paling diingat sebagai gentleman’s gentleman Giles French dalam sitkom CBS-TV Family Affair (1966–1971). Ia juga dikenal karena memerankan Wazir dalam film Kismet (1955) dan Dr. Carl Hyatt dalam serial CBS-TV Checkmate (1960–1962).

name: Sebastian Koch
title: Sebastian Koch
extract: Sebastian Koch is a German television and film actor. He is known for roles in the 2007 Academy Award-winning film The Lives of Others, Black Book (film), in Steven Spielberg's Bridge of Spies, and as Otto Düring in the fifth season of the Showtime series Homeland.
extract_id: Sebastian Koch adalah aktor televisi dan film Jerman. Ia dikenal dari peran-perannya dalam film pemenang Academy Award 2007 The Lives of Others, Black Book (film), dalam Bridge of Spies karya Steven Spielberg, dan sebagai Otto Düring dalam musim kelima serial Showtime Homeland.

name: Sebastian Maniscalco
title: Sebastian Maniscalco
extract: Sebastian Maniscalco is an American stand-up comedian and actor. Best known for his stand-up comedy, Maniscalco has released seven comedy specials. He has also had supporting acting roles in the films Green Book (2018) and The Irishman (2019), playing mobster Joe Gallo in the latter. He also played Frank Russo in the 2022 film Somewhere in Queens, and later voice acted in The Nut Job 2: Nutty by Nature (2017), The Super Mario Bros. Movie (2023) and IF (2024). Maniscalco co-wrote and co-starred in the 2023 film About My Father, with Robert De Niro playing the role of his father. Maniscalco starred in the TV series Bookie.
extract_id: Sebastian Maniscalco adalah komedian stand-up dan aktor Amerika. Terkenal untuk komedi stand-up-nya, Maniscalco telah merilis tujuh spesial komedi. Ia juga memiliki peran pendukung dalam film Green Book (2018) dan The Irishman (2019), memerankan mobster Joe Gallo dalam film terakhir. Ia juga memerankan Frank Russo dalam film Somewhere in Queens (2022), dan kemudian melakukan pengisi suara dalam The Nut Job 2: Nutty by Nature (2017), The Super Mario Bros. Movie (2023) dan IF (2024). Maniscalco menulis bersama dan berperan dalam film About My Father (2023), dengan Robert De Niro sebagai ayahnya. Maniscalco juga membintangi serial TV Bookie.

name: Sebastian Schipper
title: Sebastian Schipper
extract: Sebastian Schipper is a German actor and filmmaker.
extract_id: Sebastian Schipper adalah aktor dan pembuat film Jerman.

name: Sela Ward
title: Sela Ward
extract: Sela Ann Ward is an American actress. Her breakthrough TV role was as Teddy Reed in the NBC drama series Sisters (1991–96), for which she received her first Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series in 1994. She received her second Primetime Emmy Award and Golden Globe Award for Best Actress – Television Series Drama for the leading role of Lily Manning in the ABC drama series Once and Again (1999–2002). Ward later had the recurring role of Stacy Warner in the Fox medical drama House, also starred as Jo Danville in the CBS police procedural CSI: NY (2010–13) and starred as Dana Mosier in the CBS police procedural series FBI (2018–19).
extract_id: Sela Ann Ward adalah aktris Amerika. Peran terobosannya di TV adalah sebagai Teddy Reed dalam serial drama NBC Sisters (1991–96), yang membuatnya menerima Primetime Emmy Award pertamanya untuk Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series pada 1994. Ia menerima Primetime Emmy Award dan Golden Globe Award kedua untuk Best Actress – Television Series Drama sebagai pemeran utama Lily Manning dalam serial drama ABC Once and Again (1999–2002). Ward kemudian memerankan karakter berulang Stacy Warner dalam drama medis Fox House, juga membintangi Jo Danville dalam serial prosedural polisi CBS CSI: NY (2010–13) dan sebagai Dana Mosier dalam serial prosedural polisi CBS FBI (2018–19).

name: Sener Sen
title: Şener Şen
extract: Şener Şen is a Turkish film and theatre actor who has won the Golden Orange for Best Actor twice for his roles in Muhsin Bey (1985) and Gönül Yarası (2005), the Golden Orange for Best Supporting Actor for Çöpçüler Kralı (1977) and a Golden Orange Lifetime Achievement Award. A prominent actor of classic films in the Turkish cinema, he has played a wide range of iconic characters in various genres, including drama, comedy. He received the distinction of "Turkish state artist" in 1998.
extract_id: Şener Şen adalah aktor film dan teater Turki yang dua kali memenangkan Golden Orange untuk Best Actor atas perannya dalam Muhsin Bey (1985) dan Gönül Yarası (2005), Golden Orange untuk Best Supporting Actor untuk Çöpçüler Kralı (1977) serta penghargaan Lifetime Achievement Golden Orange. Sebagai aktor terkemuka di film klasik perfilman Turki, ia telah memerankan berbagai karakter ikonik dalam berbagai genre, termasuk drama dan komedi. Ia menerima gelar "seniman negara Turki" pada 1998.

name: Sergei M. Eisenstein
title: Sergei Eisenstein
extract: Sergei Mikhailovich Eisenstein was a Soviet film director, screenwriter, film editor and film theorist. Considered one of the greatest filmmakers of all time, he was a pioneer in the theory and practice of montage.
