He is noted in particular for his silent films Strike (1925), Battleship Potemkin (1925) and October (1928), as well as the historical epics Alexander Nevsky (1938) and Ivan the Terrible (1945/1958). In its decennial poll, the magazine Sight and Sound named his Battleship Potemkin the 54th-greatest film of all time.
extract_id: Sergei Mikhailovich Eisenstein adalah sutradara film Soviet, penulis skenario, editor film, dan teoritikus film. Dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film terbesar sepanjang masa, ia adalah pionir dalam teori dan praktek montase. Ia terkenal terutama untuk film bisunya Strike (1925), Battleship Potemkin (1925) dan October (1928), serta epik sejarah Alexander Nevsky (1938) dan Ivan the Terrible (1945/1958). Dalam jajak pendapat satu dekade majalah Sight and Sound, filmnya Battleship Potemkin dinobatkan sebagai film terbesar ke-54 sepanjang masa.

name: Sergi López
title: Sergi López (actor)
extract: Sergi López i Ayats is a Spanish actor mostly known for his work on Dirty Pretty Things, Mine Alone, and Pan's Labyrinth. He has developed a substantial career in both Spanish films and French films and is the recipient of multiple accolades, including a César Award for Best Actor and a European Film Award.
extract_id: Sergi López i Ayats adalah aktor Spanyol yang paling dikenal karena karyanya di Dirty Pretty Things, Mine Alone, dan Pan's Labyrinth. Ia mengembangkan karier substansial baik dalam film Spanyol maupun Prancis dan menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk César Award untuk Best Actor dan European Film Award.

name: Sergio Leone
title: Sergio Leone
extract: Sergio Leone was an Italian filmmaker, credited as the pioneer of the spaghetti Western genre. He is widely regarded as one of the greatest directors in the history of cinema.
extract_id: Sergio Leone adalah pembuat film Italia, dikenal sebagai pelopor genre spaghetti Western. Ia dianggap secara luas sebagai salah satu sutradara terbesar dalam sejarah perfilman.

name: Sergio Pablos
title: Sergio Pablos
extract: Sergio Pablos is a Spanish animator, director and screenwriter. While at the helm of his company, Pablos developed several concepts for animated feature films, most notably the original ideas upon which Despicable Me and Smallfoot were based.
extract_id: Sergio Pablos adalah animator, sutradara, dan penulis skenario Spanyol. Saat memimpin perusahaannya, Pablos mengembangkan beberapa konsep untuk film animasi panjang, yang paling menonjol adalah ide asli yang menjadi dasar Despicable Me dan Smallfoot.

name: Sessue Hayakawa
title: Sessue Hayakawa
extract: Kintarō Hayakawa, known professionally as Sessue Hayakawa, was a Japanese actor. He was a popular star and matinée idol in Hollywood during the silent film era of the 1910s and early 1920s. Hayakawa was the first actor of Asian descent to achieve stardom as a leading man in the United States and Europe. His "broodingly handsome" good looks and typecasting as a sexually dominant villain made him a heartthrob among American women during a time of racial discrimination, and he became one of the first male sex symbols of Hollywood.
extract_id: Kintarō Hayakawa, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Sessue Hayakawa, adalah aktor Jepang. Ia merupakan bintang populer dan idola matinée di Hollywood selama era film bisu tahun 1910-an dan awal 1920-an. Hayakawa adalah aktor keturunan Asia pertama yang mencapai ketenaran sebagai pemeran utama di Amerika Serikat dan Eropa. Penampilannya yang "tampan dan melankolis" serta sering berperan sebagai penjahat dominan seksual membuatnya menjadi idola bagi wanita Amerika pada masa diskriminasi rasial, dan ia menjadi salah satu simbol seks laki-laki pertama di Hollywood.

name: Seth Rogen
title: Seth Rogen
extract: Seth Aaron Rogen is a Canadian actor, comedian, filmmaker, and cannabis entrepreneur. Known primarily for his comedic leading man roles in films and on television, he has often collaborated with his writing partner, Evan Goldberg, and filmmaker and producer Judd Apatow. Rogen has received various accolades including five Primetime Emmy Awards, two Actor Awards, a Golden Globe Award, a Producers Guild of America Award, a Writers Guild of America Award, and a Directors Guild of America Award.
extract_id: Seth Aaron Rogen adalah aktor, komedian, pembuat film, dan pengusaha ganja asal Kanada. Dikenal terutama untuk peran utama komedi dalam film dan televisi, ia sering berkolaborasi dengan mitra penulisnya, Evan Goldberg, serta pembuat film dan produser Judd Apatow. Rogen telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk lima Primetime Emmy Awards, dua Actor Awards, Golden Globe Award, Producers Guild of America Award, Writers Guild of America Award, dan Directors Guild of America Award.

name: Setsuko Hara
title: Setsuko Hara
extract: Setsuko Hara was a Japanese actress. She is best known for her performances in Yasujirō Ozu's films Late Spring (1949), Tokyo Story (1953) and Tokyo Twilight (1957), amongst many others, and for working extensively with director Mikio Naruse. She is widely considered to be one of the greatest Japanese film actresses of all time.
extract_id: Setsuko Hara adalah aktris Jepang. Ia paling dikenal atas penampilannya dalam film-film Yasujirō Ozu seperti Late Spring (1949), Tokyo Story (1953), dan Tokyo Twilight (1957), di antara banyak lainnya, serta atas kerja sama intensif dengan sutradara Mikio Naruse. Ia secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu aktris film Jepang terbesar sepanjang masa.

name: Seymour Cassel
title: Seymour Cassel
extract: Seymour Joseph Cassel was an American actor who appeared in over 200 films and television shows, with a career spanning over 50 years. He first came to prominence in the 1960s in the pioneering independent films of writer/director John Cassavetes. The first of these was Too Late Blues (1961), followed by Faces (1968), for which he was nominated for an Academy Award and won a National Society of Film Critics Award. Cassel went on to appear in Cassavetes's Minnie and Moskowitz (1971), The Killing of a Chinese Bookie (1976), Opening Night (1977), and Love Streams (1984).
extract_id: Seymour Joseph Cassel adalah aktor Amerika yang tampil dalam lebih dari 200 film dan acara televisi, dengan karier selama lebih dari 50 tahun. Ia pertama kali dikenal di tahun 1960-an dalam film-film independen yang dipelopori oleh penulis/sutradara John Cassavetes. Film pertama adalah Too Late Blues (1961), diikuti oleh Faces (1968), yang membuatnya dinominasikan ke Academy Award dan memenangkan National Society of Film Critics Award. Cassel kemudian tampil dalam film Cassavetes Minnie and Moskowitz (1971), The Killing of a Chinese Bookie (1976), Opening Night (1977), dan Love Streams (1984).

name: Shah Rukh Khan
title: Shah Rukh Khan
extract: Shah Rukh Khan, popularly known by the initials SRK, is an Indian actor and film producer renowned for his work in Hindi cinema. Referred to in the media as the "Baadshah of Bollywood" and "King Khan", he has appeared in more than 90 films and earned numerous accolades, including a National Film Award and 15 Filmfare Awards. He has been awarded the Padma Shri by the Government of India, as well as the Order of Arts and Letters and Legion of Honour by the Government of France. Khan has a significant following in Asia and among the Indian diaspora worldwide. In terms of audience size and income, several media outlets have described him as one of the most successful film stars in the world. Many of his films thematise Indian national identity and connections with diaspora communities, or gender, racial, social and religious differences and grievances.
extract_id: Shah Rukh Khan, yang populer dikenal dengan inisial SRK, adalah aktor dan produser film India yang terkenal atas karyanya di perfilman Hindi. Disebut oleh media sebagai "Baadshah of Bollywood" dan "King Khan", ia telah tampil dalam lebih dari 90 film dan meraih berbagai penghargaan, termasuk National Film Award dan 15 Filmfare Awards. Ia dianugerahi Padma Shri oleh Pemerintah India, serta Order of Arts and Letters dan Legion of Honour oleh Pemerintah Prancis. Khan memiliki pengikut signifikan di Asia dan di antara diaspora India di seluruh dunia. Dari segi ukuran penonton dan penghasilan, beberapa media menyebutnya sebagai salah satu bintang film paling sukses di dunia. Banyak filmnya mengangkat tema identitas nasional India dan hubungan dengan komunitas diaspora, atau perbedaan dan permasalahan gender, ras, sosial, dan agama.

name: Shahab Hosseini
title: Shahab Hosseini
extract: Sayyid Shahabeddin Hosseini Tonekaboni, known professionally as Shahab Hosseini, is an Iranian actor and producer. he was nominated for the Crystal Simorgh for Best Supporting Actor at the Fajr Film Festival for his performances in A Candle in the Wind (2003) and Redemption at 8:20 (2004). In 2008, Hosseini won the Crystal Simorgh for Best Actor at the Fajr Film Festival for his role in Superstar.
extract_id: Sayyid Shahabeddin Hosseini Tonekaboni, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Shahab Hosseini, adalah aktor dan produser Iran. Ia dinominasikan untuk Crystal Simorgh untuk Best Supporting Actor di Festival Film Fajr untuk penampilannya dalam A Candle in the Wind (2003) dan Redemption at 8:20 (2004). Pada 2008, Hosseini memenangkan Crystal Simorgh untuk Best Actor di Festival Film Fajr atas perannya dalam Superstar.

name: Shahid Kapoor
title: Shahid Kapoor
extract: Shahid Pankaj Kapoor is an Indian actor who works in Hindi films. Initially recognised for portraying romantic roles, he has since taken on parts in action films and thrillers. One of the highest-paid Indian actors, he has featured in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list since 2012. Kapoor is the recipient of several awards, including three Filmfare Awards.
extract_id: Shahid Pankaj Kapoor adalah aktor India yang berkarya dalam film-film Hindi. Awalnya dikenal karena memerankan peran romantis, ia kemudian mengambil bagian dalam film aksi dan thriller. Sebagai salah satu aktor India dengan bayaran tertinggi, ia telah masuk dalam daftar Forbes India's Celebrity 100 sejak 2012. Kapoor menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk tiga Filmfare Awards.

name: Shailene Woodley
title: Shailene Woodley
extract: Shailene Diann Woodley is an American actress. Known for her work on screen and stage, her accolades include a Primetime Emmy Award and a Trophée Chopard, in addition to nominations for two Actor Awards, a British Academy Film Award, and two Golden Globes.
extract_id: Shailene Diann Woodley adalah aktris Amerika. Dikenal atas karyanya di layar dan panggung, penghargaan yang diterimanya meliputi Primetime Emmy Award dan Trophée Chopard, selain nominasi untuk dua Actor Awards, British Academy Film Award, dan dua Golden Globes.

name: Shameik Moore
title: Shameik Moore
extract: Shameik Alti Moore is an American actor and musician. He made his lead acting debut in Dope (2015), and is best known for voicing Miles Morales / Spider-Man in the animated Spider-Verse film series and for portraying Wu-Tang Clan member Raekwon in the Hulu series Wu-Tang: An American Saga.
extract_id: Shameik Alti Moore adalah aktor dan musisi Amerika. Ia memulai debut peran utama dalam Dope (2015), dan dikenal sebagai pengisi suara Miles Morales / Spider-Man dalam seri film animasi Spider-Verse serta memerankan anggota Wu-Tang Clan Raekwon dalam serial Hulu Wu-Tang: An American Saga.

name: Shammi Kapoor
title: Shammi Kapoor
extract: Shammi Kapoor was an Indian actor known for his work in Hindi cinema. Kapoor is regarded as one of the greatest actors in the history of Indian cinema. In a career spanning over five decades, he worked in over 100 films and was the recipient of three Filmfare Awards, including one for Best Actor.
extract_id: Shammi Kapoor adalah aktor India yang dikenal karena karyanya di sinema Hindi. Kapoor dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar dalam sejarah sinema India. Dalam karier yang berlangsung lebih dari lima dekade, ia telah bekerja dalam lebih dari 100 film dan menerima tiga Penghargaan Filmfare, termasuk satu untuk Aktor Terbaik.

name: Shane Meadows
title: Shane Meadows
extract: Shane Meadows is an English director, screenwriter and actor, known for his work in independent film, most notably the cult film This Is England (2006) and its three television sequels (2010–2015).
extract_id: Shane Meadows adalah sutradara, penulis skenario, dan aktor Inggris, yang dikenal karena karyanya di film independen, terutama film kultus This Is England (2006) dan tiga sekuel televisinya (2010–2015).

name: Sharlto Copley
title: Sharlto Copley
extract: Sharlto Copley is a South African actor. His acting credits include lead roles in the Academy Award-nominated science fiction film District 9; the 2010 adaptation of The A-Team; the science fiction film Elysium; the science fiction horror film Europa Report; the 2014 dark fantasy adventure film Maleficent; and the 2022 thriller Beast. He also played the title character in the 2015 science fiction film Chappie, played Jimmy in the 2015 science fiction action film Hardcore Henry, and starred in two seasons as Christian Walker of the TV series Powers (2015-16). In 2025 he played Leo Bonhart in season 4 of the Netflix TV series The Witcher.
extract_id: Sharlto Copley adalah aktor Afrika Selatan. Kredit aktingnya termasuk peran utama dalam film fiksi ilmiah yang dinominasikan untuk Academy Award District 9; adaptasi tahun 2010 dari The A-Team; film fiksi ilmiah Elysium; film horor fiksi ilmiah Europa Report; film petualangan fantasi gelap Maleficent tahun 2014; dan thriller Beast tahun 2022. Ia juga memerankan karakter utama dalam film fiksi ilmiah Chappie tahun 2015, memerankan Jimmy dalam film aksi fiksi ilmiah Hardcore Henry tahun 2015, dan membintangi dua musim sebagai Christian Walker dalam serial TV Powers (2015-16). Pada tahun 2025, ia memerankan Leo Bonhart dalam musim ke-4 serial TV Netflix The Witcher.

name: Sharman Joshi
title: Sharman Joshi
extract: Sharman Joshi is an Indian actor who primarily works in Hindi films. Joshi is a recipient of several awards including an IIFA Award and nominations for two Filmfare Awards.
extract_id: Sharman Joshi adalah aktor India yang terutama bekerja dalam film Hindi. Joshi menerima beberapa penghargaan termasuk Penghargaan IIFA dan nominasi untuk dua Penghargaan Filmfare.

name: Sharon Percy
title: Sharon Percy
extract: Sharon Percy is a British actress.
extract_id: Sharon Percy adalah aktris asal Inggris.

name: Sharon Stone
title: Sharon Stone
extract: Sharon Vonne Stone is an American actress. Known for primarily playing femmes fatales and women of mystery in film and television, she became one of the most popular sex symbols of the 1990s. Her accolades include a Primetime Emmy Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a nomination for an Academy Award. She was named Officer of the Order of Arts and Letters in France in 2005.
extract_id: Sharon Vonne Stone adalah aktris Amerika. Dikenal karena sering memerankan femme fatale dan wanita misterius dalam film dan televisi, dia menjadi salah satu simbol seks paling populer di tahun 1990-an. Penghargaan yang dimilikinya meliputi Primetime Emmy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan nominasi Academy Award. Dia diangkat sebagai Officer of the Order of Arts and Letters di Prancis pada tahun 2005.

name: Sheetal Menon
title: Sheetal Menon
extract: Sheetal Menon is an Indian model and former actress, who works predominantly in Hindi films and television.
extract_id: Sheetal Menon adalah model dan mantan aktris India, yang bekerja terutama dalam film dan televisi Hindi.

name: Shelley Duvall
title: Shelley Duvall
extract: Shelley Alexis Duvall was an American actress and producer known for her distinctive screen presence, portrayals of eccentric characters, and later productions in children's programming. Her accolades include a Cannes Award and a Peabody Award, in addition to nominations for a British Academy Film Award and two Primetime Emmy Awards. Four of Duvall's films have been preserved in the National Film Registry by the Library of Congress as "culturally, historically, or aesthetically significant" as of 2025.
extract_id: Shelley Alexis Duvall adalah aktris dan produser Amerika yang dikenal karena kehadiran layar yang khas, penggambaran karakter eksentrik, dan kemudian produksi dalam program anak-anak. Penghargaannya termasuk Penghargaan Cannes dan Penghargaan Peabody, selain nominasi untuk British Academy Film Award dan dua Primetime Emmy Awards. Empat film Duvall telah dilestarikan dalam National Film Registry oleh Library of Congress sebagai "bermakna secara budaya, sejarah, atau estetis" pada tahun 2025.

name: Shelley Winters
title: Shelley Winters
extract: Shelley Winters was an American actress, whose film career spanned seven decades. In 1943 she changed her name to Shelley, after her favorite poet, and Winter(s) taking her mother's maiden name. She won two Academy Awards for The Diary of Anne Frank (1959) and A Patch of Blue (1965), and received Oscar nominations for A Place in the Sun (1951) and The Poseidon Adventure (1972). She was also a Golden Globe Award winner for the Poseidon Adventure, a Primetime Emmy Award winner, and a two-time BAFTA Award nominee. She was an active member of the Actors Studio.
extract_id: Shelley Winters adalah aktris Amerika, dengan karier film yang berlangsung selama tujuh dekade. Pada tahun 1943 ia mengganti namanya menjadi Shelley, setelah penyair favoritnya, dan Winter(s) mengambil nama keluarga ibunya. Dia memenangkan dua Academy Awards untuk The Diary of Anne Frank (1959) dan A Patch of Blue (1965), serta menerima nominasi Oscar untuk A Place in the Sun (1951) dan The Poseidon Adventure (1972). Dia juga adalah pemenang Golden Globe Award untuk The Poseidon Adventure, pemenang Primetime Emmy Award, dan dua kali nominee BAFTA Award. Dia merupakan anggota aktif Actors Studio.

name: Shernaz Patel
title: Shernaz Patel
extract: Shernaz Patel is an Indian film and theatre actress, who works in Hindi and English films, most known for her roles in films like Black (2005) and Guzaarish (2010) and English language theatre in Mumbai. She made her theatre debut with The Diary Of Anne Frank in 1984. Since then, she has acted in several noted productions in Mumbai-based English theatre, and formed RAGE theatre group in Mumbai, with Rahul da Cunha and Rajit Kapur in 1993. She has also given voice to the character of Yashoda in the TV series Little Krishna.
extract_id: Shernaz Patel adalah aktris film dan teater India, yang bekerja dalam film Hindi dan Inggris, paling dikenal karena perannya dalam film seperti Black (2005) dan Guzaarish (2010) serta teater berbahasa Inggris di Mumbai. Dia memulai debut teaternya dengan The Diary Of Anne Frank pada tahun 1984. Sejak saat itu, dia telah berakting dalam beberapa produksi ternama di teater berbahasa Inggris yang berbasis di Mumbai, dan membentuk grup teater RAGE di Mumbai bersama Rahul da Cunha dan Rajit Kapur pada tahun 1993. Dia juga mengisi suara karakter Yashoda dalam serial TV Little Krishna.

name: Shigeru Muroi
title: Shigeru Muroi
extract: Shigeru Muroi is a Japanese actress. She won the award for Best Supporting Actress at the 19th Hochi Film Awards for Izakaya Yūrei. She is known for her role as Reiko Onda on Yappari Neko ga Suki series. she also starred in two television drama series Shinryounaikai Ryoko and Koritsuku Natsu in late 90's.
extract_id: Shigeru Muroi adalah aktris Jepang. Dia memenangkan penghargaan Pemeran Pendukung Terbaik di Penghargaan Film Hochi ke-19 untuk Izakaya Yūrei. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Reiko Onda dalam serial Yappari Neko ga Suki. Dia juga membintangi dua serial drama televisi Shinryounaikai Ryoko dan Koritsuku Natsu pada akhir 90-an.

name: Shigesato Itoi
title: Shigesato Itoi
extract: Shigesato Itoi is a Japanese copywriter, essayist, lyricist, game designer, and actor. Itoi is the editor-in-chief of his website and company Hobo Nikkan Itoi Shinbun where he is currently the chairman and CEO.
extract_id: Shigesato Itoi adalah penulis naskah iklan, esais, penulis lirik, perancang game, dan aktor Jepang. Itoi adalah pemimpin redaksi dari situs web dan perusahaan miliknya Hobo Nikkan Itoi Shinbun di mana saat ini dia menjabat sebagai ketua dan CEO.

name: Shilpa Shukla
title: Shilpa Shukla
extract: Shilpa Shukla is an Indian film and theatre actress. She is known for her roles in the 2007 sports drama Chak De! India and the 2013 neo-noir film B.A. Pass, for which she was awarded the Filmfare Critics Award for Best Actress.
extract_id: Shilpa Shukla adalah aktris film dan teater India. Dia dikenal karena perannya dalam drama olahraga tahun 2007 Chak De! India dan film neo-noir tahun 2013 B.A. Pass, yang memberikannya Penghargaan Kritikus Filmfare untuk Aktris Terbaik.

name: Shima Iwashita
title: Shima Iwashita
extract: Shima Iwashita is a Japanese stage and film actress who has appeared in films of Yasujirō Ozu, Keisuke Kinoshita, Masaki Kobayashi and most frequently of Masahiro Shinoda, her husband. She is best known for starring in the Yakuza Wives series of yakuza films between 1986 and 1998. In 2000, Iwashita ranked tenth on Kinema Junpo's readers' poll of the top female movie stars of the 20th century. In 2025, she was ranked fourth in a poll conducted by Sankei Shimbun on the top actresses of the Shōwa era.
extract_id: Shima Iwashita adalah aktris panggung dan film Jepang yang telah tampil dalam film-film Yasujirō Ozu, Keisuke Kinoshita, Masaki Kobayashi dan paling sering Masahiro Shinoda, suaminya. Dia paling dikenal karena membintangi seri film Yakuza Wives antara tahun 1986 dan 1998. Pada tahun 2000, Iwashita menempati peringkat kesepuluh dalam jajak pendapat pembaca Kinema Junpo tentang bintang film wanita terbaik abad ke-20. Pada tahun 2025, dia menempati peringkat keempat dalam jajak pendapat yang dilakukan oleh Sankei Shimbun tentang aktris terbaik era Shōwa.

name: Shimit Amin
title: Shimit Amin
extract: Shimit Amin is an Indian film director and editor. He is best known for directing Chak De! India (2007) starring Shah Rukh Khan.
extract_id: Shimit Amin adalah sutradara dan editor film India. Dia paling dikenal karena mengarahkan Chak De! India (2007) yang dibintangi Shah Rukh Khan.

name: Shin Ha-kyun
title: Shin Ha-kyun
extract: Shin Ha-kyun is a South Korean actor. He first gained recognition for his role in Joint Security Area (2000), followed by notable performances in Sympathy for Mr. Vengeance (2002), Save the Green Planet! (2003), and Welcome to Dongmakgol (2005). Shin has also been active in television, earning praise for his roles in Brain (2011), Less Than Evil (2018–2019), and Beyond Evil (2021), the latter of which earned him the Baeksang Arts Award for Best Actor.
extract_id: Shin Ha-kyun adalah aktor Korea Selatan. Dia pertama kali dikenal lewat perannya dalam Joint Security Area (2000), diikuti penampilan penting dalam Sympathy for Mr. Vengeance (2002), Save the Green Planet! (2003), dan Welcome to Dongmakgol (2005). Shin juga aktif di televisi, mendapatkan pujian atas perannya dalam Brain (2011), Less Than Evil (2018–2019), dan Beyond Evil (2021), yang terakhir memberinya Penghargaan Baeksang Arts untuk Aktor Terbaik.

name: Shin'ichi Himori
title: Shinichi Himori
extract: Shinichi Himori , born Kazuo Moriyama , was a Japanese film actor. He appeared in more than seventy films from 1925 to 1959.
extract_id: Shinichi Himori, lahir sebagai Kazuo Moriyama, adalah aktor film Jepang. Dia tampil dalam lebih dari tujuh puluh film dari tahun 1925 hingga 1959.

name: Shin'ichirô Watanabe
title: Shinichirō Watanabe
extract: Shinichirō Watanabe is a Japanese anime television and film director, best known for directing the critically acclaimed and commercially successful anime series Cowboy Bebop, Macross Plus, Samurai Champloo, Space Dandy, Terror in Resonance, and Carole & Tuesday. Watanabe's work is characterized by evocative uses of music, mature themes, and the incorporation of multiple film genres.
extract_id: Shinichirō Watanabe adalah sutradara anime televisi dan film Jepang, paling dikenal karena menyutradarai serial anime yang dikritik dan sukses secara komersial seperti Cowboy Bebop, Macross Plus, Samurai Champloo, Space Dandy, Terror in Resonance, dan Carole & Tuesday. Karya Watanabe dicirikan oleh penggunaan musik yang evocative, tema dewasa, dan penggabungan berbagai genre film.

name: Shirley Eaton
title: Shirley Eaton
extract: Shirley Jean Eaton is an English former actress and singer. Eaton appeared regularly in British films throughout the 1950s and 1960s, and gained her highest profile for her appearance as Bond Girl Jill Masterson in the James Bond film Goldfinger (1964), which gained her bombshell status. Eaton also had roles in the early Carry On films.
extract_id: Shirley Jean Eaton adalah mantan aktris dan penyanyi Inggris. Eaton sering tampil dalam film-film Inggris sepanjang tahun 1950-an dan 1960-an, dan meraih profil tertingginya sebagai Bond Girl Jill Masterson dalam film James Bond Goldfinger (1964), yang memberinya status bombshell. Eaton juga berperan dalam film-film Carry On awal.

name: Shirley MacLaine
title: Shirley MacLaine
extract: Shirley MacLaine is an American actress and author. With a career spanning over 70 years, she has received numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, an Emmy Award, two BAFTA Awards, six Golden Globe Awards, two Volpi Cups, and two Silver Bears. She has been honored with the Film Society of Lincoln Center Tribute in 1995, the Cecil B. DeMille Award in 1998, the AFI Life Achievement Award in 2012, and the Kennedy Center Honor in 2014. MacLaine is one of the last remaining stars from the Golden Age of Hollywood.
extract_id: Shirley MacLaine adalah aktris dan penulis Amerika. Dengan karier lebih dari 70 tahun, dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, Emmy Award, dua BAFTA Awards, enam Golden Globe Awards, dua Volpi Cups, dan dua Silver Bears. Dia telah dihormati dengan Tribute dari Film Society of Lincoln Center pada 1995, Cecil B. DeMille Award pada 1998, AFI Life Achievement Award pada 2012, dan Kennedy Center Honor pada 2014. MacLaine adalah salah satu bintang terakhir yang tersisa dari Era Keemasan Hollywood.

name: Shishir Sharma
title: Shishir Sharma
extract: Shishir Sharma is an Indian film and television actor. He appeared in Zee TV's Ghar Ki Lakshmi Betiyann, and is known for playing the role of Jagmohan Prasad in Yahaaan Main Ghar Ghar Kheli. Currently, he can be seen in second season of the web-show Permanent Roommates on TVFPlay. Sharma has acted in more than 40 films and TV serials including Story of a Lonely Goldfish, Swabhimaan, Bombay Boys, Sarkar Raj and The Second Best Exotic Marigold Hotel. His film Mission Raniganj with Gaurav Prateek was released on 6 October 2023
extract_id: Shishir Sharma adalah aktor film dan televisi India. Dia tampil dalam Ghar Ki Lakshmi Betiyann di Zee TV, dan dikenal karena memerankan peran Jagmohan Prasad dalam Yahaaan Main Ghar Ghar Kheli. Saat ini, ia dapat dilihat dalam musim kedua serial web Permanent Roommates di TVFPlay. Sharma telah berperan dalam lebih dari 40 film dan serial TV termasuk Story of a Lonely Goldfish, Swabhimaan, Bombay Boys, Sarkar Raj dan The Second Best Exotic Marigold Hotel. Filmnya Mission Raniganj bersama Gaurav Prateek dirilis pada 6 Oktober 2023.

name: Shoojit Sircar
title: Shoojit Sircar
extract: Shoojit Sircar is an Indian filmmaker, director and producer known for his work in Hindi films. He has received several awards, including three National Film Awards and two Filmfare Awards from five nominations.
extract_id: Shoojit Sircar adalah pembuat film, sutradara, dan produser India yang dikenal karena karyanya dalam film Hindi. Dia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk tiga Penghargaan Film Nasional dan dua Penghargaan Filmfare dari lima nominasi.

name: Shraddha Kapoor
title: Shraddha Kapoor
extract: Shraddha Kapoor is an Indian actress who primarily works in Hindi films. One of India's highest-paid actresses, Kapoor has been featured in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list since 2014 and was featured by Forbes Asia in their 30 Under 30 list of 2016.
extract_id: Shraddha Kapoor adalah aktris India yang terutama bekerja dalam film Hindi. Salah satu aktris dengan bayaran tertinggi di India, Kapoor telah masuk dalam daftar Forbes India Celebrity 100 sejak 2014 dan muncul dalam daftar Forbes Asia 30 Under 30 pada tahun 2016.

name: Shraddha Srinath
title: Shraddha Srinath
extract: Shraddha Srinath is an Indian actress who predominantly appears in Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam and Telugu films. Shraddha is a recipient of several awards including two Filmfare Awards South and two SIIMA Award.
extract_id: Shraddha Srinath adalah aktris India yang sebagian besar tampil dalam film Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, dan Telugu. Shraddha menerima beberapa penghargaan termasuk dua Penghargaan Filmfare Selatan dan dua Penghargaan SIIMA.

name: Shriya Saran
title: Shriya Saran
extract: Shriya Saran Bhatnagar is an Indian actress who primarily works in Tamil, Telugu and Hindi films. Although Saran aspired to become a dancer, she became an actress and made her film debut with the Telugu film Ishtam (2001). She had her first commercial success with Santosham (2002).
extract_id: Shriya Saran Bhatnagar adalah aktris India yang terutama bekerja dalam film Tamil, Telugu, dan Hindi. Meskipun Saran bercita-cita menjadi penari, dia menjadi aktris dan memulai debut filmnya dengan film Telugu Ishtam (2001). Dia meraih kesuksesan komersial pertamanya dengan Santosham (2002).

name: Shûichirô Moriyama
title: Shūichirō Moriyama
extract: Hiroo Ōtsuka , known by the stage name Shūichirō Moriyama , was a Japanese actor and voice actor. He was the official Japanese dub-over artist of actors Telly Savalas, Jean Gabin, Spencer Tracy, and Lino Ventura.
extract_id: Hiroo Ōtsuka, yang dikenal dengan nama panggung Shūichirō Moriyama, adalah seorang aktor dan pengisi suara asal Jepang. Dia adalah artis pengisi suara resmi Jepang untuk aktor Telly Savalas, Jean Gabin, Spencer Tracy, dan Lino Ventura.

name: Shûsuke Kaneko
title: Shusuke Kaneko
extract: Shusuke Kaneko is a Japanese filmmaker. He is best known for revitalizing the kaiju genre with the critically acclaimed Heisei Gamera film trilogy and Godzilla, Mothra and King Ghidorah: Giant Monsters All-Out Attack (2001).
extract_id: Shusuke Kaneko adalah seorang pembuat film Jepang. Dia dikenal karena menghidupkan kembali genre kaiju dengan trilogi film Heisei Gamera yang mendapat pujian kritis dan Godzilla, Mothra and King Ghidorah: Giant Monsters All-Out Attack (2001).

name: Sibel Kekilli
title: Sibel Kekilli
extract: Sibel Kekilli is a German actress. She gained public attention after starring in the 2004 film Head-On. She won two Lolas, the most prestigious German film award, for her performances in Head-On and When We Leave (2010). Beginning in 2011, she became more widely known for her role as Shae in the HBO series Game of Thrones.
extract_id: Sibel Kekilli adalah seorang aktris Jerman. Dia menarik perhatian publik setelah membintangi film Head-On tahun 2004. Dia memenangkan dua Lolas, penghargaan film Jerman paling bergengsi, untuk penampilannya dalam Head-On dan When We Leave (2010). Mulai tahun 2011, dia lebih dikenal luas berkat perannya sebagai Shae dalam serial HBO Game of Thrones.

name: Siddharth
title: Siddharth (actor)
extract: Siddharth Suryanarayan, known mononymously as Siddharth, is an Indian actor who primarily works in Tamil, Telugu, and Hindi language films. Apart from acting, he has also been involved in films as a screenwriter, producer and playback singer. Siddharth is a recipient of several accolades including three Filmfare Awards South and a Tamil Nadu State Film Award.
extract_id: Siddharth Suryanarayan, dikenal secara mononim sebagai Siddharth, adalah aktor India yang sebagian besar bekerja dalam film berbahasa Tamil, Telugu, dan Hindi. Selain berakting, dia juga terlibat dalam film sebagai penulis naskah, produser, dan penyanyi playback. Siddharth telah menerima beberapa penghargaan termasuk tiga Filmfare Awards South dan Tamil Nadu State Film Award.

name: Sidney Blackmer
title: Sidney Blackmer
extract: Sidney Alderman Blackmer was an American Broadway and film actor active between 1914 and 1971, usually in major supporting roles.
extract_id: Sidney Alderman Blackmer adalah aktor Broadway dan film Amerika yang aktif antara tahun 1914 dan 1971, biasanya dalam peran pendukung utama.

name: Sidney Lumet
title: Sidney Lumet
extract: Sidney Arthur Lumet was an American film director. Lumet started his career in theatre before moving to directing television in 1950, and then directing films from 1957, where he gained a reputation for making realistic and gritty New York dramas that focused on the working class, tackled social injustices, and often questioned authority. He received various accolades including an Academy Honorary Award and a Golden Globe Award as well as nominations for nine British Academy Film Awards and a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Sidney Arthur Lumet adalah seorang sutradara film Amerika. Lumet memulai kariernya di teater sebelum beralih ke penyutradaraan televisi pada tahun 1950, dan kemudian menyutradarai film sejak 1957, di mana ia dikenal karena membuat drama New York yang realistis dan kasar yang berfokus pada kelas pekerja, menangani ketidakadilan sosial, dan sering mempertanyakan otoritas. Ia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Academy Honorary Award dan Golden Globe Award serta nominasi untuk sembilan British Academy Film Awards dan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Sidney Poitier
title: Sidney Poitier
description: Bahamian-American actor, filmmaker, diplomat and author (1927–2022)
extract: Sidney Poitier was a Bahamian-American actor, film director, activist, and diplomat. In 1964, he was the first black male actor and first Bahamian to win the Academy Award for Best Actor. Among his other accolades are two competitive Golden Globe Awards, a BAFTA Award and a Grammy Award, in addition to nominations for two Emmy Awards and a Tony Award. In 1999, he was ranked number 22 among the "American Film Institute's 100 Stars". Poitier was one of the last surviving stars from the Golden Age of Hollywood.
extract_id: Sidney Poitier adalah seorang aktor, sutradara film, aktivis, dan diplomat asal Bahama-Amerika. Pada tahun 1964, ia menjadi aktor pria kulit hitam pertama dan orang Bahama pertama yang memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktor Terbaik. Di antara penghargaan lainnya adalah dua Golden Globe Awards kompetitif, BAFTA Award, dan Grammy Award, selain nominasi untuk dua Emmy Awards dan Tony Award. Pada 1999, ia menduduki peringkat nomor 22 dalam "American Film Institute's 100 Stars". Poitier adalah salah satu bintang terakhir yang masih hidup dari Era Keemasan Hollywood.

name: Sidse Babett Knudsen
title: Sidse Babett Knudsen
extract: Sidse Babett Knudsen is a Danish actress who works in theatre, television, and film. Knudsen made her screen debut in the 1997 improvisational comedy Let's Get Lost, for which she received both the Robert and Bodil awards for Best Actress.
extract_id: Sidse Babett Knudsen adalah seorang aktris Denmark yang bekerja di teater, televisi, dan film. Knudsen membuat debut layar pada tahun 1997 dalam komedi improvisasi Let's Get Lost, yang membuatnya menerima penghargaan Robert dan Bodil untuk Aktris Terbaik.

name: Sienna Miller
title: Sienna Miller
extract: Sienna Rose Diana Miller is a British actress. She began her career as a model, appearing in the pages of Italian Vogue and for the 2003 Pirelli Calendar. Her acting breakthrough came in the 2004 films Layer Cake and Alfie. She portrayed socialite Edie Sedgwick in Factory Girl (2006) and author Caitlin Macnamara in The Edge of Love (2008), and was nominated for the BAFTA Rising Star Award in 2008. Her role as The Baroness in G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra (2009) was followed by a brief sabbatical from the screen amid increased tabloid scrutiny.
extract_id: Sienna Rose Diana Miller adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Dia memulai kariernya sebagai model, tampil di majalah Italian Vogue dan untuk Kalender Pirelli 2003. Terobosan aktingnya datang melalui film Layer Cake dan Alfie tahun 2004. Dia memerankan socialite Edie Sedgwick dalam Factory Girl (2006) dan penulis Caitlin Macnamara dalam The Edge of Love (2008), serta dinominasikan untuk BAFTA Rising Star Award pada 2008. Perannya sebagai The Baroness dalam G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra (2009) diikuti oleh masa cuti singkat dari layar lebar di tengah meningkatnya pengawasan media tabloid.

name: Sigourney Weaver
title: Sigourney Weaver
extract: Susan Alexandra "Sigourney" Weaver is an American actress. Prolific in film since the late 1970s, she is known for her pioneering portrayals of action heroines in blockbusters and for her various roles in independent films. She is the recipient of numerous accolades, including a British Academy Film Award, two Golden Globe Awards, and a Grammy Award, in addition to nominations for three Academy Awards, four Primetime Emmy Awards, and a Tony Award.
extract_id: Susan Alexandra "Sigourney" Weaver adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Aktif di dunia film sejak akhir 1970-an, dia dikenal karena perannya yang pionir sebagai pahlawan aksi dalam film blockbuster dan berbagai peran dalam film independen. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk British Academy Film Award, dua Golden Globe Awards, dan Grammy Award, serta nominasi untuk tiga Academy Awards, empat Primetime Emmy Awards, dan Tony Award.

name: Silvia Pinal
title: Silvia Pinal
extract: Silvia Pinal Hidalgo was a Mexican actress and politician. She began her career in theatre before venturing into cinema in 1949. She became one of the greatest female stars of the Golden Age of Mexican cinema and, with her performance in Shark! (1969), part of the Golden Age of Hollywood. Her work in film and popularity in her native country led Pinal to work in Europe, particularly in Spain and Italy. Pinal achieved international recognition by starring in a trilogy of films directed by Luis Buñuel: Viridiana (1961), The Exterminating Angel (1962) and Simon of the Desert (1965).
extract_id: Silvia Pinal Hidalgo adalah seorang aktris dan politisi Meksiko. Dia memulai kariernya di teater sebelum terjun ke dunia film pada tahun 1949. Dia menjadi salah satu bintang wanita terbesar pada Era Keemasan sinema Meksiko dan, dengan penampilannya dalam Shark! (1969), bagian dari Era Keemasan Hollywood. Pekerjaannya di film dan popularitasnya di tanah kelahirannya membuat Pinal bekerja di Eropa, khususnya di Spanyol dan Italia. Pinal mendapatkan pengakuan internasional dengan membintangi trilogi film yang disutradarai oleh Luis Buñuel: Viridiana (1961), The Exterminating Angel (1962), dan Simon of the Desert (1965).

name: Simon Pegg
title: Simon Pegg
extract: Simon John Pegg is an English actor, comedian and screenwriter. He came to prominence in the UK as the co-creator of the Channel 4 sitcom Spaced (1999–2001), directed by Edgar Wright. He and Wright co-wrote the films Shaun of the Dead (2004), Hot Fuzz (2007), and The World's End (2013), known collectively as the Three Flavours Cornetto trilogy, all of which saw Wright directing and Pegg starring alongside Nick Frost. Pegg and Frost also wrote and starred in the sci-fi comedy film Paul (2011).
extract_id: Simon John Pegg adalah aktor, komedian, dan penulis skenario Inggris. Dia menjadi terkenal di Inggris sebagai pencipta bersama sitkom Channel 4 Spaced (1999–2001), yang disutradarai Edgar Wright. Dia dan Wright menulis bersama film Shaun of the Dead (2004), Hot Fuzz (2007), dan The World's End (2013), yang dikenal sebagai trilogi Three Flavours Cornetto, semuanya disutradarai Wright dengan Pegg membintangi bersama Nick Frost. Pegg dan Frost juga menulis dan membintangi film komedi sci-fi Paul (2011).

name: Simon Yam
title: Simon Yam
extract: Simon Yam Tat-wah is a Hong Kong actor and film producer. He is best known for his collaborations with filmmaker Johnnie To in PTU (2003), Election (2005), Triangle (2007), and Sparrow (2008). His other notable films include SPL: Sha Po Lang (2005), Night & Fog (2009), and Echoes of the Rainbow (2010).
extract_id: Simon Yam Tat-wah adalah aktor dan produser film Hong Kong. Dia dikenal karena kolaborasinya dengan pembuat film Johnnie To dalam PTU (2003), Election (2005), Triangle (2007), dan Sparrow (2008). Film terkenalnya lainnya termasuk SPL: Sha Po Lang (2005), Night & Fog (2009), dan Echoes of the Rainbow (2010).

name: Simone Signoret
title: Simone Signoret
extract: Simone Signoret was a French actress. She received various accolades, including an Academy Award, three BAFTA Awards, a César Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, and the Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Actress, in addition to nominations for two Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Simone Signoret adalah seorang aktris Prancis. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, tiga BAFTA Awards, César Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dan Penghargaan Festival Film Cannes untuk Aktris Terbaik, serta nominasi untuk dua Golden Globe Awards.

name: Sissy Spacek
title: Sissy Spacek
extract: Mary Elizabeth "Sissy" Spacek is an American actress and singer. She has received numerous accolades throughout her career spanning over five decades, including an Academy Award, three Golden Globe Awards, and a Screen Actors Guild Award as well as nominations for four British Academy Film Awards, three Primetime Emmy Awards, and a Grammy Award. For her contributions to the film industry, Spacek was honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 2012.
extract_id: Mary Elizabeth "Sissy" Spacek adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Amerika. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan sepanjang kariernya yang berlangsung lebih dari lima dekade, termasuk Academy Award, tiga Golden Globe Awards, dan Screen Actors Guild Award serta nominasi untuk empat British Academy Film Awards, tiga Primetime Emmy Awards, dan Grammy Award. Untuk kontribusinya di industri film, Spacek dianugerahi bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada tahun 2012.

name: Siu-Wong Fan
title: Louis Fan (actor)
description: Hong Kong actor and martial artist
extract: Louis Fan Siu-wong is a Hong Kong actor and martial artist. He is best known worldwide for his starring role as Ricky in Riki-Oh: The Story of Ricky (1991) and as Jin Shanzhao in Ip Man (2008) and Ip Man 2 (2010), as well as roles in numerous television series produced by TVB.
extract_id: Louis Fan Siu-wong adalah aktor dan ahli seni bela diri Hong Kong. Dia dikenal di seluruh dunia karena perannya sebagai Ricky dalam Riki-Oh: The Story of Ricky (1991) dan sebagai Jin Shanzhao dalam Ip Man (2008) dan Ip Man 2 (2010), serta berbagai peran dalam banyak serial televisi yang diproduksi oleh TVB.

name: Slavko Stimac
title: Slavko Štimac
extract: Slavko Štimac is a Serbian actor.
extract_id: Slavko Štimac adalah seorang aktor Serbia.

name: Slim Pickens
title: Slim Pickens
extract: Louis Burton Lindley, better known by his stage name Slim Pickens, was an American actor and rodeo performer. Starting off in the rodeo, Pickens took up acting, and appeared in dozens of movies and TV shows. For much of his career, Pickens played cowboy roles. He played comic roles in Dr. Strangelove, Blazing Saddles, 1941, and had a villainous role in One-Eyed Jacks with Marlon Brando.
extract_id: Louis Burton Lindley, yang lebih dikenal dengan nama panggung Slim Pickens, adalah aktor dan pemain rodeo Amerika. Awalnya dari dunia rodeo, Pickens kemudian terjun ke dunia akting, dan tampil dalam puluhan film dan acara TV. Selama kariernya, Pickens sering memerankan peran koboi. Dia memainkan peran komik dalam Dr. Strangelove, Blazing Saddles, 1941, dan memainkan peran jahat dalam One-Eyed Jacks bersama Marlon Brando.

name: Sofia Coppola
title: Sofia Coppola
extract: Sofia Carmina Coppola is an American filmmaker and former actress. She has received various accolades, including an Academy Award, two Golden Globe Awards, a Golden Lion, and a Cannes Film Festival Award as well as nominations for three BAFTA Awards and a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Sofia Carmina Coppola adalah pembuat film dan mantan aktris Amerika. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, dua Golden Globe Awards, Golden Lion, dan Penghargaan Festival Film Cannes serta nominasi untuk tiga BAFTA Awards dan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Soha Ali Khan
title: Soha Ali Khan
extract: Soha Ali Khan Pataudi is an Indian actress who has worked in Hindi, Bengali, and English films. She is the younger daughter of veteran actress Sharmila Tagore and former India cricket captain Mansoor Ali Khan, of Bhopal, and the younger sister of actor Saif Ali Khan. She started her acting career with the period drama film Iti Srikanta (2004) and is best known for her role in the drama film Rang De Basanti (2006) and the romance film Ahista Ahista (2006). In 2017, she authored a book The Perils of Being Moderately Famous that won the Crossword Book Award in 2018.
extract_id: Soha Ali Khan Pataudi adalah aktris India yang telah bekerja dalam film berbahasa Hindi, Bengali, dan Inggris. Dia adalah putri bungsu dari aktris veteran Sharmila Tagore dan mantan kapten kriket India Mansoor Ali Khan, dari Bhopal, serta adik perempuan aktor Saif Ali Khan. Dia memulai karier aktingnya dengan film drama periodik Iti Srikanta (2004) dan dikenal luas untuk perannya dalam film drama Rang De Basanti (2006) dan film romantis Ahista Ahista (2006). Pada 2017, dia menulis buku The Perils of Being Moderately Famous yang memenangkan Crossword Book Award pada 2018.

name: Sohum Shah
title: Sohum Shah
extract: Sohum Shah is an Indian entrepreneur, actor and producer who works in Hindi films. He was born on 16th December 1983. He made his first screen appearance in 2009 with the film Baabarr, where he played the antagonist and later appeared in the 2012 National Award-winning film Ship of Theseus which was produced under his banner, Recyclewala Films. Following his debut, Shah featured in Talvar (2015) and Simran (2017). His 2018 film Tumbbad, as producer and actor, received critical acclaim. He played in silent comedy thriller Ufff Yeh Siyapaa (2025).
extract_id: Sohum Shah adalah seorang pengusaha, aktor, dan produser India yang bekerja dalam film berbahasa Hindi. Dia lahir pada 16 Desember 1983. Dia melakukan penampilan layar pertamanya pada 2009 dengan film Baabarr, di mana dia memerankan antagonis dan kemudian tampil dalam film pemenang Penghargaan Nasional 2012 Ship of Theseus yang diproduksi di bawah banner-nya, Recyclewala Films. Setelah debutnya, Shah tampil dalam Talvar (2015) dan Simran (2017). Filmnya pada 2018, Tumbbad, sebagai produser dan aktor, menerima pujian kritis. Dia juga bermain dalam film komedi bisu thriller Ufff Yeh Siyapaa (2025).

name: Soledad Villamil
title: Soledad Villamil
extract: Soledad Villamil is an Argentine film and television actress and singer. She has won two Carlos Gardel Awards, Argentine equivalent of American Grammy Awards and British BRIT Awards besides, Goya Award for Best New Actress for the film, The Secret in Their Eyes.
extract_id: Soledad Villamil adalah aktris dan penyanyi film serta televisi Argentina. Dia telah memenangkan dua Carlos Gardel Awards, setara dengan Grammy Awards Amerika dan BRIT Awards Inggris, selain Penghargaan Goya untuk Aktris Baru Terbaik untuk film The Secret in Their Eyes.

name: Solveig Dommartin
title: Solveig Dommartin
extract: Solveig Dommartin was a French actress and filmmaker. She appeared in seven major films, including Wings of Desire (1987), Until the End of the World (1991), and Faraway, So Close! (1993). She was also known as a writer, editor (Tokyo-Ga), and director.
extract_id: Solveig Dommartin adalah seorang aktris dan pembuat film Prancis. Dia tampil dalam tujuh film utama, termasuk Wings of Desire (1987), Until the End of the World (1991), dan Faraway, So Close! (1993). Dia juga dikenal sebagai penulis, editor (Tokyo-Ga), dan sutradara.

name: Sonam Kapoor
title: Sonam Kapoor
extract: Sonam Kapoor Ahuja is an Indian former actress who worked in Hindi films. Known for portraying the lives of ordinary Indian women, she is also cited in the media as a fashion icon. She has received several awards, including a National Film Award and a Filmfare Award. Kapoor appeared in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list from 2012 to 2016.
extract_id: Sonam Kapoor Ahuja adalah mantan aktris India yang bekerja dalam film berbahasa Hindi. Dikenal karena memerankan kehidupan wanita India biasa, dia juga disebut-sebut di media sebagai ikon mode. Dia telah menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk National Film Award dan Filmfare Award. Kapoor masuk dalam daftar Forbes India Celebrity 100 dari 2012 hingga 2016.

name: Sondra Locke
title: Sondra Locke
extract: Sandra Louise Anderson, professionally known as Sondra Locke, was an American actress and director.
extract_id: Sandra Louise Anderson, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Sondra Locke, adalah seorang aktris dan sutradara Amerika.

name: Sonia Todd
title: Sonia Todd
extract: Sonia Todd is an Australian actress. She is best known for her television roles as Sgt. Georgia Rattray in Police Rescue (1989–1996), Meg Fountain in McLeod's Daughters (2001–2008) and Gina Austin in the soap opera Home and Away (2009–2013).
extract_id: Sonia Todd adalah seorang aktris Australia. Dia dikenal luas untuk peran televisinya sebagai Sgt. Georgia Rattray dalam Police Rescue (1989–1996), Meg Fountain dalam McLeod's Daughters (2001–2008) dan Gina Austin dalam opera sabun Home and Away (2009–2013).

name: Sonoya Mizuno
title: Sonoya Mizuno
extract: Sonoya Mizuno is a British actress. She is known for her collaborations with Alex Garland—most notably, portraying Kyoko in the film Ex Machina (2014) and starring in the FX miniseries Devs (2020)—as well as for her roles in the Netflix series Maniac (2018), the HBO series House of the Dragon (2022–present) and the film Crazy Rich Asians (2018).
extract_id: Sonoya Mizuno adalah seorang aktris Inggris. Dia dikenal karena kolaborasinya dengan Alex Garland—paling menonjol, memerankan Kyoko dalam film Ex Machina (2014) dan berperan dalam miniseri FX Devs (2020)—serta untuk perannya dalam serial Netflix Maniac (2018), serial HBO House of the Dragon (2022–sekarang) dan film Crazy Rich Asians (2018).

name: Sophie Kennedy Clark
title: Sophie Kennedy Clark
extract: Sophie Kennedy Clark is a Scottish actress. She is the daughter of actress and singer Fiona Kennedy and the granddaughter of singer Calum Kennedy.
extract_id: Sophie Kennedy Clark adalah seorang aktris Skotlandia. Dia adalah putri dari aktris dan penyanyi Fiona Kennedy dan cucu dari penyanyi Calum Kennedy.

name: Sophie Marceau
title: Sophie Marceau
extract: Sophie Marceau is a French actress. As a teenager, she achieved popularity with her debut films La Boum (1980) and La Boum 2 (1982), receiving a César Award for Most Promising Actress. She became a film star in Europe with a string of successful films, including L'Étudiante (1988), Pacific Palisades (1990), Fanfan (1993) and Revenge of the Musketeers (1994). She became an international film star with her performances in Braveheart (1995), Firelight (1997), Anna Karenina (1997) and as Elektra King in the 19th James Bond film The World Is Not Enough (1999). Some of her later films tackle critical social issues such as Arrêtez-moi (2013), Jailbirds (2015) and Everything Went Fine (2021).
extract_id: Sophie Marceau adalah seorang aktris Prancis. Saat remaja, dia meraih popularitas dengan film debutnya La Boum (1980) dan La Boum 2 (1982), menerima César Award untuk Most Promising Actress. Dia menjadi bintang film di Eropa dengan sederet film sukses, termasuk L'Étudiante (1988), Pacific Palisades (1990), Fanfan (1993) dan Revenge of the Musketeers (1994). Dia menjadi bintang film internasional dengan penampilannya dalam Braveheart (1995), Firelight (1997), Anna Karenina (1997) dan sebagai Elektra King dalam film James Bond ke-19 The World Is Not Enough (1999). Beberapa filmnya yang lebih baru mengangkat isu sosial kritis seperti Arrêtez-moi (2013), Jailbirds (2015) dan Everything Went Fine (2021).

name: Sophie Okonedo
title: Sophie Okonedo
extract: Sophie Okonedo is a British actress and narrator. The recipient of a Tony Award, she has been nominated for an Academy Award, three BAFTA TV Awards, an Emmy Award, two Laurence Olivier Awards, and a Golden Globe Award. She was appointed Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) in the 2010 Birthday Honours and Commander of the Order of the British Empire (CBE) in 2019 New Year Honours, both for services to drama.
extract_id: Sophie Okonedo adalah seorang aktris dan narator Inggris. Penerima Tony Award, dia telah dinominasikan untuk Academy Award, tiga BAFTA TV Awards, Emmy Award, dua Laurence Olivier Awards, dan Golden Globe Award. Dia diangkat sebagai Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) dalam Birthday Honours 2010 dan Commander of the Order of the British Empire (CBE) dalam New Year Honours 2019, keduanya untuk jasa dalam drama.

name: Spencer Tracy
title: Spencer Tracy
extract: Spencer Bonaventure Tracy was an American actor. He was known for his natural performing style and versatility. One of the major stars of Hollywood's Golden Age, Tracy was the first actor to win two consecutive Academy Awards for Best Actor, from nine nominations. During his career, he appeared in 75 films and developed a reputation among his peers as one of the screen's greatest actors. In 1999, the American Film Institute ranked Tracy as the ninth greatest male star of Classic Hollywood Cinema.
extract_id: Spencer Bonaventure Tracy adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena gaya aktingnya yang alami dan serba bisa. Salah satu bintang utama Zaman Keemasan Hollywood, Tracy adalah aktor pertama yang memenangkan dua Academy Awards berturut-turut untuk Aktor Terbaik, dari sembilan nominasi. Selama kariernya, ia tampil dalam 75 film dan mengembangkan reputasi di antara rekan-rekannya sebagai salah satu aktor layar terbesar. Pada 1999, American Film Institute menempatkan Tracy sebagai bintang pria kesembilan terbesar dalam Sinema Hollywood Klasik.

name: Spike Jonze
title: Spike Jonze
extract: Adam Spiegel, known professionally as Spike Jonze, is an American filmmaker, actor, musician, and photographer. His work includes films, commercials, music videos, skateboard videos and television.
extract_id: Adam Spiegel, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Spike Jonze, adalah seorang pembuat film, aktor, musisi, dan fotografer Amerika. Karyanya meliputi film, iklan, video musik, video skateboard, dan televisi.

name: Spike Lee
title: Spike Lee
extract: Shelton Jackson "Spike" Lee is an American filmmaker and actor. Cited by various publications as one of the most important filmmakers of the late 20th century, his work explores issues including race relations, issues within the black community, the role of media in contemporary life, urban crime and poverty. Lee has received numerous accolades including an Academy Award, a British Academy Film Award, two Primetime Emmy Awards, and three Peabody Awards, as well as nominations for three Golden Globe Awards and a Grammy Award.
extract_id: Shelton Jackson "Spike" Lee adalah seorang pembuat film dan aktor Amerika. Disebut oleh berbagai publikasi sebagai salah satu pembuat film terpenting akhir abad ke-20, karyanya mengeksplorasi isu-isu termasuk hubungan ras, masalah dalam komunitas kulit hitam, peran media dalam kehidupan kontemporer, kejahatan perkotaan dan kemiskinan. Lee telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Academy Award, British Academy Film Award, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan tiga Peabody Awards, serta nominasi untuk tiga Golden Globe Awards dan Grammy Award.

name: Sridevi
title: Sridevi
extract: Sridevi Kapoor, known mononymously as Sridevi, was an Indian actress who worked in Telugu, Tamil, Hindi, Malayalam, and Kannada language films. Cited as the "first female superstar" of Indian cinema, she was the recipient of various accolades, including a National Film Award, Seven Filmfare Awards, Tamil Nadu State Film Awards, a Kerala State Film Award, and a Nandi Award. Sridevi's career spanned over 50 years in a wide range of genres. She was known for her reticent and introverted off-screen personality, but headstrong and outspoken on-screen persona, often playing strong-willed women. In 2013, Sridevi was honoured with the Padma Shri, the country's fourth highest civilian honour.
extract_id: Sridevi Kapoor, yang dikenal secara mononim sebagai Sridevi, adalah seorang aktris India yang berkarier di film-film berbahasa Telugu, Tamil, Hindi, Malayalam, dan Kannada. Disebut sebagai "superstar wanita pertama" perfilman India, ia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk National Film Award, Tujuh Filmfare Awards, Tamil Nadu State Film Awards, Kerala State Film Award, dan Nandi Award. Karier Sridevi berlangsung lebih dari 50 tahun dalam berbagai genre. Dia dikenal karena kepribadian off-screen yang tertutup dan introvert, tetapi persona on-screen yang keras kepala dan vokal, sering memerankan wanita dengan kemauan kuat. Pada 2013, Sridevi dianugerahi Padma Shri, penghargaan sipil keempat tertinggi di negara tersebut.

name: Srinidhi Shetty
title: Srinidhi Shetty
description: Indian actress and beauty pageant titleholder (born 1992)
extract: Srinidhi Shetty is an Indian model, actress and beauty pageant title holder, who primarily works in Kannada and Telugu films. At the Miss Diva 2016 pageant, Shetty was crowned Miss Diva Supranational. She later represented India and won the Miss Supranational 2016, thus becoming the second Indian to win the crown.
extract_id: Srinidhi Shetty adalah seorang model, aktris, dan pemegang gelar kontes kecantikan India, yang terutama bekerja di film Kannada dan Telugu. Pada kontes Miss Diva 2016, Shetty dinobatkan sebagai Miss Diva Supranational. Ia kemudian mewakili India dan memenangkan Miss Supranational 2016, sehingga menjadi orang India kedua yang memenangkan mahkota tersebut.

name: Sriram Raghavan
title: Sriram Raghavan
extract: Sriram Raghavan is an Indian film director and screenwriter who works in Hindi cinema. He is primarily considered an auteur of neo-noir action thrillers.
extract_id: Sriram Raghavan adalah seorang sutradara film dan penulis skenario India yang bekerja di perfilman Hindi. Dia terutama dianggap sebagai sutradara auteur dari thriller aksi neo-noir.

name: Stanley Baker
title: Stanley Baker
extract: Sir William Stanley Baker was a Welsh actor and film producer. Known for his rugged appearance and intense, grounded screen persona, he was one of the top British male film stars of the late 1950s, and later a producer.
extract_id: Sir William Stanley Baker adalah seorang aktor dan produser film asal Wales. Dikenal karena penampilannya yang tangguh dan persona layar yang intens dan membumi, ia adalah salah satu bintang pria film Inggris teratas akhir 1950-an, dan kemudian menjadi produser.

name: Stanley Donen
title: Stanley Donen
extract: Stanley Donen was an American film director and choreographer. He received the Honorary Academy Award in 1998, and the Career Golden Lion at the Venice Film Festival in 2004. Four of his films have been inducted into the National Film Registry at the Library of Congress.
extract_id: Stanley Donen adalah seorang sutradara dan koreografer film Amerika. Dia menerima Honorary Academy Award pada 1998, dan Career Golden Lion di Festival Film Venesia 2004. Empat film buatannya telah dimasukkan ke dalam National Film Registry di Library of Congress.

name: Stanley Holloway
title: Stanley Holloway
extract: Stanley Augustus Holloway was an English actor, comedian, singer and monologist. He was famous for his comic and character roles on stage and screen, especially that of Alfred P. Doolittle in My Fair Lady. He was also renowned for his comic monologues and songs, which he performed and recorded throughout most of his 70-year career.
extract_id: Stanley Augustus Holloway adalah seorang aktor, komedian, penyanyi, dan monologis Inggris. Dia terkenal dengan peran komedi dan karakternya di panggung dan layar, terutama sebagai Alfred P. Doolittle dalam My Fair Lady. Dia juga dikenal luas karena monolog dan lagu-lagu komedinya, yang dia tampilkan dan rekam selama hampir 70 tahun kariernya.

name: Stanley Kramer
title: Stanley Kramer
extract: Stanley Earl Kramer was an American film director and producer, responsible for making many of Hollywood's most famous "message films" and a liberal movie icon. As an independent producer and director, he brought attention to topical social issues that most studios avoided. Among the subjects covered in his films were racism, nuclear war, greed, creationism vs. evolution, and the causes and effects of fascism. His other films included High Noon, The Caine Mutiny, and Ship of Fools (1965).
extract_id: Stanley Earl Kramer adalah seorang sutradara dan produser film Amerika, yang bertanggung jawab atas banyak "message films" terkenal Hollywood dan ikon film liberal. Sebagai produser dan sutradara independen, dia mengangkat perhatian pada isu sosial terkini yang sering dihindari oleh sebagian besar studio. Di antara topik yang dibahas dalam film-filmnya adalah rasisme, perang nuklir, keserakahan, kreasionisme vs evolusi, serta penyebab dan akibat fasisme. Film-filmnya lainnya termasuk High Noon, The Caine Mutiny, dan Ship of Fools (1965).

name: Stanley Kubrick
title: Stanley Kubrick
extract: Stanley Kubrick was an American filmmaker and photographer. A prominent figure of the New Hollywood era, Kubrick is regarded as one of the greatest and most influential filmmakers. His films spanned a number of genres and gained recognition for their attention to detail, innovative cinematography, extensive set design, and dark humor.
extract_id: Stanley Kubrick adalah seorang pembuat film dan fotografer Amerika. Sebagai sosok terkemuka era New Hollywood, Kubrick dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film terbesar dan paling berpengaruh. Film-filmnya mencakup berbagai genre dan diakui karena perhatian pada detail, sinematografi inovatif, desain set yang luas, dan humor gelap.

name: Stefania Sandrelli
title: Stefania Sandrelli
extract: Stefania Sandrelli is an Italian actress, famous for her many roles in the "Italian-style comedy", starting from the 1960s. She was 14 years old when she starred in Divorce Italian Style as Angela, the cousin and love interest of Ferdinando, played by Marcello Mastroianni.
extract_id: Stefania Sandrelli adalah seorang aktris Italia, terkenal atas banyak perannya dalam "komedi gaya Italia", yang dimulai sejak 1960-an. Dia berusia 14 tahun saat membintangi Divorce Italian Style sebagai Angela, sepupu dan cinta Ferdinando, yang diperankan oleh Marcello Mastroianni.

name: Stellan Skarsgård
title: Stellan Skarsgård
extract: Stellan John Skarsgård is a Swedish actor. He is known for his collaborations with director Lars von Trier, appearing in Breaking the Waves (1996), Dancer in the Dark (2000), Dogville (2003), Melancholia (2011), and Nymphomaniac (2013). Skarsgård's early English-speaking film roles include The Unbearable Lightness of Being (1988), The Hunt for Red October (1990), Good Will Hunting (1997), Ronin (1998), and King Arthur (2004). His accolades include two Golden Globe Awards, in addition to nominations for an Academy Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, and a Critics’ Choice Award.
extract_id: Stellan John Skarsgård adalah seorang aktor Swedia. Dia dikenal atas kolaborasinya dengan sutradara Lars von Trier, tampil dalam Breaking the Waves (1996), Dancer in the Dark (2000), Dogville (2003), Melancholia (2011), dan Nymphomaniac (2013). Peran film berbahasa Inggris awal Skarsgård termasuk The Unbearable Lightness of Being (1988), The Hunt for Red October (1990), Good Will Hunting (1997), Ronin (1998), dan King Arthur (2004). Penghargaan yang diterimanya antara lain dua Golden Globe Awards, selain nominasi Academy Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dan Critics’ Choice Award.

name: Stephen Baldwin
title: Stephen Baldwin
extract: Stephen Andrew Baldwin is an American actor. He has appeared in the films Born on the Fourth of July (1989), Posse (1993), 8 Seconds, Threesome, The Usual Suspects (1995), Bio-Dome (1996), and The Flintstones in Viva Rock Vegas (2000). Baldwin also starred in the television series The Young Riders (1989–1992) and as himself in the reality shows Celebrity Big Brother 7, in which he placed 9th in the United Kingdom, and The Celebrity Apprentice. In 2004, he directed Livin' It, a Christian-themed skateboarding DVD. He is the youngest of the four Baldwin brothers.
extract_id: Stephen Andrew Baldwin adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dia telah tampil dalam film Born on the Fourth of July (1989), Posse (1993), 8 Seconds, Threesome, The Usual Suspects (1995), Bio-Dome (1996), dan The Flintstones in Viva Rock Vegas (2000). Baldwin juga membintangi serial televisi The Young Riders (1989–1992) dan tampil sebagai dirinya sendiri dalam acara realitas Celebrity Big Brother 7, di mana dia menempati posisi ke-9 di Inggris, serta The Celebrity Apprentice. Pada 2004, dia menyutradarai Livin' It, sebuah DVD skateboard bertema Kristen. Dia adalah anak bungsu dari empat bersaudara Baldwin.

name: Stephen Boyd
title: Stephen Boyd
extract: William Millar, better known by his stage name Stephen Boyd, was an actor from Northern Ireland. He emerged as a leading man during the late 1950s with his role as the villainous Messala in Ben-Hur (1959), a role that earned him the Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor – Motion Picture. He received his second Golden Globe nomination for the musical Billy Rose's Jumbo (1962).
extract_id: William Millar, yang lebih dikenal dengan nama panggung Stephen Boyd, adalah seorang aktor asal Irlandia Utara. Dia muncul sebagai pemeran utama pada akhir 1950-an dengan perannya sebagai penjahat Messala dalam Ben-Hur (1959), peran yang memberinya Golden Globe Award untuk Best Supporting Actor – Motion Picture. Dia menerima nominasi Golden Globe kedua untuk film musikal Billy Rose's Jumbo (1962).

name: Stephen Chbosky
title: Stephen Chbosky
extract: Stephen Chbosky is an American film director, screenwriter, and author. He is best known for writing the bestselling coming-of-age novel The Perks of Being a Wallflower (1999), and writing and directing its 2012 film adaptation. He also directed the drama Wonder (2017) and the 2021 film adaptation of Dear Evan Hansen. His first psychological horror novel, Imaginary Friend, was published in October 2019.
extract_id: Stephen Chbosky adalah seorang sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan penulis Amerika. Dia paling dikenal sebagai penulis novel laris coming-of-age The Perks of Being a Wallflower (1999), serta menulis dan menyutradarai adaptasi filmnya pada 2012. Dia juga menyutradarai drama Wonder (2017) dan adaptasi film Dear Evan Hansen (2021). Novel horor psikologis pertamanya, Imaginary Friend, diterbitkan pada Oktober 2019.

name: Stephen Chow
title: Stephen Chow
extract: Stephen Chow Sing-chi is a Hong Kong filmmaker and former actor, known for his mo lei tau comedy, which has a significant influence on Chinese popular culture. His career began in television, where he gained recognition through variety shows and TV dramas. Chow's breakthrough came in 1989 with the comedy dramas The Final Combat and The Justice of Life, the latter marking the beginning of his on-screen collaboration with Ng Man-tat. He consecutively broke Hong Kong’s box office records in the next two years with films All for the Winner (1990) and Fight Back to School (1991), cementing his status as one of the region's most popular actors.
extract_id: Stephen Chow Sing-chi adalah seorang pembuat film dan mantan aktor Hong Kong, dikenal dengan komedi mo lei tau-nya, yang memiliki pengaruh signifikan pada budaya populer Tionghoa. Kariernya dimulai di televisi, di mana dia memperoleh pengakuan melalui acara varietas dan drama TV. Terobosan Chow terjadi pada 1989 dengan drama komedi The Final Combat dan The Justice of Life, yang menandai awal kolaborasinya di layar dengan Ng Man-tat. Dia secara berturut-turut memecahkan rekor box office Hong Kong dalam dua tahun berikutnya dengan film All for the Winner (1990) dan Fight Back to School (1991), menegaskan statusnya sebagai salah satu aktor paling populer di wilayah tersebut.

name: Stephen Daldry
title: Stephen Daldry
extract: Stephen David Daldry CBE is an English director and producer of film, theatre, and television. He has won three Tony Awards for his work on Broadway and an Olivier Award for his work in the West End. He has received three Academy Awards nominations for Best Director, for the films Billy Elliot (2000), The Hours (2002), and The Reader (2008).
extract_id: Stephen David Daldry CBE adalah seorang sutradara dan produser film, teater, dan televisi Inggris. Dia telah memenangkan tiga Tony Awards untuk karyanya di Broadway dan Olivier Award untuk karyanya di West End. Dia menerima tiga nominasi Academy Awards untuk Sutradara Terbaik, untuk film Billy Elliot (2000), The Hours (2002), dan The Reader (2008).

name: Stephen Frears
title: Stephen Frears
extract: Sir Stephen Arthur Frears is a British director and producer of film and television, often depicting real-life stories as well as projects that explore social class through sharply-drawn characters. He has received numerous accolades including three BAFTA Awards, and a Primetime Emmy Award as well as nominations for two Academy Awards. In 2008, The Daily Telegraph named Frears among the 100 most influential people in British culture. In 2009, he received the Commandeur de l'Ordre des Arts et des Lettres. He received a knighthood in 2023 for his contributions to the film and television industries.
extract_id: Sir Stephen Arthur Frears adalah seorang sutradara dan produser film serta televisi Inggris, yang sering menggambarkan kisah nyata serta proyek yang mengeksplorasi kelas sosial melalui karakter yang digambar dengan tajam. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk tiga BAFTA Awards dan Primetime Emmy Award serta nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards. Pada 2008, The Daily Telegraph menobatkannya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh dalam budaya Inggris. Pada 2009, dia menerima Commandeur de l'Ordre des Arts et des Lettres. Dia menerima gelar kebangsawanan pada 2023 atas kontribusinya di industri film dan televisi.

name: Stephen Graham
title: Stephen Graham
extract: Stephen Graham is an English actor, producer, and screenwriter. He is the official voice for McDonalds UK. He has received nominations for seven British Academy Television Awards and one British Academy Film Award. He has also won three Primetime Emmy Awards, one Golden Globe Award and two Actor Awards, among other accolades.
extract_id: Stephen Graham adalah seorang aktor, produser, dan penulis skenario Inggris. Dia adalah suara resmi untuk McDonalds UK. Dia telah menerima nominasi untuk tujuh British Academy Television Awards dan satu British Academy Film Award. Dia juga memenangkan tiga Primetime Emmy Awards, satu Golden Globe Award, dan dua Actor Awards, di antara penghargaan lainnya.

name: Stephen Rea
title: Stephen Rea
extract: Stephen Rea is an Irish actor. Born in Belfast, Northern Ireland, he began his career as a member of Dublin's Focus Theatre, and played many roles on the stage and on Irish television. He came to the attention of international film audiences in Irish filmmaker Neil Jordan's 1992 film The Crying Game, and subsequently starred in many more of Jordan's films, including Interview with the Vampire (1994), Michael Collins (1996), Breakfast on Pluto (2005), and Greta (2018). He also played a starring role in the Hugo Blick 2011 TV series The Shadow Line.
extract_id: Stephen Rea adalah seorang aktor Irlandia. Lahir di Belfast, Irlandia Utara, ia memulai karirnya sebagai anggota Focus Theatre Dublin, dan memainkan banyak peran di panggung dan televisi Irlandia. Dia menarik perhatian penonton film internasional dalam film 1992 karya pembuat film Irlandia Neil Jordan, The Crying Game, dan kemudian membintangi banyak film Jordan lainnya, termasuk Interview with the Vampire (1994), Michael Collins (1996), Breakfast on Pluto (2005), dan Greta (2018). Dia juga memainkan peran utama dalam serial TV Hugo Blick 2011 The Shadow Line.

name: Stephen Tobolowsky
title: Stephen Tobolowsky
extract: Stephen Harold Tobolowsky is an American character actor and writer. He is known for film roles such as insurance agent Ned Ryerson in Groundhog Day and amnesiac Sammy Jankis in Memento, as well as such television characters as Commissioner Hugo Jarry in Deadwood, Bob Bishop in Heroes, Sandy Ryerson in Glee, Stu Beggs in Californication and White Famous, "Action" Jack Barker in Silicon Valley, Dr. Leslie Berkowitz in One Day at a Time, Principal Earl Ball in The Goldbergs, and Dr. Schulman in The Mindy Project.
extract_id: Stephen Harold Tobolowsky adalah seorang aktor karakter dan penulis Amerika. Dia dikenal untuk peran film seperti agen asuransi Ned Ryerson dalam Groundhog Day dan amnesiak Sammy Jankis dalam Memento, serta karakter televisi seperti Komisaris Hugo Jarry dalam Deadwood, Bob Bishop dalam Heroes, Sandy Ryerson dalam Glee, Stu Beggs dalam Californication dan White Famous, "Action" Jack Barker dalam Silicon Valley, Dr. Leslie Berkowitz dalam One Day at a Time, Kepala Sekolah Earl Ball dalam The Goldbergs, dan Dr. Schulman dalam The Mindy Project.

name: Stephen Trask
title: Stephen Trask
extract: Stephen Trask is an American musician and composer who graduated from Wesleyan University. He was the music director and house band member at the New York City club Squeezebox, where he performed with stars such as Debbie Harry, Lene Lovich, Hole, Green Day, and Joey Ramone.
extract_id: Stephen Trask adalah musisi dan komposer Amerika yang lulus dari Wesleyan University. Dia pernah menjadi direktur musik dan anggota house band di klub Squeezebox New York City, di mana ia tampil bersama bintang seperti Debbie Harry, Lene Lovich, Hole, Green Day, dan Joey Ramone.

name: Stephen Young
title: Stephen Young (actor)
description: Canadian actor, producer and TV host (born 1939)
extract: Stephen Young is a retired Canadian actor and television host. He worked mostly as a character actor and had supporting roles in the films Patton (1970), Soylent Green (1973), and The Silent Partner (1978).
extract_id: Stephen Young adalah aktor dan pembawa acara televisi Kanada yang telah pensiun. Ia kebanyakan bekerja sebagai aktor karakter dan memiliki peran pendukung dalam film Patton (1970), Soylent Green (1973), dan The Silent Partner (1978).

name: Sterling Hayden
title: Sterling Hayden
extract: Sterling Walter Hayden was an American actor. A leading man for most of his career, he specialized in Westerns and film noir throughout the 1950s, in films such as John Huston's The Asphalt Jungle (1950), Nicholas Ray's Johnny Guitar (1954), and Stanley Kubrick's The Killing (1956). In the 1960s, he became noted for supporting roles, perhaps most memorably as General Jack D. Ripper in Kubrick's Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb (1964).
extract_id: Sterling Walter Hayden adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Sebagai pemeran utama selama sebagian besar karirnya, dia mengkhususkan diri dalam genre Western dan film noir sepanjang tahun 1950-an, dalam film seperti The Asphalt Jungle (1950) karya John Huston, Johnny Guitar (1954) karya Nicholas Ray, dan The Killing (1956) karya Stanley Kubrick. Pada tahun 1960-an, dia dikenal untuk peran pendukung, mungkin yang paling dikenang sebagai Jenderal Jack D. Ripper dalam Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb (1964) karya Kubrick.

name: Steve Buscemi
title: Steve Buscemi
extract: Steven Vincent Buscemi is an American actor. His accolades include two Emmy Awards, a Golden Globe Award and two Independent Spirit Awards.
extract_id: Steven Vincent Buscemi adalah aktor Amerika. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk dua Emmy Awards, satu Golden Globe Award, dan dua Independent Spirit Awards.

name: Steve Carell
title: Steve Carell
extract: Steven John Carell is an American actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer. He starred as Michael Scott in the NBC sitcom The Office, and also worked at several points as a producer, executive producer, writer, and director. Carell has received numerous accolades, including a Golden Globe Award for The Office. He was recognized as "America's Funniest Man" by Life.
extract_id: Steven John Carell adalah aktor, komedian, penulis skenario, dan produser Amerika. Dia membintangi sebagai Michael Scott dalam sitkom NBC The Office, dan juga bekerja sebagai produser, produser eksekutif, penulis, dan sutradara pada beberapa kesempatan. Carell menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Golden Globe Award untuk The Office. Dia dikenal sebagai "America's Funniest Man" oleh majalah Life.

name: Steve Coogan
title: Steve Coogan
extract: Stephen John Coogan is a British actor, comedian, screenwriter and producer. His accolades include six BAFTA Awards and nominations for two Academy Awards and a Golden Globe Award. He is best known for his character Alan Partridge, a socially inept and politically incorrect media personality, which he developed while working with On the Hour (1991–1992) and The Day Today (1994). The role has been featured in numerous projects such as I'm Alan Partridge (1997–2002) and Alan Partridge: Alpha Papa (2013).
extract_id: Stephen John Coogan adalah aktor, komedian, penulis skenario, dan produser Inggris. Penghargaannya meliputi enam BAFTA Awards dan nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards serta satu Golden Globe Award. Dia paling dikenal untuk karakternya Alan Partridge, seorang kepribadian media yang sosialnya canggung dan politis tidak benar, yang dikembangkan saat bekerja dengan On the Hour (1991–1992) dan The Day Today (1994). Peran tersebut muncul dalam berbagai proyek seperti I'm Alan Partridge (1997–2002) dan Alan Partridge: Alpha Papa (2013).

name: Steve Martin
title: Steve Martin
description: American comedian, actor, musician and writer (born 1945)
extract: Stephen Glenn Martin is an American comedian, actor, writer, producer, and musician. Known for his work in comedy films, television, and recording, he has received many accolades, including five Grammy Awards, a Primetime Emmy Award, and a Screen Actors Guild Award as well as nominations for eight Golden Globe Awards and two Tony Awards. Martin received the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor in 2005, the Kennedy Center Honors in 2007, the Honorary Academy Award in 2013, and an AFI Life Achievement Award in 2015. In 2004, Comedy Central ranked Martin at sixth place in a list of the 100 greatest stand-up comics.
extract_id: Stephen Glenn Martin adalah seorang komedian, aktor, penulis, produser, dan musisi Amerika. Dikenal atas karya-karyanya dalam film komedi, televisi, dan rekaman, ia telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk lima Grammy Awards, satu Primetime Emmy Award, dan satu Screen Actors Guild Award serta nominasi untuk delapan Golden Globe Awards dan dua Tony Awards. Martin menerima Mark Twain Prize for American Humor pada tahun 2005, Kennedy Center Honors pada 2007, Honorary Academy Award pada 2013, dan AFI Life Achievement Award pada 2015. Pada 2004, Comedy Central menempatkan Martin di urutan keenam dalam daftar 100 komedian stand-up terhebat.

name: Steve McQueen
title: Steve McQueen
extract: Terrence Stephen McQueen was an American actor.
