His antihero persona, emphasized during the height of 1960s counterculture, made him a top box office draw for his films of the late 1950s to the mid-1970s. He was nicknamed the "King of Cool" and used the alias "Harvey Mushman" when participating in motor races.
extract_id: Terrence Stephen McQueen adalah aktor Amerika. Persona antihero-nya, yang ditekankan selama puncak kontra budaya tahun 1960-an, menjadikannya salah satu aktor yang paling banyak menarik penonton box office untuk film-filmnya dari akhir 1950-an hingga pertengahan 1970-an. Dia dijuluki "King of Cool" dan menggunakan nama samaran "Harvey Mushman" saat ikut dalam balapan motor.

name: Steve Zahn
title: Steve Zahn
extract: Steven James Zahn is an American actor and comedian. In film, Zahn is best known for his lead roles in That Thing You Do! (1996), Safe Men (1998), Happy, Texas (1999), Joy Ride (2001), National Security (2003), A Perfect Getaway (2009), the Diary of a Wimpy Kid film series (2010–2012), Cowboys (2020), and LaRoy, Texas (2023). His notable supporting roles in films include Reality Bites (1994), Out of Sight (1998), Forces of Nature (1999), Employee of the Month (2004), the Stuart Little film series (1999–2002), Riding in Cars with Boys (2001), Daddy Day Care (2003), Chicken Little (2005), Sahara (2005), Sunshine Cleaning (2008), Dallas Buyers Club (2013), The Good Dinosaur (2015), Captain Fantastic (2016), War for the Planet of the Apes (2017) and Anaconda (2025).
extract_id: Steven James Zahn adalah aktor dan komedian Amerika. Dalam film, Zahn paling dikenal karena peran utama dalam That Thing You Do! (1996), Safe Men (1998), Happy, Texas (1999), Joy Ride (2001), National Security (2003), A Perfect Getaway (2009), seri film Diary of a Wimpy Kid (2010–2012), Cowboys (2020), dan LaRoy, Texas (2023). Peran pendukungnya yang menonjol dalam film termasuk Reality Bites (1994), Out of Sight (1998), Forces of Nature (1999), Employee of the Month (2004), seri film Stuart Little (1999–2002), Riding in Cars with Boys (2001), Daddy Day Care (2003), Chicken Little (2005), Sahara (2005), Sunshine Cleaning (2008), Dallas Buyers Club (2013), The Good Dinosaur (2015), Captain Fantastic (2016), War for the Planet of the Apes (2017), dan Anaconda (2025).

name: Steven Bauer
title: Steven Bauer
extract: Steven Bauer is a Cuban-American actor.
extract_id: Steven Bauer adalah aktor Kuba-Amerika.

name: Steven Soderbergh
title: Steven Soderbergh
extract: Steven Andrew Soderbergh is an American filmmaker, cinematographer, and editor. A pioneer of modern independent cinema, Soderbergh later drew acclaim for formally inventive films made within the studio system.
extract_id: Steven Andrew Soderbergh adalah pembuat film, sinematografer, dan editor Amerika. Sebagai pelopor sinema independen modern, Soderbergh kemudian mendapat pujian untuk film-film yang secara formal inovatif yang dibuat dalam sistem studio.

name: Steven Spielberg
title: Steven Spielberg
extract: Steven Allan Spielberg is an American filmmaker. A major figure of the New Hollywood era and pioneer of the modern blockbuster, Spielberg is widely regarded as one of the greatest and most influential filmmakers in the history of cinema and is the highest-grossing film director of all time, with his films having earned almost $11 billion worldwide. Among other accolades, he has received three Academy Awards, four Golden Globe Awards, four BAFTA Awards, twelve Emmy Awards, a Tony Award, and a Grammy Award, as well as the AFI Life Achievement Award in 1995, an honorary knighthood in 2001, the Kennedy Center Honor in 2006, the Cecil B. DeMille Award in 2009, the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2015, and the National Medal of Arts in 2023. According to Forbes, he is one of the world's wealthiest celebrities, with a net worth of at least $5.3 billion. He is one of 22 people to achieve EGOT status.
extract_id: Steven Allan Spielberg adalah pembuat film Amerika. Sebagai tokoh utama era New Hollywood dan pelopor blockbuster modern, Spielberg secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film terbesar dan paling berpengaruh dalam sejarah sinema dan adalah sutradara film dengan pendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa, dengan film-filmnya telah menghasilkan hampir $11 miliar di seluruh dunia. Di antara penghargaan lainnya, ia menerima tiga Academy Awards, empat Golden Globe Awards, empat BAFTA Awards, dua belas Emmy Awards, satu Tony Award, dan satu Grammy Award, serta AFI Life Achievement Award pada tahun 1995, gelar kehormatan kesatria pada tahun 2001, Kennedy Center Honor pada 2006, Cecil B. DeMille Award pada 2009, Presidential Medal of Freedom pada 2015, dan National Medal of Arts pada 2023. Menurut Forbes, dia adalah salah satu selebriti terkaya di dunia, dengan kekayaan bersih setidaknya $5,3 miliar. Dia adalah salah satu dari 22 orang yang mencapai status EGOT.

name: Strother Martin
title: Strother Martin
extract: Strother Douglas Martin Jr. was an American actor, who appeared in over 170 film and television productions between 1950 and 1980, mainly in character roles. He often appeared in support of John Wayne and Paul Newman, and in Westerns directed by John Ford and Sam Peckinpah. He was nominated for a Golden Globe Award for his role on the television legal drama Hawkins (1973–74).
extract_id: Strother Douglas Martin Jr. adalah aktor Amerika yang tampil dalam lebih dari 170 produksi film dan televisi antara tahun 1950 dan 1980, terutama dalam peran karakter. Dia sering muncul sebagai pendukung bagi John Wayne dan Paul Newman, serta dalam film Western yang disutradarai oleh John Ford dan Sam Peckinpah. Dia dinominasikan untuk Golden Globe Award atas perannya dalam drama hukum televisi Hawkins (1973–74).

name: Stuart Rosenberg
title: Stuart Rosenberg
extract: Stuart Rosenberg was an American film and television director. He was most noted for his collaborations with actor Paul Newman, whom he directed in Cool Hand Luke (1967), WUSA (1970), Pocket Money (1972), and The Drowning Pool (1975). He was a five-time Directors Guild of America Award nominee, and a Primetime Emmy Award winner.
extract_id: Stuart Rosenberg adalah sutradara film dan televisi Amerika. Ia paling dikenal untuk kolaborasinya dengan aktor Paul Newman, yang ia sutradarai dalam Cool Hand Luke (1967), WUSA (1970), Pocket Money (1972), dan The Drowning Pool (1975). Ia lima kali dinominasikan untuk Directors Guild of America Award, dan memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Stuart Wolfenden
title: Stuart Wolfenden
extract: Stuart Wolfenden is an English actor. He has played three different roles in Coronation Street, first as paper boy Craig Russell, then as Mark Casey and later as Greig Hodge. Around 2019, he joined the cast of Hollyoaks as Terry Hay, the father of regular character Ste Hay.
extract_id: Stuart Wolfenden adalah aktor Inggris. Dia telah memainkan tiga peran berbeda di Coronation Street, pertama sebagai tukang koran Craig Russell, kemudian sebagai Mark Casey dan kemudian sebagai Greig Hodge. Sekitar tahun 2019, dia bergabung dengan pemeran Hollyoaks sebagai Terry Hay, ayah dari karakter reguler Ste Hay.

name: Sudha Kongara
title: Sudha Kongara
extract: Sudha Kongara Prasad, known professionally as Sudha Kongara, is an Indian film director and screenwriter who predominantly works in Tamil. She made her directorial debut with the Telugu film Andhra Andhagadu (2008), and in Tamil with Drohi (2010). In 2016, she directed the bilingual Irudhi Suttru for which she won the Filmfare Award for Best Director – Tamil. She subsequently directed the film's Telugu remake, Guru (2017). In her career, working over 3 languages, she has won two National Film Awards, two Filmfare Awards South, two Tamil Nadu State Film Awards and two SIIMA Awards.
extract_id: Sudha Kongara Prasad, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Sudha Kongara, adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario India yang sebagian besar bekerja dalam bahasa Tamil. Dia membuat debut sutradaranya dengan film Telugu Andhra Andhagadu (2008), dan dalam bahasa Tamil dengan Drohi (2010). Pada tahun 2016, dia menyutradarai film dwibahasa Irudhi Suttru yang membuatnya memenangkan Filmfare Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik – Tamil. Dia kemudian menyutradarai remake Telugu dari film tersebut, Guru (2017). Dalam kariernya yang mencakup lebih dari 3 bahasa, dia telah memenangkan dua National Film Awards, dua Filmfare Awards South, dua Tamil Nadu State Film Awards, dan dua SIIMA Awards.

name: Sujoy Ghosh
title: Sujoy Ghosh
extract: Sujoy Ghosh is an Indian filmmaker and actor who works in Hindi and Bengali films.
extract_id: Sujoy Ghosh adalah pembuat film dan aktor India yang bekerja dalam film Hindi dan Bengali.

name: Sully Boyar
title: Sully Boyar
extract: Irving "Sully" Boyar was an American character actor of stage, film, and television of Russian-Jewish descent.
extract_id: Irving "Sully" Boyar adalah aktor karakter Amerika keturunan Rusia-Yahudi yang tampil di panggung, film, dan televisi.

name: Sumi Shimamoto
title: Sumi Shimamoto
extract: Sumi Koshikawa , known professionally as Sumi Shimamoto , is a Japanese actress and narrator.
extract_id: Sumi Koshikawa, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Sumi Shimamoto, adalah aktris dan narator Jepang.

name: Sumita Sanyal
title: Sumita Sanyal
extract: Sumita Sanyal was an Indian actress who is known for her work in Bengali and Hindi cinema. She made her debut opposite Uttam Kumar in Bibhuti Laha's Khokababur Pratyabartan (1960). She subsequently appeared in a series of Bengali films in the 1960s and 1970s. She also enacted a cameo role in The Peacock Spring.
extract_id: Sumita Sanyal adalah aktris India yang dikenal atas karyanya dalam sinema Bengali dan Hindi. Dia membuat debutnya berlawanan dengan Uttam Kumar dalam Khokababur Pratyabartan (1960) karya Bibhuti Laha. Dia kemudian tampil dalam serangkaian film Bengali pada 1960-an dan 1970-an. Dia juga berperan dalam cameo di The Peacock Spring.

name: Sunil Dutt
title: Sunil Dutt
extract: Balraj Raghunath Dutt, publicly known as Sunil Dutt, was an Indian actor, film producer, director, and politician known for his work in Hindi cinema. He acted in more than 80 films over a career spanning five decades and was the recipient of three Filmfare Awards, including two for Best Actor. Regarded as one of the most successful and finest actors in the history of Indian cinema, Dutt was known for his unique style and delivering impactful messages through his films. In 1968, the Government of India honoured him with the Padma Shri, India's fourth highest civilian award, for his contribution to Indian cinema.
extract_id: Balraj Raghunath Dutt, yang dikenal secara publik sebagai Sunil Dutt, adalah aktor India, produser film, sutradara, dan politisi yang dikenal atas karyanya dalam sinema Hindi. Dia berakting dalam lebih dari 80 film selama karir yang berlangsung selama lima dekade dan menerima tiga Filmfare Awards, termasuk dua untuk Aktor Terbaik. Dipandang sebagai salah satu aktor paling sukses dan terbaik dalam sejarah sinema India, Dutt dikenal dengan gaya unik dan penyampaian pesan yang berdampak melalui film-filmnya. Pada tahun 1968, Pemerintah India memberi penghargaan Padma Shri, penghargaan sipil keempat tertinggi di India, untuk kontribusinya terhadap sinema India.

name: Sunil Shetty
title: Suniel Shetty
extract: Suniel Veerappa Shetty is an Indian actor, film producer, television host, and entrepreneur, primarily known for his work in Hindi cinema. Nicknamed as Anna, Shetty has appeared in over 100 films since the 1990s and is known for his various supporting and leading action and comedy roles.
extract_id: Suniel Veerappa Shetty adalah aktor, produser film, pembawa acara televisi, dan pengusaha India, yang terutama dikenal karena karyanya dalam sinema Hindi. Dijuluki Anna, Shetty telah tampil dalam lebih dari 100 film sejak 1990-an dan dikenal untuk berbagai peran pendukung serta utama dalam aksi dan komedi.

name: Suraj Sharma
title: Suraj Sharma
extract: Suraj Sharma is an Indian actor who made his debut in the 2012 film Life of Pi. Directed by Ang Lee, the film was adapted from the novel of the same name, and earned Sharma critical acclaim as well as a BAFTA Rising Star Award nomination. In 2014, he portrayed Aayan Ibrahim in season 4 of the Showtime series Homeland. From 2018 to 2020, he starred as Rakesh Singh in the CBS comedy-drama series God Friended Me.
extract_id: Suraj Sharma adalah aktor India yang memulai debutnya dalam film Life of Pi tahun 2012. Disutradarai oleh Ang Lee, film ini diadaptasi dari novel dengan judul yang sama, dan membawa Sharma memperoleh pujian kritis serta nominasi BAFTA Rising Star Award. Pada tahun 2014, ia memerankan Aayan Ibrahim dalam musim ke-4 serial Showtime Homeland. Dari 2018 hingga 2020, ia membintangi sebagai Rakesh Singh dalam serial komedi-drama CBS God Friended Me.

name: Suriya
title: Suriya
extract: Saravanan Sivakumar, known professionally as Suriya, is an Indian actor and film producer who primarily works in Tamil cinema. One of the highest-paid Tamil film actors, Suriya is considered as one of the finest actors of Indian cinema. Suriya has received numerous accolades including two National Film Awards, seven Filmfare Awards South and ten Tamil Nadu State Film Awards. He has featured seven times in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list.
extract_id: Saravanan Sivakumar, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Suriya, adalah aktor dan produser film India yang terutama bekerja di sinema Tamil. Salah satu aktor film Tamil dengan bayaran tertinggi, Suriya dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terbaik dalam sinema India. Suriya telah menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk dua National Film Awards, tujuh Filmfare Awards South, dan sepuluh Tamil Nadu State Film Awards. Ia telah masuk dalam daftar Celebrity 100 Forbes India sebanyak tujuh kali.

name: Susan Harrison
title: Susan Harrison
extract: Susan Stewart Harrison was an American actress, most famous for her appearance in the 1957 film noir classic Sweet Smell of Success as the sister for whom Burt Lancaster has an unhealthy affection, and in The Twilight Zone episode "Five Characters in Search of an Exit".
extract_id: Susan Stewart Harrison adalah seorang aktris Amerika, paling terkenal karena penampilannya dalam film noir klasik Sweet Smell of Success tahun 1957 sebagai saudari yang memiliki kasih sayang tidak sehat terhadap Burt Lancaster, dan dalam episode The Twilight Zone "Five Characters in Search of an Exit".

name: Susanne Bier
title: Susanne Bier
extract: Susanne Bier is a Danish filmmaker. Bier is the first female director to collectively receive an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, a European Film Award and a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Susanne Bier adalah seorang pembuat film Denmark. Bier adalah sutradara wanita pertama yang secara kolektif menerima Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, European Film Award, dan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Susanne Lothar
title: Susanne Lothar
extract: Susanne Lothar was a German film, television and stage actress. Her work included collaborations with Austrian filmmaker Michael Haneke. She was married to fellow actor Ulrich Mühe, with whom she frequently appeared on stage and in films.
extract_id: Susanne Lothar adalah seorang aktris film, televisi, dan panggung Jerman. Karyanya termasuk kolaborasi dengan pembuat film Austria Michael Haneke. Dia menikah dengan sesama aktor Ulrich Mühe, dengan siapa dia sering tampil di panggung dan dalam film.

name: Sushant Singh Rajput
title: Sushant Singh Rajput
extract: Sushant Singh Rajput was an Indian actor best known for his work in Hindi cinema. Rajput is the recipient of several accolades, including a Screen Award and three Filmfare Award nominations. He was featured twice on Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list, and was regarded as one of the most talented and versatile actors of his generation.
extract_id: Sushant Singh Rajput adalah aktor India yang paling dikenal karena karyanya di sinema Hindi. Rajput menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk Screen Award dan tiga nominasi Filmfare Award. Ia dua kali masuk dalam daftar Celebrity 100 Forbes India, dan dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor paling berbakat dan serba bisa dari generasinya.

name: Susumu Terajima
title: Susumu Terajima
extract: Susumu Terajima is a Japanese actor. Though he has played a wide range of characters, he is perhaps best known for his portrayal of yakuza figures, most notably in the films of Takeshi Kitano.
extract_id: Susumu Terajima adalah aktor Jepang. Meskipun ia telah memainkan berbagai karakter, ia mungkin paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai tokoh yakuza, terutama dalam film-film karya Takeshi Kitano.

name: Suzanne Clément
title: Suzanne Clément
extract: Suzanne Clément is a Canadian actress. She is known for her work in Xavier Dolan's arthouse films I Killed My Mother (2009), Laurence Anyways (2012), and Mommy (2014).
extract_id: Suzanne Clément adalah aktris Kanada. Ia dikenal karena karyanya dalam film arthouse Xavier Dolan seperti I Killed My Mother (2009), Laurence Anyways (2012), dan Mommy (2014).

name: Suzanne Pleshette
title: Suzanne Pleshette
extract: Suzanne Pleshette was an American actress known for her roles in theatre, film, and television. She was nominated for three Emmy Awards and two Golden Globe Awards. For her role as Emily Hartley on the CBS sitcom The Bob Newhart Show (1972–1978), she received two nominations for the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series.
extract_id: Suzanne Pleshette adalah aktris Amerika yang dikenal karena peran-perannya di teater, film, dan televisi. Ia dicalonkan untuk tiga Emmy Awards dan dua Golden Globe Awards. Untuk perannya sebagai Emily Hartley dalam sitkom CBS The Bob Newhart Show (1972–1978), ia menerima dua nominasi Primetime Emmy Award untuk Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series.

name: Sylvain Chomet
title: Sylvain Chomet
description: French comic writer, animator, film director (born 1963)
extract: Sylvain Chomet is a French comic writer, animator and film director.
extract_id: Sylvain Chomet adalah penulis komik Prancis, animator, dan sutradara film.

name: Sylvester Stallone
title: Sylvester Stallone
extract: Sylvester Gardenzio Stallone is an American actor and filmmaker. Known for his raw portrayals of vulnerable, working-class characters, he is considered a leading actor of the 1980s. Stallone has earned numerous accolades over a 58-year career, including a Golden Globe Award and a Critics' Choice Award, and has been nominated for three Academy Awards and two BAFTA Awards. He is also, along with Harrison Ford, one of two actors in history to have starred in a box office number-one film across six consecutive decades. Films in which he has appeared have grossed over $7.5 billion worldwide.
extract_id: Sylvester Gardenzio Stallone adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Dikenal karena penggambaran karakternya yang mentah tentang kelas pekerja yang rentan, ia dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terkemuka tahun 1980-an. Stallone telah meraih banyak penghargaan selama kariernya yang berlangsung 58 tahun, termasuk Golden Globe Award dan Critics' Choice Award, dan telah dinominasikan untuk tiga Academy Awards dan dua BAFTA Awards. Ia juga, bersama Harrison Ford, merupakan salah satu dari dua aktor dalam sejarah yang membintangi film box office nomor satu selama enam dekade berturut-turut. Film-film yang dibintanginya telah menghasilkan lebih dari $7,5 miliar di seluruh dunia.

name: Sylvia Hoeks
title: Sylvia Hoeks
extract: Sylvia Hoeks is a Dutch actress and former model, best known internationally for her roles in Blade Runner 2049 (2017) and The Girl in the Spider's Web (2018).
extract_id: Sylvia Hoeks adalah aktris dan mantan model Belanda, yang paling dikenal secara internasional untuk perannya dalam Blade Runner 2049 (2017) dan The Girl in the Spider's Web (2018).

name: Sylvia Miles
title: Sylvia Miles
extract: Sylvia Miles was an American actress. She was twice nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her performances in Midnight Cowboy (1969) and Farewell, My Lovely (1975).
extract_id: Sylvia Miles adalah aktris Amerika. Ia dua kali dicalonkan untuk Academy Award kategori Best Supporting Actress atas penampilannya dalam Midnight Cowboy (1969) dan Farewell, My Lovely (1975).

name: Sylvie Testud
title: Sylvie Testud
extract: Sylvie Testud is a French actress whose film career began in 1991. She won the César Award for Most Promising Actress for Murderous Maids (2000), the César Award for Best Actress for Fear and Trembling (2003), and the European Film Award for Best Actress for Lourdes (2009). Her other film roles include Beyond Silence (1996), La Vie en Rose (2007), and French Women (2014).
extract_id: Sylvie Testud adalah aktris Prancis yang karier filmnya dimulai pada tahun 1991. Ia memenangkan César Award untuk Most Promising Actress untuk Murderous Maids (2000), César Award untuk Best Actress untuk Fear and Trembling (2003), dan European Film Award untuk Best Actress untuk Lourdes (2009). Peran film lainnya termasuk Beyond Silence (1996), La Vie en Rose (2007), dan French Women (2014).

name: Sô Yamamura
title: Sō Yamamura
extract: Sō Yamamura , sometimes credited as Satoshi Yamamura, was a Japanese actor and film director.
extract_id: Sō Yamamura, terkadang dikreditkan sebagai Satoshi Yamamura, adalah seorang aktor dan sutradara film Jepang.

name: T.J. Miller
title: T.J. Miller
extract: Todd Joseph Miller is an American stand-up comedian, actor, producer, and screenwriter. He played Erlich Bachman in the HBO sitcom Silicon Valley (2014–2017) and the Marvel Comics character Weasel in the superhero comedy film Deadpool (2016) and its 2018 sequel.
extract_id: Todd Joseph Miller adalah pelawak stand-up, aktor, produser, dan penulis skenario Amerika. Ia memerankan Erlich Bachman dalam sitkom HBO Silicon Valley (2014–2017) dan karakter Marvel Comics Weasel dalam film komedi superhero Deadpool (2016) dan sekuelnya pada 2018.

name: Taapsee Pannu
title: Taapsee Pannu
extract: Tapasee Pannu, professionally known as Taapsee Pannu, is an Indian actress who primarily works in Hindi, Telugu and Tamil films. She has received two Filmfare Awards and a Filmfare OTT Award.
extract_id: Tapasee Pannu, secara profesional dikenal sebagai Taapsee Pannu, adalah aktris India yang terutama bekerja di film Hindi, Telugu, dan Tamil. Ia telah menerima dua Filmfare Awards dan sebuah Filmfare OTT Award.

name: Tabu
title: Tabu (actress)
extract: Tabassum Fatima Hashmi, professionally known as Tabu, is an Indian actress who primarily works in Hindi films. Widely regarded as one of Hindi cinema's most accomplished actresses, she is known for portraying complex, often troubled women, in both mainstream and independent films. She has received numerous accolades, including two National Film Awards, seven Filmfare Awards, and two Filmfare Awards South. In 2011, she was honoured with the Padma Shri, India's fourth-highest civilian award.
extract_id: Tabassum Fatima Hashmi, secara profesional dikenal sebagai Tabu, adalah aktris India yang terutama bekerja di film Hindi. Dia sangat dihormati sebagai salah satu aktris paling luar biasa dalam sinema Hindi, dikenal karena memerankan wanita yang rumit dan sering bermasalah, baik dalam film mainstream maupun independen. Ia telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk dua National Film Awards, tujuh Filmfare Awards, dan dua Filmfare Awards South. Pada tahun 2011, ia dianugerahi Padma Shri, penghargaan sipil tertinggi keempat di India.

name: Tae-Hyun Cha
title: Cha Tae-hyun
extract: Cha Tae-hyun is a South Korean actor, singer, television personality, radio DJ and director. He is best known for his lead roles in the box-office hit comedies My Sassy Girl (2001), Scandal Makers (2008), Hello Ghost (2010), The Grand Heist (2012), and fantasy drama action hit Along with the Gods: The Two Worlds (2017) as well as the television series Jeon Woo-chi (2012), The Producers (2015), and Police University (2021). He made his directorial debut with the variety-drama Hit the Top (2017), in which he also starred.
extract_id: Cha Tae-hyun adalah aktor, penyanyi, tokoh televisi, DJ radio, dan sutradara Korea Selatan. Ia paling dikenal karena peran utama dalam film komedi box-office My Sassy Girl (2001), Scandal Makers (2008), Hello Ghost (2010), The Grand Heist (2012), dan drama aksi fantasi Along with the Gods: The Two Worlds (2017) serta serial televisi Jeon Woo-chi (2012), The Producers (2015), dan Police University (2021). Ia memulai debut penyutradaraannya dengan drama-varietas Hit the Top (2017), yang juga dibintanginya.

name: Tahar Rahim
title: Tahar Rahim
extract: Tahar Rahim is a French actor, most known for his performance in A Prophet (2009), for which he won the César Award for Best Actor and César Award for Best Male Revelation, alongside a BAFTA Rising Star Award nomination.
extract_id: Tahar Rahim adalah aktor Prancis, paling dikenal karena penampilannya dalam A Prophet (2009), yang membuatnya memenangkan César Award untuk Best Actor dan César Award untuk Best Male Revelation, serta nominasi BAFTA Rising Star Award.

name: Taika Waititi
title: Taika Waititi
extract: Taika David Cohen, known professionally as Taika Waititi, is a New Zealand filmmaker, writer, actor, and comedian. He has received numerous accolades including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award and a Grammy Award, as well as nominations for two Golden Globe Awards and six Emmy Awards. Time magazine named him one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2022.
extract_id: Taika David Cohen, secara profesional dikenal sebagai Taika Waititi, adalah pembuat film, penulis, aktor, dan komedian Selandia Baru. Ia telah menerima banyak penghargaan termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan Grammy Award, serta nominasi dua Golden Globe Awards dan enam Emmy Awards. Majalah Time menamainya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia pada tahun 2022.

name: Takako Matsu
title: Takako Matsu
extract: Takako Matsu is a Japanese actress and pop singer.
extract_id: Takako Matsu adalah aktris dan penyanyi pop Jepang.

name: Takao Osawa
title: Takao Osawa
extract: Takao Osawa is a Japanese actor.
extract_id: Takao Osawa adalah aktor Jepang.

name: Takashi Shimura
title: Takashi Shimura
extract: Takashi Shimura was a Japanese actor who appeared in over 200 films between 1934 and 1981. He appeared in 21 of Akira Kurosawa's 30 films, including as a lead actor in Drunken Angel (1948), Rashomon (1950), Ikiru (1952) and Seven Samurai (1954). He played Professor Kyohei Yamane in Ishirō Honda's original Godzilla (1954) and its first sequel, Godzilla Raids Again (1955).
extract_id: Takashi Shimura adalah aktor Jepang yang tampil dalam lebih dari 200 film antara tahun 1934 dan 1981. Ia tampil dalam 21 dari 30 film Akira Kurosawa, termasuk sebagai aktor utama dalam Drunken Angel (1948), Rashomon (1950), Ikiru (1952), dan Seven Samurai (1954). Ia berperan sebagai Profesor Kyohei Yamane dalam film asli Godzilla (1954) karya Ishirō Honda dan sekuelnya Godzilla Raids Again (1955).

name: Takeshi Aono
title: Takeshi Aono
extract: Takeshi Aono was a Japanese voice actor and narrator from Asahikawa, Hokkaidō. He was attached to Aoni Production at the time of his death. He graduated from Hokkaidō Asahikawa Higashi High School.
extract_id: Takeshi Aono adalah seorang pengisi suara dan narator Jepang dari Asahikawa, Hokkaidō. Dia terkait dengan Aoni Production pada saat kematiannya. Dia lulus dari Hokkaidō Asahikawa Higashi High School.

name: Takeshi Kaneshiro
title: Takeshi Kaneshiro
extract: Takeshi Kaneshiro is a Japanese actor and singer active in the Chinese world. He began his career as a pop idol before shifting his focus to acting. His notable films include Chungking Express (1994), Fallen Angels (1995), House of Flying Daggers (2004), Perhaps Love (2005), The Warlords (2007), Red Cliff (2008), Dragon (2011), and The Crossing (2014–2015).
extract_id: Takeshi Kaneshiro adalah aktor dan penyanyi Jepang yang aktif di dunia Tionghoa. Dia memulai karirnya sebagai idola pop sebelum beralih fokus ke akting. Film-film terkenalnya termasuk Chungking Express (1994), Fallen Angels (1995), House of Flying Daggers (2004), Perhaps Love (2005), The Warlords (2007), Red Cliff (2008), Dragon (2011), dan The Crossing (2014–2015).

name: Takeshi Kitano
title: Takeshi Kitano
extract: Takeshi Kitano , also known as Beat Takeshi in Japan, is a Japanese comedian, actor, and filmmaker. While he is known primarily as a comedian and TV host in his native Japan, he is better known abroad for his work as a filmmaker and actor as well as TV host.
extract_id: Takeshi Kitano, juga dikenal sebagai Beat Takeshi di Jepang, adalah seorang komedian, aktor, dan pembuat film Jepang. Meskipun dia dikenal terutama sebagai komedian dan pembawa acara TV di Jepang asalnya, dia lebih dikenal di luar negeri untuk karyanya sebagai pembuat film dan aktor serta pembawa acara TV.

name: Takuya Ishida
title: Takuya Ishida
extract: Takuya Ishida is a Japanese actor.
extract_id: Takuya Ishida adalah seorang aktor Jepang.

name: Takuya Kimura
title: Takuya Kimura
description: Japanese actor, singer, and radio personality (born 1972)
extract: Takuya Kimura is a Japanese actor, singer, and radio personality. He is regarded as a Japanese icon after achieving success as an actor. He was also a popular member of SMAP, one of the best-selling boy bands in Asia. In the media, he is known as a huge heartthrob in Japan, and a sex symbol, having been voted Japan's sexiest man for 15 years in a row by readers of one magazine.
extract_id: Takuya Kimura adalah seorang aktor, penyanyi, dan pribadi radio Jepang. Dia dianggap sebagai ikon Jepang setelah meraih kesuksesan sebagai aktor. Dia juga merupakan anggota populer dari SMAP, salah satu boy band terlaris di Asia. Di media, dia dikenal sebagai idola besar di Jepang, dan simbol seks, telah dipilih sebagai pria terseksi Jepang selama 15 tahun berturut-turut oleh para pembaca satu majalah.

name: Talia Shire
title: Talia Shire
extract: Talia Rose Shire is an American actress and member of the Coppola family. She is best known for her roles as Connie Corleone in The Godfather trilogy (1972–1990) and Adrian Pennino Balboa in the Rocky series (1976–1990). For her work in The Godfather Part II (1974) and Rocky (1976), Shire was nominated for two Academy Awards for Best Supporting Actress and Best Actress, respectively, while also receiving a nomination for the Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Drama for her role in Rocky.
extract_id: Talia Rose Shire adalah seorang aktris Amerika dan anggota keluarga Coppola. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Connie Corleone dalam trilogi The Godfather (1972–1990) dan Adrian Pennino Balboa dalam seri Rocky (1976–1990). Untuk karyanya di The Godfather Part II (1974) dan Rocky (1976), Shire dinominasikan untuk dua Academy Awards untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik dan Aktris Terbaik, masing-masing, sambil juga menerima nominasi Golden Globe Award untuk Aktris Terbaik dalam Drama untuk perannya di Rocky.

name: Tallulah Bankhead
title: Tallulah Bankhead
extract: Tallulah Brockman Bankhead was an American actress. Primarily an actress of the stage, Bankhead also appeared in several films including an award-winning performance in Alfred Hitchcock's Lifeboat (1944). She also had a brief but successful career on radio and made appearances on television. In all, Bankhead amassed nearly 300 film, stage, television and radio roles during her career. She was posthumously inducted into the American Theater Hall of Fame in 1972 and the Alabama Women's Hall of Fame in 1981.
extract_id: Tallulah Brockman Bankhead adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Terutama seorang aktris panggung, Bankhead juga tampil dalam beberapa film termasuk penampilan pemenang penghargaan dalam film Lifeboat karya Alfred Hitchcock (1944). Dia juga memiliki karier singkat namun sukses di radio dan tampil di televisi. Secara keseluruhan, Bankhead mengumpulkan hampir 300 peran dalam film, panggung, televisi, dan radio selama kariernya. Dia secara anumerta dimasukkan ke dalam American Theater Hall of Fame pada tahun 1972 dan Alabama Women's Hall of Fame pada tahun 1981.

name: Tamannaah Bhatia
title: Tamannaah Bhatia
extract: Tamanna Santosh Bhatia, better known as Tamannaah Bhatia, is an Indian actress who predominantly works in Tamil, Telugu and Hindi films. Having appeared in 89 films, she is recognized as a leading actress in South Indian cinema and has received several awards, including three Santosham Film Awards, two SIIMA Awards and the Kalaimamani Award.
extract_id: Tamanna Santosh Bhatia, yang lebih dikenal sebagai Tamannaah Bhatia, adalah seorang aktris India yang sebagian besar berkarier di film Tamil, Telugu, dan Hindi. Setelah tampil dalam 89 film, dia diakui sebagai aktris terkemuka dalam sinema India Selatan dan telah menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk tiga Santosham Film Awards, dua SIIMA Awards, dan Penghargaan Kalaimamani.

name: Taner Birsel
title: Taner Birsel
extract: Taner Birsel is a Turkish film actor. He has appeared in twelve films since 1995. He starred in The Confession, which was screened in the Un Certain Regard section at the 2002 Cannes Film Festival.
extract_id: Taner Birsel adalah aktor film Turki. Dia telah tampil dalam dua belas film sejak 1995. Dia membintangi The Confession, yang diputar di bagian Un Certain Regard di Festival Film Cannes 2002.

name: Taraji P. Henson
title: Taraji P. Henson
extract: Taraji Penda Henson is an American actress, producer, author, and mental health advocate. Her accolades include a Golden Globe Award, alongside nominations for an Academy Award, six Emmy Awards, and a Tony Award. In 2016 and 2024, Time named Henson one of the 100 most influential people in the world.
extract_id: Taraji Penda Henson adalah seorang aktris, produser, penulis, dan advokat kesehatan mental Amerika. Penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk Golden Globe Award, bersama dengan nominasi untuk Academy Award, enam Emmy Awards, dan Tony Award. Pada 2016 dan 2024, Time menamai Henson sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia.

name: Taraneh Alidoosti
title: Taraneh Alidoosti
extract: Taraneh Alidoosti is an Iranian actress. She is best known internationally for her role in The Salesman (2016), which won the Best Foreign Language Film Award at the 89th Academy Awards. In a poll conducted among 130 film critics by Sanate Cinema magazine, she was voted the best Iranian movie actress of the decade. In 2012, a similar poll by the Film magazine also chose her as the best actress of the decade.
extract_id: Taraneh Alidoosti adalah seorang aktris Iran. Dia paling dikenal secara internasional untuk perannya dalam The Salesman (2016), yang memenangkan Penghargaan Film Berbahasa Asing Terbaik di Academy Awards ke-89. Dalam sebuah jajak pendapat yang dilakukan di antara 130 kritikus film oleh majalah Sanate Cinema, dia dipilih sebagai aktris film Iran terbaik dalam dekade ini. Pada 2012, jajak pendapat serupa oleh majalah Film juga memilihnya sebagai aktris terbaik dalam dekade ini.

name: Taron Egerton
title: Taron Egerton
extract: Taron Egerton is a Welsh actor and singer. A graduate of the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art, he performed in stage plays before gaining recognition for his starring role as a spy in the action comedy films Kingsman: The Secret Service (2014) and Kingsman: The Golden Circle (2017). He has also voiced characters in animated projects like the Sing franchise (2016–present) and The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance (2019).
extract_id: Taron Egerton adalah aktor dan penyanyi Wales. Lulusan Royal Academy of Dramatic Art, dia tampil dalam drama panggung sebelum mendapatkan pengakuan melalui peran utamanya sebagai mata-mata dalam film komedi aksi Kingsman: The Secret Service (2014) dan Kingsman: The Golden Circle (2017). Dia juga mengisi suara karakter dalam proyek animasi seperti waralaba Sing (2016–sekarang) dan The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance (2019).

name: Tarsem Singh
title: Tarsem Singh
extract: Tarsem Singh Dhandwar, known professionally as Tarsem, is an Indian director who has worked on films, music videos, and commercials. He directed The Cell (2000), The Fall (2006), Immortals (2011), Mirror Mirror (2012), Self/less (2015), and Dear Jassi (2023).
extract_id: Tarsem Singh Dhandwar, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Tarsem, adalah seorang sutradara India yang telah mengerjakan film, video musik, dan iklan. Dia menyutradarai The Cell (2000), The Fall (2006), Immortals (2011), Mirror Mirror (2012), Self/less (2015), dan Dear Jassi (2023).

name: Tarun Arora
title: Tarun Arora
extract: Tarun Arora is an Indian model, actor and producer who works in Hindi, Telugu and Tamil language films. He is known for winning Gladrags Manhunt title, and appearing in commercials like Raymond and for his roles in movies like Pyaar Mein Kabhi Kabhi and Jab We Met.
extract_id: Tarun Arora adalah seorang model, aktor, dan produser India yang bekerja di film berbahasa Hindi, Telugu, dan Tamil. Dia dikenal karena memenangkan gelar Gladrags Manhunt, dan muncul dalam iklan seperti Raymond serta karena perannya dalam film seperti Pyaar Mein Kabhi Kabhi dan Jab We Met.

name: Tarô Yamamoto
title: Taro Yamamoto
extract: Tarō Yamamoto is a Japanese politician and former actor, who is the founder and former leader of the anti-establishment political party Reiwa Shinsengumi. Yamamoto served in the House of Councillors representing Tokyo until his resignation in 2026, and previously served in the House of Representatives from 2021 to 2022. He unsuccessfully ran in the 2020 Tokyo gubernatorial election as a candidate under Reiwa.
extract_id: Tarō Yamamoto adalah seorang politikus dan mantan aktor Jepang, yang merupakan pendiri dan mantan pemimpin partai politik anti-establishment Reiwa Shinsengumi. Yamamoto menjabat di Dewan Penasihat mewakili Tokyo hingga pengunduran dirinya pada tahun 2026, dan sebelumnya menjabat di Dewan Perwakilan dari 2021 hingga 2022. Dia mencalonkan diri tanpa berhasil dalam pemilihan gubernur Tokyo 2020 sebagai kandidat dari Reiwa.

name: Tate Taylor
title: Tate Taylor (filmmaker)
extract: Tate Taylor is an American filmmaker and actor. Taylor is best known for directing The Help (2011), Get On Up (2014), The Girl on the Train (2016), and Ma (2019).
extract_id: Tate Taylor adalah pembuat film dan aktor Amerika. Taylor terkenal karena menyutradarai The Help (2011), Get On Up (2014), The Girl on the Train (2016), dan Ma (2019).

name: Tatsuya Fujiwara
title: Tatsuya Fujiwara
extract: Tatsuya Fujiwara is a Japanese actor. Internationally, he is best known for his leading roles as Shuya Nanahara in the Battle Royale films, Light Yagami in the Death Note films, Kaiji Itō in the Kaiji films, and Rikuhiko Yuki in Hideo Nakata's The Incite Mill. In 2014, he portrayed the villain Shishio Makoto in the live action Rurouni Kenshin films.
extract_id: Tatsuya Fujiwara adalah aktor Jepang. Secara internasional, dia paling dikenal untuk peran utamanya sebagai Shuya Nanahara dalam film Battle Royale, Light Yagami dalam film Death Note, Kaiji Itō dalam film Kaiji, dan Rikuhiko Yuki dalam The Incite Mill karya Hideo Nakata. Pada 2014, dia memerankan penjahat Shishio Makoto dalam film live action Rurouni Kenshin.

name: Tatsuya Nakadai
title: Tatsuya Nakadai
extract: Tatsuya Nakadai was a Japanese actor. Widely regarded as one of the greatest actors in the history of cinema, he collaborated extensively with many of Japan's best-known and acclaimed directors. In his over seven decade career, he appeared in more than 160 films, and received numerous accolades. He was honored with a Medal with Purple Ribbon in 1996 and Japan's Order of Culture in 2015.
extract_id: Tatsuya Nakadai adalah aktor Jepang. Secara luas dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar dalam sejarah perfilman, dia banyak berkolaborasi dengan banyak sutradara Jepang paling dikenal dan terkemuka. Dalam karirnya yang berlangsung lebih dari tujuh dekade, dia tampil dalam lebih dari 160 film, dan menerima berbagai penghargaan. Dia dianugerahi Medal with Purple Ribbon pada 1996 dan Order of Culture Jepang pada 2015.

name: Tatum O'Neal
title: Tatum O'Neal
extract: Tatum Beatrice O'Neal is an American actress. At age ten, she became the youngest person ever to win a competitive Academy Award, for her performance as Addie Loggins in Paper Moon co-starring her father, Ryan O'Neal. She later starred in the films The Bad News Bears, Nickelodeon, and Little Darlings, and appeared in guest roles in the television series Sex and the City, 8 Simple Rules, and Law & Order: Criminal Intent.
extract_id: Tatum Beatrice O'Neal adalah aktris Amerika. Pada usia sepuluh tahun, dia menjadi orang termuda yang pernah memenangkan Academy Award kompetitif, untuk penampilannya sebagai Addie Loggins dalam Paper Moon yang juga dibintangi ayahnya, Ryan O'Neal. Dia kemudian membintangi film The Bad News Bears, Nickelodeon, dan Little Darlings, serta tampil dalam peran tamu di serial televisi Sex and the City, 8 Simple Rules, dan Law & Order: Criminal Intent.

name: Taylor Hackford
title: Taylor Hackford
extract: Taylor Edwin Hackford is an American film director and former president of the Directors Guild of America. He won the Academy Award for Best Live Action Short Film for Teenage Father (1979). Hackford went on to direct a number of highly regarded feature films, including An Officer and a Gentleman (1982), The Devil's Advocate (1997) and Ray (2004), for the latter of which he was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Director and Academy Award for Best Picture.
extract_id: Taylor Edwin Hackford adalah sutradara film Amerika dan mantan presiden Directors Guild of America. Dia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Film Pendek Live Action Terbaik untuk Teenage Father (1979). Hackford kemudian menyutradarai sejumlah film fitur yang sangat diakui, termasuk An Officer and a Gentleman (1982), The Devil's Advocate (1997), dan Ray (2004), untuk film terakhir dia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award Sutradara Terbaik dan Academy Award Film Terbaik.

name: Taylor Sheridan
title: Taylor Sheridan
extract: Sheridan Taylor Gibler Jr., known professionally as Taylor Sheridan, is an American writer, producer, director, and actor. He is best known as the co-creator of the television series Yellowstone and creator of its prequels 1883 (2021) and 1923 (2022).
extract_id: Sheridan Taylor Gibler Jr., dikenal secara profesional sebagai Taylor Sheridan, adalah penulis, produser, sutradara, dan aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal sebagai salah satu pencipta seri televisi Yellowstone dan pencipta prekuelnya 1883 (2021) dan 1923 (2022).

name: Ted Demme
title: Ted Demme
extract: Edward Kern Demme was an American director, producer, and actor.
extract_id: Edward Kern Demme adalah sutradara, produser, dan aktor Amerika.

name: Ted Kotcheff
title: Ted Kotcheff
extract: William Theodore Kotcheff was a Canadian director and producer of film, television, and theatre. He worked at various times in Canada, the United Kingdom, and the United States. He was known for having directed such films as the seminal Australian New Wave picture Wake in Fright (1971), the Mordecai Richler adaptations The Apprenticeship of Duddy Kravitz (1974) and Joshua Then and Now (1985), the original Rambo film First Blood (1982), and the comedies Fun with Dick and Jane (1977), North Dallas Forty (1979), and Weekend at Bernie's (1989).
extract_id: William Theodore Kotcheff adalah sutradara dan produser film, televisi, dan teater Kanada. Dia bekerja pada berbagai waktu di Kanada, Inggris Raya, dan Amerika Serikat. Dia dikenal karena telah menyutradarai film-film seperti film penting Australian New Wave Wake in Fright (1971), adaptasi Mordecai Richler The Apprenticeship of Duddy Kravitz (1974) dan Joshua Then and Now (1985), film Rambo asli First Blood (1982), serta komedi Fun with Dick and Jane (1977), North Dallas Forty (1979), dan Weekend at Bernie's (1989).

name: Telly Savalas
title: Telly Savalas
extract: Aristotelis "Telly" Savalas was an American actor. Noted for his bald head and deep, resonant voice, he is perhaps best known for portraying Lt. Theo Kojak on the crime drama series Kojak (1973–1978) and James Bond archvillain Ernst Stavro Blofeld in the film On Her Majesty's Secret Service (1969).
extract_id: Aristotelis "Telly" Savalas adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal karena kepalanya yang botak dan suara yang dalam dan resonan, dia mungkin paling dikenal karena memerankan Letnan Theo Kojak dalam serial drama kriminal Kojak (1973–1978) dan penjahat utama James Bond Ernst Stavro Blofeld dalam film On Her Majesty's Secret Service (1969).

name: Temuera Morrison
title: Temuera Morrison
extract: Temuera Derek Morrison is a New Zealand actor who first gained recognition in his home country for playing Hone Ropata on the soap opera Shortland Street. He garnered critical acclaim for starring as Jake "The Muss" Heke in the 1994 film Once Were Warriors and its 1999 sequel What Becomes of the Broken Hearted?.
extract_id: Temuera Derek Morrison adalah aktor Selandia Baru yang pertama kali dikenal di negaranya sendiri setelah memerankan Hone Ropata dalam opera sabun Shortland Street. Dia mendapatkan pujian kritis karena membintangi sebagai Jake "The Muss" Heke dalam film 1994 Once Were Warriors dan sekuelnya pada 1999 What Becomes of the Broken Hearted?.

name: Tensai Okamura
title: Tensai Okamura
extract: Tensai Okamura , born Yutaka Okamura on December 13, 1961, in Fukushima Prefecture, is a Japanese anime director and animator. Okamura grew up in Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture. He is a graduate of Waseda University's department of science and engineering. In 1991, he changed his first name to Tensai.
extract_id: Tensai Okamura, lahir Yutaka Okamura pada 13 Desember 1961 di Prefektur Fukushima, adalah sutradara dan animator anime Jepang. Okamura dibesarkan di Yokohama, Prefektur Kanagawa. Dia adalah lulusan departemen ilmu pengetahuan dan teknik Universitas Waseda. Pada 1991, dia mengganti namanya menjadi Tensai.

name: Teo Briones
title: Teo Briones
extract: Mateo Justis Briones is an American actor and musician. He is best known for his starring roles as Junior Wheeler in the Syfy and USA Network series Chucky (2021) and as Charlie Reyes in the supernatural horror film Final Destination Bloodlines (2025). He's also appeared in the Freeform teen drama series Pretty Little Liars (2012–2013) and the Netflix psychological thriller series Ratched (2020).
extract_id: Mateo Justis Briones adalah aktor dan musisi Amerika. Dia paling dikenal untuk peran utamanya sebagai Junior Wheeler dalam seri Chucky Syfy dan USA Network (2021) serta sebagai Charlie Reyes dalam film horor supernatural Final Destination Bloodlines (2025). Dia juga pernah tampil dalam serial drama remaja Freeform Pretty Little Liars (2012–2013) dan serial thriller psikologis Netflix Ratched (2020).

name: Terence Alexander
title: Terence Alexander
extract: Terence Joseph Alexander was an English film and television actor, best known for his role as Charlie Hungerford in the British TV drama Bergerac, the original iteration of which ran for nine series on BBC1 from 1981 to 1991.
extract_id: Terence Joseph Alexander adalah aktor film dan televisi Inggris, dikenal karena perannya sebagai Charlie Hungerford dalam drama TV Inggris Bergerac, iterasi aslinya yang berlangsung selama sembilan seri di BBC1 dari 1981 hingga 1991.

name: Terence Young
title: Terence Young (director)
extract: Stewart Terence Herbert Young was a British film director and screenwriter who worked in the United Kingdom, Europe and Hollywood. He is best known for directing three James Bond films: the first two films in the series, Dr. No (1962) and From Russia with Love (1963), and Thunderball (1965). His other films include the Audrey Hepburn thrillers Wait Until Dark (1967) and Bloodline (1979), the historical drama Mayerling (1968), the infamous Korean War epic Inchon (1981), and the Charles Bronson films Cold Sweat (1970), Red Sun (1971), and The Valachi Papers (1972).
extract_id: Stewart Terence Herbert Young adalah sutradara film dan penulis skenario asal Inggris yang bekerja di Inggris, Eropa, dan Hollywood. Dia dikenal karena menyutradarai tiga film James Bond: dua film pertama dalam seri ini, Dr. No (1962) dan From Russia with Love (1963), serta Thunderball (1965). Film-film lainnya termasuk thriller Audrey Hepburn Wait Until Dark (1967) dan Bloodline (1979), drama sejarah Mayerling (1968), epik Perang Korea Inchon (1981), dan film-film Charles Bronson Cold Sweat (1970), Red Sun (1971), dan The Valachi Papers (1972).

name: Teresa Mo
title: Teresa Mo
extract: Teresa Mo Shun-kwan is a Hong Kong actress. She won the Hong Kong Film Award for Best Actress for Tomorrow Is Another Day (2017), previously winning Best Supporting Actress for 2 Young (2005).
extract_id: Teresa Mo Shun-kwan adalah seorang aktris Hong Kong. Dia memenangkan Hong Kong Film Award untuk Aktris Terbaik untuk Tomorrow Is Another Day (2017), sebelumnya memenangkan Aktris Pendukung Terbaik untuk 2 Young (2005).

name: Teresa Palmer
title: Teresa Palmer
extract: Teresa Mary Palmer is an Australian actress. Following her film debut in Wolf Creek (2005), Palmer had supporting roles in films such as The Grudge 2 (2006), Bedtime Stories (2008), The Sorcerer's Apprentice (2010), I Am Number Four, Take Me Home Tonight, Knight of Cups (2015), Triple 9 (2016), The Choice (2016), and The Fall Guy (2024).
extract_id: Teresa Mary Palmer adalah aktris Australia. Setelah debut filmnya di Wolf Creek (2005), Palmer memerankan peran pendukung dalam film seperti The Grudge 2 (2006), Bedtime Stories (2008), The Sorcerer's Apprentice (2010), I Am Number Four, Take Me Home Tonight, Knight of Cups (2015), Triple 9 (2016), The Choice (2016), dan The Fall Guy (2024).

name: Teresa Wright
title: Teresa Wright
extract: Muriel Teresa Wright was an American actress. She won the 1942 Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her role as Carol Beldon in Mrs. Miniver. She was nominated for the same award in 1941 for her debut work in The Little Foxes. Also in 1942, she received a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Actress for her performance in The Pride of the Yankees, opposite Gary Cooper. She is also known for her performances in Alfred Hitchcock's Shadow of a Doubt (1943), and in William Wyler's The Best Years of Our Lives (1946). Wright received five Photoplay Awards, two National Board of Review Awards, and two Hollywood Walk of Fame Stars for her contributions to motion pictures and television.
extract_id: Muriel Teresa Wright adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik pada 1942 untuk perannya sebagai Carol Beldon dalam Mrs. Miniver. Dia dinominasikan untuk penghargaan yang sama pada 1941 untuk perannya sebagai debut di The Little Foxes. Juga pada 1942, dia menerima nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik atas penampilannya dalam The Pride of the Yankees, bersama Gary Cooper. Dia juga dikenal karena penampilannya dalam Shadow of a Doubt (1943) karya Alfred Hitchcock, dan dalam The Best Years of Our Lives (1946) karya William Wyler. Wright menerima lima Photoplay Awards, dua National Board of Review Awards, dan dua Hollywood Walk of Fame Stars atas kontribusinya dalam film dan televisi.

name: Teri Garr
title: Teri Garr
extract: Terry Ann "Teri" Garr was an American actress, comedienne and dancer. Known for her comedic roles in film and television in the 1970s and 1980s, she often played women struggling to cope with the life-changing experiences of their husbands, children or boyfriends. She received nominations for an Academy Award and a British Academy Film Award for her performance in Tootsie (1982), playing a struggling actress who loses the soap opera role of a female hospital administrator to her male friend and acting coach.
extract_id: Terry Ann "Teri" Garr adalah aktris, komedian, dan penari Amerika. Dikenal karena peran komedinya di film dan televisi pada era 1970-an dan 1980-an, dia sering memerankan wanita yang berjuang menghadapi pengalaman hidup yang mengubah suami, anak, atau pacarnya. Dia menerima nominasi Academy Award dan British Academy Film Award untuk penampilannya dalam Tootsie (1982), memerankan aktris yang berjuang yang kehilangan peran opera sabun sebagai administrator rumah sakit wanita kepada teman pria dan pelatih aktingnya.

name: Teri Hatcher
title: Teri Hatcher
extract: Teri Lynn Hatcher is an American actress best known for her portrayal of Lois Lane on the television series Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman (1993–1997). She also played Paris Carver in the James Bond film Tomorrow Never Dies (1997), Mel Jones and the Beldam in Coraline (2009) and Susan Mayer on the television series Desperate Housewives (2004–2012), for which she won a Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Musical or Comedy and three Screen Actors Guild Awards, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series.
extract_id: Teri Lynn Hatcher adalah aktris Amerika yang dikenal karena perannya sebagai Lois Lane dalam serial televisi Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman (1993–1997). Dia juga memerankan Paris Carver dalam film James Bond Tomorrow Never Dies (1997), Mel Jones dan Beldam dalam Coraline (2009) serta Susan Mayer dalam serial televisi Desperate Housewives (2004–2012), yang membuatnya memenangkan Golden Globe Award untuk Aktris Terbaik dalam Musical atau Komedi dan tiga Screen Actors Guild Awards, serta dinominasikan untuk Primetime Emmy Award untuk Aktris Utama Terbaik dalam Serial Komedi.

name: Terrence Howard
title: Terrence Howard
extract: Terrence Dashon Howard is an American actor performing on film and television. He has received a Screen Actors Guild Award as well as nominations for an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, and two Independent Spirit Awards.
extract_id: Terrence Dashon Howard adalah aktor Amerika yang tampil dalam film dan televisi. Dia telah menerima Screen Actors Guild Award serta nominasi untuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan dua Independent Spirit Awards.

name: Terrence Malick
title: Terrence Malick
extract: Terrence Frederick Malick is an American filmmaker. Malick began his career as part of the New Hollywood generation of filmmakers and received numerous accolades, including the Palme d'Or and the Golden Bear, in addition to nominations for three Academy Awards, a Golden Globe Award, a DGA Award, and a WGA Award.
extract_id: Terrence Frederick Malick adalah pembuat film Amerika. Malick memulai karirnya sebagai bagian dari generasi pembuat film New Hollywood dan menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Palme d'Or dan Golden Bear, selain nominasi untuk tiga Academy Awards, Golden Globe Award, DGA Award, dan WGA Award.

name: Terry George
title: Terry George
extract: Terence George is an Irish screenwriter and film director. Much of his film work involves "The Troubles".
extract_id: Terence George adalah penulis skenario dan sutradara film Irlandia. Banyak karyanya yang mengangkat tema "The Troubles".

name: Terry Gilliam
title: Terry Gilliam
extract: Terrence Vance Gilliam is an American-born British filmmaker, comedian, collage animator, and actor. In a career spanning more than five decades, he has received various accolades including the BAFTA Fellowship for lifetime achievement in 2009, as well as nominations for an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a BAFTA Award.
extract_id: Terrence Vance Gilliam adalah pembuat film, komedian, animator kolase, dan aktor keturunan Amerika-Britania. Dalam karirnya yang berlangsung lebih dari lima dekade, dia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk BAFTA Fellowship untuk pencapaian seumur hidup pada 2009, serta nominasi untuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, dan BAFTA Award.

name: Terry Jones
title: Terry Jones
description: Welsh actor, comedian, director, historian and writer (1942–2020)
extract: Terence Graham Parry Jones was a Welsh actor, comedian, director, historian, writer and member of the Monty Python comedy troupe.
extract_id: Terence Graham Parry Jones adalah aktor, komedian, sutradara, sejarawan, penulis asal Wales dan anggota kelompok komedi Monty Python.

name: Tessa Thompson
title: Tessa Thompson
extract: Tessa Lynne Thompson is an American actress. Known for her roles in both blockbusters and independent dramas, her accolades include nominations for two BAFTA Awards, a Golden Globe Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Tessa Lynne Thompson adalah aktris Amerika. Dikenal karena perannya dalam blockbuster dan drama independen, penghargaannya termasuk nominasi untuk dua BAFTA Awards, Golden Globe Award, dan Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Tesshô Genda
title: Tesshō Genda
extract: Tesshō Genda is a Japanese actor, voice actor and narrator. He is employed by the talent management firm 81 Produce. When he debuted, he used his real name, Mitsuo Yokoi as artist name. Because he had experience with ballet, he was known by the nickname "Pirouette Genda." Genda is one of Japan's most prolific voice actors, with 234 roles credited to his name as of September 25, 2007.
extract_id: Tesshō Genda adalah aktor, pengisi suara, dan narator Jepang. Dia bekerja di perusahaan manajemen bakat 81 Produce. Saat debut, dia menggunakan nama asli Mitsuo Yokoi sebagai nama artis. Karena memiliki pengalaman balet, dia dikenal dengan julukan "Pirouette Genda." Genda adalah salah satu pengisi suara paling produktif di Jepang, dengan 234 peran yang tercatat hingga 25 September 2007.

name: Tetsurô Tanba
title: Tetsurō Tamba
extract: Tetsurō Tamba , born Shozaburo Tanba , was a Japanese actor with a career spanning five decades. He appeared in nearly 300 film and television productions, both in leading and supporting roles, and was the winner of the 1981 Japan Academy Film Prize for Best Supporting Actor.
extract_id: Tetsurō Tamba, lahir dengan nama Shozaburo Tanba, adalah aktor Jepang dengan karir yang berlangsung lima dekade. Dia tampil dalam hampir 300 produksi film dan televisi, baik dalam peran utama maupun pendukung, dan memenangkan Japan Academy Film Prize untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik pada 1981.

name: Tetsuya Nakashima
title: Tetsuya Nakashima
extract: Tetsuya Nakashima (中島哲也) is a Japanese film director and screenwriter.
extract_id: Tetsuya Nakashima (中島哲也) adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film Jepang.

name: Thandie Newton
title: Thandiwe Newton
extract: Melanie Thandiwe Newton, formerly credited as Thandie Newton, is a British actress. She has received various awards, including a Primetime Emmy and a BAFTA, as well as nominations for two Golden Globes. She was appointed Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) in the 2019 New Year Honours for services to film and charity.
extract_id: Melanie Thandiwe Newton, yang sebelumnya dikenal sebagai Thandie Newton, adalah aktris Inggris. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Primetime Emmy dan BAFTA, serta nominasi untuk dua Golden Globes. Dia diangkat sebagai Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) pada 2019 New Year Honours atas jasanya di bidang film dan amal.

name: Thelma Ritter
title: Thelma Ritter
extract: Thelma Ritter was an American character actress known for her strong New York City accent, diminutive size, and plain look; she favored working-class roles and earned a Tony Award and six Academy Award nominations for Best Supporting Actress, more than any other actress in the category.
extract_id: Thelma Ritter adalah aktris karakter Amerika yang dikenal dengan aksen New York City-nya yang kuat, ukuran tubuh yang kecil, dan penampilan sederhana; dia lebih memilih peran kelas pekerja dan memenangkan Tony Award serta enam nominasi Academy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik, lebih banyak daripada aktris lain di kategori tersebut.

name: Theodore Melfi
title: Theodore Melfi
extract: Theodore Melfi is an American filmmaker. In 2016, Melfi co-wrote, directed, and co-produced Hidden Figures, for which he received Oscar nominations for Best Picture and Best Adapted Screenplay. He is of Italian descent.
extract_id: Theodore Melfi adalah pembuat film Amerika. Pada 2016, Melfi menulis, menyutradarai, dan memproduseri bersama Hidden Figures, yang membuatnya menerima nominasi Oscar untuk Film Terbaik dan Skenario Adaptasi Terbaik. Dia berdarah keturunan Italia.

name: Thierry Lhermitte
title: Thierry Lhermitte
description: French actor, director, writer and producer (born 1952)
extract: Thierry Michel Lhermitte is a French actor, director, writer and producer, best known for his comedic roles. He was a founder of the comedy troupe Le Splendid in the 1970s, along with, among others, Christian Clavier, Gérard Jugnot, and Michel Blanc. The group adapted a number of its stage hits for the cinema, and scored major successes with films such as Les Bronzés (1978), Les Bronzés font du ski (1979), Le Père Noël est une ordure (1982) and Un indien dans la ville (1994).
extract_id: Thierry Michel Lhermitte adalah aktor, sutradara, penulis, dan produser Prancis, dikenal karena peran komedinya. Dia adalah salah satu pendiri grup komedi Le Splendid pada 1970-an, bersama, antara lain, Christian Clavier, Gérard Jugnot, dan Michel Blanc. Grup ini mengadaptasi beberapa hits panggungnya untuk layar lebar dan meraih kesuksesan besar dengan film seperti Les Bronzés (1978), Les Bronzés font du ski (1979), Le Père Noël est une ordure (1982), dan Un indien dans la ville (1994).

name: Thierry van Werveke
title: Thierry Van Werveke
extract: Thierry van Werveke was a Luxembourgish actor. He appeared in over 60 films and television shows between 1988 and 2009. He starred in Hochzäitsnuecht, which was screened in the Un Certain Regard section at the 1992 Cannes Film Festival.
extract_id: Thierry van Werveke adalah aktor asal Luksemburg. Dia tampil dalam lebih dari 60 film dan acara televisi antara 1988 dan 2009. Dia membintangi Hochzäitsnuecht, yang ditayangkan dalam bagian Un Certain Regard di Festival Film Cannes 1992.

name: Thom Hoffman
title: Thom Hoffman
extract: Thomas Antonius Cornelis Ancion, known by the pseudonym Thom Hoffman, is a Dutch actor and photographer.
extract_id: Thomas Antonius Cornelis Ancion, dikenal dengan nama samaran Thom Hoffman, adalah aktor dan fotografer Belanda.

name: Thomas Bo Larsen
title: Thomas Bo Larsen
extract: Thomas Bo Larsen is a Danish actor. He is known for his appearance in several films by Thomas Vinterberg, including The Celebration (1998), The Hunt (2012), Another Round (2020), and the 2024 TV series Families like Ours.
extract_id: Thomas Bo Larsen adalah aktor Denmark. Dia dikenal karena penampilannya dalam beberapa film karya Thomas Vinterberg, termasuk The Celebration (1998), The Hunt (2012), Another Round (2020), dan serial TV 2024 Families like Ours.

name: Thomas F. Wilson
title: Thomas F. Wilson
extract: Thomas Francis Wilson Jr. is an American actor, stand-up comedian, musician, podcaster, and YouTuber. He is best known for playing Biff Tannen, Griff Tannen, and Buford "Mad Dog" Tannen in the Back to the Future film trilogy (1985–1990). He played coach Ben Fredricks in the comedy series Freaks and Geeks (1999–2000) and voices various characters, mainly villains, like Flats the Flounder and The Tattletale Strangler on the animated series SpongeBob SquarePants (2001–present). He also voices Cecil Star, the father of Patrick Star, in the SpongeBob spinoff The Patrick Star Show.
extract_id: Thomas Francis Wilson Jr. adalah aktor Amerika, komedian stand-up, musisi, podcaster, dan YouTuber. Dia dikenal karena memerankan Biff Tannen, Griff Tannen, dan Buford "Mad Dog" Tannen dalam trilogi film Back to the Future (1985–1990). Dia memerankan pelatih Ben Fredricks dalam serial komedi Freaks and Geeks (1999–2000) dan mengisi suara berbagai karakter, terutama penjahat, seperti Flats the Flounder dan The Tattletale Strangler dalam serial animasi SpongeBob SquarePants (2001–sekarang). Dia juga mengisi suara Cecil Star, ayah Patrick Star, dalam spin-off SpongeBob, The Patrick Star Show.

name: Thomas Jahn
title: Thomas Jahn
extract: Thomas Jahn is a German film and television director.
extract_id: Thomas Jahn adalah sutradara film dan televisi asal Jerman.

name: Thomas Kail
title: Thomas Kail
extract: Thomas Kail is an American theatre director, television director, and producer. He is known for directing the Off-Broadway and Broadway productions of Lin-Manuel Miranda's musicals In the Heights and Hamilton, garnering the 2016 Tony Award for Best Direction of a Musical for the latter. Kail was awarded the Kennedy Center Honor in 2018. He has also directed the television series Fosse/Verdon (2019), for which he was nominated for two Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: Thomas Kail adalah sutradara teater Amerika, sutradara televisi, dan produser. Ia dikenal karena menyutradarai produksi Off-Broadway dan Broadway dari musikal Lin-Manuel Miranda In the Heights dan Hamilton, memenangkan Tony Award 2016 untuk Sutradara Terbaik Musikal untuk yang terakhir. Kail dianugerahi Kennedy Center Honor pada tahun 2018. Ia juga menyutradarai serial televisi Fosse/Verdon (2019), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk dua Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Thomas Kretschmann
title: Thomas Kretschmann
extract: Thomas Kretschmann is a German actor who has appeared in many European and American films. Best known for portraying historical or fictional military officers, his notable roles include Lieutenant Hans von Witzland in Stalingrad (1993), Hauptmann Wilm Hosenfeld in The Pianist (2002), Hermann Fegelein in Downfall (2004), Captain Englehorn in King Kong (2005), Major Otto Remer in Valkyrie (2008), the voice of Professor Z in Cars 2 (2011), and the journalist Jürgen Hinzpeter in A Taxi Driver (2017). He also portrayed Baron Wolfgang von Strucker in the Marvel Cinematic Universe films Captain America: The Winter Soldier (2014) and Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015).
extract_id: Thomas Kretschmann adalah aktor Jerman yang telah tampil dalam banyak film Eropa dan Amerika. Terkenal karena memerankan perwira militer historis atau fiktif, peran pentingnya meliputi Letnan Hans von Witzland dalam Stalingrad (1993), Hauptmann Wilm Hosenfeld dalam The Pianist (2002), Hermann Fegelein dalam Downfall (2004), Kapten Englehorn dalam King Kong (2005), Mayor Otto Remer dalam Valkyrie (2008), pengisi suara Profesor Z dalam Cars 2 (2011), dan jurnalis Jürgen Hinzpeter dalam A Taxi Driver (2017). Ia juga memerankan Baron Wolfgang von Strucker dalam film-film Marvel Cinematic Universe Captain America: The Winter Soldier (2014) dan Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015).

name: Thomas Mann
title: Thomas Mann (actor)
extract: Thomas Mann is an American actor. After making his film debut with a supporting role in It's Kind of a Funny Story (2010), Mann had his breakout with a lead role in the found footage teen comedy film Project X (2012).
extract_id: Thomas Mann adalah aktor Amerika. Setelah memulai debut filmnya dengan peran pendukung dalam It's Kind of a Funny Story (2010), Mann meraih terobosan dengan peran utama dalam film komedi remaja found footage Project X (2012).

name: Thomas Mitchell
title: Thomas Mitchell (actor)
extract: Thomas John Mitchell was an American character actor, writer, and theater director. He is considered one of the both greatest supporting and character actors of the Golden Age of Hollywood and a leading man on Broadway.
extract_id: Thomas John Mitchell adalah aktor karakter Amerika, penulis, dan sutradara teater. Ia dianggap sebagai salah satu aktor pendukung dan karakter terbaik pada Zaman Keemasan Hollywood serta pemeran utama di Broadway.

name: Thomas Turgoose
title: Thomas Turgoose
extract: Thomas Aiden Turgoose is an English actor, best known for his role as Shaun Fields in the film This Is England (2006), a role he reprises in the This Is England mini TV series trilogy This Is England '86 (2010), This Is England '88 (2011) and This Is England '90 (2015).
extract_id: Thomas Aiden Turgoose adalah aktor Inggris, paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Shaun Fields dalam film This Is England (2006), sebuah peran yang diulanginya dalam trilogi serial mini TV This Is England yaitu This Is England '86 (2010), This Is England '88 (2011), dan This Is England '90 (2015).

name: Thomas Vinterberg
title: Thomas Vinterberg
extract: Thomas Vinterberg is a Danish film director who, along with Lars von Trier, co-founded the Dogme 95 movement in filmmaking, which established rules for simplifying movie production. He is best known for the films The Celebration (1998), Submarino (2010), The Hunt (2012), Far from the Madding Crowd (2015), and Another Round (2020). For Another Round he was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Director, the first Danish filmmaker nominated in the Best Director category.
extract_id: Thomas Vinterberg adalah sutradara film Denmark yang, bersama dengan Lars von Trier, mendirikan gerakan Dogme 95 dalam pembuatan film yang menetapkan aturan untuk menyederhanakan produksi film. Ia paling dikenal lewat film-film The Celebration (1998), Submarino (2010), The Hunt (2012), Far from the Madding Crowd (2015), dan Another Round (2020). Untuk Another Round ia dinominasikan untuk Academy Award Sutradara Terbaik, menjadi pembuat film Denmark pertama yang dinominasikan dalam kategori Sutradara Terbaik.

name: Thomasin McKenzie
title: Thomasin McKenzie
extract: Thomasin Harcourt McKenzie is a New Zealand actress. After a minor role in The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies (2014), she rose to critical prominence for playing a young girl living in isolation in Debra Granik's drama film Leave No Trace (2018), winning the National Board of Review Award for Breakthrough Performance.
extract_id: Thomasin Harcourt McKenzie adalah aktris Selandia Baru. Setelah peran kecil dalam The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies (2014), ia meraih sorotan kritis dengan memerankan seorang gadis muda yang hidup dalam isolasi dalam film drama Debra Granik Leave No Trace (2018), memenangkan National Board of Review Award untuk Penampilan Terobosan.

name: Thora Birch
title: Thora Birch
extract: Thora Birch is an American actress. She made her film debut with a starring role in Purple People Eater (1988) and won a Young Artist Award for "Best Actress Under Nine Years of Age". Birch rose to prominence as a child star during the 1990s through a string of parts in films, such as Paradise (1991), Patriot Games (1992), Hocus Pocus (1993), Monkey Trouble (1994), Now and Then (1995), and Alaska (1996). Her breakthrough into adult-oriented roles came with her portrayal of Jane Burnham in American Beauty (1999), for which she was nominated for the BAFTA for Best Supporting Actress.
extract_id: Thora Birch adalah aktris Amerika. Ia memulai debut filmnya dengan peran utama dalam Purple People Eater (1988) dan memenangkan Young Artist Award untuk "Aktris Terbaik di Bawah Usia Sembilan Tahun". Birch meraih ketenaran sebagai bintang cilik pada 1990-an melalui sejumlah peran dalam film seperti Paradise (1991), Patriot Games (1992), Hocus Pocus (1993), Monkey Trouble (1994), Now and Then (1995), dan Alaska (1996). Terobosan peran dewasa didapatkan saat ia memerankan Jane Burnham dalam American Beauty (1999), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk BAFTA Aktris Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Tigmanshu Dhulia
title: Tigmanshu Dhulia
extract: Tigmanshu Dhulia is an Indian filmmaker and actor, known for his works in Hindi cinema and Television. He wrote the dialogue for the 1998 film Dil Se.., the first Bollywood film to chart in the UK top ten, and screened at the Berlin International Film Festival. His directing career has also garnered international recognition with the biographical film Paan Singh Tomar, premiered at the 2010 BFI London Film Festival and the thriller drama Saheb, Biwi Aur Gangster.
extract_id: Tigmanshu Dhulia adalah pembuat film dan aktor India, dikenal karena karyanya dalam sinema Hindi dan Televisi. Ia menulis dialog untuk film tahun 1998 Dil Se.., film Bollywood pertama yang masuk dalam sepuluh besar di Inggris dan diputar di Berlin International Film Festival. Karir penyutradaraannya juga mendapatkan pengakuan internasional dengan film biografi Paan Singh Tomar yang ditayangkan perdana di BFI London Film Festival 2010 dan drama thriller Saheb, Biwi Aur Gangster.

name: Til Schweiger
title: Til Schweiger
extract: Tilman Valentin Schweiger is a German actor and filmmaker. He became known in the 1990s for films such as Manta, Manta, Der bewegte Mann and Knockin' on Heaven's Door. He went on to star in international film productions such as Inglourious Basterds, Lara Croft: Tomb Raider – The Cradle of Life and King Arthur. He founded his own production company Barefoot Films. Films like Rabbit Without Ears, Rabbit Without Ears 2, Kokowääh and Head Full of Honey, in which he was director, producer and actor, drew large audiences, making Schweiger the most commercially successful German filmmaker.
extract_id: Tilman Valentin Schweiger adalah aktor dan pembuat film Jerman. Ia dikenal pada tahun 1990-an melalui film-film seperti Manta, Manta, Der bewegte Mann, dan Knockin' on Heaven's Door. Ia melanjutkan karir dengan membintangi produksi film internasional seperti Inglourious Basterds, Lara Croft: Tomb Raider – The Cradle of Life, dan King Arthur. Ia mendirikan perusahaan produksinya sendiri bernama Barefoot Films. Film-film seperti Rabbit Without Ears, Rabbit Without Ears 2, Kokowääh, dan Head Full of Honey, di mana ia menjadi sutradara, produser, dan aktor, menarik banyak penonton, membuat Schweiger menjadi pembuat film Jerman dengan pencapaian komersial tertinggi.

name: Tilda Swinton
title: Tilda Swinton
extract: Katherine Matilda "Tilda" Swinton is a Scottish actress. Known for her performances on both stage and screen, she has received various accolades, including an Academy Award, two BAFTAs, and a Volpi Cup, in addition to nominations for five Actor Awards and four Golden Globe Awards. In 2020, The New York Times ranked her as one of the greatest actors of the 21st century.
extract_id: Katherine Matilda "Tilda" Swinton adalah aktris Skotlandia. Dikenal karena penampilannya di panggung dan layar, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, dua BAFTA, dan Volpi Cup, serta nominasi untuk lima Actor Awards dan empat Golden Globe Awards. Pada 2020, The New York Times menempatkannya sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar abad ke-21.

name: Tim Allen
title: Tim Allen
extract: Timothy Alan Dick, known professionally as Tim Allen, is an American actor and comedian. He is known for playing Tim "The Toolman" Taylor on the ABC sitcom Home Improvement (1991–1999) for which he won a Golden Globe Award and Mike Baxter on the ABC/Fox sitcom Last Man Standing (2011–2021). He voices Buzz Lightyear for the Toy Story franchise (1995–present) for which he won an Annie Award and played Scott Calvin and Santa Claus in The Santa Clause franchise (1994–2023).
extract_id: Timothy Alan Dick, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Tim Allen, adalah aktor dan komedian Amerika. Ia dikenal karena memerankan Tim "The Toolman" Taylor dalam sitkom ABC Home Improvement (1991–1999) yang membuatnya memenangkan Golden Globe Award, dan Mike Baxter dalam sitkom ABC/Fox Last Man Standing (2011–2021). Ia mengisi suara Buzz Lightyear dalam waralaba Toy Story (1995–sekarang) yang membuatnya memenangkan Annie Award serta memerankan Scott Calvin dan Santa Claus dalam waralaba The Santa Clause (1994–2023).

name: Tim Blake Nelson
title: Tim Blake Nelson
extract: Timothy Blake Nelson is an American actor, director, and writer. Described as a "modern character actor", his roles include Delmar O'Donnell in O Brother, Where Art Thou? (2000), Gideon in Minority Report (2002), Doctor Steve Pendanski in Holes (2003), Doctor Jonathan Jacobo in Scooby-Doo 2: Monsters Unleashed (2004), Danny Dalton Jr. in Syriana (2005), Samuel Sterns / The Leader in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, Richard Schell in Lincoln (2012), the eponymous character of The Ballad of Buster Scruggs (2018), and Henry McCarty in Old Henry (2021). He portrayed Wade Tillman / Looking Glass in the HBO limited series Watchmen (2019), for which he received a Critics' Choice Television Awards nomination for Best Supporting Actor in a Drama Series in 2020.
extract_id: Timothy Blake Nelson adalah aktor, sutradara, dan penulis Amerika. Dideskripsikan sebagai "aktor karakter modern", perannya meliputi Delmar O'Donnell dalam O Brother, Where Art Thou? (2000), Gideon dalam Minority Report (2002), Dokter Steve Pendanski dalam Holes (2003), Dokter Jonathan Jacobo dalam Scooby-Doo 2: Monsters Unleashed (2004), Danny Dalton Jr. dalam Syriana (2005), Samuel Sterns / The Leader dalam Marvel Cinematic Universe, Richard Schell dalam Lincoln (2012), tokoh utama dalam The Ballad of Buster Scruggs (2018), dan Henry McCarty dalam Old Henry (2021). Ia memerankan Wade Tillman / Looking Glass dalam seri terbatas HBO Watchmen (2019), yang membuatnya menerima nominasi Critics' Choice Television Awards untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam Serial Drama pada 2020.

name: Tim Burton
title: Tim Burton
extract: Timothy Walter Burton is an American filmmaker and former animator. He is known for pioneering Goth subculture in Hollywood, with his films employing a distinctive style that blends Gothic horror and dark fantasy aesthetics with whimsical and surreal elements. He has received numerous accolades, including one Emmy Award and nominations for two Academy Awards, a Golden Globe Award, and three BAFTA Awards. He was honored with the Venice International Film Festival's Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement in 2007 and France's Order of Arts and Letters in 2010.
extract_id: Timothy Walter Burton adalah pembuat film dan mantan animator Amerika. Ia dikenal karena mempelopori subkultur Goth di Hollywood, dengan film-filmnya menggunakan gaya khas yang memadukan estetika horor Gotik dan fantasi gelap dengan unsur-unsur aneh dan surealis. Ia telah menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk satu Emmy Award dan nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards, satu Golden Globe Award, dan tiga BAFTA Awards. Ia dianugerahi Golden Lion untuk Prestasi Seumur Hidup oleh Venice International Film Festival pada 2007 dan Order of Arts and Letters dari Prancis pada 2010.

name: Tim Holt
title: Tim Holt
extract: Charles John "Tim" Holt III was an American actor. He was a popular Western star during the 1940s and early 1950s, appearing in forty-six B westerns released by RKO Pictures.
extract_id: Charles John "Tim" Holt III adalah aktor Amerika. Ia adalah bintang film western populer selama tahun 1940-an dan awal 1950-an, membintangi empat puluh enam film western B yang dirilis oleh RKO Pictures.

name: Tim McGraw
title: Tim McGraw
extract: Samuel Timothy McGraw is an American country singer and actor. He has released 17 studio albums. Ten of those albums have reached number one on the Top Country Albums charts, with his 1994 breakthrough album Not a Moment Too Soon being the top country album of 1994. In total, McGraw's albums have produced 65 singles, 25 of which have reached number one on the Hot Country Songs or Country Airplay charts.
extract_id: Samuel Timothy McGraw adalah penyanyi country dan aktor Amerika. Ia telah merilis 17 album studio. Sepuluh dari album tersebut mencapai posisi nomor satu di tangga lagu Top Country Albums, dengan album terobosannya tahun 1994 Not a Moment Too Soon menjadi album country teratas tahun 1994. Secara total, album McGraw menghasilkan 65 single, 25 di antaranya mencapai posisi nomor satu di tangga lagu Hot Country Songs atau Country Airplay.

name: Tim Miller
