title: Tim Miller (director)
extract: Timothy Miller is an American filmmaker, animator, and visual effects artist. He is best known for directing the films Deadpool (2016) and Terminator: Dark Fate (2019). He is also the creator of the animated anthology series Love, Death & Robots (2019–present), for which he has won three Primetime Emmy Awards for Outstanding Short Form Animated Program.
extract_id: Timothy Miller adalah pembuat film, animator, dan artis efek visual Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena menyutradarai film Deadpool (2016) dan Terminator: Dark Fate (2019). Ia juga pencipta serial antologi animasi Love, Death & Robots (2019–sekarang), yang membuatnya memenangkan tiga Primetime Emmy Awards untuk Outstanding Short Form Animated Program.

name: Tim Robbins
title: Tim Robbins
extract: Timothy Francis Robbins is an American actor, director, producer, and writer. Known for his work on film and television, his accolades include an Academy Award, an Actor Award, and three Golden Globe Awards, in addition to nominations for two BAFTAs and a Grammy Award.

name: Tim Roth

name: Timothy Bottoms
title: Timothy Bottoms
extract: Timothy James Bottoms is an American actor and film producer. He is best known for playing the lead in Johnny Got His Gun (1971); Sonny Crawford in The Last Picture Show (1971), where he and his fellow co-stars, Cybill Shepherd and Jeff Bridges, rose to fame; and as James Hart, the first-year law student who battles with Prof. Kingsfield, in the film adaptation The Paper Chase (1973). He is also known for playing the main antagonist in the disaster film Rollercoaster (1977) and for playing President George W. Bush multiple times, including on the sitcom That's My Bush!, the comedy film The Crocodile Hunter: Collision Course and the docudrama DC 9/11: Time of Crisis.
extract_id: Timothy James Bottoms adalah aktor dan produser film Amerika. Ia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai pemeran utama dalam Johnny Got His Gun (1971); Sonny Crawford dalam The Last Picture Show (1971), di mana ia dan rekan-rekannya Cybill Shepherd dan Jeff Bridges meraih ketenaran; serta sebagai James Hart, mahasiswa hukum tahun pertama yang berkonflik dengan Prof. Kingsfield, dalam adaptasi film The Paper Chase (1973). Ia juga dikenal karena memerankan antagonis utama dalam film bencana Rollercoaster (1977) dan memerankan Presiden George W. Bush beberapa kali, termasuk dalam sitkom That's My Bush!, film komedi The Crocodile Hunter: Collision Course, dan docudrama DC 9/11: Time of Crisis.

name: Timothy Hutton
title: Timothy Hutton
extract: Timothy Hutton is an American actor and film director. He is the youngest recipient of the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor, which he won at age 20 for Ordinary People (1980). Hutton has since appeared regularly in feature films and on television, with notable roles including the drama Taps (1981), the spy film The Falcon and the Snowman (1985), and the horror film The Dark Half (1993), among others.

Hutton sejak itu sering tampil dalam film fitur dan televisi, dengan peran penting termasuk drama Taps (1981), film mata-mata The Falcon and the Snowman (1985), dan film horor The Dark Half (1993), di antara lainnya.

name: Timothy Spall
title: Timothy Spall

name: Timothée Chalamet
title: Timothée Chalamet

name: Tina Fey
title: Tina Fey
extract: Elizabeth Stamatina "Tina" Fey is an American actress, comedian, writer, and producer. Known for her comedic roles in sketch comedy, television and film, Fey has received numerous accolades, including ten Primetime Emmy Awards and two Golden Globe Awards as well as nominations for a Grammy Award and a Tony Award. She appeared on the Time 100 list of the 100 most influential people in the world in both 2007 and 2009, and was awarded the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor in 2010.
extract_id: Elizabeth Stamatina "Tina" Fey adalah aktris, komedian, penulis, dan produser Amerika. name: Tiny Sandford
title: Tiny Sandford
extract: Stanley J. "Tiny" Sandford was an American actor who is best remembered for his roles in Laurel and Hardy and Charlie Chaplin films. His tall, burly physique usually led him to be cast as a comic heavy, and often played policemen, doormen, prizefighters, or bullies.
extract_id: Stanley J. "Tiny" Sandford adalah aktor Amerika yang paling dikenang karena perannya dalam film-film Laurel and Hardy dan Charlie Chaplin. Tubuhnya yang tinggi dan besar biasanya membuatnya diperankan sebagai karakter berat komedi, dan sering berperan sebagai polisi, petugas pintu, petinju, atau pembuli.

name: Tippi Hedren
title: Tippi Hedren
extract: Nathalie Kay "Tippi" Hedren is an American former actress. Initially a fashion model, appearing on the front covers of Life and Glamour magazines, she became an actress after being discovered by director Alfred Hitchcock while appearing on a television commercial in 1961. Hedren received worldwide recognition due to her work in two of his films, the suspense-thriller The Birds (1963) and the psychological drama Marnie (1964). She performed in over 80 films and television shows, including Charlie Chaplin's final film A Countess from Hong Kong (1967), the political satire Citizen Ruth (1996), and the existential comedy I Heart Huckabees (2004). Among other honors, her contributions to world cinema have been recognized with the Jules Verne Award and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
extract_id: Nathalie Kay "Tippi" Hedren adalah mantan aktris Amerika. Awalnya seorang model fashion, tampil di sampul depan majalah Life dan Glamour, dia menjadi aktris setelah ditemukan oleh sutradara Alfred Hitchcock saat tampil dalam iklan televisi pada tahun 1961. Hedren menerima pengakuan dunia karena karyanya dalam dua filmnya, film thriller suspense The Birds (1963) dan drama psikologis Marnie (1964). Dia tampil dalam lebih dari 80 film dan acara televisi, termasuk film terakhir Charlie Chaplin A Countess from Hong Kong (1967), satir politik Citizen Ruth (1996), dan komedi eksistensial I Heart Huckabees (2004). Di antara penghargaan lainnya, kontribusinya terhadap sinema dunia telah diakui dengan Jules Verne Award dan sebuah bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame.

name: Tisca Chopra
title: Tisca Chopra

extract_id: Tisca Chopra adalah seorang aktris, penulis, dan produser film India yang telah tampil dalam lebih dari 45 film fitur, terutama dalam bahasa Hindi.

name: Tobey Maguire
title: Tobey Maguire
extract: Tobias Vincent Maguire is an American actor and film producer. He began his career in supporting roles, before gaining international recognition and critical praise for his role as Spider-Man in Sam Raimi's 2002 film Spider-Man. Maguire reprised the role in two sequels, Spider-Man 2 (2004) and Spider-Man 3 (2007). He returned to the role in Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021).
extract_id: Tobias Vincent Maguire adalah seorang aktor dan produser film Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya dengan peran pendukung, sebelum mendapatkan pengakuan internasional dan pujian kritis untuk perannya sebagai Spider-Man dalam film Spider-Man karya Sam Raimi pada tahun 2002. Maguire mengulangi peran tersebut dalam dua sekuel, Spider-Man 2 (2004) dan Spider-Man 3 (2007). Dia kembali memerankan peran tersebut dalam Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021).

name: Toby Kebbell
title: Toby Kebbell

He is known for his roles in films such as Dead Man's Shoes (2004), Control (2007), RocknRolla (2008), Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time (2010), The Sorcerer's Apprentice (2010), War Horse (2011), Wrath of the Titans (2012), Dawn of the Planet of the Apes (2014), Fantastic Four (2015), Warcraft (2016), A Monster Calls (2016), Ben-Hur (2016), Gold (2016), and Bloodshot (2020). He is also known for his work in the Black Mirror episode "The Entire History of You" (2011) and starred in the MonsterVerse film Kong: Skull Island (2017) and the Apple TV+ series Servant (2019–2023) and For All Mankind (2023–present).

name: Tod Browning
title: Tod Browning
extract: Tod Browning was an American film director, film actor, screenwriter, vaudeville performer, and carnival sideshow and circus entertainer. He directed a number of films of various genres between 1915 and 1939, but was primarily known for horror films. Some film writers have referred to Browning as "the Edgar Allan Poe of cinema".
extract_id: Tod Browning adalah seorang sutradara film Amerika, aktor film, penulis naskah, pemain vaudeville, dan penghibur pertunjukan sampingan karnaval serta sirkus. Dia menyutradarai sejumlah film dengan berbagai genre antara tahun 1915 dan 1939, tetapi terutama dikenal untuk film-film horor. Beberapa penulis film telah menyebut Browning sebagai "Edgar Allan Poe dari sinema".

name: Todd Haynes
title: Todd Haynes
extract: Todd Haynes is an American film director, screenwriter, and producer whose work is known for its engagement with melodrama, historical pastiche, and queer cinema. Across four decades, his films frequently explore the emotional and psychological consequences of social repression, particularly as they relate to sexuality, identity, illness, and conformity. Haynes is often associated with the New Queer Cinema movement of the early 1990s and is noted for reworking classical Hollywood forms — such as the woman’s picture and the biopic — to examine marginalized experiences and unspoken desire.
extract_id: Todd Haynes adalah seorang sutradara film, penulis naskah, dan produser Amerika yang karyanya dikenal karena keterlibatannya dengan melodrama, pastiche historis, dan sinema queer. Selama empat dekade, film-filmnya sering mengeksplorasi konsekuensi emosional dan psikologis dari represi sosial, terutama yang berkaitan dengan seksualitas, identitas, penyakit, dan konformitas. Haynes sering dikaitkan dengan gerakan New Queer Cinema pada awal 1990-an dan dikenal karena mengolah ulang bentuk klasik Hollywood — seperti film wanita dan biopik — untuk memeriksa pengalaman yang termarjinalkan dan keinginan yang tidak terucapkan.

name: Todd Phillips
title: Todd Phillips
extract: Todd Phillips is an American filmmaker. He began his career in 1993 and directed films in the 2000s such as Road Trip, Old School, Starsky & Hutch, and School for Scoundrels. He came to wider prominence in the early 2010s for directing The Hangover film series. In 2019, Phillips co-wrote and directed the psychological thriller film Joker, based on the DC Comics character of the same name, which premiered at the 76th Venice International Film Festival where it received the top prize, the Golden Lion. Joker went on to earn Phillips three Academy Award nominations for Best Picture, Best Director, and Best Adapted Screenplay, with his co-writer Scott Silver, his second, third, and fourth Academy Award nominations after also being nominated for Best Adapted Screenplay for Borat at the 79th Academy Awards.
extract_id: Todd Phillips adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya pada tahun 1993 dan menyutradarai film-film pada tahun 2000-an seperti Road Trip, Old School, Starsky & Hutch, dan School for Scoundrels. Dia menjadi lebih terkenal pada awal 2010-an karena menyutradarai seri film The Hangover. Pada tahun 2019, Phillips menulis bersama dan menyutradarai film thriller psikologis Joker, berdasarkan karakter DC Comics dengan nama yang sama, yang tayang perdana di Festival Film Internasional Venesia ke-76 dan meraih penghargaan tertinggi, Golden Lion. Joker kemudian membawa Phillips meraih tiga nominasi Academy Award untuk Best Picture, Best Director, dan Best Adapted Screenplay, bersama co-writer-nya Scott Silver, sebagai nominasi Academy Award kedua, ketiga, dan keempatnya setelah juga dinominasikan untuk Best Adapted Screenplay untuk Borat pada Academy Awards ke-79.

name: Todd Solondz
title: Todd Solondz
extract: Todd Solondz is an American filmmaker and playwright known for his style of dark, socially conscious satire. Solondz's work has received critical acclaim for its commentary on the "dark underbelly of middle class American suburbia", a reflection of his own background in New Jersey. His work includes Welcome to the Dollhouse (1995), Happiness (1998), Storytelling (2001), Palindromes (2004), Life During Wartime (2009), Dark Horse (2011), and Wiener-Dog (2016). He is also a professor at New York University.
extract_id: Todd Solondz adalah seorang pembuat film dan penulis drama Amerika yang dikenal dengan gaya satir gelap dan sadar sosial. Karya Solondz mendapat pujian kritis untuk komentarnya tentang "kegelapan sisi terselubung kelas menengah Amerika suburban", sebuah refleksi dari latar belakangnya sendiri di New Jersey. Karyanya meliputi Welcome to the Dollhouse (1995), Happiness (1998), Storytelling (2001), Palindromes (2004), Life During Wartime (2009), Dark Horse (2011), dan Wiener-Dog (2016). Dia juga seorang profesor di New York University.

name: Tom Cruise
title: Tom Cruise

name: Tom Hanks
title: Tom Hanks

His numerous awards include two Academy Awards, seven Emmy Awards, and four Golden Globe Awards; he has also been nominated for five BAFTAs and a Tony Award. He received the AFI Life Achievement Award in 2002, the Kennedy Center Honor in 2014, the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2016, and the Golden Globe Cecil B. DeMille Award in 2020.
extract_id: Thomas Jeffrey Hanks adalah seorang aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. name: Tom Skerritt
title: Tom Skerritt
extract: Thomas Roy Skerritt was an American actor and director who appeared in over 170 film and television productions between 1962 and 2025. The beginning of his film career coincided with the New Hollywood movement, with a breakthrough role as Duke Forrest in Robert Altman's M*A*S*H (1970). He then starred in notable films like The Turning Point (1977), Up in Smoke (1978), Ice Castles (1978), Alien (1979), The Dead Zone (1983), Top Gun (1986), SpaceCamp (1986), Steel Magnolias (1989), and A River Runs Through It (1992).
extract_id: Thomas Roy Skerritt adalah aktor dan sutradara Amerika yang tampil dalam lebih dari 170 produksi film dan televisi antara tahun 1962 dan 2025. name: Tom Tykwer
title: Tom Tykwer
extract: Tom Tykwer is a German film director, producer, screenwriter, and composer. He is best known internationally for directing the thriller films Run Lola Run (1998), Heaven (2002), Perfume: The Story of a Murderer (2006), and The International (2009). He collaborated with The Wachowskis as co-director for the science fiction film Cloud Atlas (2012) and the Netflix series Sense8 (2015–2017), and worked on the score for Lana Wachowski's The Matrix Resurrections (2021). Tykwer is also well known as the co-creator of the internationally acclaimed German television series Babylon Berlin (2017–2026).
extract_id: Tom Tykwer adalah sutradara film, produser, penulis skenario, dan komponis Jerman. Dia dikenal secara internasional karena menyutradarai film thriller Run Lola Run (1998), Heaven (2002), Perfume: The Story of a Murderer (2006), dan The International (2009). Dia berkolaborasi dengan The Wachowskis sebagai co-sutradara film fiksi ilmiah Cloud Atlas (2012) dan serial Netflix Sense8 (2015–2017), serta bekerja pada skor untuk film Lana Wachowski The Matrix Resurrections (2021). Tykwer juga dikenal sebagai pencipta bersama serial televisi Jerman yang diakui secara internasional Babylon Berlin (2017–2026).

name: Tom Waits
title: Tom Waits
extract: Thomas Alan Waits is an American singer, songwriter, composer and actor. His lyrics often focus on society's underbelly and are delivered in his trademark deep, gravelly voice. He began in the folk scene during the 1970s, but his music since the 1980s has reflected the influence of such diverse genres as rock, jazz, Delta blues, opera, vaudeville, cabaret, funk and experimental techniques verging on industrial music. Jim Fusilli calls him "A keen, sensitive and sympathetic chronicler of the adrift and downtrodden" who "creates three-dimensional characters who, even in their confusion and despair, are capable of insight and startling points of view." His unique voice was described by Daniel Durchholz as sounding "like it was soaked in a vat of bourbon, left hanging in the smokehouse for a few months, and then taken outside and run over with a car."
extract_id: Thomas Alan Waits adalah penyanyi, penulis lagu, komponis, dan aktor Amerika. Liriknya sering fokus pada sisi gelap masyarakat dan disampaikan dengan suara khasnya yang dalam dan berkerak. Dia memulai di dunia folk pada tahun 1970-an, tetapi musiknya sejak 1980-an mencerminkan pengaruh genre yang beragam seperti rock, jazz, Delta blues, opera, vaudeville, kabaret, funk, dan teknik eksperimental yang hampir menyentuh musik industrial. Jim Fusilli menyebutnya "Seorang pencatat tajam, sensitif, dan simpatik bagi mereka yang tersesat dan tertindas" yang "membuat karakter tiga dimensi yang, bahkan dalam kebingungan dan keputusasaan mereka, mampu memberikan wawasan dan sudut pandang yang mengejutkan." Suara uniknya digambarkan oleh Daniel Durchholz seperti terdengar "seperti direndam dalam tong bourbon, digantung di rumah asap selama beberapa bulan, lalu dibawa ke luar dan ditabrak mobil."

name: Tom Wilkinson
title: Tom Wilkinson
extract: Thomas Geoffrey Wilkinson was an English actor. Known for his roles on stage and screen, he received numerous accolades including a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award as well as nominations for two Academy Awards and two Laurence Olivier Awards. In 2005, he was made an Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE).
extract_id: Thomas Geoffrey Wilkinson adalah seorang aktor Inggris. Dikenal karena perannya di panggung dan layar, ia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk BAFTA Award, Golden Globe Award, dan Primetime Emmy Award serta nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards dan dua Laurence Olivier Awards. Pada tahun 2005, ia diangkat menjadi Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE).

name: Tomas Alfredson
title: Tomas Alfredson
extract: Hans Christian Tomas Alfredson is a Swedish film director who is best known internationally for directing the 2008 vampire film Let the Right One In and 2011 espionage film Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy. Alfredson has received the Guldbagge award for Best Direction twice; in 2005 for Four Shades of Brown, and in 2008 for Let the Right One In.
extract_id: Hans Christian Tomas Alfredson adalah sutradara film Swedia yang dikenal secara internasional karena menyutradarai film vampir Let the Right One In tahun 2008 dan film spionase Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy tahun 2011. Alfredson telah menerima penghargaan Guldbagge untuk Sutradara Terbaik dua kali; pada tahun 2005 untuk Four Shades of Brown, dan pada 2008 untuk Let the Right One In.

name: Tomm Moore
title: Tomm Moore
extract: Thomas "Tomm" Moore is an Irish filmmaker, animator, illustrator and comics artist. He co-founded Cartoon Saloon with Nora Twomey and Paul Young, an animation studio and production company based in Kilkenny, Ireland. His first three feature films, The Secret of Kells (2009), co-directed with Nora Twomey, Song of the Sea (2014) and Wolfwalkers (2020), co-directed with Ross Stewart, have received critical acclaim and were all nominated for the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature.
extract_id: Thomas "Tomm" Moore adalah pembuat film Irlandia, animator, ilustrator, dan seniman komik. Ia ikut mendirikan Cartoon Saloon bersama Nora Twomey dan Paul Young, sebuah studio animasi dan perusahaan produksi yang berbasis di Kilkenny, Irlandia. Tiga film panjangnya yang pertama, The Secret of Kells (2009), disutradarai bersama Nora Twomey, Song of the Sea (2014) dan Wolfwalkers (2020), disutradarai bersama Ross Stewart, telah menerima pujian kritis dan semuanya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Fitur Animasi Terbaik.

name: Tommy Chong
title: Tommy Chong
extract: Thomas Bing Kin Chong is a Canadian comedian, actor, musician and activist. He is known for his role/inspiration in the marijuana industry, his marijuana-themed Cheech & Chong comedy albums and movies with Cheech Marin, and playing the character Leo on Fox's That '70s Show. He became a naturalized United States citizen in the late 1980s.
extract_id: Thomas Bing Kin Chong adalah komedian, aktor, musisi, dan aktivis Kanada. Ia dikenal karena perannya/inspirasinya dalam industri ganja, album dan film komedi bertema ganja Cheech & Chong bersama Cheech Marin, serta memerankan karakter Leo di acara Fox That '70s Show. Ia menjadi warga negara Amerika Serikat pada akhir 1980-an.

name: Tommy Lee Jones
title: Tommy Lee Jones
extract: Thomas Lee Jones is an American actor, film director, and former football player. He has received various accolades including an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, and two Screen Actors Guild Awards.
extract_id: Thomas Lee Jones adalah aktor Amerika, sutradara film, dan mantan pemain sepak bola. Ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dan dua Screen Actors Guild Awards.

name: Tomoko Yamaguchi
title: Tomoko Yamaguchi
extract: Tomoko Yamaguchi is a Japanese actress, voice actress and singer from Tochigi. She is the lead actress for the classic dorama series Long Vacation, starring alongside Takuya Kimura.
extract_id: Tomoko Yamaguchi adalah aktris, pengisi suara, dan penyanyi Jepang dari Tochigi. Dia adalah pemeran utama untuk seri dorama klasik Long Vacation, bermain bersama Takuya Kimura.

name: Toni Collette
title: Toni Collette
extract: Toni Collette is an Australian actress. Primarily known for her portrayals of troubled and multi-faceted women, she is known for starring in primetime television, independent films and blockbusters. She has received various accolades including five AACTA Awards, a Golden Globe Award, and a Primetime Emmy Award, in addition to nominations for an Academy Award, two British Academy Film Awards and a Tony Award.
extract_id: Toni Collette adalah aktris Australia. Terutama dikenal karena perannya sebagai wanita yang bermasalah dan multifaset, ia dikenal karena tampil dalam televisi primetime, film independen, dan film blockbuster. Ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk lima AACTA Awards, Golden Globe Award, dan Primetime Emmy Award, selain nominasi untuk Academy Award, dua British Academy Film Awards, dan Tony Award.

name: Toni Servillo
title: Toni Servillo
extract: Marco Antonio "Toni" Servillo is an Italian actor and theatrical director.
extract_id: Marco Antonio "Toni" Servillo adalah aktor dan sutradara teater Italia.

name: Tony Bancroft
title: Tony Bancroft
extract: Tony Bancroft is an American animator and film director who frequently collaborates with Disney. He is the founder and owner of the faith-driven animation company Toonacious Family Entertainment. Tony is the Executive VP Creative Development and Production for DivideNine Animation Studios.
extract_id: Tony Bancroft adalah animator dan sutradara film Amerika yang sering bekerja sama dengan Disney. Ia adalah pendiri dan pemilik perusahaan animasi berlandaskan kepercayaan Toonacious Family Entertainment. Tony adalah Executive VP Pengembangan Kreatif dan Produksi di DivideNine Animation Studios.

name: Tony Chiu-Wai Leung
title: Tony Leung Chiu-wai
extract: Tony Leung Chiu-wai is a Hong Kong actor and singer. He is one of Asia's most successful and internationally recognized actors. He has won many international acting prizes, including the Cannes Film Festival award for Best Actor. He was named by CNN as one of "Asia's 25 Greatest Actors of All Time".
extract_id: Tony Leung Chiu-wai adalah aktor dan penyanyi Hong Kong. Ia adalah salah satu aktor Asia yang paling sukses dan dikenal secara internasional. Ia telah memenangkan banyak penghargaan akting internasional, termasuk penghargaan Aktor Terbaik Festival Film Cannes. Ia dinobatkan oleh CNN sebagai salah satu "25 Aktor Terbesar Asia Sepanjang Masa".

name: Tony Curtis
title: Tony Curtis
extract: Tony Curtis was an American actor with a career that spanned six decades, achieving the height of his popularity in the 1950s and early 1960s. He acted in more than 100 films, in roles covering a wide range of genres. In his later years, Curtis made numerous television appearances.
extract_id: Tony Curtis adalah aktor Amerika dengan karier yang berlangsung selama enam dekade, mencapai puncak popularitasnya pada tahun 1950-an dan awal 1960-an. Ia berakting dalam lebih dari 100 film, dalam peran yang meliputi berbagai genre. Pada tahun-tahun terakhirnya, Curtis banyak tampil di televisi.

name: Tony Hale
title: Tony Hale
extract: Tony Hale is an American actor and comedian. He had a leading role in the Fox series Arrested Development as Buster Bluth from 2003 to 2019, and portrayed Gary Walsh on the HBO series Veep from 2012 to 2019. For the latter, Hale won the 2013 and 2015 Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series.
extract_id: Tony Hale adalah aktor dan komedian Amerika. Ia memerankan peran utama dalam serial Fox Arrested Development sebagai Buster Bluth dari 2003 hingga 2019, dan memerankan Gary Walsh di serial HBO Veep dari 2012 hingga 2019. Untuk peran terakhir, Hale memenangkan Primetime Emmy Award 2013 dan 2015 untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam Seri Komedi.

name: Tony Kaye
title: Tony Kaye (director)
extract: Tony Kaye is an English director of films, music videos, advertisements, and documentaries. He directed the 1998 film American History X.
extract_id: Tony Kaye adalah sutradara Inggris untuk film, video musik, iklan, dan dokumenter. Ia menyutradarai film American History X tahun 1998.

name: Tony Lo Bianco
title: Tony Lo Bianco
extract: Anthony LoBianco was an American actor.
extract_id: Anthony LoBianco adalah aktor Amerika.

name: Tony Moran
title: Tony Moran (actor)
extract: Anthony Moran is an American actor and producer. He is known for briefly playing the unmasked Michael Myers in the 1978 horror classic Halloween. Since then, he has gone on to make guest appearances in television series The Waltons and CHiPs. He is the elder brother of fellow actors Erin Moran and John Moran.
extract_id: Anthony Moran adalah aktor dan produser Amerika. Ia dikenal karena perannya sebentar sebagai Michael Myers tanpa topeng dalam film horor klasik Halloween tahun 1978. Sejak itu, ia tampil dalam beberapa episode serial televisi The Waltons dan CHiPs. Ia adalah kakak laki-laki dari sesama aktor Erin Moran dan John Moran.

name: Tony Roberts
title: Tony Roberts (actor)
extract: David Anthony Roberts was an American actor known for his roles on stage and screen. He is best known for his collaborations with filmmaker Woody Allen, having acted in six of his films, most notably Annie Hall (1977).
extract_id: David Anthony Roberts adalah aktor Amerika yang dikenal karena perannya di panggung dan layar. Ia dikenal baik karena kolaborasinya dengan pembuat film Woody Allen, berperan di enam film Allen, yang paling terkenal adalah Annie Hall (1977).

name: Tony Scott
title: Tony Scott
extract: Anthony David Leighton Scott was an English filmmaker. He made his theatrical film debut with The Hunger (1983) and went on to direct highly successful action and thriller films such as Top Gun (1986), Beverly Hills Cop II (1987), Days of Thunder (1990), The Last Boy Scout (1991), True Romance (1993), Crimson Tide (1995), Enemy of the State (1998), Man on Fire (2004), Déjà Vu (2006), The Taking of Pelham 123 (2009), and Unstoppable (2010).
extract_id: Anthony David Leighton Scott adalah pembuat film Inggris. Ia memulai debut film teatrikalnya dengan The Hunger (1983) dan kemudian menyutradarai film aksi dan thriller yang sangat sukses seperti Top Gun (1986), Beverly Hills Cop II (1987), Days of Thunder (1990), The Last Boy Scout (1991), True Romance (1993), Crimson Tide (1995), Enemy of the State (1998), Man on Fire (2004), Déjà Vu (2006), The Taking of Pelham 123 (2009), dan Unstoppable (2010).

name: Tony Todd
title: Tony Todd
extract: Anthony Tiran Todd was an American actor. Known for his distinctly deep and gravelly voice, he amassed numerous credits on screen and in video games since the 1980s, including the title character in the Candyman film series (1992–2021) and William Bludworth in the Final Destination franchise (2000–2025). For the former, he was nominated at the Critics' Choice and Fangoria Chainsaw Awards.
extract_id: Anthony Tiran Todd adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal dengan suara dalam dan seraknya yang khas, ia mengumpulkan banyak kredit di layar dan dalam permainan video sejak 1980-an, termasuk tokoh utama dalam seri film Candyman (1992–2021) dan William Bludworth dalam franchise Final Destination (2000–2025). Untuk peran pertama, ia dinominasikan di Critics' Choice dan Fangoria Chainsaw Awards.

name: Topol
title: Chaim Topol
extract: Chaim Topol, mononymously known as Topol, was an Israeli actor and singer who portrayed Tevye, the lead character in the stage musical Fiddler on the Roof. Topol estimated that he played Tevye more than 3,500 times on stage from 1967 through 2009, and he also portrayed the character in the 1971 film adaptation of the play.
extract_id: Chaim Topol, yang dikenal hanya sebagai Topol, adalah aktor dan penyanyi Israel yang memerankan Tevye, tokoh utama dalam musikal panggung Fiddler on the Roof. Topol memperkirakan bahwa ia memerankan Tevye lebih dari 3.500 kali di panggung dari tahun 1967 hingga 2009, dan juga memerankan karakter tersebut dalam adaptasi film tahun 1971 dari drama tersebut.

name: Toshirô Mifune
title: Toshiro Mifune
extract: Toshiro Mifune was a Japanese actor and producer. The recipient of numerous awards and accolades over a lengthy career, he is widely considered one of the greatest actors of all time. Noted for his commanding screen presence in the Japanese film industry, he typically played hypermasculine or heroic characters.
extract_id: Toshiro Mifune adalah aktor dan produser Jepang. Penerima banyak penghargaan dan prestasi sepanjang karier panjangnya, ia dianggap secara luas sebagai salah satu aktor terbesar sepanjang masa. Dikenal dengan kehadiran skrinnya yang kuat dalam industri film Jepang, ia biasanya memerankan karakter hiper-maskulin atau pahlawan.

name: Toshirô Yanagiba
title: Toshirō Yanagiba
extract: Toshiro Yanagiba is a Japanese actor.
extract_id: Toshiro Yanagiba adalah aktor Jepang.

name: Travis Knight
title: Travis Knight
extract: Travis Andrew Knight is an American filmmaker, animator, and former rapper. The son of Nike co-founder Phil Knight, he has worked as the lead animator and is the current CEO of the stop-motion animation studio Laika as well as the director of the company's films Kubo and the Two Strings (2016) and Wildwood (2026). He also directed the live-action films Bumblebee (2018) and Masters of the Universe (2026). For his work at Laika, Knight has earned three Academy Award nominations for Best Animated Feature.
extract_id: Travis Andrew Knight adalah pembuat film, animator, dan mantan rapper Amerika. Putra salah satu pendiri Nike, Phil Knight, ia bekerja sebagai animator utama dan saat ini CEO studio animasi stop-motion Laika serta sutradara film perusahaan Kubo and the Two Strings (2016) dan Wildwood (2026). Ia juga menyutradarai film live-action Bumblebee (2018) dan Masters of the Universe (2026). Untuk karyanya di Laika, Knight telah menerima tiga nominasi Academy Award untuk Fitur Animasi Terbaik.

name: Treat Williams
title: Treat Williams
extract: Richard Treat Williams Jr. was an American actor, whose career on stage and in film and television spanned five decades. He received many accolades for his work, including nominations for three Golden Globe Awards, two Primetime Emmy Awards, two Screen Actors Guild Awards, a Satellite Award, and an Independent Spirit Award.
extract_id: Richard Treat Williams Jr. adalah aktor Amerika, dengan karier di panggung, film, dan televisi yang berlangsung selama lima dekade. Ia menerima banyak penghargaan untuk karyanya, termasuk nominasi untuk tiga Golden Globe Awards, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dua Screen Actors Guild Awards, sebuah Satellite Award, dan Independent Spirit Award.

name: Trevor Howard
title: Trevor Howard
extract: Trevor Wallace Howard-Smith was an English stage and screen actor. After varied work in the theatre, he achieved leading man star status in the film Brief Encounter (1945), followed by The Third Man (1949), portraying what BFI Screenonline called "a new kind of male lead in British films: steady, middle-class, reassuring ... but also capable of suggesting neurosis under the tweedy demeanour."
extract_id: Trevor Wallace Howard-Smith adalah aktor Inggris panggung dan layar. Setelah berbagai pekerjaan di teater, ia mencapai status bintang pemeran utama dalam film Brief Encounter (1945), diikuti oleh The Third Man (1949), memerankan apa yang disebut BFI Screenonline sebagai "jenis pemeran utama pria baru dalam film Inggris: stabil, kelas menengah, menenangkan ... tetapi juga mampu menunjukkan neurosis di balik perilaku tweedynya."

name: Trey Parker
title: Trey Parker
description: American animator, filmmaker, songwriter and actor (born 1969)
extract: Randolph Severn "Trey" Parker III is an American animator, filmmaker, songwriter and actor.
extract_id: Randolph Severn "Trey" Parker III adalah animator, pembuat film, penulis lagu, dan aktor Amerika.

name: Trine Dyrholm
title: Trine Dyrholm
extract: Trine Dyrholm is a Danish actress, singer and songwriter. Dyrholm received national recognition when she placed third in the Dansk Melodi Grand Prix as a 14-year-old singer. Four years later, she again achieved national recognition when she won the Bodil Award for Best Actress in her debut film: the teenage romance Springflod. Dyrholm has won the Bodil Award for Best Actress five times and a Bodil award for Best Supporting Actress twice as well as six Robert Awards in her acting career.
extract_id: Trine Dyrholm adalah seorang aktris, penyanyi, dan penulis lagu asal Denmark. Dyrholm mendapat pengakuan nasional ketika dia menempati posisi ketiga dalam Dansk Melodi Grand Prix sebagai penyanyi berusia 14 tahun. Empat tahun kemudian, dia kembali mendapatkan pengakuan nasional ketika memenangkan Bodil Award untuk Aktris Terbaik dalam film debutnya: romansa remaja Springflod. Dyrholm telah memenangkan Bodil Award untuk Aktris Terbaik lima kali dan Bodil Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik dua kali serta enam Robert Awards dalam karier aktingnya.

name: Troy Duffy
title: Troy Duffy
extract: Troy Duffy is an American filmmaker. He has directed two films, The Boondock Saints and its sequel The Boondock Saints II: All Saints Day. Duffy was the subject of the 2003 documentary film Overnight.
extract_id: Troy Duffy adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika. Dia telah menyutradarai dua film, The Boondock Saints dan sekuelnya The Boondock Saints II: All Saints Day. Duffy menjadi subjek film dokumenter tahun 2003 Overnight.

name: Tsunehiko Kamijô
title: Tsunehiko Kamijō
description: Japanese singer, actor and voice actor (1940–2025)
extract: Tsunehiko Kamijō was a Japanese singer, actor and voice actor.
extract_id: Tsunehiko Kamijō adalah seorang penyanyi, aktor, dan pemeran suara asal Jepang.

name: Tsutomu Tatsumi
title: Tsutomu Tatsumi
extract: Tsutomu Tatsumi is a former actor from Kansai, Japan. At the time, he was affiliated with Actor Pro.
extract_id: Tsutomu Tatsumi adalah mantan aktor dari Kansai, Jepang. Pada saat itu, dia berafiliasi dengan Actor Pro.

name: Tsutomu Yamazaki
title: Tsutomu Yamazaki
extract: Tsutomu Yamazaki is a Japanese actor. He won the Blue Ribbon Award for Best Actor in 1984 for The Funeral and Farewell to the Ark. Yamazaki is known for his roles as Goro in Tampopo (1985) and Nenbutsu no Tetsu on the television jidaigeki Hissatsu Shiokinin and Shin Hissatsu Shiokinin.
extract_id: Tsutomu Yamazaki adalah seorang aktor Jepang. Dia memenangkan Blue Ribbon Award untuk Aktor Terbaik pada tahun 1984 untuk film The Funeral dan Farewell to the Ark. Yamazaki dikenal karena perannya sebagai Goro dalam Tampopo (1985) dan Nenbutsu no Tetsu dalam drama jidaigeki televisi Hissatsu Shiokinin dan Shin Hissatsu Shiokinin.

name: Tsuyoshi Ihara
title: Tsuyoshi Ihara
extract: Tsuyoshi Ihara is a Japanese actor of Korean descent.
extract_id: Tsuyoshi Ihara adalah aktor Jepang keturunan Korea.

name: Tuncel Kurtiz
title: Tuncel Kurtiz
extract: Tuncel Tayanç Kurtiz was a Turkish theatre, movie and TV series actor, playwright, and film director. From 1964 until his death in 2013, he acted in more than 70 movies, including many international productions.
extract_id: Tuncel Tayanç Kurtiz adalah aktor teater, film, dan serial TV Turki, penulis drama, dan sutradara film. Dari tahun 1964 hingga kematiannya pada 2013, dia berperan dalam lebih dari 70 film, termasuk banyak produksi internasional.

name: Tung Cho 'Joe' Cheung
title: Joe Cheung
extract: Joe Cheung Tung-joe is a Hong Kong director, producer, scriptwriter and actor.
extract_id: Joe Cheung Tung-joe adalah sutradara, produser, penulis skenario, dan aktor asal Hong Kong.

name: Tyler Hoechlin
title: Tyler Hoechlin
extract: Tyler Lee Hoechlin is an American actor. He initially earned recognition for starring as Michael Sullivan Jr. in the 2002 film Road to Perdition, for which he was nominated for the Critics' Choice Movie Award for Best Young Performer. In television, Hoechlin starred as Martin Brewer on 7th Heaven from 2003 to 2007, and also became known for portraying Derek Hale on Teen Wolf, Clark Kent / Superman in the CW's Supergirl (2016–2019) and Superman & Lois (2021–2024), and for voicing Sephiroth in the Final Fantasy VII Remake franchise.
extract_id: Tyler Lee Hoechlin adalah aktor Amerika. Dia pertama kali dikenal setelah berperan sebagai Michael Sullivan Jr. dalam film Road to Perdition tahun 2002, yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Critics' Choice Movie Award untuk Best Young Performer. Di televisi, Hoechlin berperan sebagai Martin Brewer dalam 7th Heaven dari 2003 hingga 2007, dan juga dikenal karena memerankan Derek Hale dalam Teen Wolf, Clark Kent / Superman dalam serial CW Supergirl (2016–2019) dan Superman & Lois (2021–2024), serta sebagai pengisi suara Sephiroth dalam franchise Final Fantasy VII Remake.

name: Tyler Perry
title: Tyler Perry
extract: Tyler Perry is an American filmmaker and actor. His films vary in style from orthodox filmmaking techniques to filmed productions of live stage plays, many of which have been subsequently adapted into feature films. Perry is the creator and performer of Mabel "Madea" Simmons, a tough elderly woman, and also portrays her brother Joe Simmons and her nephew Brian Simmons. Madea's first appearance was in I Can Do Bad All by Myself (1999) staged in Chicago.
extract_id: Tyler Perry adalah pembuat film dan aktor Amerika. Film-filmnya beragam mulai dari teknik pembuatan film ortodoks hingga produksi yang direkam dari pertunjukan panggung langsung, banyak di antaranya kemudian diadaptasi menjadi film fitur. Perry adalah pencipta dan pemeran Mabel "Madea" Simmons, seorang wanita tua yang keras, dan juga memerankan saudara lelakinya Joe Simmons dan keponakannya Brian Simmons. Penampilan pertama Madea adalah dalam I Can Do Bad All by Myself (1999) yang dipentaskan di Chicago.

name: Tyrone Power
title: Tyrone Power
extract: Tyrone Edmund Power III was an American actor. From the 1930s to the 1950s, Power appeared in dozens of films, often in swashbuckler roles or romantic leads. His better-known films include Jesse James, The Mark of Zorro, Marie Antoinette, Blood and Sand, The Black Swan, Prince of Foxes, Witness for the Prosecution, The Black Rose, and Captain from Castile. Power's own favorite film among those in which he starred was Nightmare Alley.
extract_id: Tyrone Edmund Power III adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Dari tahun 1930-an hingga 1950-an, Power tampil dalam puluhan film, sering kali dalam peran ksatria layar atau tokoh romantis utama. Film-filmnya yang lebih dikenal termasuk Jesse James, The Mark of Zorro, Marie Antoinette, Blood and Sand, The Black Swan, Prince of Foxes, Witness for the Prosecution, The Black Rose, dan Captain from Castile. Film favorit Power di antara yang dia bintangi adalah Nightmare Alley.

name: Tôru Emori
title: Tōru Emori
extract: Tōru Emori is a Japanese actor, voice actor, and theater director. He has appeared in more than sixty films since 1965.
extract_id: Tōru Emori adalah aktor, pengisi suara, dan sutradara teater asal Jepang. Dia telah tampil dalam lebih dari enam puluh film sejak tahun 1965.

name: Tôru Furuya
title: Tōru Furuya
extract: Tōru Furuya is a Japanese actor and narrator. As a child, he was a member of Gekidan Himawari, a children's acting troupe. He has been employed by talent management firm Aoni Production since 1982.
extract_id: Tōru Furuya adalah aktor dan narator Jepang. Sebagai anak-anak, dia adalah anggota Gekidan Himawari, sebuah kelompok teater anak-anak. Dia telah bekerja di perusahaan manajemen bakat Aoni Production sejak 1982.

name: Ugur Yücel
title: Uğur Yücel
extract: Uğur Yücel is a Turkish film actor, producer and director. He graduated from the Theater Department of the Istanbul Municipality Conservatory. He took part in several plays between 1975 and 1984 in Kenter Tiyatrosu, Tef Kabare Theatre, Dormen Theatre, and Şan Müzikholü. He was noticed for his roles in Selamsız Bandosu (1987) and Muhsin Bey (1987), then gained mainstream success when he took part in Eşkıya (1996).
extract_id: Uğur Yücel adalah aktor film, produser, dan sutradara asal Turki. Dia lulus dari Departemen Teater Konservatorium Kota Istanbul. Dia terlibat dalam beberapa drama antara tahun 1975 dan 1984 di Kenter Tiyatrosu, Tef Kabare Theatre, Dormen Theatre, dan Şan Müzikholü. Dia dikenal karena perannya dalam Selamsız Bandosu (1987) dan Muhsin Bey (1987), kemudian meraih kesuksesan arus utama saat berperan dalam Eşkıya (1996).

name: Ulla Jacobsson
title: Ulla Jacobsson
extract: Ulla Jacobsson was a Swedish actress. She had the lead role in One Summer of Happiness (1951) and played the only female speaking role in the film Zulu (1964).
extract_id: Ulla Jacobsson adalah seorang aktris asal Swedia. Dia berperan utama dalam One Summer of Happiness (1951) dan memerankan satu-satunya peran perempuan yang berbicara dalam film Zulu (1964).

name: Ulrich Matthes
title: Ulrich Matthes
extract: Ulrich Matthes is a German actor. He is best known for having played Joseph Goebbels in the 2004 film Downfall.
extract_id: Ulrich Matthes adalah aktor Jerman. Dia paling dikenal karena memerankan Joseph Goebbels dalam film Downfall tahun 2004.

name: Ulrich Mühe
title: Ulrich Mühe
extract: Friedrich Hans Ulrich Mühe was a German film, television and theatre actor. He played the role of Hauptmann (Captain) Gerd Wiesler in the Oscar-winning film Das Leben der Anderen, for which he received the gold award for Best Performance by an Actor in a Leading Role, at the Deutscher Filmpreis ; and the Best Actor Award at the 2006 European Film Awards.
extract_id: Friedrich Hans Ulrich Mühe adalah aktor film, televisi, dan teater asal Jerman. Dia memerankan peran Hauptmann (Kapten) Gerd Wiesler dalam film pemenang Oscar Das Leben der Anderen, yang membuatnya menerima penghargaan emas untuk Penampilan Terbaik oleh Aktor dalam Peran Utama di Deutscher Filmpreis; serta Penghargaan Aktor Terbaik di European Film Awards 2006.

name: Ulrich Thomsen
title: Ulrich Thomsen
extract: Ulrich Thomsen is a Danish actor, best known for his role as Christian in the 1998 film The Celebration and as Kai Proctor in the Cinemax original series Banshee (2013–2016). Since 2026, he is currently starring as the DC Comics character Sinestro in the DC Universe, beginning with the superhero crime neo-Western thriller series Lanterns.
extract_id: Ulrich Thomsen adalah aktor Denmark, paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Christian dalam film The Celebration tahun 1998 dan sebagai Kai Proctor dalam serial original Cinemax Banshee (2013–2016). Sejak 2026, dia saat ini membintangi karakter DC Comics Sinestro di DC Universe, dimulai dengan serial neo-Barat thriller kejahatan superhero Lanterns.

name: Ulrich Tukur
title: Ulrich Tukur
extract: Ulrich Tukur is a German actor and musician. He is known for his roles in Michael Haneke's The White Ribbon, Steven Soderbergh's Solaris, the docudrama North Face based on the 1936 Eiger climbing disaster in Switzerland, and as Wilhelm Uhde in Martin Provost's biopic Séraphine.
extract_id: Ulrich Tukur adalah aktor dan musisi Jerman. Dia dikenal karena perannya dalam The White Ribbon karya Michael Haneke, Solaris karya Steven Soderbergh, docudrama North Face berdasarkan bencana pendakian Eiger tahun 1936 di Swiss, dan sebagai Wilhelm Uhde dalam biopik Séraphine karya Martin Provost.

name: Uma Thurman
title: Uma Thurman
extract: Uma Karuna Thurman is an American actress. Known for her collaborations with Quentin Tarantino, she has performed in over fifty film and television productions since the 1980s, across genres that range from comedies and dramas to science fiction and action. Her accolades include a Golden Globe Award and nominations for an Academy Award, two British Academy Film Awards, a Primetime Emmy Award, and two Screen Actors Guild Awards.
extract_id: Uma Karuna Thurman adalah aktris Amerika. Dikenal karena kolaborasinya dengan Quentin Tarantino, dia telah tampil dalam lebih dari lima puluh produksi film dan televisi sejak tahun 1980-an, dalam genre yang beragam mulai dari komedi dan drama hingga fiksi ilmiah dan aksi. Penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk Golden Globe Award dan nominasi untuk Academy Award, dua British Academy Film Awards, Primetime Emmy Award, dan dua Screen Actors Guild Awards.

name: Umesh Shukla
title: Umesh Shukla
extract: Umesh Shukla is an Indian actor and director who works in Bollywood films. He is best known for his work in the critically acclaimed comedy drama film Oh My God. He made his directorial debut with UTV Motion Pictures' and Bindass' presentation Dhoondte Reh Jaaoge.
extract_id: Umesh Shukla adalah aktor dan sutradara India yang bekerja di film Bollywood. Dia paling dikenal atas karyanya dalam film drama komedi yang diakui secara kritis Oh My God. Dia membuat debut sutradara dengan presentasi Dhoondte Reh Jaaoge oleh UTV Motion Pictures dan Bindass.

name: Val Kilmer
title: Val Kilmer
extract: Val Edward Kilmer was an American actor. Initially a stage actor, he later found fame as a leading man in films in a wide variety of genres, including comedies, dramas, action adventures, westerns, historical films, crime dramas, science fiction films, and fantasy films. Films in which Kilmer appeared grossed more than $3.85 billion worldwide. In 1992, the film critic Roger Ebert remarked, "if there is an award for the most unsung leading man of his generation, Kilmer should get it".
extract_id: Val Edward Kilmer adalah aktor Amerika. Awalnya aktor panggung, dia kemudian meraih ketenaran sebagai pemeran utama dalam film dengan berbagai genre, termasuk komedi, drama, petualangan aksi, western, film sejarah, drama kriminal, film fiksi ilmiah, dan film fantasi. Film-film yang dibintangi Kilmer menghasilkan lebih dari $3,85 miliar secara global. Pada tahun 1992, kritikus film Roger Ebert berkomentar, "jika ada penghargaan untuk pemeran utama pria paling tidak dikenal di generasinya, Kilmer pantas mendapatkannya."

name: Valentin Zubkov
title: Valentin Zubkov
extract: Valentin Ivanovich Zubkov was a Soviet film actor. He was born in Peschanoye Settlement of Ryazan Province. He finished Armavir Military Aviation School (1941–1943) and served as a pilot at frontlines of the German-Soviet War.
extract_id: Valentin Ivanovich Zubkov adalah aktor film Soviet. Dia lahir di Peschanoye Settlement, Provinsi Ryazan. Dia menyelesaikan pendidikan di Sekolah Penerbangan Militer Armavir (1941–1943) dan bertugas sebagai pilot di garis depan Perang Jerman-Soviet.

name: Valeria Golino
title: Valeria Golino
description: Italian model, actress and film director (born 1965)
extract: Valeria Golino is an Italian actress and filmmaker. She is best known to English-language audiences for her roles in Rain Man, Big Top Pee-wee, and Hot Shots! (1991). She has won David di Donatello, Nastro d'Argento, Ciak d'oro, and Globo d'oro awards, and is one of four actresses to have twice won the Best Actress award at the Venice Film Festival.
extract_id: Valeria Golino adalah aktris dan pembuat film Italia. Dia paling dikenal oleh penonton berbahasa Inggris karena perannya dalam Rain Man, Big Top Pee-wee, dan Hot Shots! (1991). Dia telah memenangkan penghargaan David di Donatello, Nastro d'Argento, Ciak d'oro, dan Globo d'oro, serta merupakan salah satu dari empat aktris yang dua kali memenangkan penghargaan Aktris Terbaik di Festival Film Venesia.

name: Valerie Faris
title: Jonathan Dayton and Valerie Faris
extract: Jonathan Dayton and Valerie Faris are two American directors and producers for films and music videos. They started their career directing videos for such artists as Red Hot Chili Peppers, R.E.M. and the Smashing Pumpkins. Together they directed the films Little Miss Sunshine (2006), Ruby Sparks (2012), and Battle of the Sexes (2017). They also directed the Netflix comedy series Living with Yourself (2019) and episodes of the Hulu series Fleishman Is In Trouble (2022).
extract_id: Jonathan Dayton dan Valerie Faris adalah dua sutradara dan produser Amerika untuk film dan video musik. Mereka memulai karier mereka dengan mengarahkan video untuk artis-artis seperti Red Hot Chili Peppers, R.E.M., dan Smashing Pumpkins. Bersama-sama mereka menyutradarai film Little Miss Sunshine (2006), Ruby Sparks (2012), dan Battle of the Sexes (2017). Mereka juga menyutradarai serial komedi Netflix Living with Yourself (2019) dan episode serial Hulu Fleishman Is In Trouble (2022).

name: Valerie Hobson
title: Valerie Hobson
extract: Babette Louisa Valerie Hobson was a British actress whose film career spanned the 1930s to the early 1950s. Her second husband was John Profumo, a British government minister who became the subject of the Profumo affair in 1963.
extract_id: Babette Louisa Valerie Hobson adalah seorang aktris Inggris yang karier filmnya berlangsung dari tahun 1930-an hingga awal 1950-an. Suami keduanya adalah John Profumo, seorang menteri pemerintah Inggris yang menjadi subjek dari kasus Profumo pada tahun 1963.

name: Vanessa Redgrave
title: Vanessa Redgrave
extract: Dame Vanessa Redgrave is a British actress and activist. In a career spanning eight decades, her accolades include an Academy Award, two Golden Globes, two Primetime Emmy Awards, Laurence Olivier Award, a Tony Award, a Volpi Cup, and two Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Actress, making her one of the few performers to achieve the Triple Crown of Acting. She has also received various honorary awards, including the BAFTA Fellowship Award, the Golden Lion Honorary Award, and an induction into the American Theatre Hall of Fame.
extract_id: Dame Vanessa Redgrave adalah seorang aktris dan aktivis Inggris. Dalam karier yang berlangsung selama delapan dekade, penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk Academy Award, dua Golden Globes, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, Laurence Olivier Award, Tony Award, Volpi Cup, dan dua Cannes Film Festival Award untuk Aktris Terbaik, menjadikannya salah satu dari sedikit pemain yang meraih Triple Crown of Acting. Dia juga menerima berbagai penghargaan kehormatan, termasuk BAFTA Fellowship Award, Golden Lion Honorary Award, dan dimasukkan ke dalam American Theatre Hall of Fame.

name: Varun Sharma
title: Varun Sharma
extract: Varun Sharma is an Indian actor and comedian. He is best known for playing "Choocha" in the Fukrey film series. He has done comic as well as supporting roles in various Hindi and Punjabi films.
extract_id: Varun Sharma adalah seorang aktor dan komedian India. Ia paling dikenal karena memerankan "Choocha" dalam seri film Fukrey. Dia telah memainkan peran komik serta peran pendukung dalam berbagai film Hindi dan Punjabi.

name: Veerle Baetens
title: Veerle Baetens
extract: Veerle Baetens is a Belgian actress, filmmaker, and singer best known for her lead role as Elise / Alabama in the romantic drama film The Broken Circle Breakdown (2012), for which she won the Tribeca Film Festival Award for Best Actress. She is also known for her lead role as Detective Hannah Maes on the VTM crime drama series Code 37 (2009–12).
extract_id: Veerle Baetens adalah aktris, pembuat film, dan penyanyi Belgia yang paling dikenal karena peran utamanya sebagai Elise / Alabama dalam film drama romantis The Broken Circle Breakdown (2012), yang membuatnya memenangkan Tribeca Film Festival Award sebagai Aktris Terbaik. Dia juga dikenal karena peran utamanya sebagai Detektif Hannah Maes dalam serial drama kejahatan VTM Code 37 (2009–12).

name: Vera Miles
title: Vera Miles
extract: Vera June Miles is an American former actress. She is known for appearing in John Ford's Western films The Searchers (1956) and The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance (1962), and for playing Lila Crane in Alfred Hitchcock's Psycho (1960) and Richard Franklin's sequel Psycho II (1983).
extract_id: Vera June Miles adalah mantan aktris Amerika. Dia dikenal karena tampil dalam film-film Barat karya John Ford seperti The Searchers (1956) dan The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance (1962), serta memerankan Lila Crane dalam film Psycho (1960) karya Alfred Hitchcock dan sekuelnya Psycho II (1983) karya Richard Franklin.

name: Verna Bloom
title: Verna Bloom
extract: Verna Frances Bloom was an American actress. She is noted for roles in the films Medium Cool (1969), High Plains Drifter (1973) and Animal House (1978).
extract_id: Verna Frances Bloom adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Dia dikenal untuk peran-perannya dalam film Medium Cool (1969), High Plains Drifter (1973), dan Animal House (1978).

name: Vernon Dobtcheff
title: Vernon Dobtcheff
extract: Vernon Alexandre Dobtcheff is a French-British character actor, who has appeared in over 300 film, television, and stage productions in a career spanning six decades. Rupert Everett described him as a "patron saint of the acting profession."
extract_id: Vernon Alexandre Dobtcheff adalah aktor karakter Prancis-Britania, yang telah tampil dalam lebih dari 300 produksi film, televisi, dan panggung dalam karier yang berlangsung selama enam dekade. Rupert Everett menggambarkannya sebagai "pelindung profesi akting."

name: Veronica Cartwright
title: Veronica Cartwright
extract: Veronica Cartwright is an English actress based in Los Angeles, California. She appeared in science fiction and horror films, and has three Primetime Emmy Award nominations. Her younger sister is actress Angela Cartwright.
extract_id: Veronica Cartwright adalah seorang aktris Inggris yang berbasis di Los Angeles, California. Dia tampil dalam film fiksi ilmiah dan horor, dan memiliki tiga nominasi Primetime Emmy Award. Adik perempuannya adalah aktris Angela Cartwright.

name: Vicellous Shannon
title: Vicellous Reon Shannon
extract: Vicellous Reon Shannon is an American actor known for his portrayal of Lesra Martin in the 1999 film The Hurricane, and of Keith Palmer in the Fox television series 24. Shannon also appeared in the 2006 film Annapolis.
extract_id: Vicellous Reon Shannon adalah aktor Amerika yang dikenal karena perannya sebagai Lesra Martin dalam film The Hurricane (1999), dan sebagai Keith Palmer dalam serial televisi Fox 24. Shannon juga tampil dalam film Annapolis (2006).

name: Vicky Jenson
title: Vicky Jenson
extract: Victoria Jenson is an American film director of both live action and animated films. She has directed projects for DreamWorks Animation, including Shrek, the first film to win an Academy Award for Best Animated Feature, giving rise to one of Hollywood's largest film franchises.
extract_id: Victoria Jenson adalah seorang sutradara film Amerika dari film aksi hidup dan animasi. Dia telah menyutradarai proyek untuk DreamWorks Animation, termasuk Shrek, film pertama yang memenangkan Academy Award untuk Best Animated Feature, yang memunculkan salah satu waralaba film terbesar di Hollywood.

name: Vicky Kaushal
title: Vicky Kaushal
extract: Vicky Kaushal is an Indian actor who works in Hindi films. He is the recipient of several accolades, including a National Film Award and three Filmfare Awards, and has appeared in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list of 2019.
extract_id: Vicky Kaushal adalah aktor India yang bekerja dalam film Hindi. Dia menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk National Film Award dan tiga Filmfare Awards, serta masuk dalam daftar Forbes India's Celebrity 100 tahun 2019.

name: Victor Buono
title: Victor Buono
extract: Victor Charles Buono was an American actor, comic, and briefly a recording artist. He was known for playing the villain King Tut in the television series Batman (1966–1968) and musician Edwin Flagg in What Ever Happened to Baby Jane? (1962), the latter of which earned him Academy Award and Golden Globe Award nominations. He was a busy actor from his late teens until his death at the age of 43 and, with his large size and sonorous voice, he made a career of playing men much older than he actually was.
extract_id: Victor Charles Buono adalah aktor, komedian Amerika, dan sempat menjadi artis rekaman. Dia dikenal karena memerankan penjahat King Tut dalam serial televisi Batman (1966–1968) dan musisi Edwin Flagg dalam What Ever Happened to Baby Jane? (1962), yang membuatnya mendapatkan nominasi Academy Award dan Golden Globe Award. Dia merupakan aktor yang sibuk sejak remaja hingga meninggal dunia pada usia 43 tahun dan, dengan ukuran tubuh besar dan suara beratnya, dia membangun karier memerankan pria yang jauh lebih tua dari usia sebenarnya.

name: Victor Fleming
title: Victor Fleming
extract: Victor Lonzo Fleming was an American film director, cinematographer, and producer. His most popular films were the historical drama Gone with the Wind, for which he won an Academy Award for Best Director, and the fantasy film The Wizard of Oz. Fleming has those same two films listed in the top 10 of the American Film Institute's 2007 AFI's 100 Years...100 Movies list.
extract_id: Victor Lonzo Fleming adalah sutradara film, sinematografer, dan produser Amerika. Filmnya yang paling populer adalah drama sejarah Gone with the Wind, yang membuatnya memenangkan Academy Award untuk Best Director, dan film fantasi The Wizard of Oz. Fleming mencantumkan kedua film tersebut dalam daftar 10 besar AFI's 100 Years...100 Movies dari American Film Institute tahun 2007.

name: Victor Jory
title: Victor Jory
extract: Victor Jory was a Canadian-American actor of stage, film, and television. He initially played romantic leads, but later was mostly cast in villainous or sinister roles, such as Oberon in A Midsummer Night's Dream (1935) and carpetbagger Jonas Wilkerson in Gone with the Wind (1939). From 1959 to 1961, he had a lead role in the 78-episode television police drama Manhunt. He also recorded numerous stories for Peter Pan Records and was a guest star in dozens of television series as well as a supporting player in dozens of theatrical films, occasionally appearing as the leading man.
extract_id: Victor Jory adalah aktor Kanada-Amerika yang bermain di panggung, film, dan televisi. Awalnya ia memerankan tokoh romantis, tetapi kemudian lebih sering memerankan peran jahat atau menyeramkan, seperti Oberon dalam A Midsummer Night's Dream (1935) dan carpetbagger Jonas Wilkerson dalam Gone with the Wind (1939). Dari tahun 1959 hingga 1961, ia memerankan peran utama dalam drama polisi televisi Manhunt yang berdurasi 78 episode. Dia juga merekam banyak cerita untuk Peter Pan Records dan menjadi bintang tamu dalam puluhan serial televisi serta pemeran pendukung dalam puluhan film teater, sesekali tampil sebagai pemeran utama.

name: Victor Sjöström
title: Victor Sjöström
description: Swedish film director, screenwriter and actor (1879–1960)
extract: Victor David Sjöström, also known in the United States as Victor Seastrom, was a pioneering Swedish film director, screenwriter, and actor. He began his career in Sweden, before moving to Hollywood in 1924. Sjöström worked primarily in the silent era; his best known films include The Phantom Carriage (1921), He Who Gets Slapped (1924), and The Wind (1928). Sjöström was Sweden's most prominent director in the "Golden Age of Silent Film" in Europe. Later in life, he played the leading role in Ingmar Bergman's Wild Strawberries (1957).
extract_id: Victor David Sjöström, juga dikenal di Amerika Serikat sebagai Victor Seastrom, adalah sutradara film, penulis skenario, dan aktor pelopor Swedia. Dia memulai kariernya di Swedia, sebelum pindah ke Hollywood pada tahun 1924. Sjöström bekerja terutama pada era film bisu; film-film terkenalnya meliputi The Phantom Carriage (1921), He Who Gets Slapped (1924), dan The Wind (1928). Sjöström adalah sutradara paling menonjol di Swedia pada "Zaman Keemasan Film Bisu" di Eropa. Di kemudian hari, ia memerankan peran utama dalam film Wild Strawberries (1957) karya Ingmar Bergman.

name: Victor Slezak
title: Victor Slezak
extract: Victor Slezak is an American stage, television and screen actor who has appeared in numerous films, including The Bridges of Madison County (1995), Beyond Rangoon (1995), The Devil's Own (1997), The Siege (1998), The Cat's Meow (2001), Timequest as John F. Kennedy (2002), and The Notorious Bettie Page (2005).
extract_id: Victor Slezak adalah aktor panggung, televisi, dan layar Amerika yang telah tampil dalam banyak film, termasuk The Bridges of Madison County (1995), Beyond Rangoon (1995), The Devil's Own (1997), The Siege (1998), The Cat's Meow (2001), Timequest sebagai John F. Kennedy (2002), dan The Notorious Bettie Page (2005).

name: Victoria Horne
title: Victoria Horne
extract: Victoria Horne was an American character actress, appearing in 49 films during the 1940s and 1950s.
extract_id: Victoria Horne adalah seorang aktris karakter Amerika yang tampil dalam 49 film selama tahun 1940-an dan 1950-an.

name: Vidya Balan
title: Vidya Balan
extract: Vidya Balan is an Indian actress. Known for pioneering a change in the portrayal of women in Hindi cinema with her roles in female-led films, she is the recipient of several awards, including a National Film Award and seven Filmfare Awards. She was awarded the Padma Shri by the Government of India in 2014.
extract_id: Vidya Balan adalah aktris India. Dikenal karena memelopori perubahan dalam gambaran wanita di sinema Hindi dengan perannya dalam film-film yang dipimpin oleh perempuan, dia menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk National Film Award dan tujuh Filmfare Awards. Dia dianugerahi Padma Shri oleh Pemerintah India pada tahun 2014.

name: Vidya Malvade
title: Vidya Malvade
extract: Vidya Malvade is an Indian actress.
extract_id: Vidya Malvade adalah seorang aktris India.

name: Viggo Mortensen
title: Viggo Mortensen
extract: Viggo Peter Mortensen Jr. is a Danish-American actor and filmmaker. He has received various accolades including an Actor Award and a Critics' Choice Award as well as nominations for three Academy Awards, three BAFTA Awards, and four Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Viggo Peter Mortensen Jr. adalah aktor dan pembuat film Denmark-Amerika. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Actor Award dan Critics' Choice Award serta nominasi untuk tiga Academy Awards, tiga BAFTA Awards, dan empat Golden Globe Awards.

name: Vijay Raaz
title: Vijay Raaz
extract: Vijay Raaz is an Indian actor, film director and narrator, who predominantly appears in Hindi films. He debuted with Bhopal Express (1999) and since worked in more than 90 films. His breakthrough came when he played the role of Dubeyji in the movie Monsoon Wedding in 2001. Raaz garnered recognition for his comedic role in Run (2004) and Dhamaal (2007). He is noted for playing gangster roles in Delhi Belly (2011) and Dedh Ishqiya (2014) as well as other notable films include Stree (2018), Zoya Akhtar's Gully Boy (2019), Lootcase (2020), Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Gangubai Kathiawadi (2022). In 2014, he debuted as a director with Kya Dilli Kya Lahore. His gruff baritone voice has been used in voice-over work, including films and commercials.
extract_id: Vijay Raaz adalah aktor, sutradara film, dan narator India yang sebagian besar tampil dalam film Hindi. Dia memulai debutnya dengan Bhopal Express (1999) dan sejak itu berperan dalam lebih dari 90 film. Terobosan kariernya terjadi ketika dia memerankan Dubeyji dalam film Monsoon Wedding pada tahun 2001. Raaz mendapatkan pengakuan atas peran komedinya dalam Run (2004) dan Dhamaal (2007). Dia terkenal karena memainkan peran gangster dalam Delhi Belly (2011) dan Dedh Ishqiya (2014), serta film-film terkenal lainnya termasuk Stree (2018), Gully Boy karya Zoya Akhtar (2019), Lootcase (2020), dan Gangubai Kathiawadi karya Sanjay Leela Bhansali (2022). Pada tahun 2014, dia memulai debut sebagai sutradara dengan Kya Dilli Kya Lahore. Suara bariton parau miliknya sering digunakan untuk dubbing, termasuk dalam film dan iklan.

name: Vijay Sethupathi
title: Vijay Sethupathi
extract: Vijaya Gurunatha Sethupathi Kalimuthu, known professionally as Vijay Sethupathi and his initials as VJS, is an Indian actor and film producer who predominantly works in Tamil films and occasionally in Telugu and Hindi films. One of the highest paid actors in Indian Cinema, Sethupathi is the recipient of several accolades, including a National Film Award, two Filmfare Awards South and two Tamil Nadu State Film Awards.
extract_id: Vijaya Gurunatha Sethupathi Kalimuthu, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Vijay Sethupathi dan dengan inisialnya VJS, adalah aktor dan produser film India yang sebagian besar bekerja dalam film Tamil dan kadang-kadang dalam film Telugu dan Hindi. Sebagai salah satu aktor dengan bayaran tertinggi dalam Sinema India, Sethupathi menerima beberapa penghargaan, termasuk National Film Award, dua Filmfare Awards South, dan dua Tamil Nadu State Film Awards.

name: Vijay Varma
title: Vijay Varma
extract: Vijay Varma is an Indian actor who works predominantly in Hindi films and series. He graduated from the Film and Television Institute of India, before gaining recognition with the crime drama film Pink (2016). This was followed by supporting roles in Middle Class Abbayi (2017), Gully Boy (2019) and Baaghi 3 (2020). His performance in the former earned him a nomination for the Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actor.
extract_id: Vijay Varma adalah aktor India yang bekerja terutama dalam film dan serial Hindi. Dia lulus dari Film and Television Institute of India, sebelum mendapatkan pengakuan melalui film drama kriminal Pink (2016). Ini dilanjutkan dengan peran pendukung dalam Middle Class Abbayi (2017), Gully Boy (2019), dan Baaghi 3 (2020). Penampilannya dalam film pertama memberinya nominasi Filmfare Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik.

name: Vikas Bahl
title: Vikas Bahl
extract: Vikas Bahl is an Indian filmmaker, best known for directing Chillar Party (2011), Queen (2013), Super 30 (2019), and Shaitaan (2024).
extract_id: Vikas Bahl adalah pembuat film India, yang dikenal karena menyutradarai Chillar Party (2011), Queen (2013), Super 30 (2019), dan Shaitaan (2024).

name: Vikramaditya Motwane
title: Vikramaditya Motwane
extract: Vikramaditya Motwane is an Indian filmmaker who works in Hindi films and series. His directorial debut Udaan (2010) was selected to compete in the Un Certain Regard category at the 2010 Cannes Film Festival and also won seven Filmfare Awards.
extract_id: Vikramaditya Motwane adalah pembuat film India yang bekerja dalam film dan serial Hindi. Debut penyutradaraannya Udaan (2010) terpilih untuk bersaing dalam kategori Un Certain Regard di Festival Film Cannes 2010 dan juga memenangkan tujuh Filmfare Awards.

name: Vin Diesel
title: Vin Diesel
extract: Mark Sinclair Vincent, known professionally as Vin Diesel, is an American actor and filmmaker. One of the world's highest-grossing actors, he gained prominence for portraying Dominic "Dom" Toretto in the Fast & Furious franchise.
extract_id: Mark Sinclair Vincent, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Vin Diesel, adalah aktor dan pembuat film asal Amerika. Salah satu aktor dengan pendapatan tertinggi di dunia, ia dikenal karena memerankan Dominic "Dom" Toretto dalam waralaba Fast & Furious.

name: Vince Edwards
title: Vince Edwards
extract: Vince Edwards was an American actor, director, and singer. He was best known for his TV role as Dr. Ben Casey and as Major Cliff Bricker in the 1968 war film The Devil's Brigade.
extract_id: Vince Edwards adalah aktor, sutradara, dan penyanyi asal Amerika. Ia paling dikenal untuk perannya di TV sebagai Dr. Ben Casey dan sebagai Mayor Cliff Bricker dalam film perang tahun 1968 The Devil's Brigade.

name: Vince Vaughn
title: Vince Vaughn
extract: Vincent Anthony Vaughn is an American actor. He is known for starring as a leading man in numerous comedy films during the late 1990s and 2000s. He has won a Critics' Choice Award and earned nominations for a Actors Award and a Emmy Award.
extract_id: Vincent Anthony Vaughn adalah aktor asal Amerika. Ia dikenal karena berperan sebagai pemeran utama dalam berbagai film komedi pada akhir 1990-an dan 2000-an. Ia memenangkan Critics' Choice Award dan mendapatkan nominasi untuk Actors Award serta Emmy Award.

name: Vincent Cassel
title: Vincent Cassel
extract: Vincent Cassel is a French actor. He has earned a César Award and a Canadian Screen Award as well as nominations for a European Film Award and a Screen Actors Guild Award.
extract_id: Vincent Cassel adalah aktor asal Perancis. Ia memenangkan César Award dan Canadian Screen Award serta mendapatkan nominasi untuk European Film Award dan Screen Actors Guild Award.

name: Vincent D'Onofrio
title: Vincent D'Onofrio
extract: Vincent Philip D'Onofrio is an American actor and filmmaker. He is known for his supporting and leading roles in both film and television. He has been nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Vincent Philip D'Onofrio adalah aktor dan pembuat film asal Amerika. Ia dikenal karena peran pendukung dan utama dalam film maupun televisi. Ia pernah dinominasikan untuk Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Vincent Price
title: Vincent Price
extract: Vincent Leonard Price Jr. was an American actor, known to film audiences for his work in the horror genre, mostly portraying villains. He appeared on stage, television, and radio, and in more than 100 films. Price has two stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, one for motion pictures and one for television.
extract_id: Vincent Leonard Price Jr. adalah aktor asal Amerika yang dikenal oleh penonton film atas karyanya di genre horor, sebagian besar memerankan tokoh penjahat. Ia tampil di panggung, televisi, radio, dan dalam lebih dari 100 film. Price memiliki dua bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame, satu untuk film dan satu lagi untuk televisi.

name: Ving Rhames
title: Ving Rhames
extract: Irving Rameses Rhames is an American actor. Born and raised in Harlem, New York City, he studied drama at SUNY Purchase before transferring to the Juilliard School, graduating with a Bachelor of Fine Arts in 1983. After early stage work in Shakespeare and contemporary plays, he made his screen debut in 1985 and gained attention through roles in Jacob's Ladder (1990), The People Under the Stairs (1991), and as Marsellus Wallace in Quentin Tarantino’s Pulp Fiction (1994). Rhames achieved further recognition as Luther Stickell in the Mission: Impossible film series, appearing in all eight installments.
extract_id: Irving Rameses Rhames adalah aktor asal Amerika. Lahir dan dibesarkan di Harlem, New York City, ia belajar drama di SUNY Purchase sebelum pindah ke Juilliard School, lulus dengan gelar Bachelor of Fine Arts pada 1983. Setelah bekerja di panggung dengan karya Shakespeare dan drama kontemporer, ia memulai debut layarnya pada 1985 dan mendapat perhatian lewat peran dalam Jacob's Ladder (1990), The People Under the Stairs (1991), dan sebagai Marsellus Wallace dalam Pulp Fiction (1994) karya Quentin Tarantino. Rhames meraih pengakuan lebih lanjut sebagai Luther Stickell dalam seri film Mission: Impossible, tampil dalam delapan seri tersebut.

name: Vinícius de Oliveira
title: Vinícius de Oliveira
extract: Vinícius de Oliveira is a Brazilian actor.
extract_id: Vinícius de Oliveira adalah aktor Brasil.

name: Viola Davis
title: Viola Davis
extract: Viola Davis is an American actress and film producer. Her accolades include both the Triple Crown of Acting and EGOT. Time named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2012 and 2017. The New York Times ranked her ninth on its list of the greatest actors of the 21st century (2020). Davis received the Cecil B. DeMille Award at the Golden Globe awards in 2025.
extract_id: Viola Davis adalah aktris dan produser film asal Amerika. Penghargaan yang diraihnya mencakup Triple Crown of Acting dan EGOT. Time menobatkannya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia pada 2012 dan 2017. The New York Times menempatkannya di urutan kesembilan dalam daftar aktor terbesar abad ke-21 (2020). Davis menerima Cecil B. DeMille Award pada Golden Globe Awards tahun 2025.

name: Virginia Cherrill
title: Virginia Cherrill
extract: Virginia Cherrill, styled as Virginia Child Villiers, Countess of Jersey between 1937 and 1946, was an American actress best known to modern audiences for her role as the blind flower girl in Charlie Chaplin's City Lights (1931).
extract_id: Virginia Cherrill, bergelar Virginia Child Villiers, Countess of Jersey antara 1937 dan 1946, adalah aktris Amerika yang paling dikenal oleh penonton modern sebagai gadis bunga tunanetra dalam film Charlie Chaplin, City Lights (1931).

name: Virginia Mayo
title: Virginia Mayo
extract: Virginia Mayo was an American actress. She was in a series of popular comedy films with Danny Kaye and was Warner Bros.' biggest box-office draw in the late 1940s. She is also known for her roles in the war drama The Best Years of Our Lives (1946), the film noir White Heat (1949), and the war adventure Captain Horatio Hornblower (1951).
extract_id: Virginia Mayo adalah aktris Amerika. Ia berperan dalam sejumlah film komedi populer bersama Danny Kaye dan merupakan aktor dengan daya tarik box-office terbesar Warner Bros. pada akhir 1940-an. Ia juga dikenal atas perannya dalam drama perang The Best Years of Our Lives (1946), film noir White Heat (1949), dan petualangan perang Captain Horatio Hornblower (1951).

name: Vishal Bhardwaj
title: Vishal Bhardwaj
extract: Vishal Bhardwaj is an Indian filmmaker, music composer, and playback singer. He is known for his work in Hindi cinema, and is the recipient of nine National Film Awards and a Filmfare Award.
extract_id: Vishal Bhardwaj adalah pembuat film, komposer musik, dan penyanyi playback India. Ia dikenal atas karyanya di sinema Hindi, dan menerima sembilan Penghargaan Film Nasional serta satu Filmfare Award.

name: Vittorio De Sica
title: Vittorio De Sica
extract: Vittorio De Sica was an Italian film director and actor, a leading figure in the neorealist movement.
extract_id: Vittorio De Sica adalah sutradara film dan aktor asal Italia, tokoh utama dalam gerakan neorealis.

name: Vivian Pickles
title: Vivian Pickles
extract: Vivian Pickles is an English actress.
extract_id: Vivian Pickles adalah aktris asal Inggris.

name: Vivien Leigh
title: Vivien Leigh
extract: Vivian Mary Olivier, known professionally as Vivien Leigh and styled as Lady Olivier after 1947, was a British actress. After completing her drama school education, Leigh performed on stage before receiving small roles in four films in 1935, eventually progressing to the role of heroine in Fire Over England (1937). She went on to win the Academy Award for Best Actress twice, for her performances as Scarlett O'Hara in Gone with the Wind (1939) and Blanche DuBois in the film adaptation of A Streetcar Named Desire (1951), a role she had played on stage in London's West End in 1949. For the latter role, she also won the Volpi Cup for Best Actress, and later won a Tony Award for her work in the Broadway musical version of Tovarich (1963).
extract_id: Vivian Mary Olivier, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Vivien Leigh dan bergelar Lady Olivier setelah 1947, adalah aktris Inggris. Setelah menyelesaikan pendidikan drama, Leigh tampil di panggung sebelum mendapatkan peran kecil di empat film pada 1935, akhirnya maju menjadi pemeran utama dalam Fire Over England (1937). Ia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik dua kali, untuk perannya sebagai Scarlett O'Hara dalam Gone with the Wind (1939) dan Blanche DuBois dalam adaptasi film A Streetcar Named Desire (1951), peran yang juga pernah ia mainkan di panggung West End London pada 1949. Untuk peran kedua, ia juga memenangkan Volpi Cup untuk Aktris Terbaik, dan kemudian memenangkan Tony Award untuk karyanya dalam versi musikal Broadway Tovarich (1963).

name: Vlad Ivanov
title: Vlad Ivanov
extract: Vlad Ivanov is a Romanian actor of Lipovan origin.
extract_id: Vlad Ivanov adalah aktor asal Rumania keturunan Lipovan.

name: Vladimir Barskiy
title: Vladimir Barsky
extract: Vladimir Gregoryevich "Goskino" Barsky was a Russian and Soviet film director, screenwriter, actor and author of articles about theatre.
extract_id: Vladimir Gregoryevich "Goskino" Barsky adalah sutradara, penulis naskah, aktor, dan penulis artikel teater asal Rusia dan Soviet.

name: Vladimir Vdovichenkov
title: Vladimir Vdovichenkov
extract: Vladimir Vladimirovich Vdovichenkov is a Russian theater and screen actor known for his roles in Brigada (2002), Leviathan (2014), Bummer (2003) and Salyut 7 (2017).
extract_id: Vladimir Vladimirovich Vdovichenkov adalah aktor teater dan layar Rusia yang dikenal lewat perannya dalam Brigada (2002), Leviathan (2014), Bummer (2003), dan Salyut 7 (2017).

name: Vladislav Dvorzhetskiy
title: Vladislav Dvorzhetsky
extract: Vladislav Vatslavovich Dvorzhetsky was a Soviet film actor. He appeared in eighteen films between 1970 and 1978.
extract_id: Vladislav Vatslavovich Dvorzhetsky adalah aktor film Soviet. Ia tampil dalam delapan belas film antara 1970 dan 1978.

name: Véra Clouzot
title: Véra Clouzot
extract: Véra Gibson-Amado, known professionally as Véra Clouzot, was a Brazilian-French film actress and screenwriter. She is known for playing Linda in The Wages of Fear (1953), Christina Delassalle in Les Diaboliques (1955), and Lucie in Les Espions (1957). Clouzot also co-wrote the screenplay for La Vérité (1960). Her husband, director Henri-Georges Clouzot, named his production company after her, Véra Films.
extract_id: Véra Gibson-Amado, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Véra Clouzot, adalah aktris dan penulis skenario film Brasil-Prancis. Ia dikenal karena memerankan Linda dalam The Wages of Fear (1953), Christina Delassalle dalam Les Diaboliques (1955), dan Lucie dalam Les Espions (1957). Clouzot juga menulis skenario untuk La Vérité (1960). Suaminya, sutradara Henri-Georges Clouzot, menamai perusahaan produksinya Véra Films setelah namanya.

name: W.S. Van Dyke
title: W. S. Van Dyke
extract: Woodbridge Strong Van Dyke II was an American film director who made several early sound films, including Tarzan the Ape Man in 1932, The Thin Man in 1934, San Francisco in 1936, and six popular musicals with Nelson Eddy and Jeanette MacDonald. He received two Academy Award nominations for Best Director for The Thin Man and San Francisco, and directed four actors to Oscar nominations: William Powell, Spencer Tracy, Norma Shearer, and Robert Morley. Known as a reliable craftsman who made his films on schedule and under budget, he earned the name "One Take Woody" for his efficient style of filming.
