extract_id: Woodbridge Strong Van Dyke II adalah sutradara film Amerika yang membuat beberapa film suara awal, termasuk Tarzan the Ape Man pada 1932, The Thin Man pada 1934, San Francisco pada 1936, dan enam musikal populer dengan Nelson Eddy dan Jeanette MacDonald. Ia menerima dua nominasi Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik atas The Thin Man dan San Francisco, dan mengarahkan empat aktor menuju nominasi Oscar: William Powell, Spencer Tracy, Norma Shearer, dan Robert Morley. Dikenal sebagai pengrajin yang dapat diandalkan yang membuat film tepat waktu dan di bawah anggaran, ia mendapat julukan "One Take Woody" karena gaya pengambilan gambarnya yang efisien.

name: Wagner Moura
title: Wagner Moura
extract: Wagner Maniçoba de Moura is a Brazilian and Americanactor and filmmaker. His accolades include a Golden Globe, a Cannes Film Festival Award, and five Brazilian Academy Film Awards, in addition to nominations for an Academy Award, an Annie Award, and two Critics' Choice Award. Time magazine named him one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2026.
extract_id: Wagner Maniçoba de Moura adalah aktor dan pembuat film Brasil dan Amerika. Penghargaan yang diraihnya termasuk Golden Globe, Penghargaan Festival Film Cannes, dan lima Penghargaan Akademi Film Brasil, ditambah nominasi untuk Academy Award, Annie Award, dan dua Critics' Choice Award. Majalah Time menobatkannya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia pada 2026.

name: Wah Yuen
title: Yuen Wah
description: Hong Kong actor, action choreographer, stuntman and martial artist
extract: Yuen Wah is a Hong Kong actor, martial artist, stuntman, and action choreographer. A member of the Seven Little Fortunes, he has appeared in over 200 films and television series since his debut in 1962. He won the Hong Kong Film Award for Best Action Choreography for The Iceman Cometh (1989), and was nominated for Best Supporting Actor for his performance in Kung Fu Hustle (2004).
extract_id: Yuen Wah adalah aktor, ahli bela diri, pemeran pengganti, dan koreografer aksi asal Hong Kong. Anggota Seven Little Fortunes, ia telah tampil dalam lebih dari 200 film dan seri televisi sejak debutnya pada 1962. Ia memenangkan Hong Kong Film Award untuk Koreografi Aksi Terbaik untuk The Iceman Cometh (1989), dan dinominasikan sebagai Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk penampilannya dalam Kung Fu Hustle (2004).

name: Wallace Ford
title: Wallace Ford
extract: Wallace Ford was an English–American vaudevillian, stage performer and screen actor. Usually playing wise-cracking characters, he combined a tough but friendly-faced demeanor with a small but powerful, stocky physique.
extract_id: Wallace Ford adalah pelawak vaudeville, pemeran panggung, dan aktor layar keturunan Inggris-Amerika. Biasanya memainkan karakter yang suka berkata lucu, ia menggabungkan sikap tegas namun bersahabat dengan fisik kecil namun kuat dan kekar.

name: Walter Brennan
title: Walter Brennan
extract: Walter Andrew Brennan was an American actor and singer. He won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for Come and Get It (1936), Kentucky (1938) and The Westerner (1940), making him the only person to win three awards in the supporting actor category. Brennan was also nominated for his performance in Sergeant York (1941). Other noteworthy performances were in To Have and Have Not (1944), My Darling Clementine (1946), Red River (1948) and Rio Bravo (1959). On television, he starred in the sitcom The Real McCoys (1957–1963).
extract_id: Walter Andrew Brennan adalah aktor dan penyanyi asal Amerika. Ia memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk Come and Get It (1936), Kentucky (1938), dan The Westerner (1940), menjadikannya satu-satunya orang yang memenangkan tiga penghargaan di kategori aktor pendukung. Brennan juga dinominasikan atas penampilannya dalam Sergeant York (1941). Penampilan penting lainnya termasuk dalam To Have and Have Not (1944), My Darling Clementine (1946), Red River (1948), dan Rio Bravo (1959). Di televisi, ia membintangi sitkom The Real McCoys (1957–1963).

name: Walter Catlett
title: Walter Catlett
extract: Walter Leland Catlett was an American actor and comedian. He was famous for playing excitable, meddlesome, temperamental, and officious blowhards.
extract_id: Walter Leland Catlett adalah seorang aktor dan komedian Amerika. Dia terkenal karena memainkan karakter yang mudah gelisah, suka mencampuri urusan, temperamental, dan sombong yang suka mengatur.

name: Walter Connolly
title: Walter Connolly
extract: Walter James Connolly Jr. was an American character actor who appeared in almost 50 films from 1914 to 1939. His best known film is It Happened One Night (1934).
extract_id: Walter James Connolly Jr. adalah seorang aktor karakter Amerika yang tampil dalam hampir 50 film dari tahun 1914 hingga 1939. Film yang paling dikenal adalah It Happened One Night (1934).

name: Walter Hampden
title: Walter Hampden
extract: Walter Hampden Dougherty, known professionally as Walter Hampden, was an American actor and theatre manager. He was a major stage star on Broadway in New York who also made numerous television and film appearances.
extract_id: Walter Hampden Dougherty, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Walter Hampden, adalah seorang aktor dan manajer teater Amerika. Dia adalah bintang panggung utama di Broadway di New York yang juga tampil dalam berbagai acara televisi dan film.

name: Walter Hill
title: Walter Hill
extract: Walter Hill is an American filmmaker, known for his action films and revival of the Western genre. He has directed such films as The Driver, The Warriors, Southern Comfort, 48 Hrs. and its sequel Another 48 Hrs., Streets of Fire and Red Heat, and wrote the screenplay for the crime drama The Getaway. He has also directed several episodes of television series such as Tales from the Crypt and Deadwood and produced films in the Alien franchise. He founded Brandywine Productions with David Giler and Gordon Carroll.
extract_id: Walter Hill adalah seorang pembuat film Amerika, dikenal karena film aksi dan kebangkitan genre Barat. Dia telah menyutradarai film seperti The Driver, The Warriors, Southern Comfort, 48 Hrs. dan sekuelnya Another 48 Hrs., Streets of Fire dan Red Heat, serta menulis skenario untuk drama kriminal The Getaway. Dia juga menyutradarai beberapa episode serial televisi seperti Tales from the Crypt dan Deadwood serta memproduksi film dalam franchise Alien. Dia mendirikan Brandywine Productions bersama David Giler dan Gordon Carroll.

name: Walter Huston
title: Walter Huston
extract: Walter Thomas Huston was a Canadian and American actor and singer. Huston won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for his role in The Treasure of the Sierra Madre, directed by his son John Huston. He is the patriarch of the four generations of the Huston acting family, including his son John, grandchildren Anjelica Huston and Danny Huston, as well as great-grandchild Jack Huston.
extract_id: Walter Thomas Huston adalah aktor dan penyanyi asal Kanada dan Amerika. Huston memenangkan Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik atas perannya dalam The Treasure of the Sierra Madre, yang disutradarai oleh putranya John Huston. Dia adalah patriark dari empat generasi keluarga akting Huston, termasuk putranya John, cucu-cucunya Anjelica Huston dan Danny Huston, serta cicitnya Jack Huston.

name: Walter Matthau
title: Walter Matthau
extract: Walter John Matthau was an American actor, known for his "hangdog face" and for playing world-weary characters. He starred in 10 films alongside his real-life friend Jack Lemmon, including The Odd Couple (1968) and Grumpy Old Men (1993). The New York Times called this "one of Hollywood's most successful pairings". Among other accolades, Matthau won an Academy Award, one BAFTA Award, and two Tony Awards.
extract_id: Walter John Matthau adalah aktor Amerika, dikenal dengan "wajah murungnya" dan memainkan karakter yang lelah secara duniawi. Dia membintangi 10 film bersama teman nyata Jack Lemmon, termasuk The Odd Couple (1968) dan Grumpy Old Men (1993). The New York Times menyebut ini sebagai "salah satu pasangan paling sukses di Hollywood". Di antara penghargaan lainnya, Matthau memenangkan Academy Award, satu BAFTA Award, dan dua Tony Awards.

name: Walter Salles
title: Walter Salles
extract: Walter Moreira Salles Júnior is a Brazilian filmmaker. A major figure of the Resumption Cinema in Brazil, Salles is widely regarded as one of the greatest filmmakers in Brazilian cinema. His accolades include an Academy Award accepted for Best International Film, three Cannes Film Festival prizes, three Venice Film Festival prizes, two British Academy Film Awards, a Golden Bear and a Golden Globe.
extract_id: Walter Moreira Salles Júnior adalah pembuat film Brasil. Sebagai sosok penting dari Sinema Kebangkitan di Brasil, Salles dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film terbesar dalam sinema Brasil. Penghargaannya meliputi Academy Award untuk Film Internasional Terbaik, tiga penghargaan Festival Film Cannes, tiga penghargaan Festival Film Venesia, dua British Academy Film Awards, sebuah Golden Bear dan sebuah Golden Globe.

name: Walter Slezak
title: Walter Slezak
extract: Walter Slezak was an Austrian-born film and stage actor active between 1922 and 1976. He mainly appeared in German films before migrating to the United States in 1930 and performing in numerous Hollywood productions.
extract_id: Walter Slezak adalah aktor film dan panggung kelahiran Austria yang aktif antara tahun 1922 hingga 1976. Dia terutama tampil dalam film-film Jerman sebelum bermigrasi ke Amerika Serikat pada tahun 1930 dan tampil dalam berbagai produksi Hollywood.

name: Walton Goggins
title: Walton Goggins
extract: Walton Sanders Goggins Jr. is an American actor. He has starred in various television series, including The Shield (2002–2008), Justified (2010–2015), Vice Principals (2016–2017), The Righteous Gemstones (2019–2025), Invincible (2021–present), Fallout (2024–present), and The White Lotus (2025). He was nominated for the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama Series for Justified and The White Lotus, and for the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Drama Series for Fallout.
extract_id: Walton Sanders Goggins Jr. adalah aktor Amerika. Dia telah membintangi berbagai serial televisi, termasuk The Shield (2002–2008), Justified (2010–2015), Vice Principals (2016–2017), The Righteous Gemstones (2019–2025), Invincible (2021–sekarang), Fallout (2024–sekarang), dan The White Lotus (2025). Dia dinominasikan untuk Primetime Emmy Award sebagai Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam Serial Drama untuk Justified dan The White Lotus, serta untuk Primetime Emmy Award sebagai Aktor Utama Terbaik dalam Serial Drama untuk Fallout.

name: Ward Bond
title: Ward Bond
extract: Wardell Edwin Bond was an American character actor who appeared in more than 200 films and starred in the NBC television series Wagon Train from 1957 to 1960. Among his best-remembered film roles are Bert the cop in Frank Capra's It's a Wonderful Life (1946) and Captain Clayton in John Ford's The Searchers (1956).
extract_id: Wardell Edwin Bond adalah aktor karakter Amerika yang tampil dalam lebih dari 200 film dan membintangi serial televisi NBC Wagon Train dari 1957 hingga 1960. Di antara peran filmnya yang paling diingat adalah Bert si polisi dalam It's a Wonderful Life (1946) karya Frank Capra dan Kapten Clayton dalam The Searchers (1956) karya John Ford.

name: Warren Beatty
title: Warren Beatty
extract: Henry Warren Beatty is an American actor and filmmaker. His career has spanned over six decades, and he has received an Academy Award and three Golden Globe Awards. He also received the Irving G. Thalberg Award in 1999, the BAFTA Fellowship in 2002, the Kennedy Center Honors in 2004, the Cecil B. DeMille Award in 2007, and the American Film Institute Life Achievement Award in 2008.
extract_id: Henry Warren Beatty adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Kariernya telah berlangsung lebih dari enam dekade, dan ia telah menerima Academy Award serta tiga Golden Globe Awards. Ia juga menerima Irving G. Thalberg Award pada 1999, BAFTA Fellowship pada 2002, Kennedy Center Honors pada 2004, Cecil B. DeMille Award pada 2007, dan American Film Institute Life Achievement Award pada 2008.

name: Warren Clarke
title: Warren Clarke
extract: Warren Clarke was an English film, television and stage actor. He appeared in several films after a significant role as Dim in Stanley Kubrick's A Clockwork Orange (1971). His television appearances included Dalziel and Pascoe, The Manageress and Sleepers.
extract_id: Warren Clarke adalah aktor film, televisi, dan panggung Inggris. Dia muncul di beberapa film setelah peran penting sebagai Dim dalam A Clockwork Orange (1971) karya Stanley Kubrick. Penampilannya di televisi termasuk Dalziel and Pascoe, The Manageress, dan Sleepers.

name: Warren Oates
title: Warren Oates
extract: Warren Mercer Oates was an American actor. He was best known for his roles in Western and crime films, most notably in collaboration with directors Sam Peckinpah and Monte Hellman. He had starring roles in Peckinpah's The Wild Bunch (1969) and Bring Me the Head of Alfredo Garcia (1974). Other of his most acclaimed performances was as officer Sam Wood in Norman Jewison's In the Heat of the Night (1967) and as Mr. Sargis in Terrence Malick's Badlands (1973).
extract_id: Warren Mercer Oates adalah aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya dalam film Barat dan kriminal, terutama kolaborasinya dengan sutradara Sam Peckinpah dan Monte Hellman. Ia memegang peran utama dalam The Wild Bunch (1969) dan Bring Me the Head of Alfredo Garcia (1974) karya Peckinpah. Penampilan paling dipuji lainnya adalah sebagai petugas Sam Wood dalam In the Heat of the Night (1967) karya Norman Jewison dan sebagai Mr. Sargis dalam Badlands (1973) karya Terrence Malick.

name: Wendee Lee
title: Wendee Lee
extract: Wendee Lee is an American voice actress, writer, and director.
extract_id: Wendee Lee adalah aktris suara, penulis, dan sutradara asal Amerika.

name: Wendell Corey
title: Wendell Corey
extract: Wendell Reid Corey was an American actor and politician. He was President of the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences and a board member of the Screen Actors Guild, and also served on the Santa Monica City Council.
extract_id: Wendell Reid Corey adalah aktor dan politikus Amerika. Dia pernah menjadi Presiden Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences dan anggota dewan Screen Actors Guild, serta juga menjabat di Dewan Kota Santa Monica.

name: Wendy Crewson
title: Wendy Crewson
extract: Wendy Jane Crewson is a Canadian actress and producer. She began her career on Canadian television, before her breakthrough role in the 1991 dramatic film The Doctor.
extract_id: Wendy Jane Crewson adalah aktris dan produser Kanada. Dia memulai kariernya di televisi Kanada, sebelum mendapatkan peran terobosannya dalam film drama The Doctor pada tahun 1991.

name: Wendy Hiller
title: Wendy Hiller
extract: Dame Wendy Margaret Hiller was an English film and stage actress who enjoyed a varied acting career that spanned nearly 60 years. Writer Joel Hirschorn, in his 1984 compilation Rating the Movie Stars, described her as "a no-nonsense actress who literally took command of the screen whenever she appeared on film". Despite many notable film performances, Hiller chose to remain primarily a stage actress.
extract_id: Dame Wendy Margaret Hiller adalah aktris film dan panggung Inggris yang menjalani karier akting yang beragam selama hampir 60 tahun. Penulis Joel Hirschorn, dalam kumpulan Rating the Movie Stars tahun 1984, menggambarkannya sebagai "aktris tanpa basa-basi yang benar-benar menguasai layar setiap kali dia tampil di film". Meskipun memiliki banyak penampilan film terkenal, Hiller memilih untuk tetap menjadi aktris panggung utama.

name: Werner Herzog
title: Werner Herzog
extract: Werner Herzog is a German filmmaker, actor, opera director, author, and documentarian. Regarded as a pioneer of New German Cinema, his films often feature ambitious protagonists with impossible dreams, people with unusual talents in obscure fields, or individuals in conflict with nature. His film-making process involves avoiding storyboards, emphasizing improvisation, and placing his cast and crew into real situations mirroring those in the film on which they are working. He has received numerous accolades including a Silver Bear Award, four Awards at the Cannes Film Festival and the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement at the Venice Film Festival in addition to a nomination for an Academy Award.
extract_id: Werner Herzog adalah pembuat film, aktor, sutradara opera, penulis, dan dokumenter asal Jerman. Dipandang sebagai pelopor New German Cinema, film-filmnya sering menampilkan protagonis ambisius dengan mimpi yang mustahil, orang dengan bakat luar biasa dalam bidang yang tidak biasa, atau individu yang berkonflik dengan alam. Proses pembuatan filmnya melibatkan penghindaran storyboard, menekankan improvisasi, dan menempatkan pemeran serta kru dalam situasi nyata yang mencerminkan situasi dalam film yang sedang mereka kerjakan. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Silver Bear Award, empat penghargaan di Festival Film Cannes, serta Golden Lion untuk Lifetime Achievement di Festival Film Venesia selain nominasi Academy Award.

name: Werner Krauss
title: Werner Krauss
extract: Werner Johannes Krauss was a German stage and film actor. Krauss dominated the German stage of the early 20th century. However, his participation in the antisemitic propaganda film Jud Süß and his collaboration with the Nazis made him a controversial figure.
extract_id: Werner Johannes Krauss adalah aktor panggung dan film Jerman. Krauss mendominasi panggung Jerman pada awal abad ke-20. Namun, partisipasinya dalam film propaganda antisemit Jud Süß dan kolaborasinya dengan Nazi membuatnya menjadi sosok yang kontroversial.

name: Wes Anderson
title: Wes Anderson
extract: Wesley Wales Anderson is an American filmmaker. His films are known for themes of grief, loss of innocence, and dysfunctional families. Due to his films' eccentricity, distinctive visual and narrative styles, and frequent use of ensemble casts, critics have described Anderson as an auteur. He has received various accolades, including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, and nominations for four Golden Globe Awards. Three of his films appeared in BBC Culture's 2016 poll of the greatest films since 2000.
extract_id: Wesley Wales Anderson adalah pembuat film Amerika. Film-filmnya dikenal dengan tema kesedihan, kehilangan kepolosan, dan keluarga disfungsional. Karena keeksentrikan filmnya, gaya visual dan naratif yang khas, serta penggunaan pemeran ansambel yang sering, kritikus menggambarkan Anderson sebagai seorang auteur. Dia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan nominasi untuk empat Golden Globe Awards. Tiga filmnya masuk dalam jajak pendapat BBC Culture 2016 tentang film terbaik sejak tahun 2000.

name: Wes Bentley
title: Wes Bentley
extract: Wes Bentley is an American actor. He is best known for his roles as Ricky Fitts in American Beauty (1999), which earned him a nomination for the BAFTA Award for Supporting Actor, Seneca Crane in The Hunger Games (2012), Doyle in Interstellar (2014), Erik in Mission: Impossible – Fallout (2018), and Jamie Dutton in Yellowstone (2018–2024). He was one of four subjects in the documentary My Big Break (2009), which covered his fame after American Beauty and his subsequent struggles with substance abuse. Rebuilding his career, he starred in the premiere of Venus in Fur by David Ives in the off-Broadway production in 2010. Other film roles include The Four Feathers (2002), Ghost Rider (2007), P2 (2007), and Pete's Dragon (2016).
extract_id: Wes Bentley adalah aktor Amerika. Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai Ricky Fitts dalam American Beauty (1999), yang memberinya nominasi BAFTA Award untuk Aktor Pendukung, Seneca Crane dalam The Hunger Games (2012), Doyle dalam Interstellar (2014), Erik dalam Mission: Impossible – Fallout (2018), dan Jamie Dutton dalam Yellowstone (2018–2024). Dia adalah salah satu dari empat subjek dalam dokumenter My Big Break (2009), yang mengulas ketenarannya setelah American Beauty dan perjuangannya dengan penyalahgunaan zat. Dalam membangun kembali kariernya, ia membintangi pemutaran perdana Venus in Fur karya David Ives dalam produksi off-Broadway pada 2010. Peran film lainnya termasuk The Four Feathers (2002), Ghost Rider (2007), P2 (2007), dan Pete's Dragon (2016).

name: Wesley Addy
title: Wesley Addy
extract: Robert Wesley Addy was an American actor of stage, television, and film.
extract_id: Robert Wesley Addy adalah aktor Amerika untuk panggung, televisi, dan film.

name: Whoopi Goldberg
title: Whoopi Goldberg
extract: Caryn Elaine Johnson, known professionally as Whoopi Goldberg, is an American actor, comedian, author, and television personality. She is one of 28 entertainers to receive the EGOT, consisting of an Emmy, a Grammy, an Oscar, and a Tony Award. Her other accolades include a BAFTA and two Golden Globes. She received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 2001, the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor in 2010, and the Disney Legend Award in 2017.
extract_id: Caryn Elaine Johnson, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Whoopi Goldberg, adalah aktor, komedian, penulis, dan tokoh televisi Amerika. Dia adalah salah satu dari 28 penghibur yang menerima EGOT, yang terdiri dari Emmy, Grammy, Oscar, dan Tony Award. Penghargaan lainnya meliputi BAFTA dan dua Golden Globes. Dia menerima bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame pada 2001, Mark Twain Prize for American Humor pada 2010, dan Disney Legend Award pada 2017.

name: Wil Johnson
title: Wil Johnson
extract: Wilbert Charles Johnson is an English actor, who has had notable television roles in Waking the Dead and Babyfather, and on stage in Othello. He played Dom Andrews in Emmerdale from 2012 to 2014.
extract_id: Wilbert Charles Johnson adalah aktor Inggris, yang memiliki peran televisi penting dalam Waking the Dead dan Babyfather, serta di panggung dalam Othello. Dia memainkan Dom Andrews dalam Emmerdale dari 2012 hingga 2014.

name: Wil Wheaton
title: Wil Wheaton
extract: Richard William "Wil" Wheaton III is an American actor and writer. He portrayed Wesley Crusher on the television series Star Trek: The Next Generation, Gordie Lachance in the film Stand by Me, Joey Trotta in Toy Soldiers, and Bennett Hoenicker in Flubber.
extract_id: Richard William "Wil" Wheaton III adalah aktor dan penulis Amerika. Dia memerankan Wesley Crusher dalam serial televisi Star Trek: The Next Generation, Gordie Lachance dalam film Stand by Me, Joey Trotta dalam Toy Soldiers, dan Bennett Hoenicker dalam Flubber.

name: Wiley Wiggins
title: Wiley Wiggins
extract: Wiley Ramsey Wiggins is an American former actor.
extract_id: Wiley Ramsey Wiggins adalah mantan aktor Amerika.

name: Wilford Brimley
title: Wilford Brimley
extract: Anthony Wilford Brimley was an American actor. After serving in the U.S. Marine Corps and working odd jobs in the 1950s, Brimley started working as an extra and stuntman in Western films in the late 1960s. He became an established character actor in the 1970s and 1980s in films such as The China Syndrome (1979), The Thing (1982), Tender Mercies (1983), The Natural (1984), Cocoon (1985), and Cocoon: The Return (1988). Brimley was known for playing characters at times much older than his age. He was the long-term face of American television advertisements for the Quaker Oats Company. He also promoted diabetes education and appeared in related television commercials for Liberty Medical, a role for which he became an Internet meme.
extract_id: Anthony Wilford Brimley adalah aktor Amerika. Setelah bertugas di Korps Marinir AS dan bekerja dengan pekerjaan serabutan pada 1950-an, Brimley mulai bekerja sebagai ekstra dan pemeran pengganti di film Barat pada akhir 1960-an. Dia menjadi aktor karakter yang mapan pada 1970-an dan 1980-an dalam film-film seperti The China Syndrome (1979), The Thing (1982), Tender Mercies (1983), The Natural (1984), Cocoon (1985), dan Cocoon: The Return (1988). Brimley dikenal memainkan karakter yang terkadang jauh lebih tua dari usianya. Dia merupakan wajah jangka panjang iklan televisi Amerika untuk Perusahaan Quaker Oats. Dia juga mempromosikan edukasi diabetes dan muncul dalam iklan televisi terkait untuk Liberty Medical, sebuah peran yang membuatnya menjadi meme Internet.

name: Wilfrid Hyde-White
title: Wilfrid Hyde-White
extract: Wilfrid Hyde-White was an English actor. Described by Philip French as a "classic British film archetype", Hyde-White often portrayed droll and urbane upper-class characters. He had an extensive stage and screen career in both the United Kingdom and the United States, and portrayed over 160 film and television roles between 1935 and 1987. He was twice nominated for a Tony Award for Best Actor in a Play, in 1957 for The Reluctant Debutante and in 1973 for The Jockey Club Stakes.
extract_id: Wilfrid Hyde-White adalah aktor Inggris. Dideskripsikan oleh Philip French sebagai "archetype film klasik Inggris", Hyde-White sering memerankan karakter kelas atas yang jenaka dan berbudaya. Dia memiliki karier panggung dan layar yang luas di Inggris dan Amerika Serikat, dan memerankan lebih dari 160 peran film dan televisi antara 1935 dan 1987. Dia dua kali dinominasikan untuk Tony Award sebagai Aktor Terbaik dalam Sebuah Drama, pada 1957 untuk The Reluctant Debutante dan pada 1973 untuk The Jockey Club Stakes.

name: Will Ferrell
title: Will Ferrell
extract: John William Ferrell is an American actor, comedian, writer, and producer. He is known for his leading man roles in comedy films and for his work as a television producer. Ferrell has received various accolades, including six Primetime Emmy Awards and a British Academy Television Award, in addition to nominations for two Golden Globe Awards and for a Tony Award. In 2011, Ferrell was honored with the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor. In 2015, he received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame and was named the year's best comedian in British GQ.
extract_id: John William Ferrell adalah aktor, komedian, penulis, dan produser Amerika. Dia dikenal karena peran utamanya dalam film komedi dan pekerjaannya sebagai produser televisi. Ferrell telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk enam Primetime Emmy Awards dan British Academy Television Award, serta nominasi untuk dua Golden Globe Awards dan Tony Award. Pada 2011, Ferrell dianugerahi Mark Twain Prize for American Humor. Pada 2015, dia mendapat bintang di Hollywood Walk of Fame dan dinobatkan sebagai komedian terbaik tahun itu oleh British GQ.

name: Will Forte
title: Will Forte
extract: Orville Willis Forte IV is an American actor, comedian, writer, and producer. He was a cast member and writer on the NBC sketch comedy series Saturday Night Live for eight seasons from 2002 to 2010. His most famous recurring character was a parody of MacGyver named MacGruber; he reprised that role in the film adaptation, MacGruber (2010); and the limited series of the same name in 2021.
extract_id: Orville Willis Forte IV adalah aktor, komedian, penulis, dan produser Amerika. Dia adalah anggota pemeran dan penulis di serial komedi sketsa NBC Saturday Night Live selama delapan musim dari 2002 hingga 2010. Karakter ulang tahunnya yang paling terkenal adalah parodi MacGyver bernama MacGruber; dia mengulang peran itu dalam adaptasi film, MacGruber (2010); dan serial terbatas dengan nama yang sama pada 2021.

name: Will Patton
title: Will Patton
extract: William Rankin Patton is an American actor. He starred as Colonel Dan Weaver in the TNT science fiction series Falling Skies. He also appeared in the films The Client (1994), Armageddon (1998), Gone in 60 Seconds (2000), Remember the Titans (2000), The Punisher (2004), American Honey (2016), Halloween (2018), Minari (2020), and Train Dreams (2025). He appeared opposite Kevin Costner in four films: No Way Out (1987), The Postman (1997), and Horizon: An American Saga – Chapter 1 and Chapter 2, as well as having a guest role in seasons 3 and 4 of Costner's Paramount Network series Yellowstone (2020–2022). Patton played Deputy Marnes in season one of the 2023 TV series Silo.
extract_id: William Rankin Patton adalah aktor Amerika. Dia membintangi sebagai Kolonel Dan Weaver dalam serial fiksi ilmiah TNT Falling Skies. Dia juga muncul dalam film The Client (1994), Armageddon (1998), Gone in 60 Seconds (2000), Remember the Titans (2000), The Punisher (2004), American Honey (2016), Halloween (2018), Minari (2020), dan Train Dreams (2025). Dia tampil bersama Kevin Costner dalam empat film: No Way Out (1987), The Postman (1997), dan Horizon: An American Saga – Chapter 1 dan Chapter 2, serta memiliki peran tamu di musim 3 dan 4 serial Paramount Network Costner, Yellowstone (2020–2022). Patton memerankan Deputi Marnes di musim pertama serial TV Silo 2023.

name: Will Poulter
title: Will Poulter
extract: William Jack Poulter is an English actor. Known for his work in film and television, his accolades include a British Academy Film Award as well as nominations for two Primetime Emmy Awards.
extract_id: William Jack Poulter adalah aktor Inggris. Dikenal atas karyanya di film dan televisi, penghargaan yang ia raih termasuk British Academy Film Award serta nominasi untuk dua Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Will Smith
title: Will Smith
extract: Willard Carroll Smith II is an American actor, rapper, and film producer. Known for his work in both the screen and music industries, his accolades include an Academy Award, a Golden Globe Award, a BAFTA Award, and four Grammy Awards. His films as a leading man have grossed over $10 billion worldwide, making him one of Hollywood's most bankable stars.
extract_id: Willard Carroll Smith II adalah aktor, rapper, dan produser film Amerika. Dikenal atas karyanya di kedua industri layar dan musik, penghargaan yang ia raih termasuk Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, BAFTA Award, dan empat Grammy Awards. Film-filmnya sebagai pemeran utama telah meraup lebih dari $10 miliar di seluruh dunia, menjadikannya salah satu bintang paling menguntungkan di Hollywood.

name: Willem Dafoe
title: Willem Dafoe
extract: William James "Willem" Dafoe is an American actor. Known for his prolific career portraying diverse roles on stage and screen, he is the recipient of various accolades including a Volpi Cup Award for Best Actor, with nominations for four Academy Awards, a British Academy Film Award, and four Golden Globe Awards. He received an Honorary Golden Bear in 2018.
extract_id: William James "Willem" Dafoe adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal atas kariernya yang produktif memerankan berbagai peran di panggung dan layar, ia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Volpi Cup Award untuk Aktor Terbaik, dengan nominasi untuk empat Academy Awards, British Academy Film Award, dan empat Golden Globe Awards. Dia menerima Honorary Golden Bear pada 2018.

name: William Atherton
title: William Atherton
extract: William Atherton is an American actor. He had starring roles in The Sugarland Express (1974), The Day of the Locust (1975), The Hindenburg (1975) and Looking for Mr. Goodbar (1977), but is most recognized for what have become iconic roles in the Ghostbusters and Die Hard film series.
extract_id: William Atherton adalah aktor Amerika. Dia memiliki peran utama dalam The Sugarland Express (1974), The Day of the Locust (1975), The Hindenburg (1975) dan Looking for Mr. Goodbar (1977), tetapi paling dikenal atas peran ikoniknya dalam seri film Ghostbusters dan Die Hard.

name: William Bendix
title: William Bendix
extract: William Bendix was an American film, radio, and television actor, known for his portrayals of rough, blue-collar characters. He gained significant recognition for his role in Wake Island, for which he was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor. Bendix is also remembered for playing Chester A. Riley, the earnest and clumsy aircraft plant worker, in both the radio and television versions of The Life of Riley. Additionally, he portrayed baseball legend Babe Ruth in The Babe Ruth Story. Bendix frequently co-starred with Alan Ladd, appearing in ten films together; both actors died in 1964.
extract_id: William Bendix adalah aktor film, radio, dan televisi Amerika, dikenal karena peranannya sebagai karakter kasar dan kelas pekerja. Dia mendapatkan pengakuan besar untuk perannya dalam Wake Island, yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik. Bendix juga diingat karena memerankan Chester A. Riley, pekerja pabrik pesawat yang sungguh-sungguh dan kikuk, dalam versi radio dan televisi dari The Life of Riley. Selain itu, dia memerankan legenda baseball Babe Ruth dalam The Babe Ruth Story. Bendix sering menjadi pemeran bersama Alan Ladd, muncul dalam sepuluh film bersama-sama; keduanya meninggal pada 1964.

name: William Daniels
title: William Daniels
extract: William David Daniels is an American actor, known for his television roles, notably as Mark Craig on the drama series St. Elsewhere, for which he won two Primetime Emmy Awards; the voice of KITT on the television series Knight Rider; and George Feeny on the sitcom Boy Meets World, which earned him four People's Choice Award nominations. He reprised his Knight Rider role in the sequel TV movie Knight Rider 2000 and his Boy Meets World role in the sequel series Girl Meets World. He also portrayed Carter Nash in Captain Nice.
extract_id: William David Daniels adalah aktor Amerika, dikenal atas peran-perannya di televisi, khususnya sebagai Mark Craig dalam serial drama St. Elsewhere, yang memberinya dua Primetime Emmy Awards; suara KITT dalam serial televisi Knight Rider; dan George Feeny dalam sitkom Boy Meets World, yang memberinya empat nominasi People's Choice Award. Dia mengulang peran Knight Rider dalam film TV sekuel Knight Rider 2000 dan peran Boy Meets World dalam serial sekuel Girl Meets World. Dia juga memerankan Carter Nash dalam Captain Nice.

name: William Friedkin
title: William Friedkin
extract: William David Friedkin was an American director, producer, and screenwriter who was closely identified with the New Hollywood movement of the 1970s. Beginning his career in documentaries in the early 1960s, he is best known for his crime thriller film The French Connection (1971), which won five Academy Awards, including Best Picture and Best Director, and the horror film The Exorcist (1973), which earned him another Academy Award nomination for Best Director.
extract_id: William David Friedkin adalah sutradara, produser, dan penulis skenario Amerika yang terkait erat dengan gerakan New Hollywood pada 1970-an. Memulai kariernya dengan dokumenter pada awal 1960-an, dia paling dikenal untuk film thriller kejahatan The French Connection (1971), yang memenangkan lima Academy Awards, termasuk Best Picture dan Best Director, serta film horor The Exorcist (1973), yang memberinya nominasi Academy Award lagi untuk Best Director.

name: William H. Macy
title: William H. Macy
extract: William Hall Macy Jr. is an American actor and filmmaker. He is a two-time Emmy Award and four-time Screen Actors Guild Award winner, and has been nominated for an Academy Award, a Drama Critics' Circle Award, and five Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: William Hall Macy Jr. adalah aktor dan pembuat film Amerika. Dia memenangkan dua Emmy Awards dan empat Screen Actors Guild Awards, serta telah dinominasikan untuk Academy Award, Drama Critics' Circle Award, dan lima Golden Globe Awards.

name: William Harrigan
title: William Harrigan
extract: William Harrigan was an American actor who performed in Hollywood during the 1930s and 1940s and on stage.
extract_id: William Harrigan adalah aktor Amerika yang tampil di Hollywood selama 1930-an dan 1940-an serta di panggung teater.

name: William Hickey
title: William Hickey (actor)
extract: William Edward Hickey was an American actor and acting teacher. He is best known for his Academy Award-nominated role as Don Corrado Prizzi in the John Huston film Prizzi's Honor (1985), as well as Uncle Lewis in National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation (1989) and the voice of Dr. Finkelstein in Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas (1993).
extract_id: William Edward Hickey adalah aktor dan guru akting Amerika. Dia paling dikenal untuk perannya yang dinominasikan Academy Award sebagai Don Corrado Prizzi dalam film John Huston Prizzi's Honor (1985), serta sebagai Paman Lewis dalam National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation (1989) dan suara Dr. Finkelstein dalam film Tim Burton The Nightmare Before Christmas (1993).

name: William Holden
title: William Holden
extract: William Franklin Holden was an American actor. He was an Academy Award and Primetime Emmy Award winner, and one of the biggest box-office draws of the 1950s. He was named one of the "Top 10 Stars of the Year" six times, and appeared as 25th on the American Film Institute's list of 25 greatest male stars of Classical Hollywood cinema.
extract_id: William Franklin Holden adalah aktor Amerika. Dia pemenang Academy Award dan Primetime Emmy Award, serta salah satu aktor dengan pendapatan box office terbesar pada 1950-an. Dia dinamai salah satu dari "Top 10 Stars of the Year" enam kali, dan muncul di peringkat ke-25 dalam daftar 25 bintang pria terbesar sinema Hollywood klasik yang disusun oleh American Film Institute.

name: William Hurt
title: William Hurt
extract: William McChord Hurt was an American actor. Known for his performances on stage and screen, he received various accolades including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, and a Cannes Film Festival Award for Best Actor, in addition to nominations for five Golden Globe Awards, two Primetime Emmy Awards, and a Tony Award.
extract_id: William McChord Hurt adalah aktor Amerika. Dikenal atas penampilannya di panggung dan layar, dia menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dan Cannes Film Festival Award untuk Aktor Terbaik, serta nominasi untuk lima Golden Globe Awards, dua Primetime Emmy Awards, dan Tony Award.

name: William Keighley
title: William Keighley
extract: William Jackson Keighley was an American stage actor and Hollywood film director.
extract_id: William Jackson Keighley adalah aktor panggung Amerika dan sutradara film Hollywood.

name: William Powell
title: William Powell
extract: William Horatio Powell was an American actor, known primarily for his film career. Under contract with Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer, he was paired with Myrna Loy in 14 films, including the Thin Man series based on the Nick and Nora Charles characters created by Dashiell Hammett. Powell was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actor three times: for The Thin Man (1934), My Man Godfrey (1936), and Life with Father (1947).
extract_id: William Horatio Powell adalah aktor Amerika, terutama dikenal atas karier filmnya. Di bawah kontrak dengan Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer, dia dipasangkan dengan Myrna Loy dalam 14 film, termasuk seri Thin Man yang berdasarkan karakter Nick dan Nora Charles yang dibuat oleh Dashiell Hammett. Powell dinominasikan untuk Academy Award Aktor Terbaik tiga kali: untuk The Thin Man (1934), My Man Godfrey (1936), dan Life with Father (1947).

name: William Sadler
title: William Sadler (actor)
extract: William Thomas Sadler is an American actor. He began his career in various Broadway productions including Neil Simon's Biloxi Blues (1985). Known as a character actor, his best known film roles include Die Hard 2 (1990), Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey (1991), The Shawshank Redemption (1994), The Green Mile (1999), The Mist (2007), and Bill & Ted Face the Music (2020). He portrayed President Matthew Ellis in various Marvel Cinematic Universe media including Iron Man 3 (2013) and Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. (2015–2016), and he also portrayed Gino Fish in the Jesse Stone television films.
extract_id: William Thomas Sadler adalah aktor Amerika. Dia memulai kariernya dalam berbagai produksi Broadway termasuk Biloxi Blues karya Neil Simon (1985). Dikenal sebagai aktor karakter, peran filmnya yang paling terkenal termasuk Die Hard 2 (1990), Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey (1991), The Shawshank Redemption (1994), The Green Mile (1999), The Mist (2007), dan Bill & Ted Face the Music (2020). Dia memerankan Presiden Matthew Ellis dalam berbagai media Marvel Cinematic Universe termasuk Iron Man 3 (2013) dan Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. (2015–2016), serta memerankan Gino Fish dalam film televisi Jesse Stone.

name: William Shatner
title: William Shatner
extract: William Shatner is a Canadian actor. From 1966 to 1994, he starred as Captain James T. Kirk in the Star Trek franchise, from his debut as the captain of the starship Enterprise in the second pilot of the first Star Trek television series to his final appearance as Captain Kirk in the seventh Star Trek feature film, Star Trek Generations.
extract_id: William Shatner adalah aktor Kanada. Dari 1966 hingga 1994, dia membintangi sebagai Kapten James T. Kirk dalam franchise Star Trek, dari debutnya sebagai kapten kapal bintang Enterprise dalam pilot kedua serial televisi Star Trek pertama hingga penampilan terakhirnya sebagai Kapten Kirk dalam film ketujuh franchise Star Trek, Star Trek Generations.

name: William Sylvester
title: William Sylvester
extract: William Sylvester was an American actor, chiefly known for his film and television work in the United Kingdom. He was a star of British B-movies and West End theatre in the 1950s and 1960s, but gained widespread recognition for his role as Dr. Heywood Floyd in the landmark science-fiction film 2001: A Space Odyssey (1968).
extract_id: William Sylvester adalah aktor Amerika, terutama dikenal karena karyanya di film dan televisi di Inggris. Dia adalah bintang film B Inggris dan teater West End pada 1950-an dan 1960-an, tetapi mendapatkan pengakuan luas atas perannya sebagai Dr. Heywood Floyd dalam film fiksi ilmiah penting 2001: A Space Odyssey (1968).

name: William Wyler
title: William Wyler
extract: William Wyler was a German-born American film director and producer. Known for his work in numerous genres over five decades, he received numerous accolades, including the most nominations for the Academy Award for Best Director (12). In addition to three Academy Awards, he also received two BAFTA Awards and one Golden Globe Award. For his oeuvre of work, Wyler was awarded the Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award, the Directors Guild of America Lifetime Achievement Award, and the American Film Institute Life Achievement Award.
extract_id: William Wyler adalah sutradara dan produser film Amerika kelahiran Jerman. Dikenal karena karyanya di berbagai genre selama lima dekade, ia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk nominasi terbanyak untuk Academy Award untuk Best Director (12). Selain tiga Academy Awards, dia juga menerima dua BAFTA Awards dan satu Golden Globe Award. Untuk karya hidupnya, Wyler dianugerahi Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award, Directors Guild of America Lifetime Achievement Award, dan American Film Institute Life Achievement Award.

name: Wilson Yip
title: Wilson Yip
extract: Wilson Yip Wai-shun is a Hong Kong filmmaker and actor. His directing credits include Bio Zombie, The White Dragon, SPL: Sha Po Lang, Dragon Tiger Gate, Flash Point and the Ip Man series.
extract_id: Wilson Yip Wai-shun adalah pembuat film dan aktor Hong Kong. Kredit penyutradaraannya termasuk Bio Zombie, The White Dragon, SPL: Sha Po Lang, Dragon Tiger Gate, Flash Point dan seri Ip Man.

name: Wim Wenders
title: Wim Wenders
extract: Wim Wenders is a German filmmaker and photographer. Regarded as a major figure of New German Cinema and widely considered an auteur director, he has received various accolades, including a BAFTA Award, a Palme d'Or, a Golden Lion, and an Honorary Golden Bear, in addition to nominations for four Academy Awards, an Emmy Award, and a Grammy Award.
extract_id: Wim Wenders adalah seorang pembuat film dan fotografer asal Jerman. Dianggap sebagai sosok utama dalam New German Cinema dan secara luas dianggap sebagai sutradara auteur, ia telah menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk BAFTA Award, Palme d'Or, Golden Lion, dan Honorary Golden Bear, selain nominasi untuk empat Academy Awards, Emmy Award, dan Grammy Award.

name: Winona Ryder
title: Winona Ryder
extract: Winona Laura Horowitz, known professionally as Winona Ryder, is an American actress. Having come to attention playing "quirky" characters in the late 1980s, she achieved success with her more dramatic performances in the 1990s. Ryder's many accolades include a Golden Globe, as well as nominations for two Academy Awards, a BAFTA Award, and a Grammy Award.
extract_id: Winona Laura Horowitz, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Winona Ryder, adalah seorang aktris Amerika. Ia mulai dikenal dengan memerankan karakter "aneh" pada akhir 1980-an, dan meraih kesuksesan dengan penampilan dramatisnya pada tahun 1990-an. Berbagai penghargaan yang diterima Ryder termasuk Golden Globe, serta nominasi untuk dua Academy Awards, BAFTA Award, dan Grammy Award.

name: Wladyslaw Kowalski
title: Władysław Kowalski (actor)
extract: Władysław Kowalski was a Polish actor. He appeared in nearly 100 films and television shows between 1957 and 2015.
extract_id: Władysław Kowalski adalah seorang aktor Polandia. Ia tampil dalam hampir 100 film dan acara televisi antara tahun 1957 dan 2015.

name: Wolfgang Becker
title: Wolfgang Becker (director, born 1954)
extract: Wolfgang Becker was a German film director and screenwriter, best known to international audiences for his work Good Bye, Lenin! (2003). He was a co-founder of the production company X Filme Creative Pool, which produced his first successful feature film, Das Leben ist eine Baustelle, in 1997.
extract_id: Wolfgang Becker adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film asal Jerman, yang paling dikenal di kalangan penonton internasional lewat karyanya Good Bye, Lenin! (2003). Ia adalah salah satu pendiri perusahaan produksi X Filme Creative Pool, yang memproduksi film fitur pertamanya yang sukses, Das Leben ist eine Baustelle, pada tahun 1997.

name: Wolfgang Lukschy
title: Wolfgang Lukschy
extract: Wolfgang Lukschy was a German actor. He performed in theater, film and television.
extract_id: Wolfgang Lukschy adalah seorang aktor Jerman. Ia tampil di panggung teater, film, dan televisi.

name: Wolfgang Petersen
title: Wolfgang Petersen
extract: Wolfgang Petersen was a German film and television director, screenwriter and producer. His international breakthrough was the war film Das Boot (1981), which earned him Academy Award nominations for Best Director and Best Adapted Screenplay. He subsequently directed the blockbuster fantasy film The NeverEnding Story (1984), based on the 1979 novel of the same name.
extract_id: Wolfgang Petersen adalah seorang sutradara, penulis skenario, dan produser film dan televisi asal Jerman. Terobosan internasionalnya adalah film perang Das Boot (1981), yang memberinya nominasi Academy Award untuk Sutradara Terbaik dan Skenario Adaptasi Terbaik. Ia kemudian menyutradarai film fantasi blockbuster The NeverEnding Story (1984), yang didasarkan pada novel tahun 1979 dengan judul yang sama.

name: Wolfgang Reitherman
title: Wolfgang Reitherman
extract: Wolfgang Reitherman, also known and sometimes credited as Woolie Reitherman, was a German-American animator, director and producer. As a member of the "Nine Old Men" at Walt Disney Productions, Reitherman was known for his action-oriented animation.
extract_id: Wolfgang Reitherman, yang juga dikenal dan kadang dikreditkan sebagai Woolie Reitherman, adalah animator, sutradara, dan produser Jerman-Amerika. Sebagai anggota "Nine Old Men" di Walt Disney Productions, Reitherman dikenal dengan animasi yang berorientasi pada aksi.

name: Won Bin
title: Won Bin
extract: Kim Do-jin, known professionally as Won Bin (원빈), is a South Korean actor. He first gained wide popularity in 2000 after starring in the television series Autumn in My Heart. One of the most selective actors in the Korean entertainment industry, he has starred in only five films to date: Guns & Talks (2001), Taegukgi (2004), My Brother (2004), Mother (2009), and The Man from Nowhere (2010). He was Gallup Korea's Film Actor of the Year in 2010 and 2011.
extract_id: Kim Do-jin, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Won Bin (원빈), adalah aktor asal Korea Selatan. Ia pertama kali populer secara luas pada tahun 2000 setelah membintangi serial televisi Autumn in My Heart. Salah satu aktor paling selektif di industri hiburan Korea, ia hanya membintangi lima film hingga saat ini: Guns & Talks (2001), Taegukgi (2004), My Brother (2004), Mother (2009), dan The Man from Nowhere (2010). Ia dinobatkan sebagai Aktor Film Terbaik versi Gallup Korea pada tahun 2010 dan 2011.

name: Wood Harris
title: Wood Harris
extract: Sherwin David "Wood" Harris is an American actor. He first garnered attention for his role as Motaw in the Jeff Pollack film Above the Rim (1994), before portraying high school football player Julius Campbell in the Walt Disney Pictures film Remember the Titans (2000) and Jimi Hendrix in the Showtime television film Hendrix (2000). He attained further recognition for his portrayal of drug kingpin Avon Barksdale on the HBO crime drama The Wire (2002–2008). Harris also played the role of cocaine dealer Ace, based on the life of Azie Faison, in the crime film Paid in Full (2002).
extract_id: Sherwin David "Wood" Harris adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Ia pertama kali mendapat perhatian untuk perannya sebagai Motaw dalam film Jeff Pollack Above the Rim (1994), sebelum memerankan pemain sepak bola sekolah menengah Julius Campbell dalam film Walt Disney Pictures Remember the Titans (2000) dan Jimi Hendrix dalam film televisi Showtime Hendrix (2000). Ia mendapat pengakuan lebih lanjut karena memerankan raja narkoba Avon Barksdale dalam drama kriminal HBO The Wire (2002–2008). Harris juga memainkan peran sebagai pengedar kokain Ace, yang berdasarkan kehidupan Azie Faison, dalam film kriminal Paid in Full (2002).

name: Woody Allen
title: Woody Allen
extract: Woody Allen is an American filmmaker, actor, writer, and comedian. In a career spanning more than seven decades, he has written for film, television, and theater. As a screenwriter, Allen holds the record of most wins (3) and nominations (16) for the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay. In addition to his four Academy Awards, he has also received numerous other accolades, including ten BAFTA Awards, two Golden Globe Awards, a Grammy Award, and nominations for an Emmy Award and a Tony Award. He received an Honorary Golden Lion in 1995, the BAFTA Fellowship in 1997, an Honorary Palme d'Or in 2002, and the Golden Globe Cecil B. DeMille Award in 2014. Two of his films have been inducted into the National Film Registry by the Library of Congress.
extract_id: Woody Allen adalah pembuat film, aktor, penulis, dan komedian asal Amerika. Dalam karier yang berlangsung lebih dari tujuh dekade, ia menulis untuk film, televisi, dan teater. Sebagai penulis skenario, Allen memegang rekor kemenangan terbanyak (3) dan nominasi (16) untuk Academy Award untuk Skenario Asli Terbaik. Selain empat Academy Award-nya, ia juga menerima berbagai penghargaan lainnya, termasuk sepuluh BAFTA Awards, dua Golden Globe Awards, Grammy Award, dan nominasi Emmy Award serta Tony Award. Ia menerima Honorary Golden Lion pada 1995, BAFTA Fellowship pada 1997, Honorary Palme d'Or pada 2002, dan Golden Globe Cecil B. DeMille Award pada 2014. Dua filmnya telah diinduksi ke dalam National Film Registry oleh Library of Congress.

name: Woody Harrelson
title: Woody Harrelson
extract: Woodrow Tracy Harrelson is an American actor. He first became known for his role as charmingly naive bartender Woody Boyd on the NBC sitcom Cheers (1985–1993), for which he won a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series from five nominations. Harrelson has received three Academy Award nominations: Best Actor for The People vs. Larry Flynt (1996), and Best Supporting Actor for The Messenger (2009) and Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri (2017).
extract_id: Woodrow Tracy Harrelson adalah seorang aktor Amerika. Ia pertama kali terkenal berkat perannya sebagai bartender naif yang menawan, Woody Boyd, dalam sitkom NBC Cheers (1985–1993), yang memberinya Primetime Emmy Award untuk Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series dari lima nominasi. Harrelson menerima tiga nominasi Academy Award: Aktor Terbaik untuk The People vs. Larry Flynt (1996), dan Aktor Pendukung Terbaik untuk The Messenger (2009) dan Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri (2017).

name: Wotan Wilke Möhring
title: Wotan Wilke Möhring
extract: Wotan Wilke Möhring is a German actor.
extract_id: Wotan Wilke Möhring adalah seorang aktor Jerman.

name: Xavier Dolan
title: Xavier Dolan
extract: Xavier Dolan-Tadros is a Canadian filmmaker and actor. He began his career as a child actor in commercials before directing several arthouse feature films. He first received international acclaim in 2009 for his feature film directorial debut, I Killed My Mother, which he also starred in, wrote, and produced, and which premiered at the 62nd Cannes Film Festival in the Directors' Fortnight section and won three awards from the program.
extract_id: Xavier Dolan-Tadros adalah pembuat film dan aktor asal Kanada. Ia memulai kariernya sebagai aktor cilik dalam iklan sebelum menyutradarai beberapa film arthouse. Ia pertama kali mendapat pengakuan internasional pada tahun 2009 dengan debutnya sebagai sutradara film fitur, I Killed My Mother, yang juga dibintanginya, ditulis dan diproduksi olehnya, serta diputar perdana di Festival Film Cannes ke-62 dalam bagian Directors' Fortnight dan memenangkan tiga penghargaan dari program tersebut.

name: Yalitza Aparicio
title: Yalitza Aparicio
extract: Yalitza Aparicio Martínez is a Mexican actress. She made her film debut as Cleo in Alfonso Cuarón's 2018 drama Roma, which earned her a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Actress; Aparicio was the first Indigenous Mexican woman to be nominated for that award. In 2019, Time magazine named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world. She was also named the UNESCO Goodwill Ambassador for Indigenous Peoples in the same year.
extract_id: Yalitza Aparicio Martínez adalah seorang aktris Meksiko. Ia memulai debut filmnya sebagai Cleo dalam drama Alfonso Cuarón Roma (2018), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Academy Award untuk Aktris Terbaik; Aparicio adalah wanita Pribumi Meksiko pertama yang dinominasikan untuk penghargaan tersebut. Pada 2019, majalah Time menobatkannya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia. Ia juga diangkat sebagai Duta Besar Goodwill UNESCO untuk Orang Pribumi pada tahun yang sama.

name: Yami Gautam
title: Yami Gautam
extract: Yami Gautam Dhar is an Indian actress who primarily works in Hindi films. Gautam's accolades include a National Film Award, two Screen Awards and a Zee Cine Award, alongside three Filmfare Awards nominations.
extract_id: Yami Gautam Dhar adalah seorang aktris India yang terutama berkarier di film Hindi. Penghargaan Gautam termasuk National Film Award, dua Screen Awards, dan Zee Cine Award, serta tiga nominasi Filmfare Awards.

name: Yann Samuell
title: Yann Samuell
extract: Yann Samuell is a French film director and screenwriter.
extract_id: Yann Samuell adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film asal Prancis.

name: Yash
title: Yash (actor)
extract: Yash is an Indian actor and producer who works in Kannada films. Known for his work in mass hero films, he is referred to as "Rocking Star" in the media. One of the highest-paid actors of Kannada cinema, Yash is a recipient of several accolades including three Filmfare Awards South and five SIIMA Awards.
extract_id: Yash adalah aktor dan produser India yang berkarier di film Kannada. Dikenal karena karyanya di film-film pahlawan masa, ia disebut sebagai "Rocking Star" di media. Salah satu aktor dengan bayaran tertinggi di sinema Kannada, Yash menerima berbagai penghargaan termasuk tiga Filmfare Awards South dan lima SIIMA Awards.

name: Yash Chopra
title: Yash Chopra
extract: Yash Raj Chopra was an Indian film director and film producer who worked in Hindi cinema. The founding chairman of the film production and distribution company Yash Raj Films, Chopra was the recipient of several awards, including 6 National Film Awards and 8 Filmfare Awards. He is considered among the best Hindi filmmakers, particularly known and admired for his romantic films with strong female leads. For his contributions to film, the Government of India honoured him with the Dadasaheb Phalke Award in 2001, and the Padma Bhushan in 2005. In 2006, the British Academy of Film and Television Arts presented him with a lifetime membership, making him the first Indian to receive the honour.
extract_id: Yash Raj Chopra adalah sutradara dan produser film India yang berkarya di sinema Hindi. Pendiri dan ketua perusahaan produksi serta distribusi film Yash Raj Films, Chopra menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk 6 National Film Awards dan 8 Filmfare Awards. Ia dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film Hindi terbaik, khususnya dikenal dan dikagumi atas film romantisnya dengan pemeran wanita utama yang kuat. Atas kontribusinya pada dunia film, Pemerintah India menganugerahinya Dadasaheb Phalke Award pada 2001, dan Padma Bhushan pada 2005. Pada 2006, British Academy of Film and Television Arts memberinya keanggotaan seumur hidup, menjadikannya orang India pertama yang menerima kehormatan tersebut.

name: Yasujirô Ozu
title: Yasujirō Ozu
extract: Yasujirō Ozu was a Japanese filmmaker. He began his career during the era of silent films, and his last films were made in colour in the early 1960s. Ozu first made a number of short comedies, before turning to more serious themes in the 1930s. The most prominent themes of Ozu's work are family and marriage, and especially the relationships between generations. His most widely beloved films include Late Spring (1949), Tokyo Story (1953) and An Autumn Afternoon (1962).
extract_id: Yasujirō Ozu adalah pembuat film Jepang. Ia memulai kariernya di era film bisu, dan film-film terakhirnya dibuat berwarna pada awal 1960-an. Ozu pertama-tama membuat sejumlah komedi pendek, sebelum beralih ke tema yang lebih serius pada 1930-an. Tema utama karya Ozu adalah keluarga dan pernikahan, terutama hubungan antar-generasi. Film-filmnya yang paling dicintai meliputi Late Spring (1949), Tokyo Story (1953) dan An Autumn Afternoon (1962).

name: Yasuo Yamada
title: Yasuo Yamada
extract: Yasuo Yamada was a Japanese actor, voice actor and narrator.
extract_id: Yasuo Yamada adalah aktor, pengisi suara, dan narator Jepang.

name: Yavuz Turgul
title: Yavuz Turgul
extract: Yavuz Turgul is a Turkish film director and screenwriter, known for classic films of Şener Şen.
extract_id: Yavuz Turgul adalah sutradara dan penulis skenario film Turki, dikenal untuk film klasik karya Şener Şen.

name: Yayan Ruhian
title: Yayan Ruhian
extract: Yayan Ruhian is an Indonesian martial artist and actor. He is known for co-starring in Gareth Evans' films The Raid (2011) as Mad Dog, The Raid 2 (2014) as Prakoso, Star Wars: The Force Awakens (2015) as Tasu Leech, and Beyond Skyline (2017) as the police chief. He reprised this role in Skylines (2020).
extract_id: Yayan Ruhian adalah seorang ahli bela diri dan aktor Indonesia. Ia dikenal karena bermain bersama dalam film-film Gareth Evans seperti The Raid (2011) sebagai Mad Dog, The Raid 2 (2014) sebagai Prakoso, Star Wars: The Force Awakens (2015) sebagai Tasu Leech, dan Beyond Skyline (2017) sebagai kepala polisi. Ia mengulangi peran ini dalam Skylines (2020).

name: Yesim Salkim
title: Yeşim Salkım
extract: Yeşim Salkım is a Turkish singer and actress. Her paternal family is of Albanian descent.
extract_id: Yeşim Salkım adalah penyanyi dan aktris Turki. Keluarga ayahnya keturunan Albania.

name: Yilmaz Erdogan
title: Yılmaz Erdoğan
extract: Yılmaz Erdoğan is a Turkish filmmaker, actor and poet who is most famous for his box-office record-breaking debut comedy film Vizontele (2001) and the television series Bir Demet Tiyatro (1995–2002/2006–2007). He founded BKM Theatre and Film Production. He was awarded the Best Supporting Actor at 4th Australian Academy of Cinema and Television Arts Awards for his performance in The Water Diviner (2014).
extract_id: Yılmaz Erdoğan adalah pembuat film, aktor, dan penyair Turki yang paling terkenal untuk film komedi debutnya yang memecahkan rekor box-office, Vizontele (2001), dan serial televisi Bir Demet Tiyatro (1995–2002/2006–2007). Ia mendirikan BKM Theatre and Film Production. Ia dianugerahi Best Supporting Actor pada Australian Academy of Cinema and Television Arts Awards ke-4 untuk penampilannya dalam The Water Diviner (2014).

name: Yimou Zhang
title: Zhang Yimou
extract: Zhang Yimou is a Chinese filmmaker. A leading figure of China's Fifth Generation directors, he is considered as one of the most successful filmmakers in the world.
extract_id: Zhang Yimou adalah pembuat film Tiongkok. Sebagai sosok utama di antara sutradara Generasi Kelima Cina, ia dianggap sebagai salah satu pembuat film paling sukses di dunia.

name: Yoko Honna
title: Yōko Honna
extract: Yōko Honna is a Japanese actress, voice actress and singer from Sōka, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. She works at Re-Max, although she formerly worked at 81 Produce.
extract_id: Yōko Honna adalah seorang aktris, pengisi suara, dan penyanyi asal Jepang dari Sōka, Prefektur Saitama, Jepang. Dia bekerja di Re-Max, meskipun sebelumnya dia bekerja di 81 Produce.

name: Yoo Ji-Tae
title: Yoo Ji-tae
extract: Yoo Ji-tae is a South Korean actor. After a stint as a fashion model, Yoo launched his acting career in 1998 then rose to fame through the films Attack the Gas Station (1999) and Ditto (2000). In the succeeding years, he gained acting recognition by working with acclaimed directors such as Hur Jin-ho in One Fine Spring Day (2001), Park Chan-wook in Oldboy (2003), and Hong Sang-soo in Woman is the Future of Man (2004). Yoo began directing short films in 2003, which were well received in the film festival circuit. His feature directorial debut Mai Ratima was released in 2012.
extract_id: Yoo Ji-tae adalah aktor Korea Selatan. Setelah berkarir sebagai model fesyen, Yoo memulai karir aktingnya pada tahun 1998 dan kemudian meraih ketenaran melalui film Attack the Gas Station (1999) dan Ditto (2000). Dalam beberapa tahun berikutnya, dia mendapatkan pengakuan akting dengan bekerja bersama sutradara ternama seperti Hur Jin-ho dalam One Fine Spring Day (2001), Park Chan-wook dalam Oldboy (2003), dan Hong Sang-soo dalam Woman is the Future of Man (2004). Yoo mulai menyutradarai film pendek pada tahun 2003, yang mendapat sambutan baik di berbagai festival film. Debut penyutradaraan film fitur-nya Mai Ratima dirilis pada tahun 2012.

name: Yoshiaki Kawajiri
title: Yoshiaki Kawajiri
extract: Yoshiaki Kawajiri is a Japanese writer, director, storyboard artist and animator. A co-founder of the anime studio Madhouse, he is best known as the director of Wicked City, Ninja Scroll, and Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust.
extract_id: Yoshiaki Kawajiri adalah seorang penulis, sutradara, seniman storyboard dan animator Jepang. Sebagai salah satu pendiri studio anime Madhouse, dia paling dikenal sebagai sutradara Wicked City, Ninja Scroll, dan Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust.

name: Yoshifumi Kondô
title: Yoshifumi Kondō
extract: Yoshifumi Kondō was a Japanese animator who worked for Studio Ghibli in his last years. He was born in Gosen, Niigata Prefecture, Japan. He worked as an animation director on Anne of Green Gables, Sherlock Hound, Kiki's Delivery Service, Only Yesterday and Princess Mononoke. Kondō directed the animated film Whisper of the Heart, and was expected to become one of the top directors at Studio Ghibli, alongside Hayao Miyazaki and Isao Takahata, and to become their eventual successor.
extract_id: Yoshifumi Kondō adalah seorang animator Jepang yang bekerja untuk Studio Ghibli di tahun-tahun terakhirnya. Dia lahir di Gosen, Prefektur Niigata, Jepang. Dia bekerja sebagai sutradara animasi pada Anne of Green Gables, Sherlock Hound, Kiki's Delivery Service, Only Yesterday, dan Princess Mononoke. Kondō menyutradarai film animasi Whisper of the Heart, dan diharapkan menjadi salah satu sutradara utama di Studio Ghibli bersama Hayao Miyazaki dan Isao Takahata, serta menjadi penerus mereka kelak.

name: Yoshino Kimura
title: Yoshino Kimura
extract: Yoshino Kimura is a British-born Japanese actress and singer. She appeared on an episode of the Showtime series Masters of Horror. She is known for her starring roles as Chika in the drama film Lost Paradise (1997) and as Shizuka in the action western film Sukiyaki Western Django (2007).
extract_id: Yoshino Kimura adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Jepang kelahiran Inggris. Dia tampil dalam sebuah episode serial Showtime Masters of Horror. Dia dikenal karena peran utamanya sebagai Chika dalam film drama Lost Paradise (1997) dan sebagai Shizuka dalam film aksi western Sukiyaki Western Django (2007).

name: You Ge
title: Ge You
extract: Ge You is a Chinese actor. One of the most critically acclaimed performers in China, Ge is known for his signature bald head, comic timing, and intelligent, subtle acting. Ge became the first Asian actor to win the Cannes Best Actor Award for his role in Zhang Yimou's To Live (1994). He is also known for TV sitcoms Stories From The Editorial Board (1992) and I Love My Family (1994); films After Separation (1993), Farewell, My Concubine (1993), The Emperor’s Shadow (1996), The Dream Factory (1997), Big Shot's Funeral (2001), Cell Phone (2003), A World Without Thieves (2004), The Banquet (2006), Sacrifice (2010), and the film series If You Are the One (2008–2023).
extract_id: Ge You adalah aktor Tiongkok. Salah satu pemeran yang paling diakui secara kritis di Tiongkok, Ge dikenal dengan kepala botaknya yang khas, timing komedi, dan akting yang cerdas serta halus. Ge menjadi aktor Asia pertama yang memenangkan Penghargaan Aktor Terbaik Cannes untuk perannya dalam film To Live karya Zhang Yimou (1994). Dia juga dikenal dari serial TV sitcom Stories From The Editorial Board (1992) dan I Love My Family (1994); film After Separation (1993), Farewell, My Concubine (1993), The Emperor’s Shadow (1996), The Dream Factory (1997), Big Shot's Funeral (2001), Cell Phone (2003), A World Without Thieves (2004), The Banquet (2006), Sacrifice (2010), dan serial film If You Are the One (2008–2023).

name: Yukiko Shimazaki
title: Yukiko Shimazaki
extract: Yukiko Shimazaki was a Japanese actress and singer. She appeared in more than twenty films from 1950 to 1964. She was married to film director Tatsumi Kumashiro from 1955 to 1967. She died in 2014.
extract_id: Yukiko Shimazaki adalah seorang aktris dan penyanyi Jepang. Dia muncul dalam lebih dari dua puluh film dari tahun 1950 hingga 1964. Dia menikah dengan sutradara film Tatsumi Kumashiro dari tahun 1955 hingga 1967. Dia meninggal dunia pada tahun 2014.

name: Yul Brynner
title: Yul Brynner
extract: Yuliy Borisovich Briner, known professionally as Yul Brynner, was a Russian and American actor. He was known for his portrayal of King Mongkut in the Rodgers and Hammerstein stage musical The King and I (1951), for which he won two Tony Awards, and later an Academy Award for Best Actor for the 1956 film adaptation. He played the role 4,625 times on stage, and became known for his shaved head, which he maintained as a personal trademark long after adopting it for The King and I.
extract_id: Yuliy Borisovich Briner, yang dikenal secara profesional sebagai Yul Brynner, adalah aktor berkebangsaan Rusia dan Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Raja Mongkut dalam musikal panggung Rodgers dan Hammerstein The King and I (1951), yang memberinya dua Tony Awards, dan kemudian meraih Academy Award untuk Aktor Terbaik untuk adaptasi film tahun 1956. Dia memainkan peran tersebut sebanyak 4.625 kali di panggung, dan dikenal dengan kepala plontos yang kemudian menjadi ciri khas pribadinya setelah mengadopsinya untuk The King and I.

name: Yun-Fat Chow
title: Chow Yun-fat
extract: Chow Yun-fat, previously known as Donald Chow, is a Hong Kong actor and filmmaker. In a film career spanning more than forty-five years, Chow has appeared in over 100 television drama series and films. Known for his versatility, encompassing action and melodrama, comedy and historical drama, his accolades include three Hong Kong Film Awards for Best Actor and two Golden Horse Awards for Best Actor.
extract_id: Chow Yun-fat, sebelumnya dikenal sebagai Donald Chow, adalah seorang aktor dan pembuat film Hong Kong. Dalam karir film yang berlangsung lebih dari empat puluh lima tahun, Chow telah tampil dalam lebih dari 100 serial drama televisi dan film. Dikenal karena fleksibilitasnya, mencakup aksi dan melodrama, komedi dan drama sejarah, penghargaan yang diterimanya termasuk tiga Hong Kong Film Awards untuk Aktor Terbaik dan dua Golden Horse Awards untuk Aktor Terbaik.

name: Yuriko Ishida
title: Yuriko Ishida
extract: Yuriko Ishida is a Japanese actress and essayist from Nagoya. She was the Japanese voice of the title character San from the 1997 animated film Princess Mononoke. She is the older sister of Hikari Ishida, also an actress.
extract_id: Yuriko Ishida adalah seorang aktris dan penulis esai Jepang dari Nagoya. Dia adalah pengisi suara karakter utama San dalam film animasi Princess Mononoke tahun 1997. Dia adalah kakak perempuan Hikari Ishida, yang juga seorang aktris.

name: Yves Montand
title: Yves Montand
extract: Ivo Livi, better known as Yves Montand, was an Italian-born French actor and singer. Montand has been described as one of France's greatest 20th-century artists.
extract_id: Ivo Livi, yang lebih dikenal sebagai Yves Montand, adalah seorang aktor dan penyanyi Prancis asal Italia. Montand digambarkan sebagai salah satu artis terbesar Prancis pada abad ke-20.

name: Yvonne Furneaux
title: Yvonne Furneaux
extract: Yvonne Furneaux was a British-French actress. A graduate of the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art, she worked with notable filmmakers like Peter Brook, Federico Fellini, Roman Polanski, Michelangelo Antonioni, and Claude Chabrol, as well as in several genre productions.
extract_id: Yvonne Furneaux adalah seorang aktris Inggris-Prancis. Lulusan Royal Academy of Dramatic Art, dia bekerja dengan pembuat film ternama seperti Peter Brook, Federico Fellini, Roman Polanski, Michelangelo Antonioni, dan Claude Chabrol, serta dalam beberapa produksi genre.

name: Yôji Matsuda
title: Yōji Matsuda
extract: Yōji Matsuda is a Japanese actor and voice actor from Tokyo, Japan.
extract_id: Yōji Matsuda adalah aktor dan pengisi suara Jepang asal Tokyo, Jepang.

name: Yôjirô Takita
title: Yōjirō Takita
extract: Yōjirō Takita is a Japanese filmmaker. Takita received an Oscar for Best Foreign Language Film for his 2008 drama Departures. It marked the first time a Japanese film won the award after the category first became competitive in 1957.
extract_id: Yōjirō Takita adalah pembuat film Jepang. Takita menerima Oscar untuk Film Berbahasa Asing Terbaik atas drama tahun 2008 Departures. Ini menandai pertama kalinya sebuah film Jepang memenangkan penghargaan setelah kategori tersebut menjadi kompetitif pada tahun 1957.

name: Yôko Tsukasa
title: Yoko Tsukasa
extract: Yōko Tsukasa is a Japanese actress. During her sixty-year career, she worked with directors such as Yasujirō Ozu, Mikio Naruse and Akira Kurosawa. For her role in The Kii River (1966) she was awarded the Blue Ribbon Award, Mainichi Film Award and Kinema Junpo Award for Best Actress.
extract_id: Yōko Tsukasa adalah aktris Jepang. Selama karirnya yang berlangsung enam puluh tahun, dia bekerja dengan sutradara seperti Yasujirō Ozu, Mikio Naruse dan Akira Kurosawa. Untuk perannya dalam The Kii River (1966), dia dianugerahi Blue Ribbon Award, Mainichi Film Award dan Kinema Junpo Award untuk Aktris Terbaik.

name: Yû Kashii
title: Yuu Kashii
extract: Yūko Odagiri , known by her stage name Yuu Kashii , is a Japanese actress and model. She studied at Mejiro University, where she majored in English.
extract_id: Yūko Odagiri, yang dikenal dengan nama panggungnya Yuu Kashii, adalah aktris dan model Jepang. Dia belajar di Universitas Mejiro, tempat dia mengambil jurusan bahasa Inggris.

name: Yûko Miyamura
title: Yūko Miyamura
extract: Yūko Miyamura , also known by her nickname Miyamū (みやむー), is a Japanese actress, voice actress, singer and sound director. She played Kazuha Toyama in Detective Conan, Casca in Berserk and Asuka Langley Soryu in Neon Genesis Evangelion.
extract_id: Yūko Miyamura, juga dikenal dengan julukan Miyamū (みやむー), adalah aktris, pengisi suara, penyanyi, dan sutradara suara Jepang. Dia memerankan Kazuha Toyama dalam Detective Conan, Casca dalam Berserk, dan Asuka Langley Soryu dalam Neon Genesis Evangelion.

name: Yûko Tanaka
title: Yūko Tanaka
extract: Yūko Tanaka is a Japanese actress from Osaka Prefecture, Japan. She has won several acting awards during a long career working in both film and television, after she graduated from Meiji University.
extract_id: Yūko Tanaka adalah seorang aktris Jepang dari Prefektur Osaka, Jepang. Dia telah memenangkan beberapa penghargaan akting selama karir panjangnya bekerja di film dan televisi, setelah dia lulus dari Universitas Meiji.

name: Yûnosuke Itô
title: Yūnosuke Itō
extract: Yūnosuke Itō was a Japanese film actor. He appeared in more than ninety films from 1947 to 1979.
extract_id: Yūnosuke Itō adalah seorang aktor film Jepang. Dia tampil dalam lebih dari sembilan puluh film dari 1947 hingga 1979.

name: Zach Galifianakis
title: Zach Galifianakis
extract: Zachary Knight Galifianakis is an American comedian, actor and writer. From 2009 to 2013, Galifianakis played Alan in The Hangover trilogy. On television, he starred in the FX series Baskets (2016–2019), for which he was nominated for the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Comedy Series in 2017. He also hosted the Funny or Die talk show Between Two Ferns with Zach Galifianakis (2008–2018) and starred in the HBO series Bored to Death (2009–2011).
extract_id: Zachary Knight Galifianakis adalah komedian, aktor, dan penulis Amerika. Dari 2009 hingga 2013, Galifianakis memerankan Alan dalam trilogi The Hangover. Di televisi, dia membintangi serial FX Baskets (2016–2019), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Primetime Emmy Award untuk Aktor Utama Terbaik dalam Seri Komedi pada tahun 2017. Dia juga menjadi pembawa acara talk show Funny or Die Between Two Ferns with Zach Galifianakis (2008–2018) dan membintangi serial HBO Bored to Death (2009–2011).

name: Zach Grenier
title: Zach Grenier
extract: Zach Grenier is an American actor. He is known for his work with director David Fincher, and his roles as Andy Cramed on the television series Deadwood (2004–06) and David Lee on The Good Wife (2010–16) and its spinoff The Good Fight (2020–22). He has starred in various Broadway and Off-Broadway plays, and was nominated for a Tony Award for Best Featured Actor in a Play for 33 Variations.
extract_id: Zach Grenier adalah aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena karyanya dengan sutradara David Fincher, dan perannya sebagai Andy Cramed dalam serial televisi Deadwood (2004–06) dan David Lee dalam The Good Wife (2010–16) serta spin-off-nya The Good Fight (2020–22). Dia telah membintangi berbagai drama Broadway dan Off-Broadway, dan dinominasikan untuk Tony Award untuk Aktor Pendukung Terbaik dalam Drama untuk 33 Variations.

name: Zachary Levi
title: Zachary Levi
extract: Zachary Levi Pugh is an American actor. He starred as Kipp Steadman in the sitcom Less Than Perfect (2002–2006), Chuck Bartowski in the action comedy series Chuck (2007–2012), and as the title character in the superhero film Shazam! (2019) and its 2023 sequel.
extract_id: Zachary Levi Pugh adalah aktor Amerika. Dia membintangi sebagai Kipp Steadman dalam sitkom Less Than Perfect (2002–2006), Chuck Bartowski dalam serial aksi komedi Chuck (2007–2012), dan sebagai karakter utama dalam film superhero Shazam! (2019) serta sekuelnya tahun 2023.

name: Zachary Quinto
title: Zachary Quinto
extract: Zachary John Quinto is an American actor. He is known for his roles as Sylar, the primary antagonist from the science fiction drama series Heroes (2006–2010); Spock in the film Star Trek (2009) and its sequels Star Trek Into Darkness (2013) and Star Trek Beyond (2016); Charlie Manx in the AMC series NOS4A2, and Dr. Oliver Thredson in American Horror Story: Asylum, for which he received a nomination for a Primetime Emmy Award.
extract_id: Zachary John Quinto adalah aktor Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Sylar, antagonis utama dalam serial drama fiksi ilmiah Heroes (2006–2010); Spock dalam film Star Trek (2009) dan sekuelnya Star Trek Into Darkness (2013) dan Star Trek Beyond (2016); Charlie Manx dalam serial AMC NOS4A2, dan Dr. Oliver Thredson dalam American Horror Story: Asylum, yang membuatnya menerima nominasi Primetime Emmy Award.

name: Zack Gottsagen
title: Zack Gottsagen
description: American actor, musician and baseball player
extract: Zachary Robin Gottsagen is an American actor and rapper. He was born with Down Syndrome. He had a breakout role for the film The Peanut Butter Falcon.
extract_id: Zachary Robin Gottsagen adalah aktor dan rapper Amerika. Dia lahir dengan Sindrom Down. Dia mendapatkan peran terobosan dalam film The Peanut Butter Falcon.

name: Zack Snyder
title: Zack Snyder
extract: Zachary Edward Snyder is an American filmmaker. After starting his career primarily directing music videos, he made his feature film debut in 2004 with Dawn of the Dead, a remake of the 1978 horror film of the same name. Since then, he has directed or produced a number of comic book and superhero films, including 300 (2006) and Watchmen (2009), as well as the Superman film that started the DC Extended Universe, Man of Steel (2013), and its follow-ups, Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice (2016) and Justice League (2017), the latter of which had a director's cut released in 2021.
extract_id: Zachary Edward Snyder adalah pembuat film Amerika. Setelah memulai karirnya terutama mengarahkan video musik, dia membuat debut film fitur pada tahun 2004 dengan Dawn of the Dead, sebuah remake dari film horor tahun 1978 dengan nama yang sama. Sejak itu, dia telah menyutradarai atau memproduseri sejumlah film buku komik dan superhero, termasuk 300 (2006) dan Watchmen (2009), serta film Superman yang memulai DC Extended Universe, Man of Steel (2013), dan sekuelnya, Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice (2016) dan Justice League (2017), yang versi director's cut-nya dirilis pada tahun 2021.

name: Zain Al Rafeea
title: Zain Al Rafeea
extract: Zain Al Rafeea is a Syrian actor living in Norway. He is best known for his starring role in the 2018 Lebanese film Capernaum, which won the Jury Prize at the 2018 Cannes Film Festival.
extract_id: Zain Al Rafeea adalah aktor Suriah yang tinggal di Norwegia. Ia dikenal luas karena peran utamanya dalam film Lebanon tahun 2018, Capernaum, yang memenangkan Jury Prize di Festival Film Cannes 2018.

name: Zaza Urushadze
title: Zaza Urushadze
extract: Zaza Urushadze was a Georgian film director, screenwriter and producer.
extract_id: Zaza Urushadze adalah sutradara film Georgia, penulis skenario, dan produser.

name: Zazie Beetz
title: Zazie Beetz
