extract: Zazie Olivia Beetz is a German-American actress. She is known for her role as Van in the FX comedy-drama series Atlanta (2016–2022), for which she received a nomination for the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Comedy Series. She starred in the Netflix anthology series Easy (2016–2019) and has voiced Amber Bennett in the adult animated superhero series Invincible since 2021. On film, she is known for her roles as Domino in the superhero film Deadpool 2 and Arthur Fleck's neighbor in the psychological thriller Joker (2019) and its sequel Joker: Folie à Deux (2024).
extract_id: Zazie Olivia Beetz adalah aktris Jerman-Amerika. Dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Van dalam serial komedi-drama FX Atlanta (2016–2022), yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Primetime Emmy Award untuk Aktris Pendukung Terbaik dalam Seri Komedi. Dia membintangi serial antologi Netflix Easy (2016–2019) dan mengisi suara Amber Bennett dalam serial animasi superhero dewasa Invincible sejak 2021. Di film, dia dikenal karena perannya sebagai Domino dalam film superhero Deadpool 2 dan tetangga Arthur Fleck dalam thriller psikologis Joker (2019) serta sekuelnya Joker: Folie à Deux (2024).

name: Zbigniew Zamachowski
title: Zbigniew Zamachowski
extract: Zbigniew Zamachowski is a Polish actor. He is a two-time recipient of the Polish Academy Award for Best Actor.
extract_id: Zbigniew Zamachowski adalah aktor Polandia. Dia adalah penerima dua kali Penghargaan Akademi Polandia untuk Aktor Terbaik.

name: Zeppo Marx
title: Zeppo Marx
extract: Herbert Manfred "Zeppo" Marx was an American comedic actor and businessman. He was the youngest, and last survivor, of the five Marx Brothers. He appeared with his brothers on Broadway during the 1920s and in the first five Marx Brothers feature films from 1929 to 1933, usually performing in a more subdued style than his brothers and serving as a romantic lead and/or straight man. After Duck Soup (1933), he abandoned acting for subsequent careers as an engineer and theatrical agent.
extract_id: Herbert Manfred "Zeppo" Marx adalah aktor komedi dan pengusaha Amerika. Dia adalah yang termuda, dan yang terakhir bertahan, dari lima Marx Brothers. Dia tampil bersama saudara-saudaranya di Broadway selama tahun 1920-an dan dalam lima film fitur pertama Marx Brothers dari 1929 hingga 1933, biasanya bermain dengan gaya yang lebih tenang daripada saudara-saudaranya dan berperan sebagai pemeran utama romantis dan/atau straight man. Setelah Duck Soup (1933), dia meninggalkan dunia akting untuk menjalani karier sebagai insinyur dan agen teater.

name: Ziyi Zhang
title: Zhang Ziyi
extract: Zhang Ziyi, sometimes credited as Ziyi Zhang, is a Chinese actress, known for playing independent and strong-willed characters. Born and raised in Beijing, Zhang was admitted to the Central Academy of Drama in 1996. That year, she made her acting debut in the television film Touching Starlight (1996). After her breakout role in Zhang Yimou's The Road Home (1999), which won her Best Actress at the 23rd Hundred Flowers Awards, she gained international fame for her performance in Ang Lee's wuxia film Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon (2000).
extract_id: Zhang Ziyi, kadang-kadang disebut Ziyi Zhang, adalah aktris Cina yang dikenal karena memainkan karakter yang mandiri dan berjiwa kuat. Lahir dan dibesarkan di Beijing, Zhang diterima di Central Academy of Drama pada tahun 1996. Tahun itu, dia memulai debut aktingnya dalam film televisi Touching Starlight (1996). Setelah peran terobosannya dalam film Zhang Yimou The Road Home (1999), yang memberinya Penghargaan Aktris Terbaik pada Penghargaan Bunga Seratus ke-23, ia meraih ketenaran internasional melalui penampilannya dalam film wuxia karya Ang Lee, Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon (2000).

name: Zoe Saldana
title: Zoe Saldaña
extract: Zoë Yadira Saldaña-Perego, known professionally as Zoe Saldaña, is an American actress. The second highest grossing lead actor in history, she is the recipient of many accolades, including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, two Critics Choice Awards, a Golden Globe Award, a SAG Award, and a Cannes Film Festival Award. Time magazine named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2023 and 2026.
extract_id: Zoë Yadira Saldaña-Perego, dikenal secara profesional sebagai Zoe Saldaña, adalah aktris Amerika. Sebagai pemeran utama dengan pendapatan tertinggi kedua dalam sejarah, dia menerima banyak penghargaan, termasuk Academy Award, BAFTA Award, dua Critics Choice Awards, Golden Globe Award, SAG Award, dan Penghargaan Festival Film Cannes. Majalah Time menobatkannya sebagai salah satu dari 100 orang paling berpengaruh di dunia pada tahun 2023 dan 2026.

name: Zooey Deschanel
title: Zooey Deschanel
extract: Zooey Claire Deschanel is an American actress and singer. She made her film debut in Mumford (1999) and had a supporting role in Cameron Crowe's film Almost Famous (2000). Deschanel is known for her deadpan roles in comedy films such as The Good Girl (2002), The New Guy (2002), Elf (2003), The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy (2005), Failure to Launch (2006), Yes Man (2008), 500 Days of Summer (2009), and Our Idiot Brother (2011). She has also ventured into dramatic film territory with Manic (2001), All the Real Girls (2003), Winter Passing (2005), Bridge to Terabithia (2007), The Happening (2008), and The Driftless Area (2015). From 2011 to 2018, she starred as Jessica Day on the Fox sitcom New Girl, for which she received nominations for a Primetime Emmy Award and three Golden Globe Awards.
extract_id: Zooey Claire Deschanel adalah aktris dan penyanyi Amerika. Dia memulai debut filmnya dalam Mumford (1999) dan memiliki peran pendukung dalam film Cameron Crowe Almost Famous (2000). Deschanel dikenal karena perannya yang kaku dalam film komedi seperti The Good Girl (2002), The New Guy (2002), Elf (2003), The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy (2005), Failure to Launch (2006), Yes Man (2008), 500 Days of Summer (2009), dan Our Idiot Brother (2011). Dia juga merambah ke film drama dengan Manic (2001), All the Real Girls (2003), Winter Passing (2005), Bridge to Terabithia (2007), The Happening (2008), dan The Driftless Area (2015). Dari tahun 2011 hingga 2018, dia berperan sebagai Jessica Day dalam sitkom Fox, New Girl, yang membuatnya dinominasikan untuk Primetime Emmy Award dan tiga Golden Globe Awards.

name: Zoya Akhtar
title: Zoya Akhtar
extract: Zoya Akhtar is an Indian director, producer and screenwriter who works in Hindi films and series. Born to Javed Akhtar and Honey Irani, she completed a diploma in filmmaking from NYU and assisted directors Mira Nair, Tony Gerber and Dev Benegal, before becoming a writer and director. She is the recipient of several accolades, including four Filmfare Awards. Akhtar and frequent collaborator Reema Kagti founded the production company Tiger Baby Films in 2015.
extract_id: Zoya Akhtar adalah sutradara, produser, dan penulis skenario India yang bekerja di film dan serial Hindi. Lahir dari Javed Akhtar dan Honey Irani, dia menyelesaikan diploma dalam pembuatan film dari NYU dan membantu sutradara seperti Mira Nair, Tony Gerber, dan Dev Benegal, sebelum menjadi penulis dan sutradara. Dia menerima berbagai penghargaan, termasuk empat Filmfare Awards. Akhtar dan kolaborator sering Reema Kagti mendirikan perusahaan produksi Tiger Baby Films pada tahun 2015.

name: Zoë Kravitz
title: Zoë Kravitz
extract: Zoë Isabella Kravitz is an American actress, singer, and filmmaker. She has received nominations for a Critics' Choice Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, and a Screen Actors Guild Award. In 2022, she was named by Time magazine as one of the 100 Most Influential People.
extract_id: Zoë Isabella Kravitz adalah aktris, penyanyi, dan pembuat film Amerika. Dia telah dinominasikan untuk Critics' Choice Award, Primetime Emmy Award, dan Screen Actors Guild Award. Pada tahun 2022, dia dinobatkan oleh majalah Time sebagai salah satu dari 100 Orang Paling Berpengaruh.

name: Álvaro Guerrero
title: Álvaro Guerrero
extract: Álvaro Guerrero is a Mexican actor, best known for his role as "Daniel" in the 2000 film Amores Perros. He appeared as a Jesuit in the Warner Bros. 1986 drama film The Mission, which marked his first film appearance.
extract_id: Álvaro Guerrero adalah aktor Meksiko, terkenal karena perannya sebagai "Daniel" dalam film Amores Perros tahun 2000. Dia tampil sebagai seorang Jesuit dalam film drama Warner Bros. 1986, The Mission, yang menandai penampilan film pertamanya.

name: Çagan Irmak
title: Çağan Irmak
description: Turkish film and television writer and director (born 1970)
extract: Çağan Irmak is a Turkish film and television writer and director, who has managed to attract a large audience in Turkey and is best known for the TV series Çemberimde Gül Oya (2004–2005) and Asmalı Konak (2002–2004), and for the hit films Alone (2008) and My Father and My Son (2005), for which he received Turkish Cinema Writers Association Awards for Best Film, Best Screenplay and Best Director.
extract_id: Çağan Irmak adalah penulis dan sutradara film serta televisi Turki, yang berhasil menarik banyak penonton di Turki dan dikenal luas karena serial TV Çemberimde Gül Oya (2004–2005) dan Asmalı Konak (2002–2004), serta film hits Alone (2008) dan My Father and My Son (2005), yang memberinya Penghargaan Asosiasi Penulis Film Turki untuk Film Terbaik, Skenario Terbaik, dan Sutradara Terbaik.

name: Çetin Tekindor
title: Çetin Tekindor
extract: Çetin Tekindor is a Turkish theatre, cinema, TV series actor and voice actor.
extract_id: Çetin Tekindor adalah aktor teater, film, serial TV, dan pengisi suara Turki.

name: Ömer Faruk Sorak
title: Ömer Faruk Sorak
extract: Ömer Faruk Sorak is a Turkish film director. He has directed more than ten films since 2000.
extract_id: Ömer Faruk Sorak adalah sutradara film Turki. Dia telah menyutradarai lebih dari sepuluh film sejak tahun 2000.

name: Özge Özberk
title: Özge Özberk
extract: Özge Özberk is a Turkish actress who has acted in many films, television series and plays.
extract_id: Özge Özberk adalah aktris Turki yang telah membintangi banyak film, serial televisi, dan drama panggung.
